śrīḥ

svacchandatantram
śrīmanmahāmāheśvarācāryakṣemarājakṛtodyotākhyavivaraṇopetam



prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ

" svacchandodyotaḥ "


viśvaikarūpaviśvātmaviśvasargādikāraṇam | 

paraprakāśavapuṣaṃ stumaḥ svacchandabhairavam || 

prasaracchaktikallolajagallaharikelaye | 

sarvasampannidhānāya bhairavāmbhodhaye namaḥ || 

ekaiva bodhajaladheḥ śaktiśuktirjayatyasau | 

yadantanīkhilaṃ bhāti muktāmayamidaṃ jagat || 

smṛtimātravinirdhūtaniḥśeṣājñānakilviṣāḥ | 

gurusūktavarasphārā vijayante jagattraye || 

tatsevāvimalavyaktamahāmāheśadarśanaḥ | 

kṣemarājo vivṛṇute śrīsvacchandanayaṃ manāk || 

abhinavabodhādityadyutivikasitahatsarojānme | 

rasayata sarasāḥ parimalamasārasaṃsāravāsanāśāntyai || 

ihānujighṛkṣārasasarasahṛdayaparasaṃvitsammukhīkṛto 
granthamavatārayituṃ kaścid devīśiṣya āha ---- 


kailāsaśikharāsīnaṃ bhairavaṃ vigatāmayam | 

caṇḍanandimahākālagaṇeśavṛṣabhṛṅgibhiḥ || 1-1 || 

kumārendrayamādityabrahmaviṣṇupuraḥsaraiḥ | 

stūyamānaṃ maheśānaṃ gaṇamātṛniṣevitam || 1-2 || 

sṛṣṭisaṃhārakarttāraṃ vilayasthitikārakam | 

anugrahakaraṃ devaṃ praṇatātīvināśanam || 1-3 || 

muditaṃ bhairavaṃ dṛṣṭvā devī vacanamabravīt | 


iha parameśvarasya cidānandaghanasya brahmadarśanoktatattvātiśāyinaḥ 
svacchandabhairavasphurattātmā paramārthaḥ, iti bhagavataḥ śāstrasya 
cāsya tadevābhidhānam | tasya 
svātmaikarūpapañcakṛtyakāritvamityāśayena 
śṛṣṭrayādipañcakṛtyakaraṃ devaṃ muditaṃ bhairavaṃ dṛṣṭvā devī 
vacanamabravīt" ityuktam | tatra devaḥ 
śivādikṣityantāśeṣasṛṣṭyādikrīḍāparaḥ, tāvadaśeṣotkarṣatayā 
vijigīṣuḥ, tadabhinnatvāt viśvasya jagadvyavahārarūpatayāpi 
dyotamānaḥ, śivamantramaheśvarādibhiḥ stūyamānaḥ, sarveṣāmagatīnāṃ 
gatiḥ prāpyo'bhinnabodhasāraśca, yathoktaṃ "divu krīḍādau" iti | 

bhairavo viśvabharaṇaravaṇavamanarūpaḥ, bhīrūṇāmabhayamiti vyutpattyā 
saṃsāriṇāmabhayadaḥ, bhayaṃ bhīḥ saṃsāratrāsaḥ, tayā janito ravaḥ 
ākrandaḥ bhīravaḥ tato jātaḥ tadākrandavatāṃ sphurita; asyaiva 
bhīravasya saṃsārabhayavimarśanasyāyaṃ śaktipātavaśenotthāpakaḥ, 
bhāni nakṣatrāṇi īrayati iti bheraḥ kāla; taṃ vāyantīti bheravāḥ 
kālagrāsasamādhirasikāḥ yoginaḥ teṣāmayamiti āntaraḥ svabhāvaḥ, 
bhiye paśujanatrāsāya ravaḥ śabdarāśisamutthākārādikalāvimarśo 
yāsāṃ khecarī-gocarī-dikcarī-bhūcarīcakrarūpāṇāṃ saṃviddevīnāṃ 
tāḥ bhīravāḥ, tāsāmayaṃ svāmī bhairavaḥ tathā bhairavo bhīṣaṇaḥ 
saṃsāravighaṭanaparaḥ, evamāgameṣu niruktatvāt,śrībṛhaspatipādaiḥ 
śivatanāvanvarthavyākhyātasvarūpatvācca | 

ata evāyaṃ mudito nityānandaghanasvātantryaśaktiyukto yaḥ taṃ 
bhairavābhidhānameva, na tu brahmaviṣṇvīśasadāśivaśivarūpam 
teṣāmekādaśapaṭalanirūpitanītyā 
etatsvabhāvābhāvādetadullāsyavilāyyatvādvā | 

ata eva mahāntamīśānaṃ sarveṣāmeṣāṃ svāminam | ata eva ke mūrdhanye 
brahmabile elā sphurantī śaktiḥ tasyāmāsaḥ āsanamuparisthitiryasya, 
vyāpinīsamanātmanaḥ śikharasya sarvādhvoparivatīnaḥ padasya, tat 
kailāsaśikharam, tatrāsīnaṃ taduttīrṇaṃ prakāśaikaghanaṃ 
tadaśeṣavyāptyā ca viśvarūpam | tato vigatāmayam ā samantāt mimīte 
ityāmayaḥ,

śaktirūpā smṛtā māyā yadadhaḥ śaktikuṇḍalī | (10-1263)

iti vakṣyamāṇākhyātirūpā mahāmāyā, tadvirahitam, vigataścāmayo
yato bhajamānānām | bhagavataḥ śaktiprapañcavyāptirūpaiḥ 
tadanugṛhītaireva caṇḍādibhiḥ kumārāntaiḥ, 
tatprapañcasāravyāptirūpasya bhagavata
umāpateḥ vyākhyātabhairavasphārasamāveśāt bhairavarūpasya tannāmnaśca
bhuvanādhvavakṣyamāṇakailāsākhyahimavacchṛṅgāsīnasya 
antaraṅgaparivārarūpairindrādibhiḥ
lokapālaiḥ, yamopalakṣitaiḥ sarvaiḥ saṃhartṛbhī rudrādibhiḥ,
ādityopalakṣitaiḥ sarvaistejomayaiḥ, brahmaviṣṇupalakṣitaiḥ 
sṛṣṭisaṃhārasthitikāribhiḥ sarvaiḥ anantabhaṭṭārakādibhiḥ, 
tatpuraḥsarairanyairapi ca nirapekṣaśaktipātapātrīkṛtaiḥ
stūyamānaṃ kalpitapramātṛtānimajjanāt sarvotkṛṣṭatvena 
parāmṛśyamānam, gaṇena kapālīśādibhairavāṣṭakena 
vakṣyamāṇaparivārarūpeṇa, mātṛbhiḥ bāhmyādidevībhiḥ, gaṇānāṃ 
mātrā prapañcavyāptyā umādevyā 
uktāntaraṅgaparivāramadhyapradhānabhūtayā niṣevyamānaṃ 
tacchaktipātādeva akhyātipraśamanatayā samāviśyamānam, 
sṛṣṭisaṃhārau tācchīlyena kurvāṇam, sṛṣṭisaṃhāraprapañcātmānaṃ 
ca viśiṣṭapratyavāyaphalaṃ vilayaṃ sthitiṃ ca vidadhatam, anugrahaṃ ca 
tācchīlyatācchabdyādisvabhāvatayā kurvantaṃ sadā pañcakṛtyakāriṇam, 
praṇatānāṃ sādhakādīnāṃ yathābhilaṣitasaṃpādanena
ātīvināśanam | 

evaṃ bhūtaṃ devaṃ bhairavaṃ muditaṃ yathoktadevarūpaiva
devī svātantryaśaktiḥ, dṛṣṭvā sākṣātkṛtya, vacanamabravīt 
pūrṇāhantātmanā parāmṛśat | 

tatparāmarśa eva hi akārahakārapratyāhārātmā
garbhīkṛtāśeṣaviśvasamagraśāstraprasaraprathamāṅkurarūpo bhagavān
śabdarāśiḥ | yad vakṣyati ---- 

adṛṣṭavigrahācchāntācchivātparamakāraṇāt | 

dhvanirūpaṃ viniṣkrāntaṃ śāstraṃ paramadurlabham || (8-27)

ityādi | cidātmaiva ca bhagavān bhairavaḥ 
sadāśivādimūtīgrahaṇapūrvaṃ
svādhāraprapañcavyāptipradhānabhūtamumāpatirūpaṃ svasattānupraveśāt
bhairavātmakameva muditamāsthāya tathābhūtāmeva ca 
umābhaṭṭārikāmūtīṃ guruśiṣyabhūmikāgrahaṇena, śāstraṃ 
vacanaprativacanarūpaṃ lokānugrahārthaṃ prathayati | yad vakṣyati ---- 

guruśiṣyapade sthitvā svayaṃ devaḥ sadāśivaḥ | 

pūrvottarapadairvākyaistantramādhārabhedataḥ || (8-31)

iti | evamāntarabāhyakramābhyāṃ śāstrārthasūtraṇāt sūtrabhūtaṃ
sārdhaślokatrayātmakaṃ tantrāvatārakavākyametadvoddhavyam | atra
ca ekavākyametat boddhavyam | devabhairavapadābhyāṃ yathāvyākhyātaṃ
garbhīkṛtamarthaṃ sphuṭīkartuṃ 
kailāsetyādiviśeṣaṇāntarāṇyupāttāni | tathāhi ---- divaḥ
krīḍāvyavahāralakṣaṇārthau śṛṣṭītyādinā, anugrahakaram" ityantena 
prakaṭīkṛtau | tatrādyaiḥ pañcabhiḥ paṭalaiḥ mudrāpaṭalena ca 
etadaṅgabhūtena caturdaśenānugrahaḥ pratipāditaḥ, ekādaśena 
sṛṣṭyādisvarūpamuktam, vijigīṣātmārthaḥ kailāseti 
padenāntarārthapareṇa maheśānapadena cābhivyakto daśamapaṭalena 
nirṇītaḥ, dyotanārtho'nāmayamuditapadābhyāṃ prakāśitaḥ, sa madhye 
madhye ---- 

"tatrastho vyañjayettejaḥ paraṃ paramakāraṇam" (4-397)
ityādau granthe prathitaḥ, stutyarthaḥ "caṇḍetyādinā, niṣevitam"
ityantena sphuṭīkṛtaḥ,

śurāsurāṇāṃ siddhyarthaṃ yajanopāyahetunā | 

 devadevena nidīṣṭa......................... ||"

ityādyuddeśeṣu nirvāhitaḥ, agatīnāṃ gatirityevaṃrūpo yo'rthaḥ
so'pi "praṇatātīvināśanam" ityantena vyaktaḥ 
ṣaṣṭhasaptamāṣṭamanavamadvādaśatrayodaśapañcadaśapaṭalainīṇītaḥ,
evaṃ bhairavapadārtho'pi yojitavyaḥ | tatra hi yathā ravaṇārthaḥ
"abravīt" ityantena vyañjitastantrāvatārapaṭalena pradaśītaḥ,
tathānye'pyarthāḥ yathāyogaṃ devapadatulyārthatayā yojyāḥ | api
ca kailāseti padena dvitīyārthena sthānapūrvakaṃ devabhairavādipadaiḥ
sṛṣṭītyādinā ca avasthāpūrvakaṃ stūyamānam ityantena ca 
stutipūrvakamasya śāstrasyāvataraṇam, ityanenaiva avatārakavākyena 
prakāśitam, muditamityanena praśnayogyāvasarajñatvaṃ śiṣyasya 
prakāśitam | bhairavapadena ca dakṣiṇasrotaḥ samudbhūtatvam asya 
śāstrasya sūcitam, srotobhedaṃ ca navamapaṭale darśayiṣyāmaḥ || 3 || 

kimabravīt ? ityākāṅkṣāyāmāha ---- 


śrīdevyuvāca ---- 


yattvayā kathitaṃ mahyaṃ svacchandaṃ parameśvara || 1-4 || 

śatakoṭipravistīrṇaṃ bhedānantyavisapītam | 

catuṣpīṭhaṃ mahātantraṃ catuṣṭayaphalodayam || 1-5 || 

na śaknuvanti manujā alpavīryaparākramāḥ | 

alpāyuṣo'lpavittāśca alpasattvāśca śaṃkara || 1-6 || 

tadarthaṃ saṃgrahaṃ tasya svalpaśāstrārthavistaram | 

bhuktimuktipradātāraṃ kathayasva prasādataḥ || 1-7 || 


he śaṃkara ! anugrahaikaparatayā śreyaskara ! sva ātmarūpa parameśvara,
yat tvayā mahyaṃ sva evacchanda icchā yasya 
tādṛganargalabhairavarūpābhidhāyitvāt
svacchandaṃ, tantrāvatārapaṭalanirūpayiṣyamāṇadṛśā 
koṭiśatādivistīrṇaṃ koṭarākṣavyādhibhakṣāghoreśvarasvacchandādinā 
bhedānantyena prasāritam, caturṇāṃ vidyāmantramaṇḍalamudrāṇām, 
pīṭham āśrayaṃ saṃbhavamātreṇa | 

mudrā maṇḍalapīṭhaṃ tu mantrapīṭhaṃ tathaiva ca | 

vidyāpīṭhaṃ tathaiveha catuṣpīṭhā tu saṃhitā || iti

tathā ---- 

svacchandabhairavaścaṇḍaḥ krodha unmattabhairavaḥ | 

granthāntarāṇi catvāri mantrapīṭhaṃ varānane || iti

śrīsarvavīre'bhihitatvāt | tatra vidyā svacchandaśivarūpā sphurattā
paramārthamātṛkā, mantrāḥ catuṣkalādyāḥ, maṇḍalaṃ navanābhādi,
mudrāḥ kapālādyanukārāḥ | 

samayi-putraka-sādhaka-ācāryarūpasya catuṣṭayasya 
vakṣyamāṇabhedabhinnasya yatphalaṃ bhogamokṣavitaraṇādirūpaṃ tasyodayo 
yasmāt tādṛśaṃ kathitaṃ tat | 

maraṇajanmadharmakā manuṣyāḥ, alpena vīryeṇotsāhena parākrameṇa 
sāmarthyena ca yuktāḥ, ata eva ca vīrasiddhiṣu aśaktāḥ, alpajīvitatvena 
alpavittatvena ca mahānuṣṭhāneṣu cāsamarthāḥ, alpasattvatayā ca 
mahārthajñānopadeśāśvāsarahitāḥ, na śaknuvanti śrotumadhyetuṃ kiṃ 
punaranuṣṭhātum, tadarthaṃ tasya śāstrasya saṃgrahaṃ saṃkṣepam, alpaḥ 
śāstrārthavistaro yasya tādṛśam, bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca tācchīlyena 
dadatam, prasādena antarnairmalyaprathanātmanā anugraheṇa, kathaya || 7 || 

atha praśnanirṇeyāni vastūni uddiśati ---- 


kīdṛśaṃ vai guruṃ vidyāt sādhakaṃ ca maheśvara | 

bhayābhayapradātāraṃ śiṣyaṃ bhūmiṃ ca kīdṛśīm || 1-8 || 

mantrāṃścaiva samāsena kālaṃ caiva samāsataḥ | 

yajanaṃ havanaṃ caiva adhivāsaṃ rajāṃsi ca || 1-9 || 

pañcagavyaṃ caruṃ caiva dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca maṇḍalam | 

dīkṣā cādhvābhiṣekau ca samayānsādhanāni ca || 1-10 || 

kalimāsādya sidhyanti tathā brūhi maheśvara | 


gurvādi bhūmyantaṃ kīdṛśaṃ vidyāt upādātuṃ hātuṃ jānīyāt | 
mantrādisādhanāntāni pañcadaśa vastūni ca yathā kalau siddhyanti tathā
brūhi | tatra samayinā śrutaśāstreṇa putrakādipadajighṛkṣayā guruḥ
parīkṣyo guruṇaiva vā parīkṣyaḥ, gurvādayaḥ kāryāḥ gurvādayo'tra
yathāprādhānyaṃ krameṇa nidīṣṭāḥ, śiṣyaḥ putrakaḥ samayī ca 
vakṣyamāṇasvarūpaḥ, sadguruḥ gurvādicatuṣṭayarūpasya 
śiṣyavargasyābhayapradaḥ, asadgurustu bhayapradaḥ, sacchiṣyavargaḥ 
asacchiṣyavargaśca svātmana eva abhayaṃ bhayaṃ ca pradadāti, bhayaṃ 
siddhimuktipratyūhāt, tadabhāvādabhayam, 
bhayābhayapradātāramityetalliṅgādipariṇāmena, 
bhūmimantradantakāṣṭhādīnāmapi vakṣyamāṇanītyā yathāyogaṃ yojyam,
bhūmiḥ mantrayāgaprastārasthānam, mantrāḥ 
āsannamūtīsakalaniṣkalādyāḥ, kālaḥ sauraḥ ābhyantaraśca vicitraḥ, 
samāsato yajanahavane sarvadīkṣitasādhāraṇe, dīkṣopayogisarvavastūnāṃ 
yogyatāpādanātmā saṃskāraḥ adhivāsaḥ, rajāṃsi śālicūrṇādīni 
vakṣyamāṇāni navanābhādimaṇḍalopayogīni, 
pāśakṣapaṇaśivapadadānarūpā dīkṣā, bahubhedo'dhvā 
varṇamantrapadakalātattvabhuvanarūpaḥ ṣaḍvidhaḥ, abhiṣekaḥ 
ācāryādīnāṃ yāgānte mantrakalaśāmbhasā secanam,
dīkṣitānāṃ śeṣavattvena niyatavidhiniṣedhāḥ samayāḥ, sādhanāni
sādhakānāṃ siddhyupāyāḥ, nyāsajapājyasaṃskārādi anyat sarvamatraiva
antarbhūtatvāt pṛthaṅ noddiṣṭam || 10 || 

atha praśnanirṇayamupakramamāṇaḥ protsāhanāpramukhaṃ 
śiṣyapravartanāya

prayojanābhidhāyi ādivākyam ---- 


śrībhairava uvāca ---- 


sādhu sādhu mahābhāge yattvayā paricoditam || 1-11 || 

anugrahāya martyānāṃ sāmprataṃ kathayāmi te | 


sādhu sādhu iti vīpsayā avasarapraṣdṛtāṃ janānukampāṃ ca 
ślāghamāna upadeśagrahaṇayogyatāpādanāya śiṣyadhiyamuttejayati devaḥ 
| mahābhāge ityanena anugrahonmukhatvaṃ ślāghitam, tvayā martyānāṃ 
mṛtidharmāṇāṃ sāmānyena sarveṣāṃ na tu niyatānāṃ 
keṣāṃcidadhikāriṇām, anugrahāya bhogamokṣasampattaye, yatprameyajātaṃ 
paripāṭyā coditaṃ pṛṣṭaṃ tatteṣāmanugrahāyaiva | ahaṃ sāmprataṃ 
parabhairavasattānupraveśonmiṣitamahāvikāsāvasare 
bālabāliśavidvajjanādyucitadīkṣāpradarśanādikrameṇa upapannaṃ ca 
kṛtvā te kathayāmi | 

atra ca 
yacchabdaparāmṛṣṭapūrvoddiṣṭaprameyaparipāṭījñānamabhidheyam,
tatprayojanaṃ bhogamokṣātmā anugrahaḥ, tatra copāyopeyabhāvātmā
sambandhaḥ, martyānāmadhikāritvam, parānujighṛkṣonmukhatayā 
nivṛttabhogābhilāṣasya śiṣyasya yogyatvottejanam, 
parabhairavasphārāvamarśonmiṣatpratibhāgāvasaratvena
ātmana āptatāṃ parasambandhasāratāṃ ca navamapaṭale nirṇeṣyamāṇāṃ
sambandhaṣaṭkasya nirūpitavān parameśvaro 
mukhyabhūtaprayojanapratipādanaparo'pi ādivākye || 11 || 

atha yathoddeśaṃ nirṇetumāha ---- 


ādau tāvatparīkṣeta ācāryaṃ śubhalakṣaṇam || 1-12 || 


śubham ---- 

"śivena sahacāritvādācāryastena kītītaḥ" (4-409)

iti ihaiva vakṣyamāṇaṃ śivābhinnasvarūpapratītirūpaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ
yasya tamācāryaṃsādhakādibhiśca ābhimukhyena caraṇīyaṃ sevyam | 
ādāviti śaktipātavaśasaṃprāptaprabuddhasuhṛdvākyāveditasatattvaḥ 
śiṣyaḥ putrakādidīkṣāṃ jighṛkṣuḥ śrutasaṃhitāśāstraḥ samayī, 
yadvā gurureva śiṣyamācāryīkartuṃ pūrvaṃ parīkṣeta, 
yadbhaviṣyati ---- 

"śrutaśīlasamācārān daiśikatve niyojayet |" (4-454) iti 

tāvacchabdenedaṃ dhvanati ---- 

śarvalakṣaṇahīno'pi jñānavān gururuttamaḥ |"

iti nītyā uktapratītirūpataiva asya śubhalakṣaṇam, 

"ahameva paro haṃsaḥ śivaḥ" (4-399)

iti vakṣyamāṇanītyā tasyā eva mocakatvāt dīkṣākriyāyā api 
śivābhedavyāptisāratvasya darśayiṣyamāṇatvāt || 12 || 

āryadeśajatvādi upacayahetuḥ śiṣyāṇāṃ siddhyaṅgam, ata evaitat
paścānnidīśati ---- 


āryadeśasamutpannaṃ sarvāvayavabhūṣitam | 

śivaśāstravidhānajñaṃ jñānajñeyaviśāradam || 1-13 || 

devakarmarataṃ śāntaṃ satyavādidraḍhavratam | 

sattvavadvīryasampannaṃ dayādākṣiṇyasaṃyutam || 1-14 || 

tyāginaṃ dambhanirmuktaṃ śivaśāstreṣu bhāvitam | 

īdṛśaṃ tu guruṃ prāpya siddhimukti na dūrataḥ || 1-15 || 


pravibhaktacāturvarṇyaḥ āryadeśaḥ | yadāha viṣṇuḥ ---- 

"cāturvarṇyavyavasthānaṃ yasmin deśe na vidyate | 

sa mlecchadeśo vijñeya āryāvartastvataḥ paraḥ ||" iti 

vidhānaṃ dīkṣādi, jñāne śivaśāstre, jñeye ca paramaśivatattve,
tattadadhvavavyāptyādau viśāradaṃ nirmalam, śāntaṃ jitendriyaḥ,
satyavādī cāsau dṛḍhavrataḥ abhyupagatanirvāhakaḥ, sattvavān
niṣkampaśca asau vīryeṇa paramudrāparamārthena sampannaḥ pūrṇaḥ,
dayā saṃsāriṇaḥ prati anujighṛkṣā, dākṣiṇyam amātsaryamānukūlyam,
tyāginaṃ tṛṇavadvittaṃ manyamānam, dambhanirmuktam avakravyavahāram,
śivaśāstreṣu bhāvitam aśeṣavidyābhijñatve'pi śivaśāstreṣveva
viśrāntāśvāsam, īdṛśamiti samanantaroktaśivābhinnasvapratītisāram,
gurum upadeṣṭāram, prāpya kāraṇabhūtamāsādya, siddhimuktī kartryau
na dūrataḥ jhaṭityeva bhavata ityarthaḥ | vyākhyātarūpaṃ 
śubhalakṣaṇatvaṃ mukterāryadeśodbhūtatvādi ca siddhihetuḥ śiṣyasya, 
ityuktaprāyam || 15 || 

evamabhayapradaṃ gurusatattvamuktavā viparyayamāha ---- 


krodhanaścapalaḥ kṣudro dayādākṣiṇyavajītaḥ | 

kekaro danturaḥ kāṇaḥ pāpiṣṭhaḥ śāstravajītaḥ || 1-16 || 

atidīrghastathā hrasvaḥ kṛśaḥ sthūla kṣayānvitaḥ | 

tākīko dambhasaṃyuktaḥ satyaśaucavivajītaḥ || 1-17 || 

anyaśāstrarato yastu nāsau muktiphalapradaḥ | 


krodhanaḥ krodhamayaḥ, capalo duśīlaḥ kāryeṣvaruḍhaśca, kṣudraḥ
kṣudrasiddhisādhanaparaḥ, kekaro lolatārakadṛṣṭiḥ, kṣayānvito
yakṣmākrāntaḥ, tākīkaḥ kutarkaśāstraikaniṣṭhaḥ, ūhātmakastu 
tarkaḥ śrīpūrvaśāstre śasta eva, yathoktam ----  
"tarko yogāṅgamuttamam | " (17-18) iti,

śaucavajītaḥ, arthaśuddhyādiśūnyaḥ, spaṣṭamanyat | evamīdṛśo guruḥ
sādhakāya phalaṃ siddhilakṣaṇaṃ na dadāti pratyuta vakṣyamāṇadiśā
bhayameva vitarati | yastu anyatra vaiṣṇavādau śāstre rataḥ, atha
ca cumbakādivṛttya śikṣitapārameśvaraśāstraḥ, tatra asamāśvastaḥ
taduktam ----  "dīkṣādi kurvannapi pāpiṣṭho na muktipradaḥ, 
śivaśāstraratastu tattadaṃśakaniṣṭhebhyaḥ sarvebhyo muktiphalaprada eva 
tasya sarvordhvavatītvāt" | 

yadvaiṣyati ----  

śarvādhvano viniṣkrāntaṃ śaivānāṃ paramaṃ padam" (10-74) iti,

muktiṃ phalaṃ ca siddhirūpaṃ pradadāti, ityevaṃ yojayitvā yathoktaṃ
vyākartavyam, evaṃ hi ----  śantāpaṃ krodhane vindyāt" (1-22)

ityādi,

"mantrāstasya na siddhyanti yaḥ satyādivivajītaḥ" (1-27)

ityantaṃ vakṣyamāṇaviruddhaphalapradatvaṃ krodhanādeḥ saṅgacchate | 
ata eva anyaśāstraratasya yadviparītaphalapradatvam uttaratra noktam,
tadapi yuktameva | 

śaṃtāpaṃ krodhane vindyāt" (1-22)

ityādi iha kramaprāptamapi apaṭhitvā śiṣyanirṇayādanantaraṃ paṭhan
śiṣyasyaiva bhūyasā īdṛśo gururbhayada iti dhvanayati || 17 || 

athātmani abhayapradasya śiṣyasya svarūpaṃ nidīśati ---- 


śiṣyo dayānvito dhīro dambhamāyāvivajītaḥ || 1-18 || 

devāgnigurubhaktaśca śāstrabhakto dṛḍhavrataḥ | 

guruśuśrūṣaṇaparaḥ suśāntendriyasaṃyutaḥ || 1-19 || 

īdṛśo vai bhavecchiṣyaḥ so'trānugrahabhājanam | 


dayā dīnādiviṣayānukampā, dhairyaṃ sarvatrotsāhaḥ, dambhaḥ 
aspaṣṭahṛdayatā, māyā vañcakatvam, dṛḍhavrato niścitamatiḥ, 
etatsādhakaviṣayaṃ tasyaiva krodhanādivajītācāryaśiṣyasya 
niścitadhītvenaiva sādhanādhikāriṇaḥ
śivadhamīlokadhamībhidā svāvasare nirṇeṣyamāṇatvāt 
devādicatuṣṭayabhaktiḥ śiṣyasya mukhyaṃ rūpam | bhaktiḥ dūrasthe gurau 
bhavati śuśrūṣā tu satataṃ tadanucaratvam | so'trānugrahabhājanam" 
ityanena asya svātmanyeva abhayapradatvamuktam | dvitīyaḥ 
śiṣyaśabdo'rhapratyayāntaḥ | spaṣṭamanyat || 19 || 

etadviparītamāha ---- 


māyānvitaḥ śaṭhaḥ krūro niḥsatyaḥ kalahapriyaḥ || 1-20 || 

kāmī ca lobhasampannaḥ śivabhaktivivajītaḥ | 

dūṣako guruśāstrāṇāṃ dīkṣito'pi na muktibhāk || 1-21 || 


śaṭhaḥ asvacchahṛdayaḥ, krūro raudraprakṛtiḥ, kalahapriyo 
vitaṇḍāvān, lobhasampannaḥ sambhavasattāyāmapi pūjādiṣu 
vittaśāṭhyavān | śivabhaktītyādinā vilayaśaktyāghrātatvamasyoktam | 
na muktibhāgityanena svātmanyeva asya bhayapradatvamuktam sarveṣāṃ 
śiṣyatvāt || 21 || 

atha śiṣyāṇāṃ yathā bhayaprado gurustathā nirūpayati ---- 


santāpaṃ krodhane vindyāccapale capalāḥ śriyaḥ | 

mantrasiddhiṃ haret kṣudra ācāryastu varānane || 1-22 || 

dayāhīnena daurbhāgyamadakṣe dasyupīḍanam | 

kekareṇa bhavedvyādhirdanturaḥ kalikārakaḥ || 1-23 || 

kāṇo vidveṣajananaḥ khalvāṭaścārthanāśanaḥ | 

śāstrahīne na siddhiḥ syād dīkṣādau vīravandite || 1-24 || 

dīrghe rājabharyaṃ jñeyaṃ hrasvaḥ putravināśanaḥ | 

kṛśaḥ kṣayakaro jñeyaḥ sthūla utpātakārakaḥ || 1-25 || 

kṣayānvitena mṛtyuḥ syāt tākīke vadhabandhanam | 

dāmbhikaḥ pāpajanako veditavyo varānane || 1-26 || 

mantrāstasya na siddhyanti yaḥ satyādivajītaḥ | 

sarve te na śubhā devi iha loke paratra ca || 1-27 || 


vindyāt labhate, na siddhyanti nānugrahādikāryaṃ kurvanti, etacca
karmapradhānācāryāśayena ucyate, jñānayoganiṣṭhastu ācāryaḥ
kāṇatvādiyoge'pi na doṣakṛt yathoktam ---- 

śarvalakṣaṇahīno'pi jñānavān gururuttamaḥ | "

iti spaṣṭamanyat | atra ca īśvaroktyekapramāṇake upapattaya 
ālajālaprāyā likhitāḥ, tā upahāsyā eva || 27 || 

atha saṃprati mātṛkāprastāre uttaratra ca yāgādāvucitāṃ bhūmiṃ
nidīśati ---- 


sitaraktapītakṛṣṇāṃ bhūmiṃ plavaviśodhitām | 

viśalyāṃ lakṣaṇairyuktāṃ sarvakāmārthasādhikām || 1-28 || 

śritveti śeṣaḥ, dīkṣāyāṃ jātyuddhārasya bhairavīyajātyāpādanasya
ca vakṣyamāṇatvāt | "varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇādīnāṃ śvetā mṛt 
kāñcanā sitā | "

iti bhedadarśanavannātra vibhāga uktaḥ, saṃkīrṇavarṇā tu 
bhūrvyavacchinnā, plavena uparijalaprakṣepeṇa śodhitāṃ 
parīkṣiteśānapūrvottaradiṅnatiṃ samanimnāṃ vā, yathoktam ---- 

"udagādiplavā śreṣṭhā........................ | " iti 

viśalyām asthyaṅgārādiśūnyām, lakṣaṇaiḥ 
snigdhatvamanoharatvādibhiryuktām, anuvādaparamapi etadeva vākyaṃ 
vidhāyakam, vidhivākyāntarasyābhāvāt || 28 || 

evaṃvidhāṃ bhūmiṃ śritvā ---- 

sugandhigandhasaṃyuktāṃ puṣpaprakaralālitām | 

sudhūpāmodabahalāṃ vitānopariśobhitām || 1-29 || 

kṛtveti śeṣaḥ, bhuvaṃ pārameśvarīṃ dhartṛśaktimādau 
pūjayedityarthaḥ || 29 || 

atha samucitācāryapradarśanapūrvaṃ mantroddhāre itikartavyatāmāha ---- 


ācāryastu śucirbhūtvā candanāgurucacītaḥ | 

sudhūpitaḥ prasannātmā khaṭikākarasaṃyutaḥ || 1-30 || 

prāṅmukhodaṅmukho vāpi ekacittaḥ samāhitaḥ | 

mātṛkāṃ prastarettatra ādikṣāntāmanukramāt || 1-31 || 


śuciḥ kṛtayatheṣṭasnānaḥ, candanetyādinā vihitanityānuṣṭhānaḥ,
ata eva prasannaḥ, dehādinimajjanādunmagnaśivabhāva ātmā yasya,
tatpuruṣasadyojātavaktrayoḥ siddhimuktihetutvāt ācāryo yathābhiprāyaṃ
"prāṅmukha udaṅmukho vā" ityuktam | ekacitto mantrodayanibhālanapravaṇaḥ
ata eva samāhito labdhamantravīryaḥ, mātṛkāṃ paśūnāmajñānāṃ 
viśvamātaraṃ sarvamantratantrajananīm, ādikṣāntāmiti  
anuttarākulavyāptisārakalāpramukhānandecchādiśaktikrameṇa prasṛtya 
kādisāntapratyāhārasvīkṛtāśeṣaviśvakṣakārātmakapiṇḍamantra- 
pradaśītaparyantavyāptisārām, prastarediti 
svapramāṇaśaktāvasthitasvābhāvikapañcāśadrudratacchamarśa- 
prasarasaṃcetaktyānānusvāraśrīsarvavīrabhargaśikhoktaśakticatuṣṭayāt
maka-lipivyāptyanusaṃdhipūrvaṃ ca prastṛṇīyāt | "prastarediti" ārṣaḥ 
pāṭhaḥ | evamanyadapi parameśvaravacaḥ sādhveva, bhagavaduktīnāṃ
mitadṛṣṭibhiravikalpyatvāt || 31 || 

evamasya śāstrasyoddiṣṭavidyāpīṭhatvacikīrṣayā pūrvabhittibhūtāṃ
mātṛkāṃ pradarśya, asyāḥ śivaśaktirūpatāṃ nirūpayati ---- 


ādiḥ ṣoḍaśabheṃdena sākṣādvai bhairavaḥ smṛtaḥ | 

kavargaścaṭavargau ca tapayāḥ śastathaiva ca || 1-32 || 

saṃhāreṇa samopetau yonirvai bhairavī smṛtā | 


ādiḥ prathamo vargaḥ, anuttarādevīsargāntasya viśvāpyāyinaḥ 
ṣoḍaśakasya svayaṃ rājamānatayā śabdanasvābhāvyena 
bhedopatāpakāritayā viśvākṣepeṇa ca svaraśabdavācyasya 
garbhīkṛtāśeṣavācyavācakādiyonivarṇatattvaprasarasamāśrayatvāt 
tadullāsakatvācca bījavyapadeśasya parasaṃvitsphārasatattvasya
bhedena vaicitryeṇa sākṣādbhairavaḥ aśeṣaviśvamayatvāt 
vācyavācakayorabhedācca | kādīnāṃ tu bījaśyānībhāvarūpatvena 
ghanatvāt bījavyaṅgyatvena 
vyañjanaśabdavyapadeśyānāmuktabījasaṃsargeṃṇa jagatkāraṇatvāt 
yonitā | tathaiva ceti vargarūpatayā saṃhāreṇa kṣakāreṇa, bhairavī || 
32 || 


proktabhairavaśaktirūpamātṛkāyāḥ prastāraṃ pradarśya, 
sarvamantradevatāsphārasārāyā asyā mantroddhārāṅgatvena pūjāṃ 
darśayan, anuṣṭhānaviśeṣatāmapi sūcayati ----  mātṛkābhairavaṃ 
devamavargeṇa prapūjayet || 33 || 

bhairavī kādinā pūjyā..........
mātṛkādhiṣṭhātāraṃ bhairavaṃ tatsphārarūpatayaiva 
bharaṇavaṇāvamanaparamārthaṃ niṣkalabhaṭṭārakasvarūpam, avargeṇa 
vyāvaṇītasvarūpeṇa ṣoḍaśakena prapūjayet | bhairavyapi 
niṣkalabhaṭṭārakābhinnasvarūpaiva kādinā kṣāntena 
yonivargagrāmeṇāvibhaktena tadadhiṣṭhātrī umā yogīśvarīrūpā
pūjyā || 33 || 


..............ṃātṝrvargaiḥ prapūjayet | 

avarge tu mahālakṣmīḥ kavarge kamalodbhavā || 1-34 || 

cavarge tu maheśānī ṭavarge tu kumārikā | 

nārāyaṇī tavarge tu vārāhī tu pavagīkā || 1-35 || 

endrī caiva yavargasthā cāmuṇḍā tu śavagīkā | 

etāḥ sapta mahāmātṝḥ saptalokavyavasthitāḥ || 1-36 || 


mātṛḥ brāhmī māheśvarī kaumārī vaiṣṇavī vārāhī endrī 
cāmuṇḍā iti sapta bhairavyo marīcirūpāḥ, 
agnīśānasomayamavaruṇendranirṛtidikṣu

"aṣṭavargavibhinnā tu vidyā mātṛkā tu vai | " (10-1144)

iti vakṣyamāṇatvādavargasya copayuktatvāt saptabhireva kādivargaiḥ
pravibhajya pūjayet, evaṃ cedamanuṣṭhānāntaramapi yuktameva, tathā ca 
bhuvanādhvani buddhibhuvaneṣu madhye yogāṣṭakādanantaram aumaṃ bhuvanaṃ 
pratipādyam | svacārunāmani bhuvane parabhairavaprapañcavyāptirūpasya
umāpateḥ mātṛsaptakaparivārasya dhyānādisvarūpamastyeva | 

tadyathā ---- 

"umāpatirjagannāthaḥ sarvānugrahakṛtparaḥ | " (10-1008)

ityupakramya taddhyānamuktvā

"mātaraḥ saptarūpiṇyaḥ" (10-1017)

ityādinā brāhmyādimātṝṇāṃ dhyānasaṃniveśādi pratipādya

śvacchandaṃ paryupāsīnāḥ parāparavibhāgaśaḥ | " (10-1029)

ityuktvā

"umā vai saptadhā bhūtvā nānārūpaviparyayaiḥ | " (10-1029)

ityādinā anuṣṭhānabhedataiva nirvāhitā, tatra tu bhagavato'paraṃ
rūpamuktam, iha tu paraṃ rūpamiti viśeṣaḥ, yadvakṣyati ---- 

śvacchandāstu parāścānyāḥ pare vyomni vyavasthitāḥ | 

 svacchandaṃ paryupāsīnāḥ parāparavibhāgaśaḥ ||" (10-1028)

iti | 
tasmātmantroddhārādaṅgabhūtamātṛkābhairavapūjanasyānuṣṭhānāntara-
rūpatve'pi na kācidanupapattiḥ || 36 || 

yuktaṃ caitat, yadāha ---- 

sarvā kāmānavāpnoti devyevaṃ bhairavo'bravīt | 

mantroddhārāṅgatve tu "phalavatsannidhāvaphalamaṅgam" iti 

nītyā mātṛkābhairavapūjanasyeyamuktiratathyā syāt, 
karmaṇo'parisamāptasya phalanirdeśāyogāt || 

evaṃ ca kṛtvā ---- 

ante'syā uddharenmantrān yathākramaniyogataḥ || 1-37 || 

asyā mātṛkāpūjāyāḥ, yathākramam āsanamantramūtīmantrādikrameṇa
yo niyogaḥ tattanmantravācyadevatānusandhānaparatvaṃ tena, sa
ca kramayogo dvitīyādipaṭalabhāvinyāsāvasaropayogi, iti || 37 || 

iha mantroddhāro'pi bhāvinyāsakramānusāramucyate, tatra ---- 


trayodaśaṃ binduyutamanantāsanamuttamam | 

anena yojayet sarvaṃ somasūryāgnimadhyagam || 1-38 || 

brahmaviṣṇumaheśānaṃ śavāntaṃ parikalpayet | 

trayodaśam okāraṃ, bindunā yutaṃ praṇavākāram, anantāsanamiti
paratattvavācakamapi, etat saṃpratīśvareṇāsanavācitvena niyuktāt
adhaḥsthānantamūlavidyeśāntamadhyavyāpinīpadasthānantaparyantāsanamanur
ūpamityarthaḥ | sarvādhvordhvavatīno'nantabhaṭṭārakasyaiva
dharādharānantarūpā prapañcavyāptiḥ, iti bhaviṣyati, tat
vyāpinīpadasthānantaparyantā ihaivāsanavyāptiḥ, ata āha ---- 
uttamamitiśa
ati-yenodgataṃ sarvādhvamūrdhasthamityarthaḥ | etadeva vyanakti ---- anena
āsanamantreṇa, sarvamadharavatī yojayet ekādhāraśaktitayā anusandadhyāt,
evaṃ somasūryāgnimadhyagaṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśānaṃ kṛtvā | ayamarthaḥ -
--- 

śāktapadmavyāptisatattve vidyāpadme dalakesarakaṇīkābhāgeṣu 
somasūryavahnimaṇḍalānāṃ sarvaprameyapramāṇapramātṛvyāptisārāṇāṃ 
madhyagatamantargataṃ brahmādisamagrakāraṇagrāmaṃ kṛtvā 
bhedavyāptyānusaṃdhāya, taduparivartyanāśritabhaṭṭārako
dvitīyapaṭalapradarśayiṣyamāṇaśavavyāptiko'nte yasya tat 
tādṛgāsanam, praṇavena gurumukhaprasiddhaviśeṣaṇānusandhānavyāptyā 
vyāpyamānaṃ parāmṛśet || 38 || 

evamanena nyāsenaiva bhedo vilāyate | aṇutvalayāyāha ---- 


mūtīṃ haṃsākṣareṇaiva bindubhinnena kalpayet || 1-39 || 

ardhacandrakṛtāṭopāṃ svasvanāṃ tuhinaprabhām | 

"ātmā vai haṃsa ......................... | "


iti vakṣyamāṇātmaparāmaśīnā haṃsapathasatatasañcāriṇā, akṣareṇa
vicaladrūpeṇa hakāreṇa, aśeṣamantrāraṇirūpeṇāpi 
samastavidyāvibhāgavedanātmakabinduyuktena bheditabindunā ataśca 
pañcapraṇavādhikāranirūpayiṣyamāṇadiśā labdhamantratvāt uccāryeṇa, 
mūtīmiti muṇḍāntabhedavyāptimohāt śuddhātmadaśāsamucchrayācca 
mūtīvyapadeśyām ātmasthitiṃ kalpayet vimṛśet | kīdṛśīm ? ardhacandre 
bindumūtīvatīni kṛta āṭopo yayā lalāṭagranthibhedāya 
āsthitotsāhāmityarthaḥ | tadbhedādeva dhvanimātṛrūpatayā
svasvanām ahaṃvimarśarūpām, tathā tuhinaprabhāṃ 
kadambagolakākāracaitanyaprakāśarūpām | taduktaṃ śrītrikahṛdaye ---- 

"anante bhairavocchrāye mūtīreṣā parāparā | 

yasyāstu nyāsamātreṇa aṇutvaṃ pravilīyate ||" iti || 39 || 

tato'pi ---- 


tadūrdhve sakalaṃ devaṃ svacchandaṃ parikalpayet || 1-40 || 


taditi cinmūrterūrdhve tatsaṅkocaṃ nimajjya, aśeṣavācyavācakaśarīraṃ
sakalaṃ prāgvyākhyātatattvam, devaṃ svacchandamiti anugrāhyānugrahāya
cinmūtībhittiṃ bhittveva niryātam, parikalpayet bhāvayet || 40 || 

parikalpanāmātrakṛta eva mūtībhairavaniṣkalānāṃ bhedaḥ, tamāha ---- 


oṃkāramuccaretpūrvamaghorebhyo anantaram | 

atha ghorebhyo samālikhya tato'nyattu samālikhet || 1-41 || 

ghoraghoratarebhyaśca sarvataḥ śarvaṃ uccaret | 

sarvebhyaḥ padamanyacca namaste rudra eva ca || 1-42 || 

rūpebhyaśca samālikhya namaskārāvasānakam | 

mantrarājaḥ samākhyātaḥ aghoraḥ surapūjitaḥ || 1-43 || 


atra mantrapadānāṃ svarūparakṣārthaṃ saṃhitākāryaṃ na daśītam | 
ādyantasthitapraṇavanamaskāravarjaṃ dvātriṃśadakṣaro'yaṃ 
ślokanidīṣṭo mahāmantraḥ | asyāyaṃ rahasyo'rthaḥ ---- he parameśvara 
rudra paracaitanyasphārānupraveśānmano rodhanasya aśeṣapāśadrāvaṇasya 
ca heto ! ghora bhedābhedātmakasadāśiveśādipadollāsaka ! śarva 
bhedamayamāyīyasvarūpaprakaṭanāt 
sṛṣṭisthitipralayasaṃhāramātratāpādanena śaraṇavaraṇarūpa ! 
ityāmantraṇatrayeṇa vyākhyāsyamānarūpatrayaucityaprayuktena
sarvadaśāpradarśanaparam aśeṣavigrahaṃ bhagavantaṃ parabhairavaṃ
saṃmukhīkṛtyāha ---- te tava, sambandhibhyaḥ 
raudrījyeṣṭhāvāmākhyaśaktitrayavibhavarūpanānārudra
tacchakticakrātmakebhyaḥ saṃhitāntare'parāparāparāparānāmaniruktebhyo
yathākramamavidyamānaṃ bhedamayaṃ bhedābhedamayaṃ ca pāśātmakaṃ
ghorasvarūpaṃ yeṣāṃ tebhyaḥ paracaitanyānandaghanād 
vayamahābhairavātmakasvasvarūpapratyabhijñāpakebhyaḥ
aghorebhyaḥ, tathā anāśritasadāśiveśvarādirūpabhedātmapadapradebhyaḥ,
atheti uktarūpabhittiprathamānatvāt anantarabhāvibhyaḥ, ata 
evāhantācchāditedantonmajjanena ādyarūpāpekṣayā bhīṣaṇatvāt 
"ghorebhyaḥ" paracitprathābhittyābhāsitāhantedantābhāsa-
kātmakasvaśaktidarpaṇoṭṭaṅkitamāyādikṣityantabhedaprathāpradebhyaḥ,
atibhīṣaṇatvāt ghoratarebhyaśca rūpebhyaḥ svabhāvebhyaḥ, ekaikasya
rūpasya parabhairavarūpabhittimayatvena pūrṇatvāt, sarvataḥ
sarveṇa rūpeṇa sarvebhyaḥ sarvadā sarvatra sarvasarvātmatayā
sphuradbhyaḥ mahāmantravīryātmakapūrṇāhantāparāmarśamayebhyo namaḥ 
āmantraṇapadaparāmarśābhimukhībhūtam 
ahārudraśaktitrayasphāravivaśībhavatpāśarāśiśarīrādikalpitapramātṛ
padaprahvībhāvena samāviśāmītyarthaḥ | uktaṃ ca śrīmālinīvijaye ---- 


"viṣayeṣveva saṃlīnānadhodhaḥ pātayantyaṇūn | 

rudrāṇūn yāḥ samāliṅgya ghorataryo'parāḥ smṛtāḥ || 

miśrakarmaphalāsaktiṃ pūrvavajjanayanti yāḥ | 

muktimārganirodhinyastāḥ syuḥ ghorāḥ parāparāḥ || 

pūrvavajjantujātasya śivadhāmaphalapradāḥ | 

parāḥ prakāśitāstajjñairaghorāḥ śivaśaktayaḥ ||" (3-31-33)


iti | śrīpañcārthapramāṇe tu ---- 


"ghoreti pāśajālākhyaṃ pāpayuktaṃ bhayānakam | 

tadyeṣāṃ tu na vidyeta hyaghorāḥ parikītītāḥ || 

vāmeśvarādayo rudrā jālamūloparisthitāḥ | 

te hyaghorāḥ samākhyātāḥ śṛṇu ghorān samāsataḥ || 

proktā gopatipūrvā ye rudrāstu gahanāntagāḥ | 

te tu ghorāḥ samākhyātā nānābhuvanavāsinaḥ || 

vidyeśvarādyanantāntā mahāmāheśvarāśca ye | 

ghoraghoratarāstvanye vijñeyāstvadha āśritāḥ || 

ete aghorā ghorāśca ghoraghoratarāstathā | 

eteṣvavasthitā nityaṃ śaktayaḥ pārameśvarāḥ || 

sthitipralayasargeṣu bandhamokṣakriyāsu ca | 

sarvārthaprerakatvena rūpeṣveteṣu śaktayaḥ || 

rūpebhya ebhyaḥ sarvebhyo namaskāraṃ karotyaṇuḥ | 

namaskāraḥ parityāgaḥ kāryakāraṇalakṣaṇaḥ ||" 

iti || 43 || 

evamasya sarvasarvātmakapārameśvarasatattvamayasya durlabhasyāpi
bhaktiśālibhiḥ satatalabdhasya mahāmantrasya svarūpamabhidhāya
māhātmyaṃ prakaṭayati ---- 


sakṛduccārito devi nāśayet sarvakilviṣam | 

janmakoṭīsahasraistu bhramadbhiḥ samupājītam || 1-44 || 


śiṣyāṇāṃ dīkṣāsamaye guruṇā prayujyamāna iti śeṣaḥ || 44 || 


tathā ---- 

smaraṇānnāśayed devi tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā | tama iti āṇavaṃ 
māyīyaṃ ca malam, tamaḥ andhakāramiva sūryodayo nāśayati, evaṃ 
dīkṣayā tamaśca dehādyabhimānarūpamajñānam, smaraṇānnāśayatyeva
svavācyabhairavadevatāsamāveśanena śiṣyāṇāmeva ca 
prāmādikasamayānanuṣṭhānakilviṣarūpam, sādhakānāṃ ca vighnarūpaṃ 
tamo'pi vyākhyātaparamārthavīryānusandhānātmakasmaraṇamātrādeva
nāśayatyevetyasmin sakalabhogāpavargaprade mahāmantre 
nārthavādā1śaṅkayā bhramitavyam | 

tathā ca śrīmataṅgaśāstre ---- 

"pramāṇamekaṃ tadvākyaṃ tathyamīśvarabhāṣitam" (1-3-18)

ityuktam | parabhairavasphāramayairasmadgurubhirapi tantrāloke'bhihitam ---- 

"vidhivākyamidaṃ caiva nārthavādaḥ kadācana | 

nārthavādābhirūpatvaṃ vākye māheśvare bhavet ||" (4-232)

iti || 44 || 

asya parameśvarasyānugrahārthaṃ bhaktibhājāṃ cinmūrtāveva  
pradarśayiṣyamāṇavyāptikamākāramuṭṭaṅkayituṃ vaktramantrānāha ---- 

yakārādivakārāntāḥ saṃhāreṇa samāyutāḥ || 1-45 || 

bindumastakasaṃbhinnā bhairavasya mukhāni ca | 


mātṛkāparyantavatītvāt saṃhāreṇa kṣakāreṇa, samyagiti ādau, 
āyutāḥ sambaddhāḥ, vedanātmakabinduvyāptisārā 
ūrdhvapūrvadakṣiṇapaścimavāmamukhānāṃ 
paramavyomavāyutejovāridharāśaktisārāṇāṃ vācakatvād 
bhairavīyasvarūpapraveśopāyatvācca bhairavasya mukhādi ete mantrāḥ | 
etāni ca ----  brahmabhaṅgyā niyojyāni mūrdhādicaraṇāvadhi || 46 || 

brahmaṇo bṛhattvāt bṛṃhakatvāt viśvātmanaḥ śaktimūrteḥ, bhaṅgyā
daṇḍākāratayā, brahmaṇāṃ ca īśānādīnāṃ pañcānāṃ, bhaṅgyā 
vibhāgena, tena praṇavapūrṇaṃ "kṣaṃ" īśānamūrdhne" "yaṃ" 
tatpuruṣavakrāya, "raṃ" aghorahṛdayāya, "vaṃ" vāmadevaguhyāya "laṃ" 
sadyojātamūrtaye, iti mūtīrekatvādekena mantreṇa daṇḍākārā 
anudbhinnāvayavā bhagavanmūtīḥ kalpyā || 46 || 

asyā vibhāgadarśanārthaṃ vaktrakṣetre 
bhāvisphuṭavaktravibhāgabhittibhūtāṃ kavāṭabhaṅgiṃ darśayati ---- 

punaścordhvaṃ mukhaṃ kalpyaṃ prāgdakṣiṇamathottaram | 

aparaṃ..........

mukhānīti padavibhaktivipariṇāmāt tṛtīyābahuvacanāntamiha yojyam,
tena mukhaiḥ "kṣaṃ yaṃ raṃ vaṃ laṃ" ityetaiḥ mukhamantraiḥ, punariti
brahmabhaṅgyā nyāsopari, mukhamiti mukhāvakāśadānārtham, 
ūrdhvaṃprāgādikavāṭe nyasedityarthaḥ | atra ca "oṃkṣaṃ 
īśānavaktrāya namaḥ" iti pṛthak pṛthaṅ nyāsaḥ kāryaḥ, vaktrāṇāṃ 
bhinnatvāt || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


........kalpayitvā tu kalābhedena vinyaset || 1-47 || 

pūrvaṃ ca dakṣiṇaṃ caiva uttaraṃ paścimaṃ tathā | 

ūrdhvamūrdhnā tu saṃyuktaṃ kṣakāraṃ tvīśarūpiṇam || 1-48 || 


iha ---- 

"śivasyaikā mahāśaktiḥ śivaścaiko hyanādimān | 

sā śaktibhīdyate bhūyobhedai........................ ||" (11-271)

iti vakṣyamāṇanītyā bhagavataḥ svātantryaśaktisārasya yathā 
mūtīgrahaṇaṃ tathā tadanurūpaṃ tattacchaktisphāramayatvaṃ na tu 
śāntarūpatvam, iti darśanasatattvamunmīlayituṃ kavāṭādibhaṅgiṣu 
kalāparyāyāṇāṃ śaktīnāṃ nyāsa ucyate, tatra "pāṭhakramādārthaḥ 
kramo balīyān" iti sthityā ūrdhvamūrdhvarūpaṃ pūrvaṃ dakṣiṇamuttaraṃ 
paścimamiti krameṇa saṃsāratārakatvādanvarthanāmā ---- 

"tārā sutārā taraṇī tārayantī sutāriṇī | 

īśānasya kalāḥ pañca ................. ||"

iti vakṣyamāṇo yaḥ kalābhedaḥ, tena "kṣakāraṃ mantramīśarūpiṇam"
īśānabhaṭṭārakākhyavācyadevatāsphāramayamūrdhvaṃ pūrvādikaṃ
vaktraṃ vinyaset | kṣakāraśca pūrvamityādi sāmānādhikaraṇyenoktaṃ
yojyam, kalābhedaśca prātilomyenānusandheya iti gurukramaḥ | evaṃ
"kṣaṃ sutāriṇyai namaḥ" ityūrdhvakavāṭe, "kṣaṃ tārayantyai namaḥ"
iti pūrvaṃsmin, yāvat "kṣaṃ tārāyai namaḥ" iti paścimakavāṭe,
īśānavyāptidarśanāya kalānyāsaḥ kārya iti piṇḍārthaḥ || 48 || 

atha vaktrāṇi sphuṭayitumāha ---- 


evaṃ vaktraṃ caturdhā tu vaktreṣveva niyojayet | 


kalābhedenetyanuvartate | evamiti ca īśānakalābhedanyāyenaiva 
pūrvavaktramantraṃ "yakāraṃ" vaktreṣu caturdhā 
pūrvādivaktranimittatatsphuṭīkaraṇāya caturdhaiva kalābhedena yojayet | 
kalāścātra ---- 

ṅivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā ca vidyā śāntā tathaiva ca | 

puruṣasya kalā etāścatasraḥ..................... ||" (1-55)

iti vakṣyamāṇāḥ | atrāpi prātilomyena sṛṣṭikrameṇa nyāsaḥ, tena
"yaṃ śāntāyai tatpuruṣavaktrāya namaḥ" ityādi "yaṃ nivṛttaye
sadyojātavaktrāya namaḥ" ityanusaṃdheyam, vaktracatuṣṭayasya
ca sphuṭatā bhāvanīyā || 

puruṣādikalānāṃ sphuṭabhedollāsakatvāt, ūrdhvavaktre tu 
anudbhinnākārabhede'vadhimāha ---- 


pañcamaṃ yadbhavedvaktraṃ kṣakāreṇaiva nidīśet || 1-49 || 


parasvarūpasya vyañjakatvāt saṃsāratrāṇācca vaktram | evakāreṇa
atra sphuṭākāratānusaṃdheyā, iti dhvanati || 49 || 

evamūrdhvavaktrakṣetrayoḥ kavāṭakalāvaktrabhaṅginyāsamuktvā 
hṛtkṣetrādāvaghorakalānyāsamāha ---- 


hṛdi grīvāṃsapṛṣṭhe tu nābhau ca jaṭhare tathā | 

pṛṣṭhe corasi vinyasyedaghoreṇa yathākramam || 1-50 || 


"tamā mohā kṣudhā nidrā mṛtyurmāyā bhayā jarā | 

aghorasya kalā hyetā aṣṭau vai varavaṇīni ||" (1-56)

iti vakṣyamāṇakalābhedāt, aghoreṇa aghoravaktramantreṇa, yathākramaṃ
vinyaset | tena "oṃ raṃ tamāyai hṛdayāya namaḥ" ityādi, "oṃ raṃ
jarāyai namaḥ udare", ityanto nyāsaḥ kāryaḥ, aghorabhaṭṭārakasya
saṃhārapradhānatvāt | kalāstathocitanāmnyaḥ || 50 || 

guhyādikṣetre śrīvāmadevakalānyāsamāha ---- 


guhye tathā gude caiva tathorvorjānunorapi | 

jaṅghayośca sphijoḥ kaṭyāṃ pārśvayorubhayorapi || 1-51 || 

vinyaseccaiva vāmena śarīre tu yathākramam | 

"rajā rakṣā ratiḥ pālyā kāmyā tṛṣṇā matiḥ kriyāḥ | 

ṛddhirmāyā ca rātriśca bhrāmaṇī mohanī tathā | 

manonmanī kalā hyetā vāmadeve trayodaśa ||"(1-57-58)


iti vakṣyamāṇaṃ sṛṣṭipradhānasya śrīvāmadevasya kalābhedaṃ 
sṛṣṭipradhānocitābhidhānaṃ guhyādisthānatrayodaśaprakaṭanaparaṃ 
yathākramaṃ vāmeneti śrīvāmadevavaktreṇa nyaset, tena "vaṃ rajāyai 
namaḥ" guhye ityanusandheyam || 51 || 

bhagavataḥ pādādikṣetrasthaśrīsadyojātakalānyāsamāha ---- 


pādau hastau tathā nāsāṃ śiraścaiva bhujāvatha || 1-52 || 

sadyena kalpayed devi sarvametadyathākramam | 


sadyena śrīsadyojātamantreṇa, pādādīn yathākramaṃ kalpayet, arthāt
sadyojātakalābhireva, tāśca vakṣyante ---- 

śiddhirṛddhirdyutirlakṣmīrmedhā kāntiḥ sudhā sthitiḥ | 

sadyojātakalāstvevamaṣṭau samparikītītāḥ ||" (1-58-59)

iti śrīmatsadyojātasya sthitipadāpyāyakatvāt siddhyādayaḥ kalāḥ,
tena "oṃ laṃ siddhaye namaḥ dakṣiṇapāde" ityanusaṃdheyam | yadyapi
pūrvavaktramantreṇa vaktrāṇāmunmīlamanaṃ kṛtam, tathāpi 
śiraḥkṣetranāsākṣetrayoḥ kalpanā punaranena vidhinā kartavyā, 
pratipadoktatvāt | evaṃ pādasthasadyojātakalānāmapi 
nāsāśiraḥkṣetraparyantāṃ vyāptamabhidadhat śarvatra sarvamasti"
iti bhaṅgyā śikṣayati hastau kalpayediti | "grahaṃ saṃmāṣṭī" itivat
pradhānavidherasya saṃkhyāyā avivakṣitatvāt aṣṭādaśabhujatvasya
ca vakṣyamāṇatvāt "prājāpātyā nava grahā bhavanti" itivat 
anāgatāvekṣaṇarūpatantrayuktyā 
dakṣavāmapārśvagatabhujanavakadvayakalpanaṃ dyutilakṣmībhyām, iti 
mantavyam || 52 || 

kalā nirdeṣṭumāha ---- 


tāsāṃ nāmāni vakṣyāmi yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ || 1-53 || 

tārā sutārā taraṇī tārayantī sutāraṇī | 

īśānasya kalā pañca nirañjanapadānugā || 1-54 || 

nivṛttaśca pratiṣṭhā ca vidyā śāntistathaiva ca | 

puruṣasya kalā hyetāścatasraḥ parīkitītāḥ || 1-55 || 

tamā mohā kṣudhā nidrā mṛtyurmāyā bhayā jarā | 

aghorasya kalā hyetā aṣṭau vai varavaṇīnī || 1-56 || 

rajā rakṣā ratiḥ pālyā kāmyā tṛṣṇā matiḥ kriyā | 

ṛddhirmāyā ca rātriśca bhrāmiṇī mohanī tathā || 1-57 || 

manonmanī kalā hyetā vāmadeve trayodaśa | 

siddhirṛddhirdyutirlakṣmīrmedhā kāntiḥ sudhā sthitiḥ || 1-58 || 

sadyojātakalāstvevamaṣṭau samparikītītāḥ | 


yathāvaditi yathāvyāptyanusāram | anupūrvaśa iti 
ūrdhvapūrvadakṣavāmapaścimavaktrakrameṇa | atra ca ---- 

aparā sā tanuḥ sthūlā ṣaṭtriṃśattattvakalpitā (4-407)

iti vakṣyamāṇanītyā ṣaṭtriṃśattamasya tattvasya "śuddhātmā unmanā
param" iti tribhedatvāt tattvavyāptyaiva bhairavadehanyāsaḥ kāryaḥ | 
ṣoḍaśadvādaśadaśa saṃkhyasomasūryāgnikalāvyāptyā 
tridhāmamayatvāpattyarthamityanye || 58 || 

athātra ṣaṭtriṃśattattvamaye dehe sūkṣmavyātyā paravyāptyā ca
mūtīnyāsaṃ darśayati ---- 


punaśca sādhako devi sarvāṅgeṣu yathākramam || 1-59 || 

navatattvaṃ tritattvaṃ ca dhruveṇa parikalpayet | 


punariti kalārūpapūrṇadehanyāsānantaraṃ yathāvibhāgamukteṣu 
sarvāṅgeṣu ---- 


prakṛtiḥ puruṣaścaiva niyatiḥ kāla eva ca | 

māyā vidyā tatheśaśca sadāśivaśivau tathā || (5-11)


iti vakṣyamāṇaṃ navatattvaṃ vāmādiśaktivyāptyā 
kapāleśādisvacchandāntabhairavavyāptyā ca, ātmavidyāśivākhyaṃ 
tritattvaṃ śuddhātmonmanāparatattvavyāptyā | dhruveṇeti sarvamantreṣu 
avicaladvyāptikena praṇavena "oṃ śivādiprakṛtyantanavatattvātmane namaḥ" 
iti prayogeṇa | rmūdhni vaktre ca kaṇṭhe ca hṛdaye (2-51)

iti vakṣyamāṇasthānānusandhānena kalpayet "oṃ śivatattvāya namaḥ"
ityādi krameṇa, śikhāntabhrūmadhyahṛdayeṣu sṛṣṭikrameṇa kalpayet || 

evamiyadantena nyāsena bhagavato bhairavabhaṭṭārakasya sphuṭībhāve
jāte ---- 


vidyāṅgāni punarnyasya teṣāṃ mantrān śṛṇu priye || 1-60 || 


paripūrṇavedanātmatayā vidyārūpasya bhagavato bahurūpasyāṅgāni || 60 
|| 


tanmantrānāha ---- 


aghorebhyo samālikhya tha ghorebhyo dvitīyakam | 

ghoraghoratarebhyaśca tṛtīyaṃ parikalpayet || 1-61 || 

sarvataḥ śarva sarvebhyo caturthaṃ parikalpayet | 

namaste rudrarūpebhyaḥ pañcamaṃ ca vidhānataḥ || 1-62 || 

oṃkāramuccaret pūrvaṃ juṃ saśca tadanantaram | 

netratrayaṃ prakalpeta vidyādehasya bhāmini || 1-63 || 

vidyāṅgāni vijānīyāt...............


dvātriṃśadakṣaravidyādehasya bhagavato'vayavarūpāḥ hṛt śiraḥ
śikhā kavacam astraṃ ca, iti pañcānāṃ pañca mantrāḥ, tryakṣarastu
ūrdhvadakṣiṇavāmanetratrayasya | atra ca padānāṃ prāgvat 
saṃhitākāryaṃ na kṛtam || 

athaiṣām ---- 


............ṇāmāni ca nibodha me | 

sarvātmā tu brahmaśiro jvālinī piṅgalaṃ tathā || 1-64 || 


durbhedyaṃ pāśupatyaṃ ca jyotīrūpaṃ tathaiva ca | 


atra anāgatāvekṣaṇatantrayuktyā ante namaḥ svāhādijātirdeyā, tena 
"aghorebhyo sarvātmane hṛdayāya namaḥ" ityādiprayogaḥ kāryaḥ | 
"durbhedyaṃ pāśupatyam" iti padadvayamastre yojyam, atra ca śarvajñatā,
tṛptiḥ, anādibodhaḥ, svatantratā, aviluptaśaktiḥ, anantaśaktiḥ"
iti bhagavadguṇā ete hṛdādinetrāṅgatayā prasṛtā ityāmnāyaḥ | 
kavacanyāsādanantaraṃ netranyāsaḥ, tato'stranyāsaḥ kāryaḥ, astrasya 
bahiraṅgatvāt netramantrasya tu vidyādehāvayavatvābhāvāt 
paścāttaduddeśaḥ kṛtaḥ | 

vaktraevamāsanacinmūtībrahmakavāṭavaktrabhaṅgīnyāsānantaraṃ
pañcādikalātmakaṣaṭṃtraśattattvavyāptyā pañcabhiḥ 
praghaṭṭakairaṣṭātriṃśatkalānyāsamuktvā bhairavanavakavyāptyā
navatattvanyāsaṃ śuddhātmonmanāparatattvavyāptyā ca 
tritattvanyāsamabhidhāya sarvajñatādidharmavyāptyāṅganyāsa uktaḥ | 
evamadhiṣṭhātra dhiṣṭheyāśeṣaviśvaśarīratva bhagavatī bahurūpatvaṃ 
daśītam | 

evaṃ caitatsarvaṃ tritayaviśrāntamapi śaktitrayasphāramayameveti 
darśayitumetadupari śaktimantrānyāsārthamāha ---- 


kriyā jñānaṃ tathaivecchā tāsāṃ mantrānnibodha me || 1-65 || 


viśvaprasarasya śaktiṣūpasaṃhāreṇaiva viśrāntiriti kriyā jñānaṃ
cecchā ceti prakramaḥ || 65 || 


āsāṃ krameṇa mantramāha ---- 


caturthasvarasaṃyuktaṃ hāntaṃ binduvibhūṣitam | 

kriyāśaktiḥ samākhyātā sarvasṛṣṭiprakāśikā || 1-66 || 


caturthasvara īkāraḥ, hāntaṃ kṣavarṇam || 66 || 


śakārasya tṛtīyaṃ tu ṣaṣṭhayuktaṃ sabindukam | 

jñānaśaktiḥ smṛtā hyeṣā prabodhajananī śubhā || 1-67 || 


śakārasya tṛtīyaṃ sakāram, ṣaṣṭhena ūkāreṇa saṃyuktam || 67 || 


kṣādiṃ dvisvarasambhinnaṃ tripañcena tu mūcchītam | 

icchāśaktiḥ samākhyātā bhairavasyāmitātmikā || 1-68 || 


kṣakārasya ādivarṇaṃ "ha", dvisvaraḥ "ākāraḥ", tripañcaḥ 
pañcadaśaḥ svaraḥ "aṅkāraḥ" || 68 || 

athāsāmaśeṣaviśvākāriṇīnāṃ śaktīnāṃ yatra viśrāntiḥ, tasya 
bhagavataḥ sarvātmatāyāmapi niṣprapañcasya svacchandabhaṭṭārakasya 
proktāśeṣamantropari nyāsāya mantramāha ---- 


haṃsākhyo bindusaṃyuktaḥ ṣaṣṭhasvaravibheditaḥ | 

bālendunādaśaktyantaḥ svacchando niṣkalaḥ smṛtaḥ || 1-69 || 


haṃsākhya iti sarvasṛṣṭisaṃhārakāritvena hānasamādānadharmā
"prakṛtivīkṛtiścaiva ubhe ṣaṣṭhena saṃyutaḥ | " (6-20)

iti vakṣyamāṇasthityā ādikṣāntasya viśvasya prakṛtibhūtaḥ
ṅādākhyaṃ yatparaṃ bījam | " (kālo0 1-5)

ityādinā, paraṃ śāstreṣu abhihitānāhatadhvanirūpaḥ, ṅāsyoccārayitā 
kaścit pratihantā na vidyate | 

svayamuccarate devaḥ ..................	 ||"" (7-59)

iti vakṣyamāṇasphāraḥ satatoditānastamitasphurataikasāro'nackahakāraḥ 
| ṣaṣṭhasvareṇa ūkāreṇonmeṣātmakajñānaśaktiprasarātmarūpeṇa 
antavīśvamūrdhvādhorūpatayā bibhratā saṃvitsphārasya 
kiñcidūnatābhāsanena kriyāśaktyāsūtraṇātmanā lipikrameṇāpi 
ūrdhvādhaḥprasṛtaśaktidvayakoṭiprakaṭanoṭṭaṅkitaśuddhāśuddhāśeṣa
-viśvasargasaṃhārātmasatataprasareṇa | 

"ṣaṣṭhaṃ ca pañcamaṃ caiva tasya devi guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ" (6-17)

iti vakṣyamāṇanītyā nādabhaṭṭārakaśaktirūpatayā guṇabhūtena 
ūrdhvādhaḥsañcāritayā ca caraṇarūpeṇa vibheditaḥ saṃṃyojitaḥ | atha 
ca parābhedabhūmeḥ kiñciccalito'nugrāhyānugrahāya 
uccāryamantrarūpatāpādanena unmukhībhūtaḥ, vindunā 
aśeṣaviśvasāmarasyavedanātmanā, samyagiti abhedāpattyā yuktaḥ, 
vakṣyamāṇavyāptisatattvā bālendunādaśaktayo 
garbhīkṛtanirodhikānādanādāntavyāpinīsamanonmanāprameyasatattvasphārā 
ante viśrāntau yasya, sa eva parameśvaraḥ svacchando niṣkalaḥ 
anāhatadhvaniparamārthamahāmantravīryarūpo'pi śirorūpākārakalayā 
ṣaṣṭhena sakāreṇa ca ghorataraśakticakrarūpeṇa brahmaviṣṇurudrān 
brahmaprakṛtimāyāṇḍāni jāgarasvapnasuṣuptāni 
prameyapramāṇapramātṛṃśceti sṛṣṭisthitisaṃhāravilayamātraṃ 
bhedamayaṃ jagat darśayati, vyākhyāsyamānasatattvatayā 
bindvādiprameyaparipāṭyā ca ghorarūpatayā 
bhedābhedamayeśvarasadāśivānāśritādīn śaktyaṇḍavatīnaḥ 
turyapadāvasthitān kramātkramaṃ sātiśayān  
sargasthitisaṃhāraśaktyākrāntānābhāsayati, unmanāśaktyā tu 
aghorarūpaśakticakraparamārthatayāśeṣaturyātītapadārohitayā 
svātmamayīkurvan mocayati, iti bhagavato bahurūpasya padārthadvāreṇa 
yāvān sphāro vyākhyātaḥ so'sya bhagavataḥ sarva eva abhedenaivāntaḥ 
sthitaḥ, ityayaṃ bhagavān sadā pañcavidhakṛtyakārī 
aśeṣaśakticakrātmakasvātantryaśaktyaviyuktaḥ śrīsvacchando, niṣkalaḥ 
iti niṣkrāntāḥ aśeṣāḥ kalāḥ śaktayo yasmāt kalanārūpāt yaśca 
niṣkrānto'prameya ityarthaḥ | atha ca 
akārokāramakārabindvādikalāyogāccatuṣkalaśabdavācyo'pi vastuto 
niṣkalānāhatadhvaniparamārthatvāt niṣkalaḥ | yadvakṣyati ---- 

śaguṇaḥ sakalo jñeyo nirguṇo niṣkalaḥ śivaḥ" (6-17)

ityalaṃ mantrarahasyaprakaṭanena | sampradāyastu mā paricchedīti
kiñcidunmīlitam | smṛta iti bhagavatā śrīkaṇṭheneśvareṇa 
sadāśivenāpi pāramparyeṇa svasvarūpaḥ parameśvarānugrahādeva 
upalabdhaḥ praṇavaḥ catuṣkalaḥ śvacchandabhairavāya namaḥ" iti ca 
prayogaḥ || 69 || 

pūrvapadasya ca māhātmyaṃ prakaṭayati ---- 


asyoccāraṇamātreṇa ye yuktāḥ sarvapātakaiḥ | 

śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśāḥ padaṃ gacchantyanāmayam || 1-70 || 


etatpūrvavyākhyānenaiva gatārtham || 70 || 

asyānāhatātmakasvasvarūpasphārāṇi sarvajñatādirūpāṇyaṅgānyāha ---
- 


sāntaṃ dīrghasvaraiḥ ṣaḍbhibhīnnajātivibheditam | 

hṛcchiraśca śikhā varma locanāstraṃ prakalpayet || 1-71 || 


sāntaṃ havarṇam, dīrghasvarāḥ ṣaṭ ā ī ū e au aḥ | ete ca 
visargamṛte binduyuktā ityarthāt, jātayaḥ ṅamaḥ svāhā" 
ityādivakṣyamāṇāḥ, ṣaḍete krameṇa hṛdayādīnāṃ mantrāḥ || 71 || 

prayoge itikartavyatāmāha ---- 


oṃkāro dīpanasteṣāmante jātiṃ prakalpayet | 

namaḥ svāhā tathā vauṣaṭ huṃ vaṣaṭ phaṭ krameṇa tu || 1-72 || 


(atra-namaḥ svāhā vaṣaṭ caiva huṃ vauṣaṭ phaṭ krameṇatu iti pāṭha
sādhīyān mantavyaḥ) tena "oṃ hā� hṛdayāya namaḥ" ityādikrameṇaiṣāṃ 
prayogaḥ || 72 || 

asya sāṅgasya nyāse phalamāha ---- 


eṣa bhairavarājastu sarvakāmārthasādhakaḥ | 


aśeṣabhogamokṣada ityarthaḥ | evaṃ cābhidadhat 
śrīsakalabhaṭṭārakaparamīkaraṇarūpasyāpi
asya bhājanaṃ janaṃ prati pṛthaganuṣṭhānatvamapi bhavati ----  iti 
sūcayati | ataśca trayodaśe paṭale bhaviṣyati, atra ca vaktramantrāḥ
pūrvoktā eva iti teṣāṃ sakalabhaṭṭārakatadaṅgavatpadavācyatvābhāvāt
bījākṣararūpatvamevāsti, iti niṣkalabhaṭṭārakatadaṅgavat na 
punarvaktramantrāntarainīṣkalīkaraṇaṃ kṛtam śāktasphāratvādasya 
nayasya || 

bhagavatyā mantramāha ---- 


haraīma akāraśca ṅādirosvarasaṃyutaḥ || 1-73 || 

yānta ekārasaṃyuktaḥ ṣādirlāntavibheditaḥ | 

lādistrisvarasambhinno haṃso bindusamāyutaḥ || 1-74 || 

ṣaṣṭhasvarasamopetaḥ phaṭkārāntavikalpitaḥ | 

aghoreśvarīti vikhyātā svacchandotsaṅgagāminī || 1-75 || 


hakārarephāvanackau, akārasyoccāraṇatvāt tena haśca raśca īśca
maśca tena "haraīmo" militāḥ ekaṃ bījam, akāraḥ a, ṅādiḥ 
ṅakārasyādiḥ ghaḥ, osvareṇa yuktaḥ gho, yāntaḥ rephaḥ, ekāreṇa 
yuktaḥ re, ṣādiḥ śakāra, lāntena vakāreṇa vibheditaḥ miśritaḥ śva, 
lasyādiḥ rephaḥ, trisvareṇa ikāreṇa miśritaḥ ri, haṃsa ityādinā 
catuṣkalasvarūpaṃ yojayan sakalaniṣkalaikyasphārasāraiṣā devīti 
prathayati | haṃsaḥ hakāra anac, bindusamāyutaḥ ṣaṣṭhasvareṇa 
ūkāreṇa samopetaḥ hū�, phaṭkāreṇa ante viśeṣeṇa kalpitaḥ nityameva 
krūrajātiyuktaḥ, ata eva aśeṣabhedadāhātmānugrahaikapravaṇaḥ, ata eva 
vyākhyātasvarūpāghorākhyaśakticakrasvāminī viśeṣeṇa khyātā 
qphurattāsāratayā dyotamānā, śrīmataḥ 
svacchandabhairavasyotsaṅgagāminī nityāviyutā 
unmanāntakordhvasaṅgaprasarasārā tatprakāśapravaṇā ca ityarthaḥ || 75 
|| 

atha ca ākṛtimato bhagavato'ṅkagatāyā devyā aṅgavaktrāṇi yojayitumāha 
---- 


bhairavāṅgasamopetā vaktrapañcakasaṃyutā | 


bhairavaśabdena samanantarapratipādito mukhyo niṣkala evātra vivakṣitaḥ, 
tena niṣkalāṅgānyeva tadavibhedasārāyā devyāḥ aṅgāni | 
"vaktrapañcakasaṃyutā" iti sāmānyoktyā sakalaniṣkalamantraikarūpāyāḥ 
śrīdevyāḥ pūrvoktabījakalpyāni 
sakalaniṣkalabhaṭṭārakavadavibhaktānyeva vaktrāṇi || 


atha śrīsvacchandabhairavaraśmipuñjātmano bhairavāṣṭakasya mantrānāha 
---- 


hānto yādiryakārānto rādiḥ ṣaṣṭhakalānvitaḥ || 1-76 || 


bindunādasamāyogāt kapāleśaḥ prakītītaḥ | 


hasyāntaḥ kṣakāraḥ anac kṣ, yasyādiḥ m, yakārasyāntaḥ r, rasyādiḥ
y, tena "kṣmry" iti krameṇa miśrīkṛtya ṣaṣṭhakalayā ūkāreṇānvitaḥ
bindunādābhyāmardhacandrāderapi svīkārāt 
vindvardhacandrādiparipāṭyāḥ samyagiti vakṣyamāṇavyākhyānusāram, ā 
samantāt paratattvaikyāpattirūpāt yogāt, ayaṃ kapāleśa uktaḥ, 
mantrāṇāṃ mantradevataikātmatvāt, evamanyatra || 


sānto binduradho hyagniḥ ṣaṣṭhayuktastu kītītaḥ || 1-77 || 


śikhivāhanasaṃjñastu jñātavyo'sau varānane | 


sāntaḥ h, tasyādho'gniḥ r, ṣaṣṭhaḥ ūkāraḥ, 
bindunādādyupalakṣaṇaparaḥ || 77 || 


saṃhāraḥ ṣaṣṭhasaṃyuktaḥ ṣaḍantena samanvitaḥ || 1-78 || 

krodharājaḥ samākhyātaḥ.............


saṃhāraḥ kṣ, ṣaṣṭhena svareṇa ūkāreṇa saṃyuktaḥ, tathā ṣaṇṇāṃ
vargāṇāṃ akacaṭatapavargāṇāmantena makāreṇa anusvāroccāraṇātmanā
yuktaḥ, arthāt bindvādiyukto'pi || 


.............ṭathānyaṃ kathayāmi te | 

ñādiḥ ṣaṣṭhasvaropetastripadena samāyutaḥ || 1-79 || 

bindumastakasambhinno vikarālo varānane | 	


ñādiḥ jh, tripadena icchājñānakriyāvyāptisāreṇa, anyatra 
triśūlaśabdābhihitena aukāreṇa samāyuktaḥ, ṣaṣṭhena ca 
ukāreṇopetaḥ, aukārānusaraṇanyāyenoccāratāyuktaḥ || 79 || 


sāntaḥ śādyena saṃyuktaḥ ṣaṣṭhasvarayuto'pyadhaḥ || 1-80 || 

caturdaśasvarākrānto bindunādāntabhūṣitaḥ | 

manmathaḥ kathito hyeṣa surasiddhanamaskṛtaḥ || 1-81 || 

yenedantu jitaṃ sarvaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam | 


sāntaḥ h, śakārasya tālavyasya ādyaḥ v, ṣaṣṭhaḥ ū, caturdaśasvaraḥ
au, etadakṣarasaṃghātātmāyaṃ mantro vindvādiyuktaḥ || 81 || 


hararādisamāyuktaḥ ūkārādhaḥ sabindukaḥ || 1-82 || 

meghanādeśvaro hyeṣa bhairavaḥ samprakītītaḥ | 


akārasya uccāraṇārthatvāt h-r, rasyādinā anackena yakāreṇa yuktaḥ
sabindukaḥ || 82 || 


kṣasāntabīndusaṃyuktaḥ pañcamena vibheditaḥ || 1-83 || 

someśvaraḥ samākhyāto janmamṛtyuvināśanaḥ | 


kṣasayoḥ kṣakārasakārayoḥ, antarmadhye "h" pañcamena ukāreṇa
vibhedita uccāryamantrarūpatāmāpāditaḥ | 


kṣādiryāntasamopeto hāntenādhoniyojitaḥ || 1-84 || 

bhānto vādirlakārānto rādyo'dhorudrayojitaḥ | 

bindvardhendusamāyukto nādaśaktisamanvitaḥ || 1-85 || 

vidyārājaḥ samākhyāto mahāpātakanāśanaḥ | 


kṣādiḥ h, yasyāntaḥ r, hasyāntaḥ kṣ, bhasyāntaḥ m, vasyādiḥ l,
lakārasyāntaḥ v, rasyādibhūtaṃ bījaṃ y, adho rudraḥ ūkāraḥ,
evamūkārāntā aṣṭauvarṇāḥ, gṛhītanādādivyāptiko vindurnavama 
ityayaṃ navātmā, mahāpātakanāśana iti pūrvavat | ete ca navame paṭale
vakṣyamāṇatattatsiddhisādhakatvādevamabhidhānā uktāḥ || 85 || 

evaṃ ca


bhairavāṣṭakametaddhi parivāraḥ prakītītaḥ || 1-86 || 


saṃsāryanugrahāya gṛhītākārasya parabhairavasya 
raśmipuñjasthānīyametadbhairavāṣṭakaṃ dvitīyapaṭale 
pradarśayiṣyamāṇadhyānasvarūpam || 86 || 

jagadadhiṣṭhātṝṇāṃ lokapālānāṃ 
bhagavacchaktirūpakapāleśādyadhiṣṭhitānāṃ tadvyāptyaiva lokottarayā 
pūjyānāṃ mantrān vaktumāha ---- 


laukapālāṃstathoddhṛtya svanāmapraṇavādikān | 

namaskārāvamānāṃśca sāstrānsaṃparikalpayet || 1-87 || 


svanāmnā praṇava ādiryeṣāmiti vigrahaḥ | sāstrānityanena astrāṇi
na pṛthagāvaraṇatayā kalpayet, api tu "oṃ indrāya vajrahastāya
namaḥ" ityādi krameṇa agniyamanirṛtivaruṇavāyukubereśānān 
śaktidaṇḍakhaṅgapāśadhvajagadātriśūlahastāṃścaturthyantān
praṇavādinamaskārāntān ekāvaraṇatayā kalpayet, iti śikṣayati | 

"bhairavāṣṭakarūpeṇa dhyātavyā" (2-125)

iti vakṣyamāṇatvādiha lokapālāṣṭakameva, na tvanyatreva taddaśakam | 
asmin mantrapaṭale śmaśānādhipamantrā bhāvino'pi noddhṛtāḥ teṣāṃ 
yadyekaviṣayatvāt "uddhṛtya parikalpayet" iti vācoyuktyā 
samanantarapaṭalabhāvino nyāsapūjāvidheḥ prakāramupakṣipan pāṭalikīṃ 
saṃgati darśayati bhagavān || 87 || 

"adhvānaṃ sakalaṃ nimajjya susitāṃ cinmūtīmunmajjya tāṃ
kṛtvā bhairavarūpiṇīṃ tadakhilaṃ rūpaṃ tritattvātmakam | 
śaktitraidhamayaṃ vilāyya parame svacchandadhāmni sphurattacchaktiprathitaṃ
tadātma nikhilaṃ lokeśvarāntaṃ numaḥ ||"

"gatānugatikaproktavyākhyābhedatamo'panut | 

parābhedarasollāsī svacchandoddyota utthitaḥ ||"


iti śrīsvacchandatantre 
śrīmahāmāheśvarācāryavaryaśrīkṣemarājaviracitoddyotākhyavyākhyopete
mantroddhāraprakāśanaṃ nāma prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ || 1 || 





dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ


" svacchandodyotaḥ "


vigalati bhavadaurgatyaṃ mokṣaśrīḥ śrayati hṛtkajaṃ kacati | 

prasarati paramānando yatra tadīśārcanaṃ jayati || 


praśnoddeśakrameṇa prāptāvasaraṃ kālasvarūpaṃ kāmyavannityavidhau 
prāyeṇa anupayogāt bahuvaktavyatvācca anabhidhāya, yatraiṣāṃ 
mantrāṇāṃ sādhakatamatvaṃ yena ca mantrāḥ phaladā bhavanti, 
tamarthasaṅgatyā prāptapratipādanāvakāśamarcājapahomādividhiṃ 
prakāśayituṃ dvitīyapaṭalārambhaḥ | tatra ṅityapūrvaṃ naimittikam" iti 
nityameva tāvadvidhiṃ pradarśayituṃ 


śrībhairava uvāca ---- 


athārcanaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ | 


atheti mantraprakāśānantaraṃ, snānanyāsāvāhanāderjapahomādeśca
arcanāṅgabhūtatvādaṅgibhūtamarcanameva, prakarṣeṇa iti vaitatyena,
vakṣyāmi | yathāvaditi garbhīkṛtavyāptiṃsatattvatayā, anupūrvaśa
iti snānaśaucādikrameṇa | yata iyamarcanakriyā pākakriyāvat 
anekāvayavakriyārambhapūtīḥ, ataḥ 
snānādyavayavakriyābhighātapuraḥsaraṃ tatpratipādanam, na ca 
akṛtaśuddheḥ snānādhikāra iti śaucapuraḥsarameva snānaṃ darśayati ---
- 


śaucaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ snānaṃ kartavyaṃ tu mṛdambhasā || 2-1 || 

śucisthānānmṛdaṃ pūrvaṃ gṛhītvāstreṇa śodhitām | 

prakṣālya jalatīraṃ tu sthāpayettāṃ varānane || 2-2 || 


astreṇeti śthūle karmaṇi niṣkalasya anadhikarāt" sakalena 
tṛṇakeśaparṇakāṣṭhādi, astramantreṇa coddharet || 2 || 


bhāgadvayaṃ tato'streṇa kartavyaṃ tu kṛśodari | 

tata iti = śodhitāyāḥ mṛdaḥ || 


bhāgārdhena kaṭiṃ corū jaṅghe pādau tathaiva ca || 2-3 || 

kṣālayeta yathānyāyaṃ trirantaritayogataḥ | 


bhāgārdheneti ---- ekabhāgasya saṃbandhinā ardhena 
śrīpūrvādyuktanītyā
saṃhārakrameṇa ādau pādau prakṣālya jaṅghorukaṭi kṣālayet iti
yathānyāyaśabdārthaḥ, trīn vārāṃstriḥ madhye bhavatā hastakṣālanena
antarito yo yogaḥ kṣālanasaṃbandhastataḥ pādau prakṣālya hastau
kṣālayet tato jaṅghe tato hastau tata ūrū tato hastau tataḥ kaṭiṃ
tato'pi hastau iti madhye trireva hastakṣālanam iti "trirantaritayogataḥ"
śabdasyārthaḥ, uktaṃ ca śrīmṛtyujiti ---- 

"pādau jaṅghe karau corū mṛtsnābhistisṛbhiḥ kramāt | 

trirantaritayogena saptabhiḥ śodhayet punaḥ ||"

iti | punaḥ paścāt saptabhirhastau kṣālayedityarthaḥ | na tu 
tisṛbhirhastāviti vyākhyeyam, dravyābhyāvṛttau sujabhāvāt | yattu 
tisṛbhirmātrābhimṛdbhāgairantarito yato yoga iti kenacitpaṭhitvā 
vyākhyātam, tadatyantāsamanvitatvādupekṣyam || 3 || 


avaśiṣṭaṃ tu bhāgārdhaṃ gṛhītvāstrābhimantritam || 2-4 || 

saptavārānvarārohe arkadīptaṃ tu kārayet | 


avaśiṣṭamiti ekasmādbhāgāt | arkadīptamiti karābhyāṃ mṛditvā | 
sūryaspṛṣṭaṃ tadadarśane prāṇaspṛṣṭaṃ vā kṛtvā || 4 || 
tenaiva ---- 


śiraḥprabhṛti pādāntamāguṇṭhya snānamācaret || 2-5 || 


śuddhatattvasṛṣṭivyāptyaitat | tadāguṇṭhyeti liptvā || 5 || 


uttīryodakamadhyāttu upaspṛśya yathākramam | 

saṃdhyāyā vandanaṃ kuryācchāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 2-6 || 


upasparśanamācamanam, tatra cāntaḥ sūkṣmadehaśuddhyarthaṃ praṇavena
trirapāṃ pānam, dviḥsṛkvimārjanam, cakṣurādidvārasparśanaṃ ceti
yathākramaśabdārthaḥ, śāstradrṛṣṭena vedādisiddhena || 6 || 


malasnānaṃ bhavedevaṃ vidhisnānaṃ pracakṣmahe | 

bhāgārdhaṃ yatsthitaṃ pūrvaṃ tato bhāgatrayaṃ kuru || 2-7 || 

vāmahastasya pūrve ca dakṣiṇe cottare kramāt | 


malasnānaṃ cittadehāśuddhiḥ | bhāgārdhamiti, ekasya bhāgasya samastasya
upayuktvād dvitīyabhāgaḥ sakalaḥ mṛdapekṣayā tvardham || 7 || 


pūrvabhāgaṃ tato'streṇa saptavārāṃstu mantrayet || 2-8 || 

dakṣiṇasthaṃ tathā vaktrairabhimantrya varānane | 

uttaraṃ cābhimantryaivaṃ devenāṅgayutena ca || 2-9 || 

pūrvabhāgaṃ gṛhītvā tu daśadikṣu vinikṣipet | 

uttareṇa tu bhāgena jalaṃ caivābhimantrayet || 2-10 || 

bāhumātrapramāṇena bhairaveśamanusmaran | 

ātmānaṃ guṇṭhayitvā tu dakṣabhāgena suvrate || 2-11 || 

snāyādrājopacāreṇa sugandhāmalakādibhiḥ | 


atraiva bhairavabhaṭṭārako yathādarśanaṃ sakalo niṣkalo vā, evameva
aṅgādyapi jñeyam | bāhumātrapramāṇenetisvābhimukhaṃ śivatīrthaṃ
hastamātraṃ prakalpayedityarthaḥ | rājāpacāreṇetigṛhasthānāṃ
sati saṃbhave sugandhāmalakādyabhyaṅgasnānaṃ vihitameva, na tu
naiṣṭhikavanniṣiddhamityarthaḥ || 11 || 


prāṇāyāmābhiṣekau tu kartavyau bhairaveṇa ca || 2-12 || 


prāṇāyāmaṃ kumbhakavṛttyā'vasthānam, abhiṣekaḥ unmajjanādanantaraṃ
kalaśamudrayā śirasi jalapātaḥ || 12 || 


uttīryodakamadhyāttu tadvāsaḥ parivartayet | 

upaspṛśya kṛtanyāso mūlamantramanusmaran || 2-13 || 

tīrthaṃ saṅgṛhya deveśi ātmano'gre nidhāpayet | 


nyāsakaraṇaṃ saṃkṣepeṇa mantraikādaśikayā, tīrthaṃ 
saṅgṛhyatiaṅkuśamudrayā ākṛṣya || 13 || 


tatrastho vandayet saṃdhyāṃ mārjanādiranukramāt || 2-14 || 

aghamarṣaḥ prakartavya upasthānaṃ divākare | 

japaṃ kṛtvā nivedyaivaṃ praṇamya ca varānane || 2-15 || 

mantrāṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā devānāmṛṣibhiḥ saha | 

sarveṣāṃ bhūtasaṃghānāṃ tatastīrthaṃ tu saṃharet || 2-16 || 

mūlamantramanusmṛtya................


hṛttāludvādaśāntaviśrāntiparayā mūlamantraparāmarśāt 
saṃdhyāvandanamidaṃ parameśvaramantrakrameṇa, pūrvaṃ tu 
vaidikairmantraiḥ taccāpi anivṛttaprāgjātivāsanaiḥ kāryam, itaraistu 
vidhisnānānantarameva śaivairmantraiḥ, yathoktam ---- 

"brāhmīṃ kuryānna vā karyācchaivīmeva niyogataḥ |" iti | 

evaṃ bhasmasnāne'pi dviḥ saṃdhyāvandanaṃ yojyam, vāmakaravipruṣāṃ
dakṣakaraśākhābhirastreṇādhaḥkṣepaḥ, vaktrāṅgamantraistu upari,
iti mārjanam, ādiśabdānmantrasaṃhitājaptadakṣakaravāriṇaḥ śirasi
kṣepaḥ taccaitadanukramāt, anukramaśca aghamarṣaṇādanantaraṃ
mārjanādi, tata upasthānamiti, īdṛśastatrāgamo dakṣiṇapāṇisthaṃ
jalaṃ sitarūpaṃ praṇavatejasoddīpitaṃ dakṣanāsāpuṭenaiva 
antaranupraviṣṭaṃ vāṅmanaḥ kāyamalakṣālanāt kṛṣṇarūpaṃ 
vāmanāsāpuṭāt bahinīḥsṛtaṃ dhyātvādhaḥ kṣipet, iti, 
īdṛśamupasthānamiti parameśvaraśaktyātmasūryasaṃmukhaṃ 
mantrasaṃhitayā añjalikṣepaḥ, tato yathāśakti japaṃ kṛtvā hṛtsthāya
śrībhagavate pūrakeṇa nivedya 
śarīrādiprahvībhāvonmagnaparasvarūpānupraveśarūpaṃ praṇāmam, 
svakalpamantrāṇāṃ jalena tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā "devebhyo namaḥ" 
ityādikrameṇa devaṣībhūtasaṃghānāṃ tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā, 
mūlamantramanusmṛtya, saṃhāramudrayā śivatīrthaṃ saṃharet svātmani 
anupraviṣṭaṃ dhyāyet || 16 || 

evaṃ jalasnānamuktvā bhasmasnānaṃ naiṣṭhikasyāvaśyakam, gṛhasthasya
kāmacārādvaktumāha ---- 


................bhasmasnānamataḥ param | 


ucyate iti śeṣaḥ, tantrāntaroktavidhisādhitam astrābhimantritaṃ
bhasma kṛtvā, ā kāddhṛdayāvadhi, ā pādācchirontaṃ hṛdantaṃ vā
saṃhārakrameṇa bhasma kṛtvā iti samuddhūlya || 


malasnānaṃ prakartavyaṃ bhāvitenāntarātmanā || 2-17 || 


prasannena cittena || 17 || 


parivṛttya tato vāsaḥ saṃdhyāṃ prāgiva vandayet | 


jalenaiva || 


vidhisnānaṃ tataḥ kuryād bhairaveśamanusmaran || 2-18 || 


bhairavavyāptimātmano vibhāvayan || 18 || 


śiro vaktraṃ ca hṛdguhyaṃ pādāntaṃ ca vibhāgaśaḥ | 

bhairaveṇāṅgayuktena samuddhūlyaṃ yathākramam || 2-19 || 


sāṅgena mūlena bhasma abhimantrya śuddhatattvasṛṣṭyarthaṃ  
mūrdhādipādāntamuddhūlayet || 19 || 

tato'pi ---- 


abhiṣekaṃ prakurvīta paraṃ tattvamanusmaran | 


niṣkalavīryamāviśan || 


saṃdhyāyā vandanaṃ kuryādyathāpūrvaṃ varānane || 2-20 || 


yathāpūrvamiti jalenaiva aghamarṣaṇādikaṃ kāryamityarthaḥ | abhiṣeko
mūlamantreṇa kalaśamudrayā bhasmamuṣṭeḥ śirasi kṣepaḥ, evaṃ 
bhasmasnānaṃ gṛhasthenāpi kāmataḥ kāryam, tantrāntaranidīṣṭanītyā 
tripuṇḍrakamātrameva vā gṛhasthena kāryam || 20 || 

evaṃ snānaṃ vidhāya arcāvidhiṃ kartumupakrameta ---- 


tato yāgagṛhaṃ gatvā hastau pādau ca kṣālayet | 

rathyādhūliliptau pādau tatsparśāddhastāvapi kṣālayet | 

śikhāṃ baddhvā śikhāṃ smṛtvā upaspṛśya vidhānataḥ || 2-21 || 


upaspṛśya ācamya, vidhānataḥ ekāgracittatayā, śikhāṃ śikhāmantraṃ
smṛtvā, śikhāṃ madhyaśaktim, baddhvā avaṣṭabhya || 21 || 

bāhyapūjādhikṛtatvamātmani janayituṃ saṃkṣepeṇa 
mantraikādaśikāsmaraṇena ---- 


sakalīkṛtadehastu puṣpamādāya suvrate | 

diṅmātṛbhyo namaskṛtya dvāraṃ saṃprokṣya yatnataḥ || 2-22 || 

śivāmbhasāstramantreṇa vighnaproccāṭanaṃ bhavet | 


śivāmbhasā iti vadan sāmānyārghapātramādau bāhyapūjārthaṃ kurvīteti
sūcayati || 22 || 

tataḥ ---- 


dvāraśākhordhvato devaṃ gaṇeśaṃ ca śriyaṃ tathā || 2-23 || 

saṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādyairdhūpādibhiranukramād | 

arghyapādyopahāraiśca................


"oṃ diṅmātṛbhyo namaḥ" iti kusumaṃ kṣiptvā, āyatane yāgagṛhe bāhye 
vā vyomni prabhāmaṇḍalavṛṣaśūlasūryān 
bāhyaparivāraniṣṭhordhvaḍambhare dvārasya dakṣiṇādvāmāntaṃ 
gaṇeśaṃ tathāśabdasamuccitāṃ vāgīśīṃ śriyaṃ ca praṇavādinamaḥ 
śabdāntena mantreṇa pūjayediti kramaḥ || 23 || 


............ṭato dvārasya cottare || 2-24 || 

nandigaṅge samabhyarcya mahākālaṃ ca dakṣiṇe | 

kālindīṃ caiva sampūjya yathānukramayogataḥ || 2-25 || 


kālindīṃ yamunām, dakṣiṇasrotasaḥ saṃhāraprādhānyānmahākālayamune
dvārasya dakṣiṇe eva pūjye | vāme tu nandigaṅge, 
śāktasphārasāratvāccāsya nayasya gupte svagṛhādau dvāravāmāt 
prabhṛti vāmakareṇa pūjayediti guravaḥ | eṣa ca dvāradevatākramaḥ 
śrītriśirobhairavasrotasi dṛśyate, kevalaṃ tatra 
dvāravāmadakṣiṇayodīṇḍimahodarāvadhikau pūjyāvuktau | vāmasrotobhede 
punaḥ sṛṣṭipradhāne dvārasya dakṣiṇe nandi-gaṅga-meṣāsyāḥ, vāme
tu mahākāla-yamunā-cchāgalāsyā iti kramaḥ, siddhānteṣu tu dvārasya
dakṣiṇe nandi-gaṅge vāme tu mahākāla-yamune | prāyaśca siddhāntapriyo
lokaḥ siddhāntakramamāśritaḥ, itīha lokottare bhairavasrotasi
bhagavadukta eva kramaḥ āśrayitavyo na tvanyathā bhramitavyam | ato
ye siddhāntadarśanabhrāntā bhagavaduktaṃ pūrvapaścimadvārāpekṣayā
viparyāsayanti te viparyastā eva || 25 || 

tataḥ ---- 


bhairavāstraṃ samuccārya puṣpaṃ saṅgṛhya bhāvitaḥ | 

saptābhimantritaṃ kṛtvā jvaladagniśikhākulam || 2-26 || 

nārācāstraprayogeṇa praviśed gṛhamadhyataḥ | 


atrādau dehalyarcāṃ kuryāt, bhairavāstramatidīptaṃ niṣkalāstrameva, 
jvaladityādi dhyānam, 
nārācāstraprayogastarjanīmadhyamāṅguṣṭhapreraṇāt, gṛhamadhyata iti, 
prakṣipanniti śeṣaḥ || 26 || 


nivāritaṃ tena sarvaṃ vighnajālamanantakam || 2-27 || 


bhāvayediti śeṣaḥ || 27 || 


tato rakṣārthamastraṃ ca daśadikṣu vinikṣipet | 


vighnānāṃ praveśāvakāśanāśāya || 

atha ---- 


madhye saṃpūjya brahmāṇaṃ gandhaiḥ puṣpairanukramāt || 2-28 || 

dakṣiṇāyāṃ tato mūrtau praṇavāsanasaṃsthitaḥ | 

upaviśyāsanaṃ baddhavā svabhyastaṃ vai puraḥsthitam || 2-29 || 


brahmāṇaṃ vāstvadhiṣṭhātāram | dakṣiṇāyām iti 
dakṣiṇasroto'nuṣṭhānapravṛttau, 
samastabhedaploṣakāghoravaktrasaṃmukhatvasyānurūpyāt; 
mantroddhāraprārambhe tvanuṣṭhānasyāpravṛtteḥ "prāṅmukhodaṅmukho vā" 
ityuktam | praṇavāsane vaṇītavyāptike samyagbhairavābhedābhimāne 
sthitaḥ || 29 || 

karanyāsamāha ---- 


gandhadigdhau karau kṛtvā astreṇa pariśodhayet | 

kavacenāvaguṇṭhyaitau plāvayedamṛtena tu || 2-30 || 

parāṃ śaktiṃ tu saṃkṣobhya.................


gandhena alaktakādinā, digdhau liptau, pariśodhayet kriyāśaktitvaṃ
prāpayet | parāṃ dvādaśāntasthaśivacandracandrikārūpāṃ śaktiṃ
saṃkṣobhyānaṅgadhenavīyuktyā prasaronmukhīṃ kṛtvā, "amṛtena"
parānandarasena, "plāvayet" ācchurayet | paścāt tathārūpatārakṣārthaṃ
kavacamantreṇāvaguṇṭhya || 30 || 


..............ṭato'nantaṃ prakalpayet | 


karaśuddhividhāne tattanmantrairnyāsa ucita eva kāryaḥ |  
tenopabāhudaṇḍāgragagranthiprāntavatīvidyāpadordhvāvasthitānāśritapre
tāntamanantāsanaṃ prāṅnarṇītatattvaṃ praṇavena kalpayet || 


mūtīṃ nyasyānuvaktrāṇi svacchandaṃ parikalpayet || 2-31 || 


mūtībrahmakavāṭakalāvaktranyāsādi prāgeva nirṇītam | ato yatra
yatrāyāti tatra tatra prathamapaṭalanirṇītavyāptiranusartavyā | 

śvacchandam"

iti sakalam || 31 || 

anantaram ---- 


aṅguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāntaṃ vinyasedaṅgapañcakam | 


ubhayorapi karayoḥ padmamudrāmāviṣṭayoḥ | "astraṃ nakheṣu" iti guravaḥ 
|| 

tataḥ ---- 


bhairavānapi saṅkalpya paraṃ tattvamanusmaret || 2-32 || 


"bhairavān" kapālīśādīnaṣṭau vāmatarjanīto dakṣiṇatarjanyantam,
paraṃ tattvaṃ niṣkalanāthaṃ sāṅgaṃ sadevīkam, arthāt 
sphāritāṅguṣṭhayoḥ, anusmaret viśvānugāmitvenānusandadhyāt | yadyapi 
karayoḥ piṇḍāvayavatvāt bhāvipiṇḍanyāsenaiva nyāsaḥ saṃpadyate, 
tathāpi sarvakarmapravṛttiprathamāṅkurakalpayor 
bhagvatkriyāśaktimayatvapratyabhijñānāyatayordehanyāsāt pūrvaṃ 
sarvāgameṣu nyāsa ucyamāna upapanna eva | śivahastastvanyādṛgeva 
viśiṣṭavidhiviṣayaḥ || 32 || 

evaṃ karanyāsamuktvā dehanyāse itikartavyatāmāha ---- 


prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kāryaṃ dehasaṃśuddhikāraṇam | 


iha caitanyaviśleṣapūvīkāṃ dehadāhotplāvanāpyāyanādimayīṃ 
śuddhimādhāya bhairavātmatāpattiḥ kāryā | caitanyasya ca ---- 

"prāksaṃvitprāṇe pariṇatā |"

iti nītyā prāṇenaiva viśodhanaṃ kāryam | na cāśuddhena tena tatkartuṃ
śakyamiti prathamaṃ tacchuddhiḥ | dehasyāśuddhasya puryaṣṭakarūpasya
saṃśuddhikāraṇam || 

tatpradarśayaṃścaitanyaviśleṣaṃ vaktumāha ---- 


aśuddhaḥ svamarudrecyaḥ śuddhenāpūrayettanum || 2-33 || 

kumbhakaṃ recakaṃ kṛtvā vyomnyātmānaṃ nidhāpayet | 


"aśuddhaḥ" iti bahiḥprasare hevākacāñcalyaprābalyollāsitavikalpatayā
jīvasya pāśatvena sthitaḥ | "recyaḥ" iti svarasavāhapraśamanena 
bhogadvādaśānte niveśyaḥ | "śuddhena" iti 
dvādaśāntaviśrāntilabdhaśāktabalena | ā samantāt svarasavāhanirodhena 
pūrayet tacchāktasparśenācchurayet | āpūryaivaṃ kaṃcitkālaṃ 
praveśanirodhena balalābhāya hṛdayānmūlapīṭhāntaṃ 
pūrṇakumbhavadacalasthityā sthāpayet | tataḥ 
kumbhakaprakarṣalabdhaśāktabalena tena 
vakṣyamāṇadivyakaraṇānusaraṇayuktayordhvarecakaṃ kṛtvā 
prāṇāśrayamātmānaṃ vyomni muṇḍānte viśrāmayet | eṣa ca 
praṇavoccārasagarbhaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ kāryaḥ | atra ca recanādau 
vyomaviśrāntyante pañcake dhāraṇāpañcakaṃ manasā 
sūkṣmabhujayānusaṃdhāyāvikalpaviśrāntyā mano'haṅkārabuddhīḥ 
paratattve vilāpya viśrāmyet | evaṃ sūkṣmaśarīraśuddhirbhavati,
iti guravaḥ || 33 || 

kiṃrūpamātmānamityāha ---- 


khadyotaianibhaṃ sūkṣmaṃ karaṇaistu vivajītam || 2-34 || 

kāryeṇaiva vihīnaṃ ca māyāpradhvastagocaram | 


khadyotakanibhaṃ prakāśamātratattvam, sūkṣmam avedyam, karaṇaiḥ 
trayodaśabhirindriyaiḥ kāryeṇa sthūlasūkṣmātmanā daśavidhena, 
pradhvasto māyāgocaraḥ kālaniyatyādiryasya, iti vyatyayaḥ pūrvanipātasya 
|| 34 || 

evaṃ śuddhatāmāpādito'pi ---- 


śivīkāryastathātmaiva yathā bhavati tacchṛṇu || 2-35 || 


"śivo bhūtvā śivaṃ yajet |"

iti nyāyāt | śṛṇu antaḥ parāmṛśa || 35 || 


paraṃ bhāvaṃ tu saṅgṛhya................


"ahameva paro haṃsaḥ śivaḥ paramakāraṇam" (4-399)

ityādau vakṣyamāṇaṃ paraṃ svabhāvam, samyagiti avikalpāvaṣṭambhena,
gṛhītvā svīkṛtya || 

ata eva sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāriparameśasvarūpasamāveśāt ---- 


........ṭataḥ śoṣyā tanuḥ priye | 


sūkṣmāyāḥ śuddhatvāt sthūlā || 


katham ---- 


saṃhāreṇa yabhinnena rudrabījayutena ca || 2-36 || 


saṃhāraḥ kṣ īśānasphārarūpo yabhinno ya ityanena yuktaḥ, rudrabījam
ūkāraḥ, bindurarthākṣiptaḥ | evamanyatra | atra dehe pāthīkā 
dhāraṇāṃ kṛtvā tacchoṣaṇe vāyavī dhāraṇā smartavyā | tanoḥ 
śoṣo'hantābhimānarasatanūbhāvaḥ || 36 || 


tenaiva dahanaṃ kāryamūrdhvādho'gniyutena ca | 


tenaivedānīṃ nirṇītatattvena saṃhāreṇa, ūrdhvādho'gninā repheṇa
yuktena tena r kṣ r y ū� iti piṇḍīkṛtabījākṣareṇāgneyyā dhāraṇayā
kālāgninā ā pādānmuṇḍāntaṃ dahanam, iti ahantābhimānapāśasya
ploṣaṇaṃ kāryam || 


adho viṣṇusamāyukto vāyuvarṇaḥ sabindukaḥ || 2-37 || 


utpūyanakaro hyeṣa..................


viṣṇurukāraḥ, vāyuvarṇo y, utpūyanamutplavanam, pluṣṭasyāpi 
dehābhimānasya saṃskāraśeṣasya vāyavyā dhāraṇayaiva nirdhūnanam || 37 
|| 


..........plāvane vāruṇaḥ smṛtaḥ | 

bindumastakasaṃbhinnaḥ................


vāruṇo vakāraḥ sabinduko vāruṇadhāraṇayā 
ūrdhvadvādaśāntādadhomukhaṃ pravṛttaiḥ 
pūrṇacandrākārabinduprasaratsitaprakāśavāripūrairaśeṣaplāvakaḥ 
smṛtaḥ, sa plāvane bhāviśuddhasargabhittiviracane prabhavatītyarthaḥ | 
sarvāṇi caitāni bījāni parasvasvabhāvaprabhāvaprabhāśrū(bhū)tāni 
vicintyāni | atra ca viṣasyeva mārakatvaṃ mantrayuktyā 
dehasyāhamabhimānātmakapāśarūpatvaṃ dahyate, pratidinaṃ 
tadabhyāsaprakarṣeṇa ca śivāhantojjṛmbhate, na tu sākṣād deho dahyate, 
pratyakṣabādhāt | ata evānādidehāhaṅkārasyāpasāryatvāt pratyahaṃ 
śuddhātmasthitigrahaṇatadānayanāmṛtaplāvanabhairavatāpādanādi 
kriyamāṇaṃ yuktameva || 

evamaśuddhadehasaṃhārayuktimuktvā śuddhadehasṛṣṭiṃ vaktumāha ---- 


.......śaktinyāsastato bhavet || 2-38 || 


tato dehadāhādyanantaraṃ viśvavaicitryaṃ bibhratyāḥ pārameśvaryā
manonmanikāyāḥ śakterbhāvimantramayaśuddhadehanirmāṇabhittibhūtāyā
nyāso bhavet || 38 || 

tadanu ---- 


ānayettaṃ yathānītaṃ plāvayedamṛtena tu | 


yatheti madhyamārgordhvarecakeṇa nītaṃ tam ātmānamūrdhvarecakeṇaiva
ānayet śaktidehasya madhyaṃ hṛdayaṃ kalpanayā prāpayet, amṛtena 
parabhāvasamāveśāvaṣṭambharasena, plāvayet bherevābhedaparāmarśamayaṃ
kuryādityarthaḥ | tathābhūtameva nītaṃ tamānayet || 

kīdṛśaṃ ca ---- 


malapradhvastacaitanyaṃ kalāvidyāsamāśritam || 2-39 || 

rāgeṇa rañjitātmānaṃ kālena kalitaṃ tathā | 

niyatyā yamitaṃ bhūyaḥ puṃbhāvenopabṛṃhitam || 2-40 || 

pradhānāśayasaṃpannaṃ guṇatrayasamanvitam | 

buddhitattvasamāsīnamahaṅkārasamāvṛtam	 || 2-41 || 

manasā buddhikarmākṣaistanmātraiḥ sthūlabhūtakaiḥ | 


yuktamiti śeṣaḥ | nayanānayanapātratvādeva saṅkocābhāsarūpeṇa malena 
pradhvastaṃ guṇībhūtaṃ caitanyaṃ yasya, ata eva 
kiñcitkartṛtvajñātṛtvarūpābhyāṃ kalāvidyābhyāṃ samāśritam | 
evamanyat | anyeṣāṃ ca kalādīnāṃ svarūpamuttaratra svāvasare 
nirṇeṣyāmaḥ || 41 || 

yadetanmāyādikṣityantaṃ tattvajātam ---- 


praṇavena tu sarvaṃ taccharīrotpattikāraṇam || 2-42 || 

nyasetkrameṇa deveśi triṃśadekaṃ ca saṃkhyayā | 


śarīrotpatteḥ kāraṇaṃ māyādikṣityantaṃ tattvāni ekatriṃśataṃ
praṇavena śrīmanniṣkalabhaṭṭārakatulyavyāptikena 
śuddhadehotpattyarthaṃ nyaset | praṇavanyāsāccaitāni 
prāgdaśāto'nyādṛṃśyeva (bhavanti) | tathāhi ---- akhyātirūpā
māyā bhedaprāgalbhyāvimohinī asya, kalā 
pūjādhyānādikiṃcitkartṛtvonmīlikā, vidyā tāttvikavivekapradā, rāgo 
bhaktyabhiṣvaṅgapradaḥ, kālaḥ upadeśādiviṣayakalanāpradaḥ, niyatiḥ 
bhagavadārādhanādau niyāmikā, puṃbhāvaḥ "ahaṃ śiva eva" iti 
prathāprarohakaḥ | evamanyat || 42 || 

asyāstattvaikatriṃśato madhyāt ---- 


ṣaṭtattvī tvātmasaṃbaddhā jñātavyātra varānane || 2-43 || 


māyādiniyatyantā kañcukarūpā ṣaṭtattvī ātmanaḥ puṃstattvasya
taṇḍulakambukavat samyagālakṣya pṛthaktayā baddhā jñātavyā, na
tvasyāmātmābhedo grāhyaḥ | evamātmanaḥ paro dehaḥ || 43 || 

sthūlasūkṣmau yugapadāha ---- 


pradhānāvaniparyantaṃ śarīraṃ ca vinimītam | 


jñātavyamiti liṅgavipariṇāmāt | vinimītaṃ kṛttrimaṃ na tu 
tāttvikamityarthaḥ || 

atra ca ---- 


catuvīṃśatitattvāni caitanyarahitāni tu || 2-44 || 

draṣṭavyāni varārohe................

draṣṭavyāni vedyatayaiva niśceyāni || 44 || 


yadyetānyacetanāni kathametāni dṛśyante ? ityāha ---- 


.........puruṣādhiṣṭhitāni tu | 

sacetanāni sarvāṇi jñātavyāni sadaiva hi || 2-45 || 


adhiṣṭhitatā kalodvalitasvakartṛtācchuraṇam, jñātavyāni 
ahantāpahastanena vedyarūpāṇi boddhavyāni, buddherapi vṛttidvāreṇa 
vedyatvāt | vedyatvādevaitāni taṇḍulatuṣavad bahiraṅgāni | ṣaṭtattvī 
tu ātmano'ntaraṅgapradhānasya saṃvedyaparvatvamiti || 45 || 

tena saha ---- 


pañcaviṃśakametacca prākṛtaṃ samudāhṛtam | 


prakṛtireva prākṛtam, prakṛterāyātaṃ ca prākṛtaṃ 
guṇādikṣityantameva | "oṃ śuddhadehāya namaḥ" iti mantreṇa 
yugapatṣaṭtattvīrūpaṃ param, tanmātrāntaḥkaraṇarūpaṃ sūkṣmam, 
pṛthivyādirūpaṃ ca sthūlaṃ parāmṛtaplāvitasyātmano dehaṃ nyaset || 

tāmeva śuddharūpatāṃ sphuṭayitumāha ---- 


tato mūtīṃ nyased devi mūlamantrasulakṣitam || 2-46 || 

sakalaṃ bhairavaṃ nyasya dvātriṃśārṇaṃ sulocane | 

mukhāni kalpayetpaścānmūrdhādicaraṇāvadhi || 2-47 || 

vaktrāṇi kalpayet paścādūrdhvaṃ pūrvaṃ ca dakṣiṇam | 

uttaraṃ paścimaṃ caiva yathāvatpravibhāgaśaḥ || 2-48 || 

kalābhedaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ śodhyādhvānaṃ prakalpayet | 

navatattvaṃ tritattvaṃ ca vidyāṅgā locanatrayam || 2-49 || 

vargātītena kṣurikāmūrdhvādho'gnipradīpitām | 

ṣoḍaśāntargatā sā tu rakṣikā vighnanāśikā || 2-50 || 

navakaṃ kalpayet paścāt rmūdhni vaktre ca kaṇṭhake | 

hṛdaye nābhideśe ca guhya ūrvośca jānutaḥ || 2-51 || 

pādāntaṃ caiva vinyasya svadhyānaguṇasaṃyutam | 

kriyājñāne tathecchā ca dakṣe vāme ca madhyataḥ || 2-52 || 

vidyārājaḥ smṛto hyeṣa bhairavo mantranāyakaḥ | 


sarvametatprathamapaṭala eva yathā nirṇītasatattvaṃ tathehottaratrāpi
cānusaṃdheyam, viṣamamatiriktaṃ ca vyākriyate | mukhānīti kṣādīni,
mūrdhādīti daṇḍabhaṅgyā sahāyameva kramo yukto bhairavanyāsāntaṃ
sṛṣṭikramasya sthitatvādityuktatvāt; ato na 
naiṣṭhikābhiprāyeṇānyathā
vyākhyeyam | yathāvatpravibhāgaśa iti kavāṭavaktrabhaṅgibhyām | 
śodhyādhvānam iti sakalanyāsānte kalādyekatamamadhvānaṃ bhāviyuktyā 
garbhīkṛtetarādhvapañcakanyāsādivaśena śodhanīyaṃ dīkṣāyāmeva 
kalpayet | yadvakṣyati ---- 

"dīkṣākāle tu deveśi śodhyādhvānaṃ prakalpayet" (2-273)

iti | vidyāṅgā iti saśo'tra ā-ādeśaḥ, vidyāṅgānītyarthaḥ | 
kṣurikāmantraḥ kaṭyāṃ nyasyaḥ, sa pūrvamanuktatvādihoktaḥ | 
vargātītaḥ kṣ, agniḥ r, ṣoḍaśāntaḥ ṣoḍaśasvarāṇāmantaḥ aḥ, 
navakam iti śrīsvacchandeśakapālīśādyaṣṭakopetam | asya rmūdhni 
ityādinā nirdeśaḥ | svasthā (dhyā) nādi samanantaraṃ bhaviṣyati | 
kriyetyādi pāṭhakramādarthakramasya balīyastvāt ---- 

"jyeṣṭhājñāne tathā dakṣe kriyā vāmā tathottare" (7-152)

iti bhāvigranthenaikārthatvāt prādhānyācca dakṣiṇe jñānaśaktervāme
kriyāśakternyāsaḥ || 52 || 

paranyāsamāha ---- 


niṣkalaṃ tu tathāvāhya aṅgānyevaṃ yathākramam || 2-53 || 


nyasedityeva | ā samantāt dvādaśāntādvāhayitvā avatāryetyarthaḥ | 
evamityāvāhya, aṅgāni ca sarvajñatvādiguṇaṣaṭkarūpāṇīti 
pūrvamevoktam | tenātrāṅgatrāṇarūpāṇyaṅgānīti
tantrāntarayojanamasat | aṅganyāsāvasare mudrāṣaṭkabandhaḥ
kāryaḥ iti guravaḥ | tatra hṛdi nilīnāṅguṣṭhā muṣṭiḥ, 
saivocchiratāṅguṣṭhā śirasi, ucchiratatarjanīkā śikhāyāṃ, 
parasparāntaritāṅguli pāṇidvayaṃ kavace, 
madhyamātarjanyanāmikābhirnetratrayasparśo netre, 
tarjanyaṅguṣṭhacchoṭikādarśanamastre || 53 || 

āvāhanānantaram ---- 


gandhairdhūpaistathā puṣpaivīvidhairbhakṣyabhojanaiḥ | 

pūjayed devadeveśaṃ manasaiva prakalpitaiḥ || 2-54 || 


evaṃ ca ---- 


ātmānaṃ bhairavaṃ dhyātvā tato hṛdyāgamācaret | 


puryaṣṭakaśarīramapi bhairavīkartumayaṃ prakrama ārabdhaḥ || 54 || 


tatra yājyasya bhairavarūpasyātmana āsananyāsaṃ tāvadvitatya  nirūpayati 
---- 


nābhau kandaṃ samāropya nālaṃ tu dvādaśāṅgulam || 2-55 || 

hṛdantaṃ kalpayedyāvattatra padmaṃ vicintayet | 

aṣṭapatraṃ mahādīptaṃ kesarālaṃ sakaṇīkam || 2-56 || 


kandaṃ padmotpattimūlam, samāropya parikalpya, mattagandhapīḍanayuktyā
ca kandaṃ nābhau nābhiviṣaye samāropya ullāsya, nālaṃ 
prāṇaśaktirūpam, nābhihṛdayāntarālasya dvādaśāṅgulatvāt 
dvādaśāṅgulamityuktam || 55-56 || 

atra vyāptimāha ---- 


kandaṃ śaktimayaṃ tatra nāle vai kaṇṭakāstu ye | 

bhuvanāni ca tānyeva rudrāṇāṃ varavaṇīni || 2-57 || 

māyātmako bhaved granthiraśuddhādhvavyavasthitaḥ | 

vidyāpadmaṃ mahādīptaṃ kaṇīkābījarājitam || 2-58 || 

puṣkarāṇi ca deveśi tatra vidyeśvarāḥ smṛtāḥ | 

evaṃ dhyātvā mahāpadmaṃ sarvadevamayaṃ śubham || 2-59 || 


kalpayedityanuvartate | śaktiricchātmā pārameśvarī ādhārabhūtā
yasyāṃ viśvamidamādhirayate sā "vyomākārām" iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt
garbhīkṛtadharāditattvacatuṣṭayā | yathoktaṃ śrīpūrvaśāstre ---- 

"ādāvādhāraśaktiṃ tu nābhyadhaścaturaṅgulām | 

dharāṃ surodaṃ potaṃ ca kandaśceti catuṣṭayam ||" (8-55)

iti | tatra aptattvavyāptyā surārṇavam, tejovyāptyā khyātaṃ (potam),
prāṇaprasūtihetuṃ vyūhātmakaṃ vāyuvyāptyā kandamityevaṃvyaktikā
śaktiḥ prakṛtaṃ rūpaṃ yasya tatsāramityarthaḥ | ata eva 
aṅkuranālarūpāśeṣādhvavyakteḥ tatra 
gandhatanmātrādikalātattvāntanālavyāptiḥ | rudrāṇāmiti 
tattattattvādhiṣṭhātṛṇām | mahādīptamiti 
śuddhādhvavartyaśeṣamantratejomayatvāt | puṣkarāṇi bījāni | 
vidyeśvarāḥ anantabhaṭṭārakādyāḥ śikhaṇḍyantāḥ | evaṃ
kandanālagranthidalakaṇīkābījarūpaṃ ṣaḍutthamāsanaṃ prasiddham || 59 
|| 

āsananyāse kramamāha ---- 


śaktinyāso bhavet pūrvaṃ kandaṃ tu tadanantaram | 

aṅkuraṃ nālavinyāsamanantaṃ parikalpayet || 2-60 || 

tejomayaṃ mahāśubhraṃ sphuratkiraṇabhāsvaram | 


viśvollekhabhittibhūtāmicchāśaktimāviśya tadavaṣṭambharūpaṃ 
kandamākramya tadunmeṣatatprasararūpāṅkuranālātmakamaśeṣaṃ 
māyāntamadhvānamāsūtrya tadupari anantaṃ vidyeśaṃ tejomayaṃ 
smaraṇamātreṇa kalpayedityarthaḥ || 60 || 

nālaṃ vinyasya yaduktaṃ "anantaṃ parikalpayet" iti, tanmadhye
granthisthāne siṃhāsanaṃ tadupari ca padma" krameṇa kalpayitumāha ---- 


dharmaṃ jñānaṃ ca vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ ca kramānnyaset || 2-61 || 


ete ca ---- 


sitaraktapītakṛṣṇā āgneyyādīśadiggatāḥ | 

pādakāḥ siṃharūpāste trinetrā bhīmavikramāḥ || 2-62 || 


pādakā iti-etadvāsanānuviddhā hi saṃsaranti saṃsāre ---- 
ityaśeṣasaṃsāriṇaḥ ajñātāḥ pādāḥ pādakāḥ, ete siṃharūpā iti 
parākramamahimnā, aśeṣaviśvā kramaṇāt | īśvaraśaktyadhiṣṭhāne 
evaitadeṣāṃ ghaṭate na tu sāṃkhyanaye jaḍabuddhidharmarūpatāyām 
itīśvaraśaktyadhiṣṭhānādete trinetrāḥ, ghorasaṃsāraghātahetutvācca 
bhīmavikramāḥ || 62 || 

ete ca mumukṣuṇā ---- 


śivaśaktimayā mantrā nyastavyā vīravandite | 


vastutaḥ parameśvaraśaktimayā eva, tathā tvaparijñātā 
adharapadasañcāriṇaḥ | yadā tu yathā pratyabhijñāyante, tadā 
mananatrāṇadharmakāḥ pratyabhijñātuḥ śivasya icchayā mantrarūpatāṃ 
prakaṭayantaḥ śuddhaprasaraṇisaṃsāriṇo bhavanti bhaktibhāja iti 
paramārthaḥ, na tvanyathaiṣāṃ mantrarūpatā kācit, 
aśuddhādhvavyavasthiteḥ || 

siṃhāsane'vayavāntarāṇyāha ---- 


adharmājñānāvairāgyamanaiśvaryaṃ ca	prāgdiśaḥ || 2-63 || 


uttarāntaṃ niveśyaṃ tu.............


ete hi ---- 


............gātrakāḥ sitavarṇakāḥ | 


siṃhāsanapaṭṭikārūpāḥ | prāyaśca 
sarve'khyātimayamāyācchāditatvādadharmādimayāḥ, ata eva dharmādīn 
prati spṛhayālava ityadharmādaya eṣāṃ māyāpade ajñātāni gātrāṇi 
gātrakāṇi, ajñātārthe "kan" || 63 || 

atraiva ---- 


saṃdhānakīlakāścaiva atasīpuṣpasaṃnibhāḥ || 2-64 || 

vedā yugāśca te caiva jñātavyāḥ kramaśaḥ priye | 


āgneyyādikrameṇa pratikoṇaṃ pādakena saha gātrakadvayasya bandhanārthaṃ
kīlakadvayamiti | ṛgādayo vedāḥ, kṛtādayaśca yugāstattadbhogavāsanāḥ
puṣṇantaḥ saṃsārabandhanahetavo vicitraśaṅkāśaṅkurūpāḥ 
saṃdhānakīlakā ityuktāḥ | bandhakatvādeva ca kṛṣṇavarṇā 
jñātavyāḥ | pūrvoktapārameśvaraśaktirūpatayā yathā'jñātā 
bandhakā bhavanti | nanu ete buddhidharmāḥ kathamiyatīṃ bhūmiṃ 
prāptāḥ? ucyate ---- sarveṣāṃ buddhyādidharmāṇāṃ māyotpattibhūḥ,
buddhyādayastu vibhavasthānam, ucchedyāstu mūlabhūmita ucchinnā na punaḥ 
prarohantītyutpattipadāducchettumetānīdṛkkramo daśītaḥ || 64 || 

ata eva sattvarajastamāṃsi mūlata evocchettuṃ siṃhāsanopari guṇamayameva
māyāmasūrakaṃ nyasitumāha ---- 


adhaśchādanamūrdhvaṃ ca raktaṃ śuklaṃ vicintayet || 2-65 || 

madhye tamo vijānīyādguṇāstvete vyavasthitāḥ | 


ūrdhvaṃ śuddhavidyānikaṭavatītvāt sitaṃ sattvarūpam | adhastu 
saṃsaraṇānuguṇatvādraktaṃ rajomayam | madhye tu 
khyātyācchādanaprakarṣāt tamomayaṃ kṛṣṇam | prādhānikaḥ prapañco 
māyāyāmasannityādi tvasat, aśeṣamāyākāryasya māyāyāṃ 
sūkṣmarūpatayā bhuvanādhvavarṇayiṣyamāṇasthityāvasthityāvasthitatvāt 
| śaktipātapavitraistu sarvametacchivaśaktirūpaṃ mantratayaiva bhavanīyam 
| 

yadvakṣyati ---- 

"yatra yatra" ityupakramya, sarvaṃ śivamayaṃ yataḥ || (4-310)

iti || 

atha siṃhāsanamasūrakopari vidyāpadmaṃ nyasitumāha ---- 


sitaṃ padmaṃ vijānīyāt kesarāṇi vicintayet || 2-66 || 

sitaraktaprapītāni mūlamadhyāgradeśataḥ | 

kaṇīkā hemasaṅkāśā bījāni haritāni tu || 2-67 || 


īdṛgvarṇameva sitapadmaṃ bhavati | sitatvaṃ cāsya śuddhavidyāmayatvāt 
|| 67 || 

asya daleṣu devatānyāsamāha ---- 


vāmāṃ pūrvadale nyasya jyeṣṭhāṃ vahnidalāśritām | 

raudrīṃ dakṣiṇapatre tu kālīṃ nairṛtagocare || 2-68 || 

kalavikaraṇīṃ dekā vinyasyed vāruṇe dale | 

balavikaraṇīṃ dekā vāyavyadalamāśritām || 2-69 || 

balapramathanī devīmuttare viniyojayet | 

sarvabhūtadamanīṃ ca eśānyāṃ viniyojayet || 2-70 || 

madhye manonmanīṃ dekā kaṇīkāyāṃ niveśayet | 


spaṣṭametat || 70 || 

etacca ---- 


śakracāpanibhaṃ devi dhyātavyaṃ śaktimaṇḍalam || 2-71 || 


tato'pi ---- 


madhye sūryasahasrābhāṃ cintayettu manonmanīm | 


etā devyo bhuvanādhvanītyā pareṇa rūpeṇa śaktitattve sthitāḥ, madhye 
tu pade parāpareṇa, iha tu vidyāyāmapareṇa rūpeṇeti vibhāgaḥ | tatraiva
cāsāṃ nāmānusāri svarūpaṃ darśayiṣyāmaḥ, sarvaṃ 
prāguktaśaktitrayamayamiti || 

vidyātattve mānameyamātṛrūpaṃ jñānakriyecchāvyāptisatattvaṃ 
maṇḍalatrayaṃ nyasitumāha ---- 


sūryādhvamaṇḍalaṃ patre somaṃ saṃyojya kesare || 2-72 || 

vahnimaṇḍalakaṃ devi kaṇīkāyāṃ niveśayet | 


atra hi meyarūpasya somasya vahnisūryātmakamātṛmānamadhyavatītvam,
na hi mātṛprakāśabhittiṃ vinā mānaprakāśācchuraṇaṃ vinā vā 
meyaprakāśaḥ kaścit | pramātraiva hi cidrasāśyānībhāvātma 
meyamābhāsyate, ābhāsyamānaṃ ca pramāṇaprakāśācchuritameva 
bhavatītyalamadhikena; (vistṛtaṃ ca) bhaviṣyatyetat sṛṣṭisaṃhārapaṭale 
|| 72 || 

etaddhāmatrayādhiṣṭhātṛdevatātrayaṃ nirūpayati 
tadadhiṣṭhātṛviśvāntarbhāvamatra prakaṭayitum ---- 


brahmā viṣṇurharaścaiva maṇḍaleṣvadhipāḥ smṛtāḥ || 2-73 || 


parāparayā vyāptyā eṣāṃ dhyānamāha ---- 


brahmā caturmukho raktaścaturbāhuvibhūṣitaḥ | 

kṛṣṇājinottarīyaśca rājīvāsanasaṃsthitaḥ || 2-74 || 

kamaṇḍaludharo devi daṇḍahastastathaiva ca | 

akṣamālādharo devaḥ padmahastaḥ sulocanaḥ || 2-75 || 

dhyātvā patreṣu taṃ nyasyet sarvakilviṣanāśanam | 

atasīpuṣpasaṅkāśaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam || 2-76 || 

pītāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam | 

sphuranmukuṭamāṇikyaṃ kiṅkiṇījālamaṇḍitam || 2-77 || 

divyakuṇḍaladhartāraṃ garuḍāsanasaṃsthitam | 

dhyātvā viṣṇuṃ mahātmānaṃ keśareṣu niveśayet || 2-78 || 


śaṅkhena padmamupalakṣyate | mānameyayorlolībhāvānmeyātmani 
somamaṇḍale sṛṣṭipradhāne'pi sthitikārī viṣṇuḥ, sthityātmani ca 
pramāṇarūpe sūryamaṇḍale sṛṣṭikartā brahmādhiṣṭhātā, iti yujyate 
evaitat || 78 || 


śaṅkhakundendudhavalaṃ śūlahastaṃ trilocanam | 

daśabāhuṃ viśālākṣaṃ nāgayajñopavītinam || 2-79 || 

siṃhacarmaparīdhānaṃ śaśāṅkakṛtabhūṣaṇam | 

nīlakaṇṭhaṃ vṛṣārūḍhaṃ rudraṃ dhyātvā varānane || 2-80 || 

niveśayet kaṇīkāyāṃ mahāpātakanāśanam | 


tadupari ---- 


mahāpretaṃ nyaset paścāt prahasantaṃ sacetanam || 2-81 || 

raktavarṇaṃ sutejaskaṃ netratrayavibhūṣitam | 


prakarṣeṇa itaḥ sphuṭedantānimajjanena ahantāpradhānāṃ 
sthitimanupraviṣṭa; prakarṣeṇa ca itaṃ gataṃ saṃbaddhaṃ viśvaṃ yasya 
iti vyutpattyā preta iha sadāśivaḥ, sa ca mahaditi padena 
anāśritaśivarūpaḥ | paramaśiva eva ca 
bhagavānekaścidrūpastadadhararūpavartī, ityanāśritādistadekajīvitaḥ,
svayaṃ tu preta iva pretaḥ, adharādhvano'tra stimitatvenāvasthānācca
pretaḥ, sa ca aparayā vyāptyā sthūlaḥ sadāśivaḥ, madhyamayā sa
eva nādarūpaḥ, parayā tu anāśritaḥ, iti tadanusāreṇa siṃhāsanaṃ
padmaṃ ca yojyam | sa ca pretaḥ paramaśivo'hantānupraveśādeva
prahasan nādāmarśarūpo mahāvikāsamayaśca, tenaiva paramaśivena
nādātmanā sacetanaḥ | evamapi tāvanmātredantonmeṣātmakopādhirūpatvāt
viśvānurañjakatvācca raktavarṇaḥ, bodhaprādhānyāt sutejaskaḥ | 
vakṣyati ca ----
