śūryakoṭisamaprabham |" (10-1214)

iti bhauvane paṭale | icchājñānakriyāśaktyātmanā ca 
eṣaṇīyajñeyakāryātma viśvaṃ nayatā netratritayena ūrdhvadṛśā 
viśeṣeṇa bhūṣitaṃ rājamānam | yathoktam ---- 

"tisro devyo yadā cainaṃ nityamevābhyupāsate | 

tryambakastu tadā jñeyaḥ....................... ||" 

iti || 81 || 

evamiyatparyantam 


praṇavena nyaset sarvamāsanaṃ bhairavasya tu || 2-82 || 


"oṃ āsanāya namaḥ" iti mantreṇa | etatsarvamāsanaṃ cidbhairavābhedena
vyāptaṃ śarvaṃ śivamayam" iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt śaktirūpam, na
tu vyatiriktāpararūpaṃ praṇavāntargarbhīkāreṇa nyaset | atra ca ---- 

"āsanaṃ vibhajenmantrī kramaśaḥ padmamudrayā |"

iti śrīraurava uktatvāt karadvayaṃ mukulīkṛtya padmamudrāsphālanīyā
sthāpanīyā || 82 || 


gandhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya.............


praṇavenaiva | 


..........ṭato mūtīṃ prakalpayet | 

kadambakusumākārāṃ tuṣāraviraṇatviṣam || 2-83 || 


prakāśāhlādamayīmityarthaḥ || 83 || 


atha ---- 


mūrtyūrdhve bhairavaṃ devaṃ sakalaṃ parikalpayet | 

dvātriṃśadvarṇakhacitaṃ sphurattaḍidivojjvalam || 2-84 || 


hṛtto dvādaśāntaṃ mantroccāraṃ kṛtvā, tatra kṣaṇaṃ viśramya 
hṛdyeva mantrarājaṃ puryaṣṭakaṃ bhairavīkartuṃ nyasediti guravaḥ | atra
ca vakṣyamāṇabrahmakavāṭakalāvaktrabhaṅgyādi sarvamāsūtritamātraṃ
prabhāpuñjanyāyena cintayet, ityāśayena śphurattaḍidivojjvalam"
ityuktam || 84 || 

atha ---- 


vaktrāṇi kalpayed devi svadhyānena maheśvari | 

mūrdhādicaraṇaṃ yāvat praṇavādinamontataḥ || 2-85 || 

aṣṭātriṃśatkalābhedaṃ śodhyādhvānaṃ prakalpayet | 

navatattvaṃ tritattvaṃ ca navakaṃ bhairavābhidham || 2-86 || 

vidyāṅgā locanaṃ caiva kṣurikāṃ ca prakalpayet | 

śaktitrayaṃ tato nyasyed dakṣadigvāmagocare || 2-87 || 

madhyapradeśe deveśi................


etadavismaraṇārthaṃ punarapi paṭhitam | tattvanyāsena 
parameśvarasṛṣṭāni tacchaktimayāni, bhagavati tu prakāśānandaghanāni 
ata eva āsanāsī (nātma?) viśvaṃ śivamayamityuktam || 87 || 

dhyānamāha ---- 


..........ṭato rūpamanusmaret | 

tripañcanayanaṃ devaṃ jaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitam || 2-88 || 

candrakoṭipratīkāśaṃ candrārdhakṛtaśekharam | 

pañcavaktraṃ viśālākṣaṃ sarpagonāsamaṇḍitam || 2-89 || 

vṛścikairagnivarṇābhairhāreṇa tu virājitam | 

kapālamālābharaṇaṃ khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇam || 2-90 || 

pāśāṅkuśadharaṃ devaṃ śarahastaṃ pinākinam | 

varadābhayahastaṃ ca muṇḍakhaṭvāṅgadhāriṇam || 2-91 || 

vīṇāḍamaruhastaṃ ca ghaṇṭāhastaṃ triśūlinam | 

vajradaṇḍakṛtāṭopaṃ paraśvāyudhahastakam || 2-92 || 

mudgareṇa vicitreṇa vartulena virājitam | 

siṃhacarmaparīdhānaṃ gajacarmottarīyakam || 2-93 || 

aṣṭādaśabhujaṃ devaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ sutejasam | 


ārurukṣūn niṣkaladhāmni praveśayituṃ bhagavatā svasvātantryāt
īdṛgākāra unmanāśaktibhūmau daśītaḥ | nahi bhauvane kvāpi 
īdṛgdevo'sti | śāktasphāramayatvādeva cāyamaṣṭādaśabhujo 
durgādevyāstathātvāt | asmiṃśca pratimudrāsthānīyākṛtigranthe 
cidbhairavavyāptirakhaṇḍitaivāsti | tathāhi ---- tisṛbhiḥ 
parādiśaktibhiḥ sthūlasūkṣmaparabhedānmāyāntaṃ vyāpya sthitānāṃ 
pañcānāṃ nayanaṃ yena taṃ tripañcanayanam, 
jaṭābhirurdhvapadāvasthitābhirvāmeśvaryādiśaktibhiḥ, mukuṭena ca 
svātantryāsphāreṇa maṇḍitam, candrakoṭipratīkāśam iti 
prakāśānandaghanam | taduktaṃ śrīlakṣmīkaulārṇave ---- 

"advaitatvāt sureśāni bhairavo gīyate bhuvi | 

na tu daṃṣṭrākarālatvāttasmāt saumyaṃ vicintayet ||" iti | 

candrārdhakṛtaśekharam iti viśvāpyāyakṛdamākhyāmṛtakalāsaṃbaddham,
pañcavaktram iti cidānandecchājñānakriyākhyāni pañca 
parasvarūpābhivyañjakāni saṃsāratrāṇarūpāṇi vaktrāṇi yasya sa tam, 
viśālākṣam iti | 

"antarlakṣyo bahirdṛṣṭinīmeṣonmeṣavajītaḥ | "

ityāmnātaparabhairavasphārāvasthitam, sarpetyādinā hāreṇa tu virājitam 
ityantena 
bahiṣkṛtamāyīyakārmāṇavākhyapāśatrayasaṃyojanaviyojanakrīḍāparatva
muktam, kapālamālābharaṇam iti aśeṣaviśvaśarīram, viśvam 
kapālamālātmanāvayavaprapañcarūpamābharaṇaṃ na tu āvaraṇaṃ yasya, 
cidānandaghanasya bhagavatastisra icchājñānakriyāḥ karaṇarūpāḥ, 
ekaikasyāśca śaktestrairūpyānnavatvam, tatrāpi parāparabhedena
dvaividhyādaṣṭādaśabhujatvam | tatra khaḍgena jñānaśaktyātmanā
pāśacchedanam, kheṭakena kriyāśaktirūpeṇa bhaktānāṃ 
saṃsāratrāsapariharaṇam, pāśena viśvabandhanena svātantryam, aṅkuśena 
tadākarṣaṇam, śarapinākābhyāṃ kāraṇagranthimālābhedanam, 
varadābhayahastatvena bhogamokṣapradatvam muṇḍadhāraṇena 
akhyātyātmakamāyāmuṇḍāpahartṛtvam, anāśritāntasya viśvasya 
asthikaraṅkasthānīyasya svacidbhittilagnatvaṃ khaṭvāṅgadhāraṇena,
vīṇāḍamarughaṇṭābhirmandratāramadhyadhvanivaicitryāśrayanādāvamarśa
nibhālanāvahitaśaktitvam, icchājñānakriyāyogisvātantryaśaktidaṇḍena 
triśūlena pāśatrayaśātanam, vajreṇa ūrdhvasthitecchādiśaktitrayeṇa 
adhaḥ sthitaiṣaṇīyāditrayeṇa ca aśeṣaviśvātmakanijaśaktitvam, 
daṇḍena niyatiśaktyātmanā viśvaniyamanam, paraśunā halākṛtinā 
nādaśaktyātmanā mudgareṇa binduśaktirūpeṇa 
aśeṣabhedavidāraṇacūrṇīkaraṇam, iti dhvanyate | siṃho 
vidyeśvarasadāśivaśaktiśivātmakapañcānanaścitsphāraḥ, tasya carma 
caritam, gajasya ca vitatavitatasya māyātmana uktasvarūpasiṃhanirbhedyasya
carma caritaṃ vilasitaṃ svasvarūpasaṃlagnatvāt parīdhānaṃ 
bodhābhedātmakasvasvarūpopari parivartamānaṃ yasya, devaṃ 
krīḍādiśīlam, nīlakaṇṭham akhyātyātmakamahāviṣaharam, sutejasaṃ 
cidānandaghanam | evamādi ca bhairavānukaraṇastotre'smābhivītatya
daśītam || 93 || 


asya bhagavato vaktradhyānamāha ---- 


ūrdhvavaktraṃ maheśāni sphaṭikābhaṃ vicintayet || 2-94 || 

āpītaṃ pūrvavaktraṃ tu nīlotpaladalaprabham | 

dakṣiṇaṃ tu vijānīyād vāmaṃ caiva vicintayet || 2-95 || 

dāḍimīkusumaprakhyaṃ kuṅkumodakasannibham | 

candrārbudapratīkāśaṃ paścimaṃ tu vicintayet || 2-96 || 


vaktrāṇāṃ digrūpavaicitryaṃ tattadanugrahādikṛtyavaicitryāt || 96 || 
evamīdṛśam ---- 


svacchandabhairavaṃ devaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam | 

dhyāyate yastu yuktātmā kṣipraṃ sidhyati mānavaḥ || 2-97 || 


yuktātmā ekacittaḥ, siddhyati bhuktimuktī labhate | yathā pūrvaṃ
vācakasya sakṛduccārāt sarvakilviṣanāśitvamuktam tathā vācyasyāpi
dhyānamātrāt sarvasiddhipradaśītvamuktam, iti mahāprabhāvatāsyocyate || 
97 || 

paraṃ nyāsamāha ---- 


tataḥ paramabījena paraṃ paramakāraṇam | 

suśāntaṃ niṣkalaṃ devaṃ sarvavyāpi nirañjanam || 2-98 || 

āvāhayet suhṛṣṭātmā tava devi vadāmyaham | 


paraṃ niratiśayam, suhṛṣṭātmā iti śāmbhavapadasamāveśaṃ prati 
utkaṇṭhātiśayāt, āvāhayet dvādaśāntādavatārayet, 
paraśaktyavaṣṭambhena tatsvarūpamunmajjya hṛtparyantaṃ 
taccamatkārasāraṃ kurvītetyarthaḥ || 99 || 

kīdṛśam ---- 


hṛtkaṇṭhatālubhrūmadhyanādāntāntasamāśritam || 2-99 || 

niṣkampaṃ kāraṇātītam..........


nādāntaḥ śaktyantaḥ, tasyāntaḥ paryanto dvādaśāntaḥ, tena 
hṛdādidvādaśāntaṃ yugapadvyāpnuvantaṃ niṣkampaṃ svarūpādacalitam || 
evam ---- 


..............āvāhya parameśvaram | 

saṃsthāpya vidhivad devamaṅgaṣaṭkaṃ tato nyaset || 2-100 || 


"uttānau tu karau kṛtvā aṅguṣṭhau talamadhyagau | 

āvāhanī tviyam.............................. ||"

iti āvāhanamudrayā āvāhanam | 

"baddhāṅguṣṭhau sthitau muṣṭī unmukhau sthāpanī bhavet |"

iti mudrayā sthāpanam || 

atha ---- 


pādyamācamanaṃ cārghaṃ svāgataṃ tadanantaram | 

saṃnidhānaṃ ca deveśi................

kalpayediti śeṣaḥ | pādārthamudakaṃ pādyam | suśobhanam 
asmadanugrahaparamāgamanamastviti svāgatam, yonimudrayā saṃnidhānam || 
evaṃ kṛtvā

.............ṇiṣṭhurayā nirodhayet || 2-101 || 


niṣṭhurā mudrā, tayā nirodhayet avicalaṃ sthāpayet | sā tu ---- 

"aṅguṣṭhagarbhagau muṣṭī.......................... | " iti | 

"..........................ṇiṣṭhurā tannirodhane | " ityuktā || 101 || 

tataḥ ---- 

gandhaiḥ puṣpaistathā dhūpairdhūpayitvā tamarcayet | 
sarvametanmānasaṃ kuryāt || 

atha sannidhānārthaṃ mudrāṃ pradarśayetpaścāt tridhā traikālyakarmaṇi 
|| 102 || 

mudaṃ harṣaṃ rāti dadāti, parabhairavacaitanyadraviṇaṃ mudrayati,
parāveśena modayati bhaktān, drāvayati pāśān iti vā niruktāṃ
parasvarūpapratibimbarūpāṃ mudrāṃ vakṣyamāṇām aṣṭādaśavidhām | 

"etā mudrā mahādevi bhairavasya pradarśayet | 

āvāhane nirodhe ca tathaiva ca visarjane ||" (14 | 20)

iti vakṣyamāṇatraikālyakarmaṇi | tridheti ---- 

"manojā guruvaktrasthā vāgbhavā mantrasaṃbhavā | 

dehodbhavāṅgavikṣepairmudreyaṃ trividhā smṛtā ||"

ityāmnāyanidīṣṭā || 102 || 

vistareṇāntaryāgaṃ vaktumāha ---- 


tataḥ snādādikaṃ karma kṛtvā caiva varānane | 

paridhāpya suvastrāṇi netrapaṭṭodbhavāni ca || 2-103 || 

vilipyāgurukarpūrairmukuṭādyaivībhūṣayet | 

vilipya paridhāpya bhūṣayediti kramaḥ || 

puṣpairnānāvidhaiḥ śubhrairarcayedbhūṣayet punaḥ || 2-104 || 

arghaṃ dattvā maheśāni punarmudrāṃ pradarśayet | 

praṇamya bhairavaṃ devaṃ svacchandaṃ viśvanāyakam || 2-105 || 


arghaṃ viśeṣārgham | praṇamya iti samāveśena tanmayībhāvamāśritya || 
105 || 


tato hyābharaṇaṃ bāhye viniveśya varānane | 


parameśvaraśaktirūpaṃ tadabhedena nyastamapi vaktrāṅgādi 
punastadicchayaiva tadābhāsitatvāt prabhāpuñjavat pṛthagiva āvaraṇatayā 
sthitaṃ viniveśyam | evaṃ cābhidadhadevaṃ śikṣayati yat ---- viśvaṃ 
grāhyagrāhakābhimataṃ śivarūpamapi śivena tathābhāsitatvāt pṛthagiva 
lakṣyate, na tu vāstavamasya pṛthaktvaṃ kadācit || 

āvaraṇanyāse vibhāgamāha ---- 


eśānyāṃ pūrvato yāmyāṃ uttarāpyāvasānakam || 2-106 || 

vinyaset pañca vaktrāṇi pañcavaktrayutāni ca | 

bāhubhirdaśabhiścaiva śaśāṅkamukuṭaiḥ saha || 2-107 || 

dhyātavyāni svarūpāṇi varābhayakarāṇi tu | 


ekaikasyāḥ śakteḥ pañcaśaktirūpatvāt pañcavaktrarūpatvamekaikasya
ca śāktasphārātmakasvarūpato bhedenābhāsitatvāt, tathāpi ca 
mantranāḍīsaṃdhānābhyāṃ tadabhedasāratvāt pṛthagapi eṣāṃ 
pūjanamuktam | svaṃ sphaṭikābhatvādi pūrvoktaṃ rūpaṃ yeṣāṃ tāni 
svarūpāṇi | varābhayakaratvaṃ 
khaḍgakheṭakapāśāṅkuśaśarapinākamuṇḍakhaṭvāṅgopalakṣaṇaparam | 
mantrāṇāṃ paraparāparāpararūpatvāt parādīnāṃ ca pratyekaṃ 
traividhyānmahāsāmānyarūpavyāptatvācca daśarūpatā, iti 
tadvyāptatvācca daśabāhutvam || 107 || 

vaktrāvaraṇānuṣaktānyaṅgānyāha ---- 


agnīśarakṣovāyavyacatudīkṣu ca taṃ nyaset || 2-108 || 

hṛcchiraśca śikhā varma astraṃ ca pravibhāgaśaḥ | 

agnīśarakṣovāyavyadikṣu yathāsaṃkhyaṃ hṛcchiraḥśikhāvarmāṇi 
astraṃ ca catudīkkam iti vibhāgaḥ | sakalāṅgānyeva pṛthagāvaraṇatayā
pūjyāni na tu niṣkalāṅgāni, teṣāṃ sarvajñatādyekarūpāṇāṃ 
niṣkalaikarūpatvāt || 108 || 

eṣāṃ rūpamāha ---- 


hṛdayaṃ raktavarṇābhaṃ śiro gorocanaprabham || 2-109 || 

taḍidvalayasaṅkāśāṃ śikhāṃ dekā vicintayet | 

ādhūmraṃ kavacaṃ vidyāt kapiśaṃ cāstrameva ca || 2-110 || 


netrarūpasthānanirdeśaṃ vaktumāha ---- 


jyotīrūpapratīkāśaṃ netraṃ madhye ca saṃsthitam | 


vinyasedityeva | madhye iti kaṇīkāyām vakṣyati hi ---- 

ṅetraṃ tu kaṇīkāyāṃ vai | " (2-171) 

iti || 

ete ca ---- 


pañcavaktrāḥ smṛtāḥ sarve daśabāhvindubhūṣitāḥ || 2-111 || 

nānābharaṇasaṃyuktā nānāsraggandhalepanāḥ | 

nānāvastraparīdhānā mukuṭairujjvalaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 2-112 || 

ratnamālāvanaddhāśca hārakeyūrabhūṣitāḥ | 


ete ca ---- 


dviraṣṭavarṣakākārāḥ surūpāḥ sthirayauvanāḥ || 2-113 || 

bhairavādyāḥ smṛtā mantrā pīṭheśāḥ pīṭhamardakāḥ | 


bhairavādyā aṅgāntā mantrāḥ, pīṭhasya 
vidyāmantramaṇḍalamudrārūpasya catuvīdhasya, īśāḥ svāminaḥ, 
svātmasātkaraṇena mardakāśca | ye tu 
pīṭhakṣetrasaṃdohādipallīparametadvyācakṣate te'sminnantaryāge
devatānyāsasya madhye'pyevaṃ kalpayanta upahāsyā eva || 113 || 

atha ---- 


yā sā pūrvaṃ mayā khyātā aghorī śaktiruttamā || 2-114 || 

bhairavaṃ pūjayitvā tu tasyotsaṅge tu tāṃ nyaset | 


tasyā dhyānamāha ---- 

yādṛśaṃ bhairavaṃ rūpaṃ bhairavyāstādṛgeva hi || 2-115 || 


tathā ca ---- 


īṣatkarālavadanāṃ gambhīravipulasvanām | 

prasannāsyāṃ sadā dhyāyed bhairakā vismitekṣaṇām || 2-116 || 


karālatvaṃ bhairavānukārataḥ pāśabhakṣaṇāt, gambhīravipulasvanatvaṃ
vimarśaprādhānyāt, prasannāsyatvaṃ parabhairavānurūpyeṇa 
anugrahapravaṇatvāt, ata eva bhairavamudrānupraveśādeva vismitekṣaṇatvam 
|| 116 || 

tataḥ ---- 


dvitīyāvaraṇe devi vinyased bhairavāṣṭakam | 


dvitīyaśabdena aṅgavaktrāṇi ekamevāvaraṇaṃ samavyāptikatvād 
bhagavaddehārambhakatvācca, iti darśayati || 

kathaṃ nyasedityāha ---- 


kapālīśaṃ tu pūrvāyāmāgneyyāṃ śikhivāhanam || 2-117 || 

dakṣiṇe krodharājaṃ tu vikarālaṃ tu nairṛte | 

manmathaṃ paścime bhāge meghanādeśvaraṃ tathā || 2-118 || 

vāyavye devi vinyasya somarājaṃ tathottare | 

vidyārājaṃ tathaiśānyāṃ vinyasettu subhāvitaḥ || 2-119 || 


aṣṭāvapi ---- 


pañcavaktrāstrinetrāśca daśabāhvinduśekharāḥ | 

kapālamālābharaṇāḥ sphuranmāṇikyamaṇḍitāḥ || 2-120 || 


eṣāṃ dikkrameṇa dhyānamāha ---- 


pūrvaṃ pītaṃ smṛtaṃ devi raktamāgneyagocare | 

dakṣiṇe nīlameghābhaṃ nairṛtyāṃ jvalanaprabham || 2-121 || 

śyāmaṃ cāparadigbhāge dhūmraṃ vāyavyagocare | 

candrabimbaprabhaṃ saumye īśāne sphaṭikaprabham || 2-122 || 


atha ---- 


tṛtīye caiva lokeśān sāstrān saṃparikalpayet | 

nāmāni teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ || 2-123 || 

indrāgniyamanirṛtivaruṇāśca samīraṇaḥ | 

somarājaḥ kuberaśca īśānaḥ parameśvaraḥ || 2-124 || 


śāstrān iti vadannastrāvaraṇaṃ na pṛthaṅnyāsyam iti nirūpayati,
tṛtīye ityabhidhānācca || 124 || 

te ca ---- 


bhairavāṣṭakarūpeṇa dhyātavyāstu varānane | 


parabhairavaśaktipuñjātmakabhairavāṣṭakaprasararūpatvāt pūrvaṃ
pītam ityādyuktabhairavāṣṭakarūpeṇaiva cintyāḥ || 
evametadastrāṇyapi bhairavāstravyāptisārāṇi yāgarakṣāparāṇi nāmata
uddiśati ---- 


vajraṃ śaktistathā daṇḍaḥ khaḍgapāśastathaiva ca || 2-125 || 

dhvajo gadā triśūlaṃ ca lokapālāyudhāni vai | 


dhyānamāha ---- 


vajraṃ cānekavarṇāḍhyaṃ śaktiṃ hemasamaprabhām || 2-126 || 

daṇḍaṃ bhinnāñjanābhaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ nīlotpalaprabham | 

kiṃśukābhaṃ tathā pāśaṃ dhvajaṃ śuklaṃ vicintayet || 2-127 || 

gadāṃ tu vidrumābhāṃ vai śūlaṃ vidyutsamaprabham | 

etāni caiṣāṃ karasthāni dhyeyāni || 2-127 || 


atha ---- 


saṃpūjyāvaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ saṃdhānaṃ mantranāyake || 2-128 || 


kartavyamityanuṣajyate || 128 || 

kathamityākāṅkṣāyām ---- 


astrāṇi lokapālāṃśca bhairavāṣṭakameva ca | 

pañca brahmāṇyathāṅgāni etānyāvaraṇāni tu || 2-129 || 

krameṇoccārayet sarvaṃ yāvattadgarbhamaiśvaram | 


astrāṇītyādistṛtīyapaṭaloktaḥ prakāro'nusaṃdheyaḥ | idaṃ cātra
pūjāsatattvam ---- 

"ullaṅdhyākhilamadhvajālamamalāṃ cinmūtīmāśritya tā 
munmujjadbahurūpamūtīmabhitaḥ śritvā dhiyā vātha tām | 
udyogādicatuṣkaladyutimahātattvātmikāṃ tanmayī	bhāvyāśeṣamihārpayeta
manasā viśvaṃ parārcāparaḥ ||"

iti || 129 || 

anantaram ---- 


mūlamantreṇa karttavyaṃ nāḍīsaṃdhānameva ca || 2-130 || 


atrāpi ---- 

"ātmano niṣkaloccāraṃ kṛtvā kumbhe niveśayet | 

kalaśasthasya vāmena recayet pūrayettataḥ || 

maṇḍalasthasya savyena punarvāmena recayet |" (4-46-47)

iti caturthapaṭalanirūpayiṣyamāṇasthityā niṣkalanāthamuccārayet,
svavāmena nirgatya bhairavadakṣiṇena viśet, tataḥ krameṇa 
vaktrāṅgabhairavalokapālāntamevameva ca kurvīta iti mūlamantreṇa 
nāḍīsaṃdhānam | evaṃ hyupasaṃhāraprasarakramābhyāṃ sarvaṃ 
devatācakraṃ bhagavatparabhairavamayameva jāyate | ye tu 
tṛtīyacaturthapaṭalagranthametat parāmṛśya 
mantrasaṃdhānanāḍīsaṃdhāne anyathā cānyathā vyācakṣate te bhrāntā 
eva, "anāgatāvekṣaṇaṃ tantrayuktiḥ" iti hi vākyavidāṃ niścayaḥ || 130 
|| 

atha ---- 


parāntaṃ yāvadābhāvya naivedyāni nivedayet | 


parāntaṃ yāvadābhāvya ityanena paramīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā naivedyāni
nivedayet, ityādiśati | vakṣyati hi tṛtīye paṭale ---- 

"mantrasaṃdhānametaddhi............................ | "

ityuktvā

"............................paramīkaraṇaṃ śṛṇu | 

uccārayettato devaṃ hrasvadīrghapluptānvitam || 

tāvaduccārayenmantraṃ yāvannirvāṇagocaram |" (3-20-21)

ityādi yāvat,

śarveṣvāvaraṇeṣveva devi tadvyāpakaṃ nyaset | 

tena cādhiṣṭhitāḥ sarve sarvakāmaphalapradāḥ ||" (3-24)

ityevamīdṛśeṣu sthāneṣu pūrvāparaṃ vimṛśya anusaṃdheyam | atha ca 
parāntaṃ yāvadābhāvya ṣaṭtriṃśattattvamayatvena dhyātvā, naivedyāni
nivedayet brahmārpaṇadṛṣṭyā bhagavati arpayet, nivedayet śivamayāni 
jānīyādityarthaḥ || 

mānasāni naivedyāni uddiśati ---- 


ghārikāṃ vaṭakā�ścaiva śaṣkulīrmodakāṃstathā || 2-131 || 

khaṇḍalaḍḍuśarāvāṇi bhakṣyāṇi vividhāni ca | 

śālyodanaṃ mudgasūpamājyāktaṃ saṃprakalpayet || 2-132 || 

kauśalyāṃ maṇḍajāpūpāṃstathā kṣaudraśirāṃsi ca | 

ghṛtāktā�ścillakāṃścaiva lavaṇaṃ parikalpayet || 2-133 || 

avadaṃśānyanekāni kaṭūni madhurāṇi ca | 

rasālāṃ ca dadhi kṣīramāsavaṃ vividhaṃ tathā || 2-134 || 

matsyamāṃsānyanekāni lehyapeyāni yāni ca | 

agramāpūrayecchaṃbhovīttaśāṭhyavivajītaḥ || 2-135 || 


"yadyatkiñcinmānasāhlādi sarvaṃ tattadyuktyaivānusandhāya pūrvam | 

viśvābhedādbhairavaikātma tasmin svasmin sarvaṃ	dhāmni līnaṃ vidadhyāt 
||"

iti naivedyarahasyam | vittaśāṭhyavivajīta iti bāhyayāge yojyam, nahi 
mānase yāge kṛpaṇatvaṃ bhavati kasyacit || 135 || 

evaṃ kṛtvā bhagavadrūpasya svātmanaḥ paramānandanirbharatvamanusandhātum 
---- 

pāścādarghaḥ pradātavyaḥ surayā susugandhayā || 

surāyā ānandahetutvādevamuktam | ye tu 
jātyuddhāraparabhairavarūpatvonmīlake'pyasmin bhairavanaye surāśabdaṃ 
jalavācinamapi vyācakṣate, te jātigrahagrastāḥ

"madyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā matsyānanyāni ca varānane | 

sācārāṃśca nirācārāṃlliṅgino na jugupsayet ||" (5-48)

iti bhāvisamayollaṅghinaḥ paśava eva || 

evaṃ ca kṛtvā ---- 


mudrāṃ pradarśayetpaścāt tridhā traikālyakarmaṇi || 2-136 || 


"traikālyakarmaṇi" ityanuvādaḥ | vyākṛtaṃ caitat prāk || 136 || 


praṇipātaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā japaṃ paścāt samācaret | 


vāsanāmātraśeṣasyāpi dehādeścidātmani parabhairave samāveśaḥ
praṇipātaḥ, anyathā antarbahiśca bhairavībhāve kṛte kaḥ kutra
kaṃ praṇipatet | japo'tra bhūyobhūyaḥ parabhairavasvarūpe vimarśaḥ || 
kathamityāha ---- 


akṣamālāṃ tu saṅgṛhya gandhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ samacītām || 2-137 || 

vāṅniruddhaḥ sucittātmā rājīvāsanasaṃsthitaḥ | 

mūlamantraṃ samuccārya nāde līnaṃ vicintayet || 2-138 || 

unmīlyākṣāṇi saṃcintya tatastu japamārabhet | 


samacītāmiti "oṃ akṣamālāyai namaḥ" itiprayogeṇa | 
rājīvāsanasaṃsthita ityanena vakṣyamāṇadivyakaraṇādhirūḍhatvaṃ 
lakṣyate | ata eva paśyantyādirūpā vāk niruddhā mantrāmarśamayīkṛtā 
yena, ata eva śobhanamavicāli cittaṃ yasya tādṛgātmā yasya, mūlamantram 
iti sakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ vā, samyagiti akṣarākṣarasantānam iti krameṇa,
uccārya ūrdhvaṃ cārayitvā nāda iti | 

ṅāsyoccārayitā kaścit" (0-59)?

iti vakṣyamāṇanityoditasphurattātmani līnaṃ tanmayībhūtaṃ viśeṣeṇa
tadanupraveśātmanā cintayet | katham ? akṣāṇi indriyāṇi, unmīlya
ūrdhvaṃ mīlitāni kṛtvā, saṃcintya mantradevatāṃ samyagātmaikyena
cintayitvā, cintayanneva japamārabheta bhūyobhūyo mantraṃ vimṛśet | 
uktaṃ ca ---- 

"bhūyobhūyaḥ pare bhāve bhāvanā bhāvyate hi yā | 

japaḥ so'tra svayaṃ nādo mantrātmā japya īdṛśaḥ ||"

iti śrīvaijñānabhairave (145 ślo0) || 138 || 

atra ca ---- 


akṣarākṣarasantānaṃ na drutaṃ na vilambitam || 2-139 || 

japaḥ prāṇasamaḥ kāryaḥ................

akṣarādakṣaraṃ santānaḥ prasaraṇaṃ yatra | tena bījākṣarāṇāṃ 
hrasvadīrghādi mātrāḥ mālāmantrāṇāmakṣarāṇi 
cicchaktyātmamantradevatāsragumbhitāni vimṛśet | yathoktam ---- 

"mantraṃ maṇivadālambya prabhāvanmantradevatām | 

japadhyānādikaṃ kuryānna tāṭasthyena kutracit ||"

iti | na drutam iti grastakramavidhiṃ parihṛtyetyarthaḥ | na vilambitam
iti madhye madhye'tyanusandhiśūnyamiti yāvat | "prāṇasamaḥ" iti
madhyavāhinā prāṇenollāsapraveśātmanā samo madhyavāhī prāṇo 
yathāntarmāntraṃ parāmarśaṃ sahata ityarthaḥ | tena mālāmantrān 
prāṇaśaktāvaṃśāṃśikātvātmakrameṇa kramātkramamadhikaṃ 
niyojayaṃstāvadabhyaset, yāvat samastamālāmantraparāmarśaṃ 
prāṇaśaktirantaḥ kṣamate | tathā sati hi 
kalāgrāsātmakasaṃvitsatattvāsādanaṃ bhavati | catuṣkalapraṇavādīni tu 
piṇḍākṣarāṇi pañcapraṇavādhikāravakṣyamāṇavyāptyanusandhānenaiva
madhyamaprāṇasāmyena uccārayan japet | uktaṃ ca ---- 

ṅa puṃsi na pare tattve śaktau mantraṃ niyojayet | " iti || 139 || 

evamitikartavyatāmuktvā phalabhedaṃ nirūpayati ---- 

.......ḍinastho muktikāṅkṣibhiḥ | 

hṛdayād dvādaśāntaṃ prāṇavāhaḥ dinam, tatra tiṣṭhati, iti 
nirgarbhamapānavṛttyā praviśya mantragarbhamūrdhvaṃ prāṇānte 
viśrāntiparo japediti yāvat || 


saṃhāraḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ...............


samastāśeṣasaṃhārāt || 

ata eva ---- 

..............śivadhāmaphalapradaḥ || 2-140 || 

sādhakābhiprāyeṇa tu ---- 


vyomni prāpto yadā nādaḥ punareva nivartate | 

śarvarī sā tu vijñeyā hṛdabjaṃ yāvadāgataḥ || 2-141 || 

sṛṣṭireṣā samākhyātā sarvasiddhiphalodayā | 


vyomni dvādaśānte, nāda iti taccheṣībhūto mantro nivartate iti 
dvādaśāntāvasthitilabdhonmeṣavaśādapānakrameṇāntavīśet | 
sṛṣṭiriti āpyāyakaratvāt, sarveṣāmuttamādisiddhiphalānāmudayo yasyām 
| tenaivaṃ sādhakainīrgarbhameva prāṇavṛttyā muktipratyūhaparihārāya 
muṇḍāntamāśritya tata unmiṣadapānaśaktyāśrayeṇa hṛtprāptiparyantaṃ 
japaḥ kāryaḥ, ubhayāthīnā tu ubhayathāpi, ityarthānmantavyam | itthaṃ 
cāsya mantrasya aśuddhatattvasaṃhāraśuddhatattvasṛṣṭikāritayā 
muktibhuktipradamekameva pūrṇaṃ vīryam, ārādhakāśayabhedāttu 
pṛthagvibhajya upadiṣṭam || 141 || 

evaṃ ca kurvatā ---- 


ātmano bhairavaṃ rūpaṃ sadā bhāvyaṃ varānane || 2-142 || 

tasya vighnā vinaśyanti japaśca saphalo bhavet | 


sarvadaśāsu parabhairavacaitanyarūpamātmānaṃ bhāvayato vimṛśato
viśeṣeṇa ghnanti muktisiddhiprāptīḥ, iti vighnāḥ pāśāḥ 
pratibandhakāśca naśyanti, ata eva japo bhuktimuktibhyāṃ saphalo 
bhavedeṣāṃ yathābhiprāyam || 142 || 


japtvā nivedayed devi bhairavāya varānane || 2-143 || 

pūrakeṇa prayogeṇa..............


hṛdi sthitāya bhairavāya dvādaśāntāt praveśarūpeṇa pūrakaprayogeṇa
mumukṣustu phalānabhisaṃdhisaṃbandhinā "bhagavan japamevaṃsaṃkhyākaṃ
gṛhāṇa" iti nivedayet || 143 || 

kīdṛśam ---- 


........ṭristhaṃ ca tritayānvitam | 

trisiddhisiddhidaṃ devi.............


triṣu ullāsapraveśobhayātmakeṣu padeṣu tiṣṭhati, iti yaḥ (saḥ
tristhaḥ), tathā vāṅmanaḥprāṇātmakena tritayenānvitaṃ yuktam,
uttamamadhyamādhamabhedāttrirūpā yā siddhiḥ sādhakebhyaḥ, tathā
siddhiretadvilakṣaṇā mumukṣormuktirūpā, tāmuktavakṣyamāṇayuktyā
dadāti yaḥ | trisiddhiriti siddhiśceti yojayitvā vyākhyeyam || 
kiṃ ca ---- 


.............ṣarahasyamudāhṛtam || 2-144 || 


yojanikāyāṃ pañcapraṇavādhikāre ca vakṣyamāṇanītyā 
mumukṣububhukṣūṇāmūrdhvaṃ dvādaśāntamāhṛtaṃ prāpitam, 
ūrdhvāccāhṛtaṃ hṛdayāntaṃ prāpitaṃ sarahasyaṃ kaiścideva 
vikasitamadhyamārrgairlabhyamityarthaḥ || 144 || 

siddhivaiśiṣṭyenāsya sādhakaṃ prati viśeṣaṃ vaktumāha ---- 


śāntike mānaso japya upāṃśuḥ pauṣṭike smṛtaḥ | 

saśabdaścābhicāre'sau prāgudagdakṣiṇāmukhaḥ || 2-145 || 


etad vyācaṣṭe ---- 


ātmā na śṛṇute yaṃ tu mānaso'sau prakītītaḥ | 

ātmanā śrūyate yastu tamupā�śuṃ vijānate || 2-146 || 

pare śṛṇvanti yaṃ devi saśabdaḥ sa udāhṛtaḥ | 


mānaso madhyamāyāṃ vāci upāṃśusaśabdau tu sūkṣmasthūlaprayatnāyāṃ
vaikharyām | trayasyāsya bhogahetutvamanyatrāpyuktam ---- 

"madhyamo bhogamokṣākhya upāṃśuḥ siddhidāyakaḥ | 

vāciko bhūtaviṣajit saśabdaścābhicārikaḥ ||" 

iti | 

evaṃ vadan paśyantīparāvāgbhyāṃ muktau jīvanmuktau ca japaḥ kāryaḥ,
iti sūcayati | uktaṃ ca ---- 

"jīvanmuktau paro jñeyo muktau mudritabhedakaḥ | " 

iti || 146 || 

japopayoginīmakṣamālāṃ nidarśayati ---- 


aṣṭottaraśatenaiva akṣamālā samerukā || 2-147 || 

rudrākṣaśaṅkhapadmākṣaputrajīvakamauktikaiḥ | 

sphāṭikī maṇiratnotthā sauvarṇī vaidrumī tathā || 2-148 || 


etāśca ---- 

daśākṣamālā deveśi gṛhasthānāṃ prakītītāḥ | 


aṣṭābhirutkṛṣṭena adhikena śatena | evakāreṇa adhikasaṃkhyāyā
vyudāsaḥ, saptaviṃśaticatuṣpañcāśatsaṃkhyāyā api bhāvāt || 
yathākramam ---- 


sūtraṃ dhyātvā parāṃ śaktimadhvabhāgāṃstato maṇīn || 2-149 || 

vyaktisthānaṃ śivasyādhvā tatastastaddhamīṇīṃ smaret | 

saptaviṃśatibhiḥ kuryād dviguṇairvā caturguṇaiḥ || 2-150 || 

samaistu saṃhatairekaṃ śivatattvātmakaṃ mukhe | 

na taṃ vilaṅghayed vidvān sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāraṇam || 2-151 || 


atra ca navānām aṣṭādaśānāṃ vā ṣaṭtriṃśato vā tattvānāṃ 
tattvadīkṣāyāmiha mṛtyuñjayādau gaṇitānāṃ 
paraśaktiśivātmakasthūlasūkṣmaparabhedatraividhyādevaṃsaṃkhyākatvameva 
bhavati, iti tatra vyāptirasti || 151 || 

naiṣṭhikānāmāha ---- 


vīrasthānaratānāṃ hi vīrāṇāṃ varavaṇīni | 

mahāśaṅkhākṣasūtraṃ tu sarvakāmaphalapradam || 2-152 || 


vīrasthānaṃ śmaśānādi, mahāśaṅkhaṃ narāsthi, vīrā niṣkampāḥ || 
152 || 


etattu ---- 


gṛhasthena na kartavyamudvegajananaṃ param | 


yata evam ---- 


tasmāttu sphāṭikī mālā japtavyā sādhakottamaiḥ || 2-153 || 


sādhakottamairgṛhasthaiḥ || 153 || 


sā hi ---- 


sādhayedvividhān kāmānadhamān madhyamottamān | 


vividhasiddhikhagatividyātattvādyāptirūpān | mumukṣostu 
daśavidhākṣamālā uktaiva || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


evaṃ hṛdambujāvastho yaṣṭavyo bhairavo vibhuḥ || 2-154 || 

sabāhyābhyantaraṃ kṛtvā paścādyajanamārabhet | 


saha bāhyābhyantarābhyāṃ dehapuryaṣṭakabhairavatvāpādanābhyāṃ
vartate yo yāga eka eva, na tu karayordehe antaśca anyānyarūpo 
bhairavaikyasyaiva prāpyatvena upadekṣyamāṇatvāditi | sabāhyābhyantarama
ityaikyena ya upasaṃhṛto yāgaścidbhairave'śeṣaviśvārpaṇātmā,taṃ 
kṛtvā hṛdyāgapratibimbakarūpaṃ ca bāhyayāgam abhisaṃdhāya, ityapi ca 
sabāhyābhyantaraṃ kṛtvā ityasyārthaḥ | paścāditi japānantaram ---- 


mahāśūnyālaye vahnau bhūtākṣaviṣayādikam | 

hūyate manasā sārdhaṃ sa homaḥ sruk ca cetanā || (149)


iti śrīvijñānabhairavoktanītyā dvādaśānte mantrasmaraṇapūrvaṃkaṃ 
viśvabhāvārpaṇarūpaṃ homaṃ vidhāya antaryāgapratibimbarūpaṃ 
yajanamārabheta bāhyamityarthaḥ || 154 || 

ātmamantrārghapātramaṇḍalabhairavakusumādidravyāṇāṃ 
kartṛkaraṇāpādānādhikaraṇa saṃpradānakarmakārakarūpāṇāṃ 
brahmārpaṇadṛṣṭyā 
paramādvaitāpādanarūpabāhyapūjanābhyāsapariniṣṭhayā 
sarvavyavahāreṣu sarvakārakāṇāṃ cidbhairavaikyaṃ pratyabhijñāpyate, 
iti yad bahiryāgasatattvaṃ tatprastāvanāya 
kartṛkaraṇasaṃskārātmakāntaryāgānantaraṃ 
karmādisaṃskārādhāyakāpāda nādisaṃskārārthamarghapātravidhiṃ 
tāvadāha ---- 


tatrārghapātramādau vai sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tathā || 2-155 || 

śāṅkhaṃ śāmbūkaṃ śauktaṃ vā tāmraṃ mṛṇmayameva vā | 

padmapatrapalāśotthaṃ gṛhītvā''kṣālya vāriṇā || 2-156 || 

astrajaptena deveśi pralipyāgurucandanaiḥ | 

mṛṣṭadhūpena saṃdhūpya vāriṇā pūrayettataḥ || 2-157 || 

vastrapūtena śuddhena.................


arghapātraṃ rakṣādhāma | tatra ityantaryāgādbhairavībhāve jāte sati | 
ādāviti kusumādisaṃskārārtham | sauvarṇādi mumukṣoryathāsaṃbhavam | 
śambūkaḥ sāmudraḥ prāṇiviśeṣaḥ | palāśo yajñiyastaruḥ | 
ākṣālanaṃ bhedaśalyāpanayanam | āpūraṇam aśeṣaviśvamayībhāvānām 
|| 157 || 

tataḥ ---- 


...........ṭāḍayedastramuccaran | 

varmāvaguṇṭhitaṃ kṛtvā.............


atrānuktamapyanena mantreṇāpyāyanamamṛtamudrayā kāryam || 

anantaram ---- 


.........yāgaṃ tatraiva vinyaset || 2-158 || 


ijyata iti yāga mantragaṇaḥ | anenaiva cātra pūjanamapi sūcitam || 158 || 

katham ---- 


pūrvoktena vidhānena...............


antaryāgoktāsanādipūrvaṃ 
sphurattejorūpasakalamantraikādaśikāniṣkalatadaṅganyāsayuktyetyarthaḥ || 

tato'pi ---- 


.................prokṣyastena samāsataḥ | 

yāgārtho dravyasaṃghātaḥ..................


parāvṛttyavaṣṭambhenāvalokyeti śeṣaḥ | prokṣaṇam atra 
tejomayatvāpādanam | 

tataḥ puṣpādibhiḥ śirasi cidbhairavaṃ pūjayitvā ---- 


.................ṭato yajanamārabhet || 2-159 || 


atra bhūmikāṃ racayati ---- 


śaktiṃ nyasya tataścādau vyomākārāṃ sujājvalām | 

sakalavyāpikāṃ sūkṣmāṃ śivādhārātu sarvagām || 2-160 || 

oṅkāradīpitāṃ dekā namaskārāvasānikām | 


śiva ādhāra āśrayo yasyāstāṃ prathamonmeṣarūpāṃ 
vinyasanīyāśeṣāsanādibhittibhūtām, cinmātramūtītvena vyomākārām 
anupādhijñatvarūpasphurattayā sujājvalām, garbhīkṛtāśeṣaviśvatayā 
sakalavyāpikām, sarvairalakṣyatvāt sūkṣmām, ādhāramāsanapakṣam 
ādheyaṃ ca śivaṃ prāpyāvasthitatvāt sarvagāṃ dekā 
viśvakrīḍādipradaśīnīṃ pārameśvarīṃ śaktimādhārarūpāṃ 
parikalpanīyasya aśeṣasya tadutthatvena śivamayatvamanusaṃdhātum 
uktavakṣyamāṇavyāptikena oṅkāreṇa parabhairavarūpeṇottejitām "oṃ 
ādhāraśaktyai namaḥ" iti prayogeṇa nyasya uttaraṃ vidhimārabhetetyarthaḥ 
| eṣa ca śaktinyāsaḥ pūrvatra antaryāgādāvapi smartavyaḥ || 160 || 


anantaṃ caiva vinyasya dharmaṃ jñānaṃ tathaiva ca || 2-161 || 

vairāgyaṃ ca tathaiśvaryamāgneyyādikrameṇa tu | 

adharmaṃ ca tathājñānamavairāgyamanaiśvaram || 2-162 || 

saṃdhānakīlakāṃścaiva adhaśchādanamūrdhvagam | 

padmaṃ sakesaraṃ devi kaṇīkāṃ puṣkarāṇi ca || 2-163 || 

maṇḍalatritayaṃ devān śaktiñcāpi śivāntakam | 

mūtīṃ brahmakalājālaṃ navatattvaṃ tritattvakam || 2-164 || 

bhairavāṣṭakavidyāṅgalocanaṃ kṣurikāṃ tathā | 

śaktitrayaṃ paraṃ devamaṅgaṣaṭkasamanvitam || 2-165 || 

vinyasya bhāvayed devi satataṃ vidhipūrvakam | 


vidhipūrvakamiti pūrvoktadhyānādiyuktyetyarthaḥ | yadihānuktaṃ 
tatpūrvato'nusaṃdheyam, yacca pūrvatra noktaṃ 
tadito'nusaṃdheyamadhikārabhedenāntarbahiryāgayoḥ
paryāyeṇa prakṛtivikṛtirūpatvāt, sarvaṃ caitat pūrvaṃ nirṇītam || 165 
|| 


nirvartya tu yathānyāyaṃ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā || 2-166 || 

svāgataṃ cārghyapādyaṃ ca sannidhānaṃ tathaiva ca | 

rodhaṃ niṣṭhurayā kuryānmūlamantramanusmaran || 2-167 || 

pūjā suvipulā kāryā gandhadhūpasragādibhiḥ | 

mudrāṃ pradarśayet paścāt tridhā traikālyakarmaṇi || 2-168 || 

tata āvaraṇaṃ bāhye viniveśyaṃ varānane | 

īśapūrvayāmyasaumyavaruṇāntaṃ prakalpayet || 2-169 || 

vaktrāṇāṃ pañcakaṃ devi svadhyānaguṇasaṃyutam | 

āgneyaiśānarakṣaḥsu sāmīraindradiśorapi || 2-170 || 

uttarāntaṃ niveśyaṃ tu aṅgānāṃ pañcakaṃ tathā | 

netraṃ tu kaṇīkāyāṃ vai pūrvasyāṃ diśi saṃsthitam || 2-171 || 


etadapi pūrvameva vyākhyātam | prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā iti bhairavāśeṣa
(veśa)mayenetyarthaḥ | atra pūrvaṃ śrīmadaghoreśvarīnyāsaḥ smartavyaḥ 
| sāmīraindradiśorapi uttarāntam ityatraindradiśa uttarāntaṃ 
catudīkkamastraṃ kalpayediti yojyam | yathoktaṃ pūrvam ---- 

"agnīśarakṣovāyavyacatudīkṣu ca taṃ nyaset" (2-108)

ityādi || 171 || 

sarvatra vyāpakaṃ vidhimāha ---- 


svamantreṇa tu sarveṣāmarghyaṃ pādyaṃ samāhitaḥ | 


dadyāditi śeṣaḥ || 

samāhitatvaṃ sphuṭayati ---- 


mantrasaṅkarapuṣpāṇi na kuryāt sādhakaḥ sadā || 2-172 || 

na bāhuṃ pṛṣṭhato vāpi mantrāṇāṃ parikalpayet | 

paripāṭyā tu dātavyaṃ na mantrāṃllaṅghayet kvacit || 2-173 || 


mantrāṇāṃ saṅkaro yatra tādṛṃśi puṣpāṇi na kuryāt, 
nānyamantreṇānyamarcayedityarthaḥ | tadityevaṃ
kṛte sati sādhakaḥ parasiddhipātraṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ || 173 || 

evaṃ ca ---- 


svamudrāmantrasaṃyuktān yugapat parikalpayet | 


dhyānapūjādau svamudrābhiśca mantraiśca saṃyuktān devān parikalpayet | 
yeṣāṃ viśiṣṭamudrā noktāsteṣām ---- 

"kapālaṃ caiva khaṭvāṅgamanukteṣu pradarśayet" (14-20)

iti bhāvinaṃ vidhiṃ smaret || 

pūjā suvipulā kāryā ityuktam, asaṃbhavadvittastu kiṃ kuryāt ?

idityāha ---- 


arghyaṃ pādyaṃ ca dhūpaṃ ca nityaṃ tāvat samācaret || 2-174 || 

sarveṣāmeva mantrāṇāṃ vidhireṣa prakītītaḥ | 


vittaśāṭhyavarjaṃ nityaṃ pūjayet, sarvathā vittābhāve 
tūktaśāmbūkādināpi vā manasaivāpi pūjayedityarthaḥ || 174 || 

evamasaṃbhavadvittaviṣayāmarghyapādyapuṣpādisaṃpādyāṃ pūjāṃ 
prasaṅgāduktvā prakṛtamanubadhnāti ---- 

bhairavāṣṭakalokeśān sāstrān samparikalpayet || 2-175 || 

atha ---- 


bāhye śmaśānavinyāsaṃ praṇavādinamontagam | 

pūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ kalpayeta vidhānataḥ || 2-176 || 

āmardakaṃ ca pūrvaṃ vai śmaśānādhipatiṃ vibhum | 

śmaśānaiḥ sakabandhaiśca saśūlodbandhabhīṣaṇaiḥ || 2-177 || 

citibhiḥ prajvalantībhiḥ śivārāvaiḥ subhīṣaṇaiḥ | 

agnikaṃ dakṣiṇe bhāge kālākhyaṃ paścime tathā || 2-178 || 

ekapādaṃ tathā saumye āgneyyāṃ tripurāntakam | 

nairṛtyāmagnijihvaṃ tu vāyavyāṃ tu karālinam || 2-179 || 

eśānyāṃ bhīmavakraṃ tu śmaśāneśāḥ prakītītāḥ | 


ete ca 
śrīkāmarūpojjayinīkāśmīrakāñcīkaravīradevīkoṭṭoḍḍayānahiraṇya
puravāsinaḥ, ityāmnāyādetadādhārapīṭhādipūjā'rthasiddhaiva | atra 
śmaśānaiḥ sakabandhairityādi sarvaśmaśānasādhāraṇam | 
itthaṃbhūtalakṣaṇe caitāstṛtīyāḥ || 179 || 

etāṃśca ---- 


tarpayenmatsyamāṃsādyairāsavaivīvidhaistathā || 2-180 || 

gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ tathā dhūpaṃ sarveṣāṃ tu pradāpayet | 


śmaśānāni hṛdyāge noktāni mā bhūd dehaśoṣa iti, evamugratvādādau 
matsyādibhistarpaṇaṃ tataḥ pūjā, etāni yativiṣayāṇyeva | atra ca 
pakṣe lokapālāstrāvaraṇe pṛthakkārye, yathā ca pañcāvaraṇā pūjā 
bhavati || 180 || 

atra ca ---- 


praṇipātaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā japtvā mantraṃ subhāvitaḥ || 2-181 || 

recakena prayogena nivedya vidhipūrvakam | 

huḍḍuṅkāranamaskārān kṛtvā caiva tato vrajet || 2-182 || 

agnikuṇḍasamīpaṃ tu arghahastaḥ subhāvitaḥ | 


mantramiti mūlamaṅgasahitam, recakena vidhipūrvakam iti 
dvādaśāntārohatadviśrāntitadavarohapūrvaṃ nāsāgreṇa japtaṃ mantraṃ 
śapuṣpaṃ bhagavañjapaṃ gṛhāṇa" iti prayogeṇārpayet | 
bhaktivaivaśyonmiṣannādāmarśamayo dhvanirmukhavādyāparaparyāyo 
huḍuṅkāraḥ || 182 || 

kuṇḍasaṃskārānāha ---- 


kuṇḍaṃ tu lakṣaṇopetaṃ prokṣayedastravāriṇā || 2-183 || 

kavacenāvaguṇṭhyaitadastradarbheṇa collikhet | 

uddhṛtya prokṣayet paścādastramantreṇa bhāmini || 2-184 || 

pūraṇaṃ tena kartavyaṃ samīkaraṇameva ca | 

secanaṃ kuṭṭanaṃ caiva lepanaṃ tena kārayet || 2-185 || 

prokṣaṇaṃ śoṣaṇaṃ caiva tathāstreṇaiva kārayet | 


lakṣaṇopetaṃ pratiṣṭhāśāstrādinirūpitamānasvarūpam | 
paradṛgavalokanānantaraṃ prokṣaṇaṃ śuddhyarthamavaguṇṭhanaṃ 
rakṣārtham iti sarvatrānumantavyam, prokṣaṇaviśeṣāt saṃtāḍanaṃ 
tenaiva saṅgṛhītam | ete ca prokṣaṇādayaḥ śoṣaṇāntāstrayodaśa 
kuṇḍaniṣpattyavasare niṣpanne'pi vā tatra 
kriyāśaktyātmaparameśvararūpasaṃpattaye bhāvanayā kartavyāḥ | ullikhet
khanet | uddharaṇam aśuddhamṛdapāsanam saṃmārjanaṃ rajonivāraṇam || 185 
|| 

anantaram ---- 


pūjanaṃ gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ.................


"oṃkriyāśaktyātmane kuṇḍāya namaḥ" iti prayogeṇa | 

athātra vāgīśvaryavatārayogyatāṃ 
kartumastreṇābhimantraṇavajrīkaraṇagṛhīkaraṇāni vaktumāha ---- 


...........'sinā cābhimantraṇam || 2-186 || 

vajrīkaraṇamastreṇa...................


tadeva vyācaṣṭe ---- 


..........ṝekhāḥ pūrvāparāstrayaḥ | 

yāmyasaumyamukhī caikā vajrametat prakītītam || 2-187 || 


traya iti liṅgavyatyayāt, ullekhanavyāpāreṇaitatkāryam | yadvā 
pūrvāparāyatadarbhatrayamadhye dakṣiṇottarāyataṃ darbhakāṇḍamekaṃ 
kṣiptvā vajrasaṃsthānena kuṇḍasya dāḍharyaṃ janayet || 187 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


asinaivāgnikuṇḍaṃ taddarbhaiḥ pūrvāgrasaṃstaraiḥ | 

sabāhyābhyantaraṃ chādyaṃ gṛhahetvarthamīśvari || 2-188 || 


nivīghnaṃ gṛhaṃ saṃpādayitum || 188 || 


atha vāgīśyā mahattarakasyāsanaṃ nirūpayati ---- 


kuṇḍasya dakṣiṇe bhāge śuṣkagomayamāsanam | 

darbheṇa viṣṭaraṃ puṣpaṃ praṇavena prakalpayet || 2-189 || 


kuṇḍāntardakṣiṇe gomayāsanopari dārbhaṃ viṣṭaraṃ tadupari puṣpaṃ 
oṃ brahmāsanāya namaḥ iti dadyāt || 189 || 

etadupari mahattaramāha ---- 


svanāmapadasaṃyuktaṃ svadhyānena namontagam | 

āmantraṇapadenaiva brahmāṇaṃ sthāpya pūjayet || 2-190 || 

puṣpādibhiḥ sudhūpādyairdhruveṇa tu yathākramam | 


atra ca oṃ brahman saṃnihito bhava namaste" iti prayogaḥ || 190 || 


atra gṛhamadhyalābhārthamāha ---- 


catuṣpathaṃ kuṇḍamadhye darbhābhyāṃ praṇavena tu || 2-191 || 

pūrvasaumyāgrabhāgābhyāṃ viṣṭaraṃ tasya copari | 

puṣpaṃ tasyopariṣṭāttu hṛdayenaiva pūjayet || 2-192 || 

vāgīśīṃ ca samāhūya praṇavādinamontagām | 


hṛdayena naiṣkalena, vāgīśasyeyaṃ vāgīśī parāśaktiḥ, 
āhvānāmantraṇavibhaktyā paścād namaste iti sarvatra prayogaḥ || 192 || 

asyā dhyānapūrvāṃ pūjāmāha ---- 


nīlotpaladalaśyāmāmṛtumaccārulocanām || 2-193 || 

sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇāṃ sarvāvayavabhūṣitām | 

dhyātvā caivaṃvidhāṃ dekā sthāpayet kuṇḍamadhyataḥ || 2-194 || 

ṛtukāla ivottānāṃ śirasaiśānasaṃsthitām | 

pūjayed gandhapuṣpādyairbhavamantramanusmaran || 2-195 || 


dekā dyotamānāṃ vākśaktim, kuṇḍasya kriyāśaktyātmano madhye, 
sthāpayed avasthitiṃ bandhayet | uttānām ūrdhvadhāmni 
prasārātmakatananarūpām, ata eva cāru locanaṃ prakāśo yasyāḥ | 
nīlotpalaśyāmalatvaṃ tu māyīyarūpāpekṣamasyāḥ | ṛtukālaḥ 
śuddhavidyātmavahnyādijananaunmukhyam, śirasā parārūpeṇa, eśāne 
svātantryabhaṭṭārake, saṃsthitāṃ nityasaṃbaddhāmīśānadiśi 
niṣṭhaśirasaṃ ca | kiṃ kurvan, bhavati tena tena 
sakalabrahmabhaṅgyādirūpeṇa bhavo niṣkalabhaṭṭārakastasya 
mantramanusmaran tatsattāsamāviṣṭaḥ || 195 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 

tato mudrāṃ darśayeta saṃnidhānāya mantravit | 


mudrāṃ yonyākhyām || 


tato'gnipātramādāya śivāmbho'streṇa prokṣayet || 2-196 || 

kavacenāvaguṇṭhyāpi praṇavenaiva pūjayet | 

araṇyādisamudbhūtaṃ lokāgnyantaṃ vidhānataḥ || 2-197 || 


agnimityuttarasthaṃ kākākṣivadihāpi saṃbandhyam || 197 || 

atha ---- 


agniṃ tu śukravad dhyātvā caitanyaṃ praṇavena tu | 


kalpayedasyeti śeṣaḥ | nāsāpathenāgniṃ praveśya svacaitanyaikīkāraṃ
nītvā recayediti guravaḥ || 

tato'pi ---- 


ṣaḍaṅgenaiva saṃpūjyaṃ amṛtatvaṃ dhruveṇa tu || 2-198 || 


dhruveṇa iti paracaitalyamantreṇa śrīniṣkalena ṣaḍaṅgenaiva 
parāmṛtāpādanarūpaṃ pūjanamasya kuryādityarthaḥ || 198 || 

atha ---- 


ātmānaṃ bhairavaṃ dhyātvā agniṃ dhyātvā tu bījavat | 

dhruveṇa kuṇḍabāhye tu tridhā bhrāmyāvatārayet || 2-199 || 

yonau tu bījavat kṣiptvā bhairaveṇa śivāmbhasā | 

astramuccārya saṃprokṣya yoniṃ pracchādayed budhaḥ || 2-200 || 

darbheṇa dhruvamantreṇa................


tridhā bhrāmya iti yonyākārasaṃpuṭagṛhītaṃ pātraṃ 
savyāpasavyakrameṇa tridhā yonikṣobhārthamābhrāmya avatārayed yoniṃ 
prāpayet | bhairaveṇa tu śrīniṣkalena | dhruvamantreṇa iti praṇavena 
taduccamekhalāsaṃsthaiḥ prāgagrairudagagrairhutabhugveśmano 
darbhairakṣavāṭaṃ | prakalpayet | śrīmantrarāje itthamūrdhvamukhaiḥ iti 
copakalpitamupekṣyam | buddhaḥ śivasamāveśaikaśālī | ātmano 
hetukartṛtvaṃ śivasya tu mukhyakartṛtvam ityādivyākhyānamasat, 
śivībhūtasyaiva śivayāge'dhikṛtatvāt kaivātra paśubhāvaśaṅkā ? 
paśutve vā kathaṃ mocakatā ? "mantrāḥ karaṇabhūtāstu paśukāryasya 
sādhane | 

ācāryaḥ karaṇaṃ proktaḥ śivarūpo yataḥ smṛtaḥ ||" (3-160)

ityādinā ca vakṣyamāṇena kā saṅgatiḥ ? irityāstāmetat | ayaṃ tatra
rahasyārtho'dyāpyanunmudrito'smadguruvaktrapāramparyāyātaḥ prakāśyate 
---- 

parāvāṅmāheśī jagadajanayat svāprathanato
	viśuddhāntardhāmā vikṛtikalanāgrastavibhavam | 

śritajyeṣṭhāsphārāttanitatanureṣā taducitaṃ
	śiśuṃ dṛṣṭyā raudryā prathayati śivābhedasarasam || 

ataḥ pūrṇāhantāmṛtarasasamāsvādasuhitaḥ
	śivāveśādvācaṃ śivarasaparaunsukhyamubhagām | 

svavīryeṇākramya pravaragururagnyādi nikhilaṃ
	śivaikātmasvātmadyutimayamayaṃ sañjanayati || 


iti || 200 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


............'kṣavāṭaṃ tato nyaset | 

astreṇaiva catudīkṣu darbhaireva prakalpayet || 2-201 || 


devyā guptyarthamakṣavāṭaṃ javanikāsthānīyaṃ 
rakṣārthamūrdhvamukhairdarbhairnyaset || 201 || 


athāntarvatnyā devyāḥ ---- 


saptavārāstramantreṇa darbheṇaiva tu kaṅkaṇam | 

dakṣahaste tu badhnīyādastramantramanusmaran || 2-202 || 

rakṣārthamagnigarbhasya................


"oṃ kaṅkaṇaṃ badhnāmi namaḥ" ityūhamantro'tra | evaṃ sarvatra
karmaucityenohamantrāḥ kartavyāḥ | dakṣahaste puṅgarbhārthaṃ 
kaṅkaṇabandhaḥ || 202 || 

evaṃ prokṣaṇāvaguṇṭhanollekhanoddharaṇaprokṣaṇādi- 
śoṣaṇāntaistrayodaśabhiḥ saṃskāraiḥ kuṇḍaṃ saṃskṛtya saṃpūjya, 
astrābhimantraṇavajrīkaraṇakuṇḍācchādanātmasaṃskāratrayaṃ
gṛhahetvarthaṃ kṛtvā, brahmaṇa āsanāvāhanapūjanāni vidhāya, 
gṛhamadhyalābhāya catuṣpathaṃ kṛtvā, 
vāgīsyāvāhanāsanapūjanaśukradhyānacaitanyāpādana (amṛtī) 
karaṇaviśeṣadhyānatrirābhramaṇayoniprakṣepān nava saṃskārān 
prakalpya, punarvāgīśyāḥ prokṣaṇayonipracchādanākṣavāṭa-
kalpanakaṅkaṇabandhāṃścatuḥsaṃskārān vidhāya, 
agnerdīkṣādikarmasaṃpattisamarthaṃ māntraṃ dehaṃ saṃpādayituṃ
vaktrāṅgakramādgarbhādhānādisaṃskārānāha ---- 


..........garbhādhānamato bhavet | 

aparāsyatrirāhutyā pūjanaṃ hṛdayena tu || 2-203 || 

hṛdā trirāhutiṃ dattvā garbhādhānaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet | 


praṇavapūrvaṃ paścimavaktrabījaṃ lakāramuccārya "garbhādhānaṃ karomi 
svāhā" iti triḥ kṛtvā hṛdayena naiṣkalena "garbhādhānaṃ saṃpadyatāṃ 
svāhā" iti trirjuhuyāt evamuttaratrānusaṃdheyam | atra "pūjanaṃ hṛdayena 
tu" iti madhyagranthaḥ pūrvaṃ yojyaḥ, tenādāvāṅgamantreṇāhutitrayam,
uttaratra īdṛśa eva kramasya bhāvāt || 203 || 

puṃsavanamāha ---- 


hṛdā vai jalabinduṃ tu darbhāgreṇātra pātayet || 2-204 || 

gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjāṃ śikhayā kārayettataḥ | 

trirāhutiṃ cottareṇa śikhayā ca trirāhutim || 2-205 || 

paṃsaḥ kalpanameva hi na strīgarbhe tu janyate | 


jalabinduṃ puryaṣṭakarūpaṃ jīvamabhisaṃdhātuṃ "pumān bhava namaḥ" 
ityantena prayogeṇa atretyāhite garbhe kṣipet | śikhayā naiṣkalyā, 
uttareṇeti vakāreṇa | puṃstvamupacayaḥ kārye śaktatvam, apacayaḥ 
strītvam || 205 || 

atha ---- 


sīmantaṃ dakṣiṇāsyena darbhāgreṇa prakalpayet || 2-206 || 

grīvāmaṃsau kaṭiṃ caiva bāhū jaṅghe prakalpayet | 

pratyaṅgāni ca saṅkalpya sīmantonnayanaṃ bhavet || 2-207 || 


puryaṣṭakopari sthūladehapravibhāgamātramiha sīmantaḥ | dakṣiṇāsyam
aghoravaktramantraḥ, pratyaṅgāni karodaracaraṇāṅgulyādīni || 207 || 

atra ca ---- 


gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjā śirasā cāhutitrayāt | 

pūrvamadhyāparān vahnau trīn bhāgān parikalpayet || 2-208 || 

mukhahṛtpādadeśāṃstu homāttacca tritattvakam | 


pūjeti kāryā, śiraseti kākākṣivat | āhutitrayāddhomādittyekavākyatā 
| taccaitadbhāgatrayaṃ śivavidyānarākhyatattvatrayarūpam | mukhena 
mūrdhā, pādābhyāṃ guhyamākṣiptamityeṣaivātra daṇḍabhaṅgiḥ || 208 
|| 


pratyaṅgānīti yaduktaṃ tadvibhaktuṃ kavāṭaktrādi nya 
situṃkavāṭanyāsaṃ tāvadāha ---- 


śirāṃsi pañcāhutyaiva ūrdhvāsyena tribhistribhiḥ || 2-209 || 


kalpayediti śeṣaḥ | śirāṃsi kavāṭāni, ūrdhvāsyena kṣakāreṇa | atra 
ca sutāriṇyādyāḥ prāgvat kalā anusaṃdheyāḥ || 209 || 


athaitadanūdya vaktrakalābhirvaktrakalpanāmāha ---- 


pañcavaktraṃ tu saṅkalpya madhyaprāgyāmyasaumyakam | 

aparaṃ cāpyāhutibhiḥ pūrvāsyena trisaṃkhyayā || 2-210 || 

vaktrāṇāṃ niṣkṛtiṃ tadvadāhutīnāṃ trisaṃkhyayā | 


"pañcamaṃ yad bhavedvaktraṃ kṣakāreṇaiva" (1-49)


iti pūrvamuktatvād ādau madhyamamūrdhvavaktraṃ kṣakāreṇa 
śāntyatītānusaṃdhānena prakalpya, paścāt pūrvāsyena yakāreṇa 
vaktracatuṣṭayaṃ śāntyādikalānusaṃdhinā pratyekaṃ tisṛbhirāhutibhiḥ 
kalpyam, madhyetyādāvuktatvād ādau madhyamavaktranyāsaḥ | etacca 
sarvatrānusaṃdheyam || 210 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


netraṃ netreṇa saṅkalpya mukheṣvevaṃ trayaṃ trayam || 2-211 || 

āhutitritayenaiva....................


netreṇa sakalanetramantreṇa || 211 || 


etacca ---- 


........ṭilaiḥ sarvaṃ tu kārayet | 


sarvamityagnisaṃskārajātam, ājyaṃ tu niṣpannasya śivāgnestarpaṇāya,
niṣpattiścāsya bhairavarūpasyaiveti || 


tataḥ kalāsamūhaṃ ca pañca cātha catuṣṭayam || 2-212 || 


sīmantonnayanamadhya eva 
tadvaktrakalādinyāsastantrāntaravailakṣaṇyenehoktaḥ || 212 || 

evamīśānapuruṣakalābhiḥ pratyaṅganyāsamuktvā aghorakalābhirāha ---- 


aṣṭāṅgāni tathā trīṇi daśa cāṣṭāvanukramāt | 

śeṣāsyaiḥ saṃprakalpyaivaṃ kalāmūtīstato bhavet || 2-213 || 


aṅgāni "hṛdi grīvā" (sva0 taṃ0 1 | 50) ityādiprāguktāni | evamiti
pratyaṅgam, tattatkalānusaṃdhināhutitrayeṇa | kalā mūtīryasyeti 
bahuvrīhiḥ || 213 || 

athātraiva ---- 


aṅgāni vinyaset paścād hṛdādyāni yathākramam | 


netrasyoktatvāt tadvajītāni sakalāṅgāni tanmantrairnyaset | evaṃ
"pratyaṅgāni saṅkalpya" iti yaduktam, tadeva pūrvamadhyetyādinā 
ślokaṣaṭkena vibhaktam || 

evametatsarvaṃ kṛtvā ---- 


trirāhutiṃ dakṣiṇena................


dakṣiṇavaktramantreṇa śīmantonnayanaṃ karomi" ityantena dadyāt || 

atha ---- 


............śirasā cāhutitrayam || 2-214 || 


cakāro'nenaivādau pūjāṃ kuryāt, iti prastāvapūraṇaṃ dhvanati | yattu 
---- 

"gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjā śirasā cāhutitrayāt" (2 | 208)

iti pūrvoktam, tadbhāgatrayakalpanayā tritattvakalpanārtham || 214 || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


sīmāntonnayanaṃ hyevaṃ..............


evaṃ vibhaktāvayavasyāgneḥ


..........jātakarma tvathocyate | 

astreṇa vījayedagnimastreṇaiva tu pūjayet || 2-215 || 

trirāhutiṃ tu pūrveṇa astreṇaivāhutitrayam | 

evaṃ mantradvayenaiva jātakarma kṛtaṃ bhavet || 2-216 || 


vījanaṃ prasavābhimukhīkaraṇam, pūrveṇa "ya"kāreṇa || 216 || 

evaṃ garbhādhānasīmantonnayanajātakarmāṇi kṛtvā ---- 


astreṇa prokṣayet kuṇḍa sadyaḥ sūtakaśuddhaye | 


āpāditaśivabhāvo'pi dīkṣādisaṃpattyarthaṃ yato'gniḥ śarīraṃ 
grāhitastataścidātmano dehagrahaḥ sūtakarūpaḥ 
sarvāśuddhiprathamāṅkuraḥ śodhya eva || 


jātasyāgneḥ ---- 


vaktrāṇyudghāṭayet paścādvaktreṇaivāhutitrayāt | 


udghāṭanaṃ vikāsaḥ | 

yathā ---- 


vaktrāṇi śodhyānyasinā āhutitrayayogataḥ || 2-217 || 


prativaktraṃ svamantreṇa parāmṛśya "śodhayāmi" ityūhānte'stramuccārya 
trirjuhuyāt || 217 || 

tathā ---- 


vaktrābhidhārau vaktraistu vaktre vaktre trayaṃ trayam | 


vaktreṣvabhidhāro dīptiḥ | trayaṃ trayamiti āhutīnāṃ dadyāditi 
śeṣaḥ || 

vahneḥ saṃrakṣaṇārthaṃ dikṣu devatānyāsaṃ prastotumāha ---- 


prokṣayet kuṇḍapārśvāni sāstreṇaiva śivāmbhasā || 2-218 || 

darbhānāstīrya pūrvāgrān dakṣiṇottarasaṃsthitān | 

saumyāgrān pūrvavāruṇyoḥ paridhīn viṣṭarāṃstathā || 2-219 || 


hastamātrāḥ śākhāḥ paridhayaḥ | samadhyagranthi dārbhamāsanaṃ
viṣṭaraḥ | 

evaṃ kramātkramamantardarbhaparidhiviṣṭarāḥ ---- 


astramantreṇa te sarve...............


nyasanīyāḥ | 

tatra ---- 


.................brahmāṇaṃ pūrvaviṣṭare | 

rudraṃ ca dakṣiṇe sthāpya viṣṇuṃ paścimaviṣṭare || 2-220 || 

sadāśivaṃ cottare'tha svanāmapadacihnitam | 

ādau dhruvaṃ smared devi namaścānte prakalpayet || 2-221 || 

gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjyāḥ svarūpaṃ teṣvanusmaret | 


spaṣṭam | 

tato'pyantaḥ ---- 


mekhalopari lokeśān pūjayet praṇavena tu || 2-222 || 


evaṃ ca ---- 


rakṣārthaṃ jātabālasya brahmādyāḥ pūjitāstu ye | 

tataḥ kaṅkaṇakaṃ muktvā dakṣahastavyavasthitam || 2-223 || 

puṣpaṃ saṅgṛhya devena śivāgnernāma kalpayet | 


garbhasya jātatvādrakṣāntarasya ca vihitatvād garbharakṣāyā adhikāro
nivṛtta iti kaṅkaṇamokṣaḥ | devena mūlamantreṇa sapraṇavena 
"śivāgnirbhava namaḥ" iti nāmakalpanam || 223 || 

atha ---- 


kavacenopacāraṃ tu gandhapuṣpādidhūpakaiḥ || 2-224 || 


kavacena naiṣkalena "śivāgnaye namaḥ" ityantena upacāraṃ pūjāṃ kuryāt 
|| 224 || 

atra ---- 


ūrdhvāsyenāhutīstisraḥ kavacena trayaṃ punaḥ | 


prāgvadūhamantreṇa dadyāt | evaṃ 
sūtakaśuddhivaktrodghāṭanavaktraśuddhivaktrābhighāraviṣṭarādinyāsa-
devatāsthāpanatadarcanakaṅkaṇamokṣaṇānyaṣṭau avāntarasaṃskārān 
kṛtvā nāmakaraṇākhyaḥ paścimaḥ saṃskāraḥ kṛtaḥ || 

atha ---- 


śivanāmāṅkitaṃ vahniṃ janayitvā surāṃstataḥ || 2-225 || 

visarjayettu svasthānaṃ sāvitrīṃ praṇavena tu | 

puṣpādibhiḥ samabhyarcya homaireva tribhistribhiḥ || 2-226 || 


tuścārthe bhinnakramaḥ | tena surān brahmādīn sarasvatīṃ ca 
praṇavādisvanāmabhirabhyarcya pratyekamāhutitrayeṇa saṃtarpya 
"kṣamyatām" ityuktvā visarjayet || 226 || 

atha ---- 

dhāmnaivedhmāstu hotavyā hastamātrapramāṇataḥ | 

catuvīśatisaṃkhyātāḥ śivāgnestarpaṇāya tu || 2-227 || 


dhāmnā niṣkalena | idhmā asphuṭitā ṛjvyaḥ satvacaḥ śakhāḥ || 227 || 

evaṃ tilaiḥ saṃskārānuktvā ājyakāryān saṃskārān 
prastotumājyaprakṣepakaraṇasruksruvasaṃskārārthamāha ---- 


sruksruvau saṃpratāpyāgnau śivāmbho'streṇa prokṣayet | 

kavacenāvaguṇṭhyaitau śivāgnau bhrāmayet tridhā || 2-228 || 

astreṇa mārjayedadbhirdarbhāgreṇātha saṃspṛśet | 

punaragnau paribhrāmya prokṣayettau śivāmbhasā || 2-229 || 

darbhamadhyena saṃspṛśya bhūyo'gnau bhrāmya tāpayet | 

śivāmbhasā mārjayitvā darbhamūlena saṃspṛśet || 2-230 || 

sruksruvābhyāṃ tato mūlaṃ sthāpayettāvadhomukhau | 

darbhāṇāṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ pūjyau dakṣiṇe'gneḥ sadā budhaiḥ || 2-231 || 


mārjanaṃ prokṣaṇameva, tāpanaṃ kāṣṭhādibhāvanivāraṇāya | yathoktam 
---- 

"...........................ṭāpayettejasi tridhā | 

sañjātau tena saṃtaptau kāṣṭhabhāvaparāṅmukhau ||" 

iti || 

sṛṣṭikrameṇātra darbhasyāgramadhyamūlaistadagramadhyamūlasparśena 
trirbhramaṇena ca icchādiśaktitrayamayatvamanayorjāyate | 
sruksruvābhyāmiti sruksruvayorityarthaḥ | saṃskāradvādaśakānantaraṃ 
pūjyāvadhomukhāviti sṛṣṭyunmukhatvābhiprāyeṇa | agnerdakṣiṇe 
hoturvāme, iti dīptyāpyāyanābhyāmanayoryugapat 
saṃbandhenāgnīṣomamayatvāpattiḥ || 231 || 

atha ---- 


ājyasaṃskaraṇaṃ kuryādājyādhiśrayaṇādikam | 


adhiśrayaṇaṃ saṃprokṣite pātre prasrutasya sthāpanam | 
kvacidadhisravaṇamiti pāṭhaḥ | tatrādhikaraṇabhāṇḍe 
tāpanamityayamarthaḥ || 

ādiśabdasūcitān saṃskārānāha ---- 


ājyaṃ saṃprokṣya cāstreṇa kavacenāvaguṇṭhayet || 2-232 || 

śivāgnau tāpyamastreṇa udvāsyaṃ kavacena tu | 

kuṇḍasya parito devi tridhā bhrāmya tu sthāpayet || 2-233 || 

yonisaṃsthaṃ cājyapātraṃ.................


tāpanaṃ dīptyarthamāgneyyāṃ diśi | udvāsanamagnerūrdhvadhārarṇaṃ
dīpteḥ sphuṭatārtham || 233 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


................utplavaṃ saṃplavaṃ tataḥ | 


tasyājyasyotplavaṃ ca kuryāditi śeṣaḥ || 

kenetyāha ---- 


darbhāgradvayamādāya prādeśaṃ madhyagranthitam || 2-234 || 

pavitrametadvihitamutplavaṃ tena saṃplavam | 


prasāritāṅguṣṭhatarjanīmānaṃ prādeśaḥ || 234 || 


kathamityāha ---- 


aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ tu gṛhītvaitat pavitrakam || 2-235 || 

parāṅmukhaṃ tu trīn vārān saṃmukhaṃ trīṃstathaiva ca | 


astreṇaiva tu mantreṇa..................


asārabhāgāpanayanāyotplavaṃ sārāharaṇāya saṃplavam || 


kiṃ ca ---- 


.............'vadyotaḥ śivāgninā || 2-236 || 


astreṇetyeva kārya iti śeṣaḥ || 236 || 


taṃ vyācaṣṭe ---- 


darbholmukaṃ tu saṅgṛhya ājyapātraṃ nirīkṣayet | 


tena prakāśayet | atra cāvasare svanetratejonirīkṣaṇena paratejomayaṃ
cājyaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ || 


nīrājanaṃ tataḥ kuryāt................


niḥśeṣeṇa rājanaṃ ca jvalitena darbheṇa sarvato bhrāmitena 
dīpanamastreṇaiva | 


..............paryagnikaraṇaṃ tataḥ || 2-237 || 


katham ---- 


dhāmnāstramantramuccārya tamagnāvulmukaṃ kṣipet | 


dhāmnā mūlena saha paritaḥ samantādagnikaraṇaṃ tejomayatvāpattiḥ || 

tataḥ ---- 


dhāmnaiva vidhinā mantrī prokṣayedasravāriṇā || 2-238 || 


vidhiḥ śivābhedābhisaṃdhiḥ || 238 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


abhimantrya ṣaḍaṅgena amṛtatvaṃ śivena tu | 


niṣkalena sāṅgenābhimantraṇamevamamṛtatvamamṛtamudrayā || 

evamājyaprokṣaṇāvaguṇṭhanatāpanodvāsanabhrāmaṇotplavasaṃplavāvadyota
nanīrājanaparyagnikaraṇaprokṣaṇāmṛtākhyasaṃskārān dvādaśa kṛtvā -
--- 


sakṛduccārayogena pūjayed bhairaveṇa tu || 2-239 || 


niṣkalena || 239 || 

evaṃ kartrapādānakaraṇādhikaraṇakarmaṇāṃ 
yaṣṭrarghapātrasrugādisthaṇḍilāgnyājyādīnāṃ saṃskāraiḥ 
saṃpradānātmakabhairavadevataikyāpādanaṃ kṛtvā tadeva 
draḍhayitumagnivaktrāṇāṃ bhairavavaktramantrairabhisandhimāha ----  
vaktrasaṃdhānakaṃ vaktrairāhutitritayena tu | 

etadvyācaṣṭe ---- 


aparāsyena tadvaktrasaṃdhānaṃ tu samācaret || 2-240 || 

evaṃ saumyasya vaktrasya saṃdhānaṃ tu kṛtaṃ bhavet | 

trirāhutiprayogeṇa dakṣiṇasyāpyayaṃ vidhiḥ || 2-241 || 

pūrvavaktre'pyathaivaṃ syādūrdhvavaktraṃ śivānvitam | 

trirāhutiprayogeṇa vaktrasaṃdhiḥ prakītītaḥ || 2-242 || 


aparāsyeneti tanmantreṇa, tadvaktrasaṃdhānamiti tenaivāparavaktreṇa
saṃdhānamiti arthāduttaravaktrabījanāmabhyāṃ vispaṣṭasya uttarasya | 
yadāha ---- evaṃ saumyasya vaktrasya saṃdhānaṃ tu kṛtaṃ bhavediti | 
ataśca "oṃlaṃ sadyojātavaktreṇa oṃvaṃ vāmadevaktramanusaṃdadhe svāhā" 
iti
prayogaḥ | evam "oṃvaṃ vāmadevavaktreṇa oṃraṃ aghoravaktramanusaṃdadhe
svāhā" iti prayogaḥ | evamanyat | śivānvitamitīiśānaviśrāntisāram | 
atra prativaktrānusaṃdhiṃ tristilairjuhuyāt, na tvājyena, 
tatsaṃskārāṇāmasamāptatvāt | paścimapramukhamūrdhve viśrāntiḥ 
kāryā || 242 || 

mumukṣūn prati asyaiva prādhānyādityāha ---- 


mukhyamūrdhvaṃ smṛtaṃ vaktraṃ guṇatvamitareṣu tu | 


atha karmaucityānuguṇyena yanmukhyaṃ vaktraṃ tadūrdhvaṃ smartavyam,
ityatrāpyarthe'nusaṃdhimuktvā prasaṅgādvaktrabhedena homamāha ---- 
muktikāmasya dīkṣāyāmūrdhvavaktrasya mukhyatā || 243 || 

etannaimittikaviṣaye || 243 || 

kāmye tu vibhāgenāha ---- 


pādalepāñjanādyā vai siddhīstu vividhāśca yāḥ | 

sadāśivāntagāḥ sarvāḥ pūrvavaktre tu homayet || 2-244 || 


vividhā iti uttamamadhyamādhamāḥ | homayediti homena sādhayet || 244 || 


māraṇoccāṭanādau tu vidveṣe stambhane tathā | 

dakṣiṇe caiva vaktre tu homāt siddhiḥ parā bhavet || 2-245 || 

śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ caiva saubhāgyākarṣaṇāni ca | 

saubhāgyārohasiddhiṃ tu uttare homayet sadā || 2-246 || 


ākarṣaṇaṃ paracittādeḥ || 246 || 

nityaviṣayamapyāha ---- 


paścime nityakarmāṇi...............


sarvaiḥ kāryāṇi, tasya vidhipūrvakatvāt || 

sa eṣa ---- 


..............viniyogaḥ prakītītaḥ | 


evaṃ ca yo yatra vaktre karma kartuṃ vāñchati, sa tadūrdhve nyaset,
ūrdhvaṃ tu tatsthāne | yadvakṣyati ---- 

".................yena yatkarma vāñchitam | 

tanmukhyavaktraṃ saṅkalpya ................. ||" (sva0 2-264)

iti || 

evaṃ prastute nityakarmaṇi ---- 


ājyabhāgo hi hotavya ūrdhvavaktre tu paścime || 2-247 || 


paścime sadyojāte, ūrdhvavaktre ūrdhvavaktrasthāne prāpita ityarthaḥ || 
247 || 

evamasya bhairavāpattiparyantān saṃskārān kṛtvā 
vahnerbhairavavaktrānunusaṃdhinā bhairaveṇaikatāṃ saṃpūrya, 
idānīmājyavahnyoḥ krameṇa tridhāmatvāpādanārthamāha ---- 


ājyapātrasya madhye tu darbhe vai bhairaveṇa tu | 

nyasitavyo varārohe tato vai vartmakalpanā || 2-248 || 


tata iti madhyasthadarbhadvayadānādvartmanāṃ trayāṇāṃ mārgāṇāṃ
kalpanā kāryā | darbha iti jātāvekavacanam || 248 || 

kathamityāha ---- 


uccārya bhairavaṃ pātre saṃpātaṃ pātya vartmanā | 

nāḍītrayeṇa yugapat pātre bhāgatrayaṃ nyaset || 2-249 || 


nāḍītrayarūpeṇa vartmanā mārgatrayeṇa bhairavaṃ niṣkalamuccārya
ājyagatabhāgatraye triṣṭhayā prāṇaśaktyā icchājñānakriyātmanā
samaṃ pātaṃ viśrāntiṃ kṛtvā vahnisomasūryātmakadhāmatrayamayaṃ
bhāgatrayaṃ nyased anusandadhīta || 249 || 

atra vibhāgaḥ ---- 


suṣumnāṃ madhyamārgasthāṃ dakṣe piṅgāṃ prakalpayet | 

iḍābhāge tu yattejo vāme saumyaṃ prakalpayet || 2-250 || 


evamājyaṃ tridhāmamayīkṛtya taddhomādvahnimapi tanmayīkartumāha ---- 


evaṃ tribhāgaṃ saṅkalpya sruvamāpūrya homayet | 

bhairaveṇaiva mantreṇāgnaye svāhāntameva ca || 2-251 || 

agnibhāgāttu saṅgṛhya................


madhyanāḍisthaṃ prakāśānandasāramagnīṣomātmakaṃ dhāma 
pṛthaktvamābhāsayad vāme somatāṃ śrayati dakṣiṇe tu vahnitām, tatra 
somātmano haviṣo'ntarvatīnaḥ prajvālakasyābhāvānna na madhyavad 
bhedadāhakātmatvam, iti tatprakāśakatvamātrāt sūryarūpatāpyucyate, 
upādānaucityāt tvagnitāpītyagnibhāgo'tra dakṣiṇaḥ, ata eveha 
piṅgaletyagnināmnā dakṣanāḍī vyavahitā | tṛtīyapaṭale tu ---- 

"piṅgalāmadhyamārgeṇa varṇoccārakrameṇa tu |" (sva0taṃ0 3-22)

iti,

"piṅgalā madhyamā nāḍī" (sva0taṃ0 3-149)

iti ca madhyanāḍyukteti yujyata eva, iti na kaścit pūrvāparavyāghāto'sti 
| tato vibhāgo'tradakṣiṇakṛtanāḍīsampātānusāraṃ svadakṣiṇastato 
homo'gnerdakṣiṇe bhāge | evaṃ vāme'pi jñeyam || 251 || 

atha ---- 


...........ṣruveṇājyāhutiṃ kṣipet | 

somabhāgastu somāya svāhetyante samuccaran || 2-252 || 


sapraṇavaṃ niṣkalapūrvo'tra mantraḥ, ityādikamādiśan 
pūrvoktamanuvadati ---- 


dhāmādipraṇavādyaṃ ca sruveṇājyāhutiṃ kṣipet | 


kriyāviśeṣaṇametat || 

tato'pi ---- 


agnīṣometi saṃjñe dve svāhānte dhāma cāditaḥ || 2-253 || 

praṇavādyājyamadhyāt tu sruvamāpūrya homayet | 

śuklapakṣe vidhirhyeṣa................


agniṣometyatra agnīṣomābhyāmiti prayogaḥ | ayaṃ śuklapakṣe vidhiḥ | 
anyatra tu ---- 


...............kṛṣṇapakṣe'nyathā bhavet || 254 || 


tamāha ---- 


somabhāge bhavet sūryo hyagnisaṃjñā tu pūrvavat | 

agneḥ sūryasya madhyād (vai) āhutiṃ pratipādayet || 2-255 || 

yataḥ sūryasya madhye vai amāvasyāṃ viśecchaśī | 


śuklapakṣe somasya pūrṇatvāt somāyetyāhutiḥ | kṛṣṇapakṣe tu 
kṣīṇasyendoḥ sūryamaṇḍalākramaṇāt sūryāyetyāhutiḥ | madhye tu 
agnisūryābhyāmiti | anyattu pūrvavat || 255 || 

evamagnerapi tridhāmamayatvaṃ saṃpādya ---- 


prāśanārthamato homo vaktrāṇāṃ bhairaveṇa tu || 2-256 || 


kārya iti śeṣaḥ | ata eva tridhāmamayīkārādanantaraṃ tena praṇavaṃ 
niṣkalaṃ vaktramantraṃ coccārya "agneḥ prāśanaṃ karomi svāhā" 
ityanto'tra prayogaḥ | prāśanaṃ ca bhāvipāśabhakṣaṇādyaucityādhānam 
|| 

anyānapi saṃskārānekapraghaṭṭakena śivāgneḥ 
puṣkalatāsaṃpattisatattvānāha ---- 


cūḍādyā ye tu saṃskārā agnerbālāntasaṃsthitāḥ | 

prāpaṇārthāya sarveṣāṃ pūrṇāmekāṃ pradāpayet || 2-257 || 

bhairavaṃ tu samuccārya.................


ādiśabdādupanayanādayo bālasya brahmacāriṇo'nte ye saṃsthitā 
udvāhādayaḥ | atra ca "agneḥ cūḍādyāḥ sarve saṃskārāḥ santu 
svāhā" ityantaḥ prayogaḥ | pūrṇāyāmitikartavyatā bhaviṣyati || 257 || 
evaṃ kṛte sati pravṛddhaḥ ---- 


..............śivāgniḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ | 


sarveṣāṃ samayyādīnāṃ sarvāḥ siddhirdadātīti tantreṇetyarthaḥ | 
evaṃ saṃskṛtācchivāgneścarvarthaṃ punaḥ saṃskāraṃ vinā 
nityakarmārthaṃ ca ---- 


"śrāpyāścarupuroḍāśāḥ pañcasaṃskārasaṃskṛte | 

anāhūte śive vahnau..................... ||"

ityanyatroktatvādanāhūtaparameśvara eva || 

agniṃ tu proddharet paścāt pātre saṃsthāpya rakṣayet || 2-258 || 


kavacāvaguṇṭhitaṃ rakṣitaṃ kuryāt || 258 || 

atha ---- 


kuṇḍasya cottare bhāge viṣṭarasya ca bāhyataḥ | 


praṇītaṃ kalpayettatra..............


viṣṭarasyeti rudrāśrayasya || 

praṇītaṃ vyācaṣṭe ---- 


.................camasaṃ vāripūritam || 2-259 || 


camasaṃ dārupātram || 259 || 

tatra ca yajñadhvaṃsanāśino viṣṇorāsanārtham ---- 


puṣpākṣatatilairyuktaṃ pavitraṃ tatra vinyaset | 


tasmiṃśca ---- 


praṇavādi samāvāhya viṣṇunāma tato namaḥ || 2-260 || 

āmantraṇapadenaiva viṣṇuṃ saṃsthāpya pūjayet | 


svāgatāsanapādyārghaiḥ..............

atra prāgvat prayogataḥ

...........ṭato vijñāpayettu tam || 2-261 || 

paśvarthaṃ yajña ārabdha ātmārthaṃ vātha sādhakaiḥ | 

bhagavaṃstvatprasādena yāge niśchidratā'stu naḥ || 2-262 || 


paśvarthaṃ naimittike, dīkṣāvidhānārthaṃ nitye, bhagavan kāmye
iti yojyam || 

evamitikartavyatāṃ kṛtvā ---- 


tato'gnau yajanaṃ kṛtvā bhairavaṃ tu prapūjayet | 


kathamityāha ---- 


sthaṇḍiloktavidhānena anantādīn prakalpayet || 2-263 || 


atra vibhāgaṃ tāvaduktvā karmaucityenāgnivaktrajihvākalpanaṃ kartumāha -
--- 


dhyātvā vaktrāṇi pañcādau yena yatkarma vāñchitam | 

tanmukhyavaktraṃ saṅkalpya mukhaṃ kuṇḍapramāṇataḥ || 2-264 || 

bhāvayennava jihvāstu vaktre vaktre pratiṣṭhitāḥ | 


vaktrāṇāṃ guṇamukhyatākalpanaṃ pūrvameva suvibhaktam | mukhamityāsyam 
|| 264 || 

jihvānāṃ digvibhāgamāha ---- 


prāgādyaṣṭau madhya ekā....................


prāgādi kṛtvā ca eśāntamaṣṭau || 

tāsāṃ ca ---- 


..............kāmyārthe diggatāstu yāḥ || 2-265 || 


yāḥ prāgādidigaṣṭasthāstāḥ kāmye karmaṇi ityarthaḥ || 265 || 

tāḥ karmacoditairnāmabhiruddiśati ---- 


rājyārthā dāhajananī mṛtyudā śatrukārikā | 

vaśīkartryuccāṭanī syādarthadā muktidāyikā || 2-266 || 


navamyāḥ karmocitaṃ nāmāha ---- 


sarvasiddhipradā madhye.................


yata evam ---- 


.............ṭasmānmadhye tu homayet | 


evamuddiṣṭānām ---- 


pūrṇā tu bhairaveṇaiva jihvānāṃ kalpanāya ca || 2-267 || 

punaḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ caiva bhairaveṇa pradāpayet | 


ekatra mūlamantrapūrvam "agnijihvāḥ kalpayāmi" iti prayogaḥ | anyatra
"jihvāsaṃnidhirastu svāhā" iti || 267 || 

atha vahneḥ paramasaṃskārakaraṇapūrvamanantādīn prakalpayediti 
yadupakṣiptaṃ tannirvāhayati ---- 


jvālāgraṃ tu hṛdāgṛhya vahnicaitanyakalpitam || 2-268 || 

ātmahṛtsthaṃ tu saṅkalpya yogapīṭhaṃ tu kalpayet | 

madhyajihvānusāreṇa agninābhau tu kandakam || 2-269 || 

nālaṃ hṛdavadhi dhyātvā padmaṃ tatra vicintayet | 


vahnicaitanyarūpatayā kalpitaṃ bhāvitaṃ jvālāgraṃ hṛdā hṛnmatreṇa 
āgṛhya nāsāpathena svīkṛtya hṛdgatacaitanyānalaikībhāvena 
bhairavīkṛtya bāhyavahneḥ sūkṣmadehasyāpi bhairavatāṃ kartuṃ | 

"yogo'sya śaktayaḥ svākyā visphūrjanti samantataḥ" | (1-5-5)

iti mataṅgoktanītyā yogapīṭham anantādisadāśivāntaṃ 
śaktirūpamāsanamasya kalpayet || 269 || 


patrāṣṭakasamopetaṃ sitavarṇaṃ sutejasam || 2-270 || 

anantaṃ kalpayettatra dharmādicaraṇāntikam | 

oṃkāreṇa śivāntaṃ ca...............


gatārthametat || 270 || 

tataḥ ---- 


............'gnimūtīṃ prakalpayet || 2-271 || 


prāgvat haṃsākṣareṇaiva || 271 || 

tato'pi ---- 


śikhā hṛdi sthitā yā tu dhruveṇotkīlayet punaḥ | 

recakeṇa kṣiped vahnau sā mūtīrbhairavātmikā || 2-272 || 


dhruveṇa niṣkalena, utkīlayet svacaitanyabhairaveṇaikīkṛtāmuddharet, tato 
dakṣanāsāpathena bāhyavahnimūrtau kṣipet, evameṣā mūtīrbhairavātmikā 
bhavati || 272 || 

atha ---- 


mūtībhūtaṃ prakalpyaivamaṣṭātriṃśatkalāyutam | 

śodhyādhvānaṃ tu vinyasyed dīkṣākāle varānane || 2-273 || 


aṣṭātriṃśatkalāḥ pūrvoktā vaktrabhaṅgyādyupalakṣaṇaparāḥ | 
śodhyādhvānamiti yenādhvanā gururdīkṣāṃ cikīrṣati || 273 || 

evaṃ kṛtvā ---- 


bhairavaṃ pūjayitvā tu śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā | 

vaktrasaṃdhiśca vaktrābhyāṃ śivavaktrāgnivaktrayoḥ || 2-274 || 


śāstradṛṣṭeneti yathoktāvaraṇāntaṃ mānasenārghādikrameṇa | 
vaktrābhyāmiti bahvarthaṃ dvivacanam, tena vaktramantrairityarthaḥ | 
śivavaktre bhairavavaktram, atra ca "oṃ laṃ sadyojātākhyabhairavavaktraṃ
śivāgnivaktre'nusaṃdadhe svāhā" ityādikrameṇa vaktrasaṃdhiśca 
pūrvoktavaktrasaṃdhivilakṣaṇaḥ kartavyaḥ || 274 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


saṃdhāya caivaṃ jihvābhyāṃ..................


antarbahirvahnivaktrāṇāṃ parameśavaktrairmantrapūrvaṃ 
jihvānusaṃdhānaṃ kṛtvā


...........ṇāḍīsaṃdhirato bhavet | 


tadāha ---- 


mūlamantraṃ samuccārya agnināsāvinirgatam || 2-275 || 

sthaṇḍilasthaśivālīnamekārthaṃ caiva saṃdhayet | 


agnihṛdayādbhāvanayā mūlamantramuccārya taddakṣiṇena nirgatya 
sthaṇḍileśasya vāmena praviśya dakṣiṇena niryāyāt, iti krameṇa 
sarvāvaraṇamantreṣvanusaṃdhāya agnervāmena viśet ekārthamityabhinnaṃ 
svacchandabhairavātmakaṃ vācyadevatārūpamityarthaḥ || 275 || 

evamanusaṃdhāya ---- 


śuddhājyenāhutiśatamaṣṭotkṛṣṭaṃ varānane || 2-276 || 

bhairavasya tu hotavyaṃ vaktrāṅgānāṃ daśāṃśakam | 

bhairavāṣṭakalokeśān daśamāṃśena homayet || 2-277 || 


ṣaṭitraśattattvāni sthūlasūkṣmaparabhedādaṣṭottaraśatamiti 
(vyāptyā) (adhiśrayaṇādidvādaśa) 
saṃskārai1rāpāditāśeṣaviśvamayatvena ājyena 
aṣṭottaraśatasruvahomādbhairavamantradevatāṃ tarpayet 
anugrahābhimukhīkuryādityarthaḥ | vaktrādīnāṃ daśāṃśatve'bhiprāyo 
japaprakaraṇe nirṇīto'ṅgavaddevyā devavadityanye || 277 || 

atha ---- 


mūlamantraṃ samuccārya pūrṇāmekāṃ prapātayet | 


sarvamantracakratarpaṇāya || 

tato'pi pradhānabhūtamūlamantratṛptyarthaṃ dvitīyāṃ pūrṇāṃ 
dadyādityāha ---- 


bhairavāpyāyanārthāya tathā pūrṇāṃ prapātayet || 2-278 || 


tato'pi ---- 


punarnyūnātiriktārthaṃ niśchidrakaraṇāya ca | 


mūlena pūrṇāṃ pātayediti śeṣaḥ | nyūnātiriktanivṛttyarthameva 
niśchidrakaraṇam || 

evaṃ nityahomavidhiṃ nirvartya ---- 


paścāddhomaḥ prakartavyo yathecchaṃ tu varānane || 2-279 || 


yathecchamiti naimittikaḥ kāmyo vā || 279 || 

athaivaṃ homadravyavibhāgaṃ tattatsādhanābhiprāyato nidīśati ---- 


sarvakāmaprado homastilaiḥ śasto ghṛtānvitaiḥ | 


pṛthak tu ---- 


dhānyairdhanārthasiddhyarthaṃ...............


ājyāktairiti sarvatrānuṣaṅgaḥ | dhanamajāvikam, artho hiraṇyādikam || 


...............ghṛtaguggulahomataḥ || 2-280 || 

jāyate vipulā siddhiradhamā madhyamottamā | 


tathā ---- 


śvetāravindairājyāktaiḥ..................


homaḥ kāryaḥ | 


..........bilvaiśca śriyamāpnuyāt || 2-281 || 

kṣīrāktatilahomena śāntikarma varānane | 


prāyaśca dravyāṇi jātabhedena caturdhā sthitānīti tairhomārhaiḥ |  
sitaraktapītakṛṣṇaiḥ śamanākṛṣṭipauṣṭikam || 282 || 


māraṇaṃ ca varārohe krameṇa parikalpayet | 


kiṃ ca ---- 


kundapuṣpaiḥ sutārthāya...............


homo bhavati || 


...............'śokaiḥ priyasaṅgamaḥ || 2-283 || 

jātikuḍmalakaiḥ kanyā gāndharvī bakulodbhavaiḥ | 

nāgaistu nāgakanyā vai siddhārthaiḥ siddhakanyakā || 2-284 || 

caṇyakaiścāpyapsaraso narendraḥ phalguṣeṇa tu | 

ghṛtāktena varārohe samantro sapurohitaḥ || 2-285 || 

rājñī putrasamopetā vaśaṃ yāti varānane | 

yakṣiṇī vaśamāyāti puṣpaiścaiva kadambajaiḥ || 2-286 || 


sarveṣvabhimateṣu tairityanuṣaṅgaḥ kāryaḥ | nāgairiti puṃnāgaiḥ, 
siddhārthaiḥ puṣpaviśeṣaiḥ | atra yaiḥ puṣpairhomastatra tairevārcanaṃ 
kāryam, phalguṣamiti nṛmāṃsam || 286 || 


tathā vidyādharīṃ kuyyakaiśca sādhayennātra saṃśayaḥ | kuyyakāni 
kuṭakākhyāni | nātra saṃśaya ityanena niścitapratipatteḥ karma phaladaṃ 
bhavati, ityāha, ata eva śiṣyalakṣaṇe dṛḍhavrata ityetatsādhakaviṣaye 
yojitam || 

home hastasaṃsthānamāha ---- 


mṛgīṃ baddhvā tilairhomaḥ...............


prasṛtatarjanīkaniṣṭhāṅguliraṅguṣṭhamadhyamānāmāsaṃdaṃśātmā 
mṛgībandhaḥ || 


................padmabilvairadhiṣṭhitam || 2-287 || 


akhaṇḍitaiḥ kṛtvā juhuyāditi śeṣaḥ || 287 || 


bhakṣyairgrāsapramāṇaistu dhānyaiḥ prasṛtisammitaiḥ | 

atra ca hastasaṃniveśo yathocitamanumantavyaḥ || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


evaṃ homānusāreṇa sādhako vidhisaṃsthitaḥ || 2-288 || 

pūjāhomarato nityaṃ yān yān kāmān samīhate | 

tāṃstān sa sādhayatyeva bhairavasya vaco yathā || 2-289 || 


vidhau śāstraniyantrite karmaṇi samyak sthitaḥ kāmān kāmyamānāni 
phalāni, yathā bhairavasyājñā sa hyāgamātmājñāmātreṇaiva sarvaṃ 
sampādayati | atha ca yathā yena satyābhisaṃdhirūpeṇa bhairavasya 
sarvaśakteḥ, na tu parimitasya kasyacididaṃ vacaḥ, tathā tena prakāreṇa 
āśvastānāmeṣa vidhiranuṣṭhīyamānaḥ sādhayatyevābhīṣṭamiti śivam 
|| 289 || 


gurucaraṇasarojāmodamattaṃ mano me
	yadiha kimapi tattvaṃ vyākarocchaivaśāstre | 

vividhavidhirahasyaṃ syāt tadāsevyamānaṃ
	bhavaharaharadhāmāveśi sadbhaktibhājām || || 


iti śrīsvacchandatantre śrīmahāmāheśvarācāryavaryaśrīkṣemarāja-
viracitoddyotākhyavyākhyopete'rcādhikāro nāma dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ || 2 || 





tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ


" svacchandodyotaḥ "

yatra galatyunmiṣite'śeṣā saṃsāravāsanāvisrā | 

adhivāso'sau sarvo jayati parānandaniḥṣyandī || 

evaṃ prāsaṅgikānantaraprameyagarbhamavaśyānuṣṭheyaṃ nityakarmoktvā
prāptanirūpaṇāvasaraṃ naimittikaprathamabhūtamadhivāsaṃ nirṇetuṃ

bhairava uvāca ---- 


adhivāsaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ | 


devaguruśiṣyadravyāṇāṃ bhāvidīkṣocitayogyatātmakasaṃskāraparigraho
yāgagṛhādhikaraṇavasanaṃ cādhivāsaḥ sa ca guruṇā kāryaḥ ---- iti
tatsaṃskāropakramameva tamāha ---- 


vāriṇā suviśuddhātmā kṛtakṛtyaḥ prasannadhīḥ || 3-1 || 

bhasmoddhūlitadehastu mudrālaṅkārabhūṣitaḥ | 

jihmajenopavītena savāsā vā digambaraḥ || 3-2 || 

sugandhigandhaliptāṅgaḥ puṣpasragdāmabhūṣitaḥ | 

divyābharaṇasaṃpannaḥ suprasannaḥ subhāvitaḥ || 3-3 || 

sudhūpitaḥ sutāmbūlaścandanāgurucacītaḥ | 


ātmā śarīraṃ manaśca | kṛtyaṃ saṃdhyāvandanādi, atha ca kṛtakṛtyaḥ 
parabhairavaikyaparipūrṇaḥ, tata eva prasannā tyaktabāhyābhilāṣā dhīḥ 
yasya | mudrālaṅkārabhūṣitaḥ 
śikhākarṇaprakoṣṭhapratiṣṭhāpitapañcamudraḥ | jihmaḥ śavaḥ tajjena 
tatkeśajena | etacca yathāyogaṃ gṛhasthanaiṣṭhikācāryaviṣayaṃ 
vyākhyeyam | sugandhi ityādinā idamāha ---- yasya svabhāvena 
śivabhāvanāparatvaṃ nāsti, sa bāhyopacāreṇāpi cetaḥ prasādya 
subhāvitaḥ śivāveśonmeṣamayaḥ syāt | yataḥ ---- 

ṅa cāvajñā kriyākāle saṃsāroddharaṇaṃ prati | 

mantradānavratādeśaśiṣyadhruṅ nārakī bhavet ||"

ityāmnātam || 

kiṃ kuryādityāha ---- 


makhadvārapradeśe tu sthitvā prāgiva bhāvitaḥ || 3-4 || 

dvārādhyakṣān pūjayitvā puṣpaprakṣepaṇaṃ tataḥ | 

huṃphaṭkāraprayogeṇa tālāśabdaṃ vidhāya ca || 3-5 || 

pārṣṇyadhohastasaṃyogādvighnaproccāṭanāya vai | 

pārṣṇyā bhūmigatān hanyāttālayā cāntarikṣagān || 3-6 || 

mantraidīvyān viśodhyaivaṃ yāgaharmyaṃ viśettataḥ | 


puṣpaprakṣepaṇaṃ tālāśabdaṃ vighnaproccāṭanāya pārṣṇyā 
adhobhūmisaṃyogāt hastasaṃyogācca vidhāyeti vidadhadviśediti yojanā | 
antarikṣaṃ bhuvolokaḥ | spaṣṭamanyat || 6 || 

atha ---- 


rakṣāṃ pūrvavadastreṇa paritaḥ parikalpayet || 3-7 || 

varmaṇā māyārūpeṇācchādyaiva tu makhālayam | 

tato dakṣiṇadigbhāge upaviśya varānane || 3-8 || 

karanyāsaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ dahanotpūyane tathā | 

plāvanāpyāyane caiva sakalīkaraṇaṃ tathā || 3-9 || 

pūrvavanmānasaṃ yāgamantardehe samācaret | 


parita iti astraprākārarūpām, māyārūpeṇa iti māyā hi 
kalātattvāntāśeṣācchādikā durbhedā ceti tadrūpena | śiṣṭaṃ 
nirṇītapūrvam || 9 || 

antaryāge prāguktaṃ vidhiṃ smārayati ---- 


śaktyādhāramanantaṃ ca dharmādicaraṇāvadhi || 3-10 || 

gātrakāṇi tvadharmādyāstathā saṃdhānakīlakān | 

adhaśchādanamūrdhvaṃ ca padmakesarakaṇīkāḥ || 3-11 || 

puṣkarāṇi ca śaktīśca maṇḍalān maṇḍalādhipān | 

śivāntamāsanaṃ dadyāt pūrvarūpaṃ dhruveṇa tu || 3-12 || 

mūtībrahmakalāvyūhaṃ navatattvaṃ tritattvakam | 

dvātriṃśadakṣaraṃ devaṃ bhairavāṣṭakameva ca || 3-13 || 

vidyāṅgāni tathā dekā kṣurikāṃ locanatrayam | 

śaktitrayaṃ paraṃ devamaṅgaṣaṭkasamanvitam || 3-14 || 


nirṇītaṃ caitat | naimittike'pi sarvametat kāryamiti punaḥ 
pāṭhe'bhiprāyaḥ || 14 || 

api ca ---- 


mudrāmantrāṃśca dravyāṇi yathāsthānaṃ prakalpayet | 


āvāhanasthāpanasaṃnidhānanirodhanādirūpā mudrāḥ, āsanato 
bhairavāntān mantrān, pādyācamanīyārghādīni dravyāṇi | 
yathāsthānamiti pūrvoktayā nītyā || 

tadetatsarvam ---- 


saṅkalpya ca yathānyāyaṃ yathāyogaṃ prakalpayet || 3-15 || 


yathāyogaṃ yathākramaṃ yo yo nyāyo nirūpitavyāptyanusaraṇaṃ 
tadanatikrameṇetyarthaḥ || 15 || 

athāvaraṇanyāsamapi smārayati ---- 


sadyojātaṃ ca vāmaṃ ca aghoraṃ ca yaduktavān | 

puruṣeśau ca devasya dalasthāṃścopakalpayet || 3-16 || 

hṛdayādīṃstataḥ pañca diśāsu vidiśāsu ca | 


uktavānahamityarthaḥ | diśāsvityādiraiśaḥ pāṭhaḥ || 16 || 


kiṃ ca ---- 


pūrvato yāvadīśāntaṃ bhairavāvaraṇaṃ bahiḥ || 3-17 || 

lokapālāṃstadastrāṇi pūrvādīśāntakāvadhi | 


parikalpayedityanuṣajyate || 17 || 


mantrasaṃdhānamāha ---- 

astrāṇi lokapālāṃśca bhairavāṣṭakameva ca || 3-18 || 

pañcabrahmāṇyathāṅgāni etānyāvaraṇāni hi | 

krameṇoccārayet sarvānyāvattadgarbhamaiśvaram || 3-19 || 


mantrasaṃdhānametaddhi.................


"śūlahastāyeśānāya namaḥ" iti prātilomyakrameṇa 
sakalāntamuttarottaralīnatākrameṇoccāraṇaṃ mantrasaṃdhānam 
"pañcabrahmāṇyathāṅgāni" iti prātilomyakrame'pyānulomyena pāṭho 
vaktrāṅgānāmekāvaraṇahetutayā, iti tryāvaraṇo'yaṃ kramaḥ || 19 || 


atha ---- 


...............paramīkaraṇaṃ śṛṇu | 

uccārayettato devaṃ hrasvadīrghaplutānvitam || 3-20 || 

tāvaduccārayenmantraṃ yāvannirvāṇagocaram | 


devaṃ dyotanādisatattvaṃ śrīniṣkalam | hrasvetyādi, 

"hrasvaṃ dīrghaṃ plutaṃ sūkṣmamatisūkṣmaṃ paraṃ śivam" (6-4)

iti pañcapraṇavādhikāre vakṣyamāṇasthityā 
akārokāramakārabindunādavarṇakalāsu hrasvādimātrārūpāsu 
vakṣyamāṇavyāptyanusāreṇa viśramya nirvāṇagocaraṃ dvādaśāntaṃ 
yāvanmantramuccārayedityarthaḥ || 20 || 


atraivetikartavyatāṃ pūrayati ---- 


adhaḥśakteryāvadūrdhvaṃ somasūryapathāntarā || 3-21 || 

piṅgalāmadhyamārgeṇa varṇoccārakrameṇa tu | 

devatāpañcakaṃ śaktiṃ vyāpinīṃ samanonmane || 3-22 || 

bhedayitvā kramāt sarvaṃ yāvadvai nidhanāntikam | 

nistaraṅgaṃ niradhvākhyaṃ sakalavyāpi conmanam || 3-23 || 


vakṣyamāṇadivyakaraṇakrameṇa adha iti kandāt prāṇaśaktiṃ hṛdayaṃ 
prāpayya vāmadakṣiṇavāhamadhye pūrvanirṇītadiśā piṅgalānāmnā 
madhyamārgeṇākārokārādīn nādaparyantaṃ 
hrasvādirūpavarṇoccārakrameṇa brahmādisadāśivāntaṃ devatāpañcakaṃ 
taduparitanasusūkṣmatamamantrāṃśaiśca śakttyādyunmanāntaṃ bhedayitvā, 
granthirūpatāvidāraṇayukttyā parāvāgrūpamantraparāmarśaṃ śeṣaṃ 
kurvan nidhanāntikaṃ sarvopaśāntipadaṃ dvādaśāntaṃ yāvat 
mantramuccārayedityarthaḥ | kīdṛśaṃ nidhanāntikam ? taraṅgebhyo 
bhedakallolebhyo niṣkrāntam, niṣkrāntā ullasitā 
varṇamantrādyādhvanāmākhyāḥ prathā yatastādṛśam, tathā 
sakalasyāśeṣasya vyāpakam | īdṛśaṃ kathamekaṃ vastu bhavatītyāha ---- 
unmanam mananaṃ sarvaṃ saṅkucitaṃ saṃvedanamutkramya sthitaṃ 
svatantramityarthaḥ || 23 || 

atha ---- 


tadadhyāsya.................


tanniṣkalaṃ tattvaṃ gāḍhāvaṣṭambhena kiṃcitkālaṃ samāviśya | 


...........ānulomyena hṛtpadme viniveśayet | 


dvādaśāntāt prabhṛti tattvaṃ ca ---- 

śamanā unmanā caiva" (11-29)

ityādivakṣyamāṇadṛṣṭyā mantraprameyasṛṣṭikrameṇāvaruhya  
hṛtpadmapratiṣṭhāpitasakalabhaṭṭārakavyāpakatvena bhāvayet || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


sarveṣvāvaraṇeṣvevaṃ devi tad vyāpakaṃ nyaset || 3-24 || 


evamiti ekenaiva prayatnena || 24 || 


tena cādhiṣṭhitāḥ sarve sarvakāmaphalapradāḥ | 


tadraśmipuñjātmakatvāt sakalādimantrāṇām | co hyarthe || 

atra pūrvoktaṃ dhyānādi smārayati ---- 


yathā svarūpasaṃsthānavarṇā ye kathitā mayā || 3-25 || 

tathā te viniyoktavyā mānase mānasena tu | 


svarūpaṃ mūlaṃ brahmāṅgādirūpam, saṃsthānam ākṛtiḥ, varṇaḥ 
sitādiḥ kathitā iti dvitīye paṭale | mānasa iti yāge, mānasena cittena 
|| 25 || 

tataśca ---- 


kaṇīkāyāṃ tu saṃsthāpya dvidhāvasthaṃ ca bhairavam || 3-26 || 

śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ sarvamantrairalaṅkṛtam | 


dvidhā sakalaniṣkalabhāvena, avasthā anugrāhyānugrahāya 
svasvātantryeṇāvasthitiryasya, sakalaṃ sitākāraṃ niṣkalaṃ tu 
prakāśamātratattvam alaṅkṛtam iti raśmiparivṛtam | evaṃ 
dvātriṃśadakṣarāpekṣayā yadyapi mūlamantrasya niṣkalatvaṃ 
tathāpyakārādikaloccāre sati sakalatvamapyastīti || 26 || 


yatsatyato niṣkalaṃ tattvaṃ tannidīśati ---- 


tatrāpi parato jñeyamanirdeśyamanāmayam || 3-27 || 


tatra tayoḥ sakalaniṣkalayorupari parataḥ paraṃ paripūrṇena rūpeṇa 
bhairavasvarūpaṃ jñeyam, svataḥ prakāśamānaṃ pratyabhijñeyamityarthaḥ 
| yatastad anirdeśyam idantāyā na viṣayo yasmāt, anāmayaṃ 
sūkṣmatamenāpi āmayenākhyātyātmakamahāmāyāsparśena śūnyam || 27 || 
tathā ca ---- 


yatra nāsti dvidhābhāvaḥ.........


niṣkalasakalādyaśeṣasāmarasyātmakatvāt || 


.........ṇa (ca)mantrādikalpanā | 

oṃkārabindunādānāṃ vilayaṃ taṃ vinidīśet || 3-28 || 


sarvamantraprameyaviśrāntipadaṃ tajjānīyādityarthaḥ | yadvakṣyati ---- 

"yāvaduccāryate vācā yāvallekhye'pi tiṣṭhati | 

tāvat sa sakalo jñeyaḥ |" (7-239) iti | 

tathā ---- 

"akṣareṣu kuto mokṣaḥ paraṃ tattvamanakṣaram |" (7-238)

iti || 28 || 

ataśca ---- 


tatsthānaṃ durlabhaṃ matvā saṃbhavenna kadācana | 

yasya nāgraṃ ca mūlaṃ ca na diśo vidiśastathā || 3-29 || 

na śabdo nāpi cākāśaṃ dhyātvā tattu vimucyate | 


tiṣṭhatyasmin sarvamiti sthānam | ākṛtiśūnyatvād mūlāgrādyabhāvaḥ, 
varṇātmakamantrarūpaśūnyatvānna śabda ityuktam | evamapi na 
tacchūnyamityāśayenoktaṃ nākāśamiti | dhyātvā iti 
akṛtakāhaṃvimarśaviśrāntyā samāviśya vimucyate jīvanmuktirāpyate || 
29 || 

tadittham ---- 


prathamaṃ mānasaṃ yāgaṃ paścād dravyasamanvitam || 3-30 || 

ya evaṃ satataṃ kuryād daiśiko yāgatatparaḥ | 

svahaste sthaṇḍile liṅge maṇḍale caruke tathā || 3-31 || 

jale cāgnau ca saṃpūjya samyag dīkṣāphalaṃ labheta | 


mānasya prāthamyaṃ śivībhāvaṃ vinā 
śivayāge'dhikārābhāvādityuktatvāt, deśika upadeśaprayojana ācāryaḥ 
| satatamiti nityārcāratatvāt | svahaste iti śivahastadānāvasare, 
sthaṇḍila ityadhivāsamaye, liṅge iti 

"liṅgaśabdena vidvāṃsaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāraṇam | "

ityādinirukteḥ prastāvocitaśiṣyacaitanye bāhye'pi vā bāṇādirūpe
bhākte, maṇḍale iti vakṣyamāṇarūpe, caruke havivīśeṣātmani, jale
kalaśasthe, vahnau pāśadāhake | dīkṣāyāḥ phalaṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ 
bhairavātmakasvarūpapratyabhijñānam labheta tatra 
hetukartṛkatvasāmarthyamāsādayatyeva | evaṃ ca sarvathā 
śivībhāvātmakamānasayāgapūrvaṃ bāhyayāgaṃ nirvartayet || 31 || 

anyathā ---- 


akṛtvā mānasaṃ yāgaṃ yo'nyaṃ yāgaṃ samārabhet || 3-32 || 

aśivaḥ sa tu vijñeyo na mokṣāya vidhīyate | 


aśiva iti mānasayāgakāryaśivībhāvābhāvāt tathābhūtaśca 
paśurmokṣāya na vidhīyate tadarthamadhikriyate ityarthaḥ || 32 || 

yataḥ ---- 


ātmayāge kṛte caiva dehaśuddhiḥ prajāyate || 3-33 || 


co hyarthe | evaśabdo jāyateśabdādanantaraṃ yojyaḥ | tena 
yasmādyāgādanantaraṃ bāhyāntarobhayarūpasya dehasya 
śivībhāvāveśātmā śuddhirjāyata eva, tasmādasāvavaśyakārya 
ityarthaḥ || 33 || 

tathā hi sati ---- 


adhiṣṭhitaṃ śivenaiva tamācāryaṃ vinidīśet | 


śivena sahacāritvādācārya iti hi vakṣyati || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


ātmanirdahanaṃ caiva mānasaṃ ca yaduktavān || 3-34 || 


ahamityarthaḥ | ātmā iha dvividho dehaḥ || 34 || 

viditvā samyagācāryaḥ pāśahā sa śivaḥ smṛtaḥ | 


samyagvedanaṃ dehādyahantāpraśamanena śivāhaṃbhāvāveśaḥ | 

yāgasyāsya prabhāvamāha ---- 


yatra yatra sthito deśe yaścaivaṃ tu vidhiṃ yajet || 3-35 || 

brahmahāpi sa mucyeta kiṃ punaḥ śivatatparaḥ | 


vihitamahāpātako'pi bhagavadicchāprayojanād yo vidhimimamabhisaṃdhāya 
yajet bhagavantamarcayet, so'pi mucyate || 35 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


sarvāvasthāgataścaiva viṣayairanurañjitaḥ || 3-36 || 

sakṛt saṃpūjya mucyeta kiṃ punaryo dine dine | 


śarvāvasthāgata" ityādinā samayapālanāsamartho bhogabhugapi 
sakṛnnirbījadīkṣāyāmarcanānmucyate, tasmāt satatametadarcanaṃ 
putrakādyaivīdheyamityevaṃparametat || 36 || 

asyā arcādikriyāyā mahattāṃ prathayati ---- 


etattantroktavidhinā yaduktaṃ vidhipūrvakam || 3-37 || 

ijyādi cānyatantre'pi tadvaitat kāmikaṃ bhavet | 


samānāsamānasrotasyanyatrāpi pārameśvare tantre yadijyādi 
dīkṣādividhipūrvakamuktam, tadetattantroktena saṃpūrṇetikartavyatākena 
vidhinā tat "kāmikam" iti tattatkāmyamānabhogamokṣaprayojanaṃ syāt | 
etaduktyā dīkṣādāvitikartavyatānyatrāśrīyamāṇābhilaṣitaṃ
pūrayatyeva saṃpūrṇatvādityarthaḥ | "tadvai" ityatra tasyeti pāṭhe
tasya kartumiti vyākhyeyam || 37 || 

ata evānyatrāpyāśrīyamāṇametat ---- 


nānāsiddhiguṇairyuktaṃ...............


adhikānapi kriyāpādoktān siddhirūpān guṇān karoti || 

tathā


............ṇānākāmaphalapradam || 3-38 || 


caryāpādoktamapyavilambitaṃ phalaṃ saṃpādayati || 38 || 

yogapādoktamapi ghaṭayatītyāha ---- 


yogasiddhiśca jāyeta..................


vidyāpādoktamapi itaḥ parādvayaspaśīno 
vidheranuṣṭhānāccasādhayatyevānuṣṭhātṛjana ityapyāha ---- 


...........ṃuktiṃ ca labhate dhruvam | 


api caitadijyānuṣṭhātṛpūjanam ---- 


sadāśivo'pi jānāti devāścaivāsurādayaḥ || 3-39 || 


parabhairavabhaktiśālino'pi mahāprabhāvā api spṛhayantīti yāvat || 39 
|| 

evaṃ prāsaṅgikamuktvā prakṛtamāha ---- 


evaṃ tu mānasaṃ yāgaṃ kṛtvā bāhyaṃ samācaret | 


tatra prathamam ---- 


parāṃ vṛttimanudhyāyan dravyāṇyādau vilokayet || 3-40 || 


parām antaryāganiṣpannabhairavāveśamayīṃ vṛttiṃ 
sphurattāmavalambamāno yāgadravyāṇi prokṣaṇādikalpitasaṃskārebhyaḥ 
pūrvaṃ parādvayajñānāpāditaikyātmamahāśuddhīni kuryādityarthaḥ || 
40 || 

tānyuddaśati ---- 


sitacandanakarpūraṃ sudhūpaṃ sitavāsasī | 

puṣpāṇi divyagandhīni tilavrīhighṛtādikam || 3-41 || 

cūtapallavadarbhāstu siddhārthān khaṭikāṃ tathā | 

karaṇīṃ kartarīṃ caiva pāśabandhanasūtrakam || 3-42 || 

vārdhānīṃ śivakumbhaṃ ca tathedhmān paridhīnapi | 

samidho dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca carusthālīṃ srucaṃ sruvam || 3-43 || 

taṇḍulāṃśca tathā kṣīramevamādīnyanekaśaḥ | 


dīkṣāyāḥ śivatvāpādanātmanaḥ śuddheḥ kāryatvāttadaucityena 
sitaguṇasya pradhānatvam | sitavāsasī cūtapallavāśca 
kalaśavārdhānyartham, vrīhayo vikirārtham, siddhārthāḥ śayyādyavasare 
rakṣārtham, khaṭikākaraṇyau maṇḍalārtham, kartarī 
pāśasūtracchedāya, vārdhānyastrayāgāya, idhmāḥ prāguktāḥ 
hastamātrāścatuvīṃśatiḥ samiddhasyāgnestṛptyartham, paridhayo 
hastapramāṇāḥ sapatrāḥ śākhāścatasraḥ kuṇḍabāhye dikṣu 
vighnapraveśarakṣārtham, śamidho yajñavṛkṣotthāḥ satvaco nirvraṇāḥ 
śubhāḥ | prādeśamātrāḥ sthaulyena kaniṣṭhābhyadhikāśca yāḥ ||"
ityuktāstāścāgnerdīptyutpādanāya, dantakāṣṭhaṃ śiṣyārtham, 
taṇḍulakṣīracarurdevagurvarthamapi | spaṣṭamanyat | evamādīni | 
ādiśabdānmaṇḍalārthaṃ rajāṃsi, śiṣyārthaṃ 
pañcagavyanetrapaṭṭādyapīti || 43 || 

evaṃ dravyāṇyavalokya ---- 


tato'rghapātramādāya kṣālayedastravāriṇā || 3-44 || 

kavacenāvaguṇṭhyaiva praṇavena tu pūjayet | 

udakādibhiraṣṭāṅgai pūrayettu varānane || 3-45 || 

udakaṃ kṣīrakusumaṃ kuśasarṣapataṇḍulāḥ | 


sayavaghṛtā aṣṭau | ihāṣṭamūrterarghyaṃ puryaṣṭakākūtam || 45 || 

atha ---- 


praṇavenāsanaṃ sarvaṃ tato mūtīṃ nyaset priye || 3-46 || 

bhairavāvaraṇairyuktāṃ pūjayettāṃ yathākramam | 

gandhaiḥ puṣpaistathā dhūpairmantrasandhānapūrvakam || 3-47 || 


bhairaveṇāvaraṇaiśca yuktāṃ nyaset, mantrasaṃdhānapūrvakaṃ pūjayet || 
47 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


mantavyaṃ paramaṃ tattvaṃ tataścaivāmṛtī bhavet | 


paramaṃ tattvaṃ niṣkalaṃ pūrvoktayuktyā 
japannamṛtamudrāpradarśanenāmṛtīkuryādityarthaḥ || 

arghapātrārthaṃ ca ---- 


pātrāṇāṃ tritayaṃ kalpyaṃ nirodhārthe vidhau tathā || 3-48 || 


paśvarghe ca...................

vidhyarghapātraṃ pūjārtham, nirodhārghapātraṃ tu 
nirodhavisarjanādyavasaropayogi surayā kartavyam | yadavocat ---- 


"paścādarghaḥ pradātavyaḥ surayā susugandhayā" (2-136) iti | 


paśostu prokṣaṇādyarthaṃ paśvarghapātram || 48 || 


tadetattryam ---- 


............prakalpyaivaṃ śivahastaṃ prakalpayet | 


iha laukike dīkṣākarmaṇi śikṣakātmanācāryeṇa 
prastūyamāne'viśiṣṭena kareṇa kathaṃ karaṇam, ityasya 
nityakarmanyāsasaṃskṛtasyāpi 
sātiśayapāśakṣapaṇaśivatvadānātmakanaimittikakarmaviśeṣaviśiṣṭāṃ
sādhakatamatāmādhātuṃ 
dīptamantracakranyāsatatsvātmaikyānusaṃdhyadhyāsita- 
śivātmakakartṛvīryāvaṣṭambhasārā śivahastatā prathamamavaśyameva 
vidhātavyā | yattu ---- 

"śivahaste vibhuṃ dhyātvā mantragrāmaṃ sujājvalam |" (3-142)

itīhaiva vakṣyati, tadanugrāhyaikaviṣayam || 

mantrasaṃdhānakaṃ prāgvannāḍīsaṃdhānameva ca || 3-49 || 


kartavyamiti śeṣaḥ || 49 || 

mantrasaṃdhāne mukhyaprakāramāha ---- 


mūlamantramanusmṛtya hṛtkaṇṭhatālumadhyagam | 

bhrūmadhyaṃ śabdakūṭaṃ tatturyasthānaṃ vibhedayet || 3-50 || 

vāmadakṣiṇamadhye tu viṣuvatsthena bhedayet | 

dvādaśāntaṃ paraṃ nītvā karastho mantravigrahaḥ || 3-51 || 


anusaṃdheya iti śeṣaḥ | paraṃ mūlamantraṃ śabdakūṭam 
aśeṣavācakaśabdātmakamantrarāśirūpamantaḥsvīkṛtamantragrāmam, 
śabdanarūpaṃ ca kūṭaṃ paranādātmakanityasvarūpamanusmṛtya 
vakṣyamāṇakaraṇabandhamātrārthānusaṃdhimān svecchayācāryo
hṛtkaṇṭhatālubhrūmadhyātmakaṃ turyasthānaṃ ca bhedayet |  kathamityāha 
---- vāmetyādinā | madhyamārgeṇa
bhrūmadhyaṃ yāvatkaraṇa krameṇa bhrūmadhyadattacittaḥ  
savyetaranāsāpuṭasamasphāraṇayuktilabdhamadhyaprāṇatīkṣṇasūcyagreṇa
bindugranthiṃ bhittvā'nāyāsena nādādigranthīnapi bhindyādityarthaḥ | 
bhaviṣyati caitat | tato dvādaśāntaṃ mantraṃ nītvā karastho 
mantravigrahaḥ śuddhyāptyaivānusaṃdheyo yathā karaṇasya 
kartṛvīryasāratā bhavati || 51 || 

nāḍīsaṃdhānamapyāha ---- 


tasyāpyanena nyāyena vilomena`viśeddhṛdi | 

ātmano recakenaiva pūrakeṇa viśeddhṛdi || 3-52 || 

nāḍī saṃdhānametaddhi śivena parikītītam | 


ātmana ūrdhvarecakena gatvā, tasyāpi iti karasthasya bhagavato vilomena iti 
dvādaśāntāddhṛdi viśet punastata ullāsya taddvādaśāntaṃ prāpya 
tenaiva pūrakeṇa hṛdi svasmin viśet, ityetannāḍīsaṃdhānaṃ 
pūrvodṣṭanāsākramanāḍīsaṃdhānavilakṣaṇaṃ śivena parikītītam  
ityanenāsyābhedavyāptipradarśakasyopādeyatvamiti dhvanati || 52 || 

evaṃ nāḍīsaṃdhānena svahṛdayaṃ praviśya ----
