vyāpakaṃ tu śivaṃ dhyāyenmantramūtīmadhiṣṭhitam || 3-53 || 


antarbāhye śivahaste ca sthitāṃ sarvāṃ mantracakramūtīmadhiṣṭhāya
sthitaṃ śivaṃ niṣkalanāthaṃ vyāpakaṃ dhyāyet || 53 || 

athaivaṃ śivahaste mahāvyāptimanusaṃdhāya 
śiṣyādyupayogipañcagavyasaṃskāramāha ---- 


darbhaṃ saṃgṛhya cāstreṇa saptavārābhimantritam | 

pañcagavyāya pātraṃ tu śodhayettu śivāmbhasā || 3-54 || 


"pavitrāḥ pāvanā gāvaḥ sarvadaivatavigrahāḥ | 

gomūtre svaḥsarinmukhyā taṭasthā mṛcca gomayam || 

amṛtaṃ tatpayo divyaṃ tadvikāro dadhi sthitam | 

tadghṛtaṃ tadgataḥ sārastatsadāmaratarpaṇam ||"


iti śrīmatparākhyasaṃhitoktātiśayāni pañcagavyāni samāhriyante
yasmiṃstat pañcagavyaṃ kuśodakena śodhayet kṣālayedityarthaḥ || 54 || 


astreṇa kṣālayettacca kavacenāvaguṇṭhayet | 


tasya ca ---- 


darbhāsanaṃ dhruveṇaiva maṇḍalaṃ tu prakalpayet || 3-55 || 


vartulaṃ svastikaṃ vā || 55 || 


tasyopari nyaset pātraṃ gomayādīni cāharet | 


pṛthakpātrasthitānyeva prokṣyāstreṇa śivāmbhasā || 3-56 || 


atha ---- 


gomayaṃ tu hṛdāmantrya gomūtraṃ śirasā dadhi | 

śikhayā varmaṇā kṣīramastreṇājyaṃ kuśodakena || 3-57 || 


tathā ---- 


dhāmnā ca mantrayet paścād gomayādīni yojayet | 

pūrvasaṃskṛtapātre tu svamantraiḥ............


tathā ---- 


....................gomayādikam || 3-58 || 

saṃyojya mantrayet paścāttaireva hṛdayādibhiḥ | 


sarvaireva yugapat || 

evaṃ saṃskṛtasyāsyātra viśeṣasaṃskārārthamāsanapūrvaṃ 
mantranyāsamāha ---- 


praṇavena tu saṅkalpya anantaṃ mūtīvigraham || 3-59 || 

dhāmāṅgāni ca bāhye tu saṃpūjyāvaraṇasthitim | 

mantrasaṃdhānakaṃ kṛtvā amṛtīkaraṇaṃ tathā || 3-60 || 

śivāmṛtaṃ tatsaṃcitya saṃpūjya sthāpayettataḥ | 


mūtīḥ cidrūpā, vigrahaḥ sakalabhaṭṭārakaḥ, dhāma mūlamantraḥ || 60 
|| 

atha yāgabhūmiṃ saṃskartum ---- 


astrābhimantritaṃ darbhaṃ gṛhītvollekhanaṃ kuru || 3-61 || 

yāvadbhūmau samantāttu saumyāsyo dakṣiṇe sthitaḥ | 

tataścaivoddharecchalyamājalāntaṃ vyavasthitam || 3-62 || 

recitaṃ bhāvayecchuddhaṃ mauktikādyaiḥ prapūrayet | 

samīkaraṇamastreṇa kavacena tu secanam || 3-63 || 

ākoṭanamathāstreṇa............


etān saṃskārānniṣpannakuṇḍavadbhāvanayā kṛtvā ---- 


..............ṭato mārjanalepane | 

astreṇa pañcagavyena gandhatoyena copari || 3-64 || 


pañcagavyena lepanaṃ tato'pi gandhatoyenetyarthaḥ || 64 || 

atha ---- 


śivāmbhasāstrayuktena vikirāṇyabhimantrayet | 

saptakṛtvo'stramantreṇa................


śivāmbhasā saṃprokṣya, vikīryanta iti vikirāṇi tilādīni | yathoktaṃ
śrīmanmataṅgatantre ---- 

"tilā lājā yavāścaiva dūrvāḥ siddhārthakāḥ śubhāḥ | 

kusumāni ca śuklāni susugandhīni bhūriśaḥ | 

īṣaccandanapaṅkena miśro'yaṃ vikiraḥ śubhaḥ | " (2-50-23-24)

iti | etāni vikirāṇyabhimantrayet || 

tataḥ ---- 


........ṣthitvā madhye tu prāgdiśaḥ || 3-65 || 

ūrdhvādho vikireddhānyānyastrabhūtāni cintayet | 


śivavadācāryasya madhye sthitiḥ || 65 || 

etāni ca ---- 


cāmareṇa suśubhreṇa astramantreṇa saṃharet || 3-66 || 

eśānyabhimukhānyeva................


kutaḥ kimavadhi? ityāha ---- 


.............ṇairṛtyā yāvadaiśvaram | 


atha yāgakṣetramadhyakrameṇa pañcagavyena saṃprokṣya gandhāmbhobhiḥ 
śivāmbhasā || 67 || 


dhruveṇa śriyamāvāhya padmahastāṃ sulocanām | 

śuklapuṣpāṇi muñcantīṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutām || 3-68 || 

nīlotpaladalaśyāmāṃ yāgaharmyāvalokinīm | 

brahmasthānopaviṣṭāṃ tu dvārābhimukhabhadradām || 3-69 || 

gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjya śivakumbhaṃ prakalpayet | 


dvārābhimukhasya yāgadhāma praviśataḥ śiṣyādeḥ kalyāṇakāriṇīṃ 
mokṣalakṣmīṃ saṃpūjya śivakumbhaṃ kuryāt || 69 || 

katham ? ityāha ---- 


eśānīṃ diśamāśritya pañcagavyena maṇḍalam || 3-70 || 

gandhodakena saṃlipya śivāmbho'streṇa prokṣayet | 

anantādyāsanaṃ dattvā dhruveṇāmaṇḍalāvadhi || 3-71 || 

sarvadoṣavinirmuktaṃ kumbhaṃ candanalepitam | 

svastikādyaiścarcayitvā yavasiddhārthadūrvabhiḥ || 3-72 || 

sitasūtreṇa saṃveṣṭya vastrapūtena cāmbhasā | 

saṃpūrya sarvataśchannaṃ cūtāśvatthādipallavaiḥ || 3-73 || 

ratnagarbhauṣadhīyuktaṃ sahadevādibhirgaṇaiḥ | 

prokṣya cāstreṇa saṃgṛhya kavacenāvaguṇṭhitam || 3-74 || 

āsanasyopari nyasyenmūlamantramanusmaran | 


āmaṇḍalāvadhi iti paravyāptyā brahmabilaśaktivyāpinyātmakāni
brahmaviṣṇurudrādhiṣṭhitāni yāni sūryādimaṇḍalāni, tadantaṃ
na tu śivāntam

"mantraśaktibhirugrābhiḥ śoṣanirdahanādibhiḥ | 

śarīraṃ śoṣitaṃ yasmāttadarthamabhiṣecanam ||" (4-450)

iti bhāvinītyāpyāyanaprayojanasyopasaṃhārapradhānaśivāntāsanatvānu-
papatteḥ | yavādibhirantargatairupalakṣitam, sūtreṇa varmabhūteneti, 
ratnagarbhamoṣadhīyuktaṃ ca | sahadevādibhirgaṇairiti

"oṣadhīnāṃ varaikaiva sahadevā śivāgame |"

iti sārasaṅgrahe kathitatvāt 
sahadevāpradhānauṣadhilohadhātubījapuñjairyuktamityarthaḥ | 
"mūlamantram" ityādinā kalaśasya paracinmūtīmayatvamuktam || 74 || 

atha tatra ---- 


kalādhvabhairavādīni nyasyārghādīn prakalpayet || 3-75 || 

mudrāṃ baddhvā hṛdādīni pūjyānyagnidalādiṣu | 

gandhapuṣpapavitrādyaiḥ sitavastreṇa bhūṣayet || 3-76 || 


a(tra) ca pūrvoktaḥ sarvo nyāsādikrama āśrayaṇīyaḥ | pavitram 
arghapātrāmbu na tu pavitrakam, tasya niyatasamayapūraṇāya  
niyatakālatvāt | evamuttaratrāpi || 76 || 

atha ---- 


vāmabhāge tu kumbhasya pañcagavyena maṇḍalam | 

śivāmbhasā tu saṃprokṣya praṇavenāsanaṃ nyaset || 3-77 || 

saṃprokṣya ca śivāmbhobhirvārdhānīṃ maṅgalānvitām | 

kumbhavaccārcayitvā tāmāsanasyopari nyaset || 3-78 || 


vāmabhāga iti kriyāśaktivyāptyā bhāvidhārāpātanakrameṇa 
vighnapraśamanasiddhyartham, kumbhavadāsanasyopari 
tadaṅgatvāttadvyāptyaivetyarthaḥ | maṅgalānvitāṃ sulakṣaṇānvitām || 
78 || 

atha ---- 


gandhapuṣpapavitrādyaiḥ pūjayitvā tu vārdhanīm | 

uccāryāstraṃ krameṇāgre dravyāṇāṃ vārdhanīṃ nayet || 3-79 || 

acchinnāmanulomena jaladhārāṃ tu pātayan | 

tatsthānāttu samuddhṛtya yāvatkoṇaṃ tu śāṅkaram || 3-80 || 


uccāryeti kākākṣivat | tatsthānāt kalaśavāmādastramuccārya 
vārdhānīṃ samuddhṛtya adhivāsyānāṃ dravyāṇāmagre 
pṛṣṭhato'nulomena pūrvādidikkrameṇa śāṅkaraṃ koṇam eśānaṃ koṇaṃ 
yāvadacchinnāṃ vighnotsādanāya jaladhārāmastramuccārya pātayanniti 
dvauṇicau || 80 || 

atra ca karmaṇi ---- 


ācāryaḥ kalaśaṃ paścād bhairaveṇa samuddharet | 

nayedvārdhānimārgeṇa tasmin saṃsthāpayet punaḥ || 3-81 || 


agre bhramantyā vārdhānyāḥ paścācchivakumbhaṃ bhramayan svamantreṇa
sthāpayedityarthaḥ || 81 || 


vārdhānīṃ sthāpayet paścādastramantramanusmaran | 


sthāpayediti, kriyāśaktivyāptyā dhārāpātena lokapālān vyavasthāpya
bhagavato dakṣiṇahaste vārdhānyastramiti || 

atha ---- 


viśeṣapūjāmubhayorgandhapuṣpapavitrakaiḥ || 3-82 || 

mantrasaṃdhānakaṃ kuryānnāḍīsaṃdhimathobhayoḥ | 


kiṃ ca ---- 


vikirān saṃhitān pūrvaṃ vārdhānyāḥ kalpayedadhaḥ || 3-83 || 


ata eva ca ---- 


akṣatāstrāṇyanekāni śarakuntāsimudgarāḥ | 

cakrapaṭṭisavajrāditriśūlāntānyanekaśaḥ || 3-84 || 

yāgauko vyāpya sarvaṃ tu tiryagūrdhvamadhaḥ sthitāḥ | 

vārdhānyastrasya sarve te raśmibhūtā vyavasthitāḥ || 3-85 || 


etāca ---- 


śiṣyasya dakṣiṇe haste vārdhānyastraṃ tu saṃhitam | 


tena svasthāna eva sthāpitasya śivasya śivakumbhadakṣiṇe'straṃ
sthāpayet | yaduktaṃ mṛgendre'pi ---- 

"taddakṣiṇe 1mahāśastram" (ki0 7-24) 

ityādi || 

yata evam ---- 


tenaitaṃ yajñarakṣārthaṃ yāgādau kalaśaṃ nyaset || 3-86 || 

"kalaśam" iti 
kalaśādhikaraṇamaśeṣayāgādyāpyāyanādyavabhṛthasnānāntaprayojanaṃ
bhagavantamityarthaḥ || 86 || 

taṃ ca ---- 


naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ dattvā nutvā vijñāpayedvibhum | 

bhagavaṃstvatprasādena yāgaṃ nirvartayāmyaham || 3-87 || 

saṃnidhānaṃ sadā tubhyaṃ............


icchāmīti śeṣaḥ | kriyāgrahaṇamapi kartavyamiti catuthīṃ || 

tataśca ---- 


...........'vighnārthaṃ sadā bhava | 


evaṃ kṛtvā ---- 


anujñātotthito yāyādarghahasto digīśvarān || 3-88 || 


tataśca ---- 


svanāmapadavinyāsānoṃkārādinamontagān | 

gandhapuṣpapavitrādyaiḥ pūjayettān prayatnataḥ || 3-89 || 


"oṃ indra saṃnihito bhava namaste" ityādisvanāmapadavinyāsapūrvametān
prapūjayet || 89 || 

tānuddaśati saṃkṣepeṇa ---- 


indrādyanantaparyantāṃllokapālān prapūjayet | 


ūrdhve brahmā, adho'nantaḥ, ityanantaparyantānityuktam, tatra 
caiśānadigūrdhve brahmā nairṛtadigbhāge'nantaḥ pūjyaḥ | ihādhivāse 
gṛharakṣārthaṃ daśa lokapālāḥ pūjyāḥ | yāge tu 
pūrvoktabhairavāṣṭakavyāptyāṣṭāveva, tathā śrutatvāt1 | 
yadarthametattadāha ---- 


tato maṇḍalakaṃ madhye yāgabhūmau prakalpayet || 3-90 || 

pañcagavyena liptvādau gandhatoyena copari | 


maṇḍalaṃ limpedityarthaḥ | rajomaṇḍalakaṃ tvadhivāsāduttarakālaṃ
bhaviṣyati || 90 || 

athaitat ---- 


śivāmbhasāstramantreṇa saṃprokṣya tvavaguṇṭhayet || 3-91 || 


arthāt kavacamantreṇa || 91 || 

atra cādau ---- 


brahmasthānasya pūrveṇa gurun pūjya vināyakam | 

vāyavye pūjayed devi gandhapuṣpairanukramāt || 3-92 || 


avighnārthamādau vāyavye gaṇapatiṃ pūjayet, tataḥ pūrvasyāṃ diśi
gurvādīnityanukramārthaḥ || 92 || 


athaitāṃstu namaskṛtya ājñāṃ dattāṃ vibhāvayet | 


etaireva | 

itthaṃ gṛhītājñaḥ ---- 


tatastu madhyadeśasthaṃ yogapīṭhaṃ prakalpayet || 3-93 || 


pūrvoktena vidhānena................


ādhāraśaktyādipretāntaṃ parameśvarasya 
yogaśabdavācyasvaśaktirūpapīṭhamāsanam | yathoktam ---- 

"yogo'sya śaktayaḥ svākyāḥ" (mataṅga0 1-1-4) 

iti || 93 || 

atra ca ---- 


..................bhairaveśaṃ varānane | 

pūjayitvā pavitrādyaistrirāvaraṇasaṃyutam || 3-94 || 

svadhyānaguṇasaṃyuktaṃ mudrālaṅkārabhūṣitam | 


brahmāṅgāvaraṇaṃ bhairavāvaraṇaṃ sāstralokapālāvaraṇaṃ ca ---- iti 
trīṇyāvaraṇāni | dhyāne guṇaḥ śuddhasphaṭikatvādiḥ | mudrā 
āyudhasaṃniveśāḥ, ābharaṇaṃ kapālamālādi || 94 || 

atra ca ---- 


mantrasaṃdhānakaṃ pūrvaṃ nāḍīsaṃdhānameva ca || 3-95 || 

paramīkaraṇaṃ kuryād vyāpakena pareṇa tu | 

naivedyān vividhākārān dattvā mudrāṃ pradarśayet || 3-96 || 

praṇipātaṃ japaṃ kṛtvā nivedya vidhipūrvakam | 

paścād baliḥ pradātavyo mātṛṇāṃ bhūtasaṃhateḥ || 3-97 || 

bhūteśvarāṇāṃ deveśi kṣetrapālasya sarvataḥ | 


"bhūtā ye vividhākārā divyabhaumāntarikṣagāḥ |" (3-207)


ityādinā bhāvinā mantreṇa kalaśādiyāgānte'pi, etebhyo 
bhagavadanucarebhyo balirdeyaḥ || 97 || 

evaṃ dattabalirācāryaḥ ---- 


tataḥ snāyādathoddhūlya athavācamya suvrate || 3-98 || 

tato'gnikuṇḍaṃ gatvā tu pūrvavacchodhanaṃ tathā | 

bhairavaṃ pūjayettatra vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 3-99 || 


satkarmāntarāyabhūtabalisparśasañjātāśuddhivikalpānusāreṇa snānādi
kāryam, śodhanamagneḥ saṃskaraṇam || 99 || 

tataśca śivīkṛtya pūjitasya ---- 


agneḥ saṃtarpaṇaṃ kuryāt sahasreṇa śatena vā | 


yathāsaṃbhavaṃ tilādyaiḥ, parivārāṇāṃ daśāṃśataḥ, ityuktameva || 
tataścaruṃ ca śrapayet................ pacet pācayedvā || 

tadvā katham ?


........ṣthālīṃ saṃgṛhya nirvraṇām || 3-100 || 

śivāmbhasā tu prakṣālya kavacenāvaguṇṭhayet | 

candanādyaivīlimpet tāṃ mṛṣṭadhūpena dhūpayet || 3-101 || 

sūtreṇa veṣṭayet kaṇṭhe varmabhūtena suvrate | 


atha sthālyāḥ ---- 


darbheṇāstrasvarūpeṇa kalpayenmaṇḍalaṃ priye || 3-102 || 

prokṣya caiva śivāmbhobhiḥ kavacenāvaguṇṭhayet | 

āsanaṃ tatra vinyasyedanantādiśivāntakam || 3-103 || 


tatra ca ---- 


mūtībhūtāṃ nyaset sthālīṃ tatrasthaṃ bhairavaṃ yajet | 

trirāvaraṇasaṃyuktaṃ gandhapuṣpairanukramāt || 3-104 || 

mānasena prayogeṇa bhāvapuṣpairvarānane | 


caroḥ puṣpādisaṅkīrṇatayā virasatā mā bhūt, iti pūjātra noktā || 
104 || 

atha ---- 


cullīṃ saṃprokṣya cāstreṇa kuṇḍavaccārcayettataḥ || 3-105 || 


prokṣaṇaṃ kuṇḍoktasaṃskārāntaropalakṣaṇāya || 105 || 


tatra sthālīṃ samāropya paścādagniṃ nyasedadhaḥ | 


pūrvasaṃskṛtoddhṛtam || 


atha sthālyām ---- 


kṣīraṃ prokṣya śivāmbhobhistaṇḍulāṃśca samāsataḥ || 3-106 || 

mantreṇāṣṭaśatenaiva prakṣipya pācayecchanaiḥ | 

mūlamantreṇa deveśi ekacittaḥ samāhitaḥ || 3-107 || 


śanairiti, yathā sthālī na bhajyate || 107 || 


tatra ca ---- 


cālanodghāṭanādīni astramantreṇa kārayet | 


kārayediti pūrvadīkṣitaśiṣyeṇa || 

athātra carau ---- 


taptābhighāraṃ susvinne aṅgaiścaiva prakalpayet || 3-108 || 

tribhistribhirghṛtenaiva sruveṇa juhuyāt priye | 


taptaścāsāvagnivyāptyābhighāraśca ājyāmṛtasecanena uddīpanātmā,
dhātvarthānusārāt | eṣa ca dīptasvāhāntamantraiḥ sthālyāṃ 
homo'svinnatādoṣanāśanāya || 108 || 

atha ---- 


bhūmau maṇḍalakaṃ kṛtvā praṇavenāvatārayet || 3-109 || 

sthālīmājyopaliptāṃ tu śītāghāraṃ ca homayet | 

bhairaveṇa ṣaḍaṅgena vaṣaḍ jātiyutena ca || 3-110 || 


śīteti somavyāptyā asvinnatādoṣanāśanāya, atrāntare svā iti carau hā 
ityagnau uccārya juhuyāditi guravaḥ | evamagnīṣomamayaścaruṃ 
saṃskārataḥ saṃpannaḥ | yathoktaṃ śrutau ---- 

"yo ha vaitadagnīṣomīyamājyaṃ juhoti tasyaitadamṛtībhavati | "

iti | 

1śrīmṛgendrottare'pi ---- 

"agnīṣomātmakāvetāvāghārau vihitau carau | 

 amṛtatvāptaye tat syādagnīṣomātmakaṃ yataḥ ||" 

iti || 110 || 

tataḥ ---- 


maṇḍalaṃ kuṇḍasāmīpye kṛtvā darbhāsanaṃ nyaset | 

sthālyāṃ(līṃ) tasyopari nyasya saṃpātaṃ mantrasaṃhitām || 3-111 || 

japannekaikayāhutyā pātayed bhairaveṇa tu | 


niṣkalatadaṅgavaktroccārapūrvaṃ svā ityagnau hā iti carau uccārya
juhuyāditi saṃpātahomakramaḥ || 111 || 


prasaṅgādagnīṣomatābhivyaktaye sarvatra saṃpātahomamāha ---- 


aṣṭotkṛṣṭaśatenaiva parāmṛtamanusmaran || 112 || 

rajasyādau tato devi kartaryāṃ karaṇau tathā | 

khaṭikātilājyasaṃpātaṃ mūlamantreṇa kārayet || 113 || 


mūlamantraṃ tatkaraṇe cidānandātmakaparāmṛtānusmaraṇena 
tatsamarthācaraṇena prayuñjītetyarthaḥ || 112-113 || 

atha ---- 

tribhāgaṃ kalpayitvā taṃ caruṃ sthālyāṃ tu saṃsthitam | 

śivāgnisādhakebhyaśca śivāyāgraṃ nivedayet || 3-114 || 


śivāgnisādhakārthaṃ trayo bhāgā yasya tādṛśaṃ tamiti alaukikaṃ 
caruṃ kalpayitvā agraṃ śivabhāgāt sthālikalaśādyarthaṃ bhāgīkṛtāt 
prathamaṃ bhāgaṃ śivāya maṇḍalasthāya dadyāt || 114 || 


agnyādibhāgādiviniyogamāha ---- 


dvitīyaṃ homayedagnau sādhakebhyastṛtīyakam | 


sādhakāḥ śivārādhakāḥ || 

śivāya vinivedane vidhimāha ---- 


caruṃ pātre tu saṃgṛhya pūjayed bhairaveṇa tu || 3-115 || 

puṣpadhūpādibhirnītvā dhāmne taṃ vinivedayet | 


anantaram ---- 


hṛdādyāvaraṇasthānāṃ daśamāṃśaṃ nivedayet || 3-116 || 

kalaśe'pyevameva tu.................


maṇḍalavat kalaśe saparivāre vidhiḥ || 116 || 


atha ---- 


........'gnau homyaścaruḥ srucā | 


atra ---- 


bhairavasya śataṃ homyamaṅgānāṃ tu daśāṃśakam || 3-117 || 

sādhakebhyastu yaccheṣaṃ pidhāya sthāpayet priye | 


śeṣam ityavaśiṣṭabhāgarūpam | sthāpayediti sādhakānāṃ 
śiṣyāṇāmadyāpyasaṃskṛtānāṃ saṃskṛtacarubhojane'nadhikārāt || 117 
|| 

athādhivāsārthaṃ homamāha ---- 


vināyake śataṃ homyaṃ bhūparigrahaṇe tathā || 3-118 || 


bhuvaḥ pūrvāvatāritamokṣalakṣyādhiṣṭhitāyāḥ parigrahe 
svīkāranimittam, tena "oṃ bhuve svāhā, oṃ śriye svāhā" iti prayogaḥ | 
śataṃ śataṃ homyam || 118 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


adhivāse tathaiveha aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutiḥ | 


prāṅnirṇītādhivāsanimittam | hutiriti bhairavasya syādityarthaḥ || 

atha ---- 


prāyaścittanimittaṃ tu anulomavilomake || 3-119 || 

nyūnātirikte deveśi aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutiḥ | 


anulomasya vidhikramasya vilomo'nyathātvam, tatra nyūnādhike ca yat 
prāyaścittaṃ prāyastapasi cittaṃ niścayastadartham, mūlena 
"prāyaścittāya juhomi svāhā" ityantena homaḥ || 119 || 

śiṣyaṃ saṃskartuṃ pīṭhabandhaṃ karoti ---- 


bhairavaṃ pūjayitvātha prārthyānujñāṃ varānane || 3-120 || 

śiśoḥ karma prakartavyaṃ yathā bhavati tacchṛṇu | 


śiśoriti śaktipātāṅkuritaśrīśivabhāvasya | karma iti adhivāsarūpam 
|| 120 || 

tadāha ---- 


dvāre maṇḍalakaṃ kṛtvā darbhaṃ tasyopari nyaset || 3-121 || 

praṇavenāsanaṃ kalpyaṃ śiṣyaṃ tasminniveśayet | 

samapādaṃ stabdhakāyaṃ saumyānanakṛtāñjalim || 3-122 || 


dvāre dvārasamīpe, stabdhakāyam utthitam, saumyadigabhimukhaṃ
prasannavadanaṃ ca || 122 || 


guruḥ pūrvamukho'streṇa prokṣayettaṃ śivāmbhasā | 

bhasmanā tāḍayenmūdhnī astramantreṇa cālabhet || 3-123 || 


bhasmanā tāḍanaṃ yateḥ, ālambhanaṃ sparśaśca || 123 || 

nābhyūrdhvaṃ trīṃstathā vārānnābhyadhastrīn prakalpayet | 


etatsaṃskāratrayaṃ pāśaśaithilyāya adhastrīn vārān 
malatrayotpuṃsanārtham, ūrdhvaṃ tu śaktitrayottejanāya || 


athaivaṃ śithilapāśatvādeva vihitadehādiśuddhau śiśau ---- 


śivaṃ nyāsāṅgasahitaṃ pūjayed bhairaveṇa tu || 3-124 || 


kiṃ ca ---- 


vastraṃ saṃprokṣya cāstreṇa kavacenāvaguṇṭhayet | 

pūjayed bhairaveṇaiva..................


tenaivāsya ---- 


..............ṃukhaṃ pracchādayettathā || 125 || 


karaṇānāṃ 
bahiṣprasaranivāraṇāyāntavīnyastabhairavaprakāśapratyaṅmukhīkaraṇāya
ca buddhīndriyāśrayasya mukhasya pracchādanam || 124 || 

buddhīndriyakarmendriyāṇāṃ saṃyamanāya 
yatpradhānapāṇyavaṣṭambhapūrvaṃ śiṣyaṃ praveśayedityāha ---- 


hastābhyāṃ taṃ gṛhītvātha viśejjavanikāntaram | 

tato'pi ---- 

devasyābhimukhaṃ kṛtvā...............

tasya ca ---- 


..............puṣpaṃ pāṇau pradāpayet || 3-126 || 


ekameva puṣpaṃ mūlābhimantritaṃ puṣpapātasya samyaṅnirṇayāya
dattvā || 

tataśca ---- 


prakṣepayettato dhāmnā..................


kṣipa puṣpamiti taṃ prayuñjīta, tatpātāvasare ca mūlamuccārayed
gururityarthaḥ || 

athāsya ---- 


...........ṃukhamudghāṭya darśayet | 

vidyāmantragaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ kāraṇaṃ sasadāśivam || 3-127 || 


kāraṇam iti niṣkalanātham, saha sadāśivena sakalabhaṭṭārakeṇa
vartamānam || 127 || 

athāsau ---- 


ajñānapaṭanirmuktaḥ prabuddhaḥ paśurīkṣate | 

daṇḍavaddharaṇīṃ gatvā praṇipatya punaḥ punaḥ || 3-128 || 


ajñānetyanena paṭāpāsane vyāptiruktā | prāgavastho yaḥ paśuḥ sa 
idānīmeva prabuddhaḥ, ata eva 
janmasahasrāpūrvabhagavatsvarūpāvalokanādvismayāviṣṭaḥ punaḥ 
punarbhagavantamīkṣate | daṇḍavad gamanena dehādipramātṛtāpahastanāt 
śrīśivasamāveśānusaraṇe yogyatāsya daśītā || 128 || 

ata evāsau ---- 


kṛtakṛtyaḥ prahṛṣṭātmā...............


taṃ ca ---- 


................prahṛṣṭanayanaṃ śiśum | 

utthāpya hastāt saṃgṛhya dakṣiṇāṃ mūtīmānayet || 3-129 || 


cidānandātmakasvarūpasparśāt prahṛṣṭanayanam | utthāpya iti cirataraṃ 
dehādibhūmimagnaṃ tata unmajjya yuktyetyarthaḥ | dakṣiṇām anukūlāṃ 
śivātmikāmeva, na tu pāśakā dehamayīm || 129 ||  

śrīmadaghorabhaṭṭārakasaṃmukhaṃ ca ---- 


tatra maṇḍalakaṃ kṛtvā puṣpeṇa praṇavāsanam | 

tasyopari śiśuṃ nyasya ūrdhvakāyamudaṅmukham || 3-130 || 

guruḥ pūrvānanaḥ sthitvā prokṣaṇādīni kārayet | 


ādiśabdāttāḍanālambhane prāgvat | kārayediti, kurvato 
mantrāṃstadvīryānupraveśena prayuñjīta | 

athātrāsane ---- 


upaveśya tataḥ kṛtvā sakalīkaraṇe vidhim || 3-131 || 

viśeṣaphalasiddhyarthaṃ mumukṣoḥ sādhakasya vā | 


sāmānyena kṛtasaṃskārasya dṛṣṭabhagavatsvarūpasyāpi ---- 

"śivapūjāgnikāryādau sakalīkṛtavigrahaḥ | 

nānyathā prāksvarūpeṇa | " (3-146)

iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt punaryathāyogaṃ bhogāya mokṣāya vā 
śivārcādyarhatvaviśeṣaphalasiddhyarthaṃ sakalīkaraṇe'sya vidhiṃ 
kṛtvā "kalādhvānaṃ nyasetpaścāt" iti vyavahitena saṃbandhaḥ || 131 || 
sakalīkaraṇaṃ krameṇādiśati ---- 


gandhadigdhau karau kṛtvā astreṇa pariśodhayet || 3-132 || 

kavacenāvaguṇṭhyaitau plāvayedamṛtena tu | 


tayoreva ca ---- 


anantamāsanaṃ kalpyaṃ bhairavāṅgāni vinyaset || 3-133 || 


bhairavaścāṅgāni ceti dvandvaḥ || 133 || 

dehanyāsamāha ---- 


vyomnyātmānaṃ yojayitvā śiśoḥ śoṣyā tanuḥ priye | 

āgneyīṃ dhāraṇāṃ dhyātvā nirdahyāstreṇa taṃ śiśum || 3-134 || 

dhūmajvālāvinirmuktaṃ dagdhakāyaṃ vibhāvayet | 

bhasmībhūtaṃ tataḥ śāntaṃ plāvayedamṛtena tu || 3-135 || 

vyomavaccintayed dehaṃ caitanyaṃ kanakāgnivat | 

śaktinyāsaṃ nyaset pūrvaṃ kamalaṃ praṇavena tu || 3-136 || 

tasyopari tadātmānaṃ dhyāyejjyotirmayaṃ śubham | 

mūtīmantraṃ samuccārya mūtībhūtaṃ prakalpayet || 3-137 || 


tatsarvaṃ bhāvanayā kāryam || 137 || 

kathamityāha ---- 


pūrvoddhṛtena mantreṇa..................


jātāvekavacanam | tena ---- 

śaṃhāreṇa yabhinnena" (2-36)

ityādiḥ sarvaḥ pūrvoktaḥ krama āśrayitavyaḥ | evamuttaratra || 

prāgvadeva śivāveśāvaṣṭambharasena--


......................plāvayedamṛtena tu | 


atha ---- 


mantranyāso yathāpūrvamaṣṭātriṃśatkalāvadhi || 3-138 || 


athātraivāntarbahiśca śuddhatattvātmakadehasargāya sṛṣṭikrameṇa ---- 


kalādhvānaṃ nyaset paścācchāntyatītādyanukramāt | 

sphaṭikābhā tathā kṛṣṇā raktā śuklā ca pītakā || 3-139 || 

śāntyatītādikā jñeyāstattvabhūtāstu tāḥ kalāḥ | 


tattvabhūtā iti khādipṛthivyantāstattvarūpatāṃ prāptāḥ, ata evāsāṃ 
yathocitameva dhyānaṃ yuktamityeṣa śuddhatattvasṛṣṭyarthaṃ 
kalāpañcakanyāso'trādhivāse tāvaduktaḥ | putrakādīnāṃ tu 
bhāvipaṭale'nyathaiva saṃhārakrameṇa dīkṣārthamasau iti bhaviṣyati, na 
tvatrāprākaraṇikametaditi bhramitavyam || 139 || 

uktasakalamantranyāsopari ---- 


dhāmnāvāhya tathāṅgāni nyasyāntaḥkaraṇaṃ bhavet || 3-140 || 

ātmāntaḥkaraṇe yadvat tadvat pūjāṃ samārabhet | 

dhāma proccārya saṃdadhyāt sabāhyābhyantaraṃ punaḥ || 3-141 || 


saṃdhānaṃ nāḍīmantrātmakam sabāhyābhyantaram iti 
dehāntaḥkaraṇāśrayabhairavaviṣayam | sthaṇḍilābhyantarabhedeti tvasat 
|| 141 || 

atha ---- 


śivahaste vibhuṃ dhyātvā mantragrāmaṃ sujājvalam | 

dhāmoccārya ca saṃdhāya śiṣyamūdhnī karaṃ nyaset || 3-142 || 

adhomukhena hṛtpṛṣṭhe śivahastena cālabhet | 


vibhuṃ vyāpakam, sujājvalatvaṃ pāśadāhāya | saṃdhāyeti 
pūrvavannāḍīmantrakrameṇa, brahmarandhrahṛdayayorbhagavadadhiṣṭhāne'pi 
pāśāvṛtatvamastīti mūlabhūmau tatra pāśadāhena 
pārameśvarasvabhāvoddīpanārthamaṅgulipañcakābhivyaktacidādiśaktipañca
kavyāptinā śivahastena sparśaḥ || 


utthāpya dattvā puṣpaṃ tu añjalau bhairaveṇa tu || 143 || 


praveśyābhyarcayecchaṃbhuṃ................


utthāpyeti, utpūrvasya tiṣṭhaterīhārthatvādbhagavatpūjodyogaṃ 
grāhayitvetyarthaḥ | praveśo "maṇḍale'tra śivaṃ pūjaya" ityājñayā 
bhaktiśraddhonmukhasya tatparatvāpādanam, yathā vyākaraṇe praveśita iti | 
arcayediti ---- arcateṇīc || 143 || 


śiṣyo'pi tathācāryeṇa śikṣitamantraḥ puṣpam ---- 


..............śivamuccārya nikṣipet | 


atha ---- 


nirgatya vandayed devaṃ daṇḍavat...........


maṇḍala iti yojyam || 

tathā ---- 


..................ṭriḥ pradakṣiṇam || 3-144 || 

śivakumbhāgnimadhyasthaṃ sthaṇḍilasthaṃ ca vandayet | 


tririti trividhe'pi kālādhvani daṇḍavat, dakṣiṇaḥ svasvarūpaprathāparo 
me bhaveti vāñchayā svadakṣiṇameva bhagavantaṃ kurvan paribhrāmyan 
stuvīta || 144 || 

evaṃ ca ---- 


śivapūjāgnikāryādau sakalīkṛtavigrahaḥ || 3-145 || 

nānyathā prāksvarūpeṇa pūjanārho bhavettu saḥ | 

bhavediti vākyadvaye yojyam | ādiśabdājjapadhyānādau || 3-145 || 


kiṃ ca ---- 


nītvā kuṇḍasamīpaṃ taṃ śiṣyahastāviyogataḥ || 3-146 || 

ātmasavye'tha digbhāge maṇḍalaṃ praṇavena tu | 

praṇavenāsanaṃ dattvā tasyopari śiśuṃ nyaset || 147 || 


vinyāsyamantratejasāṃ jñānakriyāśaktisphāramayena svahastenāsya nimagne 
jñānakriyāśaktī hastākarṣaṇayuktyā karṣanniti hastāviyogārthaḥ | 
savye dakṣiṇe, śiśumityadyāpi ataruṇībhūtaśivasvarūpam || 147 || 


upaveśya kare darbhaṃ bhairaveṇa samarpayet | 


darbhasya ---- 


mūlaṃ śiṣyasya hastasthaṃ sāgramācāryajaṅghayoḥ || 3-148 || 


hastayoḥ prasāritayoḥ savyetaraśākhārūpayormadhye tiṣṭhati, iti 
hastastham, jaṅghayoriti jaṅghopajaṅghayorūrujānusaṃdhāvityarthaḥ || 148 
|| 

darbhasya vyāptimāha ---- 


piṅgalā madhyamā nāḍī śiṣyadehādvinirgatā | 

saivātra darbhabhūtā tu gurunāḍyāṃ layaṃ gatā || 3-149 || 


atha ---- 


nāḍīsaṃdhānahetvarthaṃ bhairaveṇāhutitrayam | 

tayā nāḍyā praveṣṭavyaṃ śiṣyasya hṛdaye sakṛt || 3-150 || 

grahaṇākarṣaṇārthaṃ tu.............


bhairavo niṣkalaḥ, "śiṣyamadhyanāḍī manmadhyanāḍyāṃ saṃlīnāstu
svāhā" ityatra prayogaḥ | ekātmyaprāptirūpanāḍīsaṃdhānapūrvameva
grahaṇākarṣaṇe yujyete | yathoktaṃ śrīspande ---- 

"ayamevātmano grahaḥ | " (4-2) 

iti || 150 || 

ata evāha ---- 


.........gṛhṇan muñcan punaḥ punaḥ | 

dīkṣākāle yataścaivaṃ tadarthaṃ nāḍisaṃhatiḥ || 3-151 || 


ācāryaḥ śiṣyātmā bhavatīti pūrvapādāntaśeṣaḥ | samayidīkṣāyāṃ 
śiṣyātmano hṛdayād dvādaśāntamākarṣaṇam, tato'pi svahṛdaye 
sāmarasyāpattirityādi, putrakādidīkṣāyāṃ tu pāśamātra (sūtra) 
vāgīśīgarbhayojanādikamadhikam || 151 || 

atha sarvāśrayanyastamantraiḥ samaṃ śiṣye vahnau 
cāgnīṣomātmatāmabhivyaṅktuṃ saṃpātahomaṃ nirūpayati ---- 


śiṣyasyātha śirobhūmau bhairaveṇa vidhāya tu | 

sampātaṃ sarvamantraistu dhruveṇājyāhutiṃ kṣipet || 3-152 || 


juhuyāditi śeṣaḥ || 152 || 

kathamityāha ---- 


mūlamantraṃ samuccārya svā ityagnau prapātayet | 

heti śiṣyasya śirasi sampātaḥ śivacoditaḥ || 3-153 || 


spaṣṭārtham || 153 || 

saṃpātaṃ vyācaṣṭe ---- 


śiṣyadehe tu ye mantrāḥ sabāhyābhyantaraṃ sthitāḥ | 

kuṇḍasthāḥ pūjitā ye tu dhāmādyāvaraṇāntagāḥ || 3-154 || 

yugapattarpaṇaṃ teṣāṃ sampātastena kītītaḥ | 

ekaikasyātra mantrasya āhutitritayena tu || 3-155 || 


saṃpāto yugapat sarvatrāgnīṣomātmakasvarūponmīlanātmā saṃskāra 
ityarthaḥ || 155 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


utthāpya ca tataḥ śiṣyaṃ tadarthaṃ mantratarpaṇam | 


kuryādityarthaḥ || 

tatra ---- 


bhairavāya śataṃ hutvā hṛdādau daśakaṃ hutiḥ || 3-156 || 


daśāṃśena syādityarthaḥ || 156 || 

atha ---- 


dhāmnā cotthāya hotavyaṃ pūrṇāhutyānutarpayet | 


utthāyetyanena pūrṇāhutiprayoga smārayati || 


evaṃ sāmānyena samayidīkṣāviṣayamadhivāsamuktvā putrakādau 
tadviśeṣamādhātuṃ yaḥ pāśasūtravidhirbhaviṣyati, tatra pāśānāṃ 
bandhanāya mantroddīpanaṃ kartumāha ---- 


mantrāṇāṃ dīpanaṃ kuryād dhāmādyastrāvadhi kramāt || 157 || 


kathamityāha ---- 


huṅkāradvayamadhye tu mūlamantraṃ samuccaran | 

praṇavādiphaḍantena āhutīḥ pratipādayet || 3-158 || 


eṣaiva ---- 


hṛdādīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ jātiruktātra dīpane | 


jāyate tattatkāryānuguṇyamanayeti "jātiḥ" viśiṣṭo mantraprayogaḥ | 
hṛcchabdo vaktrādīnyupalakṣayati || 

etacca ---- 


pāśānāṃ bandhanārthāya mantrāṇāṃ dīpanaṃ smṛtam || 3-159 || 


te ca dīptāḥ santaḥ ---- 


mantrāḥ karaṇabhūtāstu paśukāryasya sādhane | 


paśukāryaṃ dīkṣā || 

yasyaitāni karaṇāni sa mahāprabhāvaḥ ---- 


ācāryaḥ karaṇaṃ proktaḥ...........


kartetyarthaḥ | 

kathamasya śarīrādimato mantrāḥ karaṇamityāha ---- 


.............śivarūpo yataḥ smṛtaḥ || 3-160 || 


satyapi dehe nirupādhicitprakāśaśivāhaṃbhāvamaya ityarthaḥ | 
īdṛśasyaivānugrahe'dhikṛtatvāccetyāhuḥ ---- "ācāryādhikaraṇaḥ 
śivo dīkṣāyāṃ sākṣātkartā maṇḍalasthastu prayojakaḥ" iti | 
tatasteṣāṃ sarasvatīgarbhādhānasamaye śivaḥ sākṣātkartā, prayojaka 
ācāryaḥ, ityādi svoktena vyāhanyate | na ca prayojyaprayojakabhāvaḥ 
kaścidatra pūrvatra vā granthe'stītyasadevaitat | tasmāt 
sarvamantrodayapraṇayahetuścidghanaśivātmamaya evācāryo'trādhikṛtaḥ |  
mantrāṇāmuddīpanamavaśyaṃ kāryamityarthaḥ || 160 || 


krūrakārye tu kartavye mantrān saṃdīpya yojayet | 

krūrajātyanurūpeṇa vācakān yojayet sadā || 3-161 || 


kūrakāryaṃ pāśānāṃ bandhacchedādi, pūrvoktena krūrajātikrameṇa
yojanameva mantrāṇāmuddīpanam || 

atra cāvasare ---- 


bhrukuṭīkarālavadanān vācyarūpān vicintayet | 


īdṛśaṃ vācyavācakānāṃ krūratvamanyatrāpi sādhakaviṣaye krūrakārye
mantavyam || 

ata evāpyāyanādau ---- 


saumyajātiyutān saumye saumyarūpān vicintayet || 3-162 || 


saumyajātirvaṣaḍādikā || 162 || 


yadarthaṃ mantroddīpanaṃ tatpratijānīte ---- 


pāśakarma tato vakṣye.................


etacca bhāviputrakadīkṣādhivāsāya | tata iti mantroddīpanānantaram | 
pāśakarma putrakādidīkṣopayokṣyamāṇasya bhāvipāśasūtrasya 
yadadhivāsarūpaṃ karma tadvakṣye ityarthaḥ || 


tatkrameṇāha ---- 


................kanyākatītasūtrakam | 

triguṇaṃ triguṇīkṛtya...............


kanyā anupajātavikāraparaśaktyānukṛtarūpeti | tato mūlabhūmeḥ 
pravṛttānāmāṇavamāyīyakārmarūpāṇāṃ 
sattvādigaṇatrayātmakaprapañcavyāptibhājāṃ pāśānāṃ 
bhāvibandhacchedādikaṃ samūlamunmūlanārtham, iti kanyākatītatve 
triguṇatriguṇatve cāśayaḥ || 

athaitat ---- 


...............pāśabandhanasūtrakam || 3-163 || 

śivāmbho'streṇa saṃprokṣya kavacenāvaguṇṭhayet | 

pūjayitvā vidhānena gandhapuṣpādidhūpakaiḥ || 3-164 || 

prasārayed gṛhītvā tanmūrdhādyaṅguṣṭhakāvadhi | 

śiṣyasya stabdhadehasya.............


"oṃ pāśabandhanasūtrāya nama" iti pūjāvidhānaṃ 
sarvādhvavyāpticintanam, "śiṣyasya iti putrakāderna tu samayinaḥ | 
stabdhadehatā pāśānāṃ bandhād dehendriyādīnāṃ 
niṣkriyatvānuvyāptyā | tatsūtraṃ pumān dakṣiṇena strī vāmena kareṇa 
mūdhnī dhārayedityasat | dīkṣyahastayordarbhanāḍīdhāraṇe 
vyāpṛtatvamataḥ śikhāyāmeva pāśasūtraṃ lambayet | ekaiva 
kriyāśaktiḥ pārameśvarītthaṃ svarūpagopanena pāśarūpatayā sthitā, 
ityekatvamiha pāśasūtrasya | śrīpūrvādau tu śaktitrayameva tritattvena 
sthitam, ityāśayena trīṇi sūtrāṇīti prakriyāmātrabhedaḥ || 164 || 
taccāsya sūtram ---- 


............ṇāḍībhūtaṃ vicintayet || 3-165 || 


sā ca ---- 


suṣumnā madhyamā nāḍī sarvanāḍīsamanvitā | 

oṃkārādi svanāmnā tu namaskārāvasānakam || 3-166 || 

śiṣyadehasthitāṃ nāḍīṃ sūtre saṃgṛhya yojayet | 


bhāvanayeti śeṣaḥ | sūtrabhūtāyāṃ nāḍyāṃ sarvanāḍībhiḥ 
samanvitā bhāvanayā saṅgatā yojitā ca || 166 || 

tām ---- 


gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjya kavacenāvaguṇṭhayet || 3-167 || 


atraiva saṃnidhānārthaṃ homamāha ---- 


saṃnidhānāhutīstisraḥ svanāmapadajātikāḥ | 


dadyāditi śeṣaḥ | "oṃ suṣumnāyai svāhā" ityatra prayogaḥ || 167 || 


atha ---- 


śivāmbho'streṇa samprokṣya śiṣyasya hṛdayaṃ punaḥ || 3-168 || 

tāḍayedastrapuṣpeṇa.................


evaṃ ca ---- 


............ḥṛdi cit saṃhṛtā bhavet | 


sarvavyāpikāpi hṛdayaikaniṣṭhīkṛtā bhavatītyarthaḥ || 

tadanu yogakrameṇa bhāvanayāpi vā ---- 


huṅkāroccārayogena recakena viśeddhṛdi || 3-169 || 

nāḍīrandhreṇa gatvā tu caitanyaṃ bhāvayecchiśoḥ | 

kadambagolakākāraṃ sphurattārakasaṃnibham || 3-170 || 

hṛtsthaṃ chittvāstrakhaḍgena huṃphaṭkārāntajātinā | 


niṣkalāstrameva khaḍgaḥ tena śiśoḥ puryaṣṭakaṃ 
raśmimātrāviyogicchittvā || 170 || 


dhāmnā cāṅkuśarūpeṇa karṣecchaktyavadhi kramāt || 3-171 || 


aṅkuśeti pāścāttyakuṭilālakātmanā khyātena | śaktyavadhi 
dvādaśāntaṃ tacca nāsikyamiha || 171 || 

tataḥ ---- 


dvādaśāntaṃ tu saṃgṛhya sampuṭya hṛdayena tu | 

saṃhāramudrayā yojyaṃ sūtre nāḍīprakalpite || 3-172 || 

vyāpakaṃ bhāvayitvā tu kavacenāvaguṇṭhayet | 


praṇavaniṣkaloccārapūrvaṃ "devadattacaitanyaṃ pāśasūtre yojayāmi
namaḥ" iti prayogāt sūtradehayojitasyāsya vyāpakatvabhāvanā || 172 || 

athāsmai pūjāṃ kṛtvā ---- 


bhairaveṇāhutīstisraḥ saṃnidhānasya hetave || 3-173 || 


dadyāditi śeṣaḥ || 173 || 

pāśasūtravidheḥ prayojanamāha ---- 


dvitīyaḥ sūtradehastu pāśā yatra sthitāstvime | 

bandhyāśchedyāstathā dāhyāḥ sūtrasthāne.....


sūtrasthāne samastapāśāśrayasya samāvṛtihetoḥ prāṇadehasya 
parokṣatvena sākṣād bandhādyayoge tatpratikṛtirūpaṃ 
bhāviśodhyadehāsūtraṇāt sūtradehaṃ kalpayitvā tatsthān pāśān 
badhnīyāt chindyāt daheccetyarthaḥ | "ime" ityanantarameva vakṣyamāṇāḥ 
|| 

"......................yenedaṃ taddhi bhogataḥ | "

ityāmnātatvādārabdhakārye dīkṣottarakāle, bhagavadarcādihetau tu na 
dāhādi yuktamityāha ---- 


.....ṇa vigrahe || 174 || 


pāśānāṃ saṃkhyāsaṃjñāsvarūpāṇi krameṇa kathayati ---- 


pāśāstu trividhā bhāvyā māyīyāṇavakarmajāḥ | 

caitanyarodhakāstvete kāryakāraṇarūpiṇaḥ || 3-175 || 


māyotthatvaṃ māyāyāṃ bhavatvaṃ malāntare'pyastīti rūḍhyaiva 
bhinnavedyaprathārūpaṃ malaṃ māyīyam ucyate | ata evānyatra ---- 

"athātmamalamāyākhyā...................... | "

ityākhyāśabdaḥ | aṇūnāmayam āṇavaḥ apūrṇammanyatātmā 
lolikārūpaḥ | karma yajanabrahmahananādirūpam, tato jātam, atra 
vāsanādhirūḍhaṃ dharmādharmātmakam | eṣāṃ ca caitanyapratirodhakatvaṃ 
guṇabhāvāpādanarūpameva pāśatvam || 175 || 

eṣāṃ kāryakāraṇarūpatāṃ sphuṭayati ---- 


malaḥ karma nimittaṃ tu naimittikamataḥ param | 


malaḥ karma cetyetadadvayaṃ nimittaṃ malasya karmahetutvāt karmaṇaśca 
māyīye kāraṇatvāt, ataḥ paraṃ māyīyaṃ naimittikaṃ malakarmaṇoḥ 
kāryamevetyarthaḥ | yadyapi kārmaṃ bhinnavedyaprathārūpe māyīye sati 
bhavati, tathāpi na taddhetukam, pūrṇasphārāṇāṃ jñānināṃ 
tatsadbhāve'pi tasyādarśanāt, ityapūrṇammanyānāmevārjyamānaṃ 
tadbhavatīti yathoktameva jyāyaḥ || 

tataśca ---- 


ādhārarūpaṃ naimittaṃ śarīrabhuvanādikam || 3-176 || 


ādhāratā bhogāśrayatā, ādiśabdāt bhāvāḥ || 176 || 

atra ca naimittike māyīye male ---- 


nimittamabhilāṣākhyaṃ................


lolikārūpamāṇavaṃ malamityarthaḥ || 

kiṃ kevalenetyāha ---- 


...............vicitrairheturūpakaiḥ | 


dharmādharmātmakaiḥ sahakāribhiryuktamityarthaḥ || 


prakṛtamanusarati ---- 


tāṃścāvalokayet sūtre bandhyabandhanahetutaḥ || 3-177 || 


tāniti pāśān vakṣyamāṇavyāpyavyāpakabhāvayuktyāvalokayet, kimarthaṃ
bandhyānāmarthātteṣāmeva bandhanahetuto bandhanāyetyarthaḥ || 177 || 

athaiṣāṃ śiṣyadehasthānāṃ tāḍanagrahaṇapūrvakaṃ sūtre krameṇa
yojanamāha ---- 


pāśānāṃ tāḍanaṃ kāryaṃ huṃphaṭkārāntajātinā | 

svanāmapraṇavādyena śāntyatītādyanukramāt || 3-178 || 


praṇavaṃ śāntyatītābījaṃ dhāma cocyārya 
"amukātmasthapāśavyāpikāyai śāntyatītāyai huṃ phaṭ" iti 
mantramuccārayan || 178 || 


puṣpeṇa tāḍayenmūdhnī grāhyaṃ...........


tataḥ ---- 


.................ḥūmādi yojayet | 

huṃphaṭkārāntayogenāgṛhya saṃhāramudrayā || 3-179 || 

dhāmnā tu yojayet sūtre namaskārāntayoginā | 


pūrvoktenaiva praṇavapūrvamūlamantrasahitena mantreṇa saṃhāramudrayā 
vakṣyamāṇayā pāśatrayamāgṛhyoktāṃ jātimapāsya 
namaskārāntajātinānenaiva mantreṇa pāśasūtre yojayet || 179 || 


amumeva kramaṃ śāntyādikalāsvapi svamantranāmayojanayuktyātidiśati ---- 


evaṃ śāntyādikān pāśān sthānāt saṃgṛhya yojayet || 3-180 || 


sthānamatra krameṇa vaktraṃ hṛd guhyaṃ pādau || 180 || 

etāṃśca ---- 


bhāvayet trividhān pāśān pañcatattvādhvavyāpakān | 

kalādīkṣāyāṃ samanantaraṃ

"tattvabhūtāstu tāḥ kalāḥ | " (3-140)

iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt pañca yāni tattvāni kalārūpāṇi 
tairātmabhūtairadhvano'śeṣasya vyāpakānityarthaḥ || 

atha kathaṃ pāśānāṃ kalāvyāptiḥ ?, kathaṃ ca 
māyordhvasthaśāntāśāntyatītāpade pāśānāṃ sattā ? ---- 

ityāśaṅkyāha ---- 
trayāṇāṃ vyāpikā śaktiḥ kriyākhyā pārameśvarī || 181 || 


śāntyatītādibhedena pañcasaṃjñāpratiṣṭhitā | 


yeyaṃ parameśvarasya nityāviyoginī śaktiḥ, sā kriyākhyā 
gṛhītakriyāśaktibhūmikā satī idantāvaicitryoṭṭaṅkanāt 
śāntyatītādipañcadhātvaṃ prāptā trayāṇāṃ malānāṃ vyāpikā | 
taduktam ---- 


śeyaṃ kriyātmikā śaktiḥ śivasya paśuvatīnī | 


bandhayitrī" (spa0 4-18) 

iti | 

ata eva yāvadidantābhāsasya sthitistāvattadaucityena pāśāḥ sthitāḥ, 
iti śāntyatītāpade'pi tacchodhanaṃ yuktam | vyāpake ca śuddhe vyāpyasya 
tatprāṇasya samyak śuddhirbhavati, iti malānāmātmabhūtakalāvyāptyā 
tadvyapadeśaiḥ śodhanam, tacca 
nityāviyogipārameśvarasvātantryaśaktirūpatonmajjanameva | 

yathoktam ---- 

śvamārgasthā jñātā siddhyupapādikā |" (spa0 4-18) 

iti | 

nirṇītaitacchaktivīryasāraireva mantrainīmagnapāramāthīkatadrūpatayā
prāptabhedānāmivāsāṃ saṃśodhanam, iti sarvamupapannam || 181 || 

evaṃ ca ---- 


ādheyagraha ādhāraṃ gṛhītaṃ bhāvayet paśoḥ || 3-182 || 


ādheyāḥ kalāḥ, ādhārā malāḥ || 182 || 

atha pārameśvaraśaktivyāptyā tatsārānāha ---- 


gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjya sūtre pāśāṃstu tarpayet | 


śāntyatītākrameṇaiva................


tacca tarpaṇam ---- 


.............āhutīnāṃ trayaṃ trayam || 3-183 || 

saṃnidhānāya pāśānāmataḥ pāśāṃstu dīpayet | 


mantraśaktyā bhāvyakramasamastabhogasiddhyaucityena yugapat paripakvān 
vidadhīt || 183 || 

kathamityāha ---- 


svanāmajātiphaṭkāradhāmabhiśca trayaṃ trayam || 3-184 || 


āhutīnāṃ dattveti śeṣaḥ | jātiratra huṅkāraḥ | mantrapāṭhasya 
kramaḥ prāgvat || 184 || 

etacca śiṣyacaitanyāt ---- 


viśleṣakaraṇārthaṃ tu pāśānāṃ dīpanaṃ bhavet | 


yata eva ---- 


dīptāḥ pāśāstato bandhyāstāḍanagrahaṇādinā || 3-185 || 


ādiśabdād granthidānamapunaḥprarohārtham | uddīpitavīryāṇāmeva 
pāśānāṃ bandhanaṃ śiṣyacaitanyāvaraṇe svātantryāpasāraṇam || 185 
|| 

tāḍanamāha ---- 


sūtrasthāṃstāḍayet puṣpaiḥ svadehasthāniva kramāt | 


(svadehasthāniveti ---- ) yathā svadehe | kramāditi 
proktamantratadvyāptyādikrameṇa tāḍitāṃstathā tāḍayet || 

bandhane yuktimāha ---- 


dhāmnā ca saṃpuṭīkṛtya svanāmnā ca sakṛtsakṛt || 3-186 || 

bandhane tu prayogo'yaṃ................


evaṃ praṇavadhāmaśāntyatītābījebhyo'nantaraṃ "śāntyatītāṃ 
devadattātmasthapāśavyāpikāṃ badhnāmi" ityuccārya dhāma ṅamaḥ" 
śabdāntamuccārayan pāśasūtrasya mūdhnī granthiṃ dadyāt | evamanyat || 
186 || 

tadāha ---- 


..............ṣūtre granthīn pradāpayet | 


granthīniti, vyāptyā pañca || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


bandhane parimāṇaṃ ca karmaṇo viṣayasya ca || 3-187 || 


na kevalaṃ granthīn yāvad bandhanasamaye karmaṇaḥ śubhādyātmano 
viṣayasya bhuvanādermāyīyamalātmanaḥ, caśabdādāṇavasya malasya 
parimāṇaṃ niyatāmadhvavyāptiṃ ca prakalpayet | tathā nivṛttāvekaṃ 
pāthīvaṃ tattvam, aṣṭottaraśataṃ ca kālāgnyādibhuvanānāmiti 
viṣayasya parimāṇaṃ bhaviṣyati | karmaṇo nivṛttipratiṣṭhāvidyāntaṃ 
yāvadvyāpteḥ, malasya tu śāntāśāntyatītāntamapi saṃskārātmanā 
sūkṣmeṇa rūpeṇa sattāstyevaitatsarvamanusaṃdadhīta || 187 ||  evaṃ ca 
pāśasaṃyogājjīvaḥ  ---- 


ṣaṭtriṃśattattvamadhyastho bhuṅakte bhogaṃ......


śuddham | 

anyacca pāśavicchedāttu netyāha ---- 


...ṇa cānyathā | 


na evārthe || 

prakṛtamāha ---- 


pāśān saṃsthāpya pātre tu saṃpātaṃ juhuyāt sakṛt || 3-188 || 


pāśāniti pāśasūtram saṃsthāpya iti śiṣyadehādvimucyetyarthaḥ | 
sampātahomaḥ

śampātaṃ sarvamantraiśca" (3-142) 

ityādau nirṇītaḥ || 188 || 

athaitān pāśān ---- 


pātrasaṃpuṭamadhyasthān sthaṇḍile vinivedayet | 


pātramadhyasthavedyavedakāntarāvasthitā ete, ityāśayāt 
kavacāvaguṇṭhanavyāptyā ca śthaṇḍile" iti tatrācīte bhagavati | 
vinivedayediti | etasya paśoḥ(pāśāḥ) tvayaiva māmikāṃ tanumāviśya 
baddhāḥ (bandhayāḥ ?), iti vijñaptiṃ kuryādityarthaḥ || 

tathaiva ca ---- 


nītvā samarpayet kumbhe.................


tatsthaṃ bhagavantaṃ vijñāpayed yathā ---- 


................pāśān saṃrakṣa he vibho || 3-189 || 


saṃrakṣaṇaṃ ca bhāviputrakādidīkṣocchedyānāmeṣāṃ sāṃprataṃ 
svakāryaśaktibandhanātmādhivāsa saṃskāraḥ || 189 || 

tataḥ ---- 


darbhaṃ vimocayecchiṣyaṃ................


nāḍīsaṃdhānārthaṃ prākparikalpitam || 

atha cāsmai ---- 


..............puṣpaṃ pāṇau pradāpayet | 


tena cāsau śrībhagavantaṃ samantrakameva ---- 


sthaṇḍile śivakumbhe ca śivāgnau ca prapūjayet || 3-190 || 


cakārādgurumūrtāvapi || 190 || 


tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā daṇḍavannipatedbhuvi | 


atha cāsmai ---- 


utthāpya pañcagavyādīn dadyādvai bhairaveṇa tu || 3-191 || 


ādiśabdāccaruṃ dantakāṣṭham, bhairaveṇeti sakalena || 191 || 

atra vidhimāha ---- 


gomayena śucau deśe kāryaṃ maṇḍalakatrayam | 

ekasmin maṇḍale viṣṭaḥ pañcagavyaṃ śiśuḥ pibet || 3-192 || 

upaviśya dvitīye tu carukaṃ prāśayed budhaḥ | 

ācamya dantakāṣṭhaṃ tu tṛtīye maṇḍale sthitaḥ || 3-193 || 

bhakṣayitvā ca deveśi tataścaiva vinikṣipet | 


pañcagavyaṃ saṃskṛtasthāpitacarubhāgabhojanayogyatāyai, carukaṃ tu itaḥ 
prabhṛti śivamayabhogyabhoktṛtvāvasāyāya, dantakāṣṭhaṃ parāṃ 
śuddhimabhivyaṅktum | ācamyeti pūrvatrāpi yojyam || 193 || 

tacca patitam ---- 


pūrvaṃ paścāttathaiśordhvaṃ cottarasyāṃ ca śobhanam || 3-194 || 

anyasyāmaśubhaṃ viddhi tasya homaḥ śataṃ bhavet | 


astramantreṇa vighnaśamanāyetyarthāt | etacca bāhulyena sādhakaviṣayam || 
194 || 

athaitadantasyāsya karmaṇaḥ samyak saṃpattyartham ---- 


ācāryo juhuyāt paścāt prāyaścittaṃ śivena tu || 3-195 || 

vidhernyūnātiriktasya cittavikṣepakarmaṇi | 


cittavikṣepakarmaṇi sati vidhernyūnātiriktatvaṃ tasya prāyaścittaṃ
juhuyāditi saṅgatiḥ | 

tacca ---- 

"agnikāryaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ ....... | " (4-31)

iti bhāvinītyā agnikāryānte, na tvadhunaiveti, paścādityasyārthaḥ || 
195 || 

atra ca ---- 


aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā prāyaścittād viśudhyati || 3-196 || 


atha mūlaviśrāntimevānusaṃdhātum ---- 


paścāt saṃtarpayeddhomasahasreṇa śatena vā | 


yāvadasya viśrāntirghaṭata ityarthaḥ || 

aṅgavaktravācinaḥ ---- 


mantrāṃśca daśabhāgena..................


anantarameṣāmeva ---- 


................vahnau naivedyadāpanam || 3-197 || 


kiṃ ca ---- 


viśeṣapūjanaṃ cārghaṃ mudrābandhaṃ varānane | 

stotraṃ vādyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā caruṃ prāśya visarjayet || 3-198 || 


parameśamityarthāt || 198 || 


nirodhārgheṇa cārghaṃ tu dattvā caiva varānane | 

recakena tu saṃgṛhya bhairavaṃ tamanusmaran || 3-199 || 

muṣṭinā pūritaṃ nītvā pūjayitvā varānane | 

agniṣṭhaṃ vai.........


agniṣṭhaṃ tamiti pūrvoktam, pūritamiti pūrakeṇa, maṇḍalāt saṃgṛhya
recakenāgnau sthitaṃ kṛtvā tatrāpi tathaivārcayitvā || 199 || 


.....pūrakeṇa gṛhītvā sthāpayet punaḥ || 3-200 || 

tatrasthaṃ pūjayitvā ca kalaśe tu vinikṣipet | 

kusumādibhirabhyarcya kumbha eva tu bhairavam || 3-201 || 


yāgagṛhamanadhiṣṭhitaṃ mābhūdityāśayāt || 201 || 

atha sthaṇḍilāt ---- 


prakṣipya caiva nirmālyaṃ gomayena spṛśet priye | 


niṣkrāntaṃ mālyaṃ na tvatra caṇḍīśayogataḥ || 

tatraiva ca ---- 


śivāmbhasā tu saṃprokṣya śiśye śayyāṃ prakalpayet || 3-202 || 

gṛhiṇo darbhaśayyāṃ tu yatervai bhasmanā priye | 

pūrvāśirā gṛhī kāryo yatirvai dakṣiṇāśirāḥ || 3-203 || 


dakṣiṇavaktrābhimukhena | śiṣṭaṃ spaṣṭam || 203 || 

atha śikhāmantreṇa ---- 


tatra sthitasya śiṣyasya śikhābandhaṃ varānane | 


tathā ---- 


siddhārtharocanādyaiśca rakṣāṃ kuryādasiṃ smaran || 3-204 || 


yatergṛhiṇaśca krameṇa rekhāyuktyā ---- 


bhasmanā rocanādyaiśca astraprākāracintanam | 


etadupasaṃharati ---- 


kavacenāvaguṇṭhyaiva śiṣyaṃ tu svāpayet tataḥ || 3-205 || 

tataścaiva tu nirgatya balikarma samārabhet | 


tadāha ---- 


balistu kalpitaḥ pūrvaṃ sarvabhūteṣvathādarāt || 3-206 || 

taṃ tu saṃgṛhya deveśi pūrvādīśāntakaṃ kṣipet | 


kalpito bhūtārthaṃ sādhitaḥ || 206 || 

atra ca ---- 


bhūtā ye vividhākārā divyabhaumāntarikṣagāḥ || 3-207 || 

pātālatalasaṃsthāśca śivayāge subhāvitāḥ | 

dhruvādisarvabhūtāśca endryādyāśāsthitāśca ye || 3-208 || 

svāhākārasamāyogāt tṛpyantūccārayan kṣipet | 


praṇavapūrvaṃ "bhūtā ye" ityādi śthitāśca ce" ityantamuccārya 
"tṛpyantu svāhā" iti mantreṇa baliṃ kṣipet | atra madhye dhruvādītyetat 
dhruvalokaparāmarśāya | atha ca dhruvaḥ praṇavaḥ, tadādi kṛtvāyaṃ 
mantraḥ paṭhanīyaḥ || 208 || 

baliṃ ca pūjāpūrvakaṃ kṣipedityāha ---- 


namaskāreṇa sampūjya gandhairdhūpairanukramāt || 3-209 || 

pūrvādīśānaparyantamadhaścordhvaṃ samantataḥ | 


adhivāse balikarmopasaṃharan dravyāntaramupakṣipati ---- 


koṇasthān kṣetrapālāṃśca patitāñchvapacānapi || 3-210 || 

baliṃ dattvā tu sarvebhya ācamya ca varānane | 

sakalīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā krameṇa prāśayeccarum || 3-211 || 


anugrahāvasare'tra yāvatsaṃbhavaṃ sarvān pūjayitvaiṣāmāśāṃṃ 
pūrayedityarthaḥ | carumiti, yamavaśiṣṭaṃ bhagavadagrāt prāthītaṃ ca | 
krameṇa iti gurusādhakaparipāṭyā || 211 || 

yadāha ---- 


sahāyaiḥ sahito vīra ekacittaḥ samāhitaḥ | 

prāṅmukha udaṅmukho vā maṇḍalasthaḥ pṛthakpṛthak || 3-212 || 


vīra iti tyaktajātyādigraho niṣkampaḥ, ekatra śivābhede cittaṃ yasya 
tādṛk samāhitaḥ, bubhukṣurdīkṣāyāṃ prāṅmukho mumukṣustu 
udaṅmukhaḥ, pṛthak pṛthag maṇḍalastha iti svasahāyānāṃ 
sādhakaputrakādīnāṃ samavyāptyabhāvāt saṅkaraśaṅkā 
mābhūdityabhiprāyāt, samavyāptiviśrāntau tvekamaṇḍalatve'pi na 
kāciddhāniḥ || 212 || 

tatra ---- 


pañcagavyaṃ pibet pūrvaṃ carukaṃ dantadhāvanam | 

prāśyaivaṃ sakalīkṛtya rakṣāṃ pūrvavadeva ca || 3-213 || 


vidhāyeti śeṣaḥ || 213 || 


yāgabhūmau svapet paścācchiṣyai saha varānane | 


bhagavadadhiṣṭhite yāgagṛhe gurvādīnāṃ svāpo 
dīkṣyaviṣayasamucitasvapnadarśanāya || 

prakārāntaramāha ---- 


bhairavadhyānayogena samādhau jāgradeva vā || 3-214 || 


gururbhavet śiṣyārthamiti śeṣaḥ | samādhau iti samādhānanimittam | iti
śivam || 214 || 


sanmānasāmbaravibodhadineśabhābhi	rāmodavadvikasitaṃ hṛdayāmbujanma | 
kṛtvā śivārcanavidhau viniveśayadhva māryā bhavabhramaṇaduḥkhamalaṃ
jahīta || || 


iti śrīsvacchandatantre 
śrīmahāmāheśvarācāryavaryaśrīkṣemarājaviracitoddyotākhyavyākhyopete 
adhivāsa nāma tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ || 3 || 




caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ

" svacchandodyotaḥ "


dīkṣājñānakriyāpluṣṭaduṣṭapāśavanāvaliḥ | 

mahājyotirjayatyeko hlādī bhairavahavyabhuk || 


adhivāsānantarabhāvinīṃ dīkṣāṃ prastāvayituṃ śrībhairava uvāca ---
- 


pratyūṣe vimale kṛtvā śaucādyān pūrvavat kramāt | 

sakalīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā pūrvavat praviśed gṛham || 4-1 || 


paṭalasaṅgatyā prakṛta ācāryaḥ, śaucādyānityādiśabdāt snānādi, 
pūrvavat praviśediti dvāradevatārcāṃ kṛtvā śiṣyaśca śucirācāntaḥ 
puṣpahastaḥ......... praviśet | 

sa ca


.............guruṃ tataḥ | 

praṇamya śirasā............


tatpraṇāmādeva ca


........ḥṛṣṭo guroḥ svapnānnivedayet || 4-2 || 


tāṃśca ---- 


śubhān svapnān pravakṣyāmi aśubhāṃśca varānane | 

svapneṣu madirāpānamāmamāṃsasya bhakṣaṇam || 4-3 || 

krimiviṣṭhānulepaṃ ca rudhireṇābhiṣecanam | 

bhakṣaṇaṃ dadhibhaktasya śvetavastrānulepanam || 4-4 || 

śvetātapatraṃ mūrdhasthaṃ śvetasragdāmabhūṣaṇam | 

siṃhāsanaṃ rathaṃ yānaṃ dhvajaṃ rājyābhiṣecanam || 4-5 || 

ratnāṅgābharaṇādīni tāmbūlaṃ phalameva ca | 

darśanaṃ śrīsarasvatyoḥ śubhanāryavagūhanam || 4-6 || 


krimirlākṣā, etatsarvaṃ śreṣṭham || 6 || 


narendrairṛṣibhirdevaiḥ siddhavidyādharairgaṇaiḥ | 

ācāryaiḥ saha samvādaṃ kṛtvā svapne prasiddhyati || 4-7 || 


samyak vādaḥ saṃvādaḥ || 7 || 

tathā ca ---- 


nadīsamudrataraṇamākāśagamanaṃ tathā | 

bhāskarodayanaṃ caiva prajvalantaṃ hutāśanam || 4-8 || 

grahanakṣatratārāṇāṃ candrabimbasya darśanam | 

harmyasyārohaṇaṃ caiva prāsādaśikhare'pi vā || 4-9 || 

narāśvavṛṣapotebhataruśailāgrarohaṇam | 

vimānagamanaṃ caiva siddhamantrasya darśanam || 4-10 || 

lābhaḥ siddhacaroścaiva devādīnāṃ ca darśanam | 

guṭikāṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca khaḍgapādukarocanāḥ || 4-11 || 

upavītāñjanaṃ caiva amṛtaṃ pāratauṣadhīḥ | 

śaktiṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ padmamakṣasūtraṃ manaḥśilām || 4-12 || 

prajvalatsiddhadravyāṇi gairikāntāni yāni ca | 

dṛṣṭvā siddhyati svapnānte kṣitilābhaṃ vraṇaṃ tathā || 4-13 || 


siddho japādikrameṇa mantro yasya, vraṇamiti svadehe'strajam, svapnānte 
iti, na tu svapnasyādyamadhyayoḥ | yathoktamanyatra ---- 

"prāṅnamittaṃ divā grāhyaṃ rātrau grāhyaṃ tu paścimam |" 

iti || 13 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


kṣatajārṇavasaṅgrāmataraṇaṃ vijayaṃ raṇe | 

jvalatpitṛvanaṃ ramyaṃ vīravīreśibhirvṛtam || 4-14 || 

vīravetālasiddhaiśca mahāmāṃsasya vikrayam | 

mahāpaśoḥ saṃvibhāgaṃ labdhvā devebhya ādarāt || 4-15 || 

ātmanā pūjayan deva japan dhyāyan stuvannapi | 

suhutaṃ cānalaṃ dīptaṃ pūjitaṃ vā prapaśyati || 4-16 || 

haṃsasārasacakrāhvamayūraśavarohaṇam | 

mātṛbhirbhairavaiścaiva mātṛrudragaṇaiḥ saha || 4-17 || 

bhairavaṃ bhairakā dṛṣṭvā siddhyatyatra na saṃśayaḥ | 


vīravetālasiddhaiśceti sahārthe tṛtīyā | mātṛrudrā devaviśeṣāḥ | 
mahāpaśuḥ puruṣapaśuḥ | sārasaḥ sarasyeva ya āste haṃsaviśeṣaḥ | 
siddhyatīti tatsvapnānusāriṇīmuttamādirūpāṃ siddhiṃ 
prāpnotītyarthaḥ | yadyapi ---- 

"dṛṣṭaḥ śruto'nubhūtaśca prāthītaḥ kalpitastathā | 

bhāvito doṣajaśceti svapnaḥ saptavidhaḥ smṛtaḥ ||"


iti nimittāntarajo'sti svapnaḥ, tathāpīha bhagavadgurvadhiṣṭhite 
yāgadhāmni mantrādimāhātmyād bhāviphalānurūpa eva 
dṛśyate'sāvadhivāse || 17 || 

evam ---- 


śubhāḥ svapnā mayākhyātā aśubhāṃśca nibodha me || 4-18 || 


tānāha ---- 


tailābhyaṅgastathā pānaṃ.............


tailasyaiva ca | 


.................viśanaṃ ca rasātale | 

andhakūpe ca patanamatha paṅke nimajjanam || 4-19 || 

vṛkṣavāhanayānebhyaḥ patanaṃ harmyaparvatāt | 

kartanaṃ karṇanāsābhyāmatha vā hastapādayoḥ || 4-20 || 

patanaṃ dantakeśānāmṛkṣavānaradarśanam | 

vetālakrūrasattvānāṃ tathaiva kālapūruṣāḥ || 4-21 || 

kṛṣṇordhvakeśā malināḥ kṛṣṇamālyāmbaracchadāḥ | 

raktākṣī strī ca yaṃ svapne puruṣaṃ tvavagūhayet || 4-22 || 

mirayate nātra saṃdeho yadi śāntiṃ na kārayet | 

gṛhaprāsādabhedaṃ ca śayyāvastrāsaneṣu ca || 4-23 || 

ātmano'bhibhavaṃ saṃkhye ātmadravyāpahāraṇam | 

kharoṣṭraśvasṛgāleṣu kaṅkagṛdhrabakeṣu ca || 4-24 || 

mahiṣolūkakākeṣu rohaṇaṃ ca pravartanam | 

bhakṣaṇaṃ pakvamāṃsasya raktamālyānulepanam || 4-25 || 

kṛṣṇaraktāni vastrāṇi vikṛtātmā prapaśyati | 

hasanaṃ valganaṃ svapne mlānasragdāmadhāraṇam || 4-26 || 

svamāṃsotkartanaṃ bandhaṃ kṛṣṇasarpeṇa bhakṣaṇam | 

udvāhaṃ ca tathā svapne dṛṣṭvā naiva prasidhyati || 4-27 || 


krūrasattvaṃ vyāghrādi, saṃkhye saṅagrāme, vikṛtātmā 
vighnavyākulacitto bhīṣaṇākṛtirvā, hasanodvāhādi ātmanaḥ, valganaṃ 
nṛttam || 27 || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


aśubhā hyevamākhyātā vijñeyā daiśikottamaiḥ | 


vijñeyā iti kālasvarūpādhikāryanusāreṇaiva eṣāṃ balābalacintā 
kāryetyarthaḥ || 

tatra ---- 


śubhāstatrānumodyāstu aśubheṣu tu homayet || 4-28 || 

aṣṭottaraśataṃ dhāmnā................


tathā sati dīkṣāntarāyopaśāntiḥ || 28 || 


...............prāyaścittād viśuddhyati | 


atra vidhimāha ---- 


pūrvavat sakalīkṛtya vighnoccāṭanarakṣaṇam || 4-29 || 

veṣṭanaṃ pūrvavat kuryācchivāmbhaḥ śivahastakam | 

lokapālāṃstu sampūjya śivakumbhaṃ ca sthaṇḍilam || 4-30 || 

agnikāryaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ pūrṇāhutiprapātanam | 

prāyaścittaṃ tataḥ paścād duḥsvapnārthaṃ yaduktavān || 4-31 || 


tat kuryāditi śeṣaḥ | veṣṭanaṃ kavacena, śivāmbha iti 
prokṣaṇā(1dyartham) śivahastaḥ karmaṇo dīptyāpattyā samyak 
prāyaścittaśāntyartham, sthaṇḍilamiti tadādheyaṃ bhairavam || 31 || 

etadupasaṃharan prakṛtaṃ prastāvayati ---- 


evaṃ pūjādikaṃ kṛtvā visṛjya sthaṇḍilācchivam | 

nirmālyāpanayaṃ kṛtvā bhūmiṃ saṃśodhya pūrvavat || 4-32 || 

nityakarma tataḥ kuryāt pūjāhomajapādikam | 

nityāhnike samāpte tu naimittikamathācaret || 4-33 || 


nityakarma svānuṣṭhānaviṣayam | tatra prāyaścittino nādhikāra iti 
tacchuddhyante tasyābhidhānamḥ naimittikaṃ dīkṣākhyānnimittādāgatam || 
33 || 

tadupakramate ---- 


upalipya śivāmbhobhirbrahmasthānaṃ prapūjayet | 

bhāvena gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ............


bhāvena praṇavena | 


................ṭato maṇḍalamālikhet || 4-34 || 


tadvidhiragre bhaviṣyati || 34 || 


atha ---- 


karaṇīṃ khaṭikāṃ caiva bhairaveṇa prapūjayet | 

dhāmnā tu rajasāṃ pātaḥ............


bhairavaḥ sakalaḥ, dhāmnābhimantritānāṃ rajasāṃ paścāt pāto 
nirmantraka eva, anyathā bhāvirajodoṣokttyanupapattiḥ || 

sa ca rajasāṃ pātaḥ ---- 


..............ṣitādyaścāgamoditaḥ || 4-35 || 


sitaṃ rajaḥ pātyamānamādyaṃ yasya, āgame bṛhattantre uditaḥ || 35 || 

atha ---- 


niṣpanne maṇḍale snātvā nityakarma samācaret | 


apare'hni, ityarthaḥ || 


nityakarmasamāptau tu kuryānnaimittikaṃ budhaḥ || 4-36 || 


tannityakarmānūdya naimittikamādiśati ---- 


snānādi pūrvavanmantraiḥ sakalīkaraṇādikam | 

ātmarakṣāstraprākāradvārapālādipūjanam || 4-37 || 

vighnoccāṭanadigbandhau bhūpātālakhavāsinām | 

astraprākāramāropya kavacenāvaguṇṭhanam || 4-38 || 

udaṅmukhaṃ tūpaviṣṭaḥ karaśuddhyādi pūrvavat | 

śivāmbhaḥ śivahastaṃ ca arghatrayaprakalpanam || 4-39 || 


kṛtveti śeṣaḥ | ātmarakṣārtho'straprākāraḥ | 
bhūpātālakhavāsināṃ vighnānāmuccāṭanamiti vyavahitaḥ saṃbandhaḥ, 
āgamaprāmāṇyāt | astraprākāramiti yāgagṛhaviṣayam | udaṅmukhamiti 
bubhukṣudīkṣāyā api muktiparyavasāyitvāt | dakṣiṇāsyasya 
cāśeṣapāśadāhakatvāt, dīkṣāprārambhe ca 
atrācāryasyodaṅmukhatvamevoktam, karaśuddhyādītyādiśabdāt 
dehaśuddhyādikam | śivāmbha iti prokṣaṇādyarthaṃ 
śivamantritamambho'rghapātrāt pṛthak, tacca prākpaṭalayoranumantavyam | 
pātratraye vidhinirodhapaśuprayojanamarghatrayam || 39 || 

tataḥ ---- 


lokapālāṃstu sampūjya śivakumbhaṃ prapūjayet | 


tato'pi ---- 


maṇḍalasyāgrato bhūtvā maṇḍalaṃ prokṣya cāsinā || 4-40 || 

varmaṇā veṣṭayet paścāt praṇavenābhimantrayet | 

aṣṭottaraśataṃ dhāmnā rajodoṣaivīśuddhyati || 4-41 || 


maṇḍalasyāgrata ityanena dīkṣyajanātiśayena maṇḍalasya 
digantarābhimukhatvamapi dhvanati | praṇavena dhāmneti praṇavapūrveṇa 
niṣkalenetyarthaḥ || 41 || 

itthaṃ ca saṃskṛtasya maṇḍalasya ---- 


catudīkṣvastraṃ sampūjya dvāre gandhādibhiḥ kramāt | 

prākāraṃ bhāvayedastraṃ.............


dvāra iti jātāvekavacanam, tena vakṣyamāṇanavanābhamaṇḍalasya
catudīkṣu yānyaṣṭau dvārāṇi tatretyarthaḥ || 


..............ṃaṇḍalaṃ praviśet tataḥ || 4-42 || 


pūjāmatrārabheta ityarthaḥ || 42 || 

tatra ---- 


gurun sampūjya vighneśaṃ puṣpādyaiḥ praṇavena tu | 


pūrvaṃ gaṇapatiṃ vāyavyakoṇe saṃpūjya gurūn prācyāṃ diśi 
prapūjayet | yathoktaṃ tṛtīyapaṭale ---- 

"brahmasthānasya pūrveṇa gurūn pūjya vināyakam" | (3-92)

vāyavye iti || 

tataḥ ---- 


anantamāsanaṃ prāgvacchivāntaṃ praṇavena tu || 4-43 || 

mūrtyādi pūrvavannyasyeddhṛdādyāvaraṇāntagam | 

pūrvoktavidhinā pūjya naivedyāni nivedayet || 4-44 || 

nirodhārgheṇa cārghaṃ tu dattvā caiva nirodhayet | 

japadhyānādikaṃ kṛtvā agniṣṭhaṃ bhairavaṃ yajet || 4-45 || 

nāḍīsandhānakaṃ triṣṭhaṃ kṛtvā santarpayedvibhum | 


agnāviti śeṣaḥ || 45 || 

tatra tāvannāḍīsaṃdhānamāha ---- 


ātmano niṣkaloccāraṃ kṛtvā kumbhe niveśayet || 4-46 || 

kalaśasthasya vāmena recayet pūrayet tataḥ | 

maṇḍalasthasya savyena punarvāmena recayet || 4-47 || 

agniṣṭhasya tu tattejo dakṣiṇena viśan smaret | 


mantrakalaśādbhirgrantherbhedakrameṇa ūrdhvadvādaśāntamāśrayan tato'pi 
hṛdayamāgatya tatra viśramya pradakṣiṇaṃ bhramitvā somamārgeṇa 
niḥsṛtya kalaśasthasya dakṣiṇena praviśet, tatrāpyamumeva kramamāsthāya 
tadvāmena nirgatya maṇḍalasthasya dakṣiṇena praviśya prāgvadvāmena 
nirgatya vahnisthasya dakṣiṇena praviśet, prāgvadeva ca hṛdaye viśrāmyet 
| evamadhikaraṇacatuṣṭayaikyāpattyā 
vahnāvagnīṣomasūryatejaḥsāmarasyena stheyam, na tu tataḥ 
svahṛdayamāgantavyamagniṣṭha eva bhavati yāgasya prastutatvāt 
prādhānyenaivāvasthiteryuktatvāt || 47 || 

yadāha ---- 


evaṃ saṃdhānakaṃ kṛtvā tatastarpaṇamārabhet || 4-48 || 


evamityagniviśrāntyantam || 48 || 

tataśca ---- 


daśabhāgavibhāgena hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ kṣipet | 


mūlahomāt pūrvoktādvaktrāṇāṃ daśamāṃśena hutvetyarthaḥ | 

atha ---- 


prāyaścittaviśuddhyarthaṃ kuryādaṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 4-49 || 

vidheḥ pūrṇātiriktasya dhāmnā pūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ | 


dhāmneti kākākṣivat || 49 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


ācāryo'thārghahastastu maṇḍalaṃ praviśettataḥ || 4-50 || 

sampūjya parameśānaṃ puṣpādyairarghapaścimam | 

mudrāṃ baddhvā praṇamyādau jānubhyāmavaniṃ gataḥ || 4-51 || 

vijñāpayeta paśvarthaṃ prārabdho'yaṃ makhottamaḥ | 

snānādhivāsanādyaṃ yanmaṇḍale'gnau ca yatkṛtam || 4-52 || 

vidhānaṃ puṣkalaṃ samyak tvatprasādādihāstu tat | 

parameśānaṃ vijñāpayet paśvarthamiti saṅgatiḥ || 4-52 || 


anuṣṭhitakarmaviṣayāṃ vijñaptiṃ kṛtvā, 
anuṣṭhāsyamānaviṣayāmapyāha ---- 


idānīṃ śiṣyadehe tu sakalīkaraṇādikā || 4-53 || 

yojanyantādhvaśuddhistu tvatprasādāt prasiddhyatu | 


tataḥ karmaprārambhaniṣpattyantaṃ kevalamantarmukhakrameṇa 
yāvanniścitapratipattyāpi bhagavadadhiṣṭhitimātmanaḥ sphuṭayediti 
vijñapterāśayaḥ || 53 || 

ata eva ---- 


evamastvityanujñātaḥ parameśena vīrarāṭ || 4-54 || 

labdhānujñaḥ prahṛṣṭātmā niṣkrāmenmaṇḍalād bahiḥ | 


vīrarāḍiti parameśvarādhiṣṭhitaḥ | evaṃ 
labdhāśeṣanirdalanātmakabhairavībhāvo'ta eva tatsamāveśāt 
prahṛṣṭātmā | bahiriti java nikāntarite yāgadhāmnyeva || 54 || 


paśvarthāya kṛtaṃ yattu tad gṛhītvārghapātrakam || 4-55 || 

dhāmnastu dakṣiṇe bhāge kārayenmaṇḍalaṃ guruḥ | 

dakṣiṇa iti dakṣiṇāsyasya pāśaploṣakatvāt || 4-55 || 


athātra ---- 


praṇavāsanaṃ kuśairnyasya śuciṃ śiṣyaṃ niveśayet || 4-56 || 

śivāmbho'streṇa saṃtāḍya bhasmanā ca kuśaiḥ kramāt | 

maṇḍale kalpite śiṣyaṃ mūtībhūtaṃ prakalpayet || 4-57 || 


śuciṃ snātam | astreṇeti triṣu yojyam | kalpita iti āsanatvena, atra ca 
mūrtyādīnāṃ pūrvoktaiva vyāptiḥ | evamuttaratrāpi || 57 || 

athāsya ---- 


upaviśya karanyāsaṃ nirdāhādyastrapūrvakam | 

sabāhyābhyantaraṃ nyāsaṃ mantrasaṃdhānameva ca || 4-58 || 


guruḥ kuryāt || 58 || 

tataḥ ---- 


śivahastaḥ pradātavyo dhyātvā devaṃ sujājvalam | 

guruṇā || 

evaṃ gururasya ---- 


mūdhnī sampātayettejaḥ pāśāṅkuravināśanam || 4-59 || 


pāśānāmaṅkurāḥ saṃsāraprarohahetava ādyā udbhedāsteṣāṃ nāśanam 
| yathoktamanyatra ---- 

"brahmapañcakasaṃyuktaḥ śivenādhiṣṭhitaḥ śivaḥ | 

pāśacchedakaraḥ kṣemī śivahastaḥ prakītītaḥ || 

anenālabdhamātrastu dehī nirmuktabandhanaḥ | 

prayāti śivasāyujyaṃ nirmalo nirupaplavaḥ ||" 

iti || 59 || 


utthāpya ca tato nītvā maṇḍalaṃ tu praveśayet | 


indriyāṇāṃ bāhyaprasarapraśamanena bhagavadekāgratāmādhātuṃ 
baddhanetrasya maṇḍaladarśanamucitamityāha ---- 


vastraṃ samprokṣya toyena kavacenāvaguṇṭhayet || 4-60 || 

pūjayed gandhapuṣpādyairbhairaveṇābhimantrayet |

netre baddhvā tu netreṇa...........


netreṇābhimantrite netramantroccārapūrvaṃ 
sarvendriyaprasarapuraḥsarabhūte netre baddhvā || 

śiṣyasya ---- 


...........puṣpaṃ pāṇau pradāpayet || 4-61 || 


sa ca ---- 


akāmānnikṣipenpuṣpaṃ devasyābhimukhaṃ sthitaḥ | 


tadanantaraṃ bubhukṣoḥ ---- 


puṣpapātavaśānnāma kuryād vai sādhakasya ca || 4-62 || 


vaktrāṅgādipūrvaṃ śivāntaṃ puṃsaḥ, striyastu śaktyantam || 62 || 

yastu niṣkāmastasya ---- 


mumukṣorgururicchātaḥ .............


yathāruci kuryādvā na vetyarthaḥ || 

pūrvoktasya sādhakadīkṣādīkṣyasya ---- 


........... nāma vai sādhakasya vā | 


"vā" śabdo niścaye | kuryādevetyarthaḥ || 

atha ---- 


mukhamuddhāṭya taṃ śiṣyaṃ śivāya praṇipātayet || 4-63 || 


śāktamārgoddhāṭanavyāptyā mukhamasya lāghavenoddhāṭayet, 
yathāsāvudbhūtaphullanyāyena1 vikasatīti guravaḥ || 63 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


pradakṣiṇamataḥ kṛtvā maṇḍale'gnau praṇamya ca | 

agnikuṇḍasamīpe tu ācāryaḥ paśunā saha || 4-64 || 


bhavediti śeṣaḥ | pradakṣiṇādikartṛtvaṃ dvayorapi | atra ca pūrvoktā 
karākarṣaṇayuktiḥ smartavyā || 64 || 


ātmasavye'tha digbhāge maṇḍalaṃ praṇavena tu | 

pūrvavannāḍisandhānaṃ tadarthaṃ cāhutitrayam || 4-65 || 

sampātābhihutiṃ kṛtvā aṇutarpaṇameva ca | 

pūrṇāhutiṃ tato dattvā prāyaścittāni homayet || 4-66 || 


dhāmnā cāṣṭaśataṃ.............

"piṅgalā madhyamā nāḍīśiṣyadehādvinirgatā |" (3-149)


iti prāguktasthityā śiṣyakaragurujaṅghāsaṅghātadarbhayukttyā 
nāḍīsandhānam, aṇavo mūlādyā mantrāḥ || 66 || 

etat kṛtvā ---- 


........paścāt pātayedāhutitrayam | 

jātyuddhāre dhruveṇaiva dvijatvāpādane tathā || 4-67 || 


dhruvaṃ praṇavamuccārya "amukasya jātyuddhāraṅkaromi svāhā" iti 
prayogeṇa paśudehasambaddhāyā jāteruddhāre tisra āhutīḥ pātayet | 
tato'pi "dvijatvāpādanaṃ karomi svāhā" iti prayogeṇa  
bhāvirudrāṃśāpādanayogyatārthācintyaśaktibhirmantraiḥ 
śuddhavidyāpadajananayogyatātmakadvijatvāpādanāyāhutīstisraḥ pātayet | 
ataśca yatkecidūcuḥ ----  dvijatvāpādanametanna vartamānaśarīraviṣayam, 
tatra (dravyā?) taddehāśritāyāḥ śūdrādijātereva sthitatvād 
dvijatvajāteśca parasyā nityāyā janyatvābhāvāditi  
karmāntaravaśasaṃbhāvyamānadvijadehāpekṣayaivaitadaṣṭācatvāriṃśatas
aṃskārāpādanena dvijasyaiva kāryamiti tadeṣāṃ 
jātigrahagrastatayānanunmiṣitavivekatvādavidita-
parameśaśāstrārthasatattvamabhidhānamupekṣyameva | yato 
bhāvidvijadehaviṣayametadityatrārthe śrutirasti | yathā ca vartamānasya 
paśuśarīrasyācintyaśaktimantraprabhāvād dāhādikaṃ jātyuddhāraśca 
kriyate, tathā śuddhatattvamayadehāntarotpattidvījatvāpādanaṃ ca yadya 
(ntyajā-)1derapi kriyate, tanna kācidanupapattiḥ | śrutistarhyatrārthe 
yathābhihitarūpā setikartavyatā spaṣṭaivāsti | śrūyate hi 
etadyathādyāpi yoginyo mantrādiprabhāvena dehajātyādi ātmanaḥ parasya ca 
parivartayantīti | māheśvare ca naye taduktaprakriyayāpi 
śivapuṃmāyābhyo'nyattattvajātyādi sarvamevānityam | yat tu 
bhuvanādhvani aṣṭacatvāriṃśatsaṃskārādhānena dvijatvāpādanaṃ 
kriyate, tatputrakasya vāgīśyāṃ garbhādhānādiyuktyā 
tattattvasaṃbhāvyamānabhūtasargabhogaśuddhimadhye dvijabhogaśuddhyartham |  
idaṃ tu samayino vartamānadehaviṣayam, tasya tattvaśuddharacoditatvāt | 
ataścaitadeva yato dīkṣitānām ---- 

"ekaiva sā smṛtā jātirbhairavīyā śivāvyayā |" (4-543)

iti vakṣyamāṇasthityā na śūdrādijātīyatvamasti, pratyuta 
prāgjātyudīraṇāt prāyaścittatvaṃ śāstrasamaye sthitānāmuktam | 
dvijasyāpi caitadalaukikaṃ dvijatvāpādanaṃ kāryameva | yattu ---- 

"yenedaṃ taddhi bhogataḥ |" (kiraṇā0)

iti dehasthityāṃ vartamānadehe mantrayojanaṃ (na) kāryamityāhuḥ, 
tadārabdhadehakarmaśuddhyarthaṃ na kāryamitiyaducyate ta(dayu)ktam, 
śoṣadāhāpyāyajātyuddhārādyarthaṃ tu vartamānadehe'pi coditatvāt 
kartavyameva | anyathā ---- 

"mantraśaktibhirugrābhiḥ śoṣanirdahanādibhiḥ | 

śarīraṃ śoṣitaṃ yasmāttadarthamabhiṣecanam ||" (4-450)

ityasaṅgataṃ syāt || 67 || 


atra dvijatvāpādane kartavyāntaramāha ---- 


bījāhāre tathā deśabhāvaśuddhau dvijo bhavet | 


praṇavapūrvaṃ "(= oṃ) bījāhāradeśabhāvaśuddhimamukasya karomi
svāhā" ityatra prayogaḥ | iha ---- 

"brahmaṇyaṃ bījaśuddhyā syāt sā ca strīṣu vyavasthitā | 

tāsāṃ tu capalaṃ cittaṃ caṇḍāleṣvapi dhāvati ||"

iti mukuṭasaṃhitoktanyāyānna kvacid bījaśuddhirvāstavī saṃbhāvyate, 
iti sā mantraireva saṃpādyā | āhārasya śrutismṛtyuktaprakriyayā 
anirvāhādaśuddhirasti, deśasyāpi mlecchādisaṃparkāt, 
bhāvasyāsatyānārjavadiyogāditi śuddhirādheyaiva || 

atraivamasya mantraiḥ śuddhavidyāyāṃ jananenāpāditalokottaradvijatvasya -
--- 


praṇavenāhutīstisro rudrāṃśāpādane tathā || 4-68 || 


praṇavapūrvaṃ "rudrāṃśo bhava svāhā" iti prayogād 
bhāvibhairavībhāvabhūmikāgrahaṇāya rudrāṃśatvāpādanamasya kāryam, 
yenādhigataśāstrārtho rudradhyānaikaniṣṭhaḥ syāt || 68 || 

tatretikartavyatāṃ darśayitumāha ---- 


astreṇa prokṣayecchiṣyaṃ puṣpayuktena tāḍayet | 

recakena tato gatvā śiṣyadehe viśeddhṛdi || 4-69 || 


puṣpeti astrajaptena puṣpeṇetyarthaḥ | recakenetyūrdhvamāgīkeṇa || 69 || 

atha tatra ---- 


oṃkārādiśivaṃ japtvā astramantraṃ phaḍantagam | 

viśleṣakaraṇaṃ kṛtvā caitanyasya vidhānataḥ || 4-70 || 

chedayedastramantreṇa kavacenāvaguṇṭhayet | 

aṅkuśena samākṛṣya dvādaśānte tu kārayet || 4-71 || 

tatrasthaḥ pudgalo grāhyaḥ sampuṭyaiva dhruveṇa tu | 

saṃhāramudrayā samyak...........


śivaṃ niṣkalam, caitanyasyeti puryaṣṭakarūpasya, vidhānata iti 
pūrvoktaraśmimātrāviyogabhāvanayā, aṅkuśeneti mūlamantrasya 
kuṭilakalākrameṇa aṅkuśamudrāpradarśanena cetyarthaḥ | pudgalo jīvaḥ, 
samyagiti svābhedapratītidārḍhyena | yathoktaṃ spande ----

iti ||

tatra ---- 


saṃskubhya sarasīkṛtya recayet pudgalaṃ punaḥ |

samarasīkaraṇaṃ vakṣyamāṇasvābhedāpādanam, 
recanamūrdhvodveṣṭanakrameṇa, devatā 
brahmaviṣṇurudreśvarasadāśivaśivākhyā 
hṛtkaṇṭhatālubhrūmadhyalalāṭabrahmarandhragāḥ, tattyāga eva śiṣyasya 
tadadhiṣṭhitādhvani viśleṣayogyatādhānahetuḥ, svāmini jite svasyāpi 
jayāt, svakaṃ padaṃ bhrūmadhyam | yadvakṣyati ---- 

"eśvaraṃ labhate padam |" (4-79) 

iti |

ityupakramya

iti || 73 ||

bhairaveṇābhimantrya.............


bhavena bhairaveṇeti niṣkalenābhimantraṇaṃ ca saptavāramityāhuḥ | 
tadetāvatparyanto rudrāṃśāpādanāya grantho na tu dvijatvāpādanāyeti 
(na) bhramitavyam || 74 || 


dvijatvāpādane tu pūrvokte vaktavyaśeṣamāha ---- 


............evamupavītaṃ śiśordadet | 


evamiti bhairaveṇābhimantrya mantraśaktyaiva idānīṃ 
śuddhavidyāpadodbhavātmakadvitīyajanmayogād dvijatvaṃ bhavati | 
upavītamiti, upa ātmasamīpe viśeṣeṇa mantrasāmarthyātmanā itaṃ 
saṃbaddham, vītaṃ ca 
śuddhamanantamantradaivatavyāpakaśuddhavidyātmakaśaktisūtrapratikṛtirūpa
metadupavītam || 

dattopavīto hi asau ---- 


ādhānādyāvadantyeṣṭiṃ dvijatve saṃskṛto bhavet || 4-75 || 


garbhādhānādayo vakṣyamāṇāścatvāriṃśacchuddhavidyodbhavātmaka-
proktadvitīyajanmopayogāya | te ca mantraśaktyaiva siddhyanti || 75 || 

etaccatvāriṃśatā saṃskāraiḥ ---- 


piṇḍasyāpādanaṃ jāteḥ.............


bhavatīti śeṣaḥ || 

kathamityāha ---- 


.................āhutitritayena tu | 


pūrvaṃ nirṇītenaiva ityarthaḥ || 

na kevalamiyatā saṃskāraiḥ piṇḍasya jātyāpādanaṃ yāvat ---- 


caitanyasyāpi saṃskāramādhānāntyeṣṭitaḥ param || 4-76 || 

sūkṣmavijñānataḥ kṛtvā dvijatve saṃskṛto bhavet | 


ādhānenādibhāvinā sahitaḥ paryantavartīantyeṣṭyātmā catvāriṃśaḥ 
saṃskāraḥ, tataḥ paraṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ 
dayākṣāntyādyātmakātmaguṇasaṃskārāṣṭakaṃ sūkṣmavijñānata iti 
bhāvanayā | evaṃ dvijatvāpādanārthaṃ yathoktaṃ nirvartyoktasatattvaṃ 
rudrāṃśāpādanaṃ kartavyam || 76 || 

tadante'pi ---- 


śatahomaṃ sahasraṃ vā hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ || 4-77 || 


dadyāditi śeṣaḥ | śatādihomo mūlamantrasya tadaṅgānāṃ tu daśāṃśa
iti sthitameva || 77 || 

tadidamupasaṃharati ---- 


samayī saṃskṛto hyevaṃ..........


evamiti jātyuddhāradvijatvarudrāṃśāpattibhiḥ | samayī samayaḥ 
pārameśaśāstramaryādāvartanamasyāstīti kṛtvā | yadāha ---- 


........vācane'syārhatā bhavet | 

śravaṇe'dhyayane home pūjanādau tathaiva ca || 4-78 || 


vācanaṃ buddhyādyārohāyāvartanam, śravaṇamarthāvabodhaḥ, adhyayanaṃ
vedavatsatatapāṭha āgamagranthasya, ādiśabdena japadhyānādayaḥ || 78 || 

itthamayaṃ samayī ---- 


caryādhyānaviśuddhātmā labhate padamaiśvaram | 


caryādhyānābhyāṃ samayapālanayogābhyāsābhyāmeva viśuddha ātmā yasya 
| dīkṣayā hi asyādhvaśuddhiyojanena vinā īśvarayogayogyataivāhiteti 
tadyogādevāsya pāśaśuddhāvīśvarapadāptiḥ | ataśca 
yatkaścidīśvaratattvayojitasyāsya putrakādidīkṣāyāmadharapadaśodhanaṃ 
na yuktam iti īśvarapadam ---- 

"śuddhabhāvasthitasyāsya kālarudraṃ nidhāpayet |"

iti kairaṇavākyānusāreṇa kālāgnidhāma vā (maiva) ityavocat, tadasat, 
samayino yojanikāderacoditatvāt kairaṇasya vākyasya cāsya 
putrakāśrayabhuvanadīkṣāviṣayatvāt | kiraṇāyāṃ hi samayidīkṣānte 
"tato dīkṣāṃ samācaret |" ityupakramya putrakaviṣayabhuvanadīkṣā 
etadvākyapramukhaṃ nirvāhitetyalam | eśvarapadalābho'parā muktiḥ || 

athoktasamayidīkṣānantaranirvartyāṃ prathamata eva vā kartavyāṃ
putrakādidīkṣāṃ nirṇetuṃ prastauti ---- 


atha dīkṣādhvaśuddhyarthaṃ bhuktimuktiphalāthīnām || 4-79 || 

vidhānamucyate sūkṣmaṃ pāśavicchittikārakam | 


bhuktyathīnaḥ sādhakāḥ, muktyathīnaḥ putrakācāryāḥ, teṣāṃ yā 
dīkṣā tasyāmadhvaśuddhyarthaṃ sūkṣmamiti bhāvivyāptyā 
samūlapāśonmūlane paratattvayojanikādirūpaṃ vidhānamucyate | samayinastu 
adhiṣṭhātṛkāraṇaviśleṣamātrapūrvamīśvaratattvārādhanayogayogyatā,
iti taṃ prati na sūkṣmavidhānaṃ nāpi parā muktirnāpi 
mantrārādhanakrameṇa bhuktiriti 
bhāviputrakādipadaprāptiyogyatājananamātraṃ samayidīkṣālakṣaṇam | 
yathoktam ---- 

śamayī rājaputravat |" 

iti || 79 || 

atha putrakasādhakadīkṣayovīṣayavibhāgaṃ sapīṭhikābandhaṃ karoti ---- 


guruḥ saṃpṛcchate śiṣyaṃ dvividhaṃ phalakāṅkṣiṇam || 4-80 || 


dvividhaṃ bubhukṣuṃ mumukṣaṃ vā, phalamiti mokṣo bhogo vā || 80 || 

ataścedamasmai brūyāt ---- 


phalamākāṅkṣase yādṛktādṛk sādhanamārabhe | 


sādhanaṃ dīkṣāvidhiḥ || 

yataḥ ---- 


vāsanābhedataḥ prāptiḥ sādhyamantrapracoditā || 4-81 || 


sādhya ārādhyo yo mantraḥ sa cintāmaṇikalpo vāsanānusāraṃ phalati ata 
eva śrīspande ---- 

"tadākramya balaṃ mantrāḥ" (spa0 2-10)

ityupakramya

śahārādhakacittena" (spa0 2-10) 

ityantam || 81 || 

tathā ca ---- 


mantramudrādhvadravyāṇāṃ homaḥ sādhāraṇaḥ smṛtaḥ | 


bhuktau muktau ca || 

sa tu ---- 


vāsanābhedato bhinnaḥ śiṣyāṇāṃ ca gurostathā || 4-82 || 


yadā śiṣyaḥ svapratyayī tadā guruḥ tadvāsanānusāraṃ muktaye bhuktaye 
vā juhuyāt | yadā tu gurupratyayī tadāsau svavāsanānusāraṃ muktaya eva, 
tasya bubhukṣābhāvādityarthalabhyo'yamatrāśayaḥ || 82 ||  

atha vāsanābhedataḥ śiṣyabhedaṃ pratipādayati ---- 


sādhako dvividhastatra śivadharmyekataḥ sthitaḥ | 

śivamantraviśuddhādhvā sādhyamantraniyojitaḥ || 4-83 || 

jñānavāṃścābhiṣiktaśca mantrārādhanatatparaḥ | 

trividhāyāstu siddhervai so'trārhaḥ śivasādhakaḥ || 4-84 || 


śivadharmaḥ śivaśāstroktasamācāro nityāviyogena vidyate yasya, ata eva 
śivapadena sādhyamantreṇaiva viśuddho na tu lokadhamīṇa iva aṃśena 
sthāpito'dhvā yasya, yasminneva ca sādhyamantrayojita 
ityācāryeṇārādhakatvena niyuktaḥ | jñānavāniti 
adhigatamantratantrarahasyaḥ || 84 || 

aparamāha ---- 


dvitīyo lokamārgastha iṣṭāpūrtavidhau rataḥ | 

karmakṛt phalamākāṅkṣan śubhaikastho'śubhojjhitaḥ || 4-85 || 


lokamārgaḥ śrutismṛtyācāraḥ, iṣṭaṃ tīrthasnānānnadānādi, pūrtaṃ
kūpataḍāgamaṭhādi (nirmāṇaṃ), phalamākāṅkṣan karma śubhameva 
karoti, na tu mantrārādhanam ---- 

"lokadhamīṇyasau dīkṣā mantrārādhanavajītā |" (4-144)

iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt śubhakarmaṇaiva tu phalasya sādhanāt sādhako'yam, 
dīkṣayā tvasyāśubhamātrameva śamanīyamityāha, aśubhojjhita iti || 85 
|| 

ata eva ---- 


tasya kāryaṃ sadā mantrairaśubhāṃśavināśanam | 


sadeti dehārambhakarmavarjaṃ yadyadakarot kariṣyati vā tatra madhye 
yo'śubhāṃśaḥ sa sarvo'sya śodhyaḥ || 

".............. prārabdhrekaṃ na śodhayet |" (4-141)

iti vākyasya prāyaśaḥ sarvaviṣayatvādasaṅkīrṇācāreṇa śivadhamīṇā
bhāvyamityāha ---- 


gṛhastho vā yatirvāsāvāśramaikatamasthitaḥ || 4-86 || 


śmaśānādikavṛttenaiva vā siddhiṃ sādhayet, gṛhasthavṛttena 
tādṛśaireva dravyairna tu śabalatayā, asāviti śivadharmī na tvanyaḥ, 
tasya mantrārādhane'nadhikārāt | na tu āśramānavakḷptiparametat, 
ihānupayogāt || 86 || 

sādhakaṃ nirṇīya mokṣaikaniṣṭhaṃ putrakaṃ nirṇetumāha ---- 


mumukṣudvīvidhaḥ prokto nirbījo bījavān punaḥ | 


ubhayovīṣayavibhāgamāha ---- 


bālabāliśavṛddhastrībhogabhugvyādhitātmanām || 4-87 || 

eṣāṃ nirbījikā dīkṣā samayādivivajitā | 


bāliśo mūrkhaḥ | vṛddho'nuṣṭhānāsamarthaḥ | bhogabhug 
upanatabhogaikasakto'pyāyātaśaktipāto dīkṣya eva | anye 
tvālasyopahato'yaṃ na pātram, ato bhogabhuk apathyaparaścāsau vyādhita 
iti yojayanti, vyādhito duścikitsyaḥ, nirbījiketyasya vyākhyānaṃ 
samayādivivajīteti | ādiśabdāt pavitrakādividhiḥ | vakṣyati ca ---- 

śamayācārapāśāṃśca nirbījāyāṃ viśodhayet |" (4-147)

iti || 87 || 


vidvaddvandvasahānāṃ tu sabījā kītītā priye || 4-88 || 


viduṣāṃ śāstravivekakuśalānāṃ dvandvasahānāṃ 
vratacaryādikleśakṣamāṇāṃ samayapālane'pi śaktatvāt || 88 || 


dīkṣānugrāhikā teṣāṃ samayācārasaṃyutā | 


pūrvāvivekyaśaktaviṣayā, iyaṃ tu viparītaviṣayeti tātparyam || 

ataśca ---- 


viśeṣasamayācārā mantrākhye ye prakītītāḥ || 4-89 || 

te'tra pālyāḥ prayatnena mokṣasiddhimabhīpsatā | 


mantrākhye mantrapīṭhe, asmin ye ---- 

ṅa nindedbhairavaṃ devaṃ na ca śāstraṃ tadudbhavam |" (5-44)

ityādayo vakṣyamāṇā viśeṣasamayācārā uktāḥ, te'treti 
sabījadīkṣāyāṃ prayatnena pālyāḥ, anyathā prāyaścittitvamiti 
bhaviṣyati | mantrākhye iti vidyāpīṭhāderapyupalakṣaṇaparam || 89 || 

yeyamevaṃ nirṇītā dīkṣā ---- 


sabījā sā tu vijñeyā putrakācāryayoḥ sthitā || 4-90 || 


vāgīśyā garbhodbhūteḥ saṃsārapraśamanenānukampitaḥ putraḥ putrakaḥ, 
sādhakadīkṣāyāṃ yadyapi samayapālanamāmnātam tathāpi na taddīkṣā 
sabījocyate, mumukṣudvīvidhaḥ, iti paribhāṣaṇāt || 90 || 

evamasmiṃścatuvīdhe dīkṣākarmaṇi prathamam ---- 


gṛhastho vāśramī vātha yatiḥ saṅkalpya dīkṣayet | 


vākyārthasyātra karmatā paśya mṛgo dhāvatītivat, tena 
gṛhastho'yamāśramīti ehikabhogaspṛhayāluḥ, yatirityetadviparīto 
vetyetat prathamaṃ saṅkalpya etaducitenaiva asaṅkīrṇena vidhinā dīkṣāṃ 
kuryāt || 

tatra putrakadīkṣāyāṃ prakramate ---- 


pāśasūtrakamādāya śiṣyadehe'valambayet || 4-91 || 


adhivāsāvasare adhivāsyakumbhāgre yatsaṃrakṣya sthāpitamavalambanaṃ 
śikhāgrāt pādāntaṃ prāgvat || 91 || 

atha ---- 


adhvānaṃ saṃdhayedagnau dhāmnā caiva vicakṣaṇaḥ | 


vakṣyamāṇaṣaḍadhvavyāptijño guruḥ prādhānyāt śivāgnāveva 
aśeṣapāśaploṣiṇi, adhvānamitīha prastutaṃ kalādhvānam, 
tattvādidīkṣāyāṃ tu tattvādirūpaṃ saṃdadhīta || 

na cāgnāveva yāvat ---- 


kumbhamaṇḍalavahnisthaścādhvātmasthaḥ śiśośca yaḥ || 4-92 || 

sūtrasthaścāpi caikatra adhvasaṃdhiḥ prakītītaḥ | 


ātmastha iti guroḥ || 92 || 

ekatretyuktamadhikaraṇaṃ vibhajannadhvaśuddhiṃ nirūpayitumāha ---- 


ṣaḍvidhasyādhvamārgasya sādhāraṇagatasya tu || 4-93 || 

kuṇḍe saṅkalpya saṃśodhyamadhvasaṃdhau tu homayet | 


varṇamantrapadakalātattvabhuvanabhedāt 
ṣaḍvidhasyādhvanastattatpadaprāptihetutayā mārgarūpasya kumbhādiṣu 
ṣaṭsu adhikaraṇeṣu sādhāraṇagatasyābhedena sthitasya tathā jñātasya 
ca madhyāt saṃśodhyamityantarbhūtādhvapañcakamekatamaṃ prādhānyena 
śodhayitumiṣṭam | kuṇḍe iti tatsthe śivāgnau saṅkalpya 
adhvasaṃdhinimittaṃ homaṃ kuryāt || 93 || 

kathamityāha ---- 


mūlamantrāṣṭaśatikamadhvasandhānahetutaḥ || 4-94 || 


praṇavamūlamantroccārapūrvamadhvasaṃdhirbhavatu svāhā iti 
prayogenādhvavyāptijño gururaṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ juhuyāditi yāvat || 94 || 

adhvāvalokanaṃ paścād vyāpyavyāpakabhedataḥ | 

avalokanaṃ bhāvanaṃ, kuryāditi śeṣaḥ || 

vyāptiṃ sphuṭayati ---- 


bhuvanavyāptitā tattveṣvanantādiśivāntake || 4-95 || 


anantādiśivāntake yāni bhuvanāni tadvyāpakatvaṃ tattveṣu || 95 || 

tāni ca tattvāni ---- 


vyāpakāni ca ṣaṭtriṃśat...................


ye tvanye trayo'dhvānaḥ ---- 


..............ṃantravarṇapadātmakāḥ | 


varṇāḥ pañcāśat, padāni navātmasaṃbandhīnyekāśītiḥ || 

te ca ---- 


tattvāntarbhāvinaḥ sarve...............


tattvāni antarbhāvayantīti kṛtvā | 

katham ---- 


...............vācyavācakayogataḥ || 4-96 || 


tattvāni vācyāni mantrādayo vācakāḥ | yathā ca ayaṃ 
vācyavācakabhāvastathāgre bhaviṣyati || 96 || 

kalādīkṣāyāḥ prastutatvāt tadantarbhāvaṃ tāvat 
pañcānāmadhvanāmāha ---- 


kalāntarbhāvinaste vai nivṛttyādyāśca tāḥ smṛtāḥ | 


asya sarvasya adhvagranthasyāyaṃ piṇḍārthaḥ ---- 

parameśvaraścidānandaghanaḥ svatantrabhaṭṭāraka 
ekādaśapaṭalanirūpayiṣyamāṇasthityā unmanākhyayā 
svasvātantryaśaktyā śūnyādikṣityantamanantaṃ vācyavācakarūpaṃ 
svabhittau svānadhikamapyadhikamiva yugapadavabhāsayati | tatra vācakaṃ 
grāhakabhāgāvasthitaṃ parasūkṣmasthūlabhedena varṇamantrapadātmakaṃ 
tridhā, vācyamapi grāhyabhāgābhiniviṣṭaṃ kalātattvabhuvanātmakam, 
tathaiva varṇā hyabhedavimarśasārāḥ kiṃcitsthaulyena 
bhedābhedavimarśanātmakamantrarūpatāmāśritya tato'pi sthaulyena 
bhedavimarśāvagamakapadarūpatayā bhānti | evaṃ vācyarūpā pārameśvarī 
kalākhyā śaktiruttarottaravaiśiṣṭyena tattvabhuvanātmatāṃ gṛhṇāti, 
vastutaśceyamakramaiva pārameśvarī śaktiḥ sphurati, tatrāpi ca 
svasvātantryād darpaṇanagaravat kramamapyādarśayati, krame'pi ca pūrvaṃ 
pūrvamutraratra vyāpakatayā sthitaṃ mṛdiva ghaṭādau uttaramuttaraṃ tu 
pūrvatra śaktyātmanā sthitaṃ vṛkṣa iva svabīja iti sarvaṃ 
sarvātmakameva | ata eva pañcatatvadīkṣāyāmanāśritatattvaparyantā 
bhūtavyāptirbhaviṣyati | evaṃ caikaiko'pi pramātā bhāvo vā vastutaḥ 
ṣaḍadhvasphārarūpapārameśaśaktimayādihāntaparāmarśasārāhantāviśra
antisatattvaḥ parabhairavarūpa eva, tathātvāparijñānāt tu 
tanmāyāśaktikṛtādapūrṇaṃmanyaḥ śabdarāśikalāviluptavibhavatvāt 
varṇādibhiḥ kalādibhiśca tāttvikasvarūpeṇāsphuradbhiḥ 
pratyayodbhavakrameṇa dehādau grāhitāhaṃbhāvo viṣayamātrāsu 
grāhitabhoktṛtābhimānaśca khecaryādicakracatuṣṭayasya bhogyatāṃ 
prāpto baddhaḥ paśuḥ saṃpanna ityasya paśubhāvaśamanāya pārameśvarī 
anugrāhikā śaktiḥ śivābhinnācāryahṛdaye pāramāthīkena svarūpeṇa 
sphurantī śiṣyasya sarvamadhvānaṃ saṅkocakatvapraśamanena 
asaṅkucitasvaśaktisāratayā sphārayantī śodhayati 
dīkṣājñānādiyogena, ata evamācāryasphārasārā mantrādayaḥ 
śodhakāḥ, paśvātmābhiniviṣṭāḥ śodhyā, iti śodhyaśodhakabhāve'pi 
na kācit kṣatiḥ | yataścaikaikasyāpyadhvanaḥ sarvamayatvamasti, ata eva 
tattadadhvaprādhānyena 
dīkṣāyāmanyādhvapañcakamantarbhāvaśodhanamuktavyāptisatattvaṃ kāryam 
| uktaṃ ca śrīspande ---- 

śeyaṃ kriyātmikā śaktiḥ śivasya paśuvatīnī | 

bandhayitrī svamārgasthā jñātā siddhyupapādikā ||" (3-16)

ityalam | kevalam ---- 

"yāvanna vetti vai vyāptiṃ kuṇḍasyaivātmano'pi vā || 

sādhyasyaiva paśoścaiva pāśānāṃ ca ṣaḍaghvanaḥ | 

bālavat krīḍate tāvat kāryaṃ tasya kathaṃ bhavet ||"(16-54-55)

iti mṛtyujityuktatvāt tatra tatra vyāptipradarśanāyāyamasmākaṃ bhara iti 
na no vācālatā kalpyā sacetobhiḥ || 

atha prasaṅgāt kalāvācakān mantrānāha ---- 


hṛdādyā vācakāstāsāṃ bījamantrāḥ prakītītāḥ || 4-97 || 


bījamantrā iti niṣkalāḥ, hṛdādyā iti 
hṛcchiraḥśikhākavacanetramantrāḥ krameṇa nivṛttyādīnāṃ vācakāḥ || 
97 || 

evaṃ cāsmin kalādīkṣāvidhau ---- 


ekaikasyāḥ kalāyāśca pṛthag vyāptiṃ vibhāvayet | 


sā cādūra eva vyaktībhaviṣyati || 

tāśca ---- 


pṛthivyādikalā jñeyā brahmādyāḥ kāraṇaśca te || 4-98 || 


nivṛtyādyāḥ pṛthivyādiśaktirūpā jñeyāḥ, 
pṛthivyādīnāmevānāśritaparyantaṃ sūkṣmatayāvasthānāt | etacca 
pañcatattvadīkṣāvidhau sphuṭībhaviṣyati | etā 
evamadhiṣṭhātṛrūpatayā brahmaviṣṇurudreśvarasadāśivaśivāḥ, ataśca 
adhiṣṭhātṛdevatāśuddhyāpyetāḥ śuddhā bhavantītyapi sūcitam || 98 || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


evaṃ vyāptiṃ bhāvayitvā...............


pratikalaṃ samanantaravakṣyamāṇavyāptim | evamiti 
nirṇītaparasūkṣmasthūlakrameṇadhvano bhāvayitvā || 


................'dhvopasthāpanaṃ bhavet | 


upasthāpanamekatamasya pradhānatayā śuddhyarthaṃ sammukhīkaraṇam | atra
ca dhāmādītyādinā (sva0 4-101) 

mantraṃ vakṣyati || 

evamupasthitasya saṃnidhānāya ---- 


trirāhutiṃ dhruveṇaiva................


dadyāditi śeṣaḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


...............'dhvaśuddhirato bhavet || 4-99 || 


katham ? ---- tyāha ---- 


agnau tu pūjite deve adhvanyāse kṛte sati | 

tadeva pādādārabhya pṛthivyādikramānnyaset || 4-100 || 


tadeveti nivṛtyādirūpam | pādāditi saṃhārakrameṇa | tatra gulphāntaṃ 
nivṛttiḥ, nābhyantaṃ pratiṣṭhā, tālvantaṃ vidyā, mūrdhāntaṃ 
śāntiḥ, brahmarandhrāntaṃ śāntyatītā, iti bhaviṣyati | itthaṃ ca 
vartamānaprāṇadehapratikṛtirūpe sūtrake 
dehānusārigulphanābhyādyavadhimati adhvanyāsatacchuddhyādikaṃ kṛtaṃ 
dehe'pi saṃpannameveti na tatra samayadīkṣāyāmiva pṛthag 
jātyuddhāradvijatvāpattyādi kriyate, pṛthagacodanāt | bhāvisthityā tu 
niṣkṛtihomāntarbhāvena bhāvidehāśrayatayāpi caitanyasya tatkṛtaṃ 
tatsthīkaraṇādiyuktyā vartamānadehāśrayasyāpi saṃpadyate | evaṃ 
samayadīkṣāntarbhāviputrakadīkṣāpakṣe ca vartamānadehaviṣayo 
dīkṣāsaṃskāraḥ punarupayuktaḥ || 100 || 

pūrvokte upasthāpane mantramāha ---- 


dhāmādiḥ praṇavādiśca nivṛttyai ca namaḥ punaḥ | 

upasthāpanamantro'yaṃ vyāptiṃ dhyātvādhvasaṃsthitām || 4-101 || 


prayoktavya iti śeṣaḥ | atra ca praṇavadhāmabhyāmanantaraṃ hṛnmantraḥ
pūrvoktaḥ paṭhanīyaḥ,

"hṛdādyā vācakāstāsāṃ bījamantrāḥ" (4-97)


ityuktatvāt | evamuttaratrāpi jñeyam || 101 || 

yaduktamekaikasyāḥ kalāyāḥ pṛthagvyāptiriti, tat spaṣṭayati ---- 


nivṛttyabhyantare pṛthvī śatakoṭipravistarā | 

tasyāṃ ca bhuvanānāṃ ca śatamaṣṭottarāvadhi || 4-102 || 

aṣṭāviṃśatiḥ padāni varṇa eko'tra saṃsthitaḥ | 

mantrau dvāveva vijñeyau................


śatakoṭīti yojanaśatakoṭivistāretyarthaḥ | śatamaṣṭottarāvadhīti ---
- tatra kālāgniḥ kūṣmāṇḍo hāṭaka iti 
brahmāṇḍāntaradhobhāgagatāstrayaḥ | madhye bhūlokādhipatiḥ śivaḥ, 
tadupari satyalokāntamadhiṣṭhātā brahmā, tadupari viṣṇurudrau 
svalokayorityantaḥ sapta, bahirasya daśasu dikṣu sthitaṃ rudraśatam, 
tadupari sarveṣāṃ svāmī vīrabhadraḥ, ityetadaṣṭottaraṃ śatam | 
padāni tvaṣṭāviṃśatiḥ, 
bhāvinavanābhamaṇḍalārambhibhāgaikāśītiniviṣṭavakṣyamāṇa- 
vibhāganavātmavarṇānyekāśītistattadviśrāntipradatvātpadāni, tebhyaḥ 
prakṛtitatvādhiṣṭhiteśadiggatabhāganavakagataṃ 
prātilomyeneśottarādikrameṇa madhyapadaṃ yāvad oṃkārādyakārāntaṃ 
padanavakam | tathaiva puruṣatattvāśritakuberadiggatamakārādiyakārāntaṃ
navakam | evaṃ niyatisthānasthavāyudiggatamūkārā(dimakārā)ntamiti 
saptaviṃśatiḥ padāni; kālatattvāspadavaruṇadiggataiśakoṇastha 
ūkāraścetyaṣṭāviṃśatiḥ padāni | atraiva spaṣṭīkaraṇārthamayaṃ 
prastāraḥ pradarśyate ---- (pūrvapṛṣṭhe draṣṭavyaḥ) varṇa eka iti 
mātṛkāsaṃbandhī prātilomyena kṣaḥ | yadyapyayaṃ pūrvaṃ 
vaktrabhaṅgyā śāntyatītāparamārtha īśānavaktravācakatvena nirūpita 
iha tu pṛthivīvācakatvena, tathāpi ādikṣāntasya 
śabdarāśeraśeṣaviśvaśarīraparabhairavaparāmarśātmakatvena 
ekaiko'pyaṃśaḥ ---- 

"pradeśo'pi brahmaṇaḥ sārvarūpyamanatikrāntaścāvikalpyaśca |"

iti sthityā viśvarūpatvādviśvābhidhāyakāḥ, vācyo'pi cāṃśaḥ ---- 

"ekaikatra ca tattve'pi ṣaṭtriṃśattattvarūpatā |"

iti nītyā viśvātmakatvāt sarvavarṇavācyaḥ | tataśca bhagavatā 
śaktiniyantraṇāya evamatyaṇvapi vā tattadāgame siddhavācakabhāve 
vicitradīkṣādikramopayogini nirūpyamāṇe'pi na kācidanupapattiḥ | 
mantrāviti niṣkalasadyojātau || 

evamasyāṃ nivṛttikalāyām ---- 


.............'dhvaṣaṭkaṃ vibhāvayet || 4-103 || 


athemāṃ nivṛttimantarbhāvitāparādhvavyāptiṃ pūrvoktakrameṇa ---- 


puṣpagandhādinā pūjya..............


asyāśca prāṅmantreṇa ---- 


................ṣaṃnidhāvāhutitrayam | 

saṃnidhānāya āhutitrayaṃ dadyāditi śeṣaḥ | 


kalādyadhvāntarmalatrayaṃ śodhyamiti vaktumāha ---- 


māyīyā bhuvanākārā malāḥ karma ca saṃsthitāḥ || 4-104 || 


pāśā iti śeṣaḥ || 104 || 

tatra ---- 


śarīrabhuvanākārā māyīyāḥ parikītītāḥ | 

bhogahetuśca karma syādabhilāṣo malo'tra tu || 4-105 || 


bhuvanairbhāvabhūtādi lakṣyate, tena yatkiṃcidvedyatayā bhāti sa māyīyo 
malaḥ, bhogena tadākṣiptaṃ janmāpi lakṣitam | uktaṃ ca pratyabhijñāyām 
---- 

"bhinnavedyaprathātraiva māyākhyam,

iti tathā ---- 

janmabhogadam kartaryabodhe kārmaṃ tu |" (ī0pra0 3-2-5) 

iti | 


abhilāṣa iti apūrṇaṃmanyatātmā lolikārūpaḥ, na tu kiṃcinme 
syāditīdṛk, rāgatattvasyaivamātmatvāt | atra tviti, etasminnāṇave 
bhittibhūte sati anyanmaladvayamityarthaḥ || 105 || 

ata eva śāntyatītāyāmapi sūkṣmabhuvanāvasthiteḥ 
pratipādayiṣyamāṇatvāt tāvatāṃśena malasaṃskārasya sattvāt 
śodhyatāṃ pratipādayiṣyannupasaṃharati ---- 


evaṃ pāśatrayaṃ bhāvyaṃ dīkṣāyāmadhvasaṃsthitam | 


athaitadbhāvayitvā ---- 


tadviśuddhyai ca dīkṣā ca kriyate sā yathāvidhi || 4-106 || 


vividhaṃ teṣāṃ pāśānāṃ viśeṣeṇa 
saṃskāraparyantatāpraśamanarūpeṇa śuddhyarthaṃ 
cakārādyojanikāgranthanirvartyaśivatvābhivyakttyarthaṃ ca 
dānakṣapaṇātmā dīkṣā kriyate || 106 || 

tadvidhiṃ prastauti ---- 


ādau śaktiṃ nyased devi kalātattvasamanvitām | 


śaktimādhārarūpāṃ pārameśīṃ kriyākhyāṃ kalādīkṣāprastāvāt 
prathamaṃ nivṛttikalātmanā tattvenāntarbhāvitāparādhvapañcakena 
sambaddhām || 

tathā ---- 


hṛdā saṅkalpya vāgīśīṃ vyāpikāṃ sarvayoniṣu || 4-107 || 


nyaset | hṛdeti kākākṣivat pūrvatrāpi yojyam | uktaṃ ca ---- 

"hṛdādyā vācakāstāsāṃ (4-97) iti | 

"vāgeva viśvā bhuvanāni jajñe |"

iti sthityā yathāsyāścaturdaśavidhabhūtasargajanmabhūmivyāpakatvaṃ
tathā nirṇītameva || 107 || 

nivṛttyanusāreṇa yonīnīrūpayati ---- 


śatarudrādyanantāntaṃ yonayo vividhāḥ sthitāḥ | 


vividhāścaturdaśavidhabhūtasargajanikāḥ || 

tāsu ca ---- 


samakālamṛtutvena vāgīśīṃ sannidhāpayet || 4-108 || 


āyātaśaktipātaṃ prati śuddhasṛṣṭyaunmukhyasaṃpādyayugapadaneka-
dehasargayogyatātmakārtavayuktayā sā tāvatsaṃnihitā | ācāryastu 
tanmūlabalāvaṣṭambhātmanā prayojakavyāpāreṇa tāṃ 
saṃnidhimudrābandhanapūrvamagnikuṇḍe'vasthāpayet || 108 || 

atha tām ---- 


dhruveṇa pūjayet puṣpairgandhadhūpairanukramāt | 


atra ca praṇavaṃ hṛdbījaṃ coccārya,
