"pṛthivītattvasthānantādivīrabhadrāntanānābhuvanagatacaturdaśavidhabhū
tasargavicitraśarīrahetave ṅivṛttivyāpikāyai vāgīśyai namaḥ" iti 
mantraḥ saṃnidhāpanapūjanayoḥ || 

atha ---- 


oṃkāreṇāhutīstisro vāgīśīsaṃnidhāpane || 4-109 || 


dadyāditi śeṣaḥ || 109 || 

dattvā ca ---- 


śiṣyaṃ saṃprokṣya cāstreṇa tāḍayedastramuccaran | 


prokṣaṇaṃ hṛdayadeśānusāre pāśasūtre śivāmbhasā, tāḍanaṃ tu 
bhasmanā taireva vā || 

tato'pi ---- 


recakenātmano gatvā chindyāttasyāsināhṛdaḥ || 4-110 || 

"śaśimārgeṇa śiṣyāṇāṃ sūryasthaḥ praviśeddhṛdi |"

iti śrīlakṣmīkaulārṇavoktanītyā svadakṣiṇena nirgatya śiṣyasya 
vāmena praviśya puryaṣṭakarūpaṃ śiṣyātmānamastramantreṇa bhāvanayā 
sūtrasthaṃ chindyāt || 110 || 

chinnaṃ ca ---- 


dhāmnākṛṣya tadātmānaṃ dvādaśānte nidhāpayet | 


ākarṣaṇayuktiḥ pūrvamevoktā | etacca ---- 

"raśmimātrāviyogena kāryam |" 

ityuktam || 

atha ---- 


dhruveṇa tatsthaṃ saṃpuṭya caitanyaṃ mudrayātmani || 111 || 

pūrayed bhairaveṇaiva...................


tatsthaṃ dvādaśāntastham | mudrayeti dīptaśivahastakṛtayā 
saṃhārākhyayā, ātmanīti svahṛdaye | bhairaveṇa niṣkalena || 111 || 

tenaiva ca ---- 


..........kumbhayed recayet tataḥ | 


nāsākrameṇaiva || 

tata eva ca ---- 


dvādaśāntāttu saṃgṛhya yojayed bhavamudrayā || 4-112 || 


yojanaṃ vāgīśīgarbhe, bhavamudrā liṅgamudrā || 112 || 

yojane itikartavyatāmāha ---- 


ātmānamīśvaraṃ dhyātvā māyāṃ vāgīśvarīmapi | 

saṃyojya tasyāṃ caitanyaṃ śarīrāṇyadhvani sṛjet || 4-113 || 


īśvaraḥ kriyāśaktiprādhānyāt sraṣṭā, prāṅnarṇītā tu 
vāgīśvarī saṃpratyaśuddhādhvapramātṛtvānmāyā, śuddhādhvaprasave tu 
eṣaiva mahāmāyātmā bhaviṣyati, māyārūpāyāścāsyāḥ 
śuddhavidyāsparśo nāsti, anyathā kramikakarmabhogānāṃ 
yugapacchuddhyarthamanantadehasṛṣṭerayogāt, caitanyamiti dīkṣyasyeti 
arthāt, adhvanīti prakṛte nivṛttikalāpradhāne || 113 || 

kimarthaṃ sṛjedityāha ---- 


prākkarmavāsanāśeṣaphalabhogatvahetave | 


pūrvakarmavāsanāhetukāni yānyaśeṣāṇi janmāyurbhogātmakāni phalāni,
teṣāṃ bhogyatvaṃ bhogasiddhiryathā syāt || 

etāni ca śarīrāṇi ---- 


yugapadbhinnabhogāni deśakālaśarīrataḥ || 4-114 || 

mantraśaktyā vipacyante............


śarīramatra svabhāvaḥ | bhinno bhogo yeṣu, deśāditrayāntāni 
śarīrāṇi mantraśaktyā yugapadvipacyante phaladānonmukhāni saṃpadyante 
|| 114 || 

na kevalaṃ śarīrāṇi yugapadbhinnabhogāni vipacyante yāvat ---- 


..........pudgalāśca tathāvidhāḥ | 

bhinnadehā visṛjyante garbhe vāgīśiyoniṣu || 4-115 || 


pudgalā ityanenaikasyāpi dīkṣyasya nānāśarīratayā bahutvaṃ vadan 
bhedavādasyāvāstavatāṃ dhvanati | yasmādekasyāpi dīkṣyātmano 
nānābhogāśrayavicitradehaśuddhau bhogyavaicitryeṇa nānātvabhāvaḥ | 
tathāvidhā iti bhinnabhogāḥ | yoniṣviti caturdaśavidhabhūtasargāpekṣaṃ
bahutvam, visṛṣṭiḥ niyatabhogārthaṃ saṃyojanam || 115 || 

taditthaṃ śiṣyacaitanyam ---- 


dhāmnā ca yojayitvā ca juhuyādāhutitrayam | 


niṣkaloccārapūrvanivṛttivyāptānantādivīrabhadrāntanānābhuva-
nagatacaturdaśavidhabhūtasargasaṃpattyarthaṃ devadattasya 
vāgīśīgarbhayojanaṃ karomi namaḥ ---- iti mantraḥ | home tu svāhāntaḥ 
| evamuttaratrāpyūhamantrāḥ svayamabhyūhyāḥ || 

evaṃ saṃyojane sati ---- 


yugapat sarvagarbheṣu dehā vividharūpakāḥ || 4-116 || 

bhairavecchāsusampannāḥ śatarudrādyanantagāḥ | 


bhavantīti śeṣaḥ | bhairavaśabdenātra bhairavasamāveśaśālī ācārya
uktaḥ || 116 || 

atha ---- 


garbheṣu garbhaniṣpattiṃ bhairaveṇāhutitrayam || 4-117 || 

hutvā tu jananaṃ kāryaṃ punastenāhutitrayāt | 


karmanāmānusārī atrohamantraḥ, garbhāṇāṃ niṣpattiryatra āhutitraye 
tadgarbheṣu garbhanimittaṃ hutvā, jananaṃ garbhaniḥsaraṇam, teneti 
niṣkalenaiva || 117 || 

śiṣyadehe ---- 1. pāśasūtrāvalambanam, 2. 
ṣaḍadhikaraṇagatādhvasaṃdhānam, 3. taddhomaḥ, 4. adhvavyāptyavalokanam, 
5. adhvopasthāpanam, 6. tatpūjā, 7. homaḥ, 8. tadantaḥpāśatrayacintanam, 
9. kalāśaktisamanvitādhāraśaktinyāsaḥ, 10. vāgīśyāḥ saṃnidhāpanam, 
11-12. tatpūjāhomau, 13-14. śiṣyasamprokṣaṇatāḍane, 15. 
taccaitanyākarṣaṇam, 16. dvādaśānte sthāpanam, 17. tato grahaṇam, 18. 
svahṛdi yojanam, 19. svadvādaśāntaprāpaṇam, 20. vāgīśīgarbhe yojanam, 
21. nānāgarbhaniṣpattihomaḥ ---- 

ityekaviṃśatyavāntarasaṃskārairupaskṛtaṃ homena janmākhyaṃ 
saṃskāramabhidhāya, adhikārākhyaṃ saṃskāraṃ vaktumāha ---- 


sarvayoniṣu dehāste yugapad vṛddhimāgatā || 4-118 || 


bhāvyā iti śeṣaḥ || 118 || 

pravṛddhadehānāmeva bhoge'dhikārādbhogamāha ---- 


bhoganiṣpattaye karma vyāpārasahakāraṇam | 


bhāvyamiti śeṣaḥ | paśoratītamanāgataṃ ca yat 
kramikānantabhogasaṃpādakaṃ saṃbhāvyate śubhādi vāsanātmakaṃ karma 
tatsarvaṃ

"anekabhavikaṃ karma dagdhaṃ bījamivāṇubhiḥ | 

bhaviṣyadapi saṃruddhaṃ yenedaṃ taddhi bhogataḥ ||"

iti śrīkiraṇoktanītyā mantrayuktyā 
yugapadbhoganiṣpattyarthamanusaṃdheyam | kīdṛk? vyāpāraiḥ 
vāṅmanaḥkāyaceṣṭābhiḥ | sahakāraṇaṃ sahetukamityarthaḥ || 

avaśyaṃ caitat anyathā ---- 


tadabhāvānna bhogaḥ syāt.............


karmaiva hi māyīyabhogahetuḥ || 

bhogārthameva tatsādhanāharaṇāya sarve pravartarnta ---- ityāha ---- 


...............ṭadarthaṃ mārjanaṃ smṛtam || 4-119 || 


yasmāt śubhādyanuṣṭhānād bhogasādhane ajīte sati bhoktavyo bhogo 
duḥkhasukhātmakaḥ | evaṃ bhogaṃ nirṇīya, nivṛtte'pi tasmin 
tatsaṃskārāntarmāyīyabhāvarūpamiva layaṃ vaktumāha ---- 


layaḥ paramayā prītyā sukhaduḥkhādike'pyalam || 4-120 || 


dīkṣyasya guruṇā bhāvya iti śeṣaḥ | taduktaṃ śrīmṛgendre ---- 

"kaṃcitkālaṃ layaḥ (8-90) 

iti || 120 || 

evamadhikārabhogalayākhyaṃ saṃskāratrayaṃ bhāvanayā parikalpya ---- 


tisṛbhistisṛbhirhomaṃ dhāmnaiva triṣu kārayet | 

ūhamantrāntenetyarthāt tisṛbhirityāhutibhiḥ || 


evaṃ janmādhikārabhogalayān pratipādya, niṣkṛtyākhyaṃ pañcamaṃ
saṃskāraṃ pratipādayitumāha ---- 


āhutīnāṃ śataṃ homyaṃ dhāmnā niṣkṛtaye punaḥ || 4-121 || 


niṣkṛteradūra eva svarūpaṃ nirvakṣyati || 121 || 

nanvasyāṃ kimiti viśeṣeṇa homa iti ? atrahetumāha ---- 


yatkarma bhogyarūpaṃ tu jātyāyurbhogalakṣaṇam | 

niṣkṛtyante viśuddhet tad bhūlokasamavasthitam || 4-122 || 


karmaṇā śubhāśubhātmanā bhogyaṃ rūpaṃ yasya jātyāyurbhogātmanaḥ 
phalasya tad niṣkṛtāveva śuddhyati, ato yukto'syāṃ śatahomaḥ | bhuvo 
lokā vīrabhadrāntāni bhuvanāni, tatra samavasthitaṃ bhogyatāṃ prāptam, 
etacceha nivṛttiśuddhiprasādādevamuktam, tacca 
pratiṣṭhādivyāptāptatattvāntargatabhuvanabhogopalakṣaṇaparam | anyastu
bhūloke iti paṭhitvā bhūrlokaikadeśe kanyādvīpe'jītamita vyākṛtavān 
|| 122 || 


"bhogo duḥkhasukhātmakaḥ" ityuktyā bhoga idānīmeva nirṇītaḥ, āyuḥ 
sṛṣṭisaṃhārapaṭale nirṇeṣyate, ityavaśiṣṭāṃ jāti 
janmaprakārabhedairādiśati ---- 


saṃsārā daśacatvāraḥ................


devamānuṣatiryagbhedabhinnaścaturdaśadhā bhūtasarga eva saṃsārā 
nānājātaya ityarthaḥ || 

bhuvanadīkṣāyām.

"antyajān śudraviṭkṣatrabrāhmaṇāṃśca viśodhayet |" (10-384)

iti sarvajātiśodhanaṃ vakṣyati | iha tu

"evaṃ trayīdharmamanuprapannā gatāgataṃ kāmakāmā labhante ||" (9-21)

iti gītoktanītyā ṣaṭkarmādhikāritvena 
bandhakarmatvānmanuṣyajātiśuddhau brāhmaṇyajātireva 
niṣkṛtihomenaivāvaśyaṃ śodhyā | saṃkṣiptatvādasya vidheriti vaktumāha 
---- 


.............ṣaṃskārā aṣṭabhiḥ saha | 

catvāriṃśad dvijatvāya vakṣyante bhuvanādhvani || 4-123 || 

yonirbījaṃ tathā bhāva āhāro deśa eva ca | 

eteṣāṃ śodhanaṃ devi................


ādhānādayo'ntyeṣṭyantāścatvāriṃśat, dayādayaḥ spṛhāntāśca 
aṣṭāviti ye'ṣṭacatvāriṃśat saṃskārā agre sphuṭībhaviṣyanti, te tu 
bhuvanadīkṣāyāṃ pṛthak śodhyāḥ, āhārādyāśca kalādidīkṣāsu tu 
niṣkṛtihomāntarbhāvayuktyā, iti bhāvivākyasaṅgatyātra piṇḍārthaḥ | 
idaṃ ca dvijajātyāpādanaṃ karmahetukabhāviśarīraviṣayam, pūrvaṃ tu 
samayino vartamānadeha eva śuddhavidyājātiyogyatvarūpamanyadeveti 
nirṇītam | ata eva pūrvaṃ samayino 
rudrāṃśāpādanamīśvaratattvaprāptiyogyatātmakamuktam, idaṃ tu 
śaktigarbhānupraveśavaśabhaviṣyadrudratvāpattiyogyatābhāvanātmakam,
na tu rudratvāpattyātmakam nivṛttipāśānāmadyāpyaśuddhatvāt | uktaṃ
ca śrīmṛgendre ---- 

"rudrāṇī śaktirucyate tadgarbhayogyatāpattirudrāṃśatvaṃ na rudratā ||"
(kri08 | 65)

iti || 123 || 

tadetadīdṛśaṃ rudrāṃśāpādanaṃ jātyāyurbhogaśuddhyā saha 
niṣkṛtihomamadhya eva saṃpādyamityāha ---- 


..............ṝudrāṃśāpādanaṃ tathā || 4-124 || 

atrāvalokanaṃ kṛtvā niṣkṛtyāmeva śuddhyati | 


na kevalaṃ janmāyurbhogānāṃ niṣkṛtau śuddhirādhātavyā, 
yāvadrudrāṃśāpattirūpāpi śuddhirvyākṛtasvarūpā 
tatraivādhātavyetyarthaḥ | atreti niṣkṛtau, avalokanamiti bhāvānām || 
124 || 

niṣkṛtisvarūpaṃ vyācaṣṭe ---- 


viṣayā bhuvanākārā ye kecidbhogyarūpiṇaḥ || 4-125 || 

bhuktakarmaphalāśeṣā niṣkṛtistena sā smṛtā | 


bhuvanaṃ stryādibhāvopalakṣaṇaparam | teṣviti ślokamadhye'dhyāhāryam | 
bhuktaṃ karmaphalamaśeṣaṃ samagraṃ yayā hetunā dīkṣyeṇa sā tathā, 
pūrvanipātavyatyaya eṣaḥ | niḥśeṣeṇa kṛtiḥ 
samastakarmaphalabhogasamāptiryasyāmiti vyutpattyā niṣkṛtiḥ | smṛteti 
dīkṣāyāmeva śodhyatveneti śeṣaḥ || 125 || 

atha ---- 


viśleṣo niṣkṛterbhogāt...............


bhogādviśleṣaḥ punarbhogairasaṃbandho bhokturbhoktṛtvābhāvāt, 
saṃskāro'pi niṣkṛteḥ kāryaḥ || 


...........bhogābhāve sa hi smṛtaḥ || 4-126 || 


nahi bhogasamāptirūpāṃ niṣkṛtiṃ vinā saṃskartuṃ śakyaḥ || 126 || 


bhoktṛtābhāvarūpaṃ viśleṣaṃ bhoktṛtānuvādapūrvaṃ vaktumāha ---- 


bhoktṛtvaṃ viṣayāsaktirmalakāryaṃ prakītītam | 

bhoktṛtvābhāvastatraiva śarīreṇa tu yatkṛtam || 4-127 || 

viśleṣaḥ kriyate tasya paśormantraiḥ śivājñayā | 


śarīreṇa yat kṛtaṃ śarīrairyadajītaṃ kiṃcit tatraiva yā 
viṣayatvenāsaktiḥ "kiṃcinme syāt" ---- ityabhiṣvaṅgastadetanmalakāryam, 
apūrṇammanyatātmakāṇavamalotthāpitaṃ bhoktṛtvam, tasyedṛśasya 
bhoktṛtvasya paśoḥ śivābhinnagurvājñayā mantraivīśleṣaḥ kriyate, sa 
ca yathoktasya bhoktṛtvasyābhāva ucyata iti saṅgatiḥ || 127 || 

atra ca ---- 


dhāmnā cāhutayastisro viśleṣakaraṇāya ca || 4-128 || 


"amukāya nivṛttipāśaviśleṣaṃ karomi svā" ---- ityatra mantraḥ | 
evamuttaratrāpi svayamūhaḥ karmaṇāmaucityena kāryaḥ || 128 || 

atha ---- 


āhutitritayaṃ dhāmnā pāśacchede'pi dāpayet | 


yatpāśacchedanimittamāhutistatpāśānāha ---- 


pāśā dehe tu māyīyāḥ kalādyā bhūtakāvadhi || 4-129 || 

śarīrakaraṇākārāḥ puruṣārthaprasiddhaye | 


dehe dehanimittaṃ kalādyā mahābhūtāntā māyīyāḥ pāśāḥ, te ca 
śarīrendriyāṇi tadupalakṣitāṃśca bhuvanabhāvādīn ākārayanti 
saṃpādayanti puruṣārthasya bhogasya prasiddhyartham | uktaṃ ca ---- 

"kalādikṣitiparyantametat saṃsāramaṇḍalam" | (11-295) iti | 

"tu"śabdaḥ ---- 

"bhoktṛtvaṃ viṣayāsaktirmalakāryaṃm |" (4-127) 

iti | 

tathā tatraiva ---- 

"śarīreṇa tu yatkṛtam | " (4-127)


iti pūrvoktāṇavakārmapāśavailakṣaṇyaṃ dyotayati || 129 || 


evaṃ ca niṣkṛtiviśleṣarūpāt ---- 


bhogābhāvādvipadyante śarīrāṇi sahasradhā || 4-130 || 

śarīrāṇīti sthūlasūkṣmādirūpāṇi | 


sahasradheti nānāvicitrabhedabhūtasargarūpāṇi | vipadyante apunarbhāvena 
naśyantītyarthaḥ || 130 || 

yasya ca dīkṣyasyaitāni vipadyante ---- 


pāśacchede vidhistasya mantraiśca vidhicoditaiḥ | 


pradaśītāṇavādipāśavyāptikapāśasūtragatanivṛttibhāgātmanaḥ 
pāśasya cchede vidyātmakaśāstravākyacoditairmantraivīdhiḥ kāryaḥ | sa
ca vidhiḥ ---- 

"śivaśaktiramogheyaṃ kartarī parikītītā |"

iti śrīhaṃsapārameśoktavyāptyā kartaryāstrajaptayā śivaṃ sāstraṃ
huṃphaḍantaṃ plutayuktyoccārayan pāśān chindyādityevaṃrūpaḥ | 
yathoktaṃ śrīmṛgendre ---- 

"tataḥ śivena sāstreṇa huṃphaḍantena sasvaram | 

chindyāt sa tāvataḥ pāśān kartaryā cāstrajaptayā ||" (kri0 8-113-114) 

iti || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


evaṃ pāśatrayasyāpi viśleṣo dīkṣayocyate || 4-131 || 


evamiti janmādhikārabhogalayaniṣkṛtyākhyayathāpratipāditasaṃskāra-
pañcakapūrvamityarthaḥ | atra coktenaiva huṃphaḍantena mantreṇa 
pūrṇāhutyā samaṃ chinnasya pāśasya homaḥ kāryaḥ, ---- iti 
saṃhitāntarokto'rtho'numantavyaḥ | tathoktaṃ śrīmṛgendra eva ---- 

"tatastāṃ sruvamāpūrya juhuyādājyasaṃyutān | 

tenaiva mantrayogena" (kri0 8-114-115) 

iti || 131 || 

evaṃ viśleṣānte saṃskāraṣaṭke kṛte ---- 


śarīrāśeṣabhaṅgena ekacaitanyabhāvanā | 


guruṇā śiṣyasya kāryetyarthaḥ || 

atra cāvasare ---- 


pūrṇāhutiṃ śivenaiva vauṣaḍjātiyutena ca || 4-132 || 


dadyādityanuṣaṅga || 132 || 

atha pāśābhāvāt ---- 


śuddhatattvāgrasaṃsthaṃ taccaitanyaṃ kanakaprabham | 


tadekīkṛtaṃ caitanyaṃ śuddhasya nivṛttyākhyasya tattvasyāgre upari 
samyaganāvṛtatayā sthitaṃ dīptaṃ bhāvayitvā uddhārāyāhutīstisraḥ 
punardhāmnā tu dāpayet || 133 || 

ṅivṛttivyāptāt pṛthivītattvād devadattamuddharāmi"

iti cātra prayogaḥ || 133 || 

atha ---- 


tasmāt tattvād gṛhītvā tu caitanyaṃ malasaṃyutam | 

mudrayā prāgvidhānena ātmasthaṃ pūrayeddhṛdi || 4-134 || 


nivṛttiśuddhyā nirmalamapi kalāntarāṇāmaśodhitatvāt malasaṃyutam | 
mudrayeti saṃhārākhyeti, prāgvidhānaṃ 
praṇavasaṃpuṭahaṃsabījatvādirūpam || 134 || 

tataḥ ---- 


kumbhitvā recya saṃgṛhya dvādaśāntād dhruveṇa tu | 

śiṣyadehe niveśyaitannāḍīrandhreṇa pūrvavat || 4-135 || 


athāsmai ---- 


tatsthīkaraṇahetvarthaṃ dhāmnā caivāhutitrayam | 


deyamiti śeṣaḥ | "śodhitacaitanyaṃ devadattasya hṛtsthaṃ karomi svāhā" 
ityanto'trāyaṃ prayogaḥ || 

evaṃ pāśacchedaḥ, taddhomaḥ, pūrṇāhomaḥ, caitanyasyaikyabhāvanam, 
taduddhārahomaḥ, pūrakeṇa hṛtsthīkaraṇam, kumbhanam, 
dvādaśāntarecanam, tato grahaṇam, śiṣyadehe niveśanam, tadartho homaḥ --
-- ityekādaśabhiravāntarasaṃskārairupaskṛtaṃ viśleṣaṃ nirvartya 
tadavaśiṣṭanivṛttyarthamāha ---- 


kalāśuddhyavasāne tu brahmāṇaṃ (karaṇā)dhipame1 || 4-136 || 

svanāmapraṇavāhvānapūjaṃ saṃtarpya cārpayet | 


"oṃ brahmannāgaccha" iti svanāmapraṇavapūrvamāhvānaṃ "tubhyaṃ namaḥ" 
iti ca pūjā yasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ | tatsantarpaṇaṃ vahnau śvāhā" iti 
prayogāt, tato'pi cārpaṇaṃ puryaṣṭakārpaṇāya || 136 || 

tadāha ---- 


śabdasparśau tyajet tasmin.............


katham ---- 


................ḍhruvādyau nāmasaṃyutau || 4-137 || 

svāhākāraprayogena tau brahmaṇi nivedayet | 

tisṛbhistisṛbhirhomāt...............


"oṃ brahmaṇe śabdamarpayāmi svāhā" iti trirhutvā (oṃ brahmaṇe)
sparśamarpayāmi svāhā iti trirjuhuyāt, iti vīpsāto'vaseyam || 137 || 


evaṃ cedamasmai ---- 


..................puryaṣṭāṃśaṃ nivedayet || 4-138 || 


puryāḥ sūkṣmadehasyārambhakamaṣṭakaṃ 
tanmātramano'haṅkṛdbuddhirūpam, tadaṃśārpaṇavibhāge'bhiprāyaṃ 
paryante sphuṭayiṣyāmaḥ || 138 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


āmantraṇavibhaktyā tu śrāvaṇāṃ tasya kārayet | 


tasyeti brahmaṇaḥ, śrāvaṇā śivājñā | yathoktaṃ śrīpūrve ---- 


"bhuvaneśa tvayā nāsya sādhakasya śivājñayā | 

pratibandhaḥ prakartavyo yātuḥ padamanāmayam ||" (mā0vi0 9-65)


iti || 

kṛtaśrāvaṇaṃ ca ---- 


brahmāṇaṃ pūjayitvā tu homaṃ kṛtvā visarjayet || 4-139 || 


kiṃ ca ---- 


dhruveṇābhyarcya vāgīśīṃ saṃtarpya ca visarjayet | 

visarjanaṃ nijaparāvāgaikātmyavimarśanam, dhruveṇa niṣkalena || 


taditthamadhvasaṃdhānāt prabhṛti vāgīśyā visarjanāntam ---- 


hutvāvalokayettatra viśuddhaṃ pāśajālakam || 4-140 || 


hutveti ---- adhvasaṃdhānam, adhvopasthānam, vāgīśīgarbhayojanam, 
tadgarbhaniṣpattirjananamadhikāraḥ, bhogaḥ, layaḥ, niṣkṛtiḥ, 
viśleṣaḥ, pāśacchedahomaḥ, pāśahomaḥ pūrṇāhomaḥ, uddhārahomaḥ, 
tatsthīkaraṇam, brahmatarpaṇam, puryaṣṭakāṃśārpaṇahomaḥ, 
punarbrahmahomaḥ, vāgīśīhomaḥ, ityekonaviṃśatihomānuktān kṛtvā, 
tatreti viśuddhāyāṃ nivṛttikalāyām, evamuttaratrāpi 
saṃskārasaṅkalanā homakalanā ca smartavyā || 140 || 

atra ca pāśaśuddhyavalokanāvasare ---- 


prākkarmabhāvikasyātha abhāvaṃ bhāvayettadā | 

mumukṣonīrapekṣatvāt...........


bhāvyeva bhāvikamarthāt karma, prākkarma ca bhāvikaṃ ceti samāhāraḥ | 
nirapekṣatvāt sādhakavat phalaunmukhyābhāvāt | kaiścittu prākkarmaṇā 
bhavatīti prākkarmabhavastatra bhavati yatphalamiti yojanayā 
prākkarmabhavikasyeti vyākhyātam, tadasat, kliṣṭaṃ cetyupekṣyam || 

phaladānonmukhasya vartamānasya kā gatirityāha ---- 


...........prārabdhrekaṃ na śodhayet || 4-141 || 


tasya bhogenaivātivāhanādityarthaḥ || 141 || 

mumukṣoḥ karmaśuddhivṛttāntamuktvā sādhakasya tamāha ---- 


sādhakasya tu bhūtyarthaṃ................


bhūtiprayojanaṃ bhāvimantrārādhanarūpaṃ yattadapi na śodhayedityarthaḥ 
| 

kevalam ---- 


...............prākkarmaikaṃ tu śodhayet | 


bhūtyarthādyat prāgdehārambhi śubhāśubhaṃ tata ekamaśubhamevāsya
śodhayet, evaṃ hi nivīghnaṃ bhogasiddhirbhavati || 141 || 


yattu janmāntarasaṃcitaṃ śubhāśubhaṃ yaccāsmin janmani kariṣyati,
tatsarvamuktanītyā mantrārādhanavarjamasya putrakavacchodhyamevetyāha ---- 


prākkarmāgāmi caikasthaṃ bhāvayitvā ca dīkṣayet || 142 || 


sādhakamiti śeṣaḥ | ekasthamiti ekapraghaṭṭakatayā bhāvitam || 

itthaṃ ca ---- 


śivadhamīṇyasau dīkṣā................


sādhake iti śeṣaḥ || 


.............ḷokadhamīṇyato'nyathā | 


kīdṛgityāha ---- 


prāktanāgāmikasyāpi adharmakṣayakāriṇī || 4-143 || 

lokadhamīṇyasau jñeyā mantrārādhanavajītā | 


"iṣṭāpūrtavidhau rataḥ | karmakṛt phalamākāṅkṣan" (4-85)

iti lokadharmī prāgeva nirṇītaḥ | adharmakṣayakāriṇīti sāpekṣaḥ 
samāsaḥ | mantrārādhanena piṇḍasiddhihetunā mantratvādiprāptihetunā ca 
sarveṇaiva vivajītā viśeṣācodanāt |  śrīmṛgendrāyāṃ ca 
vartamānasiddhihetormantrārādhanasya śivadhamīṇyeva pratipāditatvāt | 
tathā ca tatroktam ---- 

"śivadhamīṇyaṇormūlaṃ śivadharmaphalaśriyaḥ | 

hitetarā vinā bhaṅgaṃ tanorāvilayādbhuvām ||" (kri0 8-6) 

iti | 

asyāyamarthaḥ ---- śivadhamīṇī yā dīkṣā sāṇoḥ 
śivadharmaphalaśriyo
mūlaṃ mantramantreśatvādiprāptyātmakapārameśaphalasaṃpado heturekā, 
itarā tu śivadhamīṇyeva bhuvāṃ bhogabhūmīnāmāvilayāt pralayakālaṃ 
yāvat tanoḥ śarīrasya bhaṅgaṃ vinā hitā 
yathābhīṣṭakhaḍgapātālalocanāñjanapādukādisiddhisaṃpādiketi | na 
cetareti lokadhamīṇī vyākartavyā ---- 

"bhogabhūmiṣu sarvāsu duṣkṛtāṃśe hate sati | 

dehāntarāṇimādyarthaṃ śiṣṭeṣṭā lokadhamīṇī ||" (kri0 8-7)

iti tatraiva pṛthaktvasyānirṇītatvāt | na ca mantrārādhanaṃ vinā
sādhakatvaṃ na bhavatīti bhramitavyam, iṣṭāpūrtaphalasādhanenāpi
tasya lābhādityalam || 144 || 

evaṃ lokadhamīdīkṣāvasāt ---- 


prārabdhadehabhede tu bhuṅkte sa hyaṇimādikān || 4-144 || 


bhogān ---- 

dīkṣāvaśādasya śubhakarmāṇimādiparyavasāyītyarthaḥ || 

atha ---- 


bhuktvā vrajedūrdhvaṃ guruṇā yatra yojitaḥ | 

sakale niṣkale vāpi.............


"yo yatrābhilaṣed bhogān |"

ityuktanītyā sakale tatra tatra bhuvaneśvare sāyujyādyarthaṃ 
śubhakarmabhogānte mumukṣurvā niṣkale śive yojitastadeva padaṃ gacchet | 
yathoktaṃ śrīmṛgendrāyām ---- 

"lokadhamīṇamāropya mate bhuvanabhartari | 

taddharmāpādanaṃ kuryācchive vā muktikāṅkṣiṇam ||" (kri0 8-148)

iti || 

etaccordhvavrajanaṃ yojanaṃ ca yathākramam ---- 


.........śiṣyācāryavaśād bhavet || 4-145 || 


śiṣyasya guroścābhisaṃdhivaśājjāyata ityarthaḥ | uktaṃ ca tatprāgeva 
---- 

"phalamākāṅkṣase yādṛk tādṛgyajanamārabhe |" (4-81) 

ityādi || 

evaṃ dvidhā bhogadīkṣāṃ nirṇīya mokṣadīkṣāṃ sabījāṃ nirbījāṃ
sadyonirvāṇadāṃ ca krameṇa nirṇetumāha ---- 

nirvāṇe'pi sabījāyāṃ karmābhāvādvipadyate | 

nirvāṇanimittaṃ yā sabījā pūrvaṃ nirṇītā dīkṣā tasyāḥ | 

viśeṣasamayācārā mantrākhye ye prakītītāḥ | 

te'tra pālyāṃḥ prayatnena ....... ||" (4-90)

iti pūrvoktaṃ yatkarma, tasyābhāvādananuṣṭhānādvipadyate kaṃcitkālaṃ
śivamayyāḥ svasattāto bhraṃśitvā kravyādatvametityarthaḥ || 146 || 

yata evamataḥ ---- 


samayācārapāśaṃ hi dīkṣitaḥ pālayettu yaḥ || 4-146 || 

taṃ pāśaṃ naiva śudhyeta.............


dīkṣitaḥ samayācārapāśaṃ pālayet yasmāttasmāttasya 
nirbījadīkṣitasyeva na śodhayet || 

dīkṣā caiṣā ---- 


.............ṣā sabījā prakītītā | 

samayācārapāśaṃ tu nirbījāyāṃ viśodhayet || 4-147 || 


tacchuddhividhiragre tu bhaviṣyati || 147 || 

asya ca nirbījadīkṣādīkṣitasya ---- 


dīkṣāmātreṇa muktiḥ syādbhaktimātrād guroḥ sadā | 

gurubhaktimātramevāsya samaya ityarthaḥ || 4-148 || 


asyā bhedāntaramāha ---- 


sadyonirvāṇadā dīkṣā nirbījā sā dvitīyikā || 4-148 || 

atītānāgatārabdhapāśatrayaviyojikā | 

dīkṣāvasāne śuddhiḥ syād dehatyāge paraṃ padam || 4-149 || 


sadya iti dīptatamamantradīkṣāviyojitadehakalāvasthitisamanantarameva | ata 
evārabdhakāryasyāpi pāśatrayasya viyojikā, dehatyāge dehatyāgasamaye 
dīkṣāyā yadavasānaṃ niṣpattistatretyarthaḥ | evaṃ 
cāriṣṭalakṣaṇādibhinīścitāsannamaraṇasyaiveyaṃ kāryeti tātparyam | 
yaduktaṃ śrīmadguhvare ---- 


"dṛṣṭvā śiṣyaṃ jarāgrastaṃ vyādhinā paripīḍitam | 

utkramayya tatastvenaṃ paratattve niyojayet ||" 


iti || 149 || 


prāsaṅgikaṃ dīkṣāvivekamupasaṃharati ---- 


evaṃ bhāvānusāreṇa śiṣyāṇāṃ guruṇā sadā | 

phalaṃ tu vividhākāraṃ niṣpādyeta sudīkṣayā || 4-150 || 


yasmāt ---- 


acintyā mantraśaktirvai parameśamukhodbhavā | 


parameśasya mukhaṃ parāśaktistadudbhavatvādevācintyā | śaktiśabdena
vīryasāratāṃ mantrāṇāmāha || 151 || 

sā ca ---- 


kriyākāle prayoktavyā guruṇā bhaktipūvīkā || 4-151 || 


kriyā dīkṣādikā, bhaktirmantrasvarūpāmarśanakrameṇa 
tadvīryānupraveśamayī saiva || 

acintyetyādinedamāha ---- 


viṣāṇāmiva pāśānāṃ mantraiḥ kavalanaṃ dhruvam | 

karoti mantratattvajñaḥ śivāveśī guruḥ kṣaṇāt || 4-152 || 


"pāśāśca pauruṣāḥ śodhyā dīkṣāyāṃ na tu dhīgatāḥ | 

tena tasyāṃ doṣavatyāmapi dīkṣā na niṣphalā || 

sutīvraśaktipātāśca doṣabījavinākṛtāḥ | 

api bhānti tulādīkṣāghaṭaśuddhivadīkṣyate || 

pāpasya gurutā no ceddhaṭaśuddhau bravīṣi kim | 

tanmantraśaktyā dīkṣāṇāṃ citratvaṃ nāsamañjasam || 

lipyakṣare kṛte yadvatāḍanādi nṛṇāṃ bhavet | 

mantraśaktyā tathā sūtre pāśānāṃ chedanaṃ sphuṭam ||"


ityāstāṃ tāvadetadagre vitatya nirṇeṣyāmaḥ || 152 || 


atha prāsaṅgikaṃ prameyaṃ nirṇīya prakṛtamanubadhnannāha ---- 


kalāsaṃdhānakaṃ kuryācchuddhāśuddhadvirūpagam | 


śuddhanivṛttikalāsaṃdhānakaṃ 
kuryācchuddhamaśuddhapratiṣṭhākalāyogāccāśuddhamata eva dvirūpagam || 
152 || 

atra ca ---- 


śuddhamuccārayeddhrasvamaśuddhaṃ dīrghameva ca || 4-153 || 

ekatvaṃ bhāvayitvā tu līnaṃ śuddhaṃ vibhāvayet | 


iha bhagavān niṣkalabhaṭṭārako 
niḥśeṣapāśaśodhako'ṅgabrahmamantraikādaśikā tu śodhyā, tathāpi ca 
śuddhāśuddhakalāvācitvānniṣkalanāthaḥ śuddhatayāśuddhatayāpi ca 
vyavahriyate, taṃ ca śuddhanivṛttivācitvācchuddham, hrasvamiti 
praśāntāśeṣaprasaraṃ parabinduvyāptisatattvamuccārayet, 
aśuddhapratiṣṭhāvācakatvāccāśuddham dīrghamiti prasaronmukhaṃ 
nādavyāptisatattvam, ekatvaṃ sāmarasyaṃ bhāvayitvoccārayet | atra ca 
śuddhaṃ līnamiti pratiṣṭhāṃ bodhayituṃ tadvācimūlamantreṇa 
sahaikībhūtaṃ vibhāvayet || 154 || 

atha pratiṣṭhākalāśuddhiḥ

na cātra hrasvadīrghamātramuccāryamapi tu ---- 


praṇavādinivṛttistu pratiṣṭhā tadanantaram || 4-154 || 

namaskārastadante tu kalāsandhānakaṃ smṛtam | 


praṇavaṃ hrasvaṃ niṣkalaṃ nivṛttivācinaṃ hṛnmantraṃ coccārya tadante 
nivṛttaye iti padaṃ tato'pi praṇavaṃ dīrghaṃ niṣkalaṃ 
pratiṣṭhāvācinaṃ ca śiromantramuccārya "pratiṣṭhāyai nama" ityatra 
prayogaḥ | home tu svāhāntaḥ || 155 || 

itthaṃ ca ---- 


āvāhya sthāpya sampūjyāhutīstisraḥ prapātayet || 4-155 || 

kalāsaṃdhānameddhi................


kalānāṃ pṛthvyādidhāraṇādhyānaṃ kāryamiti kecidvadanti | 

atha ---- 


.........vyāptiṃ tasyā (vi)lokayet | 


tasyāḥ pratiṣṭhāyāḥ || 

tatra ---- 


gulphādārabhya nābhyantaṃ śiṣyadehe'dhvakalpanam || 4-156 || 

pratiṣṭhāyā bhaved vyāptiścatuvīṃśatitattvikā | 

ṣaṭpañcāśadbhuvanikā trayoviṃśativaṇīkā || 4-157 || 

jñeyaikaviṃśatipadā trimantrā ca vidhīyate | 


abādīni guṇatattvena saha pradhānāntāni catuvīṃśatistattvāni yasyām, 
tathā guhyātiguhyapavitrasthāṇusthūladevayoniyogākhyāni 
saptāṣṭakarūpāṇi bhuvanādhvani vakṣyamāṇāni 
ṣaṭpañcāśadbhuvaneśvarādhiṣṭhitāni, 
tāvantyevāntarbhūtabhuvanāntarāṇi pradhānāni bhuvanāni yasyām, 
hakārāt ṭakārāntāni trayoviṃśativarṇāni yasyām | ekaviṃśatīti 
pūrvaṃ kalātattvāspadavāruṇadiggatapadanavakādīśakoṇastha ūkāro 
yāvadupayuktaḥ, iti prātilomyena tadantarasthādyakārādārabhya 
lakārāntamaṣṭakam, tathā māyātattvāśrayanairṛtadiksthakoṣṭhanavaka-
gatamūkārādimakārāntaṃ navakam, vidyātattvādhiṣṭhitadakṣadiggata-
koṣṭhanavakamadhyādūkārādilakārāntaṃ catuṣṭayaṃ 
cetyekaviṃśatipadāni yasyām | traya vāmadevaḥ, śiraḥ, śikhā ca mantrā 
yasyām, na tu hṛdayaṃ, hṛnmantrasya nivṛttyantarbhāvāt || 157 || 

itthaṃ ca ṣaḍadhvātmānaḥ ---- 


mukhyā hyete smṛtāḥ pāśāḥ..............


mukhyatvameṣāṃ sarvāṇusādhāraṇyāt, padavarṇamantrā api ---- 

"śabdarāśisamutthasya" (spa0 4-15)

iti yuktyā vācakarūpatāmaśnuvānāḥ pāśā eva ata eva 
nirupādhicidānandaghanasvarūpāmarśaparamārthamūlamantrātiriktaṃ 
sarvamatra śodhyameva | yaduktamasmadgurubhiḥ śrītantrāloke ---- 

"yatkiṃcitparamādvaitasaṃvitsvātantryasundarāt | 

parācchivāduktarūpādanyattatpāśa ucyate ||" (8-292) 

iti || 

atraiva ca ---- 


.............ṣūkṣmānantavībhāvayet || 4-158 || 


tān sphuṭayati ---- 


anyatantraprasiddhaṃ tu tanmātrendriyaśodhanam | 


atrāntarbhāvyamityarthaḥ | anyattantraṃ lākulādi | yadyapi ca 
"trayoviṃśatitāttvika" ityuktvā tanmātrādīnyantarbhāvitāni, tathāpi 
tāni bāhyabhauvanasaṃniveśavyāpakānyanyānyeva, etāni tu 
sthūlasūkṣmaśarīrasaṃniviṣṭānyaparāṇyeva, iti na bhramitavyam || 159 
|| 

kiṃ ca ---- 


ṣaṭkośān viṣayān pañca tadantarbhāvayet sadā || 4-159 || 


asṛṅmāṃsalomamajjāsthisnāyvākhyāḥ ṣaṭkośāḥ sūkṣmadehopari 
kośākāratayā sthitāḥ | sadeti dīkṣākāle | evaṃ ca vartamāne'pi 
dehaśodhanaṃ coditameveti tatra kartavyaṃ yairuktaṃ te bhrāntā eva || 

ata evoktādhvavyāptivimarśarūpam ---- 


viśeṣasthāpanaṃ kṛtvā pūjyā gandhādibhistataḥ | 


tathā ---- 


bhairaveṇāhutīstisraḥ...............


dadyāditi śeṣaḥ | bhairaveṇeti kākākṣivat, tena 
praṇavaniṣkalapratiṣṭhābījānyuccārya "pratiṣṭhāyai namaḥ" iti 
mantreṇa pūjā, svāhāntena homaḥ | evamuttaratrāpi || 

atha ---- 


...........ṭasyā vāgīśikalpanā || 4-160 || 


sā hi vipruṣi sarvamantaḥkartuṃ kṣamā | atra cādau śaktiṃ nyasedityādi
pūrvoktaṃ smartavyam || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


svanāmāvāhanādyasya arghahomādi pūrvavat | 

prokṣaṇaṃ tāḍanaṃ cheda ākarṣagrahaṇe tathā || 4-161 || 

dhāmnāpūrya kumbhayitvā chittvātha grāhayet punaḥ | 

yojanaṃ garbhadhāritvaṃ jananaṃ pūrvavat kramāt || 4-162 || 


pūrvavadityatideśena nivṛttyuktaṃ sarvaṃ vidhikramamanusmarediti
śikṣayati || 162 || 

atha prasaṅgāt sarvadīkṣāsu vaktavyaśeṣaṃ pūrayati ---- 


eśvarīṃ mūtīmāsthāya tāḍanādīni kārayet | 


tāḍanaprokṣaṇādīni kriyāśaktyāveśe kāryāṇi, iti 
kriyāśaktipradhāneśvarāhaṃbhāvenaiva yuktāni || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


adhikārastathā bhogo layo niṣkṛtireva ca || 4-163 || 

śivarūpeṇa kartavyāḥ.............


adhikārādijñānaṃ prabhutvasaṃpādyam | prabhuśca sadāśivādau viśvatra 
śiva eveti śivāhaṃbhāvenaiva taducitam, nivṛttau niṣkṛtiviśleṣahomau 
mūlenaivoktau || 

iha tayovīśeṣamāha ---- 


.........ṇiṣkṛtiḥ śirasā punaḥ | 

viśleṣaśca hṛdā homyaḥ..............

punaḥśabdo viśeṣāya sarvatraiva | 

............pāśacchedastathāsinā || 4-164 || 


tathāśabdānmūlenāpi | yathoktaṃ prāk ---- 

"āhutitritayaṃ dhāmnā pāśacchede'pi" (4-129)

iti puryaṣṭakacchedanatāḍanādīnyapi asinaivetyapi "tathā" śabdārthaḥ | 
ākarṣaṇagrahaṇādyāstu dhāmnaivetyuktam || 164 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


pūrṇāhutisamuddhāraṃ pūrvavadbhairaveṇa tu | 


niṣkalenetyarthaḥ || 

jñānaśaktipradhānaḥ śrīsadāśiva iti ---- 


sadāśivatanau sthitvā viśleṣādīni kārayet || 4-165 || 


viśleṣādīnāṃ bhedopaśāntiparatvāttatpradhānā sadāśivasya 
vyāptirgrāhyā | "ādi" śabdādekacaitanyabhāvitoddhārādayaḥ || 165 || 

evaṃ prasaṅgādvadhiṃ pūrayitvā prakṛtamāha ---- 


ātmasthaṃ pūrakeṇaiva hṛtsthaṃ recakavṛttitaḥ | 


sarvametat pūrvameva nirṇītam | 

atha pratiṣṭhādhipatim ---- 


svanāmnoccārayedviṣṇuṃ dhyātvāvāhya tu sthāpayet || 4-166 || 


pūjayet puṣpagandhādyaiḥ.............


asmai ca ---- 


.................ṭarpaṇāyāhutitrayam | 


dadyāt || 


kiṃ ca ---- 


rasaṃ puryaṣṭakāṃśaṃ tu arpayedviṣṇave sadā || 4-167 || 


dīkṣāsviti śeṣaḥ || 167 || 

pūrvavat kṛtaśrāvaṇam ---- 


visarjayettato viṣṇuṃ vāgīśīṃ ca visarjayet | 


atha ---- 


kalāsaṃdhiryathāpūrvaṃ hrasvadīrghaprayogataḥ || 4-168 || 

abhāvaṃ bhāvayettasmin pāśajāle tvanantake | 


atha ---- 


kalādvayavinirmuktaḥ paśururdhvagamotsukaḥ || 4-169 || 

tasyedānīṃ tṛtīyasyāṃ vidyāyāṃ yojya śodhayet | 


caitanyamityarthāt || 169 || 

tāṃ ca vidyām ---- 


sthāpayitvātha sampūjya juhuyādāhutitrayam || 4-170 || 

evaṃ tu saṃmukhīkṛtya prāgivādhvāvalokanam | 


kāryamityarthaḥ || 170 || 

tadevāha ---- 


puṃstattvādyāvanmāyāntaṃ vidyāyā vyāptiriṣyate || 4-171 || 


evaṃ ca ---- 


sapta tattvāni................


puruṣaniyatikālarāgavidyākalāmāyākhyāni, 
puruṣasyaitattattvaṣaṭkametatatkañcukarūpamantaraṅgavedanahetutayā 
sthitatvādvidyākhyayā kalayā vyāptam, pratitiṣṭhate 
bhogahetutattvajālaṃ yatreti nirukttyā pratiṣṭhā, nivartate 
tattvasṛṣṭiryata iti nivṛttiḥ, aśeṣabhedopaśamācchāntā, 
tāmapyatītā tatsaṃskāreṇāpi śūnyā śāntyatītetyanusaṃdheyam || 

tathā ---- 


...........bhuvanasaptaviṃśatireva ca | 


yadyapi pumānniyatirityādistattvakramastathāpi puṃso lolikāmayasya 
sāmānyābhiṣvaṅgātmanā rāgeṇāvyabhicāraḥ, kiṃcidvedanātmano 
vidyāyā niyamanātmanā niyatyā, kartṛtvodbalanātmanaśca kalāyāḥ 
kāleneti tattvapadadīkṣayoḥ saṃpuṭayogasya 
vakṣyamāṇatvāttadanusāreṇaiva bhuvaneśasthitistatra 
puruṣarāgatattvayovīdyeśāṣṭakaṃ pradhānamiti tadadhiṣṭhitānyaṣṭau 
bhuvanāni, niyatividyayostu 
vāmādimanonmanāntabhuvaneśanavakādhiṣṭhitāni nava, 
kālakalayormahādevāditrayādhiṣṭhitaṃ trayam | evam viṃśatiḥ | 
etattattvakāraṇabhūtāyāṃ māyāyāmadhobhāge gopatirūrdhve viśve madhye 
trikālakṣemeśabrahmādhipatiśivāścatvāraḥ, etadadhiṣṭhātā 
cānantaḥ, iti sapteti bhuvanasaptaviśatiḥ || 


tathā ---- 


padaviṃśatirākhyātā.................


dakṣadiggatapadanavakāllakārāntaṃ catuṣṭayaṃ 
pūrvatrāntarbhūtamityavaśiṣṭaṃ prāgvanmādikṣāntaṃ pañcakam, 
tatheśatattvādhiṣṭhitāgneyakoṣṭhanavakādūkārādirephāntaṃ navakam, 
sadāśivatattvādhiṣṭhitapūrvadiggatānnavakādūkārādikṣakārāntaṃ 
ṣaṭkamiti padaviṃśatiḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


...............varṇāḥ sapta prakītītāḥ || 4-172 || 


ñādyāḥ ghāntā || 172 || 


tathā ---- 


mantrau dvau............


aghoraḥ kavacam || 

itthamatra ---- 


..........ṣaḍvadhādhvānaṃ jñātvā vāgīśikalpanam | 


atra pūrvoktaṃ smārayati ---- 


praṇavena samāvāhya vyāpinīṃ sarvayoniṣu || 4-173 || 

samakālamṛtutvena dhyātvā sampūjya tarpayet | 


kiṃ ca ---- 


tataḥ śivāmbhasā śiṣyaṃ prokṣya cāstreṇa tāḍayet || 4-174 || 

tenaiva cāstrabhūtena huṃphaṭkārayutena tu | 

ātmano recakenaiva.............


gatveti śeṣaḥ | 


...................śiṣyadehe viśeddhṛdi || 4-175 || 


athāsya puryaṣṭakarūpam ---- 


astramantreṇa saṃchidya (viśleṣyā)streṇa1 karṣayet | 

dvādaśāntāttu saṃgṛhya ātmasthaṃ pūrvavat kuru || 4-176 || 

pūrakeṇātha saṅkumbhya recayitvā tu yojayet | 

pūrvavad vyāpakaṃ nyasya caitanyaṃ sarvayoniṣu || 4-177 || 

yogādyaṃ layaparyantaṃ dhāmnā caivātra pūrvavat | 


kuryādityarthaḥ || 177 || 

viśeṣastvatrāyam ---- 


śikhayā śatahomāttu vidyāyā niṣkṛtirbhavet || 4-178 || 


athāsya viśleṣapāśacchedābhyāmanantaraṃ pareṇātmasthatatsthatve
kuryāt || 178 || 

atha puryaṣṭakāṃśārpaṇāya ---- 


praṇavādi tato rudramāvāhya sthāpya pūjayet | 

tato'sya vinyased devi gandharūpe dhruvāhutī || 4-179 || 


evam ---- 


puryaṣṭakāṃśaṃ vinyasya visarjya rudradevatām | 

vāgīśīṃ ca visarjyaivaṃ kalāsaṃdhiśca pūrvavat || 4-180 || 


kāryaḥ || 

katham ---- 


hrasvadīrghavibhāgena vidyāṃ śāntau niyojayet | 

saṃdhānārthaṃ tu mūlena juhuyādāhutitrayam || 4-181 || 


saṃdheranantaramadhvopasthāpanāya ---- 


svanāmnāvāhanaṃ śāntevīdhipūrvaṃ nivedanam | 

prameyabhāvanāṃ kṛtvā................


tāṃ ca ---- 


.............pūjayet kusumādibhiḥ || 4-182 || 

trirāhutiṃ tu mūlena.................


dadyāt || 182 || 

asyā adhvāntaravyāptimāha ---- 


..........vidyātattvāt sadāśivam | 

tattvānāṃ tritaye vyāptirvarṇānāṃ traya eva ca || 4-183 || 


ka-kha-ga ityatra ca || 183 || 


padaikādaśikā jñeyā............


pūrvadiggatānnavakāt kṣāntasya ṣaṭkasya 
vidyāyāmantarbhāvādrephapraṇavahakārātmakaṃ trayaṃ madhyamācca 
navakādūkārādihāntamaṣṭakamiti padaikādaśikā || 


...........purāṇi daśa sapta ca | 


tatra vidyāyāṃ triguṇyādīnāṃ vidyarājñīnāmekamīśvaratattve 
tvaiśvaraṃ bhuvanamanantādiśikhaṇḍyantavidyeśvarabhuvanānyaṣṭau, 
dharmādīnāṃ bhuvanāni catvāri, vāmādiśaktitrayabhuvanamekam, 
jñānakriyābhuvanamekam tasminneva ca bhuvane vidyādvayādeḥ 
prabhavadvādaśakaparyantarsyaikonaṣaṣṭerbhuvanānāmavāntaro vibhāgaḥ | 
vakṣyati ca ---- 

"ekonaṣaṣṭirbhuvanaṃ jñānaśakttyāditaḥ kramāt | " (10-1185)

ityevamīśvaratattve pañcadaśa bhuvanāni | yadvakṣyati ---- 

"daśa pañca ca śodhyāni bhuvanānyaiśvare pade |" (10-1171)

iti | sadāśivatattve sādāśivamekaṃ bhuvanaṃ svamiva 
brahmāṅgasakalādyaṣṭakaśivarudrabhedāvaraṇagatānantabhuvanavyāpakamiti
saptadaśa bhuvanāni || 

tathātra ---- 


mantrau dvau...........


tatpuruṣāstrarūpau || 

tadatra ---- 


.....ṣaḍvidho'dhvaivaṃ mukhyāḥ pāśā ime smṛtāḥ || 4-184 || 


pūrvavacca ---- 


sūkṣmapāśānanekāṃśca tadantarbhāvayet sadā | 


atha ---- 


vāgīśīṃ kalpayettatra pūrveṇa vidhināhutiḥ || 4-185 || 

pūjanaṃ mūlamantreṇa tataḥ prokṣaṇatāḍanam | 

chedākarṣagrahaṃ caiva yogadhāritvajanma ca || 4-186 || 

adhikārastathā bhogo layo vai pūrvavadbhavet | 

sarve te mūlamantreṇa āhutitritayena tu || 4-187 || 


yogo garbheṣu caitanyasya, dhāritvaṃ yugapadgarbhavardhanam | yaduktam ---- 

śarvayoniṣu garbhāste yugapadvṛddhimāgatāḥ | " (4-118) 

iti | 


sarve iti garbhādhānādyāḥ saṃskārāḥ || 4-187 || 


kiṃ ca ---- 


niṣkṛtau śatahomaṃ tu kavacena tu kārayet | 


tuśabdaḥ pūrvasmādviśeṣāya || 


viśleṣaṃ pāśacchedaṃ tu kuryādastreṇa daiśikaḥ || 4-188 || 

uddhārakaraṇātmasthatatsthīkārān bhavena tu | 


atha ---- 


svanāmnā praṇavādyena īśamāvāhya pūjayet || 4-189 || 

sampūjya hutvā santarpya buddhyahaṅkṛtidvyaṃśakam | 


atra prayogaḥ ---- 


svanāmnā praṇavādyaṃ tu svāhānte buddhimarpayet || 4-190 || 

ahaṅkāraṃ tathāpyevaṃ hutvedaṃ kṣamayettataḥ | 

vāgīśīṃ pūjayitvā tu tarpayitvā visarjayet || 4-191 || 


yadatrānuktaṃ tatpūrvato yojyam || 191 || 

atha--


kalāsaṃdhānakaṃ pūrvaṃ śāntyatīte tu yojayet | 

hrasvadīrghavibhāgena .............


prāgvacchāntāśāntyatīte anusaṃdadhītetyarthaḥ || 

tadarthaṃ ca ---- 


................ juhuyādāhutitrayam || 4-192 || 


atha ---- 


dhruveṇa tattvasaṃdhānaṃ kartavyaṃ vidhivedinā | 


pūrvavat praṇavadhāmaśāntyatītābījoccārapūrvaṃ "śāntyatītāyai
namaḥ" iti prayogaḥ smartavyaḥ | tattvamatra prakṛtā śāntyatītā,
vidhivedinā vyāptijñena || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


kalopasthāpanaṃ paścād dhruveṇa juhuyāt priye || 4-193 || 

trirāhutiprayogeṇa svanāmapadamuccaran | 

śāntyatītāṃ samāvāhya sthāpayet pūjayet punaḥ || 4-194 || 

vyāptimālokya cādhvasthāṃ..............


tāmeva spaṣṭayati ---- 


..................śivatattvagatāśca ye | 

padārthāste'nusaṃdheyā atretyarthaḥ | 


tānāha ---- 


bindurnādastathā śaktiḥ śivatattve vyavasthitāḥ || 4-195 || 


śivatattvaṃ samanāvyāptyantamiheti tacchodhyameva | bindunādaśaktayo'tra
garbhīkṛtavakṣyamāṇaṣoḍaśabhuvanā mukhyānyāvaraṇāni || 195 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


padamekaṃ mantra eko varṇāḥ ṣoḍaśa kītītāḥ | 

bhuvanāni tu sūkṣmāṇi śāntyatīte tu bhāvayet || 4-196 || 


padaṃ madhyakoṣṭhanavakamadhyagata oṃkāraḥ, mantra īśānabhaṭṭārako 
dhāmatrayamayanetramantrābhinnamūtīḥ, varṇā visargādyā akārāntāḥ 
ṣoḍaśa, bhuvanāni bhūmikātmakaprameyamātrarūpatvāt sūkṣmāṇi na tu 
saṃniveśavanti, tāni ca ṣoḍaśa | tadyathā ---- bindvāvaraṇe 
nivṛttyādikalācatuṣkaparivṛtaṃ śāntyatītābhuvanamekam, 
tato'rdhacandranirodhikābhuvane dve nijanijakalāpañcakapariṣkṛte, 
nādāvaraṇe punarindhikādiśaktīnāṃ svaśaktimadadhiṣṭhitānāṃ pañca 
bhuvanāni, nādānte suṣumṇeśaparabrahmādhiṣṭhitamekaṃ bhuvanam, 
śakttyāvaraṇe tu sūkṣmādiśakticatuṣkapariṣkṛtaṃ 
parāśaktibhuvanamekam, tato'pi vyāpinībhūmau 
vyāpyavyomarūpānāthānantānāśritānāṃ pañca bhuvanāni, tato'pi 
samanāyāṃ mahāmāyārūpāyāṃ tacchaktimārūḍhaḥ 
pañcavidhakṛtyakārī śiva iti | nanviha mantrāṇāṃ śodhakānāmapi 
kathaṃ śodhyatvamuktam, tathātve vā kasya tacchodhakatvaṃ mūlamantrasyāpi 
ca mantratvācchodhyatvaprasaṅgaḥ nivṛttyādivacca 
śāntyatītāyāmapyaṅgamantraḥ kiṃ noktaḥ | 
nivṛttiśāntyatītayormūlena niṣkṛtihomaḥ pratiṣṭhāvidyāśāntānāṃ 
śiraḥśikhākavacainīvṛttau viśleṣo mūlenānyatra 
hṛdayenāparatrāstreṇeti ko'yaṃ kramaḥ | atrocyate ---- iha mantrāḥ 
śivāveśaśālino vīryavido guronījaśaktisāratayā sphurantaḥ 
śodhakāḥ, paśūnāṃ tu gūhitasvavīryāḥ svasvarūpāvaraṇatayā 
tiṣṭhantaḥ śodhyā eva, te cāṅgavaktrabhedādekādaśa, mūlamantrastu ---
- 

śvayamuccarate devaḥ" (7-59)

iti vakṣyamāṇasthityā nādāmarśaparamārthatayā sarvasya sphuratīti 
nāsya śodhyatvam kevalamakārādisamanāntaprameyaikādaśakamatra 
sūkṣmarūpatayā garbhīkṛtamantraikādaśikāsphāramityārurukṣvāśayena 
viśleṣaṇakramayuktyāṃśāṃśikābhiprāyāt |  

"akṣareṣu kuto mokṣa ākāśe kusumaṃ kutaḥ |" (7-238)

iti mūlamantraviṣayamuktam | tattadvācyabhāgābhiprāyeṇa ca ---- 

śamanāntaṃ varārohe pāśajālamanantakam |" (4-432)

ityuktam vastutastvaśeṣaviśvābhedamayo nityoditānuccāryamahāvimarśarūpa 
evāyaṃ niṣkalanāthastadabhinnamūttīḥ sakalo'pi veti nāsya kadācidapi 
śodhyatvaṃ śaṅkitavyam | śāntyatītāyāṃ ca nāmānurūpatvādeva na 
pṛthagaṅgamantraḥ saṃbhavati | dhāmatrayātmanetramantrastu 
īśānamantrabhinnamūtīravaśyamanupraviṣṭo'nyathā mantraikādaśikā na 
śodhitā syāt,

"mantrā ekādaśa jñeyāḥ |" (4-200)

iti ca bhāvivākyamasaṅgataṃ syādata 
evāstramantrastāḍanādāvevopayuṅkte | netramantrastu mūlamantrādabhinna 
iti na tau kalāntaḥśodhyau, ityekīyamatamasat | yastu niṣkṛtyādihomeṣu 
mantraniyama uktastatreśvarājñaiva niyantriketi sarvamanavadyam || 196 || 

ta ete sarva eva pāśāḥ ---- 


śodhanīyā varārohe...............


vara utkṛṣṭa ūrdhvadvādaśāntaviśrāntirūpa āroha ullāso yasyāḥ 
śakteḥ || 

tāvaccaite śodhyāḥ ---- 


...............yāvatte śivaraśmayaḥ | 


niravaśeṣabhedopaśāntyā śivasya raśmirūpā abhinnaprabhāmātrātmānaḥ
saṃpadyante ityarthaḥ || 

ata eva ---- 


śivasyordhve śivo jñeyo yatra yukto na jāyate || 4-197 || 


uttīrṇaśivatattvopari 
viśvottīrṇaviśvamayacidānandaghanasvacchandabhaṭṭārako yatra 
vakṣyamāṇayojanikākrameṇa yukto na jāyate, mucyate ityarthaḥ || 197 || 

ata evāsya yāvān kalāpañcakāntaḥ prapañcitaḥ, sa sarva eva ---- 


ṣaḍadhvā caikato jñeyaḥ................


ekasmin paramaśivātmanyabhedenāvasthitastatsāmarasyamāpanno jñātavyo 
guruṇā sākalyena saṅkalpitaḥ || 

kiyānasāvadhvā yo dīkṣyasya śivaikātmyaṃ prāpta iti darśayitumāha ---
- 


........ṭasya saṃkhyāṃ punaḥ śṛṇu | 

kalāśca pañca vijñeyāstattvaṣaṭtriṃśadeva tu || 4-198 || 

sacatuvīṃśati jñeyaṃ bhuvanānāṃ śatadvayam | 

ekāśītipadānyatra varṇārdhaśatikā smṛtā || 4-199 || 

mantrā ekādaśa jñeyā ityetaccādhvamaṇḍalam | 

etasmin śuddhimāpanne muktimāpnoti dīkṣitaḥ || 4-200 || 


śuddhirasya paramaśivābhivyaktirityuktam || 200 || 

evaṃ prasaṅgikamadhvaśuddhigranthamabhidhāya prakṛtamāha ---- 


dhruveṇāvāhya vāgīśīṃ vinyaset........


tadartham ---- 


.......pūrvavaddhutiḥ | 

sampūjya kusumādyaistu tadyonau pūrvavat paśum || 4-201 || 


yojayediti śeṣaḥ || 201 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


dhruveṇa sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ jananādilayāntakam | 

niṣkṛtau śatahomaṃ tu mūlamantreṇa kalpayet || 4-202 || 

viśleṣapāśacchedābhyāṃ prāgvat kuryād dhruveṇa tu | 


chedābhyāmiti tādarthye | tena viśleṣādyarthaṃ prāgvat kuryāt, 
hutyādikarmetyarthaḥ || 202 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


graheṇātmasthatasthatvaṃ praṇavena paśoḥ smṛtam || 4-203 || 


praṇavo niṣkalanāthaḥ || 203 || 


sadāśivamathāvāhya mūlamantraṃ samuccaran | 

namaskāreṇa saṃsthāpya puṣpaiḥ sampūjya tarpayet || 4-204 || 

manaḥ puryaṣṭakāṃśaṃ tu vinyaset kāraṇeśvare | 


kathamityāha ---- 


praṇavādi samuccārya manaḥ saṃjñāṃ namastathā || 4-205 || 

vinyasya pūjayet paścāt saṃjñāsvāhāntameva ca | 


praṇavadhāmabhyāmanantaraṃ "mano devadattasyārpayāmi namaḥ" iti 
mantraprayogaḥ, home tu svāhetyantaḥ | saṃjñāsvāhāntamiti 
kriyāviśeṣaṇam || 205 || 

atra ca ---- 


āhutitritayaṃ hutvā puryaṣṭāṃśādviśuddhyati || 4-206 || 

tato visarjayed devaṃ kāraṇaṃ ca sadāśivam | 

puṣpādibhiḥ samabhyarcya vāgīśīṃ tadanantaram || 4-207 || 

tāṃ tu sampūjya saṃtarpya vijñāpyā bhaktibhāvitā | 

kṣamasva devadeveśi paśvarthaṃ kheditā mayā || 4-208 || 

idānīṃ noparoddhavyaṃ gaccha devi svaviṣṭapam | 


sarvadīkṣānta iyaṃ vijñaptiḥ kāryeti viśeṣadyotanāya tuśabdaḥ | 
khedanaṃ bhūyobhūyaḥ parasvarūpād garbhādhānādyarthamavatāraṇam, 
noparoddhavyamiti asya dīkṣitasyedānīṃ tvayā noparodhena 
svarūpāvaraṇaṃ kāryamiti yāvat | ata eva svaviṣṭapaṃ dīkṣitasya 
paramaśivātmasvātmasvarūpamadhikaraṇaṃ gaccha tanmayatayāsya sadā 
sphuretyarthaḥ | ata eva śrīspande'bhihitam ---- 

śvamārgasthā jñātā siddhyupapādikā" (spa0 34-18) 

iti | 

yaduktaṃ brahmaṇi śabdasparśau, viṣṇau rasaḥ, rudre rūpagandhau, 
īśvare buddhyahaṅkārau, sadāśive manaḥ puryaṣṭakāṃśamarpayet | 
tatrāyamabhiprāyaḥ ---- iha brahmā paramayā vyāptyā nādāntopari 
brahmabilādhiṣṭhātṛbrahmarūpaḥ, viṣṇurapi tadupari 
prasaradrūpaśaktipradhānaśakttyātmā, rudro'pi 
vyāpinīpadāvasthitānāśritanātharūpaḥ, īśvaro'pi 
samanāpadādhirūḍhaḥ sṛṣṭyadhikārī śivaḥ, sadāśivastu 
svacchasvacchandacidānandaghanaḥ paramaśivaḥ, 
ityekādaśapaṭaloktavyavasthayā parasya brahmaṇo 
nādāntaśaktyormadhyavatītvāt sūkṣmatamābhyāṃ śabdasparśābhyāṃ 
yogaḥ | evaṃ mūlabhūmau sparśapradhānāpi prasaradrūpatayā rasamayī 
śaktiriti tanmayasya viṣṇoḥ sūkṣmatamarasasaṃbandhaḥ, tato'pi rudrasya 
vyāpinyāmanāśritapade viśvasyāsūtraṇādamātrātmanaḥ 
prāksṛṣṭopasaṃhṛtajagadgatasusūkṣmatamasaṃskāramātrātmanā 
tanīyastamena gandhena cāsti saṃbandhaḥ | samanādhiṣṭhātari tu śive 
mananamātrasāre vigaladvuddhyahaṅkāravāsanāsaṅgaḥ, paramaśive'pi 
unmanāśaktisamāśliṣṭe mananasaṃskārasyāpi 
galanamityatisusūkṣmatamasvapraśāntamanaḥsaṃskārasaṃbandho'sti, 
ityāśayena niravaśeṣasaṃskāraparyaṃntapuryaṣṭakapraśāntyarthameva 
puryaṣṭakāṃśārpaṇam | anye tu ---- 

"śrutitvagviplutirbrāhmī brahmakravyādayonidā | 

rāsanī vaiṣṇavī raudrī ghrāṇalocanahetukā || 

eśvarī garvadhīrūpā mānasī śivadevatā |" (mi.kri. 8-140-141)

iti nirbījadīkṣāviṣayaśrīmṛgendravākyaṭīkāyāmuktendriya-
viplutyātmasamayollaṅghanasaṃbhāvyamānatattatkravyādatvapraśamanāya 
pāśaśodhanapare'pi vākye nirbījadīkṣāyāṃ puryaṣṭakāt 
śabdasparśārpaṇaṃ brahmaṇi kāryamityādi 
yadbhaṭṭanārāyaṇakaṇṭhenokttaṃ tadevātra yojayāñcakruḥ | tatra 
sabījanirbījādisarvadīkṣāsu puryaṣṭakāṃśārpaṇamāmnātam, ato 
mṛgendrāyāṃ samayapāśaśodhanapare'pi vākye nirbījadīkṣāviṣayameva 
puryaṣṭakāṃśārpaṇaṃ tadabhiprāyavarṇanaṃ ca tenākāri, 
tadyuktamayuktaṃ veti sacetasaḥ pramāṇamityalam || 208 || 

atha vāgīśīm ---- 


visarjyaivaṃ kalā bhāvyā śāntyatītā layaṃ gatā || 4-209 || 

svaśaktyādhāraparyante susūkṣmābhāvasaṃsthite | 


svā svātantryātmā śaktirādhāraḥ samavāyinī yasya, sa evāśeṣasya 
samanāpratiṣṭhāsthānatvāt paryantaḥ, ata eva suṣṭhu 
sūkṣmasyābhāvasya samanātmano 
vyāpinyādikṣityantaniḥśeṣabhāvābhāvabhittibhūtasya mahāśūnyasya 
saṃsthitaṃ saṃsthānaṃ yatra || 209 || 

atha kāyavāṅmanaḥkarmānyathābhāve jāte sati ---- 


ātmatattvavibhāgena dhāmnā vai juhuyācchatam || 4-210 || 


ātmaśabdo vidyāśivāvupalakṣayati, 
tenātmavidyāśivatattvavibhāgenetyatrārthaḥ || 210 || 

tathā ---- 


saśabdoccārayogena ātmatattve tu homayet | 


praṇavaniṣkaloccārapūrvaṃ 
dīkṣyasyātmatattvavyāptamāyāntādhvaśuddhau 
vidhinyūnātiriktadoṣaśuddhirastu svāhā ---- ityatra prayogaḥ || 

etaccātmatattvam ---- 


māyātattvāvadhi jñeyaṃ daiśikena mahādhvare || 4-211 || 

māyāntaṃ vedyaṃ sarvamiti tadvyāptyātmatattvaṃ | 


mahādhvare dīkṣāprayojanaśivayāge || 211 || 

kimarthamayaṃ homaḥ, ityāha ---- 


vidhivaikalyakarmārthaṃ prāyaścittaviśuddhaye | 


vidhiḥ pūjāhomādiḥ śāstracoditastasya vaikalyakarma 
nyūnātirekānuṣṭhitistadarthamiti tannivṛttyarthaṃ yā 
prāyaścittaśuddhistasyai || 

atha ---- 


vidyātattve tu hotavyaṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ priye || 4-212 || 


tacca


upāṃśūccārayogena vidyātattve tu homayet | 


pūrvoktāyā vidyāyā iyamanyaiva | 

māyānte vidyā karaṇarūpā bhagavataḥ, iti vaktumāha ---- 


sadāśivāntamadhvānaṃ vidyātattvaṃ vinidīśet || 4-213 || 


jñānakriyātmā śaktiḥ śivasya kāraṇaṃ tadrūpaśca sadāśivaḥ, iti
tadantā vidyātattvasya vyāptiḥ || 213 || 
 
atra ca ---- 


mantroccāravilomena prāyaścittaṃ tu yadbhavet | 

tadviśuddhyai sa homaḥ syādvidyātatve tu yaḥ kṛtaḥ || 4-214 || 


vilomatā'nyathākaraṇam | atra ca praṇavaniṣkalāvuccārya dīkṣyasya
vidyātattvavyāptasadāśivāntādhvaśuddhau mantroccāravailomyaśuddhirastu
svāheti prayogaḥ || 214 || 

anantaram ---- 


manovijñānavaikalyāt prāyaścittaṃ tu yadbhavet | 

tacchuddhyarthaṃ śive tattve mūlamantreṇa homayet || 4-215 || 

mānasena prayogena..............


manovijñānaṃ bhāvanā, śivatattvamuktatattvāpekṣayātra pramātṛrūpam 
|| 215 || 

etacca ---- 


........śaktyante'dhvani saṃsthitam | 


śaktyantaṃ samanāntamuttīrya śivabhaṭṭārakasya tāvadvyāptikatvāt || 

athāśeṣabandhabhittermuṇḍāntordhvavāhinyāḥ 
prāṇaśakteradhovāhātmakabandhakatvopaśamāya tadanukāriṇyāḥ 
sthūladehagatāyāḥ śikhāyāśchedamādiśati ---- 


tattvatrayaviśuddhyante śikhācchedaṃ tu kalpayet || 4-216 || 


kathaṃ ca ---- 


adhvāntasthāṃ parāṃ śāntāmanaupamyāmanāmayām | 

vyāpinīṃ sarvatattvānāṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam || 4-217 || 

dhyātvā śiśoḥ śikhāgre tu puṣpāgre jalabinduvat | 


adhvano'nte'ta evāvidyamānādhvānte pade ca sthitāṃ parāṃ śāntāmiti
śāntyatītāṃ sarvopādhikṣaiṇyādanāmayāmakalaṅkāṃ ṣaṇṇāmapi 
kāraṇānāṃ kāraṇaṃ śiśoḥ śikhāgre dhyātveti saṅgatiḥ || 217 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


kartarīṃ śikhayāmantrya śikhayā cchedayecchikhām || 4-218 || 


śikhayeti naiṣkalena śikhāmantreṇa | iha 
viśeṣānabhidhānānnirbījasabījadīkṣādvayaviṣayaśikhācchedanaṃ
na tu nirbījāyāmeva || 218 || 

atha ---- 


śikhāṃ samarpya cānyasya nirgacchet sa saśiṣyakaḥ | 


tatra ca ---- 


snānaṃ samācarecchiṣyaḥ................


chinnaśikhatvāt || 

tatsparśāttu ---- 


................gurorācamanaṃ bhavet || 4-219 || 


sa śiṣyasaṃparkatvāt parāśayagrahaṇāya vā ---- 


snānamuddhūlanaṃ vātha ācaret svecchayā guruḥ | 


tataḥ ---- 


praviśya sakalīkṛtya..............


ātmānam | 


............pūrṇayā juhuyācchikhām || 4-220 || 


uktavyāptiprāṇaśakttyanukāriṇīm | atra ca pūrvasaṃvāditaḥ 
pāśahomamantraḥ prayoktavyaḥ || 220 || 

itthaṃ ca ---- 


hutvā nirgamya cācamyākṣālya sruksruvakartarīḥ | 

praviśya sakalīkṛtya śivahastānupūjanam || 4-221 || 


kurvītetyarthaḥ || 


tatastu maṇḍale paścāt pūjayet parameśvaram | 

puṣpādibhiraśeṣaistu tato vijñāpayecchivam || 4-222 || 

bhagavaṃstvatprasādena adhvaṣaṭkavyavasthitam | 

paśaṃ saṃgṛhya saṃśodhya śikhācchedāvasānakam || 4-223 || 

tvanmukhoktavidhānaṃ tu leśato vatītaṃ mayā | 


grahaṇaṃ pāśasūtrāt svadehācca | saṃśodhanaṃ malebhyaḥ | vatītaṃ
saṃpāditam || 223 || 

kiṃ ca, śiṣyamiṣṭaṃ dhāma lambhayitaṃ mayā ---- 


tvacchaktyaiva tu gantavyamāśu dhruvapadaṃ śivam || 4-224 || 


evakāro nirapekṣaḥ śaktipāta evātra prabhavatīti dhvanati | etacca 
pañcamapaṭalānte nirṇeṣyāmaḥ | dhruvapadaṃ saptamaṃ paramaśivasthānam 
|| 224 || 

tadarthameva ---- 


idānīṃ yojaye karma................


mayārabhyate | 

tato'tra ---- 


...............ṭavājñānuvidhāyinaḥ | 

ājñā me dīyatāṃ nātha śiṣyaṃ saṃyojayāmyaham || 4-225 || 


tavājñeti

"dīkṣaṇīyāstvayā śiṣyāḥ |"

ityadhikārāvasare prāptā | 

atha ---- 


labdhānujñātamātmānaṃ..................


ājñālābhayuktyaiva rudraśaktisamāveśāt ---- 


.............prahṛṣṭo nirgataḥ purāt | 

arghahasto vrajedagnim.................


purāditi maṇḍalakṣetrāt | 


athātra ---- 


..............śiṣyamāhūya prokṣayet || 4-226 || 


prokṣitasya ---- 


pūrvavaccāsanasthasya sakalīkaraṇādikam | 

antaḥkaraṇavinyāsaṃ nāḍīsandhānapūrvakam || 4-227 || 

pūjaṃ tarpaṇaṃ cāgnau mantrāṇāṃ ca śivasya ca | 


kuryāt | tarpaṇaṃ mūlāpekṣayā vaktrāṅgānām || 


daśabhāgavibhāgena................


nacātra dravyeyattāniyama ityāha ---- 


.............yathā dravyānusārataḥ || 4-228 || 


yadvakṣyati ---- 

"tisraḥ pañca daśaikā vā tilairvātha ghṛtena vā |" (4-448)

iti || 228 || 

atha ye niṣkalasvarūpanimajjanena sakalatāmunmajjya 
bhagavato'ntaraṅgaśaktirūpā vaktrāṅgamantrā bhedaprathotthāpanena 
cidātmanā saṃśuddhatvāpādane'dhikṛtāstān ---- 


mantrān saṃśodhayet paścāt sakalīkaraṇe sthitān | 

sakṛdāhutiyogena..................


mūlamantreṇaivetaramantraśuddhiriti nirṇītam, ataḥ 
praṇavaniṣkaloccārapūrvaṃ hṛdādyekaikaṃ jātyantamuccārya "bhagavan 
dīkṣyasya niṣkalaśuddhadhāmaprathāparo bhava svahā" iti prayogeṇa 
niṣkaladhāmaviśrāntibhāvanayāhutiṃ dadyāt || 

tata etānidaṃ śrāvayet ---- 


..............'dhikāro vivarjyatām || 4-229 || 

sakalīkaraṇatvena na kadācit paśoḥ punaḥ | 


sakalīkāro bhavadbhiḥ kārya iti śeṣaḥ || 229 || 


evaṃ dīkṣyasya mantraikādaśikāśuddhimitikartavyatvenoktvā devīmāha
bhagavān ---- 


yojanīyaṃ prayogaṃ tu adhunā kathayāmi te || 4-230 || 


yojanāyai hitaṃ yojanīyam, prakṛṣṭaṃ yogamitikartavyatārūpaṃ prayogaṃ 
cādhunā niḥśeṣapāśakṣapaṇe jāte sati, te ityanugrahaikapravaṇatayā 
bhagavatyā evaikasyāḥ parasyāḥ śakteryojanāyāṃ śaktāyāḥ kathayāmi 
vimarśapadaṃ lambhayāmītyarthaḥ || 230 || 

asya cābhyastajñānayogaduṣprāpadaiśikapravarasādhyatvamiti darśayituṃ 
mahatā pīṭhikābandhagrahaṇena yojanopayogi prameyatrayodaśakaṃ 
sadgurūṇāṃ hṛdayaṅgamīkāryaṃ nirṇetumudākṣipati parameśvaraḥ ---- 


jñātvā cārapramāṇaṃ tu prāṇasañcārameva ca | 

ṣaḍvidhādhvavibhāgaṃ tu prāṇaikatra yathāsthitam || 4-231 || 

haṃsoccāraṃ tu varṇaiśca kāraṇatyāgameva ca | 

śūnyaṃ samarasaṃ jñeyaṃ tyāgaṃ saṃyogamudbhavam || 4-232 || 

bhedanaṃ ca padārthānāṃ bhāvaprāptivaśāt punaḥ | 

ātmavidyāśivavyāptimevaṃ jñātvā tu yojayet || 4-233 || 


iha ---- 

"tasmin yuktaḥ pare tattve sarvajñādiguṇānvitaḥ | 

śiva eko bhaved devi avibhāgena sarvataḥ ||" (4-402)

iti bhāvinītyā parabhairavaikyāpattyātmā yojanā 
puryaṣṭakāhantāpraśāntyaiva guroḥ kartavyā | puryaṣṭake ca 
prāṇāśraye śūnyāśrayaṃ ca svapnasauṣupatyostathā niścayāditi 
prāṇaśūnyapadayoḥ praśamanīyatve cārasya prāṇavāhasya 
deśakālābhyāṃ pramāṇamavaśyaṃ jñātavyam, tatrāpi 
cārohāvaroharūpasañcaraṇaṃ jñātasañcārasya 
tatrasthollaṅghanīyasamastādhvaparijñānamupayogi, adhvollaṅghanamapi 
ūrdhvanadanātmahasoccāraparijñānāt, taduccāro dvidhā svābhāvikaḥ 
prāyatnikaśceti, prāyatnike tasmin naiṣkalairakārokārādibhirvarṇaiḥ 
kāraṇānāṃ brahmādīnāṃ tyāgo'pi jñeyaḥ, 
cakārāttadūcitakālatyāga ihānuddaṣṭo'pi vakṣyamāṇo jñātavya eva, 
prāṇavacca śūnyamapi praśamanīyatvājjñeyameva,  
parabhairavaikyātmayojanaṃ ca mantrātmanāḍyādisāmarasyajñaptipūrvakam, 
sāmarasyajñānaṃ sāmyajñaptipūrvakamiti sāmyātmaviṣuvatsvarūpamapi 
bhaviṣyati, akārādyunmanāntaṃ dvādaśavidhaṃ jñeyamapi 
mantroccārāṅgatayā jñeyameva, tyāgāya caitajjñeyamiti tyāga uktaḥ, sa 
ca tattaddaśāsaṃyogapūrvakaḥ tattaddaśātyāge 
cordhvordhvārohātmodbhavo'pi jñātavyaḥ, yāvaccaiṣāṃ granthīnāṃ 
bhedanaṃ na vṛttaṃ na tāvattattyāgenordhvodbhavo ghaṭate, bhedanaṃ ca 
jñānayogābhyām | yadvakṣyati ---- 

"bhedayejjñānaśūlena" (4-335) iti | 

tathā

"bhedayenmantraśūlena mudrābhāvayutena tu |" (4-357) 

ityādi | 

tacca bhāvasya 
dṛḍhārūḍhapratipattyātmanastattacchabdādyanubhavātmanaśca 
vakṣyamāṇasya prāptivaśādbhavati | evamiyajjñānapūrvaṃ prāṇe śūnye 
ca praśamite'pi, ātmatattvasyaitāvaduttīrṇā 
śuddhātmadaśānubhavarūpā, vidyātattvasya conmanāviśrāntyātmā, 
śivatattvasyāpi ca paratattvasamāveśarūpā vyāptiravaśyaṃ jñeyeti, 
iyatprameyaparijñānamāgamato'nubhavataśca 
yojanāyāmupayogītyāśayenātra vākye jñātveti dvirupāttam || 233 || 

yathoddaṣṭaṃ nirṇetumāha ---- 


tadvibhāgaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathā jñāyeta tattvataḥ | 


vibhāgo vibhajanamasādhāraṇena rūpeṇa vivecanalakṣaṇam | 
prakārabhedakathanamapi yathāsambhavam | 

taṃ krameṇāha ---- 


ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulaścāro hṛtpadmādyāvaśaktitaḥ || 4-234 || 

tuṭiṣoḍaśamānena kālena kalitaḥ priye | 


yāvacchabde talopa eśvaraḥ | ādyenārdhena deśato dvitīyena 
kālataścārapramāṇamuktam | śaktiriha bhāvinītyā samanāntābhipretā | 
tuṭiścaṣakaṣaḍbhāgarūpasya prāṇāpānavāhasya 
dvātriṃśattamoṃ'śaḥ | 

atha prāṇasañcāramāha ---- 


sañcarantaṃ vibhāgena yathāvattaṃ śṛṇuṣva me || 4-235 || 


tamiti prāṇaṃ tālvādisthānānusāriṇā vibhāgena yathāvat 
svānubhavasākṣikaṃ samyak carantaṃ śṛṇu kathitamantanībhālaya || 235 
|| 


hṛtpadmādyāvadayanaṃ bhāgamekaṃ tyajettu saḥ | 

nāsikāgre dvitīyaṃ tu śaktyante tu tṛtīyakam || 4-236 || 

tatrastho vinivarteta yāvattatvaṃ na vindati | 

vidite tu pare tattve tatrastho'pi na bādhyate || 4-237 || 


etacchāstraprakriyayā mantrodayasthānāddhṛtpadmāt prabhṛti | ayanamiti 
kālādhikāravakṣyamāṇayā "prāṇe dinodaya" iti sthityā prāṇādityasya 
madhyāhnagatāśrayaṃ tālusthānamaṣṭādaśāṅgulāntamiha vivakṣitam | 
tacca māyāgranthyātmakaṃ rudrasthānaṃ 
durbhedamityaśikṣitatadanupraveśasya tu madhyanāḍyā nāsikāgraṃ 
bhrūmadhyamaiśvaraṃ sthānaṃ prāpnoti, evamapyabhinnabhrūgranthestasmin 
nāsikāgre | dvitīyamiti ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ bhāgaṃ tyajet, 
tatpraveśamanāsādya pārśvanāḍīdvayena yāvacchikṣitatadanupraveśasya 
tu śaktyantaṃ brahmabilaparyantamāśrayati, tathāpyasvīkṛtaśāktabalasya 
śakttyante tasmiṃstṛtīyaṃ bhāgaṃ dvādaśāṅgulaṃ tyajet, 
tatrāntarajñasya brahmarandhreṇādhaḥ prasaret, etadeva tatrasthetyādinā 
ślokārdhenoktamata evāsāditaśāktabalaḥ samagragranthisañcārābhijñaḥ 
parasmiṃstattve vidite | tatretyukte.qu granthisthāneṣvapi sthito na 
bādhyate, na dehādipramātṛtāvaivaśyametīti yāvat | ataśca 
paratattvajñaptiparyantaḥ prāṇasañcāraḥ śikṣaṇīya iti piṇḍārthaḥ 
|| 237 || 

atraiva sañcāre pāribhāṣikīḥ saṃjñā udghāṭayati ---- 

śaktyā cādho yadā gacchedabudhastu tadā bhavet | 

śaktiparyante'pi pade labdhe tattve'nārohāt | 

yadā tu tadārohāya ---- 


hṛdgataḥ punaruttiṣṭhed budhyamānaḥ sa ucyate || 4-238 || 


tataśca ---- 


śaktiṃ prāpya budho jñeyaḥ...............


tato'pi śāktabalalābhāt tattvārohayuktijñasya ---- 


..............vyāpinyaṃśe prabuddhatā | 


yadā tu tato'pyūrdhvamārohati, tadā samanāparyantameṣamadhvānam ---- 


atītaḥ suprabuddhastu..................


paratattvānulābhāt abuddharūpataiveti kecit, tadasat, tasyeha
prākaraṇikatve'pi suprabuddhaikarūpatvāt, anyathā gurutvāyogāt | 

asya ca ---- 


...............unmanastvaṃ tadā bhavet || 4-239 || 


manaḥsaṃskārasyāpi kṣayāt || 239 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


na kālo na kalā cāro na tattvaṃ na ca kāraṇam | 

sunirvāṇaṃ paraṃ śuddhaṃ gurupāramparāgatam || 4-240 || 

tadviditvā vimucyeta gatvā bhūyo na jāyate | 


kālastuṭyādiḥ parārdhāntaḥ, kalā nivṛttyādikā, cāraḥ 
prāṇavāhaḥ, tattvaṃ pṛthivyādi, kāraṇaṃ brahmādi, sunirvāṇamiti 
parādvayamayatvāt, ata eva paraṃ śuddhaṃ 
śuddhāśuddhasadāśivādipadādapi prakarṣāt, gurūṇāṃ paramparaiva 
pāramparaṃ parabhairavatacchaktisadāśiveśānantaśrīkaṇṭhādirūpaṃ 
tata āgatam | viditveti anubhūya, vimucyate iti jīvanneva vimuktaḥ syāt, 
gatveti dehānte tadaikātmyameti || 

athādhvaṣaṭkavibhāgamāha ---- 


adhvaṣaṭkaṃ yathā prāṇe saṃsthitaṃ kathayāmi te || 4-241 || 

āpādānmūrdhaparyantaṃ citeḥ saṃvedanaṃ hi yat | 

bhuvanādhvā sa vijñeyastattvādhvā ca tathaiva hi || 4-242 || 


iha tasya bhāvastananāttattvamiti vyutpattyā niruktyā ca viśeṣaniṣṭhaḥ 
sāmānyābhāsaḥ śarīrabhuvanabhāvaviracanāhetutattvam | tadābhogaḥ 
śarīrabhuvanādiryathā dehamṛddārupāṣāṇādau kāṭhinyābhāsaḥ 
pṛthivītattvam, evamanyat | sāmānyābhāsaśca cidbhittau bhāti 
paracidbhūmau ca sarvaṃ cidekarasamiti na ko'pi vibhāgastataḥ, "prāk 
saṃvitprāṇe pariṇatā" iti nyāyāt, prāṇasaṅkocinyāstasyāḥ 
prāṇatvāroheṇa dehamapyaśnuvānāyā yastattvapratibhāsarūpaṃ sa eva 
tattvādhvā ghaṭate ityabhipretyāpādānmūrdhāntaṃ yacciteḥ saṃvedanaṃ 
tattatkāṭhinyādipratibhāsarūpaṃ sa eva tattvādhvā bhuvanādhvā 
cetyuktam | tattvasattayaiva ca bhuvanasattāpi saukṣmyeṇānumīyate | 
prāṇacāro hṛdayācchaktyantaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgula uktaḥ | 
adhvaṣaṭkavibhāgastu prāṇaikatreti samastadehavyāpisūkṣmaprāṇamātra
evoddaṣṭo na tu prāṇacāra ityāpādādityādikā yuktaivoktiḥ | 
tattvānāṃ coddeśānte śrīmataṅge'pyuktam ---- 

"tattvaṃ vastupadaṃ vyaktaṃ sphuṭamāmnāyadarśanāt | 

tatametena vā yasmāttattattvaṃ tattvasaṃtatau ||" (1-5-4) 

iti | 

tathā

"śivādyavaniparyanto yo'yamadhvātivistṛtaḥ | 

sa samastaścito jñeyo nāśivatvādvimucyate ||" (1-10-23)

iti || 242 || 

prāṇe kalādhvasthitimāha ---- 


kalākalitasaṃtānaḥ prāṇaḥ sañcarate sadā | 


kalābhiḥ kalito vyāptaḥ saṃtānaḥ prāṇavāho yasya || 

asya hi ---- 


nivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā ca adhobhāge pravatīke || 4-243 || 

vidyā śāntistathā cordhve śāntyatītā tvadhiṣṭhikā | 


"ā pādānmūrdhaparyantam" ityuktvā samastadehavyāpī 
sāmānyaprāṇanārūpaḥ prāṇa uddaṣṭo yasya prāṇāpānādyātmikā 
viśiṣṭā vṛttayaḥ | tato'dhobhāgapravatīke ityādikaṃ saṅgatameva | ye 
tūrdhvavāhiprāṇāśrayametat, ityabhiprāyeṇa adhobhāgapravatīke iti 
paṭhitvā adhobhāge pravṛttiravasthitivīdyate yayorityādi śliṣṭaṃ 
vyācakṣate, teṣāṃ 

"śaktyā cādho yadā gacchediti (4-238) 

pūrvoktaṃ vismṛtam, jaḍasya ca śaktyātmakakalāvyāpakatvamuktam na tu 
viparyaya ityāstāmetat | evaṃprāyaṃ vyākhyānaṃ bahu asamañjasaṃ 
ṭīkākṛtāmasti, tat svayamevānveṣṭavyam | granthagauravabhayāt 
pratipadaṃ nonmīlitaṃ kiyanmātraṃ tu daśītam || 

heyahānyā śiṣyāṇāmupādeye dhīḥ prarohatviti kalātītaṃ padaṃ 
nirūpayitumāha ---- 


tadatītaḥ paro bhāvaḥ.................


śāntyatītāmapyatikrāntaḥ śuddhātmadaśārūpaḥ svabhāva ityarthaḥ | 
ata evonmanāparatattvātmakaśaktiśaktimatsāmarasyātmakam ---- 


............ṭadūrdhvaṃ padamavyayam || 4-244 || 


yatprāptyarthamiyān śāstrasaṃrambhaḥ || 244 || 

prāṇe nivṛttyādikalāsthitimuktvā mantrakalāsthitimapyāha ---- 


evaṃ bindukalā jñeyā nādaśaktyātmikāśca yāḥ | 

vyāpinyādyātmikā yāśca vyāpyavyāpakabhedataḥ || 4-245 || 

prāṇaikasaṃsthitāḥ sarvāḥ...............


akārokāramakārātmānaḥ kalāḥ prāṇaiḥ sarvairuccarantya upalabhyante | 
yāstu bindvādyāḥ samanāntāḥ krameṇa vyāpyavyāpakabhāvena sthitāḥ, 
tāḥ sarvāḥ prāṇe sthitā jñeyāḥ prayatnenānubhavitavyāḥ | 
bindunādavyāpinīnāṃ tisṛṇāṃ pradhānatayā iha 
uddeśo'rdhacandrādiśaktīnāṃ yathāyogametadantarbhūtatvena 
prādhānyāt| 

ata eva ---- 


.............ṣaṭtyāgāt saptame layaḥ | 


sarvopalabhyā akārokāramakārakalāḥ, yogagamyāstu bindunādavyāpinya 
ityāsāṃ ṣaṇṇāmapi tyāgāt paramayogināṃ saptame paraśaktimati 
paratattta eva layo viśrāntiḥ kāryā || 

etadupasaṃhṛtyānyadavatārayati ---- 


kalādhvaivaṃ samākhyāto varṇādhvānaṃ nibodha me || 4-246 || 


tamāha ---- 


varṇāḥ śabdātmakāḥ sarve jagatyasmiṃścarācare | 

sthitāḥ pañcāśatā bhedaiḥ śāstreṣvānantyakoṭiṣu || 4-247 || 

śabdāt prāṇaḥ samākhyātastasmādvarṇāstu prāṇataḥ | 

utpadyante layaṃ yānti yatra śabdo layaṃ gataḥ || 4-248 || 


ānantyena koṭisaṃkhyeṣu śāstreṣu pañcāśatā bhedairmātṛkārūpaiḥ 
care jaṅgame vāgvati, acare cāntaḥsaṃjñe sthāvare 
tattadavyaktavācyākṣarādyabhivyañjake varṇāḥ sthitāḥ | te ca 
śabdātmakāḥ śabdanarūpāḥ, śabdo'pi prāṇanātmā dhvanisatattvaśca 
prāṇo'ta evāsmād dhvanirūpādvarṇā jāyante, yatra ca śabdātmā 
prāṇo layaṃ yāti tatraiva varṇā līyante, iti prāṇanātmani prāṇa eva 
varṇādhvā sthitaḥ || 248 || 

yataśca varṇānāṃ prāṇasya caikatra layastataḥ ---- 


śabdātīto varārohe tattvena saha yujyate | 

yuktaḥ sarvagato devi dharmādharmavivajītaḥ || 4-249 || 

nādho nirīkṣate bhūyaḥ śivatattvaṃ gato yadā | 


tattvena paramaśivena saha yujyate ekyameti, ata eva sarvagato 
dharmādharmābhyāṃ prāṇāpānābhyāṃ śubhāśubhābhyāṃ ca rahitaḥ | 
adha iti idantārūpo bhedaḥ | yadeti yataḥ || 

etadupapādayati ---- 


adho vai yātyadharmeṇa dharmeṇordhvaṃ vrajet punaḥ || 4-250 || 

vijñānena dvayaṃ tyaktvā sarvagastu bhavediha | 


adharmeṇāśubhenādhaḥ sthāvarāntamapānātmadehabhūmiṃ, dharmeṇa 
śubhena devayonyāditām, prāṇātmanā tu śaktyantaṃ vrajati | etaddvayaṃ 
tu viśiṣṭena śivaikyātmavimarśātmanā | jñānena tyaktvā, iheti 
dehāvasthito'pi sarvagaḥ śivo bhavati || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


varṇādhvaivaṃ samākhyātaḥ...........


atha ---- 


.................padādhvā procyate'dhunā || 4-251 || 

ekāśītipadānyeva vidyārājasthitānyapi | 

varṇātmakāni tānyatra varṇāḥ prāṇātmakāḥ sthitāḥ || 4-252 || 

tasmādevaṃ padānyatra tāni prāṇakrameṇa tu | 


ekasminnapi vidyārāje navātmanyekāśītipadāni prāgvibhaktanītyā yāni 
sthitāni, tānyapīdānīmeva nirṇītanītyā varṇātmakāni, varṇāśca 
prāṇarūpāstadātmakatvāt padānām || 252 || 


padādhvaivaṃ samākhyātaḥ.................


athātra ---- 


................ṃantrādhvānaṃ nibodha me || 4-253 || 


tamāha ---- 


mantraikādaśikā yā tu sā ca haṃse vyavasthitā | 

padaikādaśikā sā ca prāṇe carati nityaśaḥ || 4-254 || 


haṃse madhyame prāṇe, naiṣkalavaktrāṅgarūpā mantraikādaśikā sthitā 
yasmāt, sā padaikādaśikā 
nityoccaranniṣkalakalārūpaviśrāntiheturbrahmādivācakākārādi-
samanāntapadarūpā | nirṇītaṃ caitat pūrvameva || 254 || 

etāni padānyāha ---- 


akāraśca ukāraśca makāro bindureva ca | 

ardhacandro nirodhī ca nādo nādānta eva ca || 4-255 || 

śaktiśca vyāpinī caiva samanaikādaśī smṛtā | 


niṣkalanāthe'kārakalā yādṛśyasti, yādṛśaṃ caitatkalānāṃ rūpaṃ 
tadadūra eva nirṇeṣyate || 255 || 

ekādaśikāyā asyā adhvarūpatāṃ darśayitumāha ---- 


unmanā ca tato'tītā tadatītaṃ nirāmayam || 4-256 || 


tata iti tāṃ samanāmatītā | tadatītamiti tāmunmanāmatiśayenetaṃ gataṃ 
tadabhinnam | unmanāparatattvaprāptihetutvāt padavarṇādīnāmiva 
mantrāṇāmapyadhvateti yāvat || 256 || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


mantrā evaṃ sthitāḥ prāṇe...........


bahiḥsthūlarūpasyāpyadhvaprapañcasya māntrakaloccāraṇe 
sūkṣmarūpatayā mantroccicārayiṣā mantraviśrāntidaśāyoge 
pararūpatayā mantraupayika evopalambho bhavatītyāśayena paryante 
mantrādhvā nirṇītaḥ || 

kramaprāptaḥ ---- 


..............ḥaṃsoccārastathocyate | 


tamāha ---- 


hakārastu smṛtaḥ prāṇaḥ svapravṛtto halākṛtiḥ || 4-257 || 


yo'yaṃ halākṛtiranacko hakāro'nāhatadhvanyātmā

śvayamuccarate devi" (7-59)

iti bhāvinītyā svapravṛttaḥ

ṅādākhyaṃ yatparaṃ bījaṃ" (kālo0 1-5)

iti tantrāntaroktadṛśā sarvasya svataḥ sphuran sa eṣa prāṇaḥ 
prāṇanāparaparyāyo jīvaḥ, smṛto gurupāramparyeṇāvicchedenādhītaḥ | 
atha ca dhūlibhedānusāreṇa halākṛtiraśeṣaṃ viśvaṃ garbhīkṛtya 
kuṇḍalinyākāraḥ prasuptabhujagarūpaḥ | svapravṛtaḥ iti svayameva 
nādāmarśarūpatāṃ nimajjya prāṇātmakaṃ rūpamāviśya sthitaḥ | yataḥ 
pārameśī bodhākhyā śaktivīśvaṃ garbhīkṛtya parā kuṇḍalikā satī 
vimarśarūpatayā nādātmavarṇakuṇḍalikātmanā 
sphuritvāntanīmajjitaitatsvarūpā prāṇakuṇḍalikātmatayā 
bhātītyāmnāyaḥ | evaṃ ca vyākhyātarūpaḥ prāṇa eva haṃsa 
ūrdhvamadhaśca svarasena vahan 
hānasamādānadharmakahakārasakāravimarśarūpatayā sphuraṇāt || 257 || 

athātraiva varṇaiḥ kāraṇatyāgaṃ nirṇeṣyan varṇoccāraṃ 
tāvannirūpayati ---- 


akāreṇa yadā yukta ukāracaraṇena tu | 

makāramātrayā yukto varṇoccāro bhavet sphuṭaḥ || 4-258 || 


yo'yaṃ nādātmano haṃsasya nityapravṛtta uccāraḥ sa eva sphuṭo 
varṇoccāro bhavati, kathamakāreṇānackahakārasyābhivyaktihetunā 
śirorūpeṇa yadā yuktastadā ukāra 
evordhvādhaḥsañcārakatvāccaraṇarūpastena tathā 
bindvādiprameyāsūtrakānusārarūpamakāramātrayā yadā yuktaḥ, īdṛśo 
hi uccarannasau sarvairupalabhyate || 258 || 

atha ca ---- 


binduḥ śiraḥsamāyogāt susvaratvaṃ prapadyate | 


uktarūpo varṇoccāra eva yogināṃ 
bhrūmadhye'kārādimātrātrayasvīkṛtaniḥśeṣabheda- 
saṃpiṇḍitāvibhāgavedanātmakabindurūpatāmāśritya śiraḥ samāyogāditi
śirasi lalāṭasthe praśāmyadvedyaprādhānye'rdhacandre 
praśāntavedyapradhānatayā ūrdhvonmukhatvena spaṣṭarekhātmani, ayogino 
nādapathapraveśarodhakatvānnirodhikāsamākhye, samyagāsamantāt 
yogāttattatpadārohāt susvaratvaṃ guṇīkṛtavedyabhedapradhāneśvarapadaṃ
samastavācakāvibhedavimarśapradhānānnādanādāntabhūmiṃ 
gṛhṇātītyarthaḥ || 

ataśceyatpadamārūḍhasya ---- 


nādo'sya vadanaṃ proktaḥ..........


yataḥ proktanītyānāhatadhvaniparamārtho'yaṃ haṃsastato 
varṇoccārātmatādaśāyāmapi lalāṭamadhye nāda evāsyavadanamiva vadanaṃ 
mukhyamaṅgam || 

yuktaṃ caitadyataḥ ---- 


............vadanaṃ śabdamīrayet || 4-259 || 


nādarūpaṃ vadanaṃ kartṛ śabdaṃ nādāntātmānamīrayed brahmarandhratale
prerayettadrūpatayā sphuret || 

na kevalamevamayaṃ nādātmā prāṇaḥ śirovadanacaraṇayukto nadan
haṃsa ityukto yāvat ---- 


anenaiva ca yogena haṃsaḥ puruṣa ucyate | 

brahmaviṣṇvīśamārgeṇa caran vai sarvajantuṣu || 4-260 || 


puruṣaḥ kṣetrajño'nenaiva madhyordhvamārgārohaṇātmanā yogena 
sarvajantuṣu hṛtkaṇṭhabhrū madhyalalāṭamārgeṇa 
prasarannadharabhūmihānordhvapadasamādānarūpo haṃsa ucyate | vakṣyati 
cāgre ---- 

"śivo dharmeṇa haṃsastu sūryo haṃsaḥ prabhānvitaḥ | " (7-39)

ityupakramya ---- 

"ātmā vai haṃsa ityuktaḥ prāṇo haṃsasamanvitaḥ ||" (7-30)

iti etacca tatraiva vyākhyāsyāmaḥ || 260 || 

evaṃ nādāntarūpatāṃ gṛhītvā ---- 


śaktitattve layaṃ yāti................


nādāntarūpatāṃ praśamayyānandasparśātmatāṃ brahmabile śrayati || 

tato'pi śivapadasamāvivikṣāvaṣṭambhātmanā ---- 


................vijñānenordhvatāṃ vrajet | 


katham ---- 


vyāpinīṃ samanāṃ tyaktvā vrajedunmanayā śivam || 4-261 || 


śaktau sparśamanubhūyordhvapraveśayuktyā vyāpinyāṃ tvakkeśapade 
vyāptiṃ labdhvā tadūrdhve śikhākeśasthāne sāmanasepade 
mantavyābhāvānmananamātrarūpatayā sthitvā tato'pyūrdhvaṃ haṃsaḥ 
śuddhātmarūpo mananollaṅghanasvabhāvo 
yugapadaśeṣaviśvābhedaprakāśātmakonmanāśaktyāśrayeṇa śivaṃ 
vrajeccidānandaghanaparabhairavasamāpattiṃ śrayet || 261 || 

evaṃ ca ---- 


śivatattvagato haṃso na caret........


śivākhyaṃ tattvaṃ paramaśivo na carenna saṅkocena prasaret || 

api tu ---- 


...................vyāpako bhavet | 


śivādikṣityantāśeṣaviśvātmanā taduttīrṇena ca rūpeṇa 
sphuredityarthaḥ || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


haṃsoccāraḥ samākhyātaḥ kāraṇaiśca samanvitaḥ || 4-262 || 


kāraṇairbrahmādibhiḥ, cakārādakārādivarṇairvastugatyā sambhavadbhiḥ
samyaganvito miśritaḥ || 

idānīṃ varṇaiḥ kāraṇatyāgaṃ nirūpayati, tatra ---- 


hakāraḥ prāṇaśaktyātmā..............

prāṇaśakterātmoktasthityā jīvitarūpaḥ | 


etasya śirorekhātmā ---- 


...............'kāro brahmavācakaḥ | 

hṛdi tyāgo bhavettasya................


vācakoccāraṇānta iti yāvat || 

evamuttaratra ---- 


...............ukāro viṣṇuvācakaḥ || 4-263 || 

kaṇṭhe tyāgo bhavettasya makāro rudravācakaḥ | 

tālumadhye tyajettaṃ tu...................


tyajediti kartṛpratyayastuśabdaśca raudragranthyullaṅghane'vadhātavyamiti 
sūciyati | 


...............binduścaiveśvaraḥ svayam || 4-264 || 


abhedoktyākārādivaditaḥ prabhṛti na pṛthag vācyavācakateti darśayati | 


tyāgastasya bhruvormadhye..................


vidhīyata ityuttarasthaṃ saṃbadhyate | ardhacandranirodhikāntāsyaiva
vyāptiḥ | 


.............ṇāde vācyaḥ sadāśivaḥ | 


tadabhedena vimṛśyetyarthaḥ | 


lalāṭānmūrdhaparyantaṃ tyāgastasya vidhīyate || 4-265 || 


nādasyaiva nādāntāntā vyāptivīdhīyate yogibhiryatnena kriyate || 265 || 

atha yāḥ sūkṣmānubhāvagamyāḥ ---- 

śaktivyāpinīsamanāstāsāṃ vācyaḥ śivo'vyayaḥ | 

sadāśivāpekṣayāyamavyayaḥ paramaśivāpekṣayā tu savyaya eva || 

tatra ---- 


mūrdhamadhye tyajecchaktiṃ tadūrdhve vyāpinīṃ tyajet || 4-266 || 


vyākhyātasparśānubhūtyante ityarthamevaṃ vyākhyātam || 266 || 

mananamātrarūpānubhavānte ---- 


samanām.............


tadūrdhve tyajedityevam || 

evamiyadadhvātikrāntyā prāptaśuddhātmasvarūpasya yoginaḥ ---- 


......unmanāṃ tyaktvā ṣaṭtyāgāt saptame layaḥ | 


bhavatīti śeṣaḥ | vyākhyātarūponmanāśaktyanupraveśena 
paramaśivībhāva evonmanātyāgaḥ | evaṃ ca ṣaṇṇāṃ 
brahmaviṣṇurudreśvarasadāśivaśivākhyānāṃ kāraṇānāṃ 
tyāgādviśrāntipūrvamullaṅghanāt saptame paramaśive layaḥ 
samāpattirbhavati || 

etadadhikāvāpenopasaṃharati ---- 


sūkṣmasūkṣmatarairbhāvairevamevaṃ tyajet priye || 4-267 || 

sthūlasthūlatarairbhāvairnānāsiddhiphalapradaiḥ | 


avarohakrameṇa yathoktavācyavācakātmāno bhāvāḥ padārthā ye 
vakṣyamāṇayuktyā sthūlasthūlatarāstattatsiddhipradāḥ 
sthitāstairevārohakrameṇa yathottaraṃ sūkṣmasūkṣmatarairupalakṣitam | 
evamiti sarvamadhvānam, evamityuktayuktyaiva tyajet, 
taistyajyamānairupalakṣitā ye sūkṣmasūkṣmatarā ārohakrameṇa 
yathottaraṃ ta eva, taiḥ kāraṇabhūtairevamiti pradaśītanītyā evamiti 
yathoktaṃ tyajet | sthūlānāṃ siddhau sūkṣmāṇāṃ muktau 
hetutvamityadhikamatropakṣiptam || 267 || 

tatra ---- 


sūkṣmo'tyantaṃ paro bhāvastvabhāvaḥ sa vidhīyate || 4-268 || 


paro bhāvaḥ parā sattā paramaśivo'tyantaṃ sūkṣmo vijñeyaṃ 
sarvakāraṇaṃ cetyarthaḥ | sa cāśeṣabhāvaprakṣayātmakatvādabhāvaḥ || 
268 || 

na ca sa evedṛg yāvat ---- 


unmanā tvaparo bhāvaḥ...............


parabhāvāpekṣayā svātmavimarśarūpatayā kiñcidaunmukhyādunmanā
aparo bhāvo mahāsattātmā sūkṣmo bhāvo'bhāvaśceti samanvayaḥ || 


...............ṣthūlastasyāparo mataḥ | 


tasyonmanākhyasya svabhāvasya yaḥ saṃbandhitayā vyāpyavyāpakarūpatayā, 
na tu tataḥ pṛthaktvenāparaḥ samanākhyastadapekṣayā 
sthūlo'kārādyapekṣayā tu so'pi sūkṣma evānyathā 
sūkṣmasūkṣmatarairiti bahuvacanaṃ na yujyate || 


tasyāparaṃ punaḥ śūnyaṃ.................


tasyeti samanātmano bhāvasyāparaṃ vyāpinīrūpaṃ 
śūnyamaśeṣabhāvāsūtraṇarūpaṃ mahāśūnyamityarthaḥ | 
"punaḥ"śabdena samanātmakaṃ 
tāvanniḥśeṣabhāvābhāvāsūtraṇarūpamekaṃ śūnyam, idaṃ tu 
sarvabhāvābhāvābhāsanabhittikalpaṃ dvitīyamityuktam || 

ata eva ca ---- 


.............ṣaṃsparśaṃ ca tato'param || 269 || 


śaktipadamityarthāt || 269 || 

tato'pi ---- 


śabdo.......


nādāntātmā nādarūpaśca | 

tato'pi ---- 


.........jyotiḥ.........

vyāptanirodhikārdhaṃcandrapado binduḥ | 

........ṭato mantrāḥ kāraṇā bhuvanāni ca | 


mantrā makārokārākāravarṇaparāmarśātmāno vācakāḥ, tadvācyā 
rudropendrabrahmāṇaḥ kāraṇāni tadāśrayabhūtāni ca tattvāni bhuvanāni 
ca krameṇātyantaṃ sthūlatamānītyarthaḥ | 

tadāha ---- 


pañcabhūtātmabhuvanaṃ kāraṇaiḥ samadhiṣṭhitam || 4-270 || 


pañca bhūmyādīni sthūlasūkṣmādirūpatayātmā kāraṇaṃ yasya 
bhuvanasya | māyāvidyādipade'pi hi bhuvanāni santi, na ca tatra 
sthūlabhūtārabdhāni, teṣāṃ ca sūkṣmabhūtārabdhyānāmapi 
svādhiṣṭhātṛkāraṇāpekṣayā sthūlatvameva, vastutastu eṣāṃ 
bhuvanādīnāṃ śivarūpatvameva | 

yathoktamanyatra ---- 

"bhuvanaṃ vigraho jyotiḥ khaṃ śabdo mantra eva ca | 

bindunādādisaṃbhinnaḥ ṣaḍvidhaḥ śiva ucyate ||" iti | 

ārurukṣūn prati tu sthūlasthūlatarairityādyuktam || 270 || 

yaduktaṃ śthūlā bhāvāḥ siddhidāḥ" iti, tatroktakramaprātilomyena 
siddhibhedaṃ vibhajya darśayati ---- 


bhuvanaṃ cintayedyastu vakṣyamāṇaikarūpakam | 

bhuvaneśatvamāpnoti...............


vakṣyamāṇamiti bhuvanādhvani bhuvaneśatvaṃ kālāgnyādirūpatvam | yastu 
paro yogitvādetadbhuvanaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ vigrahādyapi śivarūpatayaiva 
paśyati saḥ ---- 


...........śivaṃ dhyātvā tu tanmayaḥ || 4-271 || 


śivasya ca cidānandaghanatayaiva dhyānaṃ natvākāreṇa | anyeṣāṃ tu ---- 


brahmādikāraṇānāṃ ca sādhane vigrahaṃ smaran | 

pūrvoktalakṣaṇaṃ yaśca tanmayatvamavāpnuyāt || 272 || 


pūrvamityāsananirṇayāvasara uktam, yaścetyatra sa ityadhyāhāryaḥ || 


mantraiśca mantrasiddhistu japahomārcanād bhavet | 


ārādhitairiti śeṣaḥ || 

ataśca japādinā pūrvameva ye sādhitā mantrā aṅgabrahmādyāḥ ---- 


pūrvoktarūpakadhyānāt siddhyantyatra na saṃśayaḥ || 4-273 || 


eṣāṃ pūrvameva dhyānam, sādhanaphalaṃ cāgre bhaviṣyati || 273 || 


jyotirdhyānāttu yogīndro yogasiddhimavāpnuyāt | 


jyotibīndu | yogasiddhiratītādijñānam || 

yogaprakarṣāttu ---- 


tanmayatvaṃ yadāpnoti yogināmadhipo bhavet || 4-274 || 


adhipa iti bhagavadīśvararūpaḥ || 274 || 


śabdadhyānācca śabdātmā vāṅmayāpūrako bhavet | 


śabdo nādaḥ || 


sparśadhyānācca sparśātmā jagataḥ kāraṇaṃ bhavet || 4-275 || 


sparśa ānandātmā śaktigatastasyādhastanajagatkāraṇatvājjagataḥ 
kāraṇamityuktam || 275 || 

vyāpinīpade tu ---- 


śūnyadhyānācca śūnyātmā vyāpī sarvagato bhavet | 

samanādhyānayogena yogī sarvajñatāṃ vrajet || 4-276 || 


evaṃ sthūlasthūlatarādibhāvāpekṣayā siddhīḥ pratipādya

śūkṣmo'tyantaṃ paro bhāvaḥ" (4-268)

ityādipratipāditadṛśātyantasūkṣmonmanāparatattvadhyānaṃ 
muktipradamityādiśati ---- 


unmanyā tu paraṃ sūkṣmamabhāvaṃ bhāvayet sadā | 


unmanyā samavāyinyā śaktyā saha paraṃ pūrvoktaśivatattvarūpamabhāvaṃ 
bhāvayet | 


abhāvaṃ vyācaṣṭe ---- 


sarvendriyamanotītastvalakṣyo'bhāva ucyate || 4-277 || 


sarvāṇīndriyāṇi manaścātīto'tiniṣkrāntaḥ, samanāpadādūrdhvasya 
veditrekarūpatvāt, ata evālakṣyaḥ, ataśca na vidyante vedyādirūpā 
bhāvā yatreti vyutpattyābhāva ucyate, vastutastvasau cidānandaghana eva || 
277 || 

nanu yadyayamīdṛśastatkathamuktam ---- "abhāvaṃ bhāvayet sadā" ? ---- 
ityāśaṅkyāha ---- 


abhāvaṃ bhāvyaṃ bhāvena bhāvaṃ kṛtvā nirāśrayam | 

na vidyante bhāvā yasmiṃstadabhāvarūpaṃ padam, bhāvena parasattātmanā 
cinmayena rūpeṇa bhāvyaṃ bhāvanīyam | nanu citattvaṃ bhāvakaṃ 
tatkathaṃ bhāvyamucyate ---- 

bhāvaṃ kṛtvā nirāśrayamiti | bhavatīti bhāvaḥ sadāśivādiḥ 
kṣityantaḥ, taṃ nirāśrayaṃ nirālambanaṃ praśāntarūpatayā 
śaktidhāmānupraveśena tanmayīkṛtya || 

itthaṃ ca ---- 


sarvopādhivinirmuktamabhāvaṃ labhate padam || 4-278 || 


upasaṃharati ---- 


eṣa te kāraṇatyāgaḥ...............


kāraṇatyāge'rthākṣiptaṃ kalātyāgamāha ---- 


...............kālatyāgaṃ nibodha me | 


sa ca ---- 


tuṭiṣoḍaśasaṃyuktaḥ prāṇastu samudāhṛtaḥ || 4-279 || 


tasya ca ---- 


tuṭidvayaṃ samāśritya ekaiko bhairavaḥ sthitaḥ | 

dvitīyāvaraṇaniṣṭhaḥ kapālīśabhairavādiḥ || 


asmiṃśca ---- 


ahorātravibhāgena kurvantyudayameva te || 4-280 || 


yathāhni prāṇe'ṣṭāvudyantyevaṃ rātrau apāne'pi || 280 || 

eṣāṃ vyāpakaḥ ---- 


navamastu paro devaḥ................


para ityaṣṭānāṃ pūrako vyāpakaḥ prakṛṣṭaśca śrīsvacchandanāthaḥ 
|| 
etadīyānmahāprakāśātmano vyāpakāt ---- 


...............ṭejasastūdayanti te | 


tadbhittāveva sphurantītyarthaḥ | ataśca prāṇodaye tadavinābhāvini 
bāhyāntaranīlasukhādijñāne tadvikalpane'pi vā parabhairavavikāsamayā 
eva mahāyogino na tu kadācit kvacidapi khaṇḍyante, pratyuta svātmavikāsena 
satataṃ maṇḍyante, iti sarahasyārtho'tra kaṭākṣitaḥ || 

evaṃ sthite sati ---- 


sarvaṃ kālaṃ tyajet prāṇe yathāvat kathayāmi te || 4-281 || 


tatra ---- 


tuṭayaḥ ṣoḍaśaivoktāḥ kālasya karaṇaṃ tu tāḥ | 

tadādiḥ saṃsthitaḥ kālaḥ sarvaṃ carati vāṅmayam || 4-282 || 


"karaṇaṃ tu tāḥ" iti prāṇārambhadvāreṇa tābhiḥ sarvasya 
kālasyotthāpanāt | tadādiriti

"kṣaṇadvayaṃ tuṭiḥ proktā" (11-201)

iti bhāvinītyā yadyapi kṣaṇādiḥ kālastathāpi

"mānuṣākṣinimeṣasyāṣṭamoṃ'śaḥ kṣaṇaḥ |" (11-201)

iti bhāvivākyenaiva lakṣyasyānumeyatvamuktamiti na tasya sāvadhānairapi 
tuṭivat sphuṭasaṃvedyatvamityevamuktam sarvaṃ carati vāṅmayamiti | 
prāṇoccāroccaranmātṛkāvyāptidvāreṇa samastavācakarāśiṃ taddvāreṇa 
ca vā(cyānya1)pi vyāpnoti || 282 || 

tadādirityuktaṃ vibhajati ---- 


tuṭirlavo nimeṣaśca kāṣṭhā caiva kalā tathā | 

muhūrtaścāpyahorātraḥ pakṣo māsa ṛtustathā || 4-283 || 

ayanaṃ vatsaraścaiva yugaṃ manvantaraṃ tathā | 

kalpaścaiva mahākalpaḥ.............


tuṭyādayaḥ ṣoḍaśa iti, vakṣyamāṇau ca dvau ekādaśapaṭale 
nirṇeṣyante | 

"mahākalpasya paryante brahmā yāti paraṃ layam |" (11-264)

iti | eṣo'tra mahākalpo na grāhyo'saṅgateḥ, api tu 
sadāśivajīvitāvadhyātmā paramamahākalpaḥ || 

yadāha ---- 


.........śaktyante taṃ parityajet || 4-284 || 


śaktyantarbhāvānupraveśānte sūkṣmadṛśā 
sadāśivāntakāraṇapañcakopasaṃhārī kālaḥ praśāmyatītyarthaḥ || 284 
|| 

atha ---- 


vyāpinyante paraḥ kālaḥ sa tadaṅgī.......


sa paramamahākalpo'ṅgamavayavaḥ tenāṅgī para iti sāmyākhyaḥ | 
yadvakṣyati ---- 

śa kālaḥ sāmyasaṃjño vai" (11-209) 

iti || 

.........ṭyajettu tam | 

taṃ ca samanānubhavadaśāyāṃ parityajet || 

pūrvaprakārāpekṣayā ca ---- 


sa ca saptadaśo jñeyaḥ...........


tato'pi ---- 

..............parārdhaḥ parataḥ sthitiḥ || 4-285 || 

so'pi cāṣṭādaśo devi samanānte tu taṃ tyajet | 


samanānubhavaparyante unmanāntarbhāve tyajet praśamayet || 285 || 


evamekaprāṇoccāreṇaiva bahivītatamapi parārdhāntaṃ kālaṃ gurupravaraḥ
praśamayya akālakalite pade sthitiṃ badhnīyāt | tadāha ---- 


sarvakālaṃ tu kālasya vyāpakaḥ paramo'vyayaḥ || 4-286 || 

unmanyante pare yojyo na kālastatra vidyate | 


kālasyeti parārdhāntasya, sarvakālaṃ nityoditatvena vyāpakaḥ, ata eva 
paramo'vyayaśca, unmanyante pare śaktiśaktimadanubhavāveśe yojyaḥ 
sāmarasyena pratyabhijñeyaḥ | tatra ca kalanātmā kālo nāsti, tasyaiva 
viśvakalanākāritvānna taṃ kaścit kalayatītyarthaḥ || 286 || 

ata evāsau ---- 


nityo nityodito vyāpī..............


nityodita iti na kenacidācchāditaḥ ityarthaḥ || 

taṃ ca sarvoparivatītvāt ---- 


.............ādirūpaṃ na saṃtyajet || 4-287 || 


tameva dṛḍhāvaṣṭambhayuktyā śrayet || 

evaṃ ca sati ---- 


taṃ ca nityoditaṃ prāpya tanmayo jāyate sadā | 


yogīndra iti śeṣaḥ | 

evaṃ ca kāraṇatyāgānantarīyakaḥ kālatyāgo nirṇīta ityāha ---- 


kālatyāgo bhavedevaṃ.............


uddeśakramāyātaḥ ---- 


...............śūnyabhāvastvathecyate || 4-288 || 


śūnyo rūpo bhāvaḥ padārthaḥ, paraśūnyapadaprāptyupāyabhūta 
ityarthaḥ || 288 || 

tamāha ---- 


ūrdhvaśūnyamadhaḥśūnyaṃ madhyaśūnyaṃ tṛtīyakam | 


"caturthaṃ vyāpinīśūnyaṃ" (4-290)

iti vakṣyamāṇatvād ūrdhvaśūnyamatra 
nādāntāntaniḥśeṣapāśapraśamabhūḥ śaktipadam, 
adhaḥśūnyamanullasitaprapañcaṃ hṛtkṣetram, madhyaśūnyaṃ tu 
krameṇādhastanaprameyapraśamātmakaṃ 
kaṇṭhatālubhrūmadhyalalāṭamūrdharandhrātmakam | 

itthaṃ ca ---- 


śūnyatrayaṃ calaṃ hyetattadadho madhya ūrdhvataḥ || 4-289 || 


tadetat krameṇādho madhya ūrdhvataḥ sthitaṃ 
śūnyatrayamāpekṣikatvāddheyamityarthaḥ || 289 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 

caturthaṃ vyāpinīśūnyaṃ samanāyāṃ ca pañcamam | 

unmanāyāṃ tathā ṣaṣṭhaṃ..........

atrāpyāpekṣikatvāccalaṃ hyetaditi yojyam | 


ataśca ---- 


..........ṣaḍete sāmayāḥ sthitāḥ || 4-290 || 


āmayapadenātra heyatvamupalakṣyate, tena calatvād ete heyā ityarthaḥ | 
unmanāyā api paratattvāpekṣayā kiṃciccalatvamasti | paratattvasyaiva tu
avicalatvādupādeyatvam || 290 || 

ata evaite ---- 


tattvenādhiṣṭhitāḥ sarve sāmayā api siddhidāḥ | 


tattvaṃ paramaśivaḥ adhiṣṭhitirvyāptiḥ | siddhiratra parayoginaḥ 
pūrṇānandaghanātmaiva, itarasya tu tattatsvapnapadocitā || 

ata eva ---- 


ṣaṭ śūnyāni parityajya saptame tu layaṃ kuru || 4-291 || 


yataḥ ---- 


tacchūnyaṃ tu paraṃ sūkṣmaṃ sarvāvasthāvivajītam | 


paraṃ sūkṣmamiti nirṇītaṃ prāk | unmanāyā api ---- 

"śaivī mukhamihocyate |" (vi0bhai0 20)

iti nyāyāt paramapadapravivikṣu (ryogyā ? kṣuyogyāśayena ---- ) 
paramattvānupraveśopāyatvād avasthātvamastīti kṛtvā 
sarvāvasthāvivajītamavasthātrayaikarūpaṃ paramevatattvam || 

evaṃ cet kathaṃ śūnyam ? ---- ityāha ---- 


aśūnyaṃ śūnyamityuktaṃ śūnyaṃ cābhāva ucyate || 4-292 || 

abhāvaḥ sa samuddaṣṭo yatra bhāvāḥ kṣayaṃ gatāḥ | 


yadetacchūnyamityuktam, tadvastuto'śūnyaṃ cidānandaghanaparamaśivatattvam 
| atra hetuḥ śūnyamiti | co hyarthe | yasmāt śūnyamabhāva ucyate, 
abhāvaśca na vidyate bhāvaḥ sarvaḥ prameyādiprapañco yatreti vyutpattyā
iha cittattvamevo(pa)diṣṭam, tasmādaśūnyameva śūnyamiti yuktamuktam || 

ata eva tat ---- 


sattāmātraṃ............


mahāsattārūpam, prakāśātmaiva hi sarveṣāṃ bhāvābhāvānāṃ sattā || 

niḥśeṣabhedapraśamāttu ---- 


............paraṃ śāntaṃ tatpadaṃ kimapi sthitam || 4-293 || 


lokottaramityarthaḥ || 293 || 

na ca viśvottīrṇarūpameva etadyāvadviśvamayamapītyāha ---- 


yatra yatra ca nādādisthūlā anye'pi saṃsthitāḥ | 

tatra tatra paraṃ śūnyaṃ sarvaṃ vyāpya vyavasthitam || 4-294 || 


nāda ādiryeṣāṃ bindvādīnām, nādasya cādayaḥ śaktivyāpinyādyā 
yatra yatra lalāṭādikṣetre, anye'pi sthūlāḥ nādādivācyāḥ 
sadāśivādyāstadadhiṣṭhitāśca tattattattvabhuvanādayo yatrāntarbahirvā 
saṃsthitāḥ, tatra sarvatra paraṃ sattāmātrarūpaṃ śūnyaṃ sarvamidaṃ 
śarkarārasavat tilaśoṃ'śamaṃśaṃ vyāpya vicitreṇa rūpeṇāvasthitam 
|| 294 || 

vyāpakameva ca vyāpyātmatayā sphurati, na tu vyāpyaṃ nāmānyadityāha ---
- 


tadeva bhavati sthūlaṃ sthūlopādhivaśāt priye | 


mahāprakāśātmā śrīsvatantranāthaḥ svasvātantryeṇaiva yataḥ 
sthūlābhāsatayā sphurati, tatastadupādhivaśāt sthūlamucyata ityarthaḥ 
|| 

itthaṃ ca ---- 


sthūlasūkṣmaprabhedena tadekaṃ saṃvyavasthitam || 4-295 || 


ata eva yasyeyatīṃ dhārāmārūḍhā saṃvinmahāyoginaḥ sa ---- 


tatprāpya tanmayatvaṃ ca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ | 


prāpyeti dṛḍhapratipattyāvalambya | na saṃśayaḥ iti 
tattvamevaitanmantavyaṃ na tu jaḍajanasulabhaḥ saṃśayo'tra kāryaḥ | 
yastviyati rahasye'rthe na samāśvastastadapekṣayā kāraṇatyāgādyuktam || 

śūnyamupasaṃhṛtyaitaducitānukramaṃ samarasamavatārayati ---- 


śūnyabhāvaḥ samākhyātaḥ sāmarasyaṃ nibodha me || 4-296 || 


samo raso yasmin sa samaraso lolībhāvaḥ || 296 || 

tadbhedānuddaśati ---- 


ātmanyekaḥ samaraso mantre jñeyo dvitīyakaḥ | 

tṛtīyaṃ nāḍigaṃ kuryācchaktau kuryāccaturthakam || 4-297 || 

vyāpinyāṃ pañcamaṃ proktaṃ samanāyāṃ tu ṣaṣṭhakam | 

tāttvaḥ samaraso devi saptamastu vidhīyate || 4-298 || 


etānyathoddeśaṃ lakṣyati ---- 


śiṣyātmānaṃ tu saṃgṛhya pūrvoktavidhinā kramāt | 

paścādātmani saṃyojya lolībhūtaṃ vicintayet || 4-299 || 


ātmānaṃ puryaṣṭakasaṃvidaṃ, pūrvoktavidhineti 
tāḍanacchedanādipūrvam, ātmani caitanyamātre saṃyojyāvikalpaṃ vimṛśya 
tadviśrāntyaiva samarasīkuryāt || 299 || 

atraivetikartavyatāṃśaṃ pūrayannāḍimantrasāmarasye nidīśati, tatra 
śiṣyātmano grahaṇārtham ---- 


pūrakaṃ kumbhakaṃ kṛtvā samānena nirodhayet | 


kumbhakaprakarṣāllabdhabalena samānena nirodhayedityākrāmedarthāt 
sarvanāḍīḥ || 

yadāha ---- 


yāvatyo nāḍayo devi tiryagūrdhvamadhaḥsthitāḥ || 4-300 || 

samānena samākṛṣṭā ekībhūtā bhavanti tāḥ | 


taditthaṃ kumbhakaprakarṣe'vasthitasya ---- 


tāsu ye vāyavaste'pi prāṇe samarasīgatāḥ || 4-301 || 

nāḍyastu suṣumnāyāmekībhūtā vyavasthitāḥ | 


bhavantīti śeṣaḥ || 301 || 

itthaṃ nāḍisāmarasyapūrvaṃ mantrasāmarasyaṃ bhavati | tadāha ---- 


tato vai uccarenmantraḥ..........

udityūrdhvamavahitasya, caret svayameva prasaret || 

uccarantaṃ ca taṃ sādākhye pade'vyaktadhvanyātmani ---- 


...........ṇāde līnaṃ vicintayet || 4-302 || 


upasaṃharati ---- 


mantra ātmā tathā nāḍī evaṃ samarasībhavet | 

vāmadakṣiṇamadhye tu..............


yugapadevetthaṃ mantrādisāmarasye vṛtte ----
