.............ṭato nādaṃ pramocayet || 4-303 || 

setubandhaṃ ca taṃ mārgaṃ yatra gatvā na jāyate | 


śaktivyāpinīsamanonmanārūpasetubandhātmakaṃ mārgaṃ 
sarvādhvapāravatīśivapadaprāpakaṃ panthānaṃ nādaṃ mocayed gamayet | 
tadgatau ca satyāṃ na saṃsarati | mucergatyarthavivakṣayā dvikarmatā || 

atra ca kāraṇasāmarasyamarthasiddhamityāha ---- 


brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraḥ śiva eva ca || 4-304 || 

ete'tra samatāṃ yānti.............


yadā tvakārokārādyuccārairhṛtkaṇṭhādau viśrāntistadā ---- 


..........'nyathā tu pṛthak pṛthak | 


samanantaroktasetugatau sāmarasyāntarāṇi sthitāni lakṣayati ---- 


tasmin samuccarennādaṃ yāvacchaktau layaṃ gataḥ || 4-305 || 

śaktimadhyagato nādaḥ śaktyātmā tu vidhīyate | 	

sarvaṃ śaktimayaṃ tatra sarvaṃ samarasībhavet || 4-306 || 


tasminniti pūrvokte setubandhe, sarvamiti nāde 
samarasībhūtamātmamantranāḍikāraṇarūpam || 

tadetacchaktyaikyamāpya ---- 


tadūrdhvaṃ vyāpinīṃ prāpya sarvaṃ tanmayatāṃ vrajet | 


sarvaṃ prāptavyāpinyabhedam || 


samantād vyāpnuyādyasmād vyāpinītyabhidhīyate || 4-307 || 


tataśca ---- 


tadūrdhvaṃ samanāṃ vyāpya tanmayatvaṃ vrajet punaḥ | 


tatra ca ---- 


sā ca sarvagatā jñeyā sāmarasyena saṃsthitā || 4-308 || 


caśabda evārthe, saiva tatra sarvagatā, śarvāvaboddhavyā" ityarthaḥ | 
gamiratra jñānārthaḥ || 308 || 

tadittham ---- 


ṣaṣṭhaṃ samarasaṃ tyaktvā saptamaṃ tu tato vrajet | 

unmanāśaktyanupraveśena prāpnuyāt || 


taṃ prāpya tanmayatvaṃ hi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 4-309 || 


yaścetthaṃ prāptaparasāmarasyaḥ ---- 


sa ca sarveṣu bhūteṣu bhāvatattvendriyeṣu ca | 

sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva cetanācetanasthitam || 4-310 || 

adhvānaṃ vyāpya sarvaṃ tu sāmarasyena saṃsthitaḥ | 


sa ceti sa eva sthāvaramacetanaṃ jaṅgamaṃ sacetanaṃ ceti saṃkṣepeṇa 
dvidhā sthitaṃ ṣaḍavidhamadhvānaṃ vyāpya tadantarvatīṣu sarveṣviti 
devayonyādiṣu caturdaśasu bhūteṣu bhāveṣu dharmādiṣu ghaṭādiṣu ca 
tattveṣu pṛthivyādiṣu bhogasādhaneṣu cendriyeṣu sāmarasyena sthitaḥ 
sarvāsvavasthāsu aviluptaparabhairavasamāpattiḥ | eṣaiva ca 
nirvyutthānasamādhyātmā mahārahasyabhūtā || 

adhyāsitasamādhiṣu tu ---- 


prasahya cañcalītyeva yogināmapi yanmanaḥ || 4-311 || 


kuṭilaṃ calati bhogābhilāṣeṇa vyutthānameva dhāvati, nābhīṣṭaṃ
padamavaṣṭa(bhnā)ti, yaditi yasmādevam || 311 || 

tataḥ ---- 


yasya jñeyamayo bhāvaḥ sthiraḥ pūrṇaḥ samantataḥ | 

mano na calate tasya sarvāvasthāgatasya tu || 4-312 || 


jñeyaṃ ca yathā vyākhyātaṃ paratattvam, bhāva āśayaḥ, sthiro
niścalaḥ, pūrṇo nirākāṅkṣaḥ, samantataḥ sarvaṃsavīkayā, "tuḥ"
apyarthe || 312 || 

īdṛśasya mahāyoginaḥ ---- 


yatra yatra mano yāti jñeyaṃ tatraiva cintayet | 

calitvā yāsyate kutra sarvaṃ śivamayaṃ yataḥ || 4-313 || 


mana eva paratattvaikyabhāvanāvāsitaṃ kartṛ yathoktaṃ jñeyaṃ sarvatra 
cintayatyeva | taduktaṃ mahāgurubhiḥ ---- 

"śivabhāvanayauṣadhyā baddhe manasi saṃsṛteḥ | 

kāṣṭhakuḍyādiṣu kṣipte rasavacchivahematā ||" (śi0dṛ0 7-48)

iti || 313 || 

etadeva draḍhayati ---- 


viṣayeṣu ca sarveṣu indriyārtheṣu ca sthitaḥ | 

yatra yatra nirūpyeta nāśivaṃ vidyate kvacit || 4-314 || 


indriyāṇi cārthaścaindriyakaṃ prayojanaṃ viṣayopabhogasteṣu sthito 
yogivaro yo nirūpyeta vicāryeta, tatra kutrāpi nāsyāśivamasti, 
sarvasyāsya prakāśamānatayā prakāśaghanaśivaikātmyāt || 314 || 


evaṃ samarasaṃ jñātvā nāsau muhyet kadācana | 

mitayogino vyutthāne muhyantyeveti "kadācana" padasyāśayaḥ || 


ataśca ---- 


yasyaivaṃ sarvato bhāvaḥ so'pi sarvagato bhavet || 4-315 || 


śivastāvat sarvagata iti nāstyatra vimatiḥ, yasya tvevaṃ śivaikyena bhāva 
āśayaḥ sarvagataḥ, so'pi sarvagato bhaved mahāvyāptimanubhavatyeva || 

etadupasaṃhṛtya etatpūrvakakṣyābhāvi anuddaṣṭamapi viṣuvatsvarūpaṃ
nirūpayati ---- 


evaṃ samarasaḥ prokto viṣuvattu nibodha me | 


tadvibhajati ---- 


prathamaṃ prāṇaviṣuvanmāntraṃ jñeyaṃ dvitīyakam || 4-316 || 

tṛtīyaṃ nāḍiviṣuvat praśāntaṃ ca caturthakam | 

pañcamaṃ śaktiviṣuvat ṣaṣṭhaṃ vai kāla ucyate || 4-317 || 

saptamaṃ tattvaviṣuvat............


viṣaṃ sāmyarūpāṃ vyāptimarhatīti viṣuvat || 


evaṃ vibhaktasyāsya ---- 


..............pravibhāgastvathocyate | 


prakarṣeṇa vibhajyate'nyaparihāreṇa vyavasthāpyate vastu yena
sa pravibhāgo lakṣaṇam | 

tatra ---- 


ātmānaṃ ca manaḥ prāṇe saṃyojya viṣuvad bhavet || 4-318 || 


śiṣyasatkamātmānamātmīyaṃ ca manaḥ prāṇe madhyavāhini 
samyagityuktavakṣyamāṇakaraṇayuktyā yojayitvā prāṇaviṣuvad bhavati || 
318 || 

evam ---- 


prāṇe viṣuvadākhyātaṃ...............


atha ---- 


...............ṃāntraṃ viṣuvaducyate | 

mantramuccārayettāvadyāvannānyamanā bhavet || 4-319 || 

parāparavibhāgena mantrātmā tu taducyate | 


mantraṃ śrīniṣkalaṃ, parāpareti nādāntamaparam unmanāntaṃ tu
param || 


māntraṃ viṣuvadityuktaṃ.............


mantroccārāśrayo nāḍirataḥ


............ṇāḍisthaṃ tannibodha me || 4-320 || 

sarvāsāmeva nāḍīnāṃ madhye yā saṃvyavasthitā | 

suṣumnā nāma sā jñeyābheḥ śaktyā śivaṃ gatā || 4-321 || 



ā nābheḥ nābherārabhya, śaktyā śaktyanubhavānupraveśena, śivaṃ
gatā paraṃ tattvaṃ prāptā || 

evaṃ sthite ---- 


tatra pravāhayennādam...............


nādamavyaktadhvanirūpam, prakarṣeṇa vāhayedakārādisaṃyogena urdhvaṃ
prāpayet || 

tadetat sarvanāḍīsāmyātmakam ---- 


..............ṇāḍīviṣuvaducyate | 


ucyate, uktamityarthaḥ || 

kramaprāptaṃ tu


praśāntaṃ viṣuvaccaivamadhunā kathayāmi te || 4-322 || 


tadāha ---- 


ayane ṣaḍaṅgulaścāraḥ kāraṇānyaṅgule'ṅgule | 

tānyadhastāt parityajya kāraṇāni ṣaḍeva tu || 4-323 || 

saptame tu praśāntaṃ vai praśāntendriyagocaram | 


viṣuvaditi śeṣaḥ | ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgule cāre kālādhikārasthityā 
hṛdayāt prabhṛti makarādirāśisañcārarūpeṣu ayaneṣu pratyekaṃ 
ṣaḍaṅgulaścāraḥ, tatra ca pratiṣaṭkaṃ ṣaṭakāraṇānyaṅgule'ṅgule 
iti ṣaṣṭhe ṣaṣṭhe iti yāvat | evaṃ yāni prapañcavyāptyā 
ṣaṭkāraṇāni adhastāt sthitāni, tāni tyaktvā saptame paramakāraṇe 
kāraṇānāṃ sāmyāvasthitirūpāt praśamāt praśāntaviṣuvad bhavatīti 
viśeṣaḥ || 

praśāntaṃ vyācaṣṭe ---- 


praśāntaḥ stimito jñeyaḥ stimito niścalaḥ smṛtaḥ || 4-324 || 

niścalo nistaraṅgaśca sthiraḥ pūrṇaḥ samantataḥ | 


bhedataraṅgaśāntyā cidghanataiva praśānta iti 
nistaraṅgapūrṇapadāśayaḥ || 


evaṃ bhāvaṃ samāsthāya dīkṣā kāryā tu daiśikaiḥ || 4-325 || 

praśāntaviṣuvati viśramyetyarthaḥ | 

etatpraśāntaviṣuvat................


atha ---- 


.............śaktyupādhiṃ nibodha me | 

śaktimadhyagato nādo nādordhvaṃ ca caredyadā || 4-326 || 

tāvattu śaktiviṣuvat................


śaktimadhyagato madhyadhāmārūḍhaḥ | nādo'vyaktadhvaniḥ, nādāt 
sadāśivapadādūrdhvaṃ śaktisthānaṃ yadā caret, yadā madhyasthastadā 
śaktiviṣuvat || 


............kālākhyaṃ tu nibodha me | 


tadarthamāha ---- 


tuṭiḥ ṣoḍāśikā yā tu prāṇānte saṃvyavasthitā || 4-327 || 

kālo bhrūkṣepamātrastu tatrānte kītīto mayā | 

taṃ parāparabhāgena punareva tridhā kuru || 328 || 


prāṇasyānte yā ṣoḍaśī tuṭiḥ, tatra tasyāmante'rdhatuṭirūpe,  
bhrūkṣepamātro'tyantasūkṣmasāṣṭabhāgāṅgulacārasañcārātmā yaḥ 
kālaḥ, tamekaṃ tridhā apareṇa pareṇa parāpareṇa ca bhāgena kuru, 
tuṭerardhīkṛtāyāḥ tridhā vibhajanamiti "punaḥ" śabdārthaḥ || 328 || 
tatra ---- 


aparaḥ ṣoḍaśo yāvat.............


ṣoḍaśaḥ pūrvokto mahākalpākhyo yāvadaparaḥ sthūlaḥ || 


..............kālaḥ saptadaśaḥ paraḥ | 


parākhyayaiva pūvaṃ nidīṣṭaḥ || 

parāparastu yaḥ kālaḥ sa priye'ṣṭādaśaḥ prabhuḥ || 4-329 || 


parāpara iti parādapi paraḥ, aṣṭādaśaḥ parārdhākhyaḥ prabhuḥ
sarvakālāvayavavyāpī || 329 || 

tadittham ---- 


prāṇa evaṃ tridhā kālaṃ kṛtvā caiva tyajet punaḥ | 


prā(ṇe) prāṇīyordhvatuṭyardhe pūrvaṃ varṇaiḥ 
kāraṇatyāgāvasare'nuniṣpāditayāṣṭādaśāvayavakalātyāgo 
mantroccārayuktyoktaḥ | idānīṃ tu yogakrameṇa prāṇacārasthityā 
saptadaśāvayavaṃ kālaṃ yatnena tyaktvāṣṭādaśe kālaviṣuvati 
viśramitavyamiti "punaḥ" śabdārthaḥ || 

tridhā vibhaktasya kālasya pūrvoktaṃ sthānavibhāgaṃ smārayati ---- 


aparaḥ śaktimūrdhastho vyāpinyāṃ ca dvitīyakaḥ || 4-330 || 

tṛtīyaḥ samanāsthāne tatkālaviṣuvat smṛtam | 

yastṛtīyastatkālaviṣuvaditi saṃbandhaḥ | 


tadūrdhvaṃ hi ---- 

ṅa kālastatra vidyate" (4-287) 

ityuktam || 330 || 

tadittham ---- 


etatṣaṣṭhaṃ samākhyātaṃ..............


atha ---- 


................ṣaptamaṃ tāttvamucyate || 4-331 || 


tadāha ---- 


unmanā parato devi tatrātmānaṃ niyojayet | 

tasmin yuktastato hyātmā tanmayaśca prajāyate || 4-332 || 


parata iti samanāyāḥ, ya evātmana unmanāyogaḥ || 332 || 

tadeva ---- 


tattvākhyaṃ viṣuvad devi sarveṣāṃ parataḥ sthitam | 


upasaṃharati ---- 


viṣuvadevaṃvidhaṃ jñātvā ko na mucyeta bandhanāt || 4-333 || 

viṣuvatte samākhyātaṃ...............


idānīṃ paramparāvinābhūtān pañcapadārthāṃllaṅghayitumuddaśati ---- 


.................padārthabhedanaṃ śṛṇu | 

tyāgaṃ cānubhavaṃ caiva yojanaṃ ca pare pade || 4-334 ||

haṃsayogaḥ purākhyātaḥ..............

avadhibhūte kṣetradvaye yo madhyadeśastatra caturaṅgulo hṛdgranthiḥ iti 
saṃbandhaḥ ||

atraiva cāṅgule ---- 


tvakśeṣe vyāpinī proktā samanā ca.....


sāpi bhūḥ śivenaivādhiṣṭhitetyarthaḥ | śaktivyāpinīsamanākhyāḥ 
śivatattvabhūmayaḥ, śivākhyakāraṇādhiṣṭhitā ityarthaḥ | evaṃ ca 
vadannāpādād bāhyamānena yatṣaṇṇavatyaṅgule muṇḍāntasthānam 
tadeveha dvādaśāntamāntaravyāptyā hāvadhestāvataḥ 
ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulatvena vibhajanāditi dhvanati | anyatra 
dṛśyamānordhvavāhidhūmalekhāntaṃ

bindvādisamanāntaprameyasopānamālikāyāḥ sarvatra 
sthānasāmyenābhidhānāt ||

padārthabhedanāṅgatayā ----

iti pūrvamevoddaṣṭam, tathāpi

akāraśca hakāraśca dvāvetāvekataḥ sthitau || 4-349 ||

catuṣṣaṣṭyaṃśaiva, evaṃ cemau catuṣṣaṣṭyaṃśāvekīkṛtau 
dvātriṃśāṃśaḥ, so'pi śaktyātmadvātriṃśāṃśena saha militaḥ

jātaḥ, so'pi nirodhyaṣṭāṃśena saha caturthāṃśaḥ 
sthito'rdhacandraḥ, aparaścaturthāṃśo bindurardhamātretyeṣa mātrā 
makārāntāśca ṣaṇmātrā iti

tatra ---- 


ekenoccārayettattvaṃ karaṇena vicakṣaṇaḥ | 

ūrdhvarecakena


nāḍīścātha dvitīyena dvārāṇi ca nirodhayet || 4-361 || 


kumbhakena


tṛtīyaṃ karaṇaṃ divyaṃ kṛtvā vai tattvamuccaret | 


tattvaṃ niṣkalaṃ tena kumbhakena dvārāṇi nirodhya divyaṃ karaṇaṃ 
baddhvā ūrdhvarecakena mantramuccārayet, ityayamatra kramaḥ || 

tameva sphuṭayitumupakramate ---- 


pūrakaṃ kumbhakaṃ kṛtvā sarvadvārāṇi rodhayet || 4-362 || 


kumbhakāvasara eva || 362 || 

tāni ---- 


gudadvāreṇa ruddhena ruddhānyatra bhavanti hi | 

rodhaścāsya saṅkocavikāsābhyāmāveśavaśena kāryaḥ | 


evaṃ kṛtvā ---- 


dvāramekaṃ tataścordhve pravahattadvicintayet || 4-363 || 


madhyanāḍirūpaṃ vicintayet na tu saṃpratyeva vāhayet || 363 || 

tathā sati hi ---- 


nāḍayo granthipadmāśca ye'dhomukhagatāḥ priye | 

te kumbhakena saṃruddhā vikasanti samantataḥ || 4-364 || 

prāṇaśaktikauṭilyadhāmāni hṛdayādīni granthayaḥ | 


saṅkocavikāsadharmatvāt padmāni | tāni 
cāpānaśaktipravāhavaśādadhomukhāni 
vikasantītyūrdhvavāhonmukhībhavanti || 364 || 

itthaṃ kumbhakādanantaram ---- 


karaṇaṃ tu tataḥ kṛtvā..............


atra ca "tattvasyoccāraṇaṃ kuru" (4-367) 

iti dūreṇa saṅgatiḥ | madhye tu karaṇalakṣaṇam || 

tadāha ---- 


..............ḷakṣaṇaṃ tasya vai śṛṇu | 


jihvā tu tāluke yojyā kiṃcidūrdhvaṃ na saṃspṛśet || 4-365 || 

īṣatprasārya vaktraṃ tu kiṃcidoṣṭhau na saṃspṛśet | 

dantapaṅktī tathaiveha dṛṣṭiścādhordhvavajītā || 4-366 || 

kāyaṃ samunnataṃ kṛtvā karaṇaṃ divyamucyate | 


atra jihvāyāstāluyojane kuñcitatvamarthalabdhaṃ kiṃcidoṣṭhau neti na 
kiṃcidapi spṛśediti yojyam | tathaiveti prasārya na saṃspṛśedityarthaḥ | 
dṛṣṭeradha ūrdhvaṃ varjanaṃ niścalatārakatvena vikalpahānaye | 
samunnatamiti samyagavikṛtatayonnatam | divi parasaṃvillābhe upāyatayā 
bhavaṃ divyam || 

tadittham ---- 


divyaṃ ca karaṇaṃ kṛtvā tattvasyoccāraṇaṃ kuru || 4-367 || 


cakārāt kumbhakamūrdhvarecakaṃ ca, tattvaṃ mūlamantraḥ || 367 || 

atra divyakaraṇāvasare ūrdhvarecakamapi kurvītetyāha ---- 


kumbhitaścaiva yaḥ prāṇo recayettaṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | 


ūrdhvamityarthāt || 

tathā sati hi ---- 


nāḍyo granthipadmāśca dehe yāḥ saṃvyavasthitāḥ || 4-368 || 

recakena samākṣiptā ūrdhvasroto bhavanti te | 


madhyavāharūpatāṃ yāntītyarthaḥ | atra ca romāñcodgamo'bhijñānam | 

evaṃ karaṇatrayabandhāvahitaḥ ---- 


tato vai jñānaśūlena granthīn bhindan samuccaret || 4-369 || 


jñānaśūlaṃ pūrvaṃ nirṇītam, granthīnāṃ bhedo hṛdayādipadeṣu 
prāṇaśakteḥ spaṣṭībhāvena tattadanubhavalābhaḥ, samyagavikalpamuccaret
svayamevamūrdhvaṃ prasaret | mantra iti arthāt || 369 || 


atra bhedena ghaṭamānasya yogino bhāvaprāptivaśāditi yaḥ pūrvaṃ
heturuktaḥ tannirṇayānubhavabhedānnirūpayati ---- 


bhitvā hṛtpadmagranthiṃ tu tataḥ śabdaḥ prajāyate | 

yadākāśasamāyogāt..............


samyagāsamantādyogād mantrādyakaloccāraikāgratārūpāt | śabda iti
upāṃśurūpatayāntarakārādikalātmā sphuṭaṃ śrūyamāṇaḥ || 

sa ca ---- 


..............ghoṣaśabdopamo bhavet || 4-370 || 


"śravaṇāṅgulisaṃyogādyaḥ śabdaḥ saṃpravartate | 

dīptavahnisvanābhogaḥ sa nādo ghoṣa ucyate ||"

iti lakṣito ghoṣo dīptāgneryo 
dhakadhakākṛtiśabdatulyākāraśrutiruccaratītyarthaḥ || 370 || 


kaṇṭhastho viramecchabdaḥ kaṇṭhaṃ prāpya varānane | 


mantro vimarśaḥ kaṇṭhaṃ prāpya yadā tatstho bhavati tadā ghoṣaḥ 
śāmyedityarthaḥ || 

tatra tu ---- 


bhindataḥ kaṇṭhadeśaṃ tu śabdo dhugadhugāyate || 4-371 || 


tadrūpākāra uccaratītyarthaḥ || 371 || 

ataḥ ūrdhvam ---- 


tālumadhyagataḥ prāṇo yadā bhavati suvrate | 

bhindatastālugranthiṃ tu śabdo ghumaghumāyate || 4-372 || 


śobhanaṃ vrataṃ madhyadhāmanibhālananiyamarūpaṃ yasyā sā suvratā, 
tatsambodhanam | (suvrate) | "ghumaghumāyate" iti 
tadanukṛtirmakāraka(lpamu)ccaratītyarthaḥ || 372 || 

tadatra granthitrayabhedena ---- 


evaṃ te'nubhavāḥ proktāḥ prāṇe carati suvrate | 


proktaśabdaviṣayāḥ


trayaste'ṣṭakalāḥ proktā uparyuparitaḥ kramāt || 4-373 || 


iha ekādaśe paṭale ---- 


aṣṭadhā tu sa deveśi vyaktaḥ śabdaḥ prakītitaḥ | 

ghoṣo rāvaḥ svanaḥ śabdaḥ sphoṭākhyo dhvanireva ca | 

jhāṅkāro dhvaṅkṛtaścaiva aṣṭau śabdāḥ prakītītāḥ ||" (11-67)

ityuktyā vyaktasya śabdasyāṣṭavidhatvaṃ vakṣyati | 

akārokāramakārāśca trayo vyaktā iti taduccārasthāneṣu 
granthibhedānubhavaviṣayāṇāṃ śabdānāṃ ghoṣādyaṣṭakalatvam, yattu 
ghoṣopama ityuktam, ta(nna), ghoṣaikarūpatvam, apitu ghoṣasamānatvamiti, 
tatrāpi ṛāvādiśabdāḥ santyeva || 373 || 

tadittham ---- 

tiṣṭhet sa yatra vai prāṇa ātmā tadgatimāpnuyāt | 

prāṇāśrayā saṃvit taddvāreṇaiva tattatsthānamāpnoti || 

tatra ---- 


tattadrūpaṃ bhavettasya sthānabhāvānurūpataḥ || 4-374 || 

sthāne hṛdādau bhāvastattatkāraṇāntarbhāvaḥ | 


evaṃ hṛtkaṇṭhatāluṣu brahmaviṣṇurudrādhiṣṭhiteṣu 
sṛṣṭisthitisaṃhārarūpatāṃ prāṇāvasthitikrameṇātmā bhajate |  

bhruvormadhyaṃ yadā gacchet sphoṭaśabdastu jāyate | 

anabhivyaktavarṇarūpasphuṭatvādaśabdakalpaḥ sphoṭaḥ | 

eṣa ca ---- 


binduṃ bhedayato devi śabdo dhumadhumāyate || 4-375 || 


bindumiti bindugranthiṃ bhindato bindukalākhya eva mantrāvayavabodhī 
dhumadhumānukṛtiruccarati | bindugranthibhedaścāyamapavargapadādhirohe 
prathamasopānakalpa ityatra bharaḥ kartavyo yogibhiḥ, tadbhede hi ullaṅghita 
evaṃ bhedamayaḥ saṃsāraḥ || 375 || 

anyathā tu ---- 


kapirvai nārikelena ācāryaḥ saha bindunā | 

abhinnena kuto mokṣaṃ sabāhyābhyantaraṃ priye || 4-376 || 


bhajate iti vākyaśeṣaḥ | 
dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikabhāvo'trārthalabhyaḥ, tena yathā 
kapirnārikelenābhinnena kuto mokṣaṃ bhajate na bhajate nārikelaṃ 
rasāsvādāyābhaṅktvā na muñcati, tathaivācāryo bindugranthinā abhinnena 
saheti sākaṃ dīkṣyeṇa śiṣyeṇetyarthāt | kutaḥ sabāhyābhyantaraṃ 
kṛtvā mokṣaṃ bhajate, bāhyāt sthūlād 
bhāvabhūtaśarīrādābhyantarācca sūkṣmāt puryaṣṭakaśūnyaśarīrānna 
mucyate, bindubhedāttu mucyate evetyarthaḥ | "kapervai nārikelena 
tathācāryasya bindunā" iti spaṣṭaḥ pāṭhaḥ || 376 || 

ataśca ---- 


bhitvā binduṃ tato devi ardhacandraṃ vibhedayet | 

bhidyataścārdhacandrasya lalāṭe jhimijhimāyate || 4-377 || 


ardhacandragranthiṃ bhindatastatsthāna evārdhacandrākhyo mantrāvayavo 
jhimijhimānukāro jāyate ityarthaḥ | itthumuttaratrāpi yojanā kāryā || 
377 || 

atha ---- 


ardhacandraṃ tu bhittvā vai bhedayettu nirodhinīm | 

tasyāstu bhidyamānāyāḥ śabdaḥ simisimāyate || 4-378 || 


bindvādau prāgvat kalāvyāptimāha ---- 


sthānatrayamidaṃ devi pañcapañcakalānvitam | 


tatra bindoḥ

ṅivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā ca vidyā śāntistathaiva ca |" (10-1217)

ityupakramya

"etasya vāmadigbhāge śāntyatītā |" (10-1218)

iti kalāpañcakaṃ vakṣyati | evamardhacandrasya

"jyotsnā jyotsnāvatī kāntiḥ suprabhā vimalā śivā ||" (10-1220)

iti, nirodhinyā api ---- 

"rundhanī rodhinī raudrī jñānabodhā tamopahā |" (10-1221)

iti kalāpañcakam | sthānatrayamiti 
vargīkaraṇamādyagranthibhedādevāparagranthibheda ityāśayāt | 
evamuttaratra || 

tadittham ---- 


prāṇasya caratastatra yasmin sthāne sa tiṣṭhati || 4-379 || 

tattadrūpo bhavedātmā tāṃ tāṃ gatimavāpnuyāt | 


tatreti teṣu triṣu īśvaratattvādhiṣṭhiteṣu sthāneṣu carataḥ, 
prāṇasyeti carantaṃ prāṇamanādṛtya saṃvitpradhānatayā 
prāṇabhūmikāṃ guṇīkṛtya yasmin yasmin sthāne sa yogyātmā tiṣṭhati, 
tattadrūpatāmanubhūya tattanmayatvamāpnotītyarthaḥ || 

atha ---- 


nirodhinīṃ bhedayitvā tato nādaṃ vrajed budhaḥ || 4-380 || 

vaṃśaśabdasamaḥ śabdastatra sūkṣmaḥ prajāyate | 


sūkṣmatvaṃ pūrvāpekṣamīśvaratattvam || 

tato'pi ---- 


bhedayennādasaṃsthānaṃ brahmarandhraṃ sudubhīdam || 4-381 || 

bhidyato brahmarandhrasya śabdaḥ śumaśumāyate | 


nādasya samyak sthānaṃ viśrāntiryatra tannādasaṃsthānaṃ brahmarandhraṃ 
sudubhīdaṃ nādāntapadaṃ tadeva ca brahmarandhramūrdhvakavāṭachidraṃ 
sudubhīdaṃ sātiśayāvadhānaireva bhettuṃ śakyam ||  

evaṃ nādanādāntasthānaṃ sadāśivādhiṣṭhitaṃ bhittvā ---- 


śaktimadhyagataḥ prāṇo vaṃśanādāntasaṃnibhaḥ || 4-382 || 


śaktibhedasparśādvaṃśanādāntatulyo bhavati, na tu śaktisthānabhedād, 
vaṃśanādasya madhuradhvanirūpasyānto'nuraṇanarūpaḥ sūkṣmastattulyo 
bhavati || 382 || 

atha ---- 


tāṃ vai tu bhedayecchaktiṃ durbhedyāṃ sarvayoginām | 

bhidyate ca yadā śaktiḥ śāntaḥ śumaśumastataḥ || 4-383 || 


durbhedatvaṃ cāsyāḥ, tadanubhavāhlādasya spṛhaṇīyatamatvena 
tyaktumaśakyatvāt | "śānta" iti pravṛttisthānakaraṇābhighātādeva 
śabdavṛttiḥ śāmyati, iha tu śamitvā ānandasparśātmatāmetītyarthaḥ 
|| 383 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


śaktiṃ bhitvā tato devi yaccheṣaṃ vyāpinī bhavet | 

anubhāvo bhavettatra sparśo yadvat pipīlikā || 4-384 || 


śaktibhedānantaraṃ yanmantrāvayavarūpaṃ vastu śeṣamiti śiṣyamāṇaṃ 
tad vyāpinī bhavet, śaktyantasarvādhvavyāpanād vyāpinyākhyo 
mantrāvayavaḥ saḥ | "taccheṣe vyāpinī bhavet" iti tu spaṣṭaḥ pāṭhaḥ 
| tatra cānubhavaḥ praśāntaśabdavyāptikatvāt sparśaprathārūpaḥ | 
yadvat pipīliketi sañcarantīnāṃ pipīlikānāmivetyarthaḥ | pipīlikā 
ityatra nāṃśabdasya lopa eśvaraḥ || 384 || 

atrāpi kalāvibhāgamāha ---- 

sthānatrayamidaṃ devi pañcapañcakalānvitam | 

tatra nādasthāne śrīsadāśivādhiṣṭhite

"indhikā dīpikā caiva rocikā mocikā tathā | 

ūrdhvagā" (10-1226)

iti vakṣyamāṇāḥ pañca kalāḥ, śaktitattve vyāpinīpade ca 
śrīśivanāthādhiṣṭhite krameṇa ---- 


śūkṣmā caiva susūkṣmā ca tathā caivāmṛtāmitā | 


vyāpinī" (10-2142)

iti pañca kalāḥ,

"vyāpinī vyomarūpā cānantānāthā tvanāśritā |" (10-1252)

iti pañcaitāśca sarvāḥ svāvasare nirvakṣyāmaḥ | 

yata evaṃ tataḥ ---- 


yatra yatra caret prāṇastattadrūpamavāpnuyāt || 4-385 || 

prāṇo jīvastattadanubhavaṃ prāpnotītyarthaḥ | 


tadanubhavābhyāsaprakarṣāt tu ---- 


yatra yatrāvatiṣṭheta tāṃ tāṃ gatimavāpnuyāt | 


tattadātmaiva bhavatītyarthaḥ | 

evaṃ ca ---- 

śamanāntaṃ varārohe pāśajālamanantakam |" (4-432)

iti vakṣyamāṇametatsarvam ---- 


tasmādvai suprayatnena bhitvā yāti parāṃ gatim || 4-386 || 


śobhanaḥ prayatno divyakaraṇadhārādhiroharūpaḥ || 386 || 

atra kramamāha ---- 


bhitvā vai vyāpinīṃ devi samanāyāṃ manastyajet | 

manasā tu manastyaktvā jīvaḥ kevalatāṃ vrajet || 4-387 || 


mana ityavikalpaṃ cetaḥ | manaseti sparśaparyantasya mantavyasya 
kṣīṇatvāt, avikalpamananamātrarūpeṇa cittenaiva tādṛśameva ca mana 
ekāgratāprakarṣāt tyaktvā vedyābhāsajighṛkṣāsaṅkocarūpaṃ svaṃ 
vedanaṃ praśamayya jīva ātmā kevalatvameti śuddho veditṛmātrarūpo 
bhavatītyarthaḥ || 387 || 

evaṃ "bhedanaṃ ca padārthānāṃ bhāvaprāptivaśāt ityupakrāntaṃ
nirvāhya kramaprāptāmātmavyāptimāha ---- 


jīvo vai kevalastatra ātmajñānakriyānvitaḥ | 

bandhanāśeṣanirmuktaḥ sattāmātrasvarūpakaḥ || 4-388 || 

samastādhvapadātītaḥ śuddhavijñānakevalaḥ | 

gṛhṇāti nāparaṃ bhāvaṃ na paraṃ ca śivātmakam || 4-389 || 

parāparavinirmuktaḥ svātmanyātmā vyavasthitaḥ | 


yo jīvaḥ prāṇanātmā, sa tatra samanordhve yataḥ 
samastamadhvapadamatīto'ta evāśeṣeṇa malatrayarūpeṇa bandhena 
niḥśeṣeṇa vāsanāparyantena muktastataśca sattāmātrasvarūpo 
bhāvāpratiyogiprakāśamātratattvo ya ātmā ātmīyābhyāṃ svocitābhyāṃ 
jñānakriyābhyām, na tu paramaśivasaṃbandhinībhyāṃ 
sāmarasyāvasthitisatattvābhyāmanvito vyāpto na tu sāṃkhyādimuktarūpaḥ 
| eṣa ca māyordhvavarttyāṇavamalayuktavijñānakevalavailakṣaṇyāt śuddho
viśiṣṭena cāśeṣādhvavedyīkaraṇātmanā, na tu 
māyāpuṃviṣayakarūpeṇa jñānena, tenaiva ca kevalo na tu 
mantramantreśvaravadvijñeyenāpi saṃpṛktaḥ ata evāparaṃ śivaṃ 
sadāśivarūpaṃ svabhāvaṃ na gṛhṇāti, na ca paraṃ paramaśivarūpaṃ 
svacchasvacchandacidānandaghanam, ataśca ayaṃ vyākhyātaparāpararūpād 
vinirmuktastyaktāpara rūpo'pyaprāptaparasvabhāvaḥ svātmanyeva 
boddhṛtāmātrarūpe vyavasthitaḥ || 

na caivātra saṃtoṣaḥ kārya ityupasaṃhāradiśā 
diśannanyadavatitārayiṣurāha ---- 


ātmavyāptirbhavedeṣā śivavyāptirataḥ param || 4-390 || 

bandhanāśeṣabhāvena sarvādhvopādhivajītā | 


eṣeti samanāntasthitā, na tu sāṃkhyapātañjalādyuktā, asyaiva tvātmana 
unmanāpadāroheṇa cidānandaghanaparatattvavyāptirūpā śivavyāptiryataḥ 
sā bandhanānāmāṇavādīnāṃ malānāmaśeṣabhāvena | 

śamanāvadhiparyantaḥ kalaṅkādhāra ucyate" (7-229)

iti bhāvinītyā samanāntena prasareṇa ye pūrvoktā sarve'dhvarūpā 
upādhayo'vacchedakāstaivīśeṣeṇa 
samastabandhanapraśamasaṃskārātmanāpi vajītā, 
śuddhavijñānakevalatāyāṃ samanāntasamastabandhanapraśame'pi 
tannivṛttisaṃskārabhāvenāvacchedakatvāt sopādhitvam, paramaśivatā tu 
viśvottīrṇaviśvamayasvatantracidānandaghanānavacchidaiva || 

yata īdṛśī śivavyāptistataḥ ---- 


aviditvā paraṃ tattvaṃ śivatvaṃ kalpitaṃ tu yaiḥ || 4-391 || 

ta ātmopāsakāḥ śaive na gacchanti paraṃ śivam | 


yairiti śaivapāśupatalākulādibhirnānātmavādibhiḥ śivatvaṃ 
kalpitamātmanāṃ 
vyāpakatvanityatvāmūrtatvacittvasraṣṭṛtvādyanantadharmasāmyena 
śivaikarūpāṇāmapi kenacitkalpanāmātreṇa niryuktikena 
bhinnaśivarūpatvamucyate, te sarve vyākhyātavyāptikātmopāsakāḥ 
śaive'sminnadvayanaye paraṃ śivaṃ vyākhyātasvarūpaṃ na gacchanti na 
tanmayībhavanti | sāṃkhyayogavedāntavādyādayastu aparapadasthā eveti kena 
teṣāmiyatpadaprāptisaṃbhāvanāpi | atha ca sarva evātmopāsakāḥ śaivena 
pārameśvarādvayadarśanoktena jñānena paraṃ śivaṃ gacchantīti tantreṇa 
saptamī tṛtīye yojye | uktaṃ ca śrīmṛtyujiti ---- 

"ye vadanti na caivānyaṃ vindanti paramaṃ śivam | 

ta ātmopāsakāḥ śaive na gacchanti paraṃ padam ||" (ne0taṃ0 8-30) 

iti | 

atra hi paramaśivamanyaṃ vadanti, kevalaṃ na caiva vindanti, na punaḥ 
kenāpi pramāṇena labhante, sādhayituṃ śaknuvantītyarthaḥ || 

te tu sarve ---- 


ātmatattvagatiṃ yānti ātmatattvānurañjitāḥ || 4-392 || 


ātmatattvarūpatāyāṃ tattvaṃ paramaśivābhedākhyātyātmā saṅkocaḥ, 
tena ye'nurañjitāstadāśvastāḥ pāśupatādyāḥ, ta ātmano yattattvaṃ 
śuddhavijñānakevalatārūpaṃ tadgatiṃ labhante, na tu tāttvikīṃ muktiṃ 
bhedasyāparityāgāditi || 392 || 

muktaśivasaṃsāraṃ parijihīrṣuṇā ---- 


tasmādātmā parityājyo yadīcchecchivamātmanaḥ | 

ātmeti muktāṇurūpatā | śivamiti muktavikasitaparamaśivaikatām || 

tadittham ---- 


ātmatattvaṃ tatastyājyaṃ vidyātattve niyojayet || 4-393 || 


ātmānamiti śeṣaḥ || 393 || 

kātra vidyā ? ---- ityāha ---- 

unmanā sā tu vijñeyā...........

tāṃ vyācaṣṭe ---- 


.............ṃanaḥ saṅkalpa ucyate | 

saṅkalpaḥ kramato jñānamunmanaṃ yugapat sthitam || 4-394 || 


saṅkalpa icchā, sā ceśitavyaviśvakramāsūtraṇātmatvāt kramato 
jñānamityuktam | unmanamutkrāntamutkarṣaṃ ca manaḥ prāptaṃ yatra 
tadunmanam | yugapaditi viśvasyāsūtraṇāvabhāsananirmāṇādyantānanta-
śākhāśatabhinnasyāpyatra 
nityoditānandaghanasvātantryaśaktyābhāsātmatvenāvasthānāt || 394 || 

yata īdṛgunmanaṃ jñānamevonmanāśaktiḥ ---- 


tasmāt sā tu parā vidyā..........


māyāntāvadhikātmatattvordhvasthaśuddhavidyādiśaktyantādhvavyāpakād
vidyātattvādiyamanyaiva vidyā || 


..............yasmādanyā na vidyate | 


īdṛśītyarthād etayaiva aśeṣaviśvakroḍīkārāt || 

tadāha ---- 


vindate hyatra yugapat sārvajñyādiguṇān parān || 4-395 || 


parānityabhedarūpān sarvajñatvādīn yato yugapadatronmanāyāṃ yogivaro 
labhate, tata iyaṃ parā vidyā "vidḷ lābhe" iti dhātvarthānugamāt || 395 
|| 

kiṃ ca ---- 


vedanānādidharmasya paramātmatvabodhanā | 

varjanā'paramātmatve tasmādvidyeti socyate || 4-396 || 


anādidharmaḥ svātantryaśaktyātmā svabhāvaḥ, tasya vedanā vicāraṇā, 
ātmanaśca yatparamātmatvaṃ śivarūpatvamasti, tasya | bodhanā 
avagamahetuḥ, ata evāparamātmatve'tadviṣaye iyaṃ varjanā saṃpadyate | 
tasmāt "vida vicāraṇe", "vida jñāne" iti dhātvarthānugamādiyaṃ 
vidyocyate || 396 || 

evaṃ ca


tatrastho vyañjayettejaḥ paraṃ paramakāraṇam | 

parasmiṃstejasi vyakte tatrasthaḥ śivatāṃ vrajet || 397 || 


tatreti unmanākhyāyāṃ vidyāyām, vyañjayedātmīyamevonmīlayet 
pratyabhijānīyāt | tejaḥ cijjyotiḥ paramasaṅkucitaṃ paramakāraṇaṃ 
paramaśivarūpam ataśca śivatāṃ vrajet tadaikātmyamiyāt || 397 || 

etad dṛṣṭāntenopapādayati ---- 


supradīpte yathā vahnau śikhā dṛśyeta cāmbare | 

dehaprāṇasthito hyātmā tadvallīyeta tatpade || 4-398 || 


dehamantraprāṇātmaśivapadānāmaucityāt 
kāṣṭhāraṇivahnitacchikhāmbarāṇi dṛṣṭāntaḥ | 
tenāraṇimanthanayuktyā supradīpte prajvalite vahnau sati yathā śikhā 
jvālā dāhyaṃ dagdhvāmbare dṛśyate, tatra layāt tadātmabhāvaṃ 
prāptāvalokyate, tadvaddivyakaraṇamantrāraṇisamuttejanena dehe yaḥ 
prāṇastasmin supradīpte madhyordhvabāhyadāvāgnitāmāyāti, dehe sthito ya 
ātmā proktaśuddhavijñānakevalarūpo vahniśikhātulyaḥ samanāntaṃ 
samastaṃ dehadāruṃ dagdhvā tasmin pade līyate 
nirupādhiparamaśivaikātmyametyevetyarthaḥ || 398 || 

itthamuktayuktyā paratattvalīne ---- 


tadvadevābhimānastu kartavyo daiśikottamaiḥ | 


tadvat paramapadavadabhimānaḥ pūrṇāhaṃvimarśaḥ kartavyaḥ svīkāryaḥ
na tu pāśave śarīrādyahaṃbhāve vatītavyametadarthamevottamapadam || 

tamabhimānaṃ sphuṭayati ---- 


ahameva paro haṃsaḥ śivaḥ paramakāraṇam || 4-399 || 


etat pūrvavyākhyābhirgatārtham || 399 || 

ataśca ---- 


matprāṇe sa tu paśvātmā līnaḥ samarasīgataḥ | 

evaṃvidhasya mama prāṇe proktaṣaḍadhvavyāptimaye || 

taṃ pūrvoktayuktyā samarasīkṛtam ---- 


mantrakaraṇakriyāyogādyojayāmi pare śive || 4-400 || 


mantro niṣkalaḥ, karaṇaṃ divyam, kriyāyogo 
dvārarodhordhvavāhādharapadatyāgagranthibhedanādyātmā || 400 || 

na caitadvacanamātreṇa ghaṭate, api tu ---- 


evaṃ yo vetti tattvena agnivad dehamadhyataḥ | 

yadvadvahniśikhātītā tadvadyojayate pare || 401 || 


tattvenānubhavarūḍhyā ya evamiti śivābhedaṃ vetti, sa indhanakalpasya 
dehasya madhye'gnivat pāśānutploṣayati, 
dīptabhā(ssva)jyotirmātrarūpatayā sthitaḥ śiṣyātmānaṃ pare śive 
yojayate, tadaikātmyamāsādayati | katham ? vahniśikhā atiśayena itā 
vyomni līnā tadaikyamāptā yadvat (tadvat) || 401 || 

ataśca ---- 


tasmin yuktaḥ pare tattve sārvajñyādiguṇānvitaḥ | 

śiva eko bhaved devi avibhāgena sarvataḥ || 402 || 


yukta iti yoga ekyam | yathoktam ---- 

"yogamekatvamicchanti" (mā0vi0 4-4) 

iti | 

eka ityavibhāgena, sarvata ityanena cābhinnaśivavādasya vāstavatvaṃ 
dhvanati | sarvajñatvādikamihābhedasāraṃ mantavyam, na tu 
mantrādivadbhedaviṣayam || 402 || 

bhāvitritattvadīkṣāyāṃ

"jñātvā tattve niyojayet | " (4-404)

iti yadvakṣyati, tatrāpyetadeva mantavyamityāha ---- 


tattvatrayaṃ paraṃ khyātamaparaṃ cādhvamadhyagam | 

bhedanaṃ tu padārthānāṃ tyāgānubhavayojanam || 4-403 || 

pūrvoktaṃ ca idaṃ sarvaṃ jñātvā tattve niyojayet | 


paraṃ śuddhātmonmanāparaśivarūpaṃ yattattvatrayaṃ prakāśitam, 
yaccāparaṃ sthūlam adhvamadhyagamiti 
pañcamapaṭalabhāvitattvabhuvanādhvadīkṣāmadhye 
māyāsadāśivaśivāntavyāptyā ātmavidyāśivākhyaṃ tattvatrayaṃ 
pūrvaṃ prāyaścittaśuddhāvapi nirṇītametat trittattvadīkṣāyāṃ 
pradhānarūpam, tathā pūrvoktaṃ bhedanādi cakārāccāraṃ pramāṇādikaṃ 
ca jñātvā etajjñānaprādhānyenaiva tattve parasmin yojayet 
śiṣyamityarthaḥ | etacca dīkṣāntaraviṣayamapīti mantavyam || 403 || 

atheha paratattvasvarūpaṃ niścinvan 
bhāvicaturbhedatattvadīkṣāmadhye'saṃgṛhītāmapyekatattvadīkṣāṃ 
prasaṅgena sūcayitumāha ---- 


saṃkṣepeṇa tu tattvasya vyāptiṃ śṛṇu sureśvari || 4-404 || 


surāṇāṃ brahmādiśivāntānāṃ kāraṇānāmīśvari 
parasvātantryaśaktirūpe || 404 || 


vidyātattvāspadaṃ baddhvā vindutattvāsane sthitaḥ | 

nādaśaktitanuścaiva vyāpinīkaraṇānvitaḥ || 405 || 


vidyātattve śuddhavidyāyāṃ 
proktakaraṇāvaṣṭambhalabhyamadhyavikāsenāspadamavasthitiṃ baddhvā, atha 
ca vidyāyā mātṛkāyāstattve mūlamantre vā sthitiṃ baddhvā, 
taduccārāvahito bhūtvā māntre 
bindutattve'bhinnavedyajyotīrūpe'śeṣaviśvaviśrāntisthānatvādāsane 
sthito'dhirūḍhaḥ, nādo vimarśamātrarūpo hlādānubhavātmakaḥ 
śaktyantastanuḥ śarīraṃ yasya, vyāpinī śaktyantādhvavyāpikā 
karaṇamāntaramupalabdhisādhanaṃ yasya guroḥ, sa sarvaṃ jñātvā tattve 
niyojayediti pūrvoktena saṃbaṃdhaḥ || 405 || 

asya karaṇarūpā yā vyāpinī ---- 


sarvajñatvāvabodhena samanā...........


saivetyarthaḥ || 


.................'ntaścarā tu sā | 


saivāsyāntaḥkaraṇamityarthaḥ || 

evamīdṛśe tattvāsane śarīrāntarbahiṣkaraṇasyāsya ---- 


tritattvaṃ yatparaṃ proktaṃ tena cāpūritā tanuḥ || 4-406 || 


parādiśaktitrayamayena ātmakalpenetyarthaḥ || 406 || 

etacca tritattvaṃ yasmādadhvātītaṃ samanāntamatikramya sthitaṃ 
tasmātparaṃ tattvam, yattu māyāsadāśivaśivavyāptyā tadaparaṃ 
yasmādadhvamadhyagam, ata evāpareṇātmāditattvatrayeṇa dharādeḥ 
śivāntasyāntaḥkṛtatvāt tadārabdhā ---- 


aparā sā tanuḥ sthūlā ṣaṭtriṃśattattvakalpitā | 


iyaṃ punaḥ ---- 


tattvatrayaṃ paraṃ yacca sarvatattvādhvavajītam || 4-407 || 

tena cāpūritāśeṣaṃ sā tattvādhvaparā tanuḥ | 


samastādhvātikrāntaṃ yat śuddhātmāditattvatrayaṃ 
tenoktasatattvenāśeṣaṃ kṛtvā āpūritā sarvātmatābhāsanena vyāptā 
yā prakrāntā nādaśaktyātmā tanuḥ sā tattvādhvanaḥ sakāśāt parā 
prakṛṣṭā || 407 || 

evamīdṛkśivābhedavimarśamaya eva yathārtha ācāryo bhavatītyāha ---- 


evamācarate yastu ācāraṃ tu śivātmakam || 4-408 || 

śivena sahacāritvādācāryastena cocyate | 


ācāraḥ proktasphārānupraveśaḥ sahacāritvaṃ 
tadabhedavimarśaparamārtham || 408 || 

asya māhātmyamāha ---- 


tasya darśanasambhāṣāsparśanāt smaraṇādapi || 4-409 || 

bhavatyevaiśvarī vyāptirna bhavettadadhogatiḥ | 


yato'sya karaṇāni proktavyāpinīsamanāvyāptimayāni, 
tatastatsaṅgādīśvarasya śivatattvasya vyāptirbhavatyeva dehānte, na tu 
śivādadhaḥ pravṛttiḥ kadācidapi | yo'pi taṃ yathārūpaṃ bhaktyā 
paśyati so'pyevam, tena tasyeti kartari karmaṇi ca ṣaṣṭhī || 409 || 

yastu anuttaraśaktipātavaśāt ---- 


tena saṃyojito jantuḥ............

........brahmahāpi śivo bhavet || 4-410 || 


paramaśiva eva || 410 || 

tadevaṃ bhavati ---- 

tatastena samo nāsti jagatyasmiṃścarācare | 

tena śivaikātmanācāryeṇa kaḥ samaḥ, tasyaikatvāt || 

ataśca ---- 


śiva ācāryarūpeṇa lokānugrahakārakaḥ || 4-411 || 


anujighṛkṣāparo hi paramaśiva ācāryadehamāsthāya paśūnāṃ 
pāśānnikṛntati || 411 || 

yata evam ---- 


tasmānna mānakā buddhiṃ kārayed deśakaṃ prati | 


diśatyupadeśamiti deśakaḥ upadeṣṭā, tasmin daurātmyānmānakā buddhiṃ
kurvantaṃ nivartayedityarthaḥ || 

yato ye'pyete māyordhvavatīno'nantabhaṭṭārakādyāste'pi ---- 


ācāryasya ca mantrasya śivajñāne śivasya ca || 4-412 || 

nānātvaṃ naiva kurvanti vidyeśāścakranāyakāḥ | 


cakrasya vidyāgrāmasya nāyakāḥ prabhavaḥ svasvarūpajñāpakāśca, 
śivajñāne pārameśe śāstre ācāryasyopadeṣṭurmantrasya śivavācino 
niṣkalādestadvācyasya ca śivasya bhedaṃ na kurvanti, naitadbhinnaṃ 
paśyantītyarthaḥ ācāryādeva śivaśāstramantraśivānāmavagamāt | yatra 
ca vidyeśvarā apyevamabhedaṃ manyante, tatra tadanugṛhītaiḥ kathaṃ 
bhedadhīḥ kāryā | evaṃ ca ye ācāryaśivamantrānaikyena jānanti, te 
vidyeśvarā iti mantreśvarasphārameva viśanti || 412 || 

yuktaṃ caitat, yataḥ ---- 


brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā vai vīravandite || 4-413 || 

ācāryatve niyuktā ye te sarve tu śivāḥ smṛtāḥ | 


śivācārya eva hi ācāryo yuktaḥ || 413 || 

ye tu ācāryamitthaṃ na manyante, te pratyavāyinaḥ ---- ityāha ---- 
anyathā prāksvarūpeṇa ye paśyanti narādhamāḥ || 414 || 


narake te prapacyante sādākhyaṃ vatsaratrayam | 


adhamatvaṃ gṛhītadīkṣāṇāmapi gurudveṣeṇa vilayaśaktyāghrātatvāt | 
sādākhyavatsaramānamekādaśe paṭale bhaviṣyati || 415 || 

pātakisaṅgatirapi pāpāya ---- ityāha ---- 


na tena saha saṃbhāṣā kartavyā tu śivāthīnā || 4-415 || 

kṛtvā saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ tena narakaṃ so'pi gacchati | 


yata evam ---- 


tasmācchivasamāḥ sarve draṣṭavyā muktimicchatā || 4-416 || 


yasmāt ---- 


bhuktimuktiphalāvāptirbhavatyeva tadājñayā | 


asya ceyān prabhāvo yadayam ---- 


ācāryaḥ svajanānāṃ ca kulako (ṭi?ṭīḥ)sahasraśaḥ || 4-417 || 

jñānajñeyaparijñānāt samastāstārayiṣyati | 


sve ātmīyā vidyāsaṃbandhino janāḥ śiṣyāḥ, teṣāṃ 
"ca"kārādātmanaśca sahasraśaḥ kulako (ṭīḥ) jñānasya 
tāvadanugrāhyānugrahābhisaṃdhipūrvaṃ 
paraśāktasphārānupraveśasyopāyarūpasya, jñeyasya copādeyasya 
paratattvasya, paritaḥ samantādavikalpasavikalpasamāpattibhyāṃ 
paratattvaviśrāntyātmakāt 
śiṣyapraśiṣyādikrameṇānantakālavyāpinaśca jñanāttārayiṣyati 
saṃsārābdheruddhariṣyati | jñānajñeyaparijñānameva gurormukhyaṃ rūpam 
| yathoktaṃ prāk ---- 

"jñānajñeyaviśāradam" (1-13) 

iti || 417 || 

etadupasaṃharan prakṛtamāha ---- 


evamuktavidhānajño bhāvajñaścāpi daiśikaḥ || 4-418 || 

pūrṇāhutyaikayaivāsau paśūn yojayate pare | 


uktaṃ prāṇacārādividhānam, bhāvaḥ paratattvabhāvanātmā || 

pūrṇāhutau prayogaṃ jijñāsuṃ dekā pratyāha ---- 


pūrṇāhutiprayogaṃ tu kathayāmyadhunā tava || 4-419 || 


pūrṇatvārthamāhutiprayogamāha ---- 


ūrdhvakāya ṛjugrīvaḥ samapādo vyavasthitaḥ | 

nābhisthāne sruco mūlamuttānāgramukhaṃ samam || 4-420 || 

srucyupari sruvaṃ devi kṛtvā caivamadhomukham | 

puṣpaṃ dattvā srugagre tu darbheṇa sahitau karau || 4-421 || 

muṣṭinā caiva hastābhyāṃ gṛhītvā yatnato'pi ca | 

agrato dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ vāmaṃ vai pṛṣṭhataḥ priye || 4-422 || 

muṣṭibhyāṃ saṃgṛhītvā vai uttānakarayogataḥ | 

tato ghṛtena saṃplāvya abhimānaṃ tu kārayet || 4-423 || 

ahameva paraṃ tattvaṃ parāparavibhāgataḥ | 



ūrdhvakāya utthitaḥ, uttānamagrasthitavedikāpuṣkarādirūpaṃ mukhaṃ 
yatra, samamṛjutayā sthitam, srucyupari sruvamiti śivaśaktivyāpakau 
sruksruvau parasparonmukhau kṛtvā, ata eva ca puṣpadānam, ataśca śiṣyasya 
śaktistyaktādhaḥprasarā śivonmukhā śivena saṃmukhena pluṣṭeti 
bhāvanīyam | karāvityatra kṛtveti śeṣaḥ | 
hastābhyāmūrdhvādhaḥsthitābhyāṃ dakṣavāmābhyāṃ kṛto yaḥ 
pratyekaṃ muṣṭistena, ata eva muṣṭibhyāmityuktiḥ | yatnata 
ityanavaliptatayā | agrata iti sruṅmūlagatavāmāpekṣayā | dakṣiṇamiti 
sruvavadadhomukhaṃ śivavyāptyā, vāmamiti srugvaduttānaṃ ca 
śaktivyāptyā | yadāha uttānena kareṇa yo yoga ityarthādadhomukhasya 
dakṣiṇasya vāmena | saṃplāvyeti saṃpūritāṃ srucaṃ kārayitvā | 
ahameva paraṃ tattvaṃ parāpareti prāgvat parasūkṣmasthūlarūpatayā 
sthitamityabhimānaṃ niścitāṃ pratipattiṃ kārayet kuryāt || 423 || 

na caitadabhimānamātraṃ, yataḥ ---- 


tattvamekaṃ hi sarvatra.............


sarvaṃ hi cetyamānatvāt cinmātraparamārthameva || 

ataśca ---- 


............ṇānyaṃ bhāvaṃ tu kārayet || 4-424 || 


kārayediti prāgvat | māyāpramātṛtāsulabhaṃ bhedābhimānaṃ 
tyajedityarthaḥ || 424 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


yatkumbhe'dhvātra vinyastaḥ ṣaṭprakāro varānane | 

maṇḍale'gnau śiśorantaḥ sādhāraṇavikalpitaḥ || 4-425 || 

srucyadhvānaṃ tamāropya prāṇasthaṃ nāḍimadhyagam | 

prāṇadhāre samīkṛtya srucā dhārāṃ vinikṣipet || 4-426 || 


kumbhamaṇḍalāgniśiśugataṃ ṣaḍvidhamadhvānamājyarūpatayā sruci 
madhyanāḍipraticchandakarūpāyāmāropya, pūrvoktayuktyā prāṇasthitaṃ ca 
taṃ madhyanāḍigataṃ kṛtvā, ata eva madhyamaṃ prāṇaṃ dhārāṃ 
cājyasaṃbandhinīṃ sruggatāṃ samīkṛtyeti 
māntravahnidrāvitaṣaḍadhvarasamayatayā bhāvayitvā tāṃ dhārāṃ kṣipet 
|| 426 || 

kathaṃ kva cetyāha ---- 


vasudhārāprayogeṇa prakṣipejjātavedasi | 


avicchinnasaṃtatyā śivāgnau dvādaśāntasthe bāhye ca 
prāṇamājyadhārāṃ cāvibhāgabhāvanayā juhuyādityarthaḥ | 
vasave'bhīṣṭaphalāyātyuccairdhārāprayogena || 

atretikartavyatāmāha ---- 


nābhisthāne sruco mūlaṃ nayennāsāntagocaram || 4-427 || 

yathā yathā tyajeddhārāṃ tathā prāṇaṃ samuccaret | 


nābhisthāne yat sruṅmūlaṃ sthitaṃ tannāsāgraṃ prāpayed 
dhārāpātānusārāya madhyaprāṇaṃ samyagabhyastavāhacāreṇa ūrdhvaṃ 
caret, dvādaśāntaviśrāntaṃ kuryāt || 427 || 

evaṃ sati na kevalaṃ drutaṣaḍadhvarasamayī dhārā yāvat ---- 


prāṇo'pi varṇatāṃ yāti ṣaḍvidhādhvamayastu saḥ || 4-428 || 


yaḥ ṣaḍadhvamayaḥ prāṇaḥ, so'pi varṇatāṃ māntraparāmarśatāṃ 
yāti || 428 || 

evaṃ ca sati ---- 


ṣaḍvidhe'dhvani nāto'nyaḥ prameyo vidyate kvacit | 


ṣaḍvidhe'dhvani yaḥ kaścit prameyaḥ so'sminnavasare | ata iti māntrāt 
parāmarśāt | nānyaḥ kvacidapi, jāgarādau viśvatra sarvasya 
māntraparāmarśaśeṣīkṛtatvāt || 

yata evam ---- 


tasmānmāntre parāmarśe heyopādeyataḥ sthitāḥ || 4-429 || 


ye heyatayā sthitāḥ samanāntāḥ padārthāḥ ye copādeyatayā 
śuddhātmonmanāparamaśivāḥ sthitāste mantra eva 
vācake'ntarabhinnavācyātmatayā sthitāḥ || 429 || 

yasmānmantrairakārādidhvanirūpaiḥ ---- 


varṇaiḥ kāraṇaṣaṭkaṃ tu..............


pūrvoktaṃ tattattattvādhiṣṭhātṛrūpaṃ vyāptam, atastadvyāptyaiva 
viśvaṃ svīkṛtamebhiḥ || 

ataśca ---- 


.............ṣaṭtyāgāt saptame layaḥ | 


kārya iti śeṣaḥ || 

yadavadhikaṃ kāraṇaṣaṭkaṃ yāvadbhirmāntrairdhvanibhirvyāptaṃ 
taddheyatvena darśayati ---- 


akāraśca ukāraśca makāro bindureva ca || 4-430 || 

ardhacandro nirodhī ca nādaścaivordhvagāminī | 

śaktiśca vyāpinī hyetāḥ samanā ca tataḥ param || 4-431 || 

samanāntaṃ varārohe pāśajālamanantakam | 

kāraṇaiḥ ṣaḍbhirākrāntaṃ mantrasthaṃ heyalakṣaṇam || 4-432 || 


pūrvameva vyākhyātametat | ūrdhvagāminī nādāntadaśā | asya māntrasya 
prameyaikādaśakasya bhedakalpanāmayatvena heyatvam, abhedavimarśātmatve tu 
upādeyateti prāgvibhaktameva || 432 || 

mantrasthaṃ heyamuktvā upādeyaṃ prastauti ---- 


atra pāśopari hyātmā vyomava (dvindu?ccitsu) nirmalaḥ | 

śivatattvaguṇāmodācchivadharmāvalokakaḥ || 4-433 || 


samanāntapāśātikramādeva citā suṣṭhu nirmalaḥ śivatattvasya 
sadāśivasya 
saṃbandhibhirabhedasarvajñatvādibhirguṇairabhilaṣyamāṇairjanitādāmodāt 
praharṣādeva śivasya dharmaṃ pūrṇapañcavidhakṛtyasvātantryaṃ 
prāpyatvenāvalokayati, na tvadyāpi prāptatadrūpaḥ || 433 || 

yataḥ ---- 


pāśāvalokanaṃ tyaktvā svarūpālokanaṃ hi yat | 

ātmavyāptirbhavedeṣā..............


pāśānāṃ samanāntānāmavalokanamātmatvenābhimananam | svarūpaṃ 
pāśottīrṇacinmātratvaṃ yadetāvatparyantātmavyāptiḥ || 


..............śivavyāptistato'nyathā || 4-434 || 


tāṃ pratipādayati ---- 


sārvajñyādiguṇā ye'rthā vyāpakān bhāvayedyadā | 

śivavyāptirbhavedeṣā caitanye heturūpiṇī || 4-435 || 


ye vakṣyamāṇāḥ sarvajñatvasarvakartṛtvādiguṇā dharmāḥ 
paramopādeyatvenārthyamānatvādarthāḥ tān, vyāpakāniti 
aśeṣamantarabhedena kroḍīkurvato yadā svātmani bhāvayet tadā 
tadbhāvanāpariniṣpattirātmanaḥ śivavyāptiḥ | sā ca bhāvake caitanye 
heturūpiṇī prayojikā,  tatprasādādeva 
śuddhātmanastadbhāvanāprarūḍheḥ || 435 || 

yato'yamevaṃ sarvajñatvādiguṇayuktaḥ ---- 


ato dhamīsvabhāvo hi śivaḥ śāntaśca paṭhyate | 


viśvasya bhittilagnatvenaiva sphuraṇāddharmakalpasyāsau dhamīkalpaḥ 
niḥśeṣabhedopaśamāt śāntaḥ, abhedasārvajñyādiyogena śreyorūpatayā 
śivaḥ, paṭhyate ityāgameṣu || 

evaṃ paṭhyamāno'pyasau vastuto na śabdagocara ityāha ---- 


unmanāśca manogrāhyaḥ...............


unmanāḥ śaktyabhedātmano viṣayatvābhāvād vastuto na śabdavācya 
ityarthaḥ | 

na kevalamīdṛk śivo yāvat ---- 


..............ātmabodhe sthitonmanāḥ || 4-436 || 


śivavadātmāpi mana utkramya manobhūmimujjhitvā bodhe saṃvinmātre 
pūrṇatvasarvajñatvasarvakartṛtvādyātmani sthitaḥ | sthitaścāsau 
unmanāśceti samāsaḥ || 436 || 

yataścātmā śivaśca na manogocarastataḥ ---- 


vyāpāraṃ mānasaṃ tyaktvā bodharūpeṇa yojayet | 

tadā śivatvamāyāti paśurmukto bhavārṇavāt || 4-437 || 


"tatsaṃvedanarūpeṇa tādātmyapratipattitaḥ |" (spa0 2-3)

iti spandadṛśā ādau śiṣyātmānaṃ svātmani samarasīkṛtya 
samanāntamatikramya śuddhātmani sthitiṃ baddhvā bodharūpeṇeti 
avikalpasaṃvitsparśenaiva praunmanāśaktyanuveśapramukhaṃ śive yojayet || 
437 || 

atra cāvasare ---- 


pare caiva niyuktasya sruvamāpūrayet punaḥ | 

sruco randhreṇa taddravyaṃ yāvadvahnau prayujyate || 4-438 || 

bahiḥsthaṃ kumbhakaṃ tāvat pare tattve tu bhāvayet | 


bahiriti ūrdhvarecakānte dvādaśānte || 


evaṃ ca yat ---- 


bahinīrodhabhāvena sāmarasyaṃ śivena ca || 4-439 || 


śabdācca tacchaktyāpi || 439 || 

tat ---- 


anyathā na bhaved devi.............

na kadācidetasyāśivībhāvaheturityarthaḥ || 


atra dṛṣṭāntaḥ ---- 


................ṇadīvega ivārṇave | 


etatsphuṭayati ---- 


sthitaḥ sa sāgare'dbhistu sindhuḥ samarasībhavet || 4-440 || 

punavībhāgaṃ nāpnoti tathātmā tu śivārṇave | 


adbhiriti sāgarasaṅgatābhiḥ | sindhurnadī ||

tāvad bahiḥ kumbhak samyāa samantāt diśet prāpayet || 441 || 

taditthaṃ pūrṇāhutau ---- 


anenaiva tu kālena bahiḥ kumbhakavṛttinā | 

ātmā samarasatvena śivībhavati sarvagaḥ || 4-442 || 


evaṃ śiṣyaśivīkaraṇānantaram ----

.................'ṅgaparimāhutīn | 


aṅgairnaiṣkalairaṅgamantraireva aṅgaparimā aṅgasaṃkhyākāḥ 
ṣaḍevāhutayo yeṣāṃ tān || 

śivatve prāpte yadyapi tadabhinnā guṇā api prāptāḥ, tathāpi te'sya 
spaṣṭamāntrapratyavamarśapūrvakasvanādodīraṇenāpi spaṣṭīkāryā 
eveti dṛṣṭāntapūrva nidīśati ---- 


yathā nṛpatve samprāpte kalaśaiścābhiṣicyate || 4-443 || 

vandibhiśca guṇāste'pi khyāpyante vasudhātale | 

tathā śivatve samprāpte guṇānāpādayed budhaḥ || 4-444 || 


dārṣṭāntike kalaśābhiṣekam ---- 

"dadyāt tato'bhiṣekaṃ tu" (4-448)

ityatra vakṣyati | vanditulyā aṅgamantrāḥ || 

guṇāpādane prayogamāha ---- 


sarvajño vai bhava svāhā paritṛptastathaiva ca | 

anādibodho bhava ca tataḥ svātantryaśaktikaḥ || 4-445 || 

tathā tvaluptaśaktiścānantaśaktistataḥ punaḥ | 


atra ca praṇavapūrvā hṛdādimantrāḥ ṣaṭ krameṇa pūrvaṃ yojyāḥ | 
sarvajñā api kapilādayo 
nivīmarśacinmātratvenānandaśaktirūpatṛptirahitāḥ | kecittu 
ānandaśaktiyuktatve'pi bhāvanayā tadrūpatāṃ prāptāḥ, 
natvanādibodhāḥ | dīkṣyasya tvanādibodhatvaṃ sthitameva sadabhirvyajyate, 
na tvapūrvaṃ janyate | kecittu sadā sarvajñatayā'nādibodhā api 
nirmāṇaśaktivikalatvāt svātantryahīnāḥ sṛṣṭyādikarmaṇi svatantrā 
api brahmādayo na nityamaluptaśaktikāḥ, nijāsu rātriṣu vyāmūḍhatvāt | 
mantramantreśvarādayastvavyāmūḍhatve'pi nānantaśaktikāḥ, tadapekṣayā 
viśvasya bhinnatvena śaktirūpatvābhāvādityekasyāpi śivanāthasyetthaṃ 
vyāvṛttibhedena sarvajñatvādayaḥ ṣaḍ guṇā vyākhyeyāḥ || 

guṇānāṃ gu(ṇi)1 viśrāntisāratāṃ sphuṭayituṃ mūlaviśrāntipūrvaṃ
mūlenaiva ṣaḍāhutīrdadyādityāha ---- 


guṇānāpādya sarvāṃstān mūlamantramanusmaret || 4-446 || 

oṃhūmātmapadopetaṃ sarvajñāyetyapaścimam | 

svāhākāraprayogeṇa āhutīḥ pratipādayet || 4-447 || 


ātmapadaṃ dīkṣyanāmapūrvaṃ caturthyantaṃ yataḥ ---- 

"anidīṣṭasamākhyaṃ ca yatkṛtaṃ tattathā bhavet | 

taduddaśya kṛtaṃ karma (phalatyeva na) saṃśayaḥ ||"

sarvajñāyetyupalakṣaṇam, tena tṛptāyetyādyapi | 
taccāpaścimamityetāvadantaṃ


pūrvamuccārya svāhākāreṇāhutīrdadyāt || 4-447 || 


tāśca sambhavavyavasāyānusāram ---- 


tisraḥ pañca daśaikā vā............

|| 

katham ---- 


paraṃ śaktyamṛtaṃ kṣobhya śiṣyamūdhnī nipātayet | 

turyadvāraṃ viśet taddhi sabāhyābhyantaraṃ smaret || 4-449 || 


dvādaśānte viśramya tatsthānamānandasparśātmakaṃ paraṃ śaktyamṛtaṃ 
kṣobhayitvā vimṛśya śiṣyasya dvādaśāntānmūtirghna patitaṃ bhāvayan 
kalaśāddhārāṃ pātayedityarthaḥ | turyadvāraṃ turyānubhavapradhānaṃ 
brahmarandhram || 449 || 

abhiṣekaprayojanamāha ---- 


mantraśaktibhirugrābhiḥ śoṣanirdahanādibhiḥ | 

śarīraṃ śoṣyate tābhistadarthamabhiṣecanam || 4-450 || 


tābhiḥ pūrvoktābhirmantraśaktibhiḥ | śoṣanirdahanādibhiriti karaṇe 
tṛtīyā | tadarthamiti śoṣanivṛttaye || 450 || 

atha ---- 


dīkṣānirvartanāt pūrvaṃ puṣpaṃ pāṇau pradāpayet | 

darbhaṃ vimocayitvā ca...........


pūrvaṃ (paratattvasya) kalpanāya dattaṃ darbhaṃ vimuñceti śiṣyaṃ 
prayujya pāritoṣikaṃ puṣpamasya haste dadyāt | yadvā ṇic vivakṣitastena 
gururātmanaḥ pāṇau pradāpayed dehīti śiṣyaṃ prayuñjīta, 
vidhirdakṣiṇāhīno mā bhūdityabhiprāyāt | evaṃ ca vadan 
guronīḥspṛhatvaṃ sūcayati | śiṣyastatkālaṃ vittaśāṭhyahīno yaddāti 
dadātu tat, guruṇā tu niḥspṛheṇaiva bhāvyamityarthaḥ || 

atha śiṣyaḥ ---- 


............śivāgnau kalaśe gurau || 4-451 || 


pratyekam ---- 


pradakṣiṇatrayaṃ kṛtvā daṇḍavannipated bhuvi | 


caturadhikaraṇaḥ śivo mama prakarṣeṇa dakṣiṇo'nukūlaḥ 
sarvadaśāsvādimadhyāntapadeṣvastu ityāśayena triḥpradakṣiṇīkaraṇam, 
daṇḍavannipatanaṃ śarīrādiguṇīkaraṇena śivasamāveśāya || 
ata eva ---- 


kṛtakṛtyaḥ prahṛṣṭātmā bhavottīrṇaḥ sunirmalaḥ || 4-452 || 

protphullanayanaḥ śāntastṛptātmānaṃ tu bhāvayet | 


kṛtaṃ pāśakṣapaṇaśivatvavyaktirūpaṃ kṛtyaṃ yasya, ata eva 
prahṛṣṭātmā pūrṇacidānandānubhavo'taśca bhavāduttīrṇaḥ, 
paramaśivatvavyaktyā suṣṭhu nirmalaḥ, tathābhūtaḥ sannapi 
vyutthānādyavasareṣu tṛptātmānamiti gurūpadeśādisamaye 
pūrṇānandaghanamātmānamanubhūtacaraṃ bhāvayet, yena sadaiva 
tanmayībhavati | atropāyaprakaṭanāya viśeṣaṇa (dvā)rakaṃ hetumāha  ---
- protphullanayanaḥ śānta iti | 

"kaivalyaṃ jāyate sadyo netrayoḥ stabdhamātrayoḥ |" (vi0bhai0 113)

iti rahasyadṛṣṭyanusāreṇa nirlakṣyastabdhadṛṣṭibandhaḥ śānto 
vigalitābhilāṣaprakṣīṇasakalavikalpajālaśca || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


iyaṃ nairvāṇikī dīkṣā nirbījā vā sabījikā || 4-453 || 


"atha dīkṣādhvaśuddhyarthaṃ" (4-79)

ityupakramya

"pāśasūtraṃ samādāya śiṣyadehe'valambayet" (4-91)

ityataḥ prabhṛti

"daṇḍavannipatedbhuvi" (4-452)

ityantaṃ yā nirbījā vā sabījā vā dīkṣoktā, sā ubhayyapi 
nirvāṇaprayojanā | "vā"grahaṇenedamāha ---- 

dvayorapi dīkṣayoḥ prokto yaḥ pāśakṣapaṇaśivayojanātmā vidhiḥ sa 
tulyaḥ, kevalaṃ nirbījāyāṃ māyīyapāśaśuddhibhāvanāvasare 
samayapāśamapyantaḥśuddhaṃ bhāvayet, na tu teṣāṃ śuddhau 
vidhyantaramasti | pūrvaṃ hi ---- 

śamayācārapāśaṃ tu nirbījāyāṃ viśodhayet" (4-147)

ityetāvanmātramuktvā

"evaṃ bhāvānusāreṇa śiṣyāṇāṃ guruṇā sadā | 

phalaṃ tu vividhākāraṃ niṣpādyeta sudīkṣayā ||" (4-150)

ityuktam | tathā

"................ṃukhyāḥ pāśā ime smṛtāḥ | 

sūkṣmapāśānanekāṃśca tadantarbhāvayet.......... ||" (4-158)

ityapyuktam | ato nirbījāyāṃ samayapāśā māyīyapāśāntarbhūtā eva 
śodhyatvena bhāvyāḥ, teṣāṃ 
kravyādabhogapradatvaśrutermāyīyapāśāntarbhāvasyaivoditatvāt | ata eva 
śrīpūrvaśāstre kaṇṭhagatamāyīyapāśaśuddhyante 
samayapāśaśuddhiruktetyetāvataiva tantrabhedaḥ | evaṃ 
dīkṣādvayavi(dha)1rekarūpatvenopasaṃhṛtatvād yat pūrvaṃ 
puryaṣṭakāṃśārpaṇaṃ nirbījaikaviṣayamuktam, tadayuktameva mantavyam || 
453 || 

evaṃ samayaputrakayordīkṣāmuktvā ācāryasādhakayo prakramate tām ---- 


teṣāṃ sabījikā dīkṣā kuryātteṣvabhiṣecanam | 


"vidvddvandvasahānāṃ tu sabīja" (4-88) 

ityuktatvāt tānevācāryatve

sādhakatve vābhiṣiñcedityarthaḥ || 

tatra ---- 


śrutaśīlasamācārān deśakatve niyojayet || 4-454 || 


śrutaṃ pārameśvarasaṃhitāyāṃ gurutastāttvikārthaparijñānam, śīlaṃ 
vāṅmanaḥkāyaviṣayā yamaniyamāḥ, samyagācāraḥ 
śāstrānuṣṭhānātmā, ete vidyante yeṣāṃ tān diśatīti deśaka 
upadeṣṭā ācāryaḥ, tadrūpatve niyuñjītetyarthaḥ | 

athābhiṣeka ācārye śivayogādanantaram | 

śivayogo yojanānto dīkṣāvidhistasya paścāt || 

kena kāryaḥ? ---- ityāha ---- 


pañcabhiḥ kalaśairbhadre sitacandanalepitaiḥ || 4-455 || 

śivakumbhavadabhyarcya ratnagarbhāmbupūritaiḥ | 

ṛddhivṛddhyādibhiḥ pūtairoṣadhyakṣatapūritaiḥ || 4-456 || 

sitapadmamukhodgāraiścūtapallavasaṃyutaiḥ | 


ṛddhivṛddhī āyurvedaprasiddhe oṣadhyau | pṛthagoṣadhīśabdaḥ 
sahadevyādau | sitapadmānyeva mukhāni tairudgāra ullāso 
bhogamokṣalakṣmīparāmarśaśca vidyate yeṣām | cūtapallavādīni 
sacchāyapatrāntarādyupalakṣaṇāya || 

athaiteṣu ---- 


pṛthivyādīni tattvāni pañca pañcasu vinyaset || 457 || 

kalaśeṣu mahādevi punaścaiva kalāṃ nyaset | 


tāśca--


nivṛttyādyāḥ kalāḥ pañca teṣu caivātra vinyaset || 4-458 || 


teṣviti pṛthivyādiṣu vyāpakatvena, cakāraḥ sahakramaṃ sūcayati || 458 
|| 

teṣvevāsanapakṣe ---- 

ekaikakalaśe vyāpyo hyanantādiśivāntakaḥ | 

bhuvaneśapuñjaḥ || 

tatra ca ---- 


pūjayed bhairavaṃ devaṃ sarvasambhārakaiḥ kramāt || 4-459 || 

ṣaḍaṅgāvaraṇopetaṃ mantrasandhānasaṃyutam | 


kramo nivṛttikalaśaḥ pūrvamityādirūpaḥ, āvaraṇāni śmaśānavarjāni,
iti kecit || 

evaṃ sampūjya ---- 


bhairaveṇābhimantreta ekaikaṃ kalaśaṃ priye || 4-460 || 

aṣṭottaraśatenaiva paratattvamanusmaran | 


eṣāṃ kalānusārāṃ diksthitimāha ---- 


vāruṇyāṃ saumyayāmyāyāmendryāmaiśyāṃ tathaiva ca || 4-461 || 

sampūjyaivaṃ vidhānena abhiṣekaṃ samācerat | 


tatra ---- 


yāgaharmyasya eśānyāṃ pīṭhaṃ saṅkalpayed budhaḥ || 4-462 ||

katham ---- 


tatra maṇḍalakaṃ kṛtvā svastikādivibhūṣitam | 

vitānoparisaṃcchannaṃ dhvajaiśca pariśobhitam || 4-463 || 

tatrāsanaṃ nyased devi śrīparṇīcandanodbhavam | 


śrīparṇīcandane praśastapadatvopalakṣaṇe || 


tatrānantāsanaṃ nyasya mūtībhūtaṃ śiśuṃ nyaset || 4-464 || 

pūrvavat sakalīkṛtya eśānyabhimukhaṃ sthitam | 


tatreti śrīparṇyādyāsane, śiśumācāryīcikīṣītam ||

gandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya nirbhartsyaḥ kāñcikaudanaiḥ || 4-465 ||

ityarthaḥ ||

caturṣvapi āśrameṣu ye sthitāḥ, teṣāṃ tvayā dīkṣā vyākhyā ca
