tadittham ---- 

śivadhamīṇyasau jñeyā............

sādhakadīkṣeti śeṣaḥ yatra sadāśivatattve yojanamasti || 

sā ca ---- 


.............ḷokadhamīṇyato'nyathā | 


aśubhaikakṣapaṇāt tattadbhuvaneśādipadayojanātmikā || 

ataśca ---- 


śivadhamīṇyasau yeṣāṃ sādhakānāṃ prakītītā || 4-482 || 

teṣāṃ kṛtvābhiṣekaṃ tu...............


vakṣyamāṇarūpam | 

tāneva ---- 


..............ṣādhakatve niyojayet | 


tatra ---- 


sādhakasyābhiṣeko'yaṃ vidyādīkṣāta uttaraḥ || 4-483 || 


vidyā sakalamantrastatkṛtā vidyātmakasadāśivapadayojanātmā 
śivapadayojanādanantarabhāvinī yā dīkṣā, tata uttaraḥ 
sādhakasyāyamitīdānīmeva kathyamānaprakāro'bhiṣekaḥ kāryaḥ || 483 || 

yadyapi sakalamantrasyāpi parapadaprāptihetutvamasti, tathāpi ---- 


vidyādīkṣā bhavet sā tu vāsanābhedataḥ sthitā | 

uktaṃ hi "mantramudrādhvadravyāṇāṃ homaḥ sādhāraṇaḥ" (4-82) 

ityādi || 

ata eva ---- 


karmabhedo na vidyeta sarvatrādhvani saṃsthitaḥ || 4-484 || 


karma pāśakṣapaṇam || 484 || 

ataśca ---- 


kṛtāni yāni karmāṇi sarvāṇyadhvagatāni tu | 

tāni saṃśodhya vidhivat kalāpañcasthitāni tu || 4-485 || 

yojanyavasare bhedo vimarśaḥ sādhakasya tu | 


pūrvaṃ ca kalātraye kārmamalasthitiḥ sthūlatayoktā, iha tu sūkṣmatayā 
kalāpañcake'pi, iti na kaścid vyāghātaḥ | prathamaḥ"tu"śabdaścārthe 
bhāvīnyapi karmāṇi samuccinoti || 

atra pūrvoktaṃ vidhiṃ smārayati ---- 


prārabdhaṃ karma pāścāttyaṃ na caikasthaṃ tu bhāvayet || 4-486 || 


vartamānadehe mantrārādhanādi yat prārabdhaṃ karma pāścāttyaṃ ca 
yattadekatra kṣapaṇīyatve sthitaṃ na bhāvayet, nāsya mantrārādhanādi 
karmāpi kṣapayedityarthaḥ || 486 || 

nirṇītaṃ caitat ---- 

sādhakasya tu bhūtyarthaṃ prāk karmaikaṃ tu śodhayet | 

prāk karma āgāmi caikasthaṃ bhāvayitvetyarthaḥ || 

ataśca ---- 


dhāma proccārya sakalaṃ sadāśivatanau nyaset || 4-487 || 


sakalaṃ dvātriṃśadakṣaram || 

katham ---- 


vidyādehasvarūpeṇa dhyātvā devaṃ sadāśivam | 

pūrṇāhutiprayogena aṇimādiguṇairyutam || 4-488 || 


vidyādeho'ṣṭādaśabhujaḥ sakalabhaṭṭārakaḥ || 

atha ---- 


aṇimādiguṇāvāptau mūlamantrasvasaṃjñayā | 

aṣṭāvevāhutīrdattvā abhiṣiñcettu sādhakam || 4-489 || 


yathā niṣkalayojanānantaraṃ tadguṇāpādanaṃ kṛtamevaṃ 
sakalayojanānantaramasyāṇimādiguṇātmatāpattiḥ kāryā | atra 
sakalamantrapūrvaṃ sādhakānāmaṇimā bhavetyuccārya punaḥ 
sakaloccārapūrvamaṇimādiguṇāya dīkṣātmane svāhetyādiprayogaḥ | 
aṇimādiguṇāvāptāviti tannimittam || 489 || 

tadabhiṣekaṃ prāgvat ---- 


kalaśaiḥ pañcabhiḥ kuryāt..........


kathamityāha ---- 

nivṛttyādyāstriṣu nyaset | 


śāntyatītāṃ pañcame ca śāntiṃ paścāccaturthake || 4-490 || 


triṣviti dakṣiṇottaravāruṇadiggateṣu prāgvaktrādipūrṇeṣu pañcasu | 
pañcama iti ceśāne | paścāditi śāntyatītānyāsādanantaram | caturthaka 
iti prācyakalaśe | atra cābhiprāyo yat sādhakasya 
śivadaśāviśrāntipūrvamavighnaṃ sādāśivī siddhirastvityevamuktvā 
bhogānayaṃ śivo bhavatviti || 490 || 

tadittham ---- 


śāntyā tu sampuṭīkṛtya............


śāntyatītākalaśānantaraṃ śāntākalaśanyāsāt śāntyā 
saṃpuṭīkāro bhavatī, śāntyatītāyāḥ kalātrayeṇa śāntyā ca 
garbhīkṛtatvāt || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


.............pṛthivyādyaiśca pañcabhiḥ | 


kalākrameṇaiva kalaśeṣu nyāsaṃ kuryāditi śeṣaḥ | pṛthivyādayo'tra 
kroḍīkṛtāśeṣatattvatattveśvarasphārā brahmapañcakaparamārthā, na tu 
sthūlabhūtamātrātmakāḥ || 

atha ---- 


ekaikakalaśe paścāt sādhyamantraṃ tu vinyaset || 4-491 || 

vidyāṅgaiḥ sakalīkṛtya.............


sādhyamantraḥ sakalabhaṭṭāraka iha mukhyaḥ, anyo'pi vā 
puṣpapātānusāram, vidyāṅgairiti sakalāṅgaiḥ 
sarvajñatvādirūpaistattatsādhyamantrāṅgairvā || 

paścāttatra ---- 


.............vidyāṅgāvaraṇaṃ nyaset | 


vidyāṅgānāṃ sarvajñatvādirūpāṇāmeva 
siddhisādhanānuguṇyānnāvaraṇāntaranyāsa uktaḥ || 

atha sādhyamantreṇaiva ---- 


saṃmantryāṣṭaśatenaiva ekaikaṃ kalaśaṃ tataḥ || 4-492 || 

bahirmaṇḍalake nyasya āsanaṃ praṇavena tu | 

sādhakaṃ tatra saṃsthāpya sakalīkaraṇaṃ tataḥ || 4-493 || 

nirbhartsya pūrvavat sarvaiḥ sādhyamantreṇa secayet | 


nivṛtyādyekaikakalaśasya sādhyamantreṇa mantraṇaṃ sarvabhūmayo'sya 
mantraprasādāt siddhipradā bhavantviti | bahiriti yāgād | maṇḍale 
svastikādirūpe | āsanaṃ śrīparṇyādirūpam | sakalīkaraṇamiti, tasya 
kuryāditi śeṣaḥ | sarvairiti pūrvoktaiḥ kāñcikādidravyaiḥ || 

tatra ---- 


nivṛtyāditribhiḥ kumbhaiḥ snāpayet pūrvadiṅmukham || 4-494 || 

śāntyatītaṃ ghaṭaṃ paścād gṛhītvā secayecchiśum | 

śāntiṃ paścāttu gṛhṇīyāt............


śāntimiti śāntighaṭam || 

tadittham ---- 


...............ṣampuṭenābhiṣecayet || 4-495 || 


saṃpuṭārthastadabhiprāyaśca vyākṛta eva || 

tadevam ---- 


sādhakasyābhiṣeko'yamanulomavilomataḥ | 


ānulomyaṃ nivṛttyāditraye, śāntiśāntyatītayostu prātilomyam || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


abhiṣicya praveśyainaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ mūtīmāsthitam || 4-496 || 


parivatītavastra ityarthāt, dakṣiṇamūrtyāśrayaṇaṃ vighnapraśamāya || 
496 || 

tatrāsya ca ---- 


praṇavenāsanaṃ dattvā sakalīkaraṇaṃ bhavet | 


athāsya siddhyupakaraṇam ---- 


sādhakasyādhikārārthamakṣamālādi kalpayet || 4-497 || 


samucitaṃ ḍhaukayet || 497 || 

kalpayitvaitat ---- 


mantrakalpākṣasūtraṃ ca khaṭikāṃ chatrapāduke | 

uṣṇīṣarahitaṃ dattvā.............

kalpaḥ sādhyamantrapustikā, uṣṇīṣa ācāryāyaiva deyaḥ | 


atha ---- 


...............praviśya śivasaṃnidhau || 4-498 || 

vijñāpya parameśānaṃ sādhako'yaṃ mayā kṛtaḥ | 

bhūyāt siddhistvadājñātastriprakārāsya bhaktitaḥ || 4-499 || 

sādhyamantraṃ dadet paścāt puṣpodakasamanvitam | 


śivasaṃnidhānanimittaṃ praviśyāntarmukhībhūya tadavaṣṭambhenaiva 
devaṃ vijñāpya sādhyamantraṃ dadyāt, sādhako'yamityādi vijñapteḥ 
svarūpam, vijñapteḥ paścāt pūrvavallabdhānujñatvaṃ bhavyam, 
śivasaṃnidhāveva ca puṣpaṃ phalotpādanadhiyā, udakaṃ siddhyāpyāyanāya 
|| 

tadāha ---- 


tasya haste samarpyeta siddhyarthaṃ sādhakasya tu || 500 || 


paraśaktita udbhūtaṃ tacchaktisaṃmukhībhūtametadityabhiprāyād hastena 
haste samarpaṇam || 

sādhakastu ---- 


praṇamyobhau gṛhītvā tu mantraṃ hṛdi niveśayet | 


ubhau gurumantrau, hṛdīti svātmānaṃ tattadvimarśamayaṃ kurvītetyarthaḥ 
|| 

tadevamubhayoryogyasaṃbandhalābhāt ---- 


prahṛṣṭavadanaḥ śiṣyo guruścāpi praharṣavān || 4-501 || 


ubhau nirgatya ca ---- 


agnyāgāre sāvadhānau...............


syātāmiti śeṣaḥ || 

tato gururagnau tu ---- 


...............ṭarpayenmantrasaṃhitām | 


tato'pi yathāsaṃbhavam ---- 


sahasraṃ vā śataṃ vāpi sādhyamantrasya tarpaṇam || 4-502 || 


kuryāt || 

evaṃ saṃtarpayitvā tu puṣpaṃ pāṇau pradāpayet | 

prāgvad guruḥ sādhakāya, tena vātmana ityarthaḥ || 

tataḥ sādhakaḥ ---- 

tristhaṃ sampūjya devaṃ tu...............

sthaṇḍilavahnigurumūtīṣu daṇḍavannipatet || 


...........ṭato'pi triḥpradakṣiṇam || 503 || 


kṛtvā || 


praṇamya bhaktiyuktātmā aṇimādiphalaṃ labheta | 


tadyogyatāmeti || 

gurustu ---- 


utthāpya sādhakaṃ brūyāt samayān pāhi yatnataḥ || 4-504 || 


te'gre bhaviṣyanti || 

kiṃ ca nirbījadīkṣādīkṣitavarjaṃ sarve śiṣyāḥ samayān śrāvyā 
ityādiśati ---- 


dīkṣāvasāne te devi śrāvaṇīyā vipaścitā | 


samayajñena || 

upasaṃharannanyadavatārayati ---- 


dīkṣāṃ evaṃ tu nirvartya sarvadaiva varānane || 4-505 || 

ātmayāgaḥ prakartavyo yathā bhavati tacchṛṇu | 


dīkṣāṃ samayyādīnām | ātmano yāgaḥ paratattvayojanātmā 
samucchedyapāśasaṃsparśavidhinyūnatādisaṃbhāvanāśaṅkāśāntaye 
kartavyaḥ || 

tadittham ---- 


vaijñānikī prākṛtī vā ācāryasya yadṛcchayā || 4-506 || 


dīkṣā bhavati | vijñānahetukā vaijñānikī | tilājyāhutihetukā 
prākṛtī || 506 || 

tatra ---- 

vaijñānikīṃ susūkṣmāṃ tu vidhinānena kārayet | 

susūkṣmāṃ pūrṇajñānasaṃpādyām | anena vakṣyamāṇena || 

tatra prākṛtī tāvat pūrvoktaprakārāt kiṃcidvailakṣaṇyenāha ---- 


tilājyādisamāyuktā adhvavāgīśikalpanā || 4-507 || 


prākṛtyāṃ kāryeti śeṣaḥ || 507 || 

tatra ca ---- 


kalābhiḥ pañcabhirvyāptamadhvānaṃ yugapannyaset | 


na tu prāgvat || 

krameṇa ca tadvyanakti ---- 


pūjāhomopacārādyān kṛtvātmānaṃ niyojayet || 4-508 || 

śiṣyacaitanyavat...............


vāgīśyāṃ yugapadaśeṣakalāvyāptikāyāmāhvānārcādipūrvaṃ 
puryaṣṭakarūpamātmānaṃyojayet | 

tato'pi ---- 


..........yogādadhvānaṃ yugapannyaset | 


garbhayojanādanantaraṃ dīkṣyamadhvānaṃ yugapannyaset || 

nyastaṃ ca ---- 


puṣpādyaiḥ pūjayitvā taṃ...........


tatraiva ---- 


...............yogārthamāhutitrayam || 4-509 || 


praṇavamūlahaṃsabījapūrvamātmānaṃ sarvādhvavyāpakaṃ vāgīśīgarbhe
yugapadyojayāmi svāhā ityatra prayogaḥ || 509 || 

atha ---- 


garbhadhāritvajanane arjane bhogatallaye | 

yugapaddhomayed devi mūlamantreṇa suvrataḥ || 4-510 || 


pratyekaṃ yugapaditi sarvādhvavyāptibhāvanayā trirhomaḥ || 510 || 


tadāha ---- 


āhutīnāṃ trayaṃ homyaṃ pratikarma varānane | 


niṣkṛteḥ prādhānyāt pṛthagghomamāha ---- 

hotavyā niṣkṛtibhīnnā pañcasthānakalātmasu || 4-511 || 

śatamekaṃ tadardhaṃ vā..............


pañca pṛthivyādīni sthānāni yāsāṃ kalānāṃ tadātmasu tadviṣaye | 
tena nivṛttau maccaitanyasya garbhādhānādikarmapañcake niṣkṛtirastu
svāhā iti prayogaḥ | evamanyatra || 

eṣā ca ---- 


.........ṇiṣkṛtiḥ parikītītā | 


pūrvameva nirṇītā | 

atha ---- 


viśleṣapāśacchedādye dhāmnaiva yugapaddhutiḥ || 4-512 || 

uddhāre cātmatattvasthe................


ādipadādvidhipūraṇe pāśadāhe ca yugapadeva pūrṇāhomaḥ | atra ca
tāḍanacchedanagrahaṇaikacaitanyabhāvanakāraṇāhvānapuryaṣṭakāṃ-
śārpaṇaṃ pūrvata upajīvyam, puryaṣṭakāṃśārpaṇaṃ sabījāyāmapi 
bhavatīti nirṇītatvāt || 

atha ---- 


............pūrṇāhutiṃ tu pātayet | 


tayaiva ca ---- 


ātmānaṃ yojayettattve śive paramakāraṇe || 4-513 || 


tato'pi ---- 


guṇān pūrvavadāpādya...........


avabhṛthasnānena || 

tāneva ---- 


............'mṛtān pūrvavat kuru | 


amṛtān avinaśvarān | 

seyaṃ prākṛtī ---- 


ātmadīkṣā.....................


putrakādidīkṣyāṇām ---- 


......ṣamāptau tu prāyaścittanivṛttaye || 4-514 || 


paśusaṃsarganyūnātiriktavidhisaṃbhāvanāśaṅkāśāntyarthamityarthaḥ || 
514 || 


nanvātmano'śuddhasya yo dīkṣayā śuddhimādatte, so'pi 
yadyaśuddhastadandhenāndhasya hastagrahaṇam | atha prāṇādivilakṣaṇatayā 
pratyabhijñāto'sau śuddhaḥ, tahī tatpaparāmarśādeva sarvaṃ 
saṃpannamiti kiṃ prākṛtyā dīkṣayā ? satyametat, yadi 
śaktipātavaśādeva rūḍhiḥ syāt, tadā prākṛtī naiva kāryā | tadā tu 
kuśalaikasampādyāṃ vijñānadīkṣāmāha ---- 


atha vijñānarūpeṇa sakṛduccāralakṣaṇā | 


dīkṣā bhavati | madhyadhāmasamanupraveśena yaḥ 
svapūrṇāhaṃparāmarśamayasya mūlamantrasya sakṛduccāraḥ, sa eva 
lakṣaṇaṃ yasyāḥ (sā vijñānadīkṣā) || 

yataḥ ---- 


heyopādeyapāśānāṃ yugapad bhairaveṇa tu || 4-515 || 


bhairaveṇa niṣkalena sakṛduccāritena māyāntānāṃ bhedaikarasatvena 
heyānām, samanāntānāṃ bhedābhedarūpatayopādeyānām, tathāpi 
bhedāṃśasaṃbandhāt pāśavyapadeśyānāṃ yugapat śuddhirbhavatīti 
śeṣaḥ | uktaṃ ca prāk ---- 

śakṛduccārito devi nāśayet sarvakilviṣam" (1-44)

iti || 515 || 

na kevalaṃ yugapat pāśakṣapaṇaṃ mantreṇa kriyate, yāvatparamaśivapade--
--


śāśvatī saṃsthitiḥ paścāt...........


eṣā ca ---- 


..........ṣūkṣmadīkṣā prakītītā | 


itthamātmadīkṣānte ---- 


viśeṣapūjanaṃ homaṃ yathāśakti prakalpayet || 4-516 || 

vādyagītasunṛtyādyaiḥ stutibhiḥ pūjayeddharam | 

triḥ pradakṣiṇamāvartya kalaśāgnisamaṇḍalam || 4-517 || 

aṣṭāṅgapatanaṃ kṛtvā vijñapet parameśvaram | 


tryadhikaraṇaṃ devaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya || 

kiṃ vijñāpayet ? ---- ityāha ---- 


bhagavan paśuhetvarthaṃ yanmayāvāhito bhavān || 4-518 || 

tatkṣantavyaṃ sadā deva vidhisthasya mama prabho | 


vidhirdīkṣākarma | mameti tvayaiva dattādhikārasya || 

yadapi ---- 


vidhinyūnamakāmasya............


prāmādikaṃ vidhinyūnatvamapi kṣantavyamityartha || 


yasmāt ---- 


............pūjā śāstroditā yathā || 4-519 || 

na bhavedatibhūyiṣṭhā prākṛtairdravyasañcayaiḥ | 


yathā śāstre pūjā bhūyiṣṭhā vitataparipāṭīkoditā, tathā 
prakṛtipariṇāmarūpaimītairdravyairna bhavediti vinayaparā uktiḥ, 
anyathārghapātravipruṭsaṃskṛtānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ śivīkṛtatvāt kathaṃ 
prākṛtatvam vittaśāṭhyavivarjanācca mitatvamasya prayojakam || 

yata evaṃ tataḥ ---- 


avalambya bhaktimātraṃ vidhānaṃ yatkṛtaṃ mayā || 4-520 || 

tatsarvaṃ saphalaṃ me'stu suprasanne vibho tvayi | 


suṣṭhu prasādo māyākāluṣyapraśamanena pūrṇacidrasamayatvena sphuraṇam 
|| 

evaṃ vijñaptisamanantaram ---- 


prasannavadano hṛṣṭo varaṃ dattaṃ vibhāvayet || 4-521 || 


atha ---- 


upaviśya tato yāgaṃ saṃhareta kramāt priye | 


tatrādau ---- 


agraṃ saṃprārthya gṛhaṇīyāt sthāpayeccāstrarakṣitam || 4-522 || 


agravatī carvādi agram,

"devadevasya naivedyaṃ cāndrāyaṇaśatādikam | "

ityanyatroktatvāt paraṃ pavitrametanmā kaścidbhūtādiradīkṣita 
āhārṣīdityastreṇāsya rakṣaṇam || 

evaṃ kṛtvā ---- 


viśeṣapūjanaṃ cārghaṃ praṇipātaṃ tataḥ punaḥ | 

nirodhārghaṃ tato gṛhya arghaṃ savyāpasavyataḥ || 4-523 || 

dattvā visarjayed devaṃ dhāmamantramanusmaran | 


arghamiti ---- 

"paścādarghaḥ pradātavyaḥ surayā |" (2-136)

ityuktapūrvaṃ dattvā praṇipātaṃ kṛtvā nirodhaprayojano'rghaḥ 
prasṛtastaṃ parisamāpte vidhau svarūpaviśrāntyarthaṃ savyāpasavyata iti 
jñānakriyāśaktivyāptibhyāṃ dakṣavāmakarābhyāṃ dattvā visarjayet || 


visarjanavidhimeva pradarśayati ---- 


ātmano recakaṃ kṛtvā puṣpaṃ devāya nikṣipet || 4-524 || 


niṣkalenetyarthāt || 524 || 


saṃhāriṇyā ca saṃgṛhya mantrān pārśvavyavasthitān | 

vidyudvaccalitān dhyātvā dhāmadehe tu vinyaset || 4-525 || 


kaniṣṭhādikrameṇa dakṣakaraśākhāsaṃvartanātmā saṃhāriṇī mudrā | 
dhāmadehe sakalabhaṭṭārake | vinyasettadekalīnān bhāvayet || 525 || 

tamapi ---- 


vidyādehaṃ bhairavasya..............


niṣkalasya upalīnaṃ cintayet || 


................ṭallīnaṃ binduvigrahe | 


tanniṣkalarūpamakārādipraśamayuktyā jyotirmātrātmani bindau līnam || 

tamapi ---- 


binduṃ tu nādaśaktisthaṃ śaktirūpaṃ tu grāhayet || 4-526 || 


ardhacandranirodhikāpraśamayuktyā vimarśapradhānanādanādāntarūpatāṃ 
gamitamānandasparśapradhānaśaktirūpaṃ saṃpādayet || 526 || 

tadapi ---- 


śaktirūpaṃ vyāpakena praṇavobhayasampuṭam | 


svarūpeṇa sthitaṃ sat || 

prakarṣeṇa nūyate stūyate sarvairiti praṇavaḥ paraṃ tattvam, tena 
ubhayataḥ sampuṭitamityantaḥkṛtaṃ sarvato vyāptamityarthaḥ || 

tathā bhāvitam ---- 


saṃhāriṇyā tu saṃgṛhya dvādaśānte tu yojayet || 4-527 || 


tato'pi ---- 


pūrakeṇa hṛdi nyasya svasthānasthaṃ tu bhāvayet | 

svasthānaṃ nirupādhiprakāśānandaghanameva tat || 

sakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ rūpaṃ tathā sakalaniṣkalam || 4-528 || 

bhinnāvasthaṃ tu mantreṣu hṛtsthaṃ tatsaṃsmaret priye | 


sakalaṃ dvātriṃśadarṇam, niṣkalaṃ ca mantravirāme 
prakāśavimarśamātratattvam, sakalaniṣkalaṃ tu catuṣkalanāthātmakaṃ 
yadekamapyanujighṛkṣayā tridhaiva bhūtvā punarvaktrāṅgādibhūmiṣu 
bhinnāvasthaṃ tadevaṃvyāptikametadekameva māntraṃ rūpaṃ hṛtsthaṃ 
smaret || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


visarjanavidhirhyevaṃ............


yathā maṇḍale tathānyatrāpyāha ---- 


......'gnāvevaṃ........


tatrādāvagnim ---- 


.........prapūjayet || 4-529 || 


tato'pi mūlena ---- 


aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ prapātayet | 


taṃ ca ---- 


arghamācamanaṃ dattvā praṇipatya kṣamāpayet || 4-530 || 


kṣamayedityatrārthe'yamaiśaḥ pāṭhaḥ || 530 || 

kathaṃ kṣamayet ? ---- ityāha ---- 


maṇḍalasthaprayogena recakāpūrakeṇa tu | 

saṃgṛhya mantrasaṃghātaṃ yathāsthānaṃ prakalpayet || 4-531 || 


svātmano mantroccārānantaraṃ nāsikyarecakena nirgatya lokapālādikrameṇa
dhāmāntamāpūrya recayitvā svātmānameva pūrayet | tatra 
lokapālamantrāṇāṃ bhairavāḥ, teṣāmaṅgavaktrāṇi, teṣāṃ sakalaḥ, 
tasyāpi sakalaniṣkalaḥ, tasyāpi vyākhyātarūpaniṣkalanāthaḥ 
sthānamityayamevātra kramaḥ || 531 || 

itthamagnisthaṃ devaṃ visṛjya ---- 

jāgarayettadāgniṃ tu nityakarmanimittataḥ | 

mā bhūt pratidinaṃ saṃskaraṇamityāśayaḥ || 

atha ---- 


nirmālyanayanaṃ kuryādrajāṃsyapaharet priye || 4-532 || 

tataḥ praviśya vasudhāṃ prokṣayettāṃ śivāmbhasā | 


nirgataṃ mālyaṃ nirmālyam, na tu caṇḍeśakalpanayā, tasyā iha 
viśeṣanayeṣvacoditatvāt || 

atha ---- 


bahinīrgatya bhūtānāṃ balikarma tu pūrvavat || 4-533 || 


prāguktenaiva mantreṇa kāryam || 533 || 

atha ---- 

ācamya sakalīkṛtya liṅginastarpayettataḥ | 


liṅgino jaṭābhasmādiyuktān | uktaṃ ca ---- 

"śivasya paripūrṇasya kiṃ nāma kriyate naraiḥ | 

yatkṛtaṃ śivabhakteṣu tatkṛtaṃ tu śive bhavet ||" 

iti | 

(śivabhakteṣu =) śivadharmeṣu || 

anantaram ---- 


guruṃ sampūjayecchiṣyo yathāvibhavavistaraiḥ || 4-534 || 


athāsmai svātmānamanṛṇīkartum ---- 


deśādhyakṣo grāmaśataṃ maṇḍaleśastadardhakam | 

śatabhuk pañca vai dadyād grāmaṃ viṃśatibhuk tathā || 4-535 || 

dadyāttu grāmabhuk kṣetraṃ kṣetrabhoktā tu viṃśatim | 


viṃśatitamaṃ bhāgamityarthaḥ | etaccopalakṣaṇam || 


vastutastu ---- 


yena yena gurustuṣyet tatsarvaṃ vinivedayet || 4-536 || 

tatastvanṛṇatāṃ yāti vittaśāṭhyavivajītaḥ | 


vittaśāṭhye sati lobhādiyuktasya śarīrādipramātṛtvānuga (tvaṃ na) 
manā ? (ga)1 pi (mi?)2 litamiti dīkṣāsaṃskāro'sya na samyagvṛtta 
ityanumīyate | yatra ca śiṣyasyedṛg vṛttaṃ tatra gururdaṇḍāpūpikayaiva 
nirlobhaḥ siddhaḥ | ata eva prāk ---- 

"puṣpaṃ pāṇau pradāpayet" (4-503)

ityuktam || 

evaṃ viditayogyabhāvaḥ śiṣyaḥ ---- 


tatastu samayān śrāvyastantre bhairavanirgate || 4-537 || 


te cāgre bhaviṣyanti || 

atha ca ---- 


carukaṃ prāśayet paścāccumbakaḥ sādhakaiḥ saha | 

vāṅniruddhaḥ prasannātmā pṛthak pātravyavasthitaḥ || 4-538 || 


carukamiti prāthītanaivedyam | sādhakairityupalakṣaṇam | cumbati 
paramparāyātena guruvaktreṇa saṃyojyate saṃyojayati ca śiṣyamiti 
niruktyā cumbako guruḥ | paramapavitracarubhojane vāṅniruddhatvaṃ 
cittaikāgryāya, ata eva prasannātmā || 

sa ca caruḥ sādhakādīnāṃ jyeṣṭhādikrameṇa deya ityāha ---- 


anukrameṇa dātavyaḥ..............


evaṃ hi sati sa sa carubhojī ---- 


...............ṭataḥ siddhimavāpnuyāt | 


eṣa ca dīkṣāvidhirasāmānyarūpa ityāha ---- 


anenaiva vidhānena dīkṣitā ye varānane || 4-539 || 

brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāścānye'thavā priye | 

sarve te samadharmāṇaḥ śivadharme niyojitāḥ || 4-540 || 

sarve jaṭādharāḥ proktā bhasmoddhūlitavigrahāḥ | 


nātra anyatantra iva dīkṣitānāṃ prāgjātisaṃskāraḥ ko'pi, kevalaṃ
samayādibhedādeva bhedaḥ || 

ata eva ---- 


ekapaṅktibhujaḥ sarve samayinastu varānane || 4-541 || 


sarva iti brāhmaṇādyāḥ saṅkīrṇāśca || 541 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


putrakāṇāṃ bhavedekā sādhakānāṃ tathā bhavet | 

cumbakānāṃ bhavedekā na prāgjātivibhedataḥ || 4-542 || 


paṅktirityarthāt || 

yataḥ ---- 


ekaiva sā smṛtā jātirbhairavīyā śivāvyayā | 


uktaṃ hi prāk ---- 


"tasmin yuktaḥ pare tattve sārvajñādiguṇānvitaḥ | 

śiva eko bhaved devi avibhāgena sarvataḥ ||" (4-402)


iti | yata eṣā bhairavasambandhinī jātistata eva śreyorūpā ca
nityā ca || 

atrāyamevāgamaḥ pramāṇamityāha ---- 


tantrametat samāśritya prāgjātiṃ nahyudīrayet || 4-543 || 

putrakāṇāṃ sādhakānāṃ tathā samayināmapi | 


kiṃ punarācāryāṇāmetattantrāśritānāmeva | ayaṃ niyamo na 
laukikānām, tantrametatsamāśrityetyetadāvṛttyā yojyam | ataśca 
etattantradīkṣitaḥ ---- 


prāgjātyudīraṇād devi prāyaścittī bhavennaraḥ || 4-544 || 


nara ityāttadehādigrahaḥ || 

ataśca ---- 


dinatrayaṃ tu rudrasya pañcāhaṃ keśavasya ca | 

pitāmahasya pakṣaikaṃ narake pacyate tu saḥ || 4-545 || 


yata evam ---- 


avivekī bhavettasmādyadīccheduttamāṃ gatim | 

avivekī svātmānamiva dīkṣitān śivaikyena paśyan || 


yataḥ ---- 


avivekena deveśi siddhirmuktirdhruvaṃ bhavet || 4-546 || 


śivaikyadārḍhyameva sarvaśreyaḥsādhanamiti śivam || 


tantrārthapratijāgarāt pratipadaṃ sadvyāptisaṃdarśanāt
	samyaksaṅkalanākramāt prakaṭito dīkṣāvidhiryo mayā | 

uddyote'tra tamāmṛśantu guravaḥ śrīśaṅkarājñādharā
	dīkṣāṃ dīkṣyajanasya kartumabhito bhogāpavargapradām ||  || 


iti śrīsvacchandatantre 
śrīmahāmāheśvarācāryavaryaśrīkṣemarājaviracitoddyotākhyavyākhyopete
dīkṣābhiṣekaprakāśanaṃ nāma caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ || 4 || 





pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥ

" svacchandodyotaḥ "

dīkṣādīkṣaṇanirmāṇanānopāyapradarśanaḥ | 

jayatyanugrahaikāntaviśrāntaḥ parameśvaraḥ || 

atha paṭalasaṅgatiṃ kurvatī uktakalādīkṣānuvādapūrvaṃ 
tattvadīkṣāṃ prastāvayituṃ śrīdevyuvāca ---- 


kalādīkṣā sureśāna kathitā parameśvara | 

tattvadīkṣāṃ samāsena kathayasva prasādataḥ || 5-1 || 


sureśāno brahmādīnāṃ svāmī | parameśvarastu 
parabhairavasattānupraveśāt | samāseneti saṃkṣepeṇa vidhivistārasya 
kalādīkṣāyāmuktatvāt || 1 || 

evamabhyathītaḥ śrībhairava uvāca ---- 


samāsāt kathayiṣyāmi tvatpriyārthaṃ varānane | 


pūrvaṃ praśnena prakṛtāṃ tattvadīkṣāṃ nānābhedabhinnām || 

tatra ---- 


ṣaṭtriṃśattattvamukhyāni yathā śodhyāni pārvati || 5-2 || 

pṛthivyādiśivāntāni svavyāptyānuguṇaiḥ saha | 

yathā śuddhyanti deveśi tathā te kathayāmyaham || 5-3 || 


tattvadīkṣāyāṃ tattvānāmantarbhāvitādhvāntarāpekṣaṃ prādhānyameva
vyāptiradhvāntarāṇāṃ tu guṇībhāvaḥ | evamanyatra | yena prakāreṇa 
śodhyāni śodhanīyāni, yathā ca śuddhyanti tathā śodhakaśodhyagataṃ 
prakāraṃ tava anugrahaikaparāyāḥ kathayāmīti pratijñā || 3 || 

tatra ---- 


vidyārājasya ye varṇā navasaṃkhyopalakṣitāḥ | 

vācakāste ca tattvānāṃ............


śodhyatvenopasthāpyānām || 

yathā bhavanti tathā ---- 


................kathayāmyanupūrvaśaḥ || 5-4 || 


tatra ---- 


dharitryādipradhānāntamūkāro vācakaḥ smṛtaḥ | 

puruṣasya yakāro vai rāgatattvānvitasya ca || 5-5 || 


smṛta iti śrīśrīkaṇṭhena | ataśca tenaiva varṇena 
praṇavanavātmoccārapūrvaṃ tattattattvaṃ kalopasthāpanavadupasthāpya 
adhvasaṃdhānādiśuddhāśuddhatattvānusaṃdhyantaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvavat 
kartavyam | evaṃ sarvatra | puruṣasya spṛhāmayatvād 
rāgatattvānvitasyetyuktam || 5 || 


niyāmikāṃ vakāreṇa vidyātattvasamanvitām | 

kālaṃ kalāṃ lakāreṇa kalpayettu varānane || 5-6 || 


kiñcidvedanātmano'śuddhavidyāyāḥ kiñcidaṃśe 
niyamānupraveśānniyatyā saha nirdeśaḥ | kalāyāstu 
kiñcitkartṛtvātmanaḥ kriyāviśiṣṭāyāḥ 
kālānuvedhasyāvaśyaṃbhāvāt kālena saha nirdeśaḥ | 
sahanirdeśaścāyaṃ vācyavācakabhāvapradarśanāya | śodhanaṃ tu 
pṛthageva || 6 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


māyātattvaṃ makāreṇa vidyātattvaṃ kṣakārataḥ | 

repheṇa caiśvaraṃ tattvaṃ hakāreṇa sadāśivaḥ || 5-7 || 

praṇavena tathā śaktirnyasitavyā varānane | 


praṇavena bindunā | śaktiriti śaktitattvaṃ paramaśivarūpameva || 7 || 

ata eva ---- 


vyāpinīṃ samanāṃ cordhve tatraiva tu viśodhayet || 5-8 || 


tatraiveti śivatattve praṇavenaiva || 8 || 

etacca sarvaṃ pūrvoktena sarveṇa vidhinā ---- 


śodhayitvā krameṇaiva mūlamantreṇa suvrate | 

yojya ātmā pare tattve unmanātītasarvage || 5-9 || 

nirābhāse pare śānte īśāne cāvyaye tvaje | 


śiṣyadehe pādāntād gulphāntaṃ pṛthvī, gulphānnābhyantaṃ 
jalādipradhānāntāni trayoviṃśatiḥ, tatastālvantaṃ pumādimāyāntāni 
sapta, tato brahmabilopāntaṃ vidyādisadāśivāntaṃ trayam, tadupari 
samanāntaṃ śaktitattvasahitaṃ śivatattvam, iti tattvāni vinyasya, 
dīkṣyasya tāni sarvāṇi krameṇa pūrvoktavidhinā proktanavātmāvayavaiḥ 
śodhayitvā, ātmā pare tattve paramaśive, mūlamantreṇetyavayavāpekṣayā 
samagreṇa navātmanā yojyaḥ | kīdṛśe ? unmanāmatīte 
tadanupraveśānantaralabhye śaktimadātmani sarvage vyāpake | 
īṣadbhāsanād niṣkrānte sarvābhāsotthāpake ca, niḥśeṣabhedopaśamāt 
pare śānte, īśāne viśveśvare, avyaye aje ceti nitye || 9 || 

taditthamekaikaṃ śodhanīyatvena ---- 


ṣaṭtriṃśattattvamākhyātaṃ...............


pātrāditvāt samāhāre strīpratyayābhāvaḥ || 

atha ---- 

................ṇavatattvaṃ pracakṣmahe || 5-10 || 


tatra ---- 


prakṛtiḥ puruṣaścaiva niyatiḥ kāla eva ca | 

māyā vidyā tatheśaśca sadāśivaśivau tathā || 5-11 || 


etāni mukhyāni navatattvāni navabhirnavātmakaiḥ prātilomyena
pūrvoktavidhinā ---- 


śodhayitvā tu vidhivad vyāptyātmānaṃ niyojayet | 


śiṣyasya | 

prādhānyena tu ---- 


pañcatattvī yadā śodhyā..............


tadā ---- 


..............vaktramantrāstu vācakāḥ || 5-12 || 


taiśca sadyojātādikrameṇa ---- 


dharitryādi khaparyantaṃ śodhayet tatkrameṇa tu | 


tattvapañcakasyāśeṣādhvaśuddhyanuguṇāṃ nivṛttyādikalāvyāptimāha --
-- 


kalānāṃ yāvatī vyāptistattvānāṃ tāvadeva hi || 5-13 || 


evaṃ ca vadan kalādīkṣokto'tra sarvo vidhiḥ, kevalaṃ 
kalopasthāpanādyavasare sadyojātādimantrairdharāditattvopasthāpanādi 
kāryam | ataśca tattvapañcakametad bhagavadvaktramantrasphārasāratayā 
parabhairavamayameveti tadabhedavyāptireva paraṃ śuddhisādhanamiti 
śikṣayati || 13 || 

atha ---- 


tritattvamadhunā vakṣye yathā śodhyaṃ varānane | 


ātmavidyāśivākhyaṃ meyamānamātṛrūpam || 

asya vācakavyāptimāha ---- 


akāra ātmatattvasya vācakaḥ parikītītaḥ || 5-14 || 

māyāntaṃ tadvijānīyāt...............


akāra iti praṇavasatkaḥ (= praṇavagataḥ) | māyāntamekatriṃśatā 
tattvairaparivajīta ātmā śivaśaktermeya iti tāvatyevāsya vyāptiḥ || 


.............vidyākhyasyāpyukārakaḥ | 

sakalāvadhi tajjñeyaṃ..................


vidyā jñānakriyātmā śaktiḥ śuddhavidyeśvarasadāśivavyāptikā | 
sakalaḥ sadāśivaḥ || 

tadupari śaktivyāpinīsamanāśaktivyāpakasya ---- 


...............śivasya tu makārakaḥ || 5-15 || 


yastu tadūrdhvago bindurunmanāvyāptisatattvaḥ ---- 


khasvaraḥ..............


khaṃ parākāśaṃ svarayati śabdayati saḥ parākāśātmā || 


ata eva ---- 


............khasvarūpasya śivatattvasya vācakaḥ | 


taditthametadanusaṃdhāya prāgvadadhvopasthāpanapūrvam ---- 


śodhayitvā krameṇaiva..............


śiṣyātmānam ---- 


..............pare tattve niyojayet || 5-16 || 


khasvaroktavyāptisāreṇa praṇavena || 16 || 

taditthamatra ---- 


tattvadīkṣā samākhyātā caturbhedavyavasthitā | 


pūrvaṃ tu yojanikāgranthānte ekatattvadīkṣāpyukteti daśītameva || 

evaṃ praśnitāṃ tattvadīkṣāmuktvā, anujighṛkṣorbhagavatyā 
āśayaparitoṣāyāpraśnitāmapi padādidīkṣāṃ nirūpayiṣyan 
bhagavānāha ---- 


padadīkṣāṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ || 5-17 || 


varṇamantradīkṣābhyāṃ tulyetikartavyatāṃ bhuvanadīkṣāṃ tadavasara 
eva saṃkṣepeṇa pratipādayiṣyati, vistareṇa tu daśamapaṭale | tataḥ 
padadīkṣāmeva tāvadāha || 17 || 

tatra ---- 


vidyārāje tu ye varṇā navasaṃkhyopalakṣitāḥ | 

pṛthagbhedena teṣāṃ tu vinyāsaṃ kathayāmi te || 5-18 || 


tatra ---- 


navanābhaṃ puraṃ kṛtvā navapadmopalakṣitam | 


katham ---- 


navahastaṃ likhedveśma aṣṭaparvādhikaṃ budhaḥ || 5-19 || 


veśma maṇḍalakṣetram | aṣṭabhiḥ parvabhiraṅgulairādhikye sarvametat 
kṣetramaṅgulaśatadvayaṃ catuvīṃśatyadhikaṃ 224 
bhuvanādhvapratibimbarūpaṃ bhavati | tasmin sarvataḥ 
saptabhāgakalpanayaikaikasya bhāgasya dvātriṃśadaṅgulatvaṃ jāyate, iti 
tadarthamaṅgulāṣṭakādhikyadānam || 19 || 

atha ---- 


saptabhāgīkṛtaṃ tattu.............


kuryāt || 

kiṃ kṛtvā ---- 


.............ḍakṣiṇottarabhājitam | 

caturaśraṃ vibhajyādau matsyaiścaivātra cihnitam || 5-20 || 


bhāvinītyā brahmasthānāt pūrvāparadiśau aṅkayitvā, kiñcidūnena 
caturbhāgena kṣetramānena sūtreṇa 
pūrvāparāṅkayorvāmahastapratibaddhena dakṣakaragatāgrabhāgena 
pārśvayormatsyabandhākāraṃ rekhādvayamutpādya, tanmadhye 
sūtramāsphālya dakṣiṇottarabhājitaṃ kṣetraṃ kṛtvā, 
kṣetrārdhamānena sūtreṇa pārśvagatamadhyāṅkapratibaddhena koṇeṣu 
matsyabandhacatuṣkamutpādya, tatra sūtrāsphālanena caturaśraṃ 
vibhajyetyatra piṇḍārthaḥ || 20 || 

evaṃ caturaśre kṣetre pūrvāparāyataiḥ sūtraiḥ saptadhā vibhakte ---- 


koṣṭhakaikonapañcāśat sūtreṇa tu samālikhet | 


dakṣiṇottarāyatairmadhyagataiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ sūtrairekonapañcāśataṃ
koṣṭhakānutthāpayet || 

evaṃ kṛtvā ---- 


madhyame koṣṭhake sūtraṃ dvātriṃśāṅgulasaṃmitam || 5-21 || 

samālikhya mahādevi caturbhāgavibhājite | 


brahmasthānāccatubhīḥ samabhāgairbhramaiḥ 
paryantabhāvivyomarekhāvakāśaṃ parikalpya vibhakte ityarthaḥ || 
tatra bhāgacatuṣṭayamadhyāt ---- 


prathame kaṇīkāṃ kuryāt kesarāṇi dvitīyake || 5-22 || 

tṛtīye dalasaṃdhīṃśca dalāgrāṇi caturthake | 


yatra dalāni tadagraiḥ saṃdhīyante te dalasaṃdhayaḥ || 

pūrvokteṣu caturṣu bhāgeṣu vṛttavartanavidhimāha ---- 


dikṣu rekhāṣṭakaṃ dattvā pratidikṣu tathaiva ca || 5-23 || 

bhrāmayeccaturo vṛttāṃścaturaṅgulasaṃmitān | 


dikṣu aṣṭasvaṣṭau, tanmadhye cāṣṭau sūtrāṇi dattvā, brahmasthānāt
pūrvavibhāgāṅkeṣu caturo bhramān kuryāt || 23 || 

atha ---- 


dvābhyāṃ pratidigrekhābhyāṃ madhye sūtraṃ nidhāpya tat || 5-24 || 

sūtrāgraṃ tu tato bhrāmyamardhacandravidhānataḥ | 


pratidalasaṃdhi ardhacandradvayavidhānāya pūrvadigrekhāyāḥ 
pārśvarekhābhyāmupalakṣite madhye madhyadvaye vāmena kareṇa sūtraṃ 
ruddhvā, dakṣiṇena sūtrāgraṃ pārśvarekhābhyāṃ madhyarekhāntaṃ 
bhrāmayet | atra caikaikapārśvarekhā āyāmato madhyāt vibhaktavyāyāmena 
saṃsaktadalā bhavati || 24 || 

ardhacandrayorutpattihetupratidigrekhayormadhyadvaye madhyagrahaṇāya
kesarasiddhyartham ---- 


madhyasūtraṃ ca dātavyaṃ kiñjalkasthaṃ vipaścitā || 5-25 || 

kiñjalke kesare tannimittaṃ tiṣṭhanti | 


tenaikaikārdhacandramadhyānusāradalamadhyasūtrotpannakiñjalkasya 
pārśvayoḥ kiñjalkadvayotpādanāya ardhacandradvayotpattyarthaṃ 
madhyalābhe cādāveva sūtradvayaṃ deyam | evaṃ sākalyena dvātriṃśat 
sūtrāṇyetāni bhavanti || 25 || 

etadupasaṃharannanyatrāpyatidiśati ---- 


pūrvapatraṃ prasādhyaivamitarāṇyevameva hi | 


prasādhayet || 

tatra ca ---- 


kesarāṇi ca saṃlikhya catuvīṃśatisaṃkhyayā || 5-26 || 

patrāgrato nyasellekhāṃ vartulāṃ tu suśobhanām | 


pratidalaṃ trīṇi kesarāṇi | patrāgrata iti dalānyutpādya tadbahiḥ,
suśobhanāṃ sampūrṇām || 26 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


tasyāntaṃ caturaśraṃ tu kartavyaṃ tatpramāṇataḥ || 5-27 || 


tasyeti vṛttarekhāntasya padmasya | tatpramāṇata iti 
vartularekhāpramāṇarekham || 27 || 

sarvasyāsya vidhebhīttibhūtamādyaṃ vidhiṃ vaktumāha ---- 


pūrvaṃ brahma prasādhyaṃ tu viṣuvatsthena helinā | 


brahma madhyasthānam | heliḥ sūryaḥ || 

tatrādau ---- 


pūrvapaścāttataṃ sūtraṃ śaṅkunā sādhayet priye || 5-28 || 

dvādaśāṅgulamānena.............


śaṅkuḥ kīlakam || 28 || 

katham ---- 


......ṃadhye śaṅkuṃ praropya tam | 

pārśve bhrāmayedrekhāṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulasaṃmitām || 5-29 || 


śaṅkukṣetrāt ṣoḍaśāṅgulaṃ bhramaṃ dvāśiṃdaṅgulapadmārthaṃ 
dadyāt | etacca jighṛkṣitakṣetropalakṣaṇaparam || 29 || 

tatra ca ---- 


pūrvāhṇe grāhayecchāyāmaparasthāṃ sucihnitām | 

aparasthena sūryeṇa prākchāyāṃ lāñchayet priye || 5-30 || 


evaṃ bhramarekhācchāyāpṛṣṭhe pūrvāparadigaṅkanāṃ kṛtvā ---- 


dhruveṇottaradakṣasthāṃ lāñchayettu varānane | 


dhruveṇa śaṅkunā hetubhūtena pūrvanirṇītadiśoḥ 
sthāpitamatsyadvayamadhyasūtreṇa uttaradakṣasthāṃ bhramarekhāṃ 
lāñchayet | yadvā kvacidrātrāveva vidhātavye yāge dhruveṇeti 
caturdaśatārakārabdhaśarīreṇa dhruvanāmnā niścalena tārakeṇādau 
uttaradakṣiṇadiksiddhiṃ kuryāt | tatra  caivamāmananti ---- 
suṣiranāḍikāmukhena dhraukā mukhatārāmuttaradiksaṃsthāṃ lakṣyīkṛtya 
tannāḍikānusāreṇottarāṃ diśamaṅkayitvā dhruvanāḍitārānusāreṇa 
madhyam, tatpucchatārānusāreṇa ca dakṣiṇāmaṅkayet | tato 
madhyarandhrānusāraṃ pūrvāpare'pyaṅkayet | ata evānyatra ---- 

"dhruvavedhena vodīcīm"

ityuktam | yattu tatra ---- 

"prācīṃ vā dhruvatārayā"

ityuktam, tatra dhruvatārāsāmyena madhyaṃ kalpayitvā tadanusāraṃ 
prācīṃ gṛhītvā tadanusāramitarāṃ vyavasthāpayediti yojyam | dhruvaṃ 
dhruvasthānagrahaṇacaturaśrīkaraṇapūrvamekonapañcāśadbhāgānāṃ 
madhyabhāge pūrvoktakrameṇa padmaṃ kuryāditi | 

upasaṃharati ---- 


tataḥ samālikhet padmaṣṭapatraṃ sakaṇīkam || 5-31 || 


atha ---- 


dikkoṣṭhakāṃśca saṅgṛhya aṣṭasaṃkhyopalakṣitān | 

śeṣā lopyā varārohe ekāntaritayogataḥ || 5-32 || 


catudīkkadvārārthaṃ bahiḥkoṣṭhakapaṅktiṃ tyaktvā madhyapadmānusāraṃ
dikṣu pratidikṣu caikaikakoṣṭhakalopāntaritakoṣṭhakāṣṭakaṃ 
padmāṣṭakārthaṃ gṛhṇīyāt | evaṃ ca madhyavīthyā(ḥ) 
padmāṣṭakakṣetrasya dvāravīthyāścaikenaiva granthena svīkāra uktaḥ || 
32 || 

evaṃ cāṣṭasu koṣṭheṣu ---- 


padmāṣṭakaṃ tato dikṣu..............


kuryāt || 

atha ---- 


	.........bāhye dvārāṇi cālikhet | 


katham ---- 


vīthyardhasaṃmitāṃ devi śobhāṃ caiva prakalpayet || 5-33 || 

upaśobhāṃ ca tanmānāṃ kapolāntaṃ samālikhet | 

tathā kaṇṭhaṃ ca tanmānaṃ dvārametat prakītītam || 5-34 || 


bāhyavīthyā madhye dairghye sūtraṃ dattvā, ādye'rdhe vīthīṃ kṛtvā, 
parārdhaṃ kalpitavīthikṣetrādūrdhvato'rdhamānāṃ śobhāṃ 
dvārīyakaṇṭhapārśvotpadyamānaṃ vipulamavayavamupaśobhāṃ ca 
tadadhogataṃ sūkṣmaṃ bhāgaṃ kalpayet | kapolo dvārasyāgre vipulo 
bhāgaḥ | kaṇṭhastu kapolapuraḥsaro bhāgaḥ, taṃ ca tanmānamiti 
nirupitavīthyardhamānaṃ dairdhyāccaiva vaipulyācca kalpayet | kapolasyātra 
mānaṃ yadyapyarthasiddhatvānnoktam, tathāpi taddairghyāt vīthimānaṃ 
vaipulyāttadardhamānamiti saṃhitāntarādavasitam, ityetadbhāganiṣpattyā 
dvāraṃ niṣpadyata ityarthaḥ || 34 || 

tadittham ---- 


dvārāṣṭakavibhāgena navanābhaṃ puraṃ smṛtam | 


vidiśi dvārasyāmnātatvāt pratidiśaṃ padmatrayāntarāladvāradvayaṃ 
kuryāt | evaṃ ca dvārāṣṭakavibhaktaṃ navanābhaṃ 
navanābhisthānasthanavapadmametat puramaṇḍalam | atra ca devasaṃmukhaṃ 
dvāradvayamapihitaṃ kāryam | yathoktaṃ lakṣmīkaulārṇave ---- 

"dvāratrayaṃ pidhātavyaṃ paścimaṃ na pidhāpayet | 

tacca pūrvaṃ vijānīyād devyā devasya saṃmukham || 

pūrvaṃ tu paścimaṃ jñeyaṃ paścimaṃ pūrvasaṃjñitam | 

uttaraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ jñeyaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ cottaraṃ tathā || 

sāmānyaḥ sarvamantrāṇāṃ kramo'yaṃ śivabhāṣitaḥ | 

gopanīyaḥ prayatnena śiṣyāṇāṃ duṣṭacetasām ||" 

iti | 


etattu gurupāramparyeṇāyātam | tadyathā ---- 

"mūlādyakṣiparapratītatanugadvārāṣṭakordhvonma(nau1)
	ghorāditritayatrayātmavikacajyotirnabābjadyutim | 

mūlādigrahatattvaparvabhuvanābhedaprathaṃ bhairavaṃ
	svaṃ vande navanābhamaṇḍalarahaḥ sāraṃ navātmeśvaram ||" 

iti | 

asyāyamarthanyāso'tra ---- 

"dhāmnā tu rajasāṃ pātaḥ sitādyaścāgamoditaḥ |" (4-35)

iti pūrvamuktatvādāgamāntaroktavibhāgo'nusartavyaḥ | sa ca ---- 

"lekhyā cātra sitā rekhā śālipiṣṭakṛtā puraḥ | 

haridrāvarṇasaṃmiśrā kaṇīkā pītapiñjarā || 

sitapītāruṇānāṃ syāt kesarāṇāṃ trayaṃ dale | "

"tāni śuklāni vā kuryāddharitānyantarāṇi vā | 

koṇā raktāḥ sitaṃ pīṭhaṃ pratirekhā sitāṅgulāt ||" 

iti | 

tathā ---- 

"aṅguṣṭhaḥ śaktimān vinduścatasro'ṅgulayaḥ kalāḥ | 

tadādhāraṃ rajaḥ kṛtvā śaktisparśā (cca)1 bindunā || 

pātayecchaktigarbhaṃ tattena tacchaktimaṇḍalam |"

iti śrīparāyāmasti | athavā ---- 

śitaṃ padmaṃ vijānīyāt kesarāṃstu vicintayet | 

sitān pītāṃstathā raktān mūlamadhyāgrataḥ kramāt || 

kaṇīkā hemasaṅkāśā puṣkarā haritāḥ smṛtāḥ |" 

iti | 

ihāntaryāgoktadhyānānusāraṃ rajaḥpātaḥ kāryaḥ || 

atha ---- 


snātvā tu vidhivad devi............


dvārārcāṃ kṛtvā ---- 


..............praviśedbhavanaṃ guruḥ || 5-35 || 


tataḥ ---- 


pūrvoktena vidhānena sakalīkaraṇādikam | 


kuryāt || 


tataḥ sampūjayed devaṃ bhairavaṃ parameśvaram || 5-36 || 


kena ---- 


praṇavena................


navātmasatkabindūpalakṣitasamagrordhvavyāptisatattvenetyarthaḥ || 

kiṃ kṛtvā ? ityāha ---- 


..........āsanaṃ dattvā śivāntaṃ varavaṇīni | 


praṇaveneti kākākṣivadihāpi yojyam, tena 
pūrvoktānantādyanantamadhyānantāntavyāptinā praṇavenāsanaṃ 
tenaivonmanāntavyāptinā tūnmanābhinnaparamaśivavādinā bhairavaṃ 
pūjayedityatrārthaḥ | varamutkṛṣṭaṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ varṇayati 
parāmṛśati tacchīlā (iti) varavaṇīnī || 

kva kiṃ kathaṃ pūjayet ? ---- ityāha ---- 


madhye sampūjayed devaṃ svacchandaṃ parameśvaram || 5-37 || 

pūrvoktena vidhānena aṅgaṣaṭkasamanvitam | 


madhya iti padmakaṇīkāyām | vidhānamāvāhanādisurārghaparyantaṃ sarvam 
| aṅgānyapyatra praṇavenaiva svanāmajātyantena navātmanāvayavabhedena, 
mantrāntarāvakā(śā)1 yogāt | evaṃ padmāntareṣvapi 
vakṣyamāṇakapālīśādibhairavatadaṅgapūjā mantavyā || 37 || 

tadevaṃ madhyapadme kaṇīkāyāṃ varṇatadvācyadevatānyāsāvuktau, 
tatpatreṣvapyāha ---- 


patrāṣṭake nyasedvarṇān pūrvādīśāṃstataḥ kramāt || 5-38 || 


tatra ---- 


sadāśivaṃ hakāreṇetyevamādi varānane | 

prakṛtyantaṃ vijānīyānmadhye pīṭheśakalpanā || 5-39 || 


pīṭheśaṃ svacchandanāthaṃ madhyakaṇīkāyāṃ 

śivatattvādhiṣṭhāyakaṃ

vinyasya, sṛṣṭikrameṇa navātmasambandhiharakṣamalavayaūkāraiḥ 
pūrvādīśāntadalāṣṭake kapālīśa-śikhivāhanakrodharāja-vikarāla-
manmatha-meghanāda-somarāja-vidyārājān 
sadāśiveśvaravidyāmāyākalāniyatipuruṣaprakṛtitattvādhiṣṭhāyino 
vinyasyārcayedityarthaḥ || 39 || 

madhyapadme vidhimuktvā pūrvādipadmeṣu saṃkṣepeṇa nirūpayati ---- 


dikpadmakaṇīkāsaṃsthānaṣṭau devān prapūjayet | 

madhyapadme pūrvādidaleṣu yaireva hakārādibhirvarṇairye kapālīśādayo
bhairavāstāneva taireva varṇaiḥ pūrvādidikpadmakaṇīkāsu pūjayet || 40 
|| 

pūrvādipadmeṣu svacchandanāthasya sthānamāha ---- 


tatsthāne bhairavaḥ pūjyaḥ...........


praṇaveṇaiva pūrvoktena | pūrvapadmasya madhye hakāreṇa kapālīśaḥ, 
praṇavena tu pūrvadale svacchandaḥ | āgneyapadmasya madhye repheṇa 
śikhivāhanaḥ, śikhivāhanasthāne āgneyapatre praṇavena svacchandanāthaḥ 
| evamanyat | evaṃ caikaikabhairavasthāne paryāyeṇa svacchandanāthasya 
vinyastatvāt ta(da)1bhedavyāptisāratā sarvabhairavāṇāṃ 
tadadhiṣṭhiyānāṃ ca sarvatattvānāṃ śivatattvavyāptimayataiva 
daśītā, iti paramādvayamayatayā mahārahasyasāratā'syānuṣṭhānasya 
prakaṭitā, ataśca śarvataḥ sarvebhyaḥ" iti rūpaviśeṣeṇa 
mantrapadārthaḥ sphuṭībhūto jāta ityalam || 

pūrvādidalānāṃ kapālīśādisvapīṭheśvaradalabyatirikteṣu daleṣu
madhyapadmadalokta eva nyāsādividhirityāha ---- 


............śeṣā varṇairyathākramam || 5-40 || 


eṣa ca varṇanyāsaḥ pūrvamevāsmābhiḥ prastāreṇa daśītaḥ | atra ca 
pṛthak-pṛthak padmasthityā nava, sāmastyena caika iti daśa devagṛhā 
jātāḥ | bhagavato vidyārājasya bindusatattvatvāt tadavayavānāmapi 
pūjākāle binduyogo'vaśyaṃbhāvī | ekaiko'pi ca varṇaḥ 
pradaśītakramavyāptyā sampūrṇavidyārājasphāra eva | yadvakṣyati ---- 

"yataḥ sarvagato devaḥ sarveṣvantargataḥ smṛtaḥ | 

tatsiddhimuktidātāsau na varṇāḥ paramārthataḥ ||" (8-25) 

iti || 

evaṃ sṛṣṭikrameṇa nyāsamuktvā saṃhārakrameṇa dīkṣāmāha ---- 


śodhayecca prakṛtyādiśivāntaṃ surasundari | 


prakṛtirvācyarūpā ādiḥ śivaścānte yasya padajātasya tacchodhayet || 

katham ---- 


īśānadiśa ārabhya madhyapīṭhaṃ viśodhayet || 5-41 || 


īśānadikpadmagateśānadikpatrāt pūrvottarādikrameṇa 
praṇavādyūkārāntaṃ padanavakaṃ 
praṇavavidyārājoccārapūrvakamuccārya, prakṛtitattvasya 
antarṇītakṣityādiguṇatattvāntatattvajātasya 
pūrvavadantarbhūtetarādhvaprapañcasya cātraivāntarbhāvaṃ bhāvayitvā, 
"padanavakāya namaḥ" ityantena mantreṇopasthānādi pūrvoktaṃ sarvaṃ 
vidhiṃ kuryāt | evamanena krameṇa padāni tāvadviśodhayet 
yāvacchivatattvavyāpakaṃ madhyapadmagatamūkārādipraṇavāntaṃ
padanavakam | yastu "prakṛtitattvarūpādipadanavakāya namaḥ" iti kenacit 
kramo daśītaḥ, sa na yuktaḥ, kalādīkṣoktapadakramasya 
navātmavarṇagataprātilomyakramoccārasya ca prasiddhasyāvṛttyā1patteḥ, 
pūrvasya saṃhārakramasya copekṣaṇāt | atra padadīkṣāyāṃ 
navatattvadīkṣāvannābhyantādyanāśritānte sthānanavake 
padmanavakagatavarṇaikāśīternyāsaḥ kāryaḥ || 41 || 

evaṃ padādhvānaṃ śodhayitvā ---- 


yojayettu pare tattve śive paramakāraṇe | 


varṇādidīkṣāmapyatideśenātidiśati ---- 


evaṃ varṇāṃstathā mantrān bhuvanāni viśodhayet || 5-42 || 


kimavadhi ? ---- ityāha ---- 


kālāgnyādi śivāntaṃ tu...........


kathaṃ varṇamantrabhuvanadīkṣāḥ kuryāt ? ---- ityāha ---- 


............kalāvidhisamāśrayāt | 


kalādīkṣoktapraghaṭṭakapañcakānusāreṇa varṇādīn pratyekaṃ 
vibhajyetyarthaḥ | atra kalādīkṣāvanmantrā adhikriyante | iha ca 
varṇānām ---- 

"śabdarāśisamutthasya" (spanda 3-15)

iti nītyā bandhakatvam, padamantrāṇāṃ tu 
tattadbhinnābhinnatattvavācakatvena | yathā ca mantrāṇāṃ śodhyatve'pi 
śodhakatvam, tannirṇītameveti tadeveha smartavyam | tadevamiha 
tripañcanavaṣṭtriṃśadbhedena catuṣprakārā tattvadīkṣā 
padamantravarṇabhuvanadīkṣāścoktāḥ | tatra pañcadīkṣāyāṃ

"kalānāṃ yāvatī vyāptiḥ" (5-13) 

ityatideśāt, varṇamantrabhuvanadīkṣāsu ca "kalāvidhisamāśrayāt" (5-43) 

ityuktatvāt kalāvadadhvapañcakāntarbhāvaścintyaḥ | padadīkṣāyāṃ tu 
navadhā vibhaktāyāḥ prathame prākṛte praṇavādyūkārānte padānāṃ 
navake nivṛttipratiṣṭhe kale, pṛthivyādīni pradhānāntāni 
pañcaviṃśītatattvāni, bhuvanānāṃ kālāgnyādiyogāṣṭakāntaṃ śataṃ 
catuṣṣaṣṭyadhikam, kṣādiṭāntāścatuvīṃśatirvarṇāḥ, 
sadyojātavāmadevahṛdayaśiraḥśikhāḥ pañca mantrāścāntarbhūtāḥ || 1 
|| 

pauruṣe ūkārādiyakārānte navake vidyā kalā, puruṣarāgau tattve, 
tuṣṭisiddhī bhuvane, 
aṇimādiguruśiṣyapaṅktitrayanāḍīvigrahāṣṭakadehapāśāgantu- 
gaṇeśavidyeśapāśabhuvanāni daśa suhṛṣṭādirudradaśakasya 
kalyāṇyāderguruśiṣyadaśakasya bhuvanamiti caturdaśa bhuvanāni, ñajhau 
varṇau, mantrāvaghorakavacau || 2 || 

ūkārādivakārānte naiyate navake kalāmantrau prāgvat | evamuttaratrāpi 
niyatividye tattve, vāmadevādyaṣṭakabhuvanaṃ vāmādinavakabhuvanaṃ ca, 
jachau varṇau || 3 || 

ūkārādilakārānte kālīye navake kālakale tattve, 
śuddhādidaśakabhuvanaṃ mahādevādibhuvanatrayaṃ ca, caṅau varṇau || 4 || 

ūkārādimakārānte māyīye navake māyā tattvam, gopatyādyanantāntāni 
sapta bhuvanāni, gha-varṇaḥ || 5 || 

ūkārādikṣakārānte vidyāpadanavake vidyātattvam, 
triguṇādividyārājñībhuvanamekaṃ, śāntā kalā, tatpuruṣāstre mantrau, 
ga-varṇaḥ || 6 || 

ūkārādirephānte eśvare navake kalāmantrau prāgvat, eśvaraṃ tattvam, 
īśvarabhuvanādijñānakriyābhuvanāntaṃ bhuvanapañcadaśakam, kha-varṇaḥ 
|| 7 || 

ūkārādihakārānte sādāśive navake sādāśivaṃ tattvam, sādāśivameva
suśivādyanantabhuvanavyāpakamekaṃ bhuvanam, ka-varṇaḥ || 8 || 

ūkārādipraṇavānte śaive navake śāntyatītā kalā, "śaktitattvābhinna"
śivatattvam, śāntyatītābhuvanādikāni śivabhuvanāntāni ṣoḍaśa
bhuvanāni, netrābhinnamūtīḥ īśānamantraḥ, visargādyā hakārāntāḥ
ṣoḍaśa varṇāḥ || 9 || 

padadīkṣāvat navatattvadīkṣā | tatra padasthāne 
prakṛtyāditattvānyupasthāpyāni, tattvasthāne tu padānyantarbhāvyānīti 
viśeṣaḥ | tritattvadīkṣāyāṃ tvātmatattve 
kṣityādimāyāntānyekatriṃśattattvāni, nivṛttiḥ pratiṣṭhā vidyā 
kalāḥ, kālāgnyādyanantāntaṃ bhuvanānāṃ śatamekanavatyadhikam, 
prakṛtikoṣṭhakeśadiggatapraṇavāt prabhṛti 
pūrvapadmagatayāmyakṣakārāntaṃ padānyekonasaptatiḥ,  
sadyojātavāmadevāghorahṛdayaśiraḥśikhākavacāḥ sapta mantrāḥ, 
kṣādighāntā ekatriṃśadvarṇāḥ || 1 || 

vidyātattve śāntā kalā, vidyeśvarasadāśivāstattvāni, 
vidyārājñyādisadāśivabhuvanāntāni saptadaśa bhuvanāni, padāni, 
pūrvapadmāt ra-oṃ-ha iti trīṇi, madhyapadmādūkārādyā hakārāntā 
aṣṭau ityekādaśa, tatpuruṣāstre mantrau, ga-kha-kavarṇāḥ || 2 || 

śivatattve śaktiśivau tattve, padaṃ praṇavaḥ, bhuvanādi prāgvat || 3 || 

1. 	ṣaṭtriṃśattattvadīkṣāyāṃ tu pṛthivyāṃ nivṛttiḥ kalā, 
aṣṭottaraśataṃ bhuvanānām, prakṛtipadmānnavapadmāni prakṛtyantaṃ 
teṣāmeva niyuktatvāt, sadyohṛdaye mantrau, kṣa-varṇaḥ | 

2. 	jale pratiṣṭhā kalā, vāmadevaśiraḥśikhāstrayo mantrāḥ, padāni 
pūrvoktāni nava | etāni mantrakalāpadāni prakṛtyantaṃ yāvat | 
evameva ha-varṇaḥ bhuvanāni lakulīśādī-nyamarāntānyaṣṭau | 

3. 	tejasi sa-varṇaḥ, bhairavādīni hariścandrāntānyaṣṭau bhuvanāni | 

4. 	vāyau ṣa-varṇaḥ, bhīmādigayāntānyaṣṭau bhuvanāni | 

5. 	khe śa-varṇaḥ, sthāṇvādivastrāpadāntāni bhuvanānyaṣṭau | 

6.	gandhe va-varṇaḥ, śārvaṃ bhuvanam |

sūcitā na sphuṭīkṛtā | samyag dīkṣāvidhiṣvatra dhīḥ 
sudhībhinīdhīyatām || 

evamīdṛgekatamaprakārakṛtadīkṣaṃ nirbījadīkṣādīkṣitavarjaṃ 
śiṣyam ---- 


samayān chrāvayet paścāt tantrāmnāyotthitān priye || 5-43 || 


tantrarūpādita āmnāyādutthitānityanena srotobhedena samayānāṃ
bhinnābhinnarūpataiveti sūcayati || 43 || 

tānāha ---- 


na ninded bhairavaṃ devaṃ śāstraṃ vānyasamudbhavam | 


laukikīṃ bhedadarśanavāsanāṃ ca hitvā tatsamudbhavānyanyānyapi 
tattadācārāṇyapi bhairavaśāstrāṇi taduktaṃ tattadupāsopāsyaṃ ca taṃ 
taṃ devaviśeṣaṃ parabhairavavadvandyatayaiva paśyedityarthaḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


sāṃkhyaṃ yogaṃ pāñcarātraṃ vedāṃścaiva na nindayet || 5-44 || 


taddarśanasthāṃstadanupapattidarśanena prayojakavyāpāreṇa na 
tannindāyāṃ prayuñjītetyarthaḥ || 44 || 

atra hetuḥ ---- 


yataḥ śivodbhavāḥ sarve hyapavargaphalapradāḥ | 


tattatsvocitamuktikāriṇaḥ, tāvanmātraviśrāntānāṃ vākyaikavākyatayā 
paripūrṇavyāptividāṃ sadyomuktidā api ---- 

"adṛṣṭavigrahācchāntāt" (8-27)

iti bhāvinītyā nānārūpācchivāt 
sarvaśāstrāṇāmutpannatvenatadabhinnavyāptikatvāt | 

anenaivāśayena ---- 

"yataḥ śivodbhavaṃ sarvaṃ śivadhāmaphalapradam |"

iti pāṭhaṃ purāṇapustakadṛṣṭamiha kecit paṭhanti | 
pūrṇavyāptyavedyabhiprāyeṇa tu ---- 

śarvān bhramayate māyā hyamokṣe mokṣalipsayā |" (10-1141)

ityādi vakṣyati || 45 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


smārttaṃ dharmaṃ na nindettu ācārapathadarśakam || 5-45 || 


tadācāraratānāṃ na buddhibhedaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ || 


brahmādidevatā yāśca mātaraścumbako giriḥ | 

vīrāścaiva bhaginyaśca gāvo bhūtagaṇāstathā || 5-46 || 


brahmādīnyullaṅghanīyānyapi kāraṇāni, mātaro laukikācārato 
brāhmyādyāḥ, cumbati vaktrapāramparyeṇa śiṣyaṃ prabodhayati 
rahasyārthe yaḥ sa guruḥ, giririva giriḥ maṃtrārādhanādāvavicalaḥ 
sādhakaḥ, vīrā rahasyacaryāniṣṭhāḥ, bhaginyo mātṛbhaktā yoginyo, 
gāvaḥ paśuśāstrapratipāditapavitrabhāvāḥ bhūtāni 
piśācāpasmārādīni, gaṇāḥ pramathāḥ | etān sarvānna nindediti
sambandhaḥ || 46 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


devadravyaṃ na hiṃsyāttu siddhānte yad vyavasthitam | 


siddhānte niścaye yadvyavasthitaṃ taddevārthamevedaṃ dravyamiti tanna 
hiṃsyāt || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


gurorannaṃ na bhuñjīta adattaṃ parameśvari || 5-47 || 


guruṇā yanna prasādīkṛtaṃ tattadīyamannamapi nāśnīyāt || 47 || 


madyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā matsyānanyāni ca varānane | 

sācārāṃśca nirācārā�lliṅgino na jugupsayet || 5-48 || 


anyānīti vīradravyāṇi, nirācārāniti tadrūpeṇa 
nihnutatatsvarūpāṇāṃ siddhānāmapi bhāvād na jugupsīta || 48 || 


carukaṃ prāśayennityaṃ...............


sveṣṭadevatāyai dattam || 


	............gurun sampūjayet sadā | 


anyathā nityārcādhikārābhāvāt || 


upaskarān mahādevi pādena tu na saṃspṛśet || 5-49 || 


upaskarān dṛṣadulūkhalamusalādīni gṛhopakaraṇādīni, teṣāṃ 
mataṅgaśāstreṣu navayāgavidhau devatāsaṅketasthānatvenāmnātatvāt || 
49 || 


saṃhitāṃ cintayennityaṃ..............


saṃhitāṃ śaivaṃ śāstram || 


.........bhaktānāṃ śrāvayet sadā | 


gurustadanujñāto'nyo'pi vā, ataḥ prādhānyenāyaṃ guroreva samayaḥ || 


āhnikaṃ na vilumpettu saṃdhyākarma varānane || 5-50 || 


āhnikaṃ pūjādinityakarma, saṃdhyāṃ saṃdhyākālasampādyāṃ 
mantropāsanam || 50 || 


adīkṣitānāṃ purato noccarecchāstrapaddhatim | 


śāstrapaddhatiṃ pārameśaśāstraprakriyām || 50 || 

sādhakaviṣayamāha ---- 


trikālaṃ pūjayed devaṃ japadhyānarataḥ sadā || 5-51 || 


prātarmadhyāhne sāyaṃ ca || 51 || 

tadetān yathāyogaṃ putrakādiḥ ---- 


samayān pālayennityamubhayārthaphalepsayā | 


ubhayārthamaihikamāmuṣmikaṃ ca phalaṃ bhogo mokṣaśca || 

taditthaṃ samayaśravaṇāntāṃ kriyādīkṣāmuktvā, jñānadīkṣāṃ 
nirūpayitumāha ---- 


ato vijñānadīkṣāṃ tu pravakṣyāmyanupūrvaśaḥ || 5-52 || 

adhyātmagaticāreṇa kevalena viśodhikām | 


anupūrvaśo vakṣyamāṇoddhātakrameṇa | adhyātmamātmani gatyā jñānena
yaścāraḥ sauṣumnamārgārohaḥ, tena | kevalena hotrādihīnena || 

tatra ---- 


śiṣyātmānaṃ gṛhītvā tamātmaprāṇe niyojayet || 5-53 || 

abhimānaṃ tathoccārya kuryādvai pūrvavattadā | 


abhimānam ---- 

"ahameva paro haṃsaḥ" (4-399)

ityuktarūpam || 53 || 

etatsarvaṃ pūrvoktamanūdya, viśeṣamāha ---- 


uddhātaiśca tato'dhvānaṃ śiṣyasya tu viśodhayet || 5-54 || 

tataḥ samuccaraṃstattvaṃ pṛthivyādyaṃ tu suvrate | 


tattvaṃ niṣkalasvarūpaṃ pūrvoktamudrābandhayuktyā samyaguccaran 
pṛthivyādyamadhvānaṃ bhāvanayā vinyastaṃ viśodhayet || 54 || 

kathamityāha ---- 


bhinnābhinnasvarūpeṇa ekaikaṃ tu yathākramam || 5-55 || 

sasvaraṃ hyakṣaroccāraṃ devatābhiḥ samanvitam | 


mantrakalāvyāptyā bhinnenāvikalpavimarśaikyācca abhinnena 
svarūpeṇopalakṣitam, tata eva devatābhirbrāhmyādyābhiḥ 
samyagabhedavyāptyānvitam, ekaikamakārokāramakārādirūpamakṣaram, 
sasvaramityāntaroccāravat paśyantīvimarśapradhānam, ata eva 
cākṣaroccāramavicalitamantradhvanirūpaṃ kurvanniti śeṣaḥ || 55 || 

tadatra ---- 

"ābrahmarandhraṃ bhrūmadhyāt santi pañca dharādayaḥ | 

granthayaḥ kāraṇaiḥ sārghaṃ tān bhittvā prāpyate śivaḥ ||"

ityāmnāyāntaroktasthityā 
bhrūmadhyādipadāvasthitasūkṣmapṛthivyādigranthapañcakabhedam 
udghātayuktyā''diśati devaḥ ---- 


bindunā śaktisaṃyogādudghātaḥ1 prathamaḥ smṛtaḥ || 5-56 || 

devatātrayanirmuktaḥ..............


pūrvavacchiṣyacaitanyaṃ svaprāṇe līnaṃ kṛtvā, 
pūrvoktakaraṇabandhapuraḥsaraṃ 
hṛdayānmadhyaśaktiprasarayuktyākṛtakavimarśasāraṃ mantramuccaran, 
māntravimarśapradhānāyāstasyāḥ śaktebīndunā saṃyogāditi bhrūmadhye 
vajralāñchitapītavarṇacaturaśrapāthīvamaṇḍalamadhyadhyātabindutejasā 
samyagityūrdhvoccārakrameṇa yogāt tadanubhavāt prathamo'yamuddhāto 
brahmaviṣṇurudrākhya devatātrayeṇa nirmukta 
īśvarākhyamantradevatāsamāpattyātmā 
pañcaguṇapṛthvītattvagatagandhākhyamukhyaguṇasaṃśodhanarūpa ityarthaḥ 
|| 

rasākhyaguṇaśuddhayarthaṃ dvitīyamāha ---- 


..............caturthāntasamanvitaḥ | 

uddhātaḥ sa tu deveśi dvitīyaḥ parikītītaḥ || 5-57 || 


caturthasya bindusthānasyānto'rdhacandraḥ, tena prāgvat samyaganvitaḥ, 
tadanubhavāveśarūpa ityarthaḥ ||  

rūpaguṇaśuddhyarthaṃ tṛtīyamāha ---- 


haṃsākṣarasamuccāraḥ sudīrgho bindusaṃyutaḥ | 

ardhacandrānnirodhinyāmudghātastu tṛtīyakaḥ || 5-58 || 


haṃsapathasya haṃsarūpasya cākṣarasya niṣkalamantrasya samyagiti 
pūrvoktayuktyā uccāraḥ, sudīrgho ---- 

"hrasvaṃ dīrghaṃ plutaṃ sūkṣmam" (6-4)

iti bhāvinītyā makārānte plutaḥ, tato'pi prathamoddhātāvadhinā 
bindunā sūkṣmarūpeṇa samyag yutastadviśrāntaḥ, tathārdhacandrād 
dvitīyodghātaviśrāntyavadhenīrodhikāsthānāntaṃ prasaraṃstṛtīya iti 
pāthīvarūpaguṇaśuddhikṛdityarthaḥ || 58 || 

sparśaguṇaśuddhyarthamāha ---- 


bhinnodghāto yadā devi nādāntastu tadā bhavet | 

udghātaḥ sa tu deveśi caturthaḥ parikītītaḥ || 5-59 || 


bhinnā udghātā iti proktāni troṇyudghātasthānāni yena mantroccāreṇa sa 
punaryadā nādānto nādānubhavaviśrānto bhavati, tadā sa 
caturthaguṇaśuddhyartha udghāta uktaḥ | tadāśabdo bhavecchabdānantaraṃ 
yojyate || 59 || 

śabdaguṇaśuddhyarthaṃ pañcamamāha ---- 


sa eva cākṣaroccāro vyāpinyante vyavasthitaḥ | 

udghātaḥ sa tu deveśi pañcamaḥ parikītītaḥ || 5-60 || 


sa caiveti naiṣkalaḥ | vyāpinyanta iti tadviśrāntirūḍhaḥ | pañcama iti 
pañcamasya śabdaguṇasya śuddhyartham || 60 || 

tadittham ---- 


pañcodghātāṃstato dattvā pṛthikā śodhayed budhaḥ | 


tata iti yataḥ pañcaguṇā pṛthvī, budha iti jñānī | atra 
pañcasvapyudghāteṣu bindusthāne pṛthikā dhāraṇāṃ pratyekaṃ dhṛtvā, 
udghātānusāraṃ bindvardhacandranirodhinādavyāpinyanteṣu viśrāntīḥ 
kurvan, śiṣyātmano gandhādiśabdānte guṇapañcake bhogyabhoktṛbhāvaṃ
śodhayet || 

itthaṃ ca vyāpinyantāśrayaṇe'pi sūkṣmavyāptyā 
pāthīvatattvabhogasthānaṃ bindudhāmaiva śuddhaṃ bhavatītyāha ---- 


akārokāramakārāntamevaṃ śuddhyati nānyathā || 5-61 || 


akārokāramakārāṇāmantaṃ bindusthānam | evamiti 
vyāpinyantānupraveśātmakodghātapañcakāt 
śabdāntaguṇapañcakasaṃśuddhiyuktyā pṛthvītattvaśodhanādityarthaḥ | 
nānyatheti hutidīkṣāyāmeva tattvaśuddhirbhavatīti bhedavādivannāsyāṃ 
jñānadīkṣāyāṃ saṃśayitavyam, hutidīkṣāyāmapi jñānasyaiva 
prādhānyāditi nirṇītatvāt | uktaṃ ca śrīmataṅgapārameśvare'pi ---- 

"yasya jñānānna samprāptiḥ kriyā tasya vidhīyate |" 

iti || 61 || 

tadittham ---- 


śuddhe'tha pāthīve tattve cintitavyaṃ tu yogibhiḥ | 

jalībhūtaṃ tadevaitadātmanā saha yogataḥ || 5-62 || 


athaśabdaḥ kramaṃ sūcayati, sa ca 
śuddhatattvācchiṣyacaitanyasyoddharaṇam, tatastatsthīkaraṇam, tata 
ātmaprāṇe yojanaṃ mantraprāṇaśiṣyātmasvātmanāṃ 
sāmarasyabhāvanamityādirūpaḥ | tadeveti pāthīvaṃ tattvam | 
jalībhūtamityuktyā śuddhāśuddhatattvānusaṃdhānamuktam | yogibhiryogata 
ityanenāyogino'tra nādhikāro jātuciditi daśītam | etadātmanā saheti 
śiṣyātmānamapi jalatattva(yo)gāya tadekātmatāmiva prāptaṃ cintayet | 
atra cāvasare ardhacandrasthāne 
padmalāñchitasitavarṇārdhacandramaṇḍalamadhyagatajalabindurūpāṃ 
jalatattvadhāraṇāṃ baghnīyādityāmnāyaḥ || 62 || 

atha pāthīve tattve śiṣyātmani ca yathoktabhāvanayā ---- 


jalībhūte punarmantrī tadeva caturuccaret | 

bindvantaṃ dhāraṇāyuktaṃ.........


tadeveti niṣkalasvarūpam, mantrīti labdhasāmarasyaḥ, 
bindvantamardhacandrasthānam, dhāraṇā vyākhyātā | caturiti 
pūrvoktayuktyārdhacandranirodhinādavyāpinīpadeṣu krameṇa 
viśrāntirūpāṃścaturudghātān dadyādityarthaḥ | punaruccarediti pāṭhe 
catuṣṭayasaṃkhyārthādyojyā || 63 || 

taditthaṃ jalatattvaṃ saṃśodhya, pūrvoktaṃ sāmarasyāntaṃ kramaṃ 
śritvā tajjalatattvāt ---- 


.......śiṣyādātmani cintayet || 5-63 || 


ataśca ---- 


śodhite toyasaṃghāte tejobhūtaṃ vicintayet | 


arthāttadeva toyaṃ śiṣyātmanā sahetyādi prāgvat || 

atra ca nirodhikāsthāne 
śaktilāñchitaraktavarṇatrikoṇamaṇḍalādirūpāṃ tejastattvadhāraṇāṃ 
baddhvā nirodhinādavyāpinīsthāneṣu māntraviśrāntirūpāḥ ---- 


tejoddhātāstrayasteṣu nirodhyantamavasthitāḥ || 5-64 || 


tejodghātā ityaiśaḥ pāṭhaḥ | nirodhyantaṃ kṛtvā tatra tejodhāraṇāṃ
baddhvetyarthaḥ || 64 || 

tadevaṃ tribhirudghātaistriguṇe tejasi pūrvavadantarbhūtetarādhvapañcake 
śuddhe ---- 


nāsti tejastato vāyurudghātadvayaśodhitaḥ | 


pūrvavat tatsthātmasthatvādi kṛtvā, tejaḥ śāntaṃ vibhāvya, 
nādasthāne ṣaṭkoṇabindulāñchitanīlavarṇamaṇḍalādirūpāṃ 
vāyudhāraṇāṃ baddhvā, 
nādavyāpinīsthānayormāntraviśrāntyātmanodghātadvayena vāyutattvaṃ 
śiṣyātmano bhogasthānaṃ śodhayet || 

atha ---- 


akāśe līyamānaṃ tamudghātena tu cintayet || 5-65 || 


taṃ vāyum || 65 || 

etad vyanakti ---- 


naṣṭe vāyau tataḥ śūnyamudghātaikena yojayet | 


naṣṭa iti ākāśaśeṣībhūtatvāt śiṣyātmano bandhakatvāccalite | tata 
iti susūkṣmatamamākāśatattvamantarbhūtetarādhvapañcakam udghātaikeneti, 
ākāśasyaikaguṇatvāt || 

yaccaitatsusūkṣmatamaṃ śūnyam ---- 


vyāpinī sā tu vijñeyā pañcamānte vyavasthitā || 5-66 || 


pañcame vyomatattvātmanyante vyavasthitā, 
tenātrāntaḥśūnyasusūkṣmaśabdaśaktilāñchitaparivartulamaṇḍalā-
kārāṃ vyomadhāraṇāṃ baddhvā, mantroccāraṇābhijño guruḥ 
śiṣyātmanā sahātraiva viśrāmyan paratejomayatāmanusaṃdadhyāt || 66 || 

evaṃ cātra jñānadīkṣāmāhātmyena caritārthatayā 
punarbhogapradatvābhāvenābandhakatvāt sarvaiva bhogyabhūḥ śiṣyasya 
śodhitā bhavati, yataścidānandecchājñānakriyākhyaśaktipañcaka-
sāmarasyasatattvaḥ śrīsvacchandabhaṭṭārakaścidādiśaktipradhāna- 
śivaśaktisadāśiveśvaravidyākhyatattva pañcakātmatāmuṭṭaṅkitāmapi 
vyāpinyādibindvantagranthipañcakasvarūpagopanātmakamahāmāyā- 
śaktyācchādayan, māyādikṣityantāṃ kramāt kramamadhikādhikasaṅkocāṃ
tattvatriṃśataṃ ṣaḍbhiḥ pañcakapraghaṭṭakairanyonyaṃ 
śaktivyaktyātmakavyāpyavyāpakabhāvabhāgbhirāsūtritavān 
saṅkucitapramātṛbhūmikāyāmiti | tadanugrahaprāptatatsvarūpeṇa yoginā 
guruṇā śiṣyātmanaikībhūya yathoktodghātavyāptiyuktyā 
śiṣyacaitanyasya samagrāṃ bhogabhūmiṃ vilāpya, jñānadīkṣayā 
cidādiśaktipañcātmakatvamevāpādayitavyam | ata eva 
pañcatriṃśattattvavyāptisārasusūkṣmapṛthivyādīnītthaṃ saṃśodhyāpi 
tatsaṃskāramayaṃ samanāpadamapi śodhayitumāha ---- 

samanāyāṃ tato hyātmā.............

susūkṣmatamatattvaprapañcamananamātrarūpāyāṃ samanāśaktau guruṇā 
śiṣyātmā tāvanmātrabhedasaṃskāranivṛttyarthaṃ yojya ityarthaḥ || 

evaṃ ca ---- 


...........ṭattvavyāpī sa ucyate | 


aśeṣatattvaprathamāsūtraṇarūpaṃ yatsamanākhyaṃ tattvaṃ tadvyāpaka 
ityarthaḥ || 

iyati ca saṃskāraparyante tattvajāte saṃśuddhe 
śuddhātmatāmāpnotītyāha ---- 


ātmavyāpī tataścordhve.............


bhavatīti śeṣaḥ || 

evamāsāditaparaśuddhātmasvarūpo'pi śiṣyātmā tato'pi parāṃ 
cidādiśaktyabhedasārāṃ parabhairavarūpatāṃ 
samanantaravakṣyamāṇayojanikākrameṇaitītyāha ---- 


...........ṣarvavyāpī tataḥ punaḥ || 5-67 || 


bhavatīti śeṣaḥ || 67 || 

atra yojanikāmāsūtrayitumekodghātarūpāṃ yuktimāha ---- 


tattvāntasaṃsthito hyātmā uddhātaikena yogavit | 

yojayet parame tattve unmanātītasarvage || 5-68 || 


tattvonāmantaḥ samanāyā ūrdhvaṃ padam | unmanātīta iti 
tadanubhavānupraveśena śaktimatsvarūpāsādanam || 68 || 

yojayedityuktiṃ sphuṭayati ---- 


yojanāṃ tu pare tattve śṛṇu devi vadāmyaham | 


anayoktyāsyārthasyāvadhānagamyatvaṃ darśayati ---- 


mantramuccārayed devi hrasvaṃ dīrghaṃ plutaṃ param || 5-69 || 

parāparavibhāgena yāvattatvaṃ paraṃ gatam | 


hrasvaṃ dīrghaṃ plutaṃ sūkṣmamatisūkṣmamiti samanantarameva 
pañcapraṇavādhikāre'kārokāramakārabindunādamātrāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ 
praṇavaikadeśabhūtānāmapi ---- 

"pradeśo'pi brahmaṇaḥ sārvarūpyamanatikrāntaḥ |"

iti sthityā praṇavatvamiti vakṣyati | tato hrasvaṃ mantramuccārayedityādi 
sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ yuktameva | parāparavibhāgeneti 
sūkṣmātisūkṣmabhedenetyarthaḥ | paramunmanātītaṃ gataṃ prāptam || 

tadatra ---- 


tridevaṃ bindusaṃyuktamardhacandraṃ nirodhikām || 5-70 || 

nādaṃ ca śaktisaṃyuktaṃ vyāpinīsamanonmanāḥ | 


jānīyāditi śeṣaḥ | trayāṇāṃ brahmādīnāṃ devānāṃ samāhāro 
yatra akārokāramakārātmani kalātraye tattathā || 70 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


unmanā ca paraścaiva sarvavyāpī śivo'vyayaḥ || 5-71 || 


jñātavya iti śeṣaḥ | yathā cātra jñānaṃ yādṛśaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ 
pūrvameva vitatya nirṇītam || 71 || 

tadittham ---- 


jñātvā sarvamaśeṣeṇa vidhimeṣāṃ yathākramam | 

tadā tu yojayenmantrī anyathā naiva yojayet || 5-72 || 


sarvamiti pūrvoktacārapramāṇādipariṣkṛtameṣāṃ māntraprameyānāṃ 
vidhiṃ samyaguccāraṇamaśeṣeṇa niścayanirūḍhyanubhavaiḥ | ata eva 
mantrī samyaṅmantrasatattvavit || 72 || 

tameva vidhiṃ sphuṭayati ---- 


bindusthaṃ tritayaṃ śabde................


mantraprameyānāṃ yanmakārāntaṃ tritayaṃ tad bindusthaṃ 
vidvadanubhavātmatāmāpāditaṃ sat śabde lādātmani kuryāt 
tanmayatvamāpādayet || 

yasmāt ---- 


.............caturtho bindureva hi | 


tasmāt tadviśrāntipuraḥsarameva nādaviśrāntaṃ makārāntaṃ trayaṃ 
kuryāt || 

tadetattrayam ---- 


brahmā viṣṇustathā rudraḥ.............


vācyabhedāt || 

etacca ---- 


............ṭrimātraṃ varṇa ucyate || 5-73 || 


mātrātrayametaduccāraṇakriyātmakatayā, varṇa ityakṣararūpatayā 
sthūlamityarthaḥ || 73 || 

caturthastu ---- 


īśvaro bindudevastu..............


tatparāmarśamaya ityarthaḥ || 

taditthaṃ mantroccāraṃ yaḥ karoti ---- 


............kaṇṭhe śabdaḥ pravartate | 


tasya hṛdayāduccarannādakalātmakamantrasatattvarūpaḥ śabdaḥ kaṇṭhe 
prakarṣeṇa vartate, tataḥ prabhṛti 
pañcapraṇavādhikāravakṣyamāṇanītyā uccāryatāmāsādayatītyarthaḥ || 
sa ca ---- 


tatra śabdaḥ kriyāntasthaḥ..............


uccāraṇakriyāntargataḥ paśyantyātmakaśabdarūpaḥ, na tu 
madhyāmavaikharīvyaṅgya ityarthaḥ || 

ata evāsau ---- 


..........kriyāśaktiriti smṛtā || 5-74 || 


taditthamuccāraṇaprayatnagataḥ ---- 

sa śabdastāluke devi īritaḥ sampravartate | 

tasya (= uccārayituḥ tāluke ityarthāt)

tato'pi ---- 


kiñcidgataḥ śabdo nāsikānte pravartate || 5-75 || 


nāsikānto bhrūmadhyam | tadetāvatparyantā māntrī kriyāśaktivyāptiḥ || 
75 || 

atha ---- 


jñānaśaktistu vijñeyā yatnataḥ parameśvari | 

mūrdhasthānagataḥ śabdo lalāṭāntamavasthitaḥ || 5-76 || 


yadā sa eva śabdo yoginaḥ pūrvoktāt 
nāsāpuṭādiprayogarūpādyatnānmūrdhasthānato 
'rdhacandrādisthānānyuktodghātayuktyāroha�llalāṭāntamavasthito bhavati, 
tadā sūkṣmarūpatopasaṃhārādanubhavaprakarṣamāpanno 
jñānarūpatāmetītyarthaḥ || 

taditthaṃ bindvādirūpatāmāsādyākārokāramakārātmā ---- 


varṇaḥ śabdagataḥ............


śabdaṃ nādātmatāṃ gatastadrūpatāmāptaḥ || 

tathābhūtaśca ---- 


....ṭeṣāmudghātaḥ sa tu kītītaḥ | 


teṣāmiti bindvantānām, sa eva nādakalānubhavātmā śabdaḥ 
pañcādibhedena bhinna udghātaḥ pūrvamukto na tvanyaḥ kaścit || 

evamiyatīṃ bhūmiṃ māntrīmāśrityāpi ---- 


tatrasthā vinivartante.............


ye ūrdhvāṃ śaktyādisopānamālikāmanāruhya tatraiva saṃtuṣyanti, te ---
- 


..........śivajñānavivajītāḥ || 77 || 


nādatuṣṭāḥ paramānandamayaśivajñaptisādhakatamāṃ 
māntrīmicchāśaktimeva nāviśanti, kutastu śivam, ata uttarottarapadārohe 
yatnaḥ kārya ityarthaḥ || 77 || 

athātraiva bindvādipadeṣu sūkṣmatamānubhavagamyaṃ bhāvinamevāntaraṃ 
pravibhāgaṃ darśayitumāha ---- 


pañcadhāvasthito bindurardhacandro nirodhikā | 


bhuvanādhvani bindvāvaraṇasya nirūpaṇāvasare vakṣyati ---- 


ṅivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā ca vidyā śāntistathaiva ca | 

parivāraḥ smṛtastasya śāntyatītasya suvrate || 

tasya vāmadiśo bhāge śāntyatītā vyavasthitā |" (10-1217-18) 

iti | 

tathā

"jyotsnā jyotsnāvatī kāntiḥ suprabhā vimalā śivā | 

ardhacandre smṛtā hyetā nirodhyaṃśe tu suvrate || 

rundhanī rodhanī raudrī jñānabodhā tamopahā |" (10-1220-21) 

iti | 

evameṣāṃ pañcadhāvasthitatvam || 

atha ---- 


tasyātīto bhavennādaḥ...............


tasyeti nirodhyanubhavaparyantavyāptikabindudevasya, taṃ bindudevamatītaḥ 
san sa varṇo nādo bhavati nādāmarśarūpatāmeti | tamiti vaktavye 
tasyetyuktibīndoreveyaṃ nādarūpatāpattirevamuttaratrāpi 
pūrvapūrvāvasthaivottarottaraṃ prakarṣametītyāśayena ṣaṣṭhī yojyā 
|| 

etadanubhave yuktimāha ---- 


........'vacchinnastvasau bhavet || 5-78 || 

īṣatprasārite vaktre.............


pūrvoktadivyakaraṇabandhenāvacchinnatāmetītyarthaḥ || 

eṣa ca ---- 


............ḍevadevaḥ sadāśivaḥ | 


devasya dyotanasatattvasya bindorapi, devaḥ sātiśayadīptaḥ prabhuśca || 

eṣa ca nādarūpaḥ ---- 


catuvīdho bhavecchabdo yaḥ suvegavahaḥ smṛtaḥ || 5-79 || 


nādāvaraṇe vakṣyati ---- 

"indrikā dīpikā caiva rodhikā mocikā tathā |" (10-1226)

iti | etābhiḥ śaktibhirasya catuvīdhatvam || 79 || 

nanu ca ---- 

"ūrdhvagā tu samākhyātā kalā tvāsāṃ tu pañcamī |" (10-1229)

iti bhaviṣyati, tatkathamasya cātuvīdhyam, satyaṃ tasyāstu na 
śabdavyāptirityāha ---- 


pañcamo na vahecchabdaḥ..............


yaḥ pañcamaḥ prakāro nāsau śabdarūpatayā vahatītyarthaḥ || 

kathaṃ tahī bhavati? ---- ityāha ---- 


............ūrdhvagāminyasau smṛtā | 


nādordhvagatecchāvyāptyavasthito yaḥ śakteḥ saṃsparśastadabhinnata eva 
nādānto'vyaktadhvaniriti cocyate ityarthaḥ || 

atha ---- 


tasyātītā bhavecchaktiḥ................


tamapi nādayatītyarthaḥ || 

sā ca ---- 


.............pañcadhā tu vyavasthitā || 5-80 || 


tadvakṣyati ---- 

"ūrdhve tu saṃsthitā śaktiḥ suṣuptabhujagākṛtiḥ |" (10-1241)

ityupakramya

śūkṣmā caiva susūkṣmā ca tathā caivāmṛtāmitā || 

vyāpinī" (10-1242) 

iti || 80 || 

atra śabdavyāpteḥ kṣīṇatvāt kīdṛganubhava ityāha ---- 


sparśastatra bhaved devi............


hlādātmeti śeṣaḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


..............ātmavittatra pūrvavat | 


tatra śaktipade ya ātmavit śaktyanubhavatuṣṭaḥ sa pūrvavaditi śivapadaṃ 
prāpnotīti yāvat | evamuttaratrāpi yojyam || 

athātaḥ ---- 


vyāpinī parataścaiva pañcadhā tu vyavasthitā || 5-81 || 


so'pi spṛśannūrdhvapadamārurukṣuryogino vyāptimayān vyāpinīrūpo 
bhavati | tatra ca ---- 

"vyāpinī vyomarūpā cānantānāthāpyanāśritā |" (10-1252)


iti vakṣyamāṇasūkṣmatamaśaktipañcakānubhavo'sti || 5-81 || 


atra ca ---- 


bālāgramāśritaṃ sparśaṃ kadācidvetti vā na vā | 


kadāciditi tatpadārohāvasare tvaśeṣasparśaṃ vetti, na veti 
tadārohaprakarṣe vyāptimātramevānubhavati, na tu pṛthak sparśamityarthaḥ 
|| 

tadittham ---- 


vyāpinī sā samuddaṣṭā na jñānaṃ parameśvari || 5-82 || 


yadetat sparśaṃ vetti na vetyuktam, sā vyāpinītyupasaṃhṛtaṃ na 
jñānamiti, naiṣā jñānaśaktirapi tu icchāśaktirityarthaḥ || 82 || 

atha ---- 


tasyāpi samanātītā.............


tadapi vyāpinījñānamatikramya sthitetyarthaḥ || 

śamanaṃ kramavijñānamunmanaṃ yugapat" (4-394)

ityuktatvādunmanānubhavaṃ pravivikṣuḥ ---- 


.............ṃanastatra na kārayet | 


na tatraiva tuṣyedityarthaḥ | 

tadiyatīyamicchāśaktivyāptirmāntrītyavaseyam || 

samanāyāṃ bhāvābhāvātmano viśvasya bhedasyāsūtraṇād heyatvamastīti 
tāmatikramya ---- 


unmanāpadamārohan...............


madhye kevalātmatāmanubhavatītyāha ---- 


...........śuddhātmā tu tato bhavet || 5-83 || 


taditthaṃ śuddhacaitanyasvarūpasāmarasya(mā)pannam ---- 


śiṣyātmānaṃ guruvara unmanyante niyojayet | 


unmanyāmante ceti samāsaḥ | svātantryaśaktisāmarasyātmani 
svatantrabhaṭṭārakasaṃvedane viśramayet tatsamāveśābhijña ityarthaḥ || 
evaṃ ca ---- 


tatra yuktaḥ pare śānte mahāśāntimavāpnuyāt || 5-84 || 


yukta ekatvaṃ prāptaḥ | samastasya bhedakalaṅkasya galanāt paraṃ 
śāntatvam || 

tadittham ---- 


gurupāramparāyātaḥ sampradāyaḥ prakāśitaḥ | 


paramparaiva pāramparam, gurūṇāṃ śaktisadāśivaśrīkaṇṭhādīnāṃ 
pārampareṇāyāto rahasyānubhavasañcārakrameṇa mayā viditaḥ, samyag 
dīkṣaṇādipūrvaṃ śaktipātabhājāṃ pradīyata iti sampradāyaḥ, 
prakāśitaḥ, tavāpi saṃkramaṇayuktipūrvaṃ mayā kathita ityarthaḥ | 
tadevaṃ guruto labdho'pi sampradāyo yathārūḍhimāpanno gurvantaraiḥ 
śiṣyāṇāṃ sampādyate || 

tatra ---- 


yojane tu pare tattve upāyaḥ kathitastava || 5-85 || 


"jñātvā cārapramāṇaṃ tu prāṇasañcārameva tu" (4-231)

ityādinā caturthapaṭala evetyarthaḥ || 85 || 

taditthaṃ sarvottamamimaṃ sampradāyam ---- 


evaṃ jñātvā varārohe sarvakarmāṇi kārayet | 


sarvāsu vyavahāradaśāsu parimāṇamāhātmya eva tiṣṭhediti yāvat | 
ācāryasādhakādīṃśca svociteṣu karmasvetajjñānapūrvakameva 
prayuñjītetyarthaḥ | varāroha iti prāgvat || 

evaṃ tattvadīkṣāprasaṅgokteyaṃ jñānadīkṣā anyādhvadīkṣāsvapi 
kartavyā iti bhaṅgyā śikṣāṃ dadāti ---- 


tattvādhvānaṃ kalādhvānaṃ bhuvanādhvānameva ca || 5-86 || 

varṇamantrapadādhvānaṃ kṛtvaivaṃ śudhyati priye | 


yathāntarbhāvitāparādhvapañcakaṃ tattvādhvānamevaṃ kṛtvā 
ityudghātapūrvaṃ pare tattve yojayitvā śuddhyati parabhairavatāmāpnoti, 
guruḥ śiṣyātmanā saha, tathānyamapyadhvānamevameva kṛtvā 
śuddhyatītyarthaḥ || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


eṣā vai dhāraṇādīkṣā.............


vijñānadīkṣāmityupakramyāpi proktadhāraṇākrameṇa kriyamāṇatvād 
dhāraṇādīkṣetyupasaṃhāre'pi na doṣaḥ || 

naiṣā sarveṇa guruṇā kāryetyabhidadhadbhāvipaṭalamapyavatitārayiṣuḥ 
pāṭalikīṃ saṅgatiṃ karoti ---- 


..............kartavyā yoginātra tu || 5-87 || 

mantrasiddhena vā devi..............


yoginā parasamāveśābhijñena | yadi vā atra tantre 
samanantarapaṭalavakṣyamāṇasādhanakrameṇa yo mantrasiddhastena kartavyā, 
dvayorapyatra sāmarthyāviśeṣāt, tadanyasya tvanadhikārāt | 

itthamiyam ---- 


.............kṛtā vai sukṛtā bhavet || 5-88 || 


samyaṅnivṛttimāsādayatyeva || 

tadevaṃ caturthapaṭale kalādīkṣoktā, asmaddaśītayuktyā 
ekatattvadīkṣā ca | iha tu 
tripañcanavaṣaṭtriṃśadbhedāścatasrastattvadīkṣāḥ, padadīkṣā ca 
navatattvadīkṣāvat, varṇamantrabhuvanadīkṣāśca tisraḥ kalādīkṣāvat, 
daśame ca vitatā bhuvanadīkṣā bhaviṣyatītyetā ekādaśa 
adhvavaicitryeṇa dīkṣāḥ | jñānadīkṣā coddhātayuktyā dvādaśī iti | 
etāḥ sabījanirbījasadyonirvāṇabhedāt putrakaviṣaye 
ṣaṭtriṃśadbhavanti | ācārye tu sabījaiva dvādaśabhedā | sādhake 
śivadhamīlokadhamībhedād dvividhe pūrvavaccatuvīṃśatibhedā | samayini 
tu adhvanyāsasyānuktatvāt jñānakriyābhyāṃ hṛdādigranthibhedanato 
dvividhā, iti catuḥsaptatiriha saṃkṣepato dīkṣābhedāḥ | tatrāpi 
sakalaniṣkalāghoreśvaryādyanuṣṭhānabhedād lokadhamīsādhakasya 
cāvāntaravaicitryād bhautikanaiṣṭhikācāryabhedācca
bahuprakārā bhavanti |  tadatra dīkṣāyāmeva pratyavatiṣṭhante saugatāḥ 
---- iha dīkṣayā kimātmanaḥ saṃskāraḥ kriyate, buddhervā? 
kimātmagrahādīnāṃ malānām, kiṃ vā karmaṇām ? ātmana 
āyātaśaktipātasya, taditarasya vā ? śaktipāto'kṣīṇamalasya, anyasya 
vā ? kaścātmanaḥ saṃskāraḥ ? karmanivṛttiḥ, 
sukhaduḥkhasaṃvinnivṛttiḥ, prakṛtyādivivekadarśanam, 
svasvarūpajñānamadvaitadṛṣṭirvā ? buddherapi kaḥ saṃskāra ? 
kimindriyapreraṇāsāmarthyam, rāgādihānyādhānam, unmūlanaṃ vā ? 
malānāmapi kiṃ tadaiva kāryaprasavāsāmarthyam, maraṇāpekṣaṃ vā 
saṃskāraḥ? evaṃ ca karmaṇām? sa ca kimāgamaikapramāṇako yuktisiddho'pi 
vā ? tatra śaktipātādātmagrahādimalakṣayaḥ, malakṣayācca śaktipāta 
ityanyonyāśrayaḥ | akṣīṇamalasya śaktipāte sarvasyāsau syāt, 
malakṣayo'nyataḥ kutaścid yadi tata eva tarhyātmanaḥ saṃskāro 
bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ śaktipātahetukena dīkṣāvidhānena ? ātmanaśca 
nityaikasvabhāvasya karmatadbhoganivṛttyanivṛttyoraviśiṣṭasya kaḥ 
saṃskāraḥ ? vaiśiṣṭye nityatāhāniḥ | karmabhogayoḥ vyatiriktayornāśe 
tasya kiṃ vṛttam ? tatsamavāyo'sya nivṛtta iti cet, so'pi karmādivat 
svātmanyevetyātmano na bhoktṛtvakartṛtve, nāpi tadupaśamātmā muktiḥ 
syāt | prakṛtyādivivekasvarūpadarśanapakṣau prāgatatsvabhāvatayāsya 
bhedamānayataḥ | ātmadarśanamātmīyādidarśanasya tanmūlānāṃ 
rāgādīnāṃ ca heturiti tato'sya bandha eva | advaitadṛṣṭau aparasya 
kasyāpyabhāvāt kriyā (bhogā? bodhā) nupapattau 
kartṛtvajñātṛtvatattvaiśvaryapravilopo muktātmanāṃ syāt | 
buddherakṣapreraṇāsāmarthyā(dhā)ne dīkṣitasya karaṇavaikalyaṃ syāt | 
rāgādidoṣāśca savāsanākā dīkṣitasya na nivartante | buddherunmūlane 
dīkṣānantaraṃ dehapātaprāptiḥ | malānāṃ tadaivāsāmarthyasādhane 
pravṛttistruṭyet | maraṇāpekṣamasāmarthyādhānamiti palāyanamārgaḥ | 
mṛtyavasare ca dīkṣitasyātmādigrahaḥ prāgvadevopalabhyate | evaṃ 
karmasvapi vācyam, ārabdhakāryakarmasaṃśodhane dīkṣāyā na 
sāmarthyamiti cet, anyatrāpi ka āśvāsaḥ ? āgamapramāṇakametaditi cet, 
āgamasya tadarthaṃ kaḥ pratibandhaḥ ? mantrapratibandhād yathā 
bījamaṅkuraṃ na sūte, tadvat karmabījānyapi na saṃsāraṃ suvate iti | 
bījādisaṃsiddhyuktyā bījādivad dīkṣitasya tailābhyaṅgadāhādayo 
'pyasāmarthyādhānahetavaḥ kriyantām | amūrtatvāt 
karmaṇāmabhyaṅgādayo na santīti tāni dīkṣaiva kṣapayati, tathā ca 
ghaṭadīkṣādīkṣitasya lāghavamapyupalabhyata iti cet, nāmūrtasya 
pāpādeḥ, gurutvābhāvāt | tasmāt kṣaṇikatvādibhāvanāpūvīkā 
nairātmyadṛṣṭireva mokṣa iti |  atrocyate ---- ihātmasaṃskāra eva 
dīkṣā | tathāhi ---- ayamātmā 
saṅkocābhāsatattvāpūrṇammanyatātmanehābhilāṣaśabdoktenāṇavena 
malena, śubhāśubhavāsanātmanā vividhajanmāyurbhogadena kārmeṇa, 
tatprabhavena ca kañcukapuryaṣṭakasthūlabhūtātmanājātikatrividha-
dehatadāśrayavicitrabhuvanabhokta-vyārthasārthapratītibhājā māyākhyena 
malena ca valitaḥ | yataḥ sarvasyaiva 
saṅkucito'bhiṣvaṅgādimayo'ntarullekhaśatākīrṇaḥ 
kṛśagaurādirūpo'mutredaṃ jānāmītyādipratītisiddha evāyamarthaḥ | 
tadīdṛśasyāsyānantajanmasahasrābhyastedṛgvāsanasyāpyākasmikaguru- 
yiyāsābhaktyādivaśonnītaśaktipātānusāranirvartyamānayā dīkṣayā 
"dīyate jñānadbhāvaḥ kṣīyate paśuvāsanā | 

dānakṣapaṇasaṃyuktā dīkṣā teneha kītītā ||"

ityāmnāyanirūpitasthityā 
āṇavādipāśapraśamanaśivatvābhivyaktiyogyatātmā saṃskāraḥ kriyate | 
pāśānāṃ ca praśamanamacintyamantraśaktivaśād bījānāmiva punaḥ 
prarohādhānāsāmarthyam | 

yattu ---- 

ṅālaṃ bījādisaṃsiddhau vidhiḥ puṃsāmajanmane | 

tailābhyaṅgāgnidāhādāvapi muktiprasaṅgataḥ ||"

ityuktaṃ taiḥ, tatteṣāmevopahāsyatāmāviṣkaroti, yataḥ 
sthāvarajaṅgamakṛtrimādyātmano viṣasya svakāryakaraṇaśaktipraśamanaṃ 
bījavadyanmantraiḥ kriyate, tatrāpi etadvaktuṃ prāptam | atha 
tailābhyaṅgāderbīja eva śaktinirodhakṛtvaṃ na tu viśeṣakṛtvaṃ, 
mantrāṇāṃ tu tatrāpītyucyate, tahī acintyaprabhāvatvāt teṣāṃ 
pāśapraśamane'pi sāmarthyaṃ kiṃ na sahyate | atha doṣāḥ 
sabījasaṃtānā dīkṣite'pyanivāritā dṛśyanta iti kimasya mantraiḥ 
kṛtamityucyate | tadatrāpyucyate proktapāśaśaktipratibandhanaṃ mantraiḥ 
kriyate asya, na tu rāgadveṣādipraśamanam | 

yathāhi ---- virūpasya vairūpyamanivartyāpi lokottararamaṇīvaśīkaraṇaṃ 
mantraiḥ kriyate, tadvaddehārambhikarmāśodhanād vartamānadehe 
rāgādyanivṛttāvapi bhāviprarohapratirodhanaṃ pāśānāṃ kurvatāṃ 
mantrāṇāṃ kimāyātam | tīvratamaśaktipātapūtānāṃ ca 
dīkṣānantaraṃ rāgadveṣādipraśamaḥ śataśo'pi dṛśyante | 
sadyonirvāṇadīkṣāyāṃ ca traikālikapāśaśodhanāt tadaiva 
dehādivigalanaṃ śivatvābhivyaktiśca bhavatyeva | śivatvābhivyaktāvatra 
kiṃ pramāṇamiti cet, 
mantraprabhāvasampāditatātkālikadehadarśanapraśamanodbhūtamanumānaṃ 
yathā ca śāntyāpyāyavaśīkāradāhoccāṭanaśoṣaṇamāraṇādi 
mantrasāmarthyādbhavatyeva tathā dīkṣāphalamapi bhavatyeveti cetasi 
niveśyatām | tatkālameva dīkṣātaḥ śivatvābhivyaktiḥ kiṃ na bhavatīti 
cet, prakṛṣṭajñānaśālibhiḥ kriyamāṇāyāṃ sahasraśo bhavantī 
asāvapi dṛśyate eva | athocyate ---- nityasyātmano dīkṣātaḥ 
saṃskārotpattau saṃskṛtatvāsaṃskṛtattvabhedād bhedaḥ syāditi cet, na | 
tattatpratibhāsabhede'pyasyākṛtakāhaṃvimarśaikyena ekatvasiddhiḥ, 
dūrāsannādau devakulāderiva tadvimarśaikyāt | vimarśanavaśādeva ca 
sarvavyavastheti pratyabhijñāyāṃ nirṇītam | etena 
bhoktṛtvakartṛtvādyapyasya samathītameva, 
tattadviṣayabhede'pyātmāvyatirekeṇāsya sphuraṇāt | yattu 
uktamātmadarśanaṃ na muktirapi tu bandha iti 
taccharīraprāṇapuryaṣṭakaśūnyeṣvanātmasvevameva | yattu satyarūpe 
cidātmanyahaṃvimarśaparamārthatayā svīkṛtāśeṣajñānakriyāparamārthe 
tatrātmadarśanaṃ saiva satyato muktiḥ | na ca 
kevalamanātmanyātmadarśanaṃ mithyājñānarūpo bandhaḥ, yāvadātmanyapi 
pūrṇaprakāśāhaṃvimarśaparamārthāśeṣaviśvamaye viśvatrāpi ca 
cidātmaikyaparamārthe yadanātmatayā jñānam, tadapi bandha eveti sarvathā 
vigalitasaṅkocacidekaghanaviśvaikātmyamayaśivatvābhivyaktireva muktiḥ | 
tatra cābhedasāraṃ sarvaṃ jñātvā samāptameveti tatprāptyarthameva 
dīkṣāpravṛttiḥ | tadevamuktanītyā malānāṃ bhedena pratipāditatvāt 
pṛthag na tatsaṃskārapakṣaḥ kaścit, ityātmana evoktarūpaḥ saṃskāro 
dīkṣayā kriyate | advayamevāsya svarūpamiti 
svarūpadarśanādvayadarśanapakṣayornāsti bhedaḥ | 
sadyonirvāṇadīkṣāyāṃ tvasya karmasukhādisaṃvinnivṛttirapi kriyata iti 
pratipāditam | asadyonirvāṇadīkṣāsu 
dehārambhikarmaśuddhirbhagavadājñāto na kriyate, na tvasāmarthyāt | 
ato'trāpi yaduktam ---- 

"gatipratītyoḥ kāraṇānyāśrayastānyadṛṣṭato'dṛṣṭanāśānna | 

gatirdīkṣitasya ||" iti,

tadapyadūṣaṇameva | prakṛtyādivivekadṛṣṭibuddhisaṃskārapakṣau 
anabhyupagamaparāhatau | tato yaduktam ---- 

"dhāraṇapreraṇakṣobhanirodhāstena (cāvaśā1ḥ?) | 

na syusteṣāmasāmarthye ta(sya)2 dīkṣādyanantaram ||"

iti tadadūṣaṇameva | yaduktaṃ pāpasya gurutvābhāvāt pratyayavatī 
tulādīkṣā nopapadyate iti; tadaviditābhiprāyatayā na samyak, 
yatastamomayapāpāvṛtihetukaṃ dehe gurutvaṃ tulādīkṣayā ghaṭaśuddhivat 
kāraṇanivṛttidvāreṇa nivartyate | tathā ca smṛtikāraḥ ---- 

"adharmāttamaso dehe gurutvaṃ yatkṣayo'sya tu | 

dharmato laghutotpādāddhaṭataḥ sampratīyate ||" 

iti | 

tathaivaitat | yatpunaruktamanāyātaśaktipātasya dīkṣyatvābhāvāt 
śaktipātavata eva dīkṣā, śaktipāto malakṣayāt sa ca 
śaktipātāditītaretarāśrayaḥ, akṣīṇamalasya śaktipāte sarvasyāsau 
syāt, atha malakṣayasya śaktipātādanyo hetuḥ kaścit sa eva tahī 
śaktipāte heturastu kiṃ malakṣayeṇetiṃ | satyametat, kiṃntu 
nirargalapārameśavicitraśaktipātavato dīkṣyatvamasmābhiriṣyate, na tu 
malaparipākādiyuktasyeti na kaściduktacodyāvaskarasaṃsparśa 
ityupapannameva dīkṣayātmasaṃskaraṇam | api ca, 
sakalavyavahāraprāṇitabhūtasarvābhyupagamāvigītaprasiddhisiddha-
sarvajñamaheśvarapraṇītatvapratītapramāṇye 
prekṣāpūrvakāryācāryaparamparānuṣṭhīyamānānuṣṭhānaprakaṭita-
tattatsarvanirvāṇādyāpyāyanādinānāphalalabdhasaṃvāde pārameśvare 
śāstre yadyathābhidhīyate tattathaiva | tataśca yaduktam ---- 

"āgamasya tathābhāvanibandhanamapaśyatām | 

muktirāgamamārgeṇa vadanaparitoṣakṛt ||" iti,

tadasadeva | yatpunaḥ ---- 

"tasmādanādisaṃtānatulyajātīyabījikām | 

utkhātamūlāṃ kuruta sattvadṛṣṭiṃ mumukṣavaḥ ||"

ityuktyā ātmadṛṣṭerahantāvikalpavāsanāmūlatvamuktam 
tatpratāraṇamātrameva, yataḥ śironirdeśa(prakhyā)1 
kṛtakāhaṃvimarśamayatvamātmanyaṅguli-
nirdeśaprakhyāsāṅketikedaṃvimṛśyatvamiva viṣayeṣu svasaṃvedanena 
pratīyata eva, anyathā prathamasaṅketagrahaṇameva na kasyāpi ghaṭeta |  
nanvahaṃpratītevīkalpavāsanāmūlatvamuktam, tat katham, yato yo vikalpo 
jñānasaṃtānamahantayābhimanyate, sa kiṃ svātmano bhedena taṃ 
tathādhyavasyati, svātmābhedena vā | bhedapakṣe idamiti 
jñānasaṃtānasyādhyavasāyaḥ syānnatvahamiti | abhedapakṣe tu vikalpasya 
svātmāpi vikalpaḥ proktaḥ, na ca tadyuktaṃ 
svātmanyavikalpakatvādvikalpānām | atha vikalpaḥ svātmano jñānāntaraiḥ 
saha bhedaṃ nādhyavasyati, na tvabhedamadhyavasyatītyucyate, tahī 
adhyavasāye pratiṣedhaḥ patita ityanadhyavasāyavyāpāra eṣa syāt | 
athātmano jñānāntaraiḥ saha 
bhedamanadhyavasyannavāntarāṇyabhedenādhyavasyati, tahī yenātmanā saha 
yeṣāṃ jñānānāṃ bhedo nādhyavasitaḥ, teṣāmabhedādhyavasāye 
tasyātmano'pyabhedādhyavasāyaḥ prāptaḥ, ātmavadvā teṣāmapyaprāptaḥ, 
anyathātmanā saha kasteṣāṃ bhedaḥ | na adhyavasāyaḥ, bhedādhyavasāya 
eva hyayamitthaṃ syāt | kiṃ ca, anubhavasaṃskārotthamātmano 
rūpavaicitryamanubhavatāpi vikalpena 
nivṛttapūrvāṇyanubhavāntarāṇyavasātuṃ śakyante, tatrāsya 
nārikeladvīpanivāsitulyatvāt | na cāsya 
prakāśātirikto'dhyavasāyasamāropābhimāna-
niścayādipadavācyābhiprāyeṇābhedavācyaḥ kaścidanyo vyāpāro 
vyavasthāpakaḥ paradarśane saṅgacchata ityāstāmatigahanametat, 
pratyabhijñāyāṃ vitatamastīha tu pratanyamānaṃ 
sukumārahṛdayānāyāsayet | tatsthitametat 
tattadābhāsabhede'pyakṛtakāhaṃ vimarśasiddhaikyaparamārtho'yamātmā 
iti | nanu ca śrīmatkheṭapālācāryeṇa malaparipākahetukaḥ 
śaktipāto'bhyupagataḥ svatantraśaktipātapakṣaśca dūṣitaḥ, tatkathaṃ 
svatantraśaktipātapakṣāśrayaṇenaitat pratisamāhitam ? atrocyate ---- 
atrārthe yadi vividiṣāsti tadetadapi nirṇīyate | śrūyatām ----  

"athānādirmalaḥ puṃsāṃ paśutvaṃ parikītītam | 

tuṣakambukavajjñeyaṃ māyājamaṅkurasya tu ||"

iti śrīsvāyaṃbhuvasūtre "mala" iti "puṃsām" iti coktiparyālocanayā 
eko'pyasau bahuśaktikaḥ anyathā bahvāvārakatvamasya na ghaṭate, ekamuktau 
ca sarve mucyeran, karmabhiśca saha pariṇamati, amiśrasya pariṇāmāyogāt | 
pariṇamaṃśca kālaviśeṣāt kaṃcitprati kathaṃcit tīvramadhyādibhedād 
yadā paripacyate, tadā puṃsāṃ karmaparipākamivāpekṣya śaktipātaṃ 
karoti maheśvaraḥ, yāvacca malasya paripāko na jātaḥ, tāvat 
tatpuṃbandhakatvenaiva taṃ pariṇamayati, yadā tu kṛtakāryatvādātmani 
pakvaṃ paśyati svaśaktipātānmalaśaktiṃ nirūṇaddhi asau | yathā ca 
svatantraśaktipātavādipakṣe pratipuruṣaṃ kiñcideva karma kadācideva 
devaḥ paripācya bhogabhogyaṃ karoti, na tu sarvān prati sarvaṃ yugapat, 
tattvāni ca niyatakāryakāraṇabhāvabhāñji darśayati, māyāprakṛtyādi 
ca svāpaprabodhayoraucityena pariṇamayatīti nāsya sarvatrāviśeṣeṇa 
kartṛtvam, tathā malaparipākapakṣe'pīti karmaṇo malasya ca vicitraṃ 
paripākamapekṣya nigrahānugrahau puṃsāṃ karoti parameśvaraḥ, na 
tvevameva, tasyāprekṣāpūrvakāritvaprasaṅgāditi 
tāvacchrīmatkheṭapālācāryamatam | yadāha bhogakārikāsu ---- 

"anādyanādisambaddho malaḥ sādhāraṇo'kṣayaḥ | 

pratipuṃniyataḥ svasvakālavyāpṛtaśaktikaḥ ||" (ślo0 128)

iti | tathā

"muktvā nirodhikāḥ śaktīrnānyo dharmo'sya vidyate | 

karmāśayasametasya hetutvaṃ ca bhavārṇave ||" (ślo0 140)

iti | tadatra yadi svātantryānmalo bandhakaḥ, śivamuktāṇūn pratyapi syāt 
| atha śivecchā (taḥ), tacchivasya vītarāgadveṣatvād muktāṇūn pratyapi 
malaśaktiprerakatvaṃ syāt | teṣāṃ svasvarūpābhivyakterna tathā iti cet, 
netareṣāmapi svasvarūpasya tathātvāt | anādimalanirodhānna 
tathātvamityayuktam, tannirodhasyaiva vicārayituṃ prakrāntatvāt | yadi 
cānādinīrodhaḥ, kṛtaṃ śivaśaktyadhiṣṭhānena | tadapyanādi cet, 
kimubhābhyām, malaśaktikṛtanirodhasyānāditvamātreṇaiva sulebhenottareṇa 
niyatapuṃviṣayatvamucyatām | evamastviti cenna, śivasya 
sarvatrādhiṣṭhātṛtvaṃ syāt, tataśca ---- 

"malasaṃsargāttadvatteṣāmakṛto hi śivavaśīkāraḥ | 

patyustvete rodhyā.............................. ||" (ta0tra0ni0,kā0 9)

iti kimarthamuktam | ata eva śivasya malaśaktyadhiṣṭhātṛtvamapīṣyate iti 
cetsatyam, iṣyate, na tu siddhyati, dvayoranāditvenānvayavyatirekābhāvāt, 
prayojanamātravaśena ca bhāvavyavasthānupapatteḥ | astu, naivaṃ tathāpi 
yān prati nirodhāya śivo malaṃ prayuṅkte, te śivatulyatvād bahutvācca 
pratyuta śivameva prati taṃ prayuñjīran, bhūyasāmekāpekṣayā 
sāmarthyātiśayāt | kiṃ ca malaśaktiryadi saṃnidhimātreṇa nirodhikā 
tacchivamuktāṇūn pratyapi syāt | atha 
jñātṛtvakartṛtvātmakasvarūpāvārakatvena (nirodhikā?), tahī ātmanāṃ 
vikāritā prāptā, svarūpanāśo vā, teṣām tadatiriktasya dhamīrūpasya 
vaiśeṣika iva śaive'nabhyupagamāt | na ca mūrtena 
malenātmanāmamūrtacitsvarūpāṇāmāvaraṇaṃ ghaṭate | 
cakṣusūryādiraśmīnāṃ tu bhautikatvāt paṭalādibhistadyujyata eva | 
yadapi madyaviṣāderjīvaṃ pratyāvārakatvam, tatsiddhasaṅkocaṃ 
prāṇādimayaṃ prati na śuddhacidātmānam | malasaṅkoca eva tvayaṃ 
prāthamiko vicāryo vartate, iti sa kathaṃ śuddhacidātmana āvārakaḥ syāt 
| pratyutā (raṇā)1 yāyāto malo'sya vedyaḥ syāditi sarvaḥ sarvajño 
bhavet | malaśca yadyavyāpakastasya vyāpakātmāvārakatā na syāt | 
vyāpakatve tu śivamuktāṇūnapyāvṛṇuyātteṣāṃ jīvānāṃ ca 
sarvadeśākrāntyātmano vyāpakatvasyāviśeṣāttasya ca pratyaṃśaṃ 
vyāpakena malenācchādanāt | ātmamalayośca na saṃyogaḥ sambandhastasya 
vyāpyavṛttitvāt tayośca vyāpakatvāt, na samavāyo nityadravyayostadayogāt 
| ata eva na kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ | nāpi tādātmyaṃ, bhinnatvāt | 
āvāryāvārakatāpi ghaṭapaṭādau na saṃyogāt vyatiriktā bhavitumarhati | 
kiṃ ca, malasya nityatvaṃ vyāpakatvamekatvamanekaśaktitvaṃ  
śivasvabhāvātmadṛkkriyānirodhanenaitannirodhaparipacane ca svātantryam, 
śivasya ca muktaśivebhyo'ṇubhyaśca bhinnatvamata 
evātadvyāpakatvamaviśvaśaktitvaṃ ca karmamalaparipākādimukhaprekṣitayā 
ca pāratantryamityādi bhedavādikṛtaṃ śivamalayoḥ 
viparyastasvarūpapratipādanamatisubhāṣitam | yacca malasya 
pariṇāmitvamucyate taistadamiśrasyāsya kathaṃ syāt | karmabhiḥ sahitasya 
bhaviṣyatīti cenna, tāni malasyāntavīśantīti kāsya taiḥ saha miśratā 
| yadyapi ---- 

"māyāvikārayoge karmayutaḥ kāraṇaṃ malo bhavinām" (taṃ0tra0ni0, kā0 
11)

ityuktaṃ bharvādbhaḥ, tathāpi vijñānakevalināṃ malasya 
karmasāhityābhāvāt pariṇāmāyoge muktyabhāvaḥ syāt | 
mantramantreśvarādīnāṃ ca yo'yamadhikārabandhaḥ, nāsau 
sahajamalakṛtaḥ tasya māyordhve'bhāvāditi tadarthaṃ 
malāntaramabhyupagantavyam | teṣāṃ māheśyā mahāmāyāśaktyaiva 
tāvatāṃśena bandhatvam, na tu vyatiriktenānyena maleneti cet, aṇūnāmapi 
māyāśaktyā saṅkucitatvābhāsanaṃ bandhanamastu, 
kimanupapannavyatiriktamalābhyupagamena | ananubandhe mantrādīnāmapi 
tādṛśo vyatirikto malo'bhyupagamyatām |  kiñca, ayaṃ malo'dhvani na 
kvāpyanupraviṣṭa iti kathamasya ṣaḍadhvadīkṣāyāmantarbhāvya śuddhiḥ 
kriyate ? karmavat puṃstattvāntarbhāvo'syeti cenna, kartrātmanaḥ puṃsaḥ 
karmāṇi saṃskārātmatayā'ntarbhavantīti yuktam, kartṛniṣṭhatvāt 
kriyāṇām, malasya tu vyatiriktasya kathaṃ tadantarbhāvaḥ | 
kiñca, nāvārakeṇa paṭādinā ghaṭādeḥ svarūpaṃ viśiṣyate, api tu 
tadviṣaye jñāturjñānaṃ vihanyate, tathā śivamuktāṇūnāmeva sa malaḥ 
syāt, teṣāṃ malena puṃviṣayajñānāvaraṇāditi malasyāvārakatvaṃ 
tāvadayuktam | yaśca malasya paripāko'bhidhīyate, sa kiṃ tasya 
tacchaktervā vināśaḥ, uta nirodhapratibandhaḥ | ādye pakṣe ekatra
