tatparipāke sarve śuddhāḥ syuḥ, tacchakteranekatvābhyupagame'pi 
sadṛśatvācchaktimadavyatirekāccaiṣa eva prasaṅgaḥ | 
phalabhedādāropitabhedo hi padārthātmaiva śaktiriti sūrayaḥ | na 
cānādervastubhūtasya malaśaktinirodhasya nāśo yuktaḥ, prāgabhāvasya 
tvavastutvāt sa bhavatu nāma | śaktinirodhapratibandho'pi 
viṣavahniśaktipratibandhavat sarvāneva prati syāt | tadvadeva ca 
pratibandhakanivṛttau tannirodhaḥ punarunmajjet | paripākaścāsya 
yadyahetukaḥ prathamameva syāt, vṛkṣaphalānāmivartau malaśaktīnāṃ 
samameva vā sāmanantaryeṇa vā paripākaḥ syāt, 
nātyantadūrakālavyavadhānena | atha ---- 

"puṃbalarodhaṃ kurvan paśyati hi sa śaktisāphalyam | 

dṛṣṭvā ca tannivṛttyai yogyaṃ yuṅkte nṛmuktaye karaṇam ||" (ta0tra0ni0, 
kā0 21)

ityuktanītyā malaḥ svakāryaṃ kṛtvā pacyate, tat punnirodhānantarameva 
pacyet | atha yadarthaṃ punnirodhaḥ, tasmin kalādikṣityantatattvodaye bhoge 
bhukte sati pacyate, tadatrabhogo yadi sāmānyena, tadekatra śarīre 
kalādikṣityantamaye tatkāryasya bhogasya sampannatvāt tadanantarameva 
malaparipākaḥ syāt | atha viśeṣeṇa, tanna kadācidapi, bhāvikalātmano 
viśeṣasya karmajabhogavaicitryasya tadutthatvāt | atheśvarecchāto malasya 
paripākaḥ, tadīyecchā yadyaniyantritā, hetuḥ sarvāṇūnāṃ 
syādityuktameva | atha bhogaparyāyataḥ; kadācidviruddhe samabale karmaṇī 
paripakve api virodhādudāsāte, karmāntarāṇi cāparipakvatvādbhogāya 
nonmukhībhavanti, iti taṃ kālamapekṣya bhagavān malaṃ ruṇaddhi, sa ca 
kālo duḥkhasukharahitaḥ svayamupalabhyetāpi kaiściditi pak,saḥ | 
tadatrāpi brūmahe ---- karmaṇāṃ kramānuṣṭhitānāṃ kramikaphalānāṃ 
kathaṃ tāvadyugapatphaladānaunmukhyam, kathaṃ vā tannirodhāvasare 
tato'nyat karma phalaṃ na dadyāt | tasya svakāla eva phaladānonmukhatvaṃ 
na tu tatkāla iti cet, tayorapi tahī na tadekakālaṃ yuktam | īśvarecchāta 
eveti cet sā yadi svatantrā, tadyugapat sarvasya sarvakarmaparipākāt 
tadbhogaṃ dattvā muktiṃ vitaratu, karmānapekṣayā vā sarvasya malaṃ 
ruṇaddhu | athāsvatantrā, tadatrāpi tasya hetvantaraṃ vaktavyam | yasya ca 
tulyabale karmaṇī bhogonmukhe ruddhe tasya tatkālaṃ dehapātaḥ syāt | atha 
na jātyāyuṣpradayoḥ karmaṇonīrodho'pi tu bhogapradayoreva | nanu 
jātyāyuṣpradakarmānirodhe'pi yadīśo malaṃ rundhe, tadbhogapradāt kimiti 
bibheti, yattannirodhamavaśyamapekṣate | yadi ca 
ruddhaśaktikarmadaśāyāmeva malaṃ rundhyāt, tatsa pralayāvasthāyāṃ 
sarveṣāṃ tathā kuryāt | tatrāpi ca teṣāṃ 
tādṛgbhogapradakarmasaṅgo'stīti cet, viruddhakarmadvayasaṅge 
tādṛgbhogadaṃ karmāstīti kiṃ vaktuṃ na śakyate | kiñca, 
vijñānākalānāṃ kārmamalaśūnyānāmīśvaro yugapanmalaṃ 
rundhyādityaṣṭau bodhitavāniti śāstreṣu saṃkhyāniyamānupapattiḥ | 
atha satyapi karmasāmye paripakvameva malamīśecchā ruṇaddhīti 
kairaṇavyākhyātṛmatamāśrīyate, tahī uktadūṣaṇāvṛttiranupapannā 
vyarthakarmasāmyābhyupagamadoṣaścāpatati | etena tadapi pratyuktaṃ 
yadāhuḥ kecit ---- 

"vairāgyaṃ bhogavairasyaṃ dharmaḥ ko'pi vivekitā | 

satsaṅgaḥ parameśānapūjādyabhyāsanityatā || 

āpatprāptistannirīkṣā dehe kiñcicca lakṣaṇam | 

śāstrasevā bhogasaṅghapūrṇatā jñānamaiśvaram || 

ityādihetuke cecchā malaṃ rundhe haṭhāditi | "

yata etadudaye'pi yadīśecchaiva kāraṇaṃ tadanyonyāśrayaḥ | 
kāraṇāntaraṃ ca vaktumaśakyam, tasyāpi niyamāyogāt | na caite sarve 
hetavaḥ, īśecchāyā āyātaśaktipātānāṃ tathārūpatvādṛṣṭeḥ, 
nāpyekaikasyeśecchāhetutvam, vairāgyādeḥ śataśo vyabhicāradarśanāt, 
parameśapūjājñānādeśca malaparipākapūrvakatvāt, na 
tvīśecchāpracodakatvaṃ yuktam | yatpunaranyaduktam ---- puṃsāṃ mukteḥ 
kramikatvaṃ dṛṣṭvā īśecchāyā api malaparipākahetutvaṃ 
kramikamanumīyate, yathā bhogasya kramāttaddhetukarmaparipākahetutvaṃ 
kramikamiti, tadasat, mukteḥ kramo malaparipākakramāt, so'pi 
īśaśaktikṛtaparipacanakramāditi satyam, īśaśaktestu malaparipācanakrame 
heturna labhyate, svātantrye tvalaṃ malaparipākāpekṣayā | tasmānna 
kathañcidapi bhedavādibhirmalapṛthaktvaṃ 
tacchaktinirodhatatpariṇāmatatparipākaśaktipātādayaḥ pratipādayituṃ 
śakyante, iti yathoktameva sādhu | yadyapi caturthapaṭale ---- 

"abhilāṣo malo'tra tu" (4-105)

ityatra malasvarūpavicārasyāvasaro'bhūt, tathāpīha ekapraghaṭṭakena 
paścāttadvicāritam, mā bhūttatra dīkṣātantranibhālanodyatānāṃ 
sukumārahṛdayānāṃ vyāmoha iti | kiñca, bhedavāde jīvānāmānantye'pi 
punaranyeṣāmudayābhāvāt īśvareṇeyattayā paricchedyamānatvācca 
naiyatyaṃ saṃsārasya cānāditvamato yadi pratiyugamekaiko'ṇurmucyate, 
taduccheda eva saṃsārasya prasaktaḥ | atha jīvānāṃ tādṛgānantyamasti, 
yadīśenāpi na paricchidyate tahī īśasyāsarvajñatā syāt | taduktaṃ 
śārīrake muninā ---- 

"antavattvamasarvajñatā vā" (2-2-41) 

iti | 

āstāmetat | yattu taiḥ svatantraśaktipātavādipakṣe coditamīśvarasya 
ninīmitte nigrahādikāritve'prekṣāpūrvakāritvaṃ 
yugapatsarvatattvasraṣṭṛtā sarvaṃ prati ca yugapatsarvakarmaphalapradatā 
jīvānāṃ ca muktau svarūpanāśaḥ punarbhavāvirbhāvaśca syādāgameṣu 
ca malasya vastutvābhidhānānupapattiriti, 
tadeṣāmaparyālocitatanmatasatattvamabhidhānam, yatastanmate 
pārameśacitprakāśavyatirekeṇa na kiñcidapyupapannamiti sa eva 
svātantryāt śivādikṣityantānantaviśvātmanā 
svarūpamavabibhāsayiṣustathā tathā bhātīti na 
kaścidanugrahanigrahādibhājanaṃ jano'śuddhiparīto vā'sti | atha ca 
nigṛhītānugṛhītatattatpramātṝṃstattatprameyajātaṃ ca svabhittau 
darpaṇanagaravat sa evoṭṭaṅkayan pañcakṛtyakāritāṃ nirbhāsayannapi na 
manāgapyatiricyate, atiricyate vā darpaṇavadeveti sa eva paraṃ 
prekṣāpūrvakārī yaścitracamatkāramayatvād yathā ca viśvamābhāsayati 
tathā tanmadhye niyatapaurvāparyakramamapi yatra yatra prathayati tatra tatra 
kāryakāraṇabhāvanaiyatyātmanā karmaphalādivaicitryeṇa 
nimīlitarūpatayā tadupasaṃhāreṇa conmīlitarūpatayeti tāvatyaṃśe 
baddhamuktarūpatayā vastutastu sa eva tāvadviśvātmanā sphuratīti na 
kaścidanyo baddho mukto vāsti | na caivaṃ svarūpāpattyātmani mokṣe 
svarūpanāśo'sti | saṅkocanāśastviṣṭa eva | na ca prāptaśivābhedasya 
sarvasarvātmatayā sarvatra sarvadā sphurataḥ punarbhavo'sti | 
paramaśivasyaiva satattvasya śivādisakalāntenāpi mahatā svasvarūpeṇa 
saratastāvatāṃśena tattadrūpatocyatām | tattvatastu 
paripūrṇaviśvasphāraḥ parameśvara evāsau | ataśca punarbhavaprasaṅgaḥ 
syāditi yaduktaṃ tadayuktameveti ---- 

"anādyaśuddhiśūnyatvāt prāpnoti na bhavāntaram |"

ityādau āgamoktau na kācidvimatiḥ | na cāsyeyadvimarśātmatāptau 
pariṇatibrahmavādipakṣoktadūṣaṇāvakāśaḥ kaścit, 
viśvātmakasvasvarūpavijṛmbhāmayatvena 
vivartapariṇāmapakṣayoranabhyupagamāt | tadittham ---- 


saṅkocavikāsavatā tadubhayayuktena tadvimuktena | 

sarvātmanā ca satataṃ svacchandaścidghanaḥ sphurati || 1 || 

yadyatsphurati ca tattadvastu dharaṇyādi tadvadeva ca | 

paurvāparyaniyatyā tattvānāṃ kramikatāpi yuktaiva || 2 || 

saṅkucitajīvarūpaṃ tattatkarmābhimānatatphalabhuk | 

bhāsayati kramaśo'sau dīkṣādāvakrameṇāpi || 3 || 

itthaṃ saṅkocātmāpyabhilāṣo lauliketi gadito yaḥ | 

so'pi tathātvasphuraṇādvastveva malo'stu śāstreṣu || 4 || 

dīkṣāyogajñānairdhvaṃse'pi malasya nātmanāśo'sti | 

svacchasvacchandātmakacidghanatāvyaktireva yanmokṣaḥ || 5 || 

jalamiva jale vinihitaṃ payasi payo yadvadapītaṃ tadvat | 

yāntyekatvaṃ dīkṣyā dīkṣākrameṇa dīkṣitā iti hi || 6 || 

rauravaśāstre'pyuktaṃ prāyastaṃ vṛthaiva vṛttikṛtā | 

yenārthavyākhyābhistasmin devastathā tathā prathitaḥ || 7 || 

tadalaṃ bhedavikalpairanargaleśānaśaktipātotthā | 

svacchandaśivaikyamayī muktirdīkṣādito ghaṭate || 8 || 

itthaṃ dīkṣopāyo yo yo yairyairyathā yathā vihitaḥ | 

so'pītthameva sarvaḥ samarthyatāṃ śaktipāteddhaiḥ || 9 || 


yuktyastrairdhārmakīrtaṃ dalitamiha mataṃ dūṣaṇodgāri samyag
	vidhvastaṃ kheṭapālaiḥ kathitamapi malaṃ bhedasaṃdhānadakṣam | 

proktaṃ dīkṣāsatattvaṃ pravigalitamalapronmiṣaccinmayaikya	
svacchasvacchandadhāmaprathanavaśabhavat sarvasarvātmarūpam || 10 || 

iti bhadram ||  || 

iti śrīsvacchandatantre 
śrīmahāmāheśvarācāryavaryaśrīkṣemarājaviracitoddyotākhyavyākhyopete
tattvādidīkṣāprakāśanaṃ nāma pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥ || 5 || 




ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ

" svacchandodyotaḥ "

hrasvākāraviriñcijāgaradharitryādyā hi ye pañcakāḥ
	śaktyādyāśca tathaiva śaṅkaranuteḥ pūrṇāvamarśātmanaḥ | 

ye prāptapraṇavābhidhāḥ kuśalavalleśe'pi viśvaprathāstaṃ 
	pañcapraṇavaṃ smarāmi satataṃ svacchandadhāmāptaye || 

praśnagranthe kālasya sādhanānāṃ ca svarūpaṃ nirṇetumavaśiṣṭam | 
tatra samanantarapaṭalena kālo nirṇeṣyate, sa ca bāhulyena siddhyaṅgam, 
siddhayo mantrasādhanapūvīkā iti sādhanānāṃ svarūpanirṇayāya 
pañcamapaṭalānte "mantrasiddhena vā" iti yadāsūtritaṃ tadvibhaktumāha --
-- 


samayācārayuktasya sādhakasya varānane | 

jāyate vividhā siddhiḥ.........


samayāḥ pūrvoktāḥ | ācāro vakṣyamāṇo mantrārādhanaprakāraḥ | 

varamutkṛṣṭaṃ

śāktasphāramayam, ānanaṃ bhogāpavargapradaparapadapraveśo yasyāḥ || 

ācāraṃ krameṇa sphuṭayati ---- 


...............girigahvaramāśrite || 6-1 || 

suśuddhe bhūpradeśe tu sarvaśalyavivajīte | 

pracchanne vijane ramye bhairavaṃ tatra pūjayet || 6-2 || 


sarvaśalyavivajītatvamahikaṇṭakaparuṣavātopadravaprasravādihīnatvam | 
pracchanne'dṛśye | pūjayediti kāmanocitena saṃbhāreṇa || 2 || 

atha ---- 


japitvākṣaralakṣaṃ tu bahurūpasya suvrate | 

pañcapraṇavasaṃyogājjapataḥ siddhyati dhruvam || 6-3 || 


bahurūpasya pūrvanirṇītaparamārthasya akṣarāṇāṃ dvātriṃśataḥ 
parimāṇena, lakṣamiti dvātriṃśallakṣāṇi, pūrvasevārthaṃ japitvā, 
dhruvaṃ niścitam, siddhyati yatheṣṭāṃ siddhimeti sādhakaḥ | kathaṃ 
japitvā? ---- ityāha ---- pañcapraṇavasaṃyogājjapataḥ | prakarṣeṇa 
nūyate stūyate, abhedaparamārthatayā vimṛśyate, aśeṣaviśvanirbharaṃ 
pārameśvaraṃ svarūpaṃ yena sa praṇavo niṣkalanāthaḥ, 
tadabhinnivyāptika oṃkāro'pi | tasya ca 
mṛgamadakulakaikadeśaleśavadviśleṣyamāṇākārādikalāḥ, tadvācyā 
brahmādidevatāḥ, tadadhiṣṭhātṝṇi dharāprakṛtimāyāditattvāni, 
varṇoccārakalā hrasvādirūpāḥ, taduccārayitravasthāśca jāgradādyāḥ 
pratyekaṃ pañcasaṃkhyāḥ sthūlāḥ 
śaktivyāpinyādikalāstadvācyataduccāraṇakalādirūpāśca 
sūkṣmadaśāḥ, "pradeśo'pi brahmaṇaḥ 
sārvarūpyamanatikrāntaścāvikalpyaśca" iti sthityā 
paripūrṇacamatkārapūrṇatvāt praṇavaśabdavācyāḥ | ata 
evaitanmantraśarīraniviṣṭatvādete'kārādayo 
brahmaviṣṇurudraśaktiśivapraṇavābhidheyapiṇḍabījaviśeṣā 
bhinnasphārā iti kṛtvā, ete pūrvoktāḥ sarva eva pañca praṇavā vidyante 
yatra sa pañcapraṇavo niṣkalastadabhinnavyāptiroṅkāraśca | tasmin 
pañcapraṇave samyagyogāduccāronmīlitahaṃsapadānulagnatātmakatvāt 
pūrvanirṇītaniṣkalavyāptyabhinnasatattvasakalamantrarahasyārthabhāvanā-
rūpaśca yo japastasmājjapato na tvakṣarapāṭhamātrādityarthaḥ || 3 || 

na kevalamitthaṃ japāt siddhyati yāvat ---- 


mucyate na tu saṃdeho bhedanāt praṇavasya tu | 


pañcapraṇavasaṃyogājjapata iti yaduktaṃ 
tadvakṣyamāṇavarṇakalādiviśleṣeṇa vyāptirūpaṃ bhedanaṃ vinā na 
bhavati | bhedanaṃ paratattvāveśapradamiti muktenīḥsaṃśayatvamuktam || 

tatra mantroccārāṅgabhūtakālakalājñānapūrvakālātītapada-
praveśārthaṃ tāvadbhedanamādiśati devaḥ ---- 


hrasvaṃ dīrghaṃ plutaṃ sūkṣmamatisūkṣmaṃ paraṃ śivam || 6-4 || 

praṇavaṃ pañcadhā jñātvā bhitvā mokṣo na saṃśayaḥ | 


praṇavamakārokāramakārābindunādakaloccāreṣu krameṇa  
hrasvādyatisūkṣmāntoccāraṇakālakalāprapañcarūpaṃ bhittvā 
tattaddaśānubhavānupraveśakrameṇādhyāsya paraṃ 
bhāvamunmanāpadāsādanena jñātvā mokṣamāpnotyevetyarthaḥ | atra ca 
hrasvādinādāntāḥ parasparānuṣaktatayoccāryāḥ, 
sūkṣmātisūkṣmayobīndunādayorupari 
ardhacandrādinādanādāntādidaśāstā ratamyabhājo'pyanusartavyāḥ | 
yathoktaṃ prāk ---- 

śūkṣmasūkṣmatarairbhāvairevamevaṃ tyajet priye | " (4-267)

iti | hrasvādīnāṃ yathā praṇavatvaṃ tathā nirṇītam, iti 
sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ yuktameva | na saṃśaya ityuktyā 
svānubhavasiddhatāmasya darśayati || 4 || 

taditthaṃ hrasvādikālakalākrameṇa vakṣyamāṇavācakādikrameṇa 
caiko'pyayaṃ mahāmantrātmā ---- 


praṇavaḥ pañcadhāvasthaḥ................


pūrvam ---- 

"pradeśo'pi brahmaṇaḥ sārvarūpyamanatikrāntaḥ"

iti sthityā hrasvādayaḥ pañca praṇavā ityabhihitamadhunā tveka eva 
mahāvimarśātmā mantra itthaṃ pañcadhā'vatiṣṭhata ityevamabhihitam 
ityuktibhedamātrametat, nirṇītadṛśā vastutattvaikyāt || 

kimitthaṃ pañcadhāvasthitimātrātmaivāyam ? netyāha ---- 


..............ḥaṃsena saha saṃyuktaḥ || 6-5 || 


pūrvaṃ

"haṃsoccārastvathocyate | 

hakārastu smṛtaḥ prāṇaḥ supravṛtto halākṛtiḥ ||" (4-257)

iti granthena haṃso'nāhatadhvaniriti nirṇītam | atastena 
svapravṛttatvādevākṛtakamadhyamaprāṇasphurattārūpeṇa 
samanantaravakṣyamāṇanītyāśeṣaviśvavāṅmayasphāramayena saha 
saṃyutastadvimarśaviśrāntiparamārtho'yamatratyo mahāmantrarūpaḥ 
praṇavaḥ || 5 || 


yatkiñcidvāṅmayaṃ loke śivajñāne pratiṣṭhitam | 

śivajñānaṃ ca tatrasthaṃ.............


yatkiñcit ṣaḍadhvano madhyālloke'sti, tatsarvaṃ śivajñānaṃ ca śivo 
jñāyate'neneti śivajñānaṃ śivajñāne jñānasphāramaye 
pārameśoktavyāptisāre praṇave proktavakṣyamāṇadṛśā 
pratiṣṭhitamabhedenāntaḥsthitam, yatastadvāṅmayaṃ parāvākprasararūpam 
| yathoktaṃ śrīsārasvate stotre ---- 

"trayīṃ tisro vṛttīstribhuvanamatho trīnapi svarā
	nakārādyairvarṇaistribhirabhidadhattīrṇavikṛti | 

turīyaṃ te dhāma dhvanibhiranurundhānamaṇubhiḥ
	samastavyastaṃ tvāṃ śaraṇada gṛṇātyomiti padam ||" (ma0sto0 27)

iti | "praṇave" iti vaktavye "śivajñāne" ityukterayaṃ bhāvaḥ yad 
vedagāruḍavaiṣṇavādiṣu rūpasāmye'pi praṇavasya pārameśvare 
proktavakṣyamāṇajñānavyāptisāratākṛta utkarṣaḥ | ata eva 
etadvyāptijñānānusāreṇa sarvatrāpyasau pūrṇasphāramayatvena 
parasiddhipradaḥ | yathoktam ---- 

"yataḥ śivodbhavaṃ sarvaṃ śivadhāmaphalapradam" (sva0 5-45)

iti | tattatparimitavyāptyanusāreṇa tu sa eva mitasiddhipradaḥ | 
yadabhiprāyeṇa vakṣyati ---- 

"bhramayatyeva tān māyā hyamokṣe mokṣalipsayā" (10-1141)

iti, āstāṃ tāvadetadiha | yaccaitadevaṃvidhapraṇavātmakaṃ śivajñānaṃ 
tadapi tatreti nirūpitasatattve haṃse, tiṣṭhati ||  

taditthamasminniṣkalanāthe pañcapraṇave nityoccarannādāvamarśarūpaḥ ---
- 


...........ḥaṃsaḥ praṇavasaṃyutaḥ || 6-6 || 


praṇave proktasatattve samyagyutaḥ prāṇarūpatayā sthitaḥ, ata 
evāśeṣaviśvakroḍīkārihaṃsasambandhādeva 
śāstrāntaroktabrahmaviṣṇurudraśaktiśivapraṇavā bhedavyāptirayaṃ 
mahāmantra ityuktameva | ataśca yaduktam ---- 

"pañcapraṇavasaṃyogājjapataḥ siddhyati dhruvam" (6-3)

iti, tatrānāhataviśrāntisatattvo 
niṣkaloccārapraguṇīkṛtamadhyadhāmasaṃlīnatayā japaḥ kāryaḥ, iti 
paramārthaḥ paryavasitaḥ || 6 || 

atha praṇavasaṃyogaṃ vinā kīdṛgayam ? ityāśaṅkyāha ---- 


vinā praṇavasaṃyogājjīva eko vyavasthitaḥ | 


jīvo viśvasya prāṇabhūto halākṛtireva | yathoktam ---- 

"hakārastu smṛtaḥ prāṇaḥ supravṛtto halākṛtiḥ" (4-257)

iti | atra prāṇa ityakārādikalātmakapraṇavasaṃyogaṃ vinā, eka 
ityadvitīyaḥ | sarvamantravīryāntarvyavasthita 
ityavicaladrūpatayānuccāryaḥ, atha cāvyavasthito na kenacit pratiniyatena 
rūpeṇa sthito'niyantritasphāra ityarthaḥ | jīvaśabdena vyavaharannayameva 
mahāsphurattārūpa ātmā mantavya ---- iti dhvanati | kaścittu 
mantrasvarūpanirūpaṇapare granthe'smin mukhyaṃ ca śabdārthamutsṛjya 
haṃsaśabdena haṃsapathaḥ, prāṇaśabdena ca sa eva, yadi vā 
praṇavaprāṇayoraikyāt prāṇayogaṃ vinā jīvaḥ puruṣaḥ, eka 
ityanabhivyaktajñānakriyāsvabhāvaḥ ---- iti vyācaṣṭe | tadyuktamayuktaṃ 
veti sacetaso jānanti || 

yato'yaṃ praṇavasaṃyogaṃ vinā svarūpamātrāvasthito jīvastataḥ ---- 


yathāprakṛti saṃyukto na ca tiṣṭhati caikataḥ || 7 || 

tathā ṣaṣṭhena saṃbhinno dehe jīvaḥ pravartate | 


jīvo haṃsaḥ prakṛtyanatikrameṇa svabhāvānullaṅghanena saṃyuktaḥ, 
svabhāvānullaṅghanena cāsya ---- 

"vibhaktirnānayorasti" (4-350)

ityuktanītyā'kārasaṅgata eva bhavatītyakāreṇa saṃyukto'sau | ekata 
ityekasminnadvitīye sāmānyaspandātmani rūpe na tiṣṭhati, api tu kiñcit 
spandādhikyamiva bhajate yathā, tathā ṣaṣṭhena ūkāreṇa saṃbhinno 
miśrito dehe pravartate, sarveṇa svābhāvikena prāṇavāhena vaha�llakṣyate 
eva | tathāśabdāpekṣayā yathā śabdo'pyatrādhyāhāryaḥ || 

pūrvoktakaraṇabandhānusāriṇā ---- 


coditastu yadā tena tadā cordhvaṃ pravartate || 6-8 || 


teneti ṣaṣṭhena ūkāreṇārthād bindvādiyuktena | tadā ceti 
tadaivetyarthaḥ | ūrdhvamiti tālvādisthānam | etaccodanāṃ vinā 
tvasyākārayuktasyāpi nordhvapravṛttirbhavatītyarthaḥ || 8 || 

tadittham ---- 


pratyakṣamapi tattattvaṃ mahāmāyāvimohitāḥ | 

kathitaṃ nābhijānanti vinā śāstreṇa codanām || 6-9 || 


tadetannādāvamarśasāraṃ mantratattvaṃ sarvasya pramātṛrūpaṃ 
sadoccaradrūpatvāt svaprakāśamapi, tathā śāstreṇetyāgamavākyaiḥ 
kathitamapi, mahāmāyayā sadāśiveśādīnapi 
mohayantyā'pūrṇatākhyātiparamārthayā viśeṣeṇa 
cidrūpatvādātmasvarūpe viśvatrānantyātmatāvabhāsanapuraḥsaramanātmani 
dehādāvātmatāmavabhāsayantyā mohitāḥ saṅkucattāṃ grāhitāḥ | 
codanāmiti mahāmāyātiraskāriparameśānugrahakāriśaktyudbodhanaṃ vinā 
na abhītyābhimukhyenāśvāsarūḍhyā jānanti | ataḥ 
sarvathaitattattvaparijñānameva paramopādeyamiti tātparyam | uktaṃ ca 
jñānagarbhe ---- 

"tavāmba paramākṣarī bhavati rūpametad bahi	
	vīśatpraṇavarūpatāṃ samupayāti hṛtkoṭare | 

avedyamakṛtātmabhirjanani bindunādātmaya	dvidanti 
	tadahelayā tvadanusaṃsmṛteryoginaḥ ||" iti || 9 || 

tajjñaptyarthamāha ---- 


ṣaṣṭhaścordhvavaho jñeyaḥ svabhāvamukhasaṃsthitaḥ | 


ṣaṣṭha ūkāraḥ, "coditastu yadā tena" (6-8) ityatra ya ūrdhvavaha 
ūrdhvapravartaka uktaḥ, svabhāvo viśvānuprāṇako madhyamārgaḥ, sa eva 
mukhaṃ śivapadaprāptyupāyastatra samyakpūrvoktakaraṇabandhakrameṇoccaran 
jñātavyaḥ || 

ataśca ---- 


aprakāśaḥ svadehastho guṇabhūtaḥ pravartate || 6-10 || 


yo'yaṃ svapravṛttatvāt prakāśayitumaśakyo 
rahasyarūpaścānāhatanāthaḥ, sve ātmīye upacitarūpe madhyadhāmātmani 
dehe tiṣṭhati, nityāvasthitaḥ sa guṇaprakāraṃ bhūtaḥ prāptastena 
yuktaḥ san pravartate ūrdhvamārohatītyarthaḥ || 10 || 

anyathā ---- 


nirguṇastu yadā deva ekākī kālavajītaḥ | 

vijñātavyaṃ na kiñcit syāt kevalo niṣkalastu saḥ || 6-11 || 


svatantracitsphāramayatvād devaḥ, tadatiriktasyābhāvādekākī, nityatvāt 
kālavajītaḥ, īdṛgyo'nāhatanāthaḥ | na ca tadvijñātavyaṃ kiñcit, 
nāsau kenāpi prakāreṇa jñeyo bhavati, jñātrekarūpatvāt, ata eva kevala 
ityadvitīyaḥ | kalābhyo'kārādivarṇebhyo hrasvādikālakalābhyo 
meyatvarūpaparicchedebhyaśca niṣkrāntaḥ, tāśca kalā 
yasmānniṣkrāntāḥ sa eva cidghanaparamārtha iti yāvat | etatsāratvādeva 
ca catuṣkalanātho'pi niṣkala ityucyate || 11 || 

ataśca ---- 


tasya rūpaṃ śarīraṃ ca nāsti varṇaḥ kriyā tathā | 


rūpaṃ śuddhasphaṭikābhatvādi | śarīraṃ pañcavaktrādi vācyagatam | 
varṇaḥ akārādirvācakarūpaḥ | kriyā uccārādirūpā | kaścittu varṇo 
brāhmaṇādiḥ, kriyā taducitā ceṣṭeti || 

taditthaṃ jñeyapakṣāduttīrṇaḥ ---- 


sa kathaṃ gṛhyate sūkṣma agrāhyo nityamavyayaḥ || 6-12 || 


sūkṣmo viśvakāraṇam | agrāhya indriyāgocaraḥ | avyayo'pariṇatidharmā 
|| 12 || 

yato'yamīdṛk ---- 


etasmāt kāraṇād devi ṣaṣṭhaṃ bījaṃ niyojitam | 


asya parameśena mantrarājarūpatā prāptā1 | puṃsāmanugrahāyeti śeṣaḥ 
|| 

tanniyojanācca ---- 


pañcapañcakasaṃyukto dehe sakalaniṣkalaḥ || 6-13 || 


hrasvādirūpamuccāraṇakālakalānāṃ pañcakamekam,  
akārokāramakārabindunādākhyavācakakalānāṃ dvitīyam, 
tadvācyabrahmaviṣṇurudreśasadāśivānāṃ tṛtīyam, 
tadadhiṣṭheyadharāprakṛtimāyeśvarasadāśivatattvādīnāṃ caturtham, 
varṇoccārayitravasthānāṃ jāgarasvapnasuṣuptaturyaturyātītānāṃ 
pañcamamiti pañcabhiruktavakṣyamāṇaiḥ pañcakaiḥ parāpararūpatayā 
sthitairyadā dehe hṛtkaṇṭhādikṣetre saṃyuktastadānā'hatabhaṭṭārako 
niṣkalo'pi vicitredṛkkalāyogāt sakalaniṣkala ucyate ityarthaḥ || 13 ||  

tenaitaduccāraṇe'pi niṣkalatattvaviśrāntāvevāvadhātavyamityāha ---- 


grahaṇaṃ tu yadā tasya yogī yogavicintakaḥ | 

yogenāvāhitasyāpi bhāvamātraṃ tu bhāvayet || 6-14 || 


atra śloke "icchati" ityadhyāhāryam | 
tenoktarūpapañcapañcakavyāptirūpaṃ yogaṃ yo 
vikalpapūrvakāvikalpavimarśātmakaṃ cintayati, sa yogī yadā tasya 
grahaṇamuccāraṇamicchati, tadā yogena 
pūrvoktadivyakaraṇabandhādyātmanā, ā samantādvāhitasya 
madhyadhāmnā'bhīṣṭaṃ padaṃ prāpitasyāpi, bhāvamātramiti ---- 

śattāmātraṃ paraṃ śāntam" (4-293)

iti yojanikāgranthanirṇītamanāhatadhvaniparamārthapūrṇasphurattāṃ 
bhāvayeduktavyāptikamantroccicārayiṣāvimarśapuraḥsaraṃ tadgrahaṇenaiva 
mantrabhūmimāruhya tadaparakoṭau viśrāmyan 
mantravīryamanuśīlayedityarthaḥ | taduktaṃ śivasūtreṣu ---- 

"vidyāśarīrasattā mantrarahasyam" (2-3)

iti, tathā ---- 

"mahāhradānusandhānānmantravīryānupraveśaḥ" (1-22)

iti | mahāhradasya vidyāśarīrasya parasaṃvitsphārasya sattā sphurattā 
mantrāṇāṃ rahasyaṃ vīryam, tatra cānupraveśo mahāhradasya 
madhyamārgasyānugatatayā 
mantravyāptyanusaraṇapūrvakataduccicārayiṣāvimarśānupraveśātmanaḥ 
sandhānānmantraviśrāntyārohādityarthaḥ || 14 ||  

evaṃ mantravīryānupraveśayuktimuktvā sādhakocitaṃ 
tadanupraveśakramamāha ---- 


yadā karoti sṛṣṭiṃ ca ūrdhve binduḥ pravartate | 


ārādhako yadā siddhikāmo bhavati, tadāsyoktayuktyaiva 
kṛtordhvapadaviśrānterārādhakasaṃvidanusāreṇonmiṣitaśāktabalo 
mantraḥ, ūrdhve sarvādhvamūrdhani 
samastabhāvābhāvarūpaśivādikālāgnyantajagadāsūtraṇātmakāvibhāga- 
prakāśarūpaḥ pravartate, tataḥ prabhṛti sṛṣṭikrameṇa 
hṛdantamasyāpūrayati, abhilaṣitapadāpūraṇenetyarthaḥ || 

mumukṣostu na proktasatattvabindvavaṣṭambhaprādhānyena mantroccāraṇam, 
api tu ---- 


bindūpari ca yacchāntaḥ śivaḥ paramakāraṇam || 6-15 || 

tatra bindurlayaṃ yāti..............


paramakāraṇatvena paramaśivādvaiśiṣṭyamuktaṃ syāditi || 15 || 

yasmādevam, tasmāt


............ṭatsthānaṃ durlabhaṃ suraiḥ | 


surairdevaiḥ sarvendriyaiśca, mananamātrapradhānasūkṣmamanovyāpāraṃ 
viṣayasāmarasyapadātikrāntatvāt | sthānamiti tiṣṭhatyasminnabhedena 
viśvamiti vyutpattyā || 

evaṃvidhamapyetat ---- 


ṣaṣṭhasvarasamāyogādabhyāsādacirāllabhet || 6-16 || 


samavadhānodyata ityanuṣaṅgaḥ | ṣaṣṭhaḥ svaro bindvādyupalakṣaṇapara 
ityuktameva || 16 || 

ata eva ---- 


ṣaṣṭhaśca pañcamaścaiva tasya devi guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ | 

tasyeti mahāvimarśātmanaḥ paratattvasya, ṣaṣṭha ūkāraḥ, pañcamastu 
tadantarbhūta eva ukāraḥ, tāvevādha ūrdhvaṃ bahiḥśaktyātmakāvasyeti 
pūrvoktameyārthaṃ caśabdādevakārācca proktarūpā niyatā 
makārabindvādiprameyaparipāṭī, guṇā ūrdhvādhaḥ prasaraṇahetavo 
dharmāḥ śaktirūpā ityarthaḥ | smṛtā ityavicchinnena 
śivādiśrīkaṇṭhāntena gurupāramparyeṇetyarthaḥ | kaścittu 
cakāramevaśabdaṃ ca acetitvā guṇā iti bahuvacanaṃ japāvṛttyapekṣayeti 
vyākhyātavān || 

yasmādevaṃ tataḥ ---- 


saguṇaḥ sakalo jñeyo nirguṇo niṣkalaḥ śivaḥ || 6-17 || 


itthamuktanītyā niṣkalanātho'pi sakalaḥ sampannaḥ | yastu pūrvam ---- 

"hakārastu smṛtaḥ prāṇaḥ svapravṛttaḥ" (4-257)

ityanāhatanātho nidīṣṭaḥ, sa eva nirguṇatvāttattvato niṣkalaḥ || 17 || 

ata eva ---- 


sakalo grahasaṃyukto niṣkalo bhāvamāśritaḥ | 


graha uccāraḥ | bhāvaḥ supravṛttā mahāsphurattātmā sphurattā || 

yataśca pūrvoktadṛśā tāttvikaniṣkalāmarśasāra evāyaṃ 
sakalaniṣkalaśabdena pūrvaṃ vyavahṛtaścatuṣkalanāthaḥ, tato'smin 
sakale japyamāne tu japto bhavati niṣkalaḥ || 18 || 

yadyevam, ayameva catuṣkalabhaṭṭārakarūpaḥ sūkṣmaḥ 
sakalapāramāthīkaniṣkalatattvaviśrāntyarthaṃ 
japādyupāsābhirāśrīyatām, kimiti dvātriṃśadakṣarātmā sthūlaḥ 
sakalaḥ ---- 

"japitvākṣaralakṣaṃ tu bahurūpasya" (6-3)

ityādyuktyopāsya uktaḥ ? ---- ityāśaṅkyāha ---- 


surāsurāṇāṃ devena yajanopāyahetunā | 

rūpaṃ tu sakalaṃ tasya dvidhāvasthaṃ prakāśitam || 6-19 || 


ādivākyanirṇītasvarūpeṇa devena cidānandaparamārthena 
svacchandabhaṭṭārakeṇa | surāṇāmiti jñānamārgāśvastahṛdayānām, 
asurāṇāṃ ca jñānāyogyatvenājñānamārgāśvastānāṃ mokṣādyarthaṃ 
yāgopāyatvena | tasyeti svasvarūpasyānāhatātmano rūpaṃ dvidhāvastham | 
sakalamiti catuṣkalabahurūpātmakaṃ tattadanugrāhyānugrahocitaṃ 
prakāśitam | etaduktaṃ bhavati ---- ekamevedaṃ pārameśvaraṃ tattvaṃ 
sthitamanugrāhyānugrahānusāraṃ sphuritam, na tvatra vāstavaḥ ko'pi bheda 
iti | yathoktam ---- 

"puṃsāmanugrahārthāya paro'pyaparatāṃ gataḥ"

iti | ata eva yogyajanābhiprāyeṇa 
kevalacatuṣkalanāthabhaṭṭārakāśrayaḥ sādhanavidhiragre bhaviṣyati | 
yastu tāttviko niṣkalanātho nāsau jātuciddhyeyajapyādirūpo bhavati, 
tasyāśeṣaviśvātmaparamātṛsphurattaikaghanatvādityuktam |  yattu 
dvidhāvasthaṃ sakalamiti sakalaniṣkalaṃ devānāṃ daityānāṃ ca 
prakāśitamiti vyākhyāya daityānāṃ tāmasatvādanucitametatprakāśanam, 
āyātaśaktitvenāsurāṇāmiti pūrvajātyudīraṇaṃ viruddhamiti 
kenacicchaṅkitvā pūrvāvasthāmātrakathanametaditi parihṛtam, 
tadyuktamayuktaṃ veti sacetasaḥ pramāṇamityalaṃ pūrvaiḥ saha pade pade 
nirbandhanena || 19 || 

tadetasya mūlamantrasya ---- 


prathamaṃ prākṛtaṃ rūpaṃ vikṛtaṃ ca dvitīyakam | 


prathamamiti viśvoccārabhittibhūtatvāt pradhānaṃ prakṛteḥ 
svabhāvādāyātaṃ svayamuccaradrūpam | vikṛtaṃ tu 
tatprathamaprasararūpamakārātmakam, na tu viparyayeṇa vyākhyeyam,

śvayamuccarate haṃsaḥ" (7 | 59)

iti,

".......................ṭasmādvarṇāstu prāṇataḥ | 

utpadyante layaṃ yānti........................ ||" (4-248)

iti,

"śāstraṃ śabdātmakaṃ sarvaṃ śabdo haṃsaḥ prakītītaḥ" (4-341)

ityādivākyavyāghātāpatteḥ || 

taditthamekatrāpi mantre yugapat ---- 


prakṛtivīkṛtiścaiva ubhe ṣaṣṭhena saṃyute || 6-20 || 


daśītamevaitadyathā mantre halākṛteḥ prakṛtibhūtasya śirorekhārūpā 
vikṛtiśabdavācyā'kārakalāstīti yugapadeva prakṛtivikṛtī 
ṣaṣṭhakalāyukte || 20 || 

ata eva ---- 


ye padārthāḥ purā proktāstatrāsāvucchvasan muhuḥ | 

pravartate ca etena punastena nivartate || 6-21 || 


yaḥ samanantarameva

ṅirguṇastu yadā devaḥ" (6-11)

ityuktyā niṣkalanātha ukto'sau 
ucchvasannityākārokārakalāsambhedenordhvaṃ prasaran, tatreti 
pūrvokteṣūnmanānteṣu padārtheṣu, tenaiva pūrvoktena krameṇa pravartate 
dvādaśāntamārohati | punaśca teneti prātilomyena nivartate hṛdayānte 
varṇavyaktimeti, anāhatadhvanimevāviśati | muhuriti japāvasare bhūyo 
bhūya ityarthaḥ || 21 || 

taditthamayaṃ padārtheṣvārohāvarohau kurvan ---- 


praṇavaḥ pañcadhāvasthaḥ...............


pañcadhātvamasya vācakakalākrameṇa vācyakrameṇa ca prathayati ---- 


.............ṭrivarṇaśca tridaivataḥ | 

bindunādasamāyuktaḥ praṇavaḥ paripaṭhyate || 6-22 || 


bindunādasaṃbhedaṃ vinā varṇasaṅghaṭṭanāmātrarūpatā bhavati, na tu 
prakarṣeṇa nūyate'nena paraṃ tattvamityedṛkpraṇavatvamityarthaḥ | evaṃ 
cākārokāramakārabindunādabhedāt prāgvadvācakarūpāḥ pañca 
praṇavāḥ, brahmaviṣṇurudrā vakṣyamāṇeśvarasadāśivasahitā 
vācyarūpāḥ pañca ca || 22 || 

tadāha ---- 


akāraśca ukāraśca makāraśca tṛtīyakaḥ | 

varṇatrayamidaṃ proktaṃ brahmādyā devatāstrayaḥ || 6-23 || 

bindunādasamāyogādīśvaraśca sadāśivaḥ | 

ete vai praṇavāḥ pañca...............


brahmādyā ye trayo devatā iti sambandhaḥ | vācyavācakarūpā ityarthāt || 

te caite ---- 


........ḥaṃsaḥ prāṇayutaḥ sadā || 6-24 || 


"hakārastu smṛtaḥ prāṇaḥ" (4-257)

iti yaḥ pūrvaṃ haṃsaprāṇo'nāhatadhvaniruktastena sadā 
yutastadanulagnastāṃ

mahāvimarśabhittiṃ vinā kasyāpyasphuraṇādityarthaḥ || 24 || 

ata evātra ---- 


paramātmā śivo haṃsastvapareṇa samanvitaḥ | 


yo haṃsaḥ svayamuccaradrūpo vācakavṛttyā, vācyavṛttyā tu paramātmā 
sarveṣāṃ brahmādīnāmanuprāṇakaḥ, 
paranirvāṇātmakaśreyaḥpradatvācchivaḥ vācyavācakayoratrāvibhāgena 
prakāśānandaghanatvena sphuraṇāt so'yamīdṛśo haṃsaḥ, apareṇeti 
proktarūpavācyavācakarūpeṇa praṇavapañcakena samanvitaḥ saṃbaddhaḥ | 
atra cākārādirūpeṣu praṇaveṣu hrasvādyuccārakalā 
jāgradādayo'vasthābhedāḥ, pṛthivīprakṛtimāyeśvarasadāśivāntāni ca 
brahmādyadhiṣṭhitāni tattvāni, iti pañcakāntarāṇyetānyantarbhūtāni 
nirṇītadṛśā praṇavarūpāṇyanusartavyāni || 

na kevalamitthamapararūpāḥ pañca praṇavā mantre'smin sthitā iti, yāvat 
---- 


parataḥ praṇavān pañca punareva vadāmyaham || 6-25 || 


anyatantrasiddhāntavailakṣaṇyenetyarthaḥ || 25 || 

tānāha ---- 


śaktiśca vyāpinī caiva samanātmā ca niṣkalaḥ | 

unmanā ca tathā devi praṇavāḥ pañca kītītāḥ || 6-26 || 


atrāpi vācakakalānāṃ vācyānāṃ 
tadgarbhīkṛtasusūkṣmatamoccārakaloccārayitravasthāśaktitattvādyā-
varaṇānāṃ ca pūrvoktayuktyā praṇavatvam || 26 || 

tadetāvato viśvasya bhittibhūtaḥ ---- 


parataḥ paramo haṃsaḥ sarvaṃ vyāpya vyavasthitaḥ | 


yo nirṇītacaraḥ paramo haṃsaḥ, sa parataḥ prakṛṣṭatayā 
parāparabhedabhinnaṃ praṇavapañcakam, taddvāreṇa ca viśvaṃ vyāpya 
sthita iti sa eva paramopādeyaḥ | tadabhedavimarśamayatvena 
niṣkalabhaṭṭārako'pi || 

tadatra ---- 


ete vai praṇavāḥ pañca parāparavibhāgaśaḥ || 6-27 || 

parāpareṇa haṃsena nityameva praṇāmitāḥ | 


haṃso halākṛtiḥ svaśaktyādyakārādiparāparapraṇavayogāccatuṣkalatāṃ 
prāptaḥ parāpara ucyate | tenobhayarūpeṇa praṇāmitāḥ 
prahvībhāvamāpāditāḥ svapratyavamarśapravaṇāḥ kṛtāḥ | praṇāmitā 
ityaiśaḥ pāṭhaḥ | ata eva prakarṣeṇa nūyate paraṃ tattvaṃ yaiste 
praṇavā iti prārambha evoktamasmābhiḥ || 27 || 

ataścaite ---- 


pravartante hi sarvatra bhuktimuktiphalapradāḥ || 6-28 || 


sarvatreti sādhakaputrakādiviṣaye || 28 || 

tasmādayaṃ mūlamantraḥ ---- 


pañcabhistu yutastvebhiḥ sa pañcapraṇavātmakaḥ | 


yo niḥsvabhāvaḥ parāparapraṇavabhedaprathanadvāreṇaiva viśvatra 
kāraṇaṃ catuṣkalanātha iti nirṇītamevaitat || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


tatrastha ekarūpastu niṣkalastattvataḥ smṛtaḥ || 6-29 || 


tatreti pūrvoktapraṇavaviśrāntidhāmni catuṣkalanāthe yastiṣṭhati | 
ekarūpa iti proktaprakṛtirūpo'nāhatabhaṭṭārakaḥ | sa eva tattvato 
niṣkala ityarthaḥ || 29 || 

na kevalamasau, yāvat ---- 


tadyogādapi tadbījaṃ................


proktaniṣkalasaṃbandhād bījamapīti catuṣkalanātho'pi niṣkala ucyata 
ityarthaḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


..........ṣarvabījaprarohakam | 


sarveṣāṃ bījānāṃ brahmādikāraṇānāmaṅgabrahmādimantrāṇāṃ ca 
prarohakaṃ sāmarthyapradaṃ tadyogādeva || 

atra hetuḥ ---- 


pravartate'yato yasmād devāsuraniketanam || 6-30 || 


ayete gacchati svayamuccarati citprakāśābhedena sphuratītyayo 
halākṛtistato yasmād devāsurāṇāṃ prāṅnirūpitanītyā niketanaṃ 
upāsāsthānaṃ catuṣkalabahurūpātma mantradvayaṃ pravartate'nugrahādau 
prasarati, tato yuktamuktam ---- 

"tadyogādapi tadbījaṃ sarvabījaprarohakam | " (6-30)

iti | devāsurā indriyāṇi, tanniketanaṃ prāṇa iti kecit || 30 || 

ataśca prathamapaṭalanirṇītavyāptyanusāraṃ catuṣkalabahurūpābhyāṃ 
viśvasya svīkārāttayośca parasphurattāsārānāhatadhvaniviśrāntatvāt -
--- 

tatra mantrāśca varṇāśca pratiṣṭhāṃ yānti nānyathā | 

mantrāḥ piṇḍabījāni | varṇā mālāmantrasambandhino mātṛkāvatīnaśca 
sarve'nāhata eva pratiṣṭhitāḥ | nahi parāṃ sphurattāṃ vinā kasyāpi 
sphuraṇaṃ ghaṭate | uktaṃ ca śrīspande ---- 

"tadākramya balaṃ mantrāḥ |" (2-10) 

ityādi || 

ataśca ---- 


tasya bodhādvimucyante ahikañcukavat priye || 6-31 || 


dīkṣitā iti śeṣaḥ || 31 || 

etat sphuṭayati ---- 


tāvad bhramati saṃsāre yāvattattvaṃ na vindati | 

vidite tu pare tattve na bhūyo jāyate kvacit || 6-32 || 


yathāhistyaktena kañcukena na punaḥ śliṣyati, tathā samanāntena bandhena 
tyaktena tattvajño na bhūyaḥ spṛśyate || 32 || 

tattvaṃ haṃsarūpameveti darśayannetadeva bhūyaḥ sphuṭayati ---- 

akṛtārtho narastāvadyāvaddhaṃsaṃ na vindati | 


vindati labhate svatvena pratyabhijānāti || 

etatsopāyaṃ vaidharmyadarśanena prakṛte yojayati ---- 


praṇavena samāyuktaṃ kṛtārtha iti nidīśet || 6-33 || 


praṇavena catuṣkalena samyagāyuktamiti 
nirṇītavakṣyamāṇataduccārajñānataduccāraṇaupayikameva 
paraniṣkalasvarūpaviśrāntatvānnaraḥ kṛtārtho bhavatītyarthaḥ || 33 || 

ataśca ---- 


uccāraṃ ca tato jñātvā uccarettaṃ varānane | 


uccareduccārayet | tamiti paraviśrāntyupāyabhūtaṃ catuṣkalam || 

tatra ---- 


uccārastrividho devi haṃsasya samudāhṛtaḥ || 6-34 || 


uktarūpaparāparapraṇavādhiṣṭhānāddhaṃsasyāpi parāparaḥ 
svarūpaniṣṭhatvena tu parātpara iti trividho ya uccāraḥ sa, udāhṛtaḥ --
-- 

"ete vai praṇavāḥ pañca parāparavibhāgaśaḥ parāpareṇa haṃsena" (6-27)

iti, tathā

"parataḥ paramo haṃsaḥ sarvaṃ vyāpya vyavasthitaḥ" (6-27)

ityādyuktyā samanantaramevoktaḥ || 34 || 

tamevoccāraṃ sphuṭayati ---- 


hakārokārasaṃyuktabindvante tu tṛtīyakaḥ | 

(sṛṣṭe)1rnyāsena tūccāraḥ saṃhārayoga ucyate || 6-35 || 


h iti luptavibhaktiko'nāhatasvarūpadarśanāya | tena h iti yaḥ 
svayamuccaradrūpo haṃsaḥ sa akāreṇa ukāreṇa ca varṇena 
saṃyuktastadūpari ca bindorante samīpe tṛtīyaka ityanusvārarūpo 
makāro'sya sambaddha evametadanto ya uccāraḥ | sṛṣṭeriti  
jāgarādyavasthātrayādhiṣṭhātṛsṛṣṭisthitisaṃhārakāribhedamayabrahma
viṣṇurudrasargasya yo nyāsaḥ pṛthakpṛthagvācakatvena vimarśastena, na 
tvabhedenetyarthaḥ | eteṣāṃ tu trayāṇāmapi bhedamayānāṃ saṃhārayoga 
iti  turyadaśāprathamakoṭisaṃsparśātmakabindupadaikyayojanārūpa
ucyate, na tvatra varṇoccāravyāptirasti || 35 || 

yathā vibhaktaḥ prāk tena ---- 


evamādikrameṇaiva mantramuccārayed budhaḥ | 


budho jñānī, evamityuktarūpeṇa, ādītyakārādikrameṇa, 
mantramityetatsambandhādeva mantrarūpatāṃ prāptaṃ haṃsamuccārayet || 

etadanuvadannata ūrdhvaṃ mantroccāre itikartavyatāntaramāha ---- 


bindusthaṃ tritayaṃ kṛtvā vaktramudghāṭayettataḥ || 6-36 || 


tritayaṃ makārāntam, bindusthaṃ kṛtveti tadabhedavyāptisāraṃ sampādya, 
nādoccāraṇārthaṃ vaktramāsyamudghāṭayedityetaduccārāvasare divyaṃ 
karaṇaṃ badhnīyādityarthaḥ || 36 || 

tataśca ---- 


īṣadudghāṭite vaktre tadā nādaṃ vijānata | 


anayetikartavyatayā mantroccārāvahitasya 
nādanādāntābhivyaktirbhavatītyarthaḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


nādasthaṃ pañcadhā caiva śaktisthaṃ pañcadhā punaḥ || 6-37 || 

vyāpinyāṃ pañcadhā caiva.............


mantrarūpaṃ vijānateti sambandhaḥ | pañcadhātvaṃ ca ---- 

"brahmādipañcakaṃ yacca" (6-41)

ityupakramya

"parāparavibhāgena te sarvatra vyavasthitāḥ" (6-41)

iti samanantaravakṣyamāṇasthityā mantavyam | tena yojanikāgranthe nādasya 
yadaṣṭakalatvamuktam tadvācakasvarūpavimarśayuktyā | idaṃ tu 
pañcadhātvaṃ tatpadādhirūḍhavācyarūpakāraṇavimarśayuktyeti na 
pūrvāparavaiṣamyaṃ kiñcit || 37 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


.............ṣamanāniṣkalātmanoḥ | 


ūrdhvordhvamavasthitayoḥ | pūrvanirṇītaṃ rūpaṃ vijānatetyanuṣaṅgaḥ 
|| 

athaitadupari ---- 


unmanā ca paraṃ tattvaṃ sarvaṃ vyāpya vyavasthitam || 6-38 || 


pūrvanirṇītaṃ rūpaṃ jānītetyarthaḥ || 38 || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


evaṃ jñātvā vimucyante śivatattvavido janāḥ | 


evamuktakrameṇa, jñātvā unmanāntāni padānyanubhūya, ye śivatattvamiti 
paramaśivamātmānam, vidanti pratijānanti, te viśeṣeṇa 
siddhāntavailakṣaṇyena mucyante | tatra hi ---- 

"avarṇovarṇamakārabindunādāśca tasya sanmantrāḥ | "

ityevaṃ mantravyāptistadgurubhirdaśītā || 

atra vaidharmyamāha ---- 


anyathā naiva mucyante bindvante ye vyavasthitāḥ || 6-39 || 


bindau tadante ca nādādipade ye vyavasthitā viśrāntāste naiva mucyante'pi 
tu tattatpadocitavibhūtimeva bhajante || 39 || 

yataḥ ---- 


jyotīrūpaṃ tu bindusthaṃ nādasthaṃ śabdarūpakam | 

śaktisthaṃ sparśagaṃ caiva tadūrdhvaṃ śūnyarūpakam || 6-40 || 


yadetad bindusthaṃ tritayamiti nādasthaṃ pañcakamityādyuktaṃ tad 
bindusthaṃ jyotīrūpamiti vedyāvibhāgaprakāśarūpam | nādasthaṃ tu 
śaktirūpamiti visargaśaktimayam | śaktipadāvasthitaṃ tu 
sparśagamānandasparśasatattvam, tadūrdhvaṃ vyāpinyāṃ tu 
śūnyatābhāsarūpam || 40 || 

yato vyāpinīdhāma ---- 


brahmādipañcakaṃ yacca teṣāṃ śūnyaṃ ca tatpadam | 


cakārād brahmādyadhiṣṭheyānāṃ tattvānāmapi | taiḥ śūnyamiti 
vaktavye teṣāṃ śūnyamiti ṣaṣṭhyā te sarve tatra 
taducitaprakṛṣṭasaṃvidrūpatayā sthitāḥ, na tu kvāpi gatāḥ, iti 
darśayati | ata eva pūrvamaśūnyaṃ śūnyamityādyuktam || 

nanu brahmādayo hṛdayādilalāṭāntapadāvasthitāste kathamiyatīṃ 
bhūmimāyātā ityāha ---- 


parāparavibhāgena te sarvatra vyavasthitāḥ || 6-41 || 


parameśvarasya hi cidānandecchājñānakriyākhyāḥ 
śaktayastatpadocitaprapañcavyāptibhājo brahmādiparyantamābhāsitavatya iti 
tadvyāptisārā brahmādyāḥ sthūlasūkṣmādivyāptyā sarvatra sthitāḥ | 
etacca ekādaśe vyaktībhaviṣyati | athavaite tattatpadaucityena tāstāḥ 
siddhīrdadati || 41 || 

atha ---- 


śūnyātītā tu samanā śuddhātmā tūnmanā tathā | 


krameṇa svocitasaṃvidrūpetyarthaḥ || 

atha ---- 


sarvātītaṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ sarvaṃ vyāpya vyavasthitam || 6-42 || 


sarvātītatve'pi sarvavyāpakatvamasya svacchasvacchandacidānandasundaratvāt 
|| 42 || 

yataśca paraṃ tattvaṃ sarvaṃ vyāpya vyavasthitamata 
evākārokāramakāravācyā atisthūlā api ---- 


mantrarūpāśca vijñeyā bindudharmāttu devatāḥ | 


cakāra evārthaḥ | mantrarūpā eva tadabhedavyāptisāreṇāviśleṣeṇa 
jñātavyāḥ || 

evaṃ hi ---- 


tatrasthā sarvakarmāṇi sādhayanti na saṃśayaḥ || 6-43 || 


tatreti vyākhyātavyāptisatattve mantre sthitā upārūḍhāḥ || 43 || 

evamullāsakrameṇa hṛdayād dvādaśāntaṃ muktyaṅgamantroccāramuktvā 
siddhyaṅgaṃ taṃ prātilomyenādiśati ---- 


tattvaṃ ca unmanātmā tu samanā śūnyameva ca | 

sparśaścaiva tathā śabdo rūpaṃ ca tadanantaram || 6-44 || 

mantrātmani sthitāḥ sarve jñātavyā daiśikena tu | 


rūpamiti bindutejaḥ | tadanantaramiti makārokā(rākā)rātmavarṇasvarūpam 
| ta ete sarva eva prameyā mantrātmaniṣkalasvarūpe'vasthitā 
ullāsapraveśakramamavimṛśya mantrāvasara eva 
muktisiddhyaṅgarūpeṇopalabhyanta ityarthaḥ | daiśikeneti prādhānyāt, 
tadupadeśāttvanyenāpi || 44 || 

na kevalamete mantrasthāḥ sarvakarmāṇi sādhayanti, yāvat ---- 


tatrasthā jñānayogaṃ ca prayacchanti varānane || 6-45 || 


jñānaṃ tattajjñeyatattvānubhavam, yogaṃ tadaikātmyaprāptim || 

sarvakarmāṇi sādhayantīti yaduktam, tatra karmānurūpaṃ mantradevatānāṃ 
dhyānamāha ---- 


karmakāle tu sakalān śiraḥpāṇyādibhiryutān | 


karma arcāhomādi || 

krameṇa ---- 


japettu sakalān devi niṣkalena samanvitān || 6-46 || 


dhyāyedityanantarasthamanuṣajyate | niṣkalena cidghanatāparamārthena, 
samyaganvitāṃstadviśrāntisārān || 46 || 

yadā tu sarvajñatvādirūpāṃ siddhimicchati, tadā binduviśrāntisatattvān 
---- 


dhyāyejjyotirmayān sarvān..............


uktaṃ hi ---- 

"jyotīrūpaṃ tu bindusthaṃ" (6-40)

iti | iha tvetphalanirūpaṇaparatvenoktamiti prakaraṇato jñāyata iti na 
punaruktam || 

atha binduviśrāntyūrdhvanādapade ---- 


.................śabdasiddhipradāyakān | 


nādaviśrāntimayatvena dhyātāstatsiddhimeva vitarantītyarthaḥ | 
evamuttaratrāpi taducitarūpadhyānāttattatsiddhipradattvameṣām || 
yadāha ---- 


śaktisthāḥ śaktidāḥ proktāḥ śūnyasthā vyāpakāḥ smṛtāḥ || 6-47 
|| 

kramājjñānapradāste vai samanāsthā varānane | 

kaivalyadāstataścordhve sarvajñāśconmane pade || 6-48 || 


śaktiḥ sarvakaraṇasāmarthyam | śūnyaṃ vyāpinī | vyāpakā 
ityārādhakasya vyāptipradāḥ | kramājjñānaṃ 
śivādikṣityantāśeṣaviṣayam | kaivalyaṃ śuddhavijñānakevalitvam, 
yadbhedavādiśaivānāṃ paraṃ prāpyam | ūrdhva iti śuddhātmapade | 
sarvajñā ityakramāśeṣaviśvābhedaprathāpradāḥ | yathoktam prāk ---- 

śamanā kramavijñānamunmanā tvakramam" (4-394) iti || 

ete ca mantrāvayavānubhavāḥ ---- 


tattvena vedhitāḥ sarve ye mayā parikītītāḥ | 


tattvena paraśivena vedhitāḥ sarvātmanā vyāptāḥ | vedhitā ityaiśaḥ 
pāṭhaḥ, "vidha vidhāne" ityasyaivāyaṃ prayogaḥ || 

ata eva ---- 


tajjñātvā siddhidāḥ sarve muktidāśca na saṃśayaḥ || 6-49 || 


taditi tattvam, sādhakānāmapi hyetanmantrakrameṇa 
siddhimuktiparyavasānenaiveti yojanikāgranthe nirṇītam | bhinnakartṛtve'pi 
(tatre1-)śvaraprāmāṇyāt || 49 || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


pañcapraṇavasaṃyuktaṃ tattvaṃ te kathitaṃ mayā | 


pañcapraṇavoccāropāyaprāptaṃ tattvaṃ 
paramaśivātmakaparamahaṃsasvarūpam, te tavaiva yogyāyāḥ śaktermayā 
kathitam, nānyasya kasyacit || 

tadetajjñātvā ---- 


pañcapraṇavapūrveṇa oṃkārādyayutena tu || 6-50 || 

namaskārāvasānena bahurūpeṇa suvrate | 

japataḥ siddhimāpnoti lakṣeṇākṣarasaṃkhyayā || 6-51 || 


sādhaka iti śeṣaḥ | pañcapraṇavaḥ catuṣkala pūrvo yasya tena |  
vyākhyātabhinnatadvyāptyatadvyāptyanusandhānapūrvaṃ 
taduccārodghāṭitamadhyamārgāśrayatvāttallīnena bahurūpeṇa yo 
japastataḥ siddhimāpnotīti sambandhaḥ |  oṃkārādyayutenetyādinedamāha -
--- yadyapi praṇavasamanāvyāptiścatuṣkalanātho bahurūpasyāghoraśabdāde 
rūpebhya ityantasyādau prayuktastathāpi sarvamantrāṇāṃ pūjājapaviṣaye
praṇavanamaskārābhyāmādyantasambandho dīpakaḥ kārya iti śāstrasamayaḥ 
| tena dvātriṃśadakṣarasya pūrvaṃ yau namaskārapraṇavau uktau, tāveva
catuṣkalapūrvasya deyau | yataḥ ---- 

"tatrasthā sarvakarmāṇi sādhayanti" (6-43)

ityuktam | akṣarasaṃkhyayā lakṣeṇeti dvātriṃśatā lakṣairityarthaḥ || 
51 || 

etadevādhikāvāpena pūrayati ---- 


praṇavādyena saṃyuktaṃ mantramevaṃ japet sadā | 


praṇava ādyo yasya catuṣkalanāthasya tena samyagyuktaṃ mantraṃ japet sadā 
iti yāvat | pūrvameva tāvadasyaikāgratāyā avicchedena japaḥ kārya 
ityarthaḥ | sadeti atrādhikāvāpaḥ || 

atha ---- 


japānte tu punarhomaṃ daśamāṃśena kārayet || 6-52 || 


"japitvākṣaralakṣaṃ tu bahurūpasya" (6-3)

ityādyupakramya pañcapraṇavasvarūpaṃ nirṇīya, "praṇavādyena saṃyuktaṃ 
mantramevaṃ japetsadā" (6-52)

ityupasaṃhṛtya

"japānte tu punarhomaṃ" (6-52)

ityuktam | ato japopakrameṇāṅgahomastāvatkṛtaḥ | jape tu 
mantradevatāsaṃmukhīkaraṇātmani niṣpanne, tattarpaṇāya svāhāntena 
mantreṇa japasaṃkhyāto daśāṃśeneti lakṣatrayeṇa sahasraviṃśatyā ca 
homaḥ kārya iti "punaḥ" śabdasyārthaḥ || 52 || 

atra home samucitaṃ dravyamāha ---- 


nṛmāṃsaṃ purasaṃyuktaṃ ghṛtena ca pariplutam | 

tataḥ siddhimavāpnoti adhamāṃ madhyamottamām || 6-53 || 


puraṃ gugguluḥ | etattrayaṃ yugapaddhutvā 
tattveśvaratvākāśotpatanapātālasiddhīruttamādirūpāḥ sarvāḥ 
prāpnoti, na tu yathāsaṃkhyamaśabdārthatvādāgamāntaravirodhācca || 53 
|| 

yadā tu ---- 


triguṇena tu japyena svacchandasadṛśo bhavet | 

brahmaviṣṇvindradevānāṃ siddhadaityorageśinām || 6-54 || 

bhayadātā ca hartā ca śāpānugrahakṛd bhavet | 

darpaṃ harati kālasya pātayed bhūdharānapi || 6-55 || 

sphoṭayed bilvayantrāṇi diggajānapi cālayet | 

brahmarākṣasavetālān krūragrahavināyakān || 6-56 || 

smaraṇānnāśayed devi avadhyastridaśairapi | 


śāpānugrahakṛttvādbhayasya dātā hartā ca, smaraṇāditi smṛtamātraḥ 
sannāśayatyevetyarthaḥ || 56 || 

asya ca mantrasya ---- 


prākṛtānyapi karmāṇi siddhyanti japalakṣataḥ || 6-57 || 


prakṛtisaṃbhūtadravyayogasaṃpādyāni vaśyādīni prākṛtāni | 
japalakṣataḥ iti pūrvasevārthaṃ daśāṃśahomasahitānnirvatītāt | 
prayogakāle karmocitohajātyantamantrābhimantraṇaṃ 
vakṣyamāṇaprayoganidīṣṭānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ 
tattadanyakalpaprayogaviṣayāṇāṃ ca sthitameva | yadupasaṃhariṣyati ---- 

"evaṃ śatasahasrāṇi anyakalpotthitāni ca | 

prayogānāṃ karotyeṣa mantrarājeśvareśvaraḥ ||" (6-94)

iti || 57 || 

evaṃ pūrvārādhitamantrasya yāni mukhyasiddhyaṅgabhāvena kadācidavasare 
prayojyāni ---- 


tāni samyak pravakṣyāmi yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ | 


samyagiti yathā visaṃvādīni na bhaviṣyanti | yathāvaditi 
yathetikartavyatayā yuktāni | atrāmuko me vaśo bhavatvityūhānto mantrasya 
lakṣajapaḥ kāryaḥ iti vyākhyānamasat

"oṃkārādyayutena tu | namaskārāvasānena" (6-51)

iti pūrvamevāsādhāraṇyena mantrasvarūpasya pratipāditatvāt | etāvatā 
yathāpratipādanamasya sāmānyena kṣudrasiddhyabhisandhimatā 
pūrvasevārthaṃ japahomau kṛtvā viniyogakāle karmocitohajātyantasya 
prayogaḥ kāryaḥ || 

tatra vaśyaprayogāṃstāvadāha ---- 


mohanā sahadevā ca bhūdhātrī cakralāñchanā || 6-58 || 

rāmavallyā sahaikatra ātmabījena peṣayet | 

bhakṣye pāne ca dātavyaṃ vaśīkaraṇamuttamam || 6-59 || 


mohanā balāmoṭā | bhūdhātrī bhūmyāmalakī | cakralāñchanā 
cakrāṅkā | rāmavallī rāmataraṇiriti prasiddhauṣadhiḥ | ātmabījaṃ 
svaśukram | pradātavyamiti mantrābhimantritam | evaṃ hyavisaṃvādi bhavati 
|| 59 || 


uttavāraṇimūlaṃ tu puṣyarkṣeṇa tu grāhayet | 

ātmendriyeṇa saṃyuktaṃ vaśīkaraṇamuttamam || 6-60 || 


uttavāraṇī viśālā | puṣyarkṣeṇa tviti puṣyanakṣatreṇa 
saumyagrahayuktena | śuklapakṣe rātrau oṣadhigrahaṇaṃ 
kāryamityoṣadhikalpeṣvasti | ātmendriyaṃ svaśukram | yathoktam ---- 

ṅṛbījamindradaivatyaṃ tasmādindriyamucyate |" 

iti | 

uttamatvamasyaikauṣadhiyogāt | bhakṣye pāne ceti sthitameva || 60 || 


śravaṇākṣimalaṃ lālā rudhirendriyasaṃyutam | 

bhūkadambasamopetaṃ dātavyaṃ payasā niśi || 6-61 || 


śravaṇābhyāmakṣibhyāṃ male lālā ceti pañca, rudhiraṃ 
vāmānāmikāsaṃbandhi, indriyaṃ śukramityātmīyaṃ saptakam, bhūkadambaṃ 
bhūtīkamaṣṭamam | etadekīkṛtya rātrau mantrābhimantritajalapānamadhye 
deyaṃ vaśīkārāya || 61 || 

etacca ---- 


apravāse pradātavyaṃ...............


dattvā na proṣitavyam || 

anyathā ---- 


............ṃirayate viraheṇa sā | 


iyānasya prayogasya mahimetyarthaḥ || 


ṣaṣṭiṃ kanakabījāni ṣoḍaśa maṇicandrikāḥ || 6-62 || 

naragodantasaṃyuktāḥ pradadyāsya bhāmini | 

eṣa kāpāliko yogo gacchantamanugacchati || 6-63 || 


sā tamiti śeṣaḥ | kanakaṃ dhattūrakam | maṇicandrikā raktikā | 
naragodantayornātra saṃkhyāniyamaḥ | etaccūrṇaṃ bhakṣye pāne vā 
deyamiti prāgvat | kapālairasthibhinīrvṛttaḥ kāpālikaḥ || 63 || 


śvetārkamūlaṃ mañjiṣṭhā caṭakasya śirastathā | 

gṛhodbhavasya kuṣṭhaṃ ca svaraktendrisaṃyutam || 6-64 || 

bhakṣye pāne pradātavyaṃ vaśīkaraṇamuttamam | 


arkataroḥ śvetatvaṃ śvetapuṣpatvāt | gṛhodbhavaścaṭako mūṣakaḥ | 
svaraktendriyaṃ prāgvat || 64 || 


mohanā caiva kāntārī mayūraśikhayā yutā || 6-65 || 

ātmalālendriyairyuktaṃ vaśīkaraṇamuttamam | 


kāntārī priyaṅguḥ | mayūraśikhā tadākāraivauṣadhiḥ |  
ātmalālendriyairiti bahuvacanādindriyadravye ubhayodbhūte | 
uttamamavisaṃvādi || 65 || 


lajjālukā ca gorambhā caṇḍālīkarmakaṃ tathā || 6-66 || 

nāgendrapadamiśraṃ tadātmabījasamanvitam | 

eṣa yogavaro divyo dīyate yasya suvrate || 6-67 || 

madhureṇa samāyukto yāvadāyurvaśī sa tu | 


lajjālukā laṅguḍā | gorambhā chatrā | caṇḍālyākhyāyā oṣadheḥ 
karmakaṃ pradhānamūlam | madhureṇa viṣeṇa, tasya ca 
dravyāntarasaṃyogānmāraṇaśaktinirodhaḥ || 67 || 


caṇakā māṣamudgāśca apānena vinirgatāḥ || 6-68 || 

vāntaṃ ghṛtaṃ tathā retaḥ strīrajo hṛnmalaṃ tathā | 

mūtraṃ raktaṃ tathā keśo lālā caiva varānane || 6-69 || 

putrajāniḥ kṛtāhvā ca nāgendrapadasaṃyutā | 

mohanā viṣṇukrāntā ca dhātrī caivaikataḥ sthitā || 6-70 || 

puṣyarkṣeṇa niyuñjīta gavītānāṃ varānane | 

bhakṣye pāne pradātavyo yogastridaśapūjitaḥ || 6-71 || 


apānena nirgatāḥ śakṛdbhāvamāgatāḥ | vāntaṃ ghṛtādi | ātmīyaṃ 
hṛnmalaṃ nābhimalam | putrajāniroṣadhiviśeṣaḥ | kṛtāhvā 
kṛtāñjaliḥ | viṣṇukrāntā prasiddhā | dhātrī āmalakam | 
tridaśapūjita ityavisaṃvādī | evamaṣṭau vaśīkāre prayogā uktāḥ || 
71 || 

atha ---- 


uccāṭanaṃ pravakṣyāmi śatrūṇāṃ gavītātmanām | 


tatra ---- 


kākolūkasya pakṣāṃśca kharoṣṭramūtramṛttikā || 6-72 || 


ebhirdravyaiḥ ---- 


kṛtvā pratikṛtiṃ prājñaḥ kākaraktena lepayet | 


athānyat ---- 


kākālūkasya pakṣāṃśca gude tasyā vinikṣipet || 6-73 || 


atha ---- 


tāṃ catuṣpathe nikhanet.................


tatra khanitvā sthagitasthāpitāyāstasyāḥ ---- 


................śmaśānāgnimathopari | 

prajvālya homayettatra kākapakṣāṃśca suvrate || 6-74 || 

udbhrāntapatrasahitān kharamūtreṇa bhāvitān | 

yasya nāma samuddaśya yakārādyantarodhitam || 6-75 || 

mantrāvasāne vinyastaṃ visargāntaṃ pracāṭayet | 


tamiti śeṣaḥ | udbhrāntapatrāṇi arjunavātadhūlidaṇḍamadhyagatāni 
patrāṇi | mantrāvasāna iti ārādhitabahurūpānte | visargāntaṃ 
yakāreṇādyantaprayuktena rodhitaṃ sampuṭitaṃ yasya śatronāmeti yaḥ 
devadatto ya uccāṭito bhavatviti sakrodhamuccārya yaḥ krodhasamāviṣṭa eva 
vakṣyamāṇanītyā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ kākapakṣān juhuyāt sādhakaḥ, sa 
tamuccāṭayediti saṃbandhaḥ || 75 || 

sa itthamuccāṭitaḥ ---- 


bhramate kākavat pṛthkā śatrurvyādhinipīḍitaḥ || 6-76 || 


vidveṣe prayogamāha ---- 


piṇyākaṃ nimbapatrāṇi mṛtkiṇvaṃ tu tuṣāṇi ca | 

śatroḥ pratikṛtiṃ kṛtvā akṣapuṣpaistu veṣṭitām || 6-77 || 

śmaśāne nikhanettāṃ tu vahniṃ prajvālya copari | 

puṣpaivībhītatarujairyasya nāmnā tu homayet || 6-78 || 

vidviṣṭo vai bhavecchatruḥ kāmadevasamo'pi yaḥ | 


piṇyāko guggulubījakalkaḥ | kiṇvaṃ surāsaṃdhānadravyam 
akṣapuṣpaivībhītapuṣpaiḥ | veṣṭitāmiti tanmālāvalitām | nāmneti 
vidviṣṭo bhavatu ityantena vidveṣaṇajātiyuktena bahurūpeṇetyarthāt | 
homo'ṣṭottaraśatasaṅkhyaḥ || 78 || 

athāsya vidviṣṭasyānyasya vā subhagīkaraṇamāha ---- 


priyaṅgulatikāmiśraṃ guggulaṃ ghṛtavedhitam || 6-79 || 

hutvā tvaṣṭaśataṃ devi subhagaḥ saṃprajāyate | 


priyaṅgulatikā gandhapriyaṅguḥ | atrāpyārādhitaṃ 
bahurūpamevoccāryāmukaḥ subhago bhavatvityante saumyajātiḥ prayojyeti || 
79 || 


jātikuṭmalakaimīśraistrimadhvaktaistilairhutaiḥ || 6-80 || 

subhagatvamavāpnoti rūpahīno'pi yo naraḥ | 


trimadhu kṣīraśarkarāghṛtam | atrāpi 
pūrvavanmantro'ṣṭottaraśatasaṅkhyaśca homaḥ | evamuttaratrāpi 
karmocitohajātyanto homo'ṣṭottaraśatasaṅkhya eva || 80 || 


tilairlavaṇasaṃmiśraistrimadhvaktairhutaiḥ priyaiḥ || 6-81 || 

saptāhādvaśamāyāti yā strī rūpeṇa gavītā | 


ākarṣaṇamāha ---- 


rājikā lavaṇaṃ caiva madhukṣīraghṛtaplutam || 6-82 || 

homayennāmasaṃmiśraṃ yasyākarṣettu taṃ drutam | 


rājikā āsurikā || 82 || 

pūrvaṃ bhakṣyapānakrameṇāṣṭau vaśīkārā uktāḥ, homena tvekaḥ,
adhunā snānādiprayojyadravyakrameṇāpyāha ---- 


narasya rocanāṃ gṛhya dviradasya madena tu || 6-83 || 

bhāvayitvābhimantryaitanmantreṇāṣṭaśataṃ japet | 

snāne vilepane madye gandhe vā yasya dīyate || 6-84 || 

sa vaśyo bhavati kṣipraṃ dhanadaḥ prāṇadastathā | 


nararocanāṃ gorocanāvad gṛhītvā, hastimadena liptvā, mantreṇeti 
bahurūpeṇa 
prāgvadūhaprayogajātyantenaitaddravyamaṣṭottaraśatajapādabhimantrya yasya 
snānādau dīyate sa vaśyo bhavatīti saṃbandhaḥ || 84 || 

māraṇamāha ---- 


athavā mārayet kṣipraṃ śatruṃ niścitamātmanaḥ || 6-85 || 

apakāraśatairyuktaṃ kṛtaghnaṃ duṣṭacetasam | 


na tu svalpāparādham || 85 || 

tatra ---- 


kapāladvayamādāya nāma śatroḥ samālikhet || 6-86 || 

kapālasaṃpuṭasthaṃ tadviṣāṅgāreṇa bhāvitam | 

rudhireṇa samāyuktaṃ huṃphaṭkāravidabhītam || 6-87 || 

mahāpretavanaṃ gatvā................


viṣāṅgāreṇa śmaśānāṅgāreṇa rudhiravimiśreṇa maṣīṃ kṛtvā 
śmaśāna eva kapālayoḥ śatrornāma dvitīyāntam, vidabhītamiti ---- 

"abhidheyaṃ bhavetpūrvaṃ tato mantraḥ sakṛdbhavet | 

vidabhīto bhavatyeṣa ............ ||"

ityāmnātatvādantanyastahuṃphaṭkāraṃ mārayāmi huṃphaḍityantaṃ samyak 
saṃruddhabhairavarūpasvātmābhimānānusandhānena likhet || 87 || 

atha ---- 


............ṣvacchandaṃ pūjayettataḥ | 

kṛṣṇamālyopahāraiśca................


śmaśāna eva, kṛṣṇarātrau, śmaśānāvaraṇayuktamityarthāt || 


..........ṭataḥ karma samārabhet || 6-88 || 

vijñāpya bhairavaṃ devaṃ śatruṃ me vinipātaya | 


atha ---- 


anujñātastu devena gṛhītvā tacchirodvayam || 6-89 || 

tatra gatvā mahādevi kapālāsanasaṃsthitaḥ | 

tatrastho roṣasaṃpūrṇo dakṣiṇābhimukhaḥ sthitaḥ || 6-90 || 

ātmano bhairavaṃ rūpaṃ jñātvā ghoraṃ subhīṣaṇam | 

kruddhaḥ samuccarenmantrī dvātriṃśākṣarasaṃmitam || 6-91 || 

vilomena mahābhāge śatrunāma tato'ntagam | 

huṃphaṭdvayaṃ samuccārya kādye cāsphālayed bhṛśam || 6-92 || 

khaṇḍaśaścūṇīte yāvattāvacchatruvīnaśyati | 

saptarātreṇa deveśi prayogastvanivartakaḥ || 6-93 || 


anujñāta iti bhāvanayā | śirodvayaṃ kapālayugmam | kapālāsanaṃ 
muṇḍāsanam | roṣastīvrāpakārasmaraṇāt | tata iti 
vilomamantroccārānantaram | anivartako na nivartate, nānyathā 
bhavatītyarthaḥ || 93 || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


evaṃ śatasahasrāṇi anyakalpotthitāni ca | 

prayogāṇāṃ karotyeṣa mantrarājeśvareśvaraḥ || 6-94 || 


evaṃ karotyavisaṃvādīni sampādayati || 94 || 

evamīdṛkppayogakramamudritasya yadyasyānukampayā sa evānyo'pi vānyasya 
vā śāntimicchet, tadā ---- 


anulomagataṃ devaṃ vauṣaṭkārāntasaṃsthitam | 


amukasyeti ūhayuktamuccārya || 


kṣīraṃ tu homayed devi śāntyarthe hitakārakam || 6-95 || 


athoktānuktakarmasu ucitajātiprayogānāha ---- 


vaṣaḍāpyāyane śastaṃ svāhāntaṃ vaśakarmaṇi | 

mantrāṇāṃ tarpaṇārthaṃ ca..............


anta ityubhayatra saṃbaddhyate || 

kiñca māntraṃ svarūpam ---- 


...........ṇatyantaṃ cārcane smṛtam || 6-96 || 


natirnamaḥśabdaḥ | cakārājjape'pi || 96 || 

etadupasaṃharan bhāvipaṭalasya saṅgatiṃ karoti ---- 


etaddhi kathitaṃ devi sādhakasya sumedhasaḥ | 

kriyākālāṃśayuktasya akleśāttu sukhāvaham || 6-97 || 


sumedhaso yamaniyamādivaśīkṛtadhiṣaṇasya, ata eva yathākathañcit 
kṣudrakarmāṇyanārabhamāṇasya, api tu mukhyasiddhyaṅgatayā 
svīkārayogyasya vaśīkaraṇādisiddhisādhanaparipanthinaścoccāṭanādi 
avasare kurvataḥ kriyayā snānārcanasamayapālanātmatayā, 
bhāvipaṭalanirṇeṣyamāṇakālena, aṃśakena 
cāṣṭamapaṭalanirṇeṣyamāṇena yuktasya, tajjñātvā 
prayogamanurundhānasyākleśādityārādhitaitanmantrābhimantraṇa-
pūrvakamanuṣṭhīyamānaṃ sukhāvahamityabhīṣṭaphalapradaṃ bhavatyeveti 
śivam || 

smāraṃ smāraṃ guruvarapadadvandvavisphūjītānāṃ
	māntraṃ vīryaṃ kimapi paramaṃ daśītaṃ yanmayātra | 

tasminnantarnamata guravo mantracakraikasāre
	saṃsārābdhiṃ tarata tarasā bhairavībhāvameta || || 

iti śrīsvacchandatantre 
śrīmahāmāheśvarācāryavaryaśrīkṣemarājaviracitoddyotākhyavyākhyopete 
pañcapraṇavādhikāraḥ nāma ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ || 6 || 




saptamaḥ paṭalaḥ


" svacchandodyotaḥ "

saṃkucaccitsphurattātmaprāṇāntaryena bhāsyate | 

kālādhvā viśvabhṛd bhuktimuktyarthaṃ sa jayatyajaḥ || 

"kriyākālāṃśayuktasya" (6 | 97) iti yadupasaṃhṛtaṃ tato viditaṃ 
kriyāsvarūpamanūdya, kālāṃśakaṃ jñātuṃ śrīdevyuvāca ---- 


kriyā jñātā mayā deva tvatprasādānmaheśvara | 

kālāṃśakaṃ ca deveśa kathayasva prasārataḥ || 7-1 || 


kriyā pūjanādisādhanāntā | kālaṃ ca tattatsiddhisādhanocitamavasaram | 
aṃśakaṃ ca brahmāṃśakaviṣṇvaṃśakādirūpam | prasārataḥ iti 
sabāhyābhyantaravyāptyā abhidhatsva | ata eva pūrvaṃ ---- 

"kālaṃ caiva samāsataḥ" (1-9)

ityuktyoddiṣṭamapi kālasvarūpaṃ tattvato'jñātvā punaḥ praśnitam || 1 
|| 

śrībhairava uvāca ---- 


kālo dvidhā'tra vijñeyaḥ sauraścādhyātmikaḥ priye | 


kalayati janmasthityādivikāraṣaṭkena paricchinatti jagadyaḥ 
pārameśakriyāśaktispandātmā kālaḥ | dvidhā ityekarūpo'pi 
bāhyābhyantaratayā saṃsthitaḥ, atra iti nityanaimittikakāmyeṣu sarveṣu 
karmasu aṅgatayārādhakairjñātavyaḥ | sūre bhavaḥ sauraḥ 
sthūlo'horātrādyātmā, sa eva tvātmanīti tadadhiṣṭhite prāṇe, 
adhyātme bhava ādhyātmikaḥ sūkṣmarūpaḥ | tatra śubhaṃ karma 
suvārasudinādau kartavyam | tatra caihikāmutrikaphalasiddhyarthaṃ 
dakṣiṇāyanottarāyaṇādisvarūpamavaśyaṃ jñātavyam ||  

tadetatsarvaṃ bāhyakālata eva jñāyata ityāha ---- 


suvārakaraṇe lagne suyoge sudine priye || 7-2 || 

tejo'pacayarāśau tu..........


śobhano vāraścandratithyādigrahanakṣayogaḥ, karaṇaṃ ca vava-vālava-
kaulavataitilādikaṃ viṣṭivajītaṃ yatra, sudine ariktatithau, suyoge 
ityānandādiyogavati yo lagnaḥ svarkṣāderanukūlaḥ sūryasañcārāpekṣaḥ 
pratidinaṃ ghaṭikāniyamena mīnādi rāśyudayastatra, tejaso'pacayarāśau 
makarasaṃkrāntau tadupalakṣite ca tadupacayarāśau karkaṭe 
āmutrikaihikakarmārambhaviṣaye'vaśyajñātavyo yaḥ kālaḥ sa eṣa saura 
iti dūreṇa sambandhaḥ | suvārakaraṇamityādiprathamāpāṭhastu spaṣṭaḥ 
|| 2 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 

.............ḍakṣiṇāyanamuttaram | 

grahaṇaṃ candrasūryābhyāṃ kālaśca ṛtavastathā || 7-3 || 

pakṣo māsaśca velā viṣuvadrāśyantaraṃ tathā | 

puṇyāpuṇyodayo devi...........

candrasūryābhyāmupalakṣitaṃ grahaṇam | 


dakṣiṇāyanottarāyaṇavadaihikapāralaukikaphalakarmaviṣayam | kālaḥ 
cāturmāsyasaṃjñaḥ | ṛtavo vasantādyā | pakṣaḥ śuklaḥ kṛṣṇaśca | 
māsaḥ caitrādiḥ | velā tattadgrahādisañcārāśrayaḥ 
pravibhakto'horātravibhāgaḥ | viṣuvat dinamahanīśāsāmyātma 
meṣatulayoḥ sūryasaṃkrāntikālaḥ | rāśyantaram itarāḥ saṃkrāntayaḥ 
| puṇyakālo vaiśākhaśuklatṛtīyādiḥ | apuṇyakālo malamāsādiḥ || 3 
|| 

tadevamādikaṃ sarvaṃ tattatkarmāṅgatayā upayujyamānaṃ yat, sa kālaḥ --
-- 


..............ṣaura eṣa prakītītaḥ || 7-4 || 


bāhya iti śeṣaḥ || 4 || 


ādhyātmikaṃ punardevi kathayāmi nibodha me | 


puna iti viśeṣeṇa | ṅibodha me" ityuktyā paramopādeyatvaṃ dhvanati || 

tatra ---- 


ṣāṭkośikastu yo deho bhūtatanmātrasaṃyutaḥ || 7-5 || 

sa manobuddhyahaṅkārabuddhikarmendriyairguṇaiḥ | 

sarvatattvaistathā devaiḥ samadhiṣṭhitavigrahaḥ || 7-6 || 

tatrātmā prabhuśaktiśca vāyurvai nāḍibhiścaran | 


sthita iti śeṣaḥ | ṣaṭkośāni tvakmāṃsaraktamajjāsthiśukrāṇi | yo 
dehaḥ, sa kāryakaraṇatrayoviṃśatyā sattvādibhirguṇaiḥ sarvatattvaiśca 
taduparisthitainīyatyādibhiḥ śivatattvāntaiḥ, tathā devairbrahmādibhiḥ 
kāraṇaiḥ, samyag vyāpyavyāpakabhāvena, adhiṣṭhitaḥ kṛtāvasthitiḥ, 
vigrahaḥ svarūpaṃ yasya | ātmā 
saṃkucitasaṃvidrūpastattatkarmānuṣṭhātā tatphalabhoktā ca, prabhoḥ 
svacchandabhairavasya, śaktiḥ svātantryātmā manaḥprasādā.vasareṣu 
bhāntī, vāyuśca nāsikāpathavāhī prāṇo 
nāḍibhirvakṣyamāṇābhiścaran sthitaḥ | ayamatrāśayaḥ ---- iha 
viśvottīrṇaviśvamayacidānandasundaraḥ svatantrabhaṭṭārakaḥ 
svasvātantryaśaktyā ---- 

śthūlasūkṣmasvarūpeṇa sa ekaḥ saṃvyavasthitaḥ" (4-295)

ityuktanyāyena sadāśivādikṣityanta viśvamunmīlayet prathamaṃ 
tadullāsanabhittiṃ śūnyātiśūnyabhūmiṃ svātmadarpaṇe | tatra ca 
citprakāśaprādhānyena śūnyasya guṇībhāvāt śūnyātiśūnyabhūḥ  
sadāśivādimantrāntaśuddhapramātṛsaṅkocaprapañcotthāpikā 
mahāmāyāśabdavācyā ucyate | yadā tu citprakāśaguṇībhāvāt 
śūnyameva prādhānyena darśayati, tadaiṣā 
māyāśaktiraśeṣavijñānākalapralayākalasakalatatprameyasaṅkoca-
prapañcapradaśīkā'bhidhīyate | yaśca saṅkocastayā pradarśyate, sa eva 
śūnyapramātā nimagnavimarśaśaktiḥ | yadā cāsau 
vyatiriktameyagrahaṇāyonmukhībhavati, tadā prāṇarūpatayā sphurati, 
tathā sphurannapi kastūrikākaṇavat tatrāpi tāvatyaṃśe 
saṃkucitāśeṣaviśvātmatayā bhāti tadabhiprāyeṇaiva ca 
vitatavitatamūtīvaicitryātmā pūrvaṃ ṣaḍvidhādhvavibhāgaḥ 
prāṇasthita ityuktam | iha caikatraiva prāṇoccāre nālikātaḥ prabhṛti 
ṣaṣṭyabdodayāntam, ekādaśapaṭale ca mānuṣāyuṣkālāt prabhṛti 
anāśritāntasya viśvasya ca 
āyuṣparimāṇamativitatavitatakriyāśaktivaicitryātmakamasti, iti 
pratipādayiṣyate | yadyapi ca 
prāṇabhūmikāyāmivātyantasaṃkucitaśarīrādyātmatāyāmapi 
parameśvaraḥ pūrṇaṣaṭtriṃśattattvasphārarūpa eva yathā pratipāditam, 
tathāpi "prāk saṃvitprāṇe pariṇatā" iti nītyā prāṇarūpaḥ parasyāḥ 
śakterantaraṅgamadhiṣṭhānam, tadavarohakrameṇa 
bhūtabhāvaśarīrāvataraṇāditi 
samagraprāṇaprasarabhittibhūtamadhyamaprāṇabhūmikādhyārohakrameṇaiva 
paraśaktipadānupraveśāvaṣṭambhapūrvameva svacchandībhairavatā'vāpyate 
mahāyogibhiḥ, mitayogibhiśca tattadāntarakālāṃśaviśrāntipūrvaṃ 
vidhimanutiṣṭhadbhiḥ sā siddhiravighnenāsādyate | ata eva 
pratipāditapratipādayiṣyamāṇaitacchāstranidīṣṭaḥ 
saṃhitāntaranidīṣṭo'pi vā sarva evopāsādikramo 
madhyaprāṇapathoccaranmantrapramukhameva phalado bhavati, ityāśayenātra 
paṭale parameśvarasyāvyātmikakālasvarūpapratipādane mahān saṃrambhaḥ, 
ityalaṃ tāvadihaivādhikena || 6 || 

yadyapyātmaprabhuśaktivāyavaḥ sarvatra dehasthitāḥ tathāpi 
prādhānyābhiprāyeṇa yathākramaṃm ---- 


nābhyadhomeḍhrakande ca sthitā vai............


nābhyantaṃ prakṛtitattvasya vyāptiriti 
nābhāvaśeṣanāḍīcakrabhūtāyāṃ prādhānyenātmā sthitaḥ, 
adhomeḍhera tu madhyaśaktiḥ (kande ca vāyuḥ) | eṣāṃ cātra 
svarūpamavadhānadhanaireva samyagupalabhyate na tu paśubhiḥ | 
evaṃ sthite satyātmaviśrāntipadāt ---- 


.......................ṇābhimadhyataḥ || 7-7 || 

tasmādvinirgatā nāḍyastiryagūrdhvamadhaḥ priye | 


ata evoktamanyatra ---- 

ṅābhicakre kāyavyūhajñānam |" (pā0yo0 3-29) 

iti | 

kecittu nābhicakrata itipāṭhaṃ pūrvatraiva yojayitvā, tasmādityanena 
kandapadaṃ pratyavamṛṣṭavantaḥ || 7 || 

tāsāṃ madhyāt ---- 


cakravat saṃsthitāstatra pradhānā daśa nāḍayaḥ || 7-8 || 


tatra iti nābhau padme | daśa nāḍīrnāmato vakṣyati || 8 || 

daśabhyastu ---- 


dvāsaptatisahasrāṇi nāḍyastābhyo vinirgatāḥ | 

punavīnirgatāścānyā ābhyo'pyanyāḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 7-9 || 


vinirgatā ityūrdhvamadhastiryak ca prasṛtāḥ || 9 || 

kimavadhi niryātāḥ ityāha ---- 


yāvatyo romakoṭyastu tāvatyo nāḍayaḥ smṛtāḥ | 


ardhacatasraḥ koṭayaḥ || 

ataśca ---- 


yathā parṇaṃ palāśasya vyāptaṃ sarvatra tantubhiḥ || 7-10 || 

śarīraṃ sarvajantūnāṃ tadvad vyāptaṃ tu nāḍibhiḥ | 


iha "prāksaṃvitprāṇe pariṇatā" iti sthityā nirṇītanītyā saṃvittiḥ 
śūnyabhūmikāmābhāsya prāṇabhūmimāśritavatī, tatrāpi 
palāśapatramadhyaśākhānyāyena 
madhyanāḍyāśrayamadhyamaprāṇarūpatāṃ śritvādikramavasthite, tatrāpi 
pradhānanā(da)ḍīdaśakāśrayaprāṇādipradhānavāyurūpatāmāsādya 
puruṣāyuṣamadhyasambhavyahaḥ saṃkhyākāni ṣaṭtriṃśatsahasrāṇi 
bahirvāhānāṃ prāṇanāḍīnām, tāvantyeva 
cāntarvāhānāmapānanāḍīnām, ityubhayaṃ dvāsaptatisahasrāṇi 
pradhānabhūtāni bhāsitavatī | tathā hi sati yāvajjīvaṃ kartavyatvena 
dīkṣitānāṃ yannityakarma bhagavatasvarūpānusandhānādi āmnātam 
taduktavyāptitattvavidā ekavāramanuṣṭhīyamānamapi sarvamevānuṣṭhitaṃ 
bhavati | yaduktaṃ kakṣyāstotre ---- 

"yā agnihotrāhutayaḥ sahasradvāsaptatiḥ syuḥ puruṣāyuṣeṇa | 

nāḍyaṃśayuktyā sakṛdeva juhvat sampādayettāstava mārgavidyaḥ ||"

iti | kiṃ ca ---- 

"madhyaprāṇaniviṣṭahaṃsavisṛtā ye romakūpāśrayāḥ

prāṇāḥ sūkṣmavimarśaśālivapuṣaḥ sārdhatrikoṭyātmakāḥ | 

tānmantrātmatayā vilomayati yo niḥśeṣatattvāśraye

dehe'sāviha nādabhairavatanuḥ svacchandanāthaḥ paraḥ ||"

iti || 10 || 

etāśca nāḍyaḥ  ---- 


mārutāpūritāḥ sarvā ātmaśakticarāḥ sadā || 7-11 || 


ātmā saṃkucitasaṃvidrūpo grāhakaḥ, śaktiḥ prābhavī 
viśvāśeṣaparasphurattātmā, tābhyāṃ hetubhyāṃ caranti vaicitryeṇa 
prasaranti || 11 || 

tāśca ---- 


pṛthag vṛttiprabhedena bhinnāścāraprabhedataḥ | 


vṛttayo vyāpārāḥ sūkṣmaprāṇavāhātmakacāraprabhedahetukāḥ || 

ata eva ---- 


cāravṛttiprabhedena saṃjñābhedo varānane || 7-12 || 


bhavati || 12 || 

ataśca saṃjñābhedāt ---- 


nāḍīnāṃ caiva vāyūnāṃ bhedo jñeyaḥ sahasraśaḥ | 


sārdhatrikoṭiparyanta ityarthaḥ || 

tatra ---- 


pradhānā daśa yāḥ proktā nāḍayaśca varānane || 7-13 || 

tāsāṃ madhye tu deveśi vāyavo ye vyavasthitāḥ | 


madhye ityantaḥ || 13 || 

teṣām ---- 


nāḍīnāṃ caiva vāyūnāṃ saṃjñāvṛttīnībodha me || 7-14 || 


vṛttīrvyāpārān || 14 || 

tatra tāvatsaṃjñā āha ---- 


iḍā ca piṅgalā caiva suṣumnā ca tṛtīyakā | 

gāndhārī hastijihvā ca pūṣā caiva yaśasvinī || 7-15 || 

alambusā kuhūścaiva śaṃkhinī daśamī smṛtā | 


āsāṃ vyāpāramāha ---- 


etāḥ prāṇavahāḥ proktāḥ pradhānā daśa nāḍayaḥ || 7-16 || 


prāṇaṃ prāṇanārūpaṃ sāmānyaṃ 
vakṣyamāṇaprāṇāpānādisaṃjñābhedād daśavidhaṃ yathākramaṃ vahanti 
|| 16 || 

vāyūnāṃ saṃjñābhedamāha ---- 


prāṇo'pānaḥ samānaśca udāno vyāna eva ca | 

nāgaḥ kūrmo'tha kṛkaro devadatto dhanañjayaḥ || 7-17 || 


eṣāṃ vṛttibhedam ---- 

"jalpitaṃ hasitaṃ gītaṃ nṛttaṃ yuddhagatiḥ kalāḥ | 

śilpaṃ ca sarvakarmāṇi prāṇasyedaṃ viceṣṭitam ||" (7-306)


ityādinā paṭalānte vitatya vakṣyati || 17 || 


ete ca ---- 


vāyavo nāḍayaścaiva cakravat saṃsthitāḥ priye | 


nābhimadhyaṃ parivṛtyetyarthaḥ || 


tāsu sañcarataḥ siddhiṃ yogaṃ caiva varānane || 7-18 || 


sañcaratīti sañcaran taṃ vāyumadhiṣṭhāya, tattaducitāṃ siddhiṃ 
cittaikāgryeṇa yogaṃ ca prāpnuyāt || 


japataśca varārohe japasiddhimavāpnuyāt | 


tāsu sañcarataḥ ityanuvartate | japājjapataḥ || 

āsāmapi ---- 


daśānāṃ tu paraṃ devi nāḍītrayamudāhṛtam || 7-19 || 

bindunādātmake dve vai madhye śaktyātmikā smṛtā | 


bindurjñānaśaktipradhānaḥ prāṇastadātmikā piṅgalā dakṣanāḍī | 
nādaḥ kriyāśaktipradhāno'pānastadātmikā iḍā vāmanāḍī | 
tayormadhye suṣumnākhyā parecchāśaktisphurattārūpā || 19 || 

tisra etāḥ ---- 


hṛccakre tu samākhyātāḥ sādhakānāṃ hitāvahāḥ || 7-20 || 


hṛtpadmamadhyakaṇīkāyāṃ samyaganupraveśena ā samantāt khyātāḥ 
satyaḥ sādhakānāṃ trividhasiddhipradāḥ || 20 || 


evaṃ sthite ---- 


prāṇo vai carate tāsu ahorātravibhāgataḥ | 


prāṇaḥ prāṇanātmā sāmānyarūpaḥ | ahorātraśabdaḥ 
pakṣamāsābdopalakṣakaḥ || 

yathā ---- 


tathā te kathayiṣyāmi pravibhajya yathāsphuṭam || 7-21 || 


atra pīṭhikābandhaṃ tāvat karoti ---- 


prabhuśaktisamākṛṣṭā marutprāṇātmasaṃsthitāḥ | 

traya ete'vibhāgena sañcarante samantataḥ || 7-22 || 


marut prāṇanātmā sāmānyaḥ, prāṇastu dakṣavāmamadhyādivāhī 
prāṇāpānodānādyākhyāviśiṣṭaḥ, ātmā saṃkucitacidātmā | 
tadrūpatayā saṃsthitāstraya ete padārthāḥ, prabhoḥ śivasya, śaktyā 
samākṛṣṭā iti śūnyapadāvabhāsapuraḥsaraṃ prāṇanābhūmimullāsya 
prāṇāpānādiviśeṣapadavīmuṭṭaṅkya bhogasāṃmukhyena pravatītāḥ, 
avibhāgena sañcarante nānādehabhūmīḥ śrayanti || 22 || 

triṣveṣu madhye yo maruduktaḥ, saḥ ---- 


adha ūrdhvaṃ vahedyasmāt sarvanāḍīḥ pravāhayan | 


tato'sya ---- 


vṛttisaṃjñāprabhedena varṇarūpāṇyanekadhā || 7-23 || 


vṛttirbahirvahanāntarvahanādivyāpārastato yaḥ 
prāṇāpānasamānādisaṃjñābhedastena, 
dvādaśaṣoḍaśādisvarabhedabhinnāstadgarbhīkṛtavyañjanātmānaśca 
varṇāḥ, tattadanubhavātmakāni ca rūpāṇi, anekadhā bhavanti | atra 
cāgamāntaroktyā garbhīkṛtavyañjanaḥ svarodayarūpaḥ 
pañcāśadvarṇodayātmā aṣṭavargodayasvarūpo vā varṇodayo'sti | sa 
tviha noktaḥ kevalaṃ varṇaśabdena sūcitaḥ || 23 || 

tadatra ---- 


dvāsaptatisahasrebhyo jāyante daśa vai priye | 


ye daśa prāṇādayaste dvāsaptatisahasrebhyo dvāsaptatisahasranimittaṃ 
jāyante, tatprapañcavyāptiṃ śrayantītyarthaḥ || 


tato'pi prāguktādhyuṣṭakoṭyātmatāṃ prāṇaḥ śrayatītyāha ---- 


koṭidhāto varārohe sa ekaḥ saṃvyavasthitaḥ || 7-24 || 


sa ca ---- 


prāṇāpānamayaḥ prāṇo visargāpūraṇaṃ prati | 


"hakārastu smṛtaḥ prāṇaḥ" (4 | 257)

iti yaḥ pūrvamevāśeṣavācyavācakāvibhāgavimarśamayo halākṛtiḥ 
prāṇa uktaḥ, sa eva svātantryāvabhāsitasaṅkocāvabhāsapuraḥsaraṃ 
nirṇītāvarohakrameṇa prakṛtaṃ rūpaṃ yasya prāṇanarūpasya 
sāmānyaprāṇasyaḥ, sa visargāpūraṇaṃ pratīti sarvaireva suṣiramārgād 
bahistattadbhāvāvabhāsasṛṣṭirūpavisargārthaṃ tadavabhāsapuraḥsaraṃ 
praveśayuktyā tadāharaṇenāntarāpūraṇārthaṃ prakarṣeṇa ananād 
dhvananādarthajighṛkṣāgrahaṇaviśrāntidaśocitādvimarśāt prāṇa 
ityarthaḥ || 

etadeva sphuṭayati ---- 


nityamāpūrayanneva prāṇināmurasi sthitaḥ || 7-25 || 

prāṇanaṃ kurute yasmāt tasmāt prāṇaḥ prakītītaḥ | 


sarvadehagato'pyayaṃ prāṇināmurasi sphuṭamupalabhyamānatvenāvasthito 
nityamāpūrayan, arthāt prāṇino'rthāṃśca praveśanirgamābhyāṃ 
prāṇanaṃ vimarśamayaṃ jīvanaṃ kurute, tasmādayaṃ prāṇa uktaḥ || 25 
|| 

yadarthamiyān pīṭhikābandhaḥ kṛtastadevānubadhnannāha ---- 


ahorātragatiṃ prāṇe adhunā kathayami te || 7-26 || 


gatiṃ jñaptiṃ prasaraṇaṃ ca || 

tatra ---- 


tuṭayaḥ ṣoḍaśa prāṇe pūrvaṃ hi kathitā mayā | 

bāhyenaiva tu kālena te lavāḥ parikītītāḥ || 7-27 || 


yāḥ pūrvaṃ caturthapaṭale sapādadvyaṅgulodayaparimāṇāḥ ṣoḍaśa 
tuṭaya uktā tāḥ ---- 

"mānuṣākṣinimeṣasya aṣṭamāṃśaḥ kṣaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ | 

kṣaṇadvayaṃ tuṭirjñeyā taddvayaṃ tu lavaḥ smṛtaḥ ||" (11-201)

ityekādaśapaṭalavakṣyamāṇena bāhyena kālena te lavā lavaśabdākhyāḥ 
kālāvayavāḥ | evaṃ ca prāṇīyā tuṭirbāhyatuṭiścānyaiva, na tu 
śabdasāmyādatra bhramitavyam | prāṇīyā tuṭirbāhyo lavaḥ, bāhyā 
tuṭiḥ prāṇīyaṃ tuṭyardhaṃ paryavasyati | itthaṃ ca bāhyaḥ kṣaṇaḥ 
prāṇīyatuṭesturyoṃ'śaḥ, iti mantavyam | anenaiva ca krameṇa 
āntaraprāṇāpānodayarūpo yaḥ sandhyākālaṃ vinā 
triṃśattuṭiko'horātraḥ, sa eva ---- 

"lavadvayaṃ nimeṣastu jñātavyo gaṇitakramāt | 

daśa pañca nimeṣāstu kāṣṭhā caiva prakītītā ||" (11-202)

ityekādaśapaṭalavyavasthayaiva kāṣṭhābhidhānaḥ kālāvayavaḥ | 
yadihaivāgre vakṣyati ---- 

"ādhyātmikāhorātreṇa bāhye kāṣṭhā vidhīyate" (7-50)

iti || 27 || 

iha tu ---- 


tābhiścatasṛbhirdevi prāṇe yāmo vidhīyate | 


tābhiriti tuṭibhiḥ, bahirvadantarapi dinacaturbhāgo yāmaḥ praharaḥ || 


taireva praharairdevi catubhīstu dinaṃ bhavet || 7-28 || 


evaṃ nirgamakramavat praveśakrameṇāpi tathaiva--


rātriścatubhīvījñeyā..............


taditthaṃ saṅkalayya ---- 


.............'horātrastvato'ṣṭabhiḥ | 


pārameśaśaktiniyamitasūryodayādisthityā yathā bahidīnaniśāvibhāgaḥ, 
tathāntarapi prāṇasūryodayādisthityā yoginaḥ 
pratidinādisādhyakāryavivakṣayā, ityuktaprāyam || 

yathāsya prāṇasya bahirantarvāhitānaiyatyam, tathopapādayati ---- 


śivo dharmeṇa haṃsastu sūryo haṃsaḥ prabhānvitaḥ || 7-29 || 

ātmā vai haṃsa ityuktaḥ prāṇo haṃsasamanvitaḥ | 


yaḥ pūrvaṃ cidānandaghanaḥ śiva uktaḥ, sa dharmeṇa svātantryātmanā 
svabhāvena, haṃsa iti hānasamādānadharmā viśvasargasaṃhārakārī, 
śivatvādeva pañcavidhaṃ kṛtyaṃ hānasamādānasatattvaṃ karoti | yathā 
cāsau, tathā tadīyajñānaśaktimayaḥ sūryo'pi, prabhayā prakāśena, 
anvitaḥ san rasavisargādānakrameṇa hānasamādānadharmā haṃsaḥ | 
yataśca nirṇītanītyā śiva eva svātantryāvabhāsitasaṃkucitacidrūpa 
ātmā, tataḥ so'pi karaṇonmīlananimīlanādikrameṇa hānasamādānadharmā
haṃsa ityukta iti | 

"anenaiva tu yogena haṃsaḥ puruṣa" (4-260)

ityatra yojanikāgranthe itthaṃ sa eva prāṇaḥ prāṇabhūmikāmāśrito'pi 
bahirantaśca hānasamādāne kurvan haṃsa eva | yataḥ sa evāyaṃ sūrya 
ātmā prāṇaśca haṃsena anāhatātmakaniṣkalabhaṭṭārakeṇa śivarūpeṇa 
samyaganvitaḥ | sa eva hyavarohakrameṇa prāṇāntaṃ padamāśritya 
bahirantargamāgamau kurvan sargasaṃhārakṛt | ata 
evaitatpadapariśīlanābhyāsenaiva jhagiti paramaśivatāmāviśanti 
mahāyoginaḥ | prasaṅgādatra rahasyārthaḥ kaṭākṣitaḥ || 29 || 

prakṛtaṃ tu ---- 


tasyodayāt kalet kālaḥ.........


tasya prāṇasya, udayāt prabhṛti janmādivikāraṣaṭkakrameṇa, kālo 
bhūtavartamānādibhedena vahan viśvaṃ jagat kalayati | kalet ityaiśaḥ 
pāṭhaḥ || 

atra coktāhorātrarūpe prāṇacāre ---- 


...............grahāṇāmudayo bhavet || 7-30 || 


sa cādūra eva vyaktībhaviṣyati || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


ṛkṣāṇi rāśayaścaiva tārāstvaṃśāstathaiva ca | 

prāṇe vai udayantyete ahorātreṇa suvrate || 7-31 || 


bāhyadinagatanakṣatrānusāraṃ prāthamyaṃ parikalpya, prāṇāpānavāhe 
saptaviṃśatidhā vibhakte pramāṇe, aśvinyādinakṣatrāṇāṃ 
tadadhiṣṭhātṝṇāṃ 
meṣādirāśīnāmanukūlānanukūlajanmāditārāṇāṃ 
tribhāganavabhāgādikalanayā ca rāśyaṃśānāṃ bāhya iva 
prāṇīye'pyahorātrodayo'sti || 31 || 

atha ---- 


ahorātrodayasyaiva vibhāgaṃ kathayāmi te | 

hṛdayordhve tu kaṇṭhādho yāvadvai pravahet priye || 7-32 || 

aṅgulena vihīne tu prathamaḥ praharaḥ smṛtaḥ | 


"tuṭibhiścatasṛbhiryāmaḥ" iti yat prāguktam, 
tattuṭicatuṣṭayavāhikālāpekṣam | idaṃ tu deśāpekṣamiti na 
paunaruktyam | hṛdayāt kaṇṭhāntaṃ pūrvaṃ daśāṃgulamekāṃgulahānyā 
navāṃgulaṃ bhavati || 32 || 

tato'pi ---- 


dvitīya ūrdhve vijñeyo madhyāhnastālumadhyataḥ || 7-33 || 


atrāpi navāṃgulataiva, yo dvitīyaḥ sa eva tālumadhye madhyāhnaḥ || 33 || 

atra viśrāntasyānuṣṭhānaphalamāha ---- 


atra homo japo dhyānaṃ kṛtaṃ vai mokṣadaṃ bhavet | 


atha ---- 


nāsāgryatryaṃgulordhve tu yāvat prāptastu suvrate || 7-34 || 

praharastu tṛtīyo'sau bhaved vai varavaṇīni | 


nāsāgryasya bhrūmadhyasya, tryaṃgulamūrdhvaṃ lalāṭam, ākaṇṭhaṃ 
caturaṃgulāttāluno bhrūmadhyaṃ dvyaṃgulamiti tadūrdhvaṃ tryaṃgulamuktam 
|| 34 || 

tadupari ---- 


śaktyante ca caturthastu praharaḥ.......


śaktyante dvādaśānte || 

etāvadantam ---- 


................'haḥ prakītītam || 7-35 || 


āntaram || 35 || 

tatra ca ---- 


caturthānte tu deveśi prāṇasūryaḥ sadāstagaḥ | 


sadā iti yadā yadā caturthapraharasyānto bhavati, tadā prāṇa eva 
ahorātravibhāgahetutvāt sūryo'stameti || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


tato'stamayasandhyātra tuṭyardhaṃ tu bhavet priye || 7-36 || 


tata iti taṃ caturthāntamavalambya, 
prāṇanivivṛtsāpānollilasiṣāsāmarasyātmatayā 
guṇībhūtavāhatvenonmajjacchaktitadvatprakāśāveśaviśrāntirūpārdha-
tuṭikalā astamayasaṃdhyā || 36 || 

atra ca sandhyāyāṃ prāṇasūryaḥ ---- 


tatkālaṃ tu vilambyaivaṃ punaścādhaḥ pravartate | 


tatkālaṃ tuṭyardham, saṃghaṭṭapade viśramya, evam ityārohakrameṇaiva, 
punaśca iti punaḥpunaḥ, adhaḥ pravartate apānacandrībhūya 
hṛdantamavarohati || 

tadāha ---- 


sa ca candrodayo devi rajanī ca vidhīyate || 7-37 || 


sūrya eva prabhāsaṃkramaṇayuktyā candra iti kālajñāḥ || 37 || 

rātrāvapi praharakramaḥ prāgvannavāṃgulasthityā 
apānacandrasañcārakrameṇetyatidiśati ---- 


pūrvoktakramayogena yāmeṣvevaṃ caratyasau | 


atra sandhyāviśrāntyanantaraṃ dinacaturthapraharodayasthānāntamādyaḥ 
praharaḥ || 

tataḥ ---- 


tāluke cārdharātrastu punarevaṃ vidhīyate || 7-38 || 


punarevam ityavarohakrameṇa navāṃgulasthityaivetyarthaḥ | atra homādi 
siddhidamityarthalabdhametat | kiṃ ca ---- punarevaṃ vidhīyata iti punarapi 
navāṃgulasthityā kaṇṭhādho'ṃgulānte tṛtīyo rātriyāma ityarthaḥ || 
38 || 

tato'pi ---- 


hṛtpadmaṃ tu yadā prāptaḥ prabhātasamayastadā | 


tatrāpi ---- 


tuṭyardhaṃ tu varārohe pūrvasaṃdhyā bhavettataḥ || 7-39 || 


etat pūrvavad vyākhyeyam | pūrvatvamatra saṃdhyāyāstadanantaraṃ 
prāṇasūryodayātmakadinaprārambhāt || 

yadāha ---- 


tasmāt samudayaścaiva sūryasya sa bhavet punaḥ | 


sūryaḥ prāṇaḥ || 

udetya ca ---- 


pūrvavat kramayogena ca careddhi sadā śubhe || 7-40 || 


śubhe ityāmantraṇam || 40 || 

atraiva ---- 


vāsare tu caret sūryo dhārāyāṃ sañcarecchaśī | 


prāṇa eva sūryaḥ apānastu candraḥ | atha ca sūrya indriyavargo vāsare 
prāṇodaye carati samullasya bāhyaṃ prakāśayati | dhārāyāṃ 
niśāyāmapānodaye śaśī meyagrāmarūpaḥ caret pramāṇaprakāśamāviśya 
pramātraikātmyameti || 

taditthamahorātramadhye ---- 


candrasūryodayo hyeṣa mayā te parikītītaḥ || 7-41 || 


sādhakānāṃ saumyetarasiddhyarthamatraiva madhye sūrodayoktavad 
grahapañcakodayakramaṃ darśayati ---- 


bhaumādyāśca grahā hyevaṃ caranti pravibhāgaśaḥ | 


yathā sadā bahirantaśca dinaniśayoḥ sūryasomau carataḥ, tathā sadaiva 
pañcadhā pañcadhā vibhaktayostayoḥ bhaumādyāḥ saurāntāḥ pañca 
vibhāgakrameṇa caranti, tena ca krūrasaumyasiddhyaṃgaṃ bhavanti || 

atha bāhyavelāvārānusāramahani niśāyāṃ cāntarapi grahasaptakodayaṃ 
gāruḍādiśāstradṛṣṭanyāyena darśayati ---- 


prāṇe cāpyudayantyete prahare prahare priye || 7-42 || 

velā vāro bhavedyasya sa caret praharadvayam | 


yasya grahasya bahirvāraḥ, sa prathame prahare bahiriva antarapyudeti | tato 
dine ṣaṭparivartanakrameṇa ardhe'rdhe prahare tadanye, yāvadantye 
taddinārdhaprahare sa eva | taduttareṣvasareṣu krameṇa 
pañcaparivṛttikrameṇānye, yāvadantye tanniśārdhaprahare sa eva | 
evamekaikasya grahasya dine'rdhapraharaṃ rātrāvardhapraharaṃ codayaḥ | 
vārabhāginastu dviguṇamiti sthite'horātramelanayā vārabhāginaḥ 
praharadvayam, tadanyeṣāṃ tu praharamudayo bhavati | taduktaṃ śrītotule --
-- 

"praharārdhabhujaḥ sarve'horātraṃ ca caranti te |" iti | 

saṃhitāsāre'pi ---- 

"ṇisivāsara dupahareṇā ābhuñjanti gahaparāhaṇā | 

jassa dinaṃ se vāro viṇivattaī rāṇiva aṇā te | 

kamaparivatteṇa diṇaratiṃ bhuñjanti bāṇaparivatte || 

iti || 42 || 

atraiva madhye ---- 


rāhuścarati somena ketuścarati bhāsvatā || 7-43 || 


ahetyarthaḥ | tena taccāra eva tayoścāraḥ | na tu grahāntaravad 
vyatiriktaḥ || 43 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


ye grahāste ca vai nāgā lokapālāṣṭakaṃ ca te | 

mūrtayaścaiva te cāṣṭāvaṣṭau te ca gaṇeśvarāḥ || 7-44 || 

te ca pañcāṣṭakā rudrāstathā yogāṣṭakāḥ pare | 

anantādiśikhaṇḍyantāste ca vidyeśvarāṣṭakāḥ || 7-45 || 

sakalādyāni tattvāni sthitāni paratastviha | 

pūrvoktā bhairavāścāṣṭau sarve te ca vyavasthitāḥ || 7-46 || 


grahā ādityādayaḥ saurāntā yathākramamanantavāsukitakṣakakārkoṭa-
padmamahāpadmaśaṃkhapālanāgāḥ, rāhustu kulikaḥ | taduktam ---- 

"inastvananta ityuktaḥ somo vāsukirucyate | 

takṣakaḥ kuja ityuktaḥ kārkoṭaḥ somajo bhavet || 

sarojo gururākhyāto mahābjaḥ śukra ucyate | 

śaṃkho mandagatirjñeyaḥ sapta nāgā grahāḥ kramāt || 

aṣṭamaḥ kuliko nāma rāhuḥ krūragraho bhavet |" 


iti | 

yaśca śrītotule ---- 

"raveḥ ṣoḍaśa madhyāttu caturo'ntācca bhārgavāt | 

caṣakau dvau budhasyādauṃ somasyāṣṭau tu madhyataḥ || 

saurasyāntāccatuḥ ṣaṣṭiṃ madhyataścaṣaka guroḥ | 

dvātriṃśataṃ kujasyāntād bhuṅkte ṣaṭparivartataḥ ||"

iti caṣakasaṃkhyayā kulikakāla uktaḥ, so'trātyantasūkṣme prāṇacāre 
durlakṣya evetyavicārya eva | evaṃ pu�bhogāya 
dinārdhapraharānadhitiṣṭhatāṃ grahāṇāṃ nāgairadhiṣṭhitatvam, 
nāgānāṃ tūktakramasthitibhirlokapālairindrādibhiḥ | indrādyā 
mūtībhiriti 
kṣityādimūrtyadhiṣṭhātṛśarvarudrabhavādibhirmūtīśvaraiḥ,
te ca caṇḍanandyādibhiḥ prāguktairgaṇeśaiḥ, te'pi guhyātiguhyapavitra
sthāṇvādyaiḥ pañcabhiraṣṭakaiḥ kramāt kramamadhiṣṭhitāḥ | 
te'pyakṛtādinā yogāṣṭakena vyāptāḥ | yogāṣṭakādapi pare ye 
prakṛtisthāḥ krodhādyā, māyāsthā maṇḍaliprabhṛtayastairvyāptāḥ, 
te'pi vidyātattvagatairanantādibhiḥ, vidyeśvarā api sakalādyairiti 
sadāśivaparivārabhūtaiḥ 

śakalo niṣkalaḥ śūnyaḥ kalāḍhya..... |" (10-1194)

iti vakṣyamāṇairaṣṭabhiḥ, yadvā sakalaḥ sadāśiva ādyo 
yeṣāmūrdhvavatībindvīśabrahmāvyāpivyomānantānāthānāśritānām, 
taistattvairityabhedabhūmisparśāt pāramāthīkairdevaiḥ | 
te'pyaunmanasapadavyāptyavasthitaśrīsvacchandanāthaparivāratvāt 
tadadhiṣṭhitaiḥ kapālīśādibhirbhairavairadhiṣṭhitāḥ | tadāha ---- 
sarva evaite teṣu prāṇīyāhorātrārdhaprahareṣu vyavasthitāḥ | atra 
cādyārdhapraharakrameṇaiva indrādīnāṃ dine rātrau ca dvituṭika udayaḥ, 
na tu ṣaṭparivṛttyādyavasthitagrahasthityā, grahāṇāṃ 
saptānāmaṣṭakaiḥ saha saṅgatyayogāt | 
vyavasthitiścaiṣāmabhedavyāptiḥ, ata evātra sāmānādhikaraṇyenoktiḥ 
kṛtā | evaṃ ca parabhairavasphāramayatvameva prāṇe paryavasitam | ato 
yadasmābhiḥ prāṇabhūmikāyāmahorātrakrameṇa vyāptipradarśanaṃ 
pūrvaṃ kṛtam, tadutsūtraṃ na mantavyam | itthaṃ ca sarvamidaṃ 
parameśvarādvayamevetyatra jñānādeva jñānināṃ jīvanmuktiḥ 
karatalagateva, sādhakānāṃ tu 
tattadbhuvaneśvarādivyāptatatpadānusāreṇāpi 
mahāvyāptyanusandhānāvighnenaiva tattatsiddhyudayo bhavati, iti 
pratipāditaṃ bhavati || 46 || 

taduktamevārthamanubadhnāti ---- 


grahādīn samadhiṣṭhāya sarveṣūdayakārakāḥ | 


sarve evaite lokapālādyā bhairavāntāḥ, sarveṣu dinarātriprahareṣu 
udayaṃ kurvanti | katham ? grahādīniti tattadardhaprahareṣu paryāyeṇa 
prāptavārān sūryādigrahān, ādiśabdādanantādināgāṃśca 
samyagabhedenādhiṣṭhāya || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


rāśibhiḥ saha nakṣatraista udyanti ahanīśam || 7-47 || 


hṛdayāt prabhṛti dvādaśāntaṃ yāvat pratyaṃgulaṣaṭkaṃ rāśiḥ, iti 
sthityā makarādayo mithunāntāḥ ṣaḍrāśayaḥ, tadadhiṣṭhitāni ca 
nakṣatrāṇi tadanusāreṇaiva pratyaṃśamapi tatra udyanti, tathaiva ca 
dvādaśāntāddhṛdayaṃ yāvat karkaṭādyā dhanvyantāḥ || 47 || 

atraivābhijidudayamāha ---- 


madhyāhne cārdharātre ca udayo'bhijito bhavet | 


tālunītyarthaḥ | abhijayati sarvān vighnān ityabhijid nakṣatraviśeṣaḥ 
|| 

ataśca ---- 


abhīpsitaṃ phalaṃ tatra sādhakānāṃ bhavediha || 7-48 || 


iha iti pārameśvareṣu śāstreṣu, uktaṃ yad bhogamokṣākhyaṃ phalaṃ 
sādhakānāmiṣṭam, tattu mādhyāhne ārdharātrike'bhijinnakṣatre 
bhavatyeva || 48 || 

etadupasaṃharannanyadavatārayati ---- 


ahorātravibhāgo'yamevaṃ te kathito mayā | 

adhunā pakṣamāsāṃśca varṣāṇi kathayāmi te || 7-49 || 


tatra nirṇītābhyantarāhorātraṃ bāhye kāle niyojayati ---- 


ādhyātmikāhorātreṇa bāhye kāṣṭhā vidhīyate | 


atra kāṣṭhā na ghaṭikā, api tu daśapañcanimeṣātmā 
kālāvayavaviśeṣa iti daśītameva || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


māsenādhyātmikenaiva bāhye caiva kalā bhavet || 7-50 || 

tatra triṃśadahorātrā māsastu varavaṇīni | 


ādhyātmiko māsaḥ, te prāṇacārātmānastriṃśadahorātrā 
bāhyāstriṃśatkāṣṭhāḥ, tena īdṛśenāntareṇa māsena bāhyakalākhya 
eva kālo bhavati | 

vakṣyati caikādaśe ---- 

"triṃśatkāṣṭhāḥ kalā jñeyā" (11-203) iti | 

"eva"śabdaḥ kalāśabdānantaraṃ yojyaḥ | varaṃ varṇayati sarvotkṛṣṭaṃ 
paraṃ tattvaṃ parāmṛśatīti varavaṇīnī ||  

kiñcādhyātmikaiḥ ---- 


māsairdvā daśabhiścaiva bāhye'tha ghaṭikā bhavet || 7-51 || 


tadeva sphuṭayati ---- 


śatāni trīṇyahorātrāḥ ṣaṣṭireva tathādhikāḥ | 

varṣametat samākhyātaṃ bāhye vai ghaṭikā ca sā || 7-52 || 


saṣaṣṭitriśataprāṇāpānacārā bāhyā ghaṭikā | "yato'sau 
ṣaṣṭiścaṣakāṇi" caṣakaṃ ca ṣaṭ prāṇāpānacārāḥ || 52 || 

evamuktarūpādhyātmikavarṣakalitāḥ ---- 


ghaṭikāḥ ṣaṣṭistvahorātre vāhye tu pravahanti vai | 

tā evāntaracāreṇa ṣaṣṭiḥ saṃvatsarāḥ smṛtāḥ || 7-53 || 


bāhyaghaṭikā āntaraṃ varṣamiti vibhaktameva | atastāḥ 
ṣaṣṭistāvantyevāntarāṇi varṣāṇi sūkṣmakālagatyā | ata evaikatra 
prāṇacāre ṣaṣṭyabdodaya iti parā kālasthitiragre sphuṭībhaviṣyati || 
53 || 

atha ṣaṣṭighaṭikātmasu varṣeṣu ---- 


prāṇasaṃkhyā punasteṣu kathayāmyadhunā tava | 

ṣaṭ śatāni varārohe sahasrāṇyekaviṃśatiḥ || 7-54 || 

ahorātreṇa bāhyena adhyātmaṃ tu surādhipe | 


ghaṭikāyāṃ saṣaṣṭistriśatī prāṇacārāṇām, iti gaṇanayā 
ṣaṣṭighaṭikāsaṃkhye bāhye'horātre'dhyātme ātmani tadāśrayeṇa 
prāṇacārāṇāmeṣaiva saṃkhyā bhavati || 

evamīdṛśī ---- 


prāṇasaṃkhyā samākhyātā jñātavyā sādhakena tu || 7-55 || 


evaṃ proktavakṣyamāṇavyāptisatattvena ---- 


prāṇahaṃse sadā līnaḥ sādhakaḥ........


līno nibhālanayā viśrāntaḥ || 

tathā prāṇabhūminyagbhāvena śāktapadasamāveśādevāsau ---- 


........paratattvavit | 


bhavati || tadā ca ---- 


tasyāyaṃ japa uddiṣṭaḥ siddhimuktiphalapradaḥ || 7-56 || 


iha prāṇo nirṇītaviśvamantravīryabhūtahaṃsāśrayatvāddhaṃsa iti | 
tatra yo līnaḥ, sa prāṇasaṃkhyayaiva sadaitāvajjapayukto bhavati | 
yathoktaṃ śrīvijñānabhairave ---- 

"ṣaṭ śatāni divārātraṃ sahasrāṇyekaviṃśatiḥ | 

japo devyāḥ samuddiṣṭaḥ prāṇasyānte sudurlabhaḥ1 ||" (ślo0 156)


iti || 56 || 

siddhimuktida iti yaduktam, tadvibhajati ---- 


adhaḥ pravahaṇe siddhirhṛtpadmaṃ yāvadāgataḥ | 

muktiścaiva bhavedūrdhve paratattve tu suvrate || 7-57 || 


etacca ---- 

"yadā karoti sṛṣṭiṃ ca" (6-15)

ityādau vitatya nirṇītam || 57 || 

tadevamuktavyāptijñānapūrvaṃ prāṇahaṃse līnatayā paratattvavido 
yoginaḥ sarva eva kālastatprarohaprakarṣāttādṛganubhavamaya eva 
bhavatītyāha ---- 


mano'pyanyatra nikṣiptaṃ cakṣuranyatra pātitam | 

yathā pravartate prāṇastvayatnādeva sarvadā || 7-58 || 


tatheti madhye'dhyāhāryam | tena yadyapyantaḥkṛtayo bahiṣkṛtayaḥ 
svadhiye prasṛtāḥ, tathāpi paratattvaviśrāntiparatvena 
prāṇavyāptijñasya tathā tenaiva paraviśrāntipradena prakāreṇa prāṇo 
haṃsātmā madhyamaḥ, ayatnādeva svarasata eva, sarvadā pravartate vahati || 
58 || 

etadevopodbalayati ---- 


nāsyoccārayitā kaścit pratihantā na vidyate | 

svayamuccarate haṃsaḥ prāṇināmurasi sthitaḥ || 7-59 || 


haṃsaḥ prāgvyāvaṇītasatattvaparaniṣkalabhaṭṭārakaḥ, 
tadadhiṣṭhitatvānmadhyamaḥ prāṇo'pi nirṇītavyāptisāraḥ | 
svayamuccarate aśeṣaṃ vācyavācakakramamullaṅghya 
paramābhedasāramahāmantravīryātmanā sphurati | yato'sya na 
kaściduccārayitā pratihantā vā asti, asyaiva sarvakartṛtvena 
paramātṛrūpatvāt | ata eva cāyam anāhata ityuddhoṣyate, itaravarṇavat  
sthānakaraṇābhighātānabhivyaktatvādanastamitatvācca | sa cāyaṃ 
prāṇināmurasi hṛdaye jīvitasyāpi jīvitabhūtaḥ sthitaḥ | kecideva 
tvavadhānadhanā etatsattāmāviśanti || 

taditthaṃ paratattvāvahitasādhakajapaniṣpattyabhiprāyeṇa ---- 


māsavatsarasaṃkhyā tu eṣā te kathitā mayā | 


ādhyātmikīti śeṣaḥ | triṃśatprāṇacārā ādhyātmiko māsaḥ, 
ṣaṣṭyadhikā tu triśatī vatsaraḥ, iti hi nirṇītameva ||
