idānīmatraiva prāṇacāre ---- 


candrasūryoparāgaṃ tu kathayāmi tataḥ param || 7-60 || 


sādhakasya bhuktimuktiphalapradamiti sthitameva || 60 || 

tatrādau ---- 


ahorātrastu yaḥ proktaḥ prāṇe'smin surasundari | 

sa eva pakṣadvitayaṃ māsaṃ ca kathayāmi te || 7-61 || 


avibhāgeneti śeṣaḥ | triṃśatprāṇacārāḥ || 61 || 

tatra kṛṣṇapakṣaṃ tāvat pakṣasaṃdhipradarśanapūrvaṃ nirūpayati ---- 


tuṭyardhaṃ cāpyadhaścordhvaṃ viśramaḥ parikītītaḥ | 

madhye pañcadaśoktā yāstithayastāḥ prakītītāḥ || 7-62 || 


adha ūrdhvaṃ ca yattuṭyardhaṃ pūrvamahorātrodaye 
pūrvāparasaṃdhyātvenoktam, sa eveha viśramaḥ pakṣasaṃdhitvena kītītaḥ 
| yāstu madhye pañcadaśa tuṭayaḥ, tā eva pratipadādyāstithayaḥ || 62 || 

atra ca pakṣasaṃdhituṭyardhamutsṛjya, pratituṭyahorātravibhāgamāha ---- 


prathamodaye tu hṛtpadmāttuṭyardhaṃ tu dinaṃ bhavet | 

dvitīye caiva tuṭyardhe yadā carati śarvarī || 7-63 || 


hṛtpadmādityupalakṣaṇam | tenaikaikasyāstuṭeḥ 
sārdhapādāṃgulaparimāṇamādyamardhaṃ dinaṃ prakāśarūpam, paraṃ tu 
viśrāntyātmā rātriḥ | yata iyaṃ bhagavatī saṃvitprakāśāndamayī, 
tato yatra yāvantāvanayā vedyavedakaviśrāntirūpau 
prakāśānandāvābhāsyete, tatra tāvadrūpe eva dinaniśe | tathā ca 
maśakādau sadāśivādau cātyalpātivitatakālatvaṃ tayoryuktameva | evaṃ 
ca pratituṭyardhaṃ vakṣyamāṇakrameṇa tadaṃśāṃśeṣvapi vā 
tāvābhāsamānau dinaniśābhedaṃ samucitaṃ pramātāraṃ prati bhāsayata 
eva | kadācicca prakāśasyādhikyam kadācicca viśrānteḥ, kadācittayoḥ 
sāmyamiti kṛtvā dinaniśayorvaiṣamyaṃ ca bhavatyantarbahiśca | "yadā 
carati" iti sūtrāṃśādanantaraṃ tadetyadhyāhāryam || 63 || 

atra ca dinarātribhede ---- 


rāśayo grahanakṣatrāṇyudayanti yathākramam | 


pārameśvaryā hi saṃvidā yā yādṛśī dinādivyavasthā kriyate, tāṃ 
sarve grahādayo'nuvartante || 

tadittham ---- 


asminnevamahorātre pūrvavacca varānane || 7-64 || 


tuṭibhiḥ pañcadaśabhiḥ pakṣaḥ sa tu vidhīyate | asmin ityāntare | evam 
iti tuṭyardhārdhakalanayā | pūrvavad iti susūkṣmayā dṛṣṭyā | pakṣa 
iti kṛṣṇa ityarthāt || 

athātraiva pakṣe āmāvasyaprātipadatithyaṃśamelanaprakaṭanena 
sūryagrahaṃ niṇīnīṣustithicchedavṛddhī darśayati ---- 


tithicchede ṛṇaṃ jñeyaṃ vṛddhau caiva dhanaṃ bhavet || 7-65 || 

ṛṇaṃ caiva bhavet kāso niḥśvāso dhana (mu)1cyate | 

ṛṇaṃ prāṇavāhasya kiñcidalpakālatā kāsavaśādbhavati | tathā sati 
jhagiti dhāvanādāmāvasyoṃ'śaḥ pratipatsthānaṃ prasarati | etacca 
darśayiṣyamāṇasūryagrahaṇopayogi | niḥśvāsavaśāttu 
kiñciccirakālatā apānacandrasya dhanam, tathā sati 
pūrṇamāsyudayaścandragrahopayogī bhavati || 

prakṛtu (tasya)2 tu ---- 


kṛṣṇapakṣordhvacāreṇa saṃhāraḥ saṃkṣayo bhavet || 7-66 || 


kṛṣṇapakṣarūpeṇordhvacāreṇa prakṛtasya prāṇasya yaḥ saṃhāraḥ, sa 
eva praveśitapūrvaprāṇāvasthitameyacandrasya pratituṭyekaikakalākrameṇa 
amāvasyāntaṃ pañcadaśakalānāṃ saṃkṣaya ityarthaḥ | taduktaṃ 
śrīkāmikāyām ---- 

"amṛtaṃ candrarūpeṇa dvidhā ṣoḍaśadhā punaḥ | 

pibanti ca surāḥ sarve daśa pañca parāḥ kalāḥ || 

amāśeṣaguhāntasthāmāvasyā viśvartārpaṇī ||" 

iti | 

dvidheti kalāpañcadaśakabhittibhūtātisvaccharūpatayā 
dṛśyamānasitapakṣapañcadaśakalātmanā cetyarthaḥ || 66 || 

yata īdṛk kṛṣṇapakṣaḥ, tataḥ ---- 


krūrakarmāṇi vai tatra kurvan siddhimavāpnuyāt | 

śubhakarmāṇi kṛṣṇe ca na ca siddhyanti suvrate || 7-67 || 


cakārau tuśabdaivaśabdayorarthe | iha yadantastadbahiriti sthityā 
yadyadāntare dinarātritatsaṃdhyāpakṣamāsādike phalamuktam, tattad 
bāhye'pi tatra tathaiveti mantavyam || 67 || 

athāntarīmamāvasyāṃ darśayati ---- 


śaktiṃ vai viśati prāṇe yā tuṭistu vidhīyate | 

āmāvasyā tu sā jñeyā kṛṣṇapakṣe varānane || 7-68 || 


śaktiḥ brahmarandhrasthānam, tuṭiriti prakṣīṇacandrā pañcadaśī | ata 
evāmākhyāyāṃ ṣoḍaśyāṃ tuṭau vasanāt tadbhittyavalambanādamāvasyā 
sā jñeyā || 68 || 

atha pūrvamāsūtritaṃ pakṣasaṃdhiṃ sphuṭayati ---- 


śaktermadhyordhvabhāge tu tuṭyardhaṃ yatprakītītam | 

pakṣasaṃdhistvasau jñeyaḥ.........


brahmarandhrādutthitāyāḥ śaktermadhyaṃ tvaksthānaṃ tvakśeṣastu 
keśasthānamūrdhvamekameva tuṭyardhaṃ yat, sa pakṣayoḥ kṛṣṇaśuklayoḥ 
saṃdhiḥ | yadeva hi prāṇasyāntyaṃ tuṭyardhaṃ tadevāpānasyādyaṃ 
bhavatītyetadubhayostuṭyardhātmakaṃ deśata ekameva 
tattuṭyardhadvayavāhakālaṃ saṃdhipadam || 

athātra sūryagrahaṇaṃ darśayati ---- 


...........'māvasyārdhapratipadā || 7-69 || 

tithicchedena vai tatra sūryasya grahaṇaṃ bhavet | 


prāguktāt kāsāt tithicchedena yadā amāvasyeti tatsambaddhaḥ 
pakṣasaṃdhyārdhakālaḥ svasmin saṃdhyātuṭibhāge pratipatkālena saha 
bhavati, tadā sūryagrahaṇaṃ bhavati || 

yataḥ ---- 


ravibimbāntare devi candrabimbaṃ tadā bhavet || 7-70 || 

tadantare bhavedrāhuramṛtāthīṃ varānane | 

amṛtaṃ sravate candro rāhuśca grasate tu tam || 7-71 || 

pītvā tyajati tadbimbaṃ tadā muktaḥ sa ucyate | 


tadeti pratipado'māvasyābhāgasaṃghaṭṭe, ravibimbāntare prāṇamadhye, 
candrabimbam apānaḥ, praviśet | pūrvoktanītyā ca candrasahacārī rāhuḥ 
sūryasaṃsparśavilīnaṃ cāndramamṛtaṃ pītvā kaṃcitkālamāsvādya 
apānarūpaṃ candrabimbaṃ svasambandhād muñcati | idamatra satattvam ---- 
prāṇārkamānahaṭhaghaṭṭitameyacandra	vidrāvitāmṛtarasotsukitaḥ 
khamātā |  svarbhānurāvṛṇuta eva raviṃ rasaṃ tu puṇye grahe'tra 
rasayet trayaghaṭṭanajñaḥ || 

evamantariva bahirapyanayaiva yuktyā bhavet || 


ādityagrahaṇaṃ caiva loke tadupadiśyate || 7-72 || 


tato jyotiḥśāstroktaprakriyayā ---- 


rāhurādityacandrau ca traya ete grahā yadā | 

dṛśyante samavāyena tanmahāgrahaṇaṃ bhavet || 7-73 || 


mahattvameva vyanakti ---- 


sa kālaḥ sarvalokānāṃ mahāpuṇyatamo bhavet | 


tathā ca ---- 


tatra snānaṃ tadā dānaṃ pūjāhomajapādikam || 7-74 || 

yatkṛtaṃ sādhakairdevi tadanantaphalaṃ bhavet | 


anantam aparicchinnaṃ mokṣākhyaṃ phalaṃ yasya | yadvakṣyati ---- 

"mokṣaścaiva punarbhadre" (7-86) 

ityādi || 

evaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣaṃ sūryagrahaṇaṃ ca pradarśya, śuklapakṣaṃ 
candragrahaṇaṃ ca kramādādiśati devaḥ ---- 


tāṃ caivārdhatuṭiṃ tyaktvā śuklapakṣodayo bhavet || 7-75 || 


tām iti yatra sūryagrahaṇaṃ daśītam, śuklapakṣaḥ 
apānacandrodayarūpaḥ || 75 || 

tadāha ---- 


śaktigarbhādadhaḥ sṛṣṭistasmād vṛddhiḥ prajāyate | 


śaktergarbhaḥ kuṇḍalākāratā, sā hi śimbikārūpatayā svāntaraśeṣaṃ 
viśvamāsūtrya, adha iti hṛdayaparyantaṃ tadeva sṛjati | ata eva vṛddhiḥ 
kramātkramamapānacandraparipuṣṭirūpā tathā 
vṛddhinīḥśvāsātmakadhanarūpā jāyate | atra kāsakrameṇa 
tithicchedasyābhāvāt || 

yata evam, ataḥ ---- 


tadārabhya ca karmāṇi śubhānyabhyudayāni ca || 7-76 || 

dhyānamantrādiyuktasya siddhyante nātra saṃśayaḥ | 


tadārabhya iti śaktigarbhasvarūpamavaṣṭabhya, śubhāni āpyāyanādīni 
karmāṇi, abhyudayāni ca tatphalāni ca || 

atra śuklapakṣe dinaniśāvibhāgaṃ pradarśayati ---- 


prāṇahaṃso yadā prāptastvadhastāṃ prathamāṃ tuṭim || 7-77 || 

pūrvamardhaṃ tvahaḥ proktaṃ tuṭyardhamaparaṃ niśā | 


prāṇahaṃsa iti prāgvat | adha iti saṃdhituṭyardhāt prathamāṃ tuṭiṃ 
śuklapakṣapratipadrūpām | "ya"dāśabdaśravaṇāt tadetyadhyāhāryam | 
ahanīśāpravibhāgaḥ prāgvadeva | evaṃ dvitīyāditithiṣvapi mantavyam || 

kiṃ cātra ---- 


rāśayo graha ṛkṣāṇi yogāśca karaṇāni ca || 7-78 || 

pūrvavat kramayogena tānyudyanti tvahanīśam | 


gatārthametat || 

yā ceyaṃ prathamā tuṭiḥ ---- 


pratipat sā tu vijñeyā............


atra ---- 


.............candraścaikakalo bhavet || 7-79 || 


kiṃ ca ---- 


dvitīyāyāṃ dvitīyā tu vṛddhimeti krameṇa tu | 


dvitīyāyām iti tuṭau | dvitīyā iti kalā || 


etā eva tuṭayaḥ ---- 


tithayaścaivamārabhya yāvatpañcadaśī tuṭiḥ || 7-80 || 


bhavati || 80 || 

sā ca pañcadaśī ---- 


paurṇamāsī tu vijñeyā tithirvai sādhakena tu | 


māḥ candraḥ pūrṇo'syāmiti kṛtvā, ata evaihikasiddhiṃ sādhayati | 
tenaiṣā sādhakairuktavakṣyamāṇavyāptisāratayā jñātavyā || 
ataśca ---- 


tatra pūjā japo dhyānaṃ sampūrṇaṃ saphalaṃ bhavet || 7-81 || 


ehikaphalamityarthāt || 81 || 

yataḥ ---- 


sampūrṇaśca bhavettasyāṃ candro vai cārulocane | 


co hyarthe | candraḥ apānaḥ || 

atha ---- 


tasyāścārdhatuṭiryā tu pakṣasaṃdhyā tu sā smṛtā || 7-82 || 


prāgvadeva | tasyā ityavadhau pañcamī || 

kṛṣṇapakṣasaṃdhyāśabdavācyasya pakṣasandhe pūrvavadeva ---- 


tasyārdhaṃ paurṇamāsī tu pratipadardhena saṃsthitā | 


pratipadaḥ sambandhinā ardheneti tṛtīyā sahārthe || 

itthaṃ ca prāguktavyāptyaiva ---- 


hṛtpadmasaṃdhimadhye tu somasya grahaṇaṃ bhavet || 7-83 || 


saṃdhimadhyaṃ prāṇāpānasaṃdhisthānam | idamatra tattvam ---- 

"śaktisaṃsnutasudhārasakramāt pūrṇamindumaṇurāhurāharan | 

chādayediha śubhe mahāgrahe drāvitaṃ pibati taṃ mahāmuniḥ ||"

iti | 

tadetad antariva bahirapi || 83 || 


ādityena vinā loke somagrahaṇamucyate | 


pratipatsaṅgāt dūrasthārkaspṛṣṭe'pīndau rātrāvarkābhāvāt, 
sūryagrahaṇe tu pārvaṇendukalayārkaḥ saṃspṛśyata eva || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


tatraiva ca mahatpuṇyaṃ dhyānahomajapādibhiḥ || 7-84 || 


yathordhvapade ādityagrahaṇaṃ mokṣapradatayā mahāpuṇyam, tathā tatraiva 
iti madhyamadhāmapraveśakramalabdhe hṛdaye, 
candragrahaṇamaihikottamasiddhipradatayā mahāpuṇyam || 84 || 

na ca kevalaṃ madhyadhāmani candrasūryayorgrahaṇam, yāvat ---- 


pakṣadvaye'pi deveśi grahaṇaṃ candrasūryayoḥ | 

nānāsiddhipradaṃ hyetat sādhakasyābhiyoginaḥ || 7-85 || 


pakṣadvaye dakṣe vāme ca, madhyavadeva grahaṇadvayam | nānā iti 
krūrasaumyasiddhipradam | abhiyogina udyuktasya || 85 || 

mumukṣostu ---- 


mokṣaścaiva punarbhadre pakṣadvayasamujjhitaḥ | 


caśabda evaśabdena saha niyataviṣayatayā 
tattveśvarapadavyāptyādirūpamuttamaṃ bhogaṃ samuccinoti | tena 
pakṣadvayojjhito madhyamārgaśca yo mokṣaḥ, tadūrdhve sūryagrahaṇe mokṣa 
eva, hṛdi tu candragrahaṇe bhogo mokṣaśca || 

ataśca yo mokṣārthī ---- 


pakṣadvayaṃ parityajya pūrvoktakaraṇena tu || 7-86 || 

unamanyante sthito nityaṃ paravṛttyavalambakaḥ | 

parityajya tvadhaḥ sarvaṃ dhyānamāsthāya yojayet || 7-87 || 

tasya muktirna saṃdehastvanyathā siddhibhāgbhavet | 


pūrvoktaṃ karaṇaṃ divyam | parā vṛttiruktā lakṣyate ca | adhastanaṃ 
sarvamunmanāntaṃ parityajya tatsamarasīkṛtya | dhyānaṃ 
paratattvavimarśaḥ | anyathā iti dakṣavāmapathordhvasthitaḥ || 86-87 || 

madhyapathagrahaṇaṃ caitad durlabham, itarattu sulabhameva ityāha ---- 


pakṣadvaye'pi grahaṇaṃ bhavedvai sarvadehinām || 7-88 || 


dehinām ityanena mitayogināmatyantaṃ dehapramātrabhimānatvamiti darśayati 
|| 88 || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


evametat samākhyātaṃ yāvadāyurvarānane | 

etad iti sāvadhānasañcetya grahaṇam | 


atraivādhyātmāhorātre tvathābdodaya ucyate || 7-89 || 


tamāha ---- 


hṛtpadmādūrdhvaparyantaṃ rāśayaḥ ṣaḍ vyavasthitāḥ | 


rāśayo makarādyāḥ || 

ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgule cāre'tra ---- 


aṅgulaiḥ ṣaḍbhirekaiko hṛtpadmādyāva śaktitaḥ || 7-90 || 


ekaika iti rāśiḥ || 

itthamasmin ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgule ṣaṇmāsodaye ---- 


aṅgule aṅgule (hyatra) tithayaḥ pañca saṃsthitāḥ | 

tasyāpyardhaṃ dinaṃ pūrvamaparārdhaṃ niśā bhavet || 7-91 || 


tasya aṅgulapañcabhāgāvadhestitheḥ || 

ata eva ---- 


ṣaṭpañcakāstithīnāṃ ye te'horātrāstu māsikāḥ | 

triṃśatā tairahorātraidvīpakṣo māsa ucyate || 7-92 || 


ṣaḍaṅgule rāśyudayasthāne triṃśadahorātrasya māsasya 
niṣpattirbhavatītyarthaḥ | dvipakṣa ityanenedamāha ---- yathāto'pi 
tattanmāsasādhyakrūrasaumyasiddhyarthakṛṣṇaśuklapakṣāśrayaṇaṃ 
susūkṣmadṛśā yoginānusartavyamiti | ata eva varṣasādhye vidhau 
tattanmāsakāryaṃ karma bāhyāntaramāsaikīkārānusaraṇapūrvaṃ 
yoginānuṣṭhātavyamiti varṣodaye'bhiprāyaḥ || 92 || 

tadittham ---- 


māsi rāśyudaye hyeṣa adhordhvaprāṇasañcare | 


ūrdhvavadadhaḥ prāṇasañcāre'pi, eṣa evamādiḥ kramo jñeya ityarthaḥ 
|| 

atha rāśyudayaṃ vibhāgenādiśita māsaprabhedadarśanāśayena ---- 


hṛdayādudayasthānāt saṃkrāntirmakare sthitā || 7-93 || 

ṣaḍaṅgulānyadhastyaktvā kumbhe saṃkramate punaḥ | 

kaṇṭhordhve dvyaṅgulaṃ tyaktvā mīne saṃkramate punaḥ || 7-94 || 

galordhvādyāvattālvantaṃ tyaktvā meṣe'tha saṃkramet | 

nāsāntaṃ yāvat saṃkrāntiraṅgulāni ṣaḍeva hi || 7-95 || 

eṣā vai viṣusaṃkrāntiruttare saṃvyavasthitā | 


udayasthānād iti mantroccāraṇabhūmeḥ | saṃkrāntiriti 
prāṇārkasyetyarthāt, ata eva māghādimāsakramo'tra sthitaḥ | 
ṣaḍaṅgulāni iti kākākṣivat | viṣusaṃkrāntiḥ viṣuvatsaṃkrāntiḥ | 
utare iti uttarāyaṇe || 

etacca prāgvat pāralaukikādisiddhyaṅgatayeti jñeyam | tadāha ---- 


japahomārcanadhyānānmahābhyudayakārikā || 7-96 || 


eṣā viṣuvatsaṃkrāntirityarthaḥ | atrāpi prāgvadantariva 
bāhyasaṃkrāntiṣvapi tattatphalapradatvaṃ smartavyam || 96 || 

atha ---- 


nāsāgraṃ tu parityajya prāṇahaṃso vṛṣe caret | 

ṣaḍaṅgulāni saṃtyajya saṃkramenmithune punaḥ || 7-97 || 

śaktyantaṃ yāvadadhvānaṃ saṃkrāntimīthune smṛtā | 


ṣaḍaṅgulāni iti kākākṣivat | śaktyantaṃ dvādaśāntam || 

etadanuvadan phalaṃ paryavasāyi darśayati ---- 


makarācca samārabhya mithunāntaṃ ca suvrate || 7-98 || 

uttarāyaṇamatraitadaihikīsiddhivajītam | 


uttīryate'neneti vyutpattyā uttaramayanam || 

tataśca ---- 


snānaṃ dhyānaṃ tathā dānaṃ pūjāhomajapādikam || 7-99 || 

sādhakādyaiḥ kṛtaṃ yacca sahasrānekadhā bhavet | 

iha janmani nāpnoti paratraivopatiṣṭhate || 7-100 || 


sādhakādīnāṃ putrakādīnāṃ cātra snānādikaraṇāttaddehānte bhogo 
mokṣaścābhīṣṭo bhavati || 99-100 || 

"iha janmani nāpnoti" ityatra hetumāha ---- 


dināni tatra vardhante makarānmithunāntikam | 

tatkāle saṃharedvīryaṃ jagatyasmiṃścarācare || 7-101 || 

haṃso raśmibhirākṛṣya garbhasthaṃ kārayettu tam | 


tatra ityuttarāyaṇe | dinavṛddhirmeyagrahaṇābhyāsena 
tiśrāntibhāgānādarāt | vīryaṃ viśvasyāpyāyanakaraṃ rasam | haṃsaḥ 
anāhatanādo'ntaḥ, bahistu sūryaḥ | raśmibhiḥ 
antarmukhībhūtābhivīmarśamayībhirindriyadevībhirantaḥ, bahistu 
prabhābhiḥ | śaṃharet" iti vyācaṣṭe ---- garbhasthaṃ śaktyantargatam, 
kārayet kurvato raśmīnniyunakti || 

tatkṛtvā ---- 


garbhasthānekadhārūpaṃ yad gṛhītaṃ purātanam || 7-102 || 

karkaṭādeḥ samārabhya sarvaṃ varṣati tatpunaḥ | 


karkaṭāderityapānodayasthānāt | tad iti vīryam || 

yata evaṃ prāṇodayo vīryasaṃhārakṛt ---- 


tasmādārabhya makarād dhyānahomajapādikam || 7-103 || 

paralokanimittāya tadanantaphalaṃ bhavet | 


pūrvoktānuvādo'yam || 

atraivottarāyaṇe sādhakasya mantrasevārthaṃ 
japādāvāntarasthānaviśeṣātmakālaviśeṣāśrayeṇoccāramādiśati ---- 


puraścaryānimittāya mantragrahavrataṃ ca yat || 7-104 || 

mīnādāvārabhet sarvaṃ mantrasiddhyarthamātmanaḥ | 


puraścaryā prathamameva, mantragrahapūrvaṃ vrataṃ niyatajapādikaraṇam |  
aṣṭāṅgulātkaṇṭhadeśādaṃguladvayaṃ tyaktvā ūrdhvaṃ tālvantaṃ 
ṣaḍaṃgulaṃ mīnasthānam, etadādau śaktyavadhimithunasthānānte | ataḥ 
prabhṛti hyūkāramakārayogāt parasya niṣkalasya mantratvamiti pūrvamuktam 
| 

"matsyavalanasaṃyogāttālurandhre vyavasthitā" | 

iti ca śrītrikasāre nirūpitatvādatra śaktermīnavanmukhapucchācchoṭanena 
tālubilākramaṇāttadgatarasāsvādanataḥ sādhakasaṃvidaḥ 
sarasatvāpādanena bhāviphalaṃ pratyaṅkurībhāvāpādanādevamuktam || 
yuktaṃ caitat, yato'tra ---- 


bāhye'pi taravo loke ṛtuṣaṭkasamīritam || 7-105 || 

kusumānandamāyānti kusumāyudhadīpakam | 


taravaḥ kuravakādyā api mīnasañcārātmakavasantātprabhṛti 
kusumavikāsamayamānandaṃ prāpnuvanti | taṃ ca ṛtuṣaṭke samīritam 
vasante prathamamudbhidya anyatrāpi ṛtau kusumānāṃ prasarāt | 
"kusumāyudhadīpakam" ityanena kāmoddīpanahetutāmabhidadhat 
sādṛśyenāntarasyāpi vasantasya kāmānāṃ prati sādhakatvaṃ dhvanati | 
ata eva bahiryathā kusumameva phalopādānam, tathāntarapi mīnādau 
karmārambhaḥ kusumapratimaḥ sādhakānāmavaśyamīpsitaṃ phalamabhimukhaṃ 
karoti iti kusumaśabdābhiprāyaḥ || 

ata eva ---- 


mantrāḥ kālānurūpeṇa vratacaryādineritāḥ || 7-106 || 

jñeyabodhapradīptāśca siddhimuktiprasādhakāḥ | 


kālo mīnādyudayaḥ | vratam ārādhananiyamaḥ | caryā 
sādhakocitasamayācāraḥ ādiśabdāt karaṇabandhādiruccāraṇopāyaḥ | 
īritāḥ uttejitāḥ | jñeyabodho mantravācyadevatāvyāptijñānam, tena 
pradīptāḥ tatprakāśāvibhedivimarśasārāḥ || 

yata evaṃ sarvamantrāṇāṃ sthitirato'yamatratyo mantraḥ pūrvasevārtham -
--- 


adhyātmaśabdarūpātmā ṣaḍrasāsvādaneritaḥ || 7-107 || 

haṃsabodhapradīptastu galake mīnamāśritaḥ | 


adhyātmaśabdo'nāhatadhvanistatparamārthaḥ | 

"śivo dharmeṇa haṃsastu" (7 | 29)


ityatra nirṇītena haṃsasya bodhena vyāptijñāneneddhaḥ | 
vyākhyātamatsyabalanavyāptyā gale mīnarāśisañcāra prāptaḥ, atha ca 
ṣaṣṭhabījamevordhvādhaḥ kalātmakamukhapucchācchoṭatayā 
procchalanmīnarūpatvam āśrita ārūḍhaḥ | tata eva ca 
sarvendriyāśrayaprāṇādhirūḍhenātmanā īrito lambikārasāsvādāya 
preritaḥ, tataḥ prabhṛti mantratāṃ prāptaḥ sannuccārya iti yāvat || 
etadevopasaṃhārabhaṅgyā ādiśati ---- 


śabdasaṃvedanaṃ tasya sphuṭaṃ tatra bhavedyataḥ || 7-108 || 

tadārabhya japāttasya sarvameva pravartate | 

mithunāntaṃ ca deveśi tataḥ siddhiḥ prajāyate || 7-109 || 


tasya adhyātmaśabdasya | sphuṭaṃ śabdasaṃvedanaṃ mantratattvānubhavanam 
| tatra iti mīnasthāne | tasya iti sādhakasya | sarvaṃ pūrvasevārthaṃ 
japapūjādhyānādi | mithunāntaṃ śaktyavasthāne viśrāntiṃ 
kṛtvetyarthaḥ | siddhiḥ prajāyate mantrārādhanaṃ niṣpadyate | 
tadatrottarāyaṇacāre prāṇasyaiva makarādirūpatvamuktam, tadanukārād 
bahiriti varṇayanti | tathāhi ---- hṛdayādudghāṭitavaktraprāṇasya 
prasaraṇānmakaratvam, kaṇṭhe kumbhavadavasthānātkumbhatvam, tataḥ 
pūrvāparācchoṭanenocchalanānmīnatvam, tato'pi huḍayuddhavad 
bhrūmadhyabhedanānmeṣatvam, tadanu dvayarasavarṣaṇād vṛṣatvam, 
anantaraṃ śivaśaktyubhayātmakatvānmithunatvamiti || 109 || 

evaṃ prāṇe mithunāntamuttarāyaṇaṃ nirṇīya, apāne 
karkaṭādidhanvyantaṃ dakṣiṇāyanaṃ nirṇetumāha ---- 


sahaṃso binduśaktisthaḥ siddhidvārairadhomukhaḥ | 

karkaṭādau sa varṣettu tulāntaṃ tālukāntare || 7-110 || 


saha haṃsena vartate yaḥ prāṇaḥ sa binduśaktistha iti ---- 

"yadā karoti sṛṣṭiṃ tu ūrdhve binduḥ pravartate" (6-15)

ityuktadṛśā samanāpadasthaḥ, siddhipradatvāttaddvāraiḥ 
ṣaḍaṅgulaiścatubhīścāraiḥ, adhomukho 
brahmarandhrakrameṇāntaḥpraviṣṭaḥ, tālukāntare tālumadhye, tulāntam 
iti kaṇṭhaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ varṣet || 

tadyāvat ---- 


kaṇṭhādadhastato dehī hṛtpadmāt sarvato vrajet | 


sarvataḥ sarvatra dehe | hṛdayasyāpānapūraṇena vikāsitatvāt padmatvam | 
hṛtpadmāt iti tadāśritya || 

yasmādevam ---- 


tasmādihātmasiddhyarthaṃ puṣṭyartha caiva sādhayet || 7-111 || 


ihātmanaḥ siddhirasminneva dehe'ṇimādyāvirbhāvanam, puṣṭiḥ 
valīpalitādyabhāvaḥ || 111 || 

kiṃ ca prāgvad bahirapi ---- 


dakṣiṇāyanaje kāle yasmāt sṛṣṭiḥ prajāyate | 


dakṣiṇam anukūlaṃ dehabhuvanāpyāyakaram | grīṣmoṣmaśoṣitānāṃ 
tṛṇalatāgulmādīnāṃ varṣāsu punaraṅkurodbhedo yato bhavati, tasmād 
bāhyābhyantaraitatkālaikīkāreṇa pūrvoktāḥ siddhīrjapādinā 
sādhayediti sambandhaḥ | nanu japaprakaraṇe ---- 

"japaḥ prāṇasamaḥ kāryo dinastho muktikāṅkṣibhiḥ | 

saṃhāraḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ śivadhāmaphalapradaḥ || 

vyomni prāpto yadā nādaḥ punareva nivartate | 

śarvarī sā tu vijñeyā hṛdabjaṃ yāvadāgataḥ | 

sṛṣṭireṣā samākhyātā sarvasiddhiphalodayā ||" (2-140-142)

iti pūrvaṃ pravibhāga uktaḥ, iha tu dinodayātmakamīnodayataḥ sādhakasya 
mantrasiddhyarthaṃ japādyuktam, tathā karkaṭādau ātmasiddhyarthaṃ 
sādhayed iti pratipāditam, tatkathametat ? ucyate | 
dvitīyapaṭalapratipādite japapravibhāge sthite evamatra viśeṣa uktaḥ ---- 
sādhakairmīnādimithunāntaviśrāntyā kalpoktajapādikrameṇa pūrvasevayā 
mantrāḥ sādhanīyāstathā sādhitāstu prayogakāle siddhyarthaṃ 
karkaṭāditulāntaviśrāntiprādhānyena prayojyā iti na kācidatra 
vicikitsā || 

atha karkaṭādiṣaṭkamaṅgulavibhāgena nirūpayati ---- 


śaktyadho hṛdaye haṃsaḥ saṃkramet karkaṭe priye || 7-112 || 

ṣaḍaṅgulāni saṃtyajya siṃhe vai saṃkramet punaḥ | 

ṣaḍaṅgulaiḥ punastyaktaiḥ kanyāṃ saṃkramate punaḥ || 7-113 || 

nāsikāgrāttu tālvantaṃ tyaktvaivaṃ viṣuvad bhavet | 

tulāsaṃkrāntireṣoktā dakṣiṇaṃ viṣuvad bhavet || 7-114 || 


śakteḥ sādhanarūpāyā adho vyāpinīśaktiḥ | brahmarandhrādipade 
karkaṭa iva adhovaktro haṃsaḥ, tataḥ sadāśivapade 
nadanapradhānatvāśeṣaviśvākramaṇakāritvābhyāṃ siṃhaḥ, tato 
bhrūmadhyādau baindavaprakāśaprādhānyād dīptikāntiyogāt 
sarvasādhāraṇaprasaraṇarūpagatitaśca kanyāśabdavācyaḥ, tato'pi 
tālumadhye samatvenāvasthitatvāt tulārūpaḥ, sāmyādeva ca viṣuṃ 
vyāptimarhatīti kṛtvā viṣuvacchabdābhidheyaḥ | punavīṣuvaditi 
pūrvoktottaraviṣuvato'nyo'yaṃ viṣuvatkāla ityarthaḥ || 114 || 

anyatvādeva ca ---- 


sādhanaṃ yat kṛtaṃ tatra iha janmani kāmadam | 


tadityarthāt | 

ataśca ---- 


mṛtyorjayaṃ tathā śāntiṃ puṣṭiṃ tasmāt samārabhet || 7-115 || 

tasmāt sa ṣaḍrasāhāro galādhaḥ prīṇayettanum | 


eṣottamādirūpā trividhātra siddhiḥ | sa iti 
dakṣiṇaviṣuvatkālasthastulyaḥ ata evātraihikaṃ krūrakarma na phalati, 
iti tat  sarvarasasaṃhāripauṣamāsādhiṣṭhātṛdhanvicāraviśrāntyā
kāryamityarthalabhyamatra || 

atha ---- 


ṣaḍaṅgulāni tyaktvā tu vṛścike kramate punaḥ || 7-116 || 

kaṇṭhordhvaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ tyaktvā kaṇṭhādhaścaturaṅgulam | 


tālutalādaṣṭāṅgulāt kaṇṭhāt ṣaḍaṅgulāni tyaktvā yat 
praveśāpekṣayā ūrdhvaṃ prāṇollāsāpekṣayā tvadhastanamaṅguladvayaṃ 
tyaktvā kaṇṭhādhaḥ ṣaḍaṅgule kṣetre prathamamaṅgulacatuṣṭayam, tatra 
pūrvāṅguladvayena saha ṣaḍaṅgule vṛścikavanniścalamavasthāya śanaiḥ 
śanaiḥ prasarpaṇād vṛścikaḥ || 

atha ---- 


vṛścikaṃ tu parityajya dhanvisaṃkrāntirucyate || 7-117 || 

ṣaḍaṅgulādadhastāttu dhanvisthaścarate hṛdi | 


adhastād ityadhaḥsthaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulamāśritya, hṛdi carati viśrāmyati | 
tatra cāyaṃ haṃso baddhalakṣyatvāddhanvītyucyate || 

tadittham ---- 


hṛtpadmāntaṃ tu vai haṃsaścaritvā ūrdhvagodayaḥ || 7-118 || 


punaḥ prāṇavṛttiṃ śrayatītyarthaḥ || 118 || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


makarādiṣu saṃkrāntau dvādaśaivaṃ caret sadā | 

amunoktakrameṇaiva āyurvai sarvadehinām || 7-119 || 


saṃkrāntau iti jātāvekavacanād makarādiṣu yāḥ saṃkrāntayaḥ tāsu 
evam uktakrameṇa dvādaśa iti māghādīn māsān sadā pratiprāṇacāraṃ 
haṃsaścaret | kimavadhītyāha ---- āyurvai sarvadehinām | 
yāvajjīvamityarthaḥ || 119 || 

atha prabuddhasya nityameva 
saṃkrāntidakṣiṇāyanottarāyaṇādipuṇyakālalābhāt 
tattatsiddhisamāsādanamanāyāsena jāyate | tadetadāha ---- 


ehikāmuṣmikī siddhiradhamā madhyamottamā | 


sādhakānāmatrasthānāṃ bhavati || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


ayanadvayamākhyātaṃ.................


atra ca makarādiṣu dvādaśasu kāryasya garbhatvam, prodbubhūṣiṣyattvam, 
prodbubhūṣattvam, udbhaviṣyattvam, udbhavaprārambhaḥ, udbhavattvam, janma, 
sattā, pariṇatiḥ, vṛddhiḥ, hrāsaḥ, kṣayaśca kramād bhava(nti)1 | 
ato'tra japādikriyaitādṛgeva phalaṃ sūte, iti guravo'bhyadhuḥ || 

yadā tu prāṇāpānayātāyātaparihāreṇa hṛdi dvādaśānte ca 
viśrāntiḥ kriyate tadā ---- 


............ṃokṣasiddhirdvayojjhitā || 7-120 || 


dvayena bhedena, ujjhitā advayamayī mahāsādhakasya bhavatītyarthaḥ || 120 
|| 

yato'sau mahāsādhakaḥ--


ayanadvayaparyanta unmanyante sadā sthitaḥ | 


yadā yadā ayanadvayamāśrayati, tadā tadā unmanyanta iti 
prāṇāpānapraśamapade dvādaśānte hṛdi ca paratattvānubhave viśrāmyati 
| yadyapi pūrvamunmanyantatā dvādaśānta evoktā, 
tathāpīhāyanadvayaparyanta unmanyante, ityabhidadhad dvādaśāntāvibhinnā 
hṛdi vyāptirastīti darśayati | 

ata eva ---- 

"dvādaśānte ca hṛdaye"

ityādyanyatroktam || 

ataśca ---- 


tatrastho vai japadhyānānmokṣasiddhimavāpnuyāt || 121 || 


japadhyānapramukhaṃ yastatra paratattva eva tiṣṭhati viśrāmyati, sa 
mucyata ityarthaḥ || 121 || 

ata evetthaṃsvabhāvenaiva  ---- 


mokṣaṃ gatvā tu nāgacchet pratijñā bhairavasya tu | 


pratijñā bhairavasya, na tu śrīkaṇṭhomāpatyāderityanena sarvathā 
dvādaśāntahṛdayayovīśrāntiḥ kartavyā, ityādiṣṭam || 

tathā dvādaśavarṣasādhyamapi kāryaṃ susūkṣmatamasthityā prāṇa evaṃ 
dvādaśavatsaravyāptimavagatyāprayāsenaiva sādhakaḥ sādhayediti 
śikṣayan dvādaśābdodayamādiśati devaḥ ---- 


asminnabdodaye bhūyo dvādaśābdodayaṃ śṛṇu || 7-122 || 


tatra dvādaśa caitrādayo'bdamāsasamānasamākhyāḥ || 122 || 


caitrasaṃvatsare yasmānmāsānāmudayo bhavet | 

tadādi sādhakaistasmāt kartavyaṃ mantrasādhanam || 7-123 || 


tadādi iti caitranāmānaṃ saṃvatsaramādibhūtaṃ kṛtvā || 123 || 

prāguktacaitrādimāsodayakāla evātra caitrādisaṃvatsarodayakālaḥ, 
ityāha ---- 


dvādaśābdaḥ sa vijñeyaścaitramāsādvarānane | 


aṣṭāṃgulāt kaṇṭhādaṃguladvayaṃ tyaktvā ṣaḍaṃgulaṃ yatprāk 
caitramāsasyoktaṃ sthānam, tadeva caitrasaṃvatsarasya || 

atha ---- 


lakṣaṇaṃ tasya vakṣyāmi prāṇe'smin pravibhāgaśaḥ || 7-124 || 

tatra saṃvatsareṇeva amunoktena suvrate | 

ahorātrastu yaḥ prokto dvādaśāṃśaṃ bhajet priye || 7-125 || 

dvādaśa te ahorātrā dvādaśābde bhavanti vai | 


āntareṇa prāṇasaṃvatsareṇa ya 
āntaro'horātro'ṃgulapañcamabhāgaparīmāṇastasya dvādaśamaṃśaṃ 
dvādaśābdodaye'horātro bhajate | eva cāṃgulasya ṣaṣṭitamo'sau bhāgo 
bhavati | itthamahorātraṃ dvādaśāhorātrā bhavanti | tathā ca satyaṃgule 
ṣaṣṭhirahorātrāṇāṃ jāteti || 


pañcabhistāṃstu saṃguṇya dvādaśābda ṛturbhavet || 7-126 || 


māsadvayamityarthaḥ || 126 || 


tameva dviguṇaṃ kṛtvā kālastu sa vidhīyate | 


caturmāsākhyaḥ || 


triguṇenaitadayane.............


aṃgulatrayeṇa triguṇenartunādyamuttarāyaṇam, tato'nyatra traye 
dakṣiṇāyanam || 

tadevam ---- 


............vatsaraḥ ṣaḍguṇena tu || 7-127 || 


tadittham ---- 


saṃkrāntayo dvādaśātra yadvadabde prakītītāḥ | 

dvādaśābdodaye prāṇe vatsarāste prakītītāḥ || 7-128 || 


yadvaditi ṣaḍaṅgulakalanayā || 128 || 

atha ye ---- 


dvādaśābde tvahorātrāḥ............


sambhavanti || 


........ṭeṣāṃ saṃkhyā nibodha me | 

sahasrāṇi tu catvāri triśatī viṃśatistathā || 7-129 || 

dvādaśābdodaye devi prāṇe'smin kathitā mayā | 


prāṇe dvādaśābdodaye iti sāmānādhikaraṇye saptamyau || 

athātisūkṣmayā vyavasthayā ---- 


ṣaṣṭyabdodayamatraiva punaśca kathayāmi te || 7-130 || 

ānandādyāstu te jñeyāḥ ṣaṣṭyabdāstu varānane | 


atraiva ityekatra prāṇacāre || 

tadāha ---- 


te cādha ūrdhvage prāṇe ekasmin surasundari || 7-131 || 

caranti pravibhāgena tathā te kathayāmyaham | 


ataśca ṣaṣṭyabdasādhyāṃ siddhiṃ yo vāñchati, 
asāvāntarādānandākhyādvarṣāt prabhṛti mantrārādhanamupakrameta ---- 
ityāha ---- 


ānandaprabhṛterdevi mantramārādhayettu yaḥ || 7-132 || 

tasyānandastu deveśi mantreṇa saha jāyate | 


mantrasya paraniṣkalasvabhāvatayā'śeṣaviśvanirbharatvena  
paramānandarūpatvāttadabhedavimarśamayaprāṇoccārajñasya ānandamayataiva 
bhavati | tataścehābhihitaṣaṣṭyabdodayasthityā sarvameva puruṣāyuṣaṃ 
yannityakarmāvaśyakartavyam tadekatraiva prāṇacāre vyāptijñasya sakṛdeva 
kṛtaṃ sarvadaiva kṛtaṃ bhavati jñāninaḥ | siddhikāmasya tu 
ṣaṣṭivarṣasādhyam, tadīyavatsare tattatsādhyaṃ vā karma 
prāṇīyavyāptijñānapūrvakaṃ kurvato na visaṃvadatītyāśayeneha 
sādhakādhikāre ṣaṣṭyabdodayādadhikaṃ noktam | śrīnandiśikhāyāṃ tu 
jñānavyāptyabhiprāyeṇa viṃśatyadhikaśatodayo'pyabhihitaḥ | evaṃ ca 
jñānayogināmevaṃ prāṇe vyāptijñānāt sarvamayatnena siddhyatyeva | 
yaduktaṃ śrīmadutpaladevapādaiḥ ---- 

śākṣādbhavanmaye nātha sarvasmin bhuvanāntare | 

 kiṃ na bhaktimatāṃ kṣetraṃ mantraḥ kvaiṣāṃ na siddhyati ||" 
(stotrāva0 1 | 4) iti || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


dvādaśābde tvahorātraṃ pañcadhā bhedayecca tam || 7-133 || 

ṣaṣṭyabde te tvahorātrāḥ pañcaiva parikītītāḥ | 


dvādaśābdodaye'ṅgulasya ṣaṣṭitamo bhāgo'horātra ityuktam | idānīṃ 
tu tamapi pañcadhā bhedayet | evaṃ ṣaṣṭyabdodaye prāṇāṅgulasya 
triśatatamo bhāgo'horātro bhavati || 

tadanayā susūkṣmayā sthityā ---- 


te vai ṣaḍguṇitāstatra māsa ekaḥ prakītītaḥ || 7-134 || 

taiśca dvādaśabhirdevi varṣamekaṃ vidhīyate | 


te iti dvādaśābdodaye'horātrāḥ | tairiti tathābhūtairmāsaiḥ || 

evaṃ ca ---- 


aṅgule tu sapañcāṃśe mānametat prakītītam || 7-135 || 


ahorātraśatatrayātmanyaṅgule māsadaśakama, ahorātraṣaṣṭyātmani 
cāṅgulapañcamāṃśe māsadvayam, iti kṛtvā sapañcāṃśe'ṅgule, etad 
iti ṣaṣṭyabdodaye varṣamānamuktam || 135 || 

tadittham ---- 


ṣaḍaṅgulaistu pañcābdāḥ ṣaṣṭyabda udayanti te | 


dvādaśābdodayasthityā varṣodayāśrayaiḥ ṣaḍbhiraṅgulairiha pañca 
varṣāṇi bhavanti | māsadaśakodayātmako'ṅgula iti taiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ 
ṣaṣṭimāsānāṃ varṣapañcakārambhiṇāṃ niṣpattiḥ || 

anayā ca kalanayā ---- 


hṛtpadmādyāva śaktyūrdhvaṃ triṃśadabdodayo bhavet || 7-136 || 


punarapi ---- 


śaktyadho yāvaddhṛtpadmaṃ triṃśadabdodayo bhavet | 


kiṃ ca ---- 


ṣaṣṭyabde ye tvahorātrāḥ saṅkhyāṃ teṣu vadāmyaham || 7-137 || 

viṃśatistu sahasrāṇi sahasraṃ ṣaṭśatādhikam | 

ahorātrāstu ṣaṣṭyabde śaṅkhyātāstu varānane || 7-138 || 


bāhyāhorātragataprāṇacārasaṃkhyāḥ || 138 || 


upasaṃharati ---- 


ṣaṣṭyabdodaya ākhyātaḥ prāṇa ekatra te mayā | 


atra ṣaṣṭyabdodayānte prayojanamāha ---- 


candrasūryoparāge ca pakṣamāsāyaneṣu ca || 7-139 || 

yugādiṣu yugānteṣu yacca saṃvatsare'pyatha | 

varṣadvādaśake caiva ṣaṣṭyabde'tha varānane || 7-140 || 

snānadānena yajñaiśca pūjāhomajapena ca | 

jñānayogādibhiścaiva bāhye kāle tu yatkṛtam || 7-141 || 

amunokte varārohe tatphalaṃ labhate mahat | 


bāhye candroparāgādau, ṣaṣṭyabdānte amunā āntareṇa prakāreṇa ukte 
tasminneva kāle snānadānādikrameṇa kṛtaṃ tatphalaṃ mahad anantasādhako 
labhate || (evaṃ yugodayasthityā caitrāṣāḍhāśvayujapauṣāṇāṃ 
siddhaye.........śedīni catvāri sādhayati) ---- 


prāṇahaṃsagatiṃ cāre jñātvaikasmistu tad bhajet || 7-142 || 


prāṇasya haṃsatvaṃ prāgvat | cāre prāṇāpānavāhe 
ṣaṣṭyabdāntavyāptike | tad iti candragrahādikam || 142 || 

nanvevaṃ vastuvṛttena tadvyāptivattvaṃ prāṇasya kathaṃ 
pratibhāgocaratāmeti ? ---- ityāśaṅkyāha ---- 


svasaṃvedyo bhaveccāro nāḍīcārajayāt sphuṭam | 


nāḍiṣu cārasya vāhasya, jayād abhyāsena sañcaraṇasvātantryalābhāt 
sarvā prāṇīyā vyāptirmadhyamārge vyaktībhavati, ato yogābhyāse yatnaḥ 
kārya iti tātparyam || 

yogābhyāsaprāvīṇye sati ---- 


athavā sa japādevamatyarthamupabṛṃhitaḥ || 7-143 || 

mantrī yogaṃ vijānāti jñātvā sarvajñatāṃ vrajet | 


japād iti pañcapraṇavādhikāroktasaṅkhyākāt, upabṛṃhito 
labdhotkarṣaḥ, mantrī iti yathoktamantravyāptijñaḥ, yogaṃ yathāruci 
prāṇasañcārasvātantryam, sarvajñatāṃ 
yathoktaprāṇīyasarvavyāptisākṣātkartṛtvaṃ parabhaivaratāṃ ca | uktaṃ 
hi ---- 

"triguṇena tu japyena svacchandasadṛśo bhavet" (6-54) 

iti || 

etadupasaṃhṛtyānyadavatārayati ---- 


punareva pravakṣyāmi nāḍitrayavibhāgataḥ || 7-144 || 

dakṣiṇottarasaṃkrāntau viṣuvaccāratastathā | 

yathā caratyasau haṃso jagatyasmiṃścarācare || 7-145 || 

antaḥsthaḥ kālarūpeṇa kalābhiḥ kalayan jagat | 


madhyamārgāśrayeṇa cārasthitiruktā | idānīṃ dakṣe vāme 
tadubhayātmani ca viṣuvati tathā haṃso jaṅgamasthāvarātmani jagati, 
carati jaṅgameṣu caran sthāvarāṇyapīndriyaprasaraṇayuktyā spṛśati, ata 
eva antaḥstha iti pramātṛṣu, bhūtavartamānādikālarūpeṇa padaṃ badhnan 
jagat sarvaṃ kṣaṇatuṭilavādirūpābhiḥ kalābhiḥ kalayan 
janmādivikāraṣaṭkarūpatayā sṛjan saṃharaṃśca yathā carati, tathā 
pravakṣyāmīti saṅgatiḥ | acarasyāpi ca antaḥsaṃjñasya 
dakṣavāmamadhyanāḍiṣu rasayojanayā puṣpaphalapoṣān haṃsaḥ karoti, iti 
vṛkṣāyurvedajñāḥ || 

kīdṛgasau caratītyāha ---- 


nāḍitrayakṛtādhāro mārgatrayavyavasthitaḥ || 7-146 || 

guṇatrayasamāviṣṭastridhāvasthāvyavasthitaḥ | 

kāraṇaiḥ ṣaḍbhirākrāntaḥ śaktitritayasaṃyutaḥ || 7-147 || 

icchājñānakriyāviddhaḥ somasūryāgnimadhyagaḥ | 


etat nāḍītrayādikrameṇa vyācaṣṭe ---- 


dakṣanāsāpuṭe caiva nāḍī vai piṅgalā smṛtā || 7-148 || 

iḍā caiva tu vāmena suṣumnā madhyataḥ sthitā | 


etannāḍītrayameva mārgatrayamityāha ---- 


dakṣiṇe devamārgastu pitṛmārgastathottare || 7-149 || 

madhyamaḥ śivamārgastu............


kā tasya śivatā ? ---- ityāha ---- 


.............ṭatra gatvā na jāyate | 


gatvā ityupalambhena viśramya || 

atraiva guṇatrayamavasthātrayaṃ ca darśayati ---- 


dakṣiṇe sattvajāgratsthaḥ svapnastho vāmato rajaḥ || 7-150 || 

madhye tamastu vijñeyaṃ suṣuptāvastha eva ca | 


sattvarūpatvaṃ jñānaprādhānyāt, kriyāśaktimayatvādvāme rajaḥ, madhye 
tvicchāśaktimaye bhedopasaṃhāramārgarūpatvāttamaḥ, ata eva madhyam | 
atrobhayanāḍīsamavāhitvaṃ samānavyātyā, na tu madhyordhvavāhitvam, 
tasya turyaprakāśarūpatvena sauṣuptatamoyogābhāvāt || 

atraiva kāraṇānyāha ---- 


brahmeśvaraśca dakṣastho vāme viṣṇu sadāśivau || 7-151 || 

madhye rudraśivau proktau sarvātītaḥ paraḥ śivaḥ | 


brahmaviṣṇurudrāṇāṃ paravyāptyeśvarasadāśivaśivā 
dakṣavāmamadhyādhiṣṭhātṛtvena sthitāḥ | ata eva 
jāgarāditrayamaye'pīśvarādyadhiṣṭhānāt turyavyāptirapyasti, iti 
mantavyam | sarvātīta ityanena tu parakāraṇasvarūpamuktam || 

kāraṇavatparāparabhedena śaktitrayasthitimāha ---- 


jyeṣṭhājñāne ca dakṣe ca kriyā vāmā tathottare || 7-152 || 

raudrī cecchā ca madhyasthā............


jñānādyā aparāḥ, jyeṣṭhādyāstu parāḥ || 

kāraṇānusāreṇa parakāraṇasvarūpavat paraśaktisvarūpamapyāha ---- 


..............parā śaktiḥ parāparā | 


sarvameva paramaparaṃ ca vyāpya sthitetyarthaḥ || 

atraiva somasūryāgnīnāha ---- 


dakṣiṇe tu sthitaḥ sūryo vāme somo virājate || 7-153 || 

pāke prakāśakatve ca madhyasthaścaiva pāvakaḥ | 


pāke prakāśakatve ceti tannimittaṃ pāvako'gniḥ | somasūryayostu ---- 

"vāyati tapati sūryaḥ somo varṣati cāmṛtam" (7-157)

iti kāryaṃ vakṣyati || 

pākaprakāśau viṣayadvāreṇa vyācaṣṭe ---- 


pācayet sarvapākaṃ hi somādiguṇasambhavam || 7-154 || 

prakāśayet svasāmarthyāt paratattvamanāmayam | 


svasāmarthyāditi guṇīkṛtaprāṇādivṛttivaśonmagnasaṃvitsvabhāvatayā 
|| 

pūrvaṃ madhyamārgāśrayadinodayānusāraṃ grahādīnāṃ sthitiruktā, 
idānīṃ tu dakṣavāmatadubhayāśrayeṇāpyāha ---- 


rāśayaśca grahāḥ sarve ṛkṣayogādayaśca ye || 7-155 || 

candrasūryapathenaiva te carantyanupūrvaśaḥ | 

sūryasomau ca te sarve bhuñjate kramaśaḥ priye || 7-156 || 


te sarve iti bhairavāṣṭakaparyantāḥ, somasūryau iti pṛthagvāhe pṛthak, 
samavāhe tu yugapad, bhuñjate'dhitiṣṭhanti || 156 || 

itthaṃ ca ---- 


somasūryātmakāste vai pathitrayavyavasthitāḥ | 


dakṣe prāṇasūryātmānaḥ, vāme'pānasomātmakāḥ, madhye 
tūbhayātmakāḥ | etacca dvitīyapaṭale ājyatripathavibhāgāvasara eva 
vibhaktam || 

somasūryātmakatve ca sati te'pi tatphalapradā ityāha ---- 


vāyati tapati sūryaḥ somo varṣati cāmṛtam || 7-157 || 

somasūryātmakaṃ yasmājjagat sthāvarajaṅgamam | 


yataḥ proktavyāptyā sūryasomavāhasambaddhatvāt sarvaṃ jagat 
sūryasomātmakam, "himamapi dahati, vahnirapi cāpyāyayati sparśanena" 
ityanena nyāyena tattatpramātṛdeśakālanyāyena viśvasya 
hlādatāpakāritvenopalambhanāt, tataḥ sūrya iti dakṣavāho vāyati 
śoṣayati ("ovai" śoṣaṇe) saṃtāpayati ca, soma iti vāmavāhastvamṛtaṃ 
varṣatyāpyāyayati | ataḥ krūrasaumyahasaddhisādhanapareṇa tadaucityenaiva 
pravartanīyamiti paramārthaḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


sauro dakṣiṇamārgastu uttarāyaṇasaṃjñitaḥ || 7-158 || 

vāmaḥ saumyastu yaḥ proktastatra vai dakṣiṇāyanam | 

somasūryātma viṣuvatpuṭadvayaviniḥsṛtam || 7-159 || 


ūrdhvādhovāhavadatrāpyuttarāyaṇādivibhāgo'stītyarthaḥ || 159 || 

atra saṃkrāntibhedaṃ darśayati ---- 


udaksaṃkrāntayaḥ pañca pañca vai dakṣiṇāyane | 

dakṣiṇottarayormadhye saṃkrāntyā viṣuvaddvayam || 7-160 || 


"ahani dvādaśa proktā" (7-168)

iti vakṣyamāṇasthityā bāhye'hni dvādaśa vāmadakṣamadhyasaṃkrāntayo 
navaśataprāṇāpānavāhātmāno bhavanti || 160 || 

atra phalaṃ darśayati ---- 


sauraśca dakṣiṇo mārgastvabhicāraprasiddhidaḥ | 

āpyāyane tathā puṣṭau śāntike saumya uttaraḥ || 7-161 || 


atha saṃkrāntidaśake kramamādiśati ---- 


dakṣiṇāduttaraṃ yāti uttarād dakṣiṇaṃ yadā | 

dakṣiṇottarasaṃkrāntiḥ sā caivaṃ saṃvidhīyate || 7-162 || 


bāhye dakṣiṇaviṣuvaddine vakṣyamāṇānusāraṃ prātarāntaraṃ 
dakṣiṇaviṣuvatkālaṃ samavāhena sthitvā dakṣiṇamārgādudetya 
uttaramārgaṃ yāti, punaruttarād dakṣiṇaṃ yadā yāti tadā sā 
dakṣiṇasaṃkrāntiruttarasaṃkrāntiścocyate | evaṃ saṃvidhīyate anenaiva 
krameṇa punaruttarād dakṣiṇaṃ yātīti saṃvidhīyate niścīyate | tena 
dakṣiṇottaradakṣottaradakṣeṣu pañca saṃkrāntīrvahatītyarthaḥ || 162 
|| 

atha ṣaṣṭhīmuttaraviṣuvatsaṃkrāntimāha ---- 


dakṣiṇasyāṃ yadā nāḍyāṃ saṃkrāmettu yadottaram | 

yāvadardhaṃ tu tatrasthaṃ madhyenottarato vahet || 7-163 || 

tāvattadviṣuvat proktamuttaraṃ tūttarāyaṇe | 


dakṣiṇanāḍyāṃ pañcasaṃkrāntyātmikāyāṃ sthitvā yadā yadottaraṃ 
mārgaṃ saṃkrāmettadā madhyenetyubhābhyāmuttaraṃ viṣuvad bhavatīti | 
uttarāyaṇa iti dakṣiṇavāhātmakottarāyaṇāśrayatvāt | kathamityāha-
tatreti | dakṣiṇasthamardhaṃ prāṇīyaṃ kṛtvobhābhyāṃ puṭābhyāṃ 
vahatītyarthaḥ | yāvaduttarata iti ca yadvyākhyātumavaśiṣṭam 
tasyāyamarthaḥ ---- tato'nantaramuttarata uttarāt prabhṛti 
vahedyāvaduttarāṃ pañcamīṃ saṃkrāntiṃ yāvat | 
tenottaradakṣottaradakṣottarāḥ pañca saṃkrāntīrvahediti tātparyārthaḥ 
| uttareti sautraṃ dvirāvartanīyam | ṭīkākāraistu 
dakṣiṇottaramityādyuttarāyaṇa ityantamuttaraviṣuvadviṣayameva 
vyācakṣāṇaiḥ saṃkrāntīnāṃ vibhāgo na daśīto, granthapaunaruktyaṃ 
cāśritamatra || 

atha dakṣiṇaviṣuvamāha ---- 


uttarād dakṣiṇāyāṃ tu saṃkrāman sa varānane || 7-164 || 

yāvadardhaṃ vahettatra ardhaṃ dakṣiṇato vahet | 

viṣuvad dakṣiṇaṃ tāvad dakṣiṇāyanajaṃ priye || 7-165 || 


pañcasaṃkrāntirūpāduttarānmārgād dakṣiṇasyāṃ nāḍyāṃ 
saṃkrāmannardhaṃ prāṇīyaṃ tatretyuttare, ardhaṃ ca dakṣiṇe 
yāvadvahatyubhābhyāṃ puṭābhyāṃ samaṃ vāhād 
dakṣiṇaviṣuvadetaddakṣiṇāyanakālajātaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ || 165 || 

atra viṣuvaddvaye phalamāha ---- 


tatra pūjā japo homo yatkṛtaṃ muktidaṃ bhavet | 


tat || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


dhyānayogena dīkṣāyāṃ tatstho vai mocayed guruḥ || 7-166 || 


dhyānamatra paratattvaviṣayam || 

tadittham ---- 


bāhye caiva tvahorātre adhyātmaṃ tu varānane | 

catuvīṃśatisaṃkrāntīḥ prāṇahaṃsastu saṃkramet || 7-167 || 


hṛdabjadalāṣṭakasya pradhānanāḍītrayasparśādevamiti vyāptijñāḥ | 
prāṇahaṃsa iti prāgvat || 

atrāyaṃ vibhāgaḥ ---- 


ahani dvādaśa proktā rātrau vai dvādaśa smṛtāḥ | 


atrāpi viṣuvatsaṃkrāntīnāṃ vibhāgamāha ---- 


pūrvāhṇe viṣuvattvekaṃ madhyāhne tu dvitīyakam || 7-168 || 

tṛtīyaṃ cāparāhṇe vai ardharātre caturthakam | 

caturdhā viṣuvat proktamahorātreṇa muktidam || 7-169 || 


tena bāhye viṣuvaddine paścimarātriśeṣaghaṭikā sapādā dinodayād 
ghaṭikā sapādā ityekaṃ viṣuvat | tataḥ pañca krameṇa saṃkrāntayaḥ 
pratyekamardhatṛtīyā ghaṭikā eveti dinārambhāt prabhṛti pādonā 
etāścaturdaśa ghaṭikā bhavanti | tato dvitīyaṃ 
viṣuvadardhatṛtīyaghaṭikāḥ | tato'pi pañca 
saṃkrāntayastathaivetyevamiyadantaṃ pādonā ekānnatriṃśannālikā 
bhavanti | tato'pi dinādavaśiṣṭāt sapādā ghaṭikā sapādā ca 
rātriprārambhaghaṭiketi tṛtīyaṃ viṣuvadityanena krameṇārdharātre 
viṣuvaccaturtham | yathā yathā dinaniśayoryo hrāso vṛddhirvā bhavati, 
tathā saṃkrāntīnāmapi sa mantavya iti samudāyārthaḥ | 
yaduktamasmadgurubhiraśeṣāgamopaniṣadāloke tantrāloke ---- 

"viṣuvadvāsare prātaḥ sāṃśāṃ nālīṃ sa madhyagaḥ | 

vāmetarodaksavyānyairyāvatsaṃkrāntipañcakam	 || 

evaṃ kṣīṇāsu pādonacaturdaśasu nāliṣu | 

madhyāhne dakṣaviṣuvannavaprāṇaśatīrvahet || 

dakṣodaganyodagdakṣaiḥ punaḥ saṃkrāntipañcakam | 

navāsuśatamekaikaṃ tato viṣuvaduttaram || 

pañcake pañcake'tīte saṃkrāntevīṣuvad bahiḥ | 

yadvattathāntaḥ saṃkrātirnavaprāṇaśatāni sā || 

evaṃ rātrāvapītyevaṃ viṣuvaddivasāt samāt | 

ārabhyāhanīśāvṛddhihrāsasaṃkrāntigo'pyasau ||" (6-201-205)

ityādi kālatattvaprakāśane ṣaṣṭha āhnike | yattu tatra madhyāhne 
dakṣaviṣuvadityuktam, tad bāhyottarāyaṇaviṣuvaddine prātaruttaraviṣuvad 
bhavatītyāśayāt | iha tu bāhyadakṣiṇāyanaviṣuvaddine 
prātardakṣiṇaviṣuvad bhavatītyāśayādanyathoktam || 169 || 

athādhyātmasaṃkrāntīnāṃ bāhyakālasthitimādiśati ---- 


catuvīṃśatisaṃkrāntyaḥ samadhātoḥ svabhāvataḥ | 

śatāni nava vai haṃsa ekāmekāṃ vahet sadā || 7-170 || 


samadhātoḥ śleṣmādyanupahatasya | atra ca śuklapratipadaḥ prabhṛti 
dinatrayamādau vāme mārge prathamamardhatṛtīyā ghaṭikā haṃso vahati, 
tato'nyaddinatrayaṃ dakṣiṇe, tato'pyanyadvāme, ityādiḥ kramaḥ 
śrīkālottarādiśāstrokta-udayajñaptyarthaṃ smartavyaḥ | yaduktaṃ 
kālāvalyām ---- 


"tatra tāvadayaṃ prāpya darśapratipadaṃ marut | 

samudeti vidhau tāvadādau candradinatrayam || 

tataḥ saṃkramate sūrye tatrāpyudayate tryaham | 

saṃkramya trayametasmāt punareti himadyutau ||" 

ityādi || 


upasaṃharati ---- 


etanmānaṃ samākhyātaṃ...............


saṃkrāntīnāmiti śeṣaḥ || 

anyathāpravahanamiṣṭetarasūcakamityāha ---- 


.............'nyathā pravahedyadā | 

iṣṭaṃ caivāpyaniṣṭaṃ ca tadā saṃsūcayettu saḥ || 7-171 || 


samadhātorityeva || 

yata evam ---- 


ātmārthaṃ vā parārthaṃ vā tasmādyogī nirūpayet | 


ātmārthaṃ nirūpayed ātmanā parīkṣīta | parārthaṃ nirūpayed iti 
paraṃ nirūpaṇāyāṃ parīkṣāyāṃ niyuñjīta | atra nirūpayediti dvau 
ṇicau || 

athātra parīkṣākālamāha ---- 


pūrvodaye tu samprāpte bhāskarasya varānane || 7-172 || 

jīvitaṃ maraṇaṃ caiva tadārabhya vicārayet | 


jīvitasaṃlagnatvāt sukhaduḥkhādibhogasya prathamaṃ tatparīkṣaiva 
prādhānyādihopakrāntā | bhāskarasya dakṣiṇaprāṇasya | pūrvodaye iti 
proktobhayavāhātmakaprātastanaviṣuvatkālānantaraṃ yadodayo bhavati, tadā 
prabhṛti vicārayet | atra ca bāhyottarāyaṇe 
viṣuvadvāsaraprātastanakālāt prabhṛti parīkṣeta, iti kālāvalīkāraḥ 
| sarvadaiva  prābhātikaproktāntavīṣuvatkālottarabhāvidakṣavāhāt
prabhṛti, iti guravaḥ || 

tatra ---- 


susaṃyatamanā yogī vīro yogāsanasthitaḥ || 7-173 || 

saṃsmarannātmajaṃ prāṇaṃ suṣumnāntargataṃ priye | 


susaṃyatatvaṃ manaso viṣayākaluṣitatvam, vīraḥ 
prāṇavāhanibhālanaikāgraḥ | yogāsanaṃ padmāsanādi | ātmajaṃ prāṇam 
iti vyākhyātāvarohakrameṇa citsvarūpādevotthitam, samyak smaran 
divyakaraṇabandhakrameṇa pūrvoktānupraveśayuktyā parāmṛśan || 

ataśca ---- 


supraśāntastadā tiṣṭhet prāṇaikagatamānasaḥ || 7-174 || 


madhyaprāṇavāhāvadhānena pratyayāntarapraśamāt supraśāntaḥ || 174 || 

evaṃ sarvaprasarabhittibhūtanibhālitasuṣumnāmārgasya yogino yadā ---- 


prāṇasaṃkrāntikālo vai piṅgalaikasthito vahet | 

pravāhe viṣuvad devi jñātvā kālaṃ samādiśet || 7-175 || 


jñātvetyato'nantaraṃ tadetyadhyāhāryam, tenāyamarthaḥ ---- 
madhyapathanibhālanapuraṃsaraṃ prabhātakālamubhayavāhātmakaṃ nibhālya, 
tadanantaraṃ piṅgale dakṣiṇamārge evaikasmin 
yathoktadakṣiṇavāmakramavāhollaṅghanātsthitaṃ cirakālaṃ 
samavasthānamupalakṣya tādṛśi pravāhe kālam iti svasya parasya vā 
mṛtyumādiśet || 175 || 

etadvibhajati ---- 


ekābdaṃ jīvitaṃ jñeyamahorātreṇa suvrate | 

abdadvayaṃ sa jīvettu ahorātradvayena tu || 7-176 || 

tryabdaṃ tu tribhirevātra catubhīścaturabdakam | 

pañcābdaṃ pañcadivasaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ ṣaḍvarṣameva ca || 7-177 || 

saptabhiḥ sapta varṣāṇi jīvedaṣṭāṣṭabhidīnaiḥ | 

navabhirnavavarṣāṇi daśabhirdaśa eva ca || 7-178 || 

dinaikādaśakenaiva varṣaikādaśakaṃ priye | 

dinairdvādaśabhiryogī jīved varṣāṇi dvādaśa || 7-179 || 

saptayāmapravāheṇa ṣaṇmāsānatha jīvati | 

praharān ṣaḍvahedyasya māsāṃstrīn vai sa jīvati || 7-180 || 

pañcapraharavāhena dvyardhamāsāyureva saḥ | 

catubhīḥ praharairdevi māsamekaṃ sa jīvati || 7-181 || 

praharatrayavāhena māsārdhaṃ caiva jīvati | 

praharadvayaṃ vahedyasya dinānyaṣṭau sa jīvati || 7-182 || 

caturaḥ praharān jīvet praharaṃ tu vahedyadā | 

praharārdhaṃ vahedyasya sa jīvet praharadvayam || 7-183 || 


atra proktanavaśataprāṇavāhātirekeṇa yadi dvādaśadivasādyekāntāni 
dināni samadhātoḥ prāṇaḥ piṅgalāyāmevaikasyāṃ sthito 
vāmamārgāsaṃsparśe vahet tattāvat saṃkhyānyeva varṣāṇi jīvitaṃ 
bhavati | saptapraharādyardhapraharānte tu svavāhābhyadhike vāhe 
ṣaṭtridvyardhaikamāsatadardhadināṣṭaka- 
catudīnaikadinadinārdhamāyurbhavati | kaścittu 
navaśatikādvāhādanantaraṃ prāṇāpānavāhātmakāntaradinasthityā 
dinavibhāgaṃ svaparaparīkṣārthaṃ 
tuṭicatuṣṭyātmakāntarapravahaṇasthityā ca praharavibhāgaṃ 
svaparīkṣārthameva vyākṛtavān, anubhavabādhaṃ ca bāhyadinādivāhe 
proktavān saptapraharādivāhaṃ tu bāhyamabhyupetyopekṣyamet | yato yadi 
bāhyāni dvādaśāpi dinānyāyātamṛtyoḥ prāṇo vahati, 
tatko'trānubhavabādhaḥ | na 
tathopalambho'stītyanāyātamṛtyunā'navadhānena caitadvaktuṃ śakyam | 
itarasya tu tathā copalambho bhavatyeva |  
tuṭicatuṣṭayātmakapraharasthityā ca saptādipraharavāho'tyantāsambaddha 
eva, nahi kasyacidapi jātucit prāṇāpānavāhaḥ svābhāvikīṃ 
dvāsaptatyaṅgulatāmutsṛjya vahati, catuṣpraharavāhe ca 
ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulānte'pānasyāpraveśe tadaiva maraṇaprasaṅgaḥ | kiṃ 
ca tathāvidhāṃśāṃśikāvāho yoginā mahatā prayatnena 
sādhitastattatsiddhiprada ityamāvasyāprayatnena ghaṭitaḥ siddhiprada evaṃ 
bhavenna tu jīvitāvasānasūcakaḥ | piṅgalaikasthita iti cātrāśliṣṭam | 
yadi tu yogibhiratra pakṣe vāgbharo dīyate, tanneyārthamapyetat sādhveva 
nāsmākaṃ grahaḥ kaścit, tadapi tu dinavāhaḥ svaparīkṣārthaḥ, 
yāmavāhastu svaparaparīkṣārtha ityatra na vacanaṃ kiñcidasti; 
praharādivāhavyavasthā ca bāhyāpyabhyupagamyata iti sphuṭamidaṃ 
svamanīṣāmātrakalpitam ---- ityalaṃ pūrvaiḥ saha nirbandhena | 
viparyastastvāgamārthāvabodho'nuṣṭhāna-


viparyāsaheturmābhūdityāśayenaitaduktam || 7-183 || 


kiṃ ca ---- 


sadyo mṛtyurbhavettasya yasya haṃsastrimārgagaḥ | 


sadya iti tasminnevārdhaprahare | trayo mārgāḥ nāsārandhre mukhaṃ ca || 

abdādijīvitaṃ ca tatparīkṣākālāt prabhṛti gaṇayedityāha ---- 


yadārabhya nirūpyeta prāṇe vai kālamīśvaram || 7-184 || 

māsaḥ pakṣo dinaṃ varṣaṃ tadahaḥ prabhṛti priye | 

saṃlakṣyaivaṃ prayatnena tatkāle niścayo bhavet || 7-185 || 


yato bāhyāt kālādārabhya sakalakālavyavasthotthāpakatvātkālam, 
prabhaviṣṇutayā viśvasyākramaṇācceśvaram prāṇe prakṛṣṭena 
nibhālanātmanā yatnenaivamuktayuktyā nirūpayet parīkṣet, tataḥ prabhṛti 
māsapakṣadinavarṣādi samyag lakṣayitvā tatkāle niścayo 
bhavedarthājjīvitasyeti sambandhaḥ || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


uttarāyaṇaje kāle evaṃ te kathitaṃ mayā | 


uttarāyaṇamatra dakṣiṇanāsāpuṭavāhaḥ, tasya saṃhārapradhānatvāt || 

prasaṅgāt prakārāntaraṃ mṛtyujñānārthaṃ pratijānīte ---- 


ayuktasyāpi ca prāṇe mṛtyujñānaṃ nibodha me || 7-186 || 


tadāha ---- 


karṇarandhrakṛtāṅguṣṭho ghoṣaṃ na śṛṇute yadā | 

maraṇaṃ tasya deveśi ṣaṇmāsena vinidīśet || 7-187 || 


ghoṣaṃ drutasaricchabdānukāraṃ na śṛṇoti | tadantaḥsthaṃ 
cīravāgākhyaprāṇikāryaciñcinītulyaṃ śabdaṃ śṛṇotyeva || 187 || 
yadā tu tamapi ---- 


ghoṣamadhye paraṃ śabdaṃ cīravākciñcinīravam | 

māsamekaṃ sa jīvettu na śṛṇoti yadā priye || 7-188 || 


karṇarandhrakṛtāṃguṣṭha ityanuvartate || 188 || 

prasaṅgādanyadapyāha ---- 


utpāṭaṃ caiva kāṇaṃ ca mṛtyuyogaṃ ca me śṛṇu | 


tatra ---- 


saṃkrāntipañcakaṃ prāṇo mukharandhre vahedyadā || 7-189 || 

tamutpāṭaṃ vadedyogaṃ.............


prāṇasya svasthānānasāpathādutpāṭanādayamutpāṭaḥ || 189 || 


yadāha ---- 


......ṣthānāt sthānāntaraṃ vrajet | 


ataścedṛgariṣṭalakṣaṇayukto'pi sthānāt sthānāntaramudbhrāntapatrivad 
bhramati, ityapyatrārthaḥ || 

kiṃ ca, īdṛśotpāṭavataḥ ---- 


vittanāśastathodvego rogavṛddhiśca jāyate || 7-190 || 

suhṛdgṛhavināśaśca tejohāniśca jāyate | 


kāṇamāha ---- 


dakṣiṇe puṭa ekasmin dakṣiṇāyanavajīte || 7-191 || 

saṃkrāntyaṣṭakavāhena kāṇayogo bhaveddhi saḥ | 


dakṣiṇāyanena vāmapuṭavāhena vajīte madhye tadrahite | evaṃ cābhidadhat 
yat

"triṃśatprāṇakṣayodayāḥ" (7-202)

iti mṛtyuyoge saṃkrāntisvarūpaṃ vakṣyati, tadihāpi sambandhyamiti 
sūcayati, dakṣiṇāyane prāptyabhāvādvarjanānupapatteḥ | ataśca 
vāmavāhanimīlanena dakṣiṇaikavāhāt kāṇaḥ iva kāṇaḥ || 

ataśca ---- 


bhagandharo'nugranthaśca netrarogaśca kāmalā || 7-192 || 

śūlaṃ visphoṭikā duḥkhamurodoṣā bhavanti ca | 


bhagandharaḥ pāyurogaḥ | anugranthaḥ saśūlo'tīsāraḥ | netrarogaḥ 
timirāmayaḥ | visphoṭikā piṭikā | urodoṣā uraḥkṣatādyāḥ ||  

vāmakāṇamuktvā dakṣiṇakāṇamāha ---- 


vāmanāsāpuṭenaiva saṃkrāntīśca trayodaśa || 7-193 || 


yadi prāṇo vahet tadā dakṣiṇavāhanimīlanādayamapi kāṇaḥ || 193 || 

tasmāt ---- 


jvaraḥ śiro'tīḥ śūlaṃ ca arśāṃsi stambha eva ca | 

mūtrakṛcchraṃ pramehaśca pāṇḍurogaśca jāyate || 7-194 || 


pramehaḥ śuklādiprasrāvaḥ || 194 || 

taditthaṃ prāṇaḥ ---- 


iḍāsthaḥ śleṣmaṇā vyādhiṃ prakopayati suvrate | 


vyādhimiti jvarādipāṇḍurogāntam || 

asya vyādherjātasyodayakālaṃ nirūpayati ---- 


yasmiṃścāre nirūpyeta tatkāladivase pare || 7-195 || 

vyādhibhiḥ pīḍyate sarvairvāmavāmetaretare | 


vāme taditarasmin dakṣiṇe ca kāṇayogaḥ, itaratra ca mukhe utpāṭo yatra 
vāhakāle dṛśyate, tataḥ paratra divase tatkāla eva proktavyādhibhiḥ 
pīḍyata ityarthaḥ || 195 || 

evamutpāṭakāṇau dvau nirṇīya, mṛtyuyogamavyākṛtya 
prasaṅgānnāsāpuṭabhāgasparśaṃ śubhādisūcakaṃ nirūpayati ---- 


athānyat sparśavijñānaṃ nāsādhastāttathopari || 7-196 || 


vakṣyāmīti śeṣaḥ || 196 || 

tatra ---- 


ūrdhvena spṛśataścordhvaṃ rugdoṣāḥ prākpracoditāḥ | 


syuriti śeṣaḥ | ūrdhvena iti ūrdhvavāhinā prāṇena | ūrdhvam iti 
nāsāyāḥ | atra ca dakṣiṇenottarasthaṃ sambadhyate || 

ūrdhvenoktvā adha āha ---- 


vācākrośābhibhavanaṃ dakṣiṇena vahedyadā || 7-197 || 


"dakṣiṇena spṛśet" iti pāṭhe pūrveṇa saha ekavākyatayā vyākhyeyam || 
197 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


madhye madhyapuṭaspaśīṃ parābhibhavatāṃ vrajet | 


madhye iti sarvapārśvasparśavarjam madhyapuṭī madhyavaṃśastatspaśīṃ
ca || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


itaścetaśca bahudhā saṃkrāntyekā vahedyadā || 7-198 || 

pūjanaṃ bahusaṃmānaṃ lābhastasya bhavettadā | 


saṃkrāntigatāni nava prāṇaśatāni | itaścetaśca iti 
vāmadakṣiṇavāhayoryadi paryāyeṇa bahuśo vahet prāṇastadā pūjādikaṃ 
bhavati | yattu kaścid "yadā" ityatra "tadā"ti paṭhitvā pūrveṇa 
parābhibhavena phalena ślokārdhaṃ yojitavān, pūjanaṃ bahvityardhaṃ 
cottaraślokena, tadāsāratvādupekṣyam || 198 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


mandacāre suṣumnāyāṃ prāṇahaṃso vahedyadā || 7-199 || 

bhūlābho dharma eśvaryaṃ bhaveccātra priyāgamaḥ | 


suṣumnāyām iti madhyamārge svarasata eva yadā vahediti vyākartavyam, na tu 
yathā bṛhaṭṭīkākāreṇa vyākṛtaṃ nāsāpuṭamadhya iti || 

evaṃ prāsaṅgikamuktvāvaśiṣṭaṃ mṛtyuyogaṃ nirṇetumāha ---- 


dvādaśaiva tu saṃkrāntīrvahedviṣuvataikataḥ || 7-200 || 

tadaikavatsareṇaiva maraṇaṃ tu samādiśet | 

hraset saṃkrāntirekaikā māsa eko hrasettadā || 7-201 || 


viṣuvateti "udvato nivataḥ" iti 
prayogadarśanādarhārthavatyantasyānavyayatvāttṛtīyā | tena 
vāmadakṣiṇayoryugapadavasthityā yadi dvādaśa saṃkrāntiḥ  
samanantaravakṣyamāṇatriṃśatprāṇacārātmakaikasaṃkrāntikalanayā 
ṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatikavāhātmikā navaśatikaṃ svābhāvikaṃ vāhamapāsya, 
ekata ityekapraghaṭṭakena vahet, tadā māsena maraṇaṃ sūcayati | ekaikā 
tu saṃkrāntiryadi hrased ityekādaśadaśādisaṃkrāntīryadā vahet tadā 
tāvadbhirmāsairmaraṇam, yāvat svābhāvikanavaśatikaviṣuvadvāhollaṅghane 
yadyekāṃ triṃśatprāṇacārātmikāṃ saṃkrāntiṃ vahet tadā māsena 
maraṇaṃ niśceyam | pūrvaṃ

"śatāni nava vai haṃsa ekāmekāṃ vahet sadā |" (7-170)

iti yat saṃkrāntermānamuktam, tadevotpāṭa-kāṇa-yogasaṃkrāntīnāṃ 
dakṣiṇāyanavajīte (7 | 191) ityabhidhānāditi nirṇītam || 201 ||  

mṛtyuyoge tvanyathetyāha ---- 


saṃkrāntyekā varārohe triṃśatprāṇakṣayodayā | 


prāṇāpānavāhasya ahorātratvena uktatvāt tattriṃśatā iha 
saṃkrāntirmantavyā, ityarthaḥ || 

itthamīdṛśyekaiva saṃkrāntiryadi svābhāvikaṃ viṣuvadvāhamapāsya, 
tatsthāne ---- 


dine dine vahed bāhye yāvat triṃśaddināni tu || 7-202 || 


tadā ---- 


māsānte tu bhavenmṛtyuḥ sadya eva varānane | 


tadittham ---- 


mṛtyuyogaḥ samākhyāto mayā te varavaṇīni || 7-203 || 


atrāpi pūrvavat parīkṣākālāt prabhṛti proktāśubhasūcakakālagaṇanā 
kāryetyāha ---- 


abdaṃ māsaṃ tathā pakṣaṃ tithiṃ velāṃ yadābhyaset | 

yatkālāttu samārabhya tatkālaṃ tu samādiśet || 7-204 || 


yatkālādabhyasedyadā parīkṣitumupakrameta, tataḥ kālādārabhya 
varṣamāsādi maraṇādisūcakaṃ krameṇa svātmanaḥ parasya vā 
kathayedityarthaḥ || 204 || 

tadīdṛśamevaṃvidhaśubhāśubhasūcakam ---- 


iḍāsuṣumnāmārgeṇa prāṇacāraṃ vidurbudhāḥ | 


sāvadhānā eva yogino jānīyuḥ, na tvanya ityarthaḥ | iḍāsuṣumne 
piṅgalāṃ viṣuvaṃ copalakṣayataḥ || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


dakṣiṇāyanaje kāle evaṃ te kathitaṃ śubham || 7-205 || 


dakṣiṇāyanajaḥ kālo vāmapuṭavāhaḥ | etadapi 
pūrvavadupalakṣaṇaparameva || 205 || 

yadarthamiyaduktam tatprastāvayati ---- 


evaṃ śarīraje kāle mṛtyuṃ cāśubhameva ca | 

jñātvā yogī jayenmṛtyumaśubhānyapyaśeṣataḥ || 7-206 || 


svasya parasya vā || 206 || 

kathamityāha ---- 


dhyātvā kāleśasvacchandaṃ haṃsaṃ vā sakaleśvaram | 


kālasya sthūlasūkṣmādibhedavato bāhyāntarādirūpasya sarvasyeśaṃ 
yathāruci nirbhāsakam, haṃsaṃ vyākhyātaparaniṣkalasvarūpaṃ 
śrīsvacchandaṃ sakalasya jagata īśvaraṃ dhyātvā anupraveśayuktyā 
sphuṭīkṛtya yogī mṛtyuṃ jayediti pūrveṇa saṅgatiḥ || 

kutrastho'sau kīdṛg dhyeyaḥ ? ---- ityāha ---- 


nāsikārandhramārgasthaḥ sa sṛjet saṃharejjagat || 7-207 || 

ta(ntra)1sthaḥ kalayet sarvaṃ sarvabhūteṣvavasthitaḥ | 


"yaḥ sarvabhūteṣu sthāvarajaṅgamarūpeṣu" ---- 

ṅādākhyaṃ yatparaṃ bījaṃ sarvabhūteṣvavasthitam" (kālo0 1 | 5)

iti tantrāntaroktasthityā avasthitaḥ, nasate kauṭilyena gacchatīti nāsikā 
madhyaśaktiḥ, tadrandhramārge sauṣumne dhāmni sthito 
yathoktāvarohakrameṇa prāṇarūpatāṃ śritvā nāsāyāṃ randhramārgeṣu 
ca cakṣurādisuṣirabhūmiṣu sthitaḥ, sa unmeṣanimeṣayuktyā 
bāhyāntararūpaṃ jagat sṛjet saṃharecca | yatastatrasthaḥ san sarvaṃ 
kalayed antaravasthitaṃ bahiḥ kṣipet, bahirābhāsitaṃ cāntaḥ kṣipet, 
atha ca kalayed gaṇayet vaicitryeṇa sthāpayet jānīyāt parāmṛśecca, 
kalateḥ kṣepasaṃkhyānagatiśabdārthatvāt || 

tenedṛśaṃ svacchandanāthaṃ kāleśvaram ---- 


tatsthaṃ dhyātvā jayenmṛtyuṃ.............


madhyadhāmnaḥ prabhṛti aśeṣarandhravyāptyāvasthitaṃ 
paracaitanyavimarśasāramakālakalitam, dhyātvā iti svātmarūpatvena 
pratyabhijñāya tadavaṣṭambhenāvasthito mṛtyuṃ jayatyeva || 

yataḥ ---- 


.........ṇākālasthaṃ kalet prabhuḥ || 7-208 || 


akāle kālātītaparameśvarātmani yastiṣṭhati tadabhedena sphurati taṃ 
prabhuḥ parameśvaro na kalayet, svātmani kriyāvarodhāt || 208 ||  

yadi cātraiva pade yogīndraḥ satatāvahito bhavati, tadāsya ---- 


dhyānayuktasya ṣaṇmāsāt sarvajñatvaṃ pravartate | 

kālatrayaṃ vijānāti kālayuktastu yogavit || 7-209 || 


parasvacchandasvarūpasamāveśarasena dhīsantānottejanāt ṣāṇmāsikāt 
sarvaṃ kālāgnyādiśivāntaṃ jānāti, yadā tu tatsamāveśarasācchurita 
eva kāle prāṇacāre yukto'vahito bhavati, tadātītavartamānānāgataṃ 
sarvaṃ jānāti yogivaraḥ || 209 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


kālahaṃsaṃ sa tu japan dhyāyan vāpi maheśvari | 

sa bhavet kālarūpī vai svacchandaḥ kālavaccaret || 7-210 || 

hatamṛtyurjarāṃ tyaktvā rogaiḥ sarvabhayojjhitaḥ | 


pūrvanirṇīto yaḥ paraniṣkalabhaṭṭārakātmā haṃsaḥ, sa eva 
nirṇītahānasamādānadharmatayā viśvaṃ kalayan kālahaṃsa itīha uktaḥ | 
taṃ japan dhyāyan veti 
pañcapraṇavādhikārayojanikāgranthoktavyāpticintanayā 
bhūyobhūyastadviśrāntiparatvena 
catuṣkalabhaṭṭārakamantroccārāvartanena japan, 
kālarūpītyaśeṣaviśvakalanātmakaṃ kālarūpaṃ praśastaṃ vidyate yasya 
śrīsvacchandabhaṭṭāraka evāsau syāt | tadvadeva ca vicareta sarvadaiva 
pañcavidhakṛtyakāritayā prasaret | rogerhetubhiḥ kṛtaṃ yadbhayam, 
tenojjhitaḥ || 

kiṃ cāsya ---- 


vijñānaṃ śravaṇaṃ dūrānmananaṃ cāvalokanam || 7-211 || 

sarvaiśvaryaguṇāvāptirbhavet kālajayāt sadā | 


dūrāditi sarvatra yojyam | vijñānaṃ buddheḥ, mananaṃ manaso vyāpāraḥ, 
avalokanaṃ cakṣuṣaḥ | etacca 
sarvāntararbahiṣkaraṇavyāpāropalakṣaṇaparam | tadevaṃ 
sarvarandhravyāpakadeśakālātītasvacchandabhairavātmakahaṃsa-
svarūpātmatāvyāptau śarīrendriyādibhūmyuttaraṇāt punaśca 
paratattvarasena  
tadāsphuraṇājjarāmṛtyurogamitaviṣayajñānānaiśvaryādya- 
bhāvo'rthasiddha ivetyuktam || 

idānīṃ dakṣiṇavāmamadhyavāheṣu krameṇa haṃsadhyāne taducitaṃ 
mṛtyujayamādiśati ---- 


dakṣanāsāpuṭe dhyātvā brāhmaiśvaryamavāpnuyāt || 7-212 || 

tadāyustatsamaṃ vīryaṃ bhūtakālaṃ ca vettyataḥ | 

bhaviṣyajjño bhavedvāme viṣṇutulyabalaśca saḥ || 7-213 || 

tatsamaṃ caitadaiśvaryaṃ tadāyuryogirāḍ bhavet | 

bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyacca sarvaṃ jānāti madhyataḥ || 7-214 || 

nityaṃ vai dhyānayogena rudrasya samatāṃ vrajet | 

āyuṣā balavīryeṇa rūpaiśvaryeṇa tatsamaḥ || 7-215 || 

brahmaṇaḥ parabhāvena eśvaraṃ padamāpnuyāt | 

viṣṇoḥ sadāśivaiśvaryaṃ parabhāvādavāpnuyāt || 7-216 || 

rudrasya yaḥ paro bhāvo dhyātvā taṃ tu śivo bhavet | 


iha ---- 

"brahmeśvarau ca dakṣasthau vāme viṣṇusadāśivau | 

madhye rudraśivau proktau......................... ||" (7-151)

iti nāḍitraya eva ṣaṭkāraṇāvasthitiḥ parāparabhedena pūrvamuktā | 
tena dakṣavāmanāḍiṣu yadi haṃsaṃ brahmaviṣṇurudrarūpamaparayā 
vyāptyā dhyāyan vimṛśati, tadā tadbalavīryaiśvaryayogī bhavati | 
atītabhāvivartamānarūpatraikālikaṃ viśvaṃ jānāti | atra ca 
brahmādīnanayā vyāptyā īśvarasadāśivaśivarūpān dhyātvā 
tadrūpatāṃ labhate || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


evaṃ mṛtyujayaḥ khyātaḥ...........


atha ---- 


..........'mṛtaṃ dhyāyato jayaḥ || 7-217 || 


mṛtyoreveti śeṣaḥ || 217 || 

kathamityāha ---- 


nāḍibhinnālarandhrasthaṃ hṛtpadmaṃ ṣoḍaśacchadam | 

dhyātvā sitaṃ suvikacaṃ kalāṣoḍaśakānvitam || 7-218 || 

sampūrṇāvayavaṃ candraṃ kaṇīkākāravigraham | 

tanmadhye cintyamātmānaṃ śuddhasphaṭikanirmalam || 7-219 || 

kṣīrāmṛtārṇavāvasthakallolāmṛtapūritam | 

upariṣṭād dvitīyābjaṃ śāktāmṛtamahodadhau || 7-220 || 

taccādho mukhapadmaṃ tu paripūrṇendukaṇīkam | 

tanmadhye cintayeddhaṃsamadho binduśikhānvitam || 7-221 || 

varṣantamamṛtaṃ divyaṃ samantāt saṃvicintayet | 

ātmordhvarandhramārgeṇa praviṣṭaṃ tacca cintayet || 7-222 || 

sitaṃ subahulaṃ sāndramamṛtaṃ mṛtyunāśanam | 

tenāplāvitamātmānaṃ pūryamāṇaṃ vicintayet || 7-223 || 

padmanālanibaddhaiśca nāḍīrandhramukhaiḥ sadā | 

amṛtāpūritaṃ dehaṃ sarvameva vicintayet || 7-224 || 

evaṃ vai nityayuktātmā amṛteśasamo bhavet | 

vyādhīn mṛtyuṃ jarāṃ tyaktvā krīḍate tvaṇimādibhiḥ || 7-225 || 

evaṃ tasyāmṛtadhyānāt kālamṛtyujayo bhavet | 


hṛddvāśāntordhvādhaḥ sthitaṃ 
śrīpūrvādyuktāmṛtādidevatāvācyakārādi-
varṇaṣoḍaśakakalitatāvatpatravikasitasitakamalamadhyastham, 
adhaḥkamalakaṇīkāpūrṇendubimbaniṣṭham, 
urdhvābjakaṇīkāpūrṇendumadhyasthādhomukhasitacatuṣkalabindu- 
prakāśaprasaratsudhāsārapūritabrahmarandhravisṛtakallolaplāvitam, 
amṛtarāśimadhyagam, ātmānaṃ sphaṭikaprabhaṃ vicintya, tadamṛtaṃ 
tadadhaḥsthasitābjanālarandhranānānāḍīmukhair 
ucchalatsamastadehavyāpakaṃ yaḥ ṣaṇmāsān satataṃ cintayati, sa 
gatavyādhirajarāmaraṇo'ṇimādisiddhibhāgamṛteśabhairavatulyo bhavatīti 
piṇḍārthaḥ | nāḍirūpatayā bhidyante nānārūpatvena sphuranti yāni 
nālarandhrāṇi, arthādadho'bjagatāni tatsthamiti, tairgranthisthānagataiḥ 
sambaddham, nālamatra madhyanāḍīrūpam, kṣīraṃ 
kṣīrodādyadudbhūtamamṛtam, tadrūpo'rṇava iti saṅgatiḥ | amṛtaṃ 
cātra paraśaktyānandasāram || 

evaṃ sarvanāḍīmārgatrayāśrayahaṃsadhyānādamṛtadhyānācca 
mṛtyujayamabhidhāya, tāttvikamanuttarasārarūpamādeṣṭumupakramate ---- 
athavā paratattvasthaḥ sarvakālairna bādhyate || 226 || 

athavetyanenedaṃ dhvanati ---- 

katipayakālaśarīrasthairyādimṛtyujayaprakārebhyo'yamanya evātivira (la1) 
mahāyogīndrahṛdayaṅgamastatprakāro yatra dehāvasthita eva 
śrīsvacchandabhairavatāṃ sarvadaiva samāviśati ko'pi (a)paścimajanmā 
jana iti || 226 || 

tatra yādṛkparaṃ tattvam, yathā ca tanmayībhāvastadādeṣṭumāha ----  


cintayet paramaṃ tattvaṃ kālacāravivajītam | 

kalākalaṅkanirmuktaṃ niṣkalaṃ paramaṃ padam || 7-227 || 


cintayet svābhedena vimṛśet, paraṃ tattvaṃ hṛddvādaśāntasphuritaṃ 
cidānandaghanātmakam, kālacāreṇa bāhyenāntareṇa ca vajītam, 
kalākalaṅkena kalpanāmalena śūnyam, ata eva 
catuṣkalavadakārādikalāyogābhāvād niṣkalam paramaṃ padamanuttaraṃ 
dhāma || 227 || 

na kevalaṃ paramaṃ dhāmedṛg yāvat ---- 


niṣkalaṃ cātmatattvaṃ tu..............


ātmatattvaṃ samanopari śuddhātma, niṣkalaṃ tyaktasamanāntabhedakalanam || 
yataḥ ---- 


...............kalaṅko deha ucyate | 

saṃyuktaḥ kāraṇaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ sarvatattvasamanvitaḥ || 7-228 || 

varṇo bindustathā nādo vyāpinīśaktisaṃyutaḥ | 

samanāvadhiparyantaḥ kalaṅkādhāra ucyate || 7-229 || 


etaduktaṃ bhavati ---- yathāyaṃ sthūlastattvādirūpo dehaḥ kalaṅkaḥ, 
tathā kāraṇāparabhairavarūpo hi paravyāptyāyamātmani | yathā 
sthūladṛṣṭyā deha prāṇādirasya kalaṅkastathā paradṛṣṭyā 
samanāntā prameyamālā kalaṅka eva | varṇaḥ akāra ukāro makāraśca | 
kalaṅkarūpaścāsāvādhāra iti samāsaḥ | kalaṅkatvaṃ cāsya sarvasya 
paraśivābhedāprathanāt || 229 || 

yasya cāyamādhāraḥ, saḥ ---- 


ādheyaḥ paramo hyātmā............


yaḥ pūrvaṃ śuddhavijñānakevalo bhedavādināṃ mokṣabhūrityuktaḥ | 
atha ---- 


...........ṭatparāpyunmanā smṛtā | 

asyāścānte paraṃ tattvaṃ sakalākalavajītam || 7-230 || 

vyāpakaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ sarvāntaḥ sarvatomukham | 

pañcapañcakatattvasthamaṣṭādaśaguṇānvitam || 7-231 || 


sakalaḥ samanāntaḥ sphāraḥ, akalaḥ śuddhātmā, tābhyāṃ vajītaṃ 
tayoḥ parasparāvacchedena saṃkucitatvāt tattu vyāpakaṃ 
dikkālāsaṃkucitam, sarvataśca bhadraṃ cidānandaghanam, sarvasya cāntaḥ 
jīvitabhūtatvena sthitam, pūrvāparamadhyakoṭimadhyagataṃ ca | sarvataḥ 
sarveṇa mukhamiva mukhaṃ svātmapratyabhijñopāyarūpam | pañcapañcakāni
tattvāni tathāṣṭādaśa guṇāṃśca svayameva vyākhyāsyati | 
pañcapañcakeṣu ca tattveṣu ca sthitaṃ tadabhinnamūttīṃ guṇeṣu 
cānvitam anugatatayā sthitam || 231 || 

taditthaṃbhūtametat ---- 


yadyasmiṃstu paraṃ vetti tadā mucyeta bandhanāt | 

"kalaṅko deha ucyate" (7-228) ityupakrāntatvādasmin 
dehaprāṇādāvevāvasthito yadyuktarūpaṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ vetti, tadā 
bandhanānmucyata eva, jīvanneva svānubhavena 
parabhairavatāmāviśatītyarthaḥ || 

atha pañcapañcakaṃ darśayati ---- 


kāraṇāni ca mantrāśca nivṛttyādyāḥ kalāstathā || 7-232 || 

binduścaivārdhacandraśca nirodhī nāda ūrdhvagaḥ | 

śaktiśca vyāpinī caiva samanātmā tathonmanā || 7-233 || 

pañcapañcakametaddhi kathitaṃ te varānane | 


kāraṇāni brahmādīni ṣaṭ | mantrā iti akārokāramakārā 
brahmaviṣṇurudravācakāstrayaḥ, 
bindunādaśaktīnāmīśasadāśivaśivavācikānāṃ 
sarvamantrasādhāraṇabindvādyunmanāntaprameyadaśakamadhye kathanāt | ato 
mantraśabdena sādhāraṇaprameyadaśakāvaśiṣṭā asādhāraṇāstraya eva 
uktāḥ | tathā vaktrāṅgamantraikādaśikāvargaścaturtha ityete daśa, 
brahmādikāraṇādhiṣṭhitāśca nivṛttyādyāḥ kalāḥ pañca prāg 
vyākṛtāḥ, tattvaṃ ca bindvādiprameyadaśakamityetatpañcapañcakam ||

śaktayaḥ | yato yatkiṃcit prakāśate viṣayaśarīrādi,

tatsambandhibhirvācyairākārainīrmuktamakārokārādivācakamantrakalā-
tadvācyarūpaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ || 

yuktaṃ caitat, yataḥ ---- 


akṣareṣu kuto mokṣa ākāśe kusumaṃ kutaḥ | 


atyantāsambhāvyametad yat sthānaprayatnāduccāryatvāt sopādhiṣu 
mantrāvayavarūpeṣu akṣareṣu uccaratsu

iti | kiṃ ca, akṣareṣu bhinneṣu bahuṣu muktātmasu iṣyamāṇeṣu kuto 
mokṣaḥ ---- 

"ta ātmopāsakāḥ" (4-392)

ityabhihitatvāt ||

ityādi || 239 || 

etad vyanakti ---- 


adhaścāre bhavet sṛṣṭirūrdhve saṃhāra ucyate | 

adhaścāreṇa jāto'sau ūrdhve caiva mṛto bhavet || 7-240 || 

sūtakaṃ mṛtakaṃ tyaktvā tiṣṭhed vai tattvavṛttitaḥ | 


adhaścāro'pānaḥ | ūrdhvacārastu prāṇaḥ | sṛṣṭisaṃhāra iti 
trividhasya dehapramātuḥ | asāviti dehapramātā | itthaṃ muhuḥ 
sūtakamṛtakāśaucamayaḥ | yadā tu dehapramātṛtābhimānaṃ praśamayya 
satyāṃ citpramātṛtāmavalambate, tadā 
dalakalpadehaprāṇādipadavartyapyayaṃ cidāmodasundarastattvavṛttisthita 
eveti kā mṛtakasūtakasambhāvanāpīti, itthametad vyākāryam, na tu 
prāṇāpānapraśamapade satatamavastheyamiti, yogināṃ 
vyutthānadaśāsambhavena tatra satatāvasthānāghaṭanāt,

"eteṣu tatparaṃ tattvamuccārālambanādṛte" (7 | 237)

ityuktena vakṣyamāṇena ca granthena virodhāpatteḥ | yadi cāmukhe 
prāṇātānapraśamapadanibhālanaṃ tattvavṛttyanubhave bhavatyupāyaḥ, 
tathāpi tadupāyapūrvaṃ sarvadā sarvāvasthāsu sarvatra 
cidānandaghanaparamaśivatāmayatvajñānameva tattvavṛttyavasthitatvam | 
yadvakṣyati ---- 

śarvaṃ śivamayaṃ smaret" (7-244) ityādi ||

nāstyupādhitvam, vyatirekābhāvāt | viśeṣeṇākhyātā tatra tatra 
śāstre

ataśca ---- 


tattvādhvadharmanirmuktaḥ kāraṇaiśca vivajītaḥ | 

tattvavṛttau sthito yogī sarvārambhavivajītaḥ || 7-242 || 

rāgadveṣavinirmukto viṣādānandavajītaḥ | 

nākāṅkṣenna ca nindettu viṣayāṃśca kadācana || 7-243 || 

samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca brāhmaṇe śvapace samaḥ | 

tulyadaśīṃ bhavennityaṃ sarvaṃ śivamayaṃ smaret || 7-244 || 


tattvādibhiḥ śarīrāvasthitairnāsyāhantāvacchidyata ityarthaḥ | ata eva 
cāyaṃ citsamāpannatvāt sarvairārambhairheyopādeyaviṣayābhiḥ 
pravṛttibhivīśeṣeṇābhiniveśātmanā vajītaḥ, 
yatastatpravṛttihetubhyāṃ rāgadveṣadoṣābhyāṃ rahitaḥ | 
tadrahitatvamapyasya viṣayasaṅgasampādyaviṣādānandavirahāt, ata evāsya 
ākāṅkṣādyabhāvo yathopanatamātrabhogātivāhakatvāt | nāsya 
śatrumitrabrāhmaṇaśvapaceṣu apakāryupakāriśuśrūṣāpavitratādidhīḥ 
|  tulyatvenāsau sarvaṃ paśyati kevalam, na tu lokamadhyastho lokasya 
sthitibhaṅgamutpādayet | idaṃ tvasya mukhyaṃ rūpaṃ yatsarvaṃ śivatvena 
cintayet |  yaduktaṃ śrīvijñānabhairave ----

tatra tatra śivāvasthā vyāpakatvāt kva yāsyati ||" (116)

iti | tathā ---- 

śarvaṃ dehaṃ cinmayaṃ hi jagadvā paribhāvayet |"

bhūdityāha ---- 

ātmānaṃ ca tathaivaivaṃ sarvathaiva sadā smaret | 

tathaivaivamiti viśvātmakaparamaśivaikyena ||

iti yadupakrāntam, tanmadhye 
nāḍitrayavāhanirūpaṇatadanyathāvāhādyutthāriṣṭajñānamṛtyujayādiba
huprameyavyavahitaṃ jātam | ata etadupasaṃharan prāguktamevānubadhnāti ---
- 


evaṃ vai mṛtyuliṅgāni riṣṭānyanyāni yāni ca || 7-261 || 

yogājjānāti yogīndro nādajāntargatāni ca | 

nijītyaitāni yogena evamuktakrameṇa tu || 7-262 || 


evamiti yathoktavāhaviparyayātmakāni yānyanyāni ca ---- 

"karṇarandhrakṛtāṅguṣṭho ghoṣaṃ na śṛṇute" (7-187)

ityādīni riṣṭāni nādajāntargatānyuktāni, "ca" śabdāt 
kāṇotpāṭādīni ca, tāni yogāt proktarūpāccārāvadhānādeva yogī 
jānāti, jñātvā ca haṃsadhyānāmṛtadhyānatattvavṛttyavasthānarūpeṇa 
paraparāparāparātmanā mṛtyujitā yogena nijītya punarapi 
nāḍīcārajayābhyāsādyogī vijānāti, jñātvā ca sarvajñatāṃ 
vrajediti sambandhaḥ || 262 || 

athedānīm ---- 


ayogī yāni jānāti ayukto vāpi suvrate | 

bahilīṅgāni tānyatra aṅgāriṣṭāni me śṛṇu || 7-263 || 


ayogītyaprāptayogaḥ | ayukta iti yogāyāghaṭamāno vā laukika evetyarthaḥ 
|| 263 || 

tānyāha ---- 


śuṣkatālvoṣṭhakaṇṭhaścedakasmāddhūsaracchaviḥ | 

skandhau ca bhaṅgamāyātaḥ ṣaṇmāsānmṛtyumāpnuyāt || 7-264 || 


akasmāditi prasiddhaṃ nimittaṃ vinā, etacca sarvatra yojyam || 264 || 


sunīlaṃ maṇḍalaṃ vyomni yaḥ paśyati dine dine | 

sitaṃ haritakṛṣṇaṃ ca vatsarārdhānmirayeta saḥ || 7-265 || 


akasmādityeva | maṇḍalamiti sūryabimbasya bāhyapariveśaḥ || 265 || 


viraśmi paśyati raviṃ somaṃ vai lakṣmavajītam | 

tārāṃ jyotsnāṃ ca kṛṣṇāṃ vai paśyet ṣaṇmāsajīvitaḥ || 7-266 || 


raviṃ maṇḍalāntasthaṃ bimbam || 266 || 


hiraṇyavarṇaṃ puruṣaṃ piṅgalaṃ kṛṣṇameva ca | 

svapne sampaśyate yo vai ṣaṇmāsān so'pi jīvati || 7-267 || 


akasmāt pittādiprakopābhāvāditi sthitameva || 267 || 


ātmano hyaśiraśchāyāṃ paśyet ṣaṇmāsajīvitaḥ | 


chāyāpuruṣaparīkṣāyāmityarthāt || 


tailābhyaṅgaṃ tathā pānaṃ raktasraganulepanam || 7-268 || 

raktāmbarāṇi kṛṣṇāni svapne paśyati vai yadā | 

pretaiḥ piśācai rakṣobhiḥ śvagomāyukasūkaraiḥ || 7-269 || 

vṛtaṃ yātaṃ gṛddhrakākairmahiṣairuṣṭragardabhaiḥ | 

aṅgabhakṣaṇamudvāhaṃ nagnaṃ cātīva vihvalam || 7-270 || 

svapne ca paśyate yo vai varṣamekaṃ sa jīvati | 


atra yathāyogamātmana ātmānamiti ca yojyam | gṛddhrādibhiryātamiti 
vāhanarūpairnīyamānam || 270 || 


śaṃkhāvarte bhujāmadhye gulphayormarmasandhiṣu || 7-271 || 

so'vaśyaṃ vadhamāyāti yasyaitat spandanaṃ nahi | 


śaṃkhāvarto lalāṭakapālasandhī netraprāntasthau | bhujāmadhyaṃ 
matsyasthānamiti prasiddham | marmasandhayo dhamanyādayaḥ sirāḥ || 271 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


somārkamaṇḍalaṃ dehe dhruvaṃ caiva tvarundhatīm || 7-272 || 

na paśyati mahāyānaṃ so'vaśyaṃ mirayate naraḥ | 


etāni prātilomyena vyācaṣṭe ---- 


tālurandhragato dhūmo mahāyānaṃ taducyate || 7-273 || 

jihvā tvarundhatītyuktā nāsāgraṃ dhruva ucyate | 


tālurandhraṃ brahmabilam, paścātkṛtasūryastadutthāṃ dhūmalekhāṃ 
chāyāyāṃ na paśyati | nāsāgraṃ tripuṭikāprāntaḥ || 273 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 

netrānte karajākrānte maṇḍalaṃ somasūryayoḥ || 7-274 || 


vāmadakṣiṇanetraprāntā yadā nakhena pīḍyante tadā jyotiryad dṛśyate, 
tatsomasūryayormaṇḍalam || 

tadetatsarvam ---- 


na paśyed gagane'pyetat so'vaśyaṃ mirayate naraḥ | 


ṛtukālādanantarameva bahiryānamākāśagaṅgāpathaḥ, arundhatī 
saptaṣīmadhyasthā, dhruvaścaturdaśatārārabdhaśarīraḥ, 
somasūryayormaṇḍalaṃ bimbabāhyapariveśaḥ || 


sthūlo'kasmācca jāyeta akasmādvai bhavet kṛśaḥ || 7-275 || 

atikruddho'tibhītaśca varṣamekaṃ sa jīvati | 


punaḥ svapnaviṣayamāha ---- 


kṛṣṇāmbaradharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ lohadaṇḍakarodyatam || 7-276 || 

naraṃ cābhimukhaṃ svapne dṛṣṭvā māsatrayāyuṣam | 


ātmānaṃ niścinuyāt || 276 || 


hṛdayaṃ śuṣyate yasya snātamātrasya tatkṣaṇāt || 7-277 || 

gātraṃ caivāpyanuṣṇaṃ ca ṛtumekaṃ sa jīvati | 

dhanunīśi divā colkā vyabhre vidyutpradarśanam || 7-278 || 

digdāho'pluṣṭadeśe'pi māsamekaṃ sa jīvati | 


dhanuraindram, apluṣṭadeśe'nyajanāparidṛśyadigdāhe'pi yasya digdāho 
bhāti, sa māsaṃ jīvati, dhanunīśi, divā colkādarśanam || 


cakṣuṣī sravato yasya śabdaṃ na śṛṇuyāt sphuṭam || 7-279 || 

nāghrāti gandhaṃ.........


āghrātīti eśaḥ pāṭhaḥ || 

yasya ca ---- 


.....vāgjāḍyaṃ......


akasmāditi sarvatra sambadhyate || 

tasya ---- 


...............ṃāsamekaṃ gatāyuṣaḥ | 


jīvitamiti sambandhaḥ || 

akasmādeva ca ---- 


raktapadmopamaṃ vaktraṃ jihvā kṛṣṇā ca yasya vai || 7-280 || 

gātre varṇānyanekāni hṛdayaṃ yasya (ca) roditi | 

tālukampo'tha nābheśca ardhamāsaṃ sa jīvati || 7-281 || 


roditi ninīmittaṃ punaḥ punaḥ svidyati, rodanamanubhavatītyanye || 281 || 

yaśca ---- 


pratyakṣakākanāsīro dīpadhūmaṃ na jighrati | 

pūrvadṛṣṭaṃ na jānāti caturmāsaṃ sa jīvati || 7-282 || 


asaṃnihitā api kākā nāsīrāḥ kaṅkāśca yena pratyakṣāḥ puro 
dṛśyante || 282 || 


binduṃ yastu na paśyettu nityaṃ vaktrānugaṃ hitam | 

nityaṃ vahati hikkāṃ tu varṣamekaṃ sa jīvati || 7-283 || 


ṣaḍaṅgakaraṇaṃ kṛtvāpi yo binduṃ na paśyati, vaktrānugaṃ 
bhrūmadhyastham, hikkāṃ hidhmām || 283 || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


bahilīṅgāni caitāni aṅgāriṣṭāni yāni ca | 


uktānīti śeṣaḥ || 

athaitāni ---- 

pūjayā japahomena dhyānadhāraṇayā priye || 7-284 || 

kṛtarakṣāvidhānena jīyante nātra saṃśayaḥ | 


pūjādidhāraṇāntaṃ bhagavadviṣayam, rakṣāvidhānaṃ vakṣyamāṇam || 
284 || 

taditthaṃ riṣṭapraśamanaṃ kṛtvā prakṛto yogābhyāsa eva kāryaḥ, sa ca 
nāḍiśuddhipūrvakaprāṇajayādeveti tatprakāśanāśayena śrīdevyuvāca -
--- 


nāḍīnāṃ śodhanaṃ caiva vāyūnāṃ ca jayaḥ katham || 7-285 || 


teṣāṃ prāgvibhaktānāṃ vāyūnām ---- 


sthānaṃ rūpaṃ ca śabdaṃ ca karma brūhi mama prabho | 


etatpraśnaṣaṭkaṃ niṇīnīṣuḥ śrībhairava uvāca ---- 


paramo yogasadbhāvo guhyād guhyataraḥ priye || 7-286 || 

yo na kasyacidākhyātastaṃ yogaṃ śṛṇu tattvataḥ | 


yattvayā praśnitam, tadyogarahasyaṃ tadvinā yogābhyāsāyogāt || 

tatra tāvat ---- 


supraśaste bhūpradeśe nāgnitoyasamīpataḥ || 7-287 || 

vālukāśarkarāhīne śuṣkavṛkṣavivajīte | 

niḥśabdakīṭavalmīke ītibhiḥ parivajīte || 7-288 || 

puṇye dhamīṣṭhasaṃvāse tatra yogaṃ samabhyaset | 


ītayaḥ ativṛṣṭyādayaḥ | puṇye sattīrthādiyukte | dhamīṣṭhasaṃvāse 
puṇyāśraye || 

tadāsau ---- 


devadevaṃ samabhyarcya bhairavaṃ savināyakam || 7-289 || 

pūrvācāryānnamaskṛtya yukto dhyānaparāyaṇaḥ | 


vighnapraśamanāya gaṇapatipūjāpūrvamājñāgrahaṇāya gurūn pūjayitvā, 
bhairavamabhyarcya dhyānaparāyaṇo yuktaḥ syāditi sambandhaḥ || 

kathamityāha ---- 


āsanaṃ svastikaṃ baddhvā padmakaṃ bhadrameva vā || 7-290 || 

sāpāśrayaṃ sārdhacandraṃ yogapaṭṭaṃ yathāsukham | 

dahanotpūyane kṛtvā plāvayedamṛtena ca || 7-291 || 

sabāhyābhyantareṇaiva sakalīkaraṇaṃ tataḥ | 

antaryāgaṃ yathāpūrvamuccāryaṃ ca paraṃ tathā || 7-292 || 

daśadhā yogamārgeṇa haṃsasvacchandamabhyaset | 


padmakamūrunyastottānapādatalaṃ padmāsanākhyam, paryaṅkasthasya 
jaṃghāvyatyāsāt svastikam, samapādasthityā bhadram, bhittyāśrayāt 
sāpāśrayametaccārdhacandraviśeṣaṇam 
bhūmiṣṭhaikacaraṇorupṛṣṭhanyastottānadvitīyacaraṇamardhacandram, 
yogārthaṃ paṭṭaparikarabandhāya baddhvā etadanyatamamāsanam, anyadapi vā 
yadyatsukhaṃ śarīraparikleśakṛnna bhavati | yathoktam ---- 

śthirasukhamāsanam" (pāta0 2-46) iti | 

tataḥ pūrvoktaṃ dahanādyuccārāntaṃ kṛtvā, daśadhā yogamārgeṇeti 
bāhyābhyantararecanādiṣaṭkapraśāntakumbhaka-pratyāhāra-dhāraṇā 
dhyānātmanā bhāvinā, atha ca bhāviprāṇādivāyudaśakajayapūrvaṃ 
pūrvoktaṃ haṃsasvacchandaṃ paraṃ niṣkalabhaṭṭārakamabhyasedanupraviśet 
|| 

tadanupraveśaṃ pūrvoktopāyānusāreṇa sphuṭayati ---- 


mantraṃ bindumatītaṃ tu nādāntajyotirākṛtim || 7-293 || 

saṅkalpya kalpanālakṣyaṃ dhyāyed vai tena sarvagam | 


(mantraṃ) catuṣkalanāthamakārādikaloccārapūrvaṃ bindumatītamiti 
tadullaṅghanād ardhacandranirodhikāpadamudghāṭya, nādanādāntakrameṇa 
jyotirākṛtimiti śakttyādiprakāśarūpam, saṅkalpya 
vikalpapūrvamavikalpenāsādya, kalpanābhiralakṣyaṃ 
svaprakāśacidānandaghanam, sarvagaṃ haṃsasvacchandaṃ dhyāyediti 
samanāntaṃ vilāpya akṛtakavimarśodayena samāviśet || 293 || 

tadetad nāḍiśuddhiprāṇajayapūrvakaṃ sughaṭaṃ syāt, ityāśayena 
nāḍijayaṃ tāvadāha ---- 


apasavyena pūryeta savyenaiva virecayet || 7-294 || 

nāḍīsaṃśodhanaṃ caitanmokṣamārgapathasya ca | 


savyena dakṣanāsāpathena, recayet recakaṃ kuryāt, apasavyena vāmena, 
pūryeta vāyupūraṇaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ | evamanavarataṃ 
kriyamāṇametannāḍīnāṃ mokṣamārgapathasya vā madhyadhāmnaḥ śodhanaṃ 
mārutapraśamanaṃ bhavati || 

prāṇajayaṃ vyaktumupakramate ---- 


recanāt pūraṇādrodhāt prāṇāyāmastridhā smṛtaḥ || 7-295 || 


prāṇasyāyamanaṃ yathāsthitavāhavijayena svāyattatānayanam || 295 || 


traya ete prāṇāyāmāḥ sarvasādhāraṇena nāsikāpathakrameṇa 
nirvartyamānāḥ sādhāraṇā bāhyāścetyāha ---- 


sāmānyā bahirete tu.............


etadabhyāsapūrvamantaḥprayujyamānaiḥ ---- 


..............punaścābhyantare trayaḥ | 


tānāha ---- 


ābhyantareṇa recyeta pūryetābhyantareṇa tu || 7-296 || 

niṣkampaṃ kumbhakaṃ kṛtvā kāryāścābhyantarāstrayaḥ | 


ābhyantareṇa madhyapathenātra recanaṃ dvādaśānte, pūraṇaṃ hṛdi, 
niṣkampaṃ kumbhakamiti nirāyāsaṃ praśāntakumbhakamityarthaḥ | kāryā 
iti nirvartanīyā bhavanti || 296 || 

atha ---- 


nābhyāṃ hṛdayasañcārānmanaścendriyagocarāt || 7-297 || 

prāṇāyāmaścaturthastu supraśānta iti śrutaḥ | 


niṣkampakumbhakānantaraṃ hṛdayasañcārād iti śanaiḥ 
śanairhṛdayādadhaḥ sañcārayuktyā prāṇaṃ nābhyāmeva niyamyetyarthāt, 
tathā mana indriyagocarāditi tatpratyāhārayuktyā nābhyāmeva niyamya, 
manoniyamapūrvakaṃ prāṇaṃ nābhau niyacchataḥ supraśāntaḥ prāṇāyāmo 
bhavati || 297 || 

tadittham ---- 


prāṇarodhe tu sampūrṇe nābhau nītvā samucchvasan || 298 || 


anantaram ---- 


śanaivīmocayedvāyuṃ vāmanāsāpuṭena tu | 


niruddhavāyuprakopāpahārāya || 

evaṃ cārajayāntaṃ prāṇāyāmapratyāhārāvabhidhāya, dhāraṇāṃ 
nirūpayati ---- 


vāyavī dhāraṇāṅguṣṭhe āgneyī nābhimadhyataḥ || 7-299 || 

māheyī kaṇṭhadeśe tu vāruṇī ghaṇṭikāśrayā | 

ākāśadhāraṇā mūdhnī sarvasiddhikarī smṛtā || 7-300 || 


pādadeśe tiryaggateḥ, nābhau jāṭharāgneḥ, kaṇṭhe sthitipade 
dharaṇyāḥ, ghaṇṭikāyāṃ rasasya, brahmarandhre ca vyomnaḥ 
sadbhāvāttathaiva dhāraṇā uktāḥ | atra codghāte 
dīkṣāprastāvanirṇītaṃ varṇamaṇḍalalāñchanākṣarātmakatvaṃ 
dhāraṇādhyeyam | tatra prathamaṃ kaṇṭhe pāthīkā dhāraṇāṃ baddhvā 
hṛdayāduddhātapañcakena pañcaguṇaṃ pāthīvaṃ tattvaṃ bhindyāt, 
tato'nenaiva krameṇa hṛdayādeva catubhīruddhātaiścaturguṇamaptattvam, 
tato hṛdayādeva nābhikṣetre tribhiruddhātaistriguṇamagnim, anantaraṃ 
hṛdayādeva dvābhyāṃ pādāṅguṣṭhagataṃ dviguṇaṃ vāyum, 
tato'pyaṅguṣṭhāt saṅkocayuktyā prāṇaśaktimūrdhvamudbodhya 
hṛdayādevaikodghātayuktyā śaravad brahmarandhrasthamekaguṇaṃ 
vyemagranthiṃ bhittvā, dvādaśāntasthasya sarvāḥ siddhayo bhavantīti 
vākyārthaḥ || 300 || 

tadetadāha ---- 


ekadvitricatuṣpañcasaṃkhyodghātaiḥ prasiddyati | 


udghātaṃ lakṣayati ---- 


saṃniruddhe tu vai prāṇe mūdhnī gatvā nivartate || 7-301 || 

sa udghāta iti prokto jñātavyo yogibhiḥ sadā | 


mūdhnī ityupalakṣaṇaparaṃ kaṇṭhādikṣetrāṇām | jñātavya iti 
tattatsthānānusāryanubhavātmako'yamityarthaṃḥ | ata eva 
pūrvamanubhavapradhāna evāsāvuktaḥ || 301 || 

atha prāṇāyāmādīnāṃ phalamādiśati ---- 


rāgadveṣau prahīyete prāṇāyāmaiḥ sudhāritaiḥ || 7-302 || 

dhāraṇābhirdahet pāpaṃ pratyāhāre'kṣasaṃyamaḥ | 


"pāpaṃ dahet" ityāvārakapṛthivyādigranthibhedāt 
śubhāśubhakarmabandhavicchedāt || 


atha yatprāṇādiviṣayaṃ praśnitam ---- śthānaṃ rūpaṃ ca śabdaṃ ca 
karma brūhi (7 | 286) iti, tatkrameṇa nirṇetumāha ---- 


hṛdagude nābhikaṇṭhe ca sarvasandhau tathaiva ca || 7-303 || 

prāṇādyāḥ saṃsthitā hyete...........


vyānāntāḥ pañcetyarthāt || 

eṣāṃ ca ---- 


........ṝūpaṃ śabdaṃ ca me śṛṇu | 


tatra ---- 


drutatāranibho rakta indragopakasaṃnibhaḥ || 304 || 

kṣīrābhaḥ sphaṭikābhaśca pañcānāṃ rūpalakṣaṇam | 


drutatāraṃ galitaṃ rūpyam || 304 || 


ghaṇṭākaṃsābdamadhuro gajanādo mahādhvaniḥ || 7-305 || 

prāṇādīnāṃ tu pañcānāmayaṃ śabda udāhṛtaḥ | 


kaṃsaṃ kāṃsyam, abdo meghaḥ, mahādhvaniḥ drutanadīghoṣopamaḥ || 305 || 

eṣāṃ karmādiśati, tatra ---- 


jalpitaṃ hasitaṃ gītaṃ nṛttaṃ yuddhagatiḥ kalāḥ || 7-306 || 

śilpaṃ ca sarvakarmāṇi prāṇasyaivaṃ viceṣṭitam | 


kalāścitrādyāḥ | sarvakarmāṇītyetānyeva || 306 || 



praveśayedannapānaṃ tanmalaṃ srāvayedadhaḥ || 7-307 || 

andhatvaṃ śrotrarogaṃ ca apānastu kariṣyati | 


"ca"śabdād grahaṇaghrāṇādi || 307 || 


aśitaṃ līḍhapītaṃ ca samānaḥ samatāṃ nayet || 7-308 || 


nāḍīṣu sañcārayet || 308 || 


kṣobho hikkā tathā chikkā udānasya viceṣṭitam | 


chikkā kṣutam || 


svedaśca romaharṣaśca śūlaṃ dāho'ṅgabhañjanam || 7-309 || 

vyānasyaitāni karmāṇi sparśaṃ caiva sa vindati | 


sa eva labhate || 309 || 

nāgādīnāṃ sthānānyādiśati ---- 


aṅguṣṭhajānuhṛdaye locane mūdhnī saṃsthitāḥ || 7-310 || 

nāgādyāḥ......


krameṇetyarthaḥ || 310 || 

sarveṣāmeṣāṃ śabalarūpatā śabalaśabdatā ca tulyetyāha ---- 


.....bahurūpaśca......


cakārād bahuśabdāḥ || 


.............karma tveṣāṃ nibodha me | 


tatrāvikṛtāvasthāyāṃ krameṇa ---- 


āhlādodvegajanakaḥ śoṣaṇastrāsanastathā || 7-311 || 

nāgaḥ kūrmaśca kṛkaro devadattaśca pañcamaḥ | 

atinidrākaraścānyo yojakaśca dhanañjayaḥ || 7-312 || 


atinidrā tandrā, yojako dehāntarasambandhakṛt || 312 || 

eṣāṃ vikṛtyavasthāyām ---- 


śvāsasaṅkocanacchedā ghurghurotkramaṇaṃ tathā | 

nāgādīnāṃ tu pañcānāṃ mṛtyukāle viceṣṭitam || 7-313 || 


utkramaṇam = dehaviśleṣaḥ || 313 || 

dhanañjayakūrmayovīśeṣastvayam yat ---- 


na caiva yāti cotkrāntau tanuṃ tyaktvā dhanañjayaḥ | 


kaṃcitkālaṃ śavaśarīraṃ na muñcati || 


ākuñcayati vai kūrmaḥ śoṣayecca kalevaram || 7-314 || 


ākuñcanaṃ saṃdhisaṅkocaḥ | śoṣastālvādisthāneṣu || 314 || 

tadevaṃ daśadhā sthitam ---- 


prāṇameva jayet pūrvaṃ jite prāṇe jitaṃ manaḥ | 

jite manasi śāntasya paraṃ tattvaṃ prakāśate || 7-315 || 


tatra ---- 


prāṇāpānaṃ gude dhyāyet prāṇasamānaṃ nābhitaḥ | 

prāṇodānaṃ tu kaṇṭhe tu prāṇavyānaṃ tu sarvagam || 7-316 || 


prāṇaśabdo'tra sāmānyaprāṇavācī apānādīnāṃ viśeṣarūpāṇāṃ 
sāmānādhikaraṇyena prayuktaḥ | yastu bahiḥprasaraṇātmā viśeṣarūpaḥ 
prāṇastaṃ pūrvoktadeśe hṛdi dhyāyet | 
yathoktavarṇaśabdādyātmānaścaite dhyātā vaśīkṛtā bhavanti || 316 || 

evameva ca ---- 


nāgādyāḥ prāṇasaṃyuktāḥ...........


sāmānyaprāṇasambaddhāḥ || 

etān yathoktarūpān pūrvokteṣu ---- 


..............ṣvasthāneṣu nirodhayet | 


tadetasya daśakasya yāvatā kālena nirodhājjitatā bhavati, tatkālaṃ 
vaktumāha ---- 


niruddhasya ca yaḥ kālastaṃ vakṣyāmi nibodha me || 7-317 || 

tālāt prabhṛti taṃ dhyāyedyāvat pañca śataṃ gatam | 

jito'nilo bhavatyeva saṃkrāntyutkrāntikarmaṇi || 7-318 || 


aṅgulyā jānubhramaṇāvadhikālastālaḥ | teṣāṃ yāvatpañcaśataṃ 
gacchati, tāvadyadi prāṇādīnāmavicalaṃ dhyānaṃ sidhyati, tadā te jitā 
bhavanti | tataśca paraśarīrasaṃkrāntau utkrāntau ca sāmarthyaṃ bhavati 
|| 318 || 

idaṃ ca tajjaye'bhijñānam ---- 


divyā kāntiḥ śubho gandhaḥ prajñā cāsya vivardhate | 

divyā dṛṣṭiśca śravaṇaṃ divyā vāk ca prajāyate || 7-319 || 

vāyuvadvicarellokān siddhān devāṃśca paśyati | 

manasā cintitāvāptiḥ pravarteta guṇāṣṭakam || 7-320 || 

sarvakāmasusampūrṇaṃḥ sarvadvandvavivajiṃtaḥ | 

saṃsārabandhanirmuktaḥ śivatulyaśca jāyate || 7-321 || 


guṇāṣṭakamaṇimādikam | tadiyatā granthena

"daśaghā yogamārgeṇa haṃsasvacchandamabhyaset" (7-293)

iti yadupakrāntamabhūttannirvāhitam || 321 || 

athedānīṃ sagarbhaprāṇīyadhāraṇābhiryogināṃ 
yogocitajāgradādyavasthā darśayan 
darśanāntaroktavedhasamāveśasvarūpajñānaṃ śikṣayati ---- 


prāṇāpānau tu saṃyojya hrasvakoṭisamanvitau | 

nābhyādhāre ca yogīndraḥ.........


yadā tiṣṭhet tadāsya ---- 


............ṣvedaḥ kampaśca jāyate || 7-322 || 


hṛdaye praśāntāśeṣataraṅgānāhataviśrāntyanantaraṃ yadā 
mantravṛddherunmiṣattā bhavati, tadā hṛdi sāmarasyāvasthitau 
prāṇāpānau hrasvakoṭyākārakalāvimarśanena yuktāvadhaḥ 
prasaraṇakrameṇa nābhau saṃyojya, proktakālaṃ tiṣṭhataḥ svedakampau 
bhavataḥ || 322 || 

athāsau ---- 


punareva tu hṛtsthau hi prāṇāpānau nirodhayet | 

dīrghakoṭisamāyogāt tatkṣaṇācca pated bhuvi || 7-323 || 


nābhipadaviśrāntyanantaramūrdhvamāruhya hṛtsthaṃ kṛtvā 
dīrghātmakamāntradvitīyakalāvimarśanaparo nirodhayet iti 
tatkāloccārasthāne kaṇṭhānte proktakālaṃ


tiṣṭhet, tadekāgratāprakarṣād bhuvi patet || 7-323 || 


tato'pi yadyasau ---- 


kaṇṭhasthaṃ ca tathaiveha prāṇameva nirodhayet | 

plutakoṭisamāyogāt svapnavṛttistato bhavet || 7-324 || 


ullāse satyapānapraśamāt prāṇamitīhoktaṃ, kālam plutakoṭiḥ, 
pūrvoktanītyā tālvantoccārī makārakalāvimarśaḥ | svapno'tra 
jijñāsitavastuprathanātmā yogyucitaḥ | evamādiśatā kampa-sveda-pātā 
yogijāgarā iti nirūpitaṃ bhavati || 324 || 

yadā tu ---- 


bhrūmadhye binduyogena prāṇarodhaṃ tu kārayet | 

suṣuptaṃ jāyate tatra kṣaṇāccaiva prabuddhyate || 7-325 || 


plutenaiva tāluno bheditatvānmāntravindukalāvyāptivimarśena bhrūmadhye 
proktakālaṃ tiṣṭhataḥ praśāntamanovṛttiḥ suṣuptāvasthā udeti, 
kṣaṇācca prabuddhyata iti na laukikavat tamovaraṇena abhibhūyate | 
taduktaṃ ---- 

"tadanyatra tu cinmayaḥ" (spa0 2 | 2)

iti || 325 || 

tato'pi ---- 


mūrdhadvāraṃ samāśritya niṣkalaṃ dhyānamārabhet | 

evamabhyasatastasya pratyayastu tadā bhavet || 7-326 || 

pipīlakaṇṭakāvedho mūrdhvadvāraṃ vibhindataḥ | 


niṣkalamiti varṇajyotirdhvanivyāptyullaṅghanāt sparśanānubhavarūpam, 
pipīlakaṇṭakāvedha iti sañcaratpipīlasparśatulyakaṇṭakasparśatulyaśca 
sparśa ityarthaḥ || 326 || 

kiṃ ca ----
