bhittvā krameṇa sarvāṇi unmanyantāni yāni tu || 327 || 

pūrvoktalakṣaṇairdevi.............


lakṣaṇairiti praṇavādhikāroktairanubhavairyujyate iti śeṣaḥ | 
tāvadantātra turyadaśā || 

athaitatsarvam ---- 


.......ṭyaktvā svacchandatāṃ vrajet | 


gāḍhagāḍhonmanāpadaviśrāntipadaprakarṣāt turyātītadaśālābhāt 
cidānandaghanaparabhairavasamāveśamanubhavati yogīndra ityarthaḥ ||  

na kevalaṃ dehottīrṇa eva pade'sya parasamāveśo ghaṭate, yāvat ---- 


jāyate unmanastvaṃ hi dehenānena sādhake || 7-328 || 


dehāvasthāyāṃ vyutthāne'pi sādhakasya 
samāveśaprakarṣāttadānandarasasaṃskārād ghūrṇamāṇataiva 
bhavatītyarthaḥ || 328 || 

kiṃ cāyaṃ svātantryaśaktyunmeṣāt ---- 


saṃkrāmet paradeheṣu kṣuttṛṣṇābhyāṃ na bādhyate | 

atītānāgataṃ caiva trailokye yat pravartate || 7-329 || 

pratyakṣaṃ tad bhavettasya sarvajñatvaṃ ca jāyate | 


yacca pravartate iti yadapi vartamānaṃ kiñcidasti, tadasya sarvaṃ 
pratyakṣībhavati | sarvajñatvam iti 
krameṇābhyāsaprakarṣānmantramantreśāditulyo bhavatītyarthaḥ || 329 || 

pāṭalikaṃ prameyamupasaṃharan paṭalāntareṇa saṅgatiṃ darśayati ---- 


prasaṅge'dhyātmakālasya jñānaṃ vijñānameva ca || 7-330 || 

sarvametat samākhyātamaṃśakāṃśca nibodha me | 


adhyātmakālakathanaprasaṅgena tattvavṛttyā jñānaṃ 
mṛtyujayayogijāgarāvasthādyātmakavedhādirūpaṃ ca 
vijñānametaduktamanuktamapyanujighṛkṣāveśāt, ataḥ ---- 

"kālāṃśakaṃ ca deveśa kathayasva prasādataḥ" (7-1)

iti yat praśnitam, tataḥ kālasvarūpaṃ kathitaṃ prasaṅgājjñānaṃ 
vijñānaṃ cāpyādiṣṭam | aṃśakasvarūpaṃ tu nirṇetumavaśiṣṭam | 
atoṃ'śakān bhāvipaṭalena nirṇeṣyamāṇannibodha jānīhīti pāṭalikī 
saṅgatiriti śivam || 330 || 

śaṃvitsphāravyāptyā viśvaṃ prāṇāntaḥsthaṃ samyagjñātvā | 

tāstāḥ siddhīraṃśajñaptyā pūrṇāsthitiṃ yāyāt ||" 


iti śrīsvacchandatantre 
śrīmahāmāheśvarācāryavaryaśrīkṣemarājaviracitoddyotākhyavyākhyopete 
kālādhikāraḥ nāma saptamaḥ paṭalaḥ || 7 || 




aṣṭamaḥ paṭalaḥ


" svacchandodyotaḥ "


yasya bodhamahāmbhodherbrahmādyā bhuvaneśvarāḥ | 

aṃśā mitā budbudavat taṃ stumaḥ parabhairavam || 

"aṃśakāṃśca nibodha me" (7 | 330)

iti yatpaṭalānte upakṣiptam, tadvibhaktuṃ śrībhairava uvāca ---- 


aṃśakaṃ ṣaḍvadhaṃ devi kathayāmyanupūrvaśaḥ | 


parasya bodhabhairavasya śaktibhirbrāhmabhyādibhiradhiṣṭhitā 
brahmādyāstathāvabhāsitā aṃśāḥ, tatastadanugrāhyā api tadaṃśā 
ityucyante | atoṃ'śānārādhyatvena sthitān kāyati, ayaṃ 
brahmāṃśo'yaṃ viṣṇvaṃśa ityādikrameṇa yo vakṣyamāṇo 
bhāvasvabhāvādiḥ, so'ṃśaka ityucyate | sa ca sādhakaṃ prati 
siddhyanukūlatvād alpāṃśo'ṃśaka ityabhidhīyate || 

tamuddiśati ---- 


bhāvāṃśakaḥ svabhāvāṃśaḥ puṣpapātāṃśa eva ca || 8-1 || 

mantrāṃśakaḥ smṛtaścānyastvaṃśakāpādanaṃ dvidhā | 


bhāvaḥ sahajastattadbhaktiyukta āśayaḥ | svabhāvastadanuguṇo vyāpāraḥ 
| yastu pūrvayuktyā baddhanetrasya puṣpapātānusāraṃ niścīyate, 
tanmantravācyadevatātmā anuṣṭhātum, sa mantrāṃśaḥ | 
aṃśakāpādanamaṃśasyānirūpitasyāpi mantrasya vīradravyādihomena 
sādhakadīkṣākrameṇa vā ārādhakaṃ prati kriyate, iti dvirūpamiti 
(ṣaḍaṃ)1śakāḥ || 

eṣāmādyasya lakṣaṇamāha ---- 


devānusmaraṇaṃ bhāvaḥ sahajaṃ taṃ vijānatā || 8-2 || 


adattānuṣṭhānasyāpi prāgjanmavāsanāparipākavaśāt 
tattanniyatadevatānusmaraṇaṃ yatsahajam, sa bhāvāṃśaḥ || 2 || 
dvitīyamāha ---- 


svabhāvaśca bhavecceṣṭā...........


proktabhāvānuguṇa evameva liṅgārcanādyātmā vyāpāraḥ || 

taṃ ca ---- 


................kathayāmyanupūrvaśaḥ | 

brahmāṃśo vedabhaktastu rudrāṃśaṃ ca nibodha me || 8-3 || 

rudrabhaktaḥ suśīlaśca śivaśāstrarataḥ sadā | 

viṣṇvaṃśo viṣṇubhaktaśca candrāṃśaḥ priyadarśanaḥ || 8-4 || 

sarvadevarataḥ śānto yakṣāṃśo dhanasaṃgrahī | 

lubdho gavītamṛṣṭāśī vātāṃśaścapalaḥ smṛtaḥ || 8-5 || 

sarpavisrambhagāmī syānnāgāṃśo dīrghaśāyyatha | 

dīrgharoṣaḥ pūtivaktro gurukṣīraruciḥ sadā || 8-6 || 

gāndharvo gāyano nityaṃ śivabhakto varānane | 

vidyādharāṃśakaḥ prāṇī daityāṃśo dveṣaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ || 8-7 || 

kāmāṃśo rūpavāṃścaiva subhago gaṇikāpriyaḥ | 

rakṣoṃśaḥ krūranistriṃśo devadveṣī dvijeṣu ca || 8-8 || 

piśācāṃśaśchalānveṣī vāsare bhīrukātaraḥ | 

agnyaṃśaḥ paruṣastīvra uṣṇādaḥ piṅgalastathā || 8-9 || 

savitraṃśaśca tejasvī pūrtadharmarataḥ sadā | 

iṣṭāni kurute nityaṃ dayāluḥ śivabhāvitaḥ || 8-10 || 


pūtivaktro durāmodalālāsyaḥ | vidyādharāṃśasya śivabhaktatvaṃ 
śivaśāstroktavidhānena guṭikāñjanādisiddhirasikatvam | krūro 
dāruṇahṛdayaḥ | nistriṃśo nirghṛṇavyāpāraḥ | paruṣo vācā | 
tīvraḥ karmaṇā | pūrtaṃ vāpīkūpādikaraṇam | iṣṭaṃ yajñaḥ | 
spaṣṭamanyat || 10 || 

ye ca yadaṃśāsteṣāmete brahmādayaḥ ---- 


svasiddheḥ phaladāḥ sarve svadhyānajapahomataḥ | 


yasya yāvadaiśvaryam, tāvadevāsāvārādhitaḥ sādhakebhyaḥ prayacchati | 
evaṃ cābhidadhadidamāha yat parimitāṃśasya tattatpadaprāpaka eva 
mantrodayā | sa ca (yaḥ)1 yeṣāṃ viśeṣataḥ śāstreṣu nāsti, teṣāṃ 
praṇava eva tannāmanamaskārayuktaḥ || 

yadā tu ---- 


"yo yatrābhilaṣed bhogān sa tatraiva niyojitaḥ | 

siddhibhāṅ mantrasāmarthyāt................... ||"

ityuktasthityā ihatyamantraiḥ kṛtadīkṣasya 
sādhakasyaitanmantrārādhanenārādhitāste devatāviśeṣāḥ tadā sarve 
bhairavarūpā eveti sarvasiddhisādhakā ityāha ---- 


bhairavāṅgasamālabdhāḥ sarve devā varānane || 8-11 || 

bhairavāstu smṛtāḥ sarve sarvasiddhiphalapradāḥ | 


bhairavāṅgasamālabdhā ityuktyedamāha ---- yeṣāṃ 
kapālīśādimantrāṇāṃ vaktrāṇi noktāni, 
teṣāmārādhakairnaiṣkalavaktrāṅgāni prayoktavyāni |  kaścidatra 
sarvaśabdasya dviḥsthitasya vākyadvayaviṣayāṃ yojanāmasahamānaḥ 
sarvedevā ityatra sarvadaiveti sarvasiddhiphalapradā ityatra ca 
sarvakāmasamanvitā iti paṭhitvā etanmantradīkṣitāḥ 
sādhakāstadārādhanād bhairavā eva pūrṇasiddhibhājanaṃ bhavantīti 
vyākhyātavān | purāṇapustakeṣu tvavigānenādyaḥ pāṭho dṛśyate || 

evam ---- 


svabhāvāṃśaḥ samākhyātaḥ sādhakānāṃ hitāya vai || 8-12 || 


sādhakapadena mumukṣūṇāṃ nāyaṃ niyama ityādiśati || 12 || 

puṣpapātāṃśaṃ lakṣayati ---- 


puṣpapātavaśānnāma kartavyaṃ surasundari | 


aniścitabhāvasvabhāvāṃśasya bubhukṣorbaddhanetrasya pūjitasarvāvaraṇe 
bhagavanmaṇḍale pūrvoktasthityā ekaṃ puṣpaṃ kṣipato yatra tatpatet, 
tanmantravācyadevatānusāreṇa nāma kāryam || 

ataśca jñātāṃśakenācāryeṇopadiṣṭatattattvasya ---- 


sa mantraḥ siddhyate tasya tamevārādhayed yadi || 8-13 || 


śāstroktavidhānenetyarthāt || 13 || 

kramaprāptaṃ mantrāṃśakamadhikavaktavyatvāt sampratyanuktvā, 
aṃśakāpādanaṃ prastauti ---- 


aṃśakāpādanaṃ devi kathayāmi samāsataḥ | 


kathamityāha ---- 


vaihāyasaṃ dhvajaṃ caiva homayed yastu sādhakaḥ || 8-14 || 

sa mantraḥ siddhyate tasya aryanto'pi hi suvrate | 


vakṣyamāṇasthityāryanto'pi yo mantrastadārādhanāyaiva vaihāyasamiti 
udbaddhanaramāṃsam, dhvajaṃ ca śūlāropitanaramāṃsamaṣṭottaraśataṃ 
sahasraṃ vā yathāsambhavavyavasāyaṃ yaḥ sādhaka ityārādhaka 
ācāryastatprayukto'nyo'pi vā sādhako homayed juhuyāt, 
tasyāsāvevamārādhitaḥ siddhyati sādhanānuguṇo bhavati || 

yasya tu proktakrameṇāvivecitāṃśako'pi prabhāvātiśayaśravaṇāt 
kaścinmantra ārirādhayiṣito bhavati, na ca vīradravyakrame yogyatāsti, 
tasyārirādhayiṣitaṃ pūjahomādinādau tarpayitvā 
prākproktasādhakadīkṣābhiṣekavidhānenaiva tanmantrāṃśakatvāpādanaṃ 
kartavyamityabhidadhad dvitīyamaṃśakāpādanaṃ lakṣayati ---- 


anaṃśako'pi yo mantro jñātacihnairvarānane || 8-15 || 

tadā yāgaṃ purā kṛtvā agnau homaṃ tu kārayet | 


proktaprakārairna paricchinna aṃśaka ārādhakaḥ śiṣyo 
yasyāsāvanaṃśakaḥ | yāgahomau taṃ śiṣyaṃ prati tasya 
mantrasyābhimukhīkaraṇāya || 

tataḥ ---- 


śiṣyasya pūrvavat karma kṛtvā tu vidhipūrvakam || 8-16 || 

pūrṇāhutiprayogeṇa yojayecchāśvate pade | 


karmeti bhagavadarcādipūrvaṃ sādhakābhiṣekāntam | yojayediti tameva 
śiṣyaṃ mantreṇa saha śāśvata iti paramaśivapade, sādhakābhimate ca 
śāśvatabhogaprade sadāśivādidhāmni | śāśvatapadayojanādeva 
cāyamāsāditavīryo'naṃśakatāmutsṛjya, sadaṃśakatvameti || 

itthamāsāditāṃśako'sau ---- 


paratattvamabhidhyāyan sādhayenmanasepsitam || 8-17 || 


evamaṃśakāpādanaṃ dvidhoktvā mantrāṃśakamāha ---- 

mantrāṃśaṃ gaṇayitvā tu gṛhṇīyāt suvicāritam | 


mantrarūpamaṃśamakṣarabhedakrameṇāṃśīkṛtaṃ mantram || 

sādhakasya cānurūpāṃśakarūpatvādapyaṃśena ---- 


hīnamadhyasamutkṛṣṭaṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ || 8-18 || 


tatra ---- 


hīnaṃ śatruṃ vijānīyānmadhyamaṃ sādhyarūpiṇam | 

siddhaṃ caiva susiddhaṃ ca uttamaṃ parikītītam || 8-19 || 


katham ? ---- ityāha ---- 


mantrākṣaraṃ tu viśleṣya mātrābindusamanvitam | 

ātmanāmākṣaraṃ tadvadadhobhāge'sya yojayet || 8-20 || 


"oṃ śivāya namaḥ" ityādike mantre oṃkārādi mantrākṣaraṃ 
mātrābhirakārokārādibhibīndunā ca samanvitaṃ 
viśleṣyetyakārokārādimātrābinduṃ ca makāramātrākalpanayā'sya 
pṛthakkṛtya, evaṃ śikāravākārābhyāmikāramākāraṃ ca viśleṣayet | 
akāramātrā tūccāraṇārtham, na kutaścidviśleṣayet pratyuta yato 
varṇānmantrāntaraṃ viśleṣitam tasyākāramuccāraṇārthaṃ kalpayet, 
anyathā uccārāyogāt | evamātmanaḥ śiṣyasambandhi yannāma 
viṣṇumitramityādikam, tata ekaikamakṣaraṃ tadvat proktamātrābhedena 
viśleṣya, asyeti vibhaktamantrasyādhobhāge yojayet | tena aumaśaivāayanama 
iti daśānāmakṣarāṇāmadhovibhaktāni viṣṇumitranāmākṣarāṇi dadyāt 
| yatra mantrākṣarāṇi bahūni bhavanti, tatra nāmākṣarāṇi punaḥ 
punaryojayedāmantrākṣarasamāptiṃ yojayet || 20 || 

evaṃ sthite sati ---- 


ātmavarṇāt samārabhya yāvanmantrārṇamāgatam | 

yasmin sa nipated devi tamāyaṃ parikalpayet || 7-21 || 


śiṣyanāmākṣaramekaikamavadhiṃ kṛtvā mātṛkāvarṇapāṭhakrameṇa 
gaṇanayā ekaikanāmākṣarordhvastha ekaiko mantravarṇo yāvadāgacchati,
tāvadvakṣyamāṇena siddhasādhyasusiddhāribhedagaṇanena yatraitadanyatame 
sa nāmavarṇo nipatet saṃyujyeta, tamāyamiti śubhāśubhasūcakaṃ 
niścinuyāt | yathoktaṃ mayasaṃgrahe ---- 

"āyāntīṣṭetarārthāya bhavantyāyāstata" iti || 21 || 

atra gaṇanopāyapradarśanapūrvamāyasvarūpamādiśati ---- 


rekhāṃguligataṃ taṃ tu kathayāmi samāsataḥ | 


rekhopalakṣitāṃgulīgatamaṃgulirekhāsu kathitaṃ tamāyam || 

sa ca ---- 


parvaṇi prathame siddhaḥ sādhyaścaiva dvitīyake || 8-22 || 

tṛtīye tu susiddhaḥ syādarirjñeyaścaturthake | 


anena krameṇa nāmākṣarāṇi mantrākṣaraprāptiṃ yāvad gaṇayitvā āyaṃ 
parīkṣeta || 

tatra ---- 


arisādhyau parityajya dātavyaścumbakena tu || 8-23 || 

siddharūpaḥ susiddhaśca bhuktimuktiphalaprada,h1 | 


arisādhyorādyantasthitayorbahalayorvā parityāgaḥ, siddhasusiddhayostu 
svīkāraḥ, krameṇa bhuktimuktipradatvāt | yathoktam ---- 


śiddhānte sidhyate'vaśyaṃ sādhyānte kṛcchrasādhanaḥ | 

susiddhaḥ pūrvasiddhastu aryanto na prasidhyati ||" iti | 

tathā ---- 

"evaṃ śuddhau kṛtāyāṃ tu susiddho'bhyadhiko yadi | 

siddhau na labhyate grāhyamūtīḥ sādhye'pi sādhakaḥ ||" iti | 


śuddhau kṛtāyāmityaṃśakaviṣaye niścitāyāṃ sādhye'pyadhike 
triścaturvā āyāte sati mantramūtīrārādhyatvena grahītavyā, 
ityatrārthaḥ | iyaṃ cāṃśakaparīkṣā ekākṣaramālāmantrayorna 
kartavyā | yathoktam ---- 

"ekākṣareṣu kūṭeṣu mālāmantreṣu bhāmini | 

aṃśakaṃ na parīkṣeta parīkṣetānyamantragam ||"

iti, kūṭeṣvadvaitatattveṣu | ata eva ---- 

"māyāṃ1 netre ca deveśi tathā dvātriṃśadakṣare | 

na ca tatrāriśaṅkā syāt.................. ||"

ityapyanyatroktam || 

taditthaṃvicārāt ---- 


yasṃtvaṃśakāviśuddhaḥ syād bhairavo'tra varānane || 8-24 || 

taṃ madhyamasthaṃ sampūjya tatsthāne madhyamaṃ nyaset | 

ya iti kapālīśādyanyatamaḥ | madhyamasthamiti, ārādhanāyāṃ 
pradhānībhūtatvāt | tatsthāna iti tasyāvaraṇakakṣyāsthasya 
kapālīśādeḥ pade | madhyamamiti śrīsvacchandamayaṃ turyādirūpatayā 
parīkṣyeti daśītam || 

atha kathaṃ śrīsvacchandanāthasya parivāraṃ prati parivāratayā nyāsaḥ 
? ---- ityāśaṅkāṃ śamayitumāha ---- 


yataḥ sarvagato devaḥ sarveṣvantargataḥ smṛtaḥ || 8-25 || 

tatsiddhimuktidātāsau na varṇāḥ paramārthataḥ | 


yaḥ sarvagato vyāpako devaḥ krīḍādiśīlaścidānandaghanaḥ 
śrīsvacchandabhaṭṭārakaḥ sarveṣu kapālīśādiṣu 
prapañcavyāptyāvasthiteṣvantargataḥ paramārtharūpo yataḥ, tattasmāt sa 
eva tattatkapālīśādyātmanā smṛtaḥ, sādhakasyāṃśakaśuddhyā 
siddhimabhedavyāptyā ca muktiṃ dadāti paramārthataḥ, na tu 
vyāptijñānaśūnyā varṇāḥ kiṃcit kurvanti | uktaṃ hi prāk ---- 

"akṣareṣu kuto mokṣaḥ" (7-238) iti | 

tena svasyāvaraṇabhedasyānyathākalpane'pi na tattvabhūmeḥ kācinmlāniḥ 
|| 

tadidamaṃśakavicārānte prasaṅgāyātaṃ vastu ---- 


kathitaṃ sarahasyaṃ te guhyād guhyataraṃ param || 8-26 || 


atha yat kathitamityuktam, tatpramāṇīkartuṃ paramaśivāt prabhṛti 
gurupāramparyeṇedaṃ rahasyaṃ tantramavatīrṇamiti darśayan parādi 
divyāntaṃ sambandhaṣaṭkaṃ pradarśayati ---- 


atastantrāvatārārthaṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ | 


tatra ---- 


adṛṣṭavigrahāyātaṃ śivāt paramakāraṇāt || 8-27 || 

dhvanirūpaṃ susūkṣmaṃ tu suśuddhaṃ suprabhānvitam | 

tadevāpararūpeṇa śivena paramātmanā || 8-28 || 

mantrasiṃhāsanasthena pañcamantramahātmanā | 

puruṣārthaṃ vicāryāśu sādhanāni pṛthak pṛthak || 8-29 || 

laukikādiśivāntāni parāparavibhūtaye | 

tadanugrahayogyānāṃ sve sve viṣayagocare || 8-30 || 

anuṣṭupchandasā''baddhaṃ koṭyarbudasahasradhā | 


śivāt paramādvayaprathātmakaśreyorūpāt, paramakāraṇāt śivāntānāṃ 
kāraṇānāṃ sarveṣāṃ svabhittāvābhāsakāt, ata evādṛṣṭaḥ 
paradraṣṭerakarūpo vigrahaḥ svarūpaṃ yasya tasmāt | bhinnametatpadaṃ 
chāndasena pañcamyātvādeśena | atha ca tasmiṃstadrūpamevāyātaṃ 
prasaraṇasphuraṇaṃ yasya tad dhvanirūpaṃ nādāmarśātmakaṃ 
susūkṣmamaprameyaṃ viśvavyāpakaṃ ca, akārādikalākalitatvābhāvāt 
suśuddham, suprabhānvitaṃ mahājñānarūpaṃ 
yattadevāpararūpeṇetyanāśritabhaṭṭārakākhyena śivena 
daṇḍavaktrabhaṃgyavasthitasadyojātapañcamahāmantraśarīre pṛthak 
pṛthaganugrāhyānusāraṃ sādhanānyanuṣṭhānāni laukikādiśivāntāni 
vicārya tattartāsaddhisādhanārthamapararūpeṇaiva sthūlena 
vedādirahasyāntatattatsrotobhedodbhūtanānāśāstrarūpamanantagranthasadarb
hātmakaṃ nibaddham | mantrasiṃhāsanasthena 
sārdhatrikoṭimantrādhipatinetyenenaiva śāstrānantyasyāvakāśo dattaḥ | 
pañcamantramahātmanetyanena śrīkaṇṭhīyasaṃhitādyuktanānāsrotobhedaḥ 
sūcitaḥ | tatra ---- 

"adṛṣṭavigrahācchāntācchivāt paramakāraṇāt | 

jñānarūpaṃ viniṣkrāntamanavaccha(bda)1 mahat ||"

ityādinā nādasvarūpaṃ nirūpya ---- 

"tato jātamidaṃ sarvaṃ caturvargaphalapradam ||"

ityuktvā srotobhedena nānāśāstraprapañcodayaḥ pradaśītaḥ | 
tadevetyādinā ābaddhamityantena tattadanugrāhyāśayānusāreṇa 
bhinnabhinnaphalānyapi śāstrāṇi vastuto vākyaikavākyatayā 
paripūrṇābhinnavimarśasphārāṇyāsūtritasamastabhedābhedaprapañcānīti 
tathāvidhavyāptijñaṃ tatvajñaṃ 
pratyabhinnacidānandaghanatattvaviśrāntiparamārthānyeveti dhvanati | 
taduktam ---- 

"yataḥ śivodbhavaṃ sarvaṃ śivadhāmaphalapradam |" 

iti || 

evaṃ parasambandhamūlatāṃ śāstraprasarasya pradarśya, 
sambandhāntaragocaratāmapi pradarśayiṣyāmītyāśayena 
paramaśivenāpītthamidamutthāpyata ityāha ---- 


guruśiṣyapade sthitvā svayaṃ devaḥ sadāśivaḥ || 7-31 || 

pūrvottarapadairvākyaistantramādhārabhedataḥ | 

tajjñānamīśvare'dāt tadīśvareṇa śivecchayā || 7-32 || 

vidyāyāḥ kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ vidyeśebhyastathādarāt | 


devaḥ paravākśaktimayaḥ śivabhaṭṭāraka eva | sadāśiva iti 
gṛhītatattadbhūmikaḥ |  svayaṃ guruśiṣyapade sthitveti pratibhābhuvi 
praṣṭṛprativaktṛbhāvāsūtraṇena 
paramamahāpaśyantīvākśaktyāsūtritapūrvottarapadātmakairvākyairupa-
lakṣitaṃ tantramaśeṣaśāstrasandarbhamayaṃ tajjñānaṃ ceśvare'dāditi 
saṃkramitavān | ādhārabhedata iti īśvarātmakamādhārabhedamāśritya 
svayaṃ tadātmanā sthitvā ityarthaḥ | tajjñānamīśvare dattamiti tu 
pāṭhaḥ pūrvaślokānta āsūtryeti yojayitvā tena cetyanuṣaṅgeṇa 
vyākhyeyaḥ | iyatā mahatsambandho daśītaḥ | śivecchayā 
sadāśivecchayā, ityanenānāyātaśaktipāto nopadeśya iti dhvanati | 
vidyāyā iti ---- 

"aṣṭavargavibhinnā ca vidyā sā (mātṛkaiva tu)" (10-1144)

iti vakṣyamāṇamātṛkāvācyāyā devyāstathā vedanapradhānatvād 
vidyāśabdavācyasyāśeṣasya mantragrāmasya, anantabhaṭṭārakādibhyaśca 
vidyeśebhyo mantracakravatībhya īśvareṇa tantraṃ tajjñānaṃ ca kathitaṃ 
saṃkramaṇayuktyā vimarśapadaṃ nītam | ādarāditi bhaktyullāsaprakarṣāt 
| yadyapi bhagavato mātṛkā tadutthāśca mantrāḥ 
parameśavadabhedenāvabhāsitā vidyātattvadhāmni 
tāvadaśeṣaviśvābhedavyāptiratra nimagneva sthiteti 
tāmunmajjayitumīśvareṇa viśvānujighṛkṣayā jñānasaṃkrāntiratra 
kartṛmupapannaiva | itaḥ prabhṛtyantarālasambandhaḥ āsūtritaḥ ---- 

"mayāpi tava deveśi sādhikāraṃ samapītam" (8-36)

ityetāvatparyanto bhaviṣyati || 

evaṃ paśyantīprasaraṇaparyantāṃ śāstrasthitimuktvā, 
madhyamāprasaraṇenāha ---- 


māyāniyatiparyantaistasmādrudrairavāpi tat || 8-33 || 


tasmāditi vidyātattvacakravatīno'nantabhaṭṭārakādityarthāt | 
māyāniyati paryantairiti maṇḍalaprabhṛtibhiḥ kañcukavāsibhiśca 
rudrairavāpīti saṃkramaṇayuktyaiva || 33 || 

tato'nantaraṃ tadeva jñānaṃ tathaiva ---- 


śrīkaṇṭheneśvarāt prāptaṃ jñānaṃ paramadurlabham | 


ahaṃ hi bhagavānīśvarātmanaḥ śivasya śiṣyaḥ 
maṇḍalyādyāstvanantaśiṣyāḥ | atra madhye puṃstattvādhiṣṭhātāro 
rudrā bandhahetutayā sthāpitā iti teṣāmetajjñānaśaktisaṃkrāntirna 
kṛtā || 

tato'pi tathaiva ---- 


tenāpi tadadhaḥ proktaṃ rudrāṇāmīśvarecchayā || 8-34 || 

pradhānācchatarudrāntaṃ dīkṣayitvā vidhānataḥ | 

mamāpi ca purā dīkṣā tathā caivābhiṣecanam || 8-35 || 

śrīkaṇṭhena purā dattaṃ tantraṃ sarvārthasādhakam | 


yadyapi guṇatattve śrīkaṇṭhanāthaḥ sthitaḥ, tathāpyasau 
śivaśiṣyatvena prabhāvātiśayavāniti svordhvasthaprakṛtivatīnaḥ 
krodhādyaṣṭasya svādhāratattvagatānāṃ ca śatarudrāntānāṃ 
rudrāṇāmanugrahītā | mamāpīti kailāsavāsinastantrapravakturbhagavata 
umāpateruktiḥ | taditthamanantādyāḥ 
śrīkaṇṭhaśceśvarabhaṭṭārakātmanaḥ śivasya śiṣyāḥ, 
maṇḍalinastvanantaśiṣyāḥ, krodhādayaḥ śatarudrāntā umāpatiśca 
śrīkaṇṭhaśiṣyā ityādiṣṭaṃ bhagavatā | tena yat kheṭakanandanena ---
- 

"maṇḍalinaḥ śrīkaṇṭhaḥ krodhādyāḥ śatabhavā savīreśāḥ | 

ete kalādiyogāt prakaṭīkṛtadṛkkriyāḥ pareśena ||" (taṣaṃ. 30)

ityuktam, tadyathoktānusāraṃ kvacit sākṣāt kvacit pāramparyeṇeti 
vyākhyeyam, natvaviśeṣeṇa | dīkṣayitveti, abhiṣecanaṃ kṛtveti ca 
śāktasamāveśasaṃkramaṇayuktyā pūrvaṃ śāṃbhavasamāveśayuktyaiva | 
evaṃ ca nādīkṣitasya jñānagrahaṇe, nāpyanabhiṣiktasya 
taddāne'dhikāra ityādiṣṭaṃ bhavati || 

athaitattantraṃ ca tajjñānaṃ ca saṃkramaṇayuktyaiva ---- 


mayāpi tava deveśi sādhikāraṃ samapītam || 8-36 || 


itaḥ prabhṛti vaikharyāḥ prasaraḥ || 36 || 

evamiyatāntarālākhyaṃ sambandhaṃ prakaṭīkṛtya, divyāntamādiśati ---- 


tvamapi skandarudrebhyo dadasva vidhipūrvakam | 

brahmaviṣṇvandradevānāṃ vasumātṛdivākṛtām || 8-37 || 

loke saṃgṛhya nāgānāṃ yakṣāṇāṃ parameśvari | 


vidhirdīkṣābhiṣekarūpaḥ || 

divyādivyasambandhamāha ---- 


kathayasva ṛṣīṇāṃ ca............


evaṃ ca devyā viśvānugrahādhikārārpaṇena bhagavatā mahākāruṇikatvaṃ 
paripoṣitam || 

adivyaṃ sambandhamāha ---- 


...........ṝṣibhyo manujeṣvapi || 8-38 || 


kathayasveti sthitam | devī eva hi parāśaktisvabhāvā viśvādhiṣṭhātrī 
anujighṛkṣārasasarasahṛdayā tattadācāryadehamāviśyānugrahaṃ karoti | 
evaṃ cādivyasambandhaparyantaḥ para eva sambandhaḥ sarvatra prapatatīṃ
tyabhihitaṃ bhavati | taduktam ---- 

"...........................ṣarvaḥ parakalāmayaḥ | 

mahānavāntaro divyo miśro'divyaśca tatparaḥ ||"

iti trikahṛdaye || 38 || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


evaṃ tantravaraṃ divyaṃ siddharatnakaraṇḍakam | 

tvayā guptataraṃ kāryaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit || 8-39 || 


yadyapi pūrvokte sarvatantre tavādhikāro dattastathāpi yadevaṃ 
nirṇītanirṇeṣyamāṇapaṭalagatarahasyārthapūrṇatvād 
varamutkṛṣṭamidaṃ dakṣiṇasrotaḥsamudbhūtabhairavatantrajātamadhye 
pradhānabhūtaṃ divyaṃ sarvabhogāpavargapradaṃ tantraṃ tattvayā 
gūhanīyaṃ jyeṣṭhāśaktipātavatāmeva prakāśyaṃ netareṣāmiti śivam 
|| 39 || 

ā devebhyaḥ kramāntaṃ nikhilamidamiyacchāsanatrāṇarūpaṃ
	viśvaṃ yatsamprasūtaṃ paramaśivapadāllokaparyantametat | 

śāstraṃ vākyaikavākyasthitamiva vigaladbhedaviśrāntilabdha
svacchasvacchandadhāmaprathanaparamidaṃ stātsamagrasya jantoḥ || || 

iti śrīsvacchandatantre 
śrīmahāmāheśvarācāryavaryaśrīkṣemarājaviracitoddyotākhyavyākhyopete 
aṃśakādhikāraḥ nāma aṣṭamaḥ paṭalaḥ || 8 || 




navamaḥ paṭalaḥ


" svacchandodyotaḥ "

śrīmanniṣkalasadbhittāvuṭṭaṅkya sakalasthitim | 

viśrāmyatyakale tattve yastaṃ bhairavamāśraye || 

sādhakoddeśenārādhyapañcapraṇavanirūpaṇānantaraṃ 
tadupayogibahuprameyagarbhaṃ kālasvarūpamabhidhāyāṃśakasatattvamuktam | 
prasaṅgāt tantrāvatāro daśītaḥ | atha vighnaughavighātena 
jhaṭityabhīṣṭasiddhisādhanaṃ śrīkoṭarākṣavidhānaṃ 
rakṣācakraprapañcamapraśnitamapyanujighṛkṣayā pratipipādayiṣuḥ 
śrībhairava uvāca ---- 


ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi rahasyamidamuttamam | 


ataḥ śabdo vyākhyātakramasūcanāya | prakarṣeṇa anujighṛkṣādareṇa 
vakṣyāmi | uttamaṃ rahasyamiti sarvavighnapraśamanaṃ 
jhaṭityabhīṣṭasiddhipradaṃ ca || 

ata eva ---- 


yanna kasyacidākhyātaṃ tatte vakṣyāmi suvrate || 9-1 || 


śobhanaṃ vrataṃ paratattvāvahitatvaṃ yasyā ityāmantraṇena  
yogyatamaviralaśiṣyaviṣayatvamasyānuṣṭhānasyeti dhvanati | ataśca 
yogyadevīvyatirekeṇa naitadanyasyāpyuktam || 1 || 

etadudghāṭayati ---- 


mahābhairavadevasya krīḍamānasya bhāmini | 

sṛṣṭisaṃhārakartāraṃ hṛdayāttu vinirgataḥ || 9-2 || 


mahābhairavadevaḥ prathamapaṭaladaśītanirvacanasthityā svacchandanāthaḥ, 
tasya niḥśeṣavighnapraśamanasarvasiddhisampādanānujighṛkṣātmikāṃ 
krīḍāṃ tācchīlyena kurva(to)1, svasvātantryaśaktyātmakād hṛdayāt, 
sṛṣṭisaṃhārayoḥ kartā vakṣyamāṇaśrīkoṭarākṣanāmā devaḥ, araṃ 
śīghram, vinirgataḥ samucchalita ityarthaḥ | ata eva bhagavānaghorahṛdaya 
ityucyate || 2 || 

taṃ bhagavantaṃ darśayitumāha ---- 


kalpāntavahnivapuṣaṃ pralayāmbudaniḥsvanam | 

taḍitpuñjanibhoddanṣṭraṃ jaṭājvālāsamaprabham || 9-3 || 

candrasūryāgninayanaṃ koṭarākṣaṃ subhīṣaṇam | 

bṛhadvakṣaḥsthalābhogaṃ nāgayajñopavītinam || 9-4 || 

sphuranmāṇikyamukuṭaṃ sarpakuṇḍalabhūṣitam | 

sarpahārakṛtāṭopaṃ sarpakaṅkaṇanūpuram || 9-5 || 

siṃhacarmaparīdhānaṃ sarpamekhalamaṇḍitam | 

gajacarmāvṛtapaṭaṃ śaśāṅkakṛtaśekharam || 9-6 || 

pañcavaktraṃ śavārūḍhaṃ daśabāhuṃ trilocanam | 

kapālamālābharaṇaṃ khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇam || 9-7 || 

pāśāṅkuśadharaṃ devaṃ śaraśārṅgāvatānitam | 

kapālakhaṭvāṅgadharaṃ varadābhayapāṇikam || 9-8 || 

bhinnāñjanacayaprakhyaṃ sphuritādharabhāsvaram | 

brahmendraviṣṇunamitaṃ tridaśairapi durlabham || 9-9 || 


sarvametat prāguktavyākhyābhirvyākhyātasatattvam | taḍitpuñjanibhe udgate 
danṣṭre yasya, jaṭānāṃ jvālānāṃ cāsamā prabhā dīptiryasya, 
koṭaraṃ kuharaṃ tadākṛtīnyakṣīṇi yasya, anena antarlakṣyatāṃ 
bahirdṛṣṭitvaṃ ca darśayati, suṣṭhu bhīṣaṇatvaṃ nāmnaivoktam | 
mekhalaśabde tu hrasvaḥ eśvaraḥ | trilocanamiti prativaktram | avatānitaṃ 
maṇḍalīkṛtadordaṇḍam |  sphuritādharatvaṃ 
niḥśeṣavighnabhakṣaṇaparatvena || 9 || 

etadrūpamanugrāhyairupāsyamityāha ---- 

evaṃ taṃ bhairavaṃ devaṃ svacchandaṃ parikīrta(cinta)1yet | 
svacchandanāthameva bahurūpatvādanena subhīṣaṇena vighnasantrāsanena 
rūpeṇa cintayedityarthaḥ || 

ataśca ---- 


smaraṇānnāśayed devaḥ pāpasaṅghātamulbaṇam || 9-10 || 


dhyāyināṃ vyādhyādyudbhāvakaprāktanamahāpāpapraśamanāyaiva 
tenaivaṃvidhaṃ rūpaṃ svecchayā gṛhītam | ataḥ smaraṇādevolbaṇaṃ 
duṣṭabhogadānāyonmukhībhūtaṃ pāpasaṅghātaṃ nāśayatyeva | ata eva 
caturvaktrāt śrīvyādhibhakṣabhaṭṭārakādayamanya eva devo 
vyādhyādhikāraṇabhūtamahāpāpabhakṣaṇa ityavagatam || 10 || 

kiṃ ca asya mantraḥ purākhyāto dvātriṃśākṣarasaṃmitaḥ | 

yastaṃ bhīṣaṇarūpānuguṇatayā ---- 


pañcapraṇavapūrvāntaṃ tatra līnaṃ japenmanum || 9-11 || 


prāgdaśītasatattvāḥ pañcaḥ praṇavāḥ pūrvāntayoryasya tam, tatraiva 
pañcapraṇavasvarūpe līnaṃ viśrāntam, tadbhittyarthaṃ tadācchuritaṃ 
cemaṃ mahāmantraṃ pūjānte japāvasare japet | ataścaivaṃ 
vācyavācakakramābhyāṃ dīptatvādaghorīśvaryuktatvād 
bhāviviśiṣṭadevatāparivṛtatvetarābhyāmasya 
dvātriṃśadakṣarādanyatvamityanuṣṭhānāntaramevaitat || 11 || 

tadīdṛśasya ---- 

tasya kalpaṃ pravakṣyāmi samāsānna tu vistarāt | 

kalpyata ārādhyate'neneti kalpaḥ vidhānam || 


tamāha ---- 


pūrvoktabhūpradeśe ca viśuddhe śubhalakṣaṇe || 9-12 || 

puṣpaprakarasaṅkīrṇe gandhadhūpādhivāsite | 

tatra maṇḍalamālikhya pūrvoktairvarṇakaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 9-13 || 

ekahastaṃ dvihastaṃ vā caturhastāṣṭahastakam | 

susūtritaṃ samaṃ kṛtvā caturasraṃ samantataḥ || 9-14 || 

pūrvavat sādhayitvā tu digbhāgāṃstu varānane | 


pūrvoktairiti ---- 

"dhāmnā tu rajasāṃ pātaḥ" (4-35)

iti vākyena sūcitaiḥ, varṇakaiḥ sindūrādibhiḥ | gatārthamanyat || 

etat prāktanamaṇḍalādviśiṣṭaṃ maṇḍalamityāha ---- 


caturdvārasamopetamaṣṭapatraṃ sakaṇīkam | 

madhye padmaṃ samālikhya kesarairupalakṣitam || 9-15 || 

dvātriṃśadakṣaraṃ bāhye cakramālikhya śobhanam | 

evaṃ susūtritaṃ kṛtvā bāhye caiva tu vartulam || 9-16 || 

caturasraṃ tadāsannaṃ bāhye vīthīṃ prakalpayet | 

madhyapadmapramāṇena dvāraṃ kalpyeta pūrvavat || 9-17 || 


evamiti cakraparīmāṇānusāreṇa, susūtritaṃ vartulaṃ bhramaṃ kṛtvā, 
tasyāsannaṃ ca caturasraṃ kṛtvā vīthīṃ prakalpayet | 
tadbāhye'ntaḥpadmakṣetramānaṃ kaṇṭhakapolaśobhopaśobhāḍhyaṃ 
catasṛṣu dikṣu dvāracatuṣṭayaṃ kalpayet || 17 || 

atha niṣpanne maṇḍale sādhakaḥ ---- 


bhasmoddhūlitadehastu mudrālaṅkārabhūṣitaḥ | 

keśayajñopavītī ca digvāsāḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ || 9-18 || 

śaṅkhārghapātrahastastu sakalīkṛtavigrahaḥ | 

parito'straṃ pravinyasya bhairavaṃ pūjayet priye || 9-19 || 

praṇavāsanasaṃsthaṃ tu............


bhasmoddhūlitatvādinā sādhakasya mantrārādhanāvasare 
mahāvratitvamuktamata eva parabhairavānukāritvenāpi tadabhimānino vighnā 
naśyanti | bhāvyasyātra jalasnānādi noktam, digvāsāḥ, tadanyasya 
yatsaṃyamanāśayenaiva kaupīnagrahaṇāt | śaṅkhamatra 
prakaraṇasāmarthyānmahāśaṅkham | parito'straṃ sarvato'straprākāram | 
praṇavāsanasthatvaṃ prāgvat || 

kathaṃ pūjayet, kaṃ ca bhairavamityāha ---- 


..........ṃūtīṃ haṃsākṣareṇa tu | 

tameva sakalaṃ devaṃ svacchandaṃ parameśvaram || 9-20 || 


mūtīṃ haṃsākṣareṇeti pūrvoktena cinmūtīmantreṇa 
dvātriṃśadakṣareṇa ca sakalamūtīrūpeṇa | tameveti pūrvoktam || 20 || 

kimaviśiṣṭam ? netyāha ---- 


yattat paramanirbhāsamanāmayamarūpakam | 

tena cāvāhayed devi...........


paramaḥ sarvotkṛṣṭo nirbhāso yasya, anāmayaṃ māyāsambandhaharam, 
arūpakamanākṛti, yatpūrvaṃ niṣkalaṃ tattvamuktam, tena 
proktanītyādyantasthitena sahitamāvāhanamudrayā''vāhayet 
pūjanārthamabhimukhīkuryāt || 

kiṃ ca ---- 

......ḥṛcchiraśca śikhāṃ tathā || 9-21 || 

varma netre tathāstraṃ ca tenaiva parikalpayet | 


tenaiveti naiṣkalena hṛdādyaṅgamantreṇa, na tu prāgvat sakalenāpi | 
brahmapañcakamantrāṇāṃ tu na sakalādivibhāgo'stīti prāgvat 
tannyāsānantaraṃ bhagavadākṛtau niṣkalāṅganyāsaḥ || 

itthaṃ ca niṣkalasakalātmakaikarūpe bhagavatyāhvānasamaye eva 
niṣkalasakalamantroccārād niṣkalasthānavihitaparamīkaraṇe nyaste 
vaktranaiṣkalāṅgavinyāse kṛte ---- 


sthāpanaṃ sannidhānaṃ ca nirodhārghādipūjanam || 9-22 || 

sarvaṃ tenaiva kartavyamuktānuktaṃ varānane | 


sthāpanādi sarvaṃ pūrvapradaśītamudrābandhapūrvaṃ kartavyam | tenaiveti 
niṣkalasampuṭitena sakalena | uktamiti sthāpanādi, anuktaṃ tu 
svāgatapādyācamanasnānādi ātmanivedanaparyantam || 

itthaṃ ca ---- 


madhyasthaṃ bhairavaṃ pūjyamaṅgaṣaṭkasamanvitam || 9-23 || 


madhyasthamiti madhyagatam, bhairavamiti bhairavateja ityarthaḥ || 23 || 

kiṃ cātra padmabāhye dvātriṃśadarake cakre ---- 


tataḥ patrasthitā devīrdvātriṃśārṇainīveśayet | 

pūrvārakāt samārabhya yāvadante vyavasthitā || 9-24 || 


patrasthitā iti aṣṭapatrasya padmasyoktatvāt 
pratidikpatrānusāristhitārācatuṣṭaye cakre saṃniveśayediti | 
dvātriṃśārṇairiti takāralopa eśvaraḥ, tena dvātriṃśaddevīḥ 
dvātriṃśataiva arṇaiḥ, arthād dvātriṃśadvarṇasambandhibhivībhajya 
niveśayet || 24 || 


tāsāṃ nāmāni vakṣyāmi dvātriṃśatparisaṃkhyayā | 


tāni mantrasthākṣarasphārasāratatsadṛśaprathamanāmākṣararūpāṇi 
nirūpayati ---- 


aruṇā ghoṣā devī ca revatī bhogadāyikā || 9-25 || 

sthāpanī ghorasaṃjñā ca rakṣā bhārabhareti ca | 

ghorarūpā ravā ghoṇā ratistārātha rūpiṇī || 9-26 || 

bhayahānistu caṇḍā vai sarvadā ca tathā varā | 

takṣakī ca tathā śārvī barbarā sarvagā tathā || 9-27 || 

raudrī ca bhrāmaṇī caiva nāginī ca manoharā | 

stambhanī roṣaṇī caiva drāvā rudrā praśāsinī || 9-28 || 

bhayāpahāriṇī devī jñeyā dvātriṃśa tatkramāt | 


tatkramāditi mantragatākṣarakramānusāreṇetyarthaḥ | evaṃ cābhidadhanna 
kevalaṃ mantrasya pūrvanirṇītavākyarūpā vīryavyāptiḥ, 
yāvadvarṇānusāreṇa proktadevatācakravyāptimayatvamapītyādiśati devaḥ 
|| 

āsāṃ devīnāmāvāhanādau mantramāha ---- 


praṇavādistato varṇo devīnāma natistathā || 9-29 || 

sarvāsāṃ tu vidhirhyeṣa kartavyo vidhivedinā | 


varṇa iti dvātriṃśadakṣarasambandhī krameṇaikaika ityarthaḥ | nāma iti 
caturthyantamityarthāt | vidhiriti pūjādiviṣayo mantroccāraṇaprakāraḥ | 
vidhivedinetyeṣa āvāhanādāvāmantraṇavibhaktyantaṃ nāma tathā 
tatkarmānusāreṇa jātiprayoga ityanumantavyamiti dhvanati || 

athāsāṃ devīnāṃ pratidiśaṃ catasṛṇāṃ pūrvoktanītyā  
bhairavīyaprapañcavyāptitattvalokapālānusāreṇa bhairavānusāreṇa 
dhyānaṃ nidīśati ---- 


hemābhaṃ prāk catuṣkaṃ tadindracāpasamaprabham || 9-30 || 

caturmukhaṃ caturbāhaṃ vajrahastaṃ sugavītam | 

kapālamālābharaṇaṃ prahasattu vicintayet || 9-31 || 


prāk catuṣkamiti padmaprāgdalasaṃśliṣṭānāṃ 
catuṣṭayaniviṣṭamaruṇādicatuṣkaṃ taddikpatitulyatvād hemaprabhaṃ 
vajrahastaṃ ca, indracāpasamaprabhamityantaḥsphurannānāvarṇabhāsvaram,
ūrdhvavaktrasya niṣprapañcatvāt siddhyanuguṇatā nāstīti 
pañcavaktraśaktimadadhiṣṭhitamapi devatācakraṃ sādhakasiddhyānuguṇyena 
gṛhītacaturmukhacaturbhujādirūpaṃ daśītam | ekatra dakṣahaste 
vajrasyoktatvādanuktamapi kapālakhaṭvāṅgadhāritvamabhayakaratvamaṃśena 
bhairavarūpānukārāduktam, ataśca kapālamālābharaṇatvamapi 
saṅgatameveti tadanusāreṇa prativaktraṃ trinetratvamapi mantavyam | 
sugavītatvaṃ prahasattvaṃ ca nivīghnasiddhidānānuguṇyena kiyadetadvastu
ityāśayāt | etaccaturmukhatvādi prahasitatvāntaṃ sarvatra 
catuṣke'numantavyam,


tathā kapālakhaṭvāṅgahastatvādikaṃ ca || 9-31 || 

āgneyaṃ raktavarṇābhaṃ śaktihastaṃ sadā smaret | 

daṇḍahastaṃ smaredyāmyaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ subhīṣaṇam || 9-32 || 

nīlamindīvarābhāsaṃ nairṛtaṃ khaḍgagahastakam | 

śyāmaṃ vāruṇadigbhāge pāśahastaṃ vicintayet || 9-33 || 

dhūmraṃ sāmīradigbhāge dhvajahastaṃ sucañcalam | 

uttaraṃ dhavalaṃ jñeyaṃ gadākheṭakadhāri ca || 9-34 || 

sphaṭikābhaṃ tathaiśānyāṃ triśūlāyudhapāṇikam | 


uttarasmin devīcatuṣṭaye kheṭakadhāritvasya 
svakaṇṭhenoktatvādabhayapāṇitvaṃ na dhyātavyam | caturmukhatvādi 
sarvamanyat prāgvat || 

atra dhyāne phalamāha ---- 


evaṃ dhyānaparo yastu cakrametat sadābhyaset || 9-35 || 

vatsarārdhād varārohe tasya siddhistridhā bhavet | 


uttamamadhyamādhamarūpā || 

evaṃ dhyānasiddhimuktvā, tasyaiva japasiddhyucitaṃ kṣetramādiśati ---- 


mahendre malaye sahye pāriyātre'rbude tathā || 9-36 || 

vindhye śrīparvate caiva tathā kolagirau priye | 

etānyaṣṭau siddhyanuguṇāni parvatasthānāni || 


kiṃ ca ---- 


gaṅgāyamunāsambādhe.............


sambādhaḥ saṅkaṭaṃ saṃmiśrayostayoḥ yāvatī pravāhabhūmiḥ || 


...............kurukṣetre varānane || 9-37 || 

gaṅgādvāre prayāge ca brahmāvarte samāsthitaḥ | 


sarasvatīcarmaṇvatyorantarastho deśo brahmāvartaḥ || 


antarvedyāṃ supuṇyāyāṃ narmadāyāṃ tathaiva ca || 9-38 || 


gaṅgāyamunāpravāhayormadhyamantarvedī | narmadāyāmapi tattaṭe || 38 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


susnigdhadeśe bhūbhāge padmaṣaṇḍairmanorame | 


padmaṣaṇḍairmanoramo yaḥ susnigdho deśastatra bhūbhāge iti yojanā || 

kiṃ ca ---- 

yeṣu yeṣu pradeśeṣu svayambhūrbhagavāñchivaḥ || 9-39 || 

teṣu sthāneṣu deveśi niyamastho jitendriyaḥ | 

vāṅnaruddhaḥ prasannātmā lakṣākṣarajape rataḥ || 9-40 || 

śākabhakṣyaḥ phalāhārī nīvārādyaśane rataḥ | 

trikālapūjānirato'thāgnikāryaparāyaṇaḥ || 9-41 || 

bhāvitātmā mahāsattvo rakṣāyāśca vidhānavit | 


yaḥ ---- 


tasya mantraḥ prasiddhayettu...........


sa ca ---- 


..........ṣādhayet sacarācaram || 9-42 || 


svayambhūnāmanugrahārthamevāvatīrṇatvāt tatkṣetrasya sātiśayaṃ 
siddhipradatvam | niyamastha iti 
śaucasaṃtoṣatapaḥsvādhyāyeśvarapraṇidhānaniṣṭhaḥ | vāk ca 
niḥśeṣeṇa ruddhā japaikaniṣṭhīkṛtā yena, prasannaḥ 
tyaktasaṅgasaṃskāra ātmā mano yasya, lakṣākṣarajape rata iti prāgvat 
dvātriṃśatā lakṣaiḥ sadaśāṃśahomaiḥ, na tu yathānye ---- akṣaraṃ 
mantrastasya lakṣeṇaikeneti, akṣaraśabdasya mantravācitvābhāvāt,

"lakṣeṇākṣarasaṃkhyayā" (6-51)

iti prāktanoktyaviśeṣapratibhāsanādetasyā ukteḥ | na ca ṣāṇmāsikasya 
proktacakradhyānasya kācidanupapattiḥ, tasyaitajjapasaṃkhyāvidhiṃ vinā 
śuddhasyaiva proktaphalahetutvāt | na ca dhyānamātrāt siddhirna bhavatīti 
vācyam, āgameṣu śataśastatpratipādanāt, jape tu tathocitaṃ dhyānaṃ na 
pratyācakṣmahe | yadi proktacakradhyānaṃ mantrajape'ṅgaṃ syāt, 
taccakradevīnāmapi japaniyamamabhidadhyādityalam | bhāvitātmā 
āśvastahṛdayaḥ, ata eva mahāsattvaḥ sāvaṣṭambho'tyantaśuddhacittaḥ | 
rakṣāyā digbandhāstraprākārādirūpāyāḥ, cakārāt 
kṣetrapālabalyādeḥ, vidhānaviditikartavyatājñaḥ || 42 || 

yaduktaṃ sādhayet sacarācaramiti, tatsaṃkṣepeṇa darśayan 
bhāvipaṭalaprameyavastu kaṭākṣayati ---- 


kālāgnirnarakāścaiva pātālā hāṭakeśvaraḥ | 

saptalokaṃ sabrahmāṇḍaṃ pañcāṣṭakamataḥ param || 9-43 || 

devayonyaṣṭakaṃ caiva pradhānapuruṣāntakam | 

niyatiḥ kālatattvaṃ ca rāgo vidyā kalā tathā || 9-44 || 

māyā vidyeśvaraṃ tattvaṃ sādākhyaṃ śaktigocaram | 

sarvaṃ siddhyatyanāyāsānmantrarājaprabhāvataḥ || 9-45 || 


etatsamanantarapaṭalanirṇeṣyamāṇaṃ śaktitattvāntaṃ sarvaṃ sādhakasya 
vaśe bhavatyataśca śivarūpaḥ sādhako jāyata iti yāvat || 45 || 

yatra ceyadviśvamasya vartate, tatra daṇḍāpūpīyanyāyo mitasiddhīnāṃ 
sthita evetyāha ---- 


pūrvoktaṃ karma vai kṣipramadhamaṃ madhyamottamam | 

sādhayennātra sandeho bhairavasya vaco yathā || 9-46 || 


adhamādi prāgvat | māraṇoccāṭanavaśyākarṣaṇaśāntikāpyāyanādi ca 
yadadhamādi karma pūrvamuktam, tadapi yathoktadravyayuktisahakṛtamayaṃ 
mantrarājaḥ pūrvoktanyāyenaiva japalakṣeṇa sahomenārādhitaḥ 
sādhayatīti siddha evāyam | bhairavasya yathaiva vacastathā atrāśvastavyam 
| āśvāso hi akampaḥ siddhiliṅgam || 46 || 

atha yogyatamasādhakaviṣayametadeva darśanaṃ 
dvātriṃśaddevatācakraparivāraṃ vinā ekavīraṃ nirūpayitumāha ---- 


athaikavīramāśritya aṅgaṣaṭkasamanvitam | 

jātiyogayutaṃ kṛtvā aṣṭapatre kuśeśaye || 9-47 || 

pūjayet pūrvavidhinā..............


ekameva devīparivārādyaparivṛtaṃ vaktrāṅgaṣaṭkamātrasahitam, vīraṃ 
sādhakānāṃ muktiparyavasitatattatsiddhisādhanāyodyatam parameśvaraṃ, 
pūrvoktavidhineti 

"bhasmoddhūlitadehastu" (9-18)

ityādinoktena sarveṇa krameṇa pūrvokta eva kṣetra ārādhanārthaṃ 
homāntena vidhinā pūjayet || 47 || 

tataḥ proktasaṃkhyākaṃ japaṃ homaṃ ca pratijñāya, tatsampattyai ---- 


...................japahomārcane rataḥ | 

dhyāyanneva mahādevi svacchandaṃ parameśvaram || 9-48 || 

prāpnoti cintitān kāmān devi nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ | 


evaṃ sādhakasiddhyānuguṇyenārādhanaprakārānuktvā rakṣākalpaṃ 
prastāvayitumāha ---- 


atha rakṣāvidhāneṣu aghoraṃ yojayedyathā || 9-49 || 

tathāhaṃ kathayiṣyāmi tadekāgramanāḥ śṛṇu | 


yatra ---- 


dvātriṃśadarasaṃyuktaṃ cakramālikhya bhāmini || 9-50 || 

nābhikesarasaṃyuktaṃ susamaṃ tu varānane | 

gorocanāṃ tu saṃgṛhya siddhālaktakasaṃyutām || 9-51 || 

dūrvākāṇḍena deveśi haritena samālikhet | 


siddhaiḥ siddhārthakairalaktena ca miśrāṃ gorocanāṃ kṛtvā 
dūrvākāṇḍena nīlena tat cakramarthād bhūrje likhet | 
siddhālaktakamalaktakaviśeṣa ityanye | siddhā bhagavatī caṇḍikā, 
tatpādād gṛhītena kuṅkumeneti tvasat || 

athāsya cakrasya ---- 


vidyārājaṃ kaṇīkāsthaṃ bindunādasamanvitam || 9-52 || 

śaktyavasānaṃ deveśi tasmin sādhyaṃ samālikhet | 

kaṣamadhye varārohe nayanādyantarodhitam || 9-53 || 

īkāraveṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā.................


vidyārājaṃ navātmamantram | kaṇīkāsthamiti 
dvātriṃśadaracakranābhigatakamalakaṇīkāgatamiti yāvat | 
bindunādaśaktayo'tra lipikrameṇa lekhitavyāḥ | sādhyamiti tannāma, evaṃ 
cābhidadhadvācyasya vācakābhinnatvamīśecchākṛtamiti sūcayati | 
kaṣamadhya iti navātmasambandhinaḥ kṣakārasya yau kakāraṣakārau 
tayormadhya iti, kāduttarasya ṣasya prathamabhāge | nayanena tryakṣareṇa 
pūrvoktena netramantreṇa, rodhitamiti sampuṭīkṛtam | tatra ca 
netramantrākṣarāṇāmādāvanulomakramaḥ paścāt pratilomakrama iti 
sampradāyaḥ | īkāraveṣṭitaṃ kṛtveti māyābījamālikhya tadīkāreṇa 
netramantrasampuṭitaṃ tatsādhyanāma triveṣṭitaṃ kaṣamadhye 
likhedityarthaḥ || 

itthaṃ kaṇīkāyāṃ likhitvā ---- 


..............'rakasthā niveśayet | 

pūrvoktadevatā devi.............


pūrvoktā aruṇādyā yathoktaikaikamantrākṣararūpāḥ sādhyānte 
bhagavatsammukhatvena, na tu tatparāṅmukhatayetyāmnāyo'tra || 

atha ---- 


............ṭadgarbhe sādhyamālikhet || 9-54 || 


sādhyamiti tannāma || 54 || 

katham ---- 


bhavagarbhe tu tatkṛtvā īkārākhyena veṣṭayet | 

trīn vārāṃstu varārohe dhyānayogasamāśritaḥ || 9-55 || 


bhava iha praṇavaḥ, tatpūrvasya devīmantrasyoktatvāt tasya garbhe madhye | 
taditi sādhyanāma kṛtvā paścāduparivatīmāyābījasatkenekāreṇa 
prāgvad veṣṭayet | tadīdṛgitikartavyatāviśeṣitaṃ sādhyanāma 
ekaikārāniviṣṭadevīmantrākṣaramadhye ālikhedityarthaḥ | evaṃ 
ghośabdasya reśabdasya anyasya ca prathamakuṭilabhāgātmani madhye etat 
lekhanīyam | tathābhūtaṃ caitadekaikaṃ devīmantrākṣaraṃ 
kaṇīkāgatamantrarājasammukhaṃ pūrvādikrameṇārāsu niveśayet | 
dhyānayogasamāśrita iti bhagavato devatānāṃ ca svarūpaṃ 
siddhisamucitayathoktākāraṃ dhyātvā tadvyāptiṃ ca bhāvayitvā likhet || 
55 || 

tadevaṃ likhitametat sarvameva cakram ---- 


ūrdhve caiva tu saṃrodhya kroṃkāreṇa varānane | 

digaṣṭake'syāṣṭau bahiḥ kroṃkārā dātavyā ityarthaḥ || 

athaitat ---- 


indunācchuritaṃ kṛtvā puṣpadhūpaiḥ prapūjayet || 9-56 || 


induḥ karpūram | pūjanaṃ madhyamantrāt prabhṛti sarvamantraiḥ 
yathāsthānam, yathālekhotpuṃsanaṃ ca sampadyate || 56 || 

atha ---- 


veṣṭayeccaiva tadbhūrjamarandhraṃ nirvraṇaṃ samam | 

pañcaraṅgakasūtreṇa veṣṭayitvā varānane || 9-57 || 

sikthena muṭayet paścāt kṣaudramadhye nidhāpayet | 


sikthaṃ madhūcchiṣṭam | kṣaudraṃ mākṣikaṃ 
sarvauṣadhirasasārabhūtamiti tanmadhye sthāpanaṃ sādhyasyāpyāyanāya || 

asya rakṣāvidheḥ phalamāha ---- 


yadā mṛtyuvaśāghrātaṃ kālena kalitaṃ priye || 9-58 || 

ariṣṭacihnitaṃ jñātvā rakṣāmetāṃ samālikhet | 

tasya mṛtyurna jāyeta ityevaṃ bhairavo'bravīt || 9-59 || 


"yadā"śabdo bhinnakramaḥ samālikhedityasyādau yojyaḥ | asya ca paścāt 
tadetyadhyāhāryam, tena kālādhikāraproktairanyairvāriṣṭaiḥ cihnitam, 
tata eva ca ---- 

"ekottaraṃ mṛtyuśatamasmin dehe pratiṣṭhitam | 

tatraikaḥ kālamṛtyuḥ syāccheṣāstvāgantavaḥ smṛtāḥ ||"

iti sthityāgantuśatenāghrātaṃ kālamṛtyunā ca ekena kalitaṃ sādhyaṃ 
jñātvā gururimāṃ rakṣāṃ yadā samālikhet, tadā tasya mṛtyuḥ ko'pi 
na syāditi bhagavataivoktametaditi nātra saṃśayitavyam | lipimātrāt 
kathametadbhavatīti ? yataḥ śrīsarvavīraśrībhargaśikhānirūpitanītyā 
lipirapi parāśaktiprasararūpaiva, ato bhagavataivaivaṃpratijñātatvāt 
satyamevaitanmantavyam || 59 || 

mṛtyurakṣaṇe prakārāntaramāha ---- 


kapālīśasya garbhe tu nāma yasya samālikhet | 

bhūrjapatre varārohe rocanāyā rasena tu || 9-60 || 

oṃkārapuṭamadhyasthaṃ rodhitaṃ nayanākṣaraiḥ | 

vauṣaḍjātiprayogeṇa tasya mṛtyurna jāyate || 9-61 || 


kapālīśaḥ pūrvoktaḥ, tasya garbhe prāgvat kaṣamadhye | kīdṛśaṃ nāma 
| oṃkārapuṭamadhyasthamādyantayoroṃkārasampuṭīkṛtam | tathākṛtaṃ ca 
satpūrvoktairnayanākṣaraivauṣaḍjātiprayogeṇa paścātkṛtenopalakṣitaiḥ 
rodhitamiti prāgvadanulomapratilomakramābhyāmādyantayoḥ sampuṭīkṛtam | 
digviśeṣānupādānādaṣṭāsu dikṣu iti | atra ca prāgvad 
dūrvākāṇḍalekhanapūjanādikṣaudramadhyanidhānaparyantaṃ 
sarvamanusartavyam || 61 || 

evaṃ parivārasthabhairavāṣṭakādyantasthakapālīśavidyārājāśrayeṇa 
rakṣāvidhānena mṛtyujayamuktvā, prasaṅgāt karmāntarasiddhimapi 
yantrakrameṇādiśati devaḥ ---- 


śikhyāhvena tu deveśi sādhyanāma vidarbhayet | 

analārṇamadhaścordhve sādhyārṇeṣu niyojayet || 9-62 || 


śikhyāhvena śikhivāhanamantreṇa pūrvoktena | vidarbhayediti ---- 

"abhidheyaṃ bhavet pūrvaṃ tato mantraḥ sakṛd bhavet"

iti śāstrāntaroktasthityānuvinyastamantraṃ kuryāt, analārṇaṃ rephaḥ, 
tadekaikatra sādhyanāmākṣaraṃ ūrdhvādho niyojayet | itthaṃ 
vidabhītametadāgneyamaṇḍalāntasthavāyumaṇḍalasaṃsthitaṃ kuryāt, 
āgneyamaṇḍalaṃ trikoṇaṃ tadbahirvāyumaṇḍalaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vartulam || 
62 || 

etacca yasya likhyate ---- 


tasya vai jāyate dāhaḥ............


vāyvādhmātāgnidīpitatvādagnivarṇamadhyagatākṣaratvāt 
śikhivāhanavidabhītatvācca || 

kiṃ śikhivāhanavidabhītamātrameva nāmāgneyamaṇḍalāntaḥ kriyate | na
tanmātrameva, kiṃ tu ---- 


..............phaṭkārādyantarodhitam | 


phaṭkārāntaśikhivāhanabījavidabhītamiti vyākhyanamasat, tathā 
vākyārthasyābhāvāt || 

etallekhanānantaraṃ ca mantranāthaṃ pūjayitvā, etaccakramadhyagatameva ---
- 
jvalantaṃ cintayet sādhyaṃ dinānāṃ saptakaṃ yadi || 63 || 

tatastasya ---- 


tatkṣaṇājjāyate dāho bhairavasya vaco yathā | 


krodharājaprayogeṇa māraṇamāha ---- 


krodharājaniruddhaṃ tu śmaśānapaṭamadhyagam || 9-64 || 

śmaśānādalinā lekhyaṃ viṣaraktānvitena tu | 

yasya nāma varārohe huṃphaṭkāravidabhītam || 9-65 || 

mārayetisamāyogāt krūrajātisamanvitam | 

mirayate saptarātreṇa yo rakṣābhiḥ surakṣitaḥ || 9-66 || 


so'pīti śeṣaḥ | śmaśānādaliḥ śmaśānāṅgāraḥ, tena 
pretaraktaviṣamiśreṇa maṣīṃ kṛtvā, pretapaṭakhaṇḍe yasya nāma 
huṃphaṭkāravidabhītamityante vinyasya huṃphaṭkāraṃ kṛtvā, paścāt 
prāguktena krodharājena niruddhamityādyantarodhitam, tato'pi mārayetyanena 
yuktam, tato'pi krūrajātyā huṃphaṭityanena samanvitaṃ likhyate, sa 
rakṣābhī rakṣito'pi saptarātrānmirayate | atra śrīkrodharājarūpaṃ 
śatrusaṃhārocitamugraṃ cintyam || 66 || 

atha śatrostrāsanāya vikarālaprayogamāha ---- 


vikarālo mahādevi ūrdhvādhaḥ pāśasaṃsthitaḥ | 

sādhyanāmnastu deveśi huṃphaṭkāravidabhīṇaḥ || 9-67 || 

na kṣāmayatyayatnena.............


yasya sādhyanāmnaḥ proktayuktayā huṃphaṭkāravidabhītasya vikarālākhyo 
mantraviśeṣa catudīggataḥ proktayā maṣyā likhyate, 
tasyāsāvayatnenahelayaiva na kṣamate | kṣāmayatītyaiśaḥ pāṭhaḥ || 

kimasya na kṣamaṇamityāha ---- 


..............ṭasya śatrorbhayaṃ bhavet | 


atra ca śrīvikarālasvarūpaṃ madhyasthitasya sādhyasya catasṛṣu dikṣu 
trāsakatvenotthitaṃ cintanīyam || 

atha manmathaprayogaṃ vaśīkārāyāha ---- 


manmathena yutaṃ kṛtvā sādhyanāma varānane || 9-68 || 

dhruvādyaṃ svāhayāntena raktadhyānasamanvitam | 

amuko'tra varārohe taddiśo'bhimukhaḥ sthitaḥ || 9-69 || 

amukasya vaśaṃ yātu japahomau samācaret | 

saptāhād vaśamāyāti iti śāstrasya niścayaḥ || 9-70 || 


pūrvoktena hvūaukārasamudāyātmanā sabindukena piṇḍākṣareṇa manmathena 
yuktaṃ yatsādhyanāma, tadeva vibhajati | amuka iti amukasya vaśaṃ yātu 
ityetadantaṃ svāhayā svāhāśabdenāntenāntasthena yutaṃ kṛtvā ca | 
īdṛśā praṇavapūrveṇa mantreṇa | raktadhyānasamanvitamiti taṃ sādhyaṃ 
raktaṃ dhyāyan tadavasthitidigabhimukhaḥ sādhako yadi saptāhaṃ japaṃ 
homaṃ ca vaśīkaraṇocitairdravyaiḥ karoti tadāsya sādhyo 
vaśamāyātyevetyatrārthaḥ |  atra ca yantraprakaraṇādetanniścitam 
yadevaṃvidhaṃ mantraṃ likhitvā sampūjya japa homau kāryau || 70 || 

meghanādaprayogamuccāṭanāyāha ---- 


meghanādāvasāne tu nāma yasya samālikhet | 

yakārādyantasaṃruddhaṃ mantraṃ phaḍdvitayānvitam || 9-71 || 

pretasthāne nidhāpyaitad bhairavaṃ tatra pūjayet | 

akṣapuṣpairvarārohe taddiśo'bhimukhaḥ sthitaḥ || 9-72 || 

tamuccāṭayate kṣipraṃ devi nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ | 


meghanādo h r y ūbindusamudāyātmā | yakāreti 
savisargayakārasampuṭitamityāmnāyaḥ | etadityevaṃ likhitaṃ bhūrje | 
nidhāpyeti śmaśānabhūmyantargataṃ kṛtvā tatra īdṛśe bhūrje | akṣā 
vibhītakāḥ | taditi sādhyadigabhimukhaḥ | saptāhāditi sthitameva | 
spaṣṭamanyat || 

somarājaprayogaṃ vibhavārthaṃ vaśīkṛtyarthaṃ cāha ---- 


somarājena deveśi ādimadhyāntasaṃyutam || 9-73 || 

nāma yasya samālikhya vaṣaḍjātisamanvitam | 

saṃnidhāpya trimadhure sthāpayet surasundari || 9-74 || 

saptarātraprayogeṇa trikālāṣṭaśatena ca | 

asādhyaṃ sādhayatyāśu dhanaṃ ca vipulaṃ labhet || 9-75 || 


somarājo huṅkāraḥ, tena sādhyanāma ādimadhyāntasambaddhaṃ kṛtveti 
nāmna ādau madhye'nte ca triḥ somarājaṃ lekhitvā, tato vaṣaḍantaṃ 
kṛtvā, tadyantraṃ saṃnidhāpya pūjayitvā sikthasaṃmuṭitaṃ 
kṣīrakṣaudraśarkarāpātrasampuṭagaṃ kṛtvā, saptadinaṃ yastrisaṃdhyaṃ 
tathaiva japedasādhyaṃ sādhayitumaśakyamapi sādhayati vaśīkaroti, 
śriyaṃ cāpnoti || 75 || 

punaḥ proktasya krodharājasya japahomābhyāṃ prayogamunmādārthamāha ---- 


pañcāṅgena piśācasya krodharājāvasānikām | 

saṃjñāṃ samuccared devi krūrajātisamanvitam || 9-76 || 

unmatto jāyate sādhyo homena ca japena ca | 


piśācasya vibhītakasya mūlakāṇḍapatrakusumaphalāni pañcāṅgāni, 
taimīlitaṃ saptāhaṃ praṇavādikrodharājahuṃphaḍantaṃ 
sādhyanāmoccārya, trisaṃdhyamaṣṭottaraśataṃ yo juhuyāt, tasyāsau 
sādhyaḥ śatrurunmatto bhavati || 

punarapyanugrahahevākitayā mṛtyujidvidhimāha ---- 


mṛtyuñjayaṃ pravakṣyāmi tamekāgramanāḥ śṛṇu || 9-77 || 

bhūrjapatraṃ samādāya nīrandhraṃ nirvraṇaṃ samam | 

tasmin samālikhet padmamaṣṭapatraṃ sakaṇīkam || 9-78 || 

tasmin vai kaṇīkāmadhye sādhyanāma samālikhet | 

saṃveṣṭyāṣṭau diśo devi svacchandena kṛśodari || 9-79 || 

praṇavena tu saṃveṣṭya.................


svacchandeneti siddhipradānena sakalena sādhyanāmāṣṭau 
diśaścakravadāvaraṇakrameṇa saṃveṣṭya tataḥ praṇavena saṃveṣṭya 
kaṇīkāmadhye likhediti yojanā || 

kaṇīkāvat pratipatraṃ likhedityāha ---- 


................patreṣvevaṃ samālikhet | 


aṣṭasvapi | 

kiṃ ca ---- 


patrāṣṭake'pyaghorasya nāmādhastāt samālikhet || 9-80 || 


patrabāhya āvaraṇakrameṇa vyomarekhāmityarthaḥ || 

evaṃ likhitvā prāgvat karpūrādinā pūrayitvā sampūjya vijñaptyartham --
-- 


vaktavyaṃ deva saṃrakṣa śaraṇaṃ tvāmupāgatam | 


sādhyamityarthāt | tata eṣā rakṣā sikthakādinā saṃveṣṭya payasi 
kṣepyā | payasi kṣīre nikṣiptamātraiva satī sādhyasya 
sadyomṛtyuvināśinīti kaṇīkāyāṃ likhitvā tallagneṣvaṣṭasu 
patreṣvevameva likhet || 

atha śāntikamāha ---- 


ādau tryakṣaravinyāsaṃ svacchandaṃ tadanantaram || 9-81 || 

janmanāma tu sādhyasya akṣarāntaritaṃ likhet | 

punastryakṣaravinyāsaṃ vaṣaḍantaṃ niyojayet || 9-82 || 


netramantrākṣarāṇi trīṇi catuṣkalaṃ ca likhitvā janmasamayakṛtaṃ 
sādhyanāmākṣarairiti, 
arthādaghorasatkairantaritamekaikatadakṣaravyavahitam, "a devadattaḥ gho 
devadattaḥ, ityādikrameṇa likhitvā punarvaṣaḍantāni prāgvallikhet || 82 
|| 

imāṃ ca rakṣāṃ sampūjya ---- 


muṭitvā sikthakenaiva kṣīramadhye tu prakṣipet | 


itthaṃ ca sādhyasya ---- 


jāyate paramā śāntiḥ...........


kiṃ ca ---- 


.................punaranyannibodha me || 9-83 || 


katham ---- 

jaṃ saḥ sampuṭamadhyasthaṃ praṇavobhayasaṃyutam | 

nāma kṛtvā varārohe prakṣipenmadhuratraye || 9-84 || 


juṃ sa ityanena prāgvat prāganulomaṃ paścāttu pratilomaṃ vinyastena 
sampuṭīkṛtaṃ nāma paścāt praṇavena sampuṭitaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ | 
madhuratrayaṃ prāgvat || 84 || 

itthaṃ ca ---- 


parāṃ śāntimavāpnoti mṛtyurogairna bādhyate | 


sādhya ityarthāt || 

punarmṛtyujayaprakārāntaramāha ---- 


bhūrjapatraṃ samādāya rocanāyā varānane || 9-85 || 

mātṛkāntaritaṃ nāma dūrvākāṇḍena cālikhet | 

tadabhyantaragarbhe tu svarairantaritaṃ kuru || 9-86 || 

punargarbhe samālikhya sādhyanāma varānane | 

dhruveṇa veṣṭayet paścād vakāreṇa tataḥ priye || 9-87 || 

sakāraṃ ca kṣakāraṃ ca likhecca tadanantaram | 

punarveṣṭya ṭhakāreṇa māyābījena suvrate || 9-88 || 

aṅkuśena niruddhyeta rakṣāṃ mṛtyuvināśinīm | 

svacchandasahitāṃ devi praṇavenādiyojitām || 9-89 || 

vaṣaḍjātisamopetāṃ karpūrakṣodacacītām | 

gandhapuṣpādināpūjya prakṣipenmadhuratraye || 9-90 || 


garbhe sādhyanāma | praṇavenādiyojitāmapi praṇavāntargarbhīkṛtāṃ 
vidhāya svacchandasahitāṃ vaṣaḍjātisamopetāṃ rakṣāṃ kṛtveti 
garbhīkṛtanāmnaḥ praṇavasya bahiraghoraṃ vaṣaḍantaṃ pariveṣṭanayā 
likhet tacca tadabhyantaragarbhe tu svarairantaritaṃ kurvīta | 
bahivīnyastakādikṣāntamātṛkāyā abhyantare ṣoḍaśabhiḥ 
svarairantaḥkṛtaiḥ parimaṇḍalena likhitairvyāptaṃ karaṇīyam | yadāha -
--- mātṛkāntaritamiti | etacca sarvaṃ punardhruveṇa veṣṭitaṃ sat 
krameṇa vakārasakārakṣakāraṭhakārairveṣṭayet | tadanu 
māyābījasatkekāreṇa trirveṣṭayet | paścādaṣṭasu dikṣu kroṃkāreṇa 
rodhayediti vyavahitavākyārthasaṅgatyanusāreṇa cakrametat pradaśītam || 
90 || 

arcayitvā caitat sikthakena muṭitaṃ madhuratraye yasya kṣipyate, tasya ---- 


jāyate paramā śāntirnātra kāryā vicāraṇā | 


niścitamatinaitat prayuktamabhīṣṭaṃ sādhayatyeva || 


athavā guṭikāṃ kṛtvā kaṇṭhe bāhau ca dhārayet || 9-91 || 


yaḥ ---- 


tasya vyādhirna jāyeta ityevaṃ bhairavo'bravīt | 


guṭikāṃ kṛtveti jatubaddhāṃ kanakādibhūṣitāṃ vidhāya kaṇṭhe bhuje 
vā dhārayet | co vārthe || 


guṭikāṃ vinā viśiṣṭamantrābhimantritabhojanapānakrameṇa satataṃ 
kriyamāṇena mṛtyujidvidhimāha ---- 


tryakṣaraṃ mūlamantraṃ ca vaṣaḍjātisamanvitam || 9-92 || 

bhojanodakapāne tu mantrayitvāśnataḥ sadā | 

na tasya jāyate mṛtyurbhairavasya vaco yathā || 9-93 || 


netramantracatuṣkalanāthābhyāṃ vaṣaḍantābhyāṃ bhojanapāne dve
satatamabhyavaharato na mṛtyurbhavati || 93 || 

atha viṣādiheturyasyāpi mṛtyurna, taṃ samādiśati ---- 


athāhinā mahādevi dūṣitaḥ sādhako yadā | 


tadā ---- 


mūlamantrasamopetamaghoraṃ tatra yojayet || 9-94 || 


mūlamantraḥ śrīcatuṣkalaḥ, tena samopetaṃ sampuṭīkṛtam | tatreti 
ahidūṣaṇapraśāntinimittam | asyānte "bhagavan viṣaṃ śamaya-śamaya huṃ 
phaṭ" iti krūrajātyanta ūhaḥ prayoktavya ityarthāt || 94 || 

prayogāvasare ca ---- 


ātmano bhairavaṃ rūpaṃ kṛtvā caiva sudāruṇam | 

daṃṣṭrākarālavikaṭaṃ jvālāmālopaśobhitam || 9-95 || 

sapai(rlā)1lambamānaiḥ khaḍgahastaṃ subhīṣaṇam | 

pūrvarūpasamopetaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham || 9-96 || 

tenākrāntaṃ mahādevi daṣṭakaṃ tu vicintayet | 

tajjvālābhiḥ sudīptābhirdagdhaṃ saṃcintayed viṣam || 9-97 || 

tatkṣaṇād devadeveśi nivīṣaḥ sa tu jāyate | 


kṛtveti dhyātvā, sarpairiti hārakaṭakādisthairupalakṣitam | pūrvarūpaṃ 
śrīkoṭarākṣasambandhi | ahidūṣitatvaṃ viṣadūṣitatvopalakṣaṇaparam 
|| 

kiṃ ca ---- 


graheṣvevaṃvidhaṃ dhyānaṃ yaḥ kuryāt.........


saḥ ---- 


...................ṃocayet kṣaṇāt || 9-98 || 


tebhyo'pasmārādigrahebhyaḥ sādhyamityarthāt | atra ca "bhagavannasya 
sādhyasya grahaṃ śamaya śamaya huṃ phaṭ" 
ityantapūrvoktamantrābhimantritenāmbhaḥkusumādinā sādhyaṃ 
tāḍayedityarthāt || 98 || 

dhyānāsamarthaṃ prati viṣaśamanaṃ 
kāruṇikatvādoṣadhiprayogairapyādiśati śambhuḥ ---- 


atha dhyāne hyakuśalo yadā kaścinnaro bhavet | 

tadāgadairmahādevi nivīṣaṃ kurute kṣaṇāt || 9-99 || 


daṣṭaṃ bhakṣitaviṣaṃ ca || 99 || 

agadamāha ---- 


kumāridvitayaṃ gṛhya nāginyā tu sahaikataḥ | 

gokaṇīkāsitaṃ mūlaṃ somāhvāmūlasaṃyutam || 9-100 || 

āmagokṣīrasaṃpiṣṭaṃ bhakṣayennivīṣo bhavet | 


kumāryākhyauṣadhiḥ saphalā bandhyā ceti dvirūpāpi, 
nāginyāmahāgonāsāhvayā saha gokṣīrapiṣṭamityekaḥ prayogaḥ | 
gokaṇīkā girikaṇīkā, somāhvā somarājī, tayoḥ sitaṃ mūlaṃ 
gokṣīrapiṣṭamiti dvitīyaḥ, kṣīreṇa piṣṭamapyetaddhṛtena saha pāne 
nasye vā prayoktavyam | 

yadvakṣyati ---- 

"agadān ghṛtasaṃyuktān pibet" (9-108) ityādi || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


gonimbasya ca mūlena nivīṣatvaṃ prajāyate || 9-101 || 


gonimbo bhūmyāmalakī | kvacittu eraṇḍasya mūleneti pāṭhaḥ | atrāpi 
āmagokṣīrapiṣṭatvaṃ sthitameva || 101 || 


aśvamārasya mūlaṃ tu udakena tu peṣayet | 

pāne nasye pradātavyaṃ tadā bhavati nivīṣaḥ || 9-102 || 


aśvamāraḥ karavīrakam || 102 || 


āragvadhasya mūlaṃ tu udakena ca peṣayet | 

pāne nasye pradātavyaṃ tadā bhavati nivīṣaḥ || 9-103 || 


āragvadhamārocakamiti prasiddham || 103 || 


madhukasya tu sāraṃ yannasye pāne prayojayet | 

nivīṣastu prajāyeta bhairavasya vaco yathā || 9-104 || 


madhukasya madhūkasya sāra āntaro bhāgastaṃ dvayoḥ | prakrāntatvād 
udakena kṣīreṇa vā piṣṭvā, nasye pāne pradātavyam | madhukaṃ 
madhuyaṣṭirityanye || 104 || 


jambulāsikamūlaṃ tu pāne nasye prayojayet | 

nivīṣastu bhaved devi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 9-105 || 


jambulāsikamūlaṃ jambuvṛkṣamūlam | atrāpi gokṣīrapiṣṭamiti sthitameva 
|| 105 || 

atha viṣānākramaṇahetumagadaguṭikāprayogamāha ---- 


ṣaḍbindupaṭakharjūrasūkṣmacūrṇaṃ tu kārayet | 

mayūrapittasaṃyuktaṃ guṭikāṃ kārayet priye || 9-106 || 

trilohaveṣṭitāṃ kṛtvā kare kaṇṭhe nidhāpayet | 

na viṣaṃ kramate tasya yaśca daṣṭo mahoragaiḥ || 9-107 || 


ṣaḍbinduḥ prāṇiviśeṣaḥ | paṭakharjūraṃ śatapadī | guṭikāṃ 
kārayedityanantaraṃ tāṃ ceti, nidhāpayedityanantaraṃ "yataḥ" iti 
cādhyāhāryam | trilohaṃ hemarajatatāmram || 107 || 

agadaprayoge śeṣavidhimāha ---- 


agadān ghṛtasaṃyuktān pibed vai viṣadūṣitaḥ | 

na viṣaṃ kramate tasya iti śāstrasya niścayaḥ || 9-108 || 


eteṣvagadeṣu vānyeṣu vā pṛthakpṛthak 
kuṇḍalīyagāruḍyekavīrābalāmoṭādimūlaviṣayeṣu niṣkampapratipattinā 
prayujyamāneṣvavisamvāditā bhavatīti darśayan paṭalamupasaṃharati ---- 


evamanye'pi ye yogāḥ svacchandena vinimītāḥ | 

kālāgnirnarakāścaiva pātālā hāṭakeśvaraḥ || 9-109 || 

pradadyād bhāvitātmā ca siddhyante nātra saśayaḥ | 


svacchandeneti sarvaṃ hi parameśvareṇa pravatītam | yaduktaṃ 
śrīśrīkaṇṭhyām ---- 


"pravarteteśvarāt sarvaṃ nivarteta tatheśvarāt | 

īśvarādhiṣṭhitaṃ sarvaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam || 

mahādevāt paraṃ nāsti satyametanna cānyathā | "


iti | ca evārthe, bhāvitātmaiva prayuñjītetyarthaḥ | pāṭalikī 
saṅgatiradūra eva ---- 

"kālāgnirnarakāścaiva pātālā hāṭakeśvaraḥ" (9-109)

ityādinā paṭalāntaṃ kaṭākṣayatā granthena kṛteti śivam || 

"vyādhīnāmagadaṃ divyamādhīnāṃ mūlakartanam | 

upadravāṇāṃ dalanaṃ mahādevamupāsmahe ||" || 


iti śrīsvacchandatantre 
śrīmahāmāheśvarācāryavaryaśrīkṣemarājaviracitoddyotākhyavyākhyopete 
navamaḥ paṭalaḥ || 9 || 




daśamaḥ paṭalaḥ


" svacchandodyotaḥ "


ā kālāgneḥ śivapuraparo yo'yamadhvā sa sarvo
	mūrtyābhāsā sphurati laharī yasya yaścākhilaṃ tam | 

meyatvena prathayati parāṃ mātṛtāṃ bhaktibhājāṃ
	vyaṅktuṃ devo jayati sa mahābhairavaḥ śrīsvatantraḥ || 


navamapaṭalopānte kālāgnirityādinā 
kaṭākṣitādhvasvarūpāvabodhārthaṃ śrīdevyuvāca ---- 


adhvāyaṃ tu mahādeva sūcito na tu vaṇītaḥ | 

kathayasva prasādena sādhakānāṃ hitāya tam || 10-1 || 


pārameśadhāmaprāptyupāyaḥ prabuddhairadanīyaścādhvāyamiti 
navamapaṭalopakrānto bhuvanātmā, sādhakānāmiti bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca 
sādhayatāmācāryādīnām || 1 || 

etatpraśnanirṇayaṃ śrībhairava uvāca ---- 


adhvānaṃ sampravakṣyāmi sādhakānāṃ hitāya vai | 


adhvānamiti bhuvanarūpam, samyak tattadbhuvaneśādhiṣṭhitakrameṇa 
prakarṣeṇa vaitatyena vakṣyāmi || 

taṃ prastauti ---- 


atha kālāgnirudrādhaḥ kaṭāhaḥ saṃvyavasthitaḥ || 10-2 || 

koṭiyojanabāhulyaḥ.............


pṛthvyāḥ sarvatattvāvṛtatvāt tadīyabrahmāṇḍāntaravasthitaṃ 
kālāgnirudrabhuvanamādau, tasyādhaḥ kaṭāho brahmāṇḍakarparaḥ kaṭāha 
iva ca yatra nimajjyonmajjyate kṛcchrāt | bāhulyaṃ ghanatā || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


............ṭasyordhve bhuvanāni tu | 

navanavatikoṭyaścāpyaṇḍānāṃ tu sahasrakam || 10-3 || 

koṭīnāṃ saptatirlakṣāṇyayutānāṃ sahasrakam | 

arbudānyatha vṛndāni kharvāṇi ca tathaiva ca || 10-4 || 

padmāni cāpyasaṃkhyānītyevamādīnyanekaśaḥ | 

teṣāṃ vai nāyako hyatra tvanantaḥ parameśvaraḥ || 10-5 || 


tasya kaṭāhasyordhve pṛṣṭhe karparabāhye ityarthaḥ | navanavatikoṭya 
ityādinā tadbahirvatīnāṃ bhuvanānāṃ brahmāṇḍānāṃ ca 
niḥsaṃkhyatvamucyate | yathoktaṃ śrīmālinīvijaye brahmāṇḍaṃ 
prakṛtyaṇḍaṃ cādhikṛtya ---- 

"pṛthagdvayamasaṃkhyātam" (2-50)

iti | śrīkaṇṭhasaṃhitāyāmapi ---- 

"brahmāṇḍaṃ koṭivistīrṇam"

ityuktam | yattu ṭīkākāraiḥ ---- 

"atha kālāgnirudrādhaḥ" (10-2)

ityatra kālāgnirudrabhuvanasāmīpyādādyaṃ pāthīvamanantabhuvanamuktam, 
aṇḍānāmityatra cāṇḍaśabdena bhuvanānyucyante, teṣāṃ ca 
kālāgnibrahmāṇḍakavāṭayormadhyavatītvamiti vyākhyātam, tadanāgamikaṃ 
svayaṃkalpitamityupekṣyam | yato'nantabhuvanasya prathamatve'pi 
śatarudramadhyavatītvenāṇḍabāhyādhobhāgagatatvamevāgameṣu dṛśyate | 
yathoktaṃ śrīmālinīvijaye ---- 

"tadbahiḥ śatarudrāṇāṃ bhuvanāni pṛthakpṛthak" (5-12)

ityupakramya......

"anantaḥ prathamasteṣāṃ" (5-13) iti | 

ihāpyekādaśe bhaviṣyati ---- 

"anātho'nantarūpeṇa sthitaścādhvani dhārakaḥ" (11-22) 

iti | 

tathā ---- 

śaṃsthitaścāmbhaso mūdhnī śaktyādhārastu hūhukaḥ" (11-24) 

iti | 

etaccānantarameva vyaktībhaviṣyati | aṇḍaśabdasya ca 
bhuvanavācakatvamaprasiddham | evamapi pṛthag bhuvanaśabdo'nupādātavyaḥ 
syāt | vakṣyamāṇe ca 
brahmāṇḍāntarvatībhuvanamānasaṃkhyāmadhye'nantabhuvanamānasyānuddeśa
anna karparikākālāgnibhuvanayormadhye'nantabhuvanam, apitvadhaḥ 
karparikābāhyapṛṣṭhabhāge'dhaḥsthaśatarudradaśakamadhye, ityalam || 5 
|| 

taditthaṃ prapañcavyāptyā'nantabrahmāṇḍāśrayā bhūḥ | tasyāta 
evānantaśabdavācyasya bhagavataḥ śuddhyā 
sarvabrahmāṇḍādhovatīniḥsaṃkhyabhuvanaśuddhirūhakākhyaiḥ 
rudrabhuvanaiḥ sahāsyāṃ bhuvanadīkṣāyāṃ sampadyata ityāha ---- 


tena śuddhena śuddhāni tvaṇḍānyatrohakaiḥ saha | 

ūhante tarkayanti parichindanti viśvamityūhakāḥ || 


kīdṛśairūhakairityāha ---- 


śaktyādhārāśrayaireva...............


śaktiḥ pārameśvaryeva viśvabhittibhūtatvādādhāra 
ivādhārastadāśrayaireva śaktiviśrāntairityarthaḥ || 

te cohakāḥ kiyantaḥ, kīdṛśāḥ, ke ? ---- ityāha ---- 


............ḍvātriṃśatparisaṃkhyayā || 10-6 || 

koṭikoṭiparīvārāstvanaupamyaguṇānvitāḥ | 

divyāṅganaughasaṅkīrṇā bhrūbhaṅgalalitekṣaṇaiḥ || 10-7 || 

sūryāyutapratīkāśāstoraṇāṭṭālamaṇḍitāḥ | 


kiṃ ca ---- 


na tatra duḥkhitaḥ kaścinmuktvā duḥkhamanaṅgajam || 10-8 || 

ramante tatra vai vīrā nārībhiḥ saha līlayā | 

bhuvaneṣu vicitreṣu yonyākāreṣu saṃsthitāḥ || 10-9 || 


anena straiṇabhogaprādhānyamevaiṣāṃ bhuvanānāmupodbalitam || 9 || 

tadittham ---- 


bhuvanānyevamuktāni bhuvanāntaravāsinām | 


"tasyordhve bhuvanāni" (10 | 3) iti yānyupakrāntāni, 
tānīhānantabhuvanamadhyagateṣu bhuvanaviśeṣeṣu ye 
vasantyūhakāsteṣāmāśrayatvenoktāni || 

evaṃ ca dīkṣāyām ---- 


sarvāṇi śuddhimāyānti tānyanante viśodhite || 10-10 || 


svāminyanantabhaṭṭārake dīkṣyaṃ prati bhogapradatvānnivatīte 
tadadhiṣṭhitā ūhakāstadbhuvanāni cānantāni śuddhyanti na bhogadatvena 
bandhakāni bhavantītyarthaḥ | evameva cottaratrāpi 
tattadbhuvaneśaśuddhidvāreṇa bhuvanaśuddhirmantavyā | śodhane 
copasthānādipūrvaṃ vidhimagre vakṣyati | evaṃ karparikāyā 
bāhye'nantabhuvanam || 10 || 

tatastu ---- 


athopariṣṭāt kālāgniḥ śrīkaṇṭhena niveśitaḥ | 

adhikāraṃ prakurute tadājñānuvidhāyakaḥ || 10-11 || 

anekarudrakoṭībhirupetastiṣṭhati priye | 


upariṣṭāditi kaṭāhasya | kālaḥ(gni) saṃhārakṛdagniḥ | yadyapi 
pūrvoktanītyā svatantrabhaṭṭārakamayatvād viśvasyordhvādharapravibhāgo 
nāsti, tathāpi 
tadicchayaivārurukṣūṇāmupadeśyopadeśakānāmayamitthamābhāsitaḥ 
kramaḥ | kālāgnyādiśca parabhairavamayatvād vyāpako'pi tadicchayaiva 
tathāvabhāsitastatra tatra tathā saṃniviṣṭaḥ || 

evaṃ kaṭāhasyādha ūrdhve ca bhuvanadvayamuktvā purapramāṇaṃ 
niṇīnīṣurupakramate ---- 


adhunā sampravakṣyāmi pramāṇaṃ śivanimītam || 10-12 || 

yojanānāṃ varārohe.............


taccopakramata eva ---- 


............yathā bhavati tacchraṇu | 


tatra ---- 


avyaktāddaśabhirbhāgairmahān sthūlo vibhāvyate || 10-13 || 

dvipañcabhāgo mahato bhūtādiḥ sthūla ucyate | 


iha yoginaḥ prati viśvaṃ meyam, ayoginastu prakṛtitattvāt prabhṛti 
meyavyavasthā, māyāyāḥ puruṣaṃ pratyācchādakatvāt kalādeśca 
kañcukarūpatvena grāhakaśaktimayatvāt | prakṛtitattvaṃ tu 
vedyasāmānyarūpaṃ mumūrṣāvasare kaṇṭhagatamiva smaryamāṇaṃ 
pratibhātyeva | kaṇṭho hi prakṛtyadhiṣṭhātuḥ viṣṇoḥ sthitidhāma | 
taditthaṃ vedyarūpādavyaktāddaśaguṇaṃ sthūlatvaṃ mahato buddheḥ | 
buddhirhyadhyavasāyavyāpārarūpā svasamvedanena samvedyate | tasyāśca 
proktaprākṛtarūpād vedyāt sthūlatvaṃ pratītisākṣikameva | 
evaṃbhūtānmahato dvipañcabhāga iti daśaguṇa eva, bhūtānāmādiḥ 
kāraṇaṃ tanmātraṃ sthūlaḥ, na tu bhūtādirahaṅkāro vyākhyeyastasya 
mahata ādhikyenāsañcetyatvāt | tanmātrasvarūpaṃ tu 
vāsanārūpatayāntaḥ sthitaṃ vṛddhasyevābhilāṣāspadībhūtaṃ 
pramadāmātrarūpaṃ sphuratyeva | taccādhyavasāyātmano buddherākāratayā 
sphuratsthūlatāṃ dhatta eva | tadetadantaḥkaraṇaikaparicchedyamityāha ---- 


bhūtādeḥ parimāṇaṃ ca bhāvagrāhyaṃ na cākṣuṣam || 10-14 || 


tadīdṛśāt ---- 


bhūtāderyaddaśaguṇamaṇīyo dṛśyate rajaḥ | 

jālāntaragate bhānau paramāṇuḥ sa ucyate || 10-15 || 


aṇīyaḥ svalpataraṃ, bhūtādyapekṣayā tu daśaguṇaṃ sthūlaṃ 
cākṣuṣatvāt | ayaṃ ca paramāṇuḥ tākīkopagataparamāṇuvilakṣaṇaḥ || 
15 || 

īdṛśaśca ---- 


aṣṭānāṃ paramāṇūnāṃ samavāyastu yo bhavet | 

trasareṇuḥ sa vikhyātaḥ tatpadmaraja ucyate || 10-16 | 


samavāyaḥ saṅghaṭṭanam | tasya trasareṇuḥ, padmaraja iti nāmadvayam || 
16 || 


trasareṇavaśca ye tvaṣṭau bālāgraṃ tu vidhīyate | 

bālāgrāṇi tathā tvaṣṭau likṣeti parikītītā || 17 || 

likṣācāśṣṭau viduryūkāṃ yūkāścāṣṭau yavo bhavet | 

aṣṭau yavā varārohe parvāṃguṣṭhamathāṃgulam || 18 || 

dvādaśāṃgulamānena vitastistāla ucyate | 

tāladvayaṃ bhaveddhastaścatuvīṃśatikāṃgulaḥ || 19 || 


bālāgrādīni pramāṇaviśeṣābhidhānāni | 
parvaṇo'ṅguṣṭhamaṃgulamiti paryāyaḥ, vitastestu tālaḥ || 19 || 


caturhasto dhanurdaṇḍo nālikā yūpa eva ca | 


dhanuṣa eva daṇḍo nālikā yūpa iti ca nāma || 


dhanuḥsahasre dve pūrṇe krośaḥ samabhidhīyate || 10-20 || 


krośadvayena gavyūtirgavyūtī dve tu yojanam | 


etatprakṛte yojayati ---- 


anena parimāṇena yojanānāṃ yaśasvini || 10-21 || 

siṃhāsanaṃ mahādīptaṃ sahasradvayavistṛtam | 

sahasramucchirataṃ tasya...........


tasyeti kālāgneḥ || 


.............ṃahāpīṭheṣu suvrate || 10-22 || 

tiṣṭhate yatra deveśaḥ kālo dvādaśalocanaḥ | 


tiṣṭhate prakāśate || 

sa paścimottaraprāgdakṣataḥ ---- 


sitaraktapītakṛṣṇaścaturvaktro mahābalaḥ || 10-23 || 


ūrdhvavaktramasyānunmīlitaṃ bhagavatā daśītaṃ mā bhūd 
bhūrādilokadāha iti || 23 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


raktāṅgo'tha karālaśca piṅgabhrū śmaśrulocanaḥ | 

vaktrajvālā jaṭājvālā lomajvālāḥ sujājvalāḥ || 10-24 || 

jvalantyasyāyudhajvālāḥ sutīvrāḥ karamadhyagāḥ | 


itthaṃ cāyam ---- 


jvalatparvatavad dīpto jvalajjvālābhirājitaḥ || 10-25 || 

daśabāhurmahātmā vai khaḍgakheṭakadhārakaḥ | 

śaraśārṅgavihastaśca pāśāṅkuśadharastathā || 10-26 || 

kapālakhaṭvāṅgadharo varadābhayapāṇibhṛt | 


vihasto viśiṣṭahastaḥ || 

api ca ---- 


daśa yojanalakṣāṇi śarīraṃ bhāti bhāsvaram || 10-27 || 


etad bhāvasvarāyāḥ kānteḥ pramāṇam na tu śarīrasya, anyathā 
prāguktāsanamānasyāsaṅgatatvāpattiḥ | śarīramānaṃ tviha noktam || 27 
|| 


koṭiyojanamānena bhuvanaṃ cāsya jājvalam | 


tacca ---- 


sambhṛtaṃ rudrakanyābhī rudrairjvalitaśūlibhiḥ || 10-28 || 

nānārūpavimānaiśca prajvaladbhiḥ samāvṛtam | 


kiṃ ca ---- 


jvālāstasya viniṣkrāntāḥ koṭayo daśa cordhvataḥ || 10-29 || 


tasyeti bhuvanasya || 29 || 


tasyopariṣṭād deveśi pañca koṭyo varānane | 

na kaścinnivasatyatra dhūmoṣmaparivāritaḥ || 10-30 || 


evaṃ kaṭāhaḥ koṭistadupari kālāgnibhuvanaṃ koṭiḥ, bhuvanajvālā daśa 
koṭayaḥ, śūnyaṃ pañca koṭaya iti saptadaśa | na cātra 
madhye'nantabhuvanaparīmāṇamuktamiti madhye tatparikalpanamasadityuktameva 
|| 30 || 


ataḥ paraṃ varārohe narakāḥ parikītītāḥ | 

pañcāśatkoṭayo devi kathitā hyanupūrvaśaḥ || 10-31 || 


antarbhāvitaṇyarthatvād narān kāyayanti sākrandān sampādayanti 
duḥkhānubhaveneti narakāḥ kathitā iti mahāsaṃhitāsu || 31 || 

iha tu ---- 

pradhānaṃ sampravakṣyāmi śataṃ tatra varānane | 

catvāriṃśatsamopetaṃ kathitaṃ.......


yanmahāsaṃhitāsu tat


................ṇāmataḥ śṛṇu || 10-32 || 

avīcī rauravaścaiva mahāraurava eva ca | 

tāmisraścāndhāmisraḥ sañjīvanasujīvanau || 10-33 || 


tadete ---- 

"avīcirvīcibhiśchannaḥ pūyāsṛkkardamādibhiḥ | 

rudantaḥ prāṇino yatra nikṣipyante sa rauravaḥ ||"

"tāmisrastamasā miśraḥ śarvarīdhvāntadhūsaraḥ | 

tathārūpo'ndhatāmisrastvavibhāvitadiṅaḥmukhaḥ ||"


iti śrīparāyāṃ niruktāḥ | raurava eva sātiśayo mahārauravaḥ | 
yātanābhirmṛtakalpānāṃ punaryātanārthaṃ yatra samyagjīvanam, suṣṭhu 
bhūyobhūyaśca jīvanaṃ tau sañjīvanasujīvanau || 33 || 


padmaścaiva mahāpadmaḥ kālasūtrastathaiva ca | 


ete ca śrīparāyām ---- 

"padmaḥ padmasamākāraḥ suṣīto himakardamaḥ | 

mahāpadmastathārūpaḥ kintu śītahimottaraḥ || 

kālasūtro'sitaḥ pāśastrikaṇṭadṛḍhaveṣṭanaḥ | "


iti niruktāḥ || 


sūcīmukhaḥ........


eṣo'pi ---- 

śūcīmukhaḥ sutīkṣṇāgrasūcīvatpravibhedakaḥ |"

iti tatraivoktaḥ || 


.....ṃahākāyaḥ......


mahān durvāhaḥ kāyo yatra || 


..............kṣuradhāro'siparvataḥ || 34 || 


"kṣuradhāro lunātyaṅgaṃ kṣuradhārānirantaraḥ |"

ityuktaḥ | asiḥ khaḍgastanmayaśca parvato gacchatāṃ duḥkhadaḥ || 34 || 


asistālo drumaścaiva drumamastaka eva ca | 

drumārāmaśca vikhyātaḥ..........


asisaṃjñaḥ ---- 

"khaḍgaśchinatti gātrāṇi khaḍgadhārāparigrahaḥ |"

iti parāyāṃ niruktaḥ | tālo'pi ---- 

"tālastālavadaṅgasthaivīdārayati valkalaiḥ"

iti niruktaḥ | drumo dāruṇavātābhibhavanīyadrumākāro niścaladehahetuḥ 
| drumo mastake yatra sa drumamastakaḥ | evaṃ drumāṇāmārāmaḥ samūho 
yatrāṅgeṣu sa drumārāmaḥ || 


...........kumbhīpākastathaiva ca || 10-35 || 


"kumbhīpāko bṛhadghoraḥ kumbhavaktrojjvalacchikhaḥ |"

iti niruktaḥ || 35 || 


ambareṣo'ṅgārarāśiḥ...........


"ambareṣo'mbarādyasmāt sutīkṣṇeṣūn pravarṣati | 

taptāṅgāro'gnisaṅkāśo lohāṅgāraniketanaḥ ||"


iti niruktāvetau || 


...........ṭīkṣṇatuṇḍastathaiva ca | 

vajratuṇḍaśca śakuniḥ.............


evaṃvidhaśakunibhirjanā yatra tāḍyante || 


...............ṃīnodarakharodarau || 10-36 || 


mīnakharayorudare mahāsantāpade yatra janāḥ pīḍyante || 36 || 


sandaṃśaḥ........


sandaṃśo yatra santaptaiḥ sandaṃśairjanāḥ pīḍyante || 


.....vajrakāyaśca.....


yatra mahāyātanānubhavavatāṃ vajramayaḥ kāyaḥ || 


..............ṃedakaśca varānane | 


yatra mahāsantāpavati medomayaśarīratā || 


uṣṭragrīvo mahākāyo vetālo vaḍavāmukhaḥ || 10-37 || 


uṣṭrasyevātidīrghatvāt kṛṣchreṇāśanīyaprāpaṇī grīvā, 
(mahā)kāyaśca mahān bahvannabharaṇīyaḥ, vetālā jvālāsyā bhayānakā 
yatra | vaḍavāmukhākāro dāruṇo'nalaḥ santāpano yatra || 37 || 


asṛkpūyahradaścaiva.........


asṛghradaḥ pūyahradaśca || 


...........bhramaro maṣakastathā | 


yatra bhramarā maṣakāśca viṣamā daṃśakāriṇaḥ || 


saṃgrahaśca.............


yatra taptodakavajjanāḥ saṃgṛhyante kvāthyante || 


.......kapālaśca......


yatra kapāleṣvivāpūpāḥ janāḥ pacyante || 


...............ṭaptakavaca eva ca || 10-38 || 


yatra taptakavacāntanīviṣṭāṅgāni pīḍyante | 


gajapādo mahāvaktraḥ kūrmākhyo nakulastathā | 


yatra gajapādairjanāḥ pīḍyante | yatra mahāvaktraiḥ prāṇibhiḥ
grasanam | yatra kūrmairnakulaiśca janā bhakṣyante trāsyante ca || 


pīḍanaścaiva..........


yatra mahāśilābhirjanāḥ pīḍyante || 


........kumbhīraḥ......


etannāmamahājalacarabhīṣaṇaḥ || 


..............krakacaḥ śūlameva ca || 10-39 || 


yatra krakacairaṅgacchedanam | yatra ca śūlāropaṇam || 39 || 


anaṅgaścāṅgārodgāraḥ............


yatra tāpenāṅgāni vilīyante | yatra cāṅgārodgārairmahoṣmabhiḥ 
santāpaḥ || 


...............pradīptastrimukhastathā | 

pañcavaktraḥ śatāsyaśca..........


pradīpto'nyatra ---- 

"antaḥsantāpakṛttāpaḥ śoṣitodarakandharaḥ"

ityuktaḥ | tripañcaśatamukhāśca prāṇino yatra daśanti || 


.............jalauko biladhūmakaḥ || 10-40 || 


yatra jalaukaḥsamākhyaiḥ prāṇibhirupadravaḥ | yatra ca dhūmabahuleṣu 
vileṣu janma || 40 || 


sutaptau jatupaṅkaśca..........

śutaptastāpakṛtproktaḥ kevalojjvalitānalaḥ | 

jatupaṅko jvalallākṣāpralepapluṣṭavigrahaḥ ||"

iti śrīparāyāṃ niruktaḥ || 


..............ghorarūpo'tidāruṇaḥ | 


yatra ghorarūpā bhīṣayante, ata evātidāruṇo'yam || 


asthibhaṅgaḥ pūtimāṃsaḥ..........


yatrāsthnāṃ bhaṅgaḥ | yatra ca pūtimayamāṃsadehatā || 


.............ḍravyaścaiva tvamedhyakaḥ || 10-41 || 


yatra dravye bahumūtramadhye'medhyamadhye ca nivāsaḥ || 41 || 


ulūkaḥ paraśurdaṇḍaḥ kākākhyaśca tathaiva ca | 

yatrolūkairbhakṣaṇam, paraśunā chedaḥ, daṇḍaistāḍanam, kākaiśca
bhakṣaṇaṃ janānām || 


socchvāsaśca nirucchvāsaḥ.......


śocchvāsaḥ śvasanaprāyo niśceṣṭakṛtakāśrayaḥ | 

nirucchvāso'kṣasaṃrodhānnirucchvasanalakṣaṇaḥ ||"

||

iti ||

iti |

kardamaḥ........

narakāḥ | khañjarīṭa etannāmakopaghātakapakṣipūrṇaḥ || 


............śabalo nīla eva ca | 


śabalo vicitro nīlo nīḍo yatra || 


kākaḥ.........


viṣamakākapūrṇaḥ || 


..........kaṅkamukhaścaiva......


kaṅkaḥ sandaṃśaḥ, tadākāramukhapakṣimayaḥ || 


..........śivārāvastataḥ paraḥ || 10-50 || 


yatra śivābhirārāvairjanāstrāsyante || 50 || 


gajanādo mahānādaḥ siṃhanādastathaiva ca | 


spaṣṭārthā ete trayaḥ || 


mahāgrāhastathā nakro mūṣikākīṭasāgaraḥ || 10-51 || 


grāhā atikrūrā nakārakhyajalacaraviśeṣavyatiriktāḥ prāṇinaḥ, te 
mahānto yatra sa mahāgrāhaḥ | tathā nakra iti mahānakraḥ | 
mūṣikāmayaḥ sāgaraḥ | kīṭasāgaraḥ sūkṣmakrimibahulāmedhyasāgaraḥ 
| yastu śrīparāyām ---- 

"viṇmūtro viṭchilāśīrṇacūrṇāsyakṛtapūraṇaḥ |"

ityuktaḥ || 51 || 


avākśirāḥ..........


avāg adhaḥ śiraḥ, ūrdhvaṃ tu pādau yatra || 


........ṭrirāvartaḥ.........


trirāvartante samantāt pravartante yatra | yaduktaṃ śrīparāyām ---- 

"trinīvāsaḥ pipāsātībubhukṣāpīḍitodaraḥ" iti || 


.............cakrapīḍanakastathā | 


yatra tilavajjanāścakreṇa pīḍyante || 


trapulepastrapukūpa.........


galitatrapuṇā taptena yatrāṅgāni lipyante | yatra ca tādṛgeva kūpaḥ || 


.......ikṣuyantraḥ......


yatra ikṣuvajjanāḥ pīḍyante || 


.........girerlatā || 10-52 || 


giriprabhavābhivīṣalatābhiryatra janāstāḍyante || 


kaṭaṅkaṭaśca vikhyātaḥ..........


etannāmamahākaṭāhaprakhyo'tiviṣamaḥ kūpaḥ || 


..............ṭaptavāluka eva ca | 


yatrātitaptāsu vālukāsu pāpīyāṃsaḥ sañcāryante || 

tadete sacatvāriṃśacchatasaṃkhyātāḥ ---- 


ete'tighorā narakāstrikoṇāḥ parikītītāḥ || 10-53 || 


narakadeśānāṃ saṃsthānatastrikoṇatvamityarthaḥ || 

ete ca ---- 


asatkarmaratānāṃ ca prāṇināṃ pātanāya tu | 


asad ekādaśapaṭalavakṣyamāṇāt sāmānyaviśeṣātmanaḥ svasmāt 
śāstrād bahiṣkṛtam || 

viśeṣatastu ---- 


nistriṃśakarmakartṝṇāṃ śaṭhānāṃ pāpināṃ tathā || 10-54 || 


nistriṃśakarma paravadhādikam, śaṭhānāṃ 
nivāraṇayāpyanivartamānānām, ata eva prāgajītādeva pāpasaṃskārāt 
punarapi pāpināmityāha || 

itthaṃ caiṣām ---- 


nirdayādhamajātīnāṃ parahiṃsāratātmanām | 


tathā ---- 


paradāraratānāṃ ca.............


viśeṣataḥ ---- 


...........śivaśāstrasya dūṣiṇām || 10-55 || 

devadravyāpahartṝṇāṃ brahmaghnapitṛghātinām | 

goghnānāṃ ca kṛtaghnānāṃ mitravisrambhaghātinām || 10-56 || 


kṛtamupakāraṃ ghnantīti kṛtaghnāḥ | mitraṃ visrambheṇa viśvāsena 
ghnantīti tacchīlā mitravisrambhaghātinaḥ || 56 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


suvarṇabhūmihartṝṇāṃ śaucācāranivatīnām | 

dayādāk.qiṇyahīnānāṃ paiśunyānṛtacetasām || 10-57 || 

narakāstu samākhyātāstvakarmapathavatīnām | 


śaucamācāraśca nijanijaśāstroktau | anyathā ---- 

"kiñcijjñairyā smṛtā śuddhiḥ sāśuddhiḥ śambhudarśane | 

na śuddhirhyaśucistasmānnivīkalpo bhavennaraḥ ||"

ityādiśrutenīvīṣayatvaṃ syāt ---- 

"jihmajenopavītena" (3-2)

ityādi ca pūrvoktamavācyaṃ syāt | atra ca yathāyogaṃ 
śarīramanovāgviṣayatvaṃ yojyam | etadevākarmapathavatītvaṃ yat 
svaśāstraviruddhācaraṇam | prakarṣāprakarṣayogāccaiṣāṃ pāpānāṃ 
taducitanarakasambandhaḥ || 

ye tu etadviparītāste ---- 


śubhakarmaratā lokā narake na patanti hi || 10-58 || 


yacca teṣāṃ sambandhi su(bhaṃ)1 karma ---- 


tatsamāsena vakṣyāmi yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ | 


anupūrvaśaḥ--

"vācyarthā niyatāḥ sarve vāṅmūlā vāṅnibandhanāḥ"

ityuktatvād vācikādikrameṇa || 

tacca ---- 


satyaṃ kṣāntirahiṃsā ca...........


etāni vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmāṇi sukhāni || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


.............śaucaṃ snānamakalkatā || 10-59 || 

dayālaulyaṃ ca yasyāsau narakān nādhigacchati | 


śaucaṃ prāgvat | snānaṃ bhasamādināpi | akalkatā śubhasaṅkalpatā | 
alaulyamindriyācāpalam | 


śānto dāntaḥ suhṛṣṭātmā tvanahaṅkāravān samaḥ || 10-60 || 

adrohī cānasūyaśca paraiśvarye ca niḥspṛhaḥ | 


narakānnādhigacchatītyeva | śānto jitacittaḥ | dānto jitendriyaḥ | 
ataśca viṣayavaivaśyābhāvāt suhṛṣṭātmā, nirahaṅkāraśca | samaḥ 
śatrumitrādi sāmyena paśyan | paraiśvarye niḥspṛhaḥ santuṣṭaḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


amātsaryamamānitvaṃ śivabhaktiracāpalam || 10-61 || 

japadhyānaratiḥ sthairyaṃ kārpaṇyasya ca varjanam | 

vratāni niyamāścaiva svādhyāyaśca trisaṃdhyatā || 10-62 || 

sarvatra śraddadhānatvamārjavaṃ hrīrmanasvitā | 

tejaḥ praśāntiḥ santoṣo'priyavākyavivarjanam || 10-63 || 

samīkṣyakāritā nityaṃ manohaṅkāranigrahaḥ | 

adambhitvamamāyitvamakalko jñānaśīlatā || 10-64 || 

pitṛdevārcane bhaktirgobrāhmaṇaśaraṇyatā | 

agnau homo gurordānaṃ jñānināṃ paryupāsanam || 10-65 || 

ekānte ca ratirdhyānamātmanyeva ca tuṣṭatā | 

avyāpāraḥ parārtheṣu audāsīnyamanāgasaḥ || 10-66 || 

akrodhitvamanālasyamete dharmāḥ prakītītāḥ | 


śivabhaktirmukhyo dharmaḥ | acāpalaṃ kartavyaviṣayā ruḍhiḥ, viśeṣāttu 
japadhyānaviśrāntau | tejaḥ parānabhibhavanīyatvam | praśāntiḥ 
saumyadarśanatā | manohaṅkārayonīgraho yatra tatra vartanaparihāraḥ | 
dambho mithyācāratā | māyā paravañcanam | akalko'pāpacittaḥ | 
parārtheṣu paravitteṣu, avyāpāro manasāpyacintanam | audāsīnyamiti 
vyavahāraviṣayam | anāgasa ityanāgastvaṃ gurvājñādāvapramāditvam | 
anālasyamityupādeyānuṣṭhānodyogaḥ | ete dharmāḥ śubhā ācārāḥ || 

ataśca ---- 


yastvetān bhajate bhāvān so'mṛtatvāya kalpate || 10-67 || 


śive bhaktirekaiva mokṣapradā kimaṅgaitaddharmāntarasahitā || 67 || 

yasmāt ---- 


naśyanti pauruṣāḥ pāśā ye'pyanantāḥ prakītītāḥ | 

śivācāraratānāṃ tu dhāmīkāṇāṃ hi dehinām || 10-68 || 

tasmādevaṃ tu vijñāya mano dharme niyojayet | 


puruṣatattvabhuvanāvasare pauruṣā ye pāśā vakṣyante, te'pi 
śivabhaktibhājāṃ naśyanti | dharma iti proktarūpe || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


yasya cittamasambhrāntaṃ nivīkalpamakalmaṣam || 10-69 || 

sa yāti paramāṃllokānnarakāṃśca na paśyati | 


akalmaṣatvādapāpatvād nivīkalpaṃ kṛtvā tāttvike'rthe samāśvastam | 
na paśyatīti darśanamātramapyasya nāstīti tadupabhoge kaiva sambhāvanā 
|| 


yasya buddhirasaṃmūḍhā sarvabhūteṣvapātakī || 10-70 || 

akalkavān sattvavān yo narakān na paśyati | 


asaṃmūḍhā nivṛttājñānā | akalkavān śuddhāśayaḥ, ata eva 
sattvavṛttiniṣṭhaḥ || 


jitāni yenendriyāṇi mano yasya vaśe sthitam || 10-71 || 

tajjayena jitaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram | 


sarvābhogabhūranena suprāpetyarthaḥ || 

etadeva ślāghate ---- 


svakārye parakārye vā yasya buddhiḥ sthirā bhavet || 10-72 || 

etadeva hi pāṇḍityaṃ śeṣāḥ pustakavācakāḥ | 


svakāryamātmajñānaniṣṭhatvam, parakāryaṃ pareṣāmātmajñāne yojanam 
|| 

upasaṃharati ---- 


ityeṣa tāntriko nyāyaḥ kathitastu samāsataḥ || 10-73 || 

atāntrikāṇāmanyeṣāṃ parisaṃkhyā na vidyate | 


tāntrikaḥ parameśasaṃhitāprasiddhaḥ | atāntrikāḥ 
dharmasūtrakārādiprasiddhāḥ || 

asāmānyairācāraiḥ ---- 


śivaśāstraratā ye tu gurubhaktiparāyaṇāḥ || 10-74 || 

paratattvavido ye tu na teṣāṃ duritaṃ bhavet | 


duṣṭamitamāgamanaṃ janmetyarthaḥ || 

evaṃ prasaṅgāduktvā prakṛtamāha ---- 


eteṣāṃ narakāṇāṃ tu pradhānāni nibodha me || 10-75 || 

pañcatriṃśattu narakāḥ...........


yasmādeta eva ---- 


..............caturbhedāḥ prakītītāḥ | 


pañcatriṃśat catubhīrguṇitāścatvāriṃśadadhikaṃ śataṃ 
bhavatītyarthaḥ || 

tadāha ---- 


catvāriṃśacchataṃ hyetat samāsāt parikītītam || 10-76 || 


yasmāt ---- 


taivīśuddhaivīśuddhyanti pañcāśatkoṭayastu tāḥ | 


tairiti catvāriṃśadadhikaśatasaṃkhyaiḥ | tā iti pūrvopakrāntāḥ || 

yadi vā ---- 


pañcatriṃśadyadā vaite dvātriṃśadvā viśodhitāḥ || 10-77 || 

catvāriṃśacchataṃ śuddhaṃ tadetat syādvarānane | 


avīcīkumbhīpākarauravavarjaṃ vakṣyamāṇanāmāno dvātriṃśat || 

yadvā ---- 


tribhiḥ śuddhaistu dvātriṃśacchuddhā eva bhavanti hi || 10-78 || 


nivīśeṣaṃ na sāmānyamiti sthityā sāmānyaśuddhyā viśeṣaśuddhiḥ, 
viśeṣāṇāṃ vā garbhīkṛtasāmānyānāṃ śuddhyā sāmānyaśuddhiḥ | 
atra cāyaṃ gurūṇāmāśayaḥ ---- yasya dīkṣyasya pāpabhūyastvaṃ 
niścitam, tasya vitatya narakaśuddhiḥ kartavyā, anyasya tu saṃkṣepeṇeti 
praghaṭṭakacatuṣṭayena śuddhiratroktā kiraṇāyāṃ tu 
praghaṭṭakatrayeṇa | yaduktam ---- 

"catvāriṃśatsamadhikaṃ yadeteṣāṃ prakītītam | 

dvātriṃśattatra rājāno rājarājeśvarāstrayaḥ ||" 

iti | 

śrīmālinīvijaye kūṣmāṇḍarudraśuddhyaiva tacchuddhirukteti 
prakriyābhedaḥ || 78 || 

atha ---- 


teṣāṃ nāmāni vakṣyāmi trayāṇāṃ varavaṇīni | 

avīciścaiva vikhyātaḥ kumbhīpākaśca dāruṇaḥ || 10-79 || 

mahārauravarājaśca............


atha ---- 


............ṣthānaṃ teṣāṃ nibodha me | 

adhomadhyordhvabhāgeṣu saṃsthitāste yathākramam || 10-80 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


vyāptiṃ teṣāṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ | 


dvātriṃśannarakāstribhiryathāntargarbhīkāreṇa vyāptāḥ, tathetyarthaḥ 
|| 

atra ---- 


narakaikādaśagatamavīciṃ śodhayet priye || 10-81 || 

ātmanā dvādaśaṃ devi kumbhīpākaṃ viśodhayet | 

mahārauravasaṃjñaṃ cāpyevameva na saṃśayaḥ || 10-82 || 


tānetān ---- 


pañcatriṃśat pravakṣyāmi samāsena varānane | 

avīciḥ kriminicayo nadī vaitaraṇī tathā || 10-83 || 

lohaśca śālmaliścaivāpyasiparvata eva ca | 

socchvāsaśca nirucchvāsaḥ pūtimāṃsaḥ parastathā || 10-84 || 

taptatrapuḥ kṣārakūpo jatulepastathaiva ca | 

antarbhūtā avīcau tu...........


avīcireva kriminicayapadena viśeṣito na tu pūrvanidīṣṭādasau 
vyatiriktaḥ saṃkhyādhikyaprasaṅgāt || 

atha ---- 


.............kumbhīpākasya śrūyatām || 10-85 || 


asthibha ngaḥ krakacacchedaḥ kūpaścāpi kaṭaṅkaṭaḥ | vasāmiśro 
hyayastuṇḍastrapulepaḥ prakītītaḥ || 86 || 


kumbhīpākaśca vijñeyastīkṣṇāsiśca tathaiva ca | 

taptalohaśca vijñeyaḥ kṣuradhārapathastathā || 10-87 || 

aśaniśca sutaptaśca dvādaśaite prakītītāḥ | 

ekādaśāntavījñeyāḥ kumbhīpākasya dāruṇāḥ || 10-88 || 

mahārauravarāje ca ata ūrdhvaṃ nibodha me | 

kālasūtro mahāpadmaḥ kumbhaḥ sañjīvanekṣukau || 10-89 || 

pāśo'mbareṣakaścaiva ayaḥpaṭṭastathaiva ca | 

daṇḍayantrastvamedhyaśca ghorarūpastathāparaḥ || 10-90 || 

mahāraurava eteṣāmupariṣṭād vyavasthitaḥ | 


vasāmiśra iti yaḥ pūrvaṃ medaka uktaḥ | ayastuṇḍastu tīkṣṇatuṇḍa 
iti, tīkṣṇāsirasiriti, kumbhastu kumbhīra iti, aśanirityaśanī 
vṛṣṭimudgarāviti, pāśo'pyuraga iti, daṇḍayantro daṇḍa iti 
pūrvamuktaḥ || 

yadā''dāvavīcyāditrayameva śodhyate, tadā ---- 


avīcau kṛminarakān kumbhīpāke sudāruṇān || 10-91 || 

mahārauravake'medhyānantarbhūtān vicintayet | 


athaitaistribhirvyāptānām ---- 


dvātriṃśannarakāṇāṃ ca mānaṃ caiva nibodha me || 10-92 || 


tatra yojanānām ---- 


navanavatirlakṣāṇi ekaikasyocchrayaḥ smṛtaḥ | 


ete ca ---- 


lakṣamātrāntarā jñeyā dvātriṃśaccāpyanukramāt || 10-93 || 


evametanmānaṃ dvātriṃśatkoṭayo narakabhūḥ || 93 || 

atha ---- 


eteṣāmupariṣṭāttu prabhutvena varānane | 

yogaiśvaryaguṇopetaḥ kūṣmāṇḍādhipatiḥ sthitaḥ || 10-94 || 


eṣa ca ---- 


"kviti kṣitiḥ samuddiṣṭā tasyāmūṣmānulomataḥ | 

so('ṇḍo)1 yadvaddurālokaḥ kūṣmāṇḍastadvadudbhaṭaḥ ||"


iti śrīparāyāṃ niruktaḥ | asya ca kukarmajanānuśāsakatvāt 
krūrarūpatvaṃ krūrarūpanirvṛttatvaṃ ca śrīparāyāmuktamataḥ 
samastanarakaśuddhiṃ kṛtvaitacchrāvaṇā kāryāṃ | evamanyatra || 94 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


navanavatirlakṣāṇi puraṃ tasya prakītītam | 


atha ---- 


tasyopariṣṭāt pātālān kathayāmi samāsataḥ || 10-95 || 

ābhāsaṃ varatālaṃ ca śarkaraṃ ca gabhastimat | 

mahātalaṃ ca sutalaṃ rasātalamataḥ param || 10-96 || 

sauvarṇamaṣṭamaṃ jñeyaṃ sarvakāmasamanvitam | 


viśeṣaṇametatsarvasādhāraṇam | ā samantāt sarvaratnādibhirbhāsanāt, 
varabhogayogāt, śarkarāvat spṛhaṇīyaguṇatvāt, bhāsvaratvāt, 
mahābhogayuktatvāt, śobhanatalatvāt, rasāsvādayuktatvāt, 
suvarṇamayatvācca etānyeṣāṃ nāmāni | yaduktaṃ śrīparāyām ---- 

śamantāt sarvaratnānāṃ bhāso yasmādvibhāntyalam | 

taddharmyāṇāṃ ca tatstrīṇāmābhāsaṃ tena tatsmṛtam ||"

ityādi | śarkarākhyaṃ tu tatra nitarāṃ bhogasampattyāditalamityuktam || 

atha ---- 


ābhāsādyāvat sauvarṇaṃ pramāṇaṃ kathayāmi te || 10-97 || 

sahasranavakotsedhamekaikaṃ tu purottamam | 


utsedha aunnatyam || 

tathā ---- 


ekaikasyāntaraṃ jñeyaṃ sahasraparisaṃkhyayā || 10-98 || 


evaṃ pātālātyaśītisahasrāṇi || 98 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


chatrākārāṇi sarvāṇi teṣāṃ vai bhuvanāni tu | 

sarvakāmaiḥ sametāni guṇaiḥ sarvairyutāni tu || 10-99 || 

hemaprākāraśikharaiśchatradhvajasamākulaiḥ | 

kiṅkiṇījālamukharaistoraṇāṭṭālamaṇḍitaiḥ || 10-100 || 

nirgamaiḥ sagavākṣaiśca divyavastravibhūṣitaiḥ | 

tantrīmurajavādyaiśca geyatūryaravākulaiḥ || 10-101 || 

nānābhuvanapaṅ ktyoghaiḥ sarvaratnasamujjvalaiḥ | 

prasādaistuṅgaśikharaiścandrātapasamaprabhaiḥ || 10-102 || 

rathyāmārgavarārāmaiḥ sadāpuṣpaphalānvitaiḥ | 

kokilārāvamadhuraiḥ śikhiṣaṭpadasevitaiḥ || 10-103 || 

haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇaiścakravākopaśobhitaiḥ | 

sārasārāvasaṃghuṣṭapadminīṣaṇḍamaṇḍitaiḥ	 || 10-104 || 

taḍāgaiḥ svacchatoyāḍhyairdīghīkābhiryutāni tu | 

puruṣaiśca mahākāyairmahābalaparākramaiḥ || 10-105 || 

sarvaiśvaryasvarūpāḍhyaiḥ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutaiḥ | 

divyavastraiḥ sutāmbūlaidīvyagandhānulepanaiḥ || 10-106 || 

divyābharaṇasaṃyuktairmukuṭai ratnamaṇḍitaiḥ | 


yuktānītyeva | mukuṭairityupalakṣitairityarthaḥ || 


kiṃ ca ---- 


śivārādhanasaktā ye tatprasādena sādhakāḥ || 10-107 || 

te viśanti mahādevi pātālaṃ siddhasevitam | 


tatprasādeneti kākākṣivad yojyam || 

viṣṭvā tu ---- 


rasaṃ rasāyanaṃ divyaṃ siddhadravyaṃ labhanti te || 10-108 || 


rasaṃ hemasādhanam | rasāyanaṃ śarīrasthairyahetuḥ | siddhadravyaṃ 
pādukādi | taducitasiddhyarthaṃ labdhvā yathāruci bhuvanāni 
carantītyarthaḥ || 108 || 

ye tu tato na niryānti, te ---- 


krīḍanti cānye satataṃ divyānāṃ yoṣitāṃ gaṇaiḥ | 

kāminaḥ(kāmarūpābhiḥ)1 mattamātaṅgagāmibhiḥ || 10-109 || 

sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaiḥ kāmaśāstrasupeśalaiḥ | 

divyavastraparīdhānaiḥ stanabhārasamānataiḥ || 10-110 || 

madhyakṣāmaiḥ prasannāsyaistaralāyatalocanaiḥ | 

sakiṅkiṇīnitambaiśca hārakeyūraśobhitaiḥ || 10-111 || 

sugandhigandhaliptāṅgaiḥ kāñcīmekhalamaṇḍitaiḥ | 

evaṃ te kathitā devi pātālāntaravāsinaḥ || 10-112 || 


kiṃ ca ---- 

trayo'surāstathā nāgā rākṣasāśca vibhāgataḥ | 

ekaikatra ca pātāle kathitāste varānane || 10-113 || 


kathitā ityetadanyaśāstroktaṃ śrībhairavaḥ śrīdekā smārayati | tathā 
ca śrīparāyām ----
