"ābhāse śaṅkukarṇākhyaḥ kuṭilo vikalaḥ patiḥ | 

varatāle'pi prahlādo vāsukirlohitānanaḥ || 

(vi)1 tale śiśupālākhyaḥ kambalo yamadaṃṣṭrakaḥ | 

gabhastyākhye sakarkandhuḥ karkaṭo vikaṭānanaḥ || 

mahātale hiraṇyākhyaḥ kālāṅgaśca karāṅgakaḥ | 

rasātale bṛhadbhogo durdarśo bhīmaniḥsvanaḥ || 

ṣaḍetāni trikhaṇḍāni bhogyānyebhirmahātmabhiḥ | 

sutale saṃsthito'dhastād balistakṣakapiṅgalau ||"


ityuktam || 113 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


pātālasaptake jñeyāstathānye bhuvanādhipāḥ | 

balo hyatibalaścaiva balavān balavikramaḥ || 10-114 || 

subalo balabhadraśca balādhyakṣaśca kītītāḥ | 


yataḥ saptasu pātāleṣu yathākramaṃ sthitā ete rudrāstataḥ ---- 


etaiḥ śuddhairime śuddhāḥ saptapātālavāsinaḥ || 10-115 || 


saptasu pātāleṣu bhūmnā vasanaṃ yaiḥ svakarmājītairbhogaviśeṣaiḥ, ta 
ime proktā bhogaviśeṣāḥ śuddhyantītyarthaḥ || 115 || 

atastu ---- 


yadūrdhve caiva sauvarṇaṃ pātālaṃ parikītītam | 

tatra vasatyasau devo hāṭakaḥ parameśvaraḥ || 10-116 || 

purakoṭisahasraistu samantāt parivāritaḥ | 

siddhai rudragaṇaidīvyairbhaginīmātṛbhirvṛtaḥ || 10-117 || 


siddhaiḥ rudrairiti siddhaviśeṣāptarudramūtībhiḥ, bhaginyo 
brāhmyādyaṅkośadbhūtā devyaḥ, mātarastu brāhmyādyāḥ, tā hi 
prapañcavyāptyā parāparabhāvena prāyaḥ sarvatra sthitāḥ || 117 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


yoginīyogakanyābhī rudraiścaiva sakanyakaiḥ | 


yoginyo yogena siddhāḥ, yogakanyāstu jātamātrā eva saṃsmāritayogāḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


siddhadravyasamairmantraiścintāmaṇirasāyanaiḥ || 10-118 || 


siddhadravyasamatvaṃ prāptamātrāṇāmevābhīṣṭapradatvam | 
cintāmaṇibhiḥ rasāyanaiścetyarthaḥ || 118 || 

tadittham ---- 


siddhavidyāsamṛddhaṃ vai hāṭakeśasya mandiram | 


etacca uktarudrādyupalakṣaṇaparam || 

hāṭakapadaṃ nirvakti ---- 


haṭhāt praveśayellokāṃstadbhāvagatamānasān || 10-119 || 

tenāsau hāṭakaḥ prokto devadevo maheśvaraḥ | 


devānāṃ balādīnāṃ devaḥ | bhagavataḥ śrīkaṇṭhasyaivetthaṃ 
bhogapradatvenānayā mūrtyā sthitatvānmaheśvaraḥ || 

evaṃ cāntarbhūtapātālasaptake tatpuraśuddhau 
hāṭakarudropasthāpanapūrvaṃ 
caturthapaṭaloktādhvasandhānādisamastetikartavyatāṃ śrāvaṇāntāṃ 
kuryāt | evaṃ pratibhuvaneśametadeva smartavyam | tadevaṃ bhūkaṭāhaḥ 
koṭiḥ, kālāgnirudrapuraṃ koṭiḥ, tajjvālā daśa koṭayaḥ, dhūmaḥ 
pañca koṭayaḥ, narakā dvātriṃśatkoṭayaḥ, kūṣmāṇḍapuraṃ 
navanavatilakṣāṇi, pātālamaśītisahasrāṇi, ityevaṃ 
sahasraviṃśatyūnāḥ pañcāśatkoṭayaḥ | etāvadanto'dhvā 
koṭipañcāśataiva, śiṣṭāni tu ---- 


tasyordhve tu sahasrāṇi yojanānāṃ tu viṃśatiḥ || 10-120 || 

bhūkaṭāhaḥ samuddiṣṭaḥ samantāttu varānane | 


bhūkaṭāho manuṣyādhārabhūḥ | evamiyadantaṃ brahmāṇḍasyārdham ||  


ato bhagavatī pṛthvī nānājanapadākulā || 10-121 || 

tasyā madhye mahāmeruḥ sauvarṇaśca varānane | 

tasyācalasya vistāramūrdhvādhaḥ kathayāmi te || 10-122 || 


janapado lokānāṃ nivāsaḥ || 122 || 

tatra ---- 


yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi caturaśītirucchirataḥ | 

ṣoḍaśaiva sahasrāṇi adhobhāge praropitaḥ || 10-123 || 


vaipulyamasyāha ---- 


tānyeva mūlavistāraḥ..........


tānīti ṣoḍaśaiva || 


.............ḍviguṇo mūrdhavistaraḥ | 


dvātriṃśanmūrdhavistāro'syetyarthaḥ | 


"bhairavīyaṃ ca talliṅgaṃ dharaṇī cāsya pīṭhikā | " (taṃ0ā0 8-45)

iti guravaḥ | eṣa ca śrīparāyāṃ kaṇīkākāramastaka ityuktaḥ || 

atha ---- 


tasyordhve tu sabhā divyā nāmnā caiva manovatī || 10-124 || 

caturdaśa sahasrāṇi yojanānāṃ pramāṇataḥ | 

sarvaratnasuśobhāḍhyā strīsahasrasamanvitā || 10-125 || 

sarvabhogagaṇopetā brahmaṇastu mahātmanaḥ | 


brahmaṇaḥ satyalokasthabrahmāṃśāvatārasyāsthānabhūḥ, ataśca sarvatra
madhyaṃ brahmasthānamucyate || 

sā ca ---- 


siddhavidyādharākīrṇā ṛṣibhiḥ parivāritā || 10-126 || 

tasyā īśānadigbhāge jyotiṣkaṃ śikharaṃ smṛtam | 


jyotiṣkaṃ sphāṭikam || 

tacca ---- 


sūryakoṭipratīkāśaṃ gaṇaprathamasevitam || 10-127 || 

sarvartukusumopetaṃ devagandharvasevitam | 

strīsahasrasamākīrṇaṃ sarvaiśvaryasamanvitam || 10-128 || 


gaṇaprathamāḥ pradhānagaṇāḥ || 128 || 


tatrāste bhagavān devastryambakaḥ parameśvaraḥ | 

lokapālairvṛto'sau hi brahmaviṣṇvindranāyakaḥ || 10-129 || 

mamāṃśaṃ taṃ vijānīyāḥ surasiddhanamaskṛtam | 


kailāsavāsina umāpateriyamuktiḥ || 

sa ca tatra ---- 


adhikāraṃ prakurute parecchāsampracoditaḥ || 10-130 || 


evaṃ cābhidadhat para evāhaṃ śrīsadāśiveśānantaśrīkaṇṭharūpatayā 
viṣṇubhuvanordhvastharudratvena meruśikharagatatryambakatvena ca 
prapañcavyāptyāvasthito na tu pṛthaktva meṣāmityādiśati | adhikāraṃ 
brahmaviṣṇvindranāyakatvameva | etacca śṛṅgapradhānatvādihoktam, na 
tvetadevāsti, śrīcandragarbhādau ---- 

"śṛṅgatrayasamopetā brahmaviṣṇuharālayāḥ" iti,

śrīkiraṇāyāṃ tu ---- 

"tribhiḥ śṛṅgaiḥ samāyukto rukmakāñcanaratnajaiḥ" | 

iti pratipāditatvāt || 130 || 

asya ca meroḥ ---- 


sabhāyā brahmaṇo'dhastāt sahasrāṇi caturdaśa | 

yojanānāṃ parityajya cakravāṭaḥ samantataḥ || 10-131 || 


cakrākāro vāṭaḥ purīṇāṃ samūhaḥ || 131 || 


eṣa eva ca ---- 


svargāṣṭakaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ.......


yataḥ ---- 


...........ṭatra tiṣṭhanti lokapāḥ | 


indrādayaḥ || 

tatra ---- 


pūrveṇendrasya vikhyātā purī nāmnāmarāvatī || 10-132 || 

tejovatī tathāgneyyāṃ citrabhānoḥ prakītītā | 

dakṣiṇe yamarājasya nāmnā saṃyamanī purī || 10-133 || 

kṛṣṇāṅgārā tu nairṛtyāṃ rākṣaseśasya kītītā | 

paścimena jaleśasya nāmnā śuddhavatī smṛtā || 10-134 || 

vāyavyāṃ tu purī vāyornāmnā gandhavahā priye | 

uttareṇāpi somasya purī nāmnā mahodayā || 10-135 || 

eśānyāmīśarājasya purī nāmnā yaśovatī | 


tathā ---- 


etāsāmuttare devi śṛṇu ṣaḍviṃśatiṃ purīḥ || 10-136 || 

dakṣiṇenāmarāvatyāḥ kāmavatyapsaraḥpurī | 

sauvarṇī siddhasaṅghānāṃ tasyā vai dakṣiṇena tu || 10-137 || 

tasyā vai dakṣiṇainānyā padmarāgopaśobhitā | 

ādityānāṃ purī khyātā nāmnā cāṃśumatī śubhā || 10-138 || 

sādhyānāṃ rājatī divyā khyātā vai kusumāvatī | 



dakṣiṇenetyeva | kāmavatī revatyāḥ purītyasat, kāmavatī sauvarṇīti hi 
nāmanī || 


vahneḥ paścimadigbhāge viśveṣāṃ revatī purī || 10-139 || 


revatyākhyā, viśve devā yatra sthitāḥ || 139 || 


tasyāstu paścime devi divyā vai viśvakarmaṇaḥ | 


divyeti nāmnā || 


paścime dharmarājasya mātṛnandā purī smṛtā || 10-140 || 

krīḍanti mātarastatra madhupānāvighūṇītāḥ | 

rudrāṇāṃ paścime tasyā rohitā nāma kāñcanī || 10-141 || 

tatra śūladharā rudrā yamasya paricārakāḥ | 

tasyāḥ paścimato jñeyā nāmnā guṇavatī purī || 10-142 || 

ekādaśānāṃ rudrāṇāṃ vajrapprākāratoraṇā | 

nirṛteḥ pūrvabhāge tu piṅgalā nāma vai purī || 10-143 || 

svakarmasaṃjñā deveśi piśācāstatra saṃsthitāḥ | 


svena karmaṇā piśitāśanena nimittena saṃjñā yeṣām || 


nairṛtyuttarasāmīpye purī kṛṣṇāvatī smṛtā || 10-144 || 

nistriṃśā nāma tatraiva vasanti rākṣasāḥ sadā | 


nairṛtyā diśa uttaraṃ yatsāmīpyaṃ samīpam, tatra || 


tasyā apyuttare bhāge purī haimī sukhāvatī || 10-145 || 

mitro vasati tatraiva bahubhṛtyajanāvṛtaḥ | 


sukhāvatīti nāmnā || 


tasyā apyuttare haimī gāndharvī nāma viśrutā || 10-146 || 

vasanti tatra gandharvā divyakanyāsamāvṛtāḥ | 

daśakoṭisahasrāṇi teṣāṃ saṃkhyā prakītītā || 10-147 || 

bhūtānāṃ siddhasenā tu varuṇasya tu dakṣiṇe | 

hemasaṃjñā vasūnāṃ tu varuṇasyāpi cottare || 10-148 || 


varuṇasyeti tatpuryāḥ || 148 || 


tasyāstūttarato devi nāmnā siddhavatī purī | 

sarvavidyādharāṇāṃ tu sā purī parikītītā || 10-149 || 

vāyordakṣiṇato devi siddhā nāma purī smṛtā | 

vasanti kinnarāstatra purairhemārkasaprabhaiḥ || 10-150 || 

vāyoḥ pūrveṇa gāndharvī haimī citrarathasya tu | 

gandharvarājamukhyasya divyagandharvanāditā || 10-151 || 

āste bhagavatī sākṣāt saptasvaravibhūṣitā | 

grāmatrayaparīdhānā jātimekhalamaṇḍitā || 10-152 || 

mūrcchanātānacitrāṅgī nānātālakalodayā | 

lakṣaṇavyañjanopetā madhyamenāvaguṇṭhitā || 10-153 || 

gandharvairgīyamānā sā tatra devī sarasvatī | 

nāradādyaiśca ṛṣibhirnāgakinnarasevitā || 10-154 || 


grāmāḥ ṣaḍmadhyamagāndhārāḥ | ṣāḍjīnandayantyādyā 
jātayo'ṣṭādaśa, tā eva mekhalāḥ | svarā mūrcchanti gumphanayā 
samucchrāyaṃ nīyante yābhistā mūrcchanā uttaramandrādyāḥ,

"kramayuktāḥ svarāḥ sapta mūrcchanetyabhiśabditāḥ | " (28-34)

iti bharatanāṭyaśāstre lakṣitā ekaviṃśatiḥ, tāstāyante vistāryante 
yaiste tānāḥ, ekonapañcāśat pañcatriṃśacca | yaduktaṃ tatraiva ---- 

"ṣaṭpañcasvarakāstānā" (28-34)

ityupakramya ---- 

"tatra mūrcchanāśrayāstānāścaturaśītirekānnapañcāśatṣaṭsvarāḥ,

pañcatriṃśatpañcasvarāḥ" (28-35) iti | 

tālāścañcatpuṭādyā yatyātmakāḥ | kalāstu tālākṣararūpā 
gurulaghumātrāḥ | lakṣaṇāni ---- 

"bhūṣaṇākṣarasaṅghātau śobhodāharaṇe tathā |"

ityādīni ṣaṭtriṃśat | vyañjaneti vyajyante yeṣu gītakaviśeṣeṣu 
tairupetā | madhyameneti madhyamākhyena svareṇa 
śravyatātiśayayogādavaguṇṭhitā | nāyikāpakṣe rūpakāṇāṃ 
śleṣacchāyā spaṣṭā || 154 || 


tasyāḥ pūrveṇa citrā vai tumburornāradasya ca | 

somasya paścāt pramadā guhyakānāṃ purī smṛtā || 10-155 || 

pūrveṇaiva tu somasya nāmnā citravatī purī | 

sarvadhātumayī citrā kuberasya mahātmanaḥ || 10-156 || 


sa hi tatra ---- 


ṣaḍviṃśatisahasraistu koṭīnāṃ parivāritaḥ | 

yakṣāṇāmuttamaḥ śrīmānāste bhogairanuttamaiḥ || 10-157 || 


yuktaḥ || 157 || 


tasyāḥ pūrve śubhā nāmnā jāmbūnadamayī purī | 

tatra vai karmadevāstu..........


te ca ---- 


.............ḍevatvaṃ karmaṇā gatāḥ || 10-158 || 


vājapeyādinā || 158 || 


paścimeneśarājasya viṣṇorvai śrīmatī purī | 

tatrāste śrīpatiḥ śrīmānatasīpuṣpasannibhaḥ || 10-159 || 

śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiḥ pītavāsā janārdanaḥ | 

īśasya dakṣiṇe bhāge nāmnā padmavatī purī || 10-160 || 

mahāpadmopaviṣṭasya padmamālādharasya tu | 

padmapatrāyatākṣasya brahmaṇaḥ padmajanmanaḥ || 10-161 || 


satyalokanivāsibrahmāṃśāvatārasya || 161 || 


tasyā dakṣiṇato devi nāmnā kāmasukhāvatī | 

aśvinau tatra deveśi..........


devavaidyau || 


........ṭathā dhanvantariḥ sthitaḥ || 10-162 || 


govaidyaḥ || 162 || 


uttare tvamarāvatyā mahāmedheti viśrutā | 

vināyakānāṃ sā divyā vasatistatra kalpitā || 10-163 || 


te hi pūrvam ---- 


daśakoṭisahasrāṇi vīryavantaḥ "qubhāstathā | 

vināyakā mahādīptā agnijvalitatejasaḥ || 10-164 || 

asurāṇāṃ vadhārthāya aṃguṣṭhānnimītā mayā | 


aṃguṣṭhāt kālāgnisthānānnimītatvād dīptatvameṣām || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


evaṃvidhairadhaścordhvaṃ meruḥ puravarairvṛtaḥ || 10-165 || 


ūrdhvaṃ brahmasabhāyā jyotiṣkagatatryambakapureṇa || 165 || 

etāśca ---- 


puryaśca yāḥ samākhyātā meroścaiva samantataḥ | 

purakoṭisahasraistu sarvāstā sambhṛtāḥ priye || 10-166 || 

sarvaiśvaryasusampūrṇāḥ sarvaratnasamujjvalāḥ | 

divyastrībhiḥ samākīrṇā divyapumbhiḥ samākulāḥ || 10-167 || 


tatra ---- 


ānandā satataṃ devi devānāṃ ca pure pure | 

vimānanagarārāmaiścaturodyānamaṇḍapaiḥ || 10-168 || 

chatradhvajapatākābhirgajavājisamākulaiḥ	 | 

dundvubhīnandiśabdaiśca śaṅkhakāhalaniḥ svanaiḥ || 10-169 || 

gītanṛttaistathākīrṇaṃ devānāṃ mandiraṃ sadā | 


ākīrṇamākulam || 

ataśca ---- 


iṣṭāpūrtaratā devi ye narā puṇyabhārate || 10-170 || 

tryambakaṃ sakṛdarcanti meruṃ gacchanti te narāḥ | 


pu(ṇya)janāśraye vakṣyamāṇe bhārate varṣe iṣṭāpūrtai ratā ye ca 
tryambakaṃ maheśvaraṃ sakṛdekavāraṃ helāmātreṇārcayanti te meruṃ 
prāpnuvanti, gṛhītadīkṣāstu satataṃ tadarcāparā mucyanta eva || 

ye'pi ---- 


gaṅgātoyasusaṃsiktāḥ...........


te'pi tatra ---- 


.............krīḍanti surasattamāḥ || 10-171 || 

prāptapradhānasurabhāvāḥ || 171 || 

evaṃ śrutagaṅgāprabhāvā tajjijñāsārthaṃ śrīdevyuvāca ---- 


kathaṃ gaṅgā samutpannā surasiddhanamaskṛtā | 

kathayasva prasādena samāsāt surasattama || 10-172 || 


śrībhairava uvāca ---- 


gaṅgāyāśca samutpattiṃ kathayiṣyāmi suvrate | 


tāṃ vaktumupakramate ---- 


jaganmātā mahādevi mama patnī purā hi sā || 10-173 || 


mama parayā vyāptyā viśvakāraṇasya parayaiva vyāptyā sthitā patnī 
kṣayākhyā śaktirata eva purā jaganmātā ādisarge viśvaprasarahetuḥ || 

svātantryād gṛhītarudralokādhiṣṭhātṛrudramūrttestvasau ---- 


mama netrodakaṃ caiva.............


ānandāśru ityarthaḥ || 

yasmādākṛtimatyā praṇayakelivaśena kadācit ---- 


.............karajaiśchādite mama | 

punarudghāṭite netre jaganmātaḥ purā tvayā || 10-174 || 

mannetrebhyo'sravattoyaṃ tvadīyāṃgulibhiḥ priye | 


evaṃ cābhidadhadumāpatirurdhvastharudralokavatīrudrabhaṭṭārakābheda 
ātmanaḥ, tatrasthadevyabhedaścomābhaṭṭārikāyā ityādiśati || 

yacca tattoyamaṃgulibhiḥ srutam, tadeva || 


daśadhā niḥsṛtā gaṅgā.............


tāsāṃ madhyāt ---- 


..............kapālāvaraṇe mama || 10-175 || 

saptaiva saṃsthitāstatra...........


kān prajāpatīn pālayatīti kapālo rudrastadāvaraṇe talloke 
brahmāṇḍordhvakapālopalakṣitāvaraṇe rudraloke ityarthaḥ | yadvakṣyati -
--- 

"vareṇyā varadā caiva variṣṭhā varavaṇīnī | 

vasiṣṭhā ca varāhā ca varārohā ca saptamī || 

gaṅgā hyetāḥ samākhyātā rudralokavahāḥ sadā | "(10-550-551)

iti || 

tisṛṇāṃ madhyāttu ---- 


..........ekā viṣṇupure sthitā | 

dvitīyā brahmalokordhve.............


brahmalokasya satyalokasya yadūrdhvam ---- 


"koṭiyojanamānena satyalokopari priye | 

brahmāsanamiti khyātaṃ japāsindūrasaprabham ||" (10-534)


iti yad brahmaṇo nivāsasthānam, tatra || 


.............ṭṛtīyā satyalokagā || 10-176 || 


tṛtīyaiva prākāmyavaśāt ---- 


svarge caiva.........


kiṃ ca ---- 


.........punaḥ sā vai saṃsthitā somamaṇḍale | 


somaloke || 

eṣaiva tu ---- 


somāccaiva viniḥsṛtya purākāśe vyavasthitā || 10-177 || 


somāt somalokāt || 177 || 


tato'haṃ saṃstuto devi brahmaviṣṇupuraḥsaraiḥ | 


yathā ---- 


gaṅgā nadīṃ mahāpuṇyāṃ martyānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 10-178 || 

avatārya mahādeva martyalokaṃ visarjaya | 


ākāśādityarthāt || 


tato mayā sureśāni proktā sā tvaparājitā || 10-179 || 

lokānāṃ tu hitārthāya āgaccha surasundari | 


athāsau ---- 


āgatya mama mūrdhānaṃ............


mameti jyotiṣkaśikharagatasya || 


..............ṃerumūdhnī punargatā || 10-180 || 

tasmānnirgatya deveśi catudīkṣūdadhiṃ gatā | 


sā ca ---- 


pūrve sītā samuddiṣṭā suvahā dakṣiṇena tu || 10-181 || 

sunandā paścime bhāge bhadrasomā tathottare | 


bahuparvatādivyavahitacatudīggatodadhiprāptirgaṃgāyāḥ prākāmyāditi 
mantavyam || 

prasaṅgād gaṅgāmāhātmyamuktvā prakṛtamāha ---- 


mandarastu mahādevi gandhamādanasaṃjñakaḥ || 10-182 || 

vipulaśca supārśvaśca pūrvādyā uttarāntakāḥ | 

viṣkambhāśca samākhyātāḥ........


avaṣṭambhakā ityarthaḥ | yaduktaṃ śrītantrāloke ---- 

"etairbhuvamavaṣṭabhya merustiṣṭhati niścalaḥ |" (8-60) 

iti || 

eṣāṃ parvatānām ---- 


..........varṇāṃścaiva nibodha me || 183 || 

sitaṃ caiva haridrābhaṃ nīlaṃ dāḍimasaprabham | 


sphaṭikahemamahānīlapadmarāgasamā ete ityarthaḥ || 

eṣāṃ ca pṛthaṅmānasyānuktatvād bhāvinavasahasrelāvṛtāṅgataiva 
mantavyā | tathā ca śrīkiraṇāyām ---- 

".................................ilāvṛtam | 

mervantaṃ caturasraṃ tu sahasranavasaṃyutam ||"

iti tasyoktatvāt, arthāttadekadeśatā pādaparvatānām || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


prāgviṣkambhasamīpe tu nāmnā citrarathaṃ vanam || 10-184 || 

tatrāruṇodakaṃ nāma taḍāgaṃ padmamaṇḍitam | 

gandhamādanasāmīpye nandanaṃ tu mahāvanam || 10-185 || 

tasya madhye'mbujacchannaṃ mānasaṃ tu sarovaram | 

vipulasya samīpe tu vaibhrājaṃ tu mahāvanam || 10-186 || 

sitodaṃ tasya madhye tu taḍāgaṃ vimalodakam | 

vanaṃ pitṛvanaṃ nāma svapārśvasya samīpataḥ || 10-187 || 

tasyāntastu mahābhadraṃ taḍāgaṃ ca manoramam | 


atraiva ---- 


kalpadrumāṃśca caturaḥ kathayāmi nibodha tān || 10-188 || 

mandare'tha kadambaṃ syānmastake tu vyavasthitam | 

sahasrayojanāyāmaṃ śākhāpañcaśatocchiratam || 10-189 || 

puṣpaiḥ kumbhapramāṇaiśca bhrājate tatsupuṣpitam | 


kadambaṃ vṛkṣaḥ | tacca śākhābhiḥ saha sārdhasahasrayojanocchrāyam || 


tatpramāṇā smṛtā jambūrgandhamādanamūrdhani || 10-190 || 

tasyāḥ phalasamūhottho raso jñeyo'mṛtopamaḥ | 

tena jambūnadī jātā priye vegavatī bhṛśam || 10-191 || 


teneti rasena || 191 || 

sa ca ---- 


meruṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya jambūmūlaṃ viśet svakam | 

tatsamparkāt samutpannaṃ kanakaṃ devabhūṣaṇam || 10-192 || 

tena jāmbūnadaṃ loke jñāyate bhūṣaṇottamam | 

tatra vṛkṣalatāgulmāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ śvāpadādayaḥ || 10-193 || 

jāmbūnadamayāḥ sarve ye cānye tatravāsinaḥ | 


kiṃ ca ---- 


vipule'pi tathāśvatthaḥ ketumāla iti śrutaḥ || 10-194 || 


tatheti tatpramāṇakaḥ || 194 || 

ketumālasaṃjñāṃ vyācaṣṭe ---- 


tasyendreṇāsurān jitvā ratnamālā pralambitā | 

tenāsau ketumāleti khyātaḥ siddhaniṣevitaḥ || 10-195 || 


kiṃ ca ---- 


nyagrodhaśca supārśve tu tattulyaḥ parikītītaḥ | 


pramāṇamahattvābhyām || 

tadittham ---- 


anekaguṇasampanno meruḥ khyātaḥ samāsataḥ || 196 || 


atha yathāyaṃ samāsata uktaḥ ---- 


tatpārśvasthān priye deśān kathayāmi samāsataḥ | 


tatrādau ---- 


merumadhyāccatudīkṣu lakṣārdhaṃ tu samāsataḥ || 10-197 || 

lavaṇodadhiparyantaṃ jambudvīpaṃ samantataḥ | 


merumūlamadhyāt pañcāśatsahasrāṇi, tatpārśvadvayakalanayā lakṣaṃ 
bhavati || 


parvatāntaritāstatra nava bhāgā bhavanti hi || 10-198 || 


tatreti jambudvīpe | bhāgāḥ khaṇḍāḥ || 

tathāhi ---- 


dakṣiṇe caiva digbhāge trayo jñeyā mahīdharāḥ | 

niṣadho hemakūṭaśca himavāniti te trayaḥ || 10-199 || 


ṅiṣiddho yatra vai tārkṣyaḥ śeṣāhiṃ hantumudyataḥ |" iti,

"hemakūṭastathā so'driryatra dattaḥ prajāpateḥ | 

suvarṇasya mahākūṭo yāgārthaṃ dhanadena tu ||" iti

"...........................ḥimavān himakūṭavān | 

ratnāḍhyo'pi himaprāyastenāsau himavān giriḥ ||"

iti śrīparāyāṃ nirūpitam || 199 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 

uttare cāpi merostu nīlaḥ śveto'tha śṛṅgavān | 

"śanistatra sunīlābho jāto nīlastvato giriḥ | 

nīlavacca giriḥ śveto yatra śveto mahāmuniḥ || 

mṛtyunā grasyamāno'pi rakṣitaścandramaulinā | " iti,

"śvetavacca triśṛṅgo'drirvajrapātopamardanaḥ | 

tryaśritasteṣu śṛṅgeṣu kila devāstrayaḥ sthitāḥ ||"

ityapi tatraivoktam || 

eṣāṃ mānamāha ---- 


prākpaścimāyatā hyete ṣaḍeva tu mahīdharāḥ || 10-200 || 


pūrvābdheḥ paścimābdhiṃ prāptāḥ || 200 || 

tatrāpi ---- 


nīlaśca niṣadhaścaiva lakṣāyāmau prakītītau | 


madhyāsannatvāt || 

dvīpavartulatānupātatastu ---- 


śvetaśca hemakūṭaśca sahasranavatiḥ smṛtau || 10-201 || 

himavān śṛṅgavāṃścaiva sahasrāśītireva tu | 


tadete ---- 


lavaṇodadhiparyantāḥ.........


pārśvamānāttu ---- 


...........ṣahasradvayavistṛtāḥ || 10-202 || 


kiṃ ca ---- 


kailāsayukto himavāṃstriśṛṅgaśca sajārudhiḥ | 


himavato madhye kailāsaḥ śṛṅgarūpaḥ | yaduktaṃ devīyāmale ---- 

"tasya madhye mahāśṛṅga śatayojanavistṛtam |"

ityupakramya,

"tatrāsāvamaraiḥ sārdhaṃ śūlī vasati sarvadā" iti | 

śṛṅgavatastu jārudhiḥ saṃlagnaḥ || 

eṣāṃ prātilomyato varṇaṃ nirūpayati ---- 


śṛṅgavāṃścandrakanibhaḥ sitaḥ śveto virājate || 10-203 || 

nīlaratnamayo nīlo niṣadhaḥ padmarāgabhaḥ | 

sauvarṇo hemakūṭaśca himābho himavāniti || 10-204 || 


meroḥ pūrvapaścimayoḥ parvatāvāha ---- 


pūrveṇa mālyavān meroḥ parvatastu virājate | 

catustriṃśatsahasrāṇi yojanānāṃ sureśvari || 10-205 || 

yāmyottarāyato bhāti sahasraṃ tasya vistṛtiḥ | 

tathaivāparadigbhāge tattulyo gandhamādanaḥ || 10-206 || 


āyāmavistārābhyām | ayaṃ ca 
dakṣiṇasthādviṣkambhakagandhamādanādanyaḥ | etau ca śrīparāyām ---- 

"dṛṣṭvā mālyāni divyāni brahmasevārthamāgataiḥ | 

sambhṛtāni yataḥ siddhairmālyavāṃstena lapyate ||"

iti tathā ca ---- 

"madamattā purā dṛṣṭā mālyā vidyādharī kila || 

ṛṣiṇā nāradenāsminnāghrātā modabhāvitā || 

gandho me mādano vipretyuktastad gandhamādanaḥ |"

iti niruktau || 206 || 

eṣāṃ sarveṣāmucchrāyamānamāha ---- 


nīlaśca niṣadhaścaiva mālyavān gandhamādanaḥ | 

catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi yojanānāṃ samucchiratāḥ || 10-207 || 


nīlādayo meroḥ pratiprākārasthānīyatvena sthitāḥ evaṃpramāṇakāḥ | 
dakṣiṇottaragatānāṃ tu śvetaśṛṅgavaddhemakūṭahimavatāṃ 
daśayojanasahasrocchiratvam | yaduktaṃ śrīmṛgendrottare ---- 

śahasradvayaviṣkambhā daśotsedhāḥ navāntarāḥ" (13-65) iti | 

evaṃ dakṣiṇottarasthaistribhistribhiḥ pūrvapaścātsthāne ca 
ekaikenetyaṣṭābhiḥ parvataivībhaktaṃ navadhā jambudvīpaṃ jātam || 207 
|| 

kiṃ ca ---- 


catudīkṣu gatau merordvau dvau sīmāntaparvatau | 


pūrvādidigabhimukhau samudrāntaṃ prāptau || 

tatra ---- 


jaṭharo hemakūṭastu pūrvabhāge vyavasthitau || 10-208 || 

kailāso himavāṃścaiva dakṣabhāge vyavasthitau | 

niṣadhaḥ pāriyātraśca apareṇa mahīdharau || 10-209 || 

jārudhiḥ śṛṅgavāṃścaiva uttareṇa vyavasthitau | 


pūrvoktahemakūṭādisamanāmāno'nya evāmī hemakūṭādyāḥ | ete 
cāṣṭāvalaṅghyatvānnavadhā vibhaktasya jambudvīpasya 
navabhāgāntarahetava iti || 

pūrvoktaparvatairnavavibhakte'tra nāmabhedena deśavibhāgamāha ---- 


meroḥ samantato ramyamilāvṛtamudāhṛtam || 10-210 || 

adhastāccakravāṭasya navasāhasravistṛtam | 

yojanānāṃ catudīkṣu caturaśraṃ samantataḥ || 10-211 || 


tena madhyavatīnaḥ ṣoḍaśasāhasrikasya meroḥ pārśvadvayaṃ nava nava 
sahasrāṇītyākalayya dairghyadiśāṃ catustriṃśatsahasrametadbhavati | ata 
eva pūrvapaścātsthayormālyavadgandhamādanayoścatustriṃśatsahasrāṇi 
dairghyamiti yuktamuktam | asya ca nirvacanam ---- 

"ilā nāmāpsarā divyā rūpayauvanaśālinī | 

dṛṣṭā sāmṛtarūpeṇa vicarantī manoharā || 

bhujābhyāmāvṛtā rāgāttenelāvṛtamucyate | "

iti śrīparāyāmuktam || 211 || 

atra ca cakravāṭāvṛtatvāt ---- 


nātapo bhānujastatra na ca somasya raśmayaḥ | 

prabhavanti hi lokānāṃ...........


kintvetat ---- 


..........ṃerorbhāsā prabhāsitam || 212 || 


ata eva ---- 


pratyagrāmbujapatrābhā janāścātīva komalāḥ | 

jambūrasaphalāhārā jarāmṛtyuvivajītāḥ || 213 || 

trayodaśābdasāhasraṃ teṣāmāyuḥ prakītītam | 


ataścākālamṛtyuvivajītā ityuktaṃ bhavati || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


devagandharvasiddhāśca ṛṣayo'tha vināyakāḥ || 10-214 || 

gaṇamātṛbhaginyaśca vetālā rākṣasādayaḥ | 

evamādyairasaṃkhyātairvṛtaṃ caitadilāvṛtam || 10-215 || 


atha ---- 


gandhamādanavāruṇyāṃ samudrasya ca pūrvataḥ | 

ketumālamiti khyātaṃ varṣaṃ sarvaguṇottamam || 10-216 || 


merupaścātsthagandhamādanasya yā vāruṇī, sā paścimābdheḥ pūrvaiva 
bhavati | uktaṃ ca śrīparāyām ---- 


"devāsurāṇāmārambhe dāruṇe samupasthite | 

akasmāttatra ketūnāṃ yā mālā sahasotthitā || 

tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vibudhā bhītāḥ ketumālamato matam |" iti | 


varṣaṃ janapadaḥ || 216 || 


nīlotpaladalaśyāmā janāstatra suśobhanāḥ | 

panasasya rasaṃ pītvā jīvantyayutameva ca || 217 || 


daśa sahasrāṇi ayutam || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


jayanto vardhamānaśca aśoko hariparvataḥ | 

viśālaḥ kambalaḥ kṛṣṇastatra sapta kulādrayaḥ || 10-218 || 


meroragre tu ---- 


mālyavat pūrvabhāgena samudrasyāpareṇa tu | 

varṣaṃ bhadrāśvasaṃjñaṃ ca tatrāpi tvayutāyuṣaḥ || 10-219 || 

janāścandrapratīkāśāḥ kālāmraphalabhojanāḥ | 


uktaṃ ca śrīparāyām ---- 

"uccaiḥśravāstu bhadrāśvaḥ kṣīrodamathanodgataḥ | 

tasmiṃścarati yenāśvo bhadrāśvaṃ tena tatsmṛtam ||" 

iti || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


kaurañjaḥ śvetaparṇaśca nīlo mālāgrakastathā || 10-220 || 

padmaścaiva samākhyātāstatra pañca kulādrayaḥ | 


ete ca ketumālabhadrāśve ---- 


dvātriṃśattu sahasrāṇi pūrvapaścāyate smṛte || 10-221 || 

catustriṃśatsahasrāṇi dakṣiṇodaksamāyate | 


evaṃ ca ketumālabhadrāśve prāk paścād dvātriṃśad dvātriṃśat 
sahasrāṇi, gandhamādano mālyavāṃścaikamekaṃ sahasram, 
ilāvṛtamubhayapārśvagatamaṣṭādaśa, ṣoḍaśa merurityevaṃ 
lakṣayojanaṃ jambudvīpaṃ pūrvāparataḥ | 
jaṭharādisīmāntaparvatamānaṃ jayantādikulaparvatamānaṃ ca 
tatraivaikadeśī bhūtatvānna pṛthaggaṇanīyam || 

evaṃ pūrvapaścimayorvarṣasthitimuktvottare'pi tāmāha ---- 


varṣe dve tu samākhyāte............

samākhyāte ityupasaṃhāropakramayoḥ kākākṣivadyojanīyam | 
pūrvapaścādgate ketumālabhadrāśve samākhyāte || 

meroruttare tu ye vakṣyamāṇavibhāge kuruhiraṇmaye varṣe, tayormadhyāt ---
- 


..............kuruvarṣanivāsinaḥ || 222 || 

kuravo nāma lokāste..........


yasmāt ---- 


.............kuruvṛkṣaphalāśinaḥ | 


ataśca ---- 


trayodaśasahasrāṇi jīvanti sthirayauvanāḥ || 10-223 || 

yugmaṃ yugmaṃ prasūyante viyogabhayavajītāḥ | 


tulyakālaṃ jāyante, tathaiva mirayante ityarthāt | ataśca 
patimanuyātānāṃ strīṇāmanujanma sambhāvyate || 

kiṃ cātra ---- 


śyāmāpuṣpanibhāḥ snigdhāḥ surūpāḥ puruṣāḥ striyaḥ || 10-224 || 


striyaścetyarthaḥ || 224 || 

tathā ---- 


sarvaratnamayī bhūmihīmavālukayā citā | 


etacca kuruvarṣaṃ pārśvamānāt ---- 


navayojanasāhasraṃ dhanvākāraṃ prakītītam || 225 || 

dhanvākāramityatra sakāralopaśchāndasaḥ | 
dairghyādetacchṛṅgavatpramāṇam | anupātena 
valayākṛtyavasthitottarābdhisamīpagatatvād dhanurākārataivāsya bhavati 
|| 


sūryakāntendukāntau ca dvau tatra kulaparvatau | 

kalpavṛkṣaḥ kururnāma tatraiva kusumojjvalaḥ || 10-226 || 

tasya nāmnā tu tajjñeyaṃ kuruvarṣaṃ suśobhanam | 


śrīmatparāyām ---- 

"ramyavat kuruvarṣākhyamupamanyurhareṇa saḥ | 

kurvevaṃ tu piba kṣīraṃ yatroktastena tatkuru ||"

iti niruktam || 226 || 

atha ---- 


tasya cottaradigbhāge praviśya lavaṇodadhim || 10-227 || 

pañcayojanasāhasraṃ candradvīpaṃ prakītītam | 

tathā vāyavyadigbhāge praviśya lavaṇodadhim || 10-228 || 

yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi catvāryeva varānane | 

daśayojanasāhasraṃ dvīpaṃ bhadraṃ prakītītam || 10-229 || 

bhadrākāramiti jñeyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam | 


catvāryevetyevakārāt pūrvatrāpyabdhipraveśa etatsambadhyata eva || 229 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


ayutāyuṣo janāstatra divyāmṛtaphalāśinaḥ || 10-230 || 


itthameva ---- 


candrākhye'pyayutaṃ cāyurjīvanti phalabhojinaḥ | 


evaṃ śṛṅgavaduttarābhyantarāle kuruvarṣamuktvā hiraṇmayaṃ varṣamāha 
---- 


śvetaśṛṅgavatoścaiva madhye jñeyaṃ hiraṇmayam || 10-231 || 


hemamayatvādihaivamuktam | parāyāṃ tu ---- 

"yatra gandharvamukhyena ramaṇā ramitā balāt | 

ramaṇaṃ tatparaṃ varṣam.......................... ||"

iti saṃjñāntareṇoktam | gandharvamukhyena citrarathena, ramaṇākhyā 
apsarāḥ || 231 || 


lakucasya phalaṃ prāśya janāstatrendusannibhāḥ | 

jīvantyabdasahasrāṇi mānenārdhatrayodaśa || 10-232 || 


atha ---- 


nīlasyottaradigbhāge tathā śvetasya dakṣiṇe | 

ramyakaṃ nāma varṣaṃ tu............


etadapi parāyām ---- 

"urvaśī yāpsarā bhadrā dṛṣṭvā candramasā kila | 

proktā ramyeti tadvākyāttenedaṃ ramyanāmakam ||"

iti niruktam || 

tatra ca ---- 


............ṇyagrodhaphalabhojanāḥ || 10-233 || 

nīlotpaladalaśyāmā jarārogavivajītāḥ | 


ataśca ---- 


dvādaśābdasahasrāṇi teṣāmāyuḥ prakītītam || 10-234 || 


etacca dairghyamānāt pūrvamuktamapi, pārśvataḥ ---- 


navasāhasravistāraṃ ramyakaṃ ca hiraṇmayam | 


ramyakaṃ ca hiraṇmayaṃ cetyarthaḥ || 

meroruttare varṣasthitimuktvā dakṣiṇe krameṇāha ---- 


hemakūṭasya saumyena dakṣiṇe niṣadhasya tu || 10-235 || 

harivarṣaṃ samākhyātaṃ raupyābhāstatra jantavaḥ | 

dvādaśaiva sahasrāṇi jīvantīkṣurasāśinaḥ || 10-236 || 

atīva śobhanaṃ tacca navasāhasravistṛtam | 


etacca ---- 

"yatra nāgena śeṣeṇa harirārādhitastathā"

iti śrīparāyāṃ niruktam || 

atha ---- 


hemakūṭasya yāmyena himavatastvatha(co)1ttare || 10-237 || 

varṣaṃ kiṃpuruṣaṃ nāma tatra hemanibhā janāḥ | 

navavarṣasahasrāṇi jīvanti plakṣabhojanāḥ || 10-238 || 

navaiva tu sahasrāṇi vistārastatra kītītaḥ | 


kiṃpuruṣam | etadapi ---- 

"yatra vidyādharī ramyā vidyādharakaracyutā | 

kiṃ tvayā puruṣastyakta ityuktā......... ||"

iti parāyāṃ niruktam || 

atha ---- 


yāmye himācalendrasya uttare lavaṇodadheḥ || 10-239 || 


bhārataṃ nāma varṣaṃ tu tatra cālpaṃ sukhaṃ smṛtam | 


yataḥ ---- 


janā rogabhayatrastā duḥkhitā mandasampadaḥ || 10-240 || 

surūpā mandarūpāśca subhagā durbhagāḥ pare | 

bhogino mandabhogāśca tathānye'tyantaduḥkhitāḥ || 10-241 || 

gaurāḥ śyāmāstathā kṛṣṇā babhravaḥ śvetapiṅgalāḥ | 

varṇajātiprabhedena nānākarmānurūpataḥ || 10-242 || 

caturvarṇā antyajāśca jāyante bhāratāhvaye | 


varṇo brāhmaṇādiḥ | jātiḥ pulastyapulahādigotrarūpā | etadapi varṣam 
---- 

"bharatena bhṛtaṃ duḥkhaṃ yatra putraiḥ kumārgagaiḥ |"

iti śrīparāyāṃ niruktam | evametāni nava varṣāṇi śrīparāyāṃ 
niruktāni, iha tvilāvṛtādyākhyasvāmyadhiṣṭhitatvāditi vakṣyati || 
atra ca ---- 


svadeśabhāṣāyuktāni dvīpadvīpāntarāṇi ca || 10-243 || 

paṇḍitāśca tathā mūrkhāḥ śilpavijñāninastathā | 

yogino jñāniyaścaiva dhamīṣṭhāḥ pāpino'pare || 10-244 || 

yācakāścāpi jāyante dātāraścāpare janāḥ | 

preṣyā dāsāśca bahavo mānavāḥ satartaṃ priye || 10-245 || 


dvīpeṣvantardvīpāni dvīpāntarāṇi | preṣyā viniyojyā adāsā api 
bhavanti || 245 || 

taditthaṃ doṣavatyapi ---- 


guṇastvekaḥ sthitastatra śubhāśubhaphalārjanam | 


dvayamapyatra sambhavati | sacetasastu aśubhavarjanena śubhārjanāya 
udyacchanti | yaduktaṃ śrīmṛgendrāyām ---- 

"guṇa eko yadudyukto neṣṭaṃ kiñcinna sādhayet" (13-92) iti || 

kiṃ ca bhāratavarjamanyavarṣeṣu ---- 


nāṣṭāsu vidyate kācidyugatrayamayī sthitiḥ || 10-246 || 


kṛtayugavyatirekeṇa tretādimayī || 246 || 

tasmāt ---- 


caturyugavatī jñeyā bhāratākhye varānane | 


evaṃ ca ---- 


tatraiva yatkṛtaṃ karma śubhaṃ vā yadi vā'śubham || 10-247 || 

vasanti tena lokāśca śivādyavīcimadhyagāḥ | 


atraiva 
bhogamokṣasiddhisādhanasvayambhūpuṇyatīrthamahānadīsampadastītyāha ---- 


mahākālastathaikāmramevamādi varānane || 10-248 || 

tīrthānāṃ koṭiruddiṣṭā mahāpuṇyaphalodayā | 

gaṅgādīnāṃ nadīnāṃ ca tatra pañca śatāni ca || 10-249 || 


evamādītyādiśabdāt śrīamareśādipañcāṣṭakānāṃ 
vārāṇasyādigataśrīmahādevāṣṭaṣaṣṭeśca parigrahaḥ | 
tīrthānāmiti prabhāsādīnām | yaduktaṃ śrīdevīyāmale ---- 

"prabhāsādyā tu tīrthānāṃ koṭirekā varānane | 

pañcāṣṭakaṃ tu tatraiva lokānugrāhakaṃ sadā ||" iti || 249 || 

kuruvarṣaṃ ca ---- 


navayojanasāhasraṃ dhanvākāraṃ nibodha tam | 


bhārate ca varṣe ---- 


nava bhedāḥ smṛtāstatra sāgarāntaritāḥ priye || 10-250 || 


himavaddairghyeṇa avatāritaiḥ sāmudrairvāribhiḥ kṛtavyavadhānāḥ | atra 
cāṣṭamo vārideśo bindusaraḥsaṃjñaḥ | yadvakṣyati ---- 

"bindusaraḥprabhṛtyeva kumāryāhvaṃ .... | " (10-254) iti || 250 || 

tadatra yojanānām ---- 


ekaikasya tu dvīpasya sahasraṃ parikītītam | 


jalena saha mānametadityarthaḥ || 

yadāha ---- 


śatāni pañca vijñeyaṃ sthalaṃ pañca jalaṃ tathā || 10-251 || 


etat pārśvamānam | dairghyaṃ tu himavadyathānupātamardhaṃ 
pañcaśatikajalavyavahitatvāt || 251 || 

evaṃ ca ---- 


parasparamagamyāste...........


te iti dvīpaviśeṣāḥ || 


..........ṭeṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu | 

indradvīpaṃ kaśeruṃ ca tāmravarṇaṃ gabhastimat || 10-252 || 

nāgadvīpaṃ ca saumyaṃ ca gāndharvaṃ vāruṇaṃ tathā | 

dvīpaṃ kumārikākhyaṃ ca navamaṃ parikītītam || 10-253 || 


dvīpāṣṭakasya sāgarāḥ sapta vyavadhāyakā uktāḥ | navamasya 
tvavadhinirūpaṇena vyavadhāyakamāha ---- 


bindusaraḥprabhṛtyeva kumāryāhvaṃ prakītītam | 


pūrvebhyo'syāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ yadayam ---- 


yojanānāṃ sahasraṃ tu...........


netaravat pañcaśatikam | kevalaṃ sāhasrikasyāsya vibhāgo 
vāruṇāntasthena bindusarasā kṛtaḥ || 

etacca ---- 


..........ṇānāvarṇāśramānvitam || 10-254 || 


varṇā brāhmaṇādyāḥ || 254 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


ye pūrvoktā guṇā loke bhārate varavaṇīni | 

te tatraiva sthitā loke kumārīsaṃjñake priye || 10-255 || 


guṇāḥ śubhārjanasvayambhūtīrthapuṇyanadyadhiṣṭhānādirūpāḥ 
kumārīdvīpa eva | yaduktaṃ śrīśrīkaṇṭhyām ---- 

"tatra madhye mahaddvīpaṃ kumārīdvīpasaṃjñakam | 

tatra rudraśataṃ pūrṇamavatīrṇaṃ śubhaṅkaram | 

paśūnāṃ hetubhūtaṃ ca smaraṇāt pāpanāśanam ||"

iti | indradvīpādistu mlecchādiprāyāṇāṃ nivāso 
devatātīrthādyanadhiṣṭhitaśca | taduktamanyatra ---- 

"varṇāśramasamācāraḥ kumāryākhye na saṃśayaḥ | 

itare mlecchasaṃjñeyāḥ śiṣṭācārabahiṣkṛtāḥ ||" iti || 255 || 

anyacca ---- 


bhūdharāḥ sapta vijñeyāstatraiva tu suśobhanāḥ | 

mahendro malayaḥ sahyaḥ śaktimānṛkṣaparvataḥ || 10-256 || 

vindhyaśca pāriyātraśca bhāntyete kulaparvatāḥ | 


suśobhanā siddhisādhanānuguṇāḥ | ketumālasthāt pāriyātrādayamanyaḥ 
| evamanyatra || 

atha ---- 


dakṣasāgaramadhyasthānyupadvīpāni ṣaṭ priye || 10-257 || 


tānyāha ---- 

aṅgadvīpaṃ yavākhyaṃ ca malayaṃ śaṅkhasaṃjñakam | 

kumudaṃ ca varāhaṃ ca ityevaṃ parikītītam || 10-258 || 


eṣāṃ madhyāt ---- 


kathito malayadvīpe malayo nāma parvataḥ | 

tasya pāde trikūṭo vai laṅkā tasyopari sthitā || 10-259 || 


pāde paryante || 259 || 

sā ca ---- 


cāmīkaramayī śubhrā catvarodyānamaṇḍitā | 


catvaraiḥ śivādhiṣṭhitaiścatuṣpathairmuktidaiḥ, udyānaiśca 
bhogasthānairbhūṣitāḥ || 

tathā ---- 


citraprākāraracitā vajravaiḍūryamaṇḍitā || 10-260 || 

anantavibhavāstatra rākṣasā devakanyakāḥ | 

ramante kanyakāsaktā mahābalaparākramāḥ || 10-261 || 


parākrama utsāhaḥ || 261 || 

anyacca ---- 


agastyaśikharaṃ tatra malaye bhūdharottame | 

tatrāśramo mahāpuṇya āgastyaḥ sphaṭikaprabhaḥ || 10-262 || 

tatrānyonyaviruddhāstu sattvāḥ krīḍantyaśaṅkitāḥ | 

na tatra jāyate mārī nākālaḥ sampravartate || 10-263 || 

na jarā na ca śokaśca nopasargabhayaṃ kvacit | 


mārī bahumaraṇam | akālo varṣātapavaiparītyam | upasargā vyādhayaḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


na vadatyanṛtaṃ kaścidrāgadveṣo na kutracit || 10-264 || 

agastyasya prabhāveṇa tvajñānaṃ dūrato gatam | 

tatra vai ṛṣayo vīrā jñānayogakṛtaśramāḥ || 10-265 || 

japādhyayanahomādipūjāstutiparāyaṇāḥ	 | 

tryambakasya mahādevi nityamārādhane ratāḥ || 10-266 || 

agastyasahitāḥ sarve mokṣābhyudayavādinaḥ | 

tiṣṭhanti bhāvitātmānaḥ śāpānugrahakāriṇaḥ || 10-267 || 


mokṣamevābhyudayaṃ vadanti tacchīlāḥ | bhāvitaḥ śivatvaṃ prāpita 
ātmā yaiḥ || 267 || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


lakṣayojanavistīrṇaṃ jambudvīpaṃ samantataḥ | 


pūrvapaścimataḥ prāgdaśītaṃ dakṣiṇottaratastūcyate | 
kuruhiraṇmayaramyakaharikiṃpuruṣabhāratavarṣāṇi ṣaṭ pratyekaṃ 
navasahasrāṇi, iti catuṣpañcāśat | pratyekaṃ dvisāhasrikāḥ 
śṛṅgavacchvetanīlahemakūṭaniṣadhahimavantaḥ, iti dvādaśa | meroḥ 
savyāpasavyagatamilāvṛtamaṣṭādaśa | meroḥ ṣoḍaśa sahasrāṇi, 
ityevaṃ lakṣayojanaṃ jambudvīpaṃ bhavati || 

asya ca ---- 


lakṣyojanavistīrṇaṃ lavaṇāmbhaḥ sthitaṃ bahiḥ || 10-268 || 


lavaṇāmbhaḥ kṣārasamudraḥ || 268 || 

tacca ---- 


triguṇaṃ pariṇāhena sthitaṃ vai maṇḍalākṛti | 


uktaṃ ca śrīmalaye ---- 


śarvatra triguṇo nāhaḥ.......................... |" iti	 || 


kiṃ ca ---- 


vṛtrāribhayasaṃtrastāḥ praviṣṭāstatra parvatāḥ || 10-269 || 

dvādaśaiva mahāvīryāstān bravīmi samāsataḥ | 


vṛtrāririndraḥ || 

tānāha ---- 


vṛṣabho dundubhirdhūmraḥ praviṣṭāḥ pūrvabhāgataḥ || 10-270 || 

candraḥ kaṅkastathā droṇaḥ praviṣṭā uttareṇa tu | 

aśoko'tha varāhaśca nandanaśca tṛtīyakaḥ || 10-271 || 

apareṇa nagāstatra praviṣṭā lavaṇodadhim | 

cakro mainākasaṃjñaśca tṛtīyastu balāhakaḥ || 10-272 || 

dakṣiṇena varārohe praviṣṭāścaiva bhūdharāḥ | 


atra ca ---- 


cakramainākayormadhye tiṣṭhedvai vaḍavāmukhaḥ || 10-273 || 


tadevamabdhiparivṛtam ---- 


jambudvīpaṃ samākhyātaṃ..........


athaiṣāṃ varṣāṇāmilāvṛtādināmakasvāmyadhiṣṭhānādeva tāḥ 
saṃjñā iti devatāsaṃjñānāmutpattiheturūpaṃ prabhavaṃ 
darśayitumupakramate ---- 


..............prabhavastvadhunocyate | 


tatrādyo bhūpatiḥ ---- 


svāyambhuvo manurnāma............


abhūt || 


..............ṭasya putraḥ priyavrataḥ || 10-274 || 

tasyātha daśa putrā vai jātā vīryabalotkaṭāḥ | 

agnīdhraścāgnibāhuśca medhā medhātithirvapuḥ || 10-275 || 

jyotiṣmān dyutimān havyaḥ savanaḥ satra eva ca | 


eṣāṃ madhyāt ---- 


medhāḥ satro'gnibāhuśca ete pravrajitāstrayaḥ || 10-276 || 

saptadvīpeṣu ye śeṣā abhiṣiktā mahābalāḥ | 


tatra ---- 


jambudvīpe tathāgnīdhraḥ............


tathetyabhiṣiktaḥ || 


...........ṭasya putrā nava smṛtāḥ || 10-277 || 

nābhiḥ kiṃpuruṣaścaiva hariścaiva ilāvṛtaḥ | 

bhadrāśvaḥ ketumālaśca ramyakaśca hiraṇmayaḥ || 10-278 || 

navamastu kururnāma.............


ete ---- 

...........ṇavavarṣādhipāḥ smṛtāḥ | 

agnīdhratastu jātā vai śūrāścātibalotkaṭāḥ || 10-279 || 

teṣāṃ nāmāṅkitānīha navavarṣāṇi pārvati | 


tatra bhārataṃ varṣaṃ prathamaṃ nābhināmāṅkitamabhūt || 

paścāt tu ---- 


nābheḥ putro mahāvīryo vṛṣabho dharmatatparaḥ || 10-280 || 

tasyāpi hi suto jñeyo bharatastu pratāpavān | 

tannāmnaiva tu vijñeyaṃ bhārataṃ varṣamuttamam || 10-281 || 


atha ---- 


tasyāpyaṣṭau punaḥ putrā jātā kanyāparā priye | 


teṣāṃ madhyāt ---- 


bhārate tvaṣṭadvīpe'tra aṣṭau putrā niveśitāḥ || 10-282 || 

navamastu kumāryāhvaḥ kumāryāḥ pratipāditaḥ | 


kanyāpratipādanādeva kumāryāhvaḥ || 

tataśca ---- 


teṣāṃ nāmnā tu te dvīpā bharatena prakītītāḥ || 10-283 || 


ye pūrvam ---- 

"indraścaiva kaśeruśca" (10-252)

ityuktāḥ || 283 || 

tadevaṃ saptadaśadhāvibhaktajambudvīpānuvādapūrvaṃ dvīpāntarāṇyāha 
---- 


jambudvīpaṃ ca śākaṃ ca kuśaṃ krauṃcaṃ ca śālmalim | 

gomedaṃ puṣkaraṃ caiva sapta dvīpāni pārvati || 10-284 || 


yaiḥ samudrairvalayitāni dvīpāni, tān ---- 


adhunā sampravakṣyāmi samudrāṃstava suvrate | 

kṣāraḥ kṣīraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ tathā ikṣuraso'pi ca || 10-285 || 

madirodaśca svādūdaḥ samudrāḥ sapta kītītāḥ | 


proktadvīpānusāramete yathoktakrameṇaiva sthitāḥ, sarveṣu 
pārameśeṣvevamevoktatvāt | tenekṣurasasurāghṛtadadhikṣīrasvādūdakā
iti pātañjale yaḥ kramo dṛśyate, sa lekhakadoṣādviparyasta iti mantavyam 
|| 

athoktajambudvīpapramāṇānuvādenaiṣāṃ dvīpasamudrāṇāṃ pramāṇamāha 
---- 


jambudvīpaṃ smṛtaṃ lakṣaṃ yojanānāṃ pramāṇataḥ || 10-286 || 

parimaṇḍalato jñeyaḥ kṣārodastatsamo bahiḥ | 


parimaṇḍalata iti vaipulyāt || 


evaṃ dviguṇavṛddhyātra samudrā dvīpasaṃsthitāḥ || 10-287 || 


saṃsthitā iti saṃśabdaḥ sahārthe | tena śākādibhiḥ dvīpaiḥ saha 
kṣīrādisamudrāḥ kramād dviguṇavṛddhyā sthitāḥ | tadyathā 
śākadvīpaṃ dve lakṣe, tathā kṣīrābdhiḥ | kuśadvīpaṃ lakṣāṇi 
catvāri, tathaiva dadhyabdhiḥ krauñcamaṣṭau, tathaiva ca ghṛtābdhiḥ | 
śālmaliḥ ṣoḍaśa, tadvadikṣurasābdhiḥ | gomedo dvātriṃśat, tadvad 
madirābdhiḥ | puṣkaraścatuṣśaṣṭiḥ, tathaiva svādūdaḥ | etacca 
dvīpasamānatvamabdhīnāmupasaṃhariṣyati ---- 

"puṣkaradvīpaguṇitaḥ svādūdo'nte vyavasthitaḥ" (10-327)

iti | itthaṃ ca mervardhāt svādūdāntaṃ koṭidvayaṃ 
tripañcāśallakṣāṇi pañcāśacca sahasrāṇi bhavanti | yadvakṣyati ---- 

"pañcāśacca sahasrāṇi tripañcāśattathaiva ca | 

yojanānāṃ tu lakṣāṇi koṭidvitayameva ca || 

mervardhādyāvat svādūdaṃ pramāṇaṃ parikītītam | " (10-328-329)

iti || 287 || 

tathā ca ---- 


agnīdhraśca samākhyāto jambudvīpe varānane | 


tathā ---- 


śāke medhātithirnāma vapuṣmān kuśasaṃjñake || 10-288 || 

rājā krauñce'tha jyotiṣmān śālmalau dyutimān smṛtaḥ | 

gomede havyanāmā tu savanaḥ puṣkare tathā || 10-289 || 


kiṃ ca ---- 


tretāyugasamaḥ kālaḥ śākagomedavāsinām | 

tathā varṇāśramācārā jñeyāstatra nivāsinām || 10-290 || 


tatheti tretāyugānuguṇāḥ | anyatra viśeṣānabhidhānāccaturyugasamatvaṃ 
sambhāvyate || 290 || 

śākādidvīpavibhāgāntaramāha ---- 


medhātitheḥ sapta putrāḥ śākadvīpe'bhiṣecitāḥ | 

śānto'bhayastvaśiśiraḥ sukhado nandakaḥ śivaḥ || 10-291 || 

kṣemakaśca dhruvaśceti varṣanāmnā tu te'ṅkitāḥ | 

prasiddhavarṣanāmānusārīṇi teṣāṃ nāmānītyarthaḥ || 

varṣāṇi sapta khyātāni...........


tatpravibhāgahetūn ---- 


...............parvatāṃśca nibodha me || 10-292 || 

gomedaścandrasaṃjñaśca nārado dundubhistathā | 

somaka ṛṣabhaścaiva vaibhrājaśca kulādrayaḥ || 10-293 || 


ete ca śākadvīpasya pārśvamānavibhāgena sthitāḥ saptadhātvaṃ kurvanti 
| evamanyatra || 293 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


sukṛtā cānasūyā ca sumukhī ca tṛtīyakā | 

vipāśā tridivā kumbhī tathā cāmṛtanālikā || 10-294 || 

etā eva mahānadyo giriṣveteṣu nirgatāḥ | 


saṃsthitāḥ satya ebhyo nirgatā ityarthaḥ || 

etāśca ---- 


pūrvādārabhya niṣkrāntāḥ praviṣṭāḥ kṣīrasāgaram || 10-295 || 


atra ca ---- 


śākadvīpe tu ye lokāḥ kṣīrāhārāḥ phalāśinaḥ | 


ataśca ---- 


candrakāntasamāḥ sarve surūpāḥ priyadarśanāḥ || 10-296 || 

krīḍanti divyanārībhiḥ sarvaiśvaryasamanvitāḥ | 


tadevam ---- 


kuśe vapuṣmatā pūrvaṃ sapta putrā niveśitāḥ || 10-297 || 

śvetalohitajīmūtā harito vaidyutastathā | 

mānasaḥ suvrataśceti varṣanāmnaiva cāṅkitāḥ || 10-298 || 


atra ca vibhāgahetavaḥ ---- 


kumudaścorvadaścaiva vārāho droṇakaṅkatau | 

mahiṣaḥ kusumaścaiva sapta sīmāntaparvatāḥ || 299 || 


atra ca ---- 


śvetatoyā tathā kṛṣṇā candrā śuklā ca locanī | 

vīvṛtā ca vivṛndā ca saptaitāstu saridvarāḥ || 10-300 || 

dadhyudakaṃ praviṣṭāstā nimnagāḥ pāvanodakāḥ | 

janāstu sukhinastatra dadhnāmṛtaphalāśinaḥ || 10-301 || 

divyabhogaratāḥ sarve krīḍantyete sayoṣitaḥ | 


dadhnā sahāmṛtamayāni phalāni cāśnanti | evamuttaratra || 


jyotiṣmatā sapta putrāḥ krauñcadvīpe niveśitāḥ || 10-302 || 

udbhijjaśca samākhyāto veṇurmaṇḍala eva ca | 

rathakāraśca lavaṇo dhṛtimān suprabhākaraḥ || 10-303 || 

kapilaśceti rājāno varṣanāmnā ca te'ṅkitāḥ | 


atrāpi vibhāgahetavaḥ ---- 


vaidrumo hemanābhaśca dyutimān puṣpadantakaḥ || 10-304 || 

kuśalo harimardaśca saptaite tu kulādrayaḥ | 


tebhyaḥ ---- 


mahī dhātā śivāpāpā pavitrāsantatadyutiḥ || 10-305 || 

dambhā ceti samākhyātāḥ saptaitāḥ saritaḥ srutāḥ | 

ghṛtodaṃ praviśantyetāḥ sarvāḥ pāpaharāḥ priye || 10-306 || 

janāstadvāsinaḥ sarve surūpāstejasotkaṭāḥ | 

ghṛtāmṛtaphalāhārāḥ sutṛptāḥ smarapīḍitāḥ || 10-307 || 

krīḍanti vanitāyuktāḥ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇāḥ | 


smarapīḍitatvaṃ sambhogaikaniṣṭhatvam || 

tathā ---- 


sapta dyutimatā putrāḥ śālmalāvabhiṣecitāḥ || 10-308 || 

manonugastathoṣṇaśca pāvano hyandhakārakaḥ | 

munirdundubhināmā ca kuśalaśceti te smṛtāḥ || 10-309 || 

varṣanāmāni teṣāṃ vai saptānāṃ sapta tu kramāt | 

krauñce'tha vāmanaścaivāpyandhakāro divākṛtiḥ || 10-310 || 

dvibinduḥ puṇḍarīkaśca dundubhiśca kulādrayaḥ | 

pauṇḍarī kauśikī gaurī siddhā caiva kumudvatī || 10-311 || 

sandhyā rātrī ca vikhyātā samāsāt parikītītāḥ | 

nadyastāḥ śailaniṣkrāntā gacchantīkṣurasārṇavam || 10-312 || 

pibantīkṣurasaṃ tatra ye janāstannivāsinaḥ | 

divyakāntiyutāḥ śāntāḥ surūpāḥ priyavādinaḥ || 10-313 || 

nānānārīsamākīrṇāḥ sarvakāmasukhodayāḥ | 


evam ---- 


havyarājaḥ sutān sapta gomode cābhyaṣecayat || 10-314 || 

jaladaśca kumāraśca sukumāro marīcakaḥ | 

kumudaśconnataścaiva mahābhadra iti smṛtāḥ || 10-315 || 

teṣāṃ nāmnā ca varṣāṇi aṅkitāni svanāmataḥ | 

udayaḥ kesaraścaiva jaṭharo'tha suraivataḥ || 10-316 || 

śyāmo'mbikeyo meruśca śailāḥ sīmāntagāstvime | 

gabhastī sukumārī ca kumārī nalinī tathā || 10-317 || 

veṇukā cāpyathekṣū ca dhenuketi saridvarāḥ | 

madirodaṃ vahantyetāḥ puṇyāḥ puṇyajalodvahāḥ || 10-318 || 

amṛtopamāni svādūni phalānyatra varānane | 

bhakṣayanti ca tallokāḥ pibanti madirāmṛtam || 10-319 || 


madirodamiti "kālabhāvagantavyādhvānaḥ karmasaṃjñāḥ" || 319 || 

te ca ---- 


sarvakāmasamṛddhāśca surūpā vyādhivajītāḥ | 

nānāyuvativṛndaiśca rūpayauvanagavītaiḥ || 10-320 || 

madālasaiḥ pānamattai ramante satataṃ priye | 

ataśca puṣkarākhye ca savanastatra nāyakaḥ || 10-321 || 

dvau putrau tena vikhyātau puṣkarākhye niveśitau | 


vakṣyamāṇasaṃjñau || 

tatra ca ---- 


parvato valayākāro mānasottarasaṃjñitaḥ || 10-322 || 

pañcāśaducchrayastasya vistāraḥ pañcaviśatiḥ | 

yojanānāṃ varārohe............


sa ca ---- 


..............ṣarvaratnasamanvitaḥ || 323 || 


tena dvidhākṛte deśe sati ---- 


dhātakī madhyame rājā mahavīto bahirnṛpaḥ | 


madhyama iti bhūgolāpekṣayā || 

atra ca ---- 


īrṣyayā rāgatṛṣṇābhirītibhiśca vivajītāḥ || 10-324 || 


ītaya ādhidaivikaduḥkhahetavaḥ || 324 || 

ata eva ---- 


sarve te sukhinastatra tasmin varṣadvaye janāḥ | 


sa ca parvataḥ ---- 


cakrākārastu boddhavyo mānasastu varānane || 10-325 || 


atha ---- 


caturṇāṃ lokapālānāṃ purīstvatra bravīmi te | 


atreti parvate || 

tatra pūrvādikrameṇa ---- 


harervasvekasārākhyā yāmyā saṃyamanī purī || 10-326 || 

sukhāhvā vāruṇī caiva somasya tu vibhāvarī | 

pūrvoddiṣṭasvarūpamānameva svādūdasyeti smārayati || 

puṣkaradvīpaguṇitaḥ svādūdo'nte vyavasthitaḥ || 10-327 || 


guṇita iti kramadviguṇavṛddhyā catuḥṣaṣṭilakṣasaṃkhyo tathā 
vibhaktaṃ prāk || 

taditthaṃ merumadhyāt svādūdāntamuktaṃ pramāṇaṃ saṅkalayati ---- 


pañcāśattu sahasrāṇi tripañcāśattathaiva ca | 

yojanānāṃ tu lakṣāṇi koṭidvitayameva ca || 10-328 || 

mervardhādyāvat svādūdaṃ pramāṇaṃ parikītītam | 


etatprāgeva vyākhyātam || 


tato hemamayī bhūmirdaśa koṭyo varānane || 10-329 || 

devānāṃ krīḍanārthāya lokālokastvataḥ param | 

parvato valayākāro yojanāyutavistṛtaḥ || 10-330 || 

lakṣamātrasamutsedho yojanānāṃ varānane | 


ayutaṃ daśasahasrāṇi || 

sa ca ---- 


sarvaratnasamopeto hemavarṇaḥ prakītītaḥ || 10-331 || 


kiṃ ca ---- 


tasyāntarbhāsayed bhānurna bahiḥ surasundari | 


loko'ntaḥsthitānāṃ caturdaśabhūtātmanāṃ lokānāmāloko yatra | yadvā 
lokaḥ prakāśo'lokaśca tamo'ntarbahiśca yasya sa lokālokaḥ, ādityasya 
lokālokasamānocchrāyatvād merostadantarālavatītvācca na 
tadbahirbhāsakatvabh || 

anyacca ---- 


lokapālāḥ sthitāstatra rudrāścāmoghaśaktayaḥ || 10-332 || 


ca evārthe | rudrā eva bhagavanto'ntarvatīsamagralokapālāstatra sthitāḥ, 
na tu tāvadadhvapālane indrādīnāṃ sāmarthyamasti, ato rudrāṇāmevātra 
niyogaḥ | indrādayastu bhagavacchaktimayāmoghaśaktyā 
etadrudrāṃśādhiṣṭhānādeva lokapālā ucyante, ata eva 
bhagavadāvaraṇatvena pūjyatvameṣām || 

etānnāmata uddiśati ---- 


virujo vasudhāmā ca śaṅkhapāt kardamastathā | 

hiraṇyaromā parjanyaḥ ketumān bhājanastathā || 10-333 || 


ete ---- 


jāmbūnadamaye śubhre siddhāmaraniveśane | 

pūrvādārabhya kramaśo yāvadīśānagocarāḥ || 10-334 || 

lokapālāḥ sthitāste vai pālayanta imāḥ prajāḥ | 


siddhānāṃ yogināmamarāṇāṃ ca niveśane'rdhasthitidhāmni | imā iti, 
antardvīpavatīcaturdaśavidhabhūtasargātmanaḥ || 

tadāha ---- 


asya madhye varārohe yonayastu caturdaśa || 10-335 || 

ceṣṭante vividhākārāḥ svakarmaparirañjitāḥ | 


yaduktam ---- 

"tasyāntarbhāsayed bhānuḥ" (10-332)

iti, tasya lokālokasaṃnikarṣaviprakarṣonmiṣitagativaicitryeṇa 
dakṣiṇottarāyaṇasthitimādiśati ---- 


lokālokopariṣṭāttu saviturdakṣiṇāyanam || 10-336 || 

tathottarāyaṇaṃ tatra uttareṇa prakītītam | 


iha merulokālokayorantarvatīgaganapathamadhye sañcaran 
bhūpīṭhikāpratiṣṭhitaliṅgamūtīmerumanavarataṃ 
parameśvaraniyatiniyantritaṣaṣṭighaṭikātmanā bāhyakālena pradakṣiṇyan 
dhruvanābhinibaddhabhacakrasañcārigrahamadhyago 
grahagrāmaṇīstattadrāśisañcārānusāritattaddattasahabhāvād 
āśritatīvramandāmandādidīptibhedo'nyarūpo bhūtasargavartanīṃ 
vicitrāṃ vartayati | ataśca sa vibhuḥ | lokālokopariṣṭāditi 
tannaikaṭyena bhramaṇāt | tatreti, lokālokamervantarālavatīni viṣaye 
sthitvā kramātkramaṃ merunikaṭād bahinīḥsaraṇena bhramaṇāt 
karkaṭādirāśiṣaṭkasañcārarūpaṃ dakṣiṇāyanam, 
lokālokasaṃnikarṣānmerunaikaṭyenāntarantaḥ praveśātmanottareṇa 
bhramaṇānmakarādisañcārarūpaṃ tūttarāyaṇaṃ bhavati | vakṣyati hi ---
- 

śarveṣāmuttare merurlokālokastu dakṣiṇe"1 iti | 

evaṃ saṅgatāgamikaprakriyayaiva etad vyākhyeyam, na tu 
parasparavisamvādijyotiśāstramatānusaraṇasaṅgatyā || 

evaṃ dakṣiṇottarāyaṇasthitimuktvodayāstamayabhedamāha ---- 


ardharātro'marāvatyāmastameti yamasya ca || 10-337 || 

madhyāhnaścaiva vāruṇyāṃ saumye sūryodayaḥ smṛtaḥ | 

yadaiva cāmarāvatyāmudayastasya dṛśyate || 10-338 || 

tadāstameti vāruṇyāmityādityagatāgatam | 


nidīṣṭanītyā meruṃ pradakṣiṇayataḥ sūryasya yadā saumya iti 
meroruttare bhāge udayo vāruṇyā āgacchato darśanaṃ tadā 
merutatpārśvasthaproktaparvatacchāyāvaśād yamasya diśi sūryo'stameti, 
na dṛśyate tatprakāśa ityarthaḥ | tadaiva ca vāruṇyāṃ diśi 
madhyāhnaḥ, tatpūrvagasyārkasyodayadeśād dakṣiṇadiśaḥ 
pañcadaśaghaṭikāvadhergateḥ sampannatvāt tadaiva 
tvamarāvatyāmardharātraḥ, ghaṭikāpañcadaśakenātra sūryodayasya 
bhaviṣyattvāt | itthaṃ ca yadaivāmarāvatyāmasyodayaḥ, tadaiva 
vāruṇīvatīnāṃ saurasya triṃśadghaṭikāvāhasya jātatvād vāruṇyāṃ 
sūryo'stameti dinānto jāyate, ityanena prakāreṇādityagatāgataṃ 
vidikṣvapi mantavyam, pratipāditakramasya upalakṣaṇabhūtatvāt || 
atra ca ---- 


suvīthī uttare tasya ajavīthī ca dakṣiṇe || 10-339 || 


etad vyācaṣṭe ---- 


pitṛdevapatho hyeṣa kathitastu mayā tava | 


śobhanā vīthī mārgo devapathaḥ | na jātā utpattisthāne samprati na 
kimapi prāptā ityajāḥ pitaraḥ, teṣāṃ vīthī panthā iti 
yathāsambhavaṃ yojyam | uttarāyaṇasya divyasiddhihetutvād devamārgatā, 
dakṣiṇāyanasya tvaihikasiddhipūrakatvāt pitṛmārgatetyarthaḥ | etacca 
kālādhikāroktanītyā'ntariva bahirapi jñeyam | yaduktaṃ gītāsu ---- 

"śuklakṛṣṇe gatī hyete jagataḥ śāśvate mate | 

anayoryātyanāvṛttimekayāvartate'nyayā ||" (8 -26) iti | 

antarapi hṛtpadmakaṇīkaiva meruḥ, taduparicijjyotirmātrarūpasyātmano 
dhruvasyānulagnaḥ prāṇādityaḥ 
kālākāroktasakalabhacakragrahādyanuyātaḥ 
kaṇīkopakaṇṭhagatapradhānanāḍīmukhasparśena 
pradakṣiṇamanāratamāvartamānastiṣṭhan 
tattanmakarādisaṃkrāntikrameṇottaradakṣiṇādivibhāgaṃ 
darśayatītyuktaprāyam | yataśca meruṃ 
(merulokālokāntarālasthavyomapathamadhyena) pradakṣiṇayatyaniśaṃ 
dineśaḥ, tata eva tadudayasthānātmakapūrvadigabhimukhānām 
ilāvṛtavarjapratipāditavarṣāṣṭakadvīpāntarādisthānāṃ janānāṃ1 
sarveṣāmuttare merurlokālokastu dakṣiṇe | meruṃ pradakṣiṇayan hi 
bhāskaratatpaścātketumālādivāsināṃ merordakṣiṇata udeti, 
taduttarasthakuruvarṣādivāsināṃ paścimataḥ, 
tatpūrvabhadrāśvādivāsināmuttarataḥ, 
taddakṣiṇaharivarṣādiniṣṭhānāṃ pūrvata iti sthityā sarveṣāṃ 
dvīpāntaragatānāmapi merulokālokau udagdakṣiṇasthau bhavata 
ilāvṛtavarjam, tatrāpi vā chāyāmātreṇa sūryaprakāśānusāriṇī 
kācidavasthitirastīti kalpanīyam || 

evaṃ prasaṅgād dakṣiṇottarāyaṇe udayāstamayasthitiṃ ca pratipādya 
prakṛtamāha ---- 


asya bāhye tamo ghoraṃ duḥprekṣyaṃ jīvavajītam || 10-340 || 

pañcatriṃśatsmṛtāḥ koṭyo lakṣāṇyekonaviṃśatiḥ | 

catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi yojanānāṃ varānane || 10-341 || 


lokālokaviṣkambho daśa sahasrāṇyuktaḥ, taiḥ saha pañcāśat mervarvāg 
jambudvīpaḥ | pañcāśadityanena lakṣeṇa prāksaṅkalanāsaṅkalitena 
koṭidvayena hemabhūkoṭidaśakena ca saha saptacatvāriṃśatkoṭayo bhavanti 
|| 341 || 

atha ---- 


saptasāgaramānaṃ tu garbhodastatsamaḥ smṛtaḥ | 

garbhe'ntaḥ saptasāgarasambandhyudakopalakṣitalokālokatamaparyantaṃ 
viśvaṃ yasya sa garbhodaḥ | tatsama iti kṣārābdhirasatulyaḥ | yaduktaṃ 
parātantre ---- 


"gaditā ye'bdhayaḥ sapta te'tra garbhe yataḥ sthitāḥ | 

prathitastena garbhodaḥ samastābdhirasodvahaḥ ||" iti | 


sa ca saptānāṃ kṣārādisāgarāṇāmekalakṣāt prabhṛti dviguṇavṛddhyā 
yanmānaṃ koṭirekā saptaviṃśatirlakṣāṇi tattulyamānaḥ | evamiyadavadhi 
prāktanena mānena sahaikonapañcāśatkoṭayo bhavanti | 
brahmāṇḍakarparikā ca koṭiriti pañcāśatkoṭayo merumadhyāt 
karparikāntam || 

tadāha ---- 


brahmaṇoṇḍakaṭāhena yuktā vai merumadhyataḥ || 10-342 || 

pañcāśatkoṭayo jñeyā daśadikṣu samantataḥ | 


ubhayapārśvakalanayā tu ---- 


evametacchataṃ jñeyaṃ koṭīnāṃ pāthīvaṃ mahat || 10-343 || 


pāthīvamiti pṛthvīgataṃ vaipulyam || 343 || 

evaṃ pṛthivyā adho madhye mānamuktam, adhunā tu ---- 


ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi pramāṇaṃ varavaṇīni | 


ūrdhvamiti bhuvarlokādhigatam || 

āstāṃ vaitat, bhūrlokagatabhuvanaśuddhau pūrvoktasaṃskārakramaṃ mā 
vismārṣīdupadeśya ityāśayena tameva tāvat smārayitumāha ---- 


athavātra mahādevi paripāṭyā samantataḥ || 10-344 || 

dīkṣākāle tu saṃskārāḥ..........


ye kartavyāḥ


...........kramaṃ teṣāṃ nibodha me | 


kalādīkṣāyāṃ kalopasthāpanapūrvaṃ ye saṃskārā uktāḥ, ta eveha 
bhuvanopasthāpanapūrvaṃ yadyapi kriyante, tathāpi śiṣyahitatvāt 
parameśvarastān smārayati vaktavyaśeṣaṃ ca yojayati || 


śaktiṃ tattvaṃ ca bhuvanaṃ yoniṃ caiva niveśayet || 10-345 || 


saṃskṛtāgnau 
ādābadhvasandhitadavalokanatadupasthāpanatatsāṃnidhyānantaraṃ 
śaktimādhārarūpāṃ tato'pi bhuvanāśrayaṃ tattvaṃ tato'pi 
bhuvaneśasahitaṃ bhuvanaṃ niveśayet śodhyatvenābhisandadhīta | tato'pi 
hṛdā vāgīśī sarvayonivyāpikāṃ nyaset || 345 || 

tataḥ ---- 


teṣāṃ gandhopacāraṃ tu kṛtvā caiva yathākramam | 


teṣāmityādhāraśaktitattvabhuvanādīnām || 

atra ca śodhanīyāni bhuvaneśasahitāni bhuvanāni krameṇa darśayati ---- 


anantaṃ caiva kālāgniṃ narakāṃśca yathākramam || 10-346 || 

pātālāni tataścordhve śodhayedanupūrvaśaḥ | 


narakāniti proktapraghaṭṭakamadhyādekatamena bhedena śodhane cātra 
kalādīkṣoktaprakriyā bhuvaneśaśrāvaṇāntā sarvānusartavyā || 

iyadantaṃ saṃśodhya ---- 


upasthānaṃ tataḥ kuryād bhuvarlokasya varānane || 10-347 || 


"dhāmādiḥ praṇavādiśca" (4-101)

ityādinā mantreṇa pūrvoktena kevalaṃ kalāsthāne 
bhuvanānāmaprakṣepyatā | upasthānaṃ ca 
kalaśādyagnyantādhikaraṇaṣaṭke nyasanam || 347 || 

evaṃ kṛtvā ---- 


tato vāgīśvarī devī sampūjyā kusumādibhiḥ | 

tataḥ paśustu samprokṣyastāḍyo viśleṣya eva ca || 10-348 || 


athāsya ---- 


chedanaṃ ca tathākarṣo grahaṇaṃ yojanaṃ tataḥ | 

garbhadhāritvajanane adhikāraṃ tathaiva ca || 10-349 || 

yogaṃ bhogaṃ layaṃ caiva tato yoniviśodhanam | 


kuryāt | sarvametat prāgeva vyākhyātam || 

yaduktaṃ yoniviśodhanamiti, tatra yā yonīḥ ---- 


caturdaśa samāsena kathayāmyanupūrvaśaḥ || 10-350 || 

paiśācaṃ rākṣasaṃ yākṣaṃ gāndharvaṃ tvendrameva ca | 

saumyaṃ tathā ca prājeśaṃ brāhmaṃ caivāṣṭamaṃ viduḥ || 10-351 || 


etaccoktameva || 351 || 


saṃhārakramayogena śodhanīyāḥ śivādhvare | 


saṃhārakramayogena ityanena cedamāha--yat sthāvarādi paśvantaṃ tāmasaṃ 
pañcakaṃ saṃśodhya mānuṣyaṃ śodhayet | tataḥ paiśācādi brahmāntaṃ 
devayonyaṣṭakamityeṣa eva ca kramo'gre sphuṭībhaviṣyati || 

evaṃ yonyaṣṭakamudghāṭya yoniṣaṭkamapyāha ---- 


paśupakṣimṛgāścaiva tathānye ca sarīsṛpāḥ || 10-352 || 

sthāvaraṃ pañcama caiva ṣaṣṭaṃ mānuṣayonikam | 


tadetat ---- 


devayonisamāyuktaṃ proktaṃ saṃsāramaṇḍalam || 10-353 || 

caturdaśavidhaṃ caiva...........


etacca ---- 


............bhūrloke tu viśodhayet | 


bhūrloke karmānusāreṇa etadarjyate, ityatra vibhāgenaitatsarvaṃ 
śodhanīyam, anyatra tu sāmānyenāpītyāśayaḥ || 

kasmāccaitat saṃsāramaṇḍalam ? ---- ityāha ---- 


ātmā saṃsarati hyatra māyādyavanigocare || 10-354 || 

saṃsāraḥ procyate tasmāt paryaṭet sa yatastataḥ | 


saṃsāraśca ---- 


sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ tathā mohaṃ bhuṃkte caivādhvamadhyagaḥ || 10-355 || 

bandhatrayasamāyukto vāmāśaktyā tvadhiṣṭhitaḥ | 

īśvareṇa nimittena sṛṣṭisaṃhāravartmani || 10-356 || 


sākṣānmantramaheśādimukhena vā īśvareṇa saṃsāravamanārūpayā svayā 
vāmāśaktyādhiṣṭhitaḥ paratantrīkṛtaḥ, tata eva 
cāṇavādibandhatrayeṇa samāyuktaḥ samyagākrānto'bhibhūtaḥ 
sukhāditrayaṃ bhuñjānaḥ || 356 || 


punaḥ punaścādhvamadhye yujyate sa śubhāśubhaiḥ | 


ataśca ---- 


adhvamadhye tu ye pāśā jñeyāścānantakoṭayaḥ || 10-357 || 

pradhānaguṇabhedena yāvaccānāśritaṃ padam | 


taduktam ---- 

śamanāntaṃ varārohe pāśajālamanantakam" (4-410) iti || 

yataścaivam ---- 


tasmādevaṃ vijānīyāt............


kiṃ ca ---- 


.........'dhvā bandhasya kāraṇam || 10-358 || 


tadiyati saṃsāramaṇḍale karmaiva kāraṇamityāha ---- 


caturdaśavidhaṃ yacca proktaṃ saṃsāramaṇḍalam | 

tasya bhedā hyanantāśca............


ye te ---- 


...............bhidyante karmabhedataḥ || 10-359 || 


taditthaṃ saṃsāramaṇḍalahetubhūtāḥ ---- 


karmavallyo hyanantāśca karmeśānādikārakāḥ | 


anādimāyāśaktimuṣitamahimā hi aṇuḥ svopabhogāya 
ceṣṭamāno'nantābhiḥ karmasantatibhirbaddhaḥ || 

na caitadasyānyataḥ kvacidāyātam, api tvapūrṇaṃmanyatayaivetyāha ---- 


ātmanā baddhyate hyātmā...........


baddhaṃ ca tamasāmarthyāt ---- 


................ṃuñcennātmānamātmanā || 10-360 || 


parameśvarānugrahaṃ vinetyarthāt | muñcedātmānamiti pāṭho na saṅgataḥ 
|| 360 || 

etaddṛṣṭāntena sphuṭayati ---- 


kośakāro yathā kīṭa ātmānaṃ veṣṭayed dṛḍham | 

na codveṣṭayituṃ śakta ātmānaṃ sa punaryathā || 10-361 || 

tathā saṃsāriṇaḥ sarve baddhāḥ svaireva bandhanaiḥ | 

na ca mocayituṃ śaktāḥ paśavaḥ pāśabandhanāḥ || 10-362 || 

svayameva svamātmānaṃ yāvadvai nekṣate śivaḥ | 


anugrahaśaktyā || 

yataḥ ---- 


śivaśaktinipātāttu mucyante pāśabandhanāt || 10-363 || 

anyathā naiva jānanti svarūpaṃ yatsunirmalam | 

yattat svābhijanaṃ śuddhamanaupamyamanāmayam || 10-364 || 


sunirmalaṃ paramaśivaikarūpam, ata eva dvitīyābhāvād anaupamyam, tathā 
sva ātmaiva abhijanaṃ kāraṇaṃ yasya tat, ananyakāryaṃ 
svatantravastvityarthaḥ | yasmāt śuddhaṃ cidekaghanamataśca anāmayaṃ 
māyāsaṃsparśaśūnyam, yattaditi lokottaram || 364 || 

kasmādetatsvarūpaṃ na jānantītyāha ---- 


mohitā malamohena baddhāḥ karmakalādinā | 

nigūḍhāstatra tiṣṭhanti kāṣṭhe vahniryathā tathā || 10-365 || 


"abhilāṣo malo'tra tu" (4-105)

iti yaḥ pūrvamapūrṇaṃmanyatātmā svarūpākhyātirūpo mala uktaḥ, sa eva 
moho'jñānam, tena mohitā ajñīkṛtāḥ, ataśca tatraiṃva pāśabandhe 
nigūḍhā nimagnaproktasvasvarūpāstiṣṭhanti, yathā kāṣṭhe'ntaragniḥ 
|| 365 || 

sa cet kāṣṭhanigūḍhaḥ ---- 


uddhṛtastu yathā vahnirmanthakasya vaśāt sphuṭam | 

svasvarūpaṃ prapaśyeta bhāsvaraṃ yatsunirmalam || 10-366 || 

anyeṣāmapi jantūnāṃ timirākrāntacakṣuṣām | 

prakāśayati vastūni hatvā vai raśmibhistamaḥ || 10-367 || 

tathātmā tu vijānāti yatsvarūpamanādimat | 

manthakasya vaśād devi nānyathā tu kathaṃcana || 10-368 || 


manthakasya vaśādityuktiṃ vibhajati ---- 


manthakastviha deveśi svayameva sadāśivaḥ | 

ācāryatanumāsthāya sadā cānugrahe sthitaḥ || 10-369 || 


ca evārthe || 369 || 


mantrā manthanavajjñeyā adhvā cātrāraṇiryathā | 

vāgīśī yonisaṃsthānā dhūmo jñeyo malādivat || 10-370 || 

ātmā vai vahnivajjñeyo bodhakastu paraḥ śivaḥ | 


manthānaṃ mathanakāraṇaṃ vaiśākhaṃ tadvanmantrāḥ, 
samanānto'dhvā'raṇiḥ, yadāvṛta ātmā vahniḥ 
pūrvanirṇītavyāptidṛśā vāgīśīyonau 
dhūmasthānīyākhyātirūpatucchamalāpāsanaṃ paramaśivena prabodhyate 
gurumūtīsthasadāśivabhaṭṭārakaprayuktyā || 

ataśca ---- 


udbodhito yathā bahninīrmalo'tīva bhāsvaraḥ || 10-371 || 

na bhūyaḥ praviśet kāṣṭhaṃ tathātmādhvana uddhṛtaḥ | 

malakarmakalādyaistu nirmukto vigataklamaḥ || 10-372 || 

tatrastho'pi na badhyeta yato'tīva sunirmalaḥ | 


malādinirmokāde(vā)1 saṃsāratayā vigataklamaḥ 
tatrastho'pyupanatabhogātivāhanamātraprayojanatastanmadhyavartyapi na 
badhyeta tadahaṃbhāvābhimānavān na bhavati, api tu suṣṭhu 
nirmalacidghanātmāviṣṭa eva sarvadā || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


rasavahnisamāyogāttāmraṃ kālikayā yathā || 10-373 || 

viśleṣitaṃ tu tattvajñairhematvaṃ pratipadyate | 

na bhūyastāmratāṃ yāti tathātmā na kadācana || 10-374 || 


akhyātirūpayā kālikayā guruṇā viyojita ātmā na punaryujyata ityarthaḥ 
|| 374 || 

atra ca ---- 


rasavanmantraśaktistu kriyā jñeyā tu vahnivat | 

tajjñaścaiva śivo jñeya ācāryatanuvigrahaḥ || 10-375 || 

ātmā vai hemavajjñeyo malo jñeyastu kālikā | 


kriyā dīkṣā, tajjño 
rasavahniyojanāvajjñānayogakriyāmayadīkṣāsatattvavit || 10-375 || 

ataśca ---- 


mantradravyakriyāyogādvahnyādhāre tathā priye || 10-376 || 

guruṇā tantraviduṣā hyātmā vai nirmalīkṛtaḥ | 

na bhūyo malatāṃ yāti śivatvaṃ yāti nirmalam || 10-377 || 


tatheti caturthapaṭaloktaprakriyāyojanikākrameṇa | tantraviduṣeti 
tantrajñānamatra para upāya iti śikṣayati | 1 uktaṃ hi ---- 


ṅa cāvajñā kriyākāle saṃsāroddharaṇaṃ prati | 

mantradānavratādeśe śiṣyaghruṅ nārakī bhavet ||" iti | 


malatāmityapūrṇaṃmanyatārūpāmakhyātim, śivatvaṃ paraśivaikyam || 377 
|| 

upasaṃharati ---- 


evaṃ jñātvā varārohe dīkṣā kāryā yathā purā | 


caturthapaṭaloktakrameṇa | vakṣyati hi ---- 

ṅāsti dīkṣāsamo mokṣaḥ" (11-199) iti || 

tatra ca dīkṣāyām ---- 


śodhayenmukhyapāśāṃśca ye proktāste mayā purā || 10-378 || 


"malakarma nimittaṃ tu naimittikamataḥ param"

iti tantrāntare || 378 || 

ataśca ---- 


guṇabhūtāstu ye pāśāste'pi śudhyanti tadvaśāt | 


guṇabhūtāḥ madamohādayaḥ, tadvaśādityāṇavakārmamāyīyaśuddhivaśāt 
|| 

kintu guṇabhūtamapīdam ---- 


caturdaśavidhaṃ caiva yaduktaṃ tu mayā purā || 10-379 || 

saṃsāramaṇḍalaṃ devi śodhyaṃ tadavanītale | 


śodhyamiti pṛthagevetyarthaḥ || 

ataśca ---- 


tadvakṣyāmi kramāt sarvaṃ yathā śodhyaṃ śivādhvare || 10-380 || 


adūra eva || 380 || 

yacca ---- 


brahmādistambhaparyantaṃ prādhānyena viśodhayet | 


na tvantarbhāvenetyuktam || 

tat krameṇa tāvaduddiśati ---- 


brāhmaṃ caiva tu prājeśaṃ saumyamaindraṃ tathaiva ca || 10-381 || 

gāndharvaṃ cāparaṃ yākṣaṃ rākṣasaṃ ca tathāparam | 

paiśācaṃ kramataḥ śodhyaṃ sthāvaraṃ mānuṣaṃ tathā || 10-382 || 


sthāvaraṃ pañcavidhaṃ tiryagyonyupalakṣaṇam | kramata iti 
saṃhārakrameṇa || 382 || 

yaduktam ---- 

śaṃhārakramayogena te ca śodhyāḥ" (10-352)

iti saṃhārakrameṇa śodhanaṃ 
tattatsthāvarādijātīyamadhyagatapradhānabhūtaikaikakrameṇa prastāvayati 
---- 


saptacchadaṃ sthāvarāṇāṃ sarpāṇāṃ vāsukiṃ tathā | 

pakṣiṇāṃ garuḍaṃ caiva mṛgāṇāṃ siṃhameva ca || 10-383 || 

paśūnāṃ caiva goyoniṃ.............


atra ca devadattātmane prākkarmājītasthāvarādijātipradhānabhūtaṃ 
saptacchadaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā, ityādyūhaḥ kāryaḥ || 

evaṃ tairyagyonaṃ pañcaprakāraṃ prātilomyena saṃśodhya ---- 


............ṃanuṣyāṃśca viśodhayet | 


tānapi prātilomyena || 


antyajān śūdraviṭkṣatrabrāhmaṇāṃśca viśodhayet || 10-384 || 


tadetāsu sarvāsu jātiṣu ---- 


pañcabhirbrahmabhirdevi tvadhikārān viśodhayet | 


adhikārān prākkarmavaśasambhāvyamānatattajjātisambandhāt || 

katham ---- 


daśāhutiprayogeṇa antyajān brāhmaṇāvadhi || 10-385 || 


"tisraḥ pañcadaśaikā vā" (4-448)

iti prāgukterihāyamapavādaḥ | tatra sthāvarādipaśvante 
pañcake'ntyajādibrāhmaṇānte ca pañcake prātilomyena sadyojātādaya 
īśānāntāḥ praṇavapūrvakā mantrā mantavyāḥ || 385 || 

brāhmaṇasya ṣaṭkarmādhikāritvāt (ta)1cchuddhau viśeṣamāha ---- 


brāhmaṇasyādhikārāṣṭau catvāriṃśatameva ca | 

viśodhayedityeva || 

tān krameṇāha ---- 


garbhaḥ puṃsavanaṃ caiva sīmanto jātakarma ca || 10-386 || 

nāma niṣkramaṇaṃ caiva annaprāśanacūḍakam | 

anenaiva varārohe śodhyāstvaṣṭau prakītītāḥ || 10-387 || 


sīmanto'ṅgopāṅgavibhāgasampattiḥ, niṣkramaṇamādityadarśanam, 
cūḍakaṃ śikhākḷptiḥ | anenaiveti, 
proktakramāyātaviniyogeneśānabhaṭṭārakakāraṇakena daśāhutiprayogeṇa 
|| 387 || 

ataśca ---- 


etainīvatītairdevi tato'sau jāyate dvijaḥ | 


aviplutābhyāṃ brāhmaṇābhyāmekaṃ vaidikairmantraiḥ saṃskāraiśca 
dvitīyaṃ janma dvijasya yatsiddhaṃ tadubhayamapīhatyaireva mantraiḥ 
kṛtamiti || 

evamasya dvijasya ---- 


navamo vratabandhastu...............


saṃskāraḥ | 


...........ṣa cāṅgī parikītītaḥ || 388 || 


yatastenāsya ---- 


aṅgāni sampravakṣyāmi yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ | 


tānyāha ---- 


mekhalā dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca ajinaṃ tryāyuṣaṃ tathā || 10-389 || 

sadhyāṃ vahnerupāsāṃ ca bhikṣāṃ vai saptamaṃ viduḥ | 


tryāyuṣaṃ bhasmatripuṇḍrakam | etāni ca mekhalāvratāni sapta, etāni 
brahmacārī samācaret || 


niyantṝṇi ca dṛṣṭāni dīkṣākāle varānane || 10-390 || 


dīkṣākāle maṇḍalopalakṣitabhāvigodānasamaye'niṣpannāni santyetāni 
niyantṝṇi prathamāśramāvasthiterlopo mā bhūdityavaśyānuṣṭheyāni || 
390 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


bhauteśaṃ pāśupatyaṃ ca gāṇaṃ gāṇeśvaraṃ tathā | 

unmattakāsidhāraṃ ca ghṛteśaṃ saptamaṃ viduḥ || 10-391 || 

saptaitāni tu dṛṣṭāni vratāni brahmacāriṇām | 


dṛṣṭānīti pārameśvare śāstre, vede tu ucchinnaśākhāpakṣe sthitāni, 
adyatve'nanuṣṭheyatvāt || 

etāni ca ---- 


caryāvratāni bodhyāni.........


vrata(bandhā)1vasare caraṇīyāni | 

etāni ca ---- 


........'ṅgatve kītītāni tu || 10-392 || 


phalena phalavato vratabandhākhyasya saṃskārasyaitānyaṅgabhūtāni 
vratāntarāṇi || 392 || 

ataśca ---- 


ebhistu sahitaṃ hyekaṃ navamaṃ vratabandhanam | 

tasyāntarbhūtamevaitat kathitaṃ vratasaptakam || 10-393 || 


tadevaṃ mekhalādīni sapta, bhauteśādīni ca sapteti kṛtvā ---- 


caturdaśa vratānyevaṃ hotavyāni varānane | 


pṛthak pṛthak, na tu vratabandhāntarbhāvamātreṇetyāśayaḥ || 

atha ---- 


vedavratāni catvāri hotavyāni na saṃśayaḥ || 10-394 || 


homena sampādyāni || 394 || 

tānyāha ---- 


eṣṭikaṃ pāvīkaṃ caiva bhautikaṃ saumikaṃ tathā | 


iṣṭiparvabhūtasomayajñapratipādakavaidikagranthapāṭhena kālakāryāṇi 
vratānyaiṣṭikādiśabdaiḥ pārameśvareṣu grantheṣu uktāni | yajñasūtre 
tu ---- 

"traividyaṃ ca caturhotraṃ godānaṃ snānamityapi | 

vedavratāni catvāri ........................ ||"

ityevamuktāni | iha tu godānaṃ pṛthageva bhaviṣyati || 

ete ca vedādhyayanādhikāradānena vratāntarāpekṣayā prādhānyāt ---- 


vrateśvarāstu catvāro brahmacāriniyāmakāḥ || 10-395 || 


brahmacāriṇāṃ niyāmakāstathātvasampādakāḥ || 395 || 

tadetāvatparyantametān saṃskārān ---- 


trayodaśa vijānīyāt..............


ebhiranuṣṭhitaścāyaṃ vedeṣvadhikṛta ityāha ---- 


...........ṭato vai vedabhājanam | 


kiṃ ca ---- 


tato bhavati godānaṃ taccaturdaśakaṃ priye || 10-396 || 


vedādhyayanānte upādhyāya gomithunadānenopalakṣitamātmanaḥ 
keśadivapanaṃ godānam || 396 || 

atha gurubhirgārhasthyāyānujñātaḥ ---- 


snāta udvāhayed bhāryāṃ jñānasiddhaḥ kumārikām | 


vedādhyayanena labdhaśuddhiḥ snāta ucyate | adhyayanānte hi 
snānamanenaivāśayenāmnātam, ata evāyaṃ vedārthādhigamātmanā jñānena 
siddhaḥ sampūrṇaḥ || 

atha vā "brahmacaryādeva pravrajet" iti coditatvāt śīghrameva 
prāvrājyamicchan ---- 


kṛtvā darbhamayīṃ patnīṃ tayā saha yajet kratūn || 10-397 || 


gṛhasthāśramacoditanityanaimittikarūpamitthamudvāhātmakasaṃskārasampāda
narūpametat karma ---- 


tajjñeyaṃ pañcadaśamaṃ.............


anenaiva ca ---- 

"pitṛdevamanuṣyāṇāṃ bhūtānāṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathā | 

brahmaṇo'dhyayanaṃ ceti mahāyajñāstu pañca vai ||"

iti yajñasūtrapratipāditā nityayajñāḥ saṃgṛhītāḥ | taduktam ---- 

"pañca sūnā gṛhasthasya cullī peṣaṇyupaskaraḥ | 

khaṇḍanī codakumbhaśca badhyate yastu vāhayan || 

tāsāṃ krameṇa sarvāsāṃ niṣkṛtyarthaṃ mahātmabhiḥ | 

pañca kḷptā mahāyajñāḥ pratyahaṃ gṛhamedhinām || 

adhyāpanaṃ brahmayajñaḥ pitṛyajñastu tarpaṇam | 

homo daivo balirbhauto nṛyajño'tithipūjanam ||"


ityevamudvāhenaivaite nityayajñāḥ saṃgrahītā ityāśayaḥ || 397 || 

naimittikānāha ---- 


..........ṭataḥ pākamakhāḥ kramāt | 

naimittikāṃśca tānāhuḥ pravakṣyāmyanupūrvaśaḥ || 10-398 || 

aṣṭakāḥ pārvaṇī śrāddhaṃ śrāvaṇyāgrāyaṇī tathā | 

caitrī cāśvayujī ceti sapta pākamakhāḥ kramāt || 10-399 || 


pauṣādikṛṣṇapakṣagatāḥ śākādyā aṣṭakāḥ | pārvaṇī 
sitāsitapakṣādyadine, tatratyo yāgastathoktaḥ | śrāddhaṃ 
pitryādidinokto vidhiḥ | śrāvaṇyāṃ yāgaḥ śrāvaṇī | āgrāyaṇī 
navānnayāgaḥ | evaṃ caitryādirapi boddhavyaḥ | anye tu 
āgrāyaṇīdvayamiti paṭhitvā śaradvasantayornavānnayāgadvayaṃ 
vyācakṣate, te ca pārvaṇaṃ śrāddhamekameva varṇayanti | ete ca 
pākayajñā vede tu puroḍāśādibhiḥ kāryā uktāḥ, vakṣyamāṇāstu 
haviryajñāḥ saktvādibhiḥ | iha tu viśeṣānabhidhānāt 
prastutaistilaireva kāryā iti jñeyam || 399 || 

tadevam ---- 


etaiḥ saha vijānīyād dvāviṃśat parisaṃkhyayā | 


etaiḥ saptabhiḥ saha pūrvoktān pañcadaśasaṃskārān | 

atha ---- 


āgneyaṃ cāgnihotraṃ ca darśaṃ caiva tataḥ param || 10-400 || 

paurṇamāsī tathā jñeyā cāturmāsyaṃ tathaiva ca | 

paśubandhaḥ samuddiṣṭaḥ sautrāmaṇirataḥ param || 10-401 || 

haviryajñāḥ samākhyātāḥ saptaite pāvanāḥ priye | 


āgneyamaraṇikrameṇāgnyānayanam | agnihotraṃ sāyaṃprātaśca homaḥ | 
darśo viparītalakṣaṇayā'dṛśyamānacandra āmāvasyo yāgaḥ | 
cāturmāsyaṃ phālgunāt caitrādvā prabhṛti māsacatuṣṭayānte 
paurṇamāsībhavo viśiṣṭo yāgaḥ | paurṇamāsīśabdena tu 
sarvapaurṇamāsīgataḥ sāmānyayāga uktaḥ | paśubandho yāgaviśeṣo yatra 
paśormāṃsavasādi hūyate | sautrāmaṇiḥ sutrāmadevatākaḥ surāyāgaḥ 
|| 

etānapi saṅkalayati ---- 


ebhiḥ saha vijānīyāt saṃskāraikonatriṃśakam || 10-402 || 


atha ---- 


agniṣṭomātyagniṣṭomau ukthyaḥ ṣoḍaśikā tathā | 

vājapeyo'tirātrastu āptoryāmastu saptamaḥ || 10-403 || 


ta ete yāgaviśeṣāḥ ---- 


somasaṃsthā samākhyātāḥ..............


grahakaraṇakasomapānayuktā yajñarūpāḥ kriyāḥ somasaṃsthāḥ || 

etāvadantānetān saṃskārān ---- 


............ṣaṭtriṃśat parisaṅkhyayā | 


proktamantrāhutikrameṇa kuryāditi śeṣaḥ | 


atha ---- 


hiraṇyapādaḥ prathamastathā guhyahiraṇyadhṛt || 10-404 || 

hiraṇyameḍhro hiraṇyanābhihīraṇyagarbha eva ca | 

hiraṇyaśrotro hiraṇyatvag hiraṇyākṣastathaiva ca || 10-405 || 

hiraṇyajihvastacchṛṅgo daśa yajñāḥ prakītītāḥ | 


garbho hṛdayam | ete pakṣyādyākārā agnicityāviśeṣā yeṣāṃ 
pādādisthāneṣu hiraṇyaṃ dīyate || 

yeṣāṃ tattatpakṣyādyākṛtibhedāt ---- 


śatena tu ghṛtaṃ cātra ekaikaṃ tu vijāyate || 10-406 || 


etatsampattyarthaṃ home viśeṣamāha ---- 


ete sarve sahasreṇa śuddhyante..........


sa eva sahasrahomasampādyo hiraṇyapādādiścityayajñaḥ | 


....ṣaptatriṃśakaḥ | 


kiṃ ca ---- 


aśvamedhaṃ tataḥ paścājjuhuyāttu yathākramam || 10-407 || 


brāhmaṇasyāpi karmavaśaprāptasārvabhaumabhūpatitvasyāyamaśvamedhaḥ
kārya eva || 407 || 

evaṃ vivāhāt prabhṛti etāvadantaiḥ ---- 


evaṃ kṛtaistu taiḥ sarvaistataścaiva gṛhī bhavet | 


dvitīyāśramasthaḥ || 


aṣṭātriṃśattamaṃ taṃ tu..........

aśvamedhākhyaṃ saṃskāraṃ jānīyādityarthaḥ | 

................vānaprasthaṃ tato bhavet || 10-408 || 

pārivrājyaṃ tato'nteṣṭimevaṃ brāhmaṇyamāpnuyāt | 


vānaprasthaṃ pārivrājyaṃ cāśramadvayarūpaṃ saṃskāradvayam | 
anteṣṭivīhitānanuṣṭhānasambhāvyamānaprāyaścittaśuddhayarthaṃ 
gārhasthyāvasthitasya kāryā, na tu vānaprasthasyāśritapārivrājyasya 
vā, tenāsau pṛthaṅ na gaṇyate | evamiti pārameśvaramantrahomakrameṇa, 
pāśave tu vidhau satyapi bījāharādidoṣasadbhāvānna samyag brāhmaṇyaṃ 
bhavati | idaṃ tu pārivrājyalakṣaṇaṃ catvāriṃśattamasaṃskārametaiḥ 
saha vijānate, etaiḥ saha gaṇitamiti yāvat || 


ata ātmaguṇānaṣṭau kathayāmi samāsataḥ || 10-409 || 

dayā sarveṣu bhūteṣu kṣāntiścāpyanasūyatā | 

śaucaṃ caivamanāyāso maṅgalaṃ cāpyataḥ param || 10-410 || 

akārpaṇyaṃ cāspṛhā cetyaṣṭāvātmaguṇāḥ smṛtāḥ | 


dayā parānukampā, kṣāntirapakāriṣu śaktatve'pyapratikriyā, 
paraguṇasahatvamanasūyatā, cittavākśarīraśuddhiḥ śaucam, 
akleśāvahakarmakāritvamanāyāsaḥ, maṅgalyadravyāṇāṃ 
darśanasparśanacintanāni maṅgalam, yathāśakti dātṛtvamakārpaṇyam, 
aspṛhā santoṣaḥ, ityete ātmana 
ātmasaṃnikṛṣṭasyāntaḥkaraṇavāgāderguṇāḥ, na tvātmanastasya 
cidekarūpatvāt | tatra (ca)1 dīkṣyātmano brāhmaṇyāya garbhādhānaṃ 
karomi svāhā, ityanena sapraṇaveśānoccārapūrveṇa mantreṇādau 
pañcakṛtvo hutvā punargarbhādhānaṃ sampannamastu, ityantena pañcakṛtvo 
juhuyāt | itthameva catvāriṃśadantān saṃskārān nidhāya 
vakṣyamāṇamantrakrameṇa guṇāṣṭakotthāpanapūrvaṃ 
brāhmaṇamasyāpādyeśānenaivādhikārabhogādipūrvaṃ brāhmaṇyamasya 
śodhyam || 

itthameva ---- 


catvāriṃśadathāṣṭau tu saṃskārāśca samāsataḥ || 10-411 || 

etaiḥ śuddhaistu śuddhyanti asaṃkhyā ye'pi suvrate | 


catvāriṃśaddehaviṣayāḥ, aṣṭau tu puryaṣṭakaniṣṭhāḥ | asaṃkhyā 
ityācārādhyāyoktavividhācārarūpāḥ || 

yata ete ātmaguṇāścatvāriṃśaddehasaṃskārānantaramuktāḥ ---- 


ato'nteṣṭiṃ tu hutvā vai guṇānāpādayecchiśoḥ || 10-412 || 


atrāpi brāhmaṇyaśuddhau sāmānyoktyeśānamantrasya viniyoge prāpte 
viśleṣamāha ---- 


pañca pañcāhutīrhutvā brahmabhiścāpyanukramāt | 


caśabda evārthe, brahmabhireva, apiśabdātsamucitohayuktaiḥ | 

anukramaśabdasyāyamarthaḥ ---- prāguktakrameṇa sadyāadicatuṣṭayena 
dayākṣāntyanasūyāśaucākhyaṃ catuṣṭayaṃ proktayuktyā pañcadhā 
pañcadhā hutvā, īśānenāyāsamaṅgalākārpaṇyāspṛhākhyaṃ 
catuṣṭayaṃ tathaivāhutibhiḥ sampādayediti || 

āhutiṣu karaṇamāha ---- 


tilairghṛtena vā tāṃśca...............


dattveti sambandhaḥ | tilāḥ snehamayabījātmakāḥ, ājyaṃ mūrtaḥ sneha 
iti | saṃskārabījānāṃ saṃskārābhilāṣasnehasya 
caitatpra(ti)kṛtirūpaṃ vāsanāsnehadāhātmake dīkṣākarmaṇi hotavyam || 
evaṃ kṛtvā ---- 


............ūrdhve tu viniyojayet || 10-413 || 


kimūrdhvamityāha ---- 

ūrdhvaśabdena cāśuddhaṃ yatkarma parikītītam | 


manuṣyajātipradasya karmaṇo bhūrloke śodhitatvāt 
taduparivatīdevayonipradaṃ karma yattadūrdhvamucyate || 

tacchuddhaye ca dīkṣyasya ---- 


tasmin saṃyojanaṃ kāryaṃ..............


na tu taṃ tyaktvānyatretyāha ---- 


.............ṇa cānyatra vidhīyate || 10-414 || 


etat sphuṭayati ---- 


tasmānnoddharaṇaṃ kāryaṃ na cāpi nayanaṃ kvacit | 

yattatra paripāṭyā tu karma tatra niyojayet || 10-415 || 


uddharaṇamullaṅghanam | nayanamasya sthāne'nyasya śodhanam | niyojayet iti 
dīkṣyam || 415 || 

evaṃ sthāvarādikrameṇa manuṣyajātibhedān saṃśodhya devayonīḥ 
śodhayitumāha ---- 


tato'ṇimādirāpādyo brahmabhiścāpyanukramāt | 

pañcāhutiprayogeṇa bhogārthaṃ caivamātmanaḥ || 10-416 || 


prāgvat saṃhārakrameṇa praṇavasadyojātoccārapūrvaṃ "devadattasya 
paiśācāṇimādimāpādayāmi svāhā" ityāhutīḥ pañca hutvā 
tadbhogaprāptimasya sañcintya tenaiva mantreṇa "paiśācabhogamasya 
śodhayāmi svāhā" iti pañcāhutīrdadyāt | anena krameṇa 
vāmadevāghoratatpuruṣaiḥ rākṣasayākṣagāndharvān saṃśodhya 
endrādibrahmāntacatuṣṭayaṃ  sattvapradhānamīśānabhaṭṭārakeṇaiva
śodhayet || 416 || 

na ca mānuṣyādanantaraṃ devayonīrurdhvasthāḥ śodhyāḥ, iti matvā 
buddhitattvavatīnīstāḥ śodhayet, api tu ---- 


ūrdhvaśabdena tajjñeyaṃ yadbhūrlokaṃ samāśritam | 

tasmin yuktasya kartavyaṃ na cānyasmin kadācana || 10-417 || 


bhūrlo(ka sa)1 māśritaṃ bhūrloke devayonyupapattidaṃ yatkarma, 
tadatrordhvaṃ jñātavyam | tatra yuktasya bhogārthaṃ yojitasya mantraiḥ 
kartavyaṃ śodhanamityarthāt, na tu buddhitattve, tatra 
sunandakarālādināmaviśeṣoccāraṇena śodhanasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt || 417 
|| 

yuktaṃ caitat, anyathā kramaprāptāt śodhyasthānād dīkṣyātmani ---- 


anuddhṛte kathaṃ yogaḥ.............


na ca tatastāvaduddharaṇaṃ yujyate ---- 


................yāvat karma na bhujyate | 


dīkṣyeṇa dīkṣāprabhāvāditi śeṣaḥ || 


yataścāyaṃ karmaphalamavaśyaṃ bhojayitavyaḥ tato yojanamasya 
tattatkarmavāsanaikatānatāmayamācāryeṇa bhāvanayā kriyata ityāha ---- 


tasmāttu yogaśabdena tattatkarmaikacintanā || 10-418 || 

nivartyate mahādevi..............


atha ---- 


...........ṇiṣkṛtiṃ juhuyāttataḥ | 

śivenāṣṭaśatāhutyā............


śiveneti niṣkalena | etaccaturthapaṭala eva nirṇītaṃ tathā 
vakṣyamāṇamapi || 

yadāha ---- 


...........ṭatastu bhuvanādhipān || 10-419 || 

bhuvanāntanīvāsāṃśca bhuvanānāṃ yathākramam | 

homenaiva tu saṃśodhya viśleṣaṃ chedanaṃ tathā || 10-420 || 

pūrṇāṃ caiva samuddhāraṃ tatsthatvaṃ cāpyanukramāt | 


kuryāditi śeṣaḥ | bhuvanānāṃ śodhane prastute bhuvaneśān 
kālāgnyādīn pradhānabhūtān bhuvanāntarvāsinaścānyānapi 
tadaṅgabhūtānāhūya āhutibhiḥ smartavyaśrāvaṇādipūrvaṃ visarjayediti 
| teṣāṃ śodhanaṃ kṛtvā bhuktebhyo bhogebhyo dīkṣyasya viśleṣo 
viyojanam, chedanaṃ tu sūtrasya bhuvanātmanaḥ pāśasya, samuddhāraṃ tato 
bhuvanāt, tatsthatvaṃ śiṣyahṛnniveśamityādi pūrvameva nirṇītam | 
yathākramamiti vadannuddhārādanantaramātmasthīkaraṇam, 
tatastatsthīkaraṇam, tato bhuvaneśāhvānamiti prāguktameva kramaṃ 
smārayati bhūrlokeśādhipatirbhagavān śarva ityagre bhaviṣyati || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


prāyaścittaṃ tato hutvā nyūnādhikanimittataḥ || 10-421 || 


uttaraṃ karma kāryamiti śeṣaḥ || 421 || 

etatsarvaṃ bhūrlokoktaṃ bhuvanāntaraśuddhāvapyatidiśati ---- 


evamādikrameṇaiva dhāmāntaṃ ca viśodhayet | 


dhāma samanāvadhikaśivatattvarūpaṃ tadantam | yaduktam ---- 

śamanāntaṃ varārohe pāśajālamanantakam" (4-410) iti | 

.vamādikrameṇeti, prokṣaṇādipūrvaṃ śiṣyātmanastatra 
prāguktasaṃskārāntaropaskṛn 
janmādhikārabhogalayaniṣkṛtiviśleṣapāśacchedapūrṇāhutyuccārātmastha
tatsthatvasaṃskārān kṛtvā 
bhuvaneśāhvānatarpaṇaśrāvaṇāvisarjanādiyuktyetyarthaḥ || 

tadetat prāsaṅgikamuktvā prakṛtamanubadhnāti ---- 


bhūrlokastu samākhyāto bhuvolokaṃ nibodha me || 10-422 || 

bhūpṛṣṭhādyāvadādityaṃ lakṣamekaṃ pramāṇataḥ | 


tatra ca ---- 


daśa vāyupathā madhye tvayutāyutasaṃkhyayā || 10-423 || 


ayutaṃ daśa sahasrāṇi, ayutāyutamantaramiti pāṭhe 
teṣāmayutāyutamantanīvāsasthānamiti vyākhyeyam || 423 || 

tatra ---- 


ādye vāyupathe meghān kathayāmi yathāsthitān | 


parameśvarecchāniyamitavāyuvitataviharaṇopabhogabhūmayo vāyupathāḥ || 

tatra ---- 


pañcāśadyojanādūrdhvamṛtaddhīrnāma mārutaḥ || 10-424 || 

yo vivardhayate puṣṭimoṣadhīnāṃ balaṃ tathā | 

bṛṃhayecca mahīṃ sarvāmāpyāyayati cāvyayaḥ || 10-425 || 


avyaya iti sadā āpyāyādi kurvannapi na kṣīyate || 425 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


divā haṃsaḥ sa vai vāyurmanujānāṃ sukhāvahaḥ | 


sa eva ---- 


yato gṛddhrān dhārayati tena gṛddhradharaḥ smṛtaḥ || 10-426 || 


eka evāyaṃ nānāsaṃjño nānāvyāpāraścetyarthaḥ || 426 || 


tadupari ---- 


prācetaso nāma vāyuḥ praceto'bhivinimītaḥ | 

sa vai nāśayate vṛkṣān kadācit sampravartayet || 10-427 || 


pracetasā varuṇenābhivinimīta utpāditaḥ | nāśayate dahati | 
pravartayatyudbhinnāṅkurān sampādayati || 427 || 

vāyoḥ kathaṃ dāhakatvamityāha ---- 


agniḥ prācetaso nāma tenaiva saha tiṣṭhati | 


tatsāhityādasau ---- 


yadā dahati veśmāni tadāsau samudāhṛtaḥ || 10-428 || 


etannāmaivetyarthaḥ || 428 || 

ayaṃ cāgnirvaḍavātmetyāha ---- 


sukhī samudre vasati..........


ayatnopanatanānānīrapānāśanaḥ || 


vasaṃścātra ---- 


............ṣa jalānnopaśāmyati | 


pratyuta jvalati || 

atha ---- 


yojanānāṃ śatādūrdhvaṃ senānīrvāyurucyate || 10-429 || 


ṅīcavāyuriti smṛtaḥ" iti kecitpaṭhanti | 
śatādūrdhvamityatrāyamāśayaḥ ---- bhūpṛṣṭhāt 
pañcāśadyojanordhvaṃ yojanapañcāśati ṛtaddhīḥ, pracetāśca 
pañcāśati || 429 || 


vidyudvanto mūkameghā vasantyasmiṃśca mārute | 


co hyarthe || 


te bhuvaḥ krośamātreṇa tiṣṭhanto'pasṛjantyapaḥ || 10-430 || 

yojanānāṃ śatādūrdhvaṃ meghāḥ sattvavahāḥ smṛtāḥ | 

matsyamaṇḍūkakūrmāṃśca varṣantyete ca dudīne || 10-431 || 


yata īdṛśāstataḥ sattvavahā ityarthaḥ || 431 || 

etasmāt sattvavahavyāptāt ---- 


yojanānāṃ śatādūrdhvaṃ vāyuroghaḥ prakītītaḥ | 

tasmiṃstu rogadā meghā varṣanti ca viṣodakam || 10-432 || 

tenopasargā jāyante............


co hyarthe || 

taiścopasargaiḥ pīḍādibhiḥ ---- 


..............ṃārakāḥ sarvadehinām | 


pravartante || 

atha ---- 


tasmādūrdhvaṃ tu tāva(d)1bho devyamoghaḥ sthito marut || 10-433 || 

tasmiṃste mārakā meghā amoghe sampratiṣṭhitāḥ | 


tāvadybhaḥ pañcāśata ityarthaḥ | tāvacchabdo 
vyavahitapañcāśadyojanāmarśakaḥ || 

atha ---- 


vajrāṅgo nāma vai vāyuḥ pañcāśadyojanasthitaḥ || 10-434 || 

tasmiṃstūpalakā nāma meghāstūpalavaṣīṇaḥ | 


tadupari ---- 


tāvadbhiryojanaireva tato vai vaidyuto'nilaḥ || 10-435 || 

meghāśca vaidyutāstasmin nivasanti tu vaidyute | 


tāvadbhiḥ pañcāśatā || 

vaidyutatvameteṣāṃ vidyutkāraṇatvenetyāha ---- 


aśanirvāyusaṃkṣobhātteṣvasau jāyate mahān || 10-436 || 


aśanivīdyut | teṣu megheṣu || 436 || 


tadūrdhvaṃ yojanānāṃ ca pañcāśadraivataḥ smṛtaḥ | 

tasmin puṣṭivaho nāma puṣṭiṃ varṣati dehinām || 10-437 || 


raivata iti tadākhyaḥ | puṣṭivahākhyo meghaḥ || 437 || 


tadupari sthite ---- 


saṃvarte rogadā meghāste rogodakavaṣīṇaḥ | 

pañcāśadyojane te vai tasmiṃstiṣṭhanti toyadāḥ || 10-438 || 


tato'pi ---- 


viṣāvarto nāma vāyuḥ pañcāśadupari sthitaḥ | 

tasmin krodhodakā nāma meghā vai sampratiṣṭhitāḥ || 10-439 || 

te krodharāgabahulaṃ saṃgrāmabahulaṃ tathā | 

rājñāṃ kṣayakaraṃ caiva prajānāṃ kṣayadaṃ tathā || 10-440 || 

varṣaṃ caivātra kurvanti yadā varṣanti te ghanāḥ | 


te ghanāḥ, saṃvartāśrayasya pañcāśata upari pañcāśadupari | 
viṣāvartasya tu mānamagre vakṣyati | krodhasahito rāgaḥ krodharāgastena 
bahulaṃ pūrṇaṃ tatsampādakamiti yāvat || 

oghādīn sapta vāyūn dharmasāmyena viśinaṣṭi ---- 


oghopyamegho vajrāṅgo vaidyuto raivatastathā || 10-441 || 

samvartaśca viṣāvarto vāyavo ghoraveginaḥ | 


ghoravegina iti, ghoro vego bhūmnā vidyate yeṣām || 


etatsaptakaṃ yeṣāmāspadaṃ tān krameṇāha ---- 


oghe vasanti vai divyāḥ piśācāḥ skandadehajāḥ || 10-442 || 

triṃśatkoṭisahasrāṇi skandasyānucarāḥ smṛtāḥ | 

te vai divyaiśca kusumairarcayanti harātmajam || 10-443 || 


tadūrdhvasthe ---- 


amoghe vināyakā ghorā mahādevasamudbhavāḥ | 

triṃśatkoṭisahasrāṇi tasmin vāyau pratiṣṭhitāḥ || 10-444 || 

ye haranti kṛtaṃ karma narāṇāmakṛtātmanām | 


akṛtātmanāmasaṃyamavatām || 


vajrāṅge'pi tathā vāyau mātaṅgāḥ krūrakamīṇaḥ || 10-445 || 

bhinnāñjananibhā ghorāstāpanā nāma viśrutāḥ | 


tadārohiṇaśca ---- 


vidyādharāṇāmadhamā manaḥpavanagāminaḥ || 10-446 || 


manaḥ pavanavanmātaṅgārohādeva gacchanti tacchīlāḥ, ata evādhamāḥ | 
uttamāstu vidyādiprabhāveṇaiva tattaddeśaprāptimantaḥ || 446 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


ye vidyāpauruṣe ye ca vetālādīn śmaśānataḥ | 

sādhayitvā tataḥ siddhāste'smin vāyau pratiṣṭhitāḥ || 10-447 || 


vidyāpauruṣe śāstravidyādispardhāyāṃ tathā vetālādīn sādhayitvā ye 
prasiddhā mṛtā ityarthaṃḥ || 447 || 


vaidyute'psarasastasmin vāsavena prayojitāḥ | 

tiṣṭhanti sarvadā tatra pṛthivīpurapālane || 10-448 || 


pṛthivīpurapālanaṃ caitat tāsāṃ yat tannivāsisadācārajanapadasya 
vimānaiḥ svabhūmiprāpaṇam || 448 || 

tadāha ---- 


bhṛgau vahnau jale vāpi saṃgrāmeṣvanivartakāḥ | 

gograhe bandimokṣe vā mirayante puruṣottamāḥ || 10-449 || 

te vrajanti tatastūrdhvaṃ vimānairmaṇicihnitaiḥ | 

patākādīghīkākīrṇaidīvyaghaṇṭānināditaiḥ || 10-450 || 


na nivartanta ityanivartakāḥ sammukhaṃ ye mirayanta ityarthaḥ | gavāṃ 
grahaḥ siṃhādibhirākramaṇam | bandyo balādgṛhītā haṭhamirayamāṇāḥ 
parayoṣitaḥ | ete ca saṃgrāmādau mṛtāḥ sadācāratvāt puruṣottamāḥ, 
na tu pūrve ---- 

"asūryā nāma te lokā andhena tamasāvṛtāḥ |"

tāṃste pretyābhigacchanti ye ke cātmahano (janāḥ)1 ||" (īśā0 3)

iti śrutau teṣāmanuttamatvenoktatvāt | tata iti svabhūmeḥ || 450 || 

kathaṃ vrajantītyāha ---- 


strīsahasraparīvāraivīmānaistānnayanti tāḥ | 


yata iti śeṣaḥ | tā ityapsarasaḥ | 


raivate tu mahātmānaḥ siddhā vai sampratiṣṭhitāḥ || 10-451 || 

goroca(nāñja)2ne bhasmapāduke ajinādi ca | 

sādhayitvā mahātmānaḥ siddhāste kāmarūpiṇaḥ || 10-452 || 


siddhāḥ sampannāḥ || 452 || 

tataścātra ---- 


te vasanti mahātmāno divyāṃ siddhimavasthitāḥ | 


vajrāṅgasthatvena tadrūpatvād vidyādharādhamā uktāḥ || 


saṃvarte'pi mahāvāyau vidyādharagaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ || 10-453 || 

daśa triṃśacca koṭyaste divyābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ | 

divyagandhānuliptāste divyasragdhāmabhūṣitāḥ || 10-454 || 


daśa ye gaṇāḥ saṃkṣepataḥ, ta eva vistaratastriṃśatkoṭaya 
ityatrārthaḥ | ete ca vidyādharā devayonibhedā eva, na tu manuṣyāḥ 
santaḥ khaḍgādisiddhyā siddhāḥ || 

athaitadupari ---- 


āgneyā dhūmajā meghāḥ śītadudīnadāḥ smṛtāḥ | 

viṣāvartaṃ nāvamiva te vāyuṃ yānti miśritāḥ || 10-455 || 

tatra gāndharvakuśalā gandharvasahadhamīṇaḥ | 

vaṃśavīṇāvidhijñāśca pakṣiṇaḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ || 10-456 || 


gandharvasahadhamītā gāndharveṇa maheśvarārādhakatvam || 456 || 


brahmajā nāma vai meghā brahmaniḥ śvāsasambhavāḥ | 

upariṣṭādyojanaśatād durjayasyopari sthitāḥ || 10-457 || 


viṣāvartākhyavāyuvyāptayojanaśatopariṣṭād yo durjayo nāma vāyuḥ, 
tasyopari brahmajā meghāḥ sthitā iti saṅgatiḥ || 457 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


tatra vai durjayā nāma indrasya parirakṣakāḥ |
