parāvahābhidhaṃ vāyuṃ te samāśritya saṃsthitāḥ || 10-458 || 

mahāvīryabalopetā daśa koṭyaḥ prakītītāḥ | 


tatreti durjayasamīpe parāvahābhidhaṃ vāyaṃ samāśrityeti saṅgatiḥ || 

ato'pyūrdhvam ---- 


puṣkarāvartakā nāma meghā vai padmajodbhavāḥ || 10-459 || 


tathā ---- 


śakreṇa pakṣā ye cchinnāḥ parvatānāṃ mahātmanām | 

parāvahastān vahati manujāniva vāraṇaḥ || 10-460 || 


tāniti puṣkarāvartakān parvatapakṣāṃśca parāvahākhyo vāyurvahati || 
460 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


tasmin vāyugamā nāma gandharvā gaganālayāḥ | 

ekādaśa tu vai koṭyasteṣāṃ tu samudāhṛtāḥ || 10-461 || 


tathā ---- 


jīmūtā nāma ye meghā devebhyo jīvasambhavāḥ | 

dvitīyamāvahaṃ vāyuṃ meghāste ca samāśritāḥ || 10-462 || 

tasmin jīmūtakā nāma vidyādharagaṇā daśa | 


jīvasamudbhavā iti ---- jīvaḥ śvāsaḥ, tata udbhavāḥ | 
dvitīyamāvahamiti puṣkarāvartakāśrayaṃ parāvahamityarthaḥ, na tu 
prathamaṃ durjayānāmādhāram || 

atha ---- 


āvahastu tato vāyuryatra droṇāḥ samāśritāḥ || 10-463 || 

tasmin droṇāḥ samākhyātā meghānāṃ parirakṣakāḥ | 


droṇā nāma meghaviśeṣā adhovatīmeghānāmayathākāritvaṃ rakṣante || 

yataḥ ---- 


hitārthaṃ tu prajānāṃ vai nimītāste mayā purā || 10-464 || 


mayeti kailāsastheneti tatra pravakturuktiḥ | hitamadhovatīmeghebhya 
upadravaparirakṣā || 464 || 

athaiṣām ---- 


upariṣṭāt kapālotthāḥ saṃvartā nāma vai ghanāḥ | 

mahāparivaho nāma vāyusteṣāṃ samāśrayaḥ || 10-465 || 


kapālotthā iti mamaivetyarthāt || 465 || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


ādye vāyupathe hyevaṃ meghā vai vāyubhiḥ saha | 

siddhāśca patayaścaiva kathitā meghacāriṇaḥ || 10-466 || 


daśasahasronmāno yo'yamādyo vāyupathastasya bhuva ūrdhvaṃ śūnyaṃ 
pañcāśadyojanāni, tadūrdhvamṛtaddhīḥ, prācetasaḥ, senānīḥ, 
sattvavahaḥ, oghaḥ, amoghaḥ, vajrāṅgaḥ, vaidyutaḥ raivataḥ, saṃvartaḥ, 
viṣāvarta iti | eta ekādaśa ye vāyavasteṣāṃ madhyāt senānīḥ 
sattvavahaśca śate śate yojanānāṃ sthitaḥ, śeṣāḥ, pratyekaṃ 
pañcāśadyojanāvasthitaya iti kalanayā bhūpṛṣṭhādviṣāvartānte 
yojanasaptaśatī | tadupari sahasranavake śatatraye ca 
durjayaparāvahadvayāvahāvahamahāparivahākhyāḥ pañca vāyavaḥ sthitā 
iti || 466 || 

ādyaṃ vāyupathaṃ vitatyoktvā, anyān saṃkṣepeṇa vibhajate ---- 


dvitīye vāyupathe jñeyā agnikanyāśca mātaraḥ | 

tā vasanti guṇopetā rudraśaktyā tvadhiṣṭhitāḥ || 10-467 || 


mātaro'pareṇa rūpeṇa brāhmyādyāḥ | guṇena sarvajñatvādinopetā yato 
rudraśaktyadhiṣṭhitāḥ || 467 || 

atha ---- 


tṛtīye vāyupathe caiva vasante siddhacāraṇāḥ | 

svakarmabhogasaṃsiddhāḥ sarvasiddhairadhiṣṭhitāḥ || 10-468 || 


svaṃ prāktanaṃ śubhaṃ karma, bhogastattatpadocitasukhātmakaḥ, tadvaśena 
saṃsiddhāḥ prāptatatpadāḥ | sarvasiddhairapyanyairapi 
tattatpadocitayogasiddhairadhiṣṭhitā āsāditāḥ || 468 || 

tadupari ---- 


caturthe pathi caivātra vasantyāyudhadevatāḥ | 

nārācacakracāpaṣṭīśūlaśaktīṣumudagarāḥ || 10-469 || 


ṛṣṭirāyudhaviśeṣaḥ | ete ca khaḍgakhaṭvāṅgādīnapyupalakṣayanti | 
āyudhānāmeva ca taddevatānāma || 469 || 

atha ---- 


pañcame pathi deveśi vasantyairāvatādayaḥ | 

erāvato'ñjanaścaiva vāmanaśca mahāgajaḥ || 10-470 || 

supratīko gajendraśca puṣpadantastathaiva ca | 

kumudaḥ puṇḍarīkaśca sārvabhaumo'pi cāṣṭamaḥ || 10-471 || 


vāmanasya viśeṣaṇaṃ mahāgaja iti | tathā supratīkasya karīndra iti || 
471 || 

ta ete ---- 


diggajā iti vikhyātāḥ svāsu dikṣu vyavasthitāḥ | 


vyavasthitā iti pūrvādikrameṇa nabhasyeva || 

tato'pi ---- 


ṣaṣṭhe vāyupathe devi pakṣirājo mahābalaḥ || 10-472 || 

garutmāniti vikhyāto durjayo'tīva vīryavān | 

saptame vyomagaṅgā tu nānājalacarānugā || 10-473 || 

divyāmṛtajalā puṇyā tridhā sā parikītītā | 


divyamamṛtatulyaṃ jalaṃ yasyāḥ sā | tridheti 
satyalokasvarlokabhuvarlokasthityā || 


sā bhrāntā nabhaso madhye samantāt parimaṇḍalā || 10-474 || 

ākāśagaṅgā prathitā devānāṃ satatotsavā | 

puṣpamāleva sā bhāti nabhasaḥ śirasi sthitā || 10-475 || 

tatra siddhairmahābhāgaivīdyādharagaṇaistathā | 

gandharvairapsarobhiśca sādhyaivīśvairmarudgaṇaiḥ || 10-476 || 

rudrairvasubhirādityaiḥ pitṛdevamahaṣībhiḥ | 

rakṣobhirguhyakaiścaiva divyastutiparāyaṇaiḥ || 10-477 || 

stuvadbhiśca japadbhiśca gāyadbhiśca mahātmabhiḥ | 

nṛtyadbhirvalgamānaiśca divyadundubhiniḥsvanaiḥ || 10-478 || 

bherīmṛdaṅgavādyaiśca vallakīnāṃ ca niḥsvanaiḥ | 

vaṃśavāditranādaiśca manovāyusamīritaiḥ || 10-479 || 


tatra siddhairiti siddhādibhirupalakṣitā | rudrādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ 
viśeṣaṇaṃ pitṛdevairiti | stuvadbhiścetyādibhivīśeṣaṇaiḥ pūrve 
yathāyogaṃ viśeṣyāḥ | divyadundubhiniḥsvanairityādyā nṛttaṃ valganaṃ 
ca prati hetutṛtīyāḥ | manodhiṣṭhitena vāyuneti prāṇena samīritaiḥ 
pūritairiti yojyam || 479 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


vaidūryanālaiḥ kamalairhemapatraiḥ sugandhibhiḥ | 

kesaraiḥ padmarāgaiśca mahācakrapramāṇakaiḥ || 10-480 || 

nṛtyantīva saricchreṣṭhā vimānaśatamaṇḍitā | 

maṇḍitā ca vanaidīvyairdharmādhārā mahānadī || 10-481 || 


kesaraiḥ padmarāgairiti padmarāgātmakakesarayuktaiḥ padmairityarthaḥ | 
dharma ā samantāddhāryate darśanasparśanādinā sampādyate yayā || 481 || 
yuktaṃ caitat, yataḥ ---- 


mama netrādviniṣkrāntā kriyāśaktiḥ parā hi sā | 


etatpūrvameva nirṇītam || 

saiṣā ---- 


mahāmandākinī devī tridaśaiḥ paryupāsitā || 10-482 || 

mahāvimānakoṭībhinīrantaramavasthitaiḥ	 | 

śobhitāsau bhagavatī nityamāste nabhastale || 10-483 || 


mahattvaṃ prabhāvātiśayādasyāḥ | avasthitairiti tridaśaviśeṣaṇam || 
483 || 


tatraiṣā meruśirasi mama vai mastakāccyutā | 

papāta dharaṇīpṛṣṭhe lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 10-484 || 


eṣā gaṅgā pūrvavaṇītayuktyā devairabhyathītena mayā 
martyalokapāvanāya samāhūya visṛṣṭā satī meruśiraḥsthitasya mama 
mastakaṃ prāpya, tataścyutā meruśirasi sthitā, paścād dharaṇīpṛṣṭhe 
papāteti saṅgatiḥ | uktaṃ ca prāk ---- 


"āgatya mama mūrdhānaṃ merumūdhnī punargatā | 

tasmānnirgatya deveśi catudīkṣūdadhiṃ gatā ||" (10-181)

iti || 484 || 

kiṃ ca, madīyaniyatiśaktiniyantraṇataḥ ---- 


akṣobhyā sāpyasau gaṅgā tiṣṭhatyaniladhāritā | 


anyathā kathamanilena na kṣobhyeta kathaṃ vāhyeta || 


yojanānāṃ śataṃ pūrṇaṃ vistāro'syāḥ prakītītaḥ || 10-485 || 

pariṇāhastataḥ koṭyaḥ.............


tata iti tasminnākāśe | koṭya iti bahvayaḥ koṭaya ityarthaḥ || 

eṣā cātra ---- 


.................ṃahāvegavatī śubhā | 

sā bhramantīva saṃtiṣṭhet samantāt parimaṇḍalā || 10-486 || 


parimaṇḍaleti brahmāṇḍāntarākāśasya tathātvāt || 486 || 

dhruvamāpūrya sā devī tvatyadbhutamavasthitā | 


dhruvamiti tannābhinibaddhabhacakramityarthaḥ | devī dyotamānā | 
atyadbhutaṃ kṛtvāvasthitā || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


divyāmṛtavahā puṇyā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī || 10-487 || 


divi bhavaṃ divyaṃ lokottaramamṛtaṃ jalaṃ vahati || 487 || 

atha ---- 


aṣṭame vṛṣarājastu sapatnīkaḥ sanandanaḥ | 

vasati tvapratīghātaḥ pratyakṣo dharma eva saḥ || 10-488 || 


vṛṣarāja iti maheśvarasya vāhanam | apratīghātaḥ svecchāvihārī | 
dharma iti ---- 

"vṛṣo dharmaḥ sa devasya guṇo jñānakriyātmakaḥ | 

dhatte sa cidacidyasmāddharmastenocyate budhaḥ ||"

iti śrīmanmayasaṃgrahoktasatattvaḥ || 488 || 


navame pathi cātrāste dakṣo nāma prajāpatiḥ | 

brahmaiva sākṣādvasati brahmaśaktyā tvadhiṣṭhitaḥ || 10-489 || 


brahmaṇaḥ śaktinīrmātṛrūpā || 489 || 


daśame vāyupathe devi vasurudradivākarāḥ | 


ete ca pūrvaṃ gaṅgāsevārthamito'vatīrṇā vaṇītāḥ || 

tatra prādhānyādādau rudrānnāmato darśayati ---- 


atra cāṅgārakaḥ sapīrnairṛtaḥ sadasatpatiḥ || 10-490 || 

budhaśca dhūmaketuśca vikhyātaśca jvarastathā | 

ajaśca bhuvaneśaśca mṛtyuḥ kāpālikastathā || 10-491 || 

ekādaśa smṛtā rudrāḥ sarvakāmaphalodayāḥ | 


sadasaspatiriti yaḥ kvaciduktaḥ | jvaro vikhyātaḥ trijagatprasiddhaḥ | 
sarveṣāṃ kāmaphalānāmudayo yebhya iti samāsaḥ || 

tadittham ---- 


dhātā dhruvaśca somaśca varuṇaścānilo'nalaḥ || 10-492 || 

pratyūṣaśca pradoṣaśca vasavo'ṣṭau prakītītāḥ | 


tadittham ---- 

vasavaḥ kathitā hyete ādityāṃśca nibodha me || 10-493 || 

aryamā indravaruṇau pūṣā viṣṇurgabhastimān | 

mitraścaiva samākhyātastvajaghanyo jaghanyakaḥ || 10-494 || 

vivasvāṃścaiva parjanyo dhātā vai dvādaśaḥ smṛtaḥ | 

kāśyapeyān vidustvetān...........


kaśyapasyāmī kāśyapeyāḥ, kaśyapāpatyānītyarthaḥ || 


................ṭeṣāṃ tejonidheratha || 10-495 || 

amṛtodbhavo ratho divyaḥ sarvadevasamanvitaḥ | 


teṣāṃ vasurudrādityānāṃ madhyāt tejonidherādityasya kṣīrododbhavo 
rathaḥ, tasyaiva tadārūḍhasya jagatprakāśāya niyuktatvāt | 
tejonidheścidarkasya paraśaktyamṛtotthitaḥ pūrvoktadṛśā sarvadevamayaḥ 
prāṇarūpo ratha ityapi sūcitam || 

anena yaduktaṃ sarvadevamaya iti, tadvibhajate ---- 


yajñaścakraṃ rathe tasmin sarvajñānamayī ca dhūḥ || 10-496 || 

saptāśvāśca svarāḥ sapta vedahūṅkāraniḥsvanāḥ | 

nāgā yoktrāṇi teṣāṃ vai aruṇaścaiva sārathiḥ || 10-497 || 

satyaṃ ca mañcakaṃ tasya vāyurvego rathasya tu | 


yajñaḥ kriyāśaktyātmā devatā, asya rathasya cakram, 
tadvaśādūrdhvādharasthasarvalokayātrāsampatteḥ | yaduktaṃ gītāsu ---- 

"tasmāt sarvagataṃ brahma nityaṃ yajñe pratiṣṭhitam" (3-15) iti | 

viśvān yajatītyāmnātatvāt sarvaśāstrajñānamayī vāgīśvarī asya 
dhūḥ, yatra lagnā aśvā vahanti |  te ca 
samastavācakātmakavedapradhānabhūtahūṅkārarūpaheṣāśabdavyañjakāḥ 
ṣaḍjādyāḥ sapta svarāḥ | evaṃ ca nadannādāmarśotthitatvaṃ 
jñānakriyādevatākāṇḍarūpatvātparāparatadubhayasiddhimayatvaṃ ca 
ūrdhvādharaśaktisambandhena vedānāṃ pratimantramudrāsthānīyatvena 
darśayati | yoktrāṇi bandhanarajjavaḥ | nāgā anantādyāḥ teṣāṃ 
ṣaḍjādīnām | na agāḥ satatagatiśīlāḥ saṅkalpā niyoktāraḥ | 
aruṇo'nūrurdīpto'haṅkāraśca | satyaṃ ca ṛtam | mañcakamāsanam | 
pratiprakāśamāne viśvatra sādhvādhāratayā sthitaṃ sattvātmakaṃ 
buddhitattvam | rathasya vego vāyvākhyā devatā | prāṇanātmana āntarasya 
ca rathasya prāṇāpānādirūpo vāyvātmaiva vegaḥ || 

tadevamīdṛgrathāruḍhasya ---- 


navayojanasāhasro vigraho bhāskarasya tu || 10-498 || 

triguṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ tasya trailokye bhāti bhāsvaram | 


jīvādityasyāpi navatālo vigrahaḥ | maṇḍalaṃ ca prakāśātmakaṃ 
tribhiḥ sattvādibhirguṇairupetam || 

sa cāyamasāmānya ityāha ---- 


jñānaśaktiḥ parā hyeṣā tapatyādityavigrahā || 10-499 || 


sarvaśaktermaheśvarasya viśvaprakāśikā 
jñānaśaktirjīvādityabāhyādityarūpatayā sthitetyarthaḥ || 

itthaṃ pārameśajñānaśaktyātmakā dvādaśādityāḥ ---- 


māsavāraprayogeṇa sañcaranti śivecchayā | 


māsena vāraḥ, sa eva prayogo niyogaḥ | jīvādityasya māsādivibhāgaḥ 
prāgeva nirṇītaḥ | dvādaśadhātvaṃ cāsya buddhibhedāt | śivecchayeti 
nātrānyasyecchā prabhavatītyarthaḥ || 

ataśca ---- 


ahorātraṃ bhramantyete bhuvarlokaṃ samantataḥ || 10-500 || 


etacca ---- 

"udayo yo'marāvatyā" (10-338)

iti proktānusāreṇa yojyam | yattu ---- 
vṛhaṭṭīkākārarājānakabhullakena yāvadaśeṣabhuvanaprakāśanavyāptiḥ 
sūryasya nāsti, tāvatsūryasaṃyamād bhuvanajñānaṃ kathaṃ 
panatañjalinoktam1, ata ā pātālāt satyalokāntaṃ sūryasya 
prakāśakatvamiti svarucyā vyākhyātam, tadasāratvādupekṣyam || 500 || 

atha sūryopari candrādīnāṃ sthitivibhāgamāha ---- 


tataḥ somastu lakṣeṇa ādityopari saṃsthitaḥ | 

āpyāyayan jagatsarvaṃ sudhādhārāpravarṣaṇaiḥ || 10-501 || 


itthaṃ ca ---- 


candrarūpeṇa tapati kriyāśaktiḥ śivasya tu | 

indūrdhve lakṣamātreṇa sthitaṃ nakṣatramaṇḍalam || 10-502 || 


nakṣatramaṇḍalaṃ tārācakram || 502 || 


lakṣadvayena tasyordhvaṃ saṃsthito bhūminandanaḥ | 

lakṣadvayena tasyordhve saṃsthitaḥ somanandanaḥ || 10-503 || 

surācāryo'pi tasyordhve dvilakṣeṇaiva saṃsthitaḥ | 

tasyordhve'pi dvilakṣeṇa tiṣṭhate bhṛgunandanaḥ || 10-504 || 

tasyopari dvilakṣeṇa sauriḥ sarpati līlayā | 


sarpati rāśiṣu sañcarati | līlayeti mandamandam, yato'yaṃ śanaiścaraḥ 
|| 

tasyopari ---- 


lakṣamātreṇa tu ṛṣīn kathayāmi samāsataḥ || 10-505 || 


tānyathāvasthitikrameṇāha ---- 


atriścaiva vaśiṣṭhaśca pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ | 

bhṛgvaṅgirā marīciśca...........


śṛgvaṅgirā gotranāmakramābhyāmeka eva || 

ete sapta ---- 


........ṝṣayaḥ samprakītītāḥ || 10-506 || 

yamaniyamato hyete śāpānugrahakārakāḥ | 


ahiṃsādyā yamāḥ1 | śaucādyā niyamāḥ2 || 506 || 


kiṃ ca ---- 


bhītāśca parapīḍāyāḥ..........


pratyavāyināmapi nigrahaṃ na kurvanti, dayāparatantratvāt || 

tathā ---- 


...........śūrāḥ śāstravicāraṇe || 10-507 || 


śūrāstīkṣṇadhiyaḥ || 507 || 

ata evānugrāhyāṇām ---- 


jñānakhaḍgodyatāḥ sarve tvajñānapaṭalāpahāḥ | 


ajñānameva citprakāśāvarakatvāt paṭalastamapaghnanti || 

tadarthameva ca ---- 


mantrayogakriyācaryāsaṃnaddhā duratikramāḥ || 10-508 || 

yogaiśvaryaguṇopetā śivārādhanatatparāḥ | 


mananasārā mantrāḥ, yogo dhyānadhāraṇādiḥ, kriyā 
nityanaimittikānuṣṭhānam, caryā vratādirūpā, etairmantrādibhiḥ 
saṃnaddhāḥ pariṣkṛtāḥ | ata eva duratikramā ajñānena na 
kadācidabhibhūyante | ataśca yogaiśvaryaguṇairaṇimādisiddhibhirupetāḥ | 
tathāpi śivārādhanapradhānakarmaṇi tatparā nityāsaktāḥ || 

atha ---- 


tebhyo lakṣād dhruvo devi tārakāḥ sa caturdaśa || 10-509 || 


eka eva san || 509 || 

ataścaturdaśabhistārakābhiḥ ---- 


śarīraṃ ghaṭitaṃ tābhirdhruvasya varavaṇīni | 


tathā ca ---- 

"uttānapānmakhahanuḥ śucidharmamūrdhā

nārāyaṇāśvivaruṇāryamahṛtpadoruḥ | 

saṃvatsaraprajanano jaghanasthamitro

vahnīndrakaśyapamarīcyabhayākhya pucchaḥ ||"

iti jyotiḥśāstre hanuśiraḥprabhṛtigātrārambho'sya 
yajñadharmādidevatābhiruktaḥ | 

eṣa ca ---- 


brahmaivāpararūpeṇa brahmasthāne niyojitaḥ || 10-510 || 


satyalokastho brahmāṇḍenāpararūpeṇa bhuvarlokamadhye niyuktaḥ || 510 || 

itthaṃ madhye cakranābhivadavasthitasya ---- 


tasya jyotirgaṇo devi nibaddho bhramate sadā | 

niścalaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ śivaśaktyā tvadhiṣṭhitaḥ || 10-511 || 


śivaśaktyaivetthaṃ vyavasthāpita ityarthaḥ | eṣa 
cāntarasthityā'vicalaścidātmaiva 
samadhyavāhatrayodaśendriyatārācakraparivṛtaḥ 
kālādhikāroktasthityāśeṣagraharkṣādyāśrayaṇaprāṇāpānasūrya 
somasañcārapravartaka iti boddhavyam | ata evātmapratinidhirūpadhruvasya ---
- 

"yadahnā kurute pāpaṃ dṛṣṭvā tanniśi mucyate | 

adhikaṃ ca bhavatyāyurdhruvāntānāṃ samāḥ samāḥ ||"

ityasya jyotiḥśāstrādau śrūyate | yattu tatra dhruvanābhinibaddhasya 
grahanakṣatracakrasya bahirbhūgolaṃ yannivartanam, sūryādīnāṃ 
bhūmyādeścānvathāvasthānaparimāṇādi śrūyate, tat ---- 

"yadupacitamanyajanmani śubhāśubhaṃ tasya karmaṇaḥ paṅktim | 

vyañjayati śāstrametattamasi dravyāṇi dīpa iva ||" (sū0jā0 1-3)

iti taduktaprakriyayaiva 
pūrvakarmānusāritejogolakādhiṣṭhātṛsūryādirūpadevatāpekṣayā 
karmārjanasthānasthabhūmyapekṣayā ca tathā, idaṃ tu 
tejogolakādyadhiṣṭhātṛsūryādirūpadevatāpekṣayā | 
yathoktaprakriyayaiva sūryādīnāmavasthānasaṃniveśabhramaṇādi 
pātālabhūmyādiparimāṇādi vāstavam | 
sarvasarvajñamaheśvaraparidṛṣṭametadeveti na tena saha 
saṃvādavisaṃvādādicarcā kāryā | ata eva ---- 

"śāstrāntarairna yaddṛṣṭaṃ taddṛṣṭaṃ pārameśvare | 

niyatyādi śivāntaṃ vāk kvānyatra paridṛśyate ||"

itīyameva prakriyā sādhvī || 511 || 


daśa pañca ca lakṣāṇi dhruvāntaṃ bhūmimaṇḍalāt | 


bhuvaḥ sūryendubhacakrāṇi pratyekaṃ lakṣāntaritāni, pratyekaṃ 
lakṣadvayena bhaumādyāḥ pañca, lakṣeṇa saptarṣayaḥ | lakṣeṇa dhruva 
iti pañcadaśalakṣameva dhruvāntaṃ bhavati || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


vāyuskandhān sthitāṃstvatra kathayāmi samāsataḥ || 10-512 || 

atreti pañcadaśayojanalakṣonmānabhuvaḥsvarlokadvaye | 


īśvaraśaktiniyamitavāyusaṃniviṣṭabhuvanādirūpān vāyuskandhān 
kathayāmi || 512 || 

teṣāṃ kakṣyābhedamāha ---- 


ā meghādbhāskarāt somānnakṣatrād grahamaṇḍalāt | 

ṛṣisaptakanirdeśādādhruvāntaṃ ca saptamaḥ || 10-513 || 


ā meghāditi proktavāyupathagatebhyo meghebhyaḥ prabhṛti dhruvāntaṃ 
saptasu kakṣyāsu sapta vāyuskandhāḥ sthitāḥ | yaduktaṃ purāṇeṣu ---- 

"pṛthivyāṃ prathamaḥ skandha ā meghebhyo ya āvahaḥ | 

dvitīyaścāpi meghebhya ā sūryāt pravahastu yaḥ || 

sūryādūrdhvaṃ tathā somādudvaho yastu vai smṛtaḥ | 

somādūrdhvaṃ tatharkṣebhyaścaturthaḥ saṃvahastu yaḥ || 

ṛkṣordhvaṃ grahaparyantaṃ pañcamo vivahastu yaḥ | 

ūrdhvaṃ grahādṛṣibhyastu ṣaṣṭho yo'sau parāvahaḥ || 

saptaṣībhyastathaivordhvamā dhruvāt saptamaḥ smṛtaḥ | 

vātaskandhaḥ parivahaḥ................................. ||"

iti | 

tatraiva ca pratyekaṃ śukrajyotiḥ 
satyajyotiścitrajyotirjyotiṣmānityādisaṃjñāḥ sapta saptāvāntarabhedā 
uktāḥ || 513 || 

tadayam ---- 


ādityādidhruvāntaśca svarlokaḥ parikītītaḥ | 

atra rājā mahendro vai tiṣṭhate surapūjitaḥ || 10-514 || 

ṛṣidevaiḥ sagandharvairvṛtaścāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ | 


bhūpṛṣṭhādādityānto bhuvarloko yojanānāṃ lakṣamekam | tato 
dhruvāntaḥ svargalokaścaturdaśa lakṣāṇi || 

īdṛśaṃ cāmum ---- 


agnihotraṃ kratūn vāpi kṛtvā jñānavivajītāḥ || 10-515 || 

svarlokaṃ tu narā yānti punarāyānti mānuṣam | 


agnihotraṃ nityāgniniṣṭho homaḥ, kratavastu jyotiṣṭomādayaḥ | 
jñānavivajītatvād dehānte svarlokaṃ yānti | tatra svakarmopacitaphalaṃ 
bhuktvā punarmānuṣādikamāyānti | jñāninastu yajñādi kurvanto'pi 
niṣkāmatvānmucyanta ityāśayaḥ || 

itthamevaṃvidhasya ---- 


svarlokasyopariṣṭāttu dve koṭī yojanāni tu || 10-516 || 

pañcāśītiśca lakṣāṇi maharloko varānane | 


evamihatyaprakriyayā sūryānto bhuvarlokaḥ | dhruvāntaḥ svarlokaḥ 
tadūrdhve sapañcāśītilakṣaṃ koṭidvayaṃ maharlokaḥ | 
śrīparāmṛgendrādau tu dhruvānto bhuvarlokaḥ, tadūrdhvam ---- 

"pañcāśītimitairlakṣaiḥ svarlokaḥ svargasaṃśrayaḥ | 

koṭidvayaṃ maharloko mahānto yatra saṃsthitāḥ ||" iti,

"tithilakṣairbhuvarloko dhruvaprānto mahītalāt | 

tadūnakoṭiḥ svarloka.......................... ||" (13-114)

iti prakriyābhedo dṛśyate, sa 
tadgranthasaṃgrahakartṛbhistathānibaddhatvāt | idaṃ tu 
sākṣātparameśvareṇoktam ---- 

"bhūrbhuvaḥsvardhruvāntaṃ syāllakṣāṇi............ |"

"...................ṃahān koṭidvayaṃ bhavet ||"


iti kiraṇādigranthena bhagavaduktena ca saṃsavādamityayameva kramo yuktaḥ 
|| 

atra maharloke ---- 


ṛṣayaścaiva siddhāśca mārkaṇḍādyā vasanti vai || 10-517 || 


atha ---- 

koṭyaṣṭakaṃ mahādevi yojanānāṃ varānane | 

maharlokopariṣṭāttu janaloko vyavasthitaḥ || 10-518 || 


kiṃ ca ---- 

ekapādo'tha jahnuśca kapilaścāsuristathā | 

bhautiko vāḍvaliścaiva janalokanivāsinaḥ || 10-519 || 


atha ---- 

dvādaśaiva tathā koṭyo janalokordhvataḥ priye | 

tapolokaḥ samākhyāta ṛṣiyogeśvarākulaḥ || 10-520 || 


tānāha ---- 

sanakaśca sanandaśca sanatkumāraḥ sanandanaḥ | 

śaṅkuścaiva triśaṅkuśca tapolokanivāsinaḥ || 10-521 || 


atha prasaṅgādbhūrlokāt satyalokāntaṃ bhuvanasaṃkhyāmāha ---- 


padmāḥ ṣaṭpañcapañcaśat koṭyo lakṣāṇi viṃśatiḥ | 

bhūrlokāntaṃ samārabhya yāvatsatyaṃ varānane || 10-522 || 

iyaṃ saṃkhyā samākhyātā bhuvanānāṃ varānane | 


parameśvareṇa bṛhattantra iti śeṣaḥ | padmasaṃkhyā ekādaśapaṭale 
vakṣyamāṇā | prakṛtamāha ---- 


koṭyaḥ ṣoḍaśa mānena tapolokordhvataḥ priye || 10-523 || 

satyalokaḥ samākhyāto yatra brahmā svayaṃ sthitaḥ | 

krīḍate bhagavān devo vṛta ātmasamaidvījaiḥ || 10-524 || 


yataste tatra ---- 


karmajñānena saṃsiddhā advaitapariniṣṭhitāḥ | 

ānandapadasamprāptā ānandapadamāgatāḥ || 10-525 || 


karmaṇā nityanaimittikānuṣṭhānena jñānena ca vedāntoktena samuccitena
samyak siddhāḥ, ata eva "vijñānamānandaṃ brahma" (bṛ0u0 3-9-34) 
ityuktādvaitapade pariniṣṭhitā rūḍhabhāvanāḥ, ataśca 
satyalokākhyamidamānandapadaṃ mahābhogasthānaṃ samprāptā adhirūḍhāḥ, 
atrāpi cānandapadamāgatāḥ svātmārāmā evetyarthaḥ || 525 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


ṛgvedo mūtīmāṃstasminnindralīnasamadyutiḥ | 

divyagandhaviliptāṅgo divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ || 10-526 || 

saṃsthitaḥ pūrvatastasya dīpyamānaḥ svatejasā | 

uttareṇa yajurvedaḥ śuddhasphaṭikasaṃnibhaḥ || 10-527 || 

divyakuṇḍaladhārī ca mahākāyo mahābhujaḥ | 

sthitaḥ paścimadigbhāge sāmavedaḥ sanātanaḥ || 10-528 || 

raktāmbaradharaḥ śrīmān padmarāgasamaprabhaḥ | 

sragdāmadhārakaścitramālābhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ	 || 10-529 || 

atharvāñjanavacchyāmaḥ sthito dakṣiṇatastathā | 

piṅgākṣo lohitagrīvo harikeśo mahātanuḥ || 10-530 || 


ṛcāṃ karmadevatāstutimātraparāyaṇānāmanuṣṭhānāsphuṭatayā 
śyāmatā | yajuṣāṃ tu tatsphuṭatayā sitatvam | sāmnāṃ 
gītiprādhānyena rañjakatvādraktatvam | atharvaṇa 
abhicārādyaihikakarmaparatayā kṛṣṇatvaṃ śabalatā ca || 530 || 

kiṃ cātra ---- 


ṣaḍaṅgānītihāsāśca purāṇānyakhilāni tu | 

vedopaniṣadaścaiva mīmāṃsāraṇyakaṃ tathā || 10-531 || 

svāhākāravaṣaṭkārau rahasyāni tathaiva ca | 

gāyatrī ca sthitā tatra yatra devaścaturmukhaḥ || 10-532 || 


aṅgānīti vedasya śikṣākalpavyākaraṇaniruktacchandojyotiḥśāstrāṇi | 
itihāsaḥ bhāratādīni | vyāsādyuktāni śāstrāṇi purāṇāni | 
vedopaniṣado vedāntāḥ | vedavicāraśāstraṃ mīmāṃsā | āraṇyakaṃ 
bṛhadāraṇyakaṃ vedānte'pi pṛthaguktamaraṇye'nūdyamānatvāt | 
dīptyāpyāyaviṣayau mantrau svāhākāravaṣaṭkārau | rahasyāni 
taittirīyādivedāntaviśeṣā rahasyatvādeva pṛthaguktāni | gāyatrī 
vedamātā | sarvā etā ākṛtimatyo devatāḥ || 532 || 

so'yaṃ satyalokaḥ ---- 


bhogasthānaṃ brahmaṇaḥ syāt............


sa tatra nirvatītādhikāraḥ ---- 


............paraṃ brahma tato vrajet | 


anākṛti "vijñānamānandaṃ brahma" (bṛ0u0 3-9-34) iti yaduktam 
tadityarthaḥ || 

atha ---- 


koṭiyojanamānena satyalokordhvataḥ priye || 10-533 || 

brahmāsanamiti khyātaṃ japāsindūrasaprabham | 


āsyate'sminnityāsanaṃ bhuvanaṃ satyalokasyordhvam || 

tatrāsau ---- 


raktendīvaramadhyasthaḥ padmarāgasamaprabhaḥ || 10-534 || 

caturmukhaścaturvedaścaturyugavaśānugaḥ | 

brahmavidbhiḥ samākīrṇo brahmā muniniṣevitaḥ || 10-535 || 

eśvaryāṣṭakasaṃyuktaḥ ṣaḍvidhasṛṣṭikārakaḥ | 

dharmādiphalasambandhapradātā ca yuge yuge || 10-536 || 

tiryaṅnārakisattvānāṃ divyānāṃ manujaiḥ saha | 

sraṣṭā ca sarvabhūtānāṃ sadevāsuramānuṣe || 10-537 || 


catvāro yugā vaśā anugā yasyeti pūrvanipātavyatyayaḥ | 
eśvaryāṣṭakamaṇimādi | ṣaḍvidheti 
nārakisthāvarasarīsṛpādipaśvantā trividhā tāmasī, rajastamomayī 
mānuṣī, rajaḥsattvarūpā maunī, sāttvikī daivī cetyekādaśe 
bhaviṣyati | yuge yuga iti dharmādiphalapradaḥ | tiryagādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ 
bhūtānāṃ caturdaśasaṃkhyānāṃ sadevāsuramānuṣe jagati sraṣṭā || 
537 || 

atha ---- 


koṭidvayaṃ tadūrdhve tu yojanānāṃ varānane | 

nīlendīvarasaṅkāśā indranīlasamaprabhā || 10-538 || 

brahmalokāt paratvena viṣṇoścaiva purī smṛtā | 

sarvakāmasamopetā sarvaratnasamujjvalā || 10-539 || 

marakatastambhasopānā nīladhvajasamākulā | 

ghaṇṭāvitānavistīrṇā cārucāmaraśobhitā || 10-540 || 

nīlotpaladalaprakhyaiḥ kanyāvṛndaiḥ samāvṛtā | 

kāmakārmukanirghoṣavitrastamṛgalocanaiḥ || 10-541 || 

nūpurārāvamukharaiḥ skhaladbhirmṛduvibhramaiḥ | 

manobhavaśarāyāsanipātaśatajarjaraiḥ || 10-542 || 

sughūṇītamadāyāsaviloladhavalekṣaṇaiḥ | 

saṃsevyate sa bhagavān viṣṇuḥ kamalalocanaḥ || 10-543 || 

indranīlasamākāro nīlotpaladalaprabhaḥ | 

caturbhujo mahākāyaḥ pīnavakṣā gadādharaḥ || 10-544 || 

kirīṭī kuṇḍalī śaṅkhī prajāpālanatatparaḥ | 

saṃsevyate sa bhagavānnikāyairātmavikramaiḥ || 10-545 || 


(kirīṭī =) kirīṭamauliḥ1 | gadāśaṅkhau cakraśārṅge 
apyupalakṣayataḥ | ātmavikramairityātmana iva vikramo yeṣāṃ taiḥ, 
nikāyairanucarasamūhaiḥ saṃsevyate || 545 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


viṣṇubhaktāśca ye nityaṃ dhyānapūjājape ratāḥ | 

te tu gacchanti tatsthānaṃ viṣṇoramitavikramāḥ || 10-546 || 


viṣṇubhaktā iti tadākāropāsāparāḥ || 546 || 

atha ---- 


saptakoṭyastadūrdhvaṃ vai rudraloko vyavasthitaḥ | 

śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaścatvarodyānamaṇḍitaḥ || 10-547 || 

sahasrabhūmikābhiśca harmyamālābhirūjītaḥ | 

vimānaiḥ puṣpakairyukto haṃsakundendunirmalaiḥ || 10-548 || 

vanopavanaṣaṇḍaiśca sarvartukusumojjvalaiḥ | 


sopānavaduparyuparivatīcārudāru (racitakṣudrā) bhūmayo bhūmikāḥ | 
puṣpakairiti saṅkalpamātrasañcāribhiḥ | śrīparāyāṃ tu ---- 

"tadbrahmordhvaṃ bhavedviṣṇuḥ sa ca koṭicatuṣṭayāt | 

ṣaḍbhiḥ sa koṭibhirdevaḥ śaṅkaraḥ saṃsthito haraḥ ||" iti | 

kiraṇāyāṃ tu ---- 

"daśaṣaṭkoṭayaḥ satya.......................... |"

ityuktvā ---- 

"tasmādūrdhvaṃ bhaved brahmā koṭitrayamitaḥ kha(ga)1 | 

tribhistu koṭibhivīṣṇuścatubhīstu haraḥ sthitaḥ ||"

iti prakriyābhedo na avasthitasyāsya devatātrayasya saṅkalayya 
daśakoṭideśatvānapāyādviruddhaḥ || 

atra ca ---- 


mārutāḥ sukhasaṃsparśā vatīkarpūragandhayaḥ || 10-549 || 


eṣa ca ---- 


nadīnadahradākīrṇaḥ padminīṣaṇḍamaṇḍitaḥ | 


tathā ca ---- 


vareṇyā varadā caiva variṣṭhā varavaṇīnī || 10-550 || 

vasiṣṭhā ca varāhā ca varārohā ca saptamī | 

gaṅgā hyetāḥ samākhyātā rudralokavahāḥ sadā || 10-551 || 


etāśca ---- 

lakṣapatradalāḍhyaiśca sitapadmaivībhūṣitāḥ | 

indranīlanibhairnālairyojanāyatagandhibhiḥ || 552 || 


dalāni pradhānapatrāṇi, pratyeiaṃ lakṣapatrāṇītyarthaḥ | (taiḥ) 
upalakṣitairityarthaḥ || 552 || 

kiṃ cātra rudraloke ---- 


strīsahasrakadambāḍhyāḥ puṣpaprakaradhūsarāḥ | 

śaradindunibhā nāryo navanītasukomalāḥ || 10-553 || 

subhrūlalāṭavadanāḥ kṛśodaryo madālasāḥ | 

alipuñjanibhaiḥ keśairmṛgāmodasugandhibhiḥ || 10-554 || 

pralambaśravaṇādhārāḥ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇāḥ | 

dāḍimīpuṣpasaṅkāśairoṣṭhairutpalagandhibhiḥ || 10-555 || 

rambhānibhābhirjaṅghābhirbāhubhibīsakomalaiḥ | 

aśokapallavākāraiḥ pādaiḥ padmadalopamaiḥ || 10-556 || 

nakhaiśca ketakīprakhyairdaśanaimauṃktikojjvalaiḥ | 

svabhāvasusugandhāḍhyaiḥ prasravadbhirivāmṛtam || 10-557 || 

hārakeyūrakaṭakaiḥ sīmantamaṇijālakaiḥ | 

kāñcīḍoraiḥ suraktaiśca kusumairbhūṣitā sadā || 10-558 || 


nāryaḥ strīsahasrakadambaiḥ parivārarūpeṇāḍhyāḥ | mṛgāmodaḥ 
kastūrikā | śravaṇādhāraḥ karṇapālī | aśokapallavā lauhityasya, 
padmadalāni tu saukumāryasya upamānāya | ketakyo lohitarājayaḥ 
svacchāśca || 558 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


tārakumbhanibhākārairunnataiśca payodharaiḥ | 

suvṛttaiḥ pīnapārśvaiśca pīnakaṇṭhasamāśritaiḥ || 10-559 || 

guruśroṇībharākrāntā muktāvalivirājitāḥ | 

rājahaṃsagatispadhīmattamātaṅgavibhramāḥ || 10-560 || 

nūpurārāvamukharapraskhalanmṛduvikramāḥ	| 

hāsyalāsyavilāsāḍhyabhrūbhaṅgataralekṣaṇāḥ	 || 10-561 || 

hlādayantīva gātrāṇi rudrāṇāṃ tannivāsinām | 


tāraṃ rajatam | pīne kaṇṭhe samāśritaṃ samāśrayaṇaṃ yeṣāṃ 
payodharāṇām, taiḥ | lāsyaṃ sukumāraṃ nṛttam, vilāsā līlāḥ, 
hāsyādibhirāḍhyā bhrūbhaṅgataralekṣaṇāśceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ || 
kiṃ ca ---- 


kāmagrahagrahāviṣṭā ghūrṇantyo madavihvalāḥ || 10-562 || 

pariṣvajanamātreṇa modayantyo gaṇeśvarān | 


kāme sambhoge graho'bhiniveśa eva graho bhūtamiti yojyam || 

evaṃvidharūpalāvaṇyaśālinya etāḥ ---- 


yadyapyevaṃvidhā nāryaḥ...............


tathāpi


...........ṇijabhartṛbhayāturāḥ || 10-563 || 


asvairiṇya ityarthaḥ || 563 || 

ataśca ---- 


vitrastamṛganetrāstu bharturutsaṅgamāgatāḥ | 


īdṛśyaśca ---- 


avagūhya ca sarvāṅgairāpīya vadanairmukham || 10-564 || 

krīḍanti rudrabhavane rudrakanyāḥ sarudrakāḥ | 


kiṃ cātra ---- 


rudrāścaivaṃvidhākārā jñānayogabalotkaṭāḥ || 10-565 || 


kāmaniṣṭhā api jñānayogābhyāṃ na parihīyanta ityarthaḥ || 565 || 

ete ca ---- 


mukuṭaiḥ kuṇḍalaiścitrairmahāratnasamujjvalaiḥ | 

keyūrakaṭakairḍoraiḥ puṣpavastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ || 10-566 || 

muktāphalāvalīhārairbrahmasūtrottarīyakaiḥ | 


upalakṣitāḥ santaḥ || 


mahākāyā mahoraskāstrinetrāḥ śūlapāṇayaḥ || 10-567 || 

candrāyutapratīkāśāḥ karpūrakṣodadhūsarāḥ | 

surasiddhanutāḥ sarve suprasannā varapradāḥ || 10-568 || 

haralabdhavarāstṛptā daśabāhvindumaulayaḥ | 


teṣāṃ ca ---- 


na tatra mṛtyurna jarā na śoko'sti viyogajaḥ || 10-569 || 


ataścaite ---- 


krīḍanti sārdhaṃ kanyābhiḥ.........


na tadbhogapradakarmakṣaye punaḥ saṃsarantītyāha ---- 


.............ṣaṃsārabhayavajītāḥ | 


kevalamete ---- 


adhikārakṣaye rudrā rudrakanyāsamāvṛtāḥ || 10-570 || 

śrīkaṇṭhasyecchayā sarve śivaṃ yānti tanukṣaye | 

gatvā bhūyo na jāyante kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 10-571 || 


icchā atra anujighṛkṣā, tāṃ vinordhvaṃ sṛjyanta evetyarthaḥ || 571 || 

tadittham ---- 


evaṃvidhairasaṃkhyātaivīmānarathagāmibhiḥ | 

mahāvṛṣagajārūḍhaiḥ siṃhavājisuvāhanaiḥ || 10-572 || 

lakṣāyutasahasraistu rudrakoṭibhirāvṛtam | 

tanmadhye sarvatobhadraṃ siṃhadvāraiḥ sutoraṇaiḥ || 10-573 || 

svacchamauktikasaṅkāśaprākāraśikharāvṛtam | 

nandīśvaramahākāladvārapālagaṇairvṛtam || 10-574 || 

kiṃkiṇījālamukharaiḥ patākādhvajasaṃkulaiḥ | 

vitānacchatraṣaṇḍaiśca muktāhārapralambitaiḥ || 10-575 || 

ghaṇṭācāmaraśobhāḍhyaṃ darpaṇaiścopaśobhitam | 

kalaśairdvāranyastaiśca ratnapallavasaṃyutaiḥ || 10-576 || 

racitaiścitraśāstrajñai ratnacūrṇasamujjvalaiḥ | 

svastikaiḥ patravallyāḍhyaiścitritaṃ bhuvanājiram || 10-577 || 

śatasiṃhāsanākīrṇaṃ vedikāratnabhūṣitam | 

gopurāṭṭālarathakairvīthībhiśca bhramāntrakaiḥ || 10-578 || 

sarvaratnavicitrāḍhyairdvārabaddhaiḥ suśobhanam | 

nirgamaiḥ sugavākṣaiśca viṭaṅkaiḥ sphaṭikaprabhaiḥ || 10-579 || 

stambhaiḥ sopānabaddhaiśca vajravaiḍūryasaprabhaiḥ | 

pūrṇacandranibhākārairaṇḍaiḥ śikharamaṇḍitaiḥ || 10-580 || 

muktāphalaprabhābhiśca bhūmibhiśca sahasraśaḥ | 

nāṭyaśālaiḥ suśobhāḍhyairnṛttagītaravākulaiḥ || 10-581 || 

maṇḍapai ratnacitrāḍhyaiḥ sabhāmaṇḍalanirbharaiḥ | 

āsīnai rudravṛndaiśca rudrakanyākadambakaiḥ || 10-582 || 

mattavāraṇakai ramyaiścandraśālāsuśobhanaiḥ | 

dhūpitaṃ dhūpavartībhiḥ kuṅkumodakasecitam || 10-583 || 

citrapaṭṭaistu saṃchannaṃ puṣpaprakarasaṃkulam | 

tūryaśabdajayadhvānakāhalākūjitena ca || 10-584 || 

vaṃśavīṇāmṛdaṅgaiśca gomukhairmukhavādanaiḥ | 

paṇavaistālavādyaiśca śaṅkhabherīraveṇa ca || 10-585 || 

dundubhīnādaśabdena murajasphālanena ca | 

kārasphoṭamahāśabdaiḥ siṃhanādapraguñjitaiḥ || 10-586 || 

garjadbhirgaṇavṛndaiśca meghastanitaniḥ svanaiḥ | 

vandināṃ stotraśabdena sāmavedaraveṇa ca || 10-587 || 

huḍuṅkārāṭṭahāsaiśca geyajhāṅkārayojitaiḥ | 

vṛṣananditaśabdena gajavājiraveṇa ca || 10-588 || 

kāñcīnūpūraśabdena nadatīva mahatpuram | 


nandīśvaramahākālapradhānā dvārapālagaṇā iti samāsaḥ | 
kiṅkiṇījālamukharairityādi vitānacchatraṣaṇḍaviśeṣaṇam | 
muktāhārapralambitairiti pūrvanipātavyatyayaḥ | citraśāstrajñaiḥ 
kartṛbhiḥ ratnacūrṇena racitā ye patravallyāḍhyāḥ 
patralatālaṃkṛtāḥ svastikāstaivīcitram | tatra rudrabhuvane 
bhuvanājiraṃ bhuvanāṅganamiti yojyam | vedikābhiścaturasrabhūmikābhiḥ, 
ratnaiśca prākārasthairbhūṣitam | gopurāṇi pradhānadvārāṇi | 
aṭṭālāḥ puraprākārāḥ | rathakā racanāviśeṣāḥ | vīthyo 
vimānasañcārabhuvaḥ | bhramāntrakaiḥ jalapravāhapraṇālaiḥ | 
sarvaratnavicitratvācca āḍhyaiḥ sphītairdvāropāntagataiḥ śobhanam | 
nirgamāḥ mārgāḥ1 | gavākṣāstadavalokanajālakasthānāni | viṭaṅkāḥ 
stambhaśīrṣakāḥ | aṇḍā vartulasaṃsthānadevagṛhāḥ | 
ratnaracanāpariṣkṛtaṃ yaccitraṃ tenāḍhyāḥ | tathā sabhāsthāneṣu 
yāni ratnacūrṇaracitāni maṇḍalāni tainīrbharā ye maṇḍapāstairyuktam 
| tūryaṃ dvikhaṇḍaṃ tāmrādimayaṃ vādyam | kāhalāstu trikhaṇḍāḥ | 
gomukhā taṭṭarī | paṇavo'ntastantrīvalayajhāṅkāriṇī ḍhakkā | 
tālavādyaṃ vādyaśabdaḥ | dundubhiḥ kāṃsyaśabdaḥ | phanatkāriṇī 
ḍhakkā bherī | garjanaṃ sarvaprāṇabalottho nādaḥ | 
bhaktivaivaśyenoccarannāntaraḥ śabdo huḍuṅkāraḥ | vṛṣasya 
parameśvaravāhanābhimāna praharṣotthito nādo nanditaśabdastena | 
kāñcīnūpuraśabdo nṛtyadrudrakanyāsambandhī | evamīdṛśaiḥ śabdaiḥ 
purameva sākṣānnadatīti jñāyate || 

tadittham ---- 


sarvasampatkaraṃ śrīmacchaṅkarasya tu mandiram || 10-589 || 


tannivāsināmityarthāt || 589 || 


atrāsau bhagavān rudro brahmaviṣṇvindrapūjitaḥ | 

gaṅgayā snapito nityaṃ divyavastrāmbaracchadaḥ || 10-590 || 

pṛthivyā gandhaliptāṅgaḥ śriyā puṣpaiḥ supūjitaḥ | 

saptasvarapramukhyaiśca sarasvatyā ca saṃstutaḥ || 10-591 || 


pṛthivī gandhaguṇā | śrīḥ puṣpāśritā | evaṃ ca gaṅgādidevatā asya 
brahmāṇḍasyopari vakṣyamāṇabhuvanebhyaḥ prākāmyādavatīrṇāḥ 
svocitaṃ snānādi kurvatyo'ntaraṅgaparivārarūpāḥ || 591 || 


api cāsya devasya ---- 


pūrṇendurātapatraṃ ca svayameva vyavasthitaḥ | 


tasmiṃstu ---- 


gaṅgā tūttarikā cchatre..........


gaṅgā tu uttarikātvaṃ prākāmyenāśritya sthitā || 

kiṃ cāsya ---- 


.........ṣarvādityāśca dīpikāḥ || 10-592 || 


tathā ---- 


puṣpadantagaṇeśādyairāsanaṃ tasya saṃvṛtam | 


tasmiṃścāsane ---- 


kapilaḥ karkaṭaścaiva vimardaḥ kaṅkaṭastathā || 10-593 || 

vikramaśca dṛḍhaścaiva niṣkampo niṣkalastathā | 

aṣṭau te harayaḥ proktāstrinetrā bhūrivikramāḥ || 10-594 || 

siṃharūpāḥ sutejaskāḥ saṭāvikaṭabhāsvarāḥ | 


etādṛśaiḥ ---- 


śaktirūpadharairmantrairyogaiśvaryasamanvitaiḥ || 595 || 

āsanaṃ vivṛtaṃ taistu mahotsāhairbalotkaṭaiḥ | 


asya bhagavato brahmāṇḍāntaravasthitasyāpi parameva māhātmyamiti kṛtvā 
---- 

"śivaśaktimayā mantrā nyastavyā vīravandite" (2-63)

iti pūrvoktabhairavāsanavacchivaśaktiparamārthā eva siṃhāḥ || 


tatra bhadrāsane rudraḥ sthitaścandrārdhaśekharaḥ || 10-596 || 

sarvalakṣaṇasampūrṇaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ | 

tryakṣo daśabhujo devo jaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitaḥ || 10-597 || 

pīnavakṣaḥsthaloruśca pīnaskandho mahābhujaḥ | 

baddhapadmāsanāsīnaḥ karpūrakṣodadhūsaraḥ || 10-598 || 

varadābhayapāṇiśca sarvāyudhadharastathā | 


bhadraṃ praśastam | varadābhayau pāṇī mukhyau | sarvāyudhāni 
pūrvoktāni khaḍgakheṭakādīni || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


śatapatrāṅkitaiścaiva hastapādaiḥ sukomalaiḥ || 10-599 || 

candrabimbanakhābhābhiraṃgulībhiralaṃkṛtaiḥ | 

suśliṣṭajānugulphaiśca pādaiścaiva samunnataiḥ || 10-600 || 

pūjitairgaṇarudraiśca brahmaviṣṇvindravanditaiḥ | 


śatapatrapadmacihnitahastapādatvādinā divyalakṣaṇatvamuktam | pādairiti 
jātau bahuvacanam, prākāmyato vā "(uta)1 viśvataspāt" (śve0u0 3-3) iti 
sthityā bahucaraṇa(tā)2'pyasya | itthaṃbhūtalakṣaṇa etāstṛtīyāḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


cāmaravyajanotkṣepai rudrastrībhiḥ samantataḥ || 10-601 || 

vījitastu sadā śrīmāṃścandrakoṭisamaprabhaḥ | 

jñānāmṛtasutṛptātmā yogaiśvaryapradāyakaḥ || 10-602 || 

dhyāto vai yogibhinītyaṃ prasannavadanekṣaṇaḥ | 

prahasan sa ivābhāti nirmalajñānaraśmibhiḥ || 10-603 || 

ajñānatimiraṃ hatvā darśayet paramaṃ vapuḥ | 

sarvasaukhyapradātā ca rudramātṛgaṇāvṛtaḥ || 10-604 || 


dhyātaḥ san parasvarūpānupraveśād jñānaraśmibhiḥ prahasannivābhāti 
ataścājñānaṃ hatvā paraṃ svarūpaṃ darśayatyeva || 604 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


tasyotsaṅgagatā devī tatkāñcanasuprabhā | 

pūjitā yoginīvṛndaiḥ sādhakaiḥ surakinnaraiḥ || 10-605 || 

sarvalakṣaṇasampūrṇā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā | 

yogasiddhipradā nityaṃ mokṣābhyudayadāyikā || 10-606 || 

devasyābhimukhī nityamumā tu lalitekṣaṇā | 


parāveśaśaktitadvantāvetadaparaṃ rūpaṃ śritvā 
brahmāṇḍāntaḥsṛṣṭisaṃhārau kurvāte ityāha ---- 


śaktiścāpararūpeṇa śaktimāṃśca harastathā || 10-607 || 

brahmāṇḍe sṛṣṭisaṃhārau (kurvāte)1 ca śivecchayā | 


cakārāvatra tulyayoge | tathetyapararūpeṇa | cakāraḥ 
sthitivilayānugrahān samuccinoti | śivo'tra paramaḥ || 

kiñcedam ---- 


dīkṣājñānavihīnā ye liṅgārādhanatatparāḥ || 10-608 || 

te prayānti harasthānaṃ sarvaiśvaryasukhāvaham | 


anenāpi krameṇāsyānugrāhakatvamityarthaḥ || 


jarāmaraṇanirmuktā vyādhiśokavivajītāḥ || 10-609 || 


te ca ---- 

nādho yānti punardevi saṃsāre duḥkhasāgare | 

kintu


śivaṃ yānti tataścordhvaṃ śrīkaṇṭhena samīkṣitāḥ || 10-610 || 


tata iti harasthānāt | samyagīkṣitāḥ śaktipātenānugṛhītāḥ | 
tadeva(ma)1sya purasya bhagavadadhiṣṭhānādayaṃ mahimā yattatprāptā 
nādho yānti, api tu śrīkaṇṭhanāthena samyaganugrahadṛṣṭyekṣitā 
mucyante, anyathā tu ūrdhvordhvameva krameṇa bhogāya sṛjyante || 610 || 

ittham ---- 


rudralokaḥ samākhyātastataścordhvamume śṛṇu | 

uttarottaravṛddhayā ca bhuvanaṃ bhuvanaṃ sthitam || 10-611 || 


vṛddhiḥ pramāṇavibhavābhyām | sā cāgre vakṣyate || 611 || 


samprati tu ---- 


brahmāṇḍasyāpyadhobhāge rudralokasya cordhvataḥ | 

daṇḍapāṇeḥ puraṃ jñeyaṃ nānārudragaṇāvṛtam || 10-612 || 

daṇḍapāṇistu bhagavān yogaiśvaryabalānvitaḥ | 

daṇḍaḥ pāṇitalenaiva dhṛto yena śivecchayā || 10-613 || 


rudrabhaṭṭāraka evānena vapuṣā sthitaḥ || 613 || 


vivṛṇoti ca brahmāṇḍe mokṣamārgaṃ sudubhīdam | 

vidhinārādhitaścaiva anudhyānācchivecchayā || 10-614 || 


anudhyānamāsthāya vidhinārcājapādirūpeṇārādhitaḥ san brahmāṇḍe 
mokṣamārgaṃ sudubhīdaṃ yogibhirmahatā prayatnena bhettuṃ śakyaṃ 
vivṛṇoti vigatāvaraṇaṃ karoti brahmāṇḍakarparikāvibhedanayuktyā 
praguṇīkaroti, na tu ruṇaddhi | atha ca paracaitanyasphārātmā bhagavān 
rudraḥ svaśaktigatasuspaṣṭīkṛtaprāṇadaṇḍaprayogeṇa 
śarīragatahṛtpradeśāśritasvātmākhyātirūpahṛdgranthyākhye 
brahmāṇḍe mokṣamārgaṃ karoti, 1"hṛdaye yaḥ sthito granthiradha 
ūrdhvaniyāmakaḥ |" ityāmnātākhyātigranthipraśamanena 
madhyamārgagataśaktibhūmim ---- 

"śaivī mukhamihocyate" (vi0bhai0 20)

ityāmnāyoktasthityā śivatāprāptihetuṃ sphuṭayatītyāntaro'rthaḥ, na 
tu brahmabilāntā brahmāṇḍavyāptiriti vyākhyātavyam | evaṃ hi 
jalādyāvaraṇavyāptirdehāśrayā na bhavet | 

ṅāḍyādhārastu nādo vai bhittvā sarvamidaṃ jagat | 

adhaḥśaktyā vinirgatya yāvad brahmāṇamūrdhvataḥ || 

nāḍyā brahmabile līnastvavyaktadhvanirakṣaraḥ | 

nadate sarvabhūteṣu śivaśaktyā tvadhiṣṭhitaḥ ||" (10-1234-36)

ityādiśca bhāvigrantho bhedavyāptihānyā nivīṣayaḥ syāt | yattu ---- 

śauṣupte'dhvanyastamito hitvā brahmāṇḍagocaram" (2-8)

iti śrīspande śrīgurubhinībaddham, tad 
brahmabilādhiṣṭhātṛvakṣyamāṇapañcabrahmopalakṣito yaḥ 
śaktyaṇḍaparyanto'dhvā, tadabhiprāyeṇa sthitamityetad bhrāntyāpi na 
muṇḍāntā brahmāṇḍavyāptirvyākhyeyeti yathāvyākṛtameva bhadram || 614 
|| 

evaṃ daṇḍapāṇyante rudraloke mūtīdvayenāvasthito viśvādhipatitvād 
mūrtīśamadhye paśupatiryaḥ, sa rudrādhiṣṭhātā | ye tvanye 
śarvādayaḥ sapta mūrtīśvarāste bhūrādisatyānteṣu saptasu 
lokeṣvadhipataya ityādiśati ---- 


saptalokeṣu ye rudrā............


adhipatayaḥ || 

tān ---- 


............kathayāmi samāsataḥ | 


tānāha ---- 


śarvo rudrastathā bhīmo bhava ugrastathaiva ca || 10-615 || 

mahādevastatheśāno rudralokādhipāstvamī | 


lokānāṃ bhūrādīnāṃ yathāsaṃkhyamadhipāḥ | anenaivāśayena ---- 

ṅivṛttyabhyantare pṛthvī śatakoṭipravistarā | 

tasyāṃ ca bhuvanānāṃ ca śatamaṣṭottarāvadhi ||" (4-102)


ityedvyākhyāne kālāgniḥ kūṣmāṇḍo hāṭaka iti 
brahmāṇḍāntaradhobhāge trayaḥ, bhūrloke śarvaḥ, satyalokānte brahmā, 
viṣṇurudrau svalokayorityantaḥ sapta, bahī rudraśatam, tadupari 
sarvādhiṣṭhātā vīrabhadra iti vyākhyātam || 

yadi bhūrlokataḥ satyalokāntamete rudrāḥ pṛthagbhuvanadīkṣāyāṃ sapta 
śodhyāḥ, tadūrdhve kā tahī sthiti ? ---- ityāha ----  brahmaloke sthito 
brahmā viṣṇurvai vaiṣṇave pure || 616 || 

brahmaloko yaḥ prāgvad brahmāsanamityuktaḥ || 

tathaitadupari ---- 


rudraloke sthito rudraḥ sarveṣāṃ nāyakaḥ smṛtaḥ | 


kālāgnyāditrayasya śarvādisaptakasya brahmaviṣṇvoścetyarthaḥ | ayaṃ 
viśvādhipatitvād mūrtīśvaramadhye paśupatirityākhyayoktaḥ | evaṃ ca --
-- 

"anantaṃ caiva kālāgniṃ narakāṃśca yathākramam | 

pātālāni tataścordhvaṃ śodhayedanupūrvaśaḥ ||" (10-347)

ityuktakrameṇa saṃśodhya bhūrādisatyāntalokasaptakaśuddhau 
śarvādīnīśāntān sapta krameṇa saṃśodhayet | tato 
brahmaviṣṇubhuvanaśuddhau brahmaviṣṇū saṃśodhyāviti 
bhuvanadīkṣāyāmasyāṃ bhuvaneśaśuddhivibhāgo granthopārūḍha eva 
sthitaḥ | tena yat śrībhullakaḥ  ---- anantabhuvanātprabhṛti 
samastadvīpasamudrabhūrlokāntaṃ śarvaḥ, (bhuvaḥ)1 svarmahaḥsu 
rudrabhīmabhavāḥ, janastapaḥsatyeṣu triṣūgraḥ, mahādevo viṣṇuloke, 
rudraloke'dhipaśceśānaḥ śodhya iti svakalpanayā'bhihitavān, 
tadupekṣyameva || 

tadetatsaṅkalayitumāha ---- 


kālāgnerdaṇḍapāṇyantamaṣṭānavatikoṭayaḥ || 10-617 || 

yojanānāṃ varārohe tvadhvāyamupavaṇītaḥ | 

kaṭāhastu adhaścordhvaṃ brahmāṇḍasya varānane || 10-618 || 

koṭiyojanamānena ghanākāreṇa saṃsthitaḥ | 

pañcāśatkoṭayaścordhvaṃ bhūpṛṣṭhāttu varānane || 10-619 || 

pañcāśacca adho jñeyā yojanānāṃ samantataḥ | 

evaṃ koṭiśataṃ jñeyaṃ pāthīvaṃ tattvamucyate || 10-620 || 


adhaḥkaṭāhādyathā bhūpṛṣṭhāntaṃ pañcāśat, tathā daśītam | 
bhūpṛṣṭhāttu dhruvāntaṃ pañcadaśa lakṣāṇi, tadūrdhvaṃ maharlokaḥ 
pañcāśītirlakṣāṇi koṭidvayaṃ ca, janolokaḥ koṭyaṣṭakam, tapolokaḥ 
koṭayo dvādaśa, satyalokaḥ ṣoḍaśa, brahmabhuvanaṃ koṭiḥ, viṣṇulokaḥ 
koṭidvayam, rudralokaḥ koṭayaḥ sapta, ūrdhvakaṭāhaḥ koṭirityūrdhvamapi 
pañcāśatkoṭayaḥ pāthīvaṃ tattvamiti tatra yaḥ sthūla ābhogaḥ, na tu 
tattvasyaitāvatyeva vyāptiḥ, uddhātadīkṣāyāṃ bindvantamapi 
sūkṣmadṛśā tadvyāpterdaśītatvāt | jñeyamucyata iti 
dīkṣādhāraṇādau jñātavyamācāryasādhakādibhirityabhidhīyate 
bhagavatetyarthaḥ || 620 || 

tadetat ---- 


śatarudrāvadhi jñeyaṃ sauvarṇaṃ parivartulam | 

vajrasārādhikasāraṃ durbhedyaṃ tridaśairapi || 10-621 || 


vajrasārādadhikaṃ sāraṃ yasya || 621 || 

etacca mantranādāstraprayogeṇa dīkṣyasya bhedanīyamityāha ---- 


huṃphaṭkāraprayogeṇa bhedayettu varānane | 


evaṃ māntratejaḥsphārānupraveśenaiva 
pādāṅguṣṭhāgragatādanantabhuvanādārabhya hṛdantamavasthitaṃ 
brahmāṇḍaṃ cedvidīrṇam, tad bāhyamapi tadanuṣaktaṃ dalitameva 
bhagavatoktaṃ bhavati || 

śatarudrāvadhīti yaduktam, tadvibhaktumāha ---- 


śatarudrānato vakṣye samāsena kṛśodari || 10-622 || 


śatarudrābhidhetthameṣāmityāha ---- 


daśa daśa krameṇaiva daśadikṣu samantataḥ | 

pūrvādikramayogena..............


yataḥ sthitāstata ete śatarudrā ucyanta iti śeṣaḥ || 

tāṃśca ---- 


................kathayāmyanupūrvaśaḥ || 10-623 || 

kapālīśo hyajo bradhno vajradehaḥ pramardanaḥ | 

vibhūtiravyayaḥ śāstā pinākī tridaśādhipaḥ || 10-624 || 


ete ca ---- 


indrasya balamākramya prabhuśaktisamanvitāḥ | 

vicaranti mahādevā indreṇa ca supūjitāḥ || 10-625 || 


ākramyetyadhiṣṭhāya, atra hetuḥ prabhoḥ parabhairavasya śaktyā 
svāntryātmanādhiṣṭhitā 
īdṛśīmunmīlitadṛkkriyāśaktimadhikārabhūmiṃ grāhitāḥ, vicaranti 
sṛṣṭyādi kurvantaḥ krīḍanti | ata evendreṇa suṣṭhu bhaktiprakarṣeṇa 
pūjyante | evamuttaratrāpi yojyam || 625 || 


agnirudro hutāśī ca piṅgalaḥ khādako haraḥ | 

jvalano dahano babhrurbhasmāntakakṣayāntakau || 10-626 || 

agnerbalaṃ samākramya prabhuśaktisamanvitāḥ | 

vicaranti mahādevā agnirājasupūjitāḥ || 10-627 || 


agnirāja āgneyadikpatiḥ | evamanyat || 627 || 


yāmyo mṛtyurharo dhātā vidhātā kartṛsaṃjñakaḥ | 

saṃyoktā ca viyoktā ca dharmo dharmapatistathā || 10-628 || 

yamasya balamākramya prabhuśaktisamanvitāḥ | 

vicaranti mahādevā yamarājasupūjitāḥ || 10-629 || 

nairṛto māruto hantā krūradṛṣṭirbhayānakaḥ | 

ūrdhvakeśo virūpākṣo dhūmalohitadaṃṣṭrakau || 10-630 || 

nairṛtaṃ balamākramya prabhuśaktisamanvitāḥ | 

vicaranti mahādevā nairṛtendrasupūjitāḥ || 10-631 || 

balo hyatibalaścaiva pāśahasto mahābalaḥ | 

śveto'tha jayabhadraśca dīrghabāhurjalāntakaḥ || 10-632 || 

meghanādī sunādī ca samāsāt parikītītāḥ | 

vāruṇaṃ balamākramya prabhuśaktisamanvitāḥ || 10-633 || 

vicaranti mahādevā varuṇendrasupūjitāḥ | 

śīghro laghurvāyuvegaḥ sūkṣmastīkṣṇo bhayānakaḥ || 10-634 || 

pañcāntakaḥ pañcaśikhaḥ kapardī meghavāhanaḥ | 

vāyostu balamākramya prabhuśaktisamanvitāḥ || 10-635 || 

vicaranti mahādevā vāyurājasupūjitāḥ | 

nidhīśo rūpavān dhanyaḥ saumyadeho jaṭādharaḥ || 10-636 || 

lakṣmī ratnadharaḥ kāmī prasādaśca prabhāsakaḥ | 

somasya balamākramya prabhuśaktisamanvitāḥ || 10-637 || 

vicaranti mahādevāḥ somarājasupūjitāḥ | 

vidyādhipo'tha sarvajño jñānadṛgvedapāragaḥ || 10-638 || 

śarvaḥ sureśo jyeṣṭhaśca bhūtapālo balipriyaḥ | 

īśānānumatā devāśceṣṭante surapūjitāḥ || 10-639 || 

vicaranti mahādevā īśaśaktyā tvadhiṣṭhitāḥ | 

vṛṣo vṛṣadharo'nantaḥ krodhano mārutāhvayaḥ || 10-640 || 

grasano ḍambareśau ca phaṇīndro vajradaṃṣṭrakaḥ | 

viṣṇostu balamākramya prabhuśaktisamanvitāḥ || 10-641 || 

vicaranti mahādevā anantena supūjitāḥ | 


īśāno dikpatiranumato dikpatitvenābhimato yeṣām | suraiḥ sarvaiḥ 
pūjitāḥ sarvasiddhipradatvāt | viṣṇorityadhodiggatasya | ananteneti 
sarvādhodigadhiṣṭhātrā || 

ūrdhvadiśi tu ---- 


śambhuvībhurgaṇādhyakṣastryakṣaśca tridaśeśvaraḥ || 10-642 || 

saṃvāhaśca vivāhaśca nalo lipsustrilocanaḥ | 

brahmaṇo balamākramya prabhuśaktisamanvitāḥ || 10-643 || 

vicaranti mahādevā brahmaṇaiva supūjitāḥ | 


eṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ madhyāt ---- 


ekaikasya sahasraṃ tu parivāro'bhidhīyate || 10-644 || 


bṛhattantreṣu || 644 || 

ete ca ---- 


śatarudrā iti khyātā brahmāṇḍaṃ vyāpya saṃsthitāḥ | 


vyāpyeti parivṛtya || 

ete ca ---- 


asaṃkhyātāḥ sahasrāṇi ye ca ūrdhvādidiggatāḥ || 10-645 || 

svacchandā viśvagā devāḥ kalpamanvantareṣvapi | 


sahasrasaṃkhyayāpi saṃkhyātumaśakyāḥ | proktaprabhuśaktisamanvitatvāt 
svacchandā anugrahādau svatantrāḥ | niyataśarīratve'pi viśvagā 
vyāpakāḥ kalpādiṣvapi ca devā dyotamānāḥ || 

pratidiśaṃ caite daśadigvyavasthāyāṃ saṃniviṣṭā ityāha ---- 


pūrvādidaśadigrudrāḥ sthitā daśa daśaiva tu || 10-646 || 


daśānāṃ daśānām ---- 


ekaikamadhipaṃ caiva kathayāmi varānane | 

sthito vai pūrvato'ṇḍasya śveto vai nāma nāmataḥ || 10-647 || 

rudrāṇāṃ tu śatairyukto mahāvīryaparākramaḥ | 

dīptimadbhirmahātīvrairmayūkhairiva bhāskaraḥ || 10-648 || 

āgneyyāmagnisaṅkāśo vaidyuto nāma viśrutaḥ | 

so'pi vidyutprabhai rudraśataistu parivāritaḥ || 10-649 || 

yāmye'ṇḍasya mahākālo yugāntānalasaṃnibhaḥ | 

śatarudrairvṛto devi tiṣṭhatyamitavikramaiḥ || 10-650 || 

nairṛte vikaṭo nāma śatena parivāritaḥ | 

saṃtiṣṭhate mahātejā dvitīya iva bhāskaraḥ || 10-651 || 


śateneti mukhyena | evamanyatra || 651 || 


paścime'ṇḍasya yo rudro mahāvīrya iti śrutaḥ | 

śatarudrairvṛtaḥ so'pi tiṣṭhatyamitavikramaḥ || 10-652 || 

vāyavyadiśi cāṇḍasya vāyuvegā mahābalaḥ | 

śatena ca vṛtaḥ śrīmāṃstiṣṭhatyatra mahābalaḥ || 10-653 || 

subhadranāmottarataḥ śatena parivāritaḥ | 

mahāvīryabalopetastiṣṭhatyatra mahābalaḥ || 10-654 || 

pariviṣṭo marīcibhistatra tiṣṭhati vīryavān | 

vidyādharo nāma rudra eśānyāṃ vai pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 10-655 || 

śatarudrairvṛtaḥ so'pi pariviṣṭa ivoḍurāṭ | 

mahāvīryabalopetastiṣṭhate'nantavikramaḥ || 10-656 || 


pariviṣṭo marīcibhiḥ parivṛtaḥ || 656 || 


adhaḥ kālāgnirudro'nyaḥ sthitastvatra dvitīyakaḥ | 

samāvṛto rudraśataiḥ sthitaistvatra varānane || 10-657 || 


dvitīyaka ityantasthāt kālāgneranyaḥ || 657 || 


śataiḥ samāvṛto rudro mayūkhairiva bhāskaraḥ | 


upariṣṭād rudra ityetadākhyayākhyātaḥ || 

tadittham ---- 


vīrabhadro vṛto rudrairuparyaṇḍasya saṃsthitaḥ || 10-658 || 

ekādaśo mahākāyai rudrakrodhasamudbhavaiḥ | 


vṛta ityetaiḥ śvetādibhireva pūrvādidiggataśatarudrādhiṣṭhātṛbhiḥ | 
evaṃ madhyavartī vīrabhadra ekādaśaḥ | etaiśca samastarugdrāvaṇasya 
bhagavato rudrasya saṃsāravitrāsakāriṇaḥ krodhādudbhūtaiḥ | 
krodhasamudbhava iti pāṭho vīrabhadraikaviṣayaḥ | yataścaite śvetādayo 
vīrabhadrasya parivārabhūtāstata eva śrīpūrvaśāstre ---- 

"anantaḥ prathamasteṣāṃ kapālīśastathāparaḥ | 

agnirudro yamaścaiva nairṛto bala eva ca || 

śīghro nidhīśvaraścaiva sarvavidyādhipo'paraḥ | 

śambhuśca........................... ||" (mā0vi0 5-13-14)

iti pratidiggatarudradaśakamadhyagamekaikaṃ rudramuktvā vīrabhadraśca 
vidhūmajvalanaprabha ekādaśa uktaḥ, śvetādayastu tatparivāratvānna 
prādhānyena gaṇitāḥ || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


evaṃ te'tra mahātmāna ekaikaṃ tu śatena ca || 10-659 || 

daśaite veṣṭitā devi śatarudraiśca suvrate | 


pratyekaṃ śatena parivārabhūtena proktaiśca 
kapālīśādibhirantaraṅgairdaśabhirveṣṭitaḥ | evamasyāṃ vitatāyāṃ 
bhuvanadīkṣāyāṃ sarva evaite pāthīvāṇḍagatā yathoktabhuvaneśvarāḥ 
śodhyāḥ, na tu prāk saṃkṣiptadīkṣoktamaṣṭottarameva śatamiti na 
tadāśayenedaṃ viparyāsitavyam, pratipadoktasya vidheḥ 
śrutipramāṇotkarṣeṇa balavattvāditi | yattu śrībhullakena ---- 
anantaśrī..... dibhirdvīpādibhiḥ saha saptanavatiḥ, bahirekādaśeti 
kalpitam, tadasadeva || 

ete śvetādayo daśa śatarudraparivṛtā api ekaikaṃ śatena parivṛtā iti 
yaduktam, tatsaṃkṣepāśayena, vistaratastu ---- 


eṣāmaparisaṃkhyeyaḥ parivāro mahātmanām || 10-660 || 


ataścaite sarve ---- 


āvṛtyāṇḍaṃ sthitā hyete madhu yadvanmadhuvratāḥ | 

kadambakusumaṃ yadvat kesaraiḥ parivāritam || 10-661 || 

parivāritaṃ tathā hyaṇḍaṃ rudrairamitavikramaiḥ | 


madhuvratā madhukarāḥ || 

tathā ---- 


gṛhaiḥ satoraṇāṭṭālairnānāratnavicitritaiḥ || 10-662 || 

jāmbūnadamayaiścitraiḥ samantāt samalaṃkṛtam | 

divyanārībhirākīrṇaṃ sarvakāmasamanvitam || 10-663 || 

brahmāṇḍametadākhyātaṃ pāśajālāvatāritam | 

janmavyādhijarāmṛtyumahodadhipariplutam || 10-664 || 

guṇatrayamalacchannaṃ nānājātisamākulam | 

paśujñānaparikrāntaṃ gatitrayasamākulam || 10-665 || 


gṛhā bhuvanāni | āṇavādipāśajālenāvatāritamācchāditaṃ 
janmādipariplutaṃ ceti tadāśrayajanābhiprāyeṇa | guṇatrayaṃ sattvādi, 
tadeva malam | jātayaścaturdaśavidho bhūtasargaḥ | paśujñānena 
vedasāṃkhyādinā paritaḥ samantāt krāntaṃ tajjñānāśvāsabahulamiti 
yāvat | gatitrayaṃ devamanuṣyatiryagrūpam || 665 || 

atra ca ---- 


anityā eva gatayaḥ sarveṣāmeva vādinām | 


gatayo devamanuṣyatiryakpravṛttayaḥ || 

"evaṃ trayīdharmamanuprapannā gatāgataṃ kāmakāmā labhante ||" (bha0gī0 
9-21)

iti nītyā'nityāḥ parimitakālāḥ | vādināmiti 
vedasāṃkhyapurāṇetihāsanyāyavaiśeṣikasaugatārhatādiniṣṭhānām || 

yata ete ---- 


parāparavibhāgaṃ tu naiva jānanti mohitāḥ || 10-666 || 


bhedātmakaṃ padamaparam, advaitaṃ tu paramiti na jānanti māyayā 
vyāmūḍhīkṛtatvāt, ato bhedapada eva suranaratiryakpadāni parāparatayā 
prāpyāṇi manyante || 666 || 

ataśca ---- 


hemāṇḍaṃ tu purā sṛṣṭaṃ kṣayātma bhuvanākṛti | 

īśamāyāsamāviṣṭasyātmavargasya bhūtaye || 10-667 || 


yadyapi samanāntaṃ kṣayayogi, tathāpi yadasya kṣayātmatvamuktam, 
tadatiparimitakālatayā tucchatāpratipādanāśayena | samāviṣṭasya 
kroḍīkṛtasya | bhūtaye karmopabhogasiddhyartham || 667 || 

gatametat ---- 


athopariṣṭāttattvāni udakādiśivāntakam | 


ucyanta iti śeṣaḥ || 

tatra mānakalanayaitāni ---- 


uttarottarayogena daśadhā saṃsthitāni tu || 10-668 || 


śatakoṭivistārād brahmāṇḍād daśadhā guṇitaṃ jalatattvam | tato 
daśaguṇaṃ tejaḥ | tato'pi vāyuḥ | tato'pi vyoma | tato'pi 
garbhīkṛtatanmātrendriya eva guṇaḥ || 668 || 


ahaṅkāraḥ.........


evaṃkalitaparimāṇādahaṅkārāt ---- 


..........ṭadūrdhvaṃ tu buddhistu śatadhā sthitā | 


tato'pi ---- 


ūrdhvaṃ sahasradhā jñeyaṃ pradhānaṃ varavaṇīni || 10-669 || 


guṇatattvena saha prakṛtitattvasya tat parimāṇamityarthaḥ || 669 || 

tadupari ---- 


pauruṣaṃ daśasāhasraṃ............


tato'pi ---- 


...........ṇiyatirlakṣadhā smṛtā | 

tadūrdhvaṃ daśa lakṣāṇi kalā yāvattu suvrate || 10-670 || 


tadevaṃvidhāt kalātattvamānādapi ---- 


māyā tu koṭidhā..........

sā ca ---- 


............vyāpya sthitā sarvaṃ carācaram | 


sarvamiti kalādikṣityantam | etaccopalakṣaṇaparaṃ sarvatattveṣu, tena 
pṛthivyāditattvānyuttarottaraṃ jalāditattvairvyāptāni | ataśca 
śatakoṭivistīrṇād brahmāṇḍād daśaguṇaṃ yadaptattvamucyate, 
tattadantarvatīnā brahmāṇḍena saha | tena madhye brahmāṇḍaṃ 
koṭiśatam, adhojalalekhikā catvāri sarvāṇi koṭiśatāni, jalāvaraṇasya 
mānaṃ madhvatīnā vyākhyātena brahmāṇḍena saha tu koṭiśatānyeva, 
sarvataḥ, pārivārtulyamānabrahmāṇḍenāntarvatīnā daśakoṭiśatāni 
jalāvaraṇamiti sthityā tejastattvādīnyapyantarvatījalāditattvamānena 
saha yathottaraṃ daśādiguṇitāni vyākhyātavyāni || 

tadevaṃvidhānmāyāparimāṇāt ---- 


daśakoṭiguṇā vidyā...........


sāpi vyākhyātadṛṣṭyā ūrdhvādhaḥkoṭinavakaparīmāṇā, madhyasthāt 
kalāmānāt koṭiguṇitāt || 


.......ṃāyāṃ vyāpya vyavasthitā || 10-671 || 


atha tato'pi ---- 


śatakoṭiguṇenaiva vyāptāsāvīśvareṇa tu | 


īśvareṇa īśvaratattvena || 

tato'pi tadvyāpyaiva sthitam ---- 


sādākhyaṃ koṭisāhasraṃ bindunādaṃ tadūrdhvataḥ || 10-672 || 


sādākhyaṃ yat tattvaṃ koṭisahasraparimāṇam, tadevordhvata iti 
tatraivādhvanyūrdhvabhāge paravyāptyā bindunādaṃ 
vakṣyamāṇabindunādātmakāvaraṇarūpatayā sthitaṃ paraṃ sādākhyaṃ 
rūpam | bindunā'rdhacandranirodhikāvaraṇe, nādena ca 
nādāntāvaraṇamupalakṣitam | etaccāgre vyaktībhaviṣyati || 672 || 

ato'pyūrdhve ---- 


yojanānāṃ tu vṛndaṃ vai śaktirvyāpya vyavasthitā | 


vṛndaṃ śatakoṭisahasrāṇi | śaktiriti śaktitattvam || 

atraiva ca śaktisambandhinyūrdhvabhāge ---- 


vyāpinī sarvamadhvānaṃ vyāpya devi vyavasthitā || 10-673 || 


śaktireva parayā vyāptyā paraśivatattvātmā vyāpinīrūpā, sarvamiti 
śaktisadāśivādyadhastanaṃ samanātmakaṃ cordhvamadhvānaṃ vyāpya sthitā 
| eṣāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ tattvānāṃ pūrvameva svarūpaṃ vyākhyātamiti 
māyāntaṃ tattatpadocitānāṃ kṣetrajñānāṃ vicitrāṇām, 
vidyādivyāpinyantaṃ tu mantramantreśvaramantramaheśvarādyāvartena 
bhedabhinnānāṃ rudrāṇāmavasthitiriti tadapekṣayā tatra tatra 
tathocitameva bhuvanabhogādikam | tadetadagre vyaktīkariṣyati bhagavān || 
673 || 

evamaparaśivatattvāntamadhvaparimāṇamuktvā viśvavyāpini paramaśivatattve 
na parimāṇamastītyāha ---- 


aprameyaṃ tato jñeyaṃ śivatattvaṃ varānane | 


tato vyāpinīsamanāntādadhvana ūrdhvaṃ yat śreyorūpaṃ tattvaṃ 
pāramāthīkaṃ svatantraprakāśānandaghanaṃ paramaśivarūpam, 
tadaprameyaṃ parapramātrekarūpamityevaṃ jñeyaṃ niścetavyam, na 
tvitaratattvavaduttarottarapramāṇādhikyakalanayā kalanīyam | evaṃ 
cābhidadhadevamādiśati yat samanāntaṃ viśvaṃ yathoktaprakriyayā 
prameyīkurvanneva parapramātrātmani svaprakāśacidānandaghane 
paramaśivapade samāviśediti || 

evaṃ prasaṅgāduktvā jalatattvādau bhuvanasthitiṃ prakaṭayitumāha ---- 


bhuvanāni pravakṣyāmi aptattvādāvanukramāt || 10-674 || 


tathā ---- 


ākāraṃ vibhavaṃ caiva bhuvanānekavistaram | 


ākāraḥ saṃsthānam | vibhavo vibhūtiḥ | bhuvanānekasya 
tattatpradhānabhuvanānulagnasya bhuvanasamūhasya vistāro 
daśasaṃkhyākṛtaṃ vaitatyam || 

etacca pārameśvaravyatirekeṇa nānyatra dṛṣṭamityāha ---- 


yanna dṛṣṭaṃ paśujñānaiḥ kupathabhrāntadṛṣṭibhiḥ || 10-675 || 


svatantracidghanānandātmakaparabhairavasvasvabhāvākhyātipāśapāśitatvāt
saṃkucitadṛkśaktīnāṃ jñānāni jñāyate'bhilaṣitaṃ paśubhiḥ 
yaistaiḥ paśuśāstraiḥ, yanna jñātaṃ tathā kupathena 
parimitakleśamātrapraśamakāriṇā, na tu 
paripūrṇapadaprāptipradenopāyapradarśanena bhrāntā 
labdhātāttvikaprakāśā dṛṣṭirjñānaṃ pratipadyamānaṃ yeṣāṃ 
tādṛgbhiḥ || 675 || 

tānyetāni paśujñānāni leśato darśayitumāha ---- 


yanna sāṃkhyairna yogairvā na caiva pāñcarātrikaiḥ | 


prakṛtipuruṣayoravivekamātrāt saṃsāro vivekāttu muktiritīdṛgjñānaiḥ 
sāṃkhyaiḥ, atraiva cittaikāgryātmayogāveśasamprāpyadraṣṭṛ- 
svarūpāvasthityātmamuktivādibhiryogaśāstrasthaiḥ, 
ṣaḍviṃśatitattvarūpamahāvibhūtyātmakavāsudevākhyaparaprakṛti- 
pariṇāmātmakaprakṛtyādijagadvādibhiḥ pāñcarātrikairyanna dṛṣṭamiti 
sambandhaḥ || 

tathā ---- 


svabhāvavādibhirnāpi na ca karmapravādibhiḥ || 10-676 || 

nāpi saṃśayavādaiśca nagnakṣapaṇakādibhiḥ | 


pṛthivyādayaḥ svabhāvena tanukaraṇabhuvanādikāryārthaṃ pravartante na 
punaratreśvaraḥ pravartako'stītyevaṃ vadadbhiḥ svabhāvavādibhiḥ, 
karmaiva viśvakāraṇaṃ nānyadityācakṣāṇaiḥ karmapravādibhiḥ, daivaṃ 
puruṣakāro vā viśvakāraṇamiti bruvāṇaiḥ saṃśayavādibhiḥ,

"jīvājīvāsravāścaiva saṃvaro vivarastathā | 

bandho mokṣaśca saptaite saptabhaṅgīvicitritāḥ ||"

iti vacanavyaktyā'nādisiddho bandho mokṣaśca | trividho jīvaḥ, ajīvastu 
sthāvaram, pudgalo dehaḥ, dharmo'dharmo bhuvanādyadhikaraṇaṃ lokākāśo 
muktapudgalasthānamalokākāśaśceti ṣaḍvidhā śabdādiviṣayā 
vikalpavṛttiḥ sukhaduḥkhādisambhinnā vikalpakapraśamanarūpā, ā 
samantāt sravati prasaratyajasramityāsravo, 
yamaniyamādiniyamitendriyavṛttipūrvamamalapudgalarūpadhyānaṃ samyag 
vṛṇīte jīvāniti saṃvaraḥ 
keśolluñcanataptaśilāpatanamaladhāraṇādisamastaduḥkhānubhavaḥ 
prāksañcitāśubhasañcayasya nirjhara iva vidhvaṃsako vivaraḥ, 
lobhamohaśokādilohapañjara ivālāvupātrāṇāṃ nimajjakaḥ 
pudgalānāmāvārako bandhaḥ, tadāvaraṇavyapagame 
mukhasaṃvidātmakapudgalonmajjanamalokākāśo mokṣaśceti 
jīvājīvādipadārthasaptakavādibhiḥ ---- 1. syādasti, 2. syānnāsti, 3. 
syādasti ca syānnāsti ca, 4. syādanirvācyam, 5. syādasti ca nirvācyam, 6. 
syānnāsti ca nirvācyam, 7. syādasti ca nāsti cānirvācyaṃ ceti 
saptabhireva bhaṅgībhiraniścitameva sarvaṃ 
vadadbhirnagnakṣapaṇakādibhiryanna dṛṣṭamiti sambandhaḥ || 

tathā ---- 


na bhūtavādibhiścaiva...........


pṛthivyaptejovāyuriti bhūtacatuṣṭayameva pratyakṣadṛṣṭamastīti 
kathayadbhiścārvākaiḥ || 


........ṇāpi syāllaukikairapi || 10-677 || 


vārtādaṇḍanītimātraniṣṭhaiḥ || 677 || 


na cātmacintakairvāpi.............


"puruṣa evedaṃ sarvaṃ yadbhūtaṃ yacca bhāvyam" (ṛ0 10-90-2)


ityādi cintayadbhirvaidikaiḥ ---- 


..........ṇa ca tarkapravādibhiḥ | 


"avijñātatatve'rthe kāraṇopapattitastattvajñānārthamūhastarkaḥ" 
(nyā0sū0 1-1-40)

ityūharūpeṇa tarkeṇa vyavasthāṃ kurvadbhiḥ || 


na ca vaiśeṣikairvā'pi ṣaṭpadārthaparāyaṇaiḥ || 10-678 || 


dravyaguṇakarmasāmānyaviśeṣasamavāyākhyapadārthaṣaṭkameva 
tattvamityabhidadhadbhiḥ kaṇādaśiṣyaiḥ || 


na cāpi nyāyavādaiśca................


pramāṇādipadārthaṣoḍaśakatattvajñānānniḥśreyasādhigamo bhavatīti 
bruvāṇairnaiyāyikaiḥ || 


.............ḥetudṛṣṭāntavādibhiḥ | 


na ca yaddṛṣṭamiti sthitameva | 

"tadbhāvahetubhāvo hi dṛṣṭānte tadavedinaḥ | 

(khyāpyete)1, (viduṣāṃ vācyo)2 hetureva hi kevalaḥ ||" (pra.vā. 3-27)

ityāraṭadbhiḥ saugataiḥ || 


nāpyekajanmavādaiśca................


vartamānamevedamekaṃ janma, na tu janmāntaramabhūd bhāvi vetyuditavadbhiḥ 
|| 


..........ṇa cāpyekatvavādibhiḥ || 10-679 || 


pārameśaśāstrapratipāditasvaprakāśasvatantracidadvayavādavyatirekeṇa 
sattādyadvayavādibhiḥ || 679 || 


na dhūrtavādairlokairvā suparijñātamaiśvaram | 


dhūrtaviracitamlecchādiśāstraniṣṭhaiḥ | īśvareṇa śivabhaṭṭārakeṇa 
proktamaptattvādibhuvanānāmākāravibhavavistārādikaṃ yat 
sāṃkhyādibhirdhūrtalokaparyantairna kaiścidapi parijñātam, tatte 
vakṣyāmīti proktenaiva saṅgatiḥ || 

na ceyanta eva vādinaḥ, api tu ---- 


ityevaṃvādināṃ teṣāṃ vādānāṃ tu śatatrayam || 10-680 || 

triṣaṣṭiradhikāścānye vādināṃ bhrāntacetasām | 

ajñānatimirāndhānāmunmīlanakṛduttamam || 10-681 || 

saṃsārapaṅkamagnānāṃ naurivottāraṇaṃ param | 

mahāmohatamo'ndhānāṃ tamonudamidaṃ param || 10-682 || 

parameśamukhodbhūtaṃ yanmayā prāptamadbhūtam | 

jñānāmṛtamidaṃ divyaṃ nānābhuvanavistaram || 10-683 || 

śṛṇuṣvaikamanā devi vicitrākāramadbhutam | 


itiśabdaḥ prakāravācī | evaṃprakāraṃ vadatāṃ vādināṃ sambandhino ye 
vādāsteṣāṃ madhye 
jalādiśivāntagatatattadbhuvanādyadhvavedyīkaraṇapratipādanena 
tāvadvedyavedakaparabhairavātmakamahāpramātṛpadasamāveśapradamidaṃ 
jñānāmṛtam | ajñānatimireṇa tattvāvedanāndhakāreṇa, andhā 
anunmīlitadṛkśaktyaḥ, tata eva bhrāntacetasaḥ, teṣāṃ śaktipātataḥ 
prāptaṃ sad unmīlanakṛt svasvabhāvonmeṣakam | tathā saṃsārakardame 
magnānāṃ naurivottāraṇaṃ paraṃ pāraprāpakam | mahāmoho 
viṣayeṣvalaṅkāravastrastryādiṣvātmābhimānaḥ, tamaḥ puryaṣṭake 
ātmābhimānaḥ, ābhyāṃ mohatāmisrāndhatāmisrā lakṣyante | 
evamebhirandhīkṛtānāṃ tamonudamityajñānanāśanam | 
parameśamukhodbhūtamiti parabhairavādeva śaktisadāśivādikrameṇāyātaṃ 
yad mayā kailāsavāsinā prāptamiti śrīśrīkaṇṭhād 
labdhadīkṣeṇādhigatam | adbhutaṃ nibhālyamānaṃ 
sadvismayamudrānupraveśanena parabhairavasvarūpābhivyañjakam, ata eva 
divyam | nānābhuvanānāṃ pratipādyamānānāṃ vistāro vibhavādiprapañco 
yatra tattādṛśam | jñānāmṛtapratipādakamidaṃ śāstrameva 
jñānāmṛtam | ekāgramanāḥ śṛṇvityanena paramopādeyatāṃ dhvanati || 

adbhutatvaṃ bhuvanānāṃ spaṣṭayati ---- 


ananto bhuvanavrātastvavyucchedād vyavasthitaḥ || 10-684 || 

madhukośajālakavattathā bhūricayāvṛtiḥ | 


avyucchedānnairantaryeṇa | madhukośe madhumakṣikāṇāṃ 
golakākṛtāvāśraye yāni jālakāni uparyupari vartulākṛtyā sthitāni | 
bhūricayāvṛtiriti vitatayā parasparamāvāryāvārakatayāvasthitaḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


mīnaśaṅkhakulāyābhaṃ dāḍimībījavat sthitam || 10-685 || 

kadambakesaranibhaṃ purāṇāṃ tu samūhakam | 


kulāyamālayaḥ | dāḍimībījavadityatinibiḍagarbhārthasthitam || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


mahāsenāvāsakavadvane tarusamūhavat || 10-686 || 

nirantaramanantāni bhuvanāni varānane | 

nānākārāṇi citrāṇi sarvaratnamayāni ca || 10-687 || 


mahatī cāsau senā ca mahāsenā, tasyā āvāsakaḥ śibiram, tadvat | 
ākāraḥ saṃsthānam | vicitrāṇi vividhaśobhābhāñji || 687 || 

tathā ---- 


parimaṇḍalāni dīrghāṇyardhacandrākṛtīni ca | 

puruṣākṛtīni cānyāni nandyāvartākṛtīni ca || 10-688 || 

parvatākṛtirūpāṇi gajayūthākṛtīni ca | 

śarāvākṛtīni cānyāni jvālārūpākṛtīni ca || 10-689 || 

mahāvimānarūpāṇi triśūlākṛtimanti ca | 

murajākṛtīni cānyāni tryaśrākṛtipurāṇi ca || 10-690 || 

mahāpuruṣarūpāṇi śataśṛṅgākṛtīni ca | 

sahasraśṛṅgāvartāni tathānyāni varānane || 10-691 || 

koṭiśṛṅgāṇi cānyāni asaṃkhyaśikharāṇi ca | 

vṛttāni caturaśrāṇi trikoṇānyaparāṇi ca || 10-692 || 


parimaṇḍalāni santi dīrghāṇīti paścātparimaṇḍalānyagre tu 
dīrghāṇi, ata eva vṛttānītyanena na punaruktatā | nandyāvartaḥ 
saṃniveśaviśeṣaḥ | murajākṛtīnāṃ bhuvanānāṃ tryaśrākṛtīni 
purāṇi gṛhā yeṣāmiti viśeṣaṇam, tena trikoṇānītyapunaruktam | 
mahāpuruṣaḥ ---- 

"pṛthuvakṣā dīrghabāhūruśca"

ityādirūpaḥ | puruṣākṛtīnīti tu sāmānyoktiḥ || 692 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


divyacitrapatākāni divyaghaṇṭādhvajāni ca | 

bherīnādasvarāḍhyāni divyagītadhvanīni ca || 10-693 || 

divyadundubhinādāni mahāveṇusvanāni ca | 

nānāvāditraghoṣāṇi bhuvanāni ca sarvadā || 10-694 || 


itthameṣāṃ vibhūtimuktvā varṇamāha ---- 


śuklāni sphaṭikābhāni padmarāgākṛtīni ca | 

candrakāntasavarṇāni muktādāmanibhāni ca || 10-695 || 

lākṣārasasavarṇāni kānicidvaravaṇīni | 

indragopakavarṇāni indranīlanibhāni ca || 10-696 || 

nīlotpalasavarṇāni vidyutpuñjanibhāni ca | 

bālādityasavarṇāni padmagarbhanibhāni ca || 10-697 || 

candraprabhāni cānyāni candrakoṭinibhāni ca | 

madhyāhnārkasavarṇāni sūryakoṭinibhāni ca || 10-698 || 

aśokastabakābhāni haritālanibhāni ca | 

śakracāpasavarṇāni gokṣīradhavalāni ca || 10-699 || 

sindūrakuṅkumābhāni gorocananibhāni ca | 

taptahemasavarṇāni nirdhūmāgninibhāni ca || 10-700 || 

śaṅkhapāṇḍuravarṇāni kānicidbhuvanāni ca | 

nānāvarṇāni cānyāni nānārūpākṛtīni ca || 10-701 || 


indragopakaḥ = khadyotakaḥ | etāni ca 
jalatattvādanāśritaśivatattvāntamīdṛṃśyuktāni || 

yataḥ ---- 


eteṣāṃ parato devi vyāpakaṃ paramaṃ padam | 

aprameyamasaṃkhyeyamagamyaṃ sarvavādinām || 10-702 || 


aprameyamidantayā paricchettumaśakyaṃ yataḥ saṃkhyayāpi 
nirdeṣṭumaśakyam | ataśca śaivaśāstrajñavyatirekeṇa prāguktānāṃ 
sarvavādināmagamyamaprāpyam || 702 || 

tadāha ---- 


vinā prasādādīśasya jñānametanna labhyate | 

na cāpi bhāvo bhavati dīkṣāmaprāpya dehinām || 10-703 || 


śaktipātato labdhamāheśvaradīkṣāṇāmetajjñānaṃ labdhaṃ sat prarohati 
nānyathetyarthaḥ || 703 || 

etadeva spaṣṭayati ---- 


yadā tu kāraṇācchaktirbhavennirvāṇakārikā | 

śivecchayā prapadyeta dīkṣāṃ jñānamayīṃ śubhām || 10-704 || 

mantrayogātmikāṃ divyāṃ...........


tadeti madhye vyākāryam | kāraṇāt paramaśivāt nirvāṇakārikā 
śaktirbhaved anugrāhyasyonmajjati tadā so'nugrāhyo dīkṣāṃ prapadyate | 
dīkṣāṃ jñānamayīmityanena proktavakṣyamāṇasamastādhvameyīkaraṇa-
labdhaparapramātṛpadānupraveśābhivyaktidām, śubhāṃ jīvanmuktirūpām, 
jñānamayīmityanena kriyādīkṣayāpi jñānasārataivetyādiśati | 
mantreṇa mananatrāṇadhamīṇā yoga ekyaṃ yasyām, dīkṣāyāṃ hi 
mantrārādhanāt tattādātmyaṃ bhavati | divyāmiti 
vaiṣṇavādidīkṣābhyo'bhyadhikaprabhāvām || 

itthaṃ jñānamayīṃ dīkṣāmāsādya ---- 


.........ṭato mokṣaṃ vrajet paśuḥ | 


jīvanmuktiṃ labhate | paśuriti prāgavasthānuvādaḥ || 

yadi tviyadviśvavedyavedanataḥ parāṃ vedakabhuvaṃ nārohati, tadā na 
mucyata ityāha ---- 


nānyathā mokṣamāyāti api jñānaśatairapi || 10-705 || 


pūrvanidīṣṭarūpaiḥ || 705 || 

ataśca ---- 


yasya prakāśitaṃ sarvaṃ śivenānantarūpiṇā | 

sa eva mokṣaṃ vrajati..........


prakāśitamityanena bhuvanādhvajñānenābhivyaktiṃ nītam | 
anantarūpiṇā'śeṣaśarīreṇa || 

kā'sya mokṣaprāptiḥ ? ---- ityāha ---- 


..............śivaḥ sarvamaheśvaraḥ || 10-706 || 


śiva iti prāptādvayaprakāśānandaghanaśreyorūpaḥ, tata eva 
brahmādyanāśritāntādhiṣṭhātṛtvāt sarveṣāṃ mahānīśvaraḥ || 706 
|| 

kiṃ ca ---- 


tenedaṃ jñānamukhyaṃ tu purā proktaṃ mayā tava | 


teneti sarvamaheśvarātmakaparasvarūpeṇa mayā kailāsavāsinā (tava) 
devyāḥ paraśaktirūpāyāḥ purā proktamityanena 
parasvarūpapratyabhijñāpanayā devīmunmiṣatsvasthānāṃ kurvannetad 
bṛṃhayan proktajñānadīkṣāto muktaḥ parameśvara umāpatiścaikaṃ 
tattvamiti | ataśca tantrāvatārapaṭaloktaparasambandhasārataiva
sarvatreti daśītaṃ bhavati || 

etacca ---- 


saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ naurivottāraṇaṃ param || 10-707 || 


yata etat ---- 

mahāmāyāñjanātītaṃ...........


māyopari mahāmāyā sadāśivādīnāmapi samucitasaṅkocotthāpikā 
śūnyātiśūnyarūpā śaktistatkṛtamañjanamāvaraṇamapyatītam || 

ata eva ---- 


...........'jñātaṃ paśugocare | 


paśūnāṃ māyāñjitatvāt || 

kiṃ cedam ---- 


anantaṃ pāramakṣobhyaṃ subodhaṃ parameśvaram || 10-708 || 


anantaṃ deśakālākārānavacchinnam | pāraṃ ca māyāparyantātmakam | 
svatantracidekaghanākāratvānna kenacit kṣobhaṇīyamapi 
tūllāsanavilāpanakrameṇa viśvakṣobhakam | subodhamiti ---- 

"didṛkṣayeva sarvārthān yadā vyāpyāvatiṣṭhate | 

tadā kiṃ bahunoktena svayamevāvabhotsyate ||" (4-13)

iti śrīspandanirūpitanītyā viśvaprameyīkaraṇena sukhopāyaprāpyaṃ 
svaprakāśasvasvarūpātmakatvāt | atha cedaṃ pārameśvaraṃ jñānaṃ 
śāstraṃ śatakoṭipravistīrṇatvādanantapāraṃ vādyantaraiḥ 
kṣobhayitumaśakyam || 708 || 

tadīdṛśam ---- 


parameśamukhodgīrṇaṃ yanmayā prāptamadbhutam | 


tat ---- 


vakṣye jñānāmṛtamidaṃ śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ priye || 10-709 || 


śṛṇuṣveti punarapi sāvadhānatvagrāhikayoktyā dekā 
prarocanāyābhimukhīṃ kurvannasya jñānasya paramopādeyatāmeva prathayati 
|| 709 || 

tatra ---- 


ūrdhvaṃ vai brahmaṇo'ṇḍasya puraikādaśakaṃ sthitam | 

ekādaśānāṃ rudrāṇāṃ yugāntāgnisamatviṣām || 10-710 || 


ūrdhvamiti śatarudrapurāṇyatikramya, ekādaśānāmapi prāguktānāṃ 
śvetādīnāṃ vīrabhadrāntānāṃ 
yugāntāgnisamatviṣāmeṣāmatidīptatvāt || 710 || 

evaṃ śatarudrādhipatervīrabhadrasya saparivārasya bhuvanānyuktvā, 
tadupari śrībhadrakālīpuramāha ---- 


athordhve bhuvanaṃ devyāḥ kathayāmi varānane | 

indranīlamayaṃ divyaṃ samantāt parimaṇḍalam || 10-711 || 

tasmin bhagavatī devī bhadrakālī vyavasthitā | 


sā ca tatra ---- 


vasatīndīvaraśyāmā snigdhakaṅkuṣṭasaprabhā || 10-712 || 

sūryamaṇḍalarūpābhyāṃ kuṇḍalābhyāmalaṅkṛtā | 

paurṇamāsyāṃ yathā sandhyā candrarkābhyāṃ virājate || 10-713 || 


kaṅkuṣṭaṃ rañjanadravyaviśeṣaḥ || 713 || 

asyāśca ---- 


rājate ca mahāhāraḥ stanābhyāmantare sthitaḥ | 

asitāñjanaśailābhyāṃ madhye srotovahā yathā || 10-714 || 


śtanābhyām" "śailābhyām" ceti sahārthe tṛtīye || 714 || 

kiṃ cāsyāḥ ---- 


catubhīśca dhṛtaṃ pīṭhaṃ siṃhairamitavikramaiḥ | 


pīṭhamāsanam || 

tatra ca ---- 


sarvavajramaye divye divyaratnavibhūṣite || 10-715 || 

āsane suprabhe devī jātyañjanasamaprabhā | 

śukle himavataḥ śṛṅge nīlamegha iva sthitā || 10-716 || 


kiṃ ca ---- 


sarvaratnamayī divyā raśanāsyāḥ virājate | 


iyaṃ ca devī ---- 


pītamālyāṃśukavatī śarvarīvāruṇodaye || 10-717 || 


śarvarī rātriḥ kṛṣṇā, aruṇodayasamaye saṃdhyārāgarañjitā bhavati 
|| 717 || 

devyā rudraśaktitvāt ---- 


tṛtīyaṃ nayanaṃ tasyā lalāṭasthaṃ virājate | 

udayastha ivādityo raśmijālavibhūṣitaḥ || 10-718 || 


kiṃ ca ---- 


ucchiratenātapatreṇa sā śvetena virājate | 

kṛṣṇameghoparisthena candreṇeva vibhāvarī || 10-719 || 


eṣā ca devatārūpāṇām ---- 


koṭikoṭisahasreṇa strīṇāṃ tu parivāritā | 

āvṛtā candralekheva nakṣatraistu nabhastale || 10-720 || 


etāśca ---- 


kumudotpalavarṇāśca hemaśyāmāśca yoṣitaḥ | 

priyaṃgukalikāśyāmāścandragauryaḥ sayauvanāḥ || 10-721 || 

padmāvadātarūpiṇyaḥ pīnaśroṇipayodharāḥ | 

hāvabhāvavidhijñāstu nṛttagītaviśāradāḥ || 10722 || 

vīṇāveṇumṛdaṅgādyairvaṃśavāditraniḥsvanaiḥ | 

upāsīnāstu tāṃ dekā ramante tatra yoṣitaḥ || 10-723 || 


hāvaśceṣṭālāñchanaḥ, bhāvastu tattacceṣṭādyuditaḥ sāttviko 
dharmaḥ || 723 || 

tadetaddevyāḥ sambandhi ---- 


evaṃ viddhi jayaṃ nāma bhuvanaṃ tu varānane | 


eṣā ca sā devī ---- 


yā durgeti smṛtā loke brahmāṇḍodaravatīnī || 10-724 || 

viṣṇunā tapasā pūrvamārādhya parameśvaram | 

avatāritā vadhārthāya mahiṣasya mahātmanaḥ || 10-725 || 


mahātmano mahāśarīrasya || 725 || 

mahiṣasya mahātmyaṃ prakaṭayati ---- 


yena caikena śṛṅgeṇa bhagavān himavān giriḥ | 

śuṣkaparṇamiva kṣiptaḥ..........


bhagavāniti devatātmā || 

so'yamīdṛśo mahiṣāsuraḥ ---- 


............bhagavatyā vināśitaḥ || 10-726 || 


kathamityāha ---- 


sā taṃ vināśayed devī tamaḥ sūrya ivotthitaḥ | 


kiṃ ca ---- 


sā devī sarvadevīnāṃ nāmarūpaiśca tiṣṭhati || 10-727 || 

yogamāyāpraticchannā............


yogāt paratattvaikyādutthitā yā māyā svarūpagopanā, tayā praticchannā 
sthagitaparasvarūpā | sarvadevīnāṃ sambandhinā nāmarūpaprapañcena 
sthitetyarthaḥ || 

kiṃ caiṣā brahmāṇḍamavatīrṇā satī ---- 


...............kumārī lokabhāvinī | 


bhagavacchaktireṣā parānupabhogyatvāt kumārītvamāśritya sthitā | 
tādṛśī cāsau lokān bhāvayatyabhīṣṭaphalena saphalān sampādayati || 
itthamākṛtiyuktāpyeṣā vastucintāyām ---- 


acintyā cāprameyā ca anyatra paripaṭhyate || 10-728 || 


anyatreti tāttvike tatsvarūpanirūpaṇapare tatra tatra śāstre || 728 || 

kiṃ caiṣā ---- 


viṣṇunā sahitā devī kalpe kalpe punaḥ punaḥ | 

bhaginītvena cāyāti nāmarūpaviparyayaiḥ || 10-729 || 

manvantare manvantare tathā caiva yuge yuge | 

rakṣaṇārthaṃ hi lokānāṃ māteva hitakāriṇī || 10-730 || 


kalpādisvarūpamekādaśe vyaktībhaviṣyati | nāmarūpaviparyayairiti 
nānānāmarūpabhogaiḥ || 730 || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


ityākhyātaṃ tu bhuvanaṃ jayaṃ nāma varānane | 


ataśca ---- 


tadbhaktāstatra gacchanti tasyā maṇḍaladīkṣitāḥ || 10-731 || 


maṇḍalaśabdena tadadhikaraṇaṃ bhuvanaṃ tatprāptyartham || 731 || 

taditthaṃ dīkṣāpūrvabhaktikramalabhyametat, nānyathetyāha ---- 


na caitattapasā prāpyaṃ na yajñairbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ | 

na dānaivīvidhaiścāpi śakyaṃ prāptuṃ varānane || 10-732 || 


kintu ---- 

prasādād devadevasya śaśāṅkāṅkitamaulinaḥ | 

dīkṣāṃ prāpya prāpnuvanti..........


jayamityanuvartate || 

na caitajjñānaprāptimeva dīkṣitāḥ, api tu ---- 


............ṃaṇḍalaṃ cakravatīnām || 10-733 || 


mantramantreśvarādīnāmapi maṇḍalametaddīkṣātaḥ prāpnuvanti | 
maṇḍale iti saptamīpāṭhe prāptirbhavatīti yojanā kāryā || 733 || 

na ca kevalaṃ dīkṣitebhyo devī svamaṇḍalaprāptiṃ vidyeśapadaprāptiṃ
ca dadāti, yāvat ---- 


nirbījadīkṣayā mokṣaṃ dadāti khalu dehinām | 


nirbījadīkṣayā mokṣaṃ dadāti, kimaṅga sabījayā || 

yataḥ ---- 


sā muktidīkṣā paramā vidhivat parikītītā || 10-734 || 


vidhivaditi samayapāśaśuddhyantena vidhinetyarthaḥ || 734 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


vidyeśāvaraṇe dīkṣā yāvatī kriyate nṛṇām | 

tāvatīṃ gatimāpnoti bhuvane'tra varānane || 10-735 || 


yāvatī yādṛśabhogaprāpikā | āpnotītyarthād dīkṣitaḥ | "yāvatīṃ 
kurute" iti tu spaṣṭaḥ pāṭhaḥ | atreti śrībhadrakālībhuvane || 735 || 

athaitadbhadrakālībhuvanādūrdhvam ---- 


bhuvanāni tadīśāṃśca saṃsthānāni yathākramam | 

kathayiṣyāmi te sarvaṃ śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ priye || 10-736 || 


saṃsthānāni bhuvanasanniveśāḥ || 736 || 


bhadrakālyāḥ paro devo rudrakrodhasamudbhavaḥ | 

koṭimātreṇa deveśi yugāntāgnisamaprabhaḥ || 10-737 || 

yugāntāmbudavṛndotthagajītadhvaniniḥsvanaḥ | 

śatabāhurmahātejā divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ || 10-738 || 

śirasīndudharaḥ śyāmo nīlāñjanasamadyutiḥ | 

śikhikaṇṭhanibhaḥ kiñcitkiñcidāpāṇḍulohitaḥ || 10-739 || 

cāṣajīmūtavarṇaśca atasīpuṣpasannibhaḥ | 

indranīlanibhaḥ kiñcitkiñcidbhṛṅganibhākṛtiḥ || 10-740 || 

jātyañjananibhākāro rudraikādaśikānvitaḥ | 


rudraikādaśikā ---- 

"atra cāṅgārakaḥ sapīrnairṛtaḥ" (10-490)

ityādinā yā pūrvamuktā, saiveha pararūpeṇa sthitā || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


yutaṃ koṭisahasreṇa rudrāṇāṃ ca mahātmanām || 10-741 || 

bhuvanaṃ tasya devasya vijayaṃ nāma viśrutam | 

indranīlanibhaṃ divyaṃ sarvavajranibhaṃ mahat || 10-742 || 


vajranibhatvaṃ sāraprakarṣāt || 

atra ca ---- 


daśakoṭisahasrāṇi rudrāṇāṃ varavaṇīni | 


mukhyāni sthitāni || 

etacca bhuvanam ---- 


antarbhuvanasaṅghātairanyaiśca parivāritam || 10-743 || 

nīlotpaladalaśyāmaiḥ śikhikaṇṭhanibhaistathā | 


anyacca ---- 


rudraidībhyairmahāvīryaiḥ samantāt parivāritam || 10-744 || 


pradhānānāmapi pradhānabhūtairityarthaḥ || 744 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


stutibhirmaṅgalairgītairnṛttavāditravāditaiḥ | 

paṇavairveṇuvīṇābhirbherījhallarigomukhaiḥ || 10-745 || 

paṭahaiḥ kāhalaiścaiva śaṅkhadundubhipīlukaiḥ | 

mṛddalaistaṭṭarībhiśca tālakairmurajaistathā || 10-746 || 

maundakāhalaṭaṅkaiśca tamiladraghaṭādibhiḥ | 

vāditrairvalgitaistālai roṭanairmukhamṛddalaiḥ || 10-747 || 

bhūtairbhūtagaṇai rudrairjalpitaiḥ paṭhitaistathā | 

dhyāyadbhiśca japadbhiśca dhāvadbhiśceṣṭitaistathā || 10-748 || 

mayūrakokilārāvān muñcadbhiśca tathāparaiḥ | 

nānārutavilāsaiśca vikurvadbhirmahātmabhiḥ || 10-749 || 

āvṛtastairmahātejā mayūkhairiva bhāskaraḥ | 

gajavaktraiḥ siṃhavaktrairaśvavaktraiḥ śubhānanaiḥ || 10-750 || 

gokarṇairgomukhaiścānyairdvīpiṛkṣamukhaistathā	 | 

vyāghravānaravaktraiśca bhagavān paryupāsyate || 10-751 || 

vīrabhadro mahātejā yugāntāgnisamaprabhaḥ | 


pīlukamṛddalatamiladraghaṭādayo vādyaviśeṣā iha prasiddhāḥ | 
tṛtīyāścaitā yathāyogamitthambhūtalakṣaṇe kartari karaṇe hetau ca 
yojyāḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


āsanaṃ tasya devasya sarvajramayaṃ mahat || 10-752 || 

daśayojanavistīrṇaṃ caturasrānalaprabham | 

rājate'trāṣṭabhiḥ siṃhairvṛtaṃ bhīmaparākramaiḥ || 10-753 || 


caturasrānalaprabhamiti karmadhārayaḥ | atreti vijayākhye pure || 753 || 

etadyeṣāṃ yathopapatti sthānam, tān darśayati ---- 


atra te puṇyakarmāṇaḥ...........


jāyante || 

ke ---- 


..............ye smaranti maheśvaram | 

jale marutsvathāgnau vā śiraśchedena vā mṛtāḥ || 10-754 || 

ye yānti caiśvaraṃ bodhaṃ vīrabhadraṃ mahādyutim | 


marutsu mahāvātyāsu | maruṣviti pāṭhe mahāpatheṣu maheśvaraṃ smaranti, 
mṛtāśca ye tathā bhagavatpādapūjārthaṃ śiraśchedena ye vā mṛtāḥ 
saṃgrāme śiraśchedena, maheśvaraṃ smaranto mṛtāsta etatsthānaṃ 
labhante | maheśvarasmaraṇaṃ vinā tu ye jalādau mṛtāste pūrvoktaṃ 
vaidyutaṃ vāyupathamiti vibhāgaḥ || 

atha ---- 


bhuvanasyāsya deveśi hyuparyāvaraṇaṃ mahat || 10-755 || 

ammayaṃ tu ghanaṃ cāpi śakracāpamiva sthitam | 

vitānamiva tadbhadramantare samavasthitam || 10-756 || 


ghanamatīva āśyānam | bhadraṃ ramyam | antara iti 
jayavijayādibhuvanānāṃ tejastattvasya ca || 


tatra cāste mahātmāsāvaṅguṣṭhāgrapramāṇakaḥ | 


bhagavān rudro dhyāyināṃ dhyānāya sūkṣmarūpamāśritya 
prabhāvātiśayaśālī tatra sthitaḥ || 

yathā ca brahmāṇḍasyordhvakarparikā koṭiyojanā, 
tathā''pyāvaraṇakarparikāpītyāha ---- 


tatra yojanakoṭirvai viṣkambhādūrdhvamucyate || 10-757 || 


tatretyāvaraṇakarparikābhāge | viṣkambhād ghanatvādūrdhvamucyata 
ityāvaraṇakarpariketyarthāt || 

ataśca ---- 


tiryaktriguṇavistāramāpyamāvaraṇaṃ priye | 


śatakoṭivistārād brahmāṇḍād daśaguṇaṃ yadāpyamāvaraṇaṃ 
sahasrakoṭyunmānamuktam, "tatsarvaṃ triguṇenohya" iti nītyā 
trisahasrakoṭiparimāṇamityarthaḥ, na tu karparikāghanatānusāreṇa 
triguṇavistāratvaṃ yojyam, āsamañjasyāpatteḥ || 

ataśca ---- 


āvṛtaṃ tena tatsarvaṃ mahāmbhodhivisāriṇā || 10-758 || 


tenetyāpyāvaraṇena || 758 || 

kimāvṛtam ? ---- ityāha ---- 


rudrāṇḍa iti vikhyātaṃ rudraloka iti priye | 


vīrabhadrādivīrāśrayatvād rudrāṇḍa iti rudraloka iti cāgameṣu 
khyātaṃ purajātamāpyāvaraṇenāvṛtamityarthaḥ || 

etadeva vibhajati ---- 


vīrabhadraniketaśca bhadrakālyālayastathā || 10-759 || 

trayodaśabhiranyaiśca bhuvanairupaśobhitam | 


vīrabhadraniketo bhadrakālyālaya ityādiprāguktarudrabhuvanaikādaśakena 
saha trayodaśabhiḥ, anyaiśca 
dharitryādibhirbhuvanairvakṣyamāṇairbhrājamānam || 

etacca ---- 


nānārudragaṇaidīvyainīrantaramalaṅkṛtam || 10-760 || 

aṇḍaṃ vai vīrabhadrasya brahmāṇḍasadṛśaṃ priye | 


vīrabhadrasyāṇḍamiti prādhānyāt | brahmāṇḍasadṛśaṃ 
caturdaśavidhabhūtasargāśrayanānābhuvanapariṣkṛtatvāt || 

yaduktamanyaiśca bhuvanairiti, tatsphuṭayati ---- 


ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi dharitryā bhuvanaṃ mahat || 10-761 || 

dhātrī yasmin bhagavatī dharāloke sanātanī | 


dhatte sarvamiti dhātrī ākṛtimatī bhagavacchaktiḥ || 

eṣā hi ---- 


hairaṇyamatulaṃ prāptā ādhāraṃ yatra saṃsthitā || 10-762 || 


ādhāramiti bhuvanam || 762 || 

kīdṛśam ---- 


cakravatīvimānaiśca bahubhiḥ parivāritam | 

āvṛtaṃ bhūtasaṅghātairācāryaistatparāyaṇaiḥ || 10-763 || 

divyagītaninādāḍhyairvāditraśataniḥsvanaiḥ | 

antarbhuvanasaṅghātai rudrāṇāṃ parivāritam || 10-764 || 


cakravatīno'tra mahāpuṇyabhājo gīrvāṇādayaḥ | bhūtasaṅghairiti 
caturdaśabhiḥ | ācāryaistatparāyaṇairiti 
pāthīvadhāraṇāsiddhairyogirūpairityarthaḥ | pārameśvarī mūtīreṣeti 
kṛtvaitadbhuvanaṃ rudrabhuvanaiḥ parivṛtam || 764 || 


bhuvanasyāsya madhye tu udayādityasaṃnibhaḥ | 

raktotpalanibho divya aśokastabakacchaviḥ || 10-765 || 

padmarāgamayo divyaḥ prāsādo bahubhūmikaḥ | 


prāsādo devagṛham | bahubhūmika iti 
śikharavartanāgatanānābhūmikāyuktaḥ || 


tasya madhye bhagavatī dharitrī lokadhāriṇī || 10-766 || 

mālayā raktapuṣpasya lambayā nityabhūṣitā | 

candrārkamaṇḍalākārakapolatalabhūṣitā	 || 10-767 || 

pītahemāṃśukavatī mahāhāravibhūṣitā | 

śatayojanavistīrṇe kūrmapṛṣṭhe vyavasthitā || 10-768 || 

caturvaktrā cāṣṭabhujā divyābharaṇabhūṣitā | 


pītahemnā kṛtamaṃśukaṃ praśastavastraṃ yasyāḥ || 


kiṃ ca ---- 


rupayauvanasampannā nṛttagītaviśāradāḥ || 10-769 || 

parivāryopāsate tāṃ divyā vai mānasāḥ striyaḥ | 


tasyāstā manasa udbhūtāḥ || 

kāḥ ? kiyatyaśca ? ---- ityāha ---- 


triṃśatkoṭyastu tāsāṃ vai divyābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ || 10-770 || 

utpāditāstu śarveṇa tadarthaṃ hitamicchatā | 


śarveṇa dharāmūrtīśvareṇa svasyā mūrterdharitryā hitārthaṃ 
vinodāyaitā manasā nimītā ityarthaḥ || 

kiṃ caitāḥ ---- 


taptajāmbūnadanibhā divyābharaṇaśobhitāḥ || 10-771 || 

ucchiratenātapatreṇa dhirayamāṇena śobhitāḥ | 


kiṃ ca ---- 


puraḥsthito mahātejā yo'sau merurmahāgiriḥ || 10-772 || 

upāsīnastu tāṃ dekā tatrāste sa nagādhipaḥ | 


śiraḥpāṇyādyākṛtimānityarthaḥ || 

tathā ---- 


nīlotpaladalaśyāmo nīlajīmūtasaṃnibhaḥ || 10-773 || 

nīlo nāma mahāśailaḥ pītavāsā mahādyutiḥ | 

atikāntena rūpeṇa kaiṭabhāririvāparaḥ || 10-774 || 

upāsyamāno divyābhirnagarībhirnagādhipaḥ | 

tasyottare candranibho nānālaṅkārabhūṣitaḥ || 10-775 || 

śvetātapatrī tejasvī śveto nāma mahāgiriḥ | 

tasyottareṇa sūryābho mukuṭādivibhūṣitaḥ || 10-776 || 

pītāmbaradharaḥ śrīmān śṛṅgavāniti viśrutaḥ | 

atikāntena rūpeṇa kusumāstra ivāparaḥ || 10-777 || 


ādyastasyottara iti śabdaḥ kākākṣivad meroruttare nīlaḥ, tasyāpyuttare 
śveta iti yojyaḥ || 

kiṃ cāsya meroḥ ---- 


dakṣiṇenāpi vakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvāvahitā priye | 


ākṛtimataḥ parvatān sthitāniti śeṣaḥ || 

tān krameṇāha ---- 


candrāvadātadīptaujā divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ || 10-778 || 

śuklāmbaradharaḥ śrīmān niṣadho nāma viśrutaḥ | 

taptahemapratīkāśo divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ || 10-779 || 

atiśubhreṇa dehena pitāmaha ivāparaḥ | 

pītāmbaradharaḥ śrīmān pītamālyānulepanaḥ || 10-780 || 

hemakūṭo mahātejāstejasāmiva saṅgrahaḥ | 

rājate bhagavān śailaḥ sandhyāvṛta ivāṃśumān || 10-781 || 

pāṇḍurābhrapratīkāśaḥ śaṅkhagokṣīrasannibhaḥ | 

śuklāmbaradharaḥ śrīmān divyakuṇḍalabhūṣitaḥ || 10-782 || 

ātapatreṇa mahatā dhirayamāṇena mūrdhani | 

himavāniti vikhyāto dvitīya iva bhāskaraḥ || 10-783 || 


kiṃ ca ---- 


indragopakasaṅkāśaḥ paścime gandhamādanaḥ | 

raktāmbaradharaḥ śrīmānastādristha ivāṃśumān || 10-784 || 

śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaḥ śuklāmbaradharaḥ śubhaḥ | 

kirīṭī kuṇḍalī śrīmān mālyavānnāma parvataḥ || 10-785 || 

ityevamādibhiścānyaiḥ parvataiḥ parivāritā | 

lokālokāvasānaiśca tathānyaiḥ kulaparvataiḥ || 10-786 || 

divyarūpadharā devī tanurvai pārameśvarī | 


bhūloke ye mervādayastadadhiṣṭhātṛrūpā evetyarthaḥ | 
pārameśvarītyanena ---- 

śthūlasūkṣmaprabhedena tadekaṃ saṃvyavasthitam" (4-295)

iti pūrvoktaṃ pramāṇīkṛtam || 

yata evamataḥ ---- 


dhāraṇāṃ gandhatanmātre prāṇāṃstyaktvā tu yoginaḥ || 10-787 || 

te yānti tādṛśīṃ mūtīṃ dharitryāḥ paramāṃ tanum | 


gandhatanmātre dhāraṇāṃ kṛtvā yoginastāmimāṃ dharitryāḥ paramāṃ 
mūtīmākṛtimatīṃ dekā sāyujyasāmīpyasālokyabhedena prāpnuvanti, 
ataśca ācāryairupāsyamānāmiti yatpūrvamuktam, tat sphuṭīkṛtam || 


ataḥ parataraṃ devi sāmudraṃ bhuvanaṃ mahat || 10-788 || 

sarvavajramayaṃ divyaṃ nānāścaryaśatānvitam | 


sāmudramiti samudrādhiṣṭhātṛdevatāśrayam || 

tacca ---- 


nīlotpalasamacchāyaṃ sarvataḥ parimaṇḍalam || 10-789 || 

madhye tu bhuvanasyāsya maṇḍalaṃ candrasaṃnibham | 

śatayojanasāhasraṃ samantāt parimaṇḍalam || 10-790 || 

tasya madhye tu puruṣo rukmavarṇo mahādyutiḥ | 

kirīṭī kuṇḍalī sragvī divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ || 10-791 || 

apāṃ nidherbhagavato varuṇasya parā tanuḥ | 


puruṣa iti samudradevatātmā || 


taṃ tu devaṃ mahātmānaṃ parivārya samantataḥ || 10-792 || 

rūpayauvanasampannāḥ satataṃ paryupāsate | 


devyaḥ || 

tāsāṃ madhye tu ---- 


śuklāmbaradharā devī śuklagandhānulepanā || 10-793 || 

śuklayajñopavītā ca śuklahāropaśobhitā | 

śuklenaivātapatreṇa dhirayamāṇena mūrdhani || 10-794 || 

gaṅgā hyuttaratastasya sthitā vai paramā tanuḥ | 

nīlāmbaradharā devī nīlagandhānulepanā || 10-795 || 

nīlasragdāmakaṇṭhā ca yamunā tasya dakṣiṇe | 

evamādyā mahānadyaḥ parivārya mahādyutim || 10-796 || 

samudrāṣṭakaṃ ca deveśi svanadībhiḥ samāvṛtam | 

upāsate sadā bhaktyā vāruṇīṃ paramāṃ tanum || 10-797 || 


paramāṃ tanumityadhiṣṭhātṛdevatārūpām || 797 || 


atra cākṛtimantyeva ---- 


nānāsarāṃsi tīrthāni............


tathā ---- 


.........ṭadbhaktāścāpi saṃsthitāḥ | 

rasatanmātra atraiva kṛtvā samyaktu dhāraṇām || 10-798 || 

apāṃ yoniṃ parāṃ prāptāḥ............


imāmeva || 

yasmādeṣām ---- 


...........vāruṇī sā parā tanuḥ | 


aṣṭamūrtermaheśituriyaṃ dvitīyā mūtīrjalādhiṣṭhātṛdevatārūpā | 
dhāraṇāsvarūpaṃ prāgdhāraṇādīkṣāvasare daśītam || 


ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi bhuvanaṃ varavaṇīni || 10-799 || 

śrīniketa iti khyātaṃ padmagarbhaṃ iti śrutam | 


etannāmabhyāṃ pratītamāgameṣvityarthaḥ || 

tacca ---- 


vimānaśatasaṅghātainīrantaramavasthitaiḥ || 10-800 || 

śobhitaṃ bhuvaneśaiśca rudrai rudragaṇaistathā | 

sarobhirmānasaidīvyairdīghīkābhiśca śobhitam || 10-801 || 

rathacakrapramāṇaiśca maṇikāñjanamaṇḍitaiḥ | 

vaidūryanālaiḥ kamalaidīvyagandhasugandhibhiḥ || 10-802 || 

mṛdubhiḥ kāntimadbhiśca candramaṇḍalasaṃnibhaiḥ | 

saṃśobhitaṃ vicitraistaivīkacairvajrakesaraiḥ || 10-803 || 

udyānaivīvidhaiścāpi nānāvihagakūjitaiḥ | 

nānākāmapradairvṛkṣaiḥ samantāt samalaṃkṛtam || 10-804 || 

nānāmaṇimayaidīvyaiḥ krīḍāśailaiśca mānasaiḥ | 

mānasībhiśca nārībhidīvyayauvanakāntibhiḥ || 10-805 || 

hāvabhāvavilāsāḍhyadivyastrībhiralaṃkṛtam | 

vicitrairmaṇipadmaiśca sitapatraiśca suvrate || 10-806 ||
