vibhūṣitaṃ gajendrasthaiḥ stutimaṅgalavādibhiḥ | 

gāyadbhiścātha nṛtyadbhidīvyastraiṇaiḥ samākulam || 10-807 || 


mānasairiti saṅkalpamātrasiddhaiḥ | svabhāvata eva padmānāṃ 
maṇikāñcanamaṇḍitatvaṃ vaidūryanālatā ca | 
candramaṇḍalasaṃnibhairityanena padmānāṃ śvetatā uktā | vajraṃ 
(he)1rakam | nānākāmapradairvṛkṣaiḥ kalpavṛkṣairityarthaḥ | 
mānasībhirmanonukūlābhiḥ | strīṇāṃ samūhaḥ straiṇam || 807 || 

tadīdṛśe ---- 


tasmiṃstu bhuvane divye padmagarbhasamaprabhe | 

śaradindunibhaṃ divyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ raśmisaṃkulam || 10-808 || 


maṇḍalaṃ pradhānabhuvanam || 808 || 


tasya madhye bhagavatī śrīḥ svayaṃ lokabhāvinī | 

candrakoṭisahasrāṇāṃ yā kāntimativartate || 10-809 || 


lokān bhāvayati prodbhūtavibhūtikān sampādayati || 809 || 


sā ca ---- 


ekatra yugapattejastejasāṃ tu virājate | 


sarvatejasāṃ sambandhi tejaḥ, ekatra rāśībhūtamiva bhavati || 

evamapi ca saumyākṛtitvāt ---- 


nirvāṇamiva yā śāntā sarvānandamanoharā || 10-810 || 

rūpiṇī..........


ākṛtimatī || 

vastutastu ---- 


.............paramā devī mūtīravyabhicāriṇī | 


paraiva dyotamānā pārameśvarī mūtīriyamitthaṃ gṛhītākṛtirityarthaḥ 
| anayaiva mokṣaśriyā nityasambaddhayā parameśvaraḥ śrīkaṇṭha ucyate 
|| 

eṣā ca ---- 


śatayojanavistīrṇe uditādityasaprabhe || 10-811 || 

candrakāntamaye padme vajrakesarakaṇīke | 

koṭipatre mahādivye gandhapuṣpaguṇānvite || 10-812 || 

padmāsane bhagavatī padmagarbhasamaprabhā | 

upaviṣṭātra sā nityaṃ vibhūtyā parayā yutā || 10-813 || 

mahāratnaiśca sragdhāma pralambamurasā śubham | 

vahantī sā tu śuśubhe jyotsneva tripathāpatham || 10-814 || 


tripathāpathamākāśaṃ gaṅgāpravāhāt || 814 || 

api ca ---- 


sphuranmayūkhacalane kapolatalamaṇḍa(ne)1 | 

sūryamaṇḍalasaṅkāśe dhārayantī ca kuṇḍale || 10-815 || 


kiṃ ca ---- 


sphuranmayūkhasaṅghātāṃ raśanāṃ sā tu bibhratī | 

hemābhā pītavasanā mahāhāravibhūṣitā || 10-816 || 

candrābhenātapatreṇa dhirayamāṇena rājitā | 

upagītā ca gandharvairmānasai rudrasambhavaiḥ || 10-817 || 

parivāritā bhagavatī sā tanuḥ pārameśvarī | 


mānasai rudrasambhavairiti rudreṇaiva bhagavatā tadārādhanārthameva 
sṛṣṭaiḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


yā prāptā tapasārādhya viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || 10-818 || 


ārādhanādeva cāsmai ---- 


dattā prītena rudreṇa viṣṇorurasi vāhinī | 


na ca sārvātmyena, api tu ---- 


ardhena sā bhagavatī viṣṇoraṅge pratiṣṭhitā || 10-819 || 

pādenendrasya devasya pādārdhena divi sthitā | 

tadardhena punardevi pāthīveṣu vyavasthitā || 10-820 || 

tadardhena manuṣyeṣu..............


divi tannivāsidevavaktra ityarthaḥ | pāthīveṣviti sarveṣu 
cakravatīṣvaṃśāṃśikāyogāt |  manuṣyeṣvamātyādiṣu,
sarveṣvitthaṃ viṣṇoraṃśāṃśikayā śrīḥ sthitā, sākalyena tu 
bhagavati śrīkaṇṭha evetyuktaṃ bhavati || 

itthameṣā sarvameva jagat ---- 


........yā sthitā vyāpya mūtībhiḥ | 

svarūpā kāmarūpā ca dvidhā sā parikītītā || 10-821 || 


mūtībhinījairaṃśāṃśikāvatāraiḥ | svaṃ pāramāthīkaṃ paripūrṇaṃ 
rūpaṃ yasyāḥ | kāmenecchāmātreṇa tattadviṣṇvindrādimāhātmyapradaṃ 
rūpaṃ yasyāḥ sā kāmarūpā || 821 || 

tatra svarūpātmā ---- 


acalā sā tanuḥ sūkṣmā akṣobhyā tatra tiṣṭhati | 


sūkṣmā sarvanijāvatāravyāpikā | akṣobhyā niratiśayā | tatreti prokte 
svapure'calā tiṣṭhati || 

yathaitacchrīpuramāpsyati, tathādiśati ---- 


rudrakrīḍāvatāreṣu prayāgādiṣu suvrate || 10-822 || 

śrīgirau ca viśeṣeṇa mṛtastadbhuvanaṃ vrajet | 


rudrasya krīḍayā, natvanujighṛkṣayā'vatāro yeṣu te 
devadāruvanaprabhṛtayo rudrakrīḍāvatārāḥ || 

ataśca ---- 


satsvanyeṣvapi bhogeṣu tviyaṃ sā gaditā gatiḥ || 10-823 || 


bubhukṣūṇāṃ prāpyatveneti śeṣaḥ || 823 || 

yasmād bubhukṣavaḥ śrīgiryādau maraṇādetadārādhanādvā ---- 


prāpya tāmīdṛśīṃ devīmaiśvaryamaṇimādikam | 


labhanta iti śeṣaḥ, prāpya tāmiti tadbhuvanamityarthāt || 

na kevalametat, yāvat ---- 


bhūtvā tu sāṣṭadhā divyā deveṣvapi ca tiṣṭhati || 10-824 || 


aṣṭadhetyaṇimādirūpatayā || 824 || 

tathā janmauṣadhimantratapaḥsamādhibhiḥ ---- 


siddheṣvapi ca sā devī uttamā siddhirucyate | 


api ca ---- 


yadarthaṃ tārakādyaiśca saṃgrāmastridaśeśvaraiḥ || 10-825 || 


saha ---- 


kṛto ghorastvasaṃkhyeyaḥ............


tathoktāṃśāṃśikārūpām ---- 


..........ṭāṃ śriyaṃ prāptumicchubhiḥ | 

asaṃkhyeyāśca saṃgrāmāḥ kṛtā vai cakravatībhiḥ || 10-826 || 


taditthamuktaiṣā ---- 


sā bandha evamuktānāmabudhānāṃ parā smṛtā | 


evamuktānāṃ tārakādīnāmabudhānāṃ vinaśvarabhogābhilāṣeṇa 
saṃgrāmādikurvatāmeṣā śrīrbandha eva, atha ca muktānāṃ 
pratyabhijñātasvarūpāṇāṃ jīvanmuktibhājāṃ sā bandha eva, na te 
tadarthaṃ prayatante, api tu prāptāṃ tāmathībhyo vitaranti | ye 
tvabudhāsteṣāmeva sā parā 
prāpyatvenābhilaṣitetyāvṛttyā'kārapraśleṣeṇa vyākhyeyametat || 

tadetat ---- 


śrīpuraṃ tu samākhyātaṃ yathāvacca varānane || 10-827 || 


atha ---- 


ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi bhuvanaṃ ca nibodha me | 

sārasvatamiti khyātaṃ gāndharvamiti ca smṛtam || 10-828 || 


ūrdhvamityuparisthitam | sarasvatyā idaṃ sārasvatam | sarasvatī ca 
sarvaśāstrasphārarūpā gāndharvavidyārūpā ceti gāndharvamityasya 
purasya nāma || 828 || 

tadetat ---- 


padmagarbhapuraṃ cāpi koṭimātreṇa suvrate | 

yojanānāṃ samākhyātaṃ pramāṇena samantataḥ || 10-829 || 


padmagarbhākāraṃ sukumārojjvalamityarthaḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


sarvaratnamayaṃ divyaṃ sarvaiśvaryasamanvitam | 

vimānaivīvidhākārairnānāratnamayaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 10-830 || 

gāndharvairmānasaiścāpi gāyadbhiścāpyanekadhā | 

nṛtyadbhiśca tathānyaiśca gaṇaiḥ pārśvagataistathā || 10-831 || 

strībhiḥ surūpiṇībhiśca gandharvaiśca samākulam | 


gandharvāṇāmamī gāndharvā vimānāstaiḥ | mānasaiḥ 
saṅkalpamātrasiddhaiḥ | gaṇaiḥ parameśvarānucaraiḥ || 

tadīdṛśasya ---- 


tasya madhye tu deveśi śaraccandranibhaṃ śubham || 10-832 || 

raśmimālākulaṃ divyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ parimaṇḍalam | 

tasya madhye bhagavatī sthitā sākṣāt sarasvatī || 10-833 || 

śaraccandrasahasrasya yā kāntimativartate | 

pītāmbaradharā devī padmapatrāyatekṣaṇā || 10-834 || 

nīlotpaladalaśyāmā divyābharaṇabhūṣitā | 

hemapaṭṭaparīdhānā divyakuṇḍaladhāriṇī || 10-835 || 

urasā tu mahāhāramudvahantī śaśiprabham | 

sphuranmayūkhasaṅghātakuṇḍaladvayamaṇḍitā || 10-836 || 


maṇḍalaṃ pradhānabhuvanam | kāntirdīptiḥ, śyāmatvaṃ tu varṇaḥ | 
ambaramāntaraṃ vastram, parīdhānaṃ tu bāhyam || 836 || 

samagragāndharvamayī asyā mūtīrityāha ---- 


grāmatrayavalīmadhyā saptasvaratanuḥ śubhā | 

tānamūrdharuhā devī mūrcchanāṅgaruhodvahā || 10-837 || 

padāsanā tālapādā gītavarṇaprabhāvatī | 


ṣaḍjamadhyamagāndhārākhyaṃ grāmatrayameva trivalilekhāśobhi madhyaṃ 
yasyāḥ sā | ṣaḍjādisaptasvaraśarīrā, tathā tanyante vistāryante 
svaragumphanāmayyo mūrcchanā yaiste tānā mūrdharuhāḥ keśā yasyāḥ | 
mūrcchanā evāṅgaruhān romāñcān yadvahati | padāni chandonibaddhāni 
gītakānyāsanaṃ yasyāḥ | cañcupuṭādayastālā eva prasaraṇahetutvāt 
pādau caraṇau yasyāḥ | dvitriśrutyātmakasvaragīyamānāḥ padaikadeśā 
gītavarṇāstaiḥ prabhā dīptiryasyāḥ || 

kiṃ cāsyāḥ ---- 


aṃgulyaḥ sandhayaścaiva lakṣaṇāni varānane || 10-838 || 


sandhayo marmāṇi | lakṣaṇāni ---- 


"alaṅkāraguṇaiścaiva bahubhiḥ samalaṃkṛtam | 

bhūṣaṇairiva citrārthaistadbhūṣaṇamiti smṛtam ||" (16-6)


ityādilakṣaṇena bharatamuninā lakṣitāni bhūṣaṇākṣarasaṅghātādīni 
ṣaṭtriṃśat | tadiyamevaṃ bhūtvā svarādyābaddhaśarīrā sarasvatī iha 
pararūpeṇādhiṣṭhātrī devatoktā | pūrvaṃ tu merugatagāndharvapuryām -
--- 

"āste bhagavatī sākṣāt saptasvaravibhūṣitā | 

grāmatrayaparīdhānā................................ ||" (10-152)


ityādyuktyā 
svarādyalaṃkṛtavāṇyātmikāpararūpeṇaitaddevatādhiṣṭheyarūpeti 
viśeṣaḥ || 838 || 

tadeṣātra ---- 


āsane parame divye vṛtā bhūtagaṇeśvaraiḥ | 

sthitā sthitirivābhāti sarvasya jagataḥ śubhā || 10-839 || 


"vācyarthā nihitāḥ sarve vāṅmūlā vāṅnibandhanāḥ"

iti nītyā jagadvyavasthāheturiyameva hi devī || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


mānasībhiśca nārībhirgāndharvairmānasairvṛtā | 


tathā ca ---- 


hāhā hūhūścitrarathastumbururnāradastathā || 10-840 || 

viśvāvasuvīśvarathaḥ.............


ta ete ---- 


................ḍivyagītavicakṣaṇāḥ | 

saṃyojya manasātmānaṃ tyaktvā karmaphalaspṛhām || 10-841 || 

te vai sārasvataṃ sthānaṃ prāptā vai surapūjite | 


svaravaikharībhūmyavasthitikrameṇa 
madhyamāpaśyantīpadapratiṣṭhaikāgramanaskā imāmeva devīmupāsīnā ete 
gandharvamukhyā etatpuraṃ prāptāḥ || 

na kevalamete puramidaṃ prāptāḥ, yāvat ---- 


ye ca vāgdhāraṇāṃ dhyātvā prāṇān muñcanti dehinaḥ || 10-842 || 

te vai sārasvataṃ lokaṃ prāpnuvanti narottamāḥ | 


vāgdhāraṇā tattvasiddhipaṭale dvādaśe vakṣyate || 


yuktaṃ caitat, yasmāt ---- 


eṣā sarasvatī devī mūtīrvai pārameśvarī || 10-843 || 

yā sthitāparabhāvena brahmāṇḍodaravatīnām | 


kathamityāha ---- 


brahmaloke ca sā devī pādenaikena tiṣṭhati || 10-844 || 

śākre cāpi tadardhena............


śakraloke'ṣṭamāṃśena || 


.................gandharveṣu tadardhataḥ | 


ṣoḍaśāṃśena || 


siddheṣu ca tadardhena............


dvātriṃśāṃśena || 


.................kinnareṣu tadardhataḥ || 10-845 || 


catuḥṣaṣṭyaṃśena || 845 || 


tadardhena ca nāgeṣu...............


aṣṭāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamenāṃśena || 


................yakṣeṣvardhena vai punaḥ | 


ṣaṭpañcāśadadhikadviśatatamāṃśena || 


piśāceṣu tadardhena............


dvādaśādhikapañcaśatatamāṃśena || 

tadittham ---- 


.........ṣā vai tiṣṭhati bhāgaśaḥ || 10-846 || 


kiṃ ca ---- 


piśācebhyaḥ sahasrāṃśānmānuṣeṣu ca tiṣṭhati | 


na caivamaṃśāṃśikayaiṣāvatīrṇā devī, apitu ---- 


taistu taptvā tapo ghoramārādhya ca pinākinam || 10-847 || 

avatāritā tu sā devī rūpiṇī svarabhūṣitā | 


rūpiṇī ākṛtimatī || 

tadevaṃ tapasā samārādhitasya pinākinastadādeśādeva prathamam ---- 


svarāṃstu smaratastasya kalpādau brahmaḷaḥ purā || 10-848 || 

svarebhyastu viniṣkrāntā tena sā tu sarasvatī | 


svarapratyavamarśavaśonmiśannādāmarśānupraveśād brahmaṇaḥ svarebhya 
ivodbhūtā'bhivyaktimāgatā yasmāt, ata eṣā'kṣarasārūpyāt 
sarasvatītyucyate | yadā tu "brahmaṇo'vyaktajanmanaḥ" iti pāṭhaḥ, 
tadā'vyaktād vakṣyamāṇāt prakṛtitattvād janma yasya buddhitattvagatasya 
parasya brahmaṇaḥ pinākiprasādād vyaktiṃ gateti vyākhyeyam || 

taditthamavatīrṇaiṣā ---- 


sā sthitā sarvaśāstreṣu kavīnāṃ kāvyamāsthitā || 10-849 || 


adhiṣṭhāya sthitetyarthaḥ || 849 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


yā vālmīkau sthitā devī vyāse caiva nirantaram | 

ṛṣīṇāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ medhābuddhivivadhīnī || 10-850 || 


medhā nivīkalpapratibhā, buddhiradhyavasāyinī dhīḥ || 850 || 

eṣā hi ---- 


sarvajñānadharī sā tu sarvajñā devapūjitā | 


brahmāṇḍāntaravatīrṇāyāśca krameṇa ---- 


merorvāyavyadigbhāge puraṃ tasyāḥ prakītītam || 10-851 || 


aparam ---- 


idaṃ tu paramaṃ devyā mayā te parikītītam | 


etadupasaṃharati ---- 


sārasvataṃ tu bhuvanaṃ kītītaṃ..........


yatra sarasvatī bhagavatī devī || 


...........paramā tanuḥ || 852 || 


parameśvarasambandhinī paramā mūtīḥ sthitetyarthaḥ || 

adhunā ---- 


atraiva tvāpyatattve tvaṃ śṛṇu vai bhuvanottamam | 


proktebhyo'pi bhuvanebhya uttamaṃ vakṣyamāṇadṛśā bhuvanāṣṭakaṃ 
śṛṇu || 

tacca bhuvaneśadvāreṇa darśayati ---- 


amareśaṃ prabhāsaṃ ca puṣkaraṃ naimiṣaṃ tathā || 10-853 || 

āṣāḍhiṃ ḍiṇḍimuṇḍiṃ ca bhārabhūtiṃ ca lākulam | 


tadetat ---- 


guhyāṣṭakamiti khyātaṃ jalāvaraṇagaṃ priye || 10-854 || 


guhyatvameṣāṃ śatarudrādibhyo'pyutkarṣaṇāt | ete ca bhuvaneśvarā 
bhuvanamapyetannāmakaṃ 
nānādiggatasvayambhūtīrthādirūpatayā'nugrahārthamavatīrṇāḥ 
prasiddhāḥ | evamanye'pi vakṣyamāṇā jñātavyāḥ || 854 || 

atha ---- 


tejastatvamataścordhvaṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ | 

agnestu bhuvanaṃ tatra kathayāmi varānane || 10-855 || 


tacca ---- 

aśokastabakānāṃ ca sarvato dīptimudvahat | 

utphullakiṃśukacchāyaṃ japākusumasaṃnibham || 10-856 || 


atilohitamityarthaḥ || 856 || 


bhūvanasyāsya madhye tu uditārkasamaprabham | 

parimaṇḍalamāgneyaṃ tejomaṇḍalamucyate || 10-857 || 


paritastrikoṇākāraṃ maṇḍalaṃ parimaṇḍalam | tejomaṇḍalamiti 
tejomayaṃ pradhānabhuvanam || 857 || 


tasya madhye tu bhagavān śivāgniḥ kāraṇaṃ param | 


śiva eva parameśvaro gṛhītāgnimūtīḥ śivāgniḥ | paraṃ kāraṇamiti 
brahmāṇḍavatīsarvāgnibhedānām || 

yadāha ---- 


yo'vatīryāṇḍamadhye tu sthito nityaṃ tridhā tridhā || 10-858 || 


bhaumāntarikṣajāṭharāgnirūpatayā || 858 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


vaktre tu dakṣiṇe tasya rudrasya paramātmanaḥ | 

sthito jihvāsvarūpeṇa svayambhūrnīlalohitaḥ || 10-859 || 


tasyeti śivāgnirūpasya rudrasya | yo nīlalohito jvālāliṅgātmā 
śrīparvatādau svayambhūḥ prasiddhaḥ, sa dakṣiṇe vaktre 
jihvārūpastaddakṣiṇavaktrād bhuvanamanugrahāyāvatīrṇa ityarthaḥ || 859 
|| 

kiṃ ca ---- 


sa eva tu mahādevi kālāgniḥ parameśvaraḥ | 


yaḥ karparikāpṛṣṭhe brahmāṇḍordhve ca pratipāditaḥ, sa eveti 
nīlalohito yasya dakṣiṇajihvāmātrātmā kālāgniḥ, sa niḥsāmānyātmeti 
yāvat || 

etasya śivāgnerdhyāyijanopayogi ---- 


tasya rūpaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvāvahitā priye || 10-860 || 

raktapadmadalacchāyaḥ padmarāgasamadyutiḥ | 

raktāmbaradharaḥ śrīmān raktamālyānulepanaḥ || 10-861 || 

arkābhābhyāṃ kuṇḍalābhyāmalaṃkṛtaśubhānanaḥ | 

mahāhāreṇa dīptena uraḥsthena virājate || 10-862 || 


padmarāgamayenetyarthāt || 862 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


kirīṭī kuṇḍalī dīpto devānāmāsyamucyate | 


asyantyanena śivāgnirūpeṇa viśvabhakṣakeṇa havirityāsyam || 

ayaṃ cātra bhuvane ---- 


sarvavajramaye pīṭhe upaviṣṭaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ || 10-863 || 

dāvāgniriva śailāgre veṇugharṣāt samutthitaḥ | 


kiṃ ca ---- 


daśakoṭisahasrāṇi āgneyāstu gaṇeśvarāḥ || 10-864 || 

dakṣiṇāsyādviniṣkrāntāḥ śvasato'sya svayambhuvaḥ | 

hitāya sarvalokānāṃ rudrā vai sūryavarcasaḥ || 10-865 || 

tena te'gniṃ mahātmāno nityaśaḥ paryupāsate | 


gaṇānāṃ svaparivārāṇāmīśvarā rudrāḥ | hitāya sarvabhūtānāmiti 
sūryamarīcyādyadhiṣṭhānadvāreṇa saṃsthitāgnyadhiṣṭhānena ca 
bhogamokṣarūpamanugrahaṃ sampādayitum, tathā ca purāṇeṣu ---- 

"candrārkayormadhyagatā ye ca candrārkaraśmiṣu | 

rasātalagatā ye ca ye ca tasmāt paraṃ gatāḥ || 

namastebhyo namastebhyo namastebhyo'stu nityaśaḥ | 

yeṣāṃ na vidyate saṃkhyā pramāṇaṃ rūpameva vā || 

asaṃkhyeyagaṇā rudrā namastebhyo'stu nityaśaḥ | " 

(vāma0pu0 26 | 159-161)

iti stutivākyamasti || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


nāryaśca vividhā divyā divyagītavicakṣaṇāḥ || 10-866 || 

gaṇā rudrā bhūtagaṇāḥ kiṅkarāśca sahasraśaḥ | 


taṃ paryupāsata iti sambandhaḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


sa vai śivāgniḥ paṭhitaḥ sarvahaumeśvaraḥ paraḥ || 10-867 || 


pārameśvareṣu śāstreṣu dīkṣātmani śivayajñe || 

kiṃ cāsau ---- 


agnikāryavidhāneṣu hūyate tadvidaiḥ sadā | 


tatra vidā jñānaṃ yeṣāṃ te tadvidāstaiḥ | 

kiṃ ca ---- 


tamagnimaiśvaraṃ yānti kṛtvāgneyīṃ tu dhāraṇām || 10-868 || 


dehānta ityarthāt || 868 || 

ayaṃ cāsya śivāgnemaihimā, yat ---- 


sa ekadhā sa bahudhā vyāpya sarvaṃ vyavasthitaḥ | 


ekadheti śivāgnitayā | bahudheti vakṣyamāṇapañcāśadrūpatayā || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


sa tejastejasāṃ yoniḥ............


yataḥ ---- 


..........ṭasmājjajñe divākaraḥ || 10-869 || 


jajñe jātaḥ | uktaṃ ca ---- 


"jñānaśaktiḥ parasyaiṣā tapatyādityavigrahā |" (10-499)


iti | śivāgnerasyehodbhavo yata uktaḥ || 869 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


bahudhā vyajyate cāsau kalpamanvantarādiṣu | 


vakṣyamāṇeṣu kalpādiṣu bahudhā vyajyate nānāprakāratayā 
brahmāṇḍāntaraṃśāṃśikayāvatarati || 

kiṃ cāyam ---- 


bhinnaśca janmabhedaiśca pañcāśadbhiśca bhūtale || 10-870 || 


te ca vāyupurāṇādau1 vidyudaraṇisūryakāntodbhūtānāṃ 
pāvakapavamānaśucisaṃjñānāṃ bhedena tatputrapautrādibhedena ca 
bharatavaiśvānarātharvabhṛdṛgādinānānādanidīṣṭena 
pañcāśannityanaimittikakāmyakarmādhikaraṇabhūtāḥ kecid laukikāḥ 
kecicca vaidikā nidīṣṭāḥ | mocakastveka eva śivāgniḥ 
parameśamantrasaṃskārasaṃskṛtaḥ sākṣādayamevāvatīrṇaḥ sa ekadheti 
yo'nantaraṃ nidīṣṭaḥ || 870 || 


upasaṃharati ---- 


tadevaṃ kītītaṃ samyagāgneyaṃ bhuvanaṃ mahat | 


atraiva ---- 


bhuvanādhipāṃśca bhuvane kathayāmi tvataḥ param || 10-871 || 

hariścandraṃ ca śrīśailaṃ jalpamāmrātakeśvaram | 

mahākālaṃ madhyamaṃ ca kedāraṃ bhairavaṃ tathā || 10-872 || 


tadabhidhāne rudrāṣṭakaṃ pūrvoktād guhyāṣṭakāt sātiśayam ---- 


atiguhyaṃ samākhyātaṃ.............


atiguhyaṃ guhyebhyaḥ prakṛṣṭatvāt | evamuttaratra || 

kathametadatra sthitam ? ---- ityāha ---- 


.............pūrveśāntamanukramāt | 


pūrvadiśa īśānadigantaṃ sthitaṃ 
pradhānabhūtametadrudrāṣṭakamityarthaḥ | 
etaccoktavakṣyamāṇāṣṭakāntareṣvapyevamavasthānaṃ prādhānyaṃ 
copalakṣayati || 


athordhve vāyvāvaraṇaṃ tatrastho vāyuravyayaḥ || 10-873 || 

prāṇasya bhuvanaṃ tatra vāyostu varavaṇīni | 

śaṅkhagokṣīradhavalaṃ śaratkundendusaprabham || 10-874 || 


prāṇākhyasya pradhānasya vāyoḥ ---- 


tasmiṃstu bhuvane divye divyāścaryaśatairyute | 

madhye tu maṇḍalaṃ divyaṃ śaraccandrasamaprabham || 10-875 || 

raśmimālākulaṃ divyaṃ dyotayad vai diśo daśa | 


maṇḍalaṃ pradhānapuram || 


tasya madhye tu deveśi vāyostu paramā tanuḥ || 10-876 || 


vāyvadhiṣṭhātṛdevaḥ sthita ityarthaḥ || 876 || 


sa ca ---- 


kirīṭī kuṇḍalī dīpto hārakeyūrabhūṣitaḥ | 

nānābharaṇacitrāṅgaścitramālyānulepanaḥ || 877 || 

citrāmbaradharaḥ śrīmān mahāhāravibhūṣitaḥ | 


taṃ ca ---- 


mārutā nāma vai devāḥ śatakoṭyo mahābalāḥ || 10-878 || 

upāsate mahātmānaṃ vāyumūtīṃ mahādyutim | 


kaṃ tamityāha ---- 


yo vyāpayeccharīrāṇi ekadhā pañcavadhā vibhuḥ || 10-879 || 


ekadhā sāmānyaprāṇātmanā | prāṇāpānasamānodānavyānānāṃ bhedena 
tu pañcadhā | vyāpayediti vyāpnuvataḥ svaprapañcavyāptirūpān vāyūn 
prayuñjīta || 879 || 

na kevalaṃ sarvāṇi śarīrāṇi svaprapañcavyāptirūpaiḥ 
sūkṣmavāyubhirvyāpayediti, yāvad bahirapi ---- 


saptadhā saptadhā caiva tiryaggo dviguṇo vibhuḥ | 


"ā meghād bhāskarāt" (10 | 513) ityādyuktanītyā ye sapta, te pratyekaṃ 
paurāṇikaprasiddhyā saptadhetyekonapañcāśaddhā bahistiryaggo vāyuḥ | 
dviguṇa iti śabdasparśākhyaguṇadvayayuktaḥ || 

evaṃbhedabhinnasyādhiṣṭhātṛdevatātmā ---- 


svamaṇḍalasya sā divyaivībhātyekā parā tanuḥ || 10-880 || 


kiṃ ca ---- 


tametamekaṃ daśadhā prāṇātmānaṃ tu yoginaḥ | 

dhyātvā tyaktvā tu vai prāṇān kṛtvā tasmiṃstu dhāraṇām || 10-881 || 

taṃ viśanti mahātmāno vāyubhūtāḥ khamūrtayaḥ | 


tamiti sāmānyaprāṇarūpamekam | daśadheti 
prāṇādibhedānnāgakūrmādibhedācca | taṃ viśantīti 
vāyvāvaraṇagatatvādvāyudevatāsāyujyaṃ yānti || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


iti prāṇasya bhuvanamākhyātaṃ tava suvrate || 10-882 || 


atha ---- 


bhuvaneśāṃstatra rudrān kathayāmyanupūrvaśaḥ | 

gayāṃ caiva kurukṣetraṃ nākalaṃ kanakhalaṃ tathā || 10-883 || 

vimalaṃ cāṭṭahāsaṃ ca māhendraṃ bhīmamaṣṭamam | 


pūrvavad bhuvanamapyavatīrṇam ---- 


guhyād guhyataraṃ hyetadveditavyaṃ prayatnataḥ || 10-884 || 


veditavyamiti dīkṣāyāmupasthānādipūrvaṃ śodhyatvena || 884 || 


athopari ---- 


ākāśe tu yathākāśaṃ śuddhasphaṭikanirmalam | 


ākāśa iti tadāvaraṇe | yathākāśamiti vyāpakam | śuddheti svaccham | 
bhuvanamityarthāt || 

tathā'tra ---- 


sūkṣmarūpo'vyayo nityo madhyadeśe vyavasthitaḥ || 10-885 || 


ākāśākhya eva parameśvaramūtīrūpo bhuvaneśa ityarthāt || 885 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


ākāśadhāraṇāyukto yogī yujyeta tatpade | 


dehāntara eva || 

atha ---- 


atrākāśe pravakṣyāmi ye rudrāḥ saṃvyavasthitāḥ || 10-886 || 


tān || 886 || 


vastrāpadaṃ rudrakoṭimavimuktaṃ mahālayam | 

gokarṇaṃ bhadrakarṇaṃ ca svarṇākṣaṃ sthāṇumaṣṭamam || 10-887 || 

pavitrāṣṭakametaddhi samāsena prakītītam | 


pavitrasya nirāvaraṇapadaniviṣṭatvena pūrvebhyo'pyutkarṣāt || 

atha ---- 


asya bāhye ahaṅkāraḥ..............


asya ākāśāvaraṇasya bāhye sarvato vyāpakatvenāvasthito'haṅkāra 
ityantargarbhīkṛtatanmātrendriyātmakasvavikāraṣoḍaśakamahaṅkārāvaraṇ
amityarthaḥ || 

ataśca ---- 


............ṭatra rudrānnibodha me || 10-888 || 

chagalāṇḍaṃ duraṇḍaṃ ca mākoṭaṃ maṇḍaleśvaram | 

kālañjaraṃ śaṅkukarṇaṃ sthūleśvarasthaleśvarau || 10-889 || 

sthāṇvaṣṭakaṃ samākhyātaṃ............


tiṣṭhatyasmin tanmātrendriyādhiṣṭhātṛdvāreṇa sarvabhogasampaditi 
sthāṇuśabdābhidheyamaṣṭakametat || 

pūrvavadaṣṭakametat ---- 


.............pūrvādīśānagocaram | 


sthitamityarthāt || 

etadaṣṭakādhiṣṭhānādeva ca ---- 


madhyadeśe sthito rudrastvahaṅkāreśvaraḥ prabhuḥ || 10-890 || 


ahaṅkārādhiṣṭhātṛdevatātmā etattattvāvibhinnamūtīḥ | ata eva 
śrīpūrvādau (5 | 21-22) pradhānabhūtasyāṣṭakasya śodhyatvamuktam, na 
tu tadadhiṣṭheyasyāhaṅkāreśvarasya || 890 || 

idānīṃ jalatattvādhipaterguhyādyaṣṭakapañcakasya dīkṣāyāṃ 
dhyānopayogi rūpamādiśati krameṇa ---- 


śvetaṃ raktaṃ tathā pītaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sphaṭikasaprabham | 


tadittham ---- 


pañcāṣṭakeṣu ye varṇāḥ samāsāt kathitāstava || 10-891 || 


śatarudrāṇāmapi pūrvādidikkrameṇaiva varṇavibhāgaṃ nirūpayati ---- 

sitā raktāstathā kṛṣṇā nīlāḥ śyāmā balāhakāḥ | 

pītāḥ śuklāśca vijñeyāḥ.............


ūrdhvaṃ tu kapiśāḥ ---- 


.....'dhastu dhūmravarcasaḥ || 10-892 || 


ta etadvarṇāḥ ---- 


śatarudrāḥ samākhyātāstrinetrāḥ śūlapāṇayaḥ | 

candrārdhamaulayaḥ sarve rudrāṇībhiḥ samanvitāḥ || 10-893 || 


sarva iti pañcāṣṭakarudrā api trinetrādirūpāḥ || 893 || 

evaṃ devānāṃ rūpamuktvā tadbhuvanānāmapyāha ---- 


padmākṛtīti jñeyāni citraratnayutāni ca | 

śatarudrabhuvanāni bhogaiśvaryayutāni ca || 10-894 || 

pañcāṣṭake purāṇi syuḥ kūrmākārāṇi sarvataḥ | 


evamahaṅkārāvaraṇe rudrānuktvā 
tadantarvatītanmātrādiṣoḍaśakakrameṇa bhuvanāni nirūpayitumupakramate -
--- 


ākāśāvaraṇādūrdhvaṃmahaṅkārādadhaḥ priye || 10-895 || 

bhuvanāni pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ punaḥ | 


tatra ---- 


ādau tu gandhatanmātraṃ vistīrṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ mahat || 10-896 || 

sthitaṃ vitānavad devi yojanānekakoṭayaḥ | 


maṇḍalaṃ bhuvanaṃ śatakoṭimānād brahmāṇḍāt krameṇa daśaguṇyā 
vṛddhyā koṭiguṇamahaṅkārāvaraṇamiti tadantarvatīnāṃṃ 
tanmātrādyāvaraṇānāmanantakoṭitaiva bhavati || 

tacca ---- 


śuklarakta1sitāpītaharitaṃ sphuṭikaprabham || 10-897 || 

vitānamiva deveśi sarvataḥ parimaṇḍalam | 


yathā ca bhūloke tathā bhūtattvakāraṇe'pi || 


śarvo hyadhipatistatra eka eva varānane || 10-898 || 


yuktaṃ caitadyataḥ ---- 


tasmāttu jāyate pṛthvī śarveśena pracoditā | 


anyathā jaḍasya tanmātrasya kathaṃ kāraṇatā syāt | evamanyatrāpi 
jñātavyam || 

atha ---- 


tasmāttu maṇḍalādūrdhvaṃ rasatanmātramaṇḍalam || 10-899 || 

haritaṃ marakataśyāmaṃ cāṣapakṣanibhaṃ priye | 

bhavo hyadhipatistatra eka eva varānane || 10-900 || 

tasmādāpo viniṣkrāntā bhaveśena pracoditāḥ | 


atha ---- 


tasmāttu maṇḍalādūrdhvaṃ rūpatanmātramaṇḍalam || 10-901 || 

sphuratsūryāṃśudīptābhaṃ padmarāgasamaprabham | 

rudraḥ paśupatistatra eka evāvatiṣṭhate || 10-902 || 

tasmāttejo viniṣkrāntaṃ tadvai paśupatīcchayā | 

tattejaḥ sarvalokānāṃ vyāpakaṃ parameśvari || 10-903 || 


paśupatyākhyo rudraḥ | lokānāṃ vyāpakamityantarbahiśca 
jāṭharabhaumarūpādyagnirūpatayā sthitamityarthaḥ || 903 || 

atha ---- 


asmāttu maṇḍalādūrdhvaṃ sparśatanmātramaṇḍalam | 

sandhyāruṇasamacchāyaṃ vāyavyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ priye || 10-904 || 


saṃdhyāyāmaruṇo guṇaḥ kiñcittamasā karburadhūsarābho bhavati || 904 || 

taccaitat ---- 


vitānākārasadṛśaṃ samantāt parimaṇḍalam | 

tatraiva maṇḍale devi tvīśānaḥ saṃvyavasthitaḥ || 10-905 || 


adhipatiḥ || 905 || 

ataśca ---- 


tasmādvāyuvīniṣkrānta īśecchāpreritaḥ priye | 


yaḥ pūrvaṃ vāyutattvarūpa uktaḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


tasmāt prāṇādayaḥ pañca.........


tasmāditi vāyoḥ || 

tato'sau ---- 


...........vāyostadvyāpakaḥ paraḥ || 10-906 || 

saptadhā saptadhā so'pi sa eko bahudhā gataḥ | 


etatpūrvameva nirṇītam || 

atha ---- 


tasmāttu maṇḍalādūrdhvaṃ śabdatanmātramaṇḍalam || 10-907 || 

nīlotpaladalaśyāmaṃ svacchodakasamaprabham | 

vitānasadṛśākāraṃ samantāt parimaṇḍalam || 10-908 || 

bhīmastatrādhipatyena eka evāvatiṣṭhate | 

tasmānnabho viniṣkrāntaṃ bhīmecchācoditaṃ mahat || 10-909 || 

vyāpakaṃ sarvalokānāṃ parāparagataṃ priye | 


paraṃ jalāditattvasthānam, aparaṃ tu brahmāṇḍāntargatam || 

atha ---- 


tasmāttu maṇḍalādūrdhvaṃ sūryamaṇḍalamucyate || 10-910 || 

sahasrādityasaṅkāśaṃ dīpyamānaṃ samantataḥ | 

vitānavadraśmidīptaṃ samantāt parimaṇḍalam || 10-911 || 

rudro hyadhipatistatra tveka evāvatiṣṭhate | 

sūryāstasmādviniṣkrāntāḥ kalpe kalpe varānane || 10-912 || 


ye brahmāṇḍāntaradhikṛtāḥ | evamuttaratra || 912 || 

atha ---- 


tasmātta maṇḍalādūrdhvaṃ somamaṇḍalamucyate | 

candrakoṭisahasrāṇāṃ tejasā tulyamaṇḍalam || 10-913 || 


tulyaṃ ca maṇḍalaṃ parimaṇḍalamityarthaḥ || 913 || 

atra ca ---- 


adhipatistu mahādeva eka evāvatiṣṭhate | 

tasmāccandrādime candrā mahādevena coditāḥ || 10-914 || 

asaṃkhyātāḥ sahasrāṇi kalpe kalpe vinirgatāḥ | 


atha ---- 


tasmāttu maṇḍalādūrdhvaṃ vedamaṇḍalamucyate || 10-915 || 

candrakoṭisamacchāyaṃ samantāt parimaṇḍalam | 

vitānavat sthitaṃ divyamugreśasamadhiṣṭhitam || 10-916 || 

saṃruddhaṃ vāmayā tattu............


ugrākhyasya rudrasya sambandhinyā vāmākhyaśaktyā tadvedamaṇḍalaṃ 
saṃruddhamācchāditaṃ parādvayasvarūpamanadhiṣṭhitamityarthaḥ || 

ataśca vedāntapratipādyādvayātmanaḥ svarūpasya vāmaśaktyāvṛtatvāt 
karmānuṣṭhānapradhānāni bhedamayānyeva ---- 


.............ṭasmādvai nirgatāni tu | 

yajamānasahasrāṇi kalpe kalpe sthitāni hi || 10-917 || 

brahmaṇastapasogreṇa ugreśena pracoditāt | 


tasmādvedamaṇḍalarūpād brahmaṇa ugreśena pracoditāt, na 
tvīśvaracodanāṃ vinā, ugreṇa tapasā lakṣitāni tāni niryātāni 
brahmāṇḍaṃ yajñānuṣṭhānāyāvatīrṇāni || 

tatsamakālameva ca ---- 


vedayajñāśca vividhā brahmaṇo'nantavartmanaḥ || 10-918 || 

tasmādete pravartante yajñā yajñaphalāni ca | 

tapodānādibhiḥ sārdhaṃ vāmaśaktyā niyantritāḥ || 10-919 || 


vedayajñā jyotiṣṭomādayaḥ | yajñā iti svādhyāyajapayajñādayaḥ | 
etacca ---- 

"brahmāṇḍametadākhyātaṃ pāśajālāvatāritam" (10-664)

ityuktadṛṣṭyā

"vāmādhaḥ prerayatyaṇum"

iti sthityā vāmāśaktyadhiṣṭhānakrameṇogradevenaiva sampādyate | 
brahmaṇo'pi hi tannirmātṛtvābhimānastenaiva dattaḥ || 919 || 

upasaṃharati ---- 

ityaṣṭau tanavastvetāḥ parā vai samprakītītāḥ | 

parameśvarasyetyarthaḥ || 

yadapekṣayā parā etāḥ, tā apyāha ---- 


aparā brahmaṇo'ṇḍaṃ vai vyāpya sarvaṃ vyavasthitāḥ || 10-920 || 


bahirantaśca sthāvarabhūtarūpā ityarthaḥ | evaṃ cābhidadhatsarvamidaṃ 
parameśvarātmakamityadvayadṛṣṭimeva prastutāṃ nirvāhayati | evaṃ 
bhūtatanmātrātmakadaśavidhakāryatattvagato bhuvanavibhāga uktaḥ, 
tatprasaṅgena ca mūrtyaṣṭakādhiṣṭhāyakamūrtīśvarāṣṭakamuktam | 
uktamūrtyaṣṭakādhiṣṭhāyakamadhye yājamānī mūtīḥ sarvopari 
pradhānabhūtoktā, yasyā mūtīpañcakaṃ kāryātmakaṃ bhogyaṃ 
sūryasomātmakaṃ ca mūtīdvayaṃ kāraṇatayā vartate || 920 || 

evaṃ kāryāvaraṇamahaṅkārāntargataṃ pañcavidhamuktvā 
karaṇāvaraṇaikādaśakaṃ prakaṭayitumāha ---- 


ebhyaḥ parataraṃ cāpi maṇḍalaṃ karaṇātmakam | 


karaṇaṃ śabdodīraṇādivyāpāratatsādhanakarmendriyodayasthānam | 
maṇḍalaṃ bhuvanaṃ vakṣyamāṇadṛṣṭyā 
vāgādikarmendriyatattvapañcātmakatayā vibhaktamityarthaḥ || 

tacca krameṇa ---- 


śuklaraktāsitaṃ pītaṃ haritaṃ cāpi varṇataḥ || 10-921 || 


tatra ca ---- 


pañcādhipāstu tiṣṭhanti maṇḍale karaṇātmake | 


te cādhārapaṭalanirūpayiṣyamāṇanītyā vahniśakraviṣṇumitrakaśyapāḥ 
|| 

kiṃ ca ---- 


karmadevāḥ pravartante tasmādvai sarvadehinām || 10-922 || 


karmadevā vacanādisvakriyādyotakāni karmendriyāṇi, tasmāt 
karaṇamaṇḍalāt, pravartante dehināṃ pratyaṇu pṛthagrūpāṇyudbhavanti 
|| 922 || 

tāni ca ---- 


vākpāṇipādapāyuśca upasthaśceti pañcamaḥ | 


antaḥprāṇāśraye tyāgādāne vāgindriyakārye | bahistvādānaṃ tyāgo 
dvayaṃ ca pāṇipāyupādanirvartyam | 
samastatyāgādānakṣobhapraśamanenānandātmakasvarūpaviśrāntirupasthakār
yam | na caitadvyatiriktaḥ kaścidvyāpāro'stīti pañcaiva karmendriyāṇi | 
teṣāṃ ca sarvaśarīravyāpakatve'pi pāṇyādyadhiṣṭhānasthānam, tena 
vaktrādināpi yadgrahaṇam, tadapi pāṇīndriyakāryameva || 

buddhīndriyāṇyāha ---- 


ebhyaḥ prakāśakaṃ nāma parataḥ sūryasaṃnibham || 10-923 || 


"rūpādiṣu pañcānāmālocanamātramiṣyate vṛttiḥ" (sā0kā0 28)


iti sthityā śrotrādīnāṃ śabdādiprakāśakatvāt tadudbhavasthānaṃ 
prakāśakaṃ maṇḍalamityuktam, ata eva sūryasannimam || 923 || 

etacca karaṇamaṇḍalāt pañcadhaiva | yadāha ---- 


tasmādvai sampravartante pañca buddhīndriyāṇi tu | 


pratyaṇu bhinnabhinnarūpāṇītyarthaḥ || 

tāni ca ---- 


śrotraṃ tvakcakṣuṣī jihvā nāsikā ca yathākramam || 10-924 || 


vyomavāyvāditattvaprasaraṇakrameṇetyarthaḥ || 

eṣāṃ ca ---- 


viṣayālocanaṃ vṛttiḥ...........


yataḥ ---- 


...............ṭejomaṇḍalasaṃsthitāḥ | 

svākyādhipatayo nityaṃ teṣveva praticodakāḥ || 10-925 || 


bhāvinītyā digvāyusūryavaruṇāśvyākhyasvakādhiṣṭhātṛdevatāpreritā 
buddhidevāścodanānusāraṃ rūpādyālocaneṣu pravartante, tenaiṣāṃ 
viṣayālocanaṃ vṛttirityarthaḥ | eṣāṃ karmendriyāṇāṃ ca 
pratilomakrameṇa bhuvanasaṃśodhanaṃ kāryam || 925 || 

atha ---- 


ebhyaḥ parataraṃ cāsti candramaṇḍalasannibham | 

vistārāt pariṇāhācca sarvato raśmimaṇḍalam || 10-926 || 

tasmādvai sampravartante pañcārthāḥ sarvadehinām | 

śabdaḥ sparśastathā rūpaṃ raso gandhaśca pañcamaḥ || 10-927 || 


bhogyabhūtāḥ pratipuruṣaṃ vicitrabhogasampādakā rūpādayaḥ sarve 
tasmādudyanti | ata eva samastāmmayacandrollāsakatvāttasya 
candramaṇḍalasannibhatvaṃ parimāṇato rūpataścoktam | 
yataścaitadraśmimaṇḍalamata evaitadbhūtā viṣayā etadraśmirūpāḥ 
prakāśamānatayā svaprakāśasvabhāvāḥ | yaduktaṃ 
śrīmaducchuṣmabhairave ---- 

"yāvanna vedakā ete tāvadvedyāḥ kathaṃ priye | 

vedyavedakamekaṃ tu tattvaṃ nāstyaśucistataḥ ||"


iti yadyapi pṛthivyādayo rūpādiguṇā evotpannāstathāpyete pratipuruṣaṃ 
vicitrabhogasampādakā anya eva rūpādayo niryātāḥ || 927 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


ebhyaḥ parataraṃ cāpi saumyaṃ somasya maṇḍalam | 


ebhya iti karaṇaprakāśaraśmimaṇḍalebhyaḥ || 


tasmānmano viniṣkrāntaṃ raśmibhirdaśapañcabhiḥ || 10-928 || 


buddhikarmendriyaviṣayākhyasya grahaṇagrāhyarūpasya 
raśmipañcadaśakasyānusandhātṛrūpamiti kṛtvā taireva tadyuktamuktam || 
928 || 

tacca ---- 


cittaṃ ceto manaśceti...........


itthamucyamānaṃ sat ---- 


...............śabdādyakṣapravartakam | 


yataścāyaṃ pravartyamānaitadraśmipañcadaśakakalāpūritatanuḥ 
svāmṛtakalayā saha ṣoḍaśakalo'ta eva ---- 


tasyādhipo mahātejāścandramāḥ somyatejasā || 10-929 || 


mahātejā nityamakṣīṇakalāṣoḍaśakādiparipūrṇamūtītvāt, ataśca 
cetanasya puruṣasya vikāraṣoḍaśakādiyuktatayā 
svāvasaranirṇeṣyamāṇasyāvarohakrameṇa pratinidhikalpatvāt ---- 

"puruṣe ṣoḍaśakale tāmāhuramṛtāṃ kalām"

ityuddhoṣyate || 929 || 

atha ---- 


tasmāttu maṇḍalādūrdhvaṃ parato maṇḍalaṃ mahat | 

japākusumasaṅkāśamaruṇādityasaṃnibham || 10-930 || 

pūrvavacca pramāṇena samantāt parimaṇḍalam | 


pūrvavaditi pūrvoktacandramaṇḍalaparimāṇamityarthaḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


tasmāttu maṇḍalād devi sandhyāruṇasamadyutiḥ || 10-931 || 

sadhūmo'gnirivāsau vai ahaṅkāraḥ pravartate | 


sarvapramātṛgatā ahaṅkārā udyantītyarthaḥ | ahaṅkāra iti 
jātāvekavacanam | 
manaḥparyantasamastaviṣayendriyādhiṣṭhātṛtvāttatkalpanasvabhāvatvācca
taijasabhūtādirūpasyāsya sadhūmāgnitulyatvamuktam | evaṃ 
cāhaṅkāramanoviṣayabuddhīndriyakāraṇabhūtāni 
sūryasomaraśmiprakāśakaraṇamaṇḍalāni pañca, tathā 
tanmātramaṇḍalāni pañca vyāpya ahaṅkāratattvaṃ sthitamiti manaḥ 
prabhṛti ṣoḍaśakamāhaṅkārikamucyate | ata eva kāraṇasakandhadṛṣṭyā 
bahistattvānyekarūpāṇi, karaṇaskandhadṛṣṭyā tu pratipuruṣaṃ 
bhinnabhinnasvabhāvānīti na karaṇaskandharūpādahaṅkārāt 
ṣoḍaśakotpattirapi tu sūryasannibhānmaṇḍalāt kāraṇaskandharūpāt 
karaṇaskandharūpāṇāṃ 
pratipramātṛbhinnānāmahaṅkārāṇāmutpattistathā manaḥ prabhṛteḥ 
ṣoḍaśakasyeti mantavyam || 

yaścāyaṃ karaṇaskandhātmā ahaṅkāra ---- , saḥ ---- 


antaḥkaraṇamātmasthaṃ..............


ātmano'ntaraṅgametat sakalavasudhādipratītisādhanaṃ kāraṇamityarthaḥ 
|| 

kiṃ ca ---- 


...........yenedaṃ rañjitaṃ jagat || 10-932 || 


jagat sthāvarajaṅgamātmakaṃ tattatsamucitābhimānaniveśanena yenoparaktaṃ 
kṛtamityarthaḥ || 932 || 

ayaṃ ca ---- 


mattadvipa ivāndhastu dāvāgnirupasarpati | 


yathā matto dvipo dāvāgniśca tattattaruprāṇyādivināśāyopasarpati, 
tathā'yamandho'vicāritayuktāyuktastadabhimānādānakrameṇa 
sarvajagannāśakaḥ || 


kimayamasya paropatāpakārī svabhāvaḥ svata evodbhūtaḥ, netyāha ---- 


tasyādhidevo rudro vai yenāyaṃ preryate sadā || 10-933 || 


rudra iti yaḥ pūrvam ---- 

"madhyadeśe sthito rudrastvahaṅkāreśvaraḥ prabhuḥ" (10-890)

ityuktaḥ | preryate saṃsārarakṣārthamabhimānātmani svakārye pravartyate 
|| 933 || 

etaṃ ye parivṛtya sthitāḥ, te'pi ---- 


chagalāṇḍādayo devi pūrvaṃ te kathitā mayā | 


gatametat || 


ahaṅkārādathordhvaṃ tu buddhyāvaraṇamucyate || 10-934 || 

sūryakoṭisahasrāṇāṃ tejasā tulyavarcasam | 


varco dīptiḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


aṣṭānāṃ devayonīnāmatraiva bhuvanaṃ śṛṇu || 10-935 || 


prāg brahmāṇḍarūpeṇoktānāṃ paiśācādibrahmaparyantānāmaṣṭānāṃ 
devayonīnāṃ sāttvikādivṛttivaicitryeṇa sthitānāṃ pararūpeṇātraiva 
buddhitattve dharmādiguṇāṣṭakayukte bhuvanāṣṭakamastītyevakārāśayaḥ 
|| 935 || 


tatra ---- 


kakubhaṃ nāma bhuvanaṃ sandhyāruṇasamaprabham | 

mānasībhistu tatstrībhirmuditābhiḥ samākulam || 10-936 || 


mānasyo manonukūlāḥ || 936 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


sthitāstatra piśācāstu sandhyāruṇasamaprabhāḥ | 

daśakoṭisahasrāṇi..........


kiṃ ca ---- 


...........ṭeṣāṃ tatra nivāsinām || 10-937 || 


madhye ---- 


svanando nāma vikrāntaḥ..........


sa ca teṣveva ---- 


............piśāceṣvīśvaro mahān | 

sandhyāruṇasamacchāyo bandhūkakusumākṛtiḥ || 10-938 || 

kuṇḍalābharaṇopeto hārakeyūrabhūṣitaḥ | 

kirīṭī cāṅgadī maulī hemacīnāmbaraḥ śubhaḥ || 10-939 || 

parivṛto bhūtagaṇaiḥ prabhūtaiḥ pārśvagaistathā | 

nānārūpadhadīvyaidīvyābharaṇabhūṣitaiḥ || 10-940 || 

divyamālyānulepaistu divyaiśvaryasamanvitaiḥ | 


mauliḥ śikhāmaṇiḥ | divyamaiśvaryaṃ 
piśācocitamevāṇimādyaṣṭavidham, evamuttaratrāpi svocitameva divyatvaṃ 
mantavyam || 

sa caitaiḥ ---- 


parivṛto mahātejā gaṇairiva mahāgaṇaḥ || 10-941 || 


mahānto gaṇā yasya sa mahāgaṇo mahādevaḥ || 

atha ---- 


ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi rākṣasaṃ bhuvanaṃ mahat | 

kokilākaṇṭhasadṛśaṃ nīlajīmūtasaṃnibham || 10-942 || 

tasmiṃstu bhuvane divye divyaiśvaryasamanvite | 

karālo rākṣaseśo vai jātyañjananibho mahān || 10-943 || 

kirīṭī kuṇḍalī dīptaḥ śobhate tu mahādyutiḥ | 

jātyañjananibhaḥ śrīmān dāvāgniriva parvate || 10-944 || 


śrīrdīptivīdyate yasya, ata eva dhūmabahulena dāvāgninopamitaḥ || 944 || 

asya ca parivāraḥ ---- 


daśakoṭisahasrāṇi muditā nāma rākṣasāḥ | 

bhṛṅgajīmūtavarṇābhā vasantyatra mahāprabhāḥ || 10-945 || 


atha ---- 


ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi yākṣaṃ vai bhuvanaṃ mahat | 

jāmbūnadamayaṃ sarvaṃ divyaratnasamujjvalam || 10-946 || 

bhogairśvaryasamutpannaṃ samantāt parimaṇḍalam | 

tasmiṃstu bhuvane bhadre subhadro nāma yakṣarāṭ || 10-947 || 

taptakāñcanavarṇābho mukuṭādivibhūṣitaḥ | 

śatakoṭisahasraistu yakṣairamitavikramaiḥ || 10-948 || 

tairvṛto bhrājate sarvaiḥ śarvaḥ sarvagaṇairiva | 


atha ---- 


ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi gāndharvaṃ bhuvanaṃ mahat || 10-949 || 

pītakauśītakīprakhyaṃ campakaistu samacchavi | 


kauśītakī puṣpaviśeṣaḥ || 


tasmiṃstu bhuvane divye surūpo nāma vai priye || 10-950 || 

gandharvadevādhipatirgandhamādanasannibhaḥ	 | 


aprakampyatvāt || 

tathā ---- 


taptajāmbūnadanibhastaruṇādityasaprabhaḥ	 || 10-951 || 

divyagandhānuliptāṅgo divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ | 

daśakoṭisahasraistu gandharvaiḥ parivāritaḥ || 10-952 || 

manaḥśilābhaṅganibhairharitālanibhaistathā | 

svakāntā nāma gandharvāścitramālyānulepanāḥ || 10-953 || 

cittrāmbaradharāḥ sarve cittrābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ | 


atha ---- 


tasmāt parataraṃ vakṣye sthānamaindraṃ ca pārvati || 10-954 || 

bṛhadbhogamiti khyātaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ sarvakāmadam | 

śaṅkhagokṣīradhavalaṃ śaratkundendusannibham || 10-955 || 


bṛhadbhogamiti yathārthanāma | ūrdhvamityutkṛṣṭam || 955 || 


tasmiṃstu bhuvane divye divyāścaryaśatairyute | 

vibhūtirnāma bhagavān mahendro bhuvaneśvaraḥ || 10-956 || 

candramaṇḍalasaṅkāśo muktāhāravibhūṣitaḥ | 

śuklāmbaradharaḥ śrīmān śuklamālyānulepanaḥ || 10-957 || 

jvalatkirīṭo dīptābhyāṃ kuṇḍalābhyāmalaṅkṛtaḥ | 

hārakeyūravān śvetaḥ śvetoṣṇīṣavibhūṣitaḥ || 10-958 || 

bhūtijā nāma vai devā vibhūtyā parayā yutāḥ | 

kirīṭinaḥ kuṇḍalino divyamālyavibhūṣitāḥ || 10-959 || 

daśakoṭisahasrāṇi devāścendrāḥ prakītītāḥ | 

tairāvṛto mahātejā nakṣatrairiva candramāḥ || 10-960 || 


bhūtyā saha jātatvādbhūtijā ityuktāḥ || 960 || 

ataḥ paraṃ tu ---- 


manojaṃ nāma bhuvanaṃ śaraccandranibhaṃ śubham | 

śuklābhrakanibhaṃ dīptaṃ muktāhārasuvarcasam || 10-961 || 

amṛto nāma vai tatra candramāḥ paramaḥ sthitaḥ | 

śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaḥ śrīmān śuklāmbarodvahaḥ || 10-962 || 

kuṇḍalairdīptisaṅkāśairbhūṣitastu virājate | 

divyagandhānuliptāṅgo divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ || 10-963 || 

tatra vai raśmayo nāmnā raśmivyūhasamaprabhāḥ | 


devāḥ || 


divyāḥ saumyāstu te jñeyāḥ somatejaḥ samudbhavāḥ || 10-964 || 

daśakoṭisahasrāṇi teṣāṃ vai saumyatejasām | 


atha ---- 


ata ūrdhvaṃ tu deveśi prājeśaṃ bhuvanaṃ mahat || 10-965 || 

tasmiṃstu bhuvane divye prajeśastvamitadyutiḥ | 

viśvarūpo viśvavarṇo viśvālaṅkārabhūṣitaḥ || 10-966 || 

viśvarūpaparairdevaivīśvātmā parivāritaḥ | 


amitadyutirityetannāmā || 

teṣāṃ ca ---- 


daśakoṭisahasrāṇi viśvānāṃ bhūritejasām || 10-967 || 

parivārya mahātmānaṃ śobhane paryupāsate | 


viśvānāmityetatsaṃjñānām, ata evāsarvanāmatvāt suḍabhāvaḥ | 
śobhana iti bhuvanaviśeṣaṇam || 

atha ---- 


brāhmaṃ caivamato jñeyaṃ śaṅkhagokṣīrasannibham || 10-968 || 

pitāmaho yatra devaḥ śuklapadmasthasaumyadṛk | 

śuklāmbaradharaḥ śrīmān śuklamālyānulepanaḥ || 10-969 || 

śuklayajñopavītī ca mahāhāravibhūṣitaḥ | 

daśakoṭisahasraistu candrabimbasamaprabhaiḥ || 10-970 || 

brāhmairdevaiḥ parivṛtaḥ śāradābhrairivāṃśumān | 


tadittham ---- 


paiśācaṃ rākṣasaṃ yākṣaṃ gāndharvaṃ tvaindrameva ca || 10-971 || 

saumyaṃ tathaiva prājeśaṃ brāhmaṃ vai bhuvanaṃ priye | 


sādhiṣṭhātṛdaivatamuktamityarthaḥ || 


etāni surayonīnāṃ sthānānyeva purāṇi tu || 10-972 || 


etāni purāṇi devayonīnāṃ sthānānyeva mukhyānyevāvasthitidhāmāni || 
972 || 

ebhyaśca sthānebhyaḥ ---- 


avatīryātmajanmānaṃ dhyāyantaḥ sambhavanti hi | 

parameśaniyogācca codyamānāśca māyayā || 10-973 || 

niyamitā niyatyā ca brahmaṇo'vyaktajanmanaḥ | 

vyajyante te ca sargādau nāmarūpairanekadhā || 10-974 || 

aṃśenaiva varārohe..............


vyaktaṃ prabhūtātmadehamayaṃ sthūlaṃ janma yasya brahmaṇo 
brahmāṇḍāntasatyalokādhipatestasya sambandhini pratyahaṃ kārye sargādau 
sṛṣṭiprārambhe vyajyante tatpadocitākṛtibhāja ātmajanmānaṃ 
buddhitattvagataṃ brahmāṇaṃ dhyāyantaḥ 
parameśvaraniyogānmāyādimāhātmyādbrahmāṇḍāntarjāyante | te 
cāṃśamātreṇaiva vyajyante || 

sarvātmanā punarete ---- 


...........ṇa tyajanti niketanam | 


niketanaṃ buddhigataṃ nijaṃ sthānam || 

evaṃ buddhitattvagataṃ devayonyaṣṭakamātramuktvā 
prastutabhuvanadīkṣāyāṃ prakṛtaṃ mā vismārṣīdityāśayenāha ---- 


puryaṣṭakendriyaiḥ sārdhamātmā mantraivīśodhayet || 10-975 || 


buddhiparyantagate bhuvanajāte śodhite sati 
tanmātramanohaṅkārabuddhirūpeṇa puryaṣṭakenendriyaiśca bāhyaiḥ 
karaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ yaḥ sthita ātmā, arthāttameva mantrairiti 
prāgvibhaktasthityā pratiṣṭhāyāṃ yathākarmavibhāgaṃ 
vinirmuktairmūlavāmadevādibhivīśodhayet | viśodhyata iti tu spaṣṭaḥ 
pāṭhaḥ || 975 || 

etadupasaṃharannanyadavatārayati ---- 


pañcāṣṭakaṃ mūrtayo'ṣṭau buddhitattvamanukramāt | 

viśodhyaivaṃ prayatnena krodhāṣṭakamataḥ param || 10-976 || 


viśodhayediti sambadhyate | anukramādityukterayamāśayaḥ ---- 

guhyādyaṣṭakacatuṣṭayaṃ jalādivyomatattvāntagaṃ śodhayitvā 
tanmātrapañcakasomasūryavedyamaṇḍalagatāḥ śarvādimūrtayo'ṣṭau 
viśodhyāḥ, tataḥ 
karmabuddhīndriyaparādhiṣṭhātṝnagnyādisomāntānekādaśa 
śodhayitvā'haṅkāragataṃ pañcama sthāṇvaṣṭakaṃ tato'pi buddhigataṃ 
devayonyaṣṭakaṃ viśodhayet | prayatneneti prāguktenādhvasandhānādinā 
bhuvaneśvaravāgīśvarīvisarjanaparyantena samastena karmavistārādinā, na 
tu helāmātreṇa | uktaṃ cānyatra1 ---- 

ṅa cāvajñā kriyākāle saṃsāroddharaṇaṃ prati"

iti || 976 || 

evamiyadantaṃ śodhayitvā buddhitattvagatameva krodheśvarāṣṭakaṃ 
yacchodhyam, taduddiśati ---- 


saṃvartastvekavīraśca kṛtānto jananāśakaḥ | 

mṛtyuhantā ca raktākṣo mahākrodhaśca durjayaḥ || 10-977 || 


mahākrodhanāmnā krodhādhiṣṭhāyinā 
rudreṇopalakṣitametatkrodhāṣṭakamucyate | ete ca rurusaṃgrahe ---- 


"krodheśaścaṇḍasaṃvartau jyotiḥpiṅgalasūrakau | 

pañcāntakaikavīrau ca śikhī deśahiteśvarāḥ ||" (4-17)

iti nāmāntareṇāpi paṭhitāḥ || 977 || 


nīlotpaladalābhāni teṣāṃ vai bhuvanāni tu | 

ekaikasya parīvāraḥ koṭirdaśasahasrakam || 10-978 || 


athātraiva tattve ---- 


krodheśvarāṣṭakādūrdhvaṃ sthitaṃ tejoṣṭakaṃ mahat | 

balādhyakṣo gaṇādhyakṣastridaśastripurāntakaḥ || 10-979 || 

sarvarūpaśca śāntaśca nimeṣonmeṣa eva ca | 


nimeṣasahita unmeṣa ityarthaḥ || 

eṣāṃ ca ---- 


sahasraiḥ pañcadaśabhiḥ parivāro'bhidhīyate || 10-980 || 


tejoṣṭakasamākhyāyā nimittamāha ---- 


agnirudrāḥ smṛtā hyete tejasā kṛṣṇavarṇakāḥ | 


agnivaddīptatvādagnirudrāḥ tejasā jñānadīptimayenopalakṣitāḥ, ata eva 
buddhigatadīptātmakatejo'ṣṭakādhiṣṭhātṛtvādapyetattejo'ṣṭakam-
ucyate || 


kūrmākārāṇi citrāṇi teṣāṃ vai bhuvanāni tu || 10-981 || 


atha ---- 

ata ūrdhvaṃ samākhyātaṃ yogāṣṭakamanuttamam | 


samprajñātāsamprajñātayogasthitānāṃ 
yogināmadhiṣṭhātṛtvādyogāṣṭakam, ata 
evādhastanāṣṭakāpekṣayotkṛṣṭatvādanuttamam || 

tacca ---- 


akṛtaṃ ca kṛtaṃ caiva raibhavaṃ brāhmameva ca || 10-982 || 

vaiṣṇavaṃ tvatha kaumāramaumaṃ śraikaṇṭhameva ca | 


ribhūṇāṃ devānāmidaṃ raibhavam, evaṃ brāhmaṃ bhuvanamityādi yojyam | 
tena rā dhanaṃ tatra bhavamityādivyākhyānamasat | etacca yogāṣṭakaṃ
pradhānatattvāśrayamiti śrīmālinīvijaye (5-24-25) 
saguṇayoganiṣṭhānāṃ ca śuddhasattvaguṇā dhīḥ pradhānaṃ vā 
prāptipadamiti na vastubhedaḥ kaścit || 

ataśca ---- 


krīḍanti yoginastatra bhuvanaiḥ sphaṭikaprabhaiḥ || 10-983 || 


tatra naiṣkarmyayoganiṣṭhā akṛtapade, karmayoganiṣṭhāḥ kṛtapade, 
nirmāṇayogagatā ribhupade, puruṣādvayayogasevino brahmapade, 
vaiṣṇavaśāstroktayogasevino vaiṣṇavapade, niṣpannabrahmacaryayogāḥ 
kumārapade sphaṭikaprabhaiḥ svacchairbhuvanairupalakṣitāḥ krīḍanti | 
tadūrdhvaṃ tvaumaṃ śraikaṇṭhaṃ ca dhāma 
śaivisiddhāntopadiṣṭaśaktiśaktim 
adārādhanapuraḥsaracittavṛttinirodhātmakaniṣpannānāṃ prāptipadam || 
983 || 

tatra śivayoginyā bhagavatyā umāyā devyā yogāṣṭakasyopari pareṇa 
rūpeṇa sthitāyā bhuvanamāha ---- 


tataḥ sākṣādbhagavatī jaganmātā vyavasthitā | 

umā tvameyā viśvasya viśvayoniḥ svayambhavā || 10-984 || 


sākṣādityuktyā yogāṣṭakamadhye bhagavatyā aṃśāvataraṇamityāha, 
evaṃ vakṣyamāṇaśrīkaṇṭhabhaṭṭārakaviṣaye'pi mantavyam | 
svayambhaveti svātantryāt parānugrahāya tatra sthitā, 
nānyayogivadyogavaśādetatpadaṃ prāptā || 984 || 

sā ca ---- 


taptajāmbūnadanibhā hyudayādityasaprabhā | 

mahāpīṭhe maṇimaye siṃhāṣṭakayute śubhe || 10-985 || 

śatayojanavistīrṇe divyasragdhāmalālite | 


sthiteti śeṣaḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


divyakuṇḍalinī devī mahāhāravibhūṣitā || 10-986 || 


kiṃ ca ---- 


vijayāgre mahābhāgā śrīrivottamarūpiṇī | 

jayā ca padmagarbhābhā sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitā || 10-987 || 

nandā ca padmapatrākṣī hārakeyūrabhūṣitā | 

sarvābharaṇacitrāṅgī sunandā ca manoharā || 10-988 || 

parivārya pratīhāryaḥ sarvataḥ samupasthitāḥ | 


śrīriveti pūrvoktaśrīrūpetyarthaḥ | sarvata iti catudīkkam || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


triṃśatkoṭisahasrāṇi triṃśatkoṭiśatāni ca || 10-989 || 

mānasyo divyanāryastāstāṃ sadā paryupāsate | 


tā iti lokottarāḥ | triṃśatkoṭīti pāṭhe varṇavyatyayaśchāndasaḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


vimānakoṭirekā ca rudrāṇāṃ bhūritejasām || 10-990 || 


tatrāsti || 990 || 

te ca vimānasthā rudrāstadārādhanaparā eveti kṛtvā ---- 


aumā iti samākhyātāḥ...........


kiṃ ca ---- 


..........vaimānā iti te'nyathā | 


vigato mānaḥ śarīrendriyādiviṣayo'bhimāno yasyāḥ sā vimānā 
bhagavatī, tasyā amī vaimānāḥ || 

ete hi ---- 


upāsate tu tāṃ dekā mātaraṃ tanayā iva || 991 || 

na ca tatrāsau kevalamanugrahaparā sthitā, yāvat | 

sāvatīryāṇḍamadhye tu mayā sārdhaṃ varānane | 

anugrahārthaṃ lokānāṃ prādurbhūtā sanātanī || 992 || 

sanātanī nityaṃ puṃsāmanugrahārthaṃ prapañcavyāptyā 
nānānāmākṛtirūpā prādurbhūtā vyaktiṃ gatetyarthaḥ | mayā 
sārdhamiti vakṣyamāṇaśrīkaṇṭhāvatāreṇa kailāsavāsinā mayā 
sahetyarthaḥ || 992 || 

pratikalpaṃ nānānāmabhedena devyavartīrṇetyāha ---- 


kalpe pūrve jaganmātā jagadyonidvītīyake | 

tṛtīye śāmbhavī nāma caturthe viśvarūpiṇī || 10-993 || 

pañcame nandinī nāma ṣaṣṭhe caiva gaṇāmbikā | 

vibhūtiḥ saptame kalpe subhūtiścāṣṭame tathā || 10-994 || 

ānandā navame kalpe daśame vāmalocanā | 

ekādaśe varārohā dvādaśe ca sumaṅgalā || 10-995 || 

kalpe trayodaśe devi mahātanurudāhṛtā | 

kalpe caturdaśe caiva anantā nāma kītītā || 10-996 || 

bhūtamātā pañcadaśe ṣoḍaśe cottamā smṛtā | 

sahasradhārā saptadaśe satī cāṣṭādaśe purā || 10-997 || 


kalpo bhāvimānena caturdaśamanvataraṃ brāhmaṃ dinaṃ yadante 
kālāgnirjagad dahati tatra prathamadvitīyādikalpakrameṇa 
tvetannāmarūpabhedena lokānugrahārthamavatīrṇā || 997 || 

āstāṃ vā niḥsaṃkhyapurākalpagatatattadavatārakīrtanenāparisaṃkhyena,
kevalamasmin vartamāne ---- 


cākṣuṣasya manoḥ kalpe dakṣasya duhitā śubhā | 


brahmaṇā svacakṣuṣā nimītatvāccākṣuṣo yo manuprajāpatistasya kalpa 
iti tadīya etatkalpasambandhini prathamamanvantarātmani tvaṃ 
lokānugrahārthaṃ dakṣaprajāpatiduhitṛrūpeṇāvatīrṇā'bhava ityarthaḥ 
| 

avatīrya ca ---- 


avamānācca dakṣasya svāṃ tanuṃ tvajahāḥ purāḥ || 10-998 || 


etatpurāṇeṣu prasiddhameva || 998 || 

tataḥ saiva ---- 


amāṃ kalāṃ tu candrasya punarāpūrya saṃsthitā | 


maheśvarānurāgāttacchiraḥsthāmamākhyāṃ viśvāpyāyikāṃ 
candrakalāmāpūryeti | evamapi jagadanugrahaprayojanaiva devī || 

atha parameśvarī anujighṛkṣāpreritena ---- 


punahīmavatārādhya duhitā tvātmanaḥ kṛtā || 10-999 || 

tvaṃ devi sā.............


tathārūpatāṃ gṛhītvā ---- 


...........'dbhutaṃ taptvā tapaḥ paramaduścaram | 

māṃ bhartāraṃ punaḥ prāpya jātāsya(ṅka)1ruhā priye || 10-1000 || 


māmiti paramaheśvarameva svātantryād gṛhītakailāsavāsimūtīm | (aṅke)2 
ruhatī (tyaṅka)3 ruhā vāmārdhabhāgagatā || 1000 || 

tadittham ---- 


kailāsanilayaścāhaṃ tvayā sārdhaṃ varānane | 


bhaktadṛśā ca mama ---- 


tvaṃ tanurvāmabhāgasya.............


ataśca tattvadṛṣṭāvivākṛtidaśāyāmapi ---- 


..............ṃatto naiva viyujyase || 10-1001 || 


na kevalamasminneva kalpe'dyatve maccharīrārdhagatatvena sthitāsi, yāvat --
-- 


dakṣādhvare punarjātā bhadrakālīti nāmataḥ | 


punarityanyasmin dakṣayajñe 
dakṣaprajāpatikṛtārādhanaprakarṣāttadanugrahāya 
bhadrakālītvenāvatīrṇā tvamabhava ityarthaḥ || 

taditthaṃ pararūpaiva tvam ---- 


ekānaṃśāparā mūtīḥ satīśānādviniḥsṛtā || 10-1002 || 


ekānaṃśā'vibhaktā'dvitīyarūpā satī ityaparā 
mūtīrīśānādviniḥsṛtetyuktaprakāranānāvidhāparāmūtīrūpā 
tvamīśānāditi parameśvarasvātantryādeva 
jagadanujighṛkṣayetthamāsthitetyarthaḥ, atha 
caikānaṃśākhyadevatātvenāpyavatīrṇetyarthaḥ || 1002 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


idaṃ caturyugaṃ prāpya dvāpare viṣṇunā saha | 

mahiṣasya vadhārthāya utpannā kṛṣṇapiṅgalā || 10-1003 || 


vartamānacaturyugagate dvāpare śrībhadrakālīpuranirūpitanītyā 
viṣṇunā ārādhitā satī tenaiva bhrātṛbhūtena saha 
mahiṣāsuravadhāyāvatīrṇā || 1003 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


kātyāyanīti durgeti vividhairnāmaparyayaiḥ | 

manuṣyāṇāṃ tu bhaktānāṃ varadā bhaktavatsalā || 10-1004 || 

pūrvamevāvatīrṇāsi vindhyaparvatamūrdhani | 


vividhairnāmaparyayairiti vindhyavāsinībhramaravāsinītyādināmabhedaiḥ | 
katasya vṛṣṇimadhyavatīno'patyaṃ kātyaḥ, tasya 
kṛṣṇāvatārādyapuruṣasyāpatyaṃ viṣṇorbhaginī kātyāyanī | duḥkhena 
gamyate japayajñadānatapobhirapi munibhirapi na prāpyate, kintu 
bhaktiśālibhirevāsādyata iti durgā | sā ca vindhyasya mūrdhani 
pūrvamevāvatīrṇetyetatkalpaprārambha 
evoktajambūdvīpagatavindhyaparvataśirasi bhaktānugrahārthamavatīrṇā'si 
|| 

athedānīm ---- 


ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi bhuvanaṃ varavaṇīni || 10-1005 || 

sucāvīti tu vikhyātaṃ sahasrādityakāntimat | 

kailāsaśikharākāraṃ śuddhasphaṭikasaprabham || 10-1006 || 

mahāvimānakoṭībhirāvṛtaṃ cakravatīnām | 


cakravatīno mantreśvarā anugrahārthamevākṛtiparigraheṇātrāvatīrṇāḥ 
|| 


tasmiṃstu bhuvane divye sūryakoṭisamadyutiḥ || 10-1007 || 

sahasrabāhucaraṇaḥ sahasravadanekṣaṇaḥ | 

umāpatirjagannāthaḥ sarvānugrahakṛdvaraḥ || 10-1008 || 


tasya ca bhagavato viśvabhoktuḥ ---- 


bhogasthānaṃ samastaṃ vai tatrasthaṃ vāmabhāgataḥ | 


vāmabhāgato vāmaṃ dehārdhamāśritya tatraiva sthitaṃ samastaṃ 
bhogasthānamaśeṣabhogyopabhogātmatayā vāmamardham, dakṣiṇaṃ tu 
bhoktṛrūpameva | evaṃ ca bhoktṛbhogātmakaviśvaśarīro'yaṃ bhagavānata 
eva sahasrabāhucaraṇādirūpaḥ || 

kiṃ cāyam ---- 


śatayojanavistīrṇe nānāratnavibhūṣite || 10-1009 || 

divyāstaraṇasaṃchanne ādityaśatasannibhe | 

āsane parame divye ratnapadmavicitrite || 10-1010 || 

upaviṣṭo mahātejā vṛṣabhairaṣṭabhirvṛtaḥ | 

hemacīnāmbaradharo hārakeyūrabhūṣitaḥ || 10-1011 || 

dhārayan supradīpte ca sūryamaṇḍalasannibhe | 

sphuranmayūkhasaṅghāte kuṇḍale raśmisaṅkule || 10-1012 || 


mayūkhāḥ sūkṣmāḥ prabhāḥ, raśmayastu sthūlāḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


dhārayan mukuṭaṃ mūdhnī divyaratnavicitritam | 

dedīpyamānamatyugraṃ kailāsaśikharopamam || 10-1013 || 

pralambo'sya mahāhāraḥ prabhavadraśmisaṅkulaḥ | 

gāṅgo himavataḥ śṛṅgāt patito nijharo yathā || 10-1014 || 


kiṃ ca ---- 


triṃśatkoṭisahasraistu triṃśatkoṭiśataistathā | 

śūlibhirjaṭibhistryakṣaidīvyābharaṇabhūṣitaiḥ || 10-1015 || 

nānārūpadharai rudrairvṛto bhūtagaṇaistathā | 

divyābhirmānasībhiśca nārībhiḥ parivāritaḥ || 10-1016 || 

vimānaśatakoṭībhirāvṛtaḥ sarva eva tu | 


anyacca ---- 


mātaraḥ sapta rūpiṇyo nānālaṅkārabhūṣitāḥ || 10-1017 || 

parivārya mahātmānaṃ samantāt paryavasthitāḥ | 


tā digvibhāgenāha ---- 


brāhmī kamalapatrābhā divyābharaṇabhūṣitā || 10-1018 || 

āgneyyāṃ diśi deveśi sthitā vai śrīrivāparā | 

śaṅkhagokṣīrasaṅkāśā tvaiśānyāṃ tu varānane || 10-1019 || 

māheśvarī mahātejāstiṣṭhate surapūjitāḥ | 

kaumārī padmagarbhābhā hārakeyūrabhūṣitā || 10-1020 || 

diśyuttarasyāṃ deveśi kāminīparyupāsitā | 

snigdhanīlotpalanibhā hārakuṇḍalamaṇḍitā || 10-1021 || 

dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi tu sā upāste parameśvaram | 

vaiṣṇavīti ca vikhyātā śivena paramātmanā || 10-1022 || 


śivenaivādhiṣṭhitā satī iyaṃ dhyātā, na tu viṣṇunā | 
pratyutaitasyaitacchaktyaṃśādhiṣṭhitatvādeva viṣṇutvam || 1022 || 


nīlajīmūtasaṅkāśā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā | 

vāruṇyāṃ diśi deveśi vārāhī paryupasthitā || 10-1023 || 

śaṅkhakundendudhavalā hārakuṇḍalamaṇḍitā | 

endryāṃ diśi ca sā devī indrāṇī paryupasthitā || 10-1024 || 

karālavadanā dīptā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā | 

nairṛtyāṃ diśi cāmuṇḍā upāste parameśvaram || 10-1025 || 

etāḥ sapta parivārabhūtāḥ, umā tu devī bhagavataḥ 
śarīrārdhasthā'ṣṭamī | saiva yogeśvarī yasyā etāḥ prapañcaḥ | 
yadvakṣyati ---- 

"umaiva saptadhā bhūtvā" (10-1029) 

iti | 

ata eva pūrvam ---- 

"mātṛkābhairavaṃ devamavargeṇa prapūjayet | 

bhairavī kādinā pūjyā mātṝrvargaiḥ prapūjyet || (1-34) 

iti | 

etadvyākhyānāvasare ihatyadevagṛhānusāreṇa yojanā daśītā || 1025 || 


etāśca devyaḥ ---- 


na tyajanti hi tā devaṃ sarvabhāvasamanvitam | 


sarvabhāvena sarvaṃsavīkayāntarbahiśca 
samanvitamabhedavyāptyā'dhiṣṭhātṛbhūtam || 

taditthaṃ satataṃ parameśvarānugatā apyetāḥ ---- 


aṃśena mānuṣaṃ lokaṃ brahmaṇā cāvatāritāḥ || 10-1026 || 

asurāṇāṃ vadhārthāya manuṣyāṇāṃ hitāya ca | 


hitamanugrahaḥ | caśabdastuśabdārthe || 

kathamavatāritā ? ---- ityāha ---- 


tapastaptvā mahāghoraṃ brahmaṇā lokadhāriṇā || 10-1027 || 


prajāhitakāriṇā || 1027 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


ruroścaiva vadhārthāya mayāpi tvavatāritāḥ | 


mayāpīti prabhuṇā satā, na tu brahmavattapastaptvā, ityapiśabdārthaḥ || 

na caitadākṛtimadevāsāṃ tāttvikaṃ rūpam, api tvaitāḥ ---- 


svacchandāstu parāścānyāḥ paravyomni vyavasthitāḥ || 10-1028 || 

svacchandaṃ paryupāsīnāḥ parāparavibhāgataḥ | 


nityaṃ sthitā iti śeṣaḥ | paraṃ svacchandaṃ cidbhairavaṃ pareṇa 
tadavibhinnena rūpeṇa, aparaṃ tadumāpatirūpam | anenaivamuktena 
vibhāgenaiva cāyamumāpatiḥ parabhairavasphārasāra eveti | 
anenaivāśayenāpyādisūtre parabhairavapadamasmābhiryuktameva vyākāri, 
parabhairavasattāsāratvādumāpatirbhairava ityukta iti || 

etāśca mātaraḥ paraśaktiprapañcavyāptirūpā ityāha ---- 


umaiva saptadhā bhūtvā nāmarūpaviparyayaiḥ || 10-1029 || 

evaṃ sa bhagavān devo mātṛbhiḥ parivāritaḥ | 

āste paramayā lakṣmyā tatrastho dyotayañjagat || 10-1030 || 


parā lakṣmīrjñānadīptimayī umā devī, tayā saha | ataśca umaiva 
saptadhā sthitā satī umāpaterdehāvibhinnetyaṣṭaśaktirmaheśvaraḥ || 
1030 || 

ata evaitadvyāptisārā eva ---- 


asyopari tathā cāṣṭau mūrtayastasya dhīmataḥ | 


asya sucāruṇo bhuvanasyopari tasya dhīmata ityetadumāpatyabhinnasya 
vakṣyamāṇaguṇatattvaniṣṭhasya śrīśrīkaṇṭhasya sambandhinyo'ṣṭau 
mūrtayo mūrtīśvarāḥ | tathā ceti tenaiva śrīkaṇṭhābhinnena 
prakāreṇa sthitāḥ || 

tā āha ---- 


śarvo bhavaśca bhagavān rudraḥ paśupatistathā || 10-1031 || 

īśānaścaiva bhīmaśca mahādevogra eva ca | 


vakṣyamāṇadṛṣṭyanusāramīśānādanantaraṃ rudraḥ paṭhanīyaḥ | 
mahādevena sahita ugra iti samāsaḥ || 

evaṃnāmanidīṣṭābhiḥ ---- 


etābhiḥ kurute śarvo mūtībhiḥ sṛṣṭimuttamām || 10-1032 || 


bhagavānumāpatiretābhiraṣṭabhiḥ, mūtībhirityanena 
mūrtīśvarāṣṭakena parāparādibhedena 
sarvamūrdhvādharapadamadhitiṣṭhato bhagavato nijaśakticakrātmanā 
sṛṣṭimiti 
sthūlasūkṣmaprabhāvabhūtatanmātrādirūpavakṣyamāṇakalādirūpāṃ 
sṛṣṭim, uttamāmityuktasūkṣmasthūlasṛṣṭimudgatāmūrdhve sthitāṃ 
bhagavānumāpatireva vakṣyamāṇadṛṣṭyā parāparabhedena tatra 
tatrāvasthitaḥ karoti || 1032 || 

kā sā sṛṣṭiḥ ? ---- ityāha ---- 


bhūmirāpo'nalo vāyurākāśaṃ sūrya eva ca | 

somaśca yajamānaścetyaṣṭau sṛṣṭiriyaṃ smṛtā || 10-1033 || 


etadaṣṭakaṃ sthūlasūkṣmaparabhedena tatra tatrāvasthitaṃ mantavyam | 
teṣāṃ ca madhyāduddhātadīkṣāyāṃ bindvādipadaiḥ 
pṛthivyādisvarūpaṃ pūrvaṃ daśītam, sūryasomāvapi karaṇaśaktirūpau, 
tadāśrayatvena ca yajamānaḥ pramāteti sarvādhvani sthitamevaitat |  
evamete mūrtīśvarāḥ ---- 


sarvātmanā tu te tasminnanyatraikāṃśata sthitāḥ | 


tasminniti buddhitattvagate mūrtīśāvaraṇe | anyatreti tanmātrāvaraṇe 
brahmāṇḍāntare ca ||  

upasaṃhārabhaṅgyā bhagavata umāpateryāvatī prapañcavyāptistāṃ 
darśayati ---- 


evamasmin sthito devo brahmalokordhvatastathā || 10-1034 || 

merośca mūrdhanīśāno yogāṣṭakamatheṣyate | 

śrīkaṇṭha iti nāmnā ca kailāsanilayastathā || 10-1035 || 

śarvādyābhiśca tanubhiraṣṭābhirvyāpya tiṣṭhati | 


asminniti sucārubhuvane, brahmalokordhvata iti rudraloke, merormūdhnī 
jyotiṣkaśikhare, athānantarameṣa eva bhagavān yogāṣṭakamiṣyate, na tu 
tadanyatkiñcit | tathā śrīkaṇṭha iti nāmnāyameva 
kailāsanilayaścomāpatirayameva śarvādyābhiśca 
mūrtīśvaramūtībhistatra tatra tattatsthūlasūkṣmādi viśvaṃ vyāpya 
tadaikātmyenāvasthitābhirayameva sthita iti prapañcavyāptiriyaṃ 
sarvadaikasyaiva, parameśvarasyeti yāvat | etaccaikādaśe sutarāṃ 
sphuṭībhaviṣyati || 

eṣāmetadumāpatibhuvanamutpattisthānamityāha ---- 


ye tu māheśvaraṃ yogaṃ saguṇaṃ paryupāsate || 10-1036 || 

bhaktyā ca brahmacaryeṇa satyena ca damena ca | 

dṛṣṭravā dehasthamātmānaṃ te'tra yānti manīṣiṇaḥ || 10-1037 || 


ye tu māheśvaraśāstranirūpitaṃ sattvavṛttiniṣṭhatvāt saguṇaṃ na tu 
jñānakriyādiśaktisphārasamāveśarūpaṃ parayogaṃ parito 
dīrghakālanairantaryasatkārairupāsate sevante, te dehasthaṃ na 
tvanavacchinnarūpamātmānaṃ jñātvā kartṛrūpaṃ svaṃ svabhāvaṃ 
sākṣātkṛtyātra yāntītyumāpatipadaṃ sāyujyādinā prāpnuvanti | atra 
ca bhaktirmukhyaṃ kāraṇaṃ satyabrahmacaryadameṣu pradhānabhūtam | dama 
indriyajayaḥ | itthaṃ cāsya yogasya saguṇatvameva vyaktīkṛtam || 1037 || 

na ca saguṇaśāmbhavayogaprāpyametatpadam, yāvat ---- 


dṛṣṭvā ca maṇḍalaṃ tasya bhaktyā ca parayā bhṛśam | 

muktadvaitā yatātmānastatra yānti manīṣiṇaḥ || 10-1038 || 


tasyetyumāpateḥ, maṇḍalamiti tadadhikaraṇaṃ yāgaṃ, dṛṣṭvā 
taddarśanātsamayadīkṣāṃ prāpya, tadbhaktyā ca muktadvaitā 
ityumāpatirevaikā pāramāthīkī devateti niścitya tatsevārthaṃ 
prayatacittāḥ pūrvavat sāyujyādinaitatpadaṃ prāpnuvanti manīṣiṇaḥ 
parameśvaraśāstrāśvastabuddhayaḥ || 1038 || 

atha ---- 


teṣāṃ caivopariṣṭāttu suśivā dvādaśa sthitāḥ | 


suṣṭhu śivā ākṛtimattve'pi śivaikyaprāptyā 
pūrṇasārvajñyādirūpāḥ | te ca ---- 


vāmo bhīmastatheśaśca śivaḥ śarvastathaiva ca || 10-1039 || 

vidyānāmadhipaścaiva ekavīraḥ pracaṇḍadhṛt | 

īśānaścāpyumābhartā ajeśo'nanta eva ca || 10-1040 || 

tathā ekaśivaścāpi suśivā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ | 


eṣāṃ dhyānāya ---- 


sarve kuṅkumasaṅkāśāḥ sūryakoṭisamaprabhāḥ || 10-1041 || 

bhuvaneṣu vicitreṣu śaṅkhākāreṣu saṃsthitāḥ | 


mūrtīśvarāṇāṃ tvadhiṣṭheyapṛthivyādyucitameva rūpamiti kṛtveha 
noktam || 

atha ---- 


ata ūrdhvaṃ vīrabhadro maṇḍalādhipatiḥ prabhuḥ || 10-1042 || 


vakṣyamāṇasya mahādevādimaṇḍaleśvarāṣṭakasyādhipatiḥ | asyaiva 
cāsau parā mūtīryaḥ pūrvaṃ śvetādimadhye tadupari coktaḥ, ata evāyaṃ 
prabhuriti || 1042 || 

athaitaddhyānādipariniṣṭhito yaḥ saḥ ---- 


tatsāyujyamanuprāpya tenaiva saha modate | 


atha ---- 


ata ūrdhvaṃ mahādevi mahādevāṣṭakaṃ viduḥ || 10-1043 || 

mahādevo mahātejā vāmadevabhavodbhavau | 

ekapiṅgekṣaṇeśānau bhuvaneśapura,hsarāḥ || 10-1044 || 

aṅguṣṭhamātrasahitā mahādevāṣṭake śivāḥ | 


ete ca ---- 


māyāñjanavinirmuktāḥ parameśānasaṃmatāḥ || 10-1045 || 


parameśānasya saṃmatā iti tantrāvatārapaṭaladaśītanītyā 
pāramparyeṇānantabhaṭṭārakamūtīnā parameśvareṇānugṛhītāḥ, 
ataśca prāptaprabodhaprakarṣatvānmāyāgarbhādhikāritve'pi 
māyāñjanavinirmuktā ityuktam | ete cāpareṇa rūpeṇehoktā 
maṇḍaleśvarāḥ, pareṇa rūpeṇa tu kālatattve bhaviṣyanti | te tu 
śrīpūrvaśāstre ---- 

"mahātejaḥprabhṛtayo maṇḍaleśānasaṃjñakāḥ | 

māyātattve sthitiḥ....................... ||" (5-28)

ityuktā iti prakriyābhedāḥ || 1045 || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


buddhitattve samāsena bhuvaneśā mayoditāḥ | 


devayonikrodhatejoyogamūrtyaṣṭakāni pañceti catvāriṃśat, 
yogāṣṭakopari punaraumaṃ śraikaṇṭhaṃ ca bhuvanam, tataḥ 
suśivadvādaśakamahādevāṣṭakaṃ ceti dvāṣaṣṭiratra 
bhuvanānyuktānīti vitatāyāmiha bhuvanadīkṣāyāṃ sarvāṇi śodhyāni | 
saṃkṣiptāyāṃ tu yaḥ śodhanaprakāraḥ, sa pañcame paṭale nirṇītaḥ || 


athordhvaṃ guṇatattvaṃ tu............


guṇasāmyātmanaḥ prakṛtitattvāt sattvaguṇaguṇotkarṣātma 
atyantavilakṣaṇamata eva buddhiriti vilakṣaṇavyapadeśyaṃ 
bījādivāṅkurarūpaṃ kathaṃ kāryaṃ jāyate yāvaducchūnatāprāyaṃ 
kiñcidvaiṣamyātma madhye guṇatattvaṃ 
prakṛtitattvādanatibhinnavyapadeśaṃ na jāyate, ityāśayeneha guṇatattvaṃ 
tattvāntaratayā daśītam | śrīmālinīvijayādau tu 
kiñcidvaiṣamyāvasthāyāmita ucchiratāyāmiva bījābhidhānavad 
guṇavyapadeśasyānivṛtterguṇatattvaṃ prakṛtitattvābhedenaivoktaṃ 
saṃkṣiptabhuvanadīkṣāpratipādanāśayena | iha tu vitatatayā 
bhauvanavidhipratipādanasya prastutatvāt prakṛtitattvādbhedena guṇatattvaṃ 
daśītamiti nāgamavisaṃvādaḥ śaṅkanīyaḥ || 

yaccaitadguṇatattvam ---- 


.........ṭasmiṃścaiva vyavasthitam || 10-1046 || 

gurupaṃktitrayaṃ divyaṃ.............


divyamiti prabhāvātiśayayogāt || 

tacca ---- 


............guṇairantaritaṃ sthitam | 


sattvādibhūmikāmupaviṣṭamityarthaḥ || 

tatra ---- 


prathamā tamasaḥ paṃktirupariṣṭād vyavasthitā || 10-1047 || 


tamoguṇordhvamadhirūḍhetyarthaḥ || 1047 || 

tadatra ---- 


teṣāṃ nāmāni kathyante yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ | 


teṣāmiti paṅktiniṣṭhānāṃ gurūṇām || 


śivaḥ prabhurvāmadevaścaṇḍaścaiva pratāpavān || 10-1048 || 

prahlādaścottamo bhīmaḥ karālaḥ piṅgalastathā | 

mahendro dinakṛccaiva pratodo dakṣa eva ca || 10-1049 || 

kalevaraśca vikhyātastathā caiva kaṭaṅkaṭaḥ | 

ambuhartā ca nārīśaḥ śveta ṛgveda eva ca || 10-1050 || 

yajurvedaḥ sāmavedastvatharvā suśivastathā | 

virūpākṣastathā jyeṣṭho vipro nārāyaṇastathā || 10-1051 || 

gaṇḍo naro yamo mālī gahaneśaśca pīḍanaḥ | 

prathamā paṃktiruddiṣṭā rudrairdvātriṃśatā smṛtā || 10-1052 || 


atha ---- 


rajasaścopariṣṭāttu dvitīyā paṃktirucyate | 

śuklo dāsaḥ sudāsaśca lokākṣaḥ sūrya eva ca || 10-1053 || 

suhotra ekapādaśca gṛddhraścaiva śiveśvaraḥ | 

gautamaścaiva yogīśo dadhibāhustathāparaḥ || 10-1054 || 

ṛṣabhaścaiva gokarṇo devaścaiva maheśvaraḥ | 

guhyeśānaḥ śikhaṇḍī ca jaṭī mālī tathograkaḥ || 10-1055 || 

bhṛguḥ śikhī tathā śūlī sugatiśca supālanaḥ | 

aṭṭahāso dārukaśca lāṅgaliścātidaṇḍakaḥ || 10-1056 || 

bhavanaśca tathā bhavyo lakuleśastathaiva ca | 

triṃśadrudrāḥ samākhyātā dvitīyā paṃktiruttamā || 10-1057 || 


atha ---- 


sattvasya copariṣṭāttu tṛtīyā paṃktirucyate | 

devo'ruṇo dīrghabāhuratibhūtiśca sthāṇukaḥ || 10-1058 || 

sadyojātastathā jhiṇṭhī ṣaṇmukhaścaturānanaḥ | 

cakrapāṇiśca kūrmākhyastvardhanārīśvarastathā || 10-1059 || 

kapālī bhūrbhuvaścaiva vaṣaṭkārastathaiva ca | 

vauṣaṭkārastathā svāhā svadhā ca parikītītaḥ || 10-1060 || 

saṃvartakaśca bhasmeśaḥ kāmanāśana eva ca | 

ekaviṃśatirudrāstu paṃktireṣā tṛtīyakā || 10-1061 || 


evamete tryaśītirguravo maheśvareṇa guṇatattvabhogaprāptikāmānāṃ 
taducitajñānayogapradāḥ parameśvarā jñeyāstathā kañcitkālaṃ 
niyojitāstatra krīḍanti | tadāha ---- 


jñānayogabalopetāḥ krīḍante daiśikottamāḥ | 


uttamapadena guṇatattvāvasthitatve'pi naiṣāṃ taduparaktatvamityāha | ata 
eva krīḍanti, natvitaravad guṇairbaddhā || 

yataḥ ---- 


saṃsārapāśanirmuktāḥ............


āṇava-kārma-māyīyamalanirmuktā jīvanmuktā ityarthaḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


.............ṃahāmohavivajītāḥ || 10-1062 || 


mahāmoho'trākhyātirūpā māyā, tadviyuktāḥ, ata eva śuddhāḥ || 1062 
|| 

śuddhavidyodayādete ---- 


trinetrā guravaḥ sarve śuddhasphaṭikanirmalāḥ | 

sarvajñāḥ sarvagāścaiva lokānugrahākārakāḥ || 10-1063 || 

sarvajñatvaṃ sarvajñānayogasiddhatvameṣām | 

sattvaguṇatattvāspadabhramādyat sāṅkhyapātañjaladṛṣṭyaitat kaiścit 
yojitam, tadasadeva | kevalameṣāṃ tāvadbhogalipsujanāśayena 
tāvatpadaprāpakāṇāṃ parameśvarayogāttatrāvasthānam || 1063 || 

ataścaiṣām ---- 


gajākārāṇi divyāni sarveṣāṃ bhuvanāni tu | 


pūrvam ---- 

"vīrabhadraniketaśca bhadrakālyālayastathā | 

trayodaśabhiḥ............................... ||" (10-759)

iti granthena śvetādibhuvanānyekādaśa 
bhadrakālīvīrabhadrabhuvanābhyāṃ saha trayodaśa saṅkalitāni | yatpunaḥ 
---- 

"..............'nyaiśca bhuvanairupaśobhitam |" (10-759)

ityuktam, tatrānyāni bhuvanāni vīrabhadrabhuvanordhvagatāni ||  

athāṇḍavatīno'ṅguṣṭhamātrapramāṇarudrabhuvanāt prabhṛti 
guṇatattvāntamasaṅkalitān rudrān saṅkalayitumāha ---- 


buddheḥ prakṛtiparyante ye rudrāstānnibodha me || 10-1064 || 


buddheriti buddheḥ pūrvaṃ ye saṅkalayitumavaśiṣṭāstānnibodha | 
kimavadhi ? ---- ityāha ---- prakṛtiparyante prakṛtiḥ paryante yatra sa 
prakṛtiparyanto guṇatattvam, tatra tadavadhītyarthaḥ || 1064 || 

tān rudrān bhuvanasaṅkalanayā saṅkalayati ---- 


śatadvayaṃ saptakaṃ ca bhuvanānāṃ varānane | 


tatra jalāvaraṇeśasyāṅguṣṭhamātrasya pṛthvyā abdheḥ śriyaḥ 
sarasvatyā guhyāṣṭakasyeti trayodaśa bhuvanāni, tataḥ 
śivāgneratiguhyāṣṭakasya vāyvīśasya guhyātiguhyāṣṭakasya 
ākāśeśasya pavitrādyaṣṭakasya, tataḥ śarvādimūrtīśādhiṣṭhitāni 
tanmātrasūryasomavedamaṇḍalānyaṣṭau, tato'pi 
karaṇaprakāśaraśmisūryasomamaṇḍalāni pañca tato'haṅkāreśasya, 
tataḥ sthāṇvaṣṭakasyāṣṭāvitīyadantaṃ dvāṣaṣṭirbhuvanāni, 
buddhāvapi pūrvoktanītyā dvāṣaṣṭiḥ, guṇatattve 
tryaśītirityetacchatadvayaṃ saptādhikaṃ bhavati || 

kiṃ cātraiva ---- 


antarbhūtāḥ sthitāścānye ye te noktā varānane || 10-1065 || 


viparyayāśaktituṣṭisiddhyādibhuvaneśvarā ye bṛhattantreṣu rudrā 
uktāḥ, te'traivāntarbhūtatvāt pṛthagiha noktāḥ || 1065 || 

atha ---- 


guṇānāmupariṣṭāttu pradhānaṃ parikītītam | 

pradhīyate'tra guṇāntaṃ viśvamiti pradhānam || 


tatra ye saṃsthitā rudrāḥ...........


tān ---- 


...............kathayāmi samāsataḥ || 10-1066 || 

krodheśvaraśca saṃvarto jyotiḥ piṅgalakrūradṛk | 

pañcāntakaikavīrau ca śikhedasahiteśvarāḥ || 10-1067 || 


śikhedasahitā aṣṭau ete pradhānatattvagatā īśvarā ityarthaḥ || 1067 || 

ta ete ---- 


tattve tu prākṛte rudrā mahāvīryāḥ prakītītāḥ | 


duratikramā ityarthaḥ || 

asya pradhānatattvasya kiṃ svarūpamityāha ---- 


guṇānāṃ yā parā kāṣṭhā tatpradhānamihocyate || 10-1068 || 


parākāṣṭhā'vibhāgāvasthā || 1068 || 

atha ---- 


ataḥ puruṣatattve tu bhuvanāni nibodha me | 


ata iti prakṛterūrdhvam, pārameśasvarūpagopanāvaśādyat 
saṃkucitacidābhāsarūpaṃ puruṣatattvam, tatra saṅkocāṃśāśrayāṇi 
bhuvanāni tu cinmātrāśrayāṇi tasya nivīkāratvāt || 

tatra tāvat ---- 


ambā ca salilā oghā vṛṣṭiḥ sārdhaṃ ca tārayā || 10-1069 || 

sutārā ca sunetrā ca kumārī ca tataḥ param | 

uttamāmbhasikā caiva tuṣṭayo nava kītītāḥ || 10-1070 || 


tathā ---- 


tārā caiva sutārā ca tārayantī pramodikā | 

pramoditā modamānā ramyakā ca tataḥ param || 10-1071 || 

sadāpramudikā caiva siddhyaṣṭakamudāhṛtam | 


sāṃkhyaśāstre tuṣṭinavakaṃ siddhyaṣṭakaṃ ca yat pratyayasevyaṃ 
buddhidharmatayā gaṇitam, tadiha saṃkucitacitsvabhāvasya 
kalādikañcukāvivekinaḥ puruṣasya bhokturāvārakam, na tu puṃsi 
dṛśimātrasvabhāve'bhoktari buddhyādivaśotthitasya bhogasya kathacidapi 
sambhavaḥ | nahi himānyantardevadatte pratibimbite sati 
śītānubhavalakṣaṇo bhogo gauṇyāpi vṛttyā sambhavati | ataḥ sarvo'yaṃ 
bhoga uktarūpapuṃsi pāramāthīke bhoktari sati ghaṭata iti tatraiva 
tuṣṭyādipratyayasadbhāvo yukta ityevamuktam | tatra ---- 

"ādhyātmikyaścatasraḥ prakṛtyupādānakālabhāgyākhyāḥ | 

pañca viṣayoparamato'rjanarakṣāsaṅgasaṃkṣayavighātaiḥ ||" (sā0kā0
50)

iti, tathā ---- 

"ūhaḥ śabdo'dhyayanaṃ duḥkhavighātatrayaṃ suhṛtprāptiḥ | 

dānaṃ ca siddhayo'ṣṭau................................. ||"

iti yāḥ sāṃkhyaiḥ,

"atattve tattvabuddhyā yaḥ santoṣastuṣṭiratra sā | 

heye'pyādeyadhīḥ siddhiḥ........................ ||"

iti gurubhirlakṣitāstuṣṭayaḥ siddhayaścoktāḥ, 
tāsāmambādikāstārādyāścādhidevatā etannāmasu bhuvaneṣu sthitā iha 
nirūpitāḥ || 

kiṃ ca, pārameśamatayogakramasādhyaṃ yadaṇimādyaṣṭakarūpamaiśvaryam, 
tadapyetannāmakadevatāṣṭakādhiṣṭhitamatraiva puṃstattve 
proktanītyā''vārakatayā sthitamityāha ---- 


aṇimā laghimā caiva mahimā prāptireva ca || 10-1072 || 

prākāmyaṃ ca tatheśitvaṃ vaśitvaṃ yadudāhṛtam | 

yatrakāmāvasāyitvamaṇimādyaṣṭakaṃ smṛtam || 10-1073 || 


aṇimā śarīrasya sūkṣmatākaraṇe sāmarthyam, laghimā 
tūlavallāghavotpādanaśaktatvam, mahimā mahattvotpādanaśaktatā, prāptiḥ 
saṅkalpamātrāttattaddeśāvāptiḥ, prākāmyamekasyaiva 
yugapannānāśarīrakaraṇe śaktatā, īśitvamaiśvaryam, vaśitvaṃ 
bhūtavaśīkāraḥ, yatrakāmāvasāyitvaṃ saṅkalpamātrād 
deśakālasvabhāvavyavahitavastuniścayaḥ | 
bhogyasāmānyaguṇatrayabhoktṛtvāt puṃso'pi tadguṇatrayacchāyāyogād 
guṇavattvam || 1073 || 


athordhvaṃ guruśiṣyāṇāṃ paṃktitrayamataḥ śruṇu | 


ata iti proktāṇimādyaṣṭakādūrdhvam || 

tatra ---- 


maskarī pūraṇaḥ kṛtsnaḥ kapilaḥ kāśa eva ca || 10-1074 || 

sanatkumāragautamavasiṣṭhādyāṃśakāstathā | 

kaśyapo nāsiketuśca gālavo bhautikastathā || 10-1075 || 

śākalyaśca samākhyāto durvāsāḥ paramastvṛṣiḥ | 

bālmīkiśca guruśreṣṭhaḥ saparāśaragālavaḥ || 10-1076 || 

pippalādaśca saumitrirvāyuputro bhadantakaḥ | 


gālavāvatra dvāvuktau || 


maskaryādibhadantāntā dṛṣṭādṛṣṭasya vādinaḥ || 10-1077 || 

dvāviṃśatirguruvarāḥ prathamā paṃktiriṣyate | 


ete ca pūrvavadanugrāhyāṇāmeva 
tatpadaprāptihetutveneśvarecchayaitatpadāvasthitijuṣaḥ kṛtāḥ | yaduktaṃ 
śrīmālinīvijaye ---- 

"mayāpyetatpurā proktaṃ kapilāya mahātmane" (16-24) 

iti | 

dṛṣṭametatpadaprāptyucitopāsādikam adṛṣṭaṃ caitatpadāvāptyātmakaṃ 
vadanti | ete ca dvāviṃśatirgurava eva || 

etadūrdhvaṃ tu rajaḥsaṃsparśapradhānāyāṃ paṃktau śiṣyarūparṣīn 
pratipādayitumāha ---- 


jahnuśca tṛṇabinduśca munistārkṣyastathaiva ca || 10-1078 || 

dhyānāśrayo'tha dīrghaśca hotā jāgara eva ca | 

agastyo vasubhaumaśca upādhyāyaśca kītītaḥ || 10-1079 || 

śukro bhṛgvaṃgirā rāmo jamadagnisuto'dhvagaḥ | 

sthūlaśirā bālakhilyo manuśceti prakītītaḥ || 10-1080 || 

vajrātreyo viśuddhaśca śivaścārurathānugaḥ | 


vasunā sahito bhauma ityetau dvāveva, bhṛguṇā sahito'ṅgirā ityetāvapi 
dvau, rāmo jamadagnisuta eka eva, upādhyāya ityetannāmeti | ete upādhyāyā 
iti tvasad, vakṣyamāṇasaṃkhyāvighātāpatteḥ || 

tadittham ---- 


jahnvādicāruparyantā dvitīyā paṃktiriṣyate || 1081 || 


atha sattvasaṃsparśavatyāmapi bhūmāvāha ---- 


haro jhiṇṭhī pratodaśca amareśaścaturthakaḥ | 

kṛṣṇapiṅgeśarudraśca indrajid vṛṣakaḥ śivaḥ || 10-1082 || 

yamaḥ krūraśca vikhyāto gaṅgādhara umāpatiḥ | 

bhūteśvaraḥ kapālīśaḥ śaṅkaraśca tathaiva ca || 10-1083 || 

ardhanārīśvaraścaiva piṅgalaśca tathāparaḥ | 

mahākālaśca saṃvarto maṇḍalī tvekavīrakaḥ || 10-1084 || 

tathā cānyaśca vikhyāto bhārabhūteśvaro dhruvaḥ | 


kṛṣṇapiṅgeśarudra eka eva | vṛṣakaḥ śivaḥ śreyorūpa ityapyeka eva | 
yama ityasya viśeṣaṇaṃ krūro vikhyāta iti krūratayā prasiddha ityarthaḥ 
| umāpatevīśeṣaṇaṃ gaṅgādhara iti | kapālīśasya viśeṣaṇaṃ 
bhūteśvara iti | anyo vikhyāta iti vikhyātanāmā'nya ityarthaḥ ||  

tadittham ---- 


jahnvādicāruparyantā ṛṣayaḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ || 10-1085 || 


tṛtīyapaṃktiniṣṭhā ityarthaḥ | iha guruvācoyuktimakurva(nta)1 ṛṣayaḥ 
śiṣyā eva puṃstattvopāsādiprakarṣādimāṃ bhūmimāptā ityādiśati || 
1085 || 

prathamapaṃktigatā iva tṛtīyapaṃktigatā api gurava eva | yadāha ---- 


harādayo dhruvāntāśca guravo viṃśatiḥ smṛtāḥ | 


ete ca sarve'tra sthitā apyaṃśena hmāṇḍāntaravatīrya tatra 
svocitamadhikāramativāhya tadeva padamāviśantīti mantavyam || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


paṃktitrayaṃ samākhyātamṛṣīṇāṃ guruśiṣyayoḥ || 10-1086 || 


proktanītyā guruśiṣyarūpamṛṣipaṃktitrayametadityarthaḥ || 1086 || 

atha ---- 


nāḍīvidyāṣṭakaṃ devi kathayāmi tvataḥ param | 


puryaṣṭakasambaddhā yā vakṣyamāṇanāḍyastāsāmaṣṭakaṃ 
bandhanavivardhanaṃ kathayāmi || 

tāśca ---- 


iḍā ca candriṇī gaurī śāntiḥ śāntikarī tathā || 10-1087 || 

mālā ca mālinī caiva svāhā caiva svadhā tathā | 


asya nāḍyaṣṭakasya ---- 


athopariṣṭād deveśi vigrahāṣṭakamucyate || 10-1088 || 


vigrahasya sūkṣmaśarīrasyotthāpakamaṣṭakaṃ 
vakṣyamāṇābhimānadevatārūpapuṃstattvāvaraṇaprayojanam || 1088 || 

tacca ---- 


kāryaṃ ca karaṇaṃ caiva sukhaduḥkhakaraṃ tathā | 

jñānaṃ sādhyaṃ ca vikhyātaṃ sādhanaṃ kāraṇaṃ tathā || 10-1089 || 


kāryaṃ kāryātmasūkṣmadehārambhitanmātrotthāpakam | karaṇamiti 
sūkṣmadehāvasthitānabhivyaktaprāyabāhyendriyadaśakotthāpakam, 
tannāmaiva devatādaśakam | sukhaduḥkhakaramiti 
sukhaduḥkhopabhogasampādakaṃ devatādvayam | jñānaṃ sādhyaṃ 
cetyanabhivyaktena buddhīndriyapañcakena karmendriyapañcakena ca sampādyaṃ 
jñānamātraṃ vyāpāramātre ca vikhyātaṃ pratītaṃ 
yattadadhitṛdevatārūpamihaivoktam, sādhanamityantaḥkaraṇe vyāpakaṃ 
devatātrayamityarthaḥ | kāraṇamiti kāraṇarūpasya 
pradhānatattvasyotthāpakaṃ devatārūpamityarthaḥ | yadyapi ca 
prāgraśmikaraṇajatejomaṇḍalādyuktiprasaṅge kārya karaṇādīnāmutpattau 
kāraṇamuktam, tathāpi tadeveha devatārūpaṃ puṃstattve'pi 
sūkṣmarūpatayā sthitaṃ tatraiva bandhanātmanastatprayojanasya 
paryavasānāt | māyāyāṃ tvetatsarvameva pāśajālaṃ 
pararūpeṇāvasthitamiti vakṣyati || 1089 || 

atha ---- 


dehapāśānato vakṣye...........


sthūladehārambhakānadhiṣṭhātṛdevatāviśeṣarūpānityarthaḥ || 

tatra ---- 


...............ḍharmaṃ ca daśadhoditam | 


ca evārthe | dharmameva mukhyaṃ bandhanamādau daśavidhaṃ vacmi || 

sa ca ---- 


ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryamakalkatā || 10-1090 || 

akrodho guruśuśrūṣā śaucaṃ santoṣa ārjavam | 

evaṃ daśavidho dharmo yenokto dharmakṛnnaraḥ || 10-1091 || 


akalkatā ---- 

śvacchatā samatā prītirnāpakāraśatairapi | 

kāluṣyamutsahet soḍhaṃ seyamuktetyakalkatā ||" (vi0 17 | 39)

iti śrīmataṅgapārameśvare itthaṃ lakṣitā || 1091 || 

evaṃ dharmākhyaṃ pradhānaṃ dehapāśamuktvā gauṇamāha ---- 


vikārān ṣoḍaśākhyāsye parabhāvena saṃsthitān | 


prāguktasthūlarūpāpekṣayā parabhāvena sūkṣmeṇa rūpeṇa 
sthitānityarthaḥ, pararūpatayā tu māyāyāṃ bhaviṣyanti || 

tānāha ---- 


raso gandhaśca rūpaṃ ca sparśaṃḥ śabdastathaiva ca || 10-1092 || 

tanmātrapañcakaṃ khyātamindriyāṇi nibodha me | 

vākpāṇipādaṃ pāyuśca upasthaḥ karmasaṃjñakam || 10-1093 || 


indriyapañcakamityarthaḥ || 1093 || 


śrotraṃ tvakcakṣuṣī jihvā nāsikā pañcamī smṛtā | 


etāni ---- 


buddhīndriyāṇi deveśi...........


tathā ---- 


.............ṃanaḥ ṣoḍaśakaṃ smṛtam || 10-1094 || 


ta ete ---- 


dehapāśāḥ samākhyātāḥ.............


kiṃ ca ---- 


.............'to buddhiguṇān viduḥ | 


puṃsi sūkṣmarūpatayā pāśakatvenāvasthitān vidurityavicchinnena 
pāramparyeṇa tattvavido janāḥ || 

te ca ---- 

dharmo jñānaṃ ca vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ ca tataḥ param || 10-1095 || 

adharmaśca tathājñānamavairāgyamanīśitā | 


prāguktādahiṃsāderdharmādayamanyo dharma iṣṭāpūrtalakṣaṇaḥ1 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


ahaṅkāraṃ ca trividhaṃ pravakṣyāmyanupūrvaśaḥ || 10-1096 || 

vaikārikaṃ taijasaṃ ca bhūtādi ca yathākramam | 


rājasaṃ sāttvikaṃ tāmasaṃ cetyarthaḥ || 

evametāni tanmātrabahiṣkaraṇāntaḥkaraṇāni sūkṣmarūpatayā 
puṃstattvāvasthitāni bandhakānīha yānyuktāni, etānyevātra bhūcarī-
dikcarī-gocarī-cakrāṇyāntarāṇi pratipāditāni | tadanusāreṇaiva ceha 
pararūpāṇītyupakrama evoktiḥ kṛtā, khecarīcakraṃ tvāntaraṃ 
kañcukadevatārūpaṃ bhaviṣyati || 

prātilomyakrameṇa dīkṣāvidhimupakrāntameva smārayati ---- 


dīkṣākāle yathā śuddhistathā caiṣāṃ nibodha me || 10-1097 || 


eṣāṃ puṃstattvagatānāṃ taijasādyahaṅkārapāśānāmityarthaḥ | yathā 
yena krameṇetyarthaḥ || 1097 || 

tameva kramamāha ---- 


tamo rajastathā sattvaṃ śodhayedanupūrvaśaḥ | 


etaccopalakṣaṇaparam, sarvān pāśān prātilomyena śodhayedityarthaḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


śabdasparśastathā rūpaṃ raso gandhaśca pañcamaḥ || 10-1098 || 

viṣayāśca samākhyātāḥ śodhanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ | 


viśeṣeṇa sinvantīti viṣayā bhoktari puṃsi sūkṣmarūpatayā 
bhogyātmānaḥ sthitāḥ, na tu pūrvoktatanmātrātmāna ityarthaḥ | 
prayatnataḥ śodhanīyā ityukterayamāśayaḥ ---- na 
saṃkṣiptabhuvanādidīkṣāvat ---- 

śūkṣmānantavībhāvayet" (4-158)

ityuktanītyā'ntarbhāva eṣāṃ cintanīyaḥ, api tu pṛthak pṛthagete sarva 
evātra vitatāyāṃ bhuvanadīkṣāyāṃ śodhyāḥ | evamanyatra || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca mohaḥ paiśunyameva ca || 10-1099 || 

janmamṛtyujarāvyādhikṣuttṛṭtṛṣṇāstathaiva ca | 

viṣādaśca bhayaṃ caiva mado harṣaṇameva ca || 10-1100 || 

rāgo dveṣaśca vaicittyaṃ kupitānṛtadrohitā | 

māyā mātsaryadharmaśca adharmaścāsvatantratā || 10-1101 || 


tṛṣṇā spṛhā, kupitānṛtadrohiṇāṃ bhāvaḥ kupitānṛtadrohitā, 
krodhaḥ pūrvāparavimarśaśūnyaḥ saprakarṣaḥ kopaḥ, mado darpaḥ, 
mātsaryadharmaḥ paraguṇāsahiṣṇutātmā svabhāvaḥ | ete ca1 
śrīmataṅgapārameśvare vitatya vyākhyātāḥ || 1101 || 

ta ime saptaviṃśatisaṃkhyāḥ pāśāḥ ---- 


āgantukāśca boddhavyāḥ............


prāguktebhyaḥ sahajebhyo'nye āgacchanti tacchīlā 
dehaprāptyuttarakālamata eva prastutatvāt 
puṃsāmabhivyaktimāyāntītyāgantukāḥ ata eva sahajāśca vairāgyādayaḥ 
| anyaḥ sthūlaḥ āgantuko rāgaḥ śodhanīyaḥ prayatnata ityanuṣaṅgaḥ | 
evamuttaratra || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


...............gaṇapāśānnibodha me | 


te ca ---- 


devī nandimahākālau gaṇeśo vṛṣabhastathā || 10-1102 || 

bhṛṅgī caṇḍīśvaraścaiva kātīkeyo'ṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ | 


ete parādvayātmakapārameśvarasvarūpamātmānamāvṛṇvānāḥ pāśā 
ucyante |  yaduktamasmatprabhuṇā tantrāloke ---- 

"yatkiñcitparamādvaitasaṃvitsvātantryasundarāt	 | 

parācchivāduktarūpādanyattat pāśa ucyate || 

tadevaṃ puṃstvamāpanne pūrṇe'pi parameśvare | 

tatsvarūpāparijñānacitrā hi puruṣāḥ sthitāḥ ||" (8-292-293)

iti || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


anantastritanuḥ sūkṣmaḥ śrīkaṇṭhaśca śivottamaḥ || 10-1103 || 

śikhaṇḍī caikanetraśca ekarudrastathāparaḥ | 

vidyeśvarātmakān pāśān dīkṣākāle viśodhayet || 10-1104 || 


"śuddhe'dhvani śivaḥ kartā prokto'nanto'site prabhuḥ"1 
ityāmnāyāntaroktanītyā'śuddhādhvakāraṇaṃ tritattvādiparivṛto 
yo'nantabhaṭṭārakastasya puṃstattvāvārakatve 
satyaśuddhādhvasraṣṭṭatvaṃ phalatīti tatra sūkṣmarūpeṇāvasthitaḥ 
iti bhaviṣyati | tadevaṃ tuṣṭinavakam, siddhyaṣṭakam, aṇimādyaṣṭakam, 
paṅktitrayaniviṣṭā dvāviṃśatiḥ pañcaviṃśativīṃśatiśceti 
saptaṣaṣṭirguruśiṣyāḥ, nāḍyaṣṭakam, vigrahāṣṭakamahiṃsādayo 
daśa, ṣoḍaśa vikārāḥ, aṣṭau buddhidharmāstrividho'haṅkāraḥ, 
śabdādiviṣayapañcakamityahiṃsādiviṣayapañcakāntā 
dvācatvāriṃśatsahajā dehapāśāḥ kāmādayaḥ, asvatantratantrāḥ 
saptatriṃśatirāgantukāḥ pāśāḥ, aṣṭau ca gaṇeśāḥ, aṣṭau 
vidyeśāḥ pāśā iti trinavatyadhikaṃ śataṃ1 pāśabhuvanānāṃ 
puṃstattve śodhanīyamuktam || 1104 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


uktānuktāśca ye cātra anyatantroktalakṣaṇāḥ | 

pauruṣeye tu śodhyāste tato mucyeta pudgalaḥ || 10-1105 || 


ye trinavatyadhikaśatasaṅkhyā iha pāśā uktāḥ, ye cānye 
ratihāsaśokotsāhādayo nirvedaglānyādayaśca ihānuktā anyatantre2 
bharatādiṣūktasvarūpāste sarve pauruṣe tattve śodhanīyāḥ | evaṃ sati 
tataḥ pāśebhyaḥ pudgalo mucyate, puthā 
antaḥśaṅkātaṅkasaṃskārotthāpanātmanā hiṃsayā gilanaṃ 
bhogyalakṣaṇaṃ yasya sa pudgalo māyāpramātā || 1105 || 

gatametat ---- 


arthordhve niyatirjñeyā tasyāṃ rudrānnibodha me | 


tānāha ---- 


vāmadevastathā śarvastathā caiva bhavodbhavau || 10-1106 || 

vajradehaḥ prabhuścaiva dhātā ca kramavikramau | 

suprabhedaśca daśamo niyatyāṃ śaṅkarāḥ smṛtāḥ || 10-1107 || 


daśadikkamavasthitā ityarthaḥ || 1107 || 

etanniyatitattvaniyamitaḥ puruṣo buddhipramātṛbhūmikāṃ 
gṛhītvā'haṅkāramayaḥ śarīre hṛtpadme'vasthita iti pratipādayitumāha 
---- 


yattaddhṛdi sthitaṃ padmamātmā tatra vyavasthitaḥ | 


śākṣaṃ kṛtsnamimaṃ dehaṃ yadyapi vyāpya tiṣṭhati | 

tathāpyasya paraṃ sthānaṃ hṛtpaṅkajasamudgakam ||"

iti sthityā hṛtpadmamātmano viśrāntipadam, ata evātrastho'yaṃ 
padmāsanasvabhāvatayoktakrameṇa tattadviṣayāvabhāsanādisṛṣṭiṃ karoti 
|| 

tacca padmam ---- 


niyatidalamahaṅkārakesaraṃ buddhikaṇīkam || 10-1108 || 


niyativaśodbhūtāni manobuddhikarmākṣaviṣayarūpāṇi dalāni 
sañcārapadāni yasyeti vyākhyeyam, na tu niyatireva dalāni yasyeti, 
niyaterahaṅkārakesarādhovyāptyabhāvāt | ahaṅkāra eva rañjakatvāt 
kesararūpo yatra, buddhistvadhyavasāya-
paryantaviṣayabhogasādhakatvāduparivatīkaṇīkārūpā | atra cāsyātmanaḥ 
---- 

"pradhānāśayamāpannaṃ guṇatrayavisapītam" (2-41)

iti pūrvoktasvarūpaṃ smartavyamanyathā buddhipramātṛtvāyogāt || 1108 || 

etacca niyatiniyamitatvaṃ kālakalitasyaiva ghaṭate, na tu 
kālottarasvabhāvasya | ato yadetatkalanākāraṇam, tatra ---- 


kālatattve śivā jñeyā..............


śodhyatveneti śeṣaḥ || 

tāṃśca ---- 


..............kathayāmi samāsataḥ | 

śuddho buddhaḥ prabuddhaśca praśāntaḥ paramākṣaraḥ || 10-1109 || 

śivaśca suśivaścaiva dhruvaścākṣaraśambhurāṭ | 

daśaite tu śivā jñeyāḥ kālatattve varānane || 10-1110 || 


akṣararāṭ śambhurāḍiti dvau || 1110 || 

tatra ---- 


hemābhāḥ śaṅkarāḥ proktāḥ śivāḥ sphaṭikasannibhāḥ | 


śaṅkarā niyatisthāḥ, śivāstu kālasthāḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


ekaikasya vinidīṣṭā parivāro yaśasvini || 10-1111 || 

koṭirekā tathānyāni sahasrāṇi tu ṣoḍaśa | 


teṣāṃ ca ---- 


kūrmākārāṇi sarveṣāṃ proktāni bhuvanāni tu || 10-1112 || 


atha ---- 

ata ūrdhvaṃ hariharau rāgatattve nibodha me | 


kālyakalanaṃ vedyasambandhaṃ vinā na yujyate bodharūpasya puṃsa iti 
kiñcinme syāditi vedyasāmānyābhilāṣātmanā, ata eva 
stryādiviṣayabuddhidharmasthūlarāgavilakṣaṇena 
rāgatattvenāvaśyamayamuparaktaḥ | ataḥ puṃrañjake rāgatattve hariharau 
mukhyau bhuvaneśau |  anyānapyāha ---- 


suhṛṣṭaḥ suprahṛṣṭaśca surūpā rūpavardhanaḥ || 10-1113 || 

manonmano mahādhīraḥ............


ete pūrvābhyāṃ sahāṣṭau ---- 


............vīreśāḥ parikītītāḥ | 


yathā niyatikālagatā rudrāḥ śaṅkarāḥ śivāścoktāḥ, tathā ete 
vīreśā ucyante duṣpariharatvāccaivamuktāḥ || 

kiṃ cānyānapi ---- 


rāgatattve pravakṣyāmi ye'nye rudrā vyavasthitāḥ || 10-1114 || 


tāniti śeṣaḥ || 1114 || 


kalyāṇaḥ piṅgalo babhrurvīraśca prabhavastathā | 

medhātithiśchandakaśca dāhakaḥ śāstrakāriṇaḥ || 10-1115 || 


śāstrakāriṇa iti śāstrakārināmna ekasyaiva gurutvādbahuvacanaṃ 
kṛtamatra pañca gurava iti pradarśanāya || 1115 || 

yadāha ---- 


pañca śiṣyāstathācāryā daśaite saṃvyavasthitāḥ | 


ādyāḥ śiṣyāḥ, antyā ācāryāḥ || 

sāmānyavedyābhivyaṅgātmakaṃ rāgatattvaṃ vedyaprakāśenopapadyate | 
tatprakāśanāya kiñcijjñatvapradaṃ vidyātattvamasya sambaddhamityāha ---- 


vidyātattvamataścordhvaṃ tasmin vai bhuvanaṃ śṛṇu || 10-1116 || 


bhuvanamiti bhuvanānītyarthaḥ || 1116 || 

tāni tadīśadvāreṇa pratipādayati ---- 


vāmo jyeṣṭhaśca raudraśca kalo vikaraṇastathā | 

balavikaraṇaścaiva balapramathanastathā || 10-1117 || 

sarvabhūtadamanaśca tathā caiva manonmanaḥ | 


kalo vikaraṇa iti kalavikaraṇa | kvacidete vāmādayaḥ strīliṅgapāṭhena 
dṛśyante || 

kiñcijjñatvarūpavidyāsambandho'pi nākarturūpapadyata iti  
māyānigūhitapūrṇajñānakriyāphārasyāsya kiñcitkartṛtvonmīlanāt 
kalātattvamasti | tatastatra ---- 


kalātattve mahādevi mahādevatrayaṃ sthitam || 10-1118 || 

mahādevo mahātejā mahājyotiḥ pratāpavān | 


mahacchabdopalakṣitaṃ devatrayaṃ mahādevatrayam | pratāpavānityatidīptaḥ 
|| 

tadittham ---- 


kalātattvaṃ samākhyātaṃ samāsena varānane || 10-1119 || 


samāsenetyukterayamāśayo yadanye'pyatra 
vāmadevabhavodbhavaikapiṅgekṣaṇabhuvaneśāṃguṣṭhamātrākhyāḥ santi | 
ete hyaṣṭau maṅgaleśvarāḥ pūrvaṃ buddhitattve'pararūpeṇoktāḥ, iha 
tu pararūpeṇa | tatra ca traya eva prādhānyāduktāstadevaṃ 
niyatikālarāgavidyākalākhyaṃ yadetattattvapañcakamuktam, 
tatproktabhauvanasanniveśāśrayatayā bahiḥ sādhāraṇameva | tatastu 
pratipuruṣametannāmakameva tattvapañcakaṃ kañcukaśabdavācyaṃ 
bhinnabhinnamevādbhutamantaḥkaraṇādivat | etacca taṇḍulasya kambukamiva 
puṃsaḥ paramāvaraṇam, prakṛtyāditanmātrāntaṃ tu 
sūkṣmaśarīrārambhakaṃ tuṣavat sūkṣmam, bhūtapañcakaṃ tu 
sthūlaśarīrārambhakaṃ kiṃśārukavat sthūlameveti sarvametatprātilomyena 
proktabhuvanavibhāgena śodhanīyam || 1119 || 

proktanāmānaḥ sarva eva ---- 


ete rudrā mahādevi trinetrāścandraśekharāḥ | 


asāmānyena maheśvarābhijñānenālaṃkṛtāḥ || 


yeṣāṃ ca prāk parivāro na saṅkhyātaḥ, te'pi ----
