rudrakoṭisahasraistu samantāt parivāritāḥ || 10-1120 || 

śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśāḥ...........


sarva eva tu ---- 


...............yogaiśvaryabalānvitāḥ | 


viśeṣameṣāmāha ---- 


rāge raktāstu vijñeyā jñānayogabalotkaṭāḥ || 10-1121 || 

chatrākārāstu teṣāṃ vai gṛhā ratnavicitritāḥ | 


anyeṣāṃ tu kūrmākārā uktāḥ || 

gatametat | athaiṣām ---- 


upariṣṭādbhavenmāyā.............


tāṃ ca te ---- 


..............kathayāmi samāsataḥ || 10-1122 || 


vyāpya yā vai tvadho'dhvānaṃ vaiśvarūpyeṇa saṃsthitā | 
vyāpyātimātramāpya, ākalādikṣityantaṃ sarvamiti vyutpattyā, na ca 
bhedenātra vyāpyavyāpakabhāvaḥ, apitvabhedenetyāśayena vyāpya viśvaṃ 
sthitetyuktam | samāsata iti saṅkṣiptabhuvaneśapratipādanāśayena || 

tadāha ---- 


tatra rudrā mahābhāgā dvādaśaiva mahābalāḥ || 10-1123 || 


pradhānabhūtāḥ sthitāḥ | mahābalā iti parameśajñānaṃ vinā 
duṣpariharāḥ || 1123 || 

tānetān puṭavibhāgena darśayati ---- 


gahanaśca asādhyaśca tathā hariharaḥ prabhuḥ | 

daśeśānaśca deveśi trigalo gopatistathā || 10-1124 || 

adhaḥpuṭe tu vijñeyā māyātattve varānane | 


ete ṣaḍityarthaḥ || 


kṣemeśo brahmaṇaḥ svāmī vidyeśānastathaiva ca || 10-1125 || 

vidyeśaśca śivaścaiva anantaḥ ṣaṣṭha ucyate | 

ūrdhvamāyāpuṭasthāstu rudrā ete prakītītāḥ || 10-1126 || 

eṣāṃ madhye tu bhagavānananteśo jagatpatiḥ | 


śrīmeṅgaśāstre punarmadhyapuṭe'pi ---- 


"yatrāsau vigraheśānaḥ sthitaḥ paramadurjayaḥ" (1-8-83)

"yatra śarvo bhavaścaiva ugro bhīmaśca vīryavān | 

bhasmāntako dundubhiśca śrīvatsaśca mahābalaḥ ||" (1 | 8 | 85)

iti granthenāṣṭakamuktam | śrīpūrvaśāstre (5-28-29) tu 
mahādevādyaṅguṣṭhamātramaṇḍaleśvarāṣṭakameva māyāyāmuktamiti 
tantraprakriyābhedaḥ | eṣa cānantanāthaḥ ---- 


udbhavaṃ bhāvayitvā tu svecchayā kurute prabhuḥ || 10-1127 || 


yasya svakarmaparipākādyādṛgudbhavaḥ sthāvarādyātmaka ucitastaṃ tasya 
bhāvayitvā vicārya svecchayā parameśecchāceṣṭitasvecchāmātreṇa, na tu 
kumbhakāravat sahakāryādyapekṣya kurute, yato'sau prabhuriyatyadhvani 
prabhavanaśīlaḥ || 1127 || 

kiṃ cāyam ---- 


sarvajñaḥ sarvakartā ca nigrahānugrahe rataḥ | 


kalādikṣityantaṃ sarvaṃ jānāti karoti ca, tatraiva 
āyātaśaktipātānāmitareṣāṃ cānugrahaṃ nigrahaṃ ca karoti || 

tadittham ---- 


prathamena tu bhedena rudrā dvādaśa kītītāḥ || 10-1128 || 


iha ---- 

"ataḥ paraṃ bhavenmāyā sarvajantuvimohinī" (10-1138)

iti vakṣyamāṇadṛṣṭyā pārameśvarī śaktirmāyā | sā tattvarūpatayā 
granthirūpatayā ca dvidhā sphuritā | tatra tattvarūpayā ---- 

"māyā tu koṭidhā vyāpya sthitā sarvaṃ carācaram" (10-671)

iti tathā ---- 

"vyāpya yā vai tvadhodhvānaṃ vaiśvarūpyeṇa saṃsthitā" (10-1123)

iti yā uktā, tasyāmūrdhvādharapuṭātmakakāṇḍarūpatvamasti | tatra 
puṭadvaye māyāyāḥ prathamena tattvātmanā bhedena dvādaśa rudrāḥ 
prakītītā vibhāgenāvasthitā uktāḥ || 1128 || 

yastvasyā niḥsaṃkhyāvāntarabhedabhinnakalādikṣityantatattvasantatisroto-
bhedaprasūtihetuḥ śakteḥ kiñciducchūnatevāmnāto granthyātmā 
sthūlasvabhāvaḥ, asau 
susūkṣmatamasattvarajastamorūpatayordhvamadhyādharagranthibhedena 
tālugranthisamānarūpeṇa tridhā'vasthitaḥ | yathoktaṃ prāk ---- 

"adhaśchādanamūrdhvaṃ ca sitaraktaṃ vinidīśet | 

madhye tamo vijānīyād guṇāstvete vyavasthitāḥ ||" (2-66)

iti | tatra tribhede granthyātmani rūpe rudrāṇāṃ vibhāgena sthitimāha --
-- 


asmiṃstu ye yathā rudrā māyātattve vyavasthitāḥ | 

tathāhaṃ kathayiṣyāmi bhedatrayavibhāgaśaḥ || 10-1129 || 


asminniti proktakalāditattvasrotaḥsantānaprasūtihetau granthyātmani 
māyīye rūpe ye gopatyādyā anantādyā yathā yena krameṇa sthitāḥ, 
tathā bhedatrayavibhāgaśa iti sattvādigranthirūpeṇa bhedena 
varṇayiṣyāmi || 1129 || 

tatra ---- 


gopatiśca tato devi adhogranthau vyavasthitaḥ | 


tatra iti kalātattvapratipāditamahādevādirudrabhuvanordhvaṃ yo 
māyīyo'dhogranthistatra prāgukta eva gopatiḥ pararūpeṇa sthitaḥ || 

tathā ---- 


granthyūrdhve saṃsthito viśvastrikalaḥ kṣema eva ca || 10-1130 || 

brahmaṇo'dhipatiścaiva śivaśceti sa pañcamaḥ | 


granthyūrdhvaṃ iti ūrdhvagranthāvityarthaḥ | sa iti prāgukta eva | 
apararūpeṇehāyaṃ viśvābhidho rudraḥ sthitaḥ, na tvanya ityarthaḥ || 
kiṃ ca ---- 


adha ūrdhvamanantastu..............


adha ityadhograntherūrdhvaṃ yo granthistatrānantaḥ sthita ityarthaḥ | 
etacca granthitattvātmatayā dvitvaṃ māyāyāḥ śrīśivatanau ---- 

"māyābilamidamuktaṃ paratastu guhā jagadyoniḥ | 

utpattyā teṣvasyāḥ patiśaktikṣobhamanuvidhīyamāneṣu || 

yonivivareṣu nānākāmasamṛddheṣu bhagasaṃjñā |"

ityādigranthena gurubhirdaśītamiti | etaṃ vyākhyākramaṃ tyaktvā yattu 
śrībhullakena vyākhyātaṃ yathā parameśvaro lakuleśāya jñānaṃ bhedena 
prakāśitavāniti śrīlakulasvacchandapradaśītasthityā dviskandhaṃ 
pārameśvarajñānamiti dvidhā māyāyāṃ bhuvaneśavibhāga iha daśīta 
iti, tadyuktamayuktaṃ veti sacetaso jānanti || 

yaścāyamanantabhaṭṭārakāśrayo madhyamo granthiruktaḥ ---- 


............pāśāścaivātra saṃsthitāḥ || 10-1131 || 


te ca ---- 


pūrvaṃ vai kathitā devi.............


vaiśabda evārthe | pūrvameva puruṣatattvanirūpaṇāvasare ---- 

"ambā ca salilā oghā" (10-1069)

ityādinā tuṣṭisiddhyādyā vidyeśapāśāntā ye pāśā uktāḥ, ta iha 
pararūpeṇāvasthitā ityarthaḥ | māyā hi sarveṣāṃ 
pāśānāmutpattibhūḥ |  taistvanantaprayuktaivīśiṣṭadevatātmabhiḥ
sūkṣmarūpairvāmaśaktyādhiṣṭhitā aṇavo badhyante | buddhitattve tu 
tuṣṭisiddhyādayaḥ kecitpāśāḥ sthūlarūpāḥ sthitāḥ, tadeṣāṃ 
vibhavasthāna mityuktaprāyam || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


.........'to ṛṣikulaṃ bhavet | 


yatpūrvaṃ pāśamadhye guruśiṣyātmakapaṅktitrayeṇa ṛṣikulamuktam, 
tadiha pāśānāmupari sthitam || 

kiṃ cātra ---- 


yonirvāgīśvarī caiva yasyāṃ jāto na jāyate || 10-1132 || 


"vāgeva viśvā bhuvanāni jajñe"1 iti sthityā yonivīśvakāraṇaṃ 
vāgīśvarī, atra sūkṣmeṇa rūpeṇa sthitā, pareṇa śuddhavidyāyāṃ 
pratipādayiṣyamāṇatvādapareṇa sārasvatabhuvane proktatvāt | sarvaṃ hi 
sthūlasūkṣmapararūpatayā trivībhaktaṃ parameśvaraśaktyātmakaṃ tatra 
tatra tathā tathāvasthitamekādaśe vakṣyati | kīdṛśī vāgīśvarī? ---- 
ityāha ---- yatra yasyāṃ prāṅnirṇītasthityā 
sthūlasūkṣmapararūpāyāṃ jāto 
mantrasaṃskṛtisampāditagarbhādhānādisaṃskāreṇotpannastatra
tatra tattve prāgajītatattatkarmaphalopabhogāya nānāyonibhedena sṛṣṭo na 
jāyata iti pāśaśuddheryojanikāyāśca sampannatvāt paraśivaikyaprāptyā 
mucyata ityarthaḥ || 1132 || 

kiṃ cātra māyāyām ---- 


oṅkārasādhyadhātāro damaneśastataḥ param | 

dhyānaṃ bhasmeśamevāhuḥ..........


oṅkārābhidhān sādhyādīn pañca rudrānāhuḥ, anye tu ṛṣikulaṃ 
yadanantaramuktam, tadevoṅkārasādhyādināmaṣaṭkena vibhaktamiti 
vyākhyātavantaḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


..........pramāṇāni tadūrdhvataḥ || 10-1133 || 


heyopādeyāśeṣapramāsādhakatvāt pramāṇaśabdābhidheyā aṣṭau rudrāḥ 
praṇavākhyarudrapañcakāvaraṇasyopari sthitāḥ || 1133 || 

tāni pramāṇānyuddiśati ---- 


pañcārthaṃ guhyamevāhū rudrāṅkuśamataḥ param | 

hṛdayaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ caiva vyūhamākarṣameva ca || 10-1134 || 

ādarśaṃ ca tathaiveha aṣṭamaṃ parikītītam | 


ete rudrā etannāmakapāśupataśāstrāvatārakāḥ | tatra ca hṛdayākhyaṃ 
yatpramāṇamuktam, tasyāntarbhūtāni yāni 
purakalpakanakaśālāniruttaraviśvaprapañcākhyāni ṣaṭkriyāpradhānāni 
pramāṇāni proktajñānapradhānapramāṇāṣṭakavilakṣaṇāni 
hṛdayākhyāt pramāṇāllakuśaśiṣyeṇa musulendreṇoddhṛtya 
ārurukṣūṇāṃ prathamaṃ pradaśītāni, na tānīhapṛthaggaṇitāni | evam 
---- 

"lākulaṃ mausulaṃ caiva dvidhā tantraṃ prakītītam" (11-71)

pāśupataṃ yat, tadatra māyāntaraparatayā sthitam, paraṃ padaṃ 
tveṣāmīśvaratattvamiti vakṣyati | ata eva ---- 

śarvādhvanau vinirmuktaṃ śaivānāṃ tu paraṃ padam" (11-74)

iti vakṣyamāṇasthityaiva pāśupatebhyaḥ śaivānāṃ mahadantaramityuktam 
|| 

ye praṇavapramāṇābhidhā rudrā uktāḥ ---- 


ete parivṛtā devi rudrakoṭisahasrakaiḥ || 10-1135 || 

nānāvarṇavicittrāśca nānābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ | 

nānānārīsahasraistu ramante patyuricchayā || 10-1136 || 


patyuranantasya | ataśca sa eva lakuleśādīnāṃ guruḥ || 1136 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


trinetrāḥ śūlinaḥ sarve jaṭācandrakirīṭinaḥ | 

aluptaśaktivibhavā māyātattvādhikāriṇaḥ || 10-1137 || 

bhuvaneṣu vicitreṣu yonyākāreṣu saṃsthitāḥ | 


evaṃ caitadārādhakā etatpadaprāptibhāja eṣāmadhikārasamāptau saha 
mucyanta ityarthalabhyam || 

evaṃ māyāyāstattvarūpatāṃ granthirūpatāṃ ca nirṇīya 
śaktirūpatāmapyākhyātumāha ---- 


ataḥ paraṃ bhavenmāyā sarvajantuvimohinī || 10-1138 || 


sarvān jantūn jāyamānān sṛjyamānān mohayati 
svasvarūpākhyātisatattvāṇavamalabhājaḥ karoti | evaṃ 
cābhidadhanmalasyāvāstavatetyāha, taccāsmābhiḥ pūrvameva nirṇītam || 
1138 || 

kiṃ cānyat ---- 


nirvairaparipanthinyā tayā bhramitabuddhayaḥ | 

idaṃ tattvamidaṃ neti vivadantīha vādinaḥ || 10-1139 || 


vivadante parasparaviruddhaṃ jalpanti, ata eva vādino vādamātre 
paryavasitāḥ, na tu tattvajñāne | vimatāvātmanepadino vadeḥ 
parasmaipadaṃ vyatyayāt || 

ataśca etānasau ---- 


satpathaṃ tu parityajya nayati drutamutpatham | 


satpathaḥ pārameśvaraśāstrāṇi, itaradasatpathaḥ || 

etadeva vyanakti ---- 


gurudevāgniśāstrasya ye na bhaktā narādhamāḥ || 10-1140 || 

asadyuktivicārajñāḥ śuṣkatarkāvalambinaḥ | 

bhramayatyeva tān māyā hyamokṣe mokṣalipsayā || 10-1141 || 


asadyuktiḥ pārameśaparādvayāgamabāhyastarkaḥ | amokṣaḥ 
paramādvaitacidānandaghanaparameśvaraikyavyāpteranyat sarvameva || 1141 || 

kathamiyaṃ parihāryā syāt ? ---- ityāha ---- 


śivadīkṣāsinā cchinnā na prarohettu sā punaḥ | 


śivena svacchasvatantracidānandaghanena śaṅkareṇa proktā yā 
jñānayogakriyāpradhānā nānāprakārā dīkṣā, "dīyate 
jñānasadbhāvaḥ" iti prāṅ1nirūpitarūpā, saiva 
pāśacchedakatvādasiriva, tena yasya cchinneti 
svātantryaśaktyātmaparasvarūpapratyabhijñānenonmūlitā, taṃ prati na 
kadācit prarohatītyarthaḥ | evaṃ māyāyāstattvagranthiśaktyātmakaṃ 
trividhaṃ rūpamuktam | tatra 
tattvātmakamaśeṣaviśvavyāpakāṇḍarūpasannibham, granthyātmakaṃ 
trividham, śāktaṃ tu svātantryaśaktisārameva | 
tathātvenāparijñāyamānatvānmohitān prati māyetyucyate | 
tadevamiyamīśvaraprayuktā nigūhitasvasvarūpān puṃsaḥ 
jñātṛkartṛrūpān svaiḥ kalādiniyatyantaistattvaiḥ 
kiñcitkartṛtvakiñcijjñātṛtvābhilāṣakalananiyamanaimītabhogyopabhoga-
bhājaḥ proktapāśaśatapāśitān vidhāya 
kiñcidaṃśātmabhogyasāmānyarūpe pradhānāśaye tathā nikṣipati, yena 
tatkāryaguṇādikṣityantasthūlapāśapāśitā 
yoneryonyantaramevaite'nusaranti | ataḥ pārameśadīkṣāyāṃ samucchedyaiva 
| iyaṃ ceyadviśvavyāpikāpi māyā'khyātirūpāpi 
pārameśvaraprakāśabhittāveva prakāśata iti | etanmukhena yā 
viśvaprakāśikā pārameśvaraprakāśabhittiḥ, sā śuddhavidyocyate | 
tatastāṃ nirūpayati ---- 


athopari mahāvidyā sarvavidyābhavodbhavā || 10-1142 || 

jagataḥ pralayotpattivibhūtinidhiravyayā | 


"daśakoṭiguṇā vidyā māyāṃ vyāpya vyavasthitā" (10-671)

ityuktatvādaśuddhavidyāvailakṣaṇyato mahatyaśeṣavedanarūpatvādvidyā 
sarvāsāṃ vidyārājñīprabhṛtīnāṃ divyānāṃ bhavānāṃ ca 
praṇavopalakṣitānāṃ sarvamantrāṇāmudbhava ullāso yasyāḥ 
māyāditattvatattatpramātṛbhuvanādirūpasya jagataḥ 
pralayotpattyovībhūtau ca ---- 

"vidyāmaṇḍalarājānāṃ maṇḍalānāṃ vibhūtayaḥ | 

na śakyāḥ parisaṅkhyātuṃ mantrāṇāṃ ca tathātmanām ||"

iti sthityā''tmabhogasampattau nidhirāśrayaḥ, 
viśvasargasthitisaṃhārakāriṇītyarthaḥ, svayaṃ tu 
prakāśarūpatayā'nyathā | yattvekādaśe'trāpi saṃhārādi vakṣyate, 
tatsaṅkocāpekṣayā || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


sā eva paramā devī vāgīśīti nigadyate || 10-1143 || 


parameti māyāyā uktāyā bhedaprathotthāpikāyā 
iyamanyā'bhedaprathonmīlanaprathamasopāna kalpā vāgīśasya 
paraparāmarśātmano maheśvarasyeyaṃ vāgīśīti nirucyate || 1143 || 

ata eva ---- 


aṣṭavargavibhinnā ca vidyā sā mātṛkaiva tu | 


a-ka-ca-ṭa-ta-pa-ya-śairaṣṭābhirvargaibhīnnā na 
tvabhinnā'nāhataparāmarśamayatvena bhinnāśeṣaviśvāvabhāsabhājo 
mantrānunmīlayet, ata eva ceyaṃ mātṛkā 
vācyavācakāśeṣaviśvahetutve'pi paśubhistathātvenāparijñātā mātā 
|| 

athātra ---- 


bhuvanāni pravakṣyāmi yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ || 10-1144 || 


tatra ---- 


vāmā jyeṣṭhā tathā raudrī kālī vikaraṇī tathā | 

balavikaraṇī caiva balapramathanī tathā || 10-1145 || 

damanī sarvabhūtānāṃ tathā caiva manonmanī | 


etāśca śrīmadānandabhairave ---- 

"vāmayā visṛjet sarvaṃ jyeṣṭhayā pālayet punaḥ | 

raudryā lokopasaṃhāraṃ kurute svecchayā prabhuḥ || 

kālyā kalati bhūtāni vikaraṇyā kiret kalāḥ | 

balamapyanyayā sarvaṃ balaṃ mathnāti cānyayā || 

damanyā damayitvā tu manaḥ saṅkalparūpakam | 

nayate paramaṃ sthānamunmanyā tu maheśvaraḥ ||"


iti niruktāḥ | vikaraṇyeti kalavikaraṇyā kalāḥ śaktīvīkiret sarvaṃ 
svaśaktyadhiṣṭhitaṃ karoti | anyayā balavikaraṇyā sarvatra balaṃ 
svavyāpārakaraṇasāmarthyaṃ vikiret | anyayā balapramathanyā sarveṣāṃ 
rudrakṣetrajñānāṃ balaṃ pramathnāti | damayitveti samanāntāṃ 
bhūmimāviśyetyevamatra saṅgatiḥ | ye tu pūrvamaśuddhavidyāyā vāmādayo 
nava devāḥ strīliṅgapāṭhādvāmādyā vā nava śaktaya uktāḥ (10-1117
-18), ta etadaṃśāvatārarūpāḥ sthūlā boddhavyāḥ || 

etāśca ---- 


taptacāmīkarākārāḥ pañcavaktrāstrilocanāḥ || 10-1146 || 

amoghavīryāḥ sarvajñāḥ sarvataḥ sarvadā sthitāḥ | 

sarvajñānugatāḥ sarvāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ || 10-1147 || 

sarvalakṣaṇasampannāḥ sarvaiśvaryasamanvitāḥ | 


taptacāmīkarākārā atidīptāḥ | lakṣaṇāni vijñānayogarūpāṇi | 
sarvataḥ sarvatra sarvakālaṃ sthitā etadanadhiṣṭhitaṃ na 
kimapyastītyarthaḥ | īdṛśyo'pi sarvajñaṃ maheśvaramanugatāstena 
śaktimatā'dhiṣṭhitāḥ | sarvamevābharaṇaṃ tena bhūṣitā |  


pradhānāḥ sapta koṭyastu mantrāṇāṃ yā vyavasthitāḥ || 10-1148 || 


tāsāṃ madhyāt ---- 


ekaikasya parīvāro lakṣāyutasahasraśaḥ | 


ekaikasyeti mantrasya || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


padmākāreṣu divyeṣu krīḍanti bhuvaneṣu te || 10-1149 || 


ta ityekaśeṣādvāmādyāḥ śaktayo mantrāśca || 

atraiva ---- 


triguṇī brahmavetālī sthāṇumatyambikā parā | 

rūpiṇī madīnī jvālā saptasaṅkhyāstadīśvarāḥ || 10-1150 || 

vidyārājñyaḥ samākhyātāḥ.............


teṣāṃ mantrāṇāṃ vidyānāṃ ceśvarāḥ prabhavaḥ, ata eva vidyānāṃ 
mantrāṇāṃ rājñya ityuktāḥ || 

ata evaitāḥ ---- 


..........ḍīkṣākāle viśodhayet | 


etacchuddhāvetadadhiṣṭhitasaptakoṭisaṅkhyākamantraśuddhisampatte || 

evaṃ māyāntāśeṣaviśvabhedasarvajñamantrāśrayabhūtā yoktā 
śuddhavidyā, sāpi svāṅgakalpatayā'hamidaṃ sarvamiti 
sphuṭedantāhantāsāmānādhikaraṇyābhāsātmanīśvaratattve bhittibhūte 
sati bhāti, nahi bhedābhedaprakāśaṃ bhittibhedaṃ vinā bhedasarvajñatāpi 
ghaṭate | tata īśvaratattvaṃ darśayitumāha ---- 


bāhye tasyaiśvaraṃ tattvaṃ...............


tasyeti vidyātattvasya | bāhya iti tadeva vyāptyā parivṛtya 
sthitamityarthaḥ || 

ataśca ---- 


...............bhuvanānyatra me śṛṇu || 10-1151 || 


tatra mukhyabhuvanāvasthitasyeśvarasya tāvat svarūpamāha ---- 


aṣṭavidyeśvarairyukto vītamāyo nirañjanaḥ | 

sthitisaṃhārakartā vai mokṣaiśvaryapradāyakaḥ || 10-1152 || 


yukto vakṣyamāṇakrameṇa parivṛtaḥ | vītā māyā yasmāt, yato'yaṃ 
bhinnavedyaprathātmano'ñjanād māyākhyānmalānniṣkrāntaḥ | nahi 
mantravadasambhedena sarvaṃ jānāti, api tu bhedābhedarūpatayā | ata eva 
bhedāṃśasparśādvidyeśvaraparivṛtatvaṃ bhuvanādivyavasthā 
cāsyocyamānā nāyuktā | evaṃ śivatattvaparyante 
sūkṣmatayā''sūtritakalpasya bhedasya bhāvād bhuvanādivyavasthāpi 
śodhyatayā vakṣyamāṇopapannaiva |  sthitisaṃhārābhyāṃ 
sṛṣṭirapyupalakṣitā | taccaitatsṛṣṭyāditrayam ---- 

"śuddhe'dhvani śivaḥ kartā"

iti nītyā mantramaṇḍalādiśuddhādhvaviṣayamevāsyeti mantavyam | tathā 
ca śrīmālinīvijaye ---- 

śa sisṛkṣurjagatsṛṣṭerādāveva nijecchayā | 

vijñānakevalānaṣṭau bodhayāmāsa pudgalān ||" (1-19)

tathā

"mantrāṇāmasṛjattadvat sapta koṭīḥ samaṇḍalāḥ | " (1-21)

iti mokṣamaiśvaryaṃ ca lokottarabhogarūpaṃ na kevalaṃ mantrebhyo dadāti, 
yāvanmantrādiprayuktyā''yātaśaktipātebhyo māyāgarbhagatebhyo'pi | 
etadapyupalakṣaṇaparam, tena dambhena devagurvādisevimāyījanebhyo 
vilayamapi dadāti | evaṃ hi pañcavidhakṛtyakāritvamasyoktaṃ bhavati || 
1152 || 

asyāsanavarṇanaṃ dhyānopayogyupadiśati ---- 


tasyāsanaṃ tu vistīrṇaṃ sahasradalasammitam | 


asaṅkhyātadalamityarthaḥ || 

yato'tra ---- 


tisraḥ koṭyo'rdhakoṭiśca mantrāstasyāsane sthitāḥ || 10-1153 || 


yadyapi sapta koṭyo mantrāṇām, tathāpi ---- 

"brahmādistambaparyante jātamātre jagatyapi | 

mantrāṇāṃ koṭayastisraḥ sārdhāḥ śivaniyojitāḥ || 

anugṛhyāṇusaṅghātaṃ yātāḥ padamanāmayam |" (1-40-41)

iti śrīmālinīvijayoktanītyā sārdhāstisraḥ 
koṭyo'nugrahādhikārāyāvasthitā ityevamuktam || 1153 || 

taditthamayaṃ viniyojyamantrapadmāsanādhirūḍhaḥ ---- 


tatrastha īśvaro devo varadaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ | 


devo dyotanādiparamārthaḥ | sarvato mukhaṃ pradhānarūpaṃ yasya || 

ākārato'pi ---- 


pañcavaktraḥ sutejasko daśabāhustrilocanaḥ || 10-1154 || 

gokṣīradhavalaḥ saumyo nāgayajñopavītavān | 

divyāmbaradharo devo divyagandhānulepanaḥ || 10-1155 || 

sarvalakṣaṇasampūrṇaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ | 

triśūlapāṇīndumaulirjaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitaḥ || 10-1156 || 

prasannavadanaḥ kānto yogaiśvaryapradāyakaḥ | 

varadābhayahastaśca dhyeyo'sāvīśayogibhiḥ || 10-1157 || 


pañcavaktrādyākṛ(tau)1 prāguktaṃ satattvaṃ mantavyam | 
varadābhayapāṇiśceti cakārāt khaḍgakheṭakādeḥ parigrahaḥ | saumya iti 
pārameśvarakriyāśaktiprādhānyena sṛṣṭiprādhānyāt, ata eva 
dvādaśapaṭalavakṣyamāṇasthityā dhyātaḥ san yogaiśvaryapradāyaka 
īśvarayoginām || 1157 || 

yathā ca parameśvaro rudrakṣetrajñānāṃ dhyānārcanādinā'nugrahītuṃ 
gṛhīteśvarākāraḥ, tathā tatsamavāyinī śaktirapi 
tathaivā''śritākṛtirityāha ---- 


tasyotsaṅgagatā vidyā sarvavidyāsamāśritā | 

divyavastraparīdhānā divyamālyānulepanā || 10-1158 || 

divyasragdāmamālābhirmuktāhāraivībhūṣitā | 

muktāphalapratīkāśā pañcavaktrā trilocanā || 10-1159 || 


vidyeti māyīyavarṇabhaṭṭārakarūpā mātṛkā, evamapi prāguktayuktyā 
aṃśena bhedasyānivṛtterutsaṅgagatetyuktam, evamuttaratra | 
sarvābhivīdyābhiḥ sarvairmantravidyāgaṇairutpattikṣetratvāt 
samyagabhedenāśritā'vaṣṭabdhā | muktāphalapratīkāśeti, 
anugrahapravaṇatvāt saumyetyarthaḥ || 1159 || 

eṣā ca ---- 


ārādhitā vidhānena vedayejjñāninaḥ sadā | 


vidhānenāntarabhedapratyavarśamabalenā''rādhitā prasādaṃ prāpitā 
satī jñānaśālino vedayet prakāśitasvasvarūpān sampādayet || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


prahasantīva sā bhāti maheśavadanekṣaṇāt || 10-1160 || 


vadanamākṛtyapekṣayā vaktraṃ svarūpāpekṣayā tu parā śaktiḥ | 
īkṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭirjñānaṃ ca || 1160 || 

ato bhagavataḥ parivārarūpān ---- 


vidyeśvarānato vakṣye pūrvādīśāntagān kramāt | 


te ca vidyātattvagatā apyatra pareṇa rūpeṇa sthitāḥ || 


anantaścaiva sūkṣmaśca tathā caiva śivottamaḥ || 10-1161 || 

ekanetraikarudrau ca trinetraśca prakītītaḥ | 

śrīkaṇṭhaśca śikhaṇḍī ca jñeyā vidyeśvarāḥ kramāt || 10-1162 || 


ete cānantādyā gurubhiḥ śivatanāvitthamuktāḥ ---- 

"bhagabilaśatakalitaguhāmūrdhāsanago'ṣṭaśaktiyugdevaḥ | 

gahanādyaṃ nirayāntaṃ sṛjati ca rudrāṃśca viniyuṅkte || 

uddharati manonmanyā puṃsasteṣveva bhavati madhyasthaḥ | 

te tenodastacitaḥ paratattvālocane'bhiniviśante || 

sa punaradhaḥpathavatīṣvadhikṛta evāṇuṣu śivena | 

avasitapativiniyogaḥ sārdhamanekātmamantrakoṭībhiḥ || 

nirvātyanantanāthastaddhāmāviśati sūkṣmarudrastu | 

anugṛhyāṇumapūrvaṃ sthāpayati patiḥ śikhaṇḍinaḥ sthāne || 

ityaṣṭau paripāṭyā yāvaddhāmāni yānti gururekaḥ | 

tāvadasaṅkhyākānāṃ jantūnāṃ nirvṛtiṃ kurute || 

te'ṣṭāvapi śaktyaṣṭakayogāmalajalaruhāsīnāḥ | 

ālocayanti devaṃ hṛdayasthaṃ kāraṇaṃ paramam || 

te bhagavantamanantaṃ dhyāyantaḥ svahṛdi kāraṇaṃ śāntam | 

saptānudhyāyantyapi mantrāṇāṃ koṭayaḥ śuddhāḥ |" 

iti | 

guhā māyā, tasyā mūrdhā śuddhavidyā, tadevāsanam | śaktyaṣṭakena 
vāmādinā yogo yatra tādṛśe'malajalaruha āsīnāḥ | paramamanantamiti 
prāpteśvararūpam || 1162 || 

atraiva ceśvaratattve bhuvanāntarāṇyāha ---- 


ato rūpamavasthānaṃ.............


vidyeśāvaraṇordhvaṃ rūpāvaraṇaṃ nāma bhuvanamityarthaḥ | evamuttaratra 
|| 


..............ṭatra rudrānnibodha me | 

dharmo jñānaṃ ca vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ ca caturthakam || 10-1163 || 


yadvaśādvidyeśvarāṇāmadhastanādhvādhāravattvamaśeṣajñatvam, 
pūrṇatayā nairākāṅkṣyam, mahāvibhavapradatvam | ta ete dharmādyā 
rudrā īśvarasya parivārāḥ || 1163 || 

atraiva ceśvaratattve ---- 


sūkṣmāvaraṇamūrdhve'taḥ...........


ato rūpāvaraṇādūrdhve || 


..............ṭatra śaktitrayaṃ viduḥ | 


tāśca ---- 


vāmā jyeṣṭhā ca raudrī ca śaktayaḥ samudāhṛtāḥ || 10-1164 || 


pradhānabhūtāḥ || 1164 || 

āsāmeva hi kālyādayaḥ prāguktāḥ prapañcaḥ | ata evāha ---- 


parivārastu tāsāṃ vai koṭyo'nekāstu saṅkhyayā | 


āsāmevāśeṣaśaktiprapañcātmakatvāt || 

ye cāsāṃ parivāratvena sthitāḥ, te ---- 


sarve sarvagatā mantrāḥ sarvajñāḥ sarvakāmadāḥ || 10-1165 || 

śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśāstrinetrāḥ śūlapāṇayaḥ | 

sarvalakṣaṇasampannāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ || 10-1166 || 

sarvaiśvaryasusampūrṇāścārucandrārdhaśekharāḥ |  


kiṃ ca ---- 


śatapatrābjabhākāraiḥ śuddhahārenduraśmibhiḥ || 10-1167 || 

nānāratnojjvalaiścitraiḥ prākāraistoraṇākulaiḥ | 

īśvarānugatāḥ sarve tiṣṭhanti bhuvaneṣu te || 10-1168 || 


śatapatrābjānāṃ bhā dīptirivākāro yeṣāṃ tādṛśaiḥ, 
tathā'nyairhāraiḥ sudīptibhiḥ prākārairupalakṣiteṣu 
bhuvaneṣvīśvarabhaṭṭārakamantrānugatāḥ krīḍantīti sambandhaḥ || 
1168 || 

ata evārādhakairete ---- 


tamārādhayituṃ devaṃ pūjyante sarvakarmasu | 


"yatkaroṣi yadaśnāsi yajjuhoṣi dadāsi yat | 

yattapasyasi kaunteya tatkuruṣva madarpaṇam ||" (bha0gī0 9-27)


iti nyāyena karmaviṣaye tamīśvaramārādhayitumete parivārarūpā mantrāḥ 
pūjyante, etatpūjakānāmevaṃvyāptividāmetanmukhena 
īśvarāvāptirbhavatītyarthaḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


vrataṃ pāśupataṃ divyaṃ ye caranti jitendriyāḥ || 10-1169 || 

bhasmaniṣṭhā japadhyānāste vrajantyaiśvaraṃ padam | 


bhasmaniṣṭhā snānamayakḷptirūpā yeṣām || 

prāsaṅgikamuktvā prakṛtamāha ---- 


tatreśvarastu bhagavān devadevo nirañjanaḥ || 10-1170 || 

adhikāraṃ prakurute śivecchāvidhicoditaḥ | 


tatreśvaratattve devānāmanantādīnāṃ devaḥ | adhikāraṃ 
teṣāmevānugrahādau viniyojanam | śivecchaiva vidhatte sarvamiti vidhiḥ, 
tatpracoditaḥ | paramaśiva eva hīcchājñānakriyāpradhānaḥ 
śivasadāśiveśvarabhūmikā bhāsayati | yaduktaṃ śrīmataṅgapārameśvare 
---- 

"layādhikārabhogāhvatritattvoktivimarśanāt | 

padārthaḥ patināmāsau prathamaḥ parikītītaḥ ||" (1-2-14) 

iti | 

atra coktavakṣyamāṇarūpāṇi ---- 


daśa pañca ca śodhyāni bhuvanānīśvare kramāt || 10-1171 || 


tatreśvarabhuvanam (1) vidyeśāṣṭakāvaraṇabhuvanam (2) 
dharmādicatuṣṭayāśrayarūpāvaraṇabhuvanam (3) 
vāmādiśaktitrayāśrayasūkṣmāvaraṇabhuvanam (4) iti catvāri 
tāvaduktāni, vakṣyamāṇāni tu śuddhāvaraṇa-vidyāvaraṇa-
pramāṇāvaraṇa-(mānā)1varaṇa-māyāvaraṇa-śuddhaśivāvaraṇa-mokṣā-
varaṇākhyāni saptāvaraṇāni, tato dhruvabhuvanam, tato 
vāmādiśaktitrayāśrayecchā-śaktibhuvanam, tataḥ prabuddhāvaraṇam tataḥ 
samayāvaraṇamityekādaśa catubhīḥ saha pañcadaśa bhavanti || 1171 || 

etāni pañcadaśāpi bhuvanānyāntareṇa krameṇa ---- 


tālukordhve vijānīyād dīkṣākāle varānane | 


māyātattvātmakatālugranthyūrdhvasthaśuddhavidyāpadmakaṇīkordhve 
yadīśvaratattvaṃ tālukordhvagatam, tatra jānīyāt 
tadviśrāntipuraḥsaraṃ pūrvoktamantrakrameṇa śodhayedityarthaḥ | 
etaccopalakṣaṇam, tena brahmāṇḍagatāni bhuvanāni hṛdviśrāntyā, 
jalādiprakṛtyantagatāni kaṇṭhaviśrāntyā, prakṛtyādimāyāntagatāni 
tāluviśrāntyā, tadūrdhvapadaviśrāntyā śuddhavidyātattvagatāni 
bhuvanāni śodhanīyāni | evaṃ lalāṭa-brahmarandhra-
vyāpinīpadaviśrāntyā sadāśiva-śakti-śivatattvagatāni vakṣyamāṇāni 
bhuvanāni śodhanīyāni || 

atha śuddhāvaraṇādibhuvanaikādaśakaṃ krameṇa darśayati ---- 


śuddhāvaraṇamūrdhvaṃ tu tasmiñ chaktidvayaṃ smṛtam || 10-1172 || 

jñānaṃ kriyā ca vikhyātaṃ............


jñānakriyāśaktibhuvanadvitayarūpeṇa tadbhuvanamityarthaḥ, evamuttaratra 
|| 

atha ---- 


..........ḍve vidye cāpyataḥ param | 

bhāvasaṃjñāpyabhāvākhyā tasmin śaktidvaye smṛte || 10-1173 || 


tasmin jñānakriyākhye prokte śaktidvaye viṣayatayā dve bhāvābhāvākhye 
vedanaparamārthatvādvidye sthite | tatra pūrvoktayuktyā 
sphuṭedantātmakabhāvavedanaśaktirekā, 
idantotthānabhitibhūtākhyātyātmābhāvavedanaśaktidvītīyetye-
tadbhuvanadvitayarūpaṃ vidyāvaraṇametadityarthaḥ || 1173 || 

ataśca ---- 


tejeśaśca dhruveśaśca pramāṇānāṃ paraṃ padam | 

pramāṇāvaraṇe cordhve............


pūrvoktānāṃ māyātattvāśritānāṃ pañcārthādipramāṇānāṃ 
paramidaṃ padaṃ prāptisthānaṃ tejeśaśca dhruveśaśca 
vidyāvaraṇādūrdhve pramāṇāvaraṇe sthite ityetatpramāṇāvaraṇamapi 
bhuvanadvitayayogi || 

atha ---- 


..............kathayāmi ca mānataḥ || 10-1174 || 


mānato māne pramāṇāvaraṇordhvagate mānanāmnyāvaraṇe rudrān kathayāmi 
|| 1174 || 

te ca ---- 


brahmā rudraḥ pratodaśca anantaśca caturthakaḥ | 


tenaitadrudrabhuvanacatuṣṭayabhuvanapariṣkṛtametanamāyāvaraṇabhuvana-
mityarthaḥ || 

atha ---- 


suśuddhāvaraṇaṃ cordhve tatra rudratrayaṃ viduḥ || 10-1175 || 

ekākṣaḥ piṅgalo haṃsaḥ kathitaṃ tu samāsataḥ | 

parivāra eṣāmasaṅkhya iti vakṣyati | 


atha ---- 


śivāvaraṇamūrdhvaṃ tu tatraiko dhruvasaṃjñakaḥ || 10-1176 || 

saṃsthito rudrarājasya..........


atha ---- 


.............ṃokṣāvaraṇamūrdhvataḥ | 


tatra ca ---- 


ekādaśaiva rudrāṃśca kathayāmi samāsataḥ || 10-1177 || 


tānāha ---- 


brahmadankidiṇḍimuṇḍāḥ saurabhaśca tathaiva ca | 

janmamṛtyuharaścaiva praṇītaḥ sukhaduḥkhadaḥ || 10-1178 || 

vijṛmbhitaḥ.............


janmaharo mṛtyuharaḥ | sukhaṃ dyati khaṇḍayatīti sukhadaḥ, evaṃ 
duḥkhadaḥ || 

ta ete ekādaśa ---- 


......ṣamākhyātāstālūrdhve tu vyavasthitāḥ | 


tālūrdhve iti prāguktamevaiśvaraṃ tattvameṣāmāśraya iti smārayati || 

atha ---- 


punarūrdhve dhruvaṃ jñeyaṃ nirañjanapadaṃ śubham || 10-1179 || 


pramāṇāvaraṇe śivāvaraṇe dhruvāvaraṇe caika eva 
sthūlasūkṣmaparabhedena dhruvākhyo rudrastriratrokta iti punaḥśabdārthaḥ 
|| 1179 || 

athāsya dhruvāvaraṇasya ---- 


īśaśaktitrayaṃ mūdhnī............


sthitam || 

tacca ---- 


...............kathitaṃ cānupūrvaśaḥ | 


vāmā jyeṣṭhā raudrī ceti yatsūkṣmāvaraṇe prāk śaktitrayamuktam, 
tadeveha pararūpeṇa sthitamityarthaḥ || 

kiṃ cātraiva pradhānabhūtāyāḥ ---- 


icchāśaktyabhidhānāyāḥ...............


śakteḥ puram || 

tāśca vāmādyā etasyāḥ ---- 


...........'ntarbhūtāḥ prakītītāḥ || 10-1180 || 


tena vāmādibhuvanatrayaparivṛtametadicchābhuvanamatretyarthaḥ || 1180 || 

atha ---- 


prabuddhāvaraṇaṃ cordhve............


tatra ca rudrān ---- 


..............kathayāmi samāsataḥ | 

prītaḥ pramuditaścaiva pramodaśca pralambakaḥ || 10-1181 || 

viṣṇurmadana evātha gahanaḥ prathitastathā | 


tadetadatra ---- 


rudrāṣṭakaṃ samākhyātaṃ vijñeyaṃ prāgdiśaḥ kramāt || 10-1182 || 


tato'pi ---- 


samayāvaraṇaṃ cordhve...........


atra rudrān ---- 


............kathayāmi samāsataḥ | 

prabhavaḥ samayaḥ kṣudro vimalaśca śivastathā || 10-1183 || 

tato ghanaḥ samākhyāto nirañjanastataḥ param | 

rudroṅkārastu pañcaite...........


prabhavākhyasya samayasya viśeṣaṇaṃ kṣudra iti | vimalaḥ śiva iti 
vimalaśivākhyaḥ || 

etāṃśca ---- 


...........ṭālūrdhve tu vijānata || 10-1184 || 


vijānateti bahuvacanamupadeśyaśiṣyapraśiṣyādibhedena, evamanyatra | 
tālūrdhvaṃ iti etāvadantamīśvaratattvāśrayamiti smaraṇāya || 1184 || 
tadatra 
bhuvanapañcadaśakāntarvatībhuvanāntarasaṅkhyāpūrvametadupasaṃharati ---
- 


ekonaṣaṣṭirbhuvanaṃ jñānaśaktyādita,h kramāt | 

rudroṅkārāntamityetad dīkṣākāle viśodhayet || 10-1185 || 


jñānaśakterādīnīśvaravidyeśvararūpasūkṣmāvaraṇagatāni yāni 
bhuvanāni, tataḥ prabhṛti 
rudroṅkārāntamekonaṣaṣṭirīśvaratattve'vāntarabhuvanāni | 
tatreśvarasyaikam, vidyeśānāmaṣṭau, rūpāvaraṇe catvāri, 
sūkṣmāvṛtau trīṇi, śuddhāvṛtau dve, vidyāvṛtau dve, pramāṇāvṛtau 
dve, (mānā)1vṛtau catvāri, suśuddhāvṛttau trīṇi, śivāvṛtāvekam, 
mokṣāvṛtāvekādaśa, dhruvāvṛtāvekam, icchāśaktibhuvanaṃ 
vāmādiśaktitrayeṇa saha catvāri, prabuddhāvṛtāvaṣṭau, samayāvṛtau 
pañcetyevamekonaṣaṣṭyā'vāntarabhuvanairyuktametadīśvaratattvaṃ 
saṅkṣepeṇa, na tu vistarataḥ śodhayet || 1185 || 

asya ca ---- 


ekaikasya parīvāraḥ koṭyo'nekāḥ sahasraśaḥ | 


te ca ---- 


trinetrā varadāḥ sarve śuddhasāmarthyavigrahāḥ || 10-1186 || 

śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśā daśabāhvinduśekharāḥ | 

triśūlapāṇayaḥ sarve jaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitāḥ || 10-1187 || 

sarve sarvaguṇopetāḥ sarvajñāḥ sarvadeśvarāḥ | 

sarvalakṣaṇasampūrṇāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ || 10-1188 || 

rudrakanyāsamākīrṇā divyai rūpairmanoharaiḥ | 

saṃkrīḍante puravaraiḥ śivecchāvidhicoditāḥ || 10-1189 || 


śuddhaṃ māyāmalenākaluṣaṃ yatsāmarthyaṃ jñānakriyāviṣayam, tadeva 
vigrahaḥ svarūpaṃ yeṣām | yadyapi sarve "ahamidaṃ sarvam" ---- iti 
svāṅgakalpāśeṣaviśvaprakāśātmānaḥ, tathāpīśvarecchāto 
nānārūpā api | evamuttaratrāpi || 1189 || 

atha ---- 


īśvarasya tathordhve tu adhaścaiva sadāśivāt | 

suśivāvaraṇaṃ cordhve tasmin jñeyaḥ sadāśivaḥ || 10-1190 || 


yadetat sarvaviṣayasphuṭedantāhantāsāmānādhikaraṇyāvabhāsāde-
kamīśvaratattvamuktam, tadantarā 
sphuṭedantācchādakāhantāvabhāsātmakasadāśivatattvaṃ vinā nopapadyate 
| nahyāntarābhāsaṃ vinā bāhyābhāsasyodayo 
bhavatītyetadīśvaratattvabhittibhūtena sadāśivatattvena 
bhavitavyamityāśayeneśvarasyopari 
sadāśivatattvavatīvakṣyamāṇapradhānasadāśivabhuvanasyādhaḥ 
sadāśivatattvāśritasuśivāvaraṇamastītyuktam | suśivaśceha 
sadāśivabhaṭṭāraka eva | yadāha "tasmin jñeyaḥ sadāśivaḥ" 
vakṣyamāṇapararūpāt sadāśivādanyo'yamapararūpa ityarthaḥ || 1190 || 

sa ca ---- 


tripañcanayano devaścandrārdhakṛtaśekharaḥ | 

vaktrapañcakasaṃyukto daśabāhurmahābalaḥ || 10-1191 || 

śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaḥ sphuran vai dīptatejasā | 

siṃhāsanopaviṣṭastu..............


tadupari ca ---- 


......śvetapadmāsanasthitaḥ || 1192 || 

pañcabrahmāṅgasahitaḥ sakalādyaiḥ samanvitaḥ | 

daśabhiśca śivairyukto rudrāṣṭādaśakānvitaḥ || 10-1193 || 


pañca brahmāṇi sadyojātādīni | aṅgāni hṛdayādīni || 1193 || 

sakalādīn vibhajati ---- 


sakalo niṣkalaḥ śūnyaḥ kalāḍhyaḥ khamalaṅkṛtaḥ | 

kṣapaṇaśca kṣayāntasthaḥ kaṇṭhyauṣṭhyaścāṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ || 10-
1194 || 


asyāntarakrameṇa sthānamāha--


bhruvormadhye tu vijñeyo devadevaḥ sadāśivaḥ | 

sakalādyairvṛto devaḥ............


deva iti dyotamānaḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


.............oṃṃkāreśādibhiḥ kramāt || 10-1195 || 


vṛta iti vartate || 1195 || 

oṃkāreśādīn daśa śivānāha ---- 


oṃkāreśaḥ śivo dīptaḥ kāraṇeśo daśeśakaḥ | 

suśivaścaiva kāleśaḥ sūkṣmarūpaḥ sutejasaḥ || 10-1196 || 

śarvaśca daśamaḥ proktaḥ..........


ta ete prāgdiśa ārabhya ---- 


.............ūrdhvāntaṃ saṃvyavasthitāḥ | 


sadāśivasya brahmāvaraṇasakalādyāvaraṇābhyāṃ bahiḥ || 

eṣāmapi ---- 


rudrāścāṣṭādaśa bahiḥ.........


saṃvyavasthitā ityeva || 


..............ṭeṣāṃ nāmāni vai śṛṇu || 10-1197 || 

vijayastvatha niḥśvāsaḥ svayambhūścāgnivīrarāṭ | 

rauravo mukuṭo visaraścandro bimbaḥ pragītavān || 10-1198 || 

lalita siddharudraśca santānaḥ śarva eva ca | 

paraśca kiraṇaścaiva pārameśvara eva ca || 10-1199 || 


agnisahito vīrarāḍiti dvau | ete caitannāmakasya muktyavatārāḥ 
śāstrāvatāraivīśvamanugṛhṇānāḥ sthitāḥ, ata eva 
daśāṣṭādaśabhedena caitaducyate || 1199 || 

tadevaṃ brahmāṅgasakalādiśivarudrāvaraṇaiścatubhīḥ parivṛtaḥ ---- 


sādākhyastu samākhyātaḥ sakalo mantravigrahaḥ | 

sarvakāraṇamadhyakṣaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ || 10-1200 || 

bhuktimuktipradātā ca sādhakānāṃ kriyāvatām | 


bhavanāmataḥ prabhṛti saditi vyapadeśapravṛtteḥ sadākhye sadāśivatattve 
bhavo devaḥ sādākhyaḥ, sa ca sakalo mantramūtīriti | 
vakṣyamāṇaniṣkalamūrtyapekṣayā'dhyakṣaḥ sarveṣāmadhiṣṭhātā 
sarvadarśī ca | sarvakāraṇatvaṃ suspaṣṭayati ---- sṛṣṭīti | 
sṛṣṭisaṃhārau sthitivilayāvapyupalakṣayataḥ | 
sādhakānāmityārādhakānāṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ muktiṃ siṣādhayiṣūṇāṃ 
muktim, bhuktipūrvāṃ muktiṃ tu kriyāvatāmanuṣṭhānaparāṇāṃ 
sampādayati || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


koṭayaḥ sapta mantrāṇāmāsane tasya saṃsthitāḥ || 10-1201 || 


nivṛttādhikārāścārdhacatasraḥ pravṛttādhikārāścārdhacatasra iti 
yāḥ sapta mantrakoṭayaḥ, tā sarvā anenādhiṣṭhitā ityarthaḥ | 
īśvarabhaṭṭārakeṇa tvadhikāre pravṛttā ardhacatasra 
evādhiṣṭhitāstasya sthūlabhogatvāditi śeṣaḥ | ata eva 
prāgīśvarasyāsanapadmaṃ sahasradalamuktam || 1201 || 

asyāsanaṃ tu tato'pi viśiṣṭamityāha ---- 


āsanaṃ lakṣapatrāḍhyaṃ candrakoṭyayutaprabham | 


īśvarapadmādapyadhikadalamityarthaḥ || 

tacca padmam ---- 


vāmādyaivībhupūrvaiśca pañcavaktraistrilocanaiḥ || 10-1202 || 

tārādyaiḥ śaktibhedaiśca prāgdiśaḥ parivāritam | 


vāmādyāḥ prāguktā eveha pareṇa rūpeṇa sthitāḥ, vibhūpūrvoktāstu --
-- 

"vibhurjñānī kriyā cecchā vāgīśī jvālinī tathā | 

vāmā jyeṣṭhā ca raudrī ca sarvāḥ kālānalaprabhāḥ ||" (8-66)

iti śrīpūrve nidīṣṭāḥ | tārādyāstu śaktayaḥ 
prāguktāṣṭātriṃśatkalārūpāḥ | tatra vāmādyāḥ prāgādidikkrameṇa 
daleṣu madhyāntāḥ | vidyādyāstu tatprātilomyena madhyādiprāgdalāntāḥ 
| taduktaṃ śrīpūrve ---- 

"vāmā jyeṣṭhā" (8-33)

ityupakramya, "bhānumārgeṇa vinyaset | 

vibhvādinavakaṃ cānyadvilomāt parikalpayet ||" (8-65) 

iti | 

tārādyāstu prāgādikrameṇaiva nyastā bhāvanīyāḥ || 

asya ca devasya ---- 


jñānaśaktiḥ kriyāśaktirvāme dakṣiṇataḥ sthite || 10-1203 || 


pāṭhakramādarthakramo balīyāniti nyāyād jñānaśaktirdakṣiṇe 
kriyāśaktirvāma iti jñeyam || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


icchāśaktiḥ parā devi yayā sarvamadhiṣṭhitam | 

utpattisthitisaṃhārāṃstirobhāvamanugraham || 10-1204 || 

yayā karoti deveśaḥ sarvadā sarvamadhvani | 

tasyotsaṅgagatā sā tu nityaṃ caivātmavatīnī || 10-1205 || 

pareti jñānakriyāpekṣayā | adhiṣṭhitaṃ vyāptam | 


sarvamiti sṛṣṭyādipañcakaviśeṣaṇam | sarvadeti ---- 

"tadevaṃ vyavahāre'pi prabhurdehādimāviśan | 

bhāntamevāntararthaughamicchayā bhāsayedbahiḥ ||" (1-6-7)

iti pratyabhijñoktanītyā dehādyāviṣṭaścidātmā 
maheśvarastadarthāvabhāsa-tatsthititaccarvaṇa-tatsaṃskārāvasthāpana-
tatprakāśamayatvāpādanaihī pratikṣaṇaṃ jagataḥ pañca kṛtyāni karoti 
| utsaṅgagateti | ākṛtimattve ātmaśivasya || 1205 || 

tatkathaṃ sadāśivasyoktamiti tatsaṃkhyāmāha ---- 


sā cecchā devadevasya śivasya paramātmanaḥ | 

sa evāpararūpeṇa pañcamantramahātanuḥ || 10-1206 || 

icchārūpadharaḥ śrīmān devadevaḥ sadāśivaḥ | 


yataḥ śiva evāpararūpeṇa sadāśivaḥ, ata icchā'sya śaktiruktetyarthaḥ 
| pañcabhirīśānādibrahmabhirmantrairmahatī viśvavyāpikā 
mahāmāhātmyā ca tanuryasya | śivasyānugrahārthametadapararūpagrahaṇaṃ 
svasvātantryādityāha ---- icchārūpadhara iti | ata evāyaṃ 
sadetyākṛtiparigrahāparigrahayoḥ śiva iveti kṛtvā sadāśiva ucyate | 
śrīmān jñānadīptyatiśayayuktaḥ || 

atra ca ---- 


śaktayastasya yāḥ proktāḥ.........


vāmādyāḥ || 


............ṭathā vai mantranāyakāḥ || 10-1207 || 


āvaraṇacatuṣṭayasthāḥ || 1207 || 

ete sarve ---- 


ekaikaṃ parito devi padmairarbudakoṭibhiḥ | 

tathā kharvanikharvaiśca pratirūpairmahābalaiḥ || 10-1208 || 

vidyārūpaiḥ svarūpāḍhyairaprameyaguṇānvitaiḥ | 

sarvalakṣaṇasampannaiḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaiḥ || 10-1209 || 

hāsyalāsyāvilāsāḍhyairbhrūkṣeponmadavibhramaiḥ | 

candrakoṭiśataprakhyaiḥ prasravadbhirivāmṛtam || 10-1210 || 


parivṛtā ityarthaḥ | ekaikamiti kriyāviśeṣaṇam | padmārbudādayo 
vakṣyamāṇasaṅkhyāviśeṣarūpāḥ | pratirūpairiti mukhyasadṛśaiḥ | 
balaṃ jñānakriyāsāmarthyam | rūpamākṛtisaundaryaṃ svarūpaṃ ca | 
guṇāḥ sarvajñatvādayaḥ | lakṣaṇāni jñānayogaiśvaryāṇi | sarveṇa 
ābharaṇeṃna bhūṣitaiḥ | aśeṣaviśvātmabhiḥ parānugrahapravaṇatayā 
nityapramuditatvena hāsyalāsyādiyuktatvam | ata eva helāmātreṇa 
parānugrahasampatterbhrūkṣepeṇodgato mado yeṣu tādṛśā vibhramā 
vilāsā yeṣāṃ taivīdyāvṛndaiḥ parivṛtā iti saṅgatiḥ || 1210 || 

ataścātra ---- 


tābhiḥ sārdhaṃ sadā rudrāḥ prakrīḍantīcchayā prabhoḥ | 

puravaraiḥ sarvatobhadraiścandrakoṭisamaprabhaiḥ || 10-1211 || 


tābhivīdyābhiḥ krīḍanti parānugrahāyaiva viharanti 
puravarairupalakṣitāḥ || 1211 || 

ta ete sarve ---- 


māyādharmavinirmuktā nirmalā vigatajvarāḥ | 

adhikāraṃ prakurvanti sarvajñāmoghaśaktayaḥ || 10-1212 || 


māyāyā dharmaścitsvarūpāvaraṇam, tena vinirmuktāḥ | yadyapi 
paramaśivāpekṣayaiṣāṃ saṅkucitatvaṃ mahāmāyākāryaṃ pāśenāsti, 
tathāpi māyāpramātṛvat saṅkocamayā na bhavanti | ata eva ca nirmalā 
māyānāvṛtāḥ | saṅkoca eva hi puṃsāmāṇavamalamityuktaprāyam | ata 
evaite vigatajvarāḥ sarvasantāparahitā | evamapi cānugrāhyānugrahāya 
śivena niyatikālādhikāravaśānubaddhāḥ sthāpitāḥ | sarvajñāśca te, 
amoghaśaktayaśca ta iti samāsaḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


adhikārakṣaye śāntā jāyante sarvagāḥ śivāḥ | 


śāntā nivṛttamahāmāyākṛtatāvanmantrākhyāḥ, tathā 
vyāpakaśivaikīrūpā bhavantītyarthaḥ || 

itthaṃ ca ---- 


parapreryāḥ punarbhūyo na bhavanti kadācana || 10-1213 || 


mahāsaṃsārataḥ sadāśivānte viśvatra śūnyātiśūnyapadamāpte 
ye'viditatattvāste mahāsṛṣṭau bhūyaḥ sṛjyante, yathaikādaśe 
darśayiṣyate | ete tu bhagavanto mucyanta eveti punaḥśabdasyārthaḥ || 
upasaṃharati ---- 


suśivāvaraṇaṃ khyātaṃ mantragarbhaṃ varānane | 


mantrā āsanagatā āvaraṇagatāśca garbhe yasya tadetat suśivasya 
sadāśivabhaṭṭārakasya sambandhi āvaraṇaṃ bhuvanamityarthaḥ | atha ca 
paripūrṇajñānaśālivyatirekeṇānyeṣāṃ parapadāvārakatvādeva 
tānyāvaraṇānītyucyante || 

atha ---- 


bindvāvaraṇamūrdhve'taścandrakoṭisamaprabham || 10-1214 || 


bindutattvasthānavyāptirūpamāvaraṇaṃ bindvāvaraṇam || 1214 || 


tatra padmaṃ mahādīptaṃ daśakoṭisamanvitam | 

tatra padme sthito devaḥ śāntyatīto mahādyutiḥ || 10-1215 || 

pañcavaktro viśālākṣo daśabāhustrilocanaḥ | 

taḍitsahasrapuñjābhaḥ sphuranmāṇikyamaṇḍitaḥ || 10-1216 || 


aśeṣaṃ yadviśvam, tadiha 
prāptamahāvikāsadīptiyogotkṛṣṭatvānmāṇikyam || 1216 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


nivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā ca vidyā śāntistathaiva ca | 

parivāraḥ smṛtastasya śāntyatītasya suvrate || 10-1217 || 


prāguktaṃ kalācatuṣṭayamevāśeṣaviśvādhvagarbhaṃ paraśaktirūpatayā 
sthitamasya devasya parivāraḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


tasya vāme tu digbhāge śāntyatītā vyavasthitā | 


etāśca ---- 


pañcavaktrā smṛtā sarvā daśabāhvinduśekharāḥ || 10-1218 || 


tadevam ---- 


bindutattvaṃ samākhyātaṃ purakoṭyarbudairvṛtam | 


mantramantreśatadīśaparivārasambandhibhiḥ | eṣa ca śāntyatīta 
īśvarabhaṭṭārakaparavyāptirūpaḥ | yadvakṣyati | 

"ābhiḥ kalābhiḥ saṃyukto dhyātavyo bindurīśvaraḥ" (12 | 157)

iti | yojanikāgranthe'pyuktam ---- 

"binduścaiveśvaraḥ svayam" (4 | 264)

iti asmin hyadhvani sthūlasūkṣmādibhedena mantradevatādīnāṃ 
sthitirityuktaprāyam || 

etadbindvāvaraṇamuktvā'rdhacandrādyāvaraṇamapyāha ---- 


ardhacandrastadūrdhve tu tadūrdhve tu nirodhikā || 10-1219 || 


atra bhuvanānyāha ---- 


ete dve tu mahāsthāne pañcapañcakalānvite | 


kalā devatāḥ ---- 

tatra ---- 


jyotsnā jyotsnāvatī kāntiḥ suprabhā vimalā śivā || 10-1220 || 

ardhacandre sthitā hyetā nirodhinyāṃ śṛṇu priye | 

rundhanī rodhanī raudrī jñānabodhā tamopahā || 10-1221 || 


vimalāyā viśeṣaṇaṃ śiveti | ardhacandrapadasya 
prakāśāhlādaprakarṣāttacchaktīnāṃ tathocitanāmāni | 
nirodhinīpadasyāpi nirodhahetutvādrundhanī rodhanī raudrīti tisraḥ 
śaktayaḥ | prabuddhānāṃ tu nirodhanivṛttau jñānabodhā tamopaheti 
śaktidvayamūrdhvapraveśadātṛtvādevamabhidhānam || 1221 || 

atra pūrvoktaṃ mātrāvibhāgaṃ smārayati ---- 


ardhamātraḥ smṛto binduḥ kharūpaśca catuṣkalaḥ | 

tasyāpyardhamardhacandrastvaṣṭāṃśaśca nirodhikā || 10-1222 || 


"hrasvaṃ dīrghaṃ plutaṃ sūkṣmamatisūkṣmam" (6 | 4)

ityetadgranthanirṇayāvasara evaitannirṇītaṃ yathā yāvadyāvanmantroccāra 
ūrdhvordhvaṃ padamāśrayati, tāvattāvadvācyavācakagatā sthūlarūpatā 
nivartate, sūkṣmasūkṣmatarādirūpatā cābhivyajyamānā 
viśrāntiprakarṣaṃ dadāti yāvadunmanāparatattvātmani paryante 
sarvopādhipraśāntyā cidānandaghanasvacchandabhairavarūpāveśo bhavatīti 
| tadeveha parameśvareṇa smāritaṃ tathā bhuvanaśuddhyavasare 
sūkṣmatarasūkṣmatamādirūpā māntrī vyāptiranusaraṇīyā gurubhiḥ | 
evamuttaratrāpi svayamanusartavyam || 1222 || 

nirodhinyāḥ svarūpaṃ nirvakti ---- 


nirodhayati devān sā brahmādyāṃstu varānane | 


kā tu kathā sāmānyajantūnām || 

yata evam, tenaiṣā ---- 


nirodhinīti vikhyātā...........


ataśca pūrvoktakaraṇabandhavyāptyanusaraṇapuraḥsaramantroccārayuktyā ---
- 


..........ṭāṃ bhittvā tu varānane || 10-1223 || 

sādākhyaparabhāvena pañcamantramahātanuḥ | 


labhyata iti śeṣaḥ | sādākhyadeva ityarthaḥ | parabhāveneti prāgukto 
yaḥ, sa evānena sūkṣmeṇa rūpeṇetyarthaḥ || 

tasya sthānaṃ rūpaṃ ca nirūpayati ---- 


tasyordhve tu smṛto nādaḥ sa kiñjalkarajaḥprabhaḥ || 10-1224 || 

mahadbhiḥ puruṣairvyāptaḥ sūryakoṭyayutaprabhaiḥ | 


tasyeti nirodhikāvaraṇasya | nāda iti 
samastavācakābhedamayaparāmarśasatattvaḥ śrīsadāśiva eva pararūpaḥ | 
kiñjalkarajaḥprabha iti dīptyatiśayayuktaḥ | mahadbhi puruṣairiti 
mantramaheśvarabhūmeḥ prabhṛtyuttarottaraṃ tāratamyena sthitaiḥ || 

kiṃ cātra ---- 


teṣāṃ vai nāyikā vakṣye bhuvane pañcasaṅkhyayā || 10-1225 || 


teṣāṃ mahatāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ madhye nāyikāḥ pradhānabhūtā devatāḥ | 
bhuvana ityasmin nādāvaraṇaṃ gate bhuvanapañcaka ityarthaḥ || 1225 || 
tā āha ---- 


indhikā dīpikā caiva rocikā mocikā tathā | 

ūrdhvagā tu samākhyātā kalā tveṣā tu pañcamī || 10-1226 || 


dīptyatiśayādāsāmīdṛṃśināmāni | pañcamītyetāsāṃ madhye 
pradhānabhūtā || 1226 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


tasmin padmaṃ suvistīrṇaṃ...........


tasminnityūrdhvagaśaktidhāmni | suvistīrṇamiti prakṛtāpekṣayā || 

tatra ca ---- 


............ūrdhvageśaḥ sthitaḥ prabhuḥ | 


ūrdhvagākhyāyā nādāntātmanaḥ śakterīśo'dhiṣṭhātā || 

sa ca ---- 


candrārbudapratīkāśaḥ pañcavaktrastrilocanaḥ || 10-1227 || 

candrārdhaśekharaḥ śānto daśabāhurmahātanuḥ | 

indhikādivṛto devaḥ śūlapāṇirjaṭādharaḥ || 10-1228 || 


śānta iti nādaparyantaviśvopaśamāt | jaṭādharatvādikaṃ prāgvat || 
1228 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


ūrdhvagā tu kalā tasya nityamutsaṅgagāminī | 


iyadantā sadāśivatattvasya vyāptiḥ | evamatra sādāśive tattve 
suśivabindvardhacandranirodhikānādanādāntarūpāṇi pañcāvaraṇāni | 
tatra suśivāvaraṇe sadāśivaḥ, vaktrāṅgaikādaśikā, sakalādyaṣṭakam, 
oṅkārādiśivadaśakam, vijayādirudrāṣṭādaśakamiti śrīsadāśivena 
sahāvaraṇadevatā aṣṭacatvāriṃśat | āsanapadmagatāstu vāmādyā nava, 
viśvādyā nava, tārādyā aṣṭātriṃśaditi ṣaṭpañcāśat, jñānakriye 
pārśvagate, icchā utsaṅgastheti saptottaraśatamatra devatānām | 
bindvāvaraṇe śāntyatīteśaḥ, śāntyatītā, nivṛttyādyāścatasra iti 
ṣaḍ devatāḥ | ardhacandrāvaraṇe tu jyotsnādiśaktipañcakam | 
nirodhinyāṃ rundhanyādiśaktipañcakam | tato nādabhaṭṭārakaḥ | tato 
nādāntapade indhikādyāścatasra ūrdhvageśvara ūrdhvagā ceti ṣaṭ | 
evamatra sadāśivatattve satriṃśacchataṃ devatānām || 

atha śaktitattve bhuvaneśānādiśati ---- 


tataḥ suṣumṇābhuvanaṃ suṣumṇā tatra saṃsthitā || 1229 || 


suṣumṇākhyā devatā, yadadhiṣṭhānānmadhyanāḍī suṣumṇetyucyate || 
1229 || 

na cāsāveva sthitā, api tu tatprabhuḥ ---- 


suṣumṇeśaḥ sthitastatra candrakoṭyayutaprabhaḥ | 

daśabāhustrinetraśca śvetapadmoparisthitaḥ || 10-1230 || 

śaśāṅkaśekharaḥ śrīmān pañcavaktro mahātanuḥ | 


kiṃ ca ---- 


iḍā ca piṅgalā caiva vāmadakṣiṇataḥ sthite || 10-1231 || 

suṣumṇā tu varārohe tuṣārakaṇadhūsarā | 

śvetapadmakarā devī padmamālāvibhūṣitā || 10-1232 || 

pañcavaktrā suśobhāḍhyā trinetrā śūladhāriṇī | 

tasyotsaṅgagatā devī dhyātavyā sādhakādibhiḥ || 10-1233 || 


tuṣāradhūsarā tviti tuśabdād iḍāpiṅgale śyāmalohite iti 
tantrāntarājjñātavyam || 1233 || 

eṣā suṣumṇā viśvavyāpinītyāha ---- 

grathitastu tayā sarvastvadhvāyamadhaūrdhvagaḥ | grathita umbhito vyāptaḥ, 
adhaḥ anantāntaḥ, ūrdhve śivatattvāntaḥ | sarvo'dhveti śārīro 
bāhyaśca || 

ataśca viśvavyāpakasuṣumṇādiśaktibhittimāśrito 
nādastadadhaḥprasaraṇamārgeṇādhastanaṃ sarvamadhvānamadhiṣṭhitaṃ 
mūlabhūtaṃ ūrdhvaprasaraṇena vibhidya, nādāntabhūmimāruhya, 
brahmabilātmani śaktitattve līyate ---- ityāha ----  nāḍyādhārastu nādo 
vai bhittvā sarvamidaṃ jagat || 1234 || 


adhaḥśaktyā vinirgatya yāvadbrahmāṇamūrdhvataḥ | 

nāḍyā brahmabile līnastvavyaktadhvanirakṣaraḥ || 10-1235 || 

nadate sarvabhūteṣu śivaśaktyā tvadhiṣṭhitaḥ | 


nāḍiḥ suṣumṇā ādhāro yasya | bhittvetyatra karaṇam, adha 
ityudayasthānādutthitā krameṇārohantī śaktiḥ | ūrdhvata 
ityūrdhvaśaktyā pūrvoktaprayogataḥ spaṣṭībhūtayā, brahmabilāntaṃ 
nirgatya tatraiva tayā nāḍyā saha līnaḥ śliṣṭo bhavati | sāpi hi 
nāḍī tadanteti tatraiva śliṣṭā śaktidvayayogācca nādasyānackasya 
dvikubjarūpatvāt | sa ca nādaḥ ---- 

ṅādākhyaṃ yatparaṃ bījaṃ sarvabhūteṣvavasthitam" (kālo0 1-5)

ityāmnāyāntaroktanītyā sarvabhūteṣvavyaktadhvanirūpaḥ, ata 
evākṣaro'vicalatsvarūpo nadan vakṣyamāṇaghoṣādiparāmarśamayatvena 
sthitaḥ | yadyapi brahmabilalīna ityuktastathāpi layo'sya 
sūkṣmatararūpeṇa śaktisphurattātmanā'vasthānamata eva śivaśaktyā 
tvadhiṣṭhita ityuktam, na tvatyantaṃ nāśa ityakṣara ityucitaivoktiḥ || 

yata evaṃvidhā nādasya vyāptirataḥ ---- 


evaṃ jñātvā varārohe śodhayettaṃ śivādhvare || 10-1236 || 

tato brahmabilaṃ jñeyaṃ rudrakoṭyarbudānvitam | 

tatra brahmā paro jñeyaḥ śaśāṅkaśatasaprabhaḥ || 10-1237 || 

daśabāhustrinetraśca pañcavaktrenduśekharaḥ | 

triśūlapāṇirbhagavān jaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitaḥ || 10-1238 || 


brahmabilaṃ nāmāvaraṇamantariva bahirbhuvanāśrayatvenāpi sthitam | 
yadyapi sārdhāstisraḥ koṭyo mantrāṇāmuktāstathāpi 
tatparivārasyāsaṅkhyatvādatrāpi ca teṣāṃ sūkṣmatamena 
rūpeṇāvasthitatvādrudrakoṭyarbudānvitamityuktam | para iti 
prāguktādbrahmāṇḍagatāt sthūlād buddhitattvagatācca 
sūkṣmādutkṛṣṭaḥ, ata eva śāktatvādayaṃ sito daśabāhvādirūpaśca 
|| 1238 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


brahmāṇī tu parā śaktiryā sā mokṣapathe sthitā | 

dvāraṃ yā mokṣamārgasya rodhayitvā vyavasthitā || 10-1239 || 

mokṣamārgapradātrī ca brahmotsaṅge ca saṃsthitā | 


paretyarthāt | mokṣapathe ---- 

"śaivī mukhamihocyate |" (vi0bhai0 20)

iti sthityordhvonmukhaśaktimārge | ataścājñāninaḥ prati tadeva 
śaktipathātmakaṃ mokṣadvāramīśvarecchayā rundhānā sthitā | 
jñāninaḥ prati mokṣamārga pradadāti tacchīlā || 

yato brahmāṇī evaṃvidhā, ataḥ proktamantroccārakrameṇa ---- 


tāṃ bhittvātra varārohe gantavyamūrdhvataḥ priye || 10-1240 || 


atreti śaktitattve yadūrdhvaṃ śaktivyāpinīsamanādhāma, tatretyarthaḥ || 
1240 || 

atha ---- 


ata ūrdhvaṃ sthitā śaktiḥ prasuptabhujagākṛtiḥ | 

ādhāro bhuvanānāṃ sā tāṃ pravakṣyāmi suvrate || 10-1241 || 


śaktiriti śaktitattvagataśaktyāvaraṇam | sā ca prasuptabhujagasyeva 
ākṛtiryasyā ityanena 
brahmabilāntamaśeṣamāntaramunmiṣitarūpatvādviṣamūchītamiva kṛtvā 
niḥspandarūpakuṇḍalākāratayā sthitā | sā cāntareṇa krameṇa 
brahmarandhropari tvagbhūmikāṃ niviṣṭā | ādhāra iyamevādha ūrdhvaṃ ca 
vyāpya viśvaṃ dhārayantī ādhāraśaktirityarthaḥ | tāṃ pravakṣyāmīti 
tatrasthāni bhuvanānyadhiṣṭhātṛdevatādvāreṇa vacmītyarthaḥ || 1241 || 

tatra ---- 


sūkṣmā caiva susūkṣmā ca tathā cānyāmṛtāmitā | 


śaktibhūmeḥ sūkṣmatvāhlādakatvāparicchinnatvayogāttaddevatānāṃ 
tādṛṃśyeva nāmāni || 

etāsāṃ ca ---- 


vyāpinī madhyato jñeyā...........


etā eva tu ---- 


..........śeṣāḥ pūrvāditaḥ kramāt || 10-1242 || 


sarvāśca etāḥ ---- 


pañcavaktrāstrinetrāśca sutejaskā mahābalāḥ | 


tadittham ---- 


śaktitattvaṃ samākhyātaṃ................


atra ca sauṣumṇāvaraṇe suṣumṇā, tadīśvaraḥ, iḍāpiṅgale catasro 
devatāḥ, brahmabilāvaraṇe brahmā brahmāṇīti dve, śaktyāvaraṇe 
sūkṣmādidevatāpañcakamityekādaśa śaktitattve devatāḥ || 

yacca prāgasphuṭedantāhantāsāmānādhikaraṇyābhāsāt sadāśivatattvaṃ 
jñānaśaktipradhānamuktam, tat tadāsūtrakecchāśaktipradhānaṃ 
śaktitattvaṃ vinā na ghaṭate | nahi 
kiñciducchūnatārūpāntarāsūtraṇāṃ vinā kasyāpyudaya iti 
sadāśivatattvasya bhittibhūtaṃ śaktitattvamuktam | tadapi śaktirūpatvāt 
svāśrayamapekṣata iti iyataḥ śaktitattvāntasya viśvasya 
yadāśrayastacchivatattvamuktam | tacca śaktyantādhvottīrṇam, 
tadārohakrameṇaiva prāpyamitthaṃ copalabhyatāṃ nātikrāmatīti 
tatrāpyatisusūkṣmatayā bhuvanasthitiṃ vaktumāha ---- 


.........śivatattvaṃ śṛṇu priye || 10-1243 || 

puraśreṣṭhairanekaistu samantāt parivāritam | 

hemaprākāraracitaṃ ratnamāṇikyamaṇḍitam || 10-1244 || 

aśeṣabhogasampannaṃ sarvakāmaguṇodayam | 


dhārādhirūḍhe'trāpi śivatattve hemaprākārādivyavasthetyaho 
batākhyātermahimā | evaṃ cābhidadhadiyatparyantātisusūkṣmasthityā 
pṛthivyādīnāṃ vyāptiriti cidānandecchājñānakriyākhyameva 
śaktipañcakaṃ guṇapradhānatādyābhāsanavaicitryeṇa 
saptapañcakatattvābhāsarūpatayā 
yathottaramāśyānībhāvaprakarṣādbhūtapañcakāntena rūpeṇa sphurati | 
bhūtapañcakamapi yathordhvaṃ sūkṣmasūkṣmatarādyābhāsavaicitryeṇa 
proktaśaktipañcakātmakena galitāśyānībhāvātmanā pūrṇena rūpeṇa 
vikasatīti pañcaśaktisāmarasyamayaṃ paramaśivatattvameva ittham ---- 

śthūlasūkṣmasvarūpeṇa tadekaṃ saṃvyavasthitam" (4-295)

ityuktayuktyā viśvātmanā'vasthitam | atastatra tatra pade śivarūpatayā 
viśvāvabhāsavattve'pi tathānavabhāsātmakānabandhavinivartanaṃ 
dīkṣājñānakrameṇa kriyata iti śikṣayati parameśvaraḥ | 
sarvakāmaguṇodayamiti sarveṣāmatyuttamabhogarūpāṇāṃ kāmānāṃ 
guṇānāṃ ca sarvajñatvādīnāmudayo yatra yataśceti yojyam || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


bhuvanāni pravakṣyāmi tatraiva saṃsthitāni tu || 1245 || 


tāni cādhiṣṭhātṛmukhenāha ---- 


vyāpakaṃ vyomarūpaṃ ca anantānāthanāśrita1m | 

kāraṇānāṃ pañcakaṃ ca śivatattve vyavasthitam || 10-1246 || 


ananteti trayasya samāhāraḥ || 1246 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


tatra padmaṃ suvistīrṇamanantānantasambhavam | 


suvistīrṇaṃ proktasarvapadmāpekṣayā | 
samanantaraproktānantādityetadāvaraṇāt 
prabhṛtyanantasyāśeṣaviśvasyānantamadhyānantāntasya sambhavo yataḥ | 
ata eva prāg (1 | 38) anantāsanamityanantādyanantam 
adhyānantāntamāsanamanantāsanamityasmābhirvyākārīti yuktamutpaśyāmaḥ 
|| 


tasya padmasya madhyastho devaścāyamanāśritaḥ || 10-1247 || 


devī dyotanādirūpaḥ, na kiñcidbhuvanādhvavatī samāśrito'pi tu 
sarvairbhuvaneśairāśritaḥ || 

sa ca ---- 


pañcavaktradharaḥ śāntaḥ sarvajñaḥ parameśvaraḥ | 

daśabāhurmahādīptaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ || 10-1248 || 

sarvānugrahakartā ca praṇatātīvināśanaḥ | 

bhuktimuktipradātā ca sūryakoṭyarbudaprabhaḥ || 10-1249 || 

sphuranmukuṭamāṇikyaḥ samantādupaśobhitaḥ | 

divyāmbaradharo devo divyagandhānulepanaḥ || 10-1250 || 

padmāsanonnatoraskaḥ śaśāṅkakṛtaśekharaḥ | 

ābaddhamaṇiparyaṃkaścāmarotkṣepavījitaḥ || 10-1251 || 

rudrakoṭyarbudānīkaiḥ samantādupaśobhitaḥ | 


śānta iti śaktyāvaraṇaparyantagatasya bhedasaṃskārasyāpi praśamāt | 
pañcavaktrāditvaṃ prāgvat | sṛṣṭisaṃhārau 
sthitivilayāvapyupalakṣayataḥ | sarveti yasya yasyānugraha āyāti, tata eva 
praṇatātīvināśana iti | etat prāgvat sādhakābhiprāyeṇa | etadeva 
bhuktimuktītyuktyā vyaktīkṛtam | unnatorasko mahotsāhaḥ || 

kiṃ cātra ---- 


vyāpinī vyomarūpā cānantānāthā tvanāśritā || 10-1252 || 

pañcavaktrā mahāvīryā daśabāhvinduśekharāḥ | 

trinetrāḥ śūlahastāśca kāraṇaiśca samanvitāḥ || 10-1253 || 

pūrvādyuttaraparyantā etāścaiva vyavasthitāḥ | 


kāraṇairityetaireva vyāpinīprabhṛtibhiḥ samyaganvitāstadabhinnā 
ityarthaḥ | etā ityanāthāntāścatasraḥ || 

pañcamyāḥ sthitimāha ---- 


anāśrito madhyagastu saṃsthitaḥ prabhuravyayaḥ || 10-1254 || 

anāśritakalā devī tasyotsaṅge ca saṃsthitā | 


evamācakṣāṇasyāyamāśayo yacchaktisambandhādeva sarve 
śaktimantastattatsvakāryaṃ sampādayanti, ataśca paramaśivapadamapi 
prasphuracchaktisphārarasamevehopeyam, na tu śāntāśeṣaśaktikam | yastu 
śāntavyapadeśo'tra, sa bhedapraśamāditi || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


evaṃ vai śivatattvaṃ tu kathitaṃ tava sundari || 10-1255 || 


tadetat ---- 


śodhayitvā tataścordhvaṃ śaktiścaiva parā smṛtā | 

samanā nāma sā jñeyā...........


tataḥ śivatattvādūrdhvaṃ 
tvakśeṣasthavyāpinīpadāvasthitānāśritabhaṭṭārakāpekṣayā 
tatpadaviśrāntyā jñātavyā | eṣā ca saha manasā susūkṣmatamena 
saṃvedanena vartate, na tu saṃvidi tribhūmikāmāpteti kṛtvā samanā | 
yaduktaṃ prāk ---- 

śaṅkalpaḥ kramato jñānaṃ"1 (4-394) iti || 

ata ūrdhvaṃ mananavyāpāro nāstītyāha ---- 


..............ṃanaścordhvaṃ na jāyate || 10-1256 || 


eṣā ca samanā ---- 


paripāṭyā sthitānāṃ tu pṛthivyādiśivāvadhau | 

sarveṣāṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca kartṛbhūtā vyavasthitā || 10-1257 || 


sarveṣāmityanantādyanāśritāntānām || 1257 || 

ataśceyam ---- 


bibhartyaṇḍānyanekāni śivena samadhiṣṭhitā | 


"pṛthagdvayamasaṅkhyātamekamekaṃ pṛthagdvayam" (2-50)

iti śrīmālinīvijayoktanītyā 
brahmāṇḍaprakṛtyaṇḍātmakamaṇḍadvayamasaṃkhyātam, 
māyāṇḍaśaktyaṇḍadvayaṃ tvekaikarūpamiti kṛtvaiṣā 
śaktiranekānyaṇḍānyantaḥkṛtvā sthiteti 
tacchāstraprakriyāpyatrorarīkṛtaiva || 

śaktitvādeva caiṣā śivena samyagabhedavyāptyā'dhiṣṭhiteti yaduktam, 
tat sphuṭayati bhāvipaṭalārthaikīkārayuktyā ---- 


tatrārūḍhastu kurute śivaḥ paramakāraṇam || 10-1258 || 

sṛṣṭisthitisamāhāraṃ tirobhāvamanugraham | 


ārūḍha ityaśeṣaviśvabhāvāsūtraṇena 
bhittikalpamananamātrātmakaitacchaktibhūmikāṃ svāmullāsyetyarthaḥ | 
paramakāraṇamiti paramaśivaḥ || 

sa hi ---- 


hetukartā maheśānaḥ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam || 10-1259 || 


sarveṣāṃ brahmādyanāśritāntānāṃ pṛthivyādibījāntānāmapi tenaiva 
tattadbhūmikāgrahaṇāt tathāvabhāsitānāṃ kāraṇānāṃ kāraṇaṃ 
svātantryāt svabhittāvullāsaka ityarthaḥ | tathā mahānīśvarasteṣāṃ 
tattaducitavibhavapradatvena sarvātiśāyī | karteti svatantraḥ | heturiti 
teṣāmeva sve sve karmaṇi yojanapravartakaṃ nimittam || 1259 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


samanā nāma yā śaktiḥ sā tasya karaṇaṃ smṛtam | 


svaśaktyaiva viśvamābhāsayatītyarthaḥ || 


yataḥ ---- 


tayādhitiṣṭhed deveśo hyadhaḥkāraṇapañcakam || 10-1260 || 


tayā svamananaśaktyā'nāśritādivyāpyantaṃ 
sadāśivādyaśeṣakāraṇatvāt kāraṇapañcakamadhitiṣṭhet 
tadanuprāṇanatayā svakāryasāmarthyayuktaṃ kuryāt | tathā ca śiva eva 
pararūpo'nāśritādirūpatāṃ gṛhṇāti | tathā tadīyā parā 
śaktirapyanāśritādiśaktirūpatayā sphurati || 1260 || 

tatra tatkāraṇapañcakamadhyāt pradhānabhūtasya ---- 


anāśritasya devasya kāraṇaṃ seyamāśritā | 


parameśvareṇa svaśaktyā''bhāsyamāno'nāśritabhaṭṭārakādiḥ 
parigrahavatīsvasvaśaktisahita eva ābhāsyate | atastā eva 
devyo'nāśritādīnāṃ svakāryakāraṇatāṃ bhajante || 

taccaitacchaktiyuktaḥ ---- 


sa vai prerayate bhūyastvanāthaṃ tu jagatpatim || 10-1261 || 


bhūya ityasyedamākūtaṃ yatparamaśiva eva gṛhītānāśritabhūmiko 
dvitīyāmimāṃ preraṇāṃ karoti || 1261 || 

itthameva ca ---- 


anāthaścāpyananteśamananto vyomarūpiṇam | 

vyomavyāpī mahādevo vyāpinaṃ bodhayet prabhum || 10-1262 || 


ete ca proktasvaśaktisahitā eva prerakāḥ preryāśca || 1262 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


vyāpinī karaṇaṃ tasya kartā vai vyāpyasau prabhuḥ | 


kartṛtvametadīyaṃ karmapradarśanenābhivyanakti ---- 


karmarūpā sthitā māyā yadadhaḥ śaktikuṇḍalī || 10-1263 || 


pūrvoktakuṇḍalākāratayā'śeṣaviśvagarbhā śaktiḥ śaktikuṇḍalinī | 
māyetyaśeṣāsūtraṇādetadantotthāpanabhittibhūtatvānmahāmāyārūpā | 
kuṇḍalīti cchāndasatvāt | yad yasmād etadīyakriyāśaktivyāpakatvāt 
karmarūpā sthitā teṣāṃ bhagavānetadābhāsakatvena kartā san 
karmībhūtaḥ | yathoktaṃ pratyabhijñāyām ---- 

"ātmānamata evāyaṃ jñeyīkuryāt pṛthaksthitiḥ | 

jñeyaṃ na tu tadaunmukhyāt khaṇḍyetāsya svatantratā |" (1-5-15)

iti | tathā ---- 

"kartṛkarmatvatattvaiva kāryakāraṇatā tataḥ" (2-4-2) iti | 

spande'pi ---- 

"avasthāyugalaṃ cātra kāryakartṛtvaśabditam" (1-4)

iti || 1263 || 

na kevalamasau mahāmāyātmā śaktistasya karmatayā sthitayā, yāvat 
tadantargataṃ tadullāsyaṃ ca ---- 


nādabindvātmakaṃ kāryam...........


etaccānantarapaṭale krameṇa vyaktīkariṣyati || 

ataścāsmād vyāpibhaṭṭārakād paramaśivādhiṣṭhitāt ---- 


..............ityādijagadudbhavaḥ | 


mahāmāyādibhūmyantaparasūkṣmasthūlavācyavācakātmakāśeṣa-
viśvodbhavaḥ | eṣa eva bhagavāṃstadābhāsātmanā sphuratītyarthaḥ | 
yata evaṃ samanābhūmimāśritya parameśvaraḥ parasūkṣmasthūlarūpaṃ 
viśvamābhāsayati, ata evābhāsyamānam ---- 


yat sadāśivaparyantaṃ pāthīvādyaṃ ca suvrate || 10-1264 || 

tatsarvaṃ prākṛtaṃ jñeyaṃ vināśotpattisaṃyutam | 


sadāśivo'tra pararūpo'nāśritabhaṭṭārakaḥ | sūkṣmadṛṣṭyā 
prakṛtevīśvakāraṇāt samanāta āyātaṃ prākṛtam, sthūladṛṣṭyā tu 
sadāśivatattvāt prabhṛti kṣityantā catustriṃśatsaṅkhyā 
tattvaprasṛtiḥ | prakṛteḥ śaktitattvāt śivatattvābhedabhāja āyātīti 
| atra dvividho vyākhyākramaḥ prasiddhaḥ | tatra ādya eva jyāyān, 
bhāvipaṭale'nāśritasyāpi sṛṣṭisaṃhārāghrātatvābhidhānāt | etacca 
vināśotpattimajjñeyaṃ na punaratrādhārapade viśramitavyam, atha ca 
jñeyaṃ jñeyamānatayaiva jñānopārohaparajñānaikātmyāpattiyuktyā 
vilāyyamityarthaḥ | utpattivināśeti vaktavye viparyayapāṭhaḥ 
sṛṣṭisaṃhāraparamparāyā anāditvapratipādanaparaḥ || 

evaṃ samanāntamadhvānamuktvā pūrvopakrāntaṃ dīkṣāvidhimeva smārayati 
---- 


yā sā śaktiḥ purā proktā samanā tvadhvamūrdhani || 10-1265 || 

sphuratsūryasahasrābhakiraṇānantabhāsvarā | 

dhyātvā caitāṃ samāvāhya sthāpayettu vidhānavit || 10-1266 || 

upacāraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā vāgīśyāvāhanaṃ tathā | 

sthāpanaṃ pūjanaṃ caiva paśoryāgaṃ tathaiva ca || 10-1267 || 

garbhadhāritvajanane adhikāraṃ tathaiva ca | 

yogaṃ bhogaṃ layaṃ caiva niṣkṛtiṃ tadanantaram || 10-1268 || 

bhuvanādhipahomaṃ ca bhuvanādhipavāsinām | 

bhuvanānāṃ yathāyogaṃ homaṃ kṛtvā varānane || 10-1269 || 

tritattvaṃ śodhayeccāto'vayavāṃśca yathākramam | 


sphuradityādinaitadāha ---- yathā viśvamatrāsūtritakalpaṃ 
prabhāmātrarūpavyatiriktaśaktyātmakamiti | "yā sā" ityatra "māyā" iti 
kecit paṭhanti | etāmiti śivatattvādhiṣṭhātṛśivabhaṭṭārakātmikām | 
āvāhanādiḥ pūrvoktakramāt | upacāraḥ pūjā | vāgīśyā āvāhanamatra 
parasvarūpāyāḥ | vāgīśīsthāpanapūjanānantaraṃ 
śiṣyaprokṣaṇatāḍana-taddhṛtpraveśa-taccaitanyākarṣa-
tadgrahaṇādipūrvaṃ vāgīśīgarbhe taccaitanyasya yogaḥ | 
garbhadhāritvametatpadocitamahāmantramayataucityena | bhuvanānāṃ ye 
bhuvanādhipāḥ pradhānabhūtāsteṣāṃ homaṃ kṛtvā, ye'nye 
tatpradhānabhuvanāpekṣayā 
bhuvanāntaravāsinastattattvagatāvāntarabhuvananiṣṭhā rudrāsteṣāmapi | 
yathāyogamiti saṃkṣiptadīkṣāyāmantarbhāvabhāvanayuktyā, anyatra tu 
pṛthag homaṃ kṛtvā śrāvaṇādi kāryam | yadyapi 
samanāntargatavyāpinīpade vyāpyādipañcakātiriktāni bhuvaneśāntarāṇi 
na santi, tathāpyasya vidheḥ sarvaśeṣatvādevamuktam | 
paścādātmavidyāśivākhyaṃ tattvatrayaṃ śodhayediti 
śārīravācikamānasaśuddhdhyarthaṃ pūrvoktahomakrameṇa śuddhaṃ 
sampādayet | evaṃ hyācāryo'smiñ chivayāge 
śarīrādivyāpārāviṣṭaśuddhatattvamaya eva bhavatīti darśayati | 
avayavāṃścetyetattattvatrayāntarvatītvād māyāntasadāśivāntāni 
tattvānyevāvayavānetadantarbhāvayuktyaiva homakarmaṇā śodhayet | 
yathoktaṃ purastāt ---- 

"ātmatattvavibhāgena dhāmnā vai juhuyācchatam || 

saśabdoccārayogena ātmatattve tu homayet | 

māyātattvāvadhi jñeyaṃ daiśikena śivādhvare || 

vidhivaikalyakarmārthaṃ prāyaścittaviśuddhaye |" (4-210-212)

ityādi || 

atra ca madhye niṣkṛtyanantaram ---- 


viśleṣapāśacchedau ca kṛtvā pūrṇāṃ tu pātayet || 10-1270 || 


taduktaṃ prāk ---- 

"viśleṣo niṣkṛterbhogāt" (4-126)

ityādi | atra ca pāśacchedānantaraṃ taddhomacaitanyaikabhāvanāpūrvaṃ 
śivena pūrṇāhutiḥ || 1270 || 

tatastaccaitanyasyoddhārātmasthīkāra-tatsthīkārān kṛtvā 
vyāpyādibhuvaneśvarāhvānatatpūjana-purryaṣṭakāṃśārpaṇa-śrāvaṇā-
visarjanādiḥ kṛtvā prāyaścittahomastritattvayuktyā kartavya iti | 
īdṛśaṃ kramaṃ leśataḥ smārayati ---- 


prāyaścittaṃ tato hutvā.........


tataḥ kiṃ kartavyamityāha ---- 


....kartarīmabhimantrayet | 


tayā ca ---- 


śikhāṃ chitvā.........


pūrvoktabhāvanāmantrādikrameṇa ---- 


....ṣamarpyaitāṃ.....


kasyaciddhaste ---- 


..............śiśuṃ saṃsnāpayed guruḥ || 10-1271 || 


snānāya ādiśet | evamihāpi śikhācchedavidhevīśeṣācodanād yat 
ṭīkākārainīrbījadīkṣāviṣayatvaṃ prāgvyākhyātam tadasadeva 
mantavyam || 1271 || 

atha ---- 


ācāryaḥ prayato bhūtvā sakalīkaraṇādikam | 


kṛtvā ---- 


sruco'gre tu śikhāṃ kṛtvā hutvā snāyādanantaram || 10-1272 || 


tato'pi ---- 


sakalīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā ācāryastu varānane | 

śiśorapi vidhiṃ kṛtvā...........


prāgvanmantranyāsādirūpam || 


...........śivakumbhaṃ samarcayet || 10-1273 || 


tathā ---- 


bhairavaṃ madhyadeśasthaṃ...........


yāgasyetyarthāt || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


............bhairavāgniṃ samarcayet | 


ācāryaḥ pūjayet || 

tato bhagavantaṃ vijñāpya, pūrvoktayuktyā yojanikārtham ---- 


pūrṇāṃ sampūrya vidhivadvāmamantramanusmaran || 10-1274 || 

pūrvoktalakṣaṇenaiva proccarettaṃ prayatnataḥ | 


pūrvoktaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ 
yojanikoktasamastaprameyānusandhipūrvapūrṇāhutiprayogarūpam | taṃ mantram 
|| 

tadatra mantroccārāvasare ---- 


heyādhvānamadhaḥ kurvan recayettaṃ varānane || 10-1275 || 

yāvat sā samanā śaktiḥ.......


samanāntasya pāśatvāddheyādhvatvam | recayedityūrdhvena, ityarthāt || 

athopādeyādhvapraveśapramukhāṃ paratattvaviśrāntirūpāṃ yojanikāmāha 
---- 


.....ṭadūrdhve conmanā smṛtā | 


mano mananamātrarūpamapi tatra na kramate na sambhavati, api tu 
mantrarūpaiveyaṃ daśetyarthaḥ | ata evātra prāk ---- 

"vyāpāraṃ mānasaṃ tyaktvā bodharūpeṇa yojayet | 

tadā śivatattvamāyāti paśurmukto bhavārṇavāt ||" (4-437)

ityuktam || 

yataścātra mananaṃ na kramate, ata eva ---- 


nātra kālaḥ kalāścāro na tattvaṃ na ca devatāḥ || 10-1276 || 


kālaḥ kṣaṇādiparārdhāntaḥ | kalā nivṛttyādiśāntyatītāntāḥ | 
cāraḥ prāṇavāha | tattvaṃ tasya bhāva iti vyutpattyā 
tattadbhuvanāvabhāsapramātrādyanugatatattatsāmānyābhāsarūpam | devatā 
brahmādyanāśritāntāḥ || 1276 || 

kiṃ tarhīdam ---- 


sunirvāṇaṃ paraṃ śuddhaṃ guruvaktraṃ taducyate | 


guroḥ paramaśivasya vaktraṃ prāptyupāyaḥ | yaduktaṃ triśirobhairave ---- 

"gurorgurutarā śaktiḥ" iti || 

ataśca ---- 


tadatītaṃ varārohe paraṃ tattvamanāmayam || 10-1277 || 


tāmapyatītaṃ tadīyapāryantikaviśrāntirūpam, na punarasau 
samanāvadatikramaṇīyā bhavati, sunirvāṇamityabhidhānāt | varārohe iti 
prāgvat | paraṃ viśvotīrṇaṃ viśvamayatvāt pūrṇaṃ ca | tasya 
kṣityāderunmanāntasya sarvasya bhāvaścitprakāśamayaḥ svabhāva iti 
vyutpattyā tattvaṃ pāramāthīṃkaṃ svarūpam, na tu pṛthvītattvādivat 
kāṭhinyādivedyābhāsarūpam | anāmayamiti na vidyata āmayo'khyātiryatra 
tat | uktaṃ ca trikasāre ---- 


"bindunādātmakairdehaiḥ śāntaiśca śivasambhavaiḥ | 

atītastu bhaved devo nirañjanaḥ paraḥ śivaḥ ||" 

iti || 1277 || 


yata evamataḥ ---- 


guruvaktraprayogeṇa tasmin yojyeta śāśvate | 


niṣkampe kāraṇātīte viraje nirmale śubhe || 10-1278 || 

sarvajñe parame tattve vyomātīte hyatīndriye | 


guruvaktre unmanāyāṃ yaḥ prakṛṣṭayogaḥ ekātmyaṃ tena ---- 

"vyāpāraṃ mānasaṃ tyaktvā bodharūpeṇa yojayet" (4-437)

ityuktarūpeṇa tadanupraveśatadavaṣṭambhātmanā | yojyeteti svātmanā saha 
śiṣyātmā tatsāmarasyamāpyeta | yathoktam ---- 

"tasmin yuktaḥ pare tattve sārvajñyādiguṇānvitaḥ | 

śiva eko bhavennityamavibhāgena sarvaśaḥ ||" (4-402)

iti | śāśvate nityodite, ata eva niṣkampe sarvadā vyavahāradaśāsvapi 
vimalacidghanaikarūpe | kāraṇāni brahmādyanāśritānyatīte 
tadanubhavavilakṣaṇe'śeṣaviśvābhāsamaya ityarthaḥ | 
aśeṣaviśvaprakāśamapi caitanna tena viśvena manāgapyupahitam, tasya 
viśvasya tatprakāśaikarūpatvādityato virajaskatvānnirmale | ataśca śubhe 
paraśreyaḥsvabhāve | sarvaṃ ca tad jñaṃ ca taditi sarvajñaṃ, tasmin 
viśvādvayaprakāśarūpe parame tattve | vyomni 
śūnyātiśūnyapadasyāpyatītamatyayaḥ praśamo yatra tasmin | atīndriya 
iti sadā sarvasya sarvatra ca svaprakāśaikaparamārthe || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


ityadhvā caiṣa vai proktaḥ samāsena mayānaghe || 10-1279 || 


cakārāt tacchuddhiparikarmāpi | eṣa ityadhvāntaravyāpto bhuvanādhvā || 
1279 || 

na cāyaṃ dīkṣāyāṃ śodhanārthamevetthamuktaḥ, api tvetāvat 
samastaprameyakaraṇe parapramātrāveśamapi 
jñānaśālināmunmīlayatītyāha ---- 


jñātvā caivaṃ mahādevi prayāti paramaṃ padam | 


evamuktarūpamimadhvānaṃ yaḥ kaścit prameyatayā paricchinatti, sa parāṃ 
pramātṛtāmāviśati || 

ācārya punaḥ ---- 


dehe deve ca śiṣye ca kalaśe hyagnimadhyataḥ | 

evaṃ jñātvā varārohe mucyate mocayatyapi || 10-1280 || 


śākṣāt svadehasaṃstho'haṃ kartānugrahakarmaṇām" (mā0vi0 9-49)

ityuktvād ādau dehe vāstakā sarvādhvamayatāṃ jānīyāt, yena 
tāvadaśeṣādhvaśarīraḥ parabhairavāviṣṭo bhavati | tato 
devādāvadhikaraṇacatuṣṭaye svāhambhāvābhedaprathāṃ tathaiva jānan 
mucyate sarvātmakaparabhairavatāmeti, tathāvidhasvātmābhedena 
cānugrāhyānapi paśyan mocayati ---- 

"matsamatvaṃ gato janturmukta ityabhidhīyate" (mā0vi0 9-53)

iti sthityā parabhairavarūpāneva sampādayatīti śivam || 1280 || 

granthagranthivibhedanaṃ pratipadaṃ pūrvāparālocanaṃ
	tāttvī yuktirabhaṅgurāntarabahistattvaikyasandarśanam | 

samyaksaṅkalanāḥ pureśaviṣayāḥ pūrṇādvayāmarśanaṃ
	svācchande bhuvanādhvanīha tadiyatkiñcinmayā dyotitam || || 


iti śrīsvacchandatantre 
śrīmahāmāheśvarācāryavaryaśrīkṣemarājaviracitoddyotākhyavyākhyopete 
bhuvanādhvadīkṣāvidhirnāma daśamaḥ paṭalaḥ || 10 || 





ekādaśaḥ paṭalaḥ


" svacchandodyotaḥ "

svasvarūpātmaśaktyaiva svābhinnaṃ saṃsṛjan jagat | 

saṃharaṃśca jayatyekaḥ svacchando bodhabhairavaḥ || 


yaduktam ---- 

"atrārūḍhastu kurute śivaḥ paramakāraṇam | 

sṛṣṭi ................................ ||" (10-1258)


ityādi, tannirṇāyayiṣuḥ paṭalasaṅgatiṃ kurvatī śrīdevyuvāca ---- 


adhvāyaṃ tu mayā jñātastvatprasādāt surādhipa | 

jagatsṛṣṭistvayā deva sūcitā na tu vaṇītā || 11-1 || 


ayamiti bhuvanātmā | jagaditi dehagatabāhyagatatattvādhvarūpameva | 
sūciteti ---- 

ṅādabindvādikaṃ kāryamityādijagadudbhavaḥ" (10-1264) 

iti || 

ataśca tvam ---- 


adhvasṛṣṭiṃ mahādeva kathaya sva prasādataḥ | 


he mahādeva aśeṣaviśvaprabho dyotanādisatattva, sva ātman, 
prasādato'ntarnairmalyagamanāt tāttvikārthānigūhanenādhvanaḥ 
sṛṣṭimutpattiṃ kathaya | sṛṣṭimityupalakṣaṇaparam, 
sthitisaṃhārayorapyabhidhāsyamānatvāt || 

etannirṇayāya śrībhairava uvāca ---- 


yo'sau sūkṣmaḥ paro devaḥ kāraṇaṃ sarvagaḥ śivaḥ || 11-2 || 

nimittakāraṇaṃ so'tra kathitastava suvrate | 


yo'sāviti pratipāditaniḥsāmānyacidānandaghanaḥ, paraḥ sūkṣma 
ityantaḥkaraṇasyāpyagocaraḥ, devo dyotanādisatattvaḥ, kāryate svaśaktyā 
ābhāsyate'sminniti ca kāraṇaṃ tena svatantraḥ kartā svaśaktyaiva 
svabhittau sarvamābhāsayatītyarthaḥ | yadvakṣyati ---- 

śvatejasā varārohe" (11-4)

ityādi | yacca tadābhāsayati, na tad vyatiriktamityāha ---- sarvaga iti | 
sarvaṃ gacchati prāpnoti sarvātmatāṃ gṛhṇāti, atha ca tadgacchati, 
ābhāsayati, adhitiṣṭhati ca 
tāvadaśeṣavyāpakatadanācchāditasvaprakāśatayā | svaprakāśasyāsya 
siddhau na varākaṃ pramāṇamupayuktam, pratyuta etadāyattā 
pramāṇādivastusiddhiḥ | ataśca śiva unmalananimīlanādyavasthāsvapi 
śreyaḥsvabhāva eva ityevaṃbhūto yaḥ, so'tra jagati kartavye 
nimittakāraṇam | tava suvrate tadadvayasamāpattikāraṇabhūte, kathitaḥ, na 
tu vyāpakatvanityatvamātreṇa dikkālādisādhāraṇena, 
nāpyupādānādyapekṣakāryajanakatvena kumbhakārādisādhāraṇena rūpeṇa 
yathā anyeṣāmadvaitopadeśāyogyānāmuktaḥ | 
evamīśvarasyānīśvaratvamevopetam | yathoktamanyaiḥ ---- 

"ye tvīśvaraṃ vyapadiśanti nimittahetuṃ
	dattastilāñjaliramībhiriheśitāyai	 | 

anyāṅgatopagamanena vaśīkṛtasya
	kāmīśvarasthitimamī vata saṅgirante ||"1 iti || 

tasmādyathoktameva sādhu || 

nanu niṣprayojanā na prekṣāpūrvakāriṇāṃ pravṛttirasti, na 
cāsyeyajjantucakrāyāsadāyāṃ sṛṣṭau kimapi prayojanamutpaśyāmaḥ ? ---
- ityāśaṅkā śamayitumāha ---- 


akāmāt saṃsṛjet sarvaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam || 11-3 || 

svatejasā varārohe vyoma saṃkṣobhya līlayā | 


akāmāt paripūrṇatvena phalānabhilāṣāt, līlayā svatantrakrīḍayaiva, 
sarvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamaṃ jagat jīvātmakaṃ nimīmīte; na tu jīvā nāma 
nityāḥ kecit sambhavanti | evaṃ hyanādimati saṃsāre jīvānāmānantye'pi 
pratiyugamekaikamuktau saṃsāroccheda eva syāt | tena parameśvara eva 
svacchasvacchandacinmātramūtīḥ ---- 

śvaśaktipracayo'sya viśvam" (3-30)

iti śivasūtroktasthityā svarūpagopanāsatattvavedyavedakaprapañcarūpaṃ 
jagad darpaṇanagaravadanatiriktamapyatiriktamivābhāsayati | evaṃ ca na 
kaścidvyatirikto jīvapadārtho'pi yadāyāsakatvena 
bhagavato'prekṣāpūrvakāritā syāt | īdṛśaṃ ca jagadasau na 
vyaktiriktena kāraṇena kenacit prakāśayati, api tu svatejasā ---- 

"tasya devātidevasya parabodhasvarūpiṇaḥ | 

vimarśaḥ paramā śaktiraviyukto yayā prabhuḥ ||"

iti śrīkālikākuloktasthityā vyoma unmanāvaraṇaṃ svasvarūpameva 
saṃkṣobhya ---- 

"atrārūḍhastu kurute śivaḥ paramakāraṇam" (10-1258)

ityuktadṛśā 
vyāpinīśaktisadāśivādibhāvābhāvātmakasvaśaktibhittibhūtasamanāśakt
ibhūmikāmāśritya samanātmakasvaśaktibhittau svaśaktyaiva parameśvareṇa
jagad bhāsyata iti tātparyam || 

ataśca yatprāk kāraṇaśabdasyārthatrayaṃ vyākhyātam, tadeveha 
sphuṭībhūtam, ata evātra na vyatiriktamupādānaṃ kimapi, api tu tadeva 
vyometyāha ---- 


upādānaṃ tu tatproktaṃ saṃkṣubdhaṃ samavāyataḥ || 11-4 || 


tadeva vyāpakāvaraṇasvasvarūpaṃ vyoma samavāyato 
nityāvibhinnavimarśamayaparāśaktisambandhāt saṃkṣubdhaṃ 
bhāvitasaṃkṣobhaṃ yogyasparśabhūmikāpradarśanena 
kiñciccalamivedantābhāsollāsabhittibhūtatvāvabhāsanenocchaladiva | 
vastuto hyunmanākhyaivaparavimarśamayī pārameśvarī 
svātantryaśaktirahantaikarasā svarūpagopanakrīḍā 
sadāśivānāśritapadātmakasarvabhāvābhāsasūtrābhittikalpasamānarūpa-
tayā sphurati | itthaṃ ca karaṇādhikaraṇopādānarūpamaśeṣaṃ 
viśvakartuḥ parameśvarādabhinnameveti pratipāditaṃ bhavati || 4 || 

yathā ca bhagavatā prakāśamānatayā svāvyatiriktamapi vyaktiriktamiva 
jagadābhāsyate, tathā tanmadhyaniyatapaurvāparyāvabhāsātmā 
mahāmāyāśaktibhūmau māyāpade ca vicitraḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvo'pi 
pradarśyate | yathoktaṃ pratyabhijñāyām ---- 

"mūtīvaicitryato deśakramamābhāsayatyasau | 

kriyāvaicitryanirbhāsāt kālakramamapīśvaraḥ ||" (2-1-5)

iti || 4 || 

tadetadupapādayitumāha ---- 


tasmācchūnyaṃ samutpannaṃ śūnyāt sparśasamudbhavaḥ | 

tasmānnādaḥ samutpannaḥ pūrvaṃ vai kathitastava || 11-5 || 


tasmāt samanāśaktirūpād vyomnaḥ 
śūnyamanāśritabhaṭṭārakāntāśeṣaviśvāvabhāsa-
praśamābhāvāvabhāsātmakavyāpinīpadamutpannam | tato'pi 
pratipāditarūpaprasuptabhujagākāraśaktitattvātmā sparśaḥ | itthamekaiva 
parameśecchāśaktiḥ parasūkṣmasthūlarūpatayā meyābhāsasūtraṇāmayī 
samanā vyāpinī śaktiriti cocyate, ekasyā apīcchāyāḥ 
sūkṣmarūpajñānakriyāśaktisambhedena tritvāt | tasmādapi śaktyātmanaḥ 
sparśāt śūnyarūpavācyavācakobhayātmakasya jagato madhyāt prathamaṃ 
samastavācakāvibhāgamayo nāda utpannaḥ | saṃśabdena utpādyamānasya 
sarvasya kāryasya śaktyātmakakāraṇabhittisaṃlagnatocyate | pūrvamiti 
nādāvaraṇarūpaṇādyavasare || 5 || 

yaścāyaṃ nāda uktaḥ ---- 


aṣṭadhā sa tu deveśi vyaktaḥ śabdaprabhedataḥ | 


svayamavyaktadhvanirūpo'pi vakṣyamāṇairbhedairaṣṭadhā vyaktarūpatāṃ 
prāptaḥ || 

tadyathā ---- 


ghoṣo rāvaḥ svanaḥ śabdaḥ sphoṭākhyo dhvanireva ca || 11-6 || 

jhāṅkāro dhvaṅkṛtaścaiva aṣṭau śabdāḥ prakītītāḥ | 


ete ca dharmaśivācāryeṇa svapaddhatau ---- 

"eteṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vacmo gurupāramparāgatam"

ityupakramya itthaṃ vyākhyātāḥ ---- 

"śravaṇāṅgulisaṃyogādyaḥ śabdaḥ sampravartate | 

dīptavahnisvanābhāsaḥ sa śabdo ghoṣa ucyate || 

tadante'nubhavo yasya īṣanmarmavisapīṇaḥ | 

bhinnakāṃsyanibho rūkṣaḥ sa rāvaḥ syāttadantagaḥ || 

tato vaṃśadhvaniprakhyo nivāte saumyavarṣavat | 

sa nādaḥ svana ityuktastatparaḥ kathito hyasau || 

caturthaḥ sa tu vai śabdaḥ sarvaśabdabhavāraṇiḥ | 

ātmānaṃ rāvayannādaḥ khe yathā bhramarīravaḥ || 

vākyasya sphuṭatāṃ dhatte varṇabhedāvabhāsakaḥ | 

sphoṭa ityudito nādaḥ pañcamaḥ śāstṛbhistataḥ || 

tato'titānadhamītvānnādaḥ śrotrasukhāvahaḥ | 

vipañcyāḥ pañcamīṃ tantrīṃ hatvā tīvraprayatnataḥ || 

tathā vyajyata ākāśe saha ṣaṣṭho dhvanisaṃjñitaḥ | 

sarvatantrīsamāghātādvīṇāyāmiva sādhuḥ yaḥ || 

mṛdustabdhaṃ ninadati jhāṅkāraḥ saptamastvasau | 

ghaṇṭāninādānukṛtiḥ kadācid vyajyate'nyathā || 

tuṅgameghadhvaninibhaḥ so'ṣṭamo dhvaṅkṛtaḥ smṛtaḥ | "

eṣāmaṣṭānāmapi ---- 


navamastu mahāśabdaḥ sarveṣāṃ vyāpakaḥ smṛtaḥ || 11-7 || 

nadatyasau sadā yasmāt sarvabhūteṣvavasthitaḥ | 


"śaktimadhyagato nādo vaṃśanādāntasaṃnibhaḥ | "

iti yo nādaḥ pratipāditaḥ, sa mahāśabdaḥ 
sarveṣvantaḥsañjñabahiḥsañjñeṣu sthāvarādidevayonyanteṣu 
bhūteṣvavasthitaḥ | ata eva hi ---- 

ṅādākhyaṃ yatparaṃ bījaṃ sarvabhūteṣvavasthitam" (kālo0 1-5)

ityādyuktipratipādatayā nādākhyayā vimarśasattayā sarveṣāṃ sattvam || 

yataḥ evamataḥ ---- 


tasmāt sadāśivo devo vyakto vai dṛkkriyātmakaḥ || 11-8 || 


sa eva nādo jñānakriyāyapasadāśivabhaṭṭārakābhivyaktisatattva 
ityarthaḥ || 8 || 

athāsmāt ---- 


nādād binduḥ samutpannaḥ sūryakoṭisamaprabhaḥ | 


antaḥkṛtajñānaśaktipradhānanādaparāmarśaḥ samastavedyāvibhaktaḥ 
kriyāśaktyātmā prakāśo binduḥ samastavedyāvibhinnaprathatvādeva 
sūryakoṭisamaprabhaḥ | 


sa caiva daśadhā jñeyo daśatattvaphalapradaḥ || 11-9 || 

daśadhā varṇarūpeṇa daśadaivatasaṃyutaḥ | 


kriyāśaktipradhāno bindurantargatecchājñānaśaktidvayaḥ, ekaikasyāśca 
śakteḥ sarvaśaktisambheda iti nava śaktayaḥ, etatsāmarasyātmā mukhyo 
daśamaḥ svabhāva iti daśadhātvamasya | tacca ---- 

śitaṃ raktaṃ ca pītaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ haritapiṅgalam | 

nīlaṃ vicitravarṇaṃ tu sphaṭikābhaṃ manoramam ||" (12-154)

iti dvādaśapaṭalavakṣyamāṇavarṇasvarūpabhedena daśadhā | tatraiva ---- 

"kuṅkumābhaṃ ca nāreśaṃ trinetraṃ tu jaṭādharam | 

pūrvānanamabhidhyāyedvāyubhakṣasya yatphalam || 

tatpuṇyaphalamāpnoti ..................... | " (12-125-126)

ityāditatpuruṣādidevatāpañcakadhyānaṃ tatphalapañcakaṃ ca 
pratipādayiṣyati | tathā 
tatraivāntargatanādānudbhinnākārabinduprakāśāpekṣayā ---- 

"ghaṇṭānādasya vā dhyānāt siddhiḥ ṣāṇmāsikī bhavet | 

īpsitā martyaloke tu siddhistasya prajāyate || 

liṅgadhyānaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāt pūrvabījena saṃyutam | 

māsenaikena paśyet sa sūkṣmaliṅgaṃ tanūpari || 

śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ tadṛṣṭvā tu vimucyate | 

siddhistu mānuṣe loke ṣaṇmāsena prajāyate ||" (12-157)

ityantargatanādāvibhaktaprakāśavidvātmaṣaṣṭhadevatādhyānaṃ tatphalaṃ 
ca pratipādayiṣyati |  yathā ---- 

ṅivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā ca vidyā śāntistathaiva ca | 

kalācatuṣṭayopeto dhyātavyo bindurīśvaraḥ ||" (12-157)

ityādyabhidhāsyati | itthaṃ daśadaivatasaṃyuto nivṛttyādikalābhiśca 
saha daśatattvaphalaprada iti vyākhyeyam | 
ṭīkākāraistvevametatpūrvāparamaparāmṛśya ---- 

śa caiva daśadhā" (11-9)

ityādivīdyātattvaviṣayo granthaḥ, tatra ca ṣaṇṭhavarṇān binduvisargau 
ca varjayitvā'kārādivarṇadaśakayuktatvaṃ 
tatsaṃbhinnaikaikakādivyañjanadevatāyogād daśadaitatvam, 
etadvarṇadaśakābhivyaktatvāt sarvavāṅmayarūpaṃ phalaṃ daśadhā'treti 
yat svakalpanayā vyākāri, tadupekṣyam | vidyātattvaviṣayastu granthaḥ ---
- 

"tasmādvidyā tato māyā" (11-54)

ityagre bhaviṣyati | etadapi tairna parāmṛṣṭam, ityalaṃ pūrvaiḥ saha 
nirbandhena || 

athaitasmāt ---- 


bindoḥ sadāśivo jñeyaḥ so'ṣṭabhedāṅgasaṃyutaḥ || 11-10 || 

pañcabrahmakalābhiśca vidyāṅgaiḥ śaktibhiryutaḥ | 

pañcabhiśca mahājñānairmūtībhiśca samanvitaḥ || 11-11 || 


sa sadāśiva iti yaḥ pūrvaṃ bhauvane'dhvani bindvāvaraṇādadhaḥ 
sthūlarūpa uktaḥ, tasyaiva hi sakalādyaṣṭabhedairaṅgaiḥ parivārai 
pañcabhirīśānādibrahmabhiḥ sarvajñatvādirūpairvedanapradhānaiḥ 
ṣaḍbhiraṅgairvāmādyābhivīdyādyābhiśca 
śaktibhistārādyaṣṭātriṃśatkalābhiḥ 
pañcavaktrodbhūtasrotaḥpañcakarūpairmahadbhirjñānaśāstraiḥ 
oṃkārādibhirdaśabhivījayādibhiraṣṭādaśabhiśca mūtībhirvyaktatvaṃ 
pūrvamabhihitam | ato yadanyaibīnduḥ sadāśiva iti paṭhitvā 
ghoṣādyaṣṭakāṅgayuktanādākhyasadāśivarūpo binduriti 
sāmānādhikaraṇyena vyākhyātam, tadasat || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


sa evāpararūpeṇa paramātmā śivo'vyayaḥ | 


yaḥ pūrvaṃ paramakāraṇarūpo'vyayaḥ śiva uktaḥ, sa evāpararūpeṇa 
sadāśivabhaṭṭārakaḥ, na tvasau vyatirikta ityarthaḥ || 

ataḥ ---- 


dvidhāvasthaḥ sa ca jñeyaḥ soccāroccāravajītaḥ || 11-12 || 

mudrāmantrasvarūpeṇa sa eva ca punadvīdhā | 

kriyājñānasvarūpeṇa icchārūpasvarūpataḥ || 11-13 || 


yaḥ śivo'vyaya uktaḥ, sa dvidhā vyāpakatvenāvasthito jñeyo jñātavyaḥ 
| katham ? ---- ityāha ---- sahoccāreṇa ūrdhvoccāraṇarūpeṇa 
bindunādādiparāmarśātmanā rūpeṇa vartate, 
uccāravajītastvaśeṣaviśvavyāpiparamaśivātmā svabhāvaḥ, 
etatsvarūpaprāptyupāyātmanāpi mudrāmantrasvarūpeṇa dvidhā | mudrā hi 
paratattvapratibimbabhūtā'ntaḥsaṃviddrviṇamudraṇād mudaṃ rāntī, 
pāśamocanabhedadrāvaṇakāriṇī tattatsaṃniveśarūpatayā 
parasphāramanukurvatī, tathā 
mantro'pyantarguptabhāṣaṇātmakaparaparāmarśasatattvena 
mananatrāṇadharmā paratattvaprāptyupāyaḥ parameśātmaiva | parameśvara 
eva hyupeyapadavadupāyarūpatayā sphuritaḥ | kiṃ ca, 
kriyāśaktipradhāneneśvarabhaṭṭārakātmanā jñānaśaktipradhānena ca 
sadāśivabhaṭṭārakātmanā sa eva sphuritaḥ, 
tathecchāśaktyātmanā'nāśritarūpeṇa svarūpeṇa ca 
śaktimadrūpaparamaśivātmanā || 13 || 

na kevalamitthamupeyātmanopāyātmatayā śaktivaicitryeṇa bhagavānevaṃ 
bhāti, yāvat samastaśāstrīyalaukikavyavahāragatasarvavācakātmatayā 
tadvācyavastvātmatayā cetyāha ---- 

śabdāvabodharūpeṇa vasturūpasvarūpataḥ | 

śabdarūpeṇa tadavabodharūpeṇa tathā śabdavācyavasturūpeṇa svarūpeṇa 
ca pūrṇacidātmanetyarthaḥ | svarūpeṇetyukteridamākūtaṃ 
yadaśeṣaśabdārthacintārūpatayā sphurannapi 
parameśvaro'parimlānacidānandaghana eveti sarvamidaṃ 
parabhairavādvaitarūpameva | taduktaṃ mayaiva ---- 

heyaṃ kecana manvate jagadidaṃ bāhyaṃ tanusthaṃ pare
(meyānte hi)1 niveśake'pyatha pare dehe parasmin sthi(tam)2 | 

bhinnaṃ bhāti na jātu yatpunaridaṃ cidbhānubhāsastato
bhābhirbhāmi nijābhirābhirabhito viśvātmabhirbhairavaḥ || 

iti | yeṣāṃ tu parameśamāyāśaktyāvṛtatvādetatprathāyogyatā nāsti, 
tadabhiprāyeṇa ---- 

śamanāntaṃ varārohe pāśajālamanantakam" (4-432)

ityādyuktamiti na pūrvāparavaiṣamyaṃ kiñcit || 

tadittham--


sthūlaḥ sūkṣmaḥ paraścaiva parātīto nirañjanaḥ || 11-14 || 

vyomarūpasvarūpeṇa samanonmana eva ca | 

unmanātīto deveśi śivo jñeyaḥ śivāgame || 11-15 || 


yo'sāvunmanākramaṃ jānāmītyuktāmunmanāśaktimatiśayenetaḥ 
prāptastaddhārādhirūḍhaḥ śaktimadātmā śivāgame śivaḥ 
śreyaḥsvabhāva ucyate, sthūlo bhūmyādiprakṛtyantena rūpeṇa, sūkṣmaḥ 
pumādimāyāntena, paraḥ śuddhavidyādiśaktitattvāntena sphuritastathā 
vyomarūpeṇānāśritātmanā svarūpeṇa, kiṃ ca samanonmane śaktī vidyete 
yasyāsau samanonmanastadrūpītyarthaḥ, aśeṣaviśvātmanā parameśa eva 
sphuratīti yāvat || 

evaṃ sthūlādyunmanāntaṃ viśvaṃ 
parameśamayevetyupasaṃhāradṛṣṭyoktvā prasarakrameṇāpi 
tattatkāraṇātmanā sa eva sphuratītyādiśati ---- 


unmanāsamanāsthānaṃ śivena samadhiṣṭhitam | 

pañcakāraṇarūpeṇa tadadhaḥ punareva saḥ || 11-16 || 


tiṣṭhatyasmin viśvamiti sthānamunmanārūpaṃ svātantryaśaktirūpam, 
tatsvātantryāvabhāsitaṃ ca yad bhāvābhāvarūpāśeṣasūtraṇātma 
samanārūpaṃ sthānaṃ tat śivena samyagadhiṣṭhitaṃ svabhittau 
svābhedenāvabhāsitamityarthaḥ | tasyāḥ samanāyā adha iti vyāpyātmani 
śūnyātiśūnye pade 
cidānandecchājñānakriyākhyaśaktipañcakapradhānenānāśritā 
divyāpyantapañcakāraṇarūpeṇa sa eva śivaḥ punarapi sthitaḥ, na 
punaranāśritādayastadvyatiriktāḥ kecit || 16 || 

kiṃ caitat ---- 


kāraṇaṃ pañcakaṃ devi adhiṣṭhāya tvadhastataḥ | 
tato'nāśritādipañcakāraṇātmano rūpādadhaḥ 
śaktibrahmabilasuṣumnānādanādāntabindupadānyadhiṣṭhāyābhedena 
tadbhūmīrābhāsyaitatkāraṇapañcakaṃ sthitamityanuṣaṅgaḥ || 

etadvibhajati ---- 


vyāpakaḥ śaktimūrdhastho biladvāramanāśritaḥ || 11-17 || 

anantaśca suṣumneśastvanāthaścordhvagastathā | 

vyomarūpī mahādevi bindvīśaḥ parikītītaḥ || 11-18 || 


vyāpaka iti vyāpibhaṭṭārakaḥ prapañcavyāptyā, śaktimūrdhastha iti 
śaktyāvaraṇarūpo yo mūrdhā tatstha iti tadgataḥ | 

śthūlaḥ sūkṣmaḥ" (11-14)

ityuktakāraṇapañcakātmatayā sphuritaḥ, tathānāśritabhaṭṭārako 
biladvāramiti tadadhiṣṭhātṛbrahmarūpaḥ, evamanantaḥ 
suṣumnāvaraṇādhiṣṭhātṛsuṣumneparūpaḥ, anātha ūrdhvaga iti 
nādāntādhiṣṭhātrūrdhvageśarūpaḥ, vyomabhaṭṭārako'pi 
bindvāvaraṇagataśāntyatītākhyabindvīśamūtīḥ | nanu 
cānāhatānāthānantavyomavyāpino ye pūrvamuddaṣṭāste yadyuttarā 
bhūmīrānulomyena bhajante, tadanāśritaḥ śaktimūrdhastha ityādyuktyā 
bhavitavyam | atha prātilomyena tathā ---- 

"vyāpī tu śaktimūrdhastho biladvāraṃ kharūpakaḥ"

ityādi darśanīyam, tatko'tra kramaḥ | eka eva pañcaśaktisāmarasyāt 
parameśvaro yathāsvātantryamanāśritādivyāpyantakāraṇapañcakarūpatāṃ 
prapañcavyāptyā śritvā 
śaktyādibindvāvaraṇagatatattadīśamūtīrūpatayāpi sphuritaḥ, na 
tvatrānulomyaṃ prātilomyaṃ vā kiñcit, api tvakrama evātra kramo 
vāstavena vṛttena sarveṣāṃ bhagavadekamayatvādityāśayenāyamīdṛśaḥ 
kramo'tra pradaśītaḥ | evamuttaratrāpi smartavyam | taduktaṃ 
śrīppatyabhijñāyām ---- 

"yā caiṣā pratibhā tattatpadārthakramarūṣitā | 

akramānantacidrūpaḥ pramātā sa maheśvaraḥ ||" (1-7-1)

iti || 18 || 

imāmevābhedasārāṃ prapañcavyāptiṃ sārdhaślokena pradarśayati ---- 


anāśritaḥ svayaṃ brahmā samadhiṣṭhāya saṃsthitaḥ | 

anātho viṣṇurityuktastvananto rudra eva ca || 11-19 || 

vyomarūpīśvaraḥ prokto vyāpī caiva sadāśivaḥ | 


anāśritabhaṭṭāraka eva svayaṃ sākṣād brahmā samadhiṣṭhāya 
saṃsthita iti bhūrādibrahmalokāntamityarthāt || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


vyāpakaśca punardevi hāṭakaḥ parameśvaraḥ || 11-20 || 

vidyāmantragaṇairyuktaḥ saptapātālanāyakaḥ | 

anantaścaiva deveśi rudraḥ kālāgnivigrahaḥ || 11-21 || 

anātho'nantarūpeṇa sthitaścādhvani dhārakaḥ | 

anāśrito mahādevi sthito vai hūhukaḥ prabhuḥ || 11-22 || 


anantarūpeṇeti karparikādhogatānantabhaṭṭārakātmanā | adhvanīti 
karparikāparyante | hūhuka iti pūrvoktānantabhuvanāntarvartī | tadevaṃ 
sthūlena hūhukādinā sūkṣmeṇa brahmādinā ca pañcakenaika eva 
parameśvaraḥ pūrvoktapañcaśaktyātmā svacchandanāthaḥ prapañcavyāptyā 
sphurita ityanenāpi āśayena ---- 

śthūlaḥ sūkṣmaḥ paraścaiva parātīto nirañjanaḥ" (11-14)

iti ślokārdhaṃ saṅgamayitavyam | anāśritādipañcakasyaivaṃ 
prapañcavyāptiṃ tathā sarvāderanāśritanāthasya 
sarvāntahūhukanātharūpatāṃ pradarśayan sarvamidaṃ 
nirañjanasatattvameveti śikṣayati, vastuto'nāśritabhaṭṭārakasya 
nirañjanaparabhairavasvarūpāvyatirekāt || 22 || 

yadāha ---- 


svaśaktyāśritaḥ sa bhagavāṃstena gītastvanāśritaḥ |  


svā viśeṣānupādānād viśvasya prabhavabhūtā yā pārameśvarī 
svātantryaśaktistāmāśritaḥ sākṣāttadbhittau tadavibhinnasphāratayā 
sphurati | parameśvaro hīcchāśaktyātmanā'nāśritabhaṭṭārakaḥ 
svarūpakalpa eva | yadāha śrīpratyabhijñākāraḥ ---- 

śā dvitīyaiva śivatā" iti || 

ataśca ---- 


tasyāśritaṃ jagatsarvamunmanyantaṃ varānane || 11-23 || 


unmanī śaktirante yasya samanāvadherjagataḥ, tat tasya 
āśritamanāśritabhaṭṭārakarūpaśivatattvāśritamityarthaḥ || 23 || 

yathā ca pārameśīṃ parāṃ viśvadhārikāṃ 
svātantryaśaktibhittimāśrityānāśritanāthaḥ, tathā ca 
paramūtīrhūhukabhaṭṭārako'pi tāmevāśritya sthitaḥ ityāha ---- 


saṃsthitaścāmbhaso mūdhnī śaktyādhārastu hūhukaḥ |
