śaktyādhāra ityaparaśaktyāśrayaḥ | ambhaso mūrdhnītyanenāsya 
deśanirdeśaḥ | yat śrībhullakaḥ śaktyādhāra iti 
brahmāṇḍakarparikārūpādhāraśaktyāśraya itīhāpi vyākārṣīt, 
tadasya vismṛtavastusamarthanacaramevetyupekṣyam || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


aptattvaṃ caiva tadadha āgneyaṃ tadanantaram || 11-24 || 

vāyavyaṃ nābhasaṃ caiva tanmātrāṇīndriyāṇi ca | 

viṣayāśca manaścaiva ahaṅkārastvanukramāt || 11-25 || 

bauddhaṃ gauṇaṃ ca deveśi prākṛtaṃ pauruṣaṃ tathā | 

niyatiḥ kālarāgau ca vidyā caiva kalā tathā || 11-26 || 

māyātattvaṃ tathā vidyā īśvaraśca sadāśivaḥ | 

bindvardhendunirodhī ca nādo nāḍī tvataḥ param || 11-27 || 

adho brahmabilaṃ devi śaktitattvaṃ tataḥ param | 

pañcakāraṇasaṃyuktā vyāpinī ca tataḥ param || 11-28 || 

samanā unmanā caiva prakriyāṇḍairyutā priye | 


viṣayā iti ye pūrvaṃ raśmyāvaraṇagatā uktāsta iha viṣayākāratayā 
sthitāḥ | tataśca yadāha śrībhullako viṣayā mahābhūtasvarūpā 
evehendriyagrāhyā indriyoktyanuṣaṅgeṇa prasaṅgāduktā iti, tadasat | 
bauddhamityādau tattvamiti yojanīyam | nāḍīti suṣumnāvaraṇagatā ca 
suṣumnaiva | adho brahmabilamityapāsya ūrdhvaṃ brahmabilamiti 
ṭīkākārapāṭho na sādhuḥ ūrdhvavadadho'pi suṣumnāntasyādhvano 
brahmabilavyāptatvāt 
pṛthivyāditattvānāmuttarottaramantarbahirvyāptyavasthityā 
pratipāditatvāt | unmanāyā viśeṣaṇaṃ prakriyāṇḍairyuteti proktayā 
prakriyayā sthitā aṇḍā 
brahmāṇḍaprakṛtyaṇḍamāyāṇḍaśaktyaṇḍāstairyutā sambaddhā | te hi 
sarve tadekāśrayāḥ || 

etat saṅkalayati ---- 


evaṃ vai prakriyāṇḍaṃ tu adhordhvaṃ saṃvyavasthitam || 11-29 || 


proktaprakriyayā sthitaṃ yadaṇḍamityekavacanād māyāṇḍaṃ śaktyaṇḍaṃ 
caikarūpam, tadadha ūrdhve cāntarvatītattattattvagarbhīkāreṇa samyak 
sabāhyābhyantaravyāptyā viśeṣeṇāvasthitam || 

kiṃ 
śaktyaṇḍamāyāṇḍadvayamevāntarvatītattattattvordhvādharādivyāptyā 
sthitam, netyāha ---- 


evaṃvidhānyabho'dho vai ūrdhvordhvaṃ ca samantataḥ | 


evaṃvidhānīti bahuvacane 
māyāṇḍāntargataprakṛtyaṇḍabrahmāṇḍaparāmarśasteṣāṃ bahutvāt | 
taduktaṃ śrīmālinīvijaye ---- 

"pṛthagdvayamasaṅkhyātamekamekaṃ pṛthag dvayam" (2-50)

iti | evaṃvidhānītyuktiḥ "adho'dha ūrdhvordhvaṃ ca samantataḥ" ityanena 
vyākhyātā || 

bahuvacanasūcitamanekatvaṃ sphuṭayati ---- 


yathā ātmāṇavo devi asaṅkhyātā vyavasthitāḥ || 11-30 || 

evaṃ vai prakriyāṇḍāni tvasaṅkhyeyānyanekaśaḥ | 


vyavasthitā iti eśvaryā māyāśaktyā tathā saṃkucitatvena 
ābhāsanādityarthaḥ | prakṛtyaṇḍānīti bahuvacanāt 
prakṛtyaṇḍabrahmāṇḍarūpāṇītyuktameva || 

tahī tānyapi vibhāgena kiṃ na varṇyante | 

yataḥ ---- 


ekena vaṇīteneha sarvo'dhvā vaṇītaḥ priye || 11-31 || 

yathā hyekaṃ tathā sarvaṃ prakriyāṇḍaṃ sthitaṃ priye | 

sarveṣāṃ prakriyāṇḍānāṃ svasvarūpeṇa suvrate || 11-32 || 

vyāpakastu śivaḥ sūkṣmaḥ sabāhyābhyantaraṃ sthitaḥ | 

sarvātiśayanirmuktaḥ sarvakāraṇavajītaḥ || 11-33 || 

sṛṣṭisaṃhāranirmuktaḥ prapañcātītagocaraḥ | 


svenānapāyicitprakāśātmanā svarūpeṇa sarveṣāṃ sūkṣmaḥ śiva iti 
paramaśivabhaṭṭārako bahirantaśca vyāpakaḥ 
sthitaścitprakāśātmakaparamaśivarūpatāṃ vinā kasyāpi sattāsiddheḥ 
śivamayameva viśvamityarthaḥ | 
śivasadāśiveśvarādīnāmadharādharāpekṣayā yathotthānamatiśayo'sti | 
paramaśivastu citprakāśamātrātmatayā mahāsattātmā mahāsāmānyarūpa 
ityetadanyasyātiśayāvadherabhāvāt sarvātiśayainīrmuktaḥ sarvakāraṇaṃ 
sarvakāraṇavajītaśca nityoditacidekamūtīriti tantreṇa vyākhyeyam yataḥ 
sṛṣṭisaṃhārābhyāṃ nirmuktaḥ | sarvasya hi jagata eṣa eva bhagavān 
svacchasvacchandacidekamūtīḥ sraṣṭā saṃhartā ca, na tvasyāpyanyastasya 
kalpyamānasyāpi etatprakāśātmatāṃ vinā'nupapatteḥ | kiṃ cāyaṃ 
prapañcaṃ vaicitryamatītaḥ svacitprakāśaikamayatvenaiva prakāśamāno 
gocaro jagadātmā sarvo viṣayo yasya | taduktaṃ śrīpratyabhijñāyām ---- 

śvātmeva svātmanā pūrṇā bhāvā bhāntyamitasya tu" (2-1-7)

iti || 

kiṃ cāyam ---- 


nirmalo vimalaḥ śāntastvadha ūrdhvaṃ vyavasthitaḥ || 34 || 


nirgatā āṇavādyā malā yasmāt tathābhūto'sau, vimalaḥ 
citprakāśaikamūtīḥ, ataśca samastabhedopaśamāt śāntaḥ, tathāpi ca sa 
evādha iti māyādikṣityantatayā, ūrdhvaṃ ca śuddhavidyādiśivāntatayā, 
vividhena rūpeṇāvasthitaḥ, nahi tatprakāśātiriktā kāpi kasyāpi kadāpi 
sattā'stītyuktatvāt || 34 || 

etad dṛṣṭāntapramukhaṃ ghaṭayati ---- 


ākāśasya yathā nordhvaṃ na madhyaṃ nāpyadhaḥ kvacit | 

evaṃ sarvagato devaḥ śivaḥ paramakāraṇam || 11-35 || 

vyāpya devi jagatsarvaṃ vyomasu vyomavat sthitaḥ | 


vyomasu gṛhaghaṭādyavacchinneṣvākāśapradeśeṣu yathā 
vyomābhedamayameva sthitam, tathā jagatsarvaṃ prakāśamānatvāt 
prakāśamayaṃ citprakāśātmā śivo'bhedena vyāpya sthitaḥ | ata evāsya 
deśakālādikṛta ūrdhvamadhyādharabhedo na kaścit || 

etadevādvayajñānaṃ paramopādeyamityāha ---- 


evaṃ jñātvā varārohe na bhūyo janmabhāg bhavet || 11-36 || 


evaṃ śivabhaṭṭārakasyaiva svaprakāśamayasamastajagadabhedavyātiṃ 
pradarśya, tatprapañcarūpāṇāṃ brahmādīnāṃ yāvatī vyāptistāmapi 
darśayati ---- 


kāraṇānāṃ punarvyāptiṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ | 


pūrvamanāśritādeḥ paramakāraṇapañcakasya hūhukāntaṃ 
vyāpyavyāpakabhāvo daśītaḥ, idānīṃ tu tasyaivāpararūpatayā 
brahmādipañcakarūpasya tattvādyadhiṣṭhānadvārikā vyāptiḥ pradarśyate 
---- 


tattve tu pāthīve brahmā adhiṣṭhātā vyavasthitaḥ || 11-37 || 

aptattve tu sthito viṣṇū rudrastejasi saṃsthitaḥ | 

īśvaro vāyutattve tu ākāśe tu sadāśivaḥ || 11-38 || 


vyavasthitaḥ pūrvam ---- 

"kalānāṃ yāvatī vyāptistattvānāṃ tāvadeva hi" (5-13)

ityuktatvāt pratiṣṭhādikalāvyāptatattvānusāryaptattvāditattvasvarūpaṃ 
mantavyam || 38 || 


ādityaśca smṛto brahmā somo viṣṇuśca suvrate | 

grahāṇāmadhipo rudro nakṣatrāṇāṃ tatheśvaraḥ || 11-39 || 

yajamānastu deveśi svayaṃ devaḥ sadāśivaḥ | 


iha pṛthivyādipañcakaṃ sūryaḥ somo yajamānaśceti yā'ṣṭau 
maheśvarasya mūrtayaḥ, tataḥ kalāvyāptisatattvaṃ meyarūpaṃ 
pṛthivyādimūtīpañcakaṃ brahmādikāraṇairadhiṣṭhitamityuktam | yattu 
karaṇapakṣe niviṣṭā ca yājamānī mūtīḥ pañcamīti, tatrāpi 
brahmādyadhiṣṭhitatvamuktam | āditya iti prāṇo dakṣiṇasrotaśca | 
somo'pāno vāmasrotaśca | grahanakṣatrādhipau bāhyau somasūryau 
prameyaprakāśenopayuktau | sadāśivasya 
yajamānatvamaśeṣaprameyapramāṇādhiṣṭhātṛparapramātṛmayatvāt || 

samastamaheśvaramūrtyadhiṣṭhātāro ye brahmādayaste'pi 
sadyāadibhagavanmantramayā evetītthamapi parameśvarādvayamayameva 
jagadityādiśati ---- 


sadyojātastu vai brahmā vāmo viṣṇuḥ prakītītaḥ || 11-40 || 

aghoro rudra ityuktastathā puruṣa īśvaraḥ | 

īśānastu varārohe svayaṃ devaḥ sadāśivaḥ || 11-41 || 


yaccaitad brahmādyadhiṣṭhātṛ bhagavacchaktirūpaṃ 
sadyāadimantrapañcakam, tadeva vedādisamastaśāstraprapañcarūpamityāha --
-- 


sadyojātastu ṛgvedo vāmadevo yajuḥ smṛtaḥ | 

aghoraḥ sāmavedastu puruṣo'tharva ucyate || 11-42 || 

īśānaśca suraśreṣṭhaḥ sarvavidyātmakaḥ smṛtaḥ | 


ṛgādivedāḥ pratyekaṃ karmadevatājñānakāṇḍātmakā mantavyāḥ | 
sarvavidyātmaka ityuktyā prokto'pi pravibhāgo'syaiva bhagavataḥ prapañca 
iti śāstrakrameṇāpi bhagavadadvayamayameva jagat || 

jñānakrameṇāpyadvaitamityāha ---- 


laukikaṃ devi vijñānaṃ sadyojātādvinirgatam || 11-43 || 

vaidikaṃ vāmadevāttu ādhyātmikamaghorataḥ | 

puruṣāccātimārgākhyaṃ nirgataṃ tu varānane || 11-44 || 

mantrākhyaṃ tu mahājñānamīśānāttu vinirgatam | 


laukikaṃ vārtādaṇḍanītyāyurvedadhanurvedanāṭya-
vedādipratipādyakṛṣinayānayacikitsādivijñānam | vaidikaṃ 
nityanaimittikakāmyayajñādisvarūpam | ādhyātmikaṃ 
sāṃkhyogādipratipāditaprakṛtipuruṣavivekajñānasarvavṛttinirodha-
jñānādikam | ātimāgīkaṃ 
vedasāṃkhyayogādyuktopāsātmakaprasiddhamārgātikrāntaṃ sāmānyena 
pārameśaśāstrapratipāditavividhamudrāmaṇḍalakriyādyupāyarūpaṃ 
vijñānamihābhipretam, natu viśiṣṭaṃ catuṣṭayāt | mantrākhyamiti 
tatraiva pārameśeṣu śāstreṣu pañcapraṇavādhikārapratipāditanītyā 
mantreṣu ā samantāt khyānaṃ yasya tathābhūtaṃ yanmahājñānaṃ 
mantravīryadaṃ 
jñānapādaproktakriyāditantrātmavijñānādvailakṣaṇyenānubhavasāratāṃ 
mantrāṇāṃ prathayati || 

pañcatattvādhiṣṭhānadvāreṇa viśvādhiṣṭhātṛtvaṃ 
brahmādikāraṇapañcakasyoktam, vitatya tu pratipādayitumāha ---- 


tathā tattvavibhāgena punaśca śṛṇu suvrate || 11-45 || 

catuvīṃśatitattvāni brahmā vyāpya vyavasthitaḥ | 

pradhānāntaṃ tu deveśi pauruṣaṃ tu janārdanaḥ || 11-46 || 


guṇatattvasya pṛthagavivakṣitatvāt catuvīṃśatitattvāni vyāpyeti 
prāgvadabhedenādhiṣṭhāya, ata eva 
pratipāditahṛdayaviṣayā''locanādisṛṣṭikāriṇī brāhmī 
vyāptirastīti tatra tatrocyate || 


niyateratha māyāntaṃ rudro vyāpya vyavasthitaḥ | 

vidyā tathaiśvaraṃ tattvaṃ vyāptaṃ caiveśvareṇa tu || 11-47 || 

ūrdhvaṃ sadāśivo devaḥ sarvaṃ vyāpya vyavasthitaḥ | 


ūrdhvamiti sadāśivaśaktiśivākhyaṃ tattvatrayam | sadāśiva 
ityanāśritaparavyāptyetyarthaḥ || 

ātmavidyāśivākhyatattvatrayavibhāgena ca kāraṇānāṃ 
viśvādhiṣṭhitatvamāha ---- 


tattvatrayavibhāgena punarvakṣyāmi suvrate || 11-48 || 


kāraṇavyāptimiti śeṣaḥ || 48 || 

tatra ---- 


ātmatattve tu vai brahmā māyānte ca vyavasthitaḥ | 

vidyātattve tathā viṣṇuryāvat sādākhyagocaram || 11-49 || 

śivatattve tathā rudro vijñeyastu varānane | 

sādākhyamūrdhvamadhvānaṃ sarvaṃ vyāpya vyavasthitaḥ || 11-50 || 


sādākhyagocaramiti sadāśivatattvam | sarvamiti śivatattvānta eva 
brahmaviṣṇurudrāntā brahmaṇo vyāptiḥ, īśvarasadāśivāntā viṣṇoḥ, 
śivarūpā rudrasyeti kāraṇapañcakasyāpyanayā bhaṅgyā'bheda eva 
daśītaḥ || 50 || 

na kevalaṃ kāraṇapañcakametāvatkāraṇatrayavyāptisatattvam, 
yāvatkāraṇatrayamapi pārameśaraudryādiśaktitrayaparamārthamityāha ---- 


raudryā adhiṣṭhitātmā vai sa rudraḥ parikītītaḥ | 

vyāptaśca vāmayā viṣṇurjyeṣṭhayā ca pitāmahaḥ || 11-51 || 


samastarugdrāvaṇād viśvavamanādabhedaprādhānyaprāśastyaprakarṣācca 
raudrīvāmājyeṣṭhākhyā yāḥ śaktayastāsāmadhiṣṭhāne 
kramavyatikramaḥ paramārthādvayakramavastutattvapradarśanāya || 51 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


jñānaśaktiḥ smṛto brahmā kriyāśaktirjanārdanaḥ | 

icchāśaktiḥ paro rudraḥ.........


paraśabdastriṣvapi sambadhyate | atrāpi kramānyathātve prokta evāśayaḥ 
|| 

yaścāyaṃ paro rudraḥ ---- 


.............ṣa śivaḥ parigīyate || 11-52 || 

viṣṇuḥ sadāśivo devo brahmā caiveśvarastathā | 


evaṃ śaktitrayeṇāparaṃ kāraṇatrayamiva tadvyāpakaṃ paramapi 
kāraṇatrayamadhiṣṭhitamityuktaṃ bhavati || 

taditthamupāyopeyādyaikātmyoktyā 
kāraṇagatādhiṣṭhātradhiṣṭheyamukhena samastādhvavyāptyā 
mūrtyaṣṭakādhiṣṭhitayuktyā vācakamukhena tajjñānadṛṣṭyā 
tadvācyaṣaṭtriṃśatpañcatriṃśattattvabhedoktidvāreṇa 
śaktitrayādhiṣṭhānanirūpaṇakrameṇa ca parabhairavādvayamayaṃ jagaditi 
vyāpyavyāpakasatattvapradarśanena paramaupaniṣadikamarthaṃ 
prapañcaprakrāntajagatsṛṣṭyapekṣaṃ 
kāryakāraṇavibhāgavaicitryamevānubadhnāti ---- 


sadāśivaḥ śivād devi utpannaḥ prabhurīśvaraḥ || 11-53 || 


yadyapi ---- 

"bindoḥ sadāśivo jñeyaḥ" (11-10)

iti prāgupakṣiptam, tathāpi 
pratipāditavyāpyavyāpakabhāvaparamārthadṛśā binduparyante prasṛtya 
śivabhaṭṭāraka eva prapañcavyāptyā sadāśiva īśvaraśca prabhuḥ 
sampanna ityatra tātparyam || 53 || 


tasmādvidyā tato māyā..............


tata iti vidyātattvāt | eṣāṃ ca tattvānāmutpattikrame yuktiḥ pūrvameva 
daśītā || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


.................vidyāyāḥ punarīśvaraḥ | 

jñānaśaktikarāgreṇa svecchayā parameśvaraḥ || 11-54 || 

sapta koṭīstu mantrāṇāṃ sṛjejjñānakriyātmikāḥ | 


"aṣṭavargavibhinnā tu vidyā sā mātṛkā parā" (10-1144)

iti pūrvamuktasvarūpāyā vidyāyāḥ sakāśāt parameśvara iti 
paramaśivasvarūpa īśvarabhaṭṭārakaḥ 
svecchāmātreṇānugrahākhyakṛtyaprapañcanārthaṃ jñānaśaktireva 
karāgraṃ tena sapta koṭīrmantrāṇāṃ mananatrāṇasatattvānāṃ sṛjati | 
jñānaśaktikaraṇatvāt sṛjyamānatvāccaitāḥ kāraṇānuguṇyena 
jñānakriyātmikā iti pūrṇajñānakriyāsatattvā bhogamokṣapradāḥ || 

parameśvara iti viśeṣaṇeneśvarasya paramaśivarūpatvamuktaṃ yatastata eva 
tatsṛṣṭānāṃ mantrāṇāmaṇuśaktiśambhupakṣatayā 
sarvatraivānugrahārthamavasthitatvamastītyāha ---- 


te ca sādākhyaparyante pāthīvādye tu suvrate || 11-55 || 

anugrahaṃ prakurvanti dehināṃ bhuvane sthitāḥ | 


pṛthvyādyanāśritānte yāni bhuvanāni, teṣu sthitāḥ santo dehināṃ 
bhogamokṣarūpamanugrahaṃ prakarṣeṇānavarataṃ kurvanti || 

ete ca ---- 


śivaśaktisamāviṣṭāstrinetrāścandramaulayaḥ || 11-56 || 


śivaśaktisamāviṣṭatvādevaiṣāmanugrahakartṛtvam || 56 || 

yuktaṃ caitadyataḥ  ---- 


rudramūtībhireko'sau śivaḥ paramakāraṇam | 

jagad vyāpya sthito māyī śūlapāṇiranekadhā || 11-57 || 


rudrāḥ sarvarugdrāviṇo mantrāḥ | eko'pyanekadhā rudramūtībhirjagad 
vyāpya sthita ityatra viśeṣaṇadvārako heturmāyīti | 
svarūpagopanārūpayā mahāmāyāśaktyā 
hyasāvanugrahākhyakṛtyanirvāhāya nānārudramūtībhiḥ sphuritaḥ | 
māyāśaktyaiva vakṣyamāṇajagadrūpatayā parameśvaraḥ 
svābhāsasvacchasvacchandacidānandasundaraḥ svasvātantryād 
darpaṇanagaravat svānadhikenāpyadhikeneva kena nāma rūpeṇa na 
bhavatītyuktamasakṛt, ato yat śrīsadyojyotiṣā uktam ---- 

"ekaḥ śivo'vikārī tacchaktiścāpyato na tau yogyau | 

 bahudhā sthātuṃ yadvā caitanyavinākṛtau vikāritvāt ||" (taṣaṃ. 45)

iti, tat proktaśrutiyuktibhyāṃ 
bādhitatvādaparyālocitādvayavādasatattvamityupekṣyameva || 57 || 

kiṃ cāyamāśritānantabhaṭṭārakamūtīḥ ---- 


jñānaśaktyā punaścaiva samālokya varānane | 

icchāśaktyā samāviṣṭaḥ kriyāśaktyā tu suvrate || 11-58 || 

māyātattvaṃ jagadbījaṃ nityaṃ vibhutayā'vyam | 

tatsthaṃ kṛtvātmavargaṃ tu yugapat kṣobhayet prabhuḥ || 11-59 || 


jagataḥ kalādikṣityantasya viśvasya yadbījaṃ kāraṇaṃ māyātattvaṃ 
nityamiti tacchakteranidaṃprathamikatayā pravṛttatvāt, ata eva cāvyayam, na 
tu tattvātmatayā tannityamavināśi ca bhavati, "tato māyā" ityuktatvāt, 
tatsaṃhārasya pratipādayiṣyamāṇatvāt; evaṃbhūtaṃ yad māyātattvaṃ 
tatsthamiti tadvaśādgopitajñānakriyārūpamātmavargaṃ kṛtveti 
svabhittāvābhāsya, punaśca taṃ tathāvidhaṃ jñānaśaktyā samālokya 
yugapadakramameva kṣobhayediti 
sarvakartṛtvasarvajñatvanairākāṃkṣyākālakalitatvasārvātmyarūpā-
ddharmādaparāmarśanamayakiñcitkartṛtvakiñcijjñatvasākāṅkṣatvakāla 
kalitatvaniyatotthāpakakalāvidyārāgakālaniyatyātmakakañcukakalanāpuraḥ-
saraṃ pradhānakāraṇakāryaparavaśaṃ sampādayati parameśvaraḥ | 
kīdṛgasau ? ---- ityāha ---- icchāśaktyā kriyāśaktyā ca samāviṣṭaḥ,
"evaṃbhūtamidaṃ vastu bhavatviti yadā punaḥ | 

jātā tadaiva tattadvatkurvatyatra kriyocyate ||" (3 | 8)

iti śrīmālinīvijayanidīṣṭanītyecchāmātrānantarameva 
kriyāśaktyā''bhāsayatītyarthaḥ || 59 || 

yugapatkṣobhayedityuktiṃ dṛṣṭāntena parighaṭayati ---- 


helādaṇḍāhatāyāśca badaryā vā phalāni tu | 

tiryagūrdhvamadhastācca nirgacchanti samāsataḥ || 11-60 || 


vāśabda ivārthe | badaryā iva phalāni māyāyā ātmānaḥ 
samanantaravakṣyamāṇatiryagūrdhvādharabhūmīrgacchanti || 60 || 

tatra ---- 


muktestu bhājanaṃ ye'tra anudhyātāḥ śivena tu | 

ūrdhvaṃ gacchanti te sarve śivaṃ paramanirmalam || 11-61 || 


anudhyātā iti kṛtaśaktipātāḥ | yaduktaṃ śrīśrīkaṇṭhyām ---- 

"yayā vinā na sarvajñaḥ śivaḥ sā śaktiraiśvarī | 

yā sā śivaprayuktā tu paśūnāṃ mokṣayettataḥ || 

pated dīkṣānusandhāne dīkṣā jñānādilakṣaṇā | " iti | 

ūrdhvamiti śivaikyaprāptirevaiṣāmūrdhvagatirityarthaḥ || 61 || 

tathā ---- 


vidyāyā bhājanaṃ tiryaṅmantrarūpā bhavanti vai | 

taduktamanyatra ---- 

"vidyāvidyeśatvaṃ tvaparā muktiḥ............ |" (ta0saṃ0 51)

iti || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


saṃsārabhājanaṃ ye tu malakarmakalānvitāḥ || 11-62 || 

adhastātte vrajantyatra ghore'dhvanyatidāruṇe | 


malo'khyātyātmaka āṇavaḥ, śubhādivāsanātmakaṃ karma, kalādikaṃ tu 
māyīyam | ghore bhedamaye | atidāruṇe duḥkhabahale || 62 || 

evaṃ prasaṅgād mantrāṇāṃ baddhamuktānāṃ ca svarūpaṃ pratipādya 
prakṛtāmeva tāttkā sṛṣṭiṃ darśayati ---- 


tasmāt kalā samutpannā vidyā rāgastathaiva ca || 11-63 || 

kālo niyatitattvaṃ ca puṃstattvaṃ prakṛtistathā | 


kevalametaducyate kañcukapañcakavalitāḥ pumāṃso bhoktāraḥ, 
bhogyasāmānyarūpā ca prakṛtiryugapadeva māyātaḥ sambhūtāḥ, 
bhoktṛbhogyayoḥ parasparāpekṣitvāt, ato'tra kalādīnāṃ yugapadeva 
tasmāditi māyātattvādudbhava uktaḥ | śrīmālinīvijaye tu kalāto 
vidyādicatuṣṭayaṃ prakṛtiśca, śrīrauravādau tu kalā rāgavidye 
prasūya, avyaktaṃ janitavatītyādirāgameṣu yaḥ krama uktaḥ tathā kvacit 
kañcukānāṃ catuṣṭayaṃ kvacittrayamiti saṅkhyānyathābhāvo'pi 
dṛśyate, na tatra bhramitavyam | 

"kadalīgarbhadalavanmodakādirasādivat | 

kadambagolavaccitrāḥ kañcukāścitrasaṃvidaḥ ||"

iti śrītrikasāranirūpitanītyā kaścidrajyanvetti kaścicca 
vidanrajyatītyādiḥ puṃsāṃ vicitrapratītikramānusārī 
kañcukakramo'nyathā'nyathā ca sambhāvyate, pratipuṃ 
kalāditattvakramasyoktatvāditi tadanusāraṃ tattacchāstrāvatārakaistathā 
tathā kramabhedamātrapratipādanametat kṛtam, antarbhāvānantarbhāvācca 
saṅkhyābhedo'pi daśītaḥ | vastutaśca 
kiñcitkaromītyādipratītipañcakākṣiptatattvapañcakakañcukavalitāḥ 
pumāṃso bhoktāraḥ, kiñcidaṃśātmā bhogyasāmānyarūpā 
prakṛtirmāyāto yugapadeva udbhūtā iti etattantroktameva jyāyaḥ 
pratibhāti || 

atha ---- 


sattvaṃ rajastamaścaiva prakṛtestu guṇāstrayaḥ || 11-64 || 


trirūpaṃ guṇatattvaṃ jātamityarthaḥ || 64 || 

etad vyāpārabhedena vibhajati ---- 


sattvaṃ prakāśajanakaṃ pravṛttijanakaṃ rajaḥ | 

tamo'vaṣṭambhakaṃ proktaṃ vijñeyaṃ tu guṇatrayam || 11-65 || 


avaṣṭambhakamāvārakam | atra sarvatropapattiḥ prāgeva (2-66) daśītā || 
65 || 

guṇatraye'dhiṣṭhātṛdevatā āha ---- 


sattvaṃ brahmā rajo viṣṇustamo rudraḥ prakītītaḥ | 


sāmānādhikaraṇyoktyā'dhiṣṭhātrabheda evādiṣṭaḥ | 
adhiṣṭhātāro'pi vyāpārabhedāt trayaḥ, vastutastveka eva 
parameśvarastattadvyāpāra iti || 

pūrvopakrāntamevārthaṃ bhāvapratyayabhaṅgyā prathayati ---- 


brahmatve sṛjate lokān viṣṇutve sthitikārakaḥ || 11-66 || 

rudratve saṃharet sarvaṃ jagadetaccarācaram | 


etadanusārataśca ---- 


jāgratsvapnasuṣuptaṃ ca tisro'vasthāśca tadgatāḥ || 11-67 || 


tadgatā iti sattvādiguṇavaśotthitā ityarthaḥ || 

atha ---- 


guṇebhyo dhiṣaṇā jātā..............


dhiṣaṇā buddhiḥ || 

sā ca ---- 


..............bhāvabhedaiḥ samanvitā | 


bhāvā dharmādayaḥ, bhedāśca ahaṅkārendriyādayo vakṣyamāṇāḥ || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


brahmā tatrādhipatyena buddhitattve vyavasthitaḥ || 11-68 || 

sarvajñaṃ ca tamevāhurbauddhānāṃ paramaṃ padam | 


tameva brahmāṇaṃ sarvajñam na tu sarvakartāram, bauddhānāṃ paramaṃ 
padaṃ mokṣadhāma āgamikāḥ kathayanti | śarva eva tadevāhuḥ" iti 
pāṭhaḥ sarva evāgamikā buddhitattvaṃ bauddhānāṃ paramaṃ padamāhuriti 
vyākāryaḥ || 

evamutpattipratipādanaprasaṅgena 
buddhivṛttyātmakaharṣaviṣādādirūpakṣaṇika- 
jñānasantatibhāvanāniṣṭhānāṃ bauddhānāṃ buddhitattvaprāptireva 
mokṣa iti pratipādya, vādyantarābhimataprāpyapadarūpān mokṣābhāsān 
pradarśya śaivānāṃ sarvottamasatyamokṣabhājanatvamiti sphuṭayati | 
yaduktaṃ purastāt ---- 

"ityevaṃvādināṃ teṣāṃ vādānāṃ tu śatatrayam || 

triṣaṣṭiradhikāścānye vādināṃ bhrāntacetasām | 

ajñānatimirāndhānāmunmīlanakṛduttamam ||" (10-680-681)

ityādi | tatra ---- 


guṇeṣvārahatānāṃ ca pradhānaṃ vedavādinām || 11-69 || 


paramaṃ padamiti sambandhaḥ, evamuttaratra | ārhatā hi 
lokapañjarasthānīyaśokamohādyāvaraṇasya taptaśilārohāditapovaśāt 
praśame sukhasaṃvidātmakapudgalānmajjanānmuktimāhuḥ, sukhaṃ ca 
sattvaguṇarūpamiti guṇeṣu sthitāḥ iti || 69 || 

te hi ---- 

"ajāmekāṃ lohitaśuklakṛṣṇāṃ bahvīḥ prajāḥ sṛjamānāṃ sarūpāḥ 
| 

ajo hyeko juṣamāṇo'nuśete jahātyenāṃ bhuktabhogāmajo'nyaḥ ||" (śve0 
4 | 5)

ityādi vadantaḥ prāyaḥ prakṛtimeva paraṃ padamityāhuḥ | taduktaṃ 
gītāsu ---- 

"traiguṇyaviṣayā vedāḥ" (bha0gī0 2-45)

pauruṣaṃ caiva sāṃkhyānāṃ sukhaduḥkhādivajītam | 

teṣāṃ hi sukhaduḥkhādyātmakaprakṛtiviviktacitiśaktimātrarūpasvarūpā-
vāptirmaukṣaḥ || 


ṣaḍviṃśakaṃ ca deveśi yogaśāstre paraṃ padam || 11-70 || 


ṣaḍviṃśameva ṣaḍviṃśakam yadyapi ---- 

"tadā draṣṭuḥ svarūpe'vasthānam" (yo0sū0 1-3)

ityuktyā viviktapuṃrūpatāvāptiryogasthairmokṣa uktaḥ, tathāpi ---- 


"kleśakarmavipākāśayairaparāmṛṣṭaḥ puruṣaviśeṣa īśvaraḥ" (yo0sū0 
1 | 24)

ityetatsūtrabhāṣye bhagevatā vyāsamuninā prāgbandhakoṭivadbhyo 
muktapuruṣebhyo'pīśvarasya nityanirmuktatvanityaiśvaryayogarūpo viśeṣo 
daśīta iti pañcaviṃśasaṅkhyakamupekṣya, tadanugrahakāri 
ṣaḍviṃśakamīśvararūpaṃ paramaṃ padaṃ yogaśāstre daśītam || 70 || 

vrate pāśupate proktamaiśvaraṃ paramaṃ padam | 

"lākulaṃ mausulaṃ caiva dvidhā tantraṃ prakītītam |"

iti dvidhā yatpāśupataṃ, tato mausulasya nirṇeṣyamāṇatvād 
lakuleśapratipāditameveha pāśupatavratamucyate | tatra 
ceśvaratattvāvāptireva paramaṃ padam | pūrvameva ---- 

"vrataṃ pāśupataṃ divyaṃ ye caranti jitendriyāḥ | 

bhasmaniṣṭhā japadhyānāste vrajantyaiśvaraṃ padam ||" (10-1170)

ityuktam || 

pāśupatabheda eva tu kriyāpradhāne ---- 


mausule kāruke caiva māyātattvaṃ prakītītam || 11-71 || 


śrīlakuleśaśiṣyeṇa musulendreṇa kārohaṇasthānāvatīrṇena cāpareṇa 
māyātattvagatakṣemeśabrahmasvāmiprāptihetukriyābahulāḥ sve sve śāstre 
vrataviśeṣā uktā iti māyātattvameva tatra paramaṃ padam || 71 || 

tathā ca māyātattvaniviṣṭaḥ ---- 


kṣemeśo brahmaṇaḥ svāmī teṣāṃ tatparamaṃ padam | 

yathāsaṅkhyena || 

ye'pi vaimalākhyāḥ pāśupatabhedāḥ, tathā 
pañcārthapramāṇāṣṭakoktopāsāparāḥ pare, 
teṣāmīśvaratattvagatatejeśadhruveśau paraṃ padamityāha ---- 


tejeśo vaimalānāṃ ca pramāṇe ca dhruvaṃ padam || 11-72 || 


vaimalapramāṇaśāstraniṣṭho hi ---- 


dīkṣājñānaviśuddhātmā dehāntaṃ yāva caryayā | 

kapālavratamāsthāya svaṃ svaṃ gacchati tatpadam || 11-73 || 


dīkṣājñānaviśuddhātmetipadena 
proktakriyāpradhānavratamātraniṣṭhamausulakārukebhyo'tra viśeṣo 
daśītaḥ | svaṃ svaṃ proktatejeśadhruveśarūpam | yaduktaṃ purastāt ---- 

"tejeśaśca dhruveśaśca pramāṇānāṃ paraṃ padam" (10-1174)

iti || 73 || 

ye tu kapālādyasthivratadhāriṇaḥ pūrvoktalākulāmnāyāt ---- 

"bhasmani śayīta" (1-3)

ityādipāśupataśāstracodanātaḥ ---- 


japabhasmakriyāniṣṭhāste vrajantyaiśvaraṃ padam | 


atra madhye mausulādiviṣayāṃ māyātattvāvasthitimullaṅghya ---- 

"vrate pāśupate proktamaiśvaraṃ paramaṃ padam" (11-71)

iti yad vyutkrameṇoktam, tanmausulādīnāṃ pāśupatabhedapradarśanāya || 

tadevamā bauddhebhyo lākulāntāstattvādhvabhogabhājaḥ na tu muktāḥ | ye 
tu ṣaṭsrotobhedabhinnaṃ śaivaśāstramāsthitāḥ, teṣām ---- 


sarvādhvano viniṣkrāntaṃ śaivānāṃ tu paraṃ padam || 11-74 || 


uktaṃ cānyatra ---- 

"vedādibhyaḥ paraṃ śaivaṃ....................... |"1 iti | 

yattu ---- 

"...................śaivādvāmaṃ tu dakṣiṇam | 

dakṣiṇātparataḥ kaulaṃ kaulātparataraṃ nahi ||"

ityucyate, tat 
śivaproktaśāstrāṇāmavāntaravaicitryapratipādanābhiprāyeṇaiva | 
śaivādvāmamityatra hi śaivaśabdenānuttīrṇaśivapadaprāpakaṃ 
kairaṇādi siddhāntaśāstramucyate || 74 || 

tadevaṃ prāsaṅgikametannirṇīya prakṛtamāha ---- 


buddhitattvādahaṅkāraḥ punarjātastridhā priye | 

sāttviko rājasaścaiva tāmasaśca prakītītaḥ || 11-75 || 


pāribhāṣikasañjñābhedastu prātilomyakrameṇa ---- 


bhūtādirvaikṛtaścaiva taijasaśca tridhā sthitaḥ | 


tatra ---- 


tanmātrāṇyatha bhūtādestebhyo bhūtānyajījanat || 11-76 || 


parameśvara iti śeṣaḥ | bhūtānāṃ sthūlasūkṣmāṇāmādiḥ 
kāraṇamiti vyutpattito'pi bhūtādiḥ || 

tanmātrāṇyāha ---- 


śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhaśca pañcamaḥ | 

etāni pañca khyātāni tanmātrāṇi........


eṣāṃ madhye ---- 


..........krameṇa tu || 11-77 || 

śabdād vyoma samutpannaṃ sparśādvāyustathā punaḥ | 

rūpāttejaḥ samutpannamāpo jātā rasāt punaḥ || 11-78 || 

gandhāttu pṛthivī jātā...........


sparśādayo yathottaraṃ pūrvapūrvatantramātrasahitā vāyvādīnāṃ 
dvyādiguṇānāṃ kāraṇamiti samānatantrādanusartavyam || 

tadetat tanmātrabhūtajanma ---- 


........ṣamāsāt kathitaṃ tava | 


kiṃ ca ---- 


karmendriyāṇi jātāni tasmādvaikārikādatha || 11-79 || 


vikāro'nyānyarūpatātmakaṃ cāñcalyaṃ prayojanaṃ yasya tadvaikārikaṃ 
rājasamiha vivakṣitam | atheti pādapūraṇāya || 79 || 

kāni tānītyāha ---- 


vākpāṇipādaṃ pāyuśca upasthaśceti pañcamam | 


tathā ---- 


buddhīndriyāṇi pañcaiva taijasāttu bhavantyatha || 11-80 || 


atheti prāgvat | tejaḥ prakāśaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya, tat taijasaṃ 
sāttvikamihābhipretam || 

tānyāha ---- 


śrotraṃ tvakcakṣuṣī jihvā nāsikā caiva pañcamī | 


cāñcalyāt sarvaviṣayaprakāśakatvācca ---- 


ubhayātma manaḥ proktaṃ vyāptṛ sarvendriyāṇi tu || 11-81 || 


vyāptṛ iti tṛnpratyayaḥ, ata eva sarvendriyāṇītyatra ṣaṣṭyabhāvaḥ | 
śrīpūrvaśāstre tu ---- 

".........ṭaijasāttasmānmano'kṣeśamajāyata | 

vaikārikāttato'kṣāṇi...................... ||" (1-31)

iti prakriyābhedamātramasti || 81 || 

tadevaṃpratipāditotpādakramāṇi sarvāṇyetāni tattvāni ---- 


ātmopakārakāṇyeva kathitāni yathārthataḥ | 


vakṣyamāṇavibhāgasyātmano 
laukikālaukikabhogatatsādhanatadāśrayādidānena yathārthena 
nijanijānurūpaprayojanasampādanenaitānyupakārakāṇyeva || 

ataścaitatkṛtavicitropaskāra ātmā vicitrarūpa ityāha ---- 


ātmā caivāntarātmā ca bāhyātmā caiva sundari || 11-82 || 

nirātmā paramātmaitān kathayāmi samāsataḥ | 


yathā ---- 


abudhaśca budhaścaiva budhyamānastathaiva ca || 11-83 || 

prabuddhaḥ suprabuddhaśca punaśca kathayāmi te | 


etānityeva || 

tatra ---- 


pradhānasāmyamāśritya sukhaduḥ khavivajītaḥ || 11-84 || 

yadā tasmin sthito devi tadātmā tu sa ucyate | 


pradhānasya prakṛtirūpasya yat sāmyaṃ 
guṇānāmanyonyābhibhavādyabhāvāt sāmarasyenāvasthānam, tadāśritya | 
tasminniti pradhāna eva | sukhādirahitaḥ prakṛtilīnatvād vyāmūḍhaḥ | 
yadvakṣyati ---- 

"guṇasāmyamanirdeśyamapratarkyamanaupamam | 

 tasmin jagadaśeṣaṃ tu prasuptamiva tiṣṭhati ||" (11-287)

iti | evameṣa kañcukamātraśarīraḥ prakṛtilīna ātmetyuktaḥ || 

ayameva ca ---- 


puryaṣṭakasamāyogāt paryaṭet sarvayoniṣu || 11-85 || 

antarātmā sa vijñeyo nibaddhastu śubhāśubhaiḥ | 


āntarasūkṣmaśarīrātmakapuryārambhakatanmātrapañcakamanobuddhyahaṅkāra
atmakaṃ puryaṣṭakam, tatsambandhādvāsanārūpaiḥ śubhāśubhainībaddhaḥ 
san yoneryonyantaraṃ 
prasarannātmabāhyātmanorantarmadhye'vasthitatvādantarātmā jñeyaḥ || 

eṣa eva tu ---- 


buddhikarmendriyairyukto mahābhūtaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ || 11-86 || 

bāhyātmā tu sadā devi bhuṅkte'sau viṣayān sadā | 


sthūladehavāniti yāvat || 

yadā tvayam ---- 


bhūtabhāvavinirmuktastattvadharmakalojjhitaḥ || 11-87 || 

maladharmaikayuktātmā māyādharmatiraskṛtaḥ | 

nirātmā tu sadā jñeyaḥ..........


bhūtaiḥ sthūlasūkṣmaiḥ, bhāvaiśca buddhidharmaivīnirmuktaḥ, 
tattvadharmeṇa puṃstattvātmanā rūpeṇa kalopalakṣitena ca 
kañcukenojjhitaḥ, kevalaṃ 
maladharmeṇaivaikenāpūrṇamanyatātmakāṇavamalasvabhāvena yuktaḥ 
saṃkucitasvabhāvaḥ, yato māyāyāḥ pūrvoktaśaktirūpāyāḥ, na tu 
tattvātmanaḥ, dharmeṇa akhyātyātmanā rūpeṇa, tiraskṛtaḥ 
saṃkucitābhāsīkṛtaḥ, evaṃbhūto nirātmā, ātmanaḥ 
pūrvoktapāśaśatavalitāt puṃstattvalakṣaṇāt svabhāvād niṣkrāntaḥ 
parameśaśāstradṛśā'bhyastamāyāpuṃstattvavivekajñāno vijñānākala 
ityarthaḥ | yaduktaṃ śrīpūrve ---- 

".........................ṭatra vijñānakevalaḥ | 

 malaikayuktaḥ.................................. ||" (1-23)

iti | malakarmaikayuktātmetyapapāṭhaḥ || 

yadā tīvratamānugrahāt pūrṇatayā sphuratyayam, tadā ---- 


.............paramātmātha kathyate || 11-88 || 


na tu pūrvavat paśurūpaḥ || 88 || 

yataḥ ---- 


malakarmakalādyaistu nirmuktaśca yadā priye | 

sarvādhvasamatītaśca māyāmohojjhitaśca yaḥ || 11-89 || 

nirmalatvaṃ yadā yāti padaṃ paramamavyayam | 

paramātmā tadā devi procyate prabhuravyayaḥ || 11-90 || 


yata evāṇavādimalatrayeṇa niḥśeṣeṇa saṃsāraparyantena rūpeṇa 
muktaḥ, ata eva sarvaṃ samanāntamadhyavānaṃ samyak teṣāṃ 
vilāpanayuktyā'pyatīto na kvāpyadhvani gṛhītātmābhimānaḥ, ataśca 
māyāmoheneti ---- 

"karmarūpā sthitā māyā yadadhaḥ śaktikuṇḍalī" (10-1263)

iti pūrvamuktā yā māyā, tatkṛtena mohena susūkṣmeṇāpi 
mahāmāyāsaṅkocena, ujjhito rahitaḥ itthaṃbhūtaḥ san yadā paramaṃ 
padaṃ paramaśivaikyarūpaṃ nirmalatvamāyāti, tadā asāvavyayo'vināśī 
prabhuḥ sarvatra svāmī paramātmetyucyate || 

athābudhādibhedān vyākartumupakramate ---- 


abudhaṃ ca punardevi kathayāmi samāsataḥ | 


tathā ca ---- 

tattvabhūtātmasaṃhāre kalākṣityantagocare || 11-91 || 

māyāsāmyaniśāyāṃ vai saṃhṛtya parameśvaraḥ | 

nirvyāpāro bhavettāvadyāvadvai nodayaḥ punaḥ || 11-92 || 


"abudhastiṣṭhate tatra" (11 | 95)

iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ | kalādikṣityantaṃ yāni tattvāni triṃśat, 
teṣāṃ tadāśrayāṇāṃ ca sthāvarādibrahmāntānāṃ caturdaśānāṃ 
bhūtānāṃ ya ātmā svabhāvaḥ, tasya saṃhāre pravṛttaḥ parameśvaro 
māyāyāḥ sāmyaṃ samastavikṛtipraśamātmakaṃ tadeva viśvaprasvāpād 
niśā tasyāṃ māyīyamaśeṣamadhvaprapañcamanantabhaṭṭārakamukhaṃ 
saṃhṛtya nirvyāpāro bhedasṛṣṭyanunmukhastāvadbhavati, yāvad 
vakṣyamāṇamāyāniśākālapraśamātmā nodaya iti, yāvannāyaṃ 
sukhapravṛttaḥ | tatpravṛttau hi sa punarantarmukhena jagat sṛjan 
savyāpāra eva bhavati || 92 || 

asmiṃśca samaye ---- 


sukhaduḥkhādyabhāvaśca hyātmavargasya karmaṇaḥ | 


karmaṇaḥ kāryasya, kalādikṣityantadehayogenollāsyasyātmavargasya sarvasya 
jīvajātasya sukhaduḥkhaśarīrādyabhāvo bhavati, gāḍhamūḍhatvaṃ 
sampadyata ityarthaḥ || 

tadā hyasāvātmavargaḥ ---- 


malanidrāvimūḍhātmā ruddhacaitanyadṛkkriyaḥ || 11-93 || 

na vijānāti śabdādīnātmānaṃ ca varānane | 

kāraṇaṃ na vijānāti na ca sthānaṃ svakaṃ priye || 11-94 || 

sarvametanna jānāti yato luptākṣadṛkkriyaḥ | 

abudhastiṣṭhate tatra yāvanmāyāaharmukham || 11-95 || 


malenākhyātyātmanā janitayā nidrayā svāpena viśeṣeṇa mūḍho jāḍyaṃ 
prāpita ātmā, yataśca ruddhe caitanyātmike pūrṇe dṛkkriye yasya, 
yataśca saṃhāravaśād lupte akṣasambandhinyau dṛkkriye yasya 
tathābhūto'yam ata eva na vijānāti śabdādīn ātmānaṃ ca 
grāhakasvarūpam, īdṛgahamityantaḥkaraṇenāpi niścinute na | kāraṇaṃ ca 
parameśamīdṛśavyāmohādidaśotthāpakaṃ svaṃ ca māyātmakaṃ 
sthānamāśrayaṃ na jānāti | etatsarvaṃ yato na jānāti 
tato'yamabudhyamānatvādabudhaḥ | tatreti māyāyāṃ tāvadāste 
yāvanmāyīyamaharmukham | māyāaharmukhamiti sandhyabhāvaśchāndasaḥ | 
yataḥ śabdāpekṣaṃ tata ityadhyāhāryam | tadayamitthaṃ māyālīnaḥ 
pralayākalo'budha ityuktaḥ | yastu pūrvam ---- 

"pradhānasāmyamāśritya" (11-84)

iti granthenātmā uktaḥ, sa prakṛtilīna iti viśeṣaḥ || 11-95 || 

tadittham ---- 


abudhastu samākhyātaḥ............


atha ---- 


............budhaṃ caiva nibodha me | 


tatra ---- 


paripākagate karmaṇīśvarecchākaroddhṛte || 11-96 || 

prakāśaṃ nāyanaṃ yadvadanugṛhṇāti bhāskaraḥ | 

karaṇānyanugṛhṇāti tadvadīśvara ātmanām || 11-97 || 


ātmanāmanekakarmamadhyāt kasmiṃścit karmaṇi, udrekavaśāt paripākagate 
phaladānayogye, asyāṇorasmāt karmaṇa īdṛk phalamastu, 
itīdṛgīśasyānantamūrterbhagavato yā icchā, saiva karastena 
uddhṛte'nantakarmasantatimadhyād niṣkṛṣya taṃ tamātmānaṃ prati 
bhogāya yojite sati, teṣāmevātmanāṃ kalādīni karaṇāni, anugṛhṇāti 
unmīlayati yena te ātmānaḥ kiñcitkartṛtvādipratītibhājo jāyante | atra 
dṛṣṭānto yathā nāyanaṃ prakāśaṃ bhāskaro'gṛhṇāti | yathā 
tadanugrahaṃ vinā nāsau bhāvān prakāśayati, evamīśvarānunmīlitāḥ 
kalādayo na kiñcitkartṛtvādipratītibhāja ātmanaḥ sampādayantīti 
sarvatra īśvarecchaiva bhagavatī bhavati || 97 || 

tadanugrahādeva hyātmā ---- 


kalonmīlitacaitanyo vidyādaśītagocaraḥ | 


etat pūrvameva vyākṛtam || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


rāgo'sya rañjakatvena viṣayānandalakṣaṇaḥ || 11-98 || 


sāmānyaviṣayābhiṣvaṅgātmā rāgo'sya puṃso rañjakatvena sthitaḥ || 98 
|| 

tathā ---- 


kālo vai kalayatyenaṃ tuṭyādipralayāvadhiḥ | 

niyatinīścitaṃ nityaṃ yojayecca śubhāśubhe || 11-99 || 


etadapi prāgeva nirṇītam || 99 || 

saṃyojya ca tatphalamasya ---- 


paramāṇusahasrāṃśānna ca nyūnaṃ ca cādhikam | 


taditthaṃ kalādipañcakaveṣṭito'yam ---- 


puṃbhāvaṃ samanuprāpya tattve ca puruṣāhvaye || 11-100 || 


vartate iti śeṣaḥ | 

"ākhyāhvayaśca vijñeyau nāmaparyāyanāmanī | "

ityukteḥ sañjñāyāṃ rūḍha āhvayaśabdaḥ | puruṣa ityāhvayo yasya tat 
puruṣāhvayam || 100 || 

puruṣaśabdamakṣarasāmyena nirvakti ---- 


puraṃ pradhānamityuktaṃ prapañcānekasaṃkulam | 

tatpuraṃ poṣayedyasmāttasmādvai puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ || 11-101 || 


buddhyādikṣityantenānekena prapañcena pariṇāmabhūyastvena saṃkulaṃ 
vyāptaṃ pradhānaṃ yasmāt poṣayed ātmaprakāśābhiniveśanena 
cetanāyamānaṃ sampādayet, tasmādayaṃ puruṣa ityukta ityarthaḥ | 
prapañcāneketi pūrvanipātavyatyayaśchāndasaḥ || 101 || 

taditthaṃ pradhānāśayamāpannamimam ---- 


yataḥ śrīkaṇṭhanāthastu niyatyā karmataḥ paśum | 

pradhānapāśajālena veṣṭayedasamañjasam || 11-102 || 


paśumāṇavapāśapāśitaṃ kalādikañcukavalitaṃ ca puruṣaṃ 
pradhānāśayamāpannaṃ pradhānāntedhvanyadhikṛtaḥ śrīkaṇṭhanāthaḥ 
pradhānasambandhinā pāśajālena niyativaśotthitakarmānusāramasamañjasam, 
anātmanyabhiniveśanāyānanurūpameva veṣṭayet || 102 || 

prādhānikapāśaveṣṭanaṃ spaṣṭayati ---- 


baddhastriguṇabandhena buddhayā vaikārikeṇa tu | 

tanmātrendriyabandhena dṛḍhaṃ bhūtaiśca veṣṭitaḥ || 11-103 || 


pūrvaṃ sattvādiguṇairvalitaḥ, tatastatpariṇāmakramādadhyavasāyātmanā 
buddhyā, tato'bhimānātmakaduratikramaṇīyavikāraprayojanena 
vaikārikādirūpeṇāhaṅkāreṇa | vaikārikeṇetyupalakṣaṇaparam | 
tato'pyāhaṅkārikeṇa tanmātrendriyavargeṇa, tato'pi 
tanmātrakāryairāhārādivaśotthaśukraśoṇitakramaprasṛtaiḥ 
sthūlairbhūtairdṛḍhaṃ gāḍhaṃ kṛtvā'yaṃ veṣṭito baddhaḥ || 103 || 

kīdṛśo'yam ---- 

baddhaḥ sañcarati hyevaṃ māyādyavanigocare | 


evaṃ baddho māyādibhūmyante sañcarati yoneryonyantaraṃ śrayati || 

ataśca ---- 


saṃsārī procyate tasmāt saṃsaredyat punaḥ punaḥ || 11-104 || 


evamitthaṃ niruktasya puruṣasya saṃsāriṇaḥ ---- 

śabdādiviṣayā yasmādvidyante viṣayī tataḥ | 

eṣa evetyarthaḥ || 

ataścāyam ---- 


viṣayāḥ paramityāha...............


stryādayo ye viṣayāḥ tadeva paraṃ prakṛṣṭaṃ vastviti brūte || 

kīdṛśā viṣayāḥ ---- 


...............ṇānābhedaivīsapītāḥ || 11-105 || 

nānākarmavipākaiśca.............


nānābhedairityupalakṣitāḥ | visapītā upasamprāptāḥ | 
nānākarmavipākaiḥ sukhaduḥkhādibhedaiḥ sahetyarthaḥ || 

tadetān viṣayānayaṃ ---- 


..............bhuṅkte tadbhāvabhāvitaḥ | 


teṣāṃ viṣayāṇāṃ bhāvena sattayā bhāvito vāsitāntaḥkaraṇaḥ || 


evaṃ bhuṅkte tu vai yasmāttasmādbhoktā sa ucyate || 11-106 || 


sa iti viṣayī || 106 || 

kiṃ cāyam ---- 


tasmiṃstajjño varārohe kṣetre vai kārṣako yathā | 


tasminniti bhūtaparyante kṣetre | tajjña iti kṣetrajña ucyate | kārṣako 
yatheti dṛṣṭāntapakṣe kṣetraṃ kedāraḥ || 

dṛṣṭāntaṃ śleṣacchāyayā sphuṭayati ---- 


mahābhilāṣamālokya kṛṣedvai lobhalāṅgalaiḥ || 11-107 ||


yathā kārṣakaḥ kaluṣajalarajoviśrāntirmā 
syāditīdṛśamahābhilāṣamālokya vicārya tat kṣetraṃ lāṅgalairhalaiḥ 
kṛṣatyullikhati, tathā

"abhilāṣo malo'tra tu" (sva0 4-105)

ityuktasthityā malarūpamabhilāṣaṃ vimṛśya dehātmakakṣetraṃ bahulobhena 
kṛṣati karmabījavāpayogyaṃ karotīti rūpakaśleṣacchāyayā uktiḥ || 

atha ca ---- 


vapecca mohabhāvena manovākkāyikaṃ sadā | 

dharmādharmamayaṃ bījaṃ pravikīrya samantataḥ || 11-108 || 


mohabhāveneti mahāyāsadāyyetadityavicāreṇa | vapediti 
kṣetrapariniṣṭhitaṃ sampādayet || 

taduttarakālaṃ ca ---- 


tasmādvai aṅkurotpattiḥ...............


tasmādeva bījād nānāśarīrendriyātmano'ṅkurasyotpattirbhavati || 

kīdṛśītyāha ---- 


..............ṣukhaduḥkhaphalodayā | 


sukharūpasya duḥkhaphalasyodayo yatra || 

sā cāṅkurotpattiḥ ---- 


vardhate kāmakrodhena siktā rāgāmbunā bhṛśam || 11-109 || 


ataśca ---- 


yasmin deśe ca kāle ca vayasā yādṛśena ca | 

uptaṃ śubhāśubhaṃ karma tatkāle labhate phalam || 11-110 || 


tatkāla iti bhāvijanmagatatāruṇyādisamaye ityarthaḥ || 110 || 

labdhvā ca tat ---- 


bhuṅkte tu vividhākāraṃ pūrvakarmavaśād budhaḥ | 


budha iti yo nirṇetumupakrāntaḥ || 

tadevamayamīdṛśaṃ kṣetram--


yasmādevaṃ vijānāti tasmāt kṣetrajña ucyate || 11-111 || 


tadittham ---- 


viṣayān budhyate yasmād budhastasmāt prakītītaḥ | 


itthamayaṃ budhaḥ puruṣaḥ saṃsārī viṣayī bhoktā kṣetrajña iti ca 
tattadarthānugatābhiḥ sañjñābhirucyate || 

budhyamānaṃ lakṣayati ---- 


tadevāniṣṭarūpeṇa yadā bhāvayate pumān || 11-112 || 

budhyamānastu sa tadā............


tadeveti viṣayabhogādi || 

etadeva vibhajati ---- 


............'dhunā kathayāmi te | 


tathā ---- 


yadā jugupsate bhogān śubhāṃścaivāśubhāṃstathā || 11-113 || 

kṛtrimāneva manyeta paraṃ vairāgyamāśritaḥ | 

māyādyavaniparyantamindrajālaṃ tu budhyate || 11-114 || 


māyetyādinā tattattattvabhuvanabhogeṣvapi bhedamayeṣvasya viraktirdaśītā 
|| 

kiṃ ca ---- 


putramitrakalatrāṇi suhṛtsvajanabāndhavāḥ | 

yadajītaṃ mayā dravyaṃ śubhenāpyaśubhena vā || 11-115 || 

tadbhokṣyante tvime sarve nirātaṅkā nirākulāḥ | 

ekākī cāhamevaiṣa yāsyāmi yamasādanam || 11-116 || 

tasmācca na śubhā hyete vairiṇo'narthakāriṇaḥ | 


mitraṃ parasparopakāravaśāt snigdham, suhṛttvakāraṇameva 
śobhanahṛdayaḥ | svajano dāsādiḥ | sadanameva sādanam | 

na kevalaṃ putrādibhya eva jugupsate, yāvat ---- 


svātmīyamapyayaṃ dehaṃ nityameva jugupsate || 11-117 || 

śukraśoṇitasambhūtaṃ viṣayoragadūṣitam | 

nānāvyādhisamākīrṇaṃ jarāmṛtyubhayākulam || 11-118 || 


ataśca ---- 


so'hamasmi malākīrṇe kathamatra ramāmyaham | 


so'hamasmītyāgamādyavagatasatyātmasvarūpo bhavāmi | malamaśucidravyam || 

taditthamayamāvirbhūtavairāgyaḥ ---- 


nityamudvignacittastu cintayedvai punaḥ punaḥ || 11-119 || 

kathaṃ muktirbhavedasmāt saṃsārād duratikramāt | 

evaṃ prabuddho deveśi tallayastatparāyaṇaḥ || 11-120 || 

sarvārambhavinirmuktaḥ pramuktaḥ procyate tadā | 

prabuddhastu samākhyātaḥ suprabuddhaṃ tu me śṛṇu || 11-121 || 

dīkṣājñānena yogena caryayāpyatha suvrate | 

yadā prāptaḥ paraṃ sthānamadhvātītaṃ nirāmayam || 11-122 || 

virajo vimalaṃ śāntaṃ prapañcātītagocaram | 

niṣkampaṃ kāraṇātītaṃ sarvajñaṃ sarvatomukham || 11-123 || 

sutṛptānādisambuddhaṃ svatantraṃ nityameva hi | 

aluptaśaktivibhavaṃ suprabuddhaṃ sanātanam || 11-124 || 

tasmin yuktastadātmā vai tadguṇaistu samanvitaḥ | 

suprabuddhaḥ sa evokto bhairavasya vaco yathā || 11-125 || 

na cādhikāritā dīkṣāṃ vinā yoge'sti śāṅkare | 


iha ātmā'ntarātmā coktaḥ, vijñānākalo nirātmeti, 
pralayākalo'pyabudha iti, sakala eva ca bāhyaviṣayāvabodhād buddha iti, 
āyātaśaktipāto buddhyamānaḥ, śivayajñadīkṣitaḥ prāptajñānaḥ 
prabuddhaḥ, svabhyastajñānastu prāptaśivaikātmyo 
niścalapratipattirjīvanmuktaḥ suprabuddha iti śuddhātmā buddhyamānaḥ 
prabuddhaḥ suprabuddhaḥ parātmeti catuvīdha uktaḥ || 
evamātmopayogitattvasarganirūpaṇānantaraṃ jñāniyoginaḥ pratyupayogino 
heyopādeyatāpradarśanāyātmano'vasthāviśeṣān nirūpya ---- 

"guṇebhyo dhiṣaṇā jātā bhāvabhedaiḥ samanvitā" (11-68)

ityupakrāntān bhāvabhedānnirūpayitum ---- 


adhunā kathayiṣyāmi bhāvabhedān varānane || 11-126 || 


bhāvayanti vāsayatyantaḥkaraṇamiti bhāvā dharmādayo'ṣṭau || 126 || 

tatrādau bhedānāha ---- 


kāraṇāni daśa trīṇi kāryaṃ ca daśadhā priye | 


bhāvānapyāha ---- 


ekādaśendriyavadhā ahaṅkārastu vai tridhā || 11-127 || 

buddhiraṣṭavidhā caiva pañcadhā tu viparyayaḥ | 


atrāhaṅkārastrividho bhedamadhye gaṇanīyaḥ || 

atha ---- 


nāmānyeṣāṃ vibhāgena kathayāmi yathākramam || 11-128 || 


tatra kāryaviṣayāṇi kāraṇāni, kāryāṇi ca sthūlāni 
sūkṣmapratītihetubhūtānītyāśayenoddeśavaiparītyena nāmānyāha ---- 


pṛthivyāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśameva ca || 11-129 || 

gandho rasaśca tanmātre rūpatanmātrameva ca | 

sparśaḥ śabdaśca pañcaiva tanmātrāṇīritāni tu || 11-130 || 


īritānyudīritāni || 130 || 


etatte daśadhā kāryaṃ kītītaṃ nāmasaṅkhyayā | 


atha ---- 


vākpāṇipādaṃ pāyuṃ ca upasthaṃ ca tathā viduḥ || 11-131 || 

śrotraṃ tvakcakṣuṣī jihvā nāsikā ceti kītītam | 

bahiṣkaraṇakaṃ devi daśadhā saṃvyavasthitam || 11-132 || 

mano'haṅkārabuddhyākhyaṃ tridhāntaḥkaraṇaṃ smṛtam | 


evaṃ trayoviṃśatidhā kāryakāraṇānyuktvā, 
indriyāsāmarthyarūpānindriyavadhākhyān bhāvān yathākramaṃ vyanakti ---
- 


mūkatā kauṇyapaṃgutvaṃ tathānutsargatāpi ca || 11-133 || 

nirānandaśca vijñeyo badhiratvaṃ tathaiva ca | 

śīrṇatā caiva gātrasya tathā cāndhatvameva ca || 11-134 || 

anāsvādastvagandhaśca anavasthā manasyatha | 

itīndriyavadhāḥ khyātā ekādaśa tu tatkramāt || 11-135 || 


tatkramāditi proktavākpāṇyādikramāt || 

prāgeva ca ---- 


tejaso vaikṛtākhyaśca bhūtādiśca tṛtīyakaḥ | 

ahaṅkārastridhā prokto mayā te varavaṇīni || 11-136 || 


atha ---- 


dharmo jñānaṃ ca vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ ca caturthakam | 

adharmaṃ ca tathājñānamavairāgyamanaiśvaram || 11-137 || 

aṣṭāvete samākhyātā buddherdharmādayo guṇāḥ | 


kiṃ ca ---- 


tamo moho mahāmohastāmisro'nyo viparyayaḥ || 11-138 || 

andhatāmisramityāhurevaṃ pañca viparyayāḥ | 


guṇabuddhyahaṅkṛttanmātrātmani sūkṣmaśarīre indriyabhūtātmake 
sthūladehe dṛṣṭānuśravikaiḥ spṛhaṇīye śabdādiviṣayapañcake ya 
ātmābhimānaḥ, sa krameṇa tamo moho mahāmoha ityucyate | yastu 
śarīrabāhyaviṣayāpakāriṇi dveṣaḥ, sa tāmisraḥ | tadviyogabhayāt 
trāso'ndhatāmisraḥ || 

tadevam ---- 


bhāvabhedāḥ samākhyātāḥ pañcāśatte yathākramam || 11-139 || 


atha dharmādīnāṃ prabhedān pratipādayan 
sāṃkhyoktāṃstuṣṭisiddhayādīn darśayituṃ prakramate ---- 


punaścāṣṭau tu ye buddherbhedā dharmādayaḥ sthitāḥ | 

teṣāṃ bhedā yathā bhinnāstathāhaṃ kathayāmi te || 11-140 || 


"punaḥ" śabdaḥ "kathayāmi" ityetadanantaraṃ yojyaḥ || 

dharmādyaṣṭakarūpā yā buddhiḥ, sā jñānākhyabhedavarjam ---- 


badhnāti saptadhā sā tu paṃsaḥ saṃsāravartmani | 


aṣṭamena tu ---- 


mocayejjñānabhāvena sāṃkhyajñānaratānnarān || 11-141 || 


sāṃkhyetyādyukteḥ sāṃkhyadṛṣṭāveva te muktāḥ, na tvihetyāśayo'gre 
vyaktībhaviṣyati || 141 || 

eṣāṃ dharmādīnāṃ madhyāt ---- 


jñānaṃ ca sāttvikaṃ proktaṃ trayo'nye rājasāḥ smṛtāḥ | 

tāmasāścāpyadharmādyāścatvāro vai varānane || 11-142 || 


traya ityaiśvaryavairāgyadharmāḥ || 142 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


dharmaśca daśadhā prokto jñānaṃ caivāṣṭadhā smṛtam | 

vairāgyaṃ navadhā caivamaiśvaryaṃ cāṣṭadhā viduḥ || 11-143 || 

eta eva viparyastā adharmādyāḥ prakītītāḥ | 


eta eva te dharmādayo yathāproktasaṅkhyāprabhedā ityarthaḥ || 

tatra dharmaṃ daśavidhaṃ tāvadāha ---- 


akrodho guruśuśrūṣā śaucaṃ santoṣa ārjavam || 11-144 || 

ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryamakalkatā | 

evaṃ daśavidho dharmaḥ kathitastu varānane || 11-145 || 


akalkatā'pāpacittatā || 145 || 

jñānabhedānāha ---- 


tāraṃ sutāraṃ taraṇaṃ tārakaṃ ca pramodakam | 

pramuditaṃ ramyakaṃ ca sadāpramuditaṃ tathā || 11-146 || 

etajjñānaṃ samākhyātaṃ samāsāt parameśvari | 


yat pūrvaṃ puṃstattvabhuvananirṇayāvasare ---- 

"tārā caiva sutārā ca" (10-1071)

ityādi siddhyapekṣayā strīpāṭhenoktam, tat 
sāṃkhyoktohādirūpasiddhyaṣṭakaṃ jñānaviśeṣamityāśayena | iha 
jñānasamānādhikaraṇyena napuṃsakanirdeśenoktau kevalaṃ pūrvaṃ 
modamāneti yatpaṭhitam, tatsthāna iha taraṇamiti pāṭhamātrabhedaḥ na tu 
vastubhedaḥ kaścit || 

pūrvoktaṃ tuṣṭinavakamapi vairāgyaprabhedarūpamityāha ---- 


ambhā ca salilā oghā vṛṣṭisañjñā tathāparā || 11-147 || 

sutārā ca supārā ca sunetrā ca parā smṛtā | 

aṣṭamī ca kumārī syāduttamāmbhasikā tathā || 11-148 || 


tadittham ---- 


vairāgyaṃ navadhā caiva kathitaṃ tu mayā tava | 


tadetatsiddhituṣṭisaptadaśakamiha 
tārādidevatādhiṣṭhitatvādevamabhihitamiti prāgevoktam || 

athaiśvarya vibhāgato darśayati ---- 


aṇimā laghimā caiva mahimā prāptireva ca || 11-149 || 

prākāmyaṃ ca tatheśitvaṃ vaśitvaṃ ca tathā param | 

yatrakāmāvasāyitvamaṣṭamaṃ parikītītam || 11-150 || 

eśvaryamaṣṭadhā caiva kathitaṃ tu varānane | 


athākrodhādiviparītān krodhādīnadharmabhedānāha ---- 


krodhaścāguruśuśrūṣā aśaucaṃ ca tataḥ param || 11-151 || 

asantoṣo'nārjavaṃ ca hiṃsā cāsatyameva ca | 

steyamabrahmacaryaṃ ca tathā caiva sakalkatā || 11-152 || 

evameṣa samākhyāto daśadhā'dharmasaṃgrahaḥ | 


ajñānabhedānāha ---- 


atāramasutāraṃ ca atāraṇamathāpi ca || 11-153 || 

atārakaṃ ca deveśi caturthaṃ parikītītam | 

apramodo'pramuditamaramyakamathāpi ca || 11-154 || 

asadāpramuditaṃ tadajñānaṃ caivamaṣṭadhā | 


etā eva sāṃkhyairuhādisiddhiviparītā aṣṭau buddheraśaktaya uktāḥ || 

avairāgyabhedānāha ---- 


anambhā asalilā ca anoghāvṛṣṭireva ca || 11-155 || 

asutāramasupāramasunetramataḥ param | 

akumārī ca vijñeyānuttamāmbhasikā tathā || 11-156 || 


tadittham ---- 


anaṇimālaghimā caivāmahimā maheśvari | 

aprāptiraprākāmyaṃ cānīśitvaṃ ca tathaiva ca || 11-157 || 

avaśitvaṃ tathā caivāyatrakāmāvasāyitā | 


tadittham ---- 


anaiśvaryaṃ ca deveśi aṣṭadhā parikītītam | 


evaṃ tattvasargāntarito yo bhāvasargo'bhihitaḥ, sa yathā yatra 
sthitastatpratipādayitumāha ---- 


anaiśvaryādibhiścaite paiśācādyā adhiṣṭhitāḥ || 11-158 || 


adhiṣṭhitā vyāptāḥ || 158 || 

ataśca ---- 


yathākrameṇa teṣvaṣṭau saṃsthitān kathayāmi te | 


teṣu paiśācādiṣu | aṣṭāvanaiśvaryādīn || 

tatra ---- 


anaiśvaryaṃ hi paiśāce avairāgyaṃ ca rākṣase || 11-159 || 

yākṣe caiva tadajñānaṃ gāndharve'dharma eva ca | 

dharmaṃ caiva tathaindre tu jñānaṃ saumye pratiṣṭhitam || 11-160 || 

prājāpatye tu vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ brahmaṇi sthitam | 


pradhānatayeti śeṣaḥ || 

yaccaitadaiśvaryamuktam ---- 


catuṣṣaṣṭiguṇaṃ caitat pade brāhme vyavasthitam || 11-161 || 

ṣaṭpañcāśadguṇaṃ tacca prājāpatye vyavasthitam | 

aṣṭacatvāriṃśadguṇaṃ saumye vai parikītītam || 11-162 || 

catvāriṃśadguṇaṃ caiva māhendraiśvaryamucyate | 

dvātriṃśadguṇitaṃ devi gāndharvaiśvaryamucyate || 11-163 || 

catuvīśaguṇaṃ yākṣaṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ rākṣasaṃ smṛtam | 

eśvaryamaṣṭaguṇitaṃ paiśācaṃ parikītītam || 11-164 || 

evaṃ sthitaṃ tadaiśvaryaṃ devayoniṣu suvrate | 


devayoniṣvityarthalabdhamabhidadhato'yamāśayaḥ ---- yādṛk sārvabhaumasya 
narapateraiśvaryam, tato'ṣṭaguṇaṃ paiśācam, 
tato'pyuttarottaramaṣṭaguṇaṃ rākṣasādiṣu, anyathā'vadherabhāve 
kimapekṣamaṣṭaguṇatvādi syāt | evaṃ brāhmaiśvaryāpekṣaṃ 
piśācānāmanaiśvaryamevolbaṇam, cakravartyapekṣayā 
tvaṣṭaguṇamaiśvaryamucyate || 

evaṃvidhaiśvaryavyaktiriktāstu ye dharmādayaḥ, te ---- 


anye saptasvarūpeṇa saṃsthitā devayoniṣu || 11-165 || 


yadyapi sarve buddhidharmāḥ santiḥ, tathāpi 
paiśācādikrameṇānaiśvaryāderekaikasya prakarṣaḥ, anyeṣāṃ tvapakarṣa 
ityuktam || 165 || 

na kevalamitthamete devayoniṣu guṇapradhānabhāvena sthitāḥ, yāvat ---- 


eta eva susaṅkīrṇā mānuṣeṣu vyavasthitāḥ | 


suṣṭhu saṅkīrṇā alakṣyamāṇavivekāḥ, ata eva mānuṣyamekarūpam || 

tiryagbhede kā vārtā ityāha ---- 


pradhānaguṇabhāvena sthāvarāntaṃ vyavasthitāḥ || 11-166 || 


paśvādayastāmasatvād adharmādicatuṣṭayamayāḥ | tatrāpi ca 
yathottaramadharmādayaḥ prakṛṣyante || 166 || 

athātraiva yathāvibhaktaviṣaye bhāvabhede ---- 


guṇatrayasya vyāptiṃ vai kathayāmi yathāsthitām | 


tatra ---- 


sattvenādhiṣṭhitā devā brahmādyā maghavāntakāḥ || 11-167 || 


brahmādyā maghavadantāścatvāraḥ sattvapradhānāḥ || 


gandharvayakṣamanujā daityāścaiva tu rājasāḥ | 

yātudhānāḥ piśācāśca tāmasāḥ parikītītāḥ || 11-168 || 


daityā yakṣaprāyā eva || 168 || 


rajaḥsattvotkaṭā jñeyā ṛṣayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ | 


saṃśitaṃ sutīkṣṇaṃ vrataṃ jñānavijñānopāyānuṣṭhānaniyamo 
yeṣāṃ te devamānuṣāntarālaprāyatvād rajaḥsattvābhyāmutkaṭāḥ || 

ye ca devādyā ṛṣiparyantayonibhedāḥ ---- 


anyonyābhibhavāste ca pṛthivyāṃ saṃvyavasthitāḥ || 11-169 || 


yātudhānaprabhṛtibhirdevaṣīprabhṛtayo durvṛttena bhūrloke'bhibhūyante, 
tairapi te śauryatapomantrādiprabhāvāt, na tu guṇā anyonyābhibhavāḥ 
pṛthivyāmiti vyākhyeyaṃ teṣāmanyonyābhibhavādirūpatāyāḥ 
sarvatrāviśeṣāt pṛthivyāmiti viśeṣacodanāyā anupapatteḥ || 169 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


atyantatamasāviṣṭāḥ sthāvarāśca sarīsṛpāḥ | 


vṛkṣādayaḥ sarpādyāśca gāḍhatāmasā mohakrodhamayatvāt || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


pādapādavihīnāśca tāmasāḥ parikītītāḥ || 11-170 || 

sarīsṛpādyā vijñeyāḥ............


sarīsṛpā ādau yeṣāṃ prātilomyakrameṇa pakṣyādīnāṃ te 
sarīsṛpādyāḥ paśvantāḥ sarva eva tāmasāḥ, kintu pādapādavihīnā 
iti sarīsṛpebhyaḥ pakṣiṇāṃ pādena hīnaṃ tāmasatvam, tebhyo'pi 
mṛgāṇāṃ, tebhyo'pi paśūnām | tadīdṛśī guṇavyāptiriha bhagavatā 
vibhajya daśītā, sāṃkhyaistu ---- 

"ūrdhvaṃ sattvaviśālastamoviśālastu mūlataḥ sargaḥ | 

madhye rajoviśālo brahmādistambaparyantaḥ ||" (sā0kā0 54)

ityaviśeṣeṇa devayonipaśvādimanuṣyāṇāṃ sattvatamorajomayatvaṃ 
daśītam || 

taditthaṃ guṇavaicitryeṇa daśītā ye ---- 


.............ṣthāvarāntāstu suvrate | 


caturdaśa yonibhedāḥ || 


eṣāmantargatāścānyā anantā eva yonayaḥ || 11-171 || 

mānuṣeṣu tathānantā bhedānantyavyavasthayā | 

na śakyā gadituṃ tā vai karmānantyaprabhedataḥ || 11-172 || 


mānuṣeṣviti punavīśeṣoktyā digdeśakālasamācārādivaicitryeṇa 
teṣāmanantaśākhatvaṃ kathayati | karmasambandhino'nantād prabhedāditi 
yonyānantyahetuḥ || 172 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


guṇāstu mānuṣe loke dharmādyā iva saṃsthitāḥ | 


yathā ---- 

"eta eva susaṅkīrṇā mānuṣeṣu vyavasthitāḥ" (11-166)

iti dharmādyāḥ susaṅkīrṇā manuṣyāṇāmuktāḥ tathā guṇā 
apyalakṣyamāṇaviśeṣā ityarthaḥ || 

adharmādibhirguṇaiśca ye saṅkīrṇā mānuṣāḥ tadupadeṣṭṝṇi ---- 


dharmādyeṣu nibaddhāni yāni jñānāni suvrate || 11-173 || 

adharmādyeṣu yāni syustāni te kathayāmyaham | 


dharmādyeṣviti tadviṣaye tadvācake ityarthāt | jñānāni śāstrāṇi || 

tatra ---- 


hetuśāstraṃ ca yalloke nityānityaviḍambakam || 11-174 || 


nityatvānityatvābhyāṃ sādhyābhyāṃ viḍambayati vañcayati pratipādyaṃ 
tattvatastanniścayāyogāditi nityānityaviḍambakam | bhāvapradhāno 
nirdeśaḥ || 174 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


vādajalpavitaṇḍābhiḥ...............


yaduktaṃ pramāṇatarkasādhanopālambhaḥ siddhāntāviruddhaḥ 
pakṣapratipakṣaparigraho vītarāgakathārūpo vādaḥ | sa eva 
cchalajātinigrahopapannaḥ puruṣaśaktiparīkṣārtho jalpaḥ | 
pratipakṣasthāpanahīnastu vitaṇḍā || 

evaṃbhūtaṃ hetuśāstraṃ sadāgamabāhyaṃ tarkaśāstraṃ yat, tena ---- 


.............vivadante hyaniścitāḥ | 


na vidyate niścitaṃ vastusatattvaniścayo yeṣām, te vivadante ---- idaṃ 
tattvamidaṃ neti parasparavyāhataṃ raṭanti || 

yatasteṣām ---- 


hetuniṣṭhāni vākyāni..............


na tvāgamikārthavicārarūpāṇi || 

ataśca ---- 


.......vastuśūnyāni suvrate || 175 || 

jñānayogavihīnāni devatārahitāni tu | 

tenaiṣām ---- 


dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu niścayo naiva jāyate || 11-176 || 


ata evaitāni ---- 


ajñānena nibaddhāni tvadharmeṇa nimittataḥ | 


uktaṃ ca prāk ---- 

"gurudevāgniśāstrasya ye na bhaktā narādhamāḥ || 

asadyuktivicārajñāḥ śuṣkatarkāvalambinaḥ | 

bhramayatyeva tān māyā hyamokṣe mokṣalipsayā ||" (10-1140-1141)

iti | tathā ---- 

śatpathaṃ tu parityajya nayati drutamutpatham" (10-1140)

iti || 

yata evaṃbhūtaṃ hetuśāstraṃ tena ---- 


nirayaṃ te pragacchanti ye tatrābhiratā narāḥ || 11-177 || 


kiṃ ca, adharmanimittakājñānamayeṣu śuṣkatarkeṣu ---- 


avairāgyādanaiśvaryaṃ bhuñjate niraye sadā | 


ataścādharmājñānāvairāgyānaiśvaryākhyā buddhidharmāḥ ---- 


catvāraste varārohe duḥkhadā narake sadā || 11-178 || 

mohakāḥ sarvajantūnāṃ yataste tāmasāḥ smṛtāḥ | 


evamadharmādicatuṣṭayamayāni śuṣkatarkaśāstrāṇyuktvā 
dharmādinibaddhāni śāstrāṇyāha ---- 


dharmeṇaikena deveśi baddhaṃ jñānaṃ hi laukikam || 11-179 || 


laukikaṃ vārtādaṇḍanītyādi || 179 || 


dharmajñānanibaddhaṃ tu pāñcarātraṃ ca vaidikam | 


pāñcarātrairabhigamanopādānejyādidharmavat ---- 

"bhūta eva sa svayaṃ bhavati"

ityādi jñānamapyupadiśyate | vaidikairapi karmānuṣṭhānavat ---- 

"puruṣa evedaṃ sarvam" (ṛ0ve0 10-90-2)

iti jñānakāṇḍādau jñānamapyucyate || 


bauddhamārahataṃ caiva vairāgyeṇaiva suvrate || 11-180 || 


baddhamityeva || 180 || 


jñānavairāgyasambaddhaṃ sāṃkhyajñānaṃ hi pārvati | 


jñānaṃ puṃsprakṛtivivekopalabdhiḥ || 


jñānaṃ vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ yogajñānapratiṣṭhitam || 11-181 || 


pātañjalādau vibhūtipāde eśvaryasyāpyuktatvāt || 181 || 

evaṃ laukikādīni yogāntāni śāstrāṇi 
dharmādirūpabuddhidharmaniṣṭhāni, taduttaraṃ tu pārameśvaram ---- 


atītaṃ buddhibhāvānāmatimārgaṃ prakītītam | 

lokātītaṃ tu tajjñānamatimārgamiti smṛtam || 11-182 || 


buddhibhāvānāṃ sarveṣāṃ proktaprapañcānāṃ dharmādīnāmatītamiti 
dvitīyāsthāne vyatyayena ṣaṣṭhī | tadetadatimārgaṃ śāstraṃ mārgaṃ 
paśulokamatītamiti kṛtvā || 182 || 

tadetat spaṣṭayati ---- 


lokāśca paśavaḥ proktāḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhāravartmani | 

teṣāmatītāste jñeyā ye'timārge vyavasthitāḥ || 11-183 || 


sṛṣṭisaṃhāramārge ye paśavaḥ svasṛṣṭasaṃhartrātmakaṃ 
saṃvittattvaṃ na jānanti, tata eva sṛjyamānāḥ saṃhriyamāṇāśca te 
sarva eveha lokā ucyante | tadatītā atimārgasthāḥ || 183 || 

yataḥ ---- 


kapālavratino ye ca tathā pāśupatāśca ye | 

sṛṣṭirna vidyate teṣāṃ............


co'pyarthe bhinnakramaḥ | ye kapālavratinaḥ pāśupatāśca, teṣāmapi 
sṛṣṭirnāstiḥ, kimaṅga sarvādhvottīrṇānāṃ śaivānāmityarthāt || 

kā tarhyeṣāṃ sthitiḥ ? ---- ityāha ---- 


...........īśvare ca dhruve sthitāḥ || 11-184 || 


uktaṃ ca prāk ---- 

"dīkṣājñānaviśuddhātmā dehānte śaivacaryayā | 

kapālavratamāsthāya svaṃ svaṃ gacchati tatpadam || 

japabhasmakriyāniṣṭhāste vrajantyaiśvaraṃ padam |" (11-73-74)


iti || 184 || 

nanu sarvasyādhvanaḥ sargasaṃhārapātratvādīśvaratattvasthānāmeṣāmapi 
tābhyāṃ bhavitavyam? ucyate ---- tāvanmātrākhyātyaṃśasaṃhāra eṣāṃ 
parabhairavasvarūpāpattiḥ, na tu paśuvat saṃhṛtasvarūpāḥ punaḥ 
sṛjyante | tadāha ---- 


yasmānmokṣaṃ gamiṣyanti apunarbhavakāraṇam | 


tasmādyuktamuktaṃ sṛṣṭirna vidyate teṣāmiti sambandhaḥ || 

ye tu nātimārgasthāḥ, teṣām ---- 


laukikānāṃ punaḥ sṛṣṭiḥ punaḥ saṃhāra eva ca || 11-185 || 


ataśca te ---- 


saṃsāracakramārūḍhā bhramanti ghaṭayantravat | 


ghaṭayantramaraghaṭṭaḥ || 

etadevopapādayati ---- 


dharmādyarakasaṃyuktamaṣṭāraṃ cakrakaṃ priye || 11-186 || 

īśvarādhiṣṭhitaṃ devi niyatyādaṇḍakāhatam | 

malakarmakalāviddhaṃ bhramate kālavegataḥ || 11-187 || 


dharmādayo ye saṃsārakāraṇabhūtāsta evārā ivārakāḥ 
paribhramaṇahetavaḥ | 

yadāhuḥ ---- 

"dharmeṇa gamanamūrdhvam" (sāṃ0kā0 44) ityādi | 

kutsitaṃ cakraṃ cakrakam, niyatireva āvartamāno daṇḍa eva daṇḍakaḥ, 
tena āhataṃ preritam, malena āṇavena, karmaṇā, kalopalakṣitena māyīyena 
vidyādinā āviddhaṃ vegena preritam kalanāmayakālatattvakṛtavegena 
bhrāmyati || 

yata īdṛśametadativiṣamaṃ cakram, tataḥ ---- 


laukikādyeṣu jñāneṣu ye teṣvabhiratāḥ priye | 

hetuśāstraparā ye tu ye cānye pāpakamīṇaḥ || 11-188 || 

te sarve cāsya cakrasya nāntaṃ paśyanti mohitāḥ | 


teṣviti proktarūpeṣu | "ye tu" ityanena laukikaniṣṭhebhyo'pi 
śuṣkatarkaniṣṭhānāmaupahatyaṃ dhvanyate | mohitā māyayā 
sthagitasvarūpāḥ || 

ayaṃ ca sarvaśāstrebhyaḥ śivaśāstrasya viśeṣaḥ, yat ---- 


laukikādyeṣu ye sādhyā atimārgāntagocare || 11-189 || 

līlayā sādhayet sarvān śivajñāne mahodaye | 


ye siddhiviśeṣā laukikādau sādhyāstān sarvānatimārgalakṣaṇo yo'ntaḥ 
sarvaśāstrapariniṣṭhāsthānam, tadgocare tadviṣaye mahodayahetau 
śivajñāne sādhako līlayā sādhayati ||  

yacca śaivajñānena sādhyate ---- 


na sarvaiḥ sādhyate tadvai..............


laukikādibhiḥ || 

atra hetuḥ ---- 


.............yato'tīva sunirmalam || 11-190 || 


śivajñānamiti śeṣaḥ || 190 || 

sunirmalatvameva spaṣṭayati ---- 


yato yojayate devi abhāve parame pade | 


avidyamānā bhāvabhedarūpāḥ padārthā yatra || 

etat sphuṭayati ---- 


abhāvaṃ bhāvanātītaṃ prapañcātītagocaram || 11-191 || 

manobuddhyādinirmuktaṃ hetuvādavivajītam | 

pratyakṣādipramāṇaiśca vyatītaṃ prabhu cāvyayam || 11-192 || 

sarvatarkāgamātītaṃ pāśamantravivajītam | 

sarvajñaṃ sarvagaṃ śāntaṃ nirmalaṃ nirupaplavam || 11-193 || 


avidyamānā bhāvā yatra tādṛśaṃ paramaṃ padam | bhāvanātītaṃ yataḥ 
prapañcaṃ vaicitryamatīto gocaro viṣayatayā sambhāvyamānaṃ rūpaṃ yasya 
| ata eva manobuddhyādinirmuktam | ata eva ca hetuvādena vivajītaṃ 
sarvavicārabhittibhūtatvādvicārayitumaśakyamityarthaḥ | tathā 
pratyakṣādipramāṇaviṣayaḥ pramāṇānāmapi svaprakāśatadbhittivaśena 
prakāśanāt sarvāvabhāsollāsakatvācca | prabhu prabhavanaśīlaṃ 
svatantram | na collāsyavināśe'syānyasyeva manāgapyanyathābhāva 
ityavyayamiti | sarvaṃ tarkyate vicāryate yairāgamairityāgamaviśeṣaiḥ 
pārameśvaraisteṣāmeva sarvavicārakatvāt, tānapyatikrāntaṃ 
teṣāmapyaviṣayaḥ, yato māyāntairaśuddhādhvagaiḥ pāśaiḥ 
śuddhādhvasthaiśca mantraivīvajītam | sarvaṃ jānātyabhedena paśyati, 
sarvaṃ gacchatyadhivyāpnoti, tathāpi ca tena na manāgapyārūṣyata iti 
śāntaṃ cidekarūpam, tathāpi ca niṣkrāntā udbhūtā āṇavādimalā 
yasmāttādṛk, īdṛgapi ca tairasaṃspṛṣṭatvād niruplavaṃ nivīkalpaṃ 
satatāvabhāsvarasarvābhāsakasvatantracidekarūpam || 193 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


sarvaśaktyātmakaṃ hyekaṃ svatantrānāthanādimat | 

sarvātiśayanirmuktamanādibhavavajītam || 194 || 


sarvajñānapadātītaṃ śaivaṃ jñānaṃ paraṃ smṛtam | 


"śaktayo'sya jagatkṛtsnaṃ"

iti nītyā jagadātmakasarvaśaktisvabhāvam | ekamadvitīyam | svamātmīyaṃ 
rūpameva tantraṃ pañcadhākṛtyakarmaṇyupakaraṇaṃ yasya, tatsvatantram | 
tathā na vidyate'nyo nātho yasya tadanāthaṃ viśveśvaram | 
tathā'nādimat sarvasyādibhūtam | sarvairjñānakriyādiviṣayainīmuktaṃ 
viśvātiśāyiniratiśayacinmātrarūpamityarthaḥ | 
anādinā'haṃprathamikāpravṛttena bhavena vajītamaspṛṣṭam | sarveṣāṃ 
bauddhasāṃkhyalākulādijñānānāṃ yatpadaṃ svaṃ svaṃ viśrāntidhāma 
tadapyullaṅghya sthitam | evaṃbhūtaṃ yat paramanuttaraṃ śivajñānam, tad 
anubhavarūpaṃ smṛtamavicchinnena pāramparyeṇa pratīhatamityarthaḥ || 
evaṃ tattvabhūtabhāvabhedasṛṣṭīḥ pratipādya, 
dharmajñānādinibaddhalaukikādijñānanirūpaṇapūrvaṃ 
śaivajñānamāhātmyaṃ ca 
nirṇīyoktatattvādisṛṣṭimanuvādabhaṅgyopasaṃharan 
śivajñānamāhātmyamevādhikāvāpena darśayati ---- 


evaṃ sṛṣṭāni tattvāni jñānāni ca varānane || 11-195 || 

tattvairetairjagatsarvaṃ visṛṣṭaṃ sacarācaram | 


viśeṣeṇa sṛṣṭaṃ caturdaśavidhabhūtasargātmanā prapañcitam || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


bhuvanāni vicitrāṇi śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || 11-196 || 

tattvābhyantarasaṃsthāni............


yāni bhuvanāni bhuvanādhvanyuktāni, tānyapi tattvaireva sṛṣṭāni || 

tathā proktajñānarūpāṇi ---- 


...........śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca | 


na kevalaṃ bhuvanāni śāstrāṇi ca tattvābhyantarāṇi, yāvat ---- 


vijñānaṃ kuhakaṃ śilpaṃ siddhisandohalakṣaṇam || 11-197 || 

sarvaṃ tattveṣu boddhavyaṃ.............


vividhaṃ mantramaṇḍalamudrādijñānam, tathā kuhakaṃ vismāpakaṃ 
mitahṛdayapratyayakāri indrajālaprāyam, śilpaṃ 
citrapustaputtalikānṛttagītādi, siddhīnāṃ vaśyākarṣaṇādirūpāṇāṃ 
sandohaṃ samūhaṃ lakṣayati darśayati ca yad jñānaṃ, tat sarvaṃ 
tattveṣvastīti jñeyam || 

yataḥ ---- 


................ṣarvatattveṣu dṛśyate | 


tattattattvaucityena tattvasākṣātkārādibhirupalabhyate || 

na kevalaṃ tattveṣu sādhakopayogi jñeyamasti, yāvat ---- 


prakriyā śivadīkṣā ca tattvairetaihī labhyate || 11-198 || 


pūrvoktatattvādipradarśanarūpā jñānaśālināṃ sādhakānāṃ 
copayoginī yā prakriyā, tathā tattattattvagatavicitrabhuvanabhogocitatattad-
yonibhedopapattiniṣkṛtikarmādipāśapraśamaḥ śivayojanikā 
caitairuktarūpaistattvairlabhyate, nānyathā | tadarthaṃ 
yathoktatattvasvarūpamavaśyajñeyam || 198 || 

yuktaṃ caitat, yataḥ ---- 


nāsti dīkṣāsamo mokṣaḥ...........


"dīkṣaiva mocayatyūrdhvaṃ śaivaṃ dhāma nayatyapi" | 

iti hi pratipāditamanyatra || 

dīkṣā ca yairmantraiḥ kriyate, tadvīryarūpā ---- 


..............ṇa vidyā mātṛkā parā | 


sā hi bhagavatī 
aśeṣavācyavācakātmakajagadabhedacamatkārātmakaśabdarāśivimarśa-
paramārthā sarvamantrāraṇistatra tatrāgameṣu nidīśyate | sā caiṣā
viśvāvamarśanena paraṃ jñānaṃ prayacchati || 

tacca pratipāditādhvaprakriyāmayamevetyāha ---- 


na prakriyāparaṃ jñānaṃ................


prakriyātaḥ paramanyajjñānaṃ paritucchameva || 

jñānaṃ jñeyasya jñāpakamiti pūrvanirūpitanītyā jñātena lakṣaṇīyo 
yo lakṣyabhūtaparatattvaikātmā yogastato'nyo mitayogo heya

evetyāha ---- 


..........ṇāsti yogastvalakṣyakaḥ || 11-199 || 


avidyamānaṃ paraṃ lakṣyaṃ viśrāntidhāma yasya tādṛśo yogo nāsti | 
vidyamāno'pi mitayoga ihānuttaracarcāyāmayoga eveti yojanikoktaḥ parayoga
eveha yogaḥ || 199 || 

evaṃ parapuruṣārthaprāpakadīkṣātadupayogimātṛkāprakriyājñānā-
lakṣyakayoga-svarūpametatsarvameva sātiśayaṃ vastu pārameśvara eva 
śāsana upādiśyata iti tadeva sarvaśāstrottamamiti nirūpayati ---- 


tatsarvaṃ kathitaṃ devi śivajñānamahodadhau | 


śivajñānamevāgādhatvāt samagrajñānanadībhedaviśrāntidhāmatvāt 
samastasampatsamavāptihetutvācca mahodadhiḥ || 

prakṛtamupasaṃharannanyadavatārayati ---- 


evaṃ sṛṣṭiḥ samākhyātā sthitiḥ saṃhāra ucyate || 11-200 || 


saṃhāraścetyarthaḥ | tatra sthitinīyatikālāvasthānātmā, tatprānte ca 
saṃhārastatheti || 200 || 

yataḥ prabhṛti pravṛtto yādṛśaśca yasya sthāpyasya saṃhāryasya ca 
kālaḥ, tatsarvamādeṣṭumāha ---- 


mānuṣākṣinimeṣasya aṣṭamāṃśaḥ kṣaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ | 

kṣaṇadvayaṃ tuṭirjñeyā taddvayaṃ tu lavaḥ smṛtaḥ || 11-201 || 

lavadvayaṃ nimeṣastu jñātavyo gaṇitakramāt | 

daśa pañca nimeṣāśca kāṣṭhā caiva prakītītā || 11-202 || 

triṃśatkāṣṭhāḥ kalā jñeyāmuhūrtastriṃśadeva tāḥ | 

muhūrtastu punastriṃśadahorātrastu mānuṣaḥ || 11-203 || 


śāstravyutpipādayiṣitānāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ svānubhavasiddho yo'kṣṇo 
nimeṣapakṣmasaṅkocastadīyo yo'ṣṭamāṃśo'tyantamaṇīyān 
kālāvayavaḥ, akṣinimeṣakāla pratītyaiva kalpyamānaḥ, sa kṣaṇaḥ | 
lava iti yaḥ prāṇīyastuṭikālaḥ | yaduktaṃ prāk ---- 

"tuṭayaḥ ṣoḍaśa prāṇe pūrvaṃ hi kathitā mayā | 

bāhyenaiva tu kālena te lavāḥ parikītītāḥ ||" (7-27) 

iti | 

lavadvayaṃ nimeṣa iti kṣaṇāṣṭakarūpaḥ | muhūrta iti 
dvighaṭikārūpaḥ || 203 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


ahorātraśataiścaiva tribhiḥ ṣaṣṭyadhikaiḥ priye | 

saṃvatsarastu vijñeyo mānuṣaḥ kamalekṣaṇe || 11-204 || 

saṃvatsaraśataṃ pūrṇamāyurjñeyaṃ tu mānuṣam | 


viṃśatyadhikaṃ hi śataṃ paramāyuriti prasiddham || 

yaduktaṃ ṣaṣṭyadhikāhorātraśatatrayeṇa vatsara iti, tadeva 
pakṣamāsādivibhāgapūrvaṃ sphuṭayati ---- 


daśa pañca tvahorātrāḥ pakṣastu parikītītaḥ || 11-205 || 

pakṣadvayena māsastu ṛtudvīguṇa eva saḥ | 

ṛtudvayena kālaḥ syādayanaṃ ca tribhistribhiḥ || 11-206 || 

tābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ varārohe varṣaṃ tu parigīyate | 


kālaścaturmāsasañjñaḥ | ayanamuttarāyaṇaṃ dakṣiṇāyanaṃ ca || 

itthamayanadvayātmako yo manuṣyāṇāṃ vatsaraḥ, sa eva pitryo'horātra 
ityāha ---- 


dakṣiṇaṃ cāyanaṃ rātriruttaraṃ cāyanaṃ dinam || 11-207 || 

pitṝṇāṃ tadahorātramanenābdastu pūrvavat | 

evaṃ daivastvahorātrastatrāpyabdādi pūrvavat || 11-208 || 


ādiśabdāt pakṣamāsādi | itthaṃ pitṝṇāṃ devānāṃ ca 
tulyā'horātrakalaneti purāṇapustakeṣu dṛśyate | adyatanaistu 

"ṛtudvīguṇa eva saḥ" (11 | 206)

ityato'nantaram ---- 

"kṛṣṇapakṣastvahaścaiva śuklastu rajanī bhavet | 

pitṝṇāṃ so'pyahorātrastvanenābdastu pūrvavat ||"

iti viparyāsya paṭhitvā mānuṣyo māsaḥ pitryo'horātra iti vyākhyātam, 
teṣāṃ ca sāṃvatsarikī pitṛdinavyavasthā laukikyapi sthitiḥ prasṛtā || 

tadevaṃ mānuṣaṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatābdaparimāṇo yo divyo 
vatsarastamāśritya ---- 


dvādaśābdasahasrāṇi vijñeyaṃ tu caturyugam | 


dvādaśābdasahasrāṇi vijñeyaṃ caturyugam || 

atra cāyaṃ vibhāgaḥ ---- 


catubhīstu kṛtaṃ devi sahasraistu yathākramam || 11-209 || 

tretā jñeyā tribhirdevi dvābhyāṃ vai dvāparaḥ smṛtaḥ | 

sahasreṇaiva varṣāṇāṃ vijñeyastu kaliḥ priye || 11-210 || 


evaṃ daśa varṣāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi || 210 || 

yattvavaśiṣṭaṃ sahasradvayam, tataḥ ---- 


sandhyādvayasya mānaṃ tu kathayāmi yuge yuge | 


ādyantagatasya || 

tatra ---- 


śatāni catvāri kṛte tvādirantaśca kīrtyate || 11-211 || 

trete śatatrayaṃ jñeyaṃ dvāpare tu śatadvayam | 

kalau cāpi śataṃ jñeyaṃ sandhyāmānamidaṃ smṛtam || 11-212 || 


evaṃ ca kalerante śataṃ kṛtasyādau catvāri śatānīti kalikṛtayugayoḥ 
sandhyā pañca śatāni, evaṃ kṛtatretayoḥ sandhyā sapta śatāni, 
tretādvāparayoḥ pañca śatāni, dvāparakaliyugayoḥ trīṇi śatānīti 
gaṇayitvā sahasradvayam | etat prāguktena sahasradaśakena saha 
dvādaśahasraṃ caturyugam | yadā tu ---- 

śandhisandhyaṃśamānaṃ tu kathayāmi"

iti pāṭhaḥ, tadāproktobhayamelanāt sasandhimānamekaikaśataṃ tu 
sandhyaṃśamānaṃ jñeyam || 212 || 

etadeva ca ---- 


laukikena tu mānena punaśca kathayāmi te | 




yāvatsaṅkhyākaṃ bhavati || 


tricatvāriṃśallakṣāṇi sahasrāṇi ca viṃśatiḥ || 11-213 || 

laukikena tu mānena tviyaṃ saṅkhyā caturyuge | 


varṣāṇāmiti śeṣaḥ || 

vibhāgenāpi ---- 


ekaikasya punardevi yugasya kathayāmi te || 11-214 || 


laukikavarṣasaṅkhyām || 214 || 


daśa sapta ca lakṣāṇi sahasrāṇyaṣṭaviṃśatiḥ | 

kṛtasyaitadbhavenmānaṃ.............


ādyantagatacatuḥśatasandhyaṃśayuktasya, na tu kevalasya | evamuttaratra || 


..........ṭretāyāḥ kathayāmi te || 11-215 || 

ṣaṇṇavatiḥ sahasrāṇi lakṣāṇi dvādaśaiva tu | 

tretāyugasya mānaṃ tu dvāparasya nibodha me || 11-216 || 

catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ sahasrāṇi hyaṣṭau lakṣāṇi suvrate | 

dvāparasya tu mānaṃ ca kalestu kathayāmi te || 11-217 || 

dvātriṃśattu sahasrāṇi lakṣāṇāṃ ca catuṣṭayam | 

etanmānaṃ kaleḥ proktaṃ samāsāttava suvrate || 11-218 || 


tadittham ---- 


varṣaistu mānavairdevi mānametadyuge yuge | 


evamuktadivyalaukikābdamānānusāreṇa ---- 


caturyugaikasaptatyā bhavenmanvantaraṃ punaḥ || 11-219 || 


etaccāsya ---- 


sandhyāmānavihīnaṃ tu yugai(rmānaṃ)1 prakītītam | 

etaddavyena mānena mānaṃ manvantare smṛtam || 11-220 || 


caturyugaśatāni dvādaśābdasahasrāṇyekasaptatyā gaṇayet || 220 || 

etadeva ca mānam ---- 


varṣamānaiḥ punaścaiva laukikaiḥ kathayāmi te | 

saptaṣaṣṭistu lakṣāṇi triṃśatkoṭyo varānane || 11-221 || 

sahasraviṃśatirjñeyaṃ mānaṃ manvantare priye | 


saṣaṣṭiśatatrayakalanayā manvantarakāla eva caindrasthitikālaḥ || 

evamevaṃvidhaiḥ ---- 


caturdaśabhirdeveśi kalpo manvantare bhavet || 11-222 || 


manvantarasandhyāmānamāha ---- 


manvantare vyatikrānte cānyasmin punarāgate | 

pañca varṣasahasrāṇi madhye sandhyā bhavet sadā || 11-223 || 


divyānītyarthāt || 223 || 

ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ, yat ---- 


ādau sahasraṃ sarveṣāmante cāpi punastathā | 


brahmadinagatamanvantarāpekṣayā''dāvante ceti prathamamanvantarasyādau 
caramamanvantarasyānte sahasramekamadhikamiti || 

taditthaṃ sasandhyākālacaturdaśamanvantarakālaḥ ---- 


kalpo brahmadinaṃ proktaṃ caturyugasahasrakam || 11-224 || 


kalpate viśvamasminniti kalpaḥ, ekasaptatyā caturyugaiśca 
manvantaraguṇitaiḥ ṣaḍbhirūnaṃ caturyugasahasraṃ bhavati | manvantareṣu 
sandhyākālo'pyuktanītyā dvāsaptatisahasraṃ iti tadīyacaturyugaṣaṭkena 
sahasramānametaduktam || 224 || 

etacca ---- 


varṣamānena divyena punaśca kathayāmi te | 


saṅkhyātamiti śeṣaḥ || 

tadāha ---- 


koṭirekā tu varṣāṇāṃ lakṣaṇāṃ caiva viṃśatiḥ || 11-225 || 

divyenaiva tu mānena brahmaṇastu dinaṃ bhavet | 


dvādaśa sahasrāṇi sahasraguṇitānyevameva bhavanti || 

īdṛśasyāsya brāhmadinasya ---- 


ṣaṇṇavatyā sahasraistu sandhyākālaḥ prakītītaḥ || 11-226 || 


aṣṭau caturyugāni ṣaṇṇavatyā varṣasahasrairbhavanti | tatra 
prātaḥsandhyāyāṃ dinaśatāni catvāri caturyugāni, sāyaṃsandhyāyāṃ 
catvārīti vibhāgaḥ | niśādyantagatānyapyevamevetyaṣṭayugaḥ prātaḥ 
sāyaṃ ca sandhyākālaḥ || 226 || 

etacca ---- 


laukikena tu mānena adhunā kathayāmi te | 


saṅkhyātamiti śeṣaḥ || 

tadāha ---- 


varṣavṛndāni catvāri tvarbudatrayameva ca || 11-227 || 

koṭidvayaṃ ca deveśi dinaṃ paitāmahaṃ smṛtam | 

sandhyā koṭitrayaṃ caiva pañca lakṣāṇi kītītā || 11-228 || 

catvāriṃśattathā ṣaṣṭiḥ sahasrāṇi tathaiva ca | 


ṣaṣṇavatisahasrāṇi saṣaṣṭiśatatrayakalitānyevameva bhavanti | ataśca 
yat śrībhullakaḥ ---- 

śandhyā koṭitrayaṃ lakṣāṇi catuḥsaptatireva ca"

ityādi paṭhitavān, tadupekṣyam || 

yathā cāyam ---- 


paścimaḥ sandhirevaṃ hi...............


sandhiḥ sandhyākālaḥ || 

tathā ---- 


..............pūrvasandhyāpi tatsamā || 11-229 || 


taditthaṃ brahmadināvadhikā ---- 


narakaiḥ saha saptānāṃ pātālānāṃ tathā priye | 

lokānāṃ caiva saptānāṃ sthitireṣā prakītītā || 11-230 || 


lokānāṃ tannivāsasthānānāṃ bhūrādīnām || 

tathaiṣāmeva ---- 


saṃhāraṃ ca punardevi śṛṇuṣva kathayāmi te | 

brahmaṇaḥ svadinānte vai kalpaḥ saṃhāra ucyate || 11-231 || 


svadinānta iti tanniśāyām | kalpa iti kalpyate cchidyate'smin viśvamiti 
kṛtvā | saṃhāra iti saṃhārakālaḥ || 231 || 

tatra ---- 


dinenaikena brāhmeṇa indrāścaiva caturdaśa | 

rājyaṃ kṛtvā kramādyānti manvantaravyavasthayā || 11-232 || 


pratimanvantaraṃ rājyaṃ kṛtvā, ekaika indraḥ svakarmaucityena gacchati || 
232 || 


tataḥ saṃharate viśvaṃ saptalokāntagocaram | 

supte pitāmahe devi ūrdhvaṃ kālāgnirīkṣate || 11-233 || 


tata iti caturdaśendrānte | paśuvannidrāyamāṇena brahmaṇā janitavismayo 
yāvat kālāgnirūrdhvamīkṣate, tāvat saptalokāntagocaraṃ viṣayajātaṃ 
saṃharati || 233 || 

atha nirīkṣaṇasamaye ---- 


tasya vai dakṣiṇaṃ vaktraṃ mahājvālāṃ vinikṣipet | 


ataśca ---- 


tasmādvaktrānmahājvālā lakṣayojanavistṛtā || 11-234 || 

ūrdhvaṃ prayāti sā dīptā tīvravegā suduḥsahā | 


atra cāvasare saptasu ---- 


lokeṣu ye sthitā lokā ye ca pātālavāsinaḥ || 11-235 || 

sukhaduḥkhobhaye kṣīṇe mohaṃ bhūyiṣṭhamāgate | 

sattāmātrāstu te sarve bhavanti brahmaviṣṭape || 11-236 || 


ye ceti caśabdānnarakādikṣetragatāḥ | brahmaviṣṭape 
satyalokordhvavatīni brahmabhuvane || 236 || 

kiyadavadhikā eṣāṃ mūḍhatā ? ---- ityāha ---- 


yāvannodayanaṃ bhūyaḥ sukhaduḥkhādikarmaṇām | 

tāvattiṣṭhanti te mūḍhā yāvad brahmā na budhyate || 11-237 || 


sukhaduḥkhayorādiśabdād janmāyuṣorhetubhūtāni karmāṇi, teṣām | udayo 
vipākaḥ || 237 || 

ye tu ---- 


rudralokādhipatayaḥ pātālapatayaśca ye | 

kūṣmāṇḍahāṭakādyāstu te tiṣṭhantyatinirmalāḥ || 11-238 || 


na tu manāgapi mlāyanti || 238 || 

kintu ---- 


nirvyāpārāstu te tāvadyāvat sṛṣṭiḥ punarbhavet | 


nivṛttānugrahādivyāpārāḥ || 

atha ---- 


śūnyabhūteṣu lokeṣu jvālā dahati durdharā || 11-239 || 

sā dahennarakān devi pātālāni samantataḥ | 

trīṃllokāṃścaiva dahati bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥpadāntikān || 11-240 || 


śūnyabhūteṣu lokeṣviti tannimittam, narakebhyaḥ prabhṛti svarlokāntaṃ 
dahati || 240 || 

ye tvanye, te ---- 


dhūmena ca trayo lokā vinaśyanti varānane | 

mahojanastapaḥsañjñāḥ.............


saptamastu ---- 


............ṣatyaloko'pi suvrate || 11-241 || 


pūrve ca sarve ---- 


tiṣṭhanti mohitātmāno nidrayā te mṛtomapāḥ | 


atha ---- 


evaṃ dagdhvā jagatsarvaṃ jvālā vaktraṃ viśet punaḥ || 11-242 || 


kālāgnerdakṣiṇameva || 242 || 


tato vānti mahāvātā brahmaniḥ śvāsasambhavāḥ | 


te ca ---- 


nāśayanti ca tadbhasma jagaddāhodbhavaṃ priye || 11-243 || 


atha ---- 


brahmaprasvedajaṃ vāri tajjagat plāvayet punaḥ | 

tenaiva vāriṇā devi jagadekārṇavaṃ bhavet || 11-244 || 


kālavahnyūṣmajo'sya prasvedaḥ || 244 || 

atha ---- 


niśākṣaye punaḥ sthitvā sukhaduḥkhaphalodaye | 

karmataḥ sarvalokasya brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || 11-245 || 

śūnyabhūtāṃ samālokya bhagavān prabhuricchayā | 

ṣaḍvidhāṃ kurute sṛṣṭiṃ yathāpūrvavyavasthayā || 11-246 || 


karmaparipākakrameṇa kamīṇāṃ sukhaduḥkhaphalasyodayo yatra tādṛśe 
rātryante | sthitvā'nupaśāntaniḥśeṣanidrāsaṃskāro bhūtvā | 
karmataḥ paripakvādicchāmātrāt | ṣaḍvidhāmiti 
nārakisthāvarasarīsṛpādipaśvantāṃ trividhāṃ kramātkramamapacitāṃ 
tāmasīm, tamorajaḥsamāviṣṭāṃ mānavīm, rajaḥsattvasamāviṣṭāṃ 
maunīm, sāttvikīṃ tu daivīm | vyavasthayeti bhuvanādimaryādayā || 246 || 

tatra ---- 


prathamāṃ tāmasīṃ sṛṣṭiṃ karoti tamasotkaṭān | 

narakān vividhākārān...........


tato'ṃśenāṃśena tamaso'nutkaṭatve ---- 


..........paśūn vai sthāvarāntagān || 247 || 


paśūniti sarīsṛpapakṣimṛgapaśūnityarthaḥ || 

tato'pi ---- 


tamorajaḥsamāveśān mānavān saṃsṛjet punaḥ | 

rajaḥsattvasamāviṣṭaḥ sṛjenmunivareśvarān || 11-248 || 


evamiyatparyantaṃ brahmaṇaḥ kramātkramaṃ 
nidrāsaṃskārasyādhikādhikataratvam || 248 || 

atha ---- 


gatanidraḥ prabuddhastu sattvaniṣṭho jagatpatiḥ | 

sṛjed devān salokāṃśca pūrvayaiva vyavasthayā || 11-249 || 


saha lokaistannivāsasthānairvartante ye tān | etacca viśeṣaṇaṃ 
siṃhāvalokitanyāyena pūrvatrāpi sambadhyate | pūrvavyavasthā 
paiśācādibrahmāntā || 249 || 

itthaṃ ṣaḍvidhāyāṃ sṛṣṭau niṣpannāyām ---- 


tato rudrendrasūryendunakṣatrāṇi graheśvarāḥ | 

adhikāraṃ prakurvanti sve sve viṣayagocare || 11-250 || 


pārameśānniyogāt ---- 


dine dine sṛjatyevaṃ.............


brahmā || 

kālāgnistu ---- 


................ṣaṃharecca dinakṣaye | 


asya ca brahmaṇaḥ ---- 


dinamānaṃ ca yatproktaṃ rātrisaṅkhyā ca tāvatī || 11-251 || 


tadittham ---- 


ahorātreṇa cānena abdaṃ vai pūrvavat smṛtam | 


śatatrayeṇa ṣaṣṭyadhikena || 


abdānāṃ tu śate pūrṇe mahākalpaḥ sa ucyate || 11-252 || 

brāhme varṣaśate devi divyānyabdāni me śṛṇu | 

ekanavatikoṭistu tathā lakṣāṇi viṃśatiḥ || 11-253 || 

tathā saptaiva kharvāṇi nikharvāṣṭakameva ca | 

brāhmaṃ varṣaśataṃ caitajjñātavyaṃ kālavedinā || 11-254 || 


divyavarṣamānena brāhmamahaḥ sandhyākālaṃ vinā saviṃśatilakṣā 
koṭireketyuktam, rātriśca tāvatīti koṭidvayaṃ sacatvāriṃśallakṣam | 
etaddanānāṃ śatatrayeṇa saṣaṣṭinā guṇitamaṣṭau vṛndāni, 
ṣaḍarbudāni, catasraśca koṭayo bhavanti | sandhyākālo'pi ṣaṇṇavatyā 
sahasrairya uktaḥ, so'pi śatatrayeṇa saṣaṣṭinā kalitaḥ saṃstisraḥ 
koṭayaḥ, pañcacatvāriṃśallakṣāṇi, ṣaṣṭiḥ sahasrāṇi bhavanti | 
so'pi sāyaṃprātarbhedād dviguṇaḥ san koṭayaḥ 
ṣaḍlakṣāṇyekanavativīṃśatiḥ sahasrāṇi bhavanti | ubhayaṃ 
vṛndānyaṣṭau, arbudāni saptatirekanavatirlakṣāṇi, viṃśatiḥ 
sahasrāṇi bhavanti 8709120000 | etadapi vatsarasaṅkhyā śatena kalitaṃ 
nikharvāṇyaṣṭau kharvāṇi sapta vṛndasthāne śūnyamekanavatiḥ koṭyo 
lakṣāṇi viṃśatiriti 870912000000 | itthameṣā yathoktaiva saṅkhyā 
bhavati | ekānnanavatiḥ koṭya ityapapāṭhaḥ || 

tadittham ---- 


daivikena tu mānena mānamitthaṃ prakītītam | 


athaitadeva ---- 


laukikena tu mānena punaścaiva nibodha me || 11-255 || 


tadyathā ---- 


dvātriṃśadabdakoṭyastu tathā kharvāṣṭakaṃ priye | 

kharvadvayaṃ ca deveśi nikharvāḥ pañca eva tu || 11-256 || 

śaṅkutrayaṃ padmamekaṃ sāgaratrayameva ca | 


pūrvoktaikanavatikoṭyā daivikamānakalitasya brāhmavarṣaśatasya 
laukikavatsaramānena ṣaṣṭiśatatrayakalanayoktaiva saṅkhyā''yāti | 
yattu śrībhullakaḥ ---- 

".............ṭhābdakoṭyastu ekaṃ caivārbudaṃ priye | 

kharvāśītistathā caiva nikharvāṇāṃ ca pañcakam || 

catuṣṭayaṃ ca śaṅkūnāṃ triṃśatsāgara eva ca |"

ityapaṭhat, tadasaṅgatatvādupekṣyameva || 

itthaṃ laukikābdamānena ---- 


etad devi samākhyātaṃ jñātavyaṃ ca mumukṣubhiḥ || 11-257 || 


mahākalpāntāvasthitidāyyapi brāhmaṃ padaṃ saṃhriyamāṇatvāt 
paryantavirasam, evaṃ vakṣyamāṇanītyā'nāśritāntamapīti sarvathā 
svasti svapnopamebhyo bhogebhyo iti matvā 
dikkālākārākalitacidghanaparabhairavasvarūpasamāpattireva 
mumukṣubhirāśrayaṇīyeti tātparyam || 257 || 

upasaṃharati--


etallaukikamānena brāhmamābdaśataṃ smṛtam | 


uktavakṣyamāṇaparimāṇopayoginyā ekādiparārdhāntāyāḥ saṅkhyāyāḥ 
krameṇa rūpaṃ lakṣayati ---- 


ekaṃ daśaguṇaṃ pūrvaṃ śataṃ daśaguṇaṃ tu tat || 11-258 || 

śataṃ daśaguṇaṃ kṛtvā sahasraṃ parikītītam | 

sahasraṃ daśaguṇitamayutaṃ taddhi kītītam || 11-259 || 

daśāyutāni lakṣaṃ tu niyutaṃ daśa tāni ca | 

daśa tāni ca koṭiḥ syāt daśa koṭistathārbudam || 11-260 || 

arbudairdaśabhirvṛndaṃ kharvaṃ daśabhireva taiḥ | 

daśabhistainīkharvaṃ tu śaṅkuḥ syād daśa tāni tu || 11-261 || 

śaṅkubhirdaśabhiḥ padmaṃ daśa padmāni sāgaraḥ | 

sāgarairdaśabhirmadhyamantyaṃ tairdaśabhiḥ smṛtam || 11-262 || 

antyaṃ daśāhataṃ kṛtvā parārdhaṃ parikītītam | 


upasaṃharati ---- 


evamaṣṭādaśaitāni sthānāni gaṇitasya tu || 11-263 || 


bhavantīti śeṣaḥ || 263 || 

evaṃ prasaṅgāt saṅkhyāsvarūpamupadarśya prakṛtamāha ---- 


mahākalpasya paryante brahmā yāti pare layam | 


avṛttaparaśaktipātaḥ pare iti sāpekṣatayā prakṛṣṭe samanantare 
kāraṇe līyate, vṛttaparaśaktipātastu paramaśive

"parasmin brahmaṇi vrajet" (10-533)

iti pūrvagranthe'yamevāśayaḥ | evamuttaratrāpyanusartavyam | 
yaścāyamevamukto mahākalpaḥ ---- 


viṣṇośca taddinaṃ proktaṃ rātrirvai tatsamā bhavet || 11-264 || 


brahmāṇḍānuviṣayalokasthasya || 264 || 

kiñca ---- 


anena parimāṇena tasyābdaṃ tu vidhīyate | 


ahnāṃ caiva śatatrayeṇa saṣaṣṭinā || 


varṣāṇāṃ ca śate pūrṇe so'pi yāti pare layam || 11-265 || 


ittham ---- 


viṣṇorāyuryadevoktaṃ rudrasyaitaddinaṃ bhavet | 


rudralokasthasya || 

sa ca ---- 


dine dine sṛjatyanyau brahmaviṣṇū prajāpatī || 11-266 || 


prāksṛṣṭayoḥ parabrahmaṇi layādanyaṃ viṣṇuṃ sṛṣṭvā, 
tanmūrtyāviṣṭo brahmāṇamapyanyaṃ sṛjatītyarthaḥ || 

yuktaṃ caitat, yasmāt ---- 


brāhmī ca vaiṣṇavī śaktiradhikārapadaṃ gatā | 

yaṃ cādhitiṣṭhatyātmānaṃ tatsañjñāṃ sa prapadyate || 11-267 || 


co bhinnakramaḥ | pārameśvarī brāhmī vaiṣṇavī ca śaktiryamātmānaṃ 
pudgalamadhitiṣṭhatyadhikurute, sa ātmā tatsañjñāmiti brahmatvaṃ 
viṣṇutvaṃ ca prāpnotītyarthaḥ || 267 || 

prāpya ca tadrūpatvamasau ---- 


tadādhikāraṃ kurute icchayā paramātmanaḥ | 


paramātmano nirṇītasvarūpasya paramaśivasya, na tu 
parecchādhiṣṭhitottarottarakāraṇasya icchayā || 

yathā ca brahmaviṣṇū pārameśvarī brāhmī vaiṣṇavī śaktiḥ 
paramārthataḥ, tathā viśvamidaṃ pārameśvaraśaktimayamevetyāha ---- 


brahmaviṣṇvindrarudrāśca vidyeśā īśvarastathā || 11-268 || 

lokādhipāśca deveśi tathā ca bhuvanādhipāḥ | 

grahādimātaro rudrā yoganakṣatrarāśayaḥ || 11-269 || 

śaktiyuktāstu te sarve bhavanti tadadhiṣṭhitāḥ | 

tatparākramavīryāstu svakīye tu pade sthitāḥ || 11-270 || 


lokādhipā indrādyā lokapālāḥ | grahādayaśca mātaraśceti dvandvaḥ, 
mātaro brāhmyādyāḥ | yogāḥ sunaphādyā jyotiḥśāstraprasiddhāḥ | te 
sarve iti, uktāstayā parameśvarecchayā'dhiṣṭhitāḥ santaḥ śaktiyuktā 
nijanijasāmarthyabhājo bhavanti || 270 || 

pūrvaṃ brāhmyā vaiṣṇavyā cādhiṣṭhitattvaṃ brahmaviṣṇvoruktam, 
idānīṃ tu brahmādibhirapi saha sarveṣāṃ paraśaktyadhiṣṭhitatvamataśca 
sarvamidaṃ jagat ---- 


śivasyaikā mahāśaktiḥ śivaścaiko hyanādimān | 

sā śaktibhīdyate devi bhedairānantyasambhavaiḥ || 11-271 || 


mahatī svātantryākhyā śaktiḥ | śivaḥ prakāśānandaghanaḥ 
śreyorūpaḥ | cakārāt śaktirapi ekā'dvitīyā'nādimatī ca 
bhedairnānāvaicitryaibhīdyate grāhyagrāhakādyābhāsatayā sphurati || 

śivaśaktyadvayamayatāṃ prāsaṅgikīmuktvā prakṛtamāha ---- 


evaṃ vai kurute sṛṣṭiṃ rudraścaiva dine dine | 

saṃhāraṃ ca dinānte vai..............


sā ca saṃsārarūpasya ---- 


.............ṝātrirvai tatsamā bhavet || 272 || 


dinarātrisāmyameveśvarecchātaḥ sūryasomasañcārāditi 
ṭīkākāramatamasamañjasam, tattadbhuvanatadīśvaraprabhābhāsvareṣu 
brahmādilokeṣu sūryādīnāṃ prakāśakatvena kvāpyaśrutatvāt || 272 || 

ittham ---- 


dinarātripramāṇenānena syādvatsaro'sya ca | 


asyeti rudrasya || 


vatsarāṇāṃ śate pūrṇe śatarudradinakṣayāt || 11-273 || 

so'pi yāti paraṃ sthānaṃ yadgatvā niṣkalo bhavet | 


raudraṃ varṣaśataṃ śatarudrāṇāṃ dinam, tasya kṣayaḥ paryantaḥ || 

tadante ca ---- 


tasmin sthāne punaścānyastatsamaśca prabhurbhavet || 11-274 || 

raudraśaktisamāyogād brahmaviṣṇvindranāyakaḥ | 


taditthamahorātrādikalanayā ---- 


śatarudrāstu deveśi svābdānāṃ tu śatakṣaye || 11-275 || 

te prayānti paraṃ tattvaṃ tato'ṇḍaṃ tu vinaśyati | 


śatarudrajīvitāvadhirbrahmāṇḍasthitikāla ityarthaḥ || 

kīdṛgaṇḍamityāha ---- 


sarvabhūtaguṇādhāraṃ sarvatattvālayālayam || 11-276 || 

saparvatavanodyānadvīpasāgaramaṇḍitam | 

vimānamālākulitaṃ grahanakṣatramaṇḍitam || 11-277 || 

devadānavagandharvasiddhavidyādharoragaiḥ | 

ṛṣibhirmānuṣādyaiśca saptalokanivāsibhiḥ || 11-278 || 

narakaiścaiva pātālairyuktaṃ bhuvanamaṇḍitam | 


sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ pṛthvyādīnām, guṇānāṃ ca śabdādīnām, 
bhūtaguṇānāṃ ca pāṇḍityaśauryādīnāmāśrayaḥ, tathā 
sarvatattvālayānāṃ ṣaṭtriṃśattattvamayānāṃ nānāśarīrāṇāmālayo 
nivāsarūpaḥ || 

īdṛśaṃ ca ---- 


aśeṣabhuvanādhāramaṇḍamapsu pralīyate || 11-279 || 


evaṃ ca yathotpādaṃ tattvāni svakāraṇeṣu līyante | yadvakṣyati ---- 

"āpastejasi līyante" (11-284) ityādi || 279 || 

itthaṃ śatarudrāntāyāṃ sthitau saṃhṛtāyāṃ 
brahmāṇḍordhvādharakarparikoparivartī saṃhartṛrūpaḥ ---- 


tataḥ kālāgnirudraśca kālatattve layaṃ vrajet | 


aśeṣaviśvakalanākāritvāt kālaścāsau tattvaṃ ca taditi 
kālatattvakālakalitaḥ parameśvaraḥ || 

yadyevam, abāditattvasaṃhāraṃ kaḥ karoti ? ---- ityāśaṅkyāha ---- 


aptattvāttu samārabhya yāvanmāyāntagocaram || 11-280 || 

tatsarvaṃ saṃharet kālaḥ svayameva carācaram | 


kālaḥ ityaśeṣaviśvakalanaḥ parameśvara 
evordhvordhvabhuvaneśamūtīmāviśyādho'dhovatītattvasaṃhāraṃ krameṇa 
karotītyarthaḥ | etaccāgre vyaktībhaviṣyati || 

śuddhe'dhvani kaḥ saṃhartā ? ---- ityāha ---- 


tadūrdhve śuddhamadhvānaṃ yāvacchaktyantagocaram || 11-281 || 

tatsarvaṃ saṃhared ghoramaghoro ghoranāśanaḥ | 


śaktyantasyādhvano ghoramiti viśeṣaṇād māyādikṣityantasya 
ghorataratvamityarthādavagatam | na vidyate ghoraṃ bhedasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ 
yasya so'ghora ityayamartho ghoranāśana ityanena vyākhyātaḥ | atrāpi
ca yathottaramīśvarasadāśivāditattveśvaramūrtyāviṣṭa 
evāghorabhaṭṭārako'dharādharatattvaṃ saṃharatītyartho 
vakṣyamāṇagranthasaṅgatyā boddhavyaḥ || 

prasaṅgāgataṃ saṃhartṛvicāramupasaṃharati ---- 


triṣvevaṃ saṃsthito rudraḥ kālarūpī maheśvaraḥ || 11-282 || 


triṣu pṛthvīmāyāśaktyanteṣu padeṣu | evamiti saṃhartṛtayā | rudra iti 
kālāgnirudro bhuvi, kālarūpī māyāntaṃ padaṃ 
kalayannanantabhaṭṭārakaḥ, śaktyanteṣu maheśvaraḥ | athavā eko 
maheśvaro rodanadrāvaṇakāritvādrudrastriṣu padeṣu kālarūpī saṃhartā 
kālāgnirudrādivaicitryeṇa sthita ityarthaḥ || 282 || 

evaṃ prāsaṅgikamarthamupasaṃhṛtya prakṛtamanusarati ---- 


tataḥ saṃharate toyamamareśaśatātyaye | 


tejastattvādhiṣṭhito rudraḥ, 
amareśasambandhivarṣaśatasaṅkhyātasvadinānte toyaṃ jalatattvaṃ 
saṃharatītyarthaḥ | amareśasya ca śatarudrāyuṣkālaparīmāṇaṃ dinamiti 
tadanusāreṇa prāgvadvarṣam, tacchatamāyustadapi 
tejastattvādhipatedīnamityādyuttarottaraṃ krameṇānusaraṇīyam | 
"amareśaḥ śatātyaye" ityapapāṭhaḥ, svaśatātyaye tasya 
saṃhartṛtvāyogāttadadharavatīśatarudrātyaye'pi 
toyatattvasaṃhārābhāvāt || 

tadevādiśati ---- 


evaṃ bhūtādyāvaraṇapatayaśca śatātyaye || 11-283 || 

saṃharanti ca deveśi sṛjanti ca parasparam | 


bhūtatanmātrādyāvaraṇeśvarā yathottaramaiśvarāṇyadharādharatattvāni 
tadīśvarasambandhivarṣaśatāntarūpe svadinānte saṃharanti, 
punastāvatkālasvarātryante'nyāni sṛjanti | kvacittu ---- 

"evaṃ bhūtapatīnāṃ tu prāpte varṣaśatātyaye | 

yātaistainīṣkalasthānaṃ tato bhūtāni śāṅkari || 

saṃharanti ca deveśi sṛjanti ca parasparam |"

iti pāṭhaḥ | atrāpi yathottaramadharādharagatāni tattvānīti vyākhyeyam 
|| 

tattvānāṃ parasparalayātmakaṃ saṃhāraṃ sphuṭayati ---- 


āpastejasi līyante tattejaścānile punaḥ || 11-284 || 

tathānilo'mbaraṃ prāpya saha tenaiva līyate | 

tanmātreṣu pralīyante yathotpannāni ca kramāt || 11-285 || 

tanmātrāṇyapyahaṅkāre sendriyāṇi yathākramam |
