sa buddhau sā ca gahane guṇasāmye pralīyate || 11-286 || 

guṇasāmyamanirdeśyamapratarkyamanaupamam | 

tasmin jagadaśeṣaṃ tu prasuptamiva tiṣṭhati || 11-287 || 


saha tenaiva līyata iti tenāntaḥkṛtapṛthivyaptejorūpatattvatrayeṇa 
vāyunā saha vyoma līyate | kva līyata ityata āha ---- tanmātreṣviti | 
pralīyanta iti bahuvacanasya praśabdasya cāyamāśayo yad vyoma tallīnāni
pṛthivyaptejovāyutattvāni svakāraṇeṣu tanmātreṣu prakarṣeṇa līyante 
tanmayāni bhavanti | yathotpannānītyekatvādikrameṇa yathā jātāni, 
tathaiva | tena pṛthvī tanmātrapañcake, āpaścatuṣṭaye, tejastattraye, 
vāyustaddvaye, vyoma śabdatanmātre | gandho rasatanmātreṃ, tathā upasthaḥ 
pāyau, pāyuḥ pāṇāvityādikramo'nusartavyaḥ | gahana iti pradhānatattve 
| upamaiva aupamam | itthaṃ kṣmādibuddhyante prakṛtiviśrānte sati 
tāvadantamaśeṣaṃ jagad gāḍhanidrāmūḍhamāste || 287 || 

itthaṃ prakṛtyante saṃhṛte sati ---- 


paramāṇupramāṇena līnaṃ saṃtiṣṭhate jagat | 


paramāṇunā'tyantamaṇīyasā paramapelavena cendriyādyagocareṇa rūpeṇa 
jagat carācaraṃ pralīnamāste || 

yacca prakṛtitattvaniviṣṭānāṃ rudrāṇāṃ pūrvoktakalanayā''yuḥ, tat 
---- 


ṣaḍviṃśakasya rudrasya caitaddinamiha smṛtam || 11-288 || 


guṇatattvena saha pradhānāntaṃ tattvapañcaviṃśatigatānāṃ 
pañcaviṃśatyā praghaṭṭakairavasthitānāṃ sarveṣāṃ rudrāṇāṃ 
svāmī śrīkaṇṭhanātha iha ṣaḍviṃśako'bhipretaḥ || 288 || 

asya ---- 


prajāḥ prajānāṃ patayaḥ pitaro mānavaiḥ saha | 

sāṅkhyajñānena ye siddhāḥ vedena brahmavādinaḥ || 11-289 || 

chandaḥ sāmāni coṅkāro buddhistaddevatāḥ priye | 

ahni tiṣṭhanti te sarve parameśasya dhīmataḥ || 11-290 || 


prajāḥ prajāyamānāni caturdaśavidhabhūtāni | patayo bhuvaneśāḥ | 
itaro anvādyāḥ | prajāgrahaṇasaṅgṛhītānāmapi mānavānāṃ 
punarupādānaṃ icitryotthāpakakarmakāritvena saṃsāre pradhānatvāt | 
sāṅkhyajñānaṃ rakṛtipuruṣavivekapratyayaḥ | vedena brahmavādina iti ---
- 

"puruṣa evedaṃ sarvam" (ṛ.10-90-2)

iti brahma ye vadanti vedāntavidaḥ | taddevatā iti buddhitattvagatā 
brahmādyā devayonayaḥ | parameśasyeti bhuvanādhvani vaṇītamāhātmyasya, 
ahni tiṣṭhanti dinārambhe'bhivyajyante || 290 || 

kiñcāsya ---- 


dinānte te pralīyante...............


punarapi ca ---- 

..............ṝātryante viśvasambhavaḥ | 


athāvyaktatattvastharudrasambandhidināvadhermānuṣyeṇa divyena cābdamānena 
kalayitumaśakyatvād buddhitattvagatabrahmasambandhibhiḥ pralayodbhavaiḥ 
saṅkalanāṃ kartumāha ---- 


ṣaṭtriṃśattu sahasrāṇi brahmaṇāṃ pralayodbhavāḥ || 11-291 || 

avyakte ca dinaṃ proktaṃ rudrāṇāṃ tannivāsinām | 


pūrvoktanītyā buddhitattvavartī brahmā guṇatattvagatarudradinānte 
saṃhriyate, taddanārambhe cānyaḥ sṛjyata iti tadīye'bde 
saṣaṣṭiśatatrayaṃ dhīgatabrahmaṇāṃ pralayollāsā bhavanti | 
tāvāṃśca guṇatattvavāsirudrāṇāṃ jīvitāvadhiḥ | sa 
cāvyaktaniṣṭharudrāṇāṃ dinakālaḥ | tadidaṃ 
yadīdṛgavyaktastharudrāṇāṃ dinamuktam, tasya cāvāntara ucyate ---- 

brahmāṇḍapralayapradhānapralayamadhyavartī jalādiguṇāntatattvaviṣayo 
vicitro yaḥ saṃhāra uktaḥ, so'vāntarapralayo mantavyaḥ || 

kastasya pralayasya tadante ca sṛṣṭeḥ kartetyāha ---- 


tasmin saṃharate sarvaṃ pradhānasya dinakṣaye || 11-292 || 

rātryante ca sṛjed bhūyaḥ śrīkaṇṭho viśvanāyakaḥ | 


yathā cāsya guṇamastakavatīno'pi viśvanāyakatvaṃ, tathā daśamapaṭale
vitatya daśītam || 

atha ---- 


tasyāpyanena nyāyena parimāṇasthitirbhavet || 11-293 || 

yasmāt pralayakoṭyaśca vyatītāśca sahasraśaḥ | 


anena nyāyena sthitiriti saṣaṣṭiśatatrayadinasaṅkhyābdaśatāvadhiḥ 
pralayakoṭya ityadhovatītattvatattveśagatāḥ || 

etadavadhyante ca ---- 


tato niyatikālau ca rāgo vidyā kalā tathā || 11-294 || 

parasparaṃ layaṃ yānti kramāt sarve svamānataḥ | 


tata iti śrīśrīkaṇṭhīyādhikārasamāptau | kramāditi 
kalādyānulomyakrameṇa yat kañcukapañcakaṃ deśavaicitryeṇāvasthitam, tad 
niyatyādiprātilomyakrameṇa cūrṇapāṣāṇajalavat parasparaṃ līyate | 
svamānata iti kañcukavāsisarvarudrasambandhiśatavarṣānte | anena
caitaddaśītaṃ yat sarveṣāṃ kañcukavāsināṃ sapuṃstattvarudrāṇāṃ 
yugapadeva ca pralaya iti | tathā ca pūrvaṃ teṣām ---- 

"tasmāt kalā samutpannā vidyārāgau tathaiva ca | 

kālo niyatitattvaṃ ca puruṣaḥ prakṛtistathā ||" (11-64)

iti sṛṣṭirapi yugapadevoktā | bhuvanādideśavyavasthā tu pṛthagiti 
tadāśayena kramāt sarve itīhoktam || 

tadittham ---- 


kalādyavaniparyantaṃ gahaneśadinakṣaye || 11-295 || 

nānābhuvanavinyāsaracanādivibhūṣitam | 

saguṇādhāraparyantarudrakṣetrajñasaṅkulam || 11-296 || 

gahaneśe layaṃ yāti mūlaprakṛtikāraṇe | 


gahaneśo māyātattvaga ādyo rudraḥ | racanādītyādiśabdādvibhavaḥ | 

"adhaśchādanamūrdhvaṃ ca raktaṃ śuklaṃ vicintayet | 

madhye tamo vijānīyād guṇāstvete vyavasthitāḥ ||" (2-66)

iti pūrvoktanītyā''dhāro māyā, sa paryante yasya 
tadguṇādhāraparyantaṃ kalātattvaṃ sahaguṇādhāraparyantā ye 
rudrakṣetrajñāstaiḥ saṅkulam | gahaneśa iti gahana īśaḥ prabhuryasya, 
tasmin gahaneśe māyātattve mūlaprakṛteḥ pradhānasyāpi kāraṇe || 

tacca tathā līnaṃ sat ---- 


rātryante jāyate bhūyo gahaneśapracodanāt || 11-297 || 


taditthamasya ---- 


ahorātrastvayaṃ proktaḥ prākṛtaḥ parameśvari | 


prakṛtiriha viśeṣācodanāt kalādikṣityantasya viśvasya kāraṇaṃ 
māyocyate, tasyā ayaṃ prākṛto māyīyaḥ || 

tadgataśca yo rātrikālaḥ ---- 


pralayaśca sa evokto bhūtānāṃ parameśvari || 11-298 || 


kalātattvāntānāṃ sarveṣāṃ 
prakṛṣṭaciratarakālānāmadhastanakālāpekṣayā kalayitumaśakyatvāt 
prādhānikakālamavadhiṃ kṛtvā kalayitumāha ---- 

prādhānikaparārdhena daśadhā guṇitena tu | 

māyā saṃharate sarvaṃ punaścaiva sṛjejjagat || 11-299 || 


pradhānasyāyaṃ prādhānikaḥ kālaḥ, tasya yat parārdhaṃ pūrvoktaḥ 
saṅkhyāviśeṣastena | daśadhā guṇiteneti daśaparārdhaguṇitena 
prādhānikakālena māyāyā dinam, rātriśca tāvatī bhavatītyarthaḥ | 
etaduktaṃ  bhavati ---- pradhānādhiṣṭhātṛrudrāyuṣkālo yaḥ 
kañcukanivāsināṃ dinam, tat saṣaṣṭiśatatrayakalitamabdastacchatena 
tadāyurityatra nedṛśī kalanā kriyate, api tu sa kañcukavāsidinātmā 
prādhānikaḥ kālaḥ parārdhadaśakena guṇitaḥ kañcukavāsināmāyuḥ, 
tacca gāhinikaṃ dinamityayamatra pūrvato viśeṣo daśītaḥ | itthaṃ ca 
parārdhadaśakaguṇito yaḥ prādhānikakālastasya śatatamo bhāgaḥ 
kañcukavāsinām varṣam, tasyāpi ṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo bhāgo'tra 
dinamitītthamatra varṣadinādivyavasthā kāryā || 299 || 


evamuktaparārdhadaśakaguṇitaṃ tad gahaneśadinam, tatkalanayā varṣam, 
tacchatarūpo yo gahaneśāvasthitikālaḥ, sa eva tadāśrayasya 
māyātattvasya kālaḥ | tamavadhiṃ 
kṛtveśvaratattvādhiṣṭhāturīśvarasya dinaparimāṇaṃ darśayitumāha ---
- 


māyākālaparārdhasya śatadhāguṇitasya ca | 

īśvaraḥ kurute sṛṣṭiṃ punaśca saṃharejjagat || 11-300 || 


atrāpi māyāyā yo'vasthitikālastasya yat parārdhaṃ tasya 
śatadhāguṇitasyeti parārdhaśatasaṅkhyātasya | tāvatkālamīśvaraḥ 
sṛṣṭiṃ svadine, saṃhāraṃ svarātrau śuddhavidyātattvāntasya viśvasya 
karotītyarthaḥ | "śatadhāguṇitasya" ityukterayamāśayo yatkila 
māyāvadhiḥ kālaḥ parārdhairdaśabhirguṇito 
vidyātattvādhipateranantanāthasyādhikārakālaḥ, tatrāpi 
pūrvavadbhāgakalanayā varṣadinapravibhāgo jñeyaḥ ---- ityevaṃvidho 
yo'nantanāthādhikārakālaḥ, so'pi parārdhadaśakaguṇita īśvarasya 
dinamiti | atrāpyuktakramānusārivatsaratacchatātmā īśvarādhikārakālaḥ 
|| 300 || 

so'pi prakrāntarītyā parārdhaśataguṇitaḥ sadāśivanāthasya dinamiti 
tadante'sāvadhovatī viśvaṃ saṃharatītyāha ---- 


tataḥ sadāśivo devaḥ svamānena ca saṃharet | 

sṛjate ca punarbhūya ātmīye devyaharmukhe || 11-301 || 


svamānenetyavataraṇikāyāmeva vyākhyātam | punarbhūyaḥ bhūyo bhūya 
ityarthaḥ || 301 || 

tadittham ---- 


mahāpralaya evoktaḥ sādākhye tu dinakṣaye | 


pūrvoktamāyīyapralayāpekṣayā'yaṃ mahān, śuddhādhvano'pi 
saṃharaṇāt || 

anena ca parimāṇenāyamapi svavarṣaśatānte ---- 


bindutattve layaṃ yāti pañcamantramahātanuḥ || 11-302 || 


vindutattva ityabhidhānāttadadhogato bhuvanādhvā pratipāditaḥ, sthūlaḥ 
sadāśivo'tra vivakṣitaḥ | bindutattve layaṃ yāti 
bindvīśvararūpatāmāviśati || 302 || 

tathāvidhaścāsau ---- 


binduṃ caivārdhacandraṃ tu bhittvā caiva nirodhikām | 

nādatattve layaṃ yāti gṛhītvā sacarācaram || 11-303 || 


bindvardhacandranirodhikābhūmīḥ kramātkramaṃ 
parārdhaśataguṇitaparimāṇadinādivyavasthākalitāvasthitīrāviśya 
sthūlaḥ sadāśivabhaṭṭārako nādātmani sūkṣme sadāśivapade līyate 
tadātmā jāyata ityarthaḥ || 303 || 

so'pi ca ---- 


nādaḥ sauṣumnamārgeṇa bhittvā brahmabilaṃ priye | 

śaktitattve layaṃ yāti śaktitattvadinakṣaye || 11-304 || 


nādātmā sūkṣmaḥ sadāśivanāthaḥ 
pūrvoktakalanāgaṇitasuṣumneśadinānte tadrūpatāṃ śritvā tathaiva 
tadavadhikālagaṇanāgaṇitabrahmeśadinānte brahmarandhrasthabrahmarūpatāṃ 
śritvā tadīyāvasthitikāle tathaiva gaṇite yacchaktitattvasthadevatādinam, 
tadante tanmayībhavatītyarthaḥ || 304 || 

atha śaktitattvadināvadhiḥ kiyān kālaḥ syāt ? ---- ityāha ---- 


parārdhaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ kālastu varavaṇīni | 


pūrvam ---- 


"prādhānikaparārdhena daśadhāguṇitena ca" (11-299)


iti, tathā ---- 

"māyākālaparārdhasya śatadhāguṇitasya ca" (11-300)

ityuktatvād śaktitattvadināntātmā kālaḥ 
parārdhaparārdhātmā'tivitatasaṅkhyo vijñeyaḥ, na 
tvekaparārdhamātrarūpaḥ, pūrvoktavyāghātāpatteḥ | tathāhi 
bhuvanādhvani tattvānāmuttarottaraṃ deśapramāṇe prakarṣa uktastatheha 
sthityādikālo'pyuttarottaraṃ prakṛṣyata evetyasya granthasya tātparyam | 
itthaṃ parārdhaparārdhamānaṃ śaktidinam, tāvatyeva ca tadīyā 
rātriranayā kalanayā yadvarṣaśatam, tadante 
śaktitattvādhiṣṭhātṛsūkṣmadevatādhikāraparisamāptiḥ || 


tacca śivatattvasthasya vyāpīśasyāpyaharmukham || 11-305 || 


tatrāsau ---- 

tataśca saṃsṛjed bhūyo vyāpī vyomasvarūpiṇi | 

līyate so'pyananteśe so'nāthe so'pyanāśrite || 11-306 || 


svādhikāraparisamāptau līyate || 306 || 

athāsyānāthāntaviśvāśrayasyānāśritanāthasya kiyaddanaṃ syāt? ---- 
ityāha ---- 


śaktikālaparārdhasya koṭidhāguṇitasya ca | 

anāśritasya devasya dinametat prakītītam || 11-307 || 


yaḥ parārdhaparārdhātmā śaktikāla uktastasya prakaraṇāt 
parārdhakoṭiguṇitasya yaḥ kālaḥ, tadanāśritasya dinam || 307 || 

atha ---- 


anena parimāṇena parārdhaguṇitena tu | 

so'pi yāti paraṃ sthānaṃ kāraṇaṃ svamanāśrayam || 11-308 || 


parārdhaparārdharūpo yaḥ śaktikālaḥ parārdhakoṭyā 
guṇito'nāśritadinātmā, so'pi parārdheneti parārdhaparārdhena 
guṇito'nāśritasyādhikārakāla iti 
tacchatabhāgatatsaṣaṣṭitriśatabhāgākarṣaṇādasya varṣadinavyavasthā
prāgvadanusaraṇīyā | 
taditthamativitatakālādhvagatasvādhikārakālaparisamāptāvanāśritanātha.
h svamanāśrayam, kāraṇamiti ---- 

"atrārūḍhastu kurute śivaḥ paramakāraṇam | 

sṛṣṭiṃ......................................... ||" (10-1258)

ityādyuktanītyā paramaśivameva, tiṣṭhatyasmin viśvamiti vyutpattyā 
sthānam, yāti, tadekātmā bhavati || 308 || 

yaścāyamiyatīmativitatavitatavitatāmadhvadhārāmadhirūḍhaḥ ---- 


sa kālaḥ sāmyasañjñaśca..............


yathā guṇānāṃ sāmyaṃ pradhānam, tathā sarveṣāṃ 
sṛṣṭisthitisaṃhārakriyākalanābhāsānāṃ yat sāmyaṃ 
prakarṣāpakarṣaśūnyaṃ vapuḥ, tat sāmyaṃ jñeyam | samatāśrayaḥ 
sāmyena, kalyamānatvādeva ca kālaśabdenoktaḥ || 

vaiṣamyanivṛttyātmakasāmyātmakatvādeva cāyam ---- 


...................janmamṛtyubhayāpahaḥ | 


samāpannasyetyarthaḥ || 

atha ---- 


tato'pyūrdhvamameyastu kālaḥ syāt paramāvadhiḥ || 11-309 || 

nityo nityodito devi akalyaśca na kalyate | 


sāmyasañjñaḥ kālaḥ praśāntaniḥśeṣavaiṣamyātmatayā kalyamānatvāt 
prameyastathā nāyam, ata eva paramo'vadhiḥ 
sarvaprameyapramātrādipratiṣṭhāpadamunmanāparatattvasāmarasyātma-
parapramātṛrūpa ityarthaḥ | co hyarthe | yato na kalyate, ata evākalyaḥ || 


kathaṃ tahī kālaśabdo'tra pravṛttaḥ ? ---- ityāha ---- 


sa cādhaḥ kalayet sarvaṃ vyāpinyādiṃ dharāvadhim || 11-310 || 

tuṭyādibhiḥ kalābhiśca devyadhvānaṃ carācaram | 


sāmyasañjñaṃ kālaṃ bhittibhūtamavadhimāśritya tadudbhūtaṃ 
vyāpinyādiṃ sarvamiti dharāntamadhvānaṃ yataḥ kalayatyantaḥ 
prakāśaikātmyena sthitaṃ bahirvaicitryaśataiḥ prakṣipati, 
bahirābhāsitaṃ cāntaḥ kṣipati nānātvena ca parigaṇayati, yata eva 
sarvaṃ kalayati tato'yaṃ kāla ucyata ityarthaḥ || 

etadevādhikāvāpenānuvadannupasaṃharati ---- 


ūrdhvamunmanaso yacca tatra kālo na vidyate || 11-311 || 

na kalyaḥ kalyate kaścinniṣkalaḥ kālavajītaḥ | 

yaḥ śāṅkaryunmanātītaḥ sa nityo vyāpako'vyayaḥ || 11-312 || 


unmanasaḥ sambandhi ūrdhvaṃ paratattvātmakaṃ yatpadaṃ tatra kalanāhetuḥ 
kālo nāsti, yasmānna tatra kalyaḥ kalanārhaḥ ko'pi kalyate, sarvasya 
tatra paramaśivaikātmyenaivāvasthiteḥ | 
yataścāyamaprameyatvāttuṭyādikalābhyaḥ kālāvayavarūpebhyo 
niṣkrāntastena kramādyavabhāsātmakakālavajītaḥ, tadrūpo na bhavati 
kevalaṃ proktavyākhyāsatattvaviśvakalanākāritvāt kāla ityuktaḥ | avyaya 
ityaparikṣīyamāṇamūtīḥ | uktaṃ ca yojanikāyām ---- 

śarvakālaṃ tu kālasya vyāpakaḥ paramo'vyayaḥ | 

unmanānte pare yojyo na kālastatra vartate	 ||" (4-287)

iti || 312 || 

yasmāt  ---- 

tasyādau yādṛśaṃ rūpaṃ kalpānte caiva tādṛśam | 

ādau sṛṣṭikāle || 

kiñca ---- 


arūpo rūpanirmuktaḥ so'nādirbhavavajītaḥ || 11-313 || 

sarvajñaḥ sarvakartāṃ ca dānādiguṇavajītaḥ | 


rūpyanta iti rūpāṇi deśakālākāraniyamā na vidyante yasya, ata eva 
rūpebhya idamīdṛgityādirūpavyāpārebhyo nirmuktaḥ, yato'nādistata eva 
bhavenotpādena vajīto'saṃspṛṣṭaḥ | sarvajña iti prāgvat | sarveṇa 
rūpeṇa kartā sarvātmanā svatantraḥ | cakāro jñatvakartṛtvayoḥ 
sāmarasyamāha | yaśca vyatirikte jñeye kārye jñātā kartā ca, 
asāvanādibhiḥ pravāhanityatayā vartamānairguṇairmāyādharmairyukto 
bhavati | ayaṃ tvabhedasarvajñasartakartṛtvātmakatvāttairasaṃspṛṣṭaḥ 
|| 

evamapi tato nānyatkiñcidasti, api tu ---- 


sa evāpararūpeṇa..............


svasvātantryāt sphurannapi ---- 


.........unmanyā rmūdhni saṃsthitaḥ || 11-314 || 


ataścāyam ---- 


devadevo jagannāthaḥ paramātmā śivo'vyayaḥ | 

pūrvānukramayogena so'kāmāt sṛjate jagat || 11-315 || 


jagatā kālāgnyādiśivāntena nāthyata iti jagannāthaḥ | 
pūrvānukramayogeneti samanāpadamāruhya 
tattatkāraṇamūrtyāśrayaṇenetyarthaḥ | akāmāditthamidamevamahaṃ 
karomīti saṅkalpaṃ vinā | śiṣṭaṃ prāgeva vyākhyātaprāyam || 315 || 

akāmādityākṣipantī śrīdevī uvāca ---- 


akāmasya kriyā nāsti niṣkriyaśca sṛjet katham | 

etaṃ praśnavaraṃ guhyaṃ kathaya sva prasādataḥ || 11-316 || 


sarvā gamanapacanādikriyā saṅkalpapūrvā, saṅkalpaśca cidānandaghane 
bhagavati neṣṭaḥ, tatkathamakriyasya sraṣṭṛtvam; atha ca 
citprakāśātmakaparameśvarasvarūpavyatiriktasyānyasya sattvameva na 
ghaṭate, kimaṅga kartṛtvam | ata etaṃ praśnānāṃ madhye varamutkṛṣṭaṃ 
praśnametannirṇayācca sarvasaṃśayocchitirbhavati | 
prasādatastattvārthonmīlanena kathayeti etannirṇayamādiśa || 316 || 

itthaṃ pṛṣṭaḥ śrībhairava uvāca ---- 


ādityasya maṇeryadvattāpitādraviraśmibhiḥ | 

vahniḥ sañjāyate tasmādravestatra na kāmitā || 11-317 || 

maṇerapi na kāmitvaṃ tadvad devasya ceṣṭitam | 


yaḥ kila kumbhakārādiḥ svavyaktiriktaṃ kāryaṃ kimapi prayojanamuddaśya 
janayati, tasya saṅkalpaṃ vinā tatpūrvakakriyānudayānmā bhūt kartṛtvam; 
parameśvarasya svatantrabhaṭṭārakasyedameva parameśvaratvam yadayam ---- 

śṛṣṭisaṃhārakartāram" (13)

ityādyuktanītyā svacidbhittau svātantryaśaktyā darpaṇanagaravat 
svānatiriktamapyatiriktamiva śivādikṣityantamanantāvāntaravaicitrya-
citritamābhāsayaṃstāvadaśeṣacamatkārātmakapūrṇānandaghanasvabhāva 
eveti vastusvabhāvamātrasāmyena sūryasampṛṣṭasūryakāntotthavahniratra 
dṛṣṭāntaḥ || 

tadāha ---- 


ādityavacchivo jñeyaḥ śaktirmaṇiriva sthitā || 11-318 || 


na tu jāḍyaṃ bhinnatvaṃ ca dārṣṭāntike śaṅkanīyam, 
dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikayoḥ sarvasādharmyāyogāt || 

kiñca ---- 


ṛtukālamitād vṛkṣāt kālo'ṅkuraniyojakaḥ | 

yadvacchivasamāyogāttadvacchakterjagatsthitiḥ || 11-319 || 


ṛtukālabhājastaroryathā'yaṃ svabhāva eva yadaṅkurādivaicitryavattvam, 
tathā nityāviyuktacidānandātmanoḥ śivaśaktyoḥ svarūpamevaitad yat 
kṛtyapañcakaprapañcātmanā sphuraṇam | taduktaṃ śivasūtreṣu ---- 

śvaśaktipracayo'sya viśvam" (3-30)

iti | itthaṃ 
caivaṃvidhāśeṣaviśvacamatkārasāraparamaśivātmakasvacidbhūmi-
vimarśanaṃ sarvaśāstreṣu paramopādeyaṃ jīvanmuktipradamucyata 
ityāśayena praśnavākye guhyamabhihitamiti śivam || 319 || 

śambhoḥ pūrṇānandacidratnarāśeḥ śaktirbāhyābhāsanātmocchalantī | 
devītraitaikātmarūpāmimāṃ tāṃ svāṃ sampūrṇāṃ devatāmāmṛśāmi 
||  || 

iti śrīsvacchandatantre śrīmahāmāheśvarācāryavarya-
śrīkṣemarājaviracitoddyotākhyavyākhyopete ekādaśaḥ paṭalaḥ || 11 || 





dvādaśaḥ paṭalaḥ


" svacchandodyotaḥ "


svātmani svecchayā kḷptatattattattvasphuṭadyutau | 

svābhinnā bhāsayan siddhīḥ svacchando jayati prabhuḥ || 


paṭalasaṅgatyarthamuktamanuvadantī tattvasiddhibubhutsayā śrīdevyuvāca --
-- 

sṛṣṭiḥ sthitiśca saṃhārastattvānāṃ kathitastvayā | 

jagatsambhavahetuśca..............


jagatastattvabhūtabhāvabhuvanādirūpasya hetuḥ paramakāraṇaṃ 
paramaśivaḥ || 

etacca ---- 


.............ṭvatprasādācchrutaṃ mayā || 12-1 || 


prasādādi prāgvat || 1 || 

idānīṃ tu ---- 


tattvavijñānamākhyāhi siddhisteṣu yathā bhavet | 


vijñānaṃ dhāraṇādikrameṇa sākṣātkāraḥ | teṣviti tadviṣayā 
siddhiryathā syāt || 

etad gadituṃ śrībhairava uvāca ---- 


pṛthivyādi śivāntaṃ ca kathayāmi samāsataḥ || 12-2 || 


yathā dehe yathā ca bahiḥ sthitam | samāsataḥ saṅkṣepeṇa, 
vistaratastvagre dhāraṇāvasare bhaviṣyati || 2 || 

tatra ---- 


pṛthvī kaṭhinarūpeṇa śṛṇu dehe yathā sthitā | 


yatheti yena māṃsādinā prakāreṇa || 

tadāha ---- 


māṃse'sthiṣu tathā caiva snāyulomanakheṣu ca || 12-3 || 

majjāntreṣu ca vijñeyā pṛthvī pañcaguṇotkaṭā | 


etaccāgre sphuṭībhaviṣyati || 


kaphāsṛgāmamūtreṣu rasasvedavasāsu ca || 12-4 || 

śukre ca saṃgrahe caiva sthitā āpaścaturguṇāḥ | 


dehe ityeva | rasa āhārapānapariṇāmottha ādyo dehadhārako dhātuḥ | 
saṃgraha pāthīvādīnāṃ māṃsādibhāvena pariṇatānāṃ saṃśleṣaḥ | 
pacane dahane caiva tejasyūṣmaṇi saṃsthitam || 5 || 

āhārādeḥ pākanimittaṃ mahākṣārajananātmakadāhāya parāsahyadīptaye 
upalabhyoṣmasampattaye ca dehe tejaḥ sthitam || 5 || 


tejastvevaṃ sthitaṃ devi prakāśe ca trilakṣaṇam | 


prakāśe iti netraraśmidvāreṇa vastuprathanāya | trayo rūpasparśaśabdā 
lakṣaṇaṃ yasya | etaccādṛṣṭavaśād dehe'nudriktarūpasparśaṃ 
spaṣṭam || 


vāyurucchvāsaniḥśvāsasparśanavyūhalakṣaṇaḥ || 12-6 || 

mūtroccāravisargeṣu annapānapraveśane | 


sparśanaṃ bāhyābhyantarasparśagrahaṇam | vyūho racanā | uccāro 
malapariṇāmaḥ | visargo bahiṣkṛtiḥ || 

tadittham ---- 


vāyurebhiḥ sthito dehe vijñeyastu dvilakṣaṇaḥ || 12-7 || 


ebhirvyāpārairupalakṣitaḥ | dvau śabdasparśau lakṣaṇaṃ 
jñaptiheturyasya sa dvilakṣaṇo dviguṇaḥ || 7 || 


ekalakṣaṇamākāśaṃ kathayāmi yathā sthitam | 


ekaḥ śabdo lakṣaṇaṃ yasya | tatra pṛthivyāḥ khaṭakhaṭārūpaḥ, 
jalasya cchalacchalatā, tejaso dhagadhagākṛtiḥ, vāyoḥ 
śukaśukāsvabhāvaḥ, ākāśasya pratiśrutkākhyaḥ śabdaḥ | sparśo'pi 
pṛthvyāḥ pākajo'nuṣṇāśītaḥ, jalasya śītaḥ, tejasa uṣṇaḥ, 
vāyorapākajo'nuṣṇāśītaḥ | pṛthvyāḥ sitādi nānārūpam, jalasya 
sitam, tejaso bhāsvaram | pṛthvyāḥ ṣaḍvidho madhurādirasaḥ, jalasya 
madhuraḥ | pṛthvyā eva tu surabhirūpo gandha iti | viśiṣṭaireva 
tairguṇairdehe pṛthivyādibhūtāni lakṣaṇīyāni || 

yathāsthitamityuktaṃ spaṣṭayati ---- 


suṣirātmakaṃ tu vijñeyaṃ navadhācchidralakṣaṇam || 12-8 || 


nava cchidrāṇi dvārāṇi 
brahmarandhracakṣuḥśrotraghrāṇāsyacūcukanābhiliṅgagudagatāni 
lakṣaṇaṃ yasya || 8 || 

itthaṃ navadvāralakṣitam ---- 


śabdātmakaṃ guṇaṃ hyetat kathitaṃ tava suvrate | 


evaṃ dehe bhūtapañcakaṃ pradarśya, tadupasthāpakatatprakāśakāni 
karmendriyabuddhimanāṃsi 
prakāśyendriyakāraṇabhautikarūpādipratītivaśānumeyāni 
rūpādyaviśeṣarūpāṇi tanmātrāṇyupapādayiṣyati | tatra tāvat ---- 


vāgindriyaṃ vadedvāṇīṃ sā ca vāṇī catuvīdhā || 12-9 || 

saṃskṛtā prākṛtī caiva apabhraṣṭānunāsikā | 


śaṃskṛtā nāma daivī vāganvākhyātā mahaṣībhiḥ"

iti tatrabhavadbhartṛhariṇāuktatātparyā saṃskṛtā | prakṛtibhūtāyā 
varṇalopānyathābhāvādikrameṇa āyātā prākṛtī | yadāhuḥ ---- 

"tadbhavastatsamo deśī trividhaḥ prākṛtakramaḥ" iti | 


apabhraṣṭā deśabhāṣā vicitraḥ | anunāsikā nāsikāmanugatā 
gīyamānākṣararūpā varṇāṅgamitiprasiddhā || 


chedanaṃ bhedanaṃ dānaṃ vyadhanaṃ śilpayojanam || 12-10 || 

grahaṇaṃ vijayaścaiva sarvaṃ hastendriye sthitam | 


chedanaṃ rajjvādiṣu | (bhedanaṃ) bhedaḥ śarādikṛto lakṣyādhiṣṭhaḥ | 
vijayo yuddham | vijayī iti vā pāṭhaḥ || 


samanimnonnatāścaiva loṣṭhakaṇṭakabālukāḥ || 12-11 || 

kardamo jaladurgāṇi rathyāṭṭālakaparvatāḥ | 

pādendriyeṇa gamyante deśāntaragamāgame || 12-12 || 


deśāntaragamanāgamananimittaṃ samanimnādisthānāni pādendriyeṇa gamyante 
|| 12 || 


utsarge padīte caiva pāyurvai ceṣṭate sadā | 


utsargo malamokṣaḥ | padītaṃ gudarandhreṇa kutsitaśabdaḥ | 


ānandakṛdupasthaśca gamyāgamyapravartakaḥ || 12-13 || 


ānandakṛttvādeva vihitaniṣiddhādau sarvatra pravartanamasya svabhāvaḥ, 
ata eva tanniyamaḥ śāstre kriyate || 13 || 

tadittham ---- 


karmasvetāni vartante tena karmendriyāṇi tu | 


yathā caitāni īdṛśi, tathā ---- 


buddhīndriyāṇi deveśi vartante buddhiyogataḥ || 12-14 || 


buddherjñānasya yogaḥ sambandhastatra tannimittaṃ pravartante || 14 || 

tatra vitatya śabdākhyaviṣayaprabhedanirūpaṇapūrvaṃ śrotrendriyasya 
tadupalabdhisādhanatvamācaṣṭe ---- 


ṣaḍjākhyarṣabhagāndhāramadhyamāḥ pañcamaḥ priye | 

dhaivato niṣadhaścaiva svarāḥ sapta prakītītāḥ || 12-15 || 

gāndhāro madhyamaḥ ṣaḍjastrayo grāmāśca pārvati | 


ittham ---- 


sapta svarāstrayo grāmā mūrchanāścaikaviṃśatiḥ || 12-16 || 

tāna ekonapañcāśadityetat suramaṇḍalam | 


tadittham ---- 


sūkṣmaśabdāḥ smṛtā hyete carācararavasthitāḥ || 12-17 || 


sūkṣmadhvanimātrarūpāḥ, ata eva carācare sarvatra ravarūpatayā 
dhvanimātrāvasthitāḥ || 17 || 

atha ---- 


sthūlāṃścaiva pravakṣyāmi yathāvattānnibodha me | 

bherīpaṭahaśaṅkhottho mṛdaṅgapaṇavotthitaḥ || 12-18 || 

veṇugomukhaśabdaśca mandalo darduro dhvaniḥ | 

tantrīvādyāni citrāṇi karavādyāni yāni ca || 12-19 || 

saṃyogajaviyogotthāḥ kāṣṭhapāṣāṇavārijāḥ | 

apabhraṃśo'nunāsikyaḥ saṃskṛtaḥ prākṛto ravaḥ || 12-20 || 


saṃyogajā huḍukkādihastasaṅgotthāḥ, vibhāgajāstu 
dalādiviśleṣoditāḥ || 20 || 

tadittham ---- 


saptasvarapratiṣṭhāni vyaktāvyaktāni caiva hi | 

uktānuktāni gṛhṇāti śravaṇendriyayogataḥ || 12-21 || 


vādyasaṃskṛtādyātmakāni sarvāṇi śabdarūpāṇi 
saptasvarātmakadhvaniviśiṣṭaniṣṭhāni śrotreṇa puruṣo gṛhṇāti || 21 
|| 

tataśca ---- 


śabdo'sya viṣayo hyeṣa yena buddhyeta pudgalaḥ | 


eṣa proktarūpaḥ sarvaḥ śabdo'sya śravaṇendriyasya viṣayaḥ | 
kasyāsyetyāha ---- yena pudgalaḥ pumān buddhyeta jānīyāt | 
evamuttaratrāpi saṅgatiḥ kāryā || 


mṛduṃ ca kaṭhinaṃ caiva karkaśaṃ śītalaṃ tathā || 12-22 || 

uṣṇaṃ ca picchilaṃ loṣṭhaṃ kardamaṃ bālukāstathā | 

śarakuntāsighātādi tāḍanaṃ chedanaṃ tathā || 12-23 || 

etāni vai vijānāti sparśanaṃ ca tvagindriyam | 


sparśanaṃ sajjānāti, sparśanakrameṇa vettītyarthaḥ || 

tadittham ---- 


sparśo'sya viṣayo hyeṣa yena buddhyeta pudgalaḥ || 12-24 || 


atha ---- 

cakṣurindriyakarmāṇi kathyamānāni me śṛṇu | 

sitaṃ raktaṃ ca pītaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ haritadhūmrakam || 12-25 || 

kapilaṃ piṅgalaṃ babhru anyānyapi viśeṣataḥ | 


rūpāṇi || 

tathā ---- 


naranārīpaśumṛgān jyotiḥ sthāvarajaṅgamam || 12-26 || 


tadittham ---- 


rūpākṛtiviviktāni cakṣuḥ paśyati sarvadā | 


rūpaṃ sitādi, ākṛtiḥ saṃsthānam; tābhyāṃ viviktāni vilakṣaṇāni 
vastūni cakṣuḥ paśyatītyasya kartṛtvamupacaritam || 

tadevam ---- 


rūpākhyo viṣayo hyasya yenātmā pratibuddhyate || 12-27 || 

madhurāmlarasaṃ caiva lavaṇaṃ kaṭu tiktakam | 

kaṣāyamiśraṃ svāduṃ ca jihvā vedayate rasam || 12-28 || 


ittham ---- 


raso'sya viṣayo hyeṣa yena buddhyeta pudgalaḥ | 

surabhidīvyagandhaśca durgandhaścāpyanekadhā || 12-29 || 

ubhau jighrati nāsāgre................


nāsā kartrī agre sthitāvubhau jighrati || 

ataścāsyāyam ---- 


...............viṣayo gandhasaṃjñitaḥ | 

yenāsau buddhyate kṣetrī ahaṅkāreṇa mohitaḥ || 12-30 || 


śarīrādau baddhābhimānatvādeva vyatirekeṇa viṣayān vetti | etacca 
pūrvatrāpi sambandhanīyam || 


saṅkalpe ca vikalpe ca daśadhākṣeṣu dhāvati | 

anivāritasandehamajayyaṃ sarvadehinām || 12-31 || 

manaśca kathitaṃ hyetaddharmādharmanibandhakam | 


buddhikarmendriyaviṣaye ya idaṃ śritamidamādadhe iti saṅkalpaḥ, yaśca 
idamīdṛśamiti niścayātmā vikalpaḥ; atra dhāvati yathātathā pravartate; 
ata evaitadanivāritasandehaṃ sarvatra sasaṃśayam, jñānayogaṃ vinā yanna 
kenacijjetuṃ pāryate; dharmādharmābhyāṃ nibadhnātīti tannibandhakaṃ 
tatsaṅgamakṛt || 

athendriyakāryarūpādyupalabdhyanusāreṇa dehe tanmātrāvasthitiṃ 
darśayitumāha ---- 


svarūpadharmaṃ vakṣyāmi tanmātrāṇāṃ yathārthataḥ || 12-32 || 


arthaḥ prayojanaṃ tadanusāreṇa tanmātrāṇāṃ 
svarūpamupāgataniyatāśrayāvasthitirūpaṃ dharmaṃ svabhāvaṃ vacmi || 32 
|| 

tatra ---- 


gandhaṃ tu gandhatanmātraṃ nāsikāgreṇa jighrati | 

jihvayā rasatanmātraṃ rasaṃ gṛhṇāti saṃsthitam || 12-33 || 

cakṣuṣā rūpatanmātraṃ rūpaṃ gṛhṇātyupāgatam | 

gṛhṇāti sparśatanmātraṃ tvacā sparśamupāgatam || 12-34 || 

śabdaṃ ca śabdatanmātraṃ gṛhṇāti śravaṇena tu | 


gandhādipratītisādhanaghrāṇādīndriyāśrayanāsikādikṣetragatam 
adṛṣṭavaśādudbhūtagandhatanmātrādikaṃ karktṛ, tenaiva ghrāṇādināṃ 
gandhādiguṇaṃ gṛhṇātīti saṅgatiḥ | atra cāya ---- māśayaḥ ---- 
yadāhaṅkārikatvād vyāpakatve'pīndriyāṇāṃ 
gandhatanmātrādyavasthitiniyamitaṃ nāsikādikṣetramabhivyaktisthānamiti, 
tata eva samudbhūtavṛttigandhatanmātraniyantritā 
gandhasyopalabdhirbhavatīti 
niyamitatanmātroparaktāhaṅkārikatvamindriyāṇām, anyathā sāṅkhyavat 
kevale āhaṅkāritve niyataviṣayasambandho na ghaṭate, naiyāyikavadvā 
kevalabhautikatve tvahaṃpratītyanugamo na syāt || 

etadupasaṃharati ---- 


sūkṣmastanmātradharmo'yaṃ bhūtānāṃ prakṛtikramāt || 12-35 || 


yato bhūtānāṃ prakṛtayastanmātrāṇi tata eva 
tattattanmātrādhiṣṭhitatattadindriyakāraṇakapṛthivyādibhūtagata- 
gandhādiguṇopalabdhirbhavatītyayamindriyagatānāṃ tanmātrāṇāṃ 
sūkṣmaḥ sarvajanāsañcetito dharmo'sti || 35 || 

dehe'haṅkārasthitiṃ darśayati ---- 


vaikārikastataścordhvaṃ buddhyate yena pudgalaḥ | 

ahaṃ vidvānahaṃ bhogī tvahaṃ jāto mahākule || 12-36 || 

ahaṃ dātā ca bhoktā ca tejasvī balavānaham | 

ahaṃ yoddhā ca saṃgrāme śatravaśca mayā jitāḥ || 12-37 || 

dharmaśīlaśca guṇavān śreyaskartā hyahaṃ param | 

ahaṃ pāpī durācāro mūrkhaścāhaṃ durākṛtiḥ || 12-38 || 

na dattaṃ na mayā bhuktaṃ matsamo nāsti duḥkhitaḥ | 

ityahaṅkāracittānāṃ mamatvavaśavatīnām || 12-39 || 

ahaṅkāro nibadhnāti saṃsāre dṛḍhabandhanaiḥ | 


vidvān boddhā pāpī, ityādisāttvikyādipratītirūpaiḥ 
saṃsārahetubhirdṛḍhairbandhanairahaṅkāro nibadhnāti janān | 
ūrdhvamityetāvadantatattvavyāpakatvena || 

tadittham ---- 


trividhasyāpyayaṃ dharmo'haṅkārasya prakītītaḥ || 12-40 || 


yattu "vaikārikastataścordhvam" ityuktam (12 | 36), tadahaṅkārasya 
rājasatāprādhānyadarśanāya || 40 || 

atha dharmamukhena dhamīrūpāyā buddherdehe sattāmāha ---- 


buddhidharmāṃstato vakṣye dharmādīṃstava suvrate | 

dharmo jñānaṃ ca vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ ca catuṣṭayam || 12-41 || 

adharmaśca tathājñānamavairāgyamanaiśvaram | 


eṣāṃ madhyāt ---- 


badhnāti saptadhā sā tu jñānabhāvena mohayet || 12-42 || 


sāṅkhyasiddhāniti, arthāt || 42 || 

eṣā cetthaṃ mukhyatayā lakṣyata ityāha ---- 


buddhiścādhyavasāyaṃ ca karoti vividheṣvapi | 


vastuṣu || 


dharmādīnāmathāṣṭānāṃ lakṣaṇāni śṛṇu priye || 12-43 || 


tatra ---- 


upavāso japo maunamakrodho'steyamārjavam | 

satyaṃ śaucaṃ ca dānaṃ ca dayā kṣāntiśca sarvadā || 12-44 || 

vidyābhyāsaśca lajjā ca indriyāṇāṃ ca nigrahaḥ | 

iṣṭāpūrtaṃ tīrthasevā pitṝṇāṃ caiva tarpaṇam || 12-45 || 

abhayaṃ sarvasattvebhyo jīvitasya ca rakṣaṇam | 

dhīguṇaḥ prathamo hyeṣa dharma ityabhidhīyate || 12-46 || 


iha yaḥ pūrvam ---- 

"akrodho guruśuśrūṣā śaucaṃ santoṣa ārjavam | 

ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryamakalkatā ||" (11-145)

ityevaṃ daśavidho dharma uktaḥ, tasyaiva 
saprapañcabhaṅgyantarapratipādanametat | tathā cendriyāṇāṃ nigraho 
brahmacaryasya prapañcoktiḥ | lajjā upavāso japo maunaṃ dānaṃ dayā 
kṣāntiriṣṭāpūrtāditrayaṃ cākalkatāyāḥ prapañcaḥ | vidyābhyāso 
jīvitarakṣā ca guruśuśrūṣāyāḥ phalam | 
sarvasattvābhayamahiṃsārūpam | steyavarjanakṣāntī santoṣārjavarūpe || 
46 || 

tadittham ---- 


dharmakarmanibaddhānāṃ saṃsāramanuvatīnām | 

punarmārtyaṃ punaḥ svargyaṃ tiryaktvaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ || 12-47 || 


bhavatīti śeṣaḥ || 47 || 

evam ---- 


dharmabhāvaḥ samākhyātaḥ..............


idānīm ---- 


.............jñānabhāvaṃ ca meṃ śṛṇu | 


bhāvaṃ buddhidharmam || 

tameva sphuṭayati ---- 


catuvīṃśatikaḥ piṇḍaḥ karaṇendriyasaṃyutaḥ || 12-48 || 

prākṛtaḥ sa tu vijñeyo dharmādharmapravartakaḥ | 


manovākkāyavyāpārairdharmādyarjakaḥ || 


akartā nirguṇaścāhaṃ..............


tena prakṛtibhinnasya ---- 


.........ṇa meṃ bandho'sti prākṛtaḥ || 12-49 || 


kevalamidaṃ sarvam ---- 


prakṛtyā kāritaṃ manye.............


buddhyādidvāreṇa pravatītamiti niścinomi || 

tadīdṛśavivekajñānotthāt ---- 


...................vāsanādeva mucyate | 


vāsanaṃ saṃskāraḥ | mucyata iti sāṅkhyabhikṣuḥ || 

tadetat ---- 


sāṅkhyajñānaṃ mayāṃ proktaṃ prakṛteryena mucyate || 12-50 || 


katipayaṃ kālaṃ pṛthagbhavati || 50 || 

atha ---- 


muktaṃ prakṛtibandhāttaṃ punarbadhnāti ceśvaraḥ | 


sa ca ---- 


baddhaḥ saṃsarate bhūyo yāvad devaṃ na vindati || 12-51 || 

īśvaraṃ sṛṣṭikartāraṃ sarvajantunibandhakam | 


prakṛterjaḍāyāḥ kartṛtvāghaṭanāt puṃsastadanabhyugamāt saṃsarge'pi 
jagadudayo na syāditi tayorbandhamokṣanirmātāraṃ yāvadīśvaraṃ na 
labhate tāvatsāṅkhyamukto'pi punaḥ pratyāvartate tattvajñānānudayāt || 

vairāgyaṃ lakṣayitumāha ---- 


vairāgyāt santyajet putrān dārāniṣṭān susammatān || 12-52 || 

hastyaśvarathayānāni suhṛdbhogadhanāni ca | 


suṣṭhu sammatānanukūlān || 

kiñca ---- 


upavāsaṃ japaṃ tīrthaṃ pañcāgniṃ jalaśāyitām || 12-53 || 

upāsyaitāni ghorāṇi dehaṃ santyajati kṣaṇāt | 


dakṣiṇāgnyāhavanīyagārhapatyaupasadikasāvitrākhyāgnipañcamadhyā-
vasthānaṃ grīṣme pañcāgnyākhyaṃ tapaḥ | etānīti tapāṃsi || 

kathaṃ tyajati ? ---- ityāha ---- 


girivṛkṣajalāgnibhyaḥ prahārodbandhanāśanaiḥ || 12-54 || 


giryādīnāśrityetyarthaḥ | vṛkṣaḥ prayāgādisthito vaṭaḥ | 
āśanamaśanamāṅ pūrvasya aśnāteḥ prayogaḥ || 

tadevaṃprāyāṇyanyānyapi ---- 


vairāgyaṃ tu samāśritya kurute sāhasānyapi | 

eśvaryabhāvamāpanno dravyaistṛptiṃ na gacchati || 12-55 || 

na dārairna dhanairbhogaiḥ parivārairna vāhanaiḥ | 

tapo vratāni mantrāṃśca eśvaryārthe tu sādhayet || 12-56 || 


kiñca ---- 


yuddhaṃ dyūtaṃ tathā māyāṃ cauryaṃ cānṛtahiṃsanam | 

anyānyapi tvayuktāni visrambhacchalaghātitām || 12-57 || 

eśvaryabhāvamāpannaḥ karoti ca bahūnyapi | 


tapovratādīni sāttvikasya, yuddhādīni tu rājasasya, āśvāsahananādīni 
tāmasasyārthāharaṇakāraṇāni || 

dharmādicatuṣṭayaṃ pradarśya, adharmādīnapi dehino darśayati krameṇa --
-- 


prāṇihiṃsārato nityaṃ caurikānṛtadambhavān || 12-58 || 

yācako duḥkhadātā ca bhaveccādharmaceṣṭitam | 


caurikā cauryam | prāṇihiṃsāratatvādi, etadadharmasya ceṣṭitaṃ 
bhavatītyarthaḥ || 


nāsti dharmo na cādharmaḥ svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca ko gataḥ || 12-59 || 

ajñānabhāvamāpannaḥ sarvaṃ mithyeti bhāṣate | 

nityaṃ duḥkhī parapreṣyo bhāraṃ yānaṃ vahannapi || 12-60 || 

kṛcchrajīvī ca satatamavairāgye na khidyate | 


satītyarthaḥ || 


rājyaṃ kṛtvā tu sāmantaḥ sāmantyād grāmabhugbhavet || 12-61 || 

grāmād bhraṣṭastadardhena vartate'sāvanīśvaraḥ | 

na śocati na codvignaḥ krīḍate pūrvarājyavat || 12-62 || 

anaiśvaryasya bhāvo'yamevaṃ te samudāhṛtaḥ | 


atha dehastham ---- 


avyaktaṃ triguṇaṃ vakṣye saṃsārasya pravartakam || 12-63 || 


īśvarecchāta iti, arthāt || 63 || 

etasmādeva ---- 


yasmācca jagadutpattiḥ prakṛtistena cocyate | 


etadeva prakarṣeṇa kriyate prapañcyate buddhyādikṣmāntaṃ 
sarvamasyāmīśvareṇeti prakṛtiḥ || 

kiñca, dehāvasthitipratītihetum ---- 


asya dharmaṃ pravakṣyāmi rajaḥsattvatamo'bhidham || 12-64 || 


tatra ---- 


prakāśabhāvaḥ sattvaṃ ca dharmaḥ sattvasamāśritaḥ | 


prakāśabhāvo'rthākṛtisamvedanam, sattvaṃ śuddhacittatā yayā pūrvokto 
dharmaḥ || 

sattvasambandhādeva yaśca pareṣāṃ dhanānnādeḥ ---- 


saṃvibhāgī ca satataṃ nityaṃ sattvopakārakaḥ || 12-65 || 

kṣamādayāsamāyukto jñānavijñānapāragaḥ | 


sa sāttvika ityarthaḥ | sattvopakārako dānaṃ vināpi vāgādinā 
prāṇyupakārī || 

kiñca ---- 


prītirdānaṃ dhṛtirmedhā tapaḥ śaucaṃ damastathā || 12-66 || 

ṛtavāk samadṛṣṭiśca divyabuddhiprabodhanam | 

yasminnete sadā dharmā bhavanti puruṣottame || 12-67 || 

sa sāttvikastu vijñeyaḥ............


samadṛṣṭiḥ svātmanīva paratra pratipattiḥ | divyabuddhiḥ pratibhā || 

atha ---- 


...........ṝajodharmāṃśca meṃ śṛṇu | 

nistriṃśaścātilobhī ca vidveṣī krodhanastathā || 12-68 || 

kāmī harṣasamāviṣṭo duḥkhārtaḥ paryaṭet sadā | 

mānī dambhasamāyukto'pyahaṅkāre vyavasthitaḥ || 12-69 || 

nityaṃ yuddharataḥ śūraḥ.........


kāmī san harṣayuktaḥ, na tu santoṣasukhavāniti || 

evaṃvidho yaḥ tasyaitannistriṃśatvādikam ---- 


............ṝājasaṃ guṇalakṣaṇam | 


atha ---- 


kāmakrodhābhibhūtatvaṃ lobhena ca samanvayaḥ || 12-70 || 

īrṣyā dambho viṣādaśca mada unmāda eva ca | 

nidrālasyamakamītvaṃ daurmedhyājñānite tathā || 12-71 || 

adharmatābuddhimattvaṃ nāstikyaṃ chalacittatā | 


etatsarvam ---- 


tamaḥ.......


tamoguṇarūpam || 
ataśca ---- 


........cihnāni caitāni dṛśyante yatra mānave || 12-72 || 

tāmasaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ puruṣaḥ kaluṣāśayaḥ | 


tadittham ---- 


etattriguṇamavyaktaṃ triguṇaṃ samudāhṛtam || 12-73 || 


etat tribhirguṇairyuktatvāt triguṇam || 73 || 


etat samyagviditvā tu mucyate prākṛtairguṇaiḥ | 


viditvā prameyatayā paricchidya, prākṛtairdharmairmucyate 
prakṛtivaivyaktyameti || 

vastutastu na sa mucyate, yata etāvatī asya pratītiryaduta ---- 


guṇadharmā na caivāhaṃ buddhyahaṅkṛdguṇo nahi || 12-74 || 

karaṇendriyahīnaśca bhūtatanmātravajītaḥ | 

akartā nirguṇaścāhaṃ cinmātraḥ puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ || 12-75 || 


karaṇabāhyendriyādhiṣṭhātṛsamaḥ | smṛta iti purāṇādipraṇetṛbhiḥ | 
ataśca ahamakartā || 75 || 

ata eva ---- 


mānasaṃ vācikaṃ caiva śārīraṃ karma yatkṛtam | 


tatsarvam ---- 


prakṛtyā kāritaṃ manye............


prakṛtiprayuktairmanaḥprabhṛtibhiḥ kṛtamityavaimi || 


evaṃ ca na prayojakatvam, nāpi mukhyaṃ kartṛtvaṃ puṃso'stīti kṛtvā ---
- 


............'kartā puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ || 12-76 || 

evaṃ saṃnyasya karmāṇi vartate na ca nityaśaḥ | 

nāhaṃ kartā na meṃ bandha evaṃ budhyeta yo naraḥ || 12-77 || 

prakṛteḥ sa vimucyeta yāvanna sṛjatīśvaraḥ | 


evamitivacanena karmāṇi saṃnyasyeti saṅgatiḥ || 

prakṛtimātravivekamātmano manyamāno'kartryā jaḍāyāḥ prakṛteḥ 
kartṛtvamadhiṣṭhāturīśvarasya bandhādikartuścākartṛtvaṃ 
mohānmanyamānastattvāprajñānāt kañcit kālaṃ 
nivṛttaprakṛtisambandho'pi na tattvataḥ prakṛtibandhāt pramucyate | 
tadāha ---- 


sāṅkhyajñānena sammūḍho muktirityabhimanyate || 12-78 || 

nahi muktirbhavettasya kañcitkālaṃ videhatā | 


kañcitkālaṃ yā videhatā sā na muktiryatastasmāt sāṅkhyajñānena mohito 
muktiriti mithyaiva jānāti || 

kevalametāvajjñānādasau ---- 


tiṣṭhet prakṛtinirmuktaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhāravajītaḥ || 12-79 || 

yāvatkarotyasau sṛṣṭimīśvaraḥ parameśvaraḥ | 


idamevāsya prakṛtinirmuktatvaṃ yat 
prakṛtikāryaśarīrādisargasaṃhāravajītatvam | evaṃ ca yāvadīśvaraḥ 
puṃsāṃ bhogāya punaḥ sṛṣṭiṃ na ārabhate, tāvadasau 
prakṛtilīnaprāya evāste ityuktaṃ bhavati | na 
caitāvanmātrasraṣṭṭatvamasya eśvaryam, api tu 
śuddhāśuddhasarvādhvaviṣayamityāśayena parameśvaro'nāśritāntasya 
viśvasya prabhurityuktam ||  

tata īśvare puṃsāṃ karmaparipākānusāribhogadānāya 
sṛṣṭyābhimukhyamāśrayati

sāṅkhyayogī ---- 


tāvatprakṛtibandhena saṃsāre kṣipyate punaḥ || 12-80 || 

kṣiptaḥ saṃsarate bhūyaḥ saṃsāre ghorasāgare | 

dharmādharmanibaddhastu sāṅkhyajñānena mohitaḥ || 12-81 || 


tāvat prakṛtādaviśiṣṭo yaḥ prakṛtibandhastena | ghoro 
vibhīṣikāśataprado durantatvācca sāgara iva sāgaraḥ | yadyapi ca nāhaṃ 
kartā prakṛtireva kartrītyanenāvasitam, tathāpi tattasyā jaḍatvād 
nopapannam, buddheścicchāyāyoge cetanatvamupacaritaṃ kathaṃ mukhyaṃ 
kartṛtvaṃ syāt, prakṛteśca sattvodrekābhāvāt 
cicchāyāgrahaṇāyogyatayopacaritamapi cetanāyamānatvaṃ nāstīti kathaṃ 
karmasambandhaḥ, kathaṃ vā jñānānnaiṣkarmyaprāptiḥ | 
ato'vaśyamīśvarecchāvaśotthāpitakalādisambandhahetukaṃ puṃso 
mitaviṣayaṃ kartṛtvamastītyanādibhavopājītadharmādharmanibaddhatvamasya 
sāṅkhyajñānamohitasyāstīti yuktamutpaśyāmaḥ || 81 || 

itthamīśvarecchātaḥ saṃsārasaṅgarato'yam ---- 


ahaṃ kartā ca bhoktā ca īśvaro balavānaham | 


iti manyamānaḥ ---- 


mamatvenaiva sammūḍho bhrāmyate ghaṭayantravat || 12-82 || 


ahaṅkārapūrvakatvānmamakārasya | bhrāmyata iti īśvareṇa | yaduktaṃ 
gītāsu ---- 

"īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ hṛdyeṣa vasate'rjuna | 

bhrāmayan sarvabhūtāni yantrārūḍhāni māyayā ||" (18-69) iti || 

etadupasaṃharati ---- 


sāṅkhyajñānaṃ mayā proktaṃ............


iha pūrvaṃ yat praśnitam ---- 


"tattvavijñānamākhyāhi siddhisteṣu yathā bhavet" (12-2)


iti, tannirṇayāya dehāśrayāṇi dharādiprakṛtyantāni tattvāni 
pratipāditāni | adhunoccāraṇādikrameṇa tattatsiddhyarthaṃ 
sākṣātkāryametatkāryatattvasvarūpaṃ sthūladṛśā pradarśya, 
sūkṣmadṛśā paradṛśā cātmāśrayāṇi niyatyādisamastāni 
śuddhavidyādiśivāntāni ca siddhyarthameva tattvāntaradhyānāni 
darśayannupakramate ---- 


...........śṛṇu dhyānādhidaivatam | 


pṛthivyāditattvānāṃ dhyānaṃ 
tatsaṃvācyatattvādhiṣṭhātṛdevatāsvarūpaṃ ca 
vakṣyamāṇatattatsiddhipradaṃ śṛṇviti sambandhaḥ | atra cādau ---- 

śamayācārayuktasya sādhakasya varānane | 

jāyate vividhā siddhigīrigahvaramāśrite || 

suśuddhe bhūpradeśe tu...................... | " (6-1-2)


ityādikrameṇa pūrvoktabhairavapūjāpūrvakaṃ 
pṛthvyāditattvadhyānamārabdhavyam || 

tatra tāvat ---- 


pṛthkā kaṭhinarūpeṇa catuḥsāgaramekhalām || 12-83 || 

saparvatavanākīrṇāṃ mṛgapakṣisamākulām | 

susthirāṃ pītavarṇābhāmūbījena samanvitām || 12-84 || 

dhyātvā tatsiddhimabhyeti...........


catuḥsāgaramekhalādirūpā yā pṛthvī pūrvaṃ uktā, tāṃ 
susthirakaṭhinapītavarṇābhāṃ bhuvanādhvapratipāditatattaddevatātmikāṃ 
sarvadehe gatāṃ dhyātvā tatsiddhimeti tanmayaḥ sādhako bhavati | asyāśca 
pūrvoktarasātmaprakriyayā ---- 

"dharitryādipradhānāntamūkāro vācakaḥ smṛtaḥ" (5-5)

iti kṛtvokārabījavācyatvamuktam | dhyātvetyuktyā dhyānātpūrvaṃ 
dhāraṇā ākṣiptā || sā ca ---- 

śvadehaṃ hemasaṅkāśaṃ turyāśraṃ vajralāñchitam" (mā.vi. 12-12)

itīdṛgdhāraṇāpūrvaṃ pṛthvīdhyānamabhyasyet || 


............viṣasattvānnivārayet | 


viṣaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamādirūpam, sattvān piśācāpasmārādīn 
śaktistambhanādikrameṇa helayaiva nāśayati || 

samāpannapṛthvīdhyānastvasau ---- 


acālyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ yathaiva vasudhā bhavet || 12-85 || 


etat ---- 

"tatsiddhimabhyeti" (12-84)

iti pūrvokteḥ sphuṭīkaraṇam | yathaiva vasudheti pṛthvījayena 
tadadhiṣṭhātṛvat tatraiśvaryamāpnoti | evamuttaratrāpi yojyam || 85 || 

jaladhyānamāha ---- 


jalāpūritasarvāṅgo jaladhyānena pūrayet | 

evamabhyasyamānastu viṣasattvān vināśayet || 12-86 || 

tṛṣṇādāhavinirmukta ītibhiśca vivajītaḥ | 

jagadāpūrayet siddhaḥ pūrvabījasamanvitaḥ || 12-87 || 


jaladhyānena pūrayediti aṅgopāṅgaprasaraṇakrameṇa viśvamāpūritaṃ 
bhāvayet | evamabhyasyanviṣādi nāśayediti āpyāyanayuktyā 
sādhyamāpyāyayati praśāntaviṣabhūtadoṣaṃ karoti, svayaṃ ca 
tattatsantāpādyavasareṣu tṛṣṇādibhirītibhiśca sarvopadravaivīvajītaḥ 
kramācca siddha iti niṣpannāptatvadhyāno jagadapi ambhovadeva āpyāyayati | 
pūrvabījamūkāra eva, pradhānāntaṃ tasyaiva vācakatvena uktatvāt | 
atrāpi ---- 

"jalātmakaṃ smared dehaṃ sitaṃ śītaṃ suvartulam |" (mā.vi. 13-2)

iti śrīpūrvoktanītyā kamalalāñchitasitārdhacandramaṇḍalātmikāṃ 
jaladhāraṇāṃ baddhvā ūkāraparāmarśapūrvaṃ 
prāṅnidīṣṭadevatādhiṣṭhitaṃ jalamayaṃ svadehaṃ dhyāyet || 87 || 

śvaśarīrotthito vahnirjvalan vai sarvadāhakaḥ | 

trikoṇaṃ cintayed dehaṃ raktajvālāvalīdharam ||" (mā.vi. 13-21)

iti śrīpūrvanirūpitavahnidhāraṇayā svadehaṃ dhyātvā ---- 


kuryāt karmasahasrāṇi svabījena tu bījitaḥ | 


bījitaḥ parāmarśayuktyā yojitaḥ | svabījaṃ repha ityasadiha tathā 
prakramābhāvāt | pradhānāntaṃ dehāśrayāṇi tattvānyuktvā 
tattvadhyānapratipādanasyāyamevāśayo yannavātmaprakriyayā 
ūkārādivācakaparāmarśapūrvametatsiddhiḥ syāditi || 


kṛṣṇareṇvātmako vāyurdhyeyo bījena saṃyutaḥ || 12-88 || 

pūrayedvai jagaddehān..............


atrāpi ---- 

śvadehaṃ cintayetkṛṣṇaṃ vṛttaṃ ṣaḍbindulāñchitam | 

 calaṃ sadhūdhūśabdaṃ ca............................. ||" (mā.vi. 13-34)

iti śrīpūrvoktavāyavīyadhāraṇāpūrvakād dhyānājjagadgatān 
dehānucchvāsamātreṇa pūrayedāpyāyayet || 88 || 

dhyānaprakarṣāttu ---- 


.............ṣiddhaścāścaryakārakaḥ | 


vāyutattvādhiṣṭhātṛdevatāprabhāvāt kiṃ kiṃ na karotītyarthaḥ || 


suṣirātmakaṃ svadehaṃ tu jagacca suṣirātmakam || 12-89 || 

dhyāyet prakṛtibījena.............


ekāreṇa (ūkāreṇa) || 

evaṃ ca ---- 


...............citrakarmāṇi kārayet | 


yaduktaṃ śrīpūrve ---- 

"ṣaṇmāsād gaganākāraḥ sūkṣmarandhrairapi vrajet | 

vatsaratritayāt sārdhād vyoma eva bhaviṣyati | 

icchayaiva mahākāyaḥ sūkṣmadehastathecchayā | 

acchedyaścāpyabhedyaśca........................ ||" (mā.vi. 13-46-47)

ityādi || 

prāksthityaiva karmendriyabuddhīndriyatanmātradhyānāni krameṇāha | tatra 
---- 


vāgindriye tathā vahnirdhyāto vāksiddhidāyakaḥ || 12-90 || 


tatheti ---- 

"jvalan vai sarvadāhakaḥ"

iti yathā pūrvamuktaḥ sa tu sarvadehagataḥ, ayaṃ tu 
jihvānusārihṛdayādimūrdhāntavāgindriyadehāśrayaḥ iti viśeṣaḥ || 90 
|| 


indraḥ pāṇāvabhidhyātaḥ.............


pīta iti, arthāt || 

yenāsau ---- 


...............bāhuśālī tvajeyakaḥ | 


svārthe kan || 


pādayordūrasañcāraṃ dhyāto viṣṇuḥ prayacchati || 12-91 || 

pāyau mitraḥ sito dhyātaḥ pāyuvyādhivināśakaḥ | 

śiśne prajāpatiṃ śyāmaṃ dhyāyedyuktena cetasā || 12-92 || 

jitendriyaśca bhavati tvicchayā ramate śatam | 


pūrvabījamanuktamatra yojyam | viṣṇuḥ kṛṣṇavarṇa iti, arthāt || 


śrotrendriye diśaścitrā dhyāyed bījena saṃyutāḥ || 12-93 || 


diśo'dhiṣṭhātṛdevatāḥ | citrā nānārūpāḥ | bījaṃ prāgvat || 93 
|| 

yaśca īdṛgasau ---- 


sakṛduktaṃ ca gṛhṇāti...............


mahāntamapi śabdasandarbhamiti, arthāt || 

asya cābhisandhimātrāt ---- 


............ḍigyātrā caiva siddhyati | 


dūrataradikprāptirapi bhavati || 


mārutaṃ kṛṣṇarūpeṇa dhyāyettu tvaci saṃsthitam || 12-94 || 

yaḥ sa daṃṣṭrādyabhedyaḥ syāt.............


asya ca ---- 


.........,na kvacijjāyate vyathā | 


vajradeho jāyata iti yāvat || 


ādityaṃ cakṣuṣi dhyāyejjihvāyāṃ varuṇaṃ tathā || 12-95 || 

nāsāyāṃ pṛthikā pītāṃ manasīnduṃ tathaiva ca | 

pītakaṃ gandhatanmātraṃ rasatanmātrakaṃ sitam || 12-96 || 

raktaṃ tu rūpatanmātraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tu sparśasaṃjñitam | 

arūpaṃ śabdatanmātraṃ dhyātavyaṃ bindurūpi ca || 12-97 || 

viṣayeṣvīpsitāṃ siddhiṃ jānāti ca vicintitam | 


tanmātrāṇāṃ ghrāṇāgrādīni sthānāni caturasrādirūpaṃ ca 
śrīpūrvato jñātavyam, yathā ---- 

"pītakaṃ gandhatanmātraṃ turyāśraṃ pañcasaṃmitam | 

nāsārandhrāgragaṃ dhyāyedvajralāñchanalāñchitam ||" (14-2)

ityādi, tathā ---- 

"jalabudbudasaṅkāśaṃ jihvāyāṃ cāgrataḥ sthitam | 

cintayedrasatanmātraṃ jihvāgrādhāramātmanaḥ || 

suśītaṃ ṣaḍrasaṃ snigdhaṃ tadgatenāntarātmanā |" (14-12-13)

iti,

"ekāntastho yadā yogī vinimīlitalocanaḥ | 

śaratsandhyābhrasaṅkāśaṃ yattatkiñcitprapaśyati || 

tatra cetaḥ samādhāya yāvadāste daśāhakam | 

tāvatprapaśyate tatra bindūn sūkṣmatamānapi || 

kecittatra sitā raktā nīlāḥ pītāstathāpare | 

tān dṛṣṭvā tatra sandadhyācceto'tyantamananyadhīḥ || 

ṣaṇmāsāt paśyate teṣu rūpāṇi subahūnyapi |" (14-20-23)

tathā ---- 

ṣaṭkoṇamaṇḍalāntaḥsthamātmānaṃ paribhāvayet | 

rūkṣamañjanasaṅkāśaṃ pratyaṃśaṃ sphuritākulam || 

tato'sya daśabhirdevi divasaistvaci sarvataḥ | 

bhavet pipīlikāsparśastatastadanucintayan || 

vajradehatvamāsādya pūrvoktaṃ pūrvavallabhet |" (14-29-31)

ityādi, tathā ---- 

"karṇau pidhāya yatnena nimīlitavilocanaḥ | 

yaṃ śṛṇoti mahāghoṣaṃ cetastatrānusandhayet | 

dīpyate jāṭharo vahnistato'sya daśabhidīnaiḥ | 

dūrātkathanavijñānaṃ ṣaṇmāsādupajāyate ||" (14-33-35)

iti | bindurūpi ceti tanmātraviṣayaṃ yathāyogaṃ yojyam | 
viṣayeṣvīpsitāṃ siddhimiti cakṣurādiviṣayeṣu tathā proktadṛśā 
tanmātrādhiṣṭhitatvādindriyāṇāṃ tanmātraviṣayeṣu rūpādiṣu 
deśakālasvabhāvaviprakṛṣṭeṣūpalabdhyādikām | jānāti ca vicintitamiti 
yasya kasyacit sambandhi vicintitaṃ saṅkalpasiddhiṃ jānātītyeṣāṃ 
manodhyānasiddhiḥ || 

ahaṅkāradhāraṇāmāha ---- 


vaikārike tathā rudro dhyātavyaḥ siddhimicchatā || 12-98 || 


ataśca ---- 


dhyānāt siddhimavāpnoti muktāhaṅkārabandhanām | 


muktamahaṅkārabandhanaṃ (yasyāḥ)1 tādṛśīṃ 
parapramātraikātmyaprāptiparyavasānāmityarthaḥ | atrāpi ---- 

"ṣoḍaśāraṃ smareccakramātmanyahamananyadhīḥ | 

eṣo'hamiti sañcintya svakāryaparivāritam || 

apradhṛṣyo bhavedyogī......................... |" (mā.vi. 16-2-3)

ityādi śrīpūrvoktamanusandheyam || 

atha ---- 


brahmāṇaṃ buddhisaṃsthaṃ tu dhyāyedyuktena cetasā || 12-99 ||

dhyāne hetuḥ | atrāpi ---- 


"uditādityabimbābhaṃ hṛdi padmamanusmaret | 


dharmādibhāvasaṃyuktamaṣṭapatraṃ sakaṇīkam | " (mā.vi. 16-8)

ityādyanusartavyam || 

evaṃ dhyānavataḥ ---- 


..................jñānaughaḥ sampravartate |

bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhavad1 bhaviṣyacca pratyakṣaṃ samprajāyate | 


jñānaughādikamatra dhyeyabrahmākhyadevatārūpamiti jñātavyam || 

atha ----

101 || 

itthaṃ ca trivarṇāyāḥ ---- 


raktaṃ ca hṛdayaṃ tasyāḥ.................

eṣā ca ---- 


..................`ahupādabhujānanā | 

dhyātavyā tattvabījena yadīcchet siddhimātmanaḥ || 12-102 || 


sarvapuruṣān prati vicitraprakāśapravṛttisthitipradatvādasyā 
bahuvaktrādi (tvavam)2 | tattvasya prakṛtyākhyasyaiva yadbījaṃ 
prakrāntaprakriyayā ūkārastenaiva tattvādhiṣṭhātrī eṣā dhyeyā | 
evaṃ ca vadato'yamāśayo yatpārameśvare sarvatattvāni 
tattaddevatādhiṣṭhitānyeva, na tveṣāṃ jaḍatvamevamityatra 
devatāpradhānameva tattvadhyānamuktam | ātmanaḥ siddhiḥ prakṛtiviviktasya 
upalabdhiḥ || 102 || 

evaṃ hyātmā muktaprakṛtibandhanaḥ ---- 


siddhaścaiva svatantraśca divyadṛṣṭiśca jāyate | 


siddha iti prakṛtivivekenopalabdho'ta eva svatantraḥ, na tu prakṛtivaśaḥ, 
tathā ca divyā lokottarā svaparaviṣayā dṛṣṭiḥ samyakpratītiryasya 
tādṛgbhavati || 

yāvatā kālenaiṣā'sya siddhistadādeśāya āha ---- 


ṣaṇmāsābhyāsayogena divyā dṛṣṭiḥ pravartate || 12-103 || 


eṣa cābhyāsakālaḥ sarvatattvaviṣayo mantavyaḥ || 103 || 

taditthaṃ divyadṛṣṭyutpattau ---- 


trailokye yatpravarteta pratyakṣaṃ tasya jāyate | 


tadevaṃ devamanuṣyatiryagrūpe lokatraye yat 
sūkṣmavyavahitaviprakṛṣṭādikaṃ kiñcit pravartate prakṛtito jāyate, 
tadasya sarvaṃ pratyakṣībhavati || 

upasaṃharati ----

iti hṛdabjakaṇīkāsthaḥ ||

iti bahuvacanaikavacanayorāśayaḥ || 105 ||

puraṃ śarīram ||

dṛśyate, naivopapadyate | yathoktaṃ śrīpratyabhijñāyām ----

iti |

yataścāyaṃ na kathañcidviṣayīkriyate, ata eva ----

...............ṣūkṣmaścānantavigrahaḥ | 


ata eva vyanakti ---- 


vālāgraśatabhāgasya śatadhā kalpitasya tu || 12-108 || 

tasya sūkṣmataro jīvaḥ sa cānantyāya kalpate | 


vālasya yadagraṃ tasya yaḥ śatabhāgastasya śatadhā kalpitasyeti tamapi 
sūkṣmatayā tathā kalpyamānatvādeva vedyapadapatitamanādṛtya 
prakṛṣṭaḥ sūkṣmo jīvo yena kenāpi prakāreṇa vedyaḥ, tata eva 
citsvarūpavedakaikātmakatvādānantyāya 
deśakālākārāparicchinnatvādaśeṣaikātmyāya kalpate tadrūpatayā 
svasvātantryāt sphurati; na tu kenacit tathā kalpyata iti | kalpitatvaṃ 
kalpanotthāpitatvam, kḷptistu svayameva tathāvasthitiḥ || 

evamakalpitatvādadhyeyasyāpyasya vakṣyamāṇa- 
kañcukāviṣṭasyādūraviprakarṣeṇotprekṣyasiddhyaṅgadhyānamāha ---- 


ādityavarṇaṃ rukmābhamabbindumiva puṣkare || 12-109 || 

paśyanti tārakamiva yogino divyacakṣuṣā | 


ādityavarṇamiti tathā rukmasya hemna iva ābhā prakāśo yasyetyanena 
dīptatvamātramasyoktam, na tvākṛtimattvam; puṣkare padme'bbindumivetyanena 
śarīrādibhūmyaspaśītvam, tārakamivetyanena tu sphurattāsāratvam | 
divyacakṣuṣeti svasaṃvedanena | atra ca prātilomyena navātmasambandhī 
dvitīyo varṇo vācakatvena prakaraṇānusāraṃ yojanīyaḥ | tārakamityanena 
ca prakṛtibandhāttārakatvameva taddhyānasyoktamiti siddhirapi nidīṣṭā | 
divyacakṣuṣetyanenāpi taddhyānādyogino'śeṣaprakāśakaṃ 
cakṣudīvyamāvirbhavatīti siddhinirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ | tadevaṃ 
puryaṣṭakavaśino'syaitaddhyānam, vāstavena tu citimātrātmanā rūpeṇa 
dhyātaivāyam; na tu dhyeyaḥ | cidātmaiva ca 
sarvādhiṣṭhātṛdevatetyāśayenātmano'tra devatāntarādhiṣṭhitatvaṃ 
noktam || 


yaścāyaṃ citisvabhāvatvāt varṇarūpādirahitaḥ puruṣa uktaḥ, asau ---- 


rāgavidyākalopetaḥ kālabaddho hi rūpavān || 12-110 || 


prāṅ nirṇītarūpakalāditattvapañcakātmakakañcukāvṛta ātmā 
rūpavānityādityavarṇatvādidhyeyarūpa uktaḥ || 110 || 

atha ---- 

"prakṛtiḥ puruṣaścaiva" (5 | 11)

ityādiproktanavātmaprakriyayā niyatidhyānamāha ----

jīvasya jīvatā niyatiniyantraṇāprāṇaivetyāśayena devatetyuktam | 
niyāmakatvādeva ca śyāmā | śyāmacchāyatve'pi cāsyā 
dakṣavāmabhāgayoḥ sitāsitatvena dharmādharmotthāpakatvamuktam || 111 || 

asyāśca ---- 


tadvarṇāni ca vaktrāṇi maṇḍalāni viśeṣataḥ | 


dakṣiṇe sitāni vāme cāsitānīti vaktracatuṣṭayamapi dakṣiṇataḥ sitaṃ 
vāmato'sitam | maṇḍalānīti vaktrāṅgotthitāni prabhāmaṇḍalakāni || 

eṣā ca sitāsitarūpatvādeva puruṣam ----

tadīdṛśīmenām ----

sarvo hi tanniyantritaḥ ||

pūrvabījasahadhyānā dvirūpeṇa samanvitā || 12-113 || 


pūrvabījena prakrāntanavātmasambandhinā vakāreṇa saha dhyānaṃ 
tatparāmarśasahitaṃ cintanaṃ yasyāḥ, sā tathā

trinetraṃ ca caturvaktraṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ caturbhujam || 12-114 || 

saṃharantaṃ durādharṣamanantaṃ kālamīśvaram |

anantamanyenāparicchedyam īśvaraṃ viśvasargasaṃhāraprabhaviṣṇum | 
īdṛśaṃ kālaṃ dhyāyet || 

ataścāsya ---- 


svabījadhyānarūpajñaḥ kālena nahi kalyate || 12-115 || 


svabījaṃ navātmasambandhī lakāraḥ || 115 || 

ye tu kālavañcanāya na yatante, te ----

"jalayantrabhramāveśasadṛśībhiḥ pravṛttibhiḥ |

iti || 

yata evam, tasmāduktadevatārūpam ----

lakāravācyaṃ puṃniyatikālānāṃ siddhyaṅgadhyānamuktvā,

dhyānamāha ---- 


rāgaṃ tu raktavarṇaṃ vai vidyāṃ śyāmāṃ sulocanām |

sulocanāmiti kākākṣivat | atrāpi caturvaktracaturbhujatve 
prāgvadanusaraṇīye | kalāyā viśeṣaṇaṃ caitanyonmīlinīmiti | 
yathoktaṃ prāk ----

etacca ----

vyāmohakatvapraśamanāya māyāyā dhyānamāha ---- 


kṛṣṇavarṇā ca raktākṣī dīrghadantā sulocanā |

sarvajantuvyāmohakatvādasyā īdṛgrūpaṃ dhyānamuktam |

tattvānāṃ svarūpamātraṃ dhyānamuktamanyeṣāmākṛtimaddevatārūpatvaṃ 
taddevatādhiṣṭhitatvam, tathāpi sarvatra tattadābhāsarūpāṇāṃ 
tattvānāṃ tattaddevatādhiṣṭhitatvameva sādhviti 
tattaddevatādhiṣṭhitamūrtīnyeva sarvatattvāni dhyātavyāni || 118 || 

sarvajantuvyāmohakatvamevāsyāḥ sphuṭayatiḥ ----

pātayati svarūpācchādanapramukhaṃ saṃsārīṇi kurute ||

nirvairaparipanthitvānmāyā granthirduruttarā || 12-119 ||

śāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca sadvidyāhamidantayoḥ" (3-1-3)

iti pratyabhijñāyāṃ

ākhyaibīndusṛṣṭarekhāśṛṅgāṭakārdhacandrasanniveśairāgamokta-

pāramparyeṇādhītetyanena samastavācakavyāpi rūpamasyā uktam |

| yataścāsyāḥ pratipāditayuktyā samastavācakavyāpitvamata

anādadhyānamāha ----

|| 138 ||

jīvanmuktimāsādayate || 139 ||

ihānunmiṣitavivekaprajñaḥ sattvādiguṇabaddhaḥ

aharandharmādharmābhyāṃ badhyate | yastvīśvarārādhanāt prāptatatsāmyo

kadācit paśujanasulabhairdharmādivikalpaiḥ sparśayata iti nistraiguṇyaḥ 
pūrṇāhaṃbhāvamayo'yam | śiṣṭaṃ kāvyamātram || 143 ||

||

tadekamāha ----

evaṃ sadāśivasya bindorīdṛgrūpam | yastvīśvaratattvagataḥ, saḥ ---- 


nivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā ca vidyā śāntistathaiva ca |

ata evaikādaśabindusvarūpapratipādanāvasare ----
