sa iti citprakāśaghanaḥ paramaśivo bhāvābhāvamaye viśvasmin, trijagati 
citprakāśaikātmyena prakāśamāno'nveṣṭavyaḥ pratyabhijñeyaḥ ---- 
yathā'yaṃ saccidātmā prakāśo maheśvaraḥ, yatprakāśābhedena 
viśvamidaṃ prakāśate, prakāśabāhyasya kasyāpi prakāśanānupapatteḥ, 
yastvevaṃ viśvaprakāśātmā svaprakāśaḥ prakāśaḥ prakāśate, sa 
evāhamiti || 

evaṃvidhasya ca paratattvaikatānahṛdayasya na deśāśramādiniyamaḥ 
ko'pītyāha ---- 


yatra tatra sthito deśe yatra tatrāśrame rataḥ | 

sukhāsīnaḥ saṃyatātmā ekacittaḥ samāhitaḥ || 12-165 || 

svacchandaṃ samanusmṛtya abhāvaṃ bhāvayet sadā | 


sukhāsīno viditavedyatvāt prāṇāyāmādyāyāsarahitaḥ | 
saṃyatātmetyekacittapadena vyākhyātaḥ | samāhita iti vyutthāne'pi 
paratattvaparāmarśaniṣṭhaḥ | svacchandaṃ samanusmṛtyeti 
viśvābhāsātmacitprakāśarūpatvena vimṛśya | abhāvaṃ bhāvayediti 
citprakāśavyatiriktaṃ na kiñcidapi kadāpyastīti pratyabhijānīyāt || 

ataśca ---- 


bhāvanāttasya tattvasya tatsamaścaiva jāyate || 12-166 || 


dehāvasthāyāmapīti yāvat || 166 || 

yuktaṃ caitat, yasmāt ---- 


ye dharmāstasya cākhyātāḥ pūrvaṃ te varavaṇīni | 


sarvajñatvādayaḥ || 


taistu dharmaiḥ samāyukto yogī vai bhavati priye || 12-167 || 

svarūparūpakadhyānaṃ tattvānāṃ kathitaṃ mayā | 


svarūpaṃ kaṭhinatvādi, rūpakaṃ pītatvādi || 

ataśca ---- 


evaṃ jñātvā ca dhyātvā ca siddhyate mucyate'pi ca || 12-168 || 


siddhirapyatratyā muktiparyavasāyinyeveti śivam || 168 || 


samastatattvavibhavapūrṇasphāraprathātmakaḥ | 

cidānandaghanaḥ svātmā svacchando jayati prabhuḥ ||  || 


iti śrīsvacchandatantre 
śrīmahāmāheśvarācāryavaryaśrīkṣemarājaviracitoddyotākhyavyākhyopete
dvādaśaḥ paṭalaḥ || 12 || 




trayodaśaḥ paṭalaḥ


" svacchandodyotaḥ "


parāmṛtarasasphārasārasambodhabṛṃhitaḥ | 

sarvasampatpradaḥ śrīmān svacchando jayati prabhu || 


evamiyati dvādaśapaṭalānte'smin granthaikadeśe 
dvāviṃśatiranuṣṭhānabhedā daśītāḥ | tadyathā mātṛkābhairavaḥ, 
śrīsvacchandabhaṭṭārakaḥ kapālīśādibhairavāṣṭakaparivṛtaḥ1, 
"yastvaṃśakaviśuddhaḥ syādbhairavo'tra varānane | 

taṃ madhyamasthaṃ sampūjya tatsthāne madhyamaṃ nyaset ||" (8-25)

ityaṃśakavicāroktagranthadṛśā kapālīśādināthāḥ 
svāmyāvaraṇavaicitryeṇāvasthitā aṣṭau, navātmā pṛthak pṛthak 
padanavakabhedena navadhā, sāmudāyikasthityā ekaḥ, dvātriṃśaddevībhiḥ 
parivṛtaḥ koṭarākṣabhaṭṭārakaḥ, kevalo vā | athedānīṃ 
sakaladarśanasārabhūtaṃ trayoviṃśatitamaṃ kevalameva niṣkalanāthamayaṃ 
svacchandaṃ

śvacchandaṃ samanusmṛtya" (12-166)

iti paṭalānte paṭalasaṅgatyarthamāsūtritaṃ nirṇāyayituṃ 
śrīdevyuvāca ---- 


sāraṃ yadasya tantrasya yāgaṃ tu parameśvara | 

tamākhyāhi samāsena sādhakānāṃ hitāya vai || 13-1 || 


ijyata iti yāgaḥ sarvatantrasārabhūto niṣkalanāthaḥ, yajanaṃ 
yāgastadārādhanaprakārastaṃ dvividhaṃ kathaya || 1 || 

evaṃpraśnitaḥ śrībhairava uvāca ---- 


mūlabījākṣaraṃ mantranāyakaṃ paramīśvaram | 

praṇavāsanamārūḍhamaṅgavaktraiḥ samanvitam || 13-2 || 

pūrvoktadravyasaṅghātaiḥ pūjayet parameśvaram | 


paraṃ mūlabījātmakamakṣaraṃ catuṣkalabhaṭṭārakam | īśvaramiti 
svacchandabhairavaṃ devatārūpam | parameśvaraṃ sarvaprabhum | 
mantrāṇāmāvaraṇagatānāṃ sarveṣāṃ (nāmakaṃ =) vācakam | 
praṇavāsanādi prāgvat | aṅgairiti sarvajñatvādiparamārthaiḥ ---- 

śāntaṃ dīrghasvaraiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ" (1-71)

iti pūrvoktaiḥ, vaktraiśceti ---- 

"yādivāntānyakṣarāṇi saṃhāreṇa yutāni ca" (1-45)

iti pūrvoktaireva, na tu 
śrīkālottaroktaniṣkalābhinnaprāyavyāptikaprāsāda- 
bhaṭṭārakabuddhyasupañcakasaṃbhinnahakārātmakairiti vyākhyeyam,
"kriyādibhedabhedena tantrabhedo yataḥ smṛtaḥ | tasmāttatra yathoktaṃ 
tatkartavyaṃ nānyatantrataḥ ||" iti śruteḥ | tena 
yathoktairevāṅgavaktramantraiḥ samyagityabhedenaivānvitam, na 
tvāvaraṇasthityetyarthaḥ | ata eva śrīmadaghoreśvaryāpyabhedenaivānvitam 
| "tasya dehārdhagāṃ gaurīmutsaṅge vā prakalpayet" iti yadyapi 
śāktasphārapradhāneṣu śāstreṣu kalpitā śrutirasti, 
tathāpīhāṅgavaktramantravat śaktimatsvarūpābhinnaivāsāviti 
garbhīkṛtaśāktasphāra evāyamatratyaḥ śaktimanmantraḥ | 
pūrvoktamityanena mūtīnyāsakalānyāsādi sarvaṃ saṃgṛhītam, kevalaṃ 
sakalanyāso niṣkalanāthenaiva sakalaniṣkalavyāptinā kāryaḥ | 
bhagavatkoṭarākṣasya paścādasyoktatvāt tadvad daśabhujo'yamiti kecit, 
svacchandanāthatvādaṣṭādaśabhuja eveti guravaḥ | 
dravyasaṅghātairityanena siddhyaṅgaṃ yajanaṃ mahāsambhāreṇa kartavyamiti 
|| 

niyatapūjitasyāsya ---- 


sa eva homavinyāsaḥ.................


saṃskṛte'gnau vinyastasya bhagavataḥ śataṃ sahasraṃ 
vā'ṣṭottaramājyādinā pūrṇānto homaḥ kārya ityarthaḥ | etacca 
śivadhamīsādhakadīkṣādīkṣitasya karma ārambhaṇīyaṃ vā'nyasya || 
tasya ca ---- 


..........ḍīkṣā saiva prakītītā || 13-3 || 


saiva pūrvoktaiva || 3 || 

evaṃ pūrvoktaśivadhamīdīkṣādīkṣito bhagavatyarcātarpaṇe vidhāya ---- 


daśalakṣaṃ japedyastu ekacittaḥ samāhitaḥ | 

samudragasarittīre sahāyaiḥ parivajītaḥ || 13-4 || 

homayennaramāṃsasya lakṣamekaṃ saguggulam | 

jitendriyaikacittastu brahmacarye vyavasthitaḥ || 13-5 || 

asādhyaṃ sādhayed devi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā | 


ekatra niṣkalabhaṭṭāraka eva japyamāne cittaṃ yasya, ata eva samāhitaḥ | 
samudragā cāsau sariditi mahānadītyarthaḥ | sahāyaiḥ parivajīta iti 
yathā''rādhyo deva ekavīrastathā''rādhako'pītyarthaḥ | 

"yathā homastathā japaḥ | "

iti nītyā home'pyekacittatvādyuktam || 

kiñcāsya ---- 


yāni kānīha karmāṇi catuṣpīṭhasthitāni ca || 13-6 || 

adhamānyatha madhyāni hyuttamāni varānane | 

tāni siddhyanti deveśi bhairavasya vaco yathā || 13-7 || 


vidyā(ta)1ntrāṇāṃ pīṭhacatuṣṭayātmani pārameśe śāstre yāni 
karmāṇi kāryāṇīha jagati 
pātālākāśatattvatattveśvaravyāptihetubhūtānyadhamādirūpāṇi 
sthitāni, tāni kṛtapūrvasevasya yoginaḥ siddhyantīti yojyam; na tu 
kuhakavādyādīnyadhamamadhyamādirūpāṇīti vyākhyeyam,

"kṛtānyapi hi karmāṇi siddhyanti japalakṣataḥ" (6-57)

iti pūrvaṃ parimitapūrvasevāsādhyatvenaiṣāṃ coditatvāt | bhairavasya 
vaco yathetyanena nātra māyāpramātṛsulabhaḥ saṃśayo grāhya ityādiśati 
|| 7 || 

athedānīṃ mukhyasiddhisādhanaparasyāpyasya sādhakasya kvacit kvacidavasare 
upayogīni prakṛtyādivaśyāni karmāṇi 
dravyamantrayuktisādhyānyāryādivṛttāntarairādeṣṭumāha ---- 


athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi kārikākośamuttamam | 

yaṃ jñātvā devadeveśi vicarantīha sādhakāḥ || 13-8 || 


śvalpābhidhānenārtho yaḥ samāsenocyate budhaiḥ | 

sūtrataḥ sānusartavyā kārikārthopadaśīnī ||"

iti lakṣitānāṃ kārikāṇāṃ kośaṃ samūham | uttamamiti 
vīraviṣayatvādavighnaphalaviṣayamityarthaḥ | ata eva vicarantīti 
karatalaprāptasarvasiddhikā yathāruci vilasantītyarthaḥ || 8 || 

tatra ---- 


abhimukhakhaḍganipātitaśūraśiraḥ śoṣitaṃ samādāya | 

raktālaktakalikhitaṃ sādhyatanau mantrayuktamabhidhānam || 13-9 || 

pretānale sutaptaṃ vidhāya niśi yatkṛte śataṃ japati | 

asurendracakravatīnamasurendraguruṃ vā tamānayatyanilavegāt || 13-10 || 


śiraḥ kapālam, śoṣitaṃ nirmāṃsīkṛtam, raktena pretasambandhinā 
sahitamalaktakaṃ raktālaktakaṃ tena likhitam, mantrayuktamiti 
tadvidabhītamiti pañcamaprayoge ---- 

"mantravidabhīta" (13-16)

ityukteḥ, jñātaṃ tacca lalāṭe lekhyam | yadvakṣyati saptame prayoge ---- 

ṅāma ca tasya lalāṭe" (13-20) iti,

abhidhānaṃ sādhyanāma (ānaya)1 ityūhāntaṃ sādhyatanāveva 
taddravyollikhite sādhyadehe pretāgnau niśi suṣṭhu taptaṃ vidhāya yasya 
sādhakasya kṛte taddigabhimukhaṃ yathālikhitaṃ śataṃ japati, taṃ 
sādhyaṃ yathāviniyogāya vāyuvegādityatiśīghramānayati || 10 || 


pretālaktakalikhitaṃ naraśirasi pretavahnisantaptam | 

yamalokādapyacirādānayati balena pūrvavat sādhyam || 13-11 || 


pūrvavat sādhyaṃ mantrayutaṃ sādhyanāma śataṃ japatītyanuvartate | 
pretālaktakaṃ pretaśarīrotthaṃ raktam | naraśirasītyaśūrasambandhini | 
apīti pūrvasmādviśeṣaḥ || 11 || 


mṛtanāryā vāmapadādudbaddhāyāstu pāṃsulīṃ samādāya | 

rudhirālaktakarocanayā sādhyatanuṃ mantrasaṃyuktām || 13-12 || 

khadirānale sutaptāṃ rātryardhe sammukho japaśatena | 

ānayati śacīmahalyāmathavā divasasya śatabhāgāt || 13-13 || 


saṃyuktāmityante likhitāmiti yojyaṃ sutaptāmityatra kṛtveti | rocanā iha 
narasatkā | pāṃsulī pāṣṇīkāsthītyanye | divasasya śatabhāgeti 
sūkṣmaḥ kālaḥ || 13 || 


udbaddhastrītanuvāmāṃghreḥ pāṃsulīṃ samādāya | 

pretālaktakanijarudhirarocanābhivīlikhya sādhyatanum || 13-14 || 

pretānale sutaptāṃ śatābhijaptāṃ svanāmamantrayutām | 

kṛtvā yakṣasurāsurapannaganārīḥ samānayatyāśu || 13-15 || 


pūrvaṃ pretaraktam, iha tu nijaraktamiti viśeṣaḥ || 


nijavāmakare'laktakarocanayā sādhyanāma parilikhitam | 

mantravidabhītametajjapaśatayuktaṃ sutāpitaṃ rātrau || 13-16 || 

khadirānale vidhūme'suragurumapyānayatyanilavegāt | 


vidabhītaṃ nāmno'nte | mantravinyāsaḥ pūrvameva daśītaḥ || 


sādhyamabhidhānalikhitaṃ bhūmitale gairikeṇa raktena || 13-17 || 

gandhodvatītavāmahastena tu tattvabījayuktena | 

ākramya bhūmilikhitaṃ sādhyābhimukho'rdharātrakāle tu || 13-18 || 

kṣitipatimapi sāmātyaṃ cānayati nimeṣaśatabhāgāt | 


abhidhānadvāreṇa prāgvad mantravidabhītena likhitaṃ kṛtvā | gairikaṃ 
hiṅgulakam | raktena pretotthenaiva | ata eva bhūmitalametat śmāśānikam | 
atra ca prākaraṇikaḥ śatajāpayogaḥ sthita eva || 


nṛkapālamadhyalikhitaṃ rocanayā raktamiśrayā sādhyam || 13-19 || 

nāma ca tasya lalāṭe mantreṇa vidabhītaṃ samālikhya | 

gandhodakena liptaṃ nṛkapālaṃ vai dvitīyamādāya || 13-20 || 

kṛtvā kapālasampuṭamatha mṛtasūtreṇa veṣṭayet samyak | 

khadirāṅgārasutaptaṃ sikthakaliptaṃ tu tatpunaḥ kṛtvā || 13-21 || 

yāvat sikthakametat kapālalagnaṃ vilīyate tāvat | 

surapatimapyākarṣati japaśatayogānnimeṣamātreṇa || 13-22 || 


mṛtasūtreṇa vakṣyamāṇachummakāyuktyā mṛtasnāyunā | japo'tra 
rātrāveveti sthitameva || 22 || 


bhittau gairikalikhitaṃ mantrārṇavidabhītaṃ tadabhidhānam | 

sādhyābhimukho rātrau vāmakarākrāntamatha japan kruddhaḥ || 13-23 || 

kroṅkārāṅkuśayogādānayati surāsurān kṣipram | 


bhittāviti śmāśānikyām | tadabhidhānamityānayanepsitasurāsuranāma | 
kroṅkārāṅkuśayogādityaṅkuśākāralikhitakroṅkāravāmakarākrāntivaśa
adityarthaḥ || 


raṇaśastraghātapatitaṃ narapiśitaṃ trimadhusaṃyutaṃ juhuyāt || 13-24 || 

viparītacakramudrāṃ baddhvā sādhyaṃ tu nikṣipenmadhye | 

sampīḍitakarasampuṭavihvalavaktraṃ karāntare dhyātvā || 13-25 || 

ānayati mahāpuruṣaṃ kṣitipatimapi divasaśatabhāgāt | 


"bhrameṇāṅgulikābhyāṃ syāccakraṃ duṣṭavikartanam |"

iti prasāritāṅgulikottānavāmopariniviṣṭadakṣahastasya 
prasāritāṅgulikasya talasaṅgharṣeṇa, 
vāmakanīyasīpārśvaprāptadakṣatarjanyā bhramaṇād yā 
cakramudrā''gameṣu sthitā, tāṃ viparītāmiti vāmakanīyasīpārśvād 
dakṣiṇasyāntaḥpraveśena baddhvā tanmadhyagataṃ sādhyaṃ 
karapīḍanavihvalībhūtaṃ dhyātvā mantravidabhītaṃ sādhyanāma 
śatasaṃkhyayā japtvā proktadravyeṇa niśi homaṃ kurvannṛpatimapi 
vidheyīkarotītyarthaḥ | rātrau śmaśāne japahomādi prākaraṇikamatra 
sthitameva || 


śitaśastrapātarahitadhvajanaraśīrṣaṃ pragṛhya lakṣmayutam || 13-26 || 

tatra trirūpagaditaṃ dhāma likhitvābhipūjayedyastu | 

tasya haripavanakamalajadhanadayamendrāḥ sasiddhagandharvāḥ || 13-27 || 

vividhavarasiddhijātaṃ vidadhati vicitrāstathāparāḥ siddhīḥ | 


ādau śastreṇa akṣato yo dhvaje narastasya śīrṣaṃ 
śūlāropitapuruṣakapālam | tatra prāgvat śoṣite 
trirūpagaditamityākṛtimanmukhaliṅgarūpamavyaktaliṅgākṛti dhāma 
mūlamantravācyaṃ daivataṃ likhitvotkīrtya yo nityamarcati, asau 
lokapālānapi vaśīkuryāt || 

etadeva bhaḍgyā sphuṭayati ślokadvayena ---- 


vyaktāvyaktaṃ tathā vyaktamavyaktaṃ tu trirūpakam || 13-28 || 

dhāma cārādhayet samyak tatra yastu vicakṣaṇaḥ | 

jāyate trividhā siddhigīrirājatanūdbhave || 13-29 || 

suniścitamateḥ samyag girirājasya tasya vai | 


tatreti triśūlāropitanarakapāle | girirājasyeti 
vakṣyamāṇachummakādṛṣṭyā sādhakendrasya || 

atra dravyaviśeṣahomasādhyaṃ vaśīkāramāha ---- 


raktacandanadhūliṃ tu rājikāṃ lavaṇaṃ tathā || 13-30 || 

pādadhūliṃ tu sādhyasya ekīkṛtya tu peṣayet | 

japan svacchandadevaṃ tu nirmathnaṃśca karadvayam || 13-31 || 

citāgnau juhuyāccūrṇaṃ cāṇḍālāgnāvathāpi vā | 

sādhyasyābhimukho bhūtvā prayogamimamācaret || 13-32 || 

śatamekaṃ japedyāvattāvadākarṣayennṛpam | 


pādadhūliḥ puṃso dakṣiṇāt pādāt, nāryā vāmād gṛhītavyā | 
praṇavaṃ niṣkalanāthaṃ namo'ntamuccārya "amuko meṃ vaśībhavatu 
svāhā" ityūhānto mantro jape home ca prayoktavyaḥ || 

vaśamākṛṣṭaścāsau sādhakasya ---- 


vaśamāyāti bhūnātha ātmanā ca dhanena ca || 13-33 || 


nātra saṃśayaḥ kārya ityāha ---- 


siddha eṣa prayogastu nānyathā te vadāmyaham | 


evaṃ vaśīkṛtau prayogadaśakamuttamādisiddhyarthaṃ ca prayogamuktvā, 
stambhane prayogamāha ---- 


tāmeva dhūliṃ saṃgṛhya lohacūrṇavimiśritām || 13-34 || 

śmaśānacīrake baddhvā śa1tajaptāṃ catuṣpathe | 

nikhanyāṣṭāṅgulaṃ bhūmau ripunāmasamanvitām || 13-35 || 

nikṣipedyasya nāmnā tāṃ sa kṣaṇāt stambhito bhavet | 


śmaśānacīrake śavavastrakhaṇḍe | śatajaptāmityamukaṃ 
stambhayetyūhabhājā nidīṣṭamantreṇa || 

unmāde prayogamāha ---- 


tāmeva dhūliṃ saṃgṛhya pañcakonmattasaṃyutām || 13-36 || 

baddhvā tāṃ pretavastreṇa ripunāmasamanvitām | 

śatajaptāṃ tu tāṃ kṛtvā śmaśāne nikhaned drutam || 13-37 || 

bhavatyunmattakaḥ sādhyaḥ............


pañcavidhamunmattakaṃ mūlakāṇḍapatrapuṣpaphalākhyāvayavapañcakayuktaṃ 
dhattūrakam | atrāpyamukamunmādayetyūhaḥ kāryaḥ || 

asya pratyānayanamāha ---- 


...............uddhṛtāyāṃ tu mucyate | 


nivṛttonmādo bhavati || 

kathamityāha ---- 


uddhṛtaṃ vastramādāya kṣīreṇa pariśodhayet || 13-38 || 

pratyānayanametaddhi siddhameva na saṃśayaḥ | 


uddhṛtaṃ śmaśānabhavanādākṛṣṭam || 

punarapyākarṣaṇe prayogāntaramāha ---- 


atha raktāśvamārasya kusumāni samāharet || 13-39 || 

śatamaṣṭottaraṃ teṣāṃ śatajaptaṃ tu kārayet | 

sakṛjjaptena puṣpeṇa liṅgamūrdhani tāḍayet || 13-40 || 

evaṃ dine dine kuryād daśāhaṃ susamāhitaḥ | 


raktāśvamārasya lohitakaravīrasya proktetikartavyatākāni puṣpāṇi 
pratyahaṃ gṛhītvā pṛthak pṛthak surakṣitāni sthāpayet || 


tatastvekādaśaitāni saṃgṛhya kusumāni tu || 13-41 || 

mahānadīṃ tato gatvā tatraikaikaṃ pravāhayet | 

ānupūrvyeṇa sarvāṇi sakṛjjaptvā tu mantravit || 13-42 || 


prathamadinapuṣpāṇāmādau pravāhaṇam, tato 
dvitīyādidinapuṣpāṇāmityānupūrvyārthaḥ || 42 || 


yatteṣāṃ paścimaṃ puṣpaṃ pratisrotaḥ prayāti hi | 


ūrdhvaṃ vahatītyarthaḥ || 


tad gṛhītvāmbusaṃmiśraṃ dantairaspṛṣṭamāpibet || 13-43 || 


pītajalaṃ kuryāt || 43 || 


tato'śvamārakusumaṃ raktaṃ vai śatamantritam | 

tarjanyagre tu tat kṛtvā aṅguṣṭhenākramed budhaḥ || 13-44 || 


dakṣiṇena || 44 || 

atha ---- 


bhrāmayet savyataḥ puṣpaṃ yasya nāmnā tu mantravit | 

svacchandaṃ japamānastu tamākarṣayate drutam || 13-45 || 


savyata iti dakṣiṇe pārśve | atrāpyamukamākarṣayeti prayogaḥ || 45 || 

ākṛṣṭasya visarjane prayogamāha ---- 


apasavyaṃ bhrāmayitvā punastasya visarjanam | 


apasavyaṃ vāmapārśve tadaśvamārapuṣpaṃ bhrāmayan sādhakasya 
yathopayogaṃ viniyuktasya visarjanaṃ karotīti śivam || 


svātantryaśaktyā parayā nānāścaryapradarśakaḥ | 

jayatyanugrahakaraḥ svacchandaḥ parabhairavaḥ ||  || 


iti śrīsvacchandatantre 
śrīmahāmāheśvarācāryavaryaśrīkṣemarājaviracitoddyotākhyavyākhyopete
trayodaśaḥ paṭalaḥ || 13 || 





caturdaśaḥ paṭalaḥ


" svacchandodyotaḥ "


mocayati pāśajālād drāvayati bhidaṃ mudaṃ rāti | 

mudrayati vighnataskaraluṇṭhanato mantrasiddhisaṅghātam || 

tattatsaṃvitsphārānanukṛtirūpān vyanakti yā śambhoḥ | 

ākṛtirūpā mudrā jayati vibhorarcanādinirvartyā || 

trayodaśabhiḥ paṭalaiḥ 
samayyādicatuṣṭayanirvartyanityanaimittikakāmyakarma sampūrṇamuditam | 
tatra rakṣāsannidhitadanupraveśādiprayojanaṃ

"mudrāṃ pradarśayet paścāttridhā traikālyakarmaṇi" (2-102)

iti yat pūrvaṃ kāyavāṅmanonirvartyamudrāsvarūpamuktam, tad vivakṣuḥ 
śrībhairava uvāca ---- 


mudrāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye asmiṃstantre yathāsthitam | 


asmiṃstantre proktaprayojanā bhagavadāyudhānukārarūpā yā mudrāḥ, 
tāsāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tattvavyavasthāpakaṃ rūpaṃ vakṣyāmīti pratijānāti 
|| 

atra yadyapi ---- 

"khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇam" (2-90)

iti āyudhakrama uktaḥ, tathāpi ---- 

"kapālaṃ caiva khaṭvāṅgamanukteṣu prayojayet" (14-21)

iti bhāvinītyā kapālakhaṭvāṅgayoḥ 
sarvāvaraṇagatadevatāsādhāraṇatvāt śrīkoṭarākṣabhaṭṭārakaviṣaye 
ca tayoḥ prādhānyādādau tanmudrālakṣaṇamāha ---- 


uttānamañjaliṃ kṛtvā kapālaṃ parikītītam || 14-1 || 


eṣā ca viśvasamāharaṇapravṛttasaṃvitsvarūpānukāriṇī | yaduktaṃ 
mayaiva śrībhairavānukaraṇastotre ---- 

"śāktāṇḍakhaṇḍamadhye viśvarasamevamahaṃ samāharāmi sadā | 

vyañjayasi karakapālagarudhiramiṣādetadiva me'ntaḥ ||" iti | 

yadyapi ---- 

"muṇḍakhaṭvāṅgadhāriṇam" (2-91)

iti pūrvaṃ paṭhitam, tathāpīha kapālamudroktermuṇḍasthāne kadācit 
kapālaṃ bhavatītyādiśati | muṇḍamudrāpi khaḍgavad muṣṭidarśaṃ 
darśanīyā || 1 || 


tiryakkṛtvā karaṃ vāmaṃ kaniṣṭhādyaṅgulitrayam | 

aṅguṣṭhenākramed devi ṛjkā kṛtvā pradeśinīm || 14-2 || 

parāṅmukhaṃ karaṃ kṛtvā skandhadeśe niveśayet | 

khaṭvāṅgaṃ kītītaṃ hyetat..............


vāmamitinirdeśāt kapālamudrā dakṣiṇena nirdeśyeti dhvanati | tathā
ca śrīmālinīvijaye ---- 

ṅimnaṃ pāṇitalaṃ dakṣamīṣattatkuñcitāṅguli | 

kapālamiti vijñeyam..................... ||" (7-23) iti | 

aṅgulitrayamiti muṣṭisaṃniveśena sthitamityarthāt | parāṅmukhamiti 
skandhāpekṣayā | etanmudrāsatattvamapi tatraiva stotre pradaśītam ---- 

ṅiḥśeṣāhṛtasārā mayyeva jagatsthitistadeiamaye | 

iti khaṭvāṅgakaraṅkodvahanacchalato dadāsyājñām ||" iti || 

atha ---- 


................khaḍgamudrāṃ nibodha me || 3 || 

aṅguṣṭhenākramed devi sakaniṣṭhāmanāmikām | 

madhyamāṃ tarjanīṃ cordhvaṃ khaḍgamudrā prakītītā || 14-4 || 


skandhakṣetre parāṅmukhadakṣakarapradarśanīyā eṣā | kṛtveti śeṣaḥ | 
yaduktaṃ tatraiva ---- 

"antaḥśaktikṛpāṇīṃ vyanakṣi saṃsṛtivibhedinīmasinā | 

nijaśaktimahimasvīkṛtasamastaviśvā hi vīravarāḥ ||" 

iti || 4 || 


muṣṭiṃ baddhvā kaniṣṭhāṃ ca prasāryeta varānane | 

ātmanaḥ sammukhaṃ kṛtvā spharaste kathito mayā || 14-5 || 


kṛtveti vāmahastamityarthāt | sphara iti sphara ityucyamānam | uktaṃ ca 
tatraiva ---- 

"bhavabhayahartā so'haṃ spharākhyo'vasthito'smi mā bhaiṣṭa | 

ityāsphoṭitakheṭakadarśanato diśasi naḥ svāmin ||" 

iti || 5 || 


muṣṭiṃ baddhvā deveśi tarjanyūrdhvaṃ tu kuñcayet | 

aṅkuśaḥ kathito hyeṣa...........


dakṣiṇapāṇiṃ nirvartya | uktaṃ ca tatraiva ---- 

"bhedamayamakhilametannijaśaktyaivākṣipāmi saṃhartum | 

ityaṅkuśadhāraṇataḥ sphuṭayati parabhairavo'smākam ||" 

iti || 


atha vāmapāṇinā pradarśyām ---- 


..............pāśamudrāṃ nibodha me || 14-6 || 


tarjanīṃ vartulāṃ kṛtvā mūle'ṅguṣṭhasya yojayet | 

pāśastu kathito hyeṣa duṣṭajālanibandhakaḥ || 7 || 


aṅguṣṭhasyeti tatsthāne muṣṭyākṛtivāmasambandhinaḥ | duṣṭajālaṃ 
vighnasamūhaḥ | asyāpi tatraiva tattvaṃ pradaśītam ---- 

ṅijaśaktipāśavalitaścidbhasmanā kalyate mahākālaḥ | 

iti pāśadhāraṇavaśāt prathayānaḥ kālakālastvam ||" iti || 7 || 


muṣṭiṃ baddhvā varārohe samprasārya pradeśinīm | 

nārācastu samākhyātaḥ samāsāttava bhairavi || 14-8 || 


samprasāryeti dhanurārūḍhanārācavat pārśvasthityetyarthaḥ | asyāpi 
samanantaravakṣyamāṇapinākamudrāsahitasya tatraiva svarūpaṃ nirṇītam --
-- 

"kodaṇḍārūḍhaśarapradarśanād brahmāviṣṇurudreśān | 

sasadāśivakāraṇahariṇān śaktyā bhinatsi yugapattvam ||" 

iti || 14-8 || 


muṣṭiṃ baddhvā prasāryeta tarjanyaṅguṣṭhakaṃ priye | 

agre nikuñcayet kiñcit pinākaṃ parikītītam || 14-9 || 


pinākaṃ dhanuḥ | agre kiñcidākuñcanād dhanurākāra eva sanniveśo 
bhavati | asyāpi satattvamuktameva || 9 || 


agraprasārito hastaḥ śliṣṭaśākho varānane | 

parāṅmukhaṃ tu taṃ kṛtvā tvabhayaḥ parikītītaḥ || 14-10 || 


patākahasto dakṣiṇaḥ svaśarīraparāṅmukha utthita ityarthaḥ | uktaṃ ca 
tatraiva ---- 

"abhayena ca bhayānyunmūlatayā prakāśyate satatam | 

viśvānugrahakaraṇasvabhāvatā tava karaṇa tena ||" 

iti || 10 || 


vāmaṃ bhujaṃ prasāryaiva jānūpari niveśayet | 

prasṛtaṃ darśayed devi varaḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ || 14-11 || 


uktaṃ ca tatra ---- 

"varadena pāṇinā tvaṃ viśvavibhūtipradatvamabhinayasi | 

na khalu paratattvaniṣṭho vittamalaiḥ spṛśyate jātu ||" 

iti || 14-11 || 


ghaṇṭākāraṃ karaṃ vāmaṃ kṛtvā caiva tvadhomukham | 

dakṣahastasya tarjanyā ghṛṣed ghaṇṭā prakītītā || 14-12 || 


asyāpi vakṣyamāṇavīṇāḍamarumudrābhyāṃ saha tatraiva satattvaṃ 
daśītam ---- 

"vīṇāghaṇṭāḍamarūnuḍḍāmaradarśayannidaṃ diśasi | 

vṛttitribhedabhinnaṃ nādāmarśaṃ nibhālayannantaḥ ||" 

iti || 12 || 


kaniṣṭhikāṃ samākrāmedaṅguṣṭhena samāhitaḥ | 

prasārya cāṅgulīstisrastriśūlaṃ parikītītam || 14-13 || 


samāhita iti | tattatsaṃvitsphārātmakavīryasāratāṃ 
sarvamudrāṇāmanusandadhītetyanenādiśati | vīryaṃ cāsya tatraiva 
daśītam ---- 

"jvaladicchādikaśaktitritayāṃ tāṃ sundarāṃ parāṃ śaktim | 

devānukaroṣi bahistriśūladhāraṇamiṣeṇa nityamapi ||" iti | 

eṣā ca parāṅmukhī janmādhārāt prollasacchikhiśikhārūpā 
bindvantametyārātrayollāsena dvādaśānte prāptasthitinībandhanīyeti 
guravaḥ || 13 || 


daṇḍo vai muṣṭibandhena..............


anukārya iti śeṣaḥ | uktaṃ ca stotre ---- 

"jagadakhilaṃ macchaktyā damitaṃ sarvā vyavasthitīrdhatte | 

iti daṇḍadhāraṇavaśād vyanakti cidbhairavo'smākam ||" iti | 

guravastu ---- 

"daṇḍākhyāmṛṣṭasauṣumnanāḍīpathavirājitā |" iti || 


.................vajramudrāṃ nibodha me | 

vāmahastamadhaḥ kṛtvā uttānaṃ tu samāhitaḥ || 14 || 


dakṣaṃ cādhomukhaṃ kṛtvā tvaṅguṣṭhaṃ ca kaniṣṭhikām | 

ubhayorapi saṅghṛṣya vajramudrāṃ pradarśayet || 15 || 


uttānamiti viralaṃ prasāritatarjanīmadhyānāmikaṃ dakṣaṃ ca 
tādṛśameva tadupari parāṅmukhaṃ nyastamubhayoḥ 
parasparamaṅguṣṭhakaniṣṭhikābandhanena pārśvakṛtakūrparavinyāsena 
pārśvasanniviṣṭatāmasyāḥ sūcayati | vīryaṃ ca tatraiva daśītam ---- 

"icchādikanijaśaktiprakāśitādhaḥsthagocaratritayām | 

svāmeva parāṃ śaktiṃ vajramayīṃ vahasi ṣaḍarāṃ tvam ||" iti | 

guravo'pi ---- 


vajramudrā bandhakatrīṃ susthitiḥ svastikāyate" iti || 14-15 || 

ḍamaruṃ muṣṭibandhena dakṣahastasya suvrate | 

suṣireṇa samāyuktaṃ darśayettu varānane || 16 || 


tattvamasyāḥ pradaśītameva || 16 || 


mudgaraṃ tu pravakṣyāmi hastau dvau samprasārayet | 

mudgaraḥ kathito hyeṣa..............


samprasārayediti sammukhau prasārayet parasparasaṃlagnāvityarthāt | asyā 
api paraśumudrayā saha tatraiva tattvaṃ daśītam ---- 

"mudgaraparaśū bibhrad baindavanādānukārarūpau tvam | 

bhedavibhedanaśakalanaparatvamīśāna nidīśasi ||" iti | 

guravo'pi ---- 

"gāḍhagranthigaṇāsphoṭo mudgareṇa pravartate |" iti | 

śrīpūrvaśāstre tu mudgaramudrā triśikhā daśītā | tathā ca ---- 

"karāvūrdhvamukhau kāryāvanyonyāntaritāṅguli | 

anāme madhyapṛṣṭhasthe tarjanyau mūlaparvataḥ || 

madhye dve tu yute kārye kaniṣṭhe paruṣāvadhi | 

tarjanyau madhyapārśvasthe virale parikalpite || 

mudgarastriśikho hyeṣa kṣaṇādevopakārakaḥ |" (7-27-29) iti

atha ---- 


.........vallakīṃ ca nibodha me || 14-17 || 


vallakīṃ vīṇām || 17 || 


hastau prasārayed devi uttānau tu samāhitaḥ | 

anāme kuñcayitvā tu vīṇāmudrā prakītītā || 14-18 || 


kubjāvīṇāviṣayā | eṣā vāmapārśve pradarśanīyā | asyāḥ satattvaṃ 
daśītameva || 18 || 


prasārayedaṅgulīstu kaniṣṭhānāmamadhyamāḥ | 

aṅguṣṭhenākramedādyāṃ paraśuḥ samudāhṛtaḥ || 14-19 || 


svaparāṅmukhena dakṣahastena skandhadeśe pradarśanīyo'yam | 
tattvamasyāḥ pūrvameva daśītam | etāśca mudrā guptāḥ 
pradarśanīyāḥ, agupte tvāyatanādau vastrācchāditāḥ, athavā smartavyā 
eveti guravaḥ | kecidatra paraśumudrāsthāne ---- 

"bhrāmayedaṅgule dve tu cakraṃ duṣṭanikṛntanam"

iti paṭhanti | anyaistvetatprasaṅgāt śaṅkhapadmamudrālakṣaṇamapi 
kṣiptam, aparaistu paraśulakṣaṇam ---- 

"rājāvartanibho devi mudgaraḥ paraśustathā |"

ityetadanantaraṃ paṭhitam | tat 
sarvamupakramopasaṃhārānurūpatvādupekṣyam | evaṃ ca prāyaśo 
granthāntaraprakṣepo granthaviparyāsaḥ pāṭhaviparyāsaścāsya granthasya 
durbhedhobhiḥ parikalpitaḥ śataśākho dṛśyate | so'smābhiḥ 
purātanapustakānveṣaṇato yāvadgati apasārita ityāstāmetat || 19 || 

etadupasaṃharan prakṛte yojayati ---- 


etā mudrā mahādevi bhairavasya pradarśayet | 

āvāhane nirodhe ca tathā caiva visarjane || 14-20 || 


etā ityupasaṃhārāt kaḥ paraśumudrāyāḥ paro granthe'vasaro 
bhairavasyoktaḥ, kaścakrapadmādimudrāṇāmavakāśo dhyānagranthe 
teṣāmanuddeśāditi yathāpaṭhitameva sādhu | āvāhanetyādinā ---- 

"mudrāṃ pradarśayet paścāttridhā traikālyakarmaṇi | " (2-102)

iti pūrvoktameva nirvāhitam || 20 || 

atha ye vaktrāṅgabhairavādyā āvaraṇasthāḥ, teṣāṃ sādhāraṇaṃ 
mudrābandhaṃ pradarśayati ---- 


kapālaṃ caiva khaṭvāṅgamanukteṣu pradarśayet | 


sarveṣāṃ jñānakriyāśaktisphārasāratvād mudrāṇāṃ sanniveśamuktvā 
yathaucityamāsāṃ mānasaṃ rūpamāha ---- 


kapālaṃ dhavalaṃ jñeyaṃ khaṭvāṅgaṃ ca tathaiva hi || 14-21 || 

triśūlaṃ caiva nārācaṃ khaḍgo nīlotpalaprabhaḥ | 

spharaṃ raktaṃ pinākaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ samparikītītam || 14-22 || 

ghaṇṭā hemaprabhā jñeyāṅkuśo marakataprabhaḥ | 

pāśo bhinnāñjananibhaḥ sphaṭikābho'bhayaḥ smṛtaḥ || 14-23 || 

varaścittaprasādena dhyātavyo varavaṇīni | 

ḍamaruṃ hemasaṅkāśaṃ vīṇāṃ caitatsamaprabhām || 14-24 || 

daṇḍaṃ raktaṃ vijānīyādvajraṃ pītaṃ vicintayet | 

rājāvartanibho devi mudgaraḥ paraśustathā || 14-25 || 


cittaprasādeneti prasādaścittatulyo'nupādhisaṃvitprakāśarūpa iti yāvat 
|| 25 || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


mudrāpīṭhaṃ samākhyātaṃ caturvargaphalodayam | 


na kevalaṃ pūrvanidīṣṭanītyedaṃ tantraṃ 
vidyāmantramaṇḍalapīṭharūpaṃ yāvadiha mudrāśrayatayā 
mudrāpīṭharūpamapi | caturvargasya samayyādicatuṣṭayasya 
rakṣāsannidhitattvānupraveśahetutvāt phalodayo yataḥ | etat ---- 

"catuṣpīṭhaṃ mahātantraṃ caturvargaphalodayam" (1-5)

ityasya granthasya nigamanarūpam || 

evaṃ mudrāṇāṃ kāyīyaṃ mānasaṃ ca rūpamuktvā, vācikamapyāha ---- 


praṇavāsanamārūḍhā oṃkārādyā varānane || 14-26 || 

svanāmakṛtavinyāsā namaskārāvasānikāḥ | 


bhagavacchaktirūpāṇāṃ mudrāṇāṃ svarūpaṃ vimṛśet || 

evaṃ sanniveśabandhadhyānamantraparāmarśasphuṭīkṛtā etā 
vighnatrāṇabhagavatsvarūpasannidhānatadanupraveśanādirūpāṇi ---- 


sādhayanti mahādevi phalāni vividhāni tu || 14-27 || 


devyā mahatpadena viśeṣaṇena mudrāvīryajñatāṃ prakāśayanmudrāṇāṃ 
vīryameva sārabhūtamiti śikṣayati || 27 || 

pāṭalikaṃ prameyamupasaṃharati ---- 


nivīghnakaraṇaṃ khyātaṃ mudrāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ priye | 

veditavyaṃ prayatnena sādhitavyaṃ mahātmanā || 14-28 || 


yadyapi bhagavatsannidhānatadanupraveśādau vighnavyudāsārthaṃ 
samayyādibhirapyetanmudrālakṣaṇaṃ jñātavyam, tathāpi sādhakena 
viśeṣato jñātavyam, mudrābandharakṣitasyaivāsya sādhyasiddheḥ | 
yathoktaṃ pūrvaśāstre ---- 

"yābhistu rakṣito mantrī mantrasiddhimavāpnuyāt" (7-1)

iti śivam || 28 || 


svāvaṣṭambhavaśonmiṣannijamahāmantrāvamarśasphurat
svacchandasphuraṇāmayāḥ paratarasphārāmṛtasyandinaḥ | 

udyantyeva tanāvakṛtrimatayā drāgeva mudrākramā
yasya troṭati pāśakuñjarabharaḥ pāyāt sa ekaḥ śivaḥ ||  || 


iti śrīsvacchandatantre 
śrīmahāmāheśvarācāryavaryaśrīkṣemarājaviracitoddyotākhyavyākhyopete
mudrāprakāśaḥ nāma caturdaśaḥ paṭalaḥ || 14 || 





pañcadaśaḥ paṭalaḥ


" svacchandodyotaḥ "

(karttā sarvasya lokasya dharttā harttā sahaiva ca | 

ādhāraḥ)svātmaviśrānteḥ svacchando jayati prabhuḥ || 


atha samayimadhye samayināṃ tāntrikavyavahāragopanena 
nivīghnasiddhisampattyarthaṃ prākprameyaśeṣatayā 
paṭalamārabhamāṇaśchummakāśarmaparyāya- 
pāribhāṣikasaṃjñābhirlokottaravyavahārapravartanena gūḍhatayā 
śāstrasyāsya rahasyatāṃ darśayituṃ śrībhairava uvāca ---- 


japadhyānādiyuktasya caryāvratadharasya ca | 

chummakāḥ sampravakṣyāmi sādhakasya varānane || 15-1 || 


chummakā tatsamayānupraviṣṭasañcityā pāribhāṣikī saṃjñā | 
sādhakasyeti prācuryāśrayeṇa || 1 || 

tatra ---- 


bhairavastu smṛto dhāma sarvadastu guruḥ smṛtaḥ | 

sādhakastu girirjñeyaḥ putrako vimalaḥ smṛtaḥ || 15-2 || 


ārādhyadevatāyāḥ paramopādeyatvāt tadupakrameyamuktiḥ | dhāmeti 
sūryasomavahnitejasāmapi prakāśakatvād viśvaviśrāntisthānakatvācca 
dhāma | sarvada iti svātmani paripūrṇatayā nirākāṅkṣasya guroḥ 
parārthaikaprayojanatvāt | girirityaprakampyatvādārādhanaikatatparaḥ | 
vimala iti sarvasyā''ntarabhūmeḥ saṃśodhanād vigatamalaḥ | smṛta 
ityavicchedena pāramparyeṇa | evamuttaratra || 2 || 


samayī kāntadehastu bhaginyo baladapītāḥ | 


kāntadeha iti kāntaḥ śuddhavidyānupraveśena dīptimān deho yasya | 
mantrasiddhiphalena yāḥ sañjātadarpā nāryastā bhaginya iva 
mantrārādhananiṣṭhānāmiti tathoktāḥ || 

sarveṣāmeṣāṃ yāgopayogidravyaviśeṣaviṣayāṃ chummakāmāha ---- 


madyaṃ tu harṣaṇaṃ jñeyaṃ..............


harṣayatīti kṛtvā || 


..............ṃuditā tu surā smṛtā || 15-3 || 


muditeti muditaṃ harṣastaddhetutvāt || 3 || 

tathā ---- 


matsyā jalacarā jñeyāḥ...............


jalacarajāteḥ śrīcaryākulanirūpitanītyā carubhojanato dīkṣitatvād 
bhairavayāge paramopādeyatvamityevaṃ chummakayā nirdeśaḥ || 


...............ṃāṃsa ca balavardhanam | 


māṃsenāsādhāraṇacamatkārahetunā rasādidhātuṣaṭkaparipuṣṭikramād 
balasya vīryasya vardhanāt ---- 

"jagdhipānakṛtollāsarasānandavijṛmbhaṇāt" (72)

iti śrīvijñānabhaṭṭārakanirūpitanītyā yoginaṃ prati balasya 
spandātmanaḥ śāktavīryasya vivardhanāduttejanādevamabhidhānam | 
govalīvardanyāyena ca matsyānmāṃsaṃ vyatiriktamucyate | 


jātaṃ prarūḍhamityāhurmṛtaṃ caiva parāṅmukham || 15-4 || 


dehaprāṇādibandhasāṃmukhyādapavṛttamityāhuḥ pāramparyaniṣṭhāḥ || 4 
|| 


raktaṃ tvamṛtamityāhuḥ padmanālo'ntrasañcayaḥ | 

śukraṃ candraḥ samākhyātaḥ snāyuḥ sūtraṃ prakītītam || 15-5 || 


tattadrahasyayāgaviśeṣopayogināṃ 
raktahṛtpadmāntraśukrasnāyūnāmamṛtaṃ padmanālaścandraḥ sūtramiti 
guptāni saṅketanāmāni paramāpyāyahetutvāt 
kaṇīkādalādiyuktatvādasthūladīrgharūpatvāt sitatvāhlādakatvayogāt 
tattadupahriyamāṇavastugrathanahetutvāccetyete'tra hetavaḥ krameṇa 
yojyāḥ | padmamityatrāvṛttyā dviḥ padmaśabdaḥ sthitaḥ, tena hṛt 
padmamityevamabhidhātavyamityarthaḥ || 5 || 

kiñca vīracaryāsthānam ---- 


śmaśānaṃ ḍāmaraṃ jñeyaṃ..............


samastaśaṅkātaṅkatroṭakatvenoḍḍāmaratvād ḍāmaram || 

tatratye'pi kvacit karmaṇi sahacaratayopayuktaḥ ---- 


..............ṝākṣasastu bhayaṅkaraḥ | 

piśāco romajananaḥ..............


adhīrāṇāṃ mihṛdayatrāsapradatvād bhayena romordhvasaraṇācca || 

kvacid rahasyācāre upayujyamānā ---- 


............ṝuhā jñeyā rajasvalā || 6 || 


rohatīti ruhā vīracaryāyā āśrayabhūtā || 


rātriṃ vai cchādikāṃ viddhi.............


chādayati paśūnāmadarśanapathaṃ prāpayati vīrācāramiti cchādikā || 

yatra tu rahasyavīrācāro darśanīyo na bhavati, tat ---- 


.............prakāśaśca dinaṃ bhavet | 


prakaṭatvāt prakāśa ityucyata ityarthaḥ || 

atha netrajihvādau karmaviśeṣopayogini śarīrāvayave pāribhāṣikaṃ 
saṅketaṃ karoti ---- 


nayane cañcale jñeye jihvāṃ saṃgrāhikāṃ viduḥ || 15-7 || 


lambikādirasasaṅgrāhitvāt || 7 || 

tathā ---- 


karau dhanakarau jñeyau pādau sahacarau viduḥ | 


parameśvaratāprāptihetupūjānidhānakarktṛtvādekaikasya 
gamanādyanupapatteśca || 

kiñca ---- 


liṅgaṃ santoṣajananaṃ bhagaḥ prītivivardhanaḥ || 15-8 || 


spaṣṭārthasaṃjñe || 8 || 

kvacid vīrapāśacchedādāvupayujyamānam ---- 


śastraṃ vibhāgajananaṃ..............


tathā ---- 


...........kartarī kāryasādhikā | 


kāryaṃ pāśasūtrādikartanaṃ sādhayatīti || 

tathā ---- 


dūtī saṃvāhikā jñeyā..............


samaṃ saha vāhayati nirvāhayati vīrasya rahasyācāramiti saṃvāhikā 
dūtī bhāryā ucyate, atha dūtī ghaṇṭā samamāntaradhvaninā vāhayati 
prāpayati bāhyamiti kṛtvā saṃvāhikā || 

tathā ---- 


.................ḍhūpo hlādana ucyate || 15-9 || 

gandhaḥ santoṣajananaḥ.............


gandha iti samālambhanadravyam | chummake ete spaṣṭārthe || 


..........ṝājāno dhārakāḥ smṛtāḥ | 


ye dhārakāḥ piṣṭādimayā dīpādhārāste rājante dīpyanta iti kṛtvā 
rājāna uktāḥ, anye tu ye rājāno bhūmipālāste dhārayanti pūjā iti 
kṛtvā dhārakā iti vyākhyātavantaḥ || 


paśuvībodhako jñeyaḥ.............


yaḥ paśurdevatābhya upahārīkriyate, sa vasāsṛgādyāhārakrameṇa 
vibodhayati tāstāḥ saṃviddevatā iti vibodhakaḥ || 

yastu devatābhiḥ sādhito viśiṣṭaḥ kaściccarukaḥ, saḥ ---- 


............carukaḥ sārvakāmikaḥ || 15-10 || 


sarvān kāmān samavāpnotīti kṛtvā || 10 || 


annaṃ sādhanamityuktaṃ..............


yatpunarannam, tat sādhanamityuktam || 


..............vasā maṇḍamihocyate | 


sarvajanasādhāraṇatvād maṇḍamiva maṇḍamācāmaḥ || 

atha ---- 


diśāṃ mukhaṃ tu śravaṇaṃ...............


śravaṇaṃ śrotraṃ digdevatādhiṣṭhitatvād diśāṃ mukhamityucyate || 


............ṭvak ca saṃvedanī smṛtā || 15-11 || 


saṃvedyate'nayā spṛśyaṃ vastu ---- iti kṛtvā || 


ghrāṇaṃ susthitamityuktaṃ..............


sugandhidravyāghrāṇakrameṇa sukhena sthitaṃ sthānaṃ saṃvido yasminniti 
kṛtvā || 


..............ṃukhaṃ tu pravicārakam | 


mukhamityupahāryapaśuśiraḥ, pravicāryate cakṣurādidvāreṇa rūpādi 
vastu yeneti kṛtvā, pravicārakamucyate || 


paśuḥ pracāro vijñeyaḥ..............


pracārasya viśvendhanakṣāravimokasya hetutvāt pracāraḥ || 

evaṃ paśvaṅgaviṣayāṃ chummakāmuktvā'nyā apyāha ---- 


..............ṃātā dhātrīti kathyate || 15-12 || 

pitaraṃ sṛṣṭikartāraṃ bhrātaraṃ pālakaṃ viduḥ | 

bhaginī śubhakarī jñeyā sakhī sarvārthasādhikā || 15-13 || 

mitraṃ guṇānāṃ jananaṃ guṇanāśaṃ ripuṃ viduḥ | 


spaṣṭam || 

punaḥ śarīrāvayaveṣu chummakāḥ prāha ---- 


chit sphijau kītīto devi..........


chinatti dvidhā prakāśayatyadhaḥkāyasaṃsthānamiti chit || 


..............ḍṛṣṭiścakṣuḥ prakītītam || 15-14 || 


dṛṣṭirdarśanavyāpāraḥ | caṣṭe vyanakti rūpamiti cakṣuḥ || 14 || 


daśanāḥ khaṇḍakā jñeyāḥ............


khaṇḍayantīti kṛtvā || 


................ādhāra udaraṃ smṛtam | 


udaraṃ yattadaśitāderā samantād dhāraṇādādhāraḥ || 


hṛdayaṃ guhyamityuktaṃ..............


hṛtsthānaṃ guhyātmāśrayatvād guhyam | yattu guhyam, tat 
prītivivardhanamiti pūrvamevoktam || 


............kaṭhinaṃ tvasthi viddhi hi || 15-15 || 

medo vasāṃ vijānīyāt...............


asthi kaṭhinamityucyate | yattu medaḥ, tad medayatīti kṛtvā vasā || 


.............ṃajjā puṣṭikaraḥ smṛtaḥ | 


majjākhyasya dhātuviśeṣasya puṣṭihetutvāt puṣṭikara ityuktaḥ || 


viṣṭhāṃ vidūṣikāṃ viddhi..............


vidūṣayati vikṛtāṃ śārīrīṃ sthitiṃ sampādayatīti kṛtvā || 


................ṃūtraṃ srāva ihocyate || 15-16 || 


sravaṇaṃ srāvaḥ || 16 || 


kāleyakaṃ tu kusumaṃ1..............


kāleyakaṃ kṛṣṇapadmam | tat kusumamiva kusumamiti camatkṛtikāritvena 
devatātmahetutvāt || 


..............ḍhūmaṃ dhṛtikaraṃ viduḥ | 


śmaśānotthito'tra dhūmo vivakṣitaḥ | sa ca devatānāṃ priyatvād 
dhṛtikara ityuktaḥ || 


melakaṃ caiva saṅghātaḥ............


devatānāṃ sambandhi yad melakaṃ melanam, tat saṅghāta ityucyate || 

etanmelakopadeśena yaḥ devānām ---- 


.........putraḥ soddyotakaḥ smṛtaḥ || 15-17 || 


uddyotayatyajñānanivāraṇena jagaditi kṛtvā || 17 || 

kiṃ ca ---- 


duhitā hlādikā jñeyā.............


hlādayati tattvopadeśena jagaditi kṛtvā || 


..........kṣubdhaṃ vai calitaṃ viduḥ | 


ārurukṣuḥ prāthamike yogābhyāse sthityalābhāt kṣubdhaścalita ityucyate 
|| 


dūṣako jāra ityuktaḥ...............


yaḥ kvacidijyādau dūṣakaḥ, sa jyāhanahetutvājjāra ityuktaḥ || 


.............pītaṃ vanditameva ca || 15-18 || 

bhakṣitaṃ prāptamityāhuśchadītaṃ vikṛtīkṛtam | 

yad rahasyadravyaṃ kiṃcit pītam, tad vanditamucyate | evameva yatkiñcid 
bhakṣitam, tat prāptamityāhuḥ | chadītaṃ yatkiñcinnaivedyaṃ 
saṃvādibhaktitāratamyād bahu aśitaṃ sat pramādād vāntam, tad 
vikṛtīkṛtaṃ vācyam || 

ittham ---- 


dūṣitaṃ kaṣītaṃ jñeyaṃ...............


yatkiñcinnalakādi dūṣitam, tat kaṣītaṃ jñeyamāhṛtacaramityarthaḥ || 


............ṣammataṃ samayaṃ viduḥ || 15-19 || 


pārameśaḥ samayo'vaśyānuṣṭheyatvāt sammatamityuktaḥ || 19 || 


mahallo rakṣako jñeyaḥ.............


yaḥ pārameśācārasya rakṣakaḥ, sa mahalla ucyate, mahaduttamaṃ 
pārameśapadaṃ lātīti kṛtvā || 


..............chagalastu kaniṣṭhakaḥ | 


yaśchagalaḥ paśuḥ, sa kaniṣṭhaka ucyate | kramo jyeṣṭhamadhyamatvāt || 


vinayo dehakarma syāt...............


taddhi vinītatāṃ karoti || 


............ṣādhanaṃ tu japaḥ smṛtaḥ || 15-20 || 


sādhyate'nena bhuktimuktī iti sādhanam || 


homitaṃ siddhijananaṃ...............


homakarmāpannaṃ haviryat, tat siddhiṃ trividhāṃ janayatīti || 

tathā ---- 


.............vibhāgo rocakaḥ smṛtaḥ | 


carukāderyo vibhāgo vibhajanam, sa rocakaḥ, rocayati parāṃ prītiṃ 
janayatīti kṛtvā || 


kadambaṃ vṛndamityāhuḥ...............


devatānāṃ vīradravyādīnāṃ yad vṛndaṃ samūhaḥ, tat kadambaṃ vadanti 
|| 


...............viralo'śliṣṭa ucyate || 15-21 || 


yo vīrācārāt pṛthagbhūta ityarthāt || 21 || 


vimalaḥ śiṣyaḥ ityuktaḥ.............


yaḥ śiṣyaḥ śāsanīyaḥ, sa guruprasādād vigatamala iti kṛtvā vimalaḥ 
|| 


..............icchā cājñā prakītītā | 


gurvādīnāṃ sambandhinī ājñā yatra labdhā, tatrāsau 
tadīyānugrāhikecchā sthiteti yāvat || 


devatādarśanaṃ yattatt................


kiñcidasāmānyametaditthaṃ vimṛṣṭamityarthaḥ || 


...............ḷabdhaṃ śastrahataṃ viduḥ || 15-22 || 


yaḥ śastrahataḥ paśuḥ, taṃ labdhamityāmananti || 22 || 


niśācaro biḍālaḥ syāt...........


niśāyāṃ caro yasya vīrasya, sa biḍāla ucyate | biḍālo hi 
rātrāvākhūnāharati, ayaṃ tu vīrapaśūn || 


..............ṇakhinaśca vidārakāḥ | 


ye vīrapaśūnāṃ vidārakāḥ, te nakhina ucyante, vidārakatvasādharmyāt 
|| 


ānītaṃ sāritaṃ jñeyaṃ...............


mahācarvādi yadānītam, tat sāmarasyena sañjātamiti kṛtvā 
sāritamityucyate || 


...............ṝakṣitaṃ pihitaṃ tathā || 15-23 || 


yad rakṣitam, tat pihitamiti vācyam || 


atha kadācit tīvraśaktipātavaśāt samāsādite melake 
tattattattvasākṣātkāramārgaṃ sādhakendrasya devyo 
darśayantītyādiśatyanugrahaparaḥ parameśvaraḥ ---- 


śikhāṃ saṃspṛśate yā tu sā tu śaktiṃ vinidīśet | 

śiraḥ pradarśayedyā tu sā ca binduṃ vinidīśet || 15-24 || 

lalāṭaṃ darśayedyā tu īśvaraṃ sā vinidīśet | 

tālukaṃ darśayedyā tu tayā rudraḥ prakītītaḥ || 15-25 || 

jihvāṃ pradarśayedyā tu vidyāṃ sātha vinidīśet | 

sapta koṭyastu mantrāṇāṃ tasyā jñeyāstu suvrate || 15-26 || 

ghaṇṭikāṃ darśayedyā tu tayānantaḥ pradaśītaḥ | 

kaṇṭhaṃ tu saṃspṛśedyā sā kālatattvaṃ vinidīśet || 15-27 || 

hṛtpadmaṃ darśayedyā tu puruṣaṃ sā vinidīśet | 

nābhiṃ pradarśayedyā tu prakṛtiṃ sā vinidīśet || 15-28 || 

tasyādhastād buddhitattvaṃ yadi syāddarśanaṃ priye | 


praśāntāśeṣataraṅgaśivadhāmani paramanirvāṇarūpe na kācit 
siddhirastīti kṛtvā sādhakebhyo melakāvasare varadānodyatā devyaḥ 
siddhimādhārādhirūḍhācchaktisthānāt prabhṛtyeva dadatīti 
tadupakramameva nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ | 
bindumityaśeṣavācyavācakāvibhāgaprakāśaṃ sādāśivaṃ dhāma | 
prakītīta iti mayā sākṣātkṛta iti daśītaḥ | sapta koṭya ityukteḥ 
sādhakasyāsyāḥ sakāśāt tattanmantrasiddhilābho bhavatīti | tālukaṃ 
tālurandhram | ghaṇṭikā tadadho lambamānā lambikākhyā śaktiḥ | ananta 
iti māyātattvādhiṣṭhātā | kālaniyatipuruṣatattvairnavātmaprakriyāvat 
kalāvidyārāgatattvāni saṃgṛhītāni daśītāni | yadi syāditi yadi tayā 
sākṣātkṛtaṃ bhavedityarthaḥ || 

kiñca ---- 


yadā guhyaṃ spṛśed devi.............


tadā'sau ---- 


...........'haṅkāro'dhidaivatam || 15-29 || 


sākṣātkṛtaṃ sūcayatītyarthaḥ | atraiva 
cāntarbhūtasyendriyatanmātraṣoḍaśakasya darśanam, na pṛthak || 

kiñca ---- 


kaṭiṃ sandarśayedyā tu vyoma tatrādhidaivatam | 

ūrukau darśayed devi pavanaṃ sā vinidīśet || 15-30 || 

jānunī darśayedyā tu tayā tejaḥ prakītītam | 

jaṅghe pradarśayedyā tu varuṇaṃ sā vinidīśet || 15-31 || 


evaṃ melakāvasare devībhiśchummakāyāṃ daśītāyāṃ pratichummakā 
yādṛk sādhakena darśayitavyā, tādṛśīmāha ---- 


śarīraṃ darśayed devi sarvadevamayaṃ priye | 


tadā'sya ---- 


pūjāgnijapayuktasya dhyānayuktasya mantriṇaḥ || 15-32 || 

samayācārayuktasya kālāṃśakavidaḥ priye | 

kriyopetasya deveśi yoginyastu varapradāḥ || 15-33 || 

darśayanti mahādhvānaṃ nānābhogasamanvitam | 

girirājasya deveśi yaṃ gatvā phalamaśnute || 15-34 || 


kriyā proktarūpā | darśayanti svadehasthameva pratyakṣīkārayanti | 
girirājasya sādhakendrasya | yaṃ gatveti sākṣādanubhūya, 
gamerjñānārthatvāt | phalamaśnuta iti tattadbhogabhug bhavati || 34 || 

kiñcāsyaitādṛg yogyatātiśayāt ---- 


bhairaveṇa samājñaptāḥ śaktayastu varānane | 

anyāśca siddhīvīvidhā adhamā madhyamottamāḥ || 15-35 || 

anyatantrasamutthāśca sādhayanti na saṃśayaḥ | 


bhairaveṇa samājñaptā ityanena parameśvara evetthaṃ 
sādhakasyābhīṣṭadānāyodyacchatītyāha | na saṃśaya iti 
niścitamevaitadityarthaḥ || 

upasaṃharati ---- 


evaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ melakaṃ tu varānane || 15-36 || 

satatābhyāsayogena...............


yogyatamatā jātā || 

tasmai ---- 


..........ḍadate caruka svakam | 


"dada dāne" ityasyāyaṃ prayogaḥ | svakaṃ svātmārthaṃ 
sādhitamasāmānyamityarthaḥ || 

tadāha ---- 


yasya samprāśanād devi vīreśasadṛśo bhavet || 15-37 || 


samprāśanamavikalpamāharaṇam | vīreśo bhairavanāthaḥ || 

yata evam ---- 


tasmād dhyānārcane homaṃ japaṃ ca varavaṇīni | 

kurvanti bhāvitātmānastataḥ siddhyanti mantriṇaḥ || 15-38 || 


bhāvitātmatvaṃ sudṛḍha āśvāsaḥ || 38 || 


(yogināṃ sādhakānāṃ ca yathāyogaṃ) dhurandhurāḥ | 
	sampūrṇasiddhīvīdadhat svacchando jayati prabhuḥ || 1 || 

sarvatraiva sphurati satataṃ sarvasarvātmamūtī	
	ryo'sau svacchocchalitalalito bodhasindhuḥ samantāt | 

svacchando'yaṃ jayati bhagavān sarvasampannidhāna
	sphītasphūrjannirupamasudhāsphārasārasvaśaktiḥ || 2 || 

nāmnaiva bhedadṛṣṭivīdhutā yenāsvatantratātattvā
	śrīmatsvatantratantraṃ bhedavyākhyāṃ na tatsahate | 

bhedadarśanasaṃskāratantusantatamāditaḥ
	svacchasvacchandacitsvātmasatattvaṃ nekṣate janaḥ || 3 || 

gatānugatikaproktabhedavyākhyātamo'panut | 
	tenādvaitāmṛtasphītaḥ svacchandoddyota umbhitaḥ || 4 || 

śrībrahmadevādigurukramādyaḥ
	śrutvā ciraṃ vyākṛtavān svatantram | 

śrīmān prayogo guravastathānye
	te'bhyarthanāyāṃ punarapravṛttau || 5 || 

nissīmajanmamaraṇādiva samprarūḍha
	bhedādhivāsitamanā na yadabhyamaṃsta | 

(svaujovikāsitaṃ hṛdaya kamalapraruḍha
	svacchandabhairavamahaḥ sphuratāt tadāsye) || 6 || 

(svasya = svacchandanāthasya yat ojo vimarśaḥ tena vikāsitaṃ yat 
sādhakasya hṛdayakamalaṃ tatra prarūḍhaṃ pūrṇatāṃ prāptam) 

śrībhairavīyaparamādvayaśaktipāta
	pūtāḥ sadaiva guravo galitāparecchāḥ | 

svacchasvatantramatisundaramātmatattvaṃ
	samprāpnuvantu saha dīkṣyajanairajasram || 7 || 

pūrṇānubhavasadyuktiḥ sadācāraparamparā | 
	viśrāntā yatra yasmiṃśca kārtārthyaṃ guravo'pyaguḥ || 8 || 

tattvopadeśādyo vidyāsudhāmbhodhisudhākaraḥ | 
	yatkṛtaiḥ śāstrasadvṛttimaṇḍanairmaṇḍitaṃ jagat || 9 || 

akasmāt sarvaśāstrārthajñatvādyaṃ lakṣmapañcakam | 
	yasmin śrīpūrvaśāstroktamadṛśyata janaiḥ sphuṭam || 10 || 

helāvalokanādeva jantūn yo'mocayat kṣaṇāt | 
	śrīmato'bhinavācchāstramāgamayya guroridam | 
vyāvṛṇot kṣemarājastatpādadhūlipavitritaḥ || 11 || 

grasto'ya sakalo bhavo vigalitāḥ karmāṇumāyāmalāḥ
	prāptānandaghanā sthitiḥ kimaparaṃ labdhaḥ prakāśaḥ paraḥ | 

śrīmaccetanabhairavastutirasāsvādena labdhodayai	rasmābhivīmale
	hṛdambaratale niryantraṇaṃ sthīyate || 12 || 

svatantraḥ svacchātmā sphurati satataṃ cetanaśivaḥ
	parā śaktiśceyaṃ karaṇasaraṇiprāntamuditā | 

tadābhogaikātma prasarati samastaṃ jagadidaṃ
	na jāne kutrāyaṃ dhvaniranupatet saṃsṛtiriti || 13 || 



iti śrīsvacchandatantre śrīmahāmāheśvarācāryavaryaśrīkṣemarāja-
viracitoddyotākhyavyākhyopete chummakāprakāśaḥ nāma pañcadaśaḥ 
paṭalaḥ || 15 ||
